items.desc: The Role The Rosalind Franklin Institute (the Franklin) is a technology institute established by the UK Government as a unique centre committed to advancing tools that are needed to transform healthcare in the future. The Institute brings together researchers in life and physical sciences, and engineering, to develop a spectrum of tools which we will use to image, interpret and intervene in biological systems. These insights will speed up the discovery of new medicines, help find new diagnostics and contribute to a deeper understanding of human health and disease. Our Science Strategy seeks to focus the Franklin’s research and unite our researchers around our Technology Innovation Challenges and Life Science Challenges. For more information on the Franklin’s Challenges click here. This research opportunity within the Virtual Cell project will advance molecular mapping of cells by expanding the range of proteins and macromolecular complexes that can be reliably detected and characterised in cryo-electron tomograms and develop methods to track how these change over time and in response to cellular perturbation. The Research Associate will develop machine-learning methods for particle localisation, detection and classification in crowded cellular volumes. The work will emphasise learning from limited annotations, generalisation to additional molecular species and experimental datasets, and discovery of candidate particle populations beyond existing labelled classes. Methods will address low signal-to-noise ratios, missing-wedge artefacts, and variation in particle orientation, abundance and conformation. The role will explore integration of complementary structural, molecular and imaging data, such as predicted or experimental protein structures, proteomics, molecular interaction data, and fluorescence or correlative microscopy. These sources will guide detection, constrain candidate molecular identities and support validation, with explicit consideration of their uncertainty, spatial resolution and potential biases. Working closely with experimental and computational researchers, the role-holder will establish robust benchmarks, develop reproducible software, and validate detections and candidate identities through subtomogram analysis and complementary evidence. The role offers opportunities to develop scientific independence within an interdisciplinary team. Key Responsibilities As a Research Associate you will: Develop and apply machine-learning methods to broaden the range of proteins and macromolecular complexes that can be detected and characterised in cryo-electron tomograms. Explore how complementary structural, molecular and imaging data can improve analysis and support interpretation of molecular organisation in cells. Work with experimental and computational colleagues to prepare datasets, evaluate methods and validate biological findings. Develop reproducible analysis workflows and research software, and share methods and findings through documentation, publications and presentations. Plan data acquisitions with experimentalists who conduct them, analyse and interpret results and supervised delivery of outputs (e.g. research report, patent application) in a scientific/technology area of interest. Work within a project team, contributing to wider projects around Franklin's key Challenges. Lead major contributions to outputs from research including papers, patents and both internal and external presentations. Support and develop others including day-to-day supervision of students or visitors in areas related to own research. Have supervised, staged progression to first stages of scientific independence with opportunities to further develop science and skills/experience. Enhance your research through collaboration with other researchers and make active contributions to exchanging of ideas through your own network. Be able to understand, interpret, create and communicate appropriately within a research context. Develop search and discovery skills and techniques. Be supervised by a Scientist/Senior Scientist in delivery of research outputs, either in the context of a project or Challenge or as an early career development fellow. items.desc: Department: Detection Location: Remote Description Who are we? Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers. And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews. If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses. The Team You will be joining the Detection team. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low – and clients happy – by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible. Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs, every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why. The Detection team is core to Ravelin’s success. They work closely with the Data Engineering Team who build infrastructure and the Intelligence & Investigations Team who liaise with clients. The Role We are currently looking for a Data Scientist to help train, deploy, debug and evaluate our fraud detection models. Our ideal candidate is pragmatic, approachable and filled with knowledge tempered by past failures. Evaluating fraud models is hard; often times we do not even get labels for 3 months. You’ll need to use your judgement when investigating cases of ambiguous fraud and when you’re investigating the veracity of the model itself. We have to build robust models that are capable of updating their beliefs when they encounter new methods of fraud: our clients expect us to be one step ahead of fraud, not behind. You will be given the equipment, space and guidance you need to build world class fraud detection models. The work is not all green field research. The everyday work is about making safe incremental progress towards better models for our clients. The ideal candidate is willing to get involved in both aspects of the job – and understand why both are important. Key Responsibilities Build out our model evaluation and training infrastructure. Develop and deploy new models to detect fraud whilst maintaining SLAs Write new features in our production infrastructure Research new techniques to disrupt fraudulent behaviour Investigate model performance issues (using your experience of debugging models). Requirements Around 1 year's experience building and deploying ML models using the Python data stack (numpy, pandas, sklearn or pytorch). Strong analytical skills. Being a strong collaborator with colleagues outside of your immediate team, for example with client support teams or engineering. Being skilled at communicating complex technical ideas to a range of audiences. The ability to prioritise and to manage your workload. items.desc: AITAD entwickelt Embedded-KI-Systeme dort, wo Zuverlässigkeit und technologische Tiefe entscheidend sind. Als wachsendes High-Tech-Unternehmen in Offenburg arbeiten wir an anspruchsvollen Industrie- und Elektronikprojekten – vom Sensor bis zum KI-Modell. Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen wollen, gerne dazulernen und hohe Ansprüche an die eigene Arbeit haben. Wer Gestaltungsspielraum, technologische Substanz und direkte Wirkung schätzt, findet bei AITAD kein bequemes Umfeld – sondern eine echte Entwicklungsplattform. Aufgaben Führen vom Data Science Team, samt Organisation und Strategie. Onboarding und Betretung von Vollzeitingenieuren, Werkstudenten, Praktikanten und Azubis Analyse, Aufbereitung und Machine-Learning-Modellierung von bestimmten Prozessen/gemessenen Daten. Entwickeln und Durchführen von Konzepten zum Datensammeln. Erarbeiten verschiedener Ideen zur Auswertung/Analyse gesammelter Daten. Implementierung von Machine Learning Modellen unter Berücksichtigung von vorgebenen Einschränkungen durch MCUs. Arbeiten in Vollzeit vor Ort und beim Kunden. Qualifikation Du hast erste Führungserfahrung in Wirtschaft oder Studium (z.B. Promotion) Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in professioneller Programmierung in Python und C. Du hast Erfahrungen im Umgang mit verschiedenen Sensoren und der Verarbeitung digitaler Signale (DSP). Du kennst dich mit serverbasierten Entwicklungsprozessen und Integrationsprozessen in Hardware aus. Du kennst dich mit Datenanalyse und Machine Learning praktisch und theoretisch aus – Begriffe wie NumPy, Pandas, OpenCV-IF, Keras, TensorFlow, PyTorch Caffe, Korrelationsanalyse, CNN/RNN, CUDA, SVMs, Quantisierung, FFT und Ähnliches sollten dir im Wesentlichen bekannt sein. Du bist gern hardwarenah und im Embedded-Gebiet unterwegs und kennst dich grundlegend mit RTOS und Embedded Linux aus. Dir bereitet es Freude, Algorithmen an geringe Ressourcen anzupassen. Benefits Was dich bei AITAD erwartet Frühe Verantwortung und eigenständiges Arbeiten Du arbeitest nicht „mit“, sondern übernimmst Aufgaben mit echter Wirkung. Intensive fachliche Entwicklung Praxisnahe Einarbeitung, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Experten, kontinuierliches Lernen im Projektalltag. Technologisch anspruchsvolles Umfeld Eigene Entwicklungs-, Test- und Produktionsinfrastruktur statt Theorie und Präsentationen. Direkter Einfluss auf Produkt und Kunde Kurze Wege, wenig Hierarchie, schnelle Entscheidungen. Hoher Qualitätsanspruch statt „Dienst nach Vorschrift“ Wir erwarten Einsatz – und geben im Gegenzug Lernkurve, Verantwortung und Vertrauen. Faire Vergütung und transparente Perspektiven Leistung, Entwicklung und Engagement zählen mehr als Titel oder Dauer der Betriebszugehörigkeit. Kostenlose Getränke, Snacks und gemeinsames Mittagessen sind selbstverständlich – stehen aber nicht im Mittelpunkt. Wenn du ein Umfeld suchst, in dem Lernen, Verantwortung und Leistung wichtiger sind als Status und Komfort, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

items.desc: Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates. As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration. We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach. If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity. Let’s build what’s next, together. Winter Internship 2027 Make a first step towards your career in data science. Gain practical experience and learn from experienced mentors. Being a part of Infobip Engineering department means working on an in-house developed product and delivering solutions on a global level. If you are a student of higher or final year of studies in the field of IT, join our data science internship program that starts in February 2027 and get a chance to land your first job at Infobip! What This Role Is All About Data Science Intern is responsible for analyzing large-scale telecommunications data to uncover patterns, anomalies, and actionable insights. You will explore massive datasets from distributed systems (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch), perform statistical analysis in Jupyter Notebooks, and build machine learning models. In this role, you will query billions of records, develop data pipelines, create visualizations that drive insights, and transform promising research into production-ready microservices deployed on multiple data centers What You’ll Do Build production-grade machine learning systems for large-scale telecommunications data analysis. Work with Python, Jupyter Notebooks, and industry-standard libraries including Pandas, Polars, Prophet, Scikit-Learn, sentence-transformers, and Darts for time series forecasting and pattern recognition. Query and analyze massive datasets from distributed systems including ClickHouse clusters, PostgreSQL databases, DuckDB and Elasticsearch, learning end-to-end data engineering workflows. Contribute to research-to-production pipelines: from exploratory data analysis in notebooks to deploying FastAPI/Flask microservices that process millions of events daily. Write production-ready, testable code following clean code principles, with emphasis on research reproducibility and service reliability in data science applications. Deploy your solutions using modern tools like uv/poetry for dependency management, Git for version control, Docker for containerization, and Kafka for real-time event streaming. Programming skills in Python and/or C++. Familiarity with Linux and Git; experience with ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or PyTorch is an advantage. Good command of English. Strong communication skills. A curious, proactive mindset, a structured approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work both independently and as part of an international team. Able to think beyond boundaries. Strong driver of change and innovation. Passionate about AI and digital technologies. Ready to turn your interest in robotics and AI into practical experience? Join our team and help shape the future of intelligent robotics! We Offer AVL contract, long-term opportunity Group accident insurance, private medical insurance Flexible working time, home office possibility (60%) International projects, business trips Travel reimbursement Relaxation and fitness room Cafe and restaurant in the office building ABOUT AVL HUNGARY KFT. AVL Hungary Kft., founded in 2002, has become a leading research and development center in almost all areas of powertrain systems in recent years by combining the 100-year tradition of the Hungarian vehicle industry and the innovative activities of the global company. The Hungarian company's team of more than 500 professionals works in a high-tech development environment not only in the headquarters in Érd, but in Budapest, Zalaegerszeg and Kecskemét. The team is operating primarily in the fields of R&D - planning, simulation, testing, software development, calibration, and production planning. The results of the work of our colleagues and the technical innovations created by AVL are used in passenger cars, heavy vehicles, construction machinery and ship industries of five continents: AVL Hungary participates in national and international projects, works with the most modern tools, and develops the powertrains of the future.

items.desc: Program Summary - Data Science & Technology Internship Company Overview: Castleton Commodities International is a leading global energy commodities merchant and infrastructure asset investor. As a trader, CCI deploys capital on a proprietary basis in the physical and financial commodity markets, providing the Company with market insights and access. As a strategic investor and developer, CCI leverages its market expertise, operations capabilities, and industry knowledge to invest in, and develop, select commodity infrastructure assets. Our strategically integrated platform has generated strong risk-adjusted returns for our investors since our formation. Position Overview: CCI is developing a leading-edge Data Science platform, as staying at the forefront of data management and analytics is essential to our investment strategy. We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Machine Learning Intern with a strong interest in quantitative analysis, particularly time series forecasting to join our Global Data Science team in our London office. Our Machine Learning Internship provides a unique opportunity to work with fundamental market data, generating insights that support our commercial trading business. You will be responsible for analyzing time series data related to market fundamentals in the Power, Natural Gas, and Oil sectors, helping to identify key supply and demand drivers. These insights will play a vital role in forecasting price movements and supporting risk management decisions. Responsibilities: Apply mathematical and statistical knowledge to enhance existing machine learning applications and explore new solutions. Work closely with Data Scientists, Analysts, and Traders to design, implement, and optimize machine learning models for time series forecasting, including ARIMA/SARIMA, gradient boosting methods (e.g., XGBoost), LSTM networks, and linear regression-based approaches. Assist in designing and implementing end-to-end data ingestion processes, ensuring seamless data flow to investing teams. Work with desk heads, traders, and analysts to understand current data architecture, investment processes, and functional requirements for data science analysis. Contribute to identifying and back-testing new data sets, leveraging machine learning techniques to drive insights. Conduct ad hoc research on emerging project topics, including energy fundamental data, analytics trends, and best practices in big data and artificial intelligence. Qualifications: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree or higher in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or related technical field with a focus in Machine Learning. Expected graduation date of Winter 2027 or Spring/Summer 2028. Experience applying machine learning techniques such as regression, time series forecasting, deep learning, reinforcement learning, or predictive modeling to solve problems involving complex data patterns and market dynamics. Strong programming experience in Python (preferred libraries: Pandas, NumPy, etc.) Ability to communicate and interact with a wide range of users, from very technical to non-technical backgrounds. Strong analytical skills with demonstrated attention to detail.

items.title: AI Fellow, Regulatory Policy, AI for Health
items.card: You will research the current state of medical device regulatory systems across the region, support our Wellcome-funded work with the Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe (MCAZ) to operationalise a regulatory sandbox for AI-enabled mental health products, and work with the Centre of Excellence for Regulatory Science and Innovation in AI & Digital Health Technologies (CERSI-AI) at the University of Birmingham to
items.desc: PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here PATH is a global nonprofit advancing health innovations for the people who need them most. With 50 years of experience, a global team of experts, and trusted partnerships spanning 70+ countries, PATH turns breakthroughs into better health for millions every single year. PATH’s Artificial Intelligence (AI) Initiative is our flagship technical team working across divisions to deliver best-in-class evaluation and implementation of AI in health, spanning model evaluation to product development and service innovation. We aim to use AI to address the world’s largest health inequities. We’re looking for a researcher to help PATH understand how national regulators in sub-Saharan Africa can be more effectively supported to assess and oversee software and AI as medical devices, and to turn that understanding into practical capacity strengthening. You will research the current state of medical device regulatory systems across the region, support our Wellcome-funded work with the Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe (MCAZ) to operationalise a regulatory sandbox for AI-enabled mental health products, and work with the Centre of Excellence for Regulatory Science and Innovation in AI & Digital Health Technologies (CERSI-AI) at the University of Birmingham to develop a course that strengthens regulators’ understanding of software as a medical device (SaMD), AI as a medical device (AIaMD), and frontier AI in healthcare settings. You will have the option of registering for a PhD at University College London (UCL), co-supervised by PATH and UCL, built from this work (assuming you don’t already have a PhD). The role is a strong fit for an early-career researcher with a grounding in regulation, governance, or quality management who wants to shape how AI-enabled health products are regulated in low- and middle-income countries. Please apply by Monday, November 23, 2026 end of day for priority consideration. Responsibilities Design and Deliver Research on Regulatory Systems in Sub-Saharan Africa (50%) A core element of the role will be figuring out how to formally study the regulatory sandboxes we’re running and post-market oversight arrangements, document lessons learned, and prepare those insights for dissemination (both in the academic literature, to policymakers, and more broadly). In parallel to the core task, this role will undertake additional research: An example of our current work: we’re mapping the current state of medical device regulation across sub-Saharan Africa, spanning which national regulatory authorities have a legal mandate and an operational pathway for medical devices, SaMD, and AIaMD; how they are staffed and resourced; where they sit against the World Health Organisation (WHO) Global Benchmarking Tool; and how far they rely on reliance, recognition, and regional harmonisation mechanisms. Future research could include: Desk research: Build on the aforementioned survey’s findings to examine the legislative reforms needed to drive national and continental action, and whether there is value in mental health-specific instruments being developed. Qualitative research: Engage with medical device leads in national regulatory authorities, as well as device manufacturers (and specifically those developing mental health-relevant tools), to better characterise challenges to progress and what interventions need to be prioritised. Quantitative/simulation: Leverage our ongoing portfolio of patient simulation and benchmarking projects to test certain assumptions that current legislation or regulatory approaches appear to take for granted. Thought leadership: Work with the technical experts in the team to think out loud about what frontier AI (general-purpose and generative models) means for existing medical device frameworks, quality management system requirements, and the practical limits of what a regulator can verify. A key part of the role is ensuring we follow best practices for research. You will work with PATH’s Office of Research Affairs to keep our studies compliant with institutional and funder requirements, prepare protocols, and shepherd them through ethics review and the associated approvals (at PATH, and with the relevant national committees in the countries where we work), maintain the records that allow us to account for what was done and why, and contribute to the donor reports, read-outs, and progress updates that keep our funders and partners informed. Convene and Support Delivery of Our Regulatory System Strengthening Programme (50%) Across this part of the role, you will serve as the primary partner for PATH’s Chief AI Officer, working together to draw on the expertise of CERSI-AI, PATH’s internal specialists, as well as our wider network of consultants, to ensure that the right people are brought together at the right time, with the agenda agreed and the preparation done, so that the programme keeps moving and what is decided is written down …

items.card: You will be responsible for developing explainable machine learning models (symbolic regression, Bayesian optimisation, and genetic algorithms) to decode polymer-solvent thermodynamics and map soft-matter physics to real world applications. The position involves featurizing complex polymer architectures, analysing multi-modal experimental datasets, and creating open-source cheminformatics tools in Python/Julia for
items.desc: The University of Sheffield is a remarkable place to work. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. Their diverse backgrounds, abilities and beliefs make Sheffield a world-class university. We offer a fantastic range of benefits including a highly competitive annual leave entitlement (with the ability to purchase more), a generous pensions scheme, flexible working opportunities, a commitment to your development and wellbeing, a wide range of retail discounts, and much more. Find out more about our benefits (opens in a new window) and join us to become part of something special. A fully funded 39 month position is available at the University of Sheffield in the field of Surface engineering & tribology for silicone-free consumer products, funded by EPSRC. The project aims to decode the fundamental polymer physics/chemistry of lubrication and slip planes across complex, heterogeneous surfaces, using explainable machine learning and materials informatics to rationally design sustainable, high-performance formulations. You will be responsible for developing explainable machine learning models (symbolic regression, Bayesian optimisation, and genetic algorithms) to decode polymer-solvent thermodynamics and map soft-matter physics to real world applications. The position involves featurizing complex polymer architectures, analysing multi-modal experimental datasets, and creating open-source cheminformatics tools in Python/Julia for sustainable inverse formulation design and AI-driven materials discovery. The work is a highly collaborative project between Dr Grant Hill and colleagues within the School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences, and an industrial partner. The project requires a high degree of independence, strong computational skills, and the initiative to bridge theoretical polymer chemistry with experimental data. Main Duties And Responsibilities Algorithm development: Develop and benchmark explainable machine learning models to predict how polymers interact with solvents. Data integration & featurization: Process and featurize complex polymer architectures to link molecular structure with bulk properties. Open-source software delivery: Build, document and maintain well-structured, open-source computational tools and workflows in Python/Julia, releasing them via GitHub. Interdisciplinary collaboration: Work closely with the whole project team to validate model predictions against real-world data. Dissemination: Prepare high-quality manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication and present research findings at national and international conferences. Carry out other duties, commensurate with the grade and remit of the post. Person Specification Our diverse community of staff and students recognises the unique abilities, backgrounds, and beliefs of all. We foster a culture where everyone feels they belong and are respected. Even if your past experience doesn't match perfectly with this role's criteria, your contribution is valuable, and we encourage you to apply. Please ensure that you reference the application criteria in the application statement when you apply. Essential Application/interview Experience in programming (e.g., Python, Julia or C++) for scientific computing, data analysis, or machine learning, including version control (Git). Essential Application / interview Ability to quickly learn, integrate, and apply new domain-specific concepts across physical science and computational disciplines. Essential Application / interview Track record of high-quality research outputs (e.g., peer-reviewed publications) appropriate to career stage. Essential Application / interview Ability to work effectively within multi-disciplinary teams and communicate complex computational concepts to diverse audiences. Essential Application / interview Strong problem solving skills. Essential Application / interview Direct experience with soft matter, polymer physics, physical chemistry, or chemical thermodynamics. Desirable Application / interview Experience with explainable AI (XAI) or optimisation techniques (such as symbolic regression, Bayesian optimisation, or genetic algorithms). Desirable Application / interview Familiarity with cheminformatics tools, polymer representations (SMILES / BigSMILES), or molecular simulation (e.g., molecular dynamics or DFT). Desirable Application / interview Track record of developing, documenting, and releasing open-source software tools or computational packages. Desirable Application / interview Experience working alongside industrial partners or translating academic research into industrial applications. items.desc: At Sandvik, we lead the way in electrification, automation, and digitalization, driving innovation and developing cutting-edge technologies in these fields. Our focus is developing fully automated and electrified robotic mining technologies for mobile machinery, including machine vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence with an aim to revolutionize the underground and surface mining industry. Tampere is the home of Sandvik's state-of-the-art Test Mine that is a facility designed to simulate real mining conditions and test new technologies in a controlled environment. This underground test mine allows for the development and validation of advanced digital mining solutions. If you’re excited to shape the innovations of tomorrow, we want to hear from you. You can join Sandvik’s smart minds, all working together to build a better future for the mining industry. The Digitalization and Automation team at Sandvik’s Research and Technology Development is seeking an experienced, proactive, and results-oriented Systems Research Engineer with a collaborative attitude to join our team based in Myllypuro, Tampere, Finland. We are part of the Technology Development and Services organization within the Digital Mining Technologies Division , one of the nine divisions in Sandvik Mining . This role requires on-site presence at our factory and state-of-the-art test mine in Tampere, with flexibility for partial remote work. Your role as a Systems Research Engineer includes research, design, implement, and integrate complex multi‑component systems. You will play a crucial role in turning research concepts into integrated, modular autonomy solutions and enabling their deployment across simulators, test platforms, and concept machines. You will work closely with key technologies such as multi-sensor systems, LiDAR point-cloud processing, sensor calibration, simulation environments, and containerized C++ applications with automated build and deployment pipelines. This role includes hands‑on integration, deployment, and testing of newly developed solutions in our state‑of‑the‑art Test Mine and Test Pit environments. You will also have the opportunity to validate your work using our cutting‑edge underground drilling, load‑and‑haul, and surface mining concepts, Amelia, AutoMine® Concept, and Surface Concept, along with future visionary concept machines yet to come. Your Key Responsibilities Working in projects involving mobile machine automation and digitalization. Managing and updating our GitHub code development and deployment pipeline. Developing and integrating modular autonomy software, sensor interfaces, and calibration solutions, ensuring consistent operation across simulation and physical test platforms. Hands‑on integration, deployment, and implementation testing in the Sandvik Test Mine and Test Pit. Your Background And What We Find Important Suitable technical education (such as an M.Sc.) in engineering. 2+ years of experience in systems engineering. 2+ years of experience in research background in automation / robotics. 2+ years of experience using simulators in technology development. Experience in managing and coordinating outsourced projects is preferred. Experience in developing complex modular autonomy systems. We are looking for someone with strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with the team and other stakeholders also in English. You have the passion to stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in digitalization and the mining industry. You work proactively and systematically with strong problem-solving attitude even under pressure. We offer you an interesting role with high impact in a truly international environment with great opportunities for your professional development and growth. You will have the unique opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. As part of our team, you’ll be among the first to see, develop, and test groundbreaking technologies in our state-of-the-art test mine and test pit. In addition, we offer good employee benefits, the possibility to work partially remotely, and an inclusive corporate culture focused on sustainable development, with values such as Curiosity, Responsibility, Customer Focus, and Winning Together. We believe in an inclusive, equal, and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Are you intrigued? Visit our Solid Ground stories hub and LinkedIn to get to know us better. Or meet Amelia, the pride of our Research and Technology Development - AutoMine® Concept Underground Drill innovative, fully autonomous, twin-boom development drill rig designed to operate without human interaction, enhancing safety and efficiency in mining operations. items.desc: About Huawei Research And Development UK Limited Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world. Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go. This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live. For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs. This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values: Staying customer-centric, Inspiring dedication, Persevering, Growing by reflection. Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward. Job Purpose Working as part of the Huawei Database team will involve empirical computer science research, system design, and prototype implementation within the Huawei Edinburgh office. The role also includes close collaboration with local universities, academic researchers, and Huawei expert teams in the UK, Europe, and China. The Edinburgh office brings together teams working on database systems, programming languages, compilers, knowledge graphs, positioning and navigation, and cloud systems infrastructure. This creates a strong environment for multidisciplinary research at the intersection of data systems, AI, cloud computing, hardware acceleration, and software infrastructure. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work on impactful research problems in modern data management, where research outcomes can be transferred into real-world database products, on-device AI-powered applications, and large-scale data platforms. Job Summary The Database team within the Huawei Edinburgh office and develops next-generation data management systems, with a focus on database kernels, query processing, storage engines, transaction processing, distributed data systems, and emerging AI Data infrastructure. We are looking for researchers and engineers with strong systems backgrounds and a deep interest in building high-performance, scalable, and intelligent data management systems. The role is suitable for candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas: database systems, on-device AI, query optimization, query execution engines, storage and indexing, transaction processing, concurrency control, distributed databases, cloud-native data systems, hardware-aware database design, AI-native data management, and performance analysis. The successful candidate will work on both exploratory research and practical system prototyping, contributing to technologies that may influence Huawei Cloud, GaussDB, and future data infrastructure for AI and intelligent applications. items.desc: Liverpool John Moores University (LJMU) is a distinctive, unique institution, rooted in the Liverpool City Region and with a global presence. Our students and staff, past, present, and future, are the beating heart of our city and can be found in every corner of every industry and community. We couldn’t exist anywhere else and have shaped the city in which we belong. Working with the people of Liverpool to improve lives and support communities is at the heart of why we were founded and why we exist today. The Faculty of Health, Innovation, Technology and Science is a pioneering Faculty, dedicated to creating and communicating knowledge and opportunities to ensure that all our students can excel within their chosen discipline. The School of Computer Science and Mathematics is dedicated to producing research that has real-world application, boasting specialisms in immersive technologies, applications of artificial intelligence, trustworthy computing technologies and data science. We are seeking to appoint a Research Associate in Artificial Intelligence to join the Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technologies Research Institute (AIDTRI). AIDTRI brings together multidisciplinary expertise in AI and advanced digital technologies, with research spanning fundamental methodological development through to real-world application and evaluation. Key areas include AI, data science, trustworthy and explainable AI, causal AI, digital twins, immersive technologies, data visualisation and advanced computational modelling. You will contribute to current AI and data science research programmes and to the development of new externally funded research. Key activities will include: conducting high-quality research in AI and Data Science; organising, harmonising and analysing large, multimodal and multi-source datasets; developing and evaluating AI methods; collaborating with internal and external research partners; preparing research papers and conference contributions; contributing to external research funding applications; and supporting research management and activities within AIDTRI. You should hold a PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a related discipline, or have submitted your thesis and be awaiting viva. Essential criteria include experience of conducting and publishing high-quality AI research, strong knowledge of AI algorithms, programming experience in Python, R or similar, excellent communication and organisational skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Experience with large and complex AI problems, novel AI or computational methods, advanced Python programming, and research funding proposals would be advantageous. You should clearly demonstrate in your supporting statement how you meet all essential criteria in the person specification, providing specific evidence and examples for each criterion. Evidence against the desirable criteria should also be provided where applicable. We anticipate holding interviews the second week of December 2026. Further information about AIDTRI is available at: https://www.ljmu.ac.uk/research/centres-and-institutes/artificial-intelligence-and-digital-technologies-research-institute For an informal discussion about the role, please contact Professor Ivan Olier, Head of AIDTRI, at I.Olier@ljmu.ac.uk . In return, we offer an excellent benefits package including generous annual leave entitlement, pension scheme, induction, and development support as well as family-friendly policies. This is an exciting time to join the university as we deliver the LJMU Strategy 2030 and its vision of LJMU as an inclusive civic university transforming lives and futures, by placing students at the heart of everything we do. Find out more about working at LJMU here . If you feel that this is the role you have been looking for and your skills and experience can make a real difference at LJMU, we look forward to hearing from you. The Faculty of Health, Innovation, Technology and Science is committed to promoting equality and diversity, including the Athena SWAN Gender Equality charter for promoting the career of Women in STEM (science, technology, engineering, mathematics) in higher education. We particularly welcome applications from women for this post and all appointments will be made on merit. Please let us know if you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process. Please note all of our vacancies will be closed to applications at midnight on the advertised closing date, unless otherwise stated. LJMU are committed to adhering to the Principles set out in the Researcher Development Concordat; in line with this all fixed-term researchers will be supported to complete 10 days professional development activities per year (pro-rata).

At Apple, we build products that become part of people's lives. Every day, people rely on their devices to hold their messages, documents, photos, and notes. The Personal Agentic Search team uses Apple Intelligence to help them find and act on that information in natural, intuitive ways.
We are engineers and researchers building AI-powered agents that understand a person's context, reason over their personal data, and retrieve exactly what they need, all while preserving the privacy Apple users expect. As an intern, you will help build and evaluate the machine learning systems behind these experiences and see your work shape features that millions of people could use.
This internship sits at the intersection of NLP, large language models, and information retrieval. You will work on real projects alongside experienced engineers and researchers, helping turn research ideas into robust, user-facing experiences. We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in computer science and machine learning, and a real curiosity about how language models and search systems work. You don't need to be an expert in every area, but you should be excited about applying ML to hard, user-centered problems.

Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, software design) and proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Swift, C++, or Java.
Solid foundation in machine learning and working knowledge of NLP fundamentals (tokenization, embeddings, language modeling, text classification), gained through coursework, research, personal projects, or professional experience.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a desire to work in a team environment.
Familiarity with LLM architectures (e.g., Transformers, attention mechanisms) and how they are trained and applied.
Familiarity with search and retrieval algorithms, such as indexing, ranking, nearest-neighbor search, and relevance evaluation.
Experience with agentic LLM workflows, such as planning, tool calling, and multi-step reasoning.
Experience with on-device machine learning or privacy-preserving ML approaches.
Experience designing experiments, metrics, and datasets to evaluate model or search quality.
Proficiency in more than one of Python, Swift, and C++.

items.desc: Location: BELFORT,FRANCE Category: Data & AI 2026-2862 Internship Full-time Orange Business Salaire selon la grille de la convention collective Publication date : Nov 10, 2026, 12:00AM Contract duration : 6 mois Avec Flux Vision, Orange développe depuis plusieurs années une solution permettant de produire des indicateurs statistiques de présence et de mobilité des populations sur le territoire, à destination de clients et partenaires publics ou privés : tourisme, transport, géomarketing, urbanisme… Ces indicateurs sont issus de l’analyse des données de signalisation du réseau mobile. Pour explorer de nouvelles sources d’information et imaginer de nouveaux services statistiques, ce stage s’intéresse aux données de connexion des Livebox. Il s’appuie sur de premiers travaux d’exploration de ces données et de détection de présence dans les logements. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe de développement et R&D Flux Vision, au sein d’un collectif pluridisciplinaire associant data scientists, spécialistes du développement et experts métier. Votre ambition : imaginer de nouveaux cas d’application, identifier leurs utilisateurs potentiels et expérimenter des indicateurs statistiques utiles à leurs décisions. Observation de l’occupation des logements, analyse territoriale des équipements connectés ou estimation de la part de locations saisonnières : ces exemples constituent des pistes de départ, et non un périmètre fermé. Vous pourrez proposer d’autres sujets et explorer d’autres publics, en portant une attention particulière à la fiabilité des résultats et à la protection de la vie privée. Les données sont dans la box. Les prochaines idées ? À vous de les trouver ! Vous vous appuyez sur les travaux existants d’exploration des données Livebox et de détection de présence pour identifier leur potentiel et leurs limites. Vous imaginez de nouveaux cas d’usage et échangez avec leurs utilisateurs potentiels pour comprendre leurs besoins et sélectionner les pistes à expérimenter. Vous prototypez des indicateurs statistiques et des visualisations , puis évaluez leur fiabilité, leurs biais et les enjeux de protection de la vie privée. Vous présentez vos résultats aux équipes et aux utilisateurs , recueillez leurs retours et proposez des suites aux expérimentations. Quelques pistes à explorer : observation de l’occupation des logements, répartition territoriale des équipements connectés ou estimation de la part de locations saisonnières. Ces exemples restent ouverts à vos propositions et à d’autres publics. Ce que vous développerez : une expérience complète de valorisation des données, de l’identification des besoins au prototypage d’indicateurs et à leur évaluation avec les utilisateurs. Vous préparez un Master 2 ou une dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs en data science, statistiques, intelligence artificielle ou informatique appliquée, et recherchez un stage de fin d’études. Vos compétences techniques Python , notamment pandas et NumPy, pour préparer et analyser les données. Analyse statistique et séries temporelles pour construire et évaluer des indicateurs. Bases en machine learning : classification, clustering et évaluation de modèles. Datavisualisation pour restituer vos analyses de manière accessible. Vos qualités personnelles Curiosité, créativité et esprit critique vous permettent d’explorer de nouvelles pistes tout en questionnant vos résultats. Vous appréciez l’autonomie, les échanges en équipe et l’écoute des utilisateurs pour enrichir vos propositions. Les avantages du stage Un terrain d’exploration ouvert : vous imaginez de nouveaux usages des données Livebox et contribuez à choisir les pistes à expérimenter, sans vous limiter à un sujet prédéfini. Une démarche complète, des données aux utilisateurs : vous vous appuyez sur des travaux existants pour prototyper des indicateurs, présenter vos résultats et enrichir vos propositions grâce aux retours des utilisateurs potentiels. Une immersion dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire : vous croisez les regards de data scientists, de spécialistes du développement et d’experts métier au sein de l’équipe de développement et R&D Flux Vision. Vos perspectives d’évolution Cette expérience vous permettra de préciser votre projet professionnel à la croisée de la data science, de l’innovation et de la conception de services fondés sur les données. items.desc: Are you passionate about AI, eager to make a real impact, and ready to work on solutions that truly matter? Would you like the opportunity to tackle exciting challenges, shape the future of advanced AI technologies, and make a meaningful difference? Then this opportunity is for you! We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for a Data Scientist to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology. Your role in our team As a Data Scientist in AI & Advanced Analytics, you will play a pivotal role in developing advanced AI capabilities that directly support critical defense operations. Working with complex, real-world data and mission-driven challenges, you will help shape the next generation of intelligent systems used by Denmark and our international partners. You will: Build state-of-the-art AI capabilities – Work with untamed data, train deep learning models, and evaluate them to ensure top-tier quality and generalization. A strong foundation in statistics and mathematics is essential, along with the ability to apply new deep learning techniques and architectures. Take ownership of AI and data modeling for key projects – Develop AI models for impactful projects in collaboration with a talented team, solving a wide range of real-world challenges. Ensure top-tier quality and security – Handle classified information and mission-critical systems while adhering to military-grade security standards. Collaborate and engage with end users – Work closely with stakeholders to ensure AI solutions meet operational needs, delivering real-world impact. Since early 2022, the global security landscape has changed significantly. Denmark and its NATO allies face increasingly complex challenges that require rapid, innovative technological responses. Within Terma’s AI & Advanced Analytics team, we develop and deploy AI-driven capabilities that strengthen decision-making and enhance situational awareness in this evolving environment. We are a passionate and dedicated group that takes full ownership of our AI products – from initial ideas to development, delivery, and long-term maintenance. Our work extends far beyond coding; we engage directly with customers and end users to understand operational needs and ensure that our solutions make a real difference. This means you will work closely with those who rely on our technology, gaining unique insights that go well beyond the traditional developer role. You will join a team that values innovation, diversity, and psychological safety. We support each other, challenge ideas constructively and ensure everyone has the opportunity to grow and contribute to delivering meaningful solutions. How you will make a meaningful contribution Your key responsibilities include: Developing and training cutting-edge Machine learning models using complex, real-world and simulated data Taking ownership of data pipelines, AI modeling, and algorithm development for high-impact projects Ensuring high-quality, secure, and reliable AI solutions that meet military-grade standards Evaluating model performance and driving continuous improvements in accuracy, robustness, and generalization Collaborating closely with end users to understand operational needs and translate them into effective AI solutions Working with peers across engineering, domain experts, and customers to deliver mission-critical capabilities Bring your world class expertise into play You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague who has: 2+ years of experience in data science with a proven track record of delivering impactful data-driven solutions, a strong background in AI/ML, and familiarity with modern software development processes Strong technical skills, including proficiency in statistical analysis, deep learning methods, and AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch Experience with AI/ML deployment, Python programming, data analysis, data manipulation, signal processing and visualization tools A degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field - or equivalent work experience Familiarity with Linux environments and containerization tools such as Docker Experience with Java is an advantage but not a requirement Most importantly, genuine passion and creativity - if you have fun side projects, unconventional experiences, or unique perspectives, we would love to hear about them As a person, you are creative, and you believe in teamwork and thrive in an environment built on mutual trust and collaboration. We challenge ourselves and one another …

About Us The ML Cloud team designs, runs and safeguards high-performance computing infrastructure tailored to machine learning workloads. Our state of the art systems are distributed across four data centers and are operated for the Tübingen AI Center, the Cluster of Excellence ’Machine Learning: New Perspectives for Science’ and the Hertie Institute for AI in Brain Health. Every day, researchers unleash thousands of compute jobs on our systems, training frontier-scale neural networks and running experiments. The Opportunity Our clusters keep growing – more GPUs, more storage, and more services around them. We are looking for an HPC Systems Eingineer who enjoys developing and running production infrastructure end to end: from bare-metal compute and the Slurm scheduler to the virtualization layer on which central service run, the storage backends and the automation that holds it all together. Build and manage provisioning and configuration of heterogeneous compute, storage and network nodes (e.g. image-based provisioning, node lifecycle, Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking) Run and extend our Proxmox virtualization clusters hosting the management plane and infrastructure services (HA, live migration, backup) Operate and scale our storage platforms: Ceph clusters for S3-compatible object storage for research data, including capacity planning, tiering, replication and backup Automate operations as code with Ansible and Git-based workflows – provisioning, configuration, roll-outs and recurring maintenance Build and operate monitoring, logging and alerting, and keep systems patched, hardened and reliable through regular maintenance windows Plan and carry out hardware roll-outs, capacity extensions and migrations together with vendors and data center staff Bring AI agents into our admin workflows and build agent-native access to the cluster for users. items.desc: Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. What began in 2008 with one person helping another remove a malware infection has grown into a global leader in online protection, with an all-in-one suite of cybersecurity, privacy, and identity protection solutions that empower millions of people worldwide to enjoy their digital lives, free from threats and scams. About ThreatDown ThreatDown is a leader in elite Managed Detection and Response (MDR), purpose-built to empower resource-constrained security teams with high-efficacy protection, without the complexity. As attacks grow faster and more automated, ThreatDown pairs proprietary AI and threat research with analyst judgment to deploy in minutes to deliver high-efficacy protection. Recognized by MRG Effitas, AVLab, and G2, ThreatDown scales security operations to intercept sophisticated attacks at the speed of modern threats. At ThreatDown, you’ll join a team driven by innovation, resilience, and a passion for empowering businesses to thrive securely. If you're ready to make a real impact in cybersecurity, we’d love to meet you. ThreatDown is looking for.. We are looking for a passionate Malware Research Engineer to join our research and development team in Perugia, Italy. We want somebody with the real passion of defending the cyberworld, finding new malware, digging into what they do and help protecting our customers by writing detection signatures as well as contributing to protection technologies. It’s more than a job, it is a mission. On-site availability is strongly preferred. Basic understanding and experience using various operating systems, incl. Windows, Linux, Mac, and Android. items.desc: Dit ga je doen bij ons: Bij de NPO werken, betekent je passie volgen om de publieke omroepen te ondersteunen in hun missie het Nederlandse publiek te informeren, inspireren en amuseren. Op de afdeling Data & AI werk je dagelijks aan het bouwen van personalisatiediensten en het ontwikkelen van contentaanbevelingen. We verzamelen gegevens over het kijk- en luistergedrag van ons publiek, zowel online als lineair, en gebruiken deze inzichten om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Naast onze personalisatiediensten zijn we bezig met het ontwikkelen van AI-toolingvoor de NPO en de publieke omroepen. Daarmee bouwen we toepassingen die redacties ondersteunen, productieprocessen slimmer maken en onze publieksdiensten verder versterken. Als machine learning engineer krijg je daarbij de kans om een bredere AI-rol op te pakken: je signaleert nieuwe kansen, onderzoekt samen met collega’s hoe deze passen bij de strategie van de NPO en helpt bij het opstellen en waarborgen van businesscases. Vervolgens adviseer je teams over de haalbaarheid en impact van nieuwe AI-toepassingen en vertaal je deze naar concrete oplossingen die waarde toevoegen voor redacties, producten en het publiek – denk aan automatische ondertiteling, metadata-verrijking, archief ontsluiting via agents, semantische zoekoplossingen en nieuwe vormen van personalisatie. Als machine learning engineer krijg je de kans je breed te ontwikkelen en mee te werken aan de hele technische keten. Je kunt modellen schrijven in Keras, TensorFlow of PyTorch, bouwt applicaties in Docker-containers, bent bekend met LLM modellen en agent ontwikkeling, optimaliseert hyperparameters in de cloud, zet systemen op in Serverless of Kubernetes, rust A/B-testsystemen uit om zowel zakelijke als sociale doelen te toetsen, en zorgt ervoor dat alle diensten soepel blijven draaien. De afdeling De afdeling Data & AI is verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van de datastrategie van de NPO. Het doel van deze strategie is het continu inzichtelijk maken van de behoeften van het Nederlandse publiek en hierop in te spelen met slimme op data gebaseerde functionaliteiten, uiteraard binnen de geldende privacy-grenzen. De afdeling bestaat uit de volgende teams: Datahub team Zoeken, Aanbevelingen & Ai team NPO-id en Profiel Metadata kwaliteit NPO Player Als Machine learning engineer maak je deel uit van het team Zoeken, Aanbevelingen & Ai. items.desc: Galadrim es una startup que diseña y desarrolla productos web, móviles y de IA. Dirigida por dos antiguos alumnos de la École Polytechnique que han trabajado para Meta, IBM y Microsoft, desarrolla soluciones complejas a medida para sus clientes utilizando metodologías ágiles. Somos más de 150 personas entre Francia y España, creciendo a un ritmo superior al 50% anual durante los últimos 8 años y, ¡el equipo de España te necesita ! Al unirte a nosotros, tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en una gran variedad de proyectos dentro de un equipo joven y apasionado por la tecnología. Buscamos desarrolladores y desarrolladoras de soluciones de inteligencia artificial para asumir alguno de los proyectos que ya tenemos en marcha en el país. Según el proyecto, también te encargarás de la parte Full Stack de tu proyecto, así que combinarás IA con desarrollo end-to-end. Además, tendrás la oportunidad de ir asumiendo mayor liderazgo técnico a medida que crezca el equipo. Este puesto es para ti si Tienes 0+ años de experiencia. (Sí, has leído bien ¡0 años!) Te apasiona la IA y sigues de cerca los últimos avances (LLM, modelos de difusión, agentes, etc.). Te encantan las interfaces modernas, fluidas y pixel-perfect . No te asusta bucear en reglas de negocio complejas para diseñar soluciones de IA pragmáticas e iterativas. Utilizas de forma fluida editores de código con IA como Cursor o Claude Code para incrementar tu agilidad y velocidad de ejecución, manteniendo siempre el control total de tu codebase . Tienes don de gentes y te motiva acompañar a los comerciales a reuniones para explicar conceptos técnicos de forma clara. Disfrutas del trabajo en equipo, pero tienes autonomía total en tus tareas. Buscas la excelencia técnica en todo lo que haces, y tienes una base sólida de ingeniería. Dominas el español a nivel nativo y el inglés con fluidez. ¡Bonus si hablas francés! Tu progresión en Galadrim En 3 meses: Habrás trabajado en tus 2 primeros proyectos de IA. En Galadrim creemos en el learning by doing, así que trabajarás rápidamente en proyectos reales para nuestros clientes, contando con el apoyo de un mentor técnico que realizará contigo sesiones de pair-programming y code reviews . También podrás participar en conferencias y workshops internacionales con el resto del equipo. En 6 meses: Ya dominarás nuestro stack y metodología, y podrás asumir más responsabilidades ayudándonos a estructurar el equipo (selección, gestión, desarrollo de herramientas internas, etc.). Para que te hagas una idea: en nuestra oficina de París pasamos de 2 a más de 20 ingenieros en menos de 3 años. A largo plazo: Podrás implicarte directamente en el crecimiento de nuestra actividad en España. Ejemplos de proyectos Te involucrarás en una gran variedad de proyectos en múltiples sectores: Desarrollo de asistentes de voz en el sector médico. Entrenamiento y despliegue de modelos de visión en sistemas embebidos. Industrialización y automatización de retoques fotográficos. Uso de LLM para la generación automática de fichas de producto. Modelización de previsión de la demanda en la industria. Stack técnico preferido No te preocupes si no dominas todas estas tecnologías, el stack depende del proyecto. Aquí tienes nuestro stack más utilizado, pero se adaptará según tu nivel y las necesidades del proyecto: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face API de OpenAI / VertexAI / Anthropic / etc. YOLO (You only look once) - Computer Vision PostgreSQL Node.js (Adonis, Nest.js) JavaScript / TypeScript React / React Native AWS Beneficios Este puesto es híbrido en Madrid (4 días de oficina / 1 en remoto acumulables). Sin embargo, trabajarás en modalidad full remote (100% teletrabajo) hasta que abramos nuestras primeras oficinas en Madrid en el segundo semestre de 2026. Salario: 30.000 € - 35.000 € brutos anuales Equipo: Macbook o PC a tu elección (con 24/32 GB de RAM y 1 TB de almacenamiento). Subscripción IA: Claude Code Max, Cursor u otra de tu elección Otros beneficios : Tickets restaurante y devolución parcial de tus gastos en deporte o gimnasio. Proceso de selección Quiz de código y lógica con tiempo limitado Entrevista técnica (en español/inglés): Desafío técnico en el lenguaje de programación que prefieras (y domines). Entrevista final con varias partes: 1. Entrevista técnica en español con Carlos ( Tech Lead en España). 2. Simulación comercial y fit en español con David (Sales en Madrid). 3. Entrevista técnica en inglés con Benjamin (CTO de IA del grupo). 4. Entrevista técnica en inglés con Arnaud (Co-fundador y CTO del grupo). Sueldo: A partir de 30.000,00€ al año Beneficios: Ordenador de empresa Ticket restaurante Ubicación del trabajo: Empleo presencial

Our client develops advanced AI and Machine Learning technology for defence, security and other demanding operational environments. MFK Recruitment has successfully recruited four Engineers to this company over the past five years, and all four are still with the business. This is a rare opportunity to apply genuine SNN experience to production software with direct operational applications. You will work alongside Researchers, Data Scientists and Engineers on SNNs, machine vision, synthetic training data and related CNN or Transformer-based projects. Contribute to projects using CNNs and Transformer networks. Integrate recent Machine Learning algorithms into production software. Contribute to system design, version control, testing and CI/CD pipelines. Support colleagues and customers during technical discussions and project delivery. Essential experience Current hands-on experience developing Spiking Neural Networks. Strong C++ programming and software engineering skills. Experience developing maintainable code using version control, testing and CI/CD. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Desirable experience CUDA and GPU programming. Python and PyTorch. CNNs, Transformers or broader deep learning architectures. Synthetic training imagery and simulation environments. ISR imagery or defence-related machine vision. Commercial software development alongside academic or research experience. An MSc, PhD or postdoctoral background involving SNNs, Computer Vision, AI or Machine Learning. items.card: The Role We are excited to launch this new opportunity for a Research Associate in Biodiversity Science to join us in the School of Natural and Environmental Sciences. The successful candidate will join the TROPS research lab of Prof Marion Pfeifer, working with her on her new ERC project, TIF-CER, ‘From Forests to Fields to Sustainable Rural Landscapes: A Multiscale Framework for Quantifying Biodiversity and
items.desc: Research Associate Biodiversity Science Requisition ID: 29914 Location: Newcastle, GB Contract Type: Fixed Term Working Pattern: Full Time Posted Date: 10 Nov 2026 Salary: £37,369 per annum Newcastle University is a great place to work, with excellent benefits. We have a generous holiday package; plus the opportunity to buy more, great pension schemes and a number of health and wellbeing initiatives to support you. Closing Date: 24 November 2026 The Role We are excited to launch this new opportunity for a Research Associate in Biodiversity Science to join us in the School of Natural and Environmental Sciences. The successful candidate will join the TROPS research lab of Prof Marion Pfeifer, working with her on her new ERC project, TIF-CER, ‘From Forests to Fields to Sustainable Rural Landscapes: A Multiscale Framework for Quantifying Biodiversity and Climate Interrelationships’ , running from January 2027 to December 2031. In this project, you will work with Marion and the wider team to quantify how the three-dimensional structure and configuration of tree-based agricultural systems (trees in farms - TIFs) influence biodiversity and ecological functions, and how these functions translate into ecosystem services and disservices valued by different stakeholders. The project operates across multiple spatial scales, from individual trees and farm plots to landscapes and catchments, and across contrasting agroclimatic contexts. Your particular focus will be on the biodiversity components of TIF-CER, including biodiversity responses to TIF structure and landscape configuration, mechanisms underpinning wildlife use of TIFs, and the potential for TIFs to contribute to habitat connectivity. You will work closely with the project's climate and land-systems science Research Associate to integrate biodiversity and climate perspectives and understand how these relationships change across spatial and temporal scales. TIF-CER is working with partners in the UK, Italy, Philippines, Tanzania, Chile and Tunisia to: establish an international network of field plots in TIFs and adjacent agricultural land uses and natural forests across contrasting agroclimatic zones; quantify biodiversity and ecological functions associated with TIFs and establish mechanisms underlying their delivery across spatial scales; analyse temporal trajectories of biodiversity, functions, services and disservices using co-designed scenario models of land-use and climate change; and develop tools for end-users using robust evidence for decision-making on tree planting in farms. The position is full-time (1.0 FTE) and involves substantial international travel, particularly during the establishment and implementation of the project's fieldwork programme. You will take a leading role in coordinating the biodiversity field programme across the international TIF-CER network. This will include planning field campaigns, coordinating equipment and field protocols, supporting local research teams, and training research assistants in standardised biodiversity data collection across different ecological and cultural contexts. You will take responsibility for the day-to-day logistics of the biodiversity research programme, working with international partners to coordinate fieldwork schedules, equipment, data collection and field protocols across countries. You will also contribute to the recruitment and training of research assistants and local field teams and ensure that biodiversity data are collected consistently across the international network. You will be expected to co-supervise two PhD students and work with a diverse range of stakeholders to identify values associated with biodiversity and the functions that TIFs provide at different spatial scales. You will work closely with ecologists, land-system scientists, hydrologists, social scientists and local stakeholders to integrate biodiversity evidence with the wider TIF-CER framework. We are looking for a candidate with strong ecological and quantitative skills who can combine field-based biodiversity research with spatial and/or statistical modelling, work effectively across disciplines and cultures, and take responsibility for delivering a complex international research programme. What happens next We are looking to appoint to both Research Associate positions by Spring 2027 at the latest, with the successful candidates expected to start as soon as possible thereafter, subject to the relevant contractual arrangements. We encourage candidates who are interested in the position to contact Prof Marion Pfeifer informally before applying to discuss the role and the TIF-CER project (marion.pfeifer@newcastle.ac.uk). items.desc: Ref Number B02-11533 Professional Expertise Clinical Department School of Life & Medical Sciences (B02) Location London Working Pattern Part time Salary £39,254 - £55,025 Contract Type Fixed-term Working Type Hybrid Available for Secondment No Closing Date 08-Dec-2026 About us The Liver Failure Group at UCL, led by Professor Rajiv Jalan, is internationally recognised for its work on acute‑on‑chronic liver failure (ACLF), systemic inflammation and infection in advanced liver disease. We are seeking a motivated Clinical Research Fellow at ST5/ST6 level to work on the AMBRENCH study, which aims to develop a novel algorithm that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to predict antimicrobial resistance (AMR). The post‑holder will collect clinical data and bacterial isolates, help with sequencing and enter study data, while learning about the microbiome, AMR and AI. The post is part‑time (0.5 FTE) for 9 months, starting in December 2026, and is based at the Royal Free Campus. It is funded through the AMBRENCH study About the role The main purpose of the role is to support delivery of the AMBRENCH study. The post‑holder will identify and help recruit eligible patients, collect high‑quality clinical data and samples, and work with the clinical microbiology laboratory to obtain and log bacterial isolates and their antimicrobial susceptibility results. They will help prepare isolates and samples for sequencing, track samples from collection to result, and enter and quality‑check clinical, microbiological and sequencing data. Working alongside clinicians, laboratory scientists and data scientists, they will help build the dataset used to train and test the AI algorithm, and will have the chance to present and publish from the study. This role is not suitable for UCL sponsorship. About you We are looking for a doctor at RDPS Nodal point 3 equivalent with full GMC registration and a licence to practise, ideally in gastroenterology/hepatology or a related specialty, with experience of caring for patients with cirrhosis or liver failure. You will be organised and accurate with data, communicate well, and be able to work across clinical and laboratory settings. items.desc: Galadrim es una startup que diseña y desarrolla productos web, móviles y de IA. Dirigida por dos antiguos alumnos de la École Polytechnique que han trabajado para Meta, IBM y Microsoft, desarrolla soluciones complejas a medida para sus clientes utilizando metodologías ágiles. Somos más de 150 personas entre Francia y España, creciendo a un ritmo superior al 50% anual durante los últimos 8 años y, ¡el equipo de España te necesita ! Al unirte a nosotros, tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en una gran variedad de proyectos dentro de un equipo joven y apasionado por la tecnología. Buscamos desarrolladores y desarrolladoras de soluciones de inteligencia artificial para asumir alguno de los proyectos que ya tenemos en marcha en el país. Según el proyecto, también te encargarás de la parte Full Stack de tu proyecto, así que combinarás IA con desarrollo end-to-end. Además, tendrás la oportunidad de ir asumiendo mayor liderazgo técnico a medida que crezca el equipo. Este puesto es para ti si Tienes 0+ años de experiencia. (Sí, has leído bien ¡0 años!) Te apasiona la IA y sigues de cerca los últimos avances (LLM, modelos de difusión, agentes, etc.). Te encantan las interfaces modernas, fluidas y pixel-perfect . No te asusta bucear en reglas de negocio complejas para diseñar soluciones de IA pragmáticas e iterativas. Utilizas de forma fluida editores de código con IA como Cursor o Claude Code para incrementar tu agilidad y velocidad de ejecución, manteniendo siempre el control total de tu codebase . Tienes don de gentes y te motiva acompañar a los comerciales a reuniones para explicar conceptos técnicos de forma clara. Disfrutas del trabajo en equipo, pero tienes autonomía total en tus tareas. Buscas la excelencia técnica en todo lo que haces, y tienes una base sólida de ingeniería. Dominas el español a nivel nativo y el inglés con fluidez. ¡Bonus si hablas francés! Tu progresión en Galadrim En 3 meses: Habrás trabajado en tus 2 primeros proyectos de IA. En Galadrim creemos en el learning by doing, así que trabajarás rápidamente en proyectos reales para nuestros clientes, contando con el apoyo de un mentor técnico que realizará contigo sesiones de pair-programming y code reviews . También podrás participar en conferencias y workshops internacionales con el resto del equipo. En 6 meses: Ya dominarás nuestro stack y metodología, y podrás asumir más responsabilidades ayudándonos a estructurar el equipo (selección, gestión, desarrollo de herramientas internas, etc.). Para que te hagas una idea: en nuestra oficina de París pasamos de 2 a más de 20 ingenieros en menos de 3 años. A largo plazo: Podrás implicarte directamente en el crecimiento de nuestra actividad en España. Ejemplos de proyectos Te involucrarás en una gran variedad de proyectos en múltiples sectores: Desarrollo de asistentes de voz en el sector médico. Entrenamiento y despliegue de modelos de visión en sistemas embebidos. Industrialización y automatización de retoques fotográficos. Uso de LLM para la generación automática de fichas de producto. Modelización de previsión de la demanda en la industria. Stack técnico preferido No te preocupes si no dominas todas estas tecnologías, el stack depende del proyecto. Aquí tienes nuestro stack más utilizado, pero se adaptará según tu nivel y las necesidades del proyecto: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face API de OpenAI / VertexAI / Anthropic / etc. YOLO (You only look once) - Computer Vision PostgreSQL Node.js (Adonis, Nest.js) JavaScript / TypeScript React / React Native AWS Beneficios Este puesto es híbrido en Madrid (4 días de oficina / 1 en remoto acumulables). Sin embargo, trabajarás en modalidad full remote (100% teletrabajo) hasta que abramos nuestras primeras oficinas en Madrid en el segundo semestre de 2026. Salario: 30.000 € - 35.000 € brutos anuales Equipo: Macbook o PC a tu elección (con 24/32 GB de RAM y 1 TB de almacenamiento). Subscripción IA: Claude Code Max, Cursor u otra de tu elección Otros beneficios: Tickets restaurante y devolución parcial de tus gastos en deporte o gimnasio. Proceso de selección Quiz de código y lógica con tiempo limitado Entrevista técnica (en español/inglés): Desafío técnico en el lenguaje de programación que prefieras (y domines). Entrevista final con varias partes: 1. Entrevista técnica en español con Carlos ( Tech Lead en España). 2. Simulación comercial y fit en español con David (Sales en Madrid). 3. Entrevista técnica en inglés con Benjamin (CTO de IA del grupo). 4. Entrevista técnica en inglés con Arnaud (Co-fundador y CTO del grupo).
