We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases.
items.desc:
Who we are: 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The Bring Something Amazing Initiative: 
 Helsing’s mission is to protect our democracies. Delivering sovereign AI and mission-critical software capability requires exceptional engineering talent at every level. Following our recent funding and the success of early-career engineers across our teams—including talent from our Formula Student partnerships—we are opening multiple roles across our London and Munich Physical Products Engineering teams. Traditional recruitment often places artificial barriers in front of early-career builders. Resumes rarely tell the full story of your technical depth, intuition, or drive. To solve this, we are piloting a direct, craft-first hiring path: Bring Something Awesome to Apply (BSA2A). 
 (This route is designed specifically for early-career engineers. It is entirely optional, you may still apply via our standard job listings if you prefer.) 
 Please note that candidates will be considered for the office nearest to them but may also be required to relocate. 
 The Process: 
 At the core of our technical interview philosophy is Bring Something Awesome (BSA). A dedicated session where candidates present an ambitious technical project they have designed, built, or contributed to. 
 With BSA2A, we are bringing this step to the very front of the application. Instead of an initial CV and recruiter screen, you apply by submitting a short (maximum 10-minute) prerecorded video walkthrough of something technically compelling you have built. We look for: 
 Engineering depth & craft: Technically challenging hardware designs. 
 First-principles problem solving: The ability to deconstruct complex technical challenges autonomously. 
 Clear technical communication: The ability to explain the how and why behind your trade-offs succinctly. 
 Candidates selected through BSA2A move into an accelerated, streamlined technical assessment: 
 Expression of Interest: Complete the short form below to confirm your eligibility. Our team will review submissions. 
 Video Submission: Eligible candidates receive a private link with detailed guidance to upload their 10-minute BSA walkthrough. Every video is evaluated directly by a Helsing engineer, not an algorithm or automated keyword filter. 
 Technical Interviews (2 × 60 mins): 
 Round 1: BSA Deep Dive. An interactive, technical exploration of your project and system trade-offs. 
 Round 2: Requirements and Design Interview. Practical, real-world scenario and problem-solving task. 
 Final Interview (30 mins): A conversation with engineering leadership focused on mission alignment, collaboration, and how you work. 
 Note: The initial form below is simply an expression of interest. You do not need your video recorded to submit this form. If your profile is eligible, we will send you dedicated instructions and a submission window. 
 Why apply via this route? 
 Evaluated on proof of work, not pedigree : Your designs, choices, and technical curiosity take centre stage—not university ranking, buzzwords, or CV formatting. 
 Play to your strengths: Your application is assessed directly by Helsing engineers on what you can actually build. Putting your real-world work front and centre gives you the highest signal—and the highest probability of success. 
 Accelerated timeline : A focused, high-signal path that bypasses standard preliminary screens and reduces the overall interview cycle by two full stages. 
 The Role: 
 At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve.

items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM 

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 



ABOUT THE ROLE

 

As an Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our clients in the industry. 

We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI tools are optimised for real-world operations.

This is an exciting, new role for an individual motivated to build their knowledge of AI transformation in the Energy value chain. 

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 

 - Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions

 - Working side-by-side with Government stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

 - Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

 - Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

 - Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

 - Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. items.desc:
About Us
 Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.
 Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.
 Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We recently raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.
 We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.
 If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.
 The Job
 We're looking for an experienced Frontend Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build the features, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Alongside that, you'll help own the quality of how we build: the tests, pipelines and guardrails that let us ship fast without breaking what care teams depend on.
 In this role, you will focus on:
 Feature Development : Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.
 Customer Insight : Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.
 Code Quality & Guardrails : Help own code quality across the frontend. Improve our CI/CD pipelines and automated tests, keep the infrastructure scalable, and build the guardrails that let AI coding agents contribute safely.
 Backend & APIs : Work with the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.
 Quality, Privacy & Safety : Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.
 Qualifications
 Several years of experience building production web applications.
 Strong TypeScript skills : this is the language for everything we build.
 Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.
 Experience with CI/CD and automated testing, and a strong sense of what good code quality looks like.
 Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.
 Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.
 Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.X
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with React Native and Expo in production.
 Experience working with AI coding agents in a real codebase.
 AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.
 Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.
 Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).
 What We Offer
 Participation in our warrant program (stock options).
 A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.
 A Copenhagen-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.
 Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.
 Join Our Team
 We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.
 At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.
 If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

Le stage est proposé dans le cadre des activités R&T pour l'IA embarquée au sein de la direction DID (Direction Ingénierie Drone). Dans un contexte où les systèmes embarqués doivent exécuter plusieurs tâches avancées (segmentation, classification, détection, etc.), la mutualisation du calcul et l'optimisation des architectures de réseaux de neurones sont des enjeux majeurs. Ce stage propose d'explorer et d'améliorer l'utilisation de backbones partagés pour plusieurs têtes applicatives, en vue de faciliter le déploiement multi-tâche sur des plateformes embarquées à ressources limitées. Le/la stagiaire analysera les capacités de transfert de tâche de backbones couramment utilisés dans l'embarqué (MobileNetV2, ConvNext…) et expérimentera différentes techniques issues de la recherche récente pour optimiser l'espace latent, telles que des méthodes de régularisation ou l'apprentissage par tâches auxiliaires (ex : JEPA, SIGReg). Ce travail comportera à la fois une dimension ingénierie (développement d'un framework d'expérimentation, entraînement de modèles, évaluation sur plusieurs tâches) et une réflexion critique nourrie par l'état de l'art. Selon ses intérêts, le/la stagiaire pourra approfondir des axes complémentaires tels que l'étude de la quantification des réseaux, le déploiement sur plateforme embarquée ou l'ajout de nouvelles tâches. Ce stage permettra de développer des compétences transverses très recherchées en IA appliquée : conception et évaluation de modèles multitâches, optimisation pour l'embarqué, et veille sur les avancées scientifiques récentes. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field. About the Role As a Forward Deployed Applied AI Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI and customer delivery. You’ll collaborate directly with defence customers to understand their challenges, build LLM-powered solutions, and take ownership of projects from first requirements through to deployment. Our solutions are built to work in real operational environments, so you’ll also test and demonstrate them with customers in the field, not just at your desk. This is a hands-on role where you combine coding with client engagement, helping shape both the solutions we deliver today and the opportunities we develop for tomorrow. What You’ll Work On Applied AI Development: Build, test and integrate applications in which LLMs and other AI technologies play a central role, to solve practical customer problems. Python is our main language, but we care about the right solution, not the language. Turn emerging capabilities into usable software that can be deployed in real operational environments. Customer Discovery & Project Ownership: Work directly with customers to understand their workflows and to distinguish between what they ask for and what they actually need. Own your projects from scoping and realistic planning through development, testing and delivery. Coordinate with the Forward Deployed Team, handle changing requirements and keep customers informed. Field Testing & Troubleshooting: Test our solutions under realistic conditions, at our facilities in Erding but also at customer sites, training areas and exercises together with the armed forces. Observe how users actually work with the software, investigate issues on the spot and adapt quickly, so that you can show something better the next day. Customer Integrations: Develop and adapt our codebase to specific client requirements and integrate new functionality into existing systems, while keeping solutions maintainable and reusable for future customers. Demonstrations & Delivery: Prepare and run technical demonstrations, gather feedback and iterate. Make sure that what we build works in practice, not just in a demo. Relationship Building: Become a trusted technical point of contact for your customers. Identify emerging needs and potential follow-on projects. Your Profile You have experience in a client-facing technical role, such as technical consulting, professional services, applied AI engineering or software implementation. You’re comfortable discussing requirements, explaining technical decisions and working directly with customers. You take ownership of problems and follow them through, from understanding customer needs to delivering a working solution. You bring strong software development skills and a solid grasp of software architecture. You can write, debug and improve code yourself rather than relying solely on high-level AI tools or prototypes. Python experience is a plus, but we’re more interested in how you build software than in which language you use. You speak German at a fluent or professional level and can confidently work with customers in German-speaking environments. You think on your feet, adapt when requirements change and work through unfamiliar technical or operational challenges without needing every step laid out for you. You’re curious about how customers operate and can translate ambiguous problems into practical solutions. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and focus on what delivers value. You want to work in defence and apply AI to real operational challenges, and you’re excited to join exercises and field tests with our customers. You enjoy hands-on development but are equally comfortable presenting a demo or discussing a problem with a customer. You’re comfortable working on-site in Munich and travelling regularly, primarily within Germany. items.desc: ClimaTech Research Programme Role Join ClimaTech, an innovative research programme within EDHEC Climate Institute, focused on developing applied research and tools to better understand and reduce climate-related risks across financial assets including infrastructure, corporate equities, and real estate. We are seeking a Sustainability Research Engineer to join ClimaTech in a newly created role that reflects the continued growth of our research programme and expanding analytical capabilities. This role is ideal for an engineer with approximately 3–8 years of relevant experience gained in a corporate setting within an industrial sector, for example as a process engineer, in operations, or in a corporate sustainability team. We are particularly interested in candidates who built deep expertise in a focused technical area before moving into sustainability, and who combine that grounding with excellent writing skills and a strong interest in understanding how organisations reduce emissions, manage climate risks, and implement sustainability strategies in practice. Responsibilities ■ Provide engineering assessment of industrial processes from a mitigation and adaptation point of view. ■ Contribute to maintaining and improving sustainability, climate, and asset-level datasets, applying engineering judgement to check their technical accuracy. ■ Work closely with researchers and developers to integrate datasets into analytical tools and research frameworks. Writing, Research Outputs, and Team Development ■ Write and contribute to research reports, methodologies, presentations, publications, and technical documentation, translating complex technical material into clear, rigorous prose for investors and decision-makers. ■ Collaborate across a multidisciplinary team of researchers, data specialists, and climate experts. ■ Take ownership of specific workstreams and contribute to the continued growth and development of ClimaTech’s research capabilities. What We Are Looking For This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge climate research while helping shape the future development of ClimaTech’s methodologies and analytical capabilities. As part of a growing team, you will have significant scope to influence how engineering and industrial expertise is applied to real-world climate challenges. items.desc: Applications are invited for an epidemiologist, statistician or health data scientist to work in our OpenSAFELY platform, deployed across the full electronic health records of 55 million patients. The successful applicant will be helping to lead a new way of delivering health data science. OpenSAFELY is a highly secure, modular, open source data analysis platform, combining best practice from both academia and the open source software community. The post-holder will have the opportunity to be involved in various research projects and platform-related activities, including (but not restricted to): Evaluating the safety and effectiveness of vaccines for respiratory viruses; Documenting national trends and variation in disease, medicines use, and clinical activity; Building tools and dashboards to gain insights from routinely-collected health data; Innovating processes for statistical disclosure control of outputs released from OpenSAFELY; Developing and maintaining regular reports to help OpenSAFELY users understand the underlying data and plan research activity; Developing and delivering training/teaching for working with routinely-collected data for research and planning; Co-piloting external OpenSAFELY users. If you have a specific interest in working on any of these areas - for example, if you have prior experience - please indicate this in your cover letter. The successful applicant will hold a relevant degree and experience in one or more of: epidemiology, data science, statistics, clinical informatics, medicine. You should also demonstrate the ability to write analytic code in at least one commonly used language, as well as having strong knowledge of routinely collected NHS patient data or clinical informatics. The Bennett Institute is a mixed team of clinicians, software developers, policy experts, data scientists, and academic researchers, all pooling skills and knowledge. We have a strong track record of delivering high impact research in Nature, Lancet and BMJ; real-world impact on policy and clinical practice; and high impact services such as OpenSAFELY, OpenPrescribing, OpenCodeCounts, and TrialsTracker. Our mission is to create a modern, open, collaborative ecosystem for health research. We do this by shipping code, delivering papers, building capacity, and advocating for new ways of working. We aim to lead by example: recurring tasks are turned into packages and libraries; all code is shared openly for review and re-use; analyses are delivered in re-executable notebooks for others to read, evaluate, re-purpose, and learn with. We want to meet outstanding researchers who share this vision and have, or can rapidly develop, the skills needed to deliver it with us. We are particularly interested in researchers who will contribute to our open science community-building work, our codebase, our open teaching resources, or our policy work. You will report to one of our Research team leads. You can read more at www.bennett.ox.ac.uk and OpenSAFELY.org. We are actively seeking to increase our team’s diversity and welcome applications from those in under-represented groups. You will be based in the Nuffield Department of Primary Care Health Sciences, Radcliffe Primary Care Building, Woodstock Road, Oxford, OX2 6GG as your normal place of work, but you will be able to agree a pattern of regular remote working with your line manager. The position is funded by the Wellcome Trust, for a duration of two years in the first instance. For further information or discuss the post please contact Dr Andrea Schaffer andrea.schaffer@phc.ox.ac.uk. “Committed to equality and valuing diversity” Applications for this vacancy are to be made online and you will be required to upload a CV and Supporting Statement as part of your online application. The Supporting Statement should include a cover letter and should also clearly describe how you meet each of the selection criteria listed in the job description. Click here for information and advice on writing an effective Supporting Statement. Please do not attach any manuscripts, papers, transcripts, mark sheets or certificates as these will not be considered as part of your application. The closing date for applications is 12:00 noon on Friday 11 December 2026. Interviews are expected to be held during the week commencing 18 January 2027.

items.desc: Location: Coventry or Skipton with hybrid working · Contract: Full-time, permanent · Salary: £35,000+ benefits · Reports to: Managing Director Help us build the future of education recruitment – from the inside. At justteachers, our consultants do brilliant work: matching great teachers, nursery nurses and support staff with the schools that need them. But too much of their day goes on admin. We want to change that, and we're looking for a curious, open-minded graduate to help us do it. About us justteachers is a specialist education recruitment agency supplying teachers, nursery nurses and support staff to schools, colleges and nurseries. We have branches across England, from the Midlands to Yorkshire and the North West, and we're a DFE GCA Approved Supplier. We're friendly, flexible and proud of the community we've built with our schools and candidates. Why this role, why now Our world is changing and we would like to provide tools to enable our JT family to work smarter, not just harder. We've decided to take the next step: bringing AI properly into our everyday workflows so our consultants can spend more time on what they're great at – developing clients, engaging candidates and supporting schools. This is a brand-new role. You won't be inheriting a fixed system or a long list of tickets. You'll be helping us shape what AI looks like at justteachers from the ground up. What you'll do Get to know how we work. Spend time with consultants, compliance, payroll and leadership to map our real day-to-day workflows and spot where time is lost. Find the opportunities. Identify repetitive, manual tasks that AI and automation could take on, such as candidate matching, compliance checks, booking admin, timesheets, emails and reporting. Build and test solutions. Prototype tools and automations using AI assistants, low-code platforms and integrations with our existing systems. Start small, test with real users, and improve. Roll out what works. Help deploy tools across our branches, write simple guides, and train colleagues so new ways of working actually stick. Measure the impact. Track time saved and adoption, and report back to the Senior Leadership Team in plain language. Keep it safe and compliant. Work with us to make sure everything respects data protection (UK GDPR), safeguarding and our framework obligations. Stay curious. Keep an eye on new AI tools and ideas, and bring us the ones worth trying. What we're looking for We care more about your mindset than a long list of skills. You'll be a recent graduate (or have equivalent experience) in computer science, machine learning, software engineering, data, maths, information systems or a related subject. You'll enjoy solving problems, you'll be comfortable talking to non-technical people, and you'll be excited rather than daunted by building something new. Full details are in the person specification below. What we offer A genuinely new role with real influence and visibility to senior leadership Structured learning and support, with budget for training and certifications in AI and automation Hybrid working and a friendly, supportive team culture 32 days Holiday entitlement + Birthday off and bank holidays, pension, and other benefits] Clear room to grow as our AI capability grows How to apply Send your CV and a short note (no more than one page) telling us about something you've built, automated or figured out – at university, work or just for fun – and why this role interests you. Apply via Indeed by 3rd December 2026. justteachers is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. This role is subject to an enhanced DBS check and satisfactory references. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Pay: From £35,000.00 per year Benefits: Bereavement leave Company events Company pension Cycle to work scheme Employee discount Employee mentoring programme Enhanced paternity leave Financial planning services Free parking Health & wellbeing programme Life insurance On-site parking Referral programme Relocation assistance Sick pay Transport links Education: Bachelor's (required) Work authorisation: United Kingdom (required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coventry CV4 8HS

items.desc: Ref Number B02-11573 Professional Expertise Research and Research Support Department School of Life & Medical Sciences (B02) Location London Working Pattern Full time Salary £44,861-£55,099 Contract Type Fixed-term Working Type Hybrid Available for Secondment No Closing Date 26-Nov-2026 About us UCL, based in Bloomsbury, is a welcoming, inclusive university situated at the heart of one of the world’s greatest cities. UCL is a top-ranked university in the UK for research in psychology, psychiatry & neuroscience. The post will be based within the Division of Psychology and Language Sciences (www.ucl.ac.uk/pals) in the Faculty of Brain Sciences. The Division houses a number of research departments, one of which is the Department of Linguistics – known for its world class research in theoretical and experimental approaches to language. The postholder will be affiliated with both the Linguistics department and the cross-departmental Deafness, Cognition and Language Research Centre (DCAL). DCAL is the leading research centre in the field of Deafness, Cognition and Language in Europe. It is a bilingual centre which brings together leading deaf and hearing researchers in the fields of linguistics, psychology and neuroscience. DCAL researchers study language – its origins, structure, use, development, processes and relationship with cognition, using the unique perspective of deafness and deaf communication. “SignGPT” is a 5-year project (2025-2030) which brings DCAL together with the Centre for Vision Speech and Signal Processing at the University of Surrey, and the Visual Geometry Group at the University of Oxford. The project, funded by the UK Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC), aims to leverage annotated sign language data from the British Sign Language (BSL) Corpus (http://www.bslcorpusproject.org) and other sources to build tools to allow spoken language to be automatically translated into photo-realistic sign language and video of sign language to be translated into spoken language. About the role This is an exciting opportunity to work with the UCL/DCAL component of “SignGPT” – a research team led by Prof Kearsy Cormier and Prof Bencie Woll. The team works closely with other collaborators on the project – Lead PI Prof Richard Bowden (University of Surrey) and Prof Andrew Zisserman (University of Oxford) and their teams. The postholder will provide linguistic expertise to the design of AI tools and assets and will then use these tools to conduct linguistic research. They will also help organise the user community workshops, post news items online, and contribute to writing up of the project findings along with the PI/CIs. The post holder will receive training, support and mentoring as appropriate to the role. The post-holder will be based at the UCL Deafness, Cognition and Language Research Centre (DCAL). The position is offered for 36 months. Appointment at Grade 7 is dependent upon having been awarded a PhD; if this is not the case, initial appointment will be at Grade 6B (salary £40,603 - £43,749 per annum) with payment at Grade 7 being backdated to the date of final submission of the PhD Thesis. To be considered eligible for this post, applicants must have formally submitted their PhD thesis and must either have successfully completed their viva examination or have an agreed viva date scheduled within 3 months of the post’s commencement date. This role meets the eligibility requirements for a skilled worker certificate of sponsorship or a global talent visa under UK Visas and Immigration legislation. Therefore, UCL welcomes applications from international applicants who require a visa. We will consider applications to work on a part-time basis or job-share wherever possible. This appointment is subject to UCL Terms and Conditions of Service for Research and Professional Services Staff. Please visit https://www.ucl.ac.uk/human-resources/conditions-service-research-teaching-and-professional-services-staff for more information. The UCL Ways of Working supports colleagues to be successful and happy at UCL through sharing expectations around how we work – please visit https://www.ucl.ac.uk/human-resources/policies-advice/ways-working to find out more. About you You will hold a doctoral degree in linguistics or related area (e.g. applied linguistics, corpus/computational linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, data science) or evidence of substantial relevant research experience in one or more of these areas. You will also have fluent skills in British Sign Language (BSL) or another sign language. You will be based at UCL DCAL and will work closely with other project members at DCAL. You will also liaise regularly with researchers at Surrey and Oxford who will be doing the main technical work. Further details This advert will close on 26 November 2026 at 23:59 GMT. A Job Description and Person Specification can be accessed at the bottom of this page. If you have any queries …

items.desc: An opportunity is available to join the BioElectronic Systems Technology group, led by Professor Róisín Owens at the University of Cambridge, Department of Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology, on a project to develop an in vitro model of the gut in healthy and disease states. This interdisciplinary research aims to enhance our understanding of the role of the microbiome in health and disease by integrating advanced 3D cell culture with electronic monitoring capabilities. The human gut hosts over 100 trillion bacteria that are known to be essential for human health. Alterations in the microbiome have been linked with many disease phenotypes including colorectal cancer, Crohn's disease, obesity, diabetes as well as neuropathologies such as autism spectrum disorder (ASD), stress and anxiety. Animal studies remain one of the sole means of assessing the importance of microbiota on development and well-being, however the use of animals to study human systems is increasingly questioned due to ethics, cost and relevance concerns. The development of advanced in vitro models with microbiota has scarcely been demonstrated even though the important role of the microbiome appears unquestionable. This post holder is primarily responsible for tissue culture support within the research group of Professor Róisín Owens, specifically within the context of the gut brain axis project. The principal activity will be to coordinate the cell culture activities of the group including maintaining cultures, freezing cells, making buffers and media, and maintaining stocks of laboratory supplies. A key aspect of the work involves generating physiologically relevant models using stem cells and organoids. As such, applicants should be comfortable with advanced culture techniques that go beyond conventional immortalised cell lines. In addition to cell maintenance, the technician will be expected to support and perform defined experimental work under the guidance of the Principal Investigator. The role requires familiarity with a broad range of biochemical and biological assays commonly used to characterise cells, including live-cell microscopy and standard analytical techniques in molecular and cell biology. Candidates should have an HNC or equivalent in a biological subject together with significant experience in academic or commercial cell biology, molecular biology and microbiology laboratories. Applicants should be trained in cell culture and aseptic techniques, with an emphasis on organoid culture, in addition to convectional biochemical assays. The BioElectronic Systems Technology group is an interdisciplinary team made up of biologists, engineers, and materials scientists. The successful candidate will need to communicate effectively with colleagues, including Masters students, PhD students, and PDRAs who may be less experienced in cell culture, and should be confident working both independently and as part of a collaborative research environment. Interviews are likely to be held on the week commencing 14th December 2026. Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 2 years in the first instance. . Our ambition at the CDC is to transform the way we traditionally deliver healthcare and explore new and innovative delivery models that reflects the needs of both our staff and our patients. To set up and develop clinical endoscopy service across at the Finchley Memorial Hospital NHS Community Diagnostic Centre . To carry out diagnostic upper GI/Transnasal endoscopy service providing advanced assessment and diagnosis for patients referred. To carry out Capsule Sponge service providing advanced assessment and diagnosis. To manage patients appropriately through the diagnostic pathway using pre assessment, outpatient and telephone clinics and MDT review. To take responsibility for own evidence-based practice. To develop and work inside clear advance practice policies and evidence-based guidelines to support the service. To develop all staff within the multidisciplinary team, providing support, advice, formal and informal education on endoscopy management. To work independently and autonomously within the endoscopy department. To support the endoscopy leadership team in ensuring world class standards within the endoscopy units across the Trust and to gain and maintain JAG accreditation. To work alongside the endoscopy leadership team in the implementation of Trans nasal UGI endoscopy at Finchley Memorial Hospital CDC Provide advice, guidance and subject matter expertise on governance processes to all those involved in the leadership of clinical care, including dealing with complaints Act as a subject matter expert, contribute towards strategic negotiations on all matters relating relation to clinical governance and quality assurance Finchley Memorial Community Diagnostic Centre (CDC), occasional requirement to attend other Royal Free London sites. The postholder will work closely with North Middlesex, as well as Barnet, Hampstead and Chase Farm Endoscopy teams. Finchley Memorial CDC works in close collaboration with its sister site Wood Green CDC, hosted by Whittington Health NHS Trust. The division has the pleasure in offering an innovative and fresh opportunity for a salaried GP to join the Hospital at Home service supporting people with medical interventions at their own home. As pressure on emergency departments across the UK grows, new care models will be pivotal in delivering and relieving some of these pressures by diverting work away from the hospital and into the community. This is an exciting opportunity to work collaboratively with other multi-disciplinary teams within primary and secondary care and to expand your portfolio and leadership skills in evolving primary care roles. Hospital at Home (Clinical sessions-negotiable) Our Hospital at Home service is designed to provide monitoring and treatment at home, which has traditionally been provided in hospital, such as intravenous (IV) therapy. The service encompasses Virtual Wards, Urgent Community Response (UCR) and IV OPAT service. The post holder will be required to undertake medical management including clinical assessment ensuring safe management of patients within the Community setting. You will be familiar with participant recruitment and running user research, structured interviews or usability testing, be competent in quantitative data analysis and research ethics governance. You will have excellent written communication and strong organisational skills with the ability to co-ordinate multiple stakeholders — academic, commercial and participant — concurrently and to a fixed project timeline. Binnen 3 jaar ben je een expert in jouw vakgebied, inclusief aantoonbare werkervaring. Heb jij een opdracht van 40 uur? Dan ontvang jij 125% over die 2 extra uren. Je zit dan op een bruto maandsalaris van €3196,88 inclusief het IKB. 12,33% IKB, waarvan 8,33% vakantiegeld en 4% voor extra verlof, een sportabonnement, een leasefiets of uitbetaling. Bonus: IKB telt mee voor je hypotheek, dus jouw droomhuis komt een stap dichterbij. Een vast contract. Deze doelen helpen je om gericht te werken aan je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Post-master: Je volgt een post-masterprogramma aan de Technische Universiteit Eindhoven. Dit programma is speciaal ontworpen om jouw kennis en vaardigheden in Data Science & AI te verdiepen en direct toe te kunnen passen in de praktijk. De 50 dagdelen les vallen binnen jouw 38 uur. De mogelijkheid om mee te doen aan de leukste activiteiten zoals onze skitrip, de wekelijkse bootcamp of festival. In een Mastership bij House of Bèta werk je aan projecten binnen de financiële dienstverlening, bijvoorbeeld bij a.s.r. en Nationale Nederlanden, maar ook binnen de publieke sector, waaronder de Rijksoverheid. Je wordt gedetacheerd voor periodes van gemiddeld 6 tot 12 maanden, waardoor je een breed scala aan ervaringen opdoet en je netwerk uitbreidt. Flexibiliteit is hierbij essentieel, omdat je op verschillende locaties en in diverse teams werkt. Tegelijkertijd volg je een opleiding op post-masterniveau van 3 jaar, gewoon bij ons op kantoor in Utrecht, vanuit de Technische Universiteit Eindhoven. De start van jouw Mastership Je begint dit Mastership met het beste onboardingsprogramma van Nederland. Daarna start je met een operationele opdracht bij één van onze klanten. In deze eerste opdracht leer je hoe complexe organisaties, processen en datasystemen functioneren, leer je over stakeholdermanagement en ontwikkel je organisatiesensitiviteit. Deze informatie en inzichten zijn nodig om je toekomstige analyses goed te kunnen onderbouwen. Als trainee ontwikkel je je gedurende dit Mastership tot bijvoorbeeld Data Scientist, AI Proces Analist, Data & AI Consultant of Business Analist. Met jouw werk maak je impact door banken, pensioenfondsen, verzekeraars of overheidsinstanties te helpen met belangrijke maatschappelijke transities. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de energietransitie en Wet toekomst pensioenen. Wat ga je doen? Tijdens het Mastership Data & AI van House of Bèta ontwikkel je jezelf tot een consultant die organisaties helpt om slimmer, efficiënter en toekomstbestendiger te werken met data en AI. Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken binnen onder andere de financiële sector, overheid en pensioensector, bijvoorbeeld bij organisaties als a.s.r., Nationale-Nederlanden en de Rijksoverheid. Denk aan thema's zoals digitalisering, AI-gedreven procesverbetering, datakwaliteit, compliance en maatschappelijke transities zoals de Wet toekomst pensioenen. In plaats van alleen techniek te leren, leer je vooral hoe je met data en AI echte impact maakt binnen organisaties. Je hebt daarom sterke kennis van data-analyse, data management tools en databases nodig om je werk goed te kunnen doen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan kennis van Python, SQL en Power BI. items.desc: BNP Paribas est un leader européen des services bancaires et financiers, présent à l’international et engagé dans l’accompagnement de ses clients et de l’économie. Au sein de Corporate & Institutional Banking, la transformation par la donnée et l’intelligence artificielle constitue un enjeu majeur pour développer de nouvelles solutions au service des métiers. Au quotidien, ça donne quoi ? Vous rejoindrez Analytics Consulting, le centre d’expertise interne de Corporate & Institutional Banking dédié à la Data, à l’Analytics et à l’Intelligence Artificielle. Rattachée à la direction Data de CIB, l’équipe rassemble environ 60 personnes à Paris et Lisbonne et accompagne principalement les métiers de CIB dans une meilleure compréhension et utilisation de leurs données. Basé à Lisbonne, vous évoluerez dans un environnement international et multiculturel, au contact de spécialistes de la Data, de l’Intelligence Artificielle et des équipes technologiques. Concrètement, Vous Serez Amené à Concevoir et développer des solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle et d’IA agentique : configuration et entraînement de modèles, conception de workflows, traduction des besoins opérationnels en exigences techniques, tests et évaluation des résultats ; Développer, faire évoluer et contribuer au support d’applications internes, en collaboration avec les spécialistes IT et les équipes de développement ; Accompagner les équipes métiers tout au long du cycle de vie des applications et proposer les approches les plus adaptées aux problématiques rencontrées ; Participer à la mise en production, au suivi et à la maintenance des modèles et solutions développés, dans le respect des bonnes pratiques du secteur ; Assurer une veille sur les nouvelles méthodologies, technologies et outils et contribuer à diffuser une culture fondée sur la donnée au sein de CIB. Et après ? Cette expérience vous permettra d’approfondir vos compétences en Data Science et en Intelligence Artificielle, avec une exposition particulière aux nouveaux usages de l’IA et de l’IA agentique. Vous développerez également votre capacité à transformer des problématiques opérationnelles en solutions techniques concrètes, de leur conception jusqu’à leur mise en production. Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe experte et multiculturelle et travaillerez en interaction avec différents métiers, spécialistes technologiques et équipes Data. Cette expérience vous permettra ainsi de développer une vision transverse des enjeux liés à la transformation par la donnée au sein d’une banque internationale. À l’issue de votre mission, les compétences acquises pourront vous permettre d’envisager différentes opportunités au sein du Groupe, notamment dans les domaines de la Data, de l’Intelligence Artificielle et de la transformation digitale, selon les opportunités disponibles. Les avantages à nous rejoindre Et la rémunération ? Fixée par arrêté ministériel, elle est versée mensuellement et se compose de deux éléments : Une indemnité commune, identique pour tous les jeunes en mission. Une indemnité géographique, variable selon le pays et parfois la ville de destination. Cette indemnité est recalculée chaque trimestre. Retrouvez plus d’informations sur le site de Business France. Rejoignez un Groupe engagé auprès de ses clients et de la société, et contribuez activement à notre transformation en faveur d’un monde plus durable. Impliquez-vous à nos côtés, sur votre temps professionnel, grâce à notre programme One Million Hours To Help. Êtes-vous notre prochain VIE Machine Learning Officer H/F ? Vous êtes diplômé d’un BAC +5 en école d’ingénieur ou équivalent universitaire, spécialisé en informatique et/ou en data. Vous souhaitez développer votre expertise dans les domaines de la Data Science, du Machine Learning et de l’Intelligence Artificielle et mettre vos connaissances techniques au service de problématiques opérationnelles concrètes. Vous disposez de connaissances vous permettant de participer à la conception, à l’entraînement, au test et à l’évaluation de modèles d’Intelligence Artificielle. Vous êtes également à l’aise avec le développement de solutions et portez un intérêt particulier aux nouvelles technologies, notamment à l’IA générative et à l’IA agentique. Votre capacité d’analyse vous permettra de comprendre des problématiques métiers et de les traduire en solutions adaptées. Votre organisation vous aidera à intervenir efficacement sur les différentes étapes du cycle de vie des applications et des modèles. Grâce à votre communication et à votre goût pour la collaboration active, vous saurez travailler avec des interlocuteurs aux expertises variées. Enfin, votre adaptabilité sera essentielle pour évoluer dans un domaine technologique en transformation permanente et au sein d’un environnement international. items.desc: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. The Role Join AMD's University Program team in Dublin and help universities across France and Europe use AMD technologies in teaching and research. You will work directly with faculty, researchers, and students, combining hands-on technical support with training, demonstrations, and collaborative projects. You will work across AI, GPU Computing, and High-Performance Computing (HPC), helping academic partners adopt AMD hardware and software technologies in teaching and research. The role offers the opportunity to build long-term relationships with leading universities and research institutions, develop technical content and educational resources, and contribute to initiatives that strengthen engagement between AMD and the academic community. This is a highly collaborative and customer-facing role involving regular travel to universities, research institutions, conferences, workshops, and training events. Travel throughout France and Europe may represent approximately 25% to 50% of the role, with occasional international travel. The Person You are technically curious, comfortable working directly with people, and motivated by helping others solve real-world problems. You can build trust with academic partners, explain technical concepts to a variety of audiences, and take ownership of work from initial discussions through delivery. Fluency in French and professional fluency in English are important for working with partners across the region. You are adaptable, collaborative, organized, and comfortable working independently while working closely with geographically distributed teams. You enjoy learning new technologies and are excited about enabling innovation through teaching, research, and technical collaboration. Key Responsibilities Build technical relationships with faculty, researchers, and students, with a particular focus on France. Help academic partners adopt AMD technologies for teaching and research in AI, GPU Computing, HPC, and related areas. Develop and deliver technical training, workshops, laboratory exercises, demonstrations, design examples, and other educational resources. Collaborate with academic partners on research, teaching, curriculum development, and student-focused programs. Respond to technical questions and help resolve software, hardware, and development-environment issues. Contribute to the evaluation and development of systems and technical solutions for academic use. Collaborate with AMD engineering, software, research, and marketing teams to support academic initiatives. Represent AMD at universities, conferences, workshops, hackathons, and other academic events. Establish and grow long-term engagement plans with key academic partners across the region. Preferred Experience Professional fluency in French and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Familiarity with AI, GPU programming, High-Performance Computing, parallel computing, or related technologies. Experience with AMD GPU software, programming environments, hardware development tools, or computer architecture concepts. Experience developing and delivering technical training, workshops, tutorials, or educational content. Experience with software development, debugging, testing, and technical problem-solving. Experience working in an academic research or teaching environment, or in applications engineering, developer relations, technical customer support, or related technical roles. Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently. Willingness to travel regularly throughout France and Europe Academic Credentials Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred. Equivalent relevant industry or research experience will also be considered. Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. Onder begeleiding van een Senior Consultant leer je stap voor stap hoe je: logistieke en supply-chainprocessen analyseert en verbetert; processen rondom planning, procurement, inventory, warehousing, fulfilment en productie leert doorgronden; klantbehoeften vertaalt naar oplossingen binnen Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management; workshops voorbereidt en uiteindelijk zelf begeleidt; nieuwe processen test, simuleert en helpt implementeren; klanten helpt hun operatie verder te digitaliseren; onderzoekt hoe Copilot, AI-agents en automation kunnen bijdragen aan slimmere supply chains. Denk aan AI die voorraadtekorten helpt voorspellen, planners ondersteunt bij uitzonderingen, vertragingen signaleert of repetitieve operationele taken automatisch opvolgt. Je hoeft dit nog niet te kunnen. Je komt juist bij ons om het te leren. Wat zoeken we? Vooral nieuwsgierigheid naar Supply Chain én technologie . Daarnaast heb je een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Supply Chain Management, Logistiek, Operations Management, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; wil je begrijpen hoe goederen en informatie door organisaties bewegen; ben je analytisch en communicatief sterk; heb je interesse in Microsoft-technologie, digitalisering en AI; krijg je energie van processen analyseren en problemen oplossen; beheers je Nederlands en Engels goed. We verwachten dus niet dat je al ERP-expert bent. We zoeken het talent en de nieuwsgierigheid om er één te worden. Jouw groei Je krijgt vanaf de start een Senior Consultant als buddy en mentor. Via projecten, Microsoft-certificeringen en de HSO Academy ontwikkel je jezelf verder van Young Professional naar Junior en uiteindelijk Medior, Senior of Lead Consultant. Gaandeweg kun je je bijvoorbeeld specialiseren in Planning, Warehouse Management, Manufacturing, Solution Architecture of Supply Chain & AI . Wat bieden we? Je krijgt een salaris van €2.895 tot €3.061 bruto per maand, exclusief 8% vakantiegeld, een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding van €675, laptop en telefoon, 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 10 dagen bij te kopen, hybride werken, workation-mogelijkheden, vitaliteitsbudget, pensioen en vooral veel ruimte om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Klaar om Supply Chain jouw vak te maken? Start je carrière bij HSO en ontdek hoe jij Supply Chain, Microsoft Dynamics 365 en AI kunt combineren om de operatie van organisaties slimmer te maken. Ben jij klaar voor de reis of heb je nog vragen? Neem contact op met Joseph via jyoussef@hso.com.

items.desc: AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ? Vous souhaitez donner du sens aux données et développer des modèles prédictifs qui répondent à des enjeux métiers concrets ? Rejoignez AVISIA et participez à des projets Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée ! Créée en 2007, AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital . Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering et Intelligence Artificielle . Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets stimulants pour faire de la donnée un véritable levier de transformation. Nous accompagnons des clients issus de secteurs variés, notamment le Luxe, le Retail, les Télécoms, la Banque, l’Assurance et l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques allant de l’analyse exploratoire des données à la conception, l’évaluation et l’industrialisation de modèles de Machine Learning. Nos missions en Data Science Chez AVISIA, nous vous proposons des missions qui allient expertise technique, Data Science et compréhension des enjeux business . Selon votre profil, vos compétences et vos affinités, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets variés, de la conception de modèles prédictifs à leur déploiement en production, en passant par l’analyse des données et l’optimisation des performances. L’objectif : concevoir des solutions concrètes, exploiter pleinement le potentiel des données et contribuer directement à la prise de décision de nos clients. Quelques exemples de sujets de Data Scientist du moment : Conception de modèles de prévision du chiffre d'affaires généré sur le site e-commerce d’un retailer. #Prévision Création et industrialisation d’un moteur de recommandation destiné à optimiser la conversion des visiteurs du site web. #Recommandation Création d’un score d’attrition afin d’identifier les clients d’un acteur de la grande distribution en perte de vitesse lente, #Churn Mise en œuvre d’une segmentation client permettant d'optimiser les actions marketing & commerciales d'une enseigne (ciblage, rétention, en fonction des appétences de canaux de contact). #SegmentationClient Les qualités humaines Chez AVISIA, nous recherchons avant tout des talents curieux, impliqués et désireux de progresser. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes ? Vous avez un excellent relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe comme les échanges avec les clients. Vous aimez vous impliquer dans les projets et contribuer concrètement à la réussite des missions. Vous disposez d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, avec la capacité de prendre du recul sur les résultats obtenus. Vous êtes attentif(ve) à la qualité de vos livrables et savez présenter et vulgariser des résultats complexes auprès d’interlocuteurs non techniques. Vous êtes curieux(se), vous vous intéressez aux évolutions de la Data Science et du Machine Learning et aimez explorer de nouvelles approches. Les compétences techniques : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation data à l’université ou en grande école et : Disposez d’une bonne connaissance des principales techniques de modélisation statistique ou de machine learning (Random Forest, XGBoost, K-means, …), Avez une bonne connaissance du SQL, Maîtrisez Python Connaissez l’une des principales solutions logicielles du marché (Dataiku, SAS, Alteryx…), En bonus, vous avez des notions sur les technologies cloud : GCP, AWS, Azure… Le processus de recrutement Vous échangerez tout d’abord avec notre Talent acquisition Leader qui vous invitera à passer un premier entretien au téléphone, en visio ou sur site. Un test technique (QCM et cas pratiques) vous sera envoyé par mail Vous rencontrerez ensuite un consultant senior (manager ou practice leader) idéalement sur site. Des échanges informels avec l’équipe pourront être organisés au besoin pour que vous puissiez en parallèle découvrir votre futur environnement de travail.

items.card: Sujet de stage Vers une supervision intelligente des réseaux optiques WDM , détection préventive des anomalies par Machine Learning Description du stage Nous recherchons notre futur(e) stagiaire pour rejoindre nos équipes internes dans notre Pôle d'Expertise Optique dans le cadre d’un stage de recherche en cybersécurité et télécommunications en 2027. Contexte Les réseaux de transport optique WDM ( Wavelength
items.desc: Sujet de stage Vers une supervision intelligente des réseaux optiques WDM , détection préventive des anomalies par Machine Learning Description du stage Nous recherchons notre futur(e) stagiaire pour rejoindre nos équipes internes dans notre Pôle d'Expertise Optique dans le cadre d’un stage de recherche en cybersécurité et télécommunications en 2027. Contexte Les réseaux de transport optique WDM ( Wavelength Division Multiplexing ) constituent aujourd’hui l’infrastructure essentielle des télécommunications à très haut débit. Leur évolution rapide répond à l’explosion du trafic numérique, portée notamment par les interconnexions de centres de données (DCI), le cloud , l’ edge computing , la 5G, l’intelligence artificielle et le calcul haute performance (HPC). Ces nouveaux usages nécessitent des réseaux toujours plus performants, offrant davantage de capacité, de flexibilité, de résilience et une faible latence. Pour y répondre, les architectures WDM traditionnelles évoluent vers des solutions flex-grid , permettant une gestion plus dynamique et optimisée du spectre. Dans ce contexte, IMS Networks assure la supervision, la maintenance et la continuité de service de ces infrastructures. Son rôle consiste à garantir leur disponibilité et leurs performances, tout en anticipant les anomalies et en intervenant rapidement en cas d’incident. Missions Ce stage s’inscrit au cœur de l’innovation dans la supervision des réseaux optiques WDM, avec pour ambition de transformer la manière dont les incidents sont détectés et traités . Le/la stagiaire interviendra sur l’observabilité des réseaux, en développant des méthodes pour collecter, centraliser et analyser intelligemment les données issues des équipements et systèmes de supervision. L’objectif est de passer d’une surveillance réactive à une supervision proactive , capable d’anticiper les dégradations et incidents, et de les gérer de manière automatisée et optimisée. À travers cette mission, le/la stagiaire contribuera à faire des flux de données un véritable levier d’intelligence opérationnelle, améliorant à la fois la réactivité, la résilience et la performance des infrastructures critiques, et explorera des solutions innovantes pour les architectures flex-grid et la gestion dynamique de la capacité spectrale. Les objectifs seront les suivants : Collecter et traiter rapidement les données de supervision WDM via les API (1830 PSS, WSNOC) ; Automatiser l’analyse grâce à des scripts Python pour la collecte, le prétraitement et la visualisation des données ; Appliquer le Machine Learning pour : (*) Détecter rapidement les anomalies optiques ; (*) Corréler les alarmes et réduire les alertes redondantes ; (*) Surveiller les variations progressives des paramètres optiques (OSNR, BER, puissance, facteur de qualité) afin d’anticiper les dégradations et optimiser la performance du réseau. Ainsi, vous réaliserez des : Scripts Python opérationnels pour la supervision WDM ; Modèles ML pour détection préventive et corrélation d’alarmes ; Tableau de bord synthétique et alertes exploitables ; Rapport technique et démonstrateur fonctionnel. Ce stage se déroulera sur notre site de Castres (81). Profil recherché Vous êtes étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou école d’ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou Télécommunications (principalement réseaux optiques) et vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études en 2027 de 6 mois Vos connaissances en machine learning , vous permettent de mieux appréhender : (*) Détection d’anomalies non supervisée (Isolation Forest, Autoencoders, One-Class SVM) (*) Clustering et corrélation d’alarmes (K-Means, DBSCAN) ; (*) Régression et prédiction de dérives lentes sur les paramètres optiques Vous êtes à l'aise avec Python pour le développement de scripts, l’automatisation et l’interaction avec des API REST/JSON Des connaissances en réseaux optiques WDM seraient appréciées Vous êtes capable de rédiger des documents techniques clairs et structurés, adaptés à un contexte industriel et scientifique Un niveau d’anglais professionnel est requis pour lire, rédiger et communiquer efficacement à l’écrit comme à l’oral avec des équipes internationales Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre esprit d’équipe Venez réaliser votre stage de fin d'études au sein du Pôle d'Expertise Optique d'IMS Networks !

items.desc: Een monteur die het juiste gereedschap niet kan vinden, verliest tijd. Daarom werken werkplaatsen over de hele wereld met gereedschap, kasten en opbergsystemen die alles overzichtelijk houden. Dat gaat van de garage om de hoek en de technische dienst van een groot ziekenhuis tot magazijnteams en industriële monteurs in het buitenland. Achter al die werkplaatsen staat een commerciële organisatie die op data draait. Zit jij het liefst zelf met je handen in die data en zet je AI in om het hele commerciële proces slimmer te maken? Dan is deze rol echt iets voor jou. Vertel verder... Werkplaatsen en magazijnen in tientallen landen werken met hun producten. Zo maken ze het werk van monteurs en technici net een stukje makkelijker. Wat ooit begon als een bescheiden productiebedrijf, is nu een snelgroeiende, internationale speler. Ze houden van aanpakken: geen onnodige lagen, wel korte lijnen en een team dat elkaar versterkt. Die groei levert steeds meer leads, deals en klantinformatie op, dus ook steeds meer data om slim mee te werken. Daarom zoeken ze iemand die de commerciële teams helpt om het maximale uit data, CRM en AI te halen. Oké, en wat ga ik dan precies doen? Je duikt zelf de data in. Je bereidt data-imports voor, schoont datasets op, structureert en mapt gegevens en zorgt dat de commerciële data in HubSpot betrouwbaar is. Op die basis bouw je dashboards en rapportages over leads, salesactiviteiten, conversie en de pipeline. Je blijft niet hangen bij het opleveren van cijfers: je ziet trends, afwijkingen en kansen, zoekt uit wat erachter zit en maakt daar concrete verbetervoorstellen van. Sales, support en marketing gebruiken jouw inzichten om betere keuzes te maken. Het effect van je werk zie je dus direct terug. Daarnaast ben je het aanspreekpunt voor de HubSpot-omgeving waar de hele commerciële organisatie dagelijks mee werkt. AI is in deze rol geen bijzaak, maar een vast onderdeel van je werk. Je zet AI-tools en automatisering zelf in om analyses te versnellen, data sneller te verwerken en terugkerende taken uit handen te nemen. Je onderzoekt waar slimme oplossingen processen, pipelines en workflows efficiënter maken, test nieuwe functionaliteiten en voert ze ook daadwerkelijk in. Je helpt bij koppelingen tussen systemen, neemt collega’s mee in nieuwe werkwijzen en houdt de documentatie bij. Zo bouw je in korte tijd een stevige basis op in data, AI en Revenue Operations, kennis waar steeds meer vraag naar is. Ik wil het, maar kan ik het ook? Je hebt een hbo werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in Commerciële Economie, Bedrijfskunde of Business Analytics. Je hebt minimaal één jaar hands-on ervaring met data, bijvoorbeeld als data-analist, in commercial operations, sales support of CRM-beheer. Belangrijk is dat je daarin zelf met datasets aan de slag ging: opschonen, analyseren en vertalen naar dashboards of rapportages. Je werkt soepel met Excel en hebt ervaring met BI-tools zoals Power BI. Ervaring met HubSpot of een ander CRM-systeem is een pre. Je hebt een duidelijke affiniteit met AI en laat dat ook in de praktijk zien. Je gebruikt AI-tools al actief om analyses te versnellen, data te verwerken of processen te automatiseren, dus voor meer dan alleen een tekstje. Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen op de voet en zoekt graag uit wat ze voor een commerciële organisatie kunnen betekenen. Verder werk je nauwkeurig, zelfstandig en proactief, vertaal je een vraag van een collega zonder moeite naar een praktische oplossing en kun je helder uitleggen hoe iets werkt. Nederlands en Engels spreek en schrijf je goed. Wat krijg ik terug? Een salaris tussen €38.000 en €47.000 bruto per jaar op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Je werkt vanuit een modern hoofdkantoor, binnen een organisatie die je volop de ruimte geeft om mee te groeien. Verder krijg je een maandelijkse pensioenbijdrage, kun je voordelig een fiets leasen en krijg je korting op je sportschoolabonnement. Op vrijdag eet je gratis mee met de lunch, elke dag staan vers fruit en gekoelde drankjes voor je klaar en je profiteert van hoge personeelskortingen. Wil jij met data en AI een hele commerciële organisatie vooruit helpen? Solliciteer direct en wie weet drinken we snel een kop koffie! To our foreign friends, speaking Dutch is a must for this role. Please don’t apply if you’re not fluent in Dutch.

Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. En tant que stagiaire Data Scientist, tu seras responsable de : La réalisation de projets de données (sécurisation de la livraison de vos projets) La communication de ton travail et réalisations au sein de l’équipe Travailler en étroite collaboration avec ton homologue conseil pour établir et entretenir des relations solides avec vos clients et mieux comprendre leurs besoins S’assurer que tes solutions apportent des valeurs à la problématique client Rechercher et développer de nouvelles approches techniques pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes Partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer aux connaissances institutionnelles d’Artefact Tu es ? Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques appliquées, Statistiques ou Informatique. Tu es à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027. Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème numérique et data et de ses technologies : web analytique, programmatique, DMP, Datalake, dataviz, data science, etc. Tu as un fort intérêt pour les problématiques business. Tu as un esprit pratique et analytique, et possèdes d’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes, y compris la capacité de désagréger les problèmes, d’identifier les causes profondes et de recommander des solutions. items.desc: Data Scientist Anti-Financial Crime Als Data Scientist Anti-Financial Crime werk jij actief mee aan het integer houden van de klanten van ASN bank. Je bouwt (AI-)modellen en voert analyses uit die bijdragen aan de betrouwbaarheid van het financiële stelsel. Jouw inzichten zorgen ervoor dat we financiële criminaliteit effectief bestrijden. Zo maak jij met jouw werk een positieve impact op de maatschappij. Wat ga je doen? Je gaat werken aan AI-oplossingen die inzetbaar zijn op het gebied van Anti Financial Crime (AFC). Denk aan de ontwikkeling van modellen voor transactiemonitoring (TM), Know Your Customer (KYC), het verwerken van sanctiewetgeving en meer. Jij ontwikkelt en optimaliseert oplossingen die bankieren bij ASN veiliger maakt voor honderdduizenden klanten. In de praktijk ga je met het volgende aan de slag: Als onderdeel van het team ontwikkel je AI-modellen en data-oplossingen. Je bent bij het hele proces betrokken, van het uitwerken van de use case, het ontwikkelen van het model ontwerp, tot het implementeren en monitoren van het model. Door de grote hoeveelheid klant- en transactiedata eigen te maken ben je snel in staat hier waardevolle inzichten uit te halen. Hierbij bouw je de datapipelines en modellen die nodig zijn om de oplossing te kunnen draaien, van het ophalen van data uit een brontabel tot het opleveren van het eindresultaat van jouw model. Je zet jouw kennis op het gebied van data, modellen en AI in, om binnen AFC geïnformeerde keuzes over modellen te kunnen maken. Je houdt nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en Data Science in de gaten en je krijgt de mogelijkheid om deze kennis zowel intern als extern met collega’s te delen. Bij ASN Bank krijg je de vrijheid én de verantwoordelijkheid om het werk op jouw manier in te vullen. Jij bent eigenaar van jouw oplossingen, van eerste analyse tot werkend model in productie. Je werkt samen met vakgenoten binnen de bank en wisselt kennis uit met je collega’s. Hier kom je te werken Je maakt deel uit van het AI voor Klantintegriteit (AIKI) team binnen de Innovation and Client Remediation (I&CR) afdeling van het Anti-Financial Crime domein. Je werkt in een team van data scientists en -engineers die geavanceerde analyses uitvoeren en AI-modellen ontwikkelen voor het tegengaan van Financial Crime. Daarnaast werk je samen met de value teams die in de operatie gebruik maken van de resultaten van jouw modellen en analyses. AIKI is een hecht, leergierig en ambitieus team. We houden elkaar scherp, maar er is ook ruimte voor humor en eerlijkheid. De sfeer is informeel, innovatief en ondernemend, met als belangrijkste doel om impact te maken met ons werk. Het team komt één of enkele dagen in de week samen op het kantoor in Utrecht om te sparren, te bouwen en successen te vieren, maar er is ook zeker ruimte om thuis te werken. Wat breng jij mee? Jij bent leergierig en geïnteresseerd in complexe data-vraagstukken. Jij begrijpt data en kan de vertaalslag maken van use case, naar data-behoeften, naar een werkend AI model binnen het AFC domein. Je inspireert je collega's en tilt het hele team naar een hoger niveau door nieuwe en verrassende inzichten op tafel te brengen. Samen met je collega's ga je voor nette AI-oplossingen die echt impact maken binnen het AFC domein. Je vindt het belangrijk dat ons financieel stelsel betrouwbaar is en onze klanten beschermd worden tegen financiële criminaliteit. Je signaleert proactief verbeterkansen en onderneemt hierop actie. Door jouw enthousiasme krijg je anderen mee en je deelt graag je kennis met collega's. Verder heb je: Een afgeronde HBO/WO-opleiding in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistiek of een gerelateerd vakgebied Affiniteit met en interesse in het AFC domein Kennis van en ervaring met Python en Kennis van en ervaring met statistiek, ML/AI-modellen en feature engineering Ervaring met het analyseren en opschonen van datasets op een gestructureerde manier (bijvoorbeeld middels data pipelines) Je bent leergierig en geïnteresseerd in de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in AI en AFC en Je kunt complexe problemen analyseren en houdt van een technische uitdaging Je bent flexibel ingesteld en weet je aan te passen aan veranderende omstandigheden en Je bent betrokken, sociaal en een echte teamplayer Kennis van en ervaring met PySpark, Linux, Git, Bash en Cloud (bij voorkeur AWS) en ervaring in het toepassen van responsible/explainable AI Dit krijg je van ons Deze functie valt in schaal 9 met een salarisrange tussen de € 4.552,48 en € 6.069,97 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur per week. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op: Een flexibel in te delen 36-urige werkweek 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand, op een moment dat het jou goed uitkomt Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband: 208,8 uur verlofuren per jaar Een goede collectieve pensioenregeling € 750,- per jaar om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen (te sparen tot € 3.000,-) Elke 5 jaar € 900,- om je thuiswerkplek weer helemaal op orde te maken Een NS-Business Card en een …
