items.desc: Start je carrière op het snijvlak van Finance, technologie en AI Net afgestudeerd en wil je méér dan alleen met cijfers werken? Bij HSO leer je hoe financiële processen écht werken én hoe organisaties technologie inzetten om Finance slimmer, sneller en meer datagedreven te maken. Als Young Professional Finance ontwikkel je jezelf tot Finance Consultant binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365. Je leert niet alleen hoe technologie werkt, maar vooral hoe je financiële vraagstukken begrijpt en vertaalt naar slimme oplossingen. En omdat het Finance-vak verandert, ontdek je vanaf het begin welke rol AI, Copilot, agents en automation daarin spelen. Jouw start bij HSO Je begint met een intensieve Masterclass van 6 weken waarin je de basis legt voor jouw carrière als consultant. Je leert over Microsoft Dynamics 365, Finance-processen, onze projectmethodologie en consulting skills. Je sluit deze periode af met een Microsoft-certificering. Daarna ga je aan de slag in een ervaren projectteam bij één van onze klanten. Onder begeleiding van een Senior Consultant leer je stap voor stap hoe je: financiële processen analyseert en verbetert; werkt met processen rondom onder andere grootboek, inkoop, verkoop, project accounting en reporting; klantbehoeften vertaalt naar oplossingen binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance; workshops voorbereidt en uiteindelijk zelf begeleidt; processen test, simuleert en helpt implementeren; klanten adviseert over digitalisering en procesoptimalisatie; ontdekt waar Copilot, AI-agents en automation Finance-processen slimmer kunnen maken. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan AI die afwijkingen in financiële transacties signaleert, ondersteunt bij forecasting, informatie voor een period-end close analyseert of routinematige Finance-taken automatiseert. Je hoeft dit nog niet te kunnen. Je komt juist bij ons om het te leren. Wat zoeken we? Vooral nieuwsgierigheid naar Finance én technologie . Daarnaast heb je een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Finance & Control, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; wil je begrijpen wat er achter de cijfers van een organisatie gebeurt; ben je analytisch en communicatief sterk; heb je interesse in Microsoft-technologie, digitalisering en AI; vind je het leuk om processen te onderzoeken en problemen op te lossen; beheers je Nederlands en Engels goed. We verwachten dus niet dat je al Dynamics 365-expert bent. We zoeken het talent en de nieuwsgierigheid om er één te worden. Jouw groei Je krijgt vanaf de start een Senior Consultant als buddy en mentor. Via projecten, Microsoft-certificeringen en de HSO Academy ontwikkel je jezelf verder van Young Professional naar Junior en uiteindelijk Medior, Senior of Lead Consultant. Daarbij kun je jouw eigen richting kiezen en je bijvoorbeeld verder specialiseren in Project Accounting, Solution Architecture of Finance & AI . Wat bieden we? Je krijgt een salaris van €2.895 tot €3.061 bruto per maand, exclusief 8% vakantiegeld, een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding van €675, laptop en telefoon, 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 10 dagen bij te kopen, hybride werken, workation-mogelijkheden, vitaliteitsbudget, pensioen en vooral veel ruimte om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Klaar om van Finance jouw vak te maken? Start je carrière bij HSO en ontdek hoe jij Finance, Microsoft Dynamics 365 en AI kunt combineren om organisaties slimmer te laten werken. Ben jij klaar voor de reis of heb je nog vragen? Neem contact op met Joseph via jyoussef@hso.com.

items.desc: Who We Are Oliver Wyman is a global management consultancy working across all areas of industry, financial services, government, and non-profit organizations. Clients approach us with their most significant challenges, and we assemble teams of experts to address each facet of these complex issues. Together, we create breakthroughs that lead to remarkable impact. The Oliver Wyman Data and Analytics (DNA) team is a dynamic and rapidly growing group of quantitative analytics specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across the firm to cover a global footprint, working across multiple industries including, but not limited to, Financial Services, Climate & Sustainability, Energy, Retail, and Transportation. In addition to high-impact analytics projects, the DNA team has a dedicated R&D function made up of Research Fellows and DNA colleagues. The R&D team explores how new tools and ideas across data science, analytics and AI can be applied in industry. We’re offering a 3-6 month placement opportunity within our Retail Solutions team as part of your PhD studies. Retail Solutions is a strategic business unit within Oliver Wyman, combining the agility of a tech startup with deep technical expertise. We tackle intellectually demanding challenges in mathematical optimisation, advanced analytics, and software engineering, translating cutting-edge algorithms into scalable products that help leading retailers answer their most complex commercial questions. Our Values We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and collaborative teams to drive innovation. Our team comes from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we embrace the unique skills and insights they bring to our work. At Oliver Wyman and within DNA, we are proud of the values we uphold that guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. What You Will Do As a DNA Research Fellow, you will work with colleagues at all levels from your first day solving some of the world’s biggest challenges. This will include: Designing solutions for complex problems using the latest research in data science, advanced analytics and AI Implementing prototypes and measuring their effectiveness Engaging in discussions with colleagues to share ideas and show results Your contributions will be crucial for creating cutting-edge products and carrying out advanced research and development within Oliver Wyman. Notable DNA Projects Include Developing an NLP-based machine learning toolkit to predict credit rating downgrades using news articles – click here for more information Exploring novel GenAI architectures and validation methods for customer-facing tools in the financial sector Modelling portfolio decarbonization strategies leveraging advanced analytics techniques for large European banks Identifying supply chain risks by combining multiple live data feeds, and developing and applying a bespoke AI based risk methodology – click here for more information Why Join us? Expect a steep learning curve, as no two weeks are ever the same: You’ll have access to the latest technologies and constantly expand your toolkit with each new endeavour You’ll be working on cutting-edge research applying the latest ideas in AI, data and analytics to real-world problems You’ll be part of a collaborative team, supported by experienced mentors and colleagues throughout your fellowship You’ll have a dedicated buddy and a talent manager to help you navigate your professional path during your placement We care deeply about sustainable work-life quality, providing you with the flexibility to balance your work with your personal life. If you’re excited by challenges and eager to make a meaningful impact, we look forward to welcoming you aboard! Who Can Apply? Current and Post PhD Graduates who are studying in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or, Engineering with capacity for at least a three-month fellowship. items.desc: Om rollen I kundsupportteamet “Klientstöd” utvecklar vi hur människor och AI-assistenter arbetar tillsammans. Vår utgångspunkt är att AI-assistenter är en del av ärendehanteringen och när ett ärende kräver mänsklig bedömning, dialog eller anpassning tar en kollega vid. Rollen kommer att jobba nära kollegornas vardag, där analys, gemensamt lärande och ett bra bemötande hänger ihop. Vårt uppdrag är att stärka egenanställdas och uppdragsanställdas makt över sitt arbete genom ett respektfullt, opartiskt, utbildande och behovsanpassat stöd. Människors förståelse, inflytande och egenmakt styr hur vi använder tekniken. AI-assistenter ska ingå i hanteringen av alla ärendetyper, med mänsklig medverkan när den behövs för att ge rätt stöd. Som analytiker med inriktning mot AI organiserar och strukturerar du arbetet mellan kundsupportens medarbetare och AI-assistenter för att nå våra gemensamma mål. Du bygger upp och utvecklar teamets kunskap och AI-assistenternas kunskapsstöd genom analys, återkoppling och pedagogisk kunskapsdelning. Det är ett löpande arbete där du formar arbetssätten tillsammans med kollegor, utvecklingsteamet och teamledaren. Det här kommer du att arbeta med Samla in kollegornas frågor, erfarenheter och återkoppling och bearbeta och analysera verksamhets- och ärendedata för att hitta behov och förbättringsmöjligheter. Strukturera och utveckla en gemensam kunskapsbank med tillförlitliga data, rutiner och regelverk som är användbara för både kollegor och AI-assistenter. Stärka teamets gemensamma kompetens genom kunskapsdelning, genomgångar och stödmaterial som gör komplexa frågor lättare att förstå. Granska och förbättra AI-svarens saklighet, förklaringar och bemötande. Undersöka om svaren är begripliga och anpassade till mottagarens kunskapsnivå och behov. Organisera och samordna arbetet mellan medarbetare och AI-assistenter utifrån analys av ärendeflöden, köer och servicenivåer, tillsammans med teamledaren. Omsätta analysens slutsatser i konkreta förbättringar och pröva nya arbetssätt tillsammans med kollegorna. Du arbetar med analys och informationskvalitet, men också med hur svar och arbetssätt hjälper människor att förstå och agera. Det handlar om både vad stödet säger och hur det möter mottagaren. Det här behöver du ha med dig Minst tre års relevant erfarenhet av självständigt analysarbete med verksamhetsdata. Du har själv bearbetat och kvalitetssäkrat underlag, dragit slutsatser och lämnat rekommendationer, inte enbart sammanställt färdiga rapporter. Statistisk grundkompetens: du kan välja, tolka och förstå relevanta mått, jämföra grupper och tidsperioder och förstå databrister. Vana att självständigt bearbeta, kombinera och analysera strukturerade underlag och skapa analysflöden som går att återanvända när nya data tillkommer, exempelvis i Power Query eller motsvarande verktyg. Praktisk erfarenhet av att strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data eller information, hantera exempelvis dubbletter och motstridiga uppgifter och skapa spårbarhet till källan. Erfarenhet av att använda egna analyser som underlag för beslut eller förbättrade arbetssätt. Obehindrad svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har Använt språkmodeller i ett arbetsrelaterat analys-, informations- eller förbättringsarbete och kan beskriva din egen insats, underlaget och hur resultatet kontrollerades. Arbetat med kunskapsbanker eller med att testa och förbättra AI-baserat kunskapsstöd eller AI-flöden. Erfarenhet från eller nära kundservice, support eller operativ ärendehantering. Varit med i en förändringsresa eller ett utvecklingsarbete där nya verktyg, processer eller arbetssätt införts tillsammans med berörda kollegor. Erfarenhet av Power BI eller andra visualiseringsverktyg. Relevant utbildning inom statistik, dataanalys eller närliggande områden. Så tror vi att du arbetar Du är nyfiken på hur människor lär sig och förstår att samma förklaring inte fungerar för alla. Du lyssnar, ställer frågor och anpassar ditt stöd efter mottagarens kunskapsnivå och behov. Du delar gärna kunskap och involverar kollegor när arbetssätt förändras. Vårt uppdrag är utgångspunkten för dina prioriteringar. Du använder data och teknik som verktyg för att skapa bättre stöd, kontrollerar dina slutsatser och uppmärksammar när en effektivisering inte hjälper användarna. Du arbetar metodiskt och är tydlig med vad underlaget faktiskt visar. Hos Frilans Finans Vi gör det möjligt för människor att arbeta uppdragsbaserat och fakturera utan att starta eget företag. Klientstöd hjälper egenanställda i Sverige, Danmark och Norge, och verksamheten satsar även på en plattform för Europa. Vi arbetar enligt TEAL-principer med självstyre och delaktighet. Våra värdeord caretaking, ansvarstagande, möjliggörande och premium tech and knowledge präglar arbetet. För oss innebär det bland annat att möta människor på deras villkor, dela kunskap och ta ansvar för att hitta en väg framåt. Du får möjlighet att påverka vår AI-omställning, arbeta nära …

items.desc: We are recruiting for a Data Scientist to join our growing Data and Technology team at Bristol Airport. Working closely with operational, commercial and corporate stakeholders, you will identify opportunities to use data, advanced analytics and AI to drive better business outcomes. You'll take projects from initial opportunity assessment through to implementation and adoption, ensuring solutions deliver measurable benefits and become embedded within everyday business operations. This role would suit a commercially minded Data Scientist with experience applying data science, advanced analytics or AI to deliver measurable business outcomes. You'll bring strong Python and SQL skills, alongside the ability to translate data into practical solutions that improve performance and support better decision-making. First stage interviews will commence the week of the 7th December 2026. Principle Responsibilities Build effective relationships with operational, commercial and corporate stakeholders to understand their objectives, processes and performance challenges. Translate business needs into clear analytical questions, use cases and measurable outcomes Proactively identify opportunities where data science and AI could improve performance, reduce cost, manage risk or generate revenue. Assess the potential value, feasibility, data requirements and risks of opportunities before recommending investment Develop clear propositions and evidence and effectively communicate this to secure stakeholder sponsorship for data science and AI initiatives Work with the data team to prioritise opportunities based on expected value, strategic alignment, complexity and deliverability Select and apply appropriate statistical, forecasting, optimisation, machine-learning and generative AI techniques to prioritised business problems Undertake focused analysis and experimentation to test assumptions, establish feasibility and determine whether an initiative is likely to deliver value Define baselines, success measures and evaluation methods before developing a solution Develop, test and validate models and AI enabled solutions, clearly documenting their assumptions, limitations and intended use Recommend whether initiatives should proceed, change or stop based on evidence and value. Work with colleagues to embed analytical and AI solutions into operational processes and decision-making. Monitor success measures and usage, refining solutions where evidence requires and communicates lessons learned and opportunities for wider roll out. Comply with organisational data, AI, privacy, security and model-assurance requirements. Overseeing the use of models and AI systems to ensure they are pre-approved and not used beyond agreed scope. Assess and manage risks relating to accuracy, bias, explainability, privacy, security, model drift and inappropriate automation. PERSON SPECIFICATION Essential Experience applying data science, advanced analytics or AI to real-world business problems and delivering measurable benefits Excellent commercial and operational awareness Ability to engage and influence stakeholders, translate business needs into analytical use cases and build support for proposed solutions across both data fluent and non data fluent stakeholders Practical skills in Python and SQL, with experience preparing data, developing models and producing reproducible, well-documented analysis Good knowledge of statistics, forecasting, optimisation, machine learning and generative AI, with the judgement to select proportionate techniques for the problem. Experience defining success measures, testing assumptions and validating solutions against both technical performance and business outcomes Understanding of responsible AI and model governance, including accuracy, bias, explainability, privacy, security, monitoring and human oversight A relevant degree, postgraduate qualification or equivalent professional experience in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, operational research or a related discipline Desirable Experience using Microsoft data and AI technologies, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, Power BI or related Azure services Experience with generative AI, large language models, natural-language processing or computer vision For full details please refer to the Role Profile attached. Why Bristol Airport? Bristol Airport is a dynamic, uniue business looking to bring in a number of new data focussed positions. This is the first of these roles enabling you to really make a difference and direct how we approach our Intellegent Airport Ambitions. In addition we have a wide range of benefits to support you in and out of work, including: Discretionary bonus scheme Flexitime and hybrid working Salary sacrifice pension, matching plus 2% upto 9% Private medical insurance including dental and the option to add dependents Life Assurance and Group income protection Comprehensive family friendly policies …

items.desc: The Centre on Sustainable Energy (SE) supports the development of devices and methods for generation, storage, and distribution of energy solutions at low environmental impact. This will be done in the perspective of energy sustainability, of systems and solutions that respect the environment and the quality of life, of solutions with a lower impact on health and on environmental pollution levels. The ground for the Centre on “Sustainable Energy” is based on the Decarbonization targets, which will demand for more flexibility of the energy system, through new gas and power grids and using energy vectors and storage solutions, as enablers for the wide penetration of renewables. The Battery and Electrification Technologies (BET) Unit targets the development and optimal use of battery technologies in both mobility and stationary applications. BET focuses on current and upcoming battery and storage technologies (e.g., LIBs, SSBs, RFBs, HESS) working on a wide range of topics from material development and characterisation to demonstration activities in relevant environment, including of course modelling and optimal management. Job Description The position concerns the modelling, optimisation, and advanced management of battery energy storage systems (BESS) and more in general energy storage systems (ESS) and their interaction with the power grid. The succesful candidate will work in the Battery and Electrification Technologies (BET) Unit, supporting both European and national projects. The position is offered within the Horizon Europe project SMART-ESS (Smart Multi-Layer AI-Based Resilient Twin for Advanced Control of Energy Storage Systems), which develops and demonstrates advanced modelling, hybrid AI control, and digital twin technologies to improve the performance, flexibility, and integration of energy storage systems into power grids. The activities of the successful candidate will focus on: Developing and parametrising physics-based battery models, including electrochemical models, to represent battery performance, operating conditions, and degradation; Developing data-driven and hybrid AI models for battery state estimation, degradation prediction, and real-time applications; Developing and implementing optimisation and energy management strategies for BESS, considering operational constraints, battery degradation, grid requirements, multi-market participation and multi-service provision; Developing and implementing power system models and Optimal Power Flow (OPF)-based optimisation methods to assess the impact of energy storage on grid flexibility and system operation; Supporting the integration of battery models and optimisation algorithms into digital twin platforms and their validation through simulation and real-time testing; Writing technical deliverables, reports, and scientific papers. Job requirements The ideal candidate should have: MSc in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or other relevant fields; Solid knowledge of energy storage technologies, particularly battery energy storage systems (BESS), their operation, modelling, and integration into power systems; Experience in mathematical modelling and simulation of battery systems; Experience in optimisation techniques for energy storage scheduling, energy management, and operational planning; Knowledge of electricity markets, ancillary services, and the role of energy storage in providing grid flexibility; Knowledge of data-driven modelling, machine learning, and their applications to energy storage systems; Familiarity with electrical power system modelling including OPF, grid-constrained optimisation; Ability to analyse simulation and experimental data, identify model parameters, and validate numerical models; Programming skills in Python, MATLAB/Simulink, C++ or other relevant programming languages Ability to write technical reports and scientific papers; Good knowledge of written and spoken English; Ability to manage multiple projects effectively; Ability to work in a collaborative environment, with a strong commitment to achieving assigned objectives; Good communication and interpersonal skills; Self-motivation and result orientation. Furthermore, the following elements will be positively evaluated: PhD degree in fields related to this call; Experience in AI-based and physics-informed modelling techniques, particularly Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), for energy storage applications; Experience with advanced optimisation, such as Model Predictive Control (MPC). Familiarity with digital twin technologies, real-time simulation, and energy management systems; Good knowledge of written and spoken Italian. Employment Type of contract: fixed-term contract Working hours : Full time (38 h per week) Start date : Preferably January 2026 Duration : 24 months with the possibility of extending the contract depending on funding Workplace : Povo (Trento) and Rovereto Gross annual …

items.desc: Hos Capgemini Invent tror vi at ulike perspektiver driver endring. Vi er rådgivere som kombinerer strategi, kreativitet og vitenskap, og vi jobber tett med kundene for å levere løsninger som virker i praksis – i en tid der AI endrer hvordan virksomheter opererer og konkurrerer. Bli med oss og driv endring som svarer på dagens og morgendagens utfordringer: forankret i data og vitenskap, drevet av kreativitet og design, og støttet av teknologi med et klart formål. Din rolle Vi søker konsulenter til vår voksende Intelligent Industry-avdeling i Capgemini Invent, med kontorer i Oslo og Stavanger. Som konsulent innen data, analyse og AI vil du arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom forretning, data og teknologi – og hjelpe kunder med å gjøre data og AI til en reell strategisk ressurs. Du vil ha direkte eksponering mot beslutningstakere hos kundene våre og ta eierskap til leveranser med høy strategisk verdi. Rollen gir stor grad av ansvar og variasjon, på tvers av bransjer og prosjekttyper, fra datastrategi og analyse til AI-drevne løsninger, og i tett samarbeid med eksperter innen AI, design og teknologi. Typiske prosjekter og oppgaver du vil jobbe med: Lede eller bidra i datastrategiprosjekter, inkludert utvikling av styringsmodeller, roller og rammeverk som hjelper kunder med å realisere verdien av data og analyse. Ta ansvar for utvalgte arbeidsstrømmer og leveranser, og samarbeide tett med kunder og interessenter for å sikre fremdrift, kvalitet og forankring. Oversette forretningsmål til konkrete krav, databehov og KPI-er. Rådgi kunder om hvordan de kan bygge moderne dataplattformer og organisere data for bedre innsikt, beslutningsstøtte og verdiskaping. Analysere strukturert og ustrukturert data og bidra i analyse- og innsiktsprosjekter, for eksempel innen rapportering, beslutningsstøtte og datadrevet forretningsforbedring. Samarbeide med data scientists og AI-engineers om å designe og levere AI-løsninger, og holde deg oppdatert på AI-verktøy og -trender for å hjelpe kunder med å velge riktige løsninger. Aktivt bidra til utvikling av vårt data- og AI-tilbud, arbeidsformer og interne kompetansemiljø. Din profil Vi ser etter deg som har: 2+ års erfaring fra data, teknologi, analyse eller konsulentvirksomhet, og mastergrad innen teknologi, økonomi eller tilsvarende. Grunnleggende forståelse for hvordan moderne dataplattformer, analyseverktøy, skyløsninger og AI/maskinlæring understøtter datadrevne beslutninger og verdiskaping. Gjerne erfaring med teknologier som Azure, Fabric, Power BI, AWS, GCP, Snowflake eller Databricks. God forretningsforståelse, og evne til å oversette forretningsutfordringer til konkrete analytiske krav. Sterke kommunikasjonsevner og evne til å formidle tekniske konsepter til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter – du er komfortabel med å presentere. En proaktiv og strukturert tilnærming til problemløsning, trygghet i møte med beslutningstakere, og evne til å skape tydelig verdi og ta eierskap til leveranser i komplekse interessentlandskap. Hva vi tilbyr I Capgemini Invent er det rom til å skape din egen rolle og karriere. Proaktivitet, samarbeid og utvikling er sentrale aspekter som beskriver vårt arbeidsmiljø. Javascript Vara en del i vårt Javascript-team och arbeta med underhåll, vidare- och nyutveckling av vår tjänst Bilprospekt (bilprospekt.se), som är ett prospekteringsverktyg för fordonshandeln. Data Science Vara en del i vårt team som arbetar med att vidareutveckla våra databaser. Du kommer att hjälpa oss med hantering av stor mängd data och att dra slutsatser och göra förutsägelser kopplat till våra tjänster och leveranser som nyttjar den. BI-utvecklare Vara en del av vårt BI-team och arbeta med att utveckla och underhålla vår Power BI-plattform. Du kommer att hjälpa oss att omvandla rådata till användbara insikter genom att skapa rapporter och datamodeller som bidrar till bättre affärsbeslut. Om dig Vi ser grit som ett personlighetsdrag som återfinns i personer som kämpar, inte ger upp och oftast lyckas - trots att förutsättningarna inte alltid är optimala. Detta är något som vi gärna ser i människorna som jobbar i våra bolag. Du har en prestigelös ”get things done”-attityd och vill se hur ditt arbete bidrar till verksamhetens övergripande mål. Lång erfarenhet av att ta emot LIA-studenter Vi på Bilvision har stor erfarenhet att ta hand om LIA-studenter från olika yrkeshögskolor. Vi sätter stort värde i detta och flera av studenterna har fått jobba och jobbar kvar på Bilvision eller något av våra systerbolag inom Movement Software-gruppen. Är du nyfiken på att veta mer om deras erfarenheter, möt några av dem här. Det här låter kul, hur går jag vidare? Intresserad? Bra, då är vi intresserade av att veta mer om dig! Skicka in din intresseanmälan genom att klicka på knappen nedan. Skriv lite om dig själv, varför Bilvision låter intressant och vad du skulle vara intresserad av att göra på din LIA hos oss. För oss är det viktigt att man trivs bra både i teamet och med de arbetsuppgifterna man har. Därför tar vi seriöst på processen att matcha studenter med uppdrag hos oss – vi vill helt enkelt att du lyckas! Det här innebär att vi kommer att göra urval lite som vid en rekrytering, med intervjuer (fast vi föredrar avslappnade samtal, så du kan skippa slipsen), och kanske något test. Varmt välkommen med din intresseanmälan! Har du frågor eller funderingar? Kontakta Elin Adolfsson, People & Talent Specialist på Movement Software. Vilka vi är Bilvision är ett framåtsträvande specialistbolag som utvecklar ledande informationstjänster för den svenska fordonsbranschen. Vi gör vardagen smidigare och smartare för våra kunder, genom att täcka flera led i deras dagliga verksamheter – allt från fordonsinformation till uppföljning. På Bilvision jobbar närmare 30 medarbetare med stor kreativ frihet. Vi uppmuntrar nytänkande och innovativ anda i våra team; utveckling, kundsupport och sälj. Här ges du möjligheten att lägga din skapande kraft till en redan framgångsrik produktportfölj. En del av Movement Software Bilvision är en del av Movement Software (tidigare Progrits) – en Nordeuropeisk mjukvarukoncern med ett tjugotal entreprenörsdrivna bolag inom tre affärsområden; digitala fordonslösningar, transport & logistik samt offentlig sektor. Sedan 2023 är Movement Software en del av Axcel, ett nordiskt riskkapitalbolag med stort intresse för tech-sektorn. Att vara en del av Movement Software innebär ökade möjligheter för utveckling både för oss som företag och för de anställda, och samtidigt större trygghet. Är du som oss, tror vi att du vill känna meningsfullhet på jobbet – och vara med om att göra Bilvision till ett ännu bättre och roligare ställe att jobba på. För roligt är viktigt – jobbet är en för stor del av livet för att inte ha kul. Bilvision tillhandahåller Sveriges ledande informationsförmedlingstjänst för fordonsbranschen. Tillsammans med våra användare gör vi vardagen i branschen enklare.

items.desc: Hos Capgemini Invent tror vi at ulike perspektiver driver endring. Vi er rådgivere som kombinerer strategi, kreativitet og vitenskap, og vi jobber tett med kundene for å levere løsninger som virker i praksis – i en tid der AI endrer hvordan virksomheter opererer og konkurrerer. Bli med oss og driv endring som svarer på dagens og morgendagens utfordringer: forankret i data og vitenskap, drevet av kreativitet og design, og støttet av teknologi med et klart formål. Din rolle Vi søker konsulenter til vår voksende Intelligent Industry-avdeling i Capgemini Invent, med kontorer i Oslo og Stavanger. Som konsulent innen data, analyse og AI vil du arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom forretning, data og teknologi – og hjelpe kunder med å gjøre data og AI til en reell strategisk ressurs. Du vil ha direkte eksponering mot beslutningstakere hos kundene våre og ta eierskap til leveranser med høy strategisk verdi. Rollen gir stor grad av ansvar og variasjon, på tvers av bransjer og prosjekttyper, fra datastrategi og analyse til AI-drevne løsninger, og i tett samarbeid med eksperter innen AI, design og teknologi. Ta ansvar for utvalgte arbeidsstrømmer og leveranser, og samarbeide tett med kunder og interessenter for å sikre fremdrift, kvalitet og forankring. Oversette forretningsmål til konkrete krav, databehov og KPI-er. Rådgi kunder om hvordan de kan bygge moderne dataplattformer og organisere data for bedre innsikt, beslutningsstøtte og verdiskaping. Analysere strukturert og ustrukturert data og bidra i analyse- og innsiktsprosjekter, for eksempel innen rapportering, beslutningsstøtte og datadrevet forretningsforbedring. Samarbeide med data scientists og AI-engineers om å designe og levere AI-løsninger, og holde deg oppdatert på AI-verktøy og -trender for å hjelpe kunder med å velge riktige løsninger. items.desc: Over Rensa Family Rensa Family is een toonaangevend technisch handelsbureau in de Nederlandse installatiebranche. Met circa 1600 medewerkers levert de organisatie dagelijks installatiematerialen aan installateurs. De stage wordt uitgevoerd bij Rensa Family Company, waar de centrale diensten worden verzorgd voor alle bedrijven binnen de Rensa Family. Wat ga je doen? Data vormt een belangrijke pijler binnen de organisatie en wordt intensief gebruikt voor rapportages en stuurinformatie via Power BI. Binnen het BI‑team wordt continu gewerkt aan het verbeteren van datakwaliteit, datamodellen en inzichten. In voorbereiding op toekomstige ontwikkelingen wil Rensa Family haar data‑omgeving geschikt maken voor het verantwoord en effectief inzetten van AI‑toepassingen binnen Business Intelligence. Tijdens Deze Afstudeerstage Werk Je Aan De AI Readiness Van De BI‑omgeving, Met Focus Op Het Gebruik Van Data Door Het BI‑team En Power BI‑gebruikers. De Nadruk Ligt Niet Alleen Op Het Onderzoeken, Maar Vooral Op Het Voorbereiden, Analyseren En Verbeteren Van Data Zodat Deze Geschikt Wordt Voor Toekomstige AI‑toepassingen. Jij Gaat Dit Verder Uitwerken Door Datakwaliteit, structuur en consistentie te analyseren Te beoordelen in hoeverre de huidige datasets, modellen en definities AI‑geschikt zijn Concrete verbeteringen en richtlijnen uit te werken voor AI‑ready data Daarnaast onderzoek je hoe BI-specialisten en Power BI-gebruikers AI-functionaliteiten kunnen benutten om vragen te stellen over data, datatransformatie, analyse en visualisatie, en hoe AI het ontwikkelproces kan versnellen. Wat is het doel? Inzicht krijgen in de huidige mate van AI‑readiness van de BI‑data Het identificeren van concrete verbeterpunten op het gebied van datakwaliteit, modellering en standaardisatie Het voorbereiden van datasets en datamodellen zodat deze geschikt zijn voor AI‑gedreven analyses Het opleveren van praktische richtlijnen, aanbevelingen en eventuele proof‑of‑concepts voor AI‑gebruik binnen Power BI Wat is je profiel? Je volgt een HBO‑opleiding in de richting van IT, Data, BI of Analytics Je hebt interesse in datakwaliteit, datamodellering en de toepassing van AI binnen BI Je kunt zelfstandig analyseren en werkt gestructureerd toe naar concrete verbeteringen en adviezen Wat bieden wij jou? Swipe om de arbeidsvoorwaarden te bekijken Werken binnen het Microsoft Azure‑landschap, onder andere met Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Warehouse en Power BI. Programmeren met T-SQL, Python en DAX. Begeleiding door een ervaren BI‑professional uit het BI‑team. Samenwerken in een betrokken en multidisciplinair team van zes collega’s (vier developers, een product owner en een business analyst). Werken volgens de SCRUM‑methodiek. Een kijkje achter de schermen bij een moderne, datagedreven familieorganisatie. Ruimte om inhoudelijk impact te maken op de datavolwassenheid van de organisatie Waarom jij moet solliciteren! Je werkt aan een toekomstgericht onderwerp met directe impact op hoe de organisatie met data en AI omgaat. De verbeteringen die jij doorvoert zorgen ervoor dat de BI‑omgeving daadwerkelijk klaar wordt gemaakt voor AI‑toepassingen. Daarmee lever je een zichtbare en structurele bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van datagedreven werken binnen Rensa Family.

items.desc: A tua próxima oportunidade começa aqui. Na Aubay Portugal, trabalhamos diariamente com algumas das maiores organizações em setores como banca, seguros, telecomunicações e energia, ajudando a construir e evoluir sistemas críticos que suportam milhões de utilizadores. Estamos em Portugal desde 2007 e fazemos parte de um grupo internacional com presença em vários países europeus. Mais do que simplesmente fornecer tecnologia, estabelecemos relações estreitas e concretizamos projetos com um impacto real. O que vais fazer? Desenvolver e implementar aceleradores tecnológicos para otimizar o desempenho e a eficiência dos sistemas; Impulsionar iniciativas de automatização para os produtos TIBCO TDV e BPM, garantindo operações mais eficientes; Contribuir ativamente para a evolução dos sistemas, abraçando novos desafios e integrando soluções avançadas. O que procuramos? Na Aubay, procuramos profissionais que combinem competências técnicas sólidas com a atitude certa: +3 anos de experiência comprovada como Software/Web Developer, com forte domínio em Python, JavaScript e SQL; Conhecimentos práticos sólidos de Unix como utilizador e experiência com comandos Linux; Familiaridade com Agentes AI, Prompt Skills e MCPs, ou uma forte apetência e vontade de aprender sobre agentes, LLMs e as suas aplicações; Atitude proativa e um desejo genuíno de explorar, inovar e implementar novas soluções e tecnologias; Fluência obrigatória em Português e bons conhecimentos de Inglês; Valorizamos pessoas que se identifiquem com a nossa cultura, atuem com integridade e ética; Privilegiamos orientação para o cliente, trabalho em equipa, priorização de tarefas e compromisso diário. O que temos para te oferecer? Na Aubay, apostamos no teu desenvolvimento e no teu bem-estar: Crescimento contínuo através da nossa Academia de Formação, com formações técnicas e comportamentais, mentoring, comunidades tecnológicas, workshops e meetups de tecnologia presenciais; Acompanhamento próximo com momentos regulares de feedback e um modelo de progressão de carreira estruturado; Seguro de saúde completo, incluindo cobertura de estomatologia, bem como acesso a uma plataforma de saúde mental e iniciativas de bem-estar; Ambiente de equipa com eventos e iniciativas que promovem a proximidade e o espírito de equipa; Apoio à tua vida pessoal e familiar, desde o nascimento dos teus filhos até ao percurso escolar; Acesso a plataforma de línguas com aulas de conversação em vários idiomas; Modelo de trabalho ajustado ao projeto: híbrido (1 dia por semana presencial em Lisboa). O que vais encontrar aqui? Um ambiente próximo e informal, onde a comunicação é direta e as pessoas são valorizadas; Reconhecimento pelo teu contributo, com iniciativas que marcam os momentos importantes; Liberdade para seres autêntico, sem formalismos desnecessários; Equipas que partilham conhecimento, colaboram e crescem em conjunto. Se procuras mais do que um projeto e queres fazer parte de uma equipa onde podes evoluir de forma consistente, envia-nos o teu CV. O futuro está à tua espera e nós também! Vamos falar? Os dados pessoais recolhidos pela AUBAY PORTUGAL SA relativos à identificação, contacto e habilitação dos candidatos, enquanto responsável pelo tratamento e do co-responsável de tratamento usado no âmbito do presente procedimento, serão utilizados para efeitos de Candidatura para integração na equipa, considerando que os mesmos se destinam à execução de diligências pré-contratuais a pedido do titular dos dados; Os dados remetidos através da presente aplicação, detido pela AUBAY serão mantidos durante o processo de recrutamento em curso, e serão guardados para as finalidades indicadas, enquanto considerados atualizados (dois anos). Os dados recolhidos poderão ser transmitidos ou incluir outras atividades de tratamento, mediante informação do respetivo titular, na decorrência normal de um processo de recrutamento e seleção, podendo igualmente vir a ser conservados para o cumprimento de quaisquer obrigações legais, pelo prazo previsto na legislação aplicável. Para o exercício de qualquer direito relativo à proteção de dados pessoais, pode contactar a AUBAY PORTUGAL, com sede na Avenida Duque D'Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa ou o Encarregado de Proteção de Dados através do seu e-mail dpo@aubay.pt, podendo ainda exercer os seus direitos junto da Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados competente – www.cnpd.pt. items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Location/Division Specific Information: Olink, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease. We are currently seeking a Data Scientist to join our Data Science Development team. As part of the Data Science Development team in Uppsala R&D, you will contribute to advancing data analysis capabilities for both external and internal use. This role offers the opportunity to work across the full product lifecycle, from concept development through post-launch support, applying cutting-edge data science and bioinformatics expertise. A Day in the Life: Develop methods and tools for data analysis for external and internal use. Participate in the development of new products through all phases from concept development to post product launch. Participate in research and development of concept design, product ideas and products in accordance with project plans and work schedules. Develop and improve quality control methods. Assist in quality control and troubleshooting of data issues. Develop solutions for monitoring and analysis of QC parameters to ensure quality in products and processes. Participate in the development of future bioinformatic and data analytics solutions for internal use. Organize internal training in programming, data analysis, and QC of data. Provide study design and advanced data analysis expertise and support to other departments. Requirements: MSc or PhD in Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Molecular Biology or similar. Advanced degree plus 2 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree plus 4 years, in data science or a related field. Experience integrating, harmonizing, and analyzing complex data in life sciences, biotechnology, biopharma, healthcare, clinical research, diagnostics, or laboratory environments. Advanced proficiency in R, Python, and SQL, for data processing, transformation, analysis, and automation. Moderate experience in applying statistical methods in medical or biological research, especially with data from high throughput technologies in proteomics and genomics Experience with cloud and scalable analytics platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Spark, Databricks) and DevOps/version control (Git). Demonstrated strong communication skills, both oral and written in English. To succeed in this role, you need to have a strong analytical mind and an interest in modern statistical and data analysis methods including machine learning. It is also important to have the ability to translate complex scientific and business problems into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts effectively to scientific, technical, and non-technical stakeholders. If you enjoy solving challenging problems, don't mind working both independently and in collaboration with others and stay current with emerging technologies, we are looking forward to meeting you! Why Join Us? At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career. Come aboard and contribute significantly to global health and safety! The last day for applications is on the 6th of December.

Daarnaast wordt gekeken in hoeverre deze beschikbaarheid, bruikbaarheid en toepasbaarheid verschilt tussen Europese landen en dus in hoeverre deze technieken bruikbaar zijn voor universele Europese modellen. Dit krijg je €800 Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd 36 uur Dit bieden we nog meer Naast het salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,50% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaal vriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Als kennisinstituut van de overheid op het gebied van volksgezondheid, voeding, milieu en veiligheid vervult het RIVM de rol van betrouwbare adviseur. In deze rol ondersteunt het RIVM burgers, professionals en overheden bij de uitdaging onszelf en onze leefomgeving gezond te houden. Het RIVM voert kennisintensieve taken uit zoals het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma, de Bevolkingsonderzoeken en CBRN (Chemische, Biologische, Radiologische, Nucleaire) crises en verricht daartoe zelf onderzoek, maar verzamelt ook wereldwijd kennis en past die toe. Het RIVM brengt jaarlijks een groot aantal kennisproducten uit: publicaties, adviezen, rapporten en factsheets. Het RIVM kiest positie midden in de maatschappij, om zo iets te betekenen voor anderen – voor opdrachtgevers, voor netwerk- en ketenpartners en voor de maatschappij als geheel. Deskundig, betrouwbaar en waakzaam zijn belangrijke kernwaarden, naast onafhankelijk, omgevingsbewust, dienend en verbindend. Tevens adviseert de afdeling over de wenselijkheid en invulling van gezondheidsonderzoek en psychosociaal crisismanagement bij (langslepende) crises en rampen, in nauw overleg met lokale partners en met VWS. Over RIVM RIVM: deskundig, betrouwbaar en onafhankelijk Als Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) zijn we een deskundige, betrouwbare en onafhankelijke adviseur voor overheid, professionals en burgers. Ons doel: een gezonde bevolking en een duurzame, veilige en gezonde leefomgeving. We bewaken gezondheid, ziekten, de kwaliteit van de leefomgeving én het milieu. Daarvoor doen we onderzoek en we verzamelen kennis voor toegankelijke informatie en toepasbare adviezen. Het RIVM zorgt voor een goede geboortescreening, het bestrijden van infectieziekten en heeft een centrale rol bij het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma en de bevolkingsonderzoeken. items.desc: Role Purpose The Team The AI Team, part of Front Office Technology, builds the AI tools and platforms used across the front office: assistants and agents for investment teams, secure access to firm data and knowledge, and the controls that let AI be used safely in a regulated trading environment. We build central capabilities for the whole firm and support teams across the business as they build their own, bringing the most successful into Technology ownership as they grow in importance. The Role As an AI Engineer with a focused on optimisation, you will build and run the AI tools and platforms used across the front office, and make sure the firm gets the most value from its AI spend. You will design and deliver central AI services, assistants and agents for PMs, traders and researchers, while making AI usage more efficient across providers and teams. A key area is moving suitable workloads onto open-weight models served on our own GPUs, fine-tuned where needed, at a fraction of the cost of external APIs. The team is small and priorities shift as the firm’s use of AI grows. You will be expected to pick up other priorities across the team as they arise, so this role will not be dedicated solely to cost optimisation. Why Join Build AI tools used in live investment workflows, and help the firm run its own models on its own GPUs. Join an AI function with a real mandate and the backing to shape how AI is built across the firm. Work with current frontier AI tooling in a team that values engineering discipline over hype. Key Responsibilities Building front office AI tools Build central platform capabilities such as model access, an AI gateway, MCP services and knowledge retrieval, with entitlements, audit and monitoring built in. Design, build and run AI assistants, agents and services used by PMs, traders, quants and researchers. Self-hosted models Stand up and run production inference for open-weight models on our own GPUs, using engines such as vLLM or SGLang behind OpenAI-compatible APIs. Fine-tune models for specific front office tasks with LoRA and QLoRA, and serve multiple adapters efficiently on shared base models. Apply quantisation (e.g. FP8, AWQ, GPTQ) and serving optimisations such as prefix caching, continuous batching, speculative decoding and tensor parallelism to get the most from each GPU. Benchmark latency and throughput (time to first token, inter-token latency, tokens per second) with tools such as GuideLLM, and plan GPU capacity against service levels. Run inference on Kubernetes with GPU scheduling, autoscaling, and monitoring of GPU utilisation and health. Cost optimisation Route traffic across hosted and self-hosted models through a central gateway such as LiteLLM, sending each workload to the cheapest model that meets its quality bar. Apply cost levers: model right-sizing, prompt caching, batching and context efficiency. Compare the cost and quality of self-hosted and API models per task, and support provider and hardware decisions with evidence. Centralising and reuse Identify AI applications built in the business with real usage or value, and bring them onto central platforms. Turn repeated requirements into shared services, MCP servers, skills and agent templates, reducing duplication across teams and providers. Wider AI engineering Pick up other priorities across the team as they arise, from new front office tools to knowledge services, MCP integrations and data access. Contribute to shared engineering standards, code review and production support. Business outcomes Provide usage, performance and cost metrics from the models and services you run to the colleague responsible for AI spend reporting, so decisions to scale, consolidate or retire AI tools are based on data. items.desc: About Nominal Engineers today are building some of the most ambitious machines humanity has ever seen. They should have AI that’s purpose-built for them. Nominal is building the Hardware Intelligence Platform that gives engineers increased visibility into complex physical systems, helps them make better decisions, and ultimately gets their products into the real world faster. It brings together the systems, data, intelligence, and applications hardware engineering requires to meet the AI moment. Hardware engineering teams use Nominal to simulate, test, manufacture, and operate the physical systems that keep the world moving, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation energy systems and robotics. Our customers span aerospace, defense, manufacturing, transportation, energy, and robotics. They include Anduril, Shield AI, Wisk Aero, Pratt Miller Motorsports, Antares, and Shinkei Systems, amongst others, alongside programs within the U.S. Air Force and Navy. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, Tesla, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software. Some of the world’s leading technology investors, including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Lux Capital, and Insight Partners, are backing Nominal’s ambition to change how machines are built and operated. We’re looking for engineers who want to take on hard problems and help make a new generation of world-changing hardware possible. London is our newest office, and we're building the team that will grow Nominal across the UK and Europe. Mission Operations We’re looking for students with solid engineering fundamentals on track to graduate in Summer 2027 or sooner. As a Mission Ops Engineer, you'll be the person on the ground helping customers deploy Nominal's platform into their test and operations environments — propulsion test stands, satellite mission ops, flight test, and similar high-stakes settings. You'll train users, troubleshoot issues in real time, and build the relationships that turn a deployment into a long-term partnership. 🚀 What you’ll do Own the outcome for a set of customer accounts: run discovery to understand their test problems, align internal and external stakeholders, and deliver solutions that stick, on time and on target Deploy and integrate: write code to ingest and normalize customer data from test stands, DAQs, telemetry streams, and other hardware sources, and build the pipelines and automations that turn that data into decisions Build custom apps, dashboards, and workflows on Nominal's platform for each customer's specific needs Build trusted relationships with everyone from front line engineers and operators to senior executives, and train their teams as they bring Nominal into daily use Debug issues across the stack in real time, and know when to solve something yourself versus pull in the broader team Be the bridge between customers and Nominal's product and engineering teams: translate customer needs and critical dependencies into solutions, and turn patterns you see across customers into clear product input 🎯 We'd love to hear from you if... You're graduating in Summer 2027 or sooner and are interested in a full-time graduate role. You have hands-on experience with hardware systems — test stands, robotics, aerospace, automotive, medical devices, energy systems, or similar — through internships, personal projects, research, or coursework You can write code (Python or similar) to work with real-world data, whether that's parsing sensor logs, building data pipelines, or automating analysis to turn data into decisions You're intellectually curious and think in systems: you see the big picture, still sweat the details, and have a strong intuition for the math and physics behind the hardware You communicate clearly and honestly, in writing and in person, and can explain technical ideas to everyone from front line engineers to senior executives, including people who aren't engineers You bring humility, eagerness to learn, and empathy, and you lift the people around you. You don't just spot problems; you solve them You're comfortable working through open-ended problems in unfamiliar environments, and you can take a technical concept from planning through deployment You're willing to travel occasionally to be on-site with customers You have a genuine interest in hardware testing and the industries Nominal serves ⚡ Bonus Experience with data acquisition or hardware tools (DAQs, LabVIEW, MATLAB/Simulink) or data tools (SQL, Python, Pandas, Grafana) Experience deploying technical software or data products into real-world workflows, whether through an internship, co-op, or capstone project Prior customer-facing, account management, technical …

items.desc: A GK Capital está a recrutar um Quantitative Analyst – Algorithmic Trading (FX) para integrar a SIWA , empresa do portefólio do G-Lock First Fund dedicada à negociação automatizada no mercado cambial. A função tem como objetivo avaliar o desempenho dos algoritmos com dados reais de sinais, ordens e posições, explicar os fatores que afetam a rentabilidade e o risco e testar melhorias às regras de negociação. Principais responsabilidades Avaliar a qualidade dos sinais e o resultado líquido das operações por algoritmo, versão e par cambial. Quantificar o impacto de spreads, comissões, slippage e swaps. Investigar posições que evoluem contra o sinal inicial ou permanecem abertas além do horizonte previsto. Medir as perdas, a duração e a margem utilizada e testar o efeito de fechar mais cedo ou reduzir a posição. Avaliar a exposição agregada por moeda e estratégia, testar cenários de stress e propor limites e alertas operacionais. Analisar o impacto do aumento do volume negociado nos custos de execução. Propor e testar alterações às regras de entrada, saída e dimensionamento das posições. Comparar as propostas com a versão em produção, com custos realistas e validação fora da amostra, e acompanhar o desempenho das alterações aprovadas. A função incide sobre o desempenho dos algoritmos da SIWA. A análise geral de mercado, a elaboração de previsões cambiais próprias e a formulação de uma visão macroeconómica ficam fora do âmbito. Perfil pretendido Formação em Matemática, Estatística, Engenharia, Física, Informática, Finanças Quantitativas ou área equivalente. Domínio de Python e SQL, com experiência em séries temporais e análise de dados de mercado, ordens ou execuções. Conhecimento de custos de negociação e métricas de risco, com capacidade para produzir análises reproduzíveis e recomendações concretas. Será valorizada experiência em FX, backtesting e avaliação de estratégias em produção . Primeiros 90 dias Espera-se a entrega de um painel de desempenho por algoritmo, de um diagnóstico das posições problemáticas e da exposição agregada, e de uma primeira lista de melhorias sustentada por testes. Candidaturas As candidaturas deverão ser submetidas através do LinkedIn, com o respetivo CV.

About the Role Join Ipsos' growing Synthetic Data team and help build the next generation of AI-powered research solutions. Working alongside data scientists, researchers and engineers, you'll explore how synthetic data and digital twins can transform the way insights are generated and delivered. This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of generative AI, applying deep learning and LLM technologies to solve genuine business challenges. You'll be involved in designing and evaluating synthetic datasets, building digital twin applications, developing experimentation frameworks and helping turn emerging technologies into practical tools that can be used across Ipsos. You'll have the freedom to test new ideas, learn from experienced colleagues and contribute to innovation that has real commercial impact. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Desirable Skills Experience within market research, analytics or customer insight environments. Familiarity with deploying machine learning models into production. Exposure to advanced generative AI methodologies. Experience contributing to innovation or R&D projects. Proficiency in AI use and adoption to improve efficiency, experimentation and research outcomes. Behaviours Analytical thinking Creative thinking Curiosity and lifelong learning Resilience, flexibility and agility Motivation and self-awareness Empathy and active listening Service orientation and customer service Benefits We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities. We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We appreciate you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications - please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application. We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme, certified as a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome. Ready to have an impact? Apply now!

items.desc: About The Role What if your curiosity and creative thinking could make AI safer for millions of people? items.desc: Sea Sentinel AI · Munich · Full-Time What we do Sea Sentinel AI is a risk intelligence platform with a focus on the maritime shipping industry. We monitor ports, vessels, and shipping routes worldwide, detecting disruptions before anyone else does. When a vessel crashes, we detect it from a local newspaper hours or days before major media picks it up. When a typhoon is still days away from hitting a port, we warn customers before the chaos starts. This way, we enable our customers to be ahead of crises, rather than reacting to them at the last minute. We sell our intelligence primarily via API, which means our customers integrate it directly into their own systems and workflows. Our rigorous focus has allowed us to build the leading product in this niche. It shows: we consistently win deals with global customers, large and small. We grow because customers pay for what we build. The role Our core data infrastructure, PRISM, is built and proven. Every day it analyzes more than 800,000 news articles alongside weather and other data to find the disruptions that matter to our customers. Owning PRISM. This is your first priority. Keeping PRISM sharp takes two things: solid traditional engineering, and serious prompt tuning backed by evaluations and test harnesses. You'll own this together with the team. Taking PRISM into new verticals. We're ambitious. Next up are other verticals such as air cargo and energy risk intelligence (LNG, oil, gas). You'll identify the master data each vertical needs, benchmark data providers, and make the case for what to integrate and how to integrate it into PRISM. You'll work with structured and unstructured data and form your own views. This is where the role becomes product work: you care whether what you build solves the right problem. Working on a system that’s still moving. PRISM runs on messy, real-world data, and new models change what’s possible every few months. You are encouraged to test your ideas against ambiguous inputs and production conditions where things break, and you’ll decide which new model capabilities are worth adopting. Then you’ll prove it with evals. You won't have a backlog handed to you on Monday morning. You'll be expected to understand the system well enough to know what the most important problems are and go solve them. What we're looking for Must haves: You've run something in production and dealt with it breaking. You know what silent failure looks like and how to find it, using sensible monitoring and alerting. Good coding standards and the judgment to know when to apply them and when to move fast. You drive your own work: you identify problems, prioritize, and see them through without someone telling you what's important. Analytical curiosity. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguous questions, forming hypotheses, and making a case for your conclusions. Real experience tuning LLM systems. You know from experience that a prompt which works well on one model can fall apart on another, or on the same model with slightly different input or settings. You treat model behavior as something to measure, never something to assume. An evaluation mindset. Fixing one case often breaks another, so you build eval sets and regression tests, measure before and after, and only ship a change you can show is a net improvement. Experience monitoring and tracing LLM pipelines in production. The question you should be able to reason about: if the input changes, or we turn this knob up or down, how does the pipeline behave, and what does that mean for our customers and analysts? Experience with AWS, Pulumi or SST. Bonus points for experience in: News data analysis (!), logistics, or energy TypeScript Web scraping (proxies, crawlers, etc.) Structuring or maintaining enterprise-grade APIs We don't expect you to arrive knowing everything. We do expect you to arrive with strong fundamentals, good instincts, and the drive to figure out what you don't yet know. We care more about the right person than the right CV. A sharp, motivated junior and a seasoned engineer can both be the right fit for this role. What we're looking for is curiosity, ownership, and the ability to operate with minimal hand-holding. Compensation reflects experience. What we offer Full ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the founders. When you make a decision, it ships. You'll be a core part of how we expand into new areas, from the research phase through to production. We go where the opportunity actually is. We have strong revenue and we're growing in the areas where we know we can win. We don't chase trends or move into spaces because someone else thinks we should. The roadmap is driven by what our customers need and what the data tells us. A domain worth caring about. Our customers reroute shipments around typhoons, prevent factory shutdowns, and pull cargo out of war zones because we gave them the intelligence to act in time. The work you do will have consequences you can actually …

items.desc: Help build and evolve our platforms that powers Data, Analytics and AI across PostNL. Develop cloud-native platform services, developer tooling and automation that enable teams to innovate faster. As a Software Engineer within our Data, Analytics & AI Platform team, you build the software, tooling and cloud platform that enable our data scientists, analytics engineers and software developers to deliver solutions faster and more reliably. Using modern software engineering practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud technologies, you help create a scalable platform that accelerates innovation across PostNL. Visible work : Your work and our platform is used every day by all PostNL data specialists. You develop reusable platform services, internal developer tooling and automation that simplify how data teams provision environments, deploy applications and manage cloud resources. By improving developer experience and reducing operational complexity, you help teams move from experimentation to production more efficiently to support analytics, machine learning and AI applications across logistics, sorting, customer contact and planning. Challenge : You help develop PostNL’s new Databricks platform while keeping existing AWS-based solutions running. The challenge is to evolve platform capabilities while enabling AI and data teams to develop, deploy and operate their solutions consistently and at scale. Drawing on your understanding of the software lifecycle, you translate platform users’ needs into reusable software, platform services and automation, and explore and integrate new capabilities. Good atmosphere : You work with colleagues who are eager to improve, help each other and enjoy trying new things. You can bring your ideas, learn from others and grow in a supportive team. Flexibility : You work hybrid: partly from home and partly from our modern office in the historic Stationspostgebouw next to The Hague Hollands Spoor. This gives you freedom to organise your week in a way that works for you. Development opportunities : Technology evolves quickly—and so do we. You'll work with modern cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code, Databricks, AWS, GitHub Actions, AI development tooling and developer platform engineering practices. Through the PostNL Academy, conferences and collaboration with experienced colleagues, you'll continue developing both your technical and engineering skills. Your role As a Software Engineer within the Data, Analytics & AI Platform team, you build and maintain the software platform that enables Data Science & AI Engineering teams across PostNL. You develop platform services, internal tooling and automation that make it easier for teams to build, deploy and operate reusable data and AI components. Your focus is on writing high-quality software, improving developer experience and creating reusable platform capabilities. Infrastructure as Code is a key part of your work. Using AWS CDK with typescript you automate the provisioning of cloud infrastructure and platform resources. You contribute to deployment pipelines, project templates and platform components that enable engineers to work consistently and efficiently. Using those insights, you translate engineering best practices into reusable platform capabilities, templates and automation. While you are not responsible for building AI and machine learning models yourself, you understand the lifecycle of Data Science & AI solutions and continuously improve the platform that supports them. Using (IaC) technologies such as AWS CDK and Terraform, you help create the platforms (on AWS and Databricks) that allow engineers to focus on solving business problems instead of managing infrastructure. You work closely with the users of the platform to understand their needs and translate them into scalable platform capabilities. Your colleagues You join the Data Analytics Services team within the Data Center of Excellence. The team includes Platform Software Engineers and Solution Consultants. You work closely with them, as well as with the data scientists and AI engineers who use your platforms every day. The team works in an open, collaborative and innovative way. Wednesday is our office day, when the team comes together in person to collaborate, share knowledge, and connect. Together, we combine engineering excellence, data expertise, and collaboration to make data and AI innovation accessible across PostNL. What we'll deliver A role full of innovation and work that you see reflected throughout the Netherlands. You help shape the logistics e‑commerce platform of the future. You can count on a strong package of employment benefits. Salary between €4,588.87 and €6,498.75 gross per month based on 37 hours (32 hours is also possible). Hybrid working and flexibility in organising your time. If you work from home two or more days a week, you receive a €45 net monthly allowance. 8% holiday allowance and 25 vacation days based on full‑time …

items.desc:
Platform & Pipeline Engineering 
 Develop, automate, and maintain resilient data pipelines connecting on-premises 
 laboratory equipment, high throughput test benches, and edge systems to Microsoft Azure.
 Investigate, unpack, and parse complex, non-standard, binary, proprietary, and undocumented file formats where standard connectors do not exist.
 Implement parsers and normalization routines capable of ingesting diverse technical data streams, for example:
 High-frequency sensor streams, time series, and bus telemetry.
 Multi-dimensional scientific arrays, spatial grids, and spectral data.
 - Hierarchical, nested, and unstructured binary logs or custom ASCII exports.
 Event logs, operational metadata, and intermittent experimental batch runs.
 Clean, validate, and transform fragmented or schema-less raw data into optimized, partitioned Lakehouse tables (Delta Lake/Parquet) ready for analytics and ML model training.
 Deploy, monitor, and maintain pipeline resources on Azure using Terraform, Databricks, and containerized workflows following established team templates.
 Collaboration & Lab Support 
 Work directly alongside experimental scientists, lab engineers, and technicians to decipher raw measurement files, clarify domain-specific semantics, and automate recurring data uploads.
 Collaborate closely with solution architects and senior engineers to implement data ingestion patterns, cataloguing schemas, and governance standards.
 Maintain clear technical documentation, code comments, and onboarding walkthroughs to help research teams connect their equipment seamlessly.
 Support proof-of-concept initiatives exploring metadata integration with corporate AI assistants, data discovery catalogs, and modern data tools.
Education 
 BSc, MSc or Ph.D. in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
 Experience 
 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering, building automated and reliable data pipelines.
 1–2 years of practical experience handling heterogeneous, non-standard, or binary data sources (e.g., physical sensor logs, laboratory exports, hardware telemetry, or raw byte streams).
 1+ years of hands-on experience utilizing Apache Spark (preferably Databricks) and Microsoft Azure in production environments.
 Demonstrated experience deciphering, parsing, or converting non-standard, legacy, or custom data formats into structured data structures.
 Technical Skills 
 Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation (including binary data handling using modules like struct, byte manipulation, NumPy, Pandas, and PySpark) and Bash.
 Solid understanding of modern Lakehouse concepts (Delta Lake), distributed data processing, SQL, and NoSQL/document datastores.
 Proficient with Git, GNU/Linux environments, and working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
 Practical experience with standard transport mechanisms (e.g., REST APIs, SFTP, Kafka/Event Hubs, or IoT/streaming protocols).
 Mindset & Soft Skills 
 Strong analytical mindset with a natural curiosity to open unfamiliar files, inspect headers, and solve data decoding puzzles.
 Friendly, empathetic communication style with the ability to bridge conversations between laboratory technicians, domain scientists, and software teams.
 C2 CEFR level in English, written and spoken.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with scientific/hierarchical file formats (e.g., HDF5, NetCDF, Parquet, Protobuf).
 Familiarity with industrial telemetry or time-series historian protocols (e.g., OPC UA, MQTT).
 Exposure to Azure analytics tooling (Azure Data Factory, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Data Explorer).
 Experience with vectorial databases.
 Languages 
 Fluent in Portuguese.
 B2 CEFR level in English, written and spoken.
 B2 CEFR level in German, written and spoken is a plus

 Challenges in an international environment | career opportunities in one of the best companies in the world | flexible hours | medical services | discounts for employees | sports and health related activities | canteen | good access to public transports | space for creativity.
 Success stories don´t just happen. They are made... 
 Make it happen! We are looking forward to your application!

Pour dépasser les limites de notre calibrage physique actuel, nous explorons des approches basées sur l'apprentissage automatique. L'équipe de recherche a étudié le remplacement de ce calibrage linéaire par une formulation basée sur l'apprentissage automatique, utilisant des arbres de décision à gradient boosté. Cette approche permet d'exploiter un ensemble de variables dérivées de Starwave plus riche et plus expressif. Plusieurs modèles candidats ont été évalués, et un modèle a été sélectionné actuellement pour ses performances prédictives, sa robustesse face à l'hétérogénéité des variables et sa gestion efficace des variables catégorielles. En s’appuyant sur des mesures terrains, vous devrez déterminer et évaluer, en fonction du type d’environnement géographique, les variables utiles qui permettent de mieux décrire la propagation radio. Étape 2 : Dans un deuxième temps, en collaboration avec un alternant en data-sciences, vous fusionnerez les variables explicatives que vous avez trouvées avec celles générées par le modèle historique afin d’évaluer les performances de l’inférence avec des mesures de test. Cadrage du besoin : Comprendre les questions métier et identifier les données géographiques pertinentes. Collecte et exploration des données : Repérer les sources disponibles, évaluer leur qualité, leur couverture et leurs limites Préparation des données : Nettoyage, harmonisation des formats et systèmes de coordonnées, traitement des valeurs manquantes et documentation. Analyse spatiale et statistique : Explorer les tendances, relations et répartitions géographiques à l’aide de méthodes adaptées. Modélisation : Définir et tester des approches de Data Science, puis évaluer leurs performances et leurs limites. Visualisation et restitution : Produire des cartes, tableaux de bord ou synthèses accessibles aux équipes métier. Industrialisation : Contribuer à des scripts ou pipelines reproductibles, éventuellement déployés dans un environnement cloud. Documentation et collaboration : Présenter les résultats, documenter les choix méthodologiques et échanger avec les équipes concernées. Votre formation : Vous préparez un diplôme d’ingénieur ou un Master 2 en Mathématiques Appliquées, Data Science, ou en Informatique/Développement. Vos compétences techniques (Hard Skills) : Une excellente maîtrise de Python et de son écosystème pour l'analyse de données (NumPy, Pandas). De solides bases théoriques et pratiques en Machine Learning (Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow ou PyTorch). Une appétence pour la manipulation de bases de données et de données géographiques est un vrai plus. Vous lisez et comprenez la documentation technique en anglais. Vos qualités (Soft Skills) : Rigueur scientifique et curiosité naturelle pour la recherche expérimentale et le prototypage rapide. Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle pour échanger et co-construire avec d'autres profils. Esprit de synthèse pour restituer simplement des concepts techniques complexes. Ce stage est une opportunité de travailler sur une problématique de recherche avancée. Vous pourrez développer vos compétences en Data Science en travaillant en particulier sur le domaine de la propagation et de la prédictibilité des communications sans fil. L'indemnité mensuelle brute de stage proposée est comprise entre 1 000 et 1 500 euros selon votre niveau d'études en cours. A cela s'ajoutent l'accès aux Activités Sociales et Culturelles proposées par votre Comité Social et Economique, l'accès subventionné au restaurant d'entreprise ou aux titres restaurant, ainsi que la prise en charge à hauteur de 50% de votre abonnement aux transports en commun. L’ambition de la Division Innovation est de porter plus loin l’innovation d’Orange et de renforcer son leadership technologique, en mobilisant nos capacités de recherche pour nourrir une innovation responsable au service de l’humain, éclairer les choix stratégiques du Groupe à long terme et influencer l’écosystème digital mondial.
