About the role Both halves of this role are about the same underlying question: which systems can reach our most sensitive infrastructure, and under what controls. You will own the security architecture for our provider-side infrastructure layer, and you will be the subject matter expert for the AI platforms and agents we operate internally, making sure they run in a secure, governed, auditable state rather than accumulating quietly as a new class of privileged access. This is a hands-on expert role. You set standards, pressure-test designs, and work directly with platform and engineering teams across our brands to get them implemented. Define and maintain security architecture standards and hardening baselines for provider-side infrastructure: virtualization and container platforms, control planes and provisioning systems, DNS, mail infrastructure, and backup and recovery systems. Assess and strengthen tenant isolation across shared hosting, virtualization, and container layers, and drive remediation with the responsible platform teams. Review infrastructure designs and major changes for security impact, and act as an escalation point for infrastructure security questions from platform, cloud, and brand engineering teams. Reduce blast radius on the paths that matter most: privileged access to customer-facing infrastructure, administrative segmentation, secrets handling, and recovery integrity — translated into workable per-brand implementation plans across our heterogeneous platforms. Support Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management, and IT Emergency Management with infrastructure expertise during incidents and post-incident hardening. Own the security architecture and baseline standards for the AI platforms we run internally: model gateways and self-hosted models, agent frameworks, assistant integrations, connectors, and retrieval pipelines over internal data. Define and enforce how agents are identified, authenticated, and authorized: non-human identity handling, credential and token management, least-privilege tool and system access, and where autonomous action requires a human in the loop. Establish what data internal AI systems may access and index, and ensure agent activity is logged, attributable, and reviewable to the standard our regulatory and certification obligations require. Run pre-deployment security reviews for new internal AI platforms and agent use cases, at a pace that fits how fast these are being adopted, and keep a picture of where unsanctioned AI usage is emerging. Advise the security functions and internal engineering teams on adopting AI safely, including the guardrails that make that adoption defensible. Qualification Several years of hands-on experience in infrastructure or platform security, ideally at a hosting provider, cloud provider, telco, or comparably large-scale multi-tenant environment. Deep practical knowledge of Linux, virtualization and container platforms, networking, and the security properties of multi-tenant infrastructure. Strong background in identity and access: privileged access, machine and workload identity, secrets management, authorization models, and infrastructure-as-code security. Experience designing and enforcing security standards in a heterogeneous, partly legacy landscape, and getting them adopted by teams you do not manage. Working knowledge of how LLM and agent systems are built and operated, and of the risks specific to them: prompt injection through untrusted data, over-scoped tool access, data exposure via retrieval, unlogged autonomous action, model and provider dependency. Ability to make and defend risk-based decisions, including blocking a deployment with a clear rationale, and to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English; German is a strong advantage given our regulatory and public-sector environment. Advantegous Hands-on experience deploying or securing internal AI platforms, agent frameworks, or tool-calling integrations in production. Familiarity with NIS2 / BSIG or ISO 27001 Background in DNS, e-mail infrastructure, or abuse-adjacent platform security. Experience in a multi-brand or post-acquisition environment where the same control has to land in several different implementations. Security engineering or development background (automation, tooling, scripting). Encadré(e) par un Senior Data Scientist en charge de la modélisation mathématique et de la biologie des systèmes, vous contribuerez à un projet visant à évaluer et affiner des approches de Machine Learning pour guider la conception de formats d’anticorps
items.desc: Date de parution: 10 nov. 2026 Ville: GIF-SUR-YVETTE Pays/Région: FR Type de contrat: Stage N° offre: 13233 STAGIAIRE Data Scientist (H/F) Nous sommes un groupe pharmaceutique à dimension humaine, international et indépendant, gouverné par une Fondation. Notre modèle, singulier, fait notre fierté mais, surtout, nous permet de servir pleinement notre vocation : « Engagés pour le progrès thérapeutique au bénéfice des patients ». Aujourd’hui leader mondial en cardiologie, nous avons choisi de devenir un acteur focalisé et innovant en oncologie d’ici 2030, en ciblant des cancers difficiles à traiter et en y consacrant plus de 70 % de notre budget R&D. Un défi que nous poursuivons en parallèle du développement de notre activité générique pour un accès à des soins de qualité pour tous, et à moindre coût. Nous ? 22 000 passionnés de plus de 50 nationalités, portés par un esprit d’entreprenariat. Chaque jour nous avançons avec et pour les patients, avec et pour nos équipes, portés par l’envie de prendre soin, d’oser, de nous développer, de nous engager pour être utiles à celles et ceux qui en ont besoin. Venez vivre et contribuez à faire vivre notre engagement #MovedByYou www.servier.com Stage - Machine Learning pour l’optimisation de formats d’anticorps multispécifiques Votre mission : En tant que stagiaire Data Scientist, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Data Science & Data Management (DSDM) de l’institut R&D Servier à Paris-Saclay. Encadré(e) par un Senior Data Scientist en charge de la modélisation mathématique et de la biologie des systèmes, vous contribuerez à un projet visant à évaluer et affiner des approches de Machine Learning pour guider la conception de formats d’anticorps multispécifiques (notamment des T-cell engagers). Pour pallier la complexité et le bruit des données expérimentales, votre projet se concentrera sur la création d'un environnement de test robuste basé sur des données synthétiques. Vos principales responsabilités incluront : Génération de données : Concevoir un générateur de données synthétiques reproduisant les caractéristiques clés de l'optimisation des formats d'anticorps (assemblage modulaire, relations structure-activité non linéaires, courbes dose-réponse, bruit de mesure) afin de fournir une vérité terrain contrôlée. Optimisation de l'espace latent : En vous appuyant sur un pipeline existant, réévaluer et affiner les méthodes de représentation numérique (embeddings) des architectures d'anticorps. L'objectif sera d'améliorer la structure de l'espace latent utilisé par les processus gaussiens pour prédire la relation dose-réponse et l'activité fonctionnelle. Benchmarking rigoureux : Évaluer systématiquement les performances des modèles sur les données synthétiques, en analysant leur robustesse, la qualité de l'estimation des incertitudes et leur capacité à généraliser à des formats moléculaires non observés. Simulation et communication : Utiliser cet environnement contrôlé pour simuler des stratégies de sélection de nouvelles architectures à tester, et communiquer vos résultats de manière pédagogique aux scientifiques de différentes disciplines. Votre profil : Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et motivé(e) par l’application du machine learning à des problématiques scientifiques concrètes en recherche pharmaceutique. Le stage se situe à l’interface entre data science, modélisation mathématique et biologie ; une expertise préalable en anticorps n’est pas indispensable. Compétences requises : Formation : Étudiant(e) en dernière année de Master (M2) ou d'école d'ingénieurs (Bac+5) à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études, ou jeune diplômé(e) (Bac+5). Spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, machine learning, data science, informatique scientifique, statistiques, bio-informatique ou domaine quantitatif proche. Hardskills : Maîtrise de Python et de l'écosystème d'analyse de données/ML. Solide compréhension théorique et pratique des algorithmes de machine learning et des statistiques. Une première expérience ou de solides connaissances en modèles probabilistes (processus gaussiens), deep learning (PyTorch/GPyTorch), optimisation ou apprentissage de représentations (embeddings) constituent un atout majeur. Anglais scientifique courant (lecture de publications et documentation). Softskills : Rigueur scientifique, capacité à s'approprier des concepts mathématiques avancés et forte autonomie. Goût pour la recherche algorithmique et la résolution de problèmes complexes. Excellente communication pour vulgariser et expliquer clairement ses résultats à une équipe interdisciplinaire (biologistes, modélisateurs, data scientists). Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? #HappyTrainees Nos étudiants sont nos meilleurs ambassadeurs. Nous sommes 1er au classement France HappyTrainees et de nouveau 2ème au classement mondial HappyTrainees 2026. items.desc: We design digital products people love to use: mobile apps, websites and the workflows behind them. We’re looking for an AI Product Designer (f/m/d) who leads clients from the first idea to a clear concept and ships smaller products themselves with AI tools. What you'll do As an AI Product Designer, you shape digital products for companies, public institutions and start-ups from the first workshop to the finished product. Design and discovery are at the core of your role. With AI tools at your side, you also build and ship less complex products yourself. Lead workshops with our clients. Meet them in Berlin, understand their users and business, and facilitate discovery and ideation sessions. Turn ideas into clear requirements. Translate client needs into user stories, flows and specifications our engineers can build on. Design products people love to use. Create user-centered concepts, wireframes and UI designs for mobile apps and websites with a high bar for usability and accessibility. Prototype what’s possible. Build clickable prototypes and pitch MVPs that make ideas tangible for clients early on. Ship it yourself. Build custom websites in Framer and small apps on managed infrastructure, from first draft to go-live. Work AI-natively every day. Use tools like Claude, Claude Code or Figma Make as a natural part of how you research, design and build. Work closely with engineering. Hand over designs and requirements to our Engineers and stay involved until the product is live. Share what you learn. Pass on AI practices and design lessons so the whole team gets better. What we're looking for A degree in UX/UI Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 3+ years of professional experience in product or UX/UI design, ideally including client or agency work A portfolio that shows your design process, not just polished screens Strong product thinking: you think in user problems and business outcomes, and you question whether a feature is worth building before you design it Experience facilitating workshops and gathering requirements directly with clients or stakeholders Solid skills in Figma and hands-on experience building and launching websites with Framer, Figma Make, Loveable or likewise Bonus points for experience in motion design, such as micro-interactions, transitions or animated prototypes A sharp eye for quality: you spot UX inconsistencies and accessibility issues before anyone else does Strong communication skills: you can explain design decisions and trade-offs clearly to clients and engineers Organized and reliable, with an eye for detail and a sense of ownership You’re fluent in German and English. We work in English internally, while workshops and client meetings often take place in German. Based in or near Berlin and able to meet clients and the team on-site whenever projects need it What we're offering Flexible working hours and hybrid work: from home or in our office in Berlin Schöneberg, on-site whenever client meetings call for it Monthly benefits such as a subsidized membership at Urban Sports Club, a monthly shopping voucher or JobRad Flat hierarchies and daily opportunities to learn, grow and develop Freely usable budget for your home office equipment Vibrant team culture with regular events like our summer and winter party An inviting and structured onboarding process on-site in Berlin with a delicious team lunch Apply for the job Do you want to join our team as our new AI Product Designer? items.desc: Vuoi iniziare una nuova avventura professionale come Data scientist (computer vision) in una delle nostre opportunità nel settore automotive? Cosa farai? Lavorerai all’interno di un team di innovazione dedicato alla gestione e all’analisi dei dati. Acquisirai, organizzerai e sincronizzerai dati multimodali provenienti da video, immagini, GPS e sensori. Svilupperai attività di pre-processing e post-processing su dati video e immagini. Utilizzerai tecniche di intelligenza artificiale, reti neurali e deep learning per analizzare dati complessi. Svilupperai soluzioni di image processing e computer vision per identificare condizioni di disagio in diversi scenari di guida. Analizzerai i dati per anticipare la dinamica del veicolo e supportare lo sviluppo di nuovi prototipi. Scriverai codice in Python per la gestione, l’elaborazione e l’analisi dei dati. Collaborerai con un team internazionale, contribuendo alla documentazione tecnica e alla condivisione dei risultati. ✍️ Cosa Richiediamo? Almeno 1 anno di esperienza come Data Scientist in ambito professionale. Il ruolo è rivolto a profili con esperienza e non è entry-level. Buona conoscenza di Python e del sistema operativo Linux . Esperienza nell’utilizzo di tecniche di intelligenza artificiale, reti neurali e deep learning . Esperienza in image processing e computer vision , preferibilmente applicate a dati video o immagini. Conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno a livello C1 e disponibilità a lavorare in modalità full onsite . Nice to have: Esperienza nella gestione di dati multimodali provenienti da video, GPS e sensori. Esperienza in ambito automotive, mobilità o sistemi basati su prototipi. Conoscenza di tecniche di sincronizzazione e post-processing dei dati. ✨ Che cosa offriamo? Una comunità internazionale che riunisce oltre 110 nazionalità diverse. Un ambiente in cui la fiducia è centrale e la crescita interna è valorizzata. Un solido sistema di formazione con Academy interna e moduli disponibili. Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con eventi interni, afterwork, team building e altre iniziative. Un forte impegno verso benessere e work-life balance. Benefici locali in Italia: Buoni pasto. items.desc: IONOS S.R.L. Cyber Security Engineer (f/m/d) Infrastructure & AI Platform Security (Hybrid) At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us. About the role Both halves of this role are about the same underlying question: which systems can reach our most sensitive infrastructure, and under what controls. You will own the security architecture for our provider-side infrastructure layer, and you will be the subject matter expert for the AI platforms and agents we operate internally, making sure they run in a secure, governed, auditable state rather than accumulating quietly as a new class of privileged access. This is a hands-on expert role. You set standards, pressure-test designs, and work directly with platform and engineering teams across our brands to get them implemented. Define and maintain security architecture standards and hardening baselines for provider-side infrastructure: virtualization and container platforms, control planes and provisioning systems, DNS, mail infrastructure, and backup and recovery systems. Assess and strengthen tenant isolation across shared hosting, virtualization, and container layers, and drive remediation with the responsible platform teams. Review infrastructure designs and major changes for security impact, and act as an escalation point for infrastructure security questions from platform, cloud, and brand engineering teams. Reduce blast radius on the paths that matter most: privileged access to customer-facing infrastructure, administrative segmentation, secrets handling, and recovery integrity — translated into workable per-brand implementation plans across our heterogeneous platforms. Support Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management, and IT Emergency Management with infrastructure expertise during incidents and post-incident hardening. Own the security architecture and baseline standards for the AI platforms we run internally: model gateways and self-hosted models, agent frameworks, assistant integrations, connectors, and retrieval pipelines over internal data. Define and enforce how agents are identified, authenticated, and authorized: non-human identity handling, credential and token management, least-privilege tool and system access, and where autonomous action requires a human in the loop. Establish what data internal AI systems may access and index, and ensure agent activity is logged, attributable, and reviewable to the standard our regulatory and certification obligations require. Run pre-deployment security reviews for new internal AI platforms and agent use cases, at a pace that fits how fast these are being adopted, and keep a picture of where unsanctioned AI usage is emerging. Advise the security functions and internal engineering teams on adopting AI safely, including the guardrails that make that adoption defensible. Qualification Several years of hands-on experience in infrastructure or platform security, ideally at a hosting provider, cloud provider, telco, or comparably large-scale multi-tenant environment. Deep practical knowledge of Linux, virtualization and container platforms, networking, and the security properties of multi-tenant infrastructure. Strong background in identity and access: privileged access, machine and workload identity, secrets management, authorization models, and infrastructure-as-code security. Experience designing and enforcing security standards in a heterogeneous, partly legacy landscape, and getting them adopted by teams you do not manage. Working knowledge of how LLM and agent systems are built and operated, and of the risks specific to them: prompt injection through untrusted data, over-scoped tool access, data exposure via retrieval, unlogged autonomous action, model and provider dependency. Ability to make and defend risk-based decisions, including blocking a deployment with a clear rationale, and to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English; German is a strong advantage given our regulatory and public-sector environment. Advantegous Hands-on experience deploying or securing internal AI platforms, agent frameworks, or tool-calling integrations in production. Familiarity with NIS2 / BSIG or ISO 27001 Background in DNS, e-mail infrastructure, or abuse-adjacent platform security. Experience in a multi-brand or post-acquisition environment where the same control has to land in several different implementations. Security engineering or development background (automation, tooling, scripting). What we offer: Access to local/international trainings, development and growth …

items.desc: Konsert Strategy & IP is a leading consultancy at the intersection of business strategy, technology and intellectual property. Founded in Gothenburg in 2006, we work with some of the world's largest technology-intensive companies, close to the leaders who decide where to compete and how to win through technology and IP. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group. Like every consultancy, we are adapting to an environment that AI is reshaping. Much of the research, analysis and preparation that used to fill a project team's weeks can now be done by machines. Our clients face the same shift from the other side. Their strategy, technology and IP functions are under a clear mandate to work faster and leaner with AI. But today's landscape of point tools depends on the user to supply the context, and without it the tools speed up the doing without improving the thinking. What clients still need is sound judgment, grounded in the right context. That is where the real value of AI lies: not in faster work, but in better, more reliable and more impactful decisions. So rather than defend the old consultancy model, we are rebuilding ours around that: consultants who work inside our clients' organizations, supported by an AI platform that holds the client's context. That platform is Sapivia. We are now growing our in-house tech team, to make sure we have the capabilities under our own roof to take Sapivia to the next level. What we are building: Sapivia Sapivia is Konsert's AI platform. At its core is the context layer: a client-specific knowledge graph that holds the context every decision depends on. How the business, its technology and its intellectual property connect, what depends on what, and the reasoning behind the decisions already made. We have built that picture for clients by hand for twenty years; Sapivia captures it, keeps it alive and makes it available to people and AI alike. Our consultants build the context layer together with the client. The client's own people, Konsert's forward-deployed strategists and the AI tools the client already uses can then reason and act on the same picture, one that grows richer over time. Sapivia is already in use with clients, starting in IP, where the need is sharpest. But the same picture answers the questions every technology company has to ask: which technologies matter, where to compete and how to turn knowledge into advantage. That is where we are taking it next. The Konsert tech core team We are building a small tech core team: a handful of engineers with complementary skills. The team is led by a Tech Lead and sits in Gothenburg, next to the consultants who deploy Sapivia with clients. Build work happens in close collaboration with those consultants, several of whom spend part of their time in the team, so the domain expertise and the client's reality are in the room when we build. We work in an agile way with shared ownership: everyone is close to the users, effort goes where it is needed, and the team ships several times a week and owns the result together. Development runs in close alignment with Konsert's leadership team, with short paths to user input and quick decisions. The tech core team has a central voice in how Sapivia is shaped. Around this core, we scale with external developers and the Rouse Group's technology organization. Questions we are working on right now Giving AI the right context is only the start. Turning that context into decisions that large companies can rely on raises questions that few teams have answered yet. These are some of the ones we are working on now. They are open questions, not tickets, and you will help answer them. How do we assure the quality of AI responses at scale, when the right answer is often a matter of judgment? How do we best combine deep domain knowledge with what the models already know? How do we make a rich, connected body of knowledge feel simple and intuitive to work with? How do we give large organizations precise control over who sees what, across regions, teams and many users? How do we shorten the path from prototype to production code, while keeping the freedom to experiment? The role: Applied AI engineer You bring the applied AI competence to the core team. Sapivia's AI features run on the client-specific knowledge graph as their context layer, and the hard problems are in the harness around the models: retrieval, context management, tools, guardrails, evaluation and feedback loops. You take LLM-based features from first prompt to production, set up the evaluation that assures their quality, and help the team decide where AI creates value and where it does not. You work closely with the consultants whose judgment the system is meant to support. What you bring Several years (likely 5+) of professional experience as a software engineer Experience building and shipping LLM-based features in a real product, including prompt design and systematic evaluation Experience with retrieval over …

I rollen som utvecklingsledare BI (Business Intelligence) blir du en nyckelperson på denna resa. Det innebär att du leder och driver arbetet med att göra vår verksamhet mer datadriven, genom att omvandla komplex information till tydliga analyser och värdefulla insikter som stöttar våra beslut. Vill du förbättra vardagen, framtiden och livskvaliteten för Linköpingsborna? Hos oss kan du kombinera viktiga uppdrag med en meningsfull vardag. Välkommen till oss! Dina arbetsuppgifter Som Utvecklingsledare BI och AI inom Socialförvaltningen har du en central roll i att utveckla, förvalta och kvalitetssäkra användningen av vårt Business Intelligence (BI)-verktyg och analysplattform Qlik Sense, men även att driva och koordinera införandet av artificiell intelligens (AI) i vår verksamhet. Ditt uppdrag är att omvandla data till meningsfulla insikter som stärker verksamhetsutvecklingen, samt i din roll som AI-koordinator identifiera var AI-tillämpningar kan bidra till ökad kvalitet och förbättrad service för våra medborgare. Detta innebär bland annat att du: Ansvarar för Qlik Sense-applikationer: Du har helhetsansvaret för apparnas livscykel – från insamling av fakta, behovsanalys och värdering av nytta, att bistå vid utveckling med upphandlad leverantör, vidmakthålla och kvalitetssäkra dem. Agerar AI-koordinator, kartlägger och etablerar AI-stöd: Du driver arbetet med att kartlägga, prioritera och införa AI-stöd i arbetsuppgifter inom socialförvaltningen där det förbättrar service till medborgaren, kvalitet och effektivitet i verksamheten. Du genomför workshops för att identifiera problem, tidskrävande moment och flaskhalsar. Tillämpar styrande principer för AI: Du säkerställer att utvecklingen sker rättssäkert och utgår från våra principer gällande bland annat volym, medborgarservice och dataseparering (hantering av personuppgifter kontra öppna data). Säkrar datakvalitet och relevans: Du ser till att rapporter och visualiseringar är tydliga, relevanta och av hög kvalitet, så att apparna tillför nytta och används effektivt. Är en pedagogisk resurs: Du stödjer och utbildar användare, chefer och kollegor i hur beslutsstöden används. Du förklarar data och den nya tekniken på ett tydligt och verksamhetsnära sätt. Arbetstiderna är kontorstider med förtroendearbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete finns när verksamheten tillåter. Du som söker Är du en driven utvecklingsledare med bred kompetens som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för Socialförvaltningens beslutsstöd? Då kan det vara dig vi söker! Vi söker dig som har en akademisk eller eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, statistik, ekonomi, samhällsvetenskap, informatik, BI, eller annan erfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig. För att lyckas i uppdraget ställer vi krav på att du har erfarenhet av arbete i Qlik Sense eller annat BI-verktyg, samt praktisk erfarenhet av analys-, kvalitets- eller uppföljningsarbete. Vidare krävs en god förståelse för BI-verktyg, där du gärna använder Qlik Sense som verktyg för visualisering, datamodellering och analys. Rollen kräver en bred systemförståelse som innefattar applikationsförvaltning och kvalitetsarbete, med en tydlig insikt i sambandet mellan teknik, process och nytta. Utöver detta ställer vi krav på att du har god teoretisk förståelse för hur AI påverkar informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och behörighetshantering, samt en god förståelse för hur AI fungerar som ett effektivt stöd i kunskapsarbete och processer. items.desc: Search continues to evolve: visibility is now relevant across Google, AI Overviews, generative search and other platforms. There is no one size fits all digital marketing solution: to come out on top, you will need to measure client performance, investigate complex search challenges and turn insight into strategies that deliver measurable growth while keeping your finger on the AI pulse. What you’ll be doing Your day-to-day will vary based on the current challenges and ever-changing landscape of search. Your role may adapt, as required, as you progress with Page1. You will be expected to: Work directly with clients to understand their current objectives and establish new strategies Monitor and evaluate current performance across organic search and AI, identifying appropriate strategies to implement to improve overall performance. Covering: - Technical audits - Keyword research - Competitor analysis - Search intent research - AI visibility - Content strategy - Website user experience Coordinate with the wider team ensuring all objectives are aligned Test new ideas, tools and approaches and sharing what you learn with the team Report on leads, revenue, conversions and meaningful business outcomes What we’re looking for Someone who knows their way around SEO, but is also tuned into AI. You’ll enjoy looking into why something is happening and taking responsibility for doing something about it. We are looking for someone with: A solid understanding of how search engines and AI works A good understanding of the various elements that make up a successful SEO/AI campaign Strong communication skills, written and verbal Good organisational skills, the ability to manage and prioritise multiple tasks Meticulous attention to detail The ability to take data and insights and think outside the box A willingness to learn, take on-board feedback and develop new skills A pro-active attitude You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. What matters is that you have strong SEO & AI foundations. You should be someone who continues to reach for the stars, striving to improve your skillset while delivering quality outputs. Why join Page1? Page1 is an established digital marketing agency based in St Austell, Cornwall. Since 2011, we have helped businesses of all sizes achieve measurable growth online, working with everyone from local SMEs to national and international brands. We specialise in Paid Advertising, SEO, Social Media and Content Marketing, delivering results-driven campaigns that generate real ROI. As a family-run business, we take pride in being flexible, collaborative and supportive in how we work. No two days are the same here, and ideas are welcomed from everyone across the team. You can expect: Meaningful ownership: you’ll be encouraged to shape strategies and influence results Interesting, varied work: solving different commercial and search challenges across a variety of sectors A modern approach to SEO: testing and developing brand success across traditional and AI-powered search Support from specialists: working alongside experienced people, you will be involved in SEO, AI, content, development, paid media and analytics Benefits Full-time, permanent position Company pension scheme Company events and team activities Ongoing training and professional development Opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients and industries Friendly and supportive office environment Ready to make your mark? items.desc: Let’s transform society together We are Sweco. We are Europe’s leading design, engineering, environment and regulatory consultancy. We are future planners, city shapers, urban innovators, digital transformers, net zero chasers, community connectors, social enterprisers and lifestyle improvers. We are #DifferenceMakers. And we are now taking applications for the Autumn 2027 cohort of our Early Careers Graduate Scheme. Now recruiting: Graduate Geotechnical Engineer to join our Infrastructure and Environment Division. At Sweco, we recruit to role – meaning you’ll join a team where your skills, interests and ambitions align with the work you’ll be doing. Our Ground Engineering team delivers a diverse portfolio of projects across the UK, supporting clients in sectors including energy, national and local infrastructure, highways, water and commercial development. The recent work includes supporting the British Antarctic Survey’s £100 million Antarctic Infrastructure Modernisation Programme, as well as delivering the detailed geotechnical design for nationally significant projects such as A47 Improvement Programme and M25 Junction improvements, York Central regeneration and Comrie Flood Mitigation Scheme. We’re looking for graduates who share our values, are curious about the world around them and are motivated to help build a more sustainable and resilient future. What will you be doing? As a Graduate Geotechnical Engineer, you’ll: Work as an integral member of a close-knit team of geotechnical engineers and engineering geologists. Collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams to deliver geotechnical design projects at every stage, from feasibility and desk studies through to ground investigation, detailed design and construction. Assist with the planning and supervision of ground investigations, including site visits, drilling, sampling, field testing and site surveys. Gather, interpret and analyse data and test results from field and laboratory investigations. Use engineering software to model geotechnical behaviour, assess ground stability and support the development of practical design solutions. Contribute to the preparation of technical reports and other project documentation, summarising investigation findings and providing recommendations for construction methods and design considerations. Assist with the design of geotechnical solutions, including earthworks, foundations, slopes, retaining structures and other ground engineering measures. Support the supervision of ground investigation and earthworks activities during construction. Develop your technical, commercial and professional skills through hand-on experience, mentoring and involvement in a wide range of projects. This is an excellent opportunity to begin your career in a supportive and forward-thinking team, working on projects that make a real difference to communities and the environment. Who are we looking for? Our unique, personalised programme is designed for passionate, forward-thinking graduates who want to change the world around them, who will thrive in a dynamic team environment, and who are hungry to collaborate not only with fellow graduates, but also with mentors and leaders across the business. What do you need to apply? We want to hear from you if you… Have a degree relevant to the role you’re applying for. Have less than 12 months of relevant work experience (excluding placements). Are confident using Microsoft Office and other relevant digital tools. Are driven, proactive, and solution-oriented. Can work in the UK without restrictions either now or in the future. This is a permanent role, and we’re looking for candidates who can grow their careers with Sweco without a time limit. What’s in it for you? Our Graduate Scheme offers a two-year blended learning experience, with a tailored programme delivered virtually and face-to-face. You’ll have the chance to network and grow with the 2027 cohort. Personal growth will be supported by our Early Careers team, mentors and subject matter experts from across the business. Structured masterclasses focus on Internal Insight, Skills Development, and Subject Matter Expertise, helping fast-track your development as you pursue professional accreditation. The programme builds your confidence early in your career and gives you a platform for genuine impact within Sweco. You’ll receive a permanent position with an industry-standard salary and benefits package, including 25 days holiday, a great pension and life assurance. Read what our previous graduates have to say about their experience on the careers section of our website. Please note, we will hold an assessment centre for this position in January / February 2027. All applicants will be contacted regardless of the outcome. We provide feedback to all attendees of interviews or assessment centres but are unable to offer personal feedback at the application stage. Ready to make a difference with us? Apply now, and let's transform society …

items.card: Responsibilities: You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results: Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results. Develop and deploy
items.desc: Full time Hamburg or Siegen eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers. Responsibilities: You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results: Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results. Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost Required Skills: 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying backend or platform services in production Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar) Working understanding of GDPR and data residency requirements, and a genuine interest in digital sovereignty Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage for working with public-sector partners Nice to have (Bonus) Running an identity provider in production (Keycloak, Zitadel, Ory, Authentik, or a managed IAM service) Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms Contributing to security certification work (ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5) or acting on penetration test findings Familiarity with quantum SDKs and toolchains (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QIR) or hardware abstraction interfaces such as QDMI Batch scheduling or HPC environments (Slurm or similar) Observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains What you can expect from eleQtron: Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements Flexible working hours : We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development Wellness Package : We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus At the forefront : Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

items.desc: About the Role NPL is seeking an experienced Higher Scientist based in Teddington to plan and deliver a number of technical activities to take our research to the next level. This full-time Research Scientist job comes with a generous salary and benefits package. As a Higher Scientist, you'll be expected to acquire new knowledge to find solutions to advance our research. Also, if commercial opportunities arise from your work, you'll need to flag these – as this is how new products and services are born. At NPL, we learn from each other, respect each other, and work together to do better for ourselves and our customers. Your primary responsibilities will include: Sharing your learnings so that we all benefit and mentoring those with less experience than you Developing partnerships to strengthen our capability Acting as an ambassador for our work externally and being willing to promote what we do Providing technical support for any bids, we may be undertaking About You This position is within the Dimensional Metrology Group at NPL and will primarily focus on theme of volumetric dimensional metrology. Applicants should have demonstrable expertise in the development, maintenance, and/or use of non-contact metrology instruments, such as laser trackers, optical CMMs, laser line scanners, and X-ray computed tomography (XCT) systems. Experience in calibrating and establishing traceability for these systems is highly desirable. A relevant PhD, EngD, or equivalent industrial metrology experience is required. The successful candidate will help to establish and run a range of measurement services and deliver bespoke technical solutions to customers via contract consultancy, while supporting the ongoing maintenance, research and development activities within our Critical Measurement Infrastructure and Applied Metrology projects. The successful candidate will support and contribute to deliver measurement service to internal and external customers. To be highly successful in this Higher Scientist role, you should be confident in: Planning and efficiently delivering complex activities both individually, and as part of a team. Following established procedures and standards, to support the quality team to ensure activities are completed to the highest standards. Challenging yourself and others, developing and exploring new ideas for improvement and taking these from conception to fruition. Communicating technical outputs and establishing connections with internal and external stakeholders/customers. Beyond that, we're looking for someone who will thrive in a diverse scientific environment like ours. Being a member of a multi-disciplinary team, you will be expected to develop, capture, exploit, and transfer your technical knowledge to support the continued development of expertise within the group and may be called upon to mentor junior members. Essential skills: Ability to think creatively and solve problems independently A desire to expand their knowledge and skills across multiple adjacent fields Strong written and verbal communication skills Demonstrable expertise in the development, maintenance and/or use of state-of-the-art non-contact metrology instruments. Understanding of the fundamental operating principles of various non-contact metrology systems including laser trackers, optical CMMs, laser line scanners, and/or X-ray computed tomography (XCT) systems. Desirable skills: The following skills would be advantageous, but not essential: Knowledge of measurement uncertainty budgeting and calculations. Experience with calibrating and establishing traceability for a measurement tool. Knowledge of data processing, analytics and visualisation using commercial metrology software. Knowledge of a programming language such as Python, MatLAB, or LabVIEW for bespoke data analysis and/or instrument control. Proven ability to document, present, and publish complex results. Project/activity costing, planning, and management experience. At NPL, we set the standards by which everything is measured. In doing so, the National Physical Laboratory is helping to combat issues on a global scale such as climate change, curing diseases, and the development of cutting-edge communications technology. Our role is to research, create and deliver the measurement infrastructure which underpins the UK's prosperity and quality of life across many fields of industry. Applied Scientist – State Estimation & Integration
items.card: You will build the computational foundations and state estimation suites for our multi-modal sensor systems (RGB cameras, LiDARs, IMUs) and ensure these algorithms run seamlessly on physical hardware. If you have a deep passion for writing clean, performant software, solving complex state estimation problems, and deploying your solutions directly onto advanced robotic platforms, you will want to join us. What You'll
items.desc: Our Mission Our mission is to solve the most important and fundamental challenges in AI and Robotics to enable future generations of intelligent machines that will help us all live better lives. We are looking for exceptional Master's and PhD graduates to join our team full-time as the critical bridge between algorithmic research and on-robot deployment. This role sits at the intersection of state estimation, sensor calibration, and high-performance systems engineering. You will build the computational foundations and state estimation suites for our multi-modal sensor systems (RGB cameras, LiDARs, IMUs) and ensure these algorithms run seamlessly on physical hardware. If you have a deep passion for writing clean, performant software, solving complex state estimation problems, and deploying your solutions directly onto advanced robotic platforms, you will want to join us. What You'll Do Play a key role in developing and integrating robust, real-time state-estimation pipelines for multimodal sensor systems. Write robust, low-latency modern C++ code for real-time execution directly on robotic hardware, optimizing for embedded platforms like the Jetson family of devices. Apply classical optimization (e.g., factor graphs) as well as learning algorithms to practical, real-world robotics problems. Profile, benchmark, and eliminate performance bottlenecks in resource-constrained Linux environments. Design and build clean, scalable software components using modern software engineering practices and ROS 2. Work collaboratively with researchers to provide a solid foundation for building advanced robotic systems, making complex algorithms easy to use and deploy. What You'll Need A Master's (MS) degree or a completed (or soon-to-be-completed) PhD degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Vision, Computational Science & Engineering, or a related field; early-career and junior candidates with a few years of experience are highly encouraged and welcomed to apply. Exceptional core software engineering foundations with mandatory proficiency in Modern C++ and Python, including system architecture, data structures, and memory management. Solid understanding of state estimation and optimization techniques, with familiarity in factor graph optimization (ideally including experience with GTSAM). Proven software engineering experience (e.g., industry internships, significant open-source contributions, or complex project work demonstrating system design capabilities). A strong interest in building robust tools that support both cutting-edge robotics research and real-world deployment. Bonus While strong core software engineering and state estimation fundamentals are required, experience in any of the following areas is a massive plus: State Estimation & Fusion: Experience with multi-sensor state estimation, visual-inertial odometry (VIO), or SLAM algorithms. Hardware Acceleration & ML Systems: Experience with GPU programming, CUDA, parallel processing, or optimizing embedded neural network inference and hardware-level ML acceleration. Open Source Contributions: Significant open source projects that showcase your problem-solving skills in robotics, computer vision, or high-performance computing. Physics & Simulation: Familiarity with computational physics, rendering pipelines (e.g., Gaussian splatting), or scalable software infrastructure for GPU-based simulation. items.desc: Vill du arbeta med utveckling av AI i avancerade signalspaningssystem? Vill du bidra till att omsätta forskning till nya verktyg och arbetssätt i en verksamhet med höga krav på informationssäkerhet? Då kan FOI vara din nya arbetsplats! Vi erbjuder ett arbetsliv i balans, en utvecklande arbetsmiljö och ett samhällsviktigt arbete! Telekrigsområdet hos FOI i Linköping befinner sig i en mycket expansiv fas och nu söker vi dig som vill bidra inom signalspaning mot radiokommunikation. Du får en viktig roll i en verksamhet där vi varje dag bidrar till att stärka Sveriges säkerhet. Vi är en arbetsplats med en stor gemenskap där du som är nyfiken på ny teknik och har god samarbetsförmåga kommer trivas. Du arbetar tillsammans med erfarna forskare och ingenjörer med olika tekniska kompetenser. Om tjänsten Du kommer att arbeta med programmering och systemutveckling för att omsätta AI-teknik i praktiskt fungerande lösningar som stödjer vår forskning och teknikutveckling. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på projekt och kan omfatta utveckling av mjukvara, anpassning och utvärdering av AI-modeller samt integration i våra experiment- och demonstratorsystem. Du får följa arbetet från idé till färdigt system, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom ditt specialistområde. En del av arbetet handlar också om att utveckla och tillgängliggöra AI-baserade verktyg för våra medarbetare och stödja kollegor i hur tekniken kan användas. Informationssäkerhet är en avgörande del av vår verksamhet, vilket ställer särskilda krav på kontrollerade miljöer, lokal modellkörning och säker informationshantering. Vi arbetar i projektform där din insats blir en viktig del av helheten och där du har stora möjligheter att påverka resultaten. Vi värdesätter att du vill ta ansvar, dela med dig av din kompetens och bidra till andras framgång. För dig som har intresse finns möjlighet att ta ett större ansvar och på sikt leda tekniska projekt. Vi genomför praktiska tester och mätningar i verklig radiomiljö, vilket innebär att arbetet även kan ske utanför kontor och laboratorier. Om enheten Du kommer att ingå i en teknisk inriktad enhet som arbetar med system för radiokommunikation och signalspaning som tillhör avdelningen Telekrig. Tillsammans med kollegor inom radioområdet utvecklar och anpassar vi tekniska lösningar för att radiokommunikation ska kunna förstås, skyddas och påverkas i krävande miljöer. Enheten Spaning mot radiokommunikation utvecklar metoder för att upptäcka, identifiera och lokalisera radiosändare samt analysera hur kommunikationssystem fungerar. Vi arbetar med hela kedjan – från antenner och mottagarsystem till mjukvara för signalanalys, inklusive konstruktion, integration och test av prototyper. Vi finns nära våra uppdragsgivare i Försvarsmakten, men har även goda kontakter i den akademiska världen och försvarsindustrin. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? Krav Vi Söker Dig Som Har civilingenjörsexamen med en relevant inriktning mot AI och maskininlärning, eller annan erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Som anställd på FOI får du ett arbete med en stor frihet, möjlighet att påverka och utrymme för egna initiativ. Att vara kreativ och ha en god analytisk förmåga är värdefulla egenskaper. Då arbetet sker i projektform och ofta tillsammans med uppdragsgivare behöver du vara relationsskapande och ha en god samarbetsförmåga. Vad erbjuder vi dig? Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga. Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. items.desc: You’ve been building your knowledge at university. Ready to see what you can do with it? Studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or Business Analytics? At Progeny, we’re looking for curious graduates who enjoy technology, have ideas to share and want to solve real-world problems. Bring your enthusiasm, and we’ll help you build your skills. You’ll join us in a full-time, permanent role on a two-year structured programme. Get hands-on experience from day one, build your technical skills and confidence, and work towards your next step as an Associate. What will you actually be doing? You’ll help build and develop business applications, automate everyday tasks, connect systems and turn data into useful insights using tools like Power Platform and Azure. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you’ll explore how AI can make technology work smarter, solve problems and help keep our digital tools secure, reliable and easy to use. Who are we looking for? We’re not expecting you to know everything on day one. We’d Love To Hear From You If You Enjoy solving problems and coming up with creative ways to make technology work smarter. Ask questions and enjoy trying new things. Enjoy working with others and sharing ideas. Have a strong degree in Digital, Data, Computing, Business Analytics, Engineering or a related subject. Understand the basics of how apps, data or digital systems work. Have tried, or are keen to explore, Power Platform, APIs that connect systems and cloud tools such as Azure. Are curious about how AI is evolving and how tools like Azure AI Foundry can solve real-world problems. Think logically, notice the details and keep your work organised. Are ready to learn new tools and explain your ideas clearly. What’s in it for you? Support from a dedicated line manager and technical mentor, so you have people to turn to as you learn. Regular feedback and chats about your development, so you know how you’re doing and what to focus on next. A clear learning plan, with opportunities to gain certifications and keep building your skills as you progress. Time to build the basics in year one, then take on more responsibility and bigger challenges in year two. You’ll also get 30 days’ holiday plus statutory public holidays, private medical insurance and a workplace pension. Why Progeny? We bring financial planning, tax, legal and asset management experts together in one business. Technology helps those teams work together and support our clients, so you’ll see how your skills make a difference beyond the screen. Our values are simple: We Connect. We Care. We’re Clear. That means working together, supporting each other and making space for questions and fresh ideas. Ready to turn your curiosity into a career? Start here.

items.desc: Vår verksamhet Vill du arbeta med utveckling av hållbara AI-lösningar? AI Center är Region Uppsalas centrala funktion för ansvarsfull och värdeskapande artificiell intelligens inom bland annat hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, administration och regional utveckling. I tvärfunktionella team arbetar vi från behov och data till utveckling, drift, uppföljning och förvaltning. Vi utvecklar vår plattform och arbetar med dataanalys, analysnära datautveckling (analytics engineering), maskininlärning och produktionsnära AI-utveckling. Vi förenar verksamhetskunskap, teknik, drift och regelefterlevnad med datakvalitet, spårbarhet, dokumentation och återanvändbara lösningar som grund. Ditt uppdrag Som teknisk dataanalytiker bedömer du databehov, betydelse och kvalitet för lösningen. Du analyserar data och förklarar resultatens betydelse för lösningens utformning och användning. Du bidrar till metadata, spårbarhet, gör återkommande kontroller reproducerbara och automatiserar valideringar där det är lämpligt. Du utvecklar AI Centers plattform med testbara, återanvändbara komponenter för datainläsning och omvandling. Vi använder främst Python, SQL, DuckDB och Parquet, Git för versionshantering och Prefect för arbetsflöden. Du bör trivas att arbeta kodnära och föra arbetet från analysmiljö eller notebook till en robust, förvaltningsbar lösning. Infrastruktur, CI/CD och drift hanteras tillsammans med andra roller i teamet. Dina kvalifikationer Krav Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom exempelvis statistik, matematik, dataanalys, informatik, systemvetenskap eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet av att självständigt undersöka och analysera data, bedöma datakvalitet och förklara resultat och begränsningar för både verksamhetsnära och tekniska målgrupper. Goda kunskaper i SQL och Python för dataanalys och databehandling samt av att utveckla reproducerbar och testbar kod och versionshantera den i Git. God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. Meriterande Vi vet att erfarenheter kan se olika ut och förväntar oss inte att du har arbetat med samtliga områden nedan. Erfarenhet av dataarbete inom hälso- och sjukvård, offentlig verksamhet eller annan reglerad verksamhet. Erfarenhet av metadata, datakataloger och spårbarhet i dataflöden. Erfarenhet av öppen källkod (open source), gemensamma kodbibliotek eller andra komponenter som utvecklas och återanvänds av flera team eller organisationer. Din kompetens Du är analytisk och strukturerad, bryter ner komplexa frågor och identifierar mönster och samband. Dina analyser, antaganden, kod och slutsatser är begripliga, återanvändbara och möjliga att följa upp. Du är trygg i din kompetens och stärker teamet genom att dela kunskap, ta emot återkoppling och ompröva egna lösningar. Samarbete, kodgranskning och gemensamt ansvar är självklara i vårt team av erfarna specialister. Du lyssnar på verksamhetens kunskap och skiljer tydligt mellan vad data visar, våra antaganden och vad som behöver undersökas. Vi erbjuder Du följer arbetet från dataanalys till en användbar, hållbar lösning med dataingenjörer, data scientists, AI-arkitekt, DevOps-ingenjörer, kravanalytiker, uppdragsledare, digitaliseringsjurist och AI-strateg. items.desc: Job Description Are you a data scientist with hands-on Python experience, keen to develop your expertise in Probability of Default (PD) models? Join the DoD/PD Team within IRB Framework and contribute to models central to Danske Bank’s risk management and regulatory compliance. Part of Group Risk Analytics, IRB Framework maintains and operates Danske Bank’s Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) models, with the DoD/PD Team focusing on PD models. You will join an international team based in Denmark and Lithuania, delivering analytical and technical solutions in a complex regulatory environment. The team combines recurring processes with analytical and development projects, offering opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues. We are looking for a Data Scientist to help maintain and improve PD models. You will combine hands-on analytical work with stakeholder collaboration, gradually taking on more responsibility with guidance when needed. Through model monitoring and improvement, you will deepen your knowledge of PD models, banking regulation and model governance while strengthening your technical and analytical expertise. What you will be doing: Preparing, validating and analysing data to support PD model maintenance, monitoring and development. Investigating and resolving issues related to data, methodology and implementation to ensure PD models operate as intended, working with colleagues as needed. Clearly documenting and communicating analytical findings, monitoring results and model changes to stakeholders and supporting internal governance and regulatory processes. Collaborating with colleagues, sharing knowledge and contributing to continuous improvement. About you: Have 2+ years of relevant experience in a data science, analytical, quantitative or technical role. Have practical Python and SQL experience, including writing, adapting and testing code to prepare and analyse data. Hold a higher education degree in a quantitative field, such as mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering, physics, data science or a related discipline. Are curious, organised and collaborative, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and ask for guidance when needed. Can explain analytical findings clearly and are interested in translating technical topics into accessible business insights. Are interested in credit risk and banking. Experience with PD models or in a regulated environment is an advantage, but not a requirement. Are fluent in English, both spoken and written. What we offer you: Monthly salary range from 2640 EUR to 3960 EUR gross (based on competencies relevant to the role). Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives an employee benefits package, which includes: Growth opportunities: a professional and supportive team, e-learning, development programmes (including professional certificates) and 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities. Health & well-being: a diverse and inclusive work environment that supports work–life balance, additional health insurance, mental well-being practices, partial psychologist counselling compensation, silence and sleep zones at the office, and game rooms. Hybrid working conditions: work from home up to two days a week, a home office budget (after the probation period), and a modern Danske Campus workplace designed with an anthropologist to support the best employee experience. Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams at higher education institutions and other important activities, plus additional days based on your seniority at Danske Bank. Monetary compensation package: accident and critical illness insurance, financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance, and third-pillar pension fund contributions. Your contractual job title will be AI Science. Are you ready for the next step? Does this sound like the opportunity you have been looking for? We would like to hear from you. If you have any questions, please contact Martynas Ruokis, DoD/PD Team Lead via LinkedIn.

items.desc: Do you want to work at the intersection of data, AI and business, turning data into real impact for leading Nordic organisations? Are you looking to kickstart your career in a growing team where you’re trusted with real responsibility? If so, read on! Vuono Group is looking for students and recent graduates eager to grow both as full stack data scientists and as trusted advisors. We are a process AI company. We help Nordic organisations across the private and public sector create superior business processes and measurable impact through data and AI. About The Role As an Associate Full Stack Data Scientist, you’re interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and care about data quality and the value it can bring to business. You’ll work alongside experienced data scientists and business experts to make our clients’ businesses more intelligent with data. In practice, this means building data pipelines, analysing data and utilising machine learning and AI for insights and operational use cases. Depending on your interests and project needs, your work can lean more towards data science or data engineering. We’re technology-agnostic by nature. We start with the business challenge and find the best way to solve it, without being tied to any particular technology or platform. The work isn’t always easy, but that’s where the learning happens. You’ll grow fast, going deep in your own field and broad beyond it, with experienced colleagues supporting you along the way. What Your Days Will Look Like Help build data pipelines and prepare data for analytics and modelling. Explore and analyse data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for business improvement. Support the development and deployment of machine learning models, and help set up process mining and automation capabilities. Take part in client workshops and work with business engineers, software developers and process specialists to turn business problems into data-driven solutions. What We’re Looking For Your motivation to learn and a “get things done” attitude matter the most. Along with that, here's what will help you get up to speed: Currently studying or recently graduated in Data Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field. Programming skills in Python, familiarity with SQL, and basic knowledge of Git and Unix. A basic understanding of statistical methods and machine learning, or of data engineering concepts such as data modelling and ETL/ELT. Hands-on experience using LLMs and generative AI at work or in studies, and curiosity about how they can create business value. Confident communication skills in both Finnish and English. An interest in consulting and a desire to develop your client-facing, project management and problem-solving skills. Based in the Greater Helsinki area, as we work closely with our clients, often on-site. Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) or data tools such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, dbt or Airflow is a plus. Why you’ll like it here Work on real client projects, not just academic exercises. Grow fast with the support of an experienced team who are always happy to help. We run on trust, not titles. You'll get plenty of freedom and real responsibility. We're just entering our next stage of growth, which means there's plenty of room for your career to evolve. Our work isn't linear, and neither is life, so we keep things flexible. Your life outside work matters. Competitive pay in line with TEK salary recommendations. Great perks like extensive healthcare, lunch and sports benefits, Friday breakfasts, fun team events and more, plus the chance to join our employee share programme. We're building the best workplace for software, data, AI and business process professionals like you. That means investing in our people, their well-being, work-life balance and growth. Further information and next steps Please send us your application and CV by December 13, 2026. We’ll start interviewing already during the application period, so don’t wait too long! To make sure you learn and have a real opportunity to make an impact (and not just eat ice cream in an empty office in July), we’re looking for new Vuonoans to join us either at the beginning of 2027 or after the summer holidays, around August. This is a 4 to 6 month fixed-term position to start, with the possibility to continue if the fit is right for both sides. We look forward to hearing from you! Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

items.desc: AI Engineer – Business Enablement London (Remote) · £50,000-£70,000 About us We’re an established, international business that’s growing through acquisition. We’re partway through a multi-year shift to become a company that genuinely runs on data and AI. We have a strong data team and a CEO who’s fully behind it. What we need now is someone to bring AI into the rest of the business, the parts that don’t write code for a living. The role You’ll sit inside our business teams, starting with People, then Finance, then Account Management. You’ll find the repetitive, manual work that slows them down, then use AI to eliminate it. In practice, that means spending time with a team and watching how they work. You’ll spot where things could be faster, build something to fix it, and then show them how to do more of it themselves. Once a team is up and running, you move on to the next one. You’ll have a lot of freedom. Come up with ideas, share them, get feedback and get building. Nobody will hand you a backlog of tickets. What you’ll do Embed with business teams, learn how they work and spot where AI can help Build small tools, scripts, workflows and automations using Claude, Cursor and agent tools, covering things like reporting, data pulls, documents and scheduling Get those solutions used, showing people how they work and improving them based on feedback Teach colleagues to use AI in their own day-to-day work, so they can automate things themselves Help make AI-first working normal across the company, one team at a time Who we’re looking for You don’t need a computer science degree or a traditional engineering background. Some of the best people for this role started out in account management, operations, finance or sales. Then they got hooked on AI tools and started building things. What matters is that: you’re genuinely fluent with AI tools and use them every day to build things, not just to write emails you’ve built something useful with AI, whether at work or on the side, and can show us you’re curious about how businesses work and enjoy solving other people’s problems you’re comfortable explaining things to non-technical people, and patient when you do you’re self-directed and happy working things out without someone managing your every step If you’ve been the person in your team who quietly automated half their job and then showed everyone else how, we’d love to hear from you. Why join You’ll see your impact quickly: you’ll be making people’s working lives better within weeks You’ll get broad exposure across the whole business, not just one department You’ll be backed by a data team and leadership who take AI seriously and invest in the best tools It’s a real chance to grow into an AI career, wherever you’re starting from

items.desc: Description With 49,000 colleagues in over 140 countries, we help organisations make forward-thinking choices about their people, their investments and the risks they face. Joining our Insurance Consulting and Technology (ICT) team, you’ll be part of our impact right from the start. Our ICT team combines deep consulting expertise with innovative technology to develop cutting-edge solutions for the global insurance industry. The market-leading risk and financial modelling software we develop is used by over 1,000 clients across six continents. Our 1,700 ICT colleagues in 35 markets share one mission – to innovate and transform insurance. To make this a reality, we deliver solutions that help our clients better select, finance and manage risk and capital. We develop software solutions that support insurance companies and other businesses that require sophisticated machine modelling and analytics processes as they confront volatile markets and regulatory changes. Our work underpins complex financial activities ranging from asset-liability modelling, pricing and reserving to economic capital aggregation and allocation. At WTW, we believe difference makes us stronger. We want our workforce to reflect the different and varied markets we operate in and to build a culture of inclusivity that makes colleagues feel welcome, valued and empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. items.card: you will work on exciting robots, including custom ones that exist nowhere else, take research from simulation to real hardware, and work directly with our research teams. We are onsite in our Zurich office. We are looking for multiple Research Engineers who are generalists with depth: roboticists who work across the whole stack and bring real expertise in one or more areas of it, such as simulation and learning,
items.desc: Our Mission Our mission is to solve the most important and fundamental challenges in AI and Robotics to enable future generations of intelligent machines that will help us all live better lives. We work in physical AI, on both existing commercial robots and our own custom hardware, from actuators and sensors to the software that runs them. As a Research Engineer you will work on exciting robots, including custom ones that exist nowhere else, take research from simulation to real hardware, and work directly with our research teams. We are onsite in our Zurich office. We are looking for multiple Research Engineers who are generalists with depth: roboticists who work across the whole stack and bring real expertise in one or more areas of it, such as simulation and learning, agentic systems, perception and spatial AI, or robot software and hardware integration. You will work with research, hardware and operations colleagues, and split your time between areas as projects require. If you are strong in one area, we expect you to understand the others, interface with them and contribute to them. Our Stack Our stack includes the following components. We look for T-shaped people: broad across the stack, with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. Reinforcement learning for robotic control. Reinforcement learning in simulation with zero shot sim2real deployment. Agentic pipelines. High level agentic reasoning and planning pipelines for long horizon tasks. Perception and Spatial AI. Perception and spatial understanding for robots: calibration, state estimation, and 3D scene representations that feed policies and agents. Robot software. The interfaces between hardware and software, and the tooling used to operate, debug and test robots to accelerate research. What You'll Do Work across simulation, learning, control, software and hardware to close the loop between research and real robots. Build and improve the stack we use to train, evaluate and deploy robot policies and controllers, in simulation and on hardware. Work with research teams to apply new ideas to working prototypes on real robots. Make advanced robotics pipelines robust on real robots. Set priorities and make sound technical decisions when the problem is ambiguous, and solve real problems alongside researchers. Build the software that connects models, agents and robots: libraries, interfaces and tooling. Deploy your work on real robots in experiments inside and outside the lab. What You'll Need BS, MS or PhD in robotics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics or equivalent practical experience. Preferably >2 years of experience. System-level thinking: you reason about how software, hardware and algorithms interact, and you can trace a failure across layers. Either a research background with deep technical expertise that you enjoy applying to real robots, or experience in applied research: working with R&D teams and using state-of-the-art methods in physical AI. A solid understanding of robotics theory and math: kinematics, dynamics, control, estimation and optimization. Hands-on robotics experience: you build, debug and run things yourself, in code and on robots. Real hardware experience is highly preferred. Strong C++ and Python. Strong Linux skills. A collaborative mindset, working closely with researchers, engineers and operators. Contributions to open-source robotics software. Note: Candidates are not expected to meet every qualification in the above list. If you do not have all of these qualifications you are still encouraged to apply.
