items.desc: Gjensidige har røtter tilbake til 1816 og er i dag et ledende nordisk forsikringsselskap med rundt 4600 medarbeidere i Norge, Sverige og Danmark. I Norge tilbyr vi forsikring, pensjon og sparing, og er notert på Oslo Børs. Sammen sikrer vi liv, helse og verdier, og går på jobb for å være der når det gjelder – for kundene våre, for hverandre og for samfunnet. Vil du bruke data og maskinlæring til å påvirke kommersielle beslutninger? I Kunde- og porteføljestyring i Privat får du jobbe tett med forretningen og ledelsen – fra å utforske data til å gi anbefalinger som former utviklingen av porteføljen. Du analyserer lønnsomhet, prisstilling og konkurransekraft og utvikler analytiske løsninger og maskinlæringsmodeller for overvåkning og styring. Du blir en del av et sterkt analytisk fagmiljø med høy kompetanse innen skadeforsikring, kunde- og porteføljeanalyse. Her får du faglige sparringspartnere og mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi bruker data og analyse til å utvikle forretningen. Hva du vil gjøre: Du får kombinere avansert analyse og data science med konkrete forretningsutfordringer. Oppgavene spenner fra utforskende analyser og beslutningsstøtte til statistisk modellering og utvikling av datadrevne løsninger. Analysere utviklingen i porteføljen med særlig fokus på lønnsomhet, prisstilling og konkurransekraft. Bidra i prosjekter for å videreutvikle distribusjon og prising. Omsette komplekse data og analyser til innsikt, anbefalinger og konkrete forretningsmuligheter. Utvikle og dele kunnskap sammen med dyktige analytikere og data scientists, og bidra til teamets rolle som kompetansesenter for analyse i divisjonen. Samarbeide med forretningen og andre fagmiljøer om strategiske problemstillinger der analysene dine kan gjøre en forskjell. Vi ser etter deg som: Er nysgjerrig, analytisk og motiveres av å løse komplekse problemstillinger ved hjelp av data Kombinerer sterke analytiske ferdigheter med forretningsforståelse og interesse for kunder, lønnsomhet og porteføljeutvikling Evner å omsette komplekse data og analyser til tydelig innsikt, anbefalinger og beslutningsgrunnlag, og kommuniserer dette godt til både analytiske og ikke-analytiske målgrupper Tar initiativ, driver problemstillinger fremover og trives med både selvstendig arbeid og tett samarbeid med andre Har høyere utdanning innen eksempelvis økonomi, statistikk, matematikk, fysikk, informatikk eller andre relevante kvantitative fag Har relevant erfaring som analytiker, data scientist, konsulent eller fra andre roller med sterk bruk av data og analyse Har gode ferdigheter i SQL og gjerne Python, R eller tilsvarende verktøy for analyse og modellering Trives med flere parallelle problemstillinger og evner å prioritere der analysene kan skape størst verdi Hos oss får du stort handlingsrom til å utforske problemstillinger, utfordre etablerte sannheter og utvikle analytiske løsninger. Du får bruke kompetansen din til å forstå kundene våre, utvikle porteføljen og bidra til bedre beslutninger. Vi ser etter deg som vil ta initiativ og være med på å utvikle både fagområdet og teamet. Gode grunner til å jobbe i Gjensidige Vi har jobbet med å sikre liv, helse og verdier i over 200 år. En av grunnene til at vi har lyktes i så lang tid, er at vi hele tiden utvikler oss i takt med - og helst i forkant av - de stadige endringene i forsikringsbransjen og samfunnet ellers. Gjensidige er en arbeidsgiver som bryr seg om sine ansatte og legger til rette for god personlig og faglig utvikling. Vi sørger for at du kan utvikle deg innenfor rollen du allerede har, men også bygge karrieren din ved å bevege deg på tvers av organisasjonen. Fleksibilitet og åpenhet er essensielle egenskaper for at vi skal utvikle oss. I Gjensidige er det derfor superhøyt under taket, og nulltoleranse for trangsynthet. Vi tilbyr også: Mulighet for å jobbe delvis fra hjemmekontor, etter avtale. Spesielt god pensjonsordning, forsikringsordninger med behandlingsforsikring og personalrabatter, firmahytter i inn- og utland, aksjespareordning og sommertid. Flotte kontorlokaler sentralt i Oslo sentrum. Her finner du treningsmuligheter i eget treningsstudio og gymsal, i tillegg til bedriftsidrettslag med for eksempel klatregruppe, turgruppe og fotball, kulturaktiviteter og andre sosiale grupper. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, etnisitet eller bakgrunn. Hos oss jobber alle slags mennesker, med hver sin personlighet og historie - og det er nettopp dette mangfoldet som gjør oss sterke. Gjensidige gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk ved alle ansettelser. Omfanget tilpasses stillingens risikonivå og ansvar, og innebærer blant annet identitetskontroll, referansesjekk, verifisering av CV og en kredittsjekk. Bakgrunnssjekk gjennomføres i sluttfasen av rekrutteringsprosessen, etter samtykke og i tett dialog med deg som kandidat. Du trenger ikke å skrive søknad, bare last opp CVen din og svar på noen korte spørsmål som hjelper oss å bli bedre kjent med deg. Vi …

items.desc: THEORETISCH DIE BESTE ENTSCHEIDUNG. PRAKTISCH AUCH. TEILE DEINE LEIDENSCHAFT. Nur hochprofessionelle Abläufe in dynamischen Teams produzieren innovative Spitzentechnologie. Aber Fahrfreude wird bei uns von der Entwicklung bis zur Fertigung vor allem auch mit Spaß an der Arbeit und Begeisterung für das gemeinsame Projekt realisiert. Deshalb geben wir Studierenden bei uns nicht nur die Gelegenheit zum Zuhören, sondern auch zum Mitreden und Weiterdenken. Unser Team der Fahrdynamikentwicklung bei BMW entwickelt Software-Tools zur Unterstützung und Automatisierung der Fahrwerksauslegung. Mithilfe geeigneter Optimierungsalgorithmen und dem Einsatz von KI-Agenten gestalten wir den Auslegungsprozess zunehmend automatisiert. Im Rahmen deines Praktikums wirkst du aktiv an dieser Weiterentwicklung mit. Was erwartet dich? Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung numerischer Optimierungsalgorithmen. Außerdem wirkst du mit bei der Definition von Zielfunktionen auf Basis technischer Anforderungen. Darüber hinaus hilfst du beim Aufbau von Optimierungsworkflows inkl. Algorithmen, Nebenbedingungen und Zielfunktionsauswertung. Zudem unterstützt du bei der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten zur Steuerung bestehender sowie zur Erstellung neuer Optimierungsworkflows. Außerdem wirkst du mit bei der Validierung und Interpretation der Optimierungsergebnisse. items.card: The role As a CS AI Quality Specialist , you will play an important role in improving how customers interact with our digital customer service across Allente and Viaplay. items.desc: At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds. We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CS AI Quality Specialist in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? The role As a CS AI Quality Specialist , you will play an important role in improving how customers interact with our digital customer service across Allente and Viaplay. Working within the CS System and Transformation team, you will focus on the quality and continuous improvement of our AI-powered chatbots, customer service systems and processes. A key part of your role will be reviewing chatbot conversations, understanding where things work well and identifying where customers may need better answers or support. You will turn these observations into actionable suggestions and work closely with colleagues and relevant system owners to help improve bot content, knowledge and customer journeys. This is a hands-on role for someone who is curious about technology, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of developing smarter and more customer-friendly ways of working. You don't need to be an AI expert – we're looking for someone with the right mindset, analytical skills and willingness to learn. Your Responsibilities Will Include Reviewing chatbot conversations to assess accuracy, clarity and whether customers receive the help they need. Identifying recurring issues, gaps in bot knowledge and unnecessary handovers to customer service, and documenting findings and suggesting improvements. Supporting updates to bot content, knowledge articles and conversation flows together with relevant teams. Testing changes to chatbots and customer service systems, reporting issues and checking that improvements work as intended. Following up on basic quality measures and customer feedback, sharing insights and highlighting areas for improvement. Collaborating with colleagues across Allente and Viaplay to support the continuous improvement of customer service systems and processes. Following company policies and guidelines, including information security and data protection, while continuously developing your knowledge and skills. What we’re looking for We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following: Some experience working with customer service, digital tools, AI, chatbots or similar systems, either professionally or through relevant studies. An interest in AI and how technology can improve customer experiences. Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot patterns, identify issues and suggest improvements. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to your work. Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different teams. A curious mindset and willingness to learn new systems, tools and ways of working. Fluent communication skills in English; Swedish or another Nordic language is a plus. It’s a bonus if you have: Experience working with chatbots, AI tools or automated customer service solutions. Experience with customer service systems, CRM platforms or knowledge management tools. Experience reviewing customer interactions, analysing feedback or working with quality assurance. An interest in process improvement and digital customer journeys. A can-do attitude, a sense of humour and the ability to work humbly with others. What we offer you We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift. Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance. A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development. Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do . So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. Hit play today If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

items.desc: About the role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer, to join our growing Data Science Engineering team. You’ll work with other engineers, data scientists, product managers, systems engineers, and analytics professionals to help deliver valuable and innovative outcomes for our customers. You’ll work within and across our Engineering and Data Science teams, delivering scalable products that improve how we serve our customers and run our operations. This role would suit someone with previous experience working as a ML Engineer / Data Science Engineer. About the Team: Within Tesco Data & Analytics, we help our customers and the communities where we operate get the most value from data. We build and run Tesco’s data platforms, we architect and engineer data onto these platforms, provide capabilities and tools to the analytics community across Tesco, develop data products at scale and maintain existing applications. Our Data Science team are involved in a broad range of projects, spanning across supply chain, logistics, store and online. These include projects in the areas of Operations Optimizations, Commercial Decision Support (e.g. Forecasting, Range Optimization, Supply Chain support), Online (e.g. Search and Recommendation) and Intelligent Edge (e.g. Computer Vision). Our Machine Learning Engineers work alongside our data scientists, helping with everything from development of tools and platforms, code optimization through to deployment of solutions on the edge, cloud and big-data environments. You will be responsible for Participating in group discussions on system design and architecture Working with product teams to communicate and translate needs into technical requirements Working alongside our Data Scientists, Software Engineers and Product teams across the software lifecycle Delivering high quality code and solutions, bringing solutions into production Performing code reviews to optimize technical performance of data science solutions. Supporting production systems, resolving incidents, and performing root cause analysis Look for how we can evolve and improve our technology, processes and practices Sharing knowledge with the immediate engineering team Collaborate with other teams on more complex initiatives via working groups Improve and build solutions using GenAI Applying SDLC practices to create and release robust software You will need You come from either an Engineering or Data Science background, with a good understanding of the Data Science Toolkit (Programming, Machine Learning, MLOps etc) and bringing data science solutions into production. You therefore tick the majority of the following points: Key Requirements: A higher degree in engineering, computer science, maths or science. Customer focus with the right balance between outcome delivery and technical excellence. The ability to apply technical skills and know-how to solving real world business problems. Demonstratable experience of building MLOps systems according to the best market standards. Commercial experience contributing to the success of high impact Data Science projects within complex organisations. Awareness of emerging MLOps practices and tooling would be an advantage e.g. feature stores and model lifecycle management. An analytical mind set and the ability to tackle specific business problems . Experience with different programming languages and a good grasp of at least one language. The ideal candidate is fluent in Python. Use of version control (Git) and related software lifecycle tooling. Experience with tooling for monitoring, logging and alerting e.g. Splunk or Grafana. Understanding of common data structures and algorithms. Experience working with open-source Data-Science environments. Knowledge of open source big-data technologies such as Apache Spark. Experience building solutions that run in the cloud, ideally Azure. Experience with software development methodologies including Scrum & Kanban. A background or strong understanding of the retail sector, logistics and/or ecommerce would be advantageous but is not required. Unsure if you fit all the criteria? Salary UoP 20 000 - 25 000 PLN gross/month Hybrid working We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about different flexible working options. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a career, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. This role requires you to be based in or near Kraków, as you will spend 60% (3 days) of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Benefits Tesco is a diverse and exciting employer, dedicated to being #aplacetogeton, …

items.desc: Jij bepaalt wat AI voor het onderwijs kan betekenen Meer dan 400 schoolbesturen in heel Nederland sturen hun organisatie aan met onze software. Dat zijn ruim 1,3 miljoen leerlingen en studenten. Jaar na jaar komen er begrotingen, formatieplannen, realisaties en prognoses bij ons samen. Weinig organisaties hebben zoveel informatie over de beheerprocessen in het onderwijs en jij gaat daar iets mee doen. We zoeken een data scientist met diepgaande AI-ervaring, die modellen begrijpt, traint en in productie brengt. Een back-end achtergrond is niet nodig. Onze klanten werken met gevoelige gegevens. Daarom kijken we nadrukkelijk naar lokale en zelf gehoste modellen, met de data binnen onze eigen omgeving. Wat ga je doen? Je wordt onderdeel van ons productteam en wordt onze AI-specialist. Je hebt veel vrijheid. Wat werkt, gaat naar productie. Je onderzoekt waar AI het verschil maakt in ons product: prognoses, het herkennen van afwijkingen in begrotingen, slimmere analyses en ondersteuning bij het opstellen van een meerjarenbegroting; Je zet lokale modellen op, traint ze en maakt ze beter. Je kiest het juiste model voor de vraag, fine-tuned waar dat loont en weet wanneer een eenvoudig statistisch model het beter doet; Je brengt modellen samen met onze engineers naar productie; Je bouwt mee aan AI-ondersteuning voor klanten en consultants, zodat veelgestelde vragen direct beantwoord worden en consultants tijd overhouden voor advies; Je denkt mee over onze AI-strategie. Als onderdeel van de Visma-groep heb je toegang tot een groot netwerk van AI-specialisten. Jij zorgt dat Datapas daar iets aan heeft en er zelf ook aan bijdraagt; Je deelt wat je leert. Collega's in consultancy en ontwikkeling werken al met AI-tools, en jij tilt dat naar een hoger niveau. Wie ben jij? Een data scientist of ML-engineer met aantoonbare ervaring in het trainen en inzetten van modellen; Ervaring met het lokaal draaien en fine-tunen van (open source) taalmodellen; Sterk in Python en de gangbare ML-tooling; Een goede statistische basis. Je weet wanneer een uitkomst klopt en wanneer niet; Je kunt technische keuzes uitleggen aan collega's en klanten zonder technische achtergrond; Nieuwsgierig en zelfstartend. Je volgt wat er in het vakgebied gebeurt en probeert het uit; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; Ervaring met SQL, datawarehouses of financiële data is een pré; Drie (of meer) jaar relevante werkervaring is ideaal. Ben je net afgestudeerd en heb je indrukwekkend werk laten zien? Solliciteer vooral! Wat bieden wij? Fulltime functie, 32 uur is bespreekbaar; Marktconform salaris afhankelijk van medior of senior startpunt; 25 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van fulltime dienstverband; 8% vakantiegeld; Opleiding en training; Pensioenregeling; Fietsregeling en thuiswerkvergoeding; Verzorgde gemeenschappelijke lunch; Een unieke dataset over de bedrijfsvoering van het Nederlandse onderwijs, en de ruimte om er iets mee te bouwen; Budget en vrijheid om te experimenteren met modellen, hardware en tools; Een hecht team van specialisten in het monumentale Olympia-gebouw in hartje Haarlem, op 5 minuten lopen van het station; De stabiliteit en kennis van Visma, met de sfeer en korte lijnen van een klein bedrijf. Over ons Datapas is een organisatie die zich specialiseert op het gebied van het onderwijs, in de onderwijsondersteunende processen. Wij leveren oplossingen op het vlak van planning en control en de monitoring van het onderwijsrendement. Daar waar andere organisaties ophouden, gaan wij verder – een flexibele organisatie vraagt om flexibele oplossingen. Door middel van onze software kunnen we naast een standaardapplicatie ook maatwerk leveren, zodat elke schoolorganisatie haar eigen processen hierin kwijt kan. Als marktleider in het PO- en VO-segment ondersteunt Datapas schoolbesturen met innovatieve SaaS-oplossingen op het gebied van begrotingen en integrale management dashboards. Sinds 2022 zijn wij onderdeel van Visma, waardoor we de charme van een klein bedrijf combineren met de slagkracht van een grote organisatie. Dat geeft ons de mogelijkheid om niet alleen ons product te verbeteren, maar óók onze manier van werken slimmer te maken. Samen met ons team werk je aan projecten die écht het verschil maken in het onderwijs. Interesse? Solliciteer op deze functie via bovenstaande knop of stuur je cv met motivatie naar Marjolein de Goeij-Weijers via werken@datapas.nl. Heb je vragen of wil je meer informatie, dan kun je mailen naar hetzelfde e-mailadres. Voor deze functie zoeken we een kandidaat die in Nederland woont en de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst. For this position, we are looking for a candidate residing in the Netherlands with a good command of Dutch.

items.desc: Location: Zurich Contract: 40%-60% with flexible duration (min 6 months) Rate: CHF 30/hour Start: ASAP / by arrangement Role Overview As an AI Operations & Enablement Intern, you will play a central role in turning the AI tools and automations Rivero already relies on into shared, well-governed company infrastructure. Using your technical background and business understanding, you'll act as a bridge between business and technology teams. We’re technology-agnostic by nature. We always start with
items.desc: Do you want to work at the intersection of business and technology, solving real challenges for leading Nordic organisations? Ready to kickstart your career in a growing team where you get real responsibility and learn from experienced colleagues, rather than just build slide decks? If so, read on! Vuono Group is looking for Associate Business Engineers to join our growing team in Helsinki. We are a process AI company. We help Nordic organisations across the private and public sector create superior business processes and measurable impact through data and AI. About The Role As an Associate Business Engineer, you'll learn to tackle complex business challenges across different industries. You'll translate business needs into practical solutions and help clients design and build better processes. Using your technical background and business understanding, you'll act as a bridge between business and technology teams. We’re technology-agnostic by nature. We always start with the business challenge and find the best way to solve it, without being tied to any particular technology or platform. Sometimes, the best solution doesn't involve technology at all. You'll get hands-on experience turning data into business value. This means analysing data with business intelligence tools, defining KPIs and building dashboards that support better decision-making. Depending on the challenge, you'll also work with tools such as low-code automation, process mining and various business technology platforms. The work isn't always easy, but that's where the learning happens. You'll grow fast, going deep in your own field and broad beyond it, with experienced colleagues supporting you along the way. What Your Days Will Look Like Consult with clients to identify and analyse business needs and challenge and translate them into solutions that work, not quick fixes. Develop insights using data analytics tools like Power BI and Celonis and deliver actionable reports Leverage low-code automation, process mining platforms, and business technology platforms to design and implement client solutions. Collaborate with technical and business teams when implementing client solutions What We’re Looking For What really counts is your drive to solve business challenges with technology and your motivation to keep learning. Along with that, here's what will help you get up to speed: Currently studying or recently graduated in Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Networks or a related field. A basic understanding of business processes, data analytics and IT systems in modern digital businesses. An analytical mindset and get things done attitude. Confident communication skills in both Finnish and English, including presentations. An interest in consulting and a desire to develop your client-facing, project management and problem-solving skills. Based in the Greater Helsinki area, as we work closely with our clients, often on-site Curiosity about technology, especially AI, and how it can create business valu Hands-on experience with technologies such as Fabric, Databricks, Celonis, Power BI, Power Automate, UiPath or n8n is a plus. Why you’ll like it here Work on real client projects, not just academic exercises. Grow fast with the support of an experienced team who are always happy to help. We run on trust, not titles. You'll get plenty of freedom and real responsibility. We're just entering our next stage of growth, which means there's plenty of room for your career to evolve. Our work isn't linear, and neither is life, so we keep things flexible. Your life outside work matters. Competitive pay in line with TEK salary recommendations. Great perks like extensive healthcare, lunch and sports benefits, Friday breakfasts, fun team events and more, plus the chance to join our employee share programme. We're building the best workplace for software, data, AI and business process professionals like you. That means investing in our people, their well-being, work-life balance and growth. Further information and next steps Please send us your application and CV by December 13, 2026. We’ll start interviewing already during the application period, so don’t wait too long! To make sure you learn and have a real opportunity to make an impact (and not just eat ice cream in an empty office in July), we’re looking for new Vuonoans to join us either at the beginning of 2027 or after the summer holidays, around August. This is a 4 to 6 month fixed-term position to start, with the possibility to continue if the fit is right for both sides. We look forward to hearing from you! Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

items.desc: Vil du arbejde med datakvalitet og være med til at videreudvikle Data Governance i Lån & Spar Bank? I perioder bidrager du desuden til BI-afdelingens øvrige opgaver med automatisering, forretningsunderstøttende dataløsninger og ledelsesrapportering. Du har gerne erfaring med Power BI eller tilsvarende værktøjer til rapportering og visualisering. SAS indgår i vores nuværende miljø. Kendskab til SAS er en fordel, men ikke et krav. items.desc: About Us STRATOS is a London-based, high-growth technology startup. We build commercial data products on Palantir Foundry for large industrial businesses, and we're growing fast on the back of strong commercial traction. The team is young and exceptionally talented: former MBB consultants alongside strong engineers, and we're about to double in size. Why Forward Deployed Engineering We have a scalable technology backbone, but we believe Forward Deployed Engineering is the future of differentiated B2B software in the GenAI age. Rather than shipping static tools, we partner closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions, where the value is created in the implementation, not just the codebase. The Role Most graduate schemes put you on a rotation for a year before you touch anything real. Here you'll be working on a live customer problem in your first month. We're looking for Junior Forward Deployed Engineers to join the team and: Deploy our existing product offering to new and existing customers. Own, define and build new use cases on top of our core data asset and product, delivering bespoke value and solving real, unique problems for each customer. What you'll get: A rare, in-demand skillset. You'll work hands-on with Palantir Foundry every day, building deep expertise in a platform few engineers get access to. No prior Foundry experience needed. We'll teach you, and that's the point. Someone to learn from. You'll pair with a senior engineer from day one. The team is small enough that you learn by sitting next to people, not through a training curriculum. Problems that matter. You'll be close to the customer, working on high-value problems where the impact of what you build is visible immediately. Room to grow. We anticipate doubling the size of the engineering team, which means leadership, ownership and scope arrive early for the people who grab them. What You'll Do Deploy and customise the STRATOS core product suite for new and existing customers. Integrate external data sources: pulling data in via REST APIs and cloud storage, and connecting to customers' CRM systems. Contribute to the STRATOS core product suite, extending existing products and helping build new ones from the ground up. Rapidly deploy bespoke workflows on the front line to solve unique problems for specific customers. What We're Looking For Proficiency in Python and SQL is a must. Prior internship experience in a technical role is a must. We'll ask you to walk us through what you built and what you'd do differently. The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-changing environment. The ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders: managing the technical side of projects, liaising with our Commercial Product Managers, and understanding each customer's context and problems through a business lens. Nice to have Prior experience with Palantir Foundry is heavily valued but not essential. Experience with PySpark. What we offer Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company. Private healthcare. Pension scheme. 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. Work from abroad: up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time. Visa sponsorship available. A company committed to social and environmental responsibility: we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes. How We Hire Intro call with our recruiter Call with Solomon, our VP Engineering Two hours in person with Marco (CTO) and Solomon 30-minute final conversation with Nico, our CEO Practicalities London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

items.desc: Organisatie Voor een landelijke toezichthouder in de zorg zoeken we een Data Scientist. De organisatie houdt toezicht op zorgaanbieders, zorgverzekeraars en zorgkantoren. Ze onderzoekt onder meer of zorg correct in rekening wordt gebracht en of zorgaanbieders hun financiële bedrijfsvoering op orde hebben. Je sluit aan bij een team dat data inzet om toezichtsvragen te beantwoorden. Je werkt samen met data-analisten en toezichthouders en helpt collega’s om data te gebruiken in hun onderzoeken. Het team draagt ook bij aan producten die inzicht geven in de betaalbaarheid en toegankelijkheid van zorg. Functie Als Data Scientist analyseer je grote hoeveelheden zorgdata en vertaal je de uitkomsten naar inzichten waarmee toezichthouders gericht vervolgonderzoek kunnen doen. Je onderzoekt bijvoorbeeld welke patronen opvallen in declaraties en of die patronen wijzen op bredere risico’s in de zorgmarkt. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Analyseren van declaratiegedrag van zorgaanbieders en verkennen van mogelijke marktbrede risico’s. Uitvoeren van data-analyses op verzoek van toezichthouders en helder toelichten wat de uitkomsten betekenen voor hun onderzoek. Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van tools die collega’s ondersteunen bij data-analyses en risicogericht toezicht. Ondersteunen van onderzoeken naar de bedrijfsvoering van zorgaanbieders en de toegankelijkheid van zorg. Functie-eisen Een afgeronde wo-master in een kwantitatieve richting, zoals (bedrijfs)economie, wiskunde, statistiek, natuurkunde of econometrie. Minimaal twee jaar werkervaring als Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare rol. Ervaring in een andere functie telt mee als je op grote schaal data hebt verwerkt en de resultaten hebt vertaald naar bruikbare inzichten. Aantoonbare ervaring met grootschalige dataverwerking en het vertalen van analyseresultaten naar inzichten die aansluiten op een concrete onderzoeksvraag. Aantoonbare ervaring met programmeren in R. Je bent analytisch en nieuwsgierig, verdiept je graag in complexe vraagstukken en weet hoofd- en bijzaken te onderscheiden. Je stelt kritische vragen wanneer dat nodig is, legt je bevindingen helder uit en werkt graag samen met data-analisten en toezichthouders. Aanbod Een salaris van €5.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur. 25 vakantiedagen + 8,33% vakantiegeld Een detacheringsopdracht voor 36 uur per week. items.desc: 🔷 About StrategyBridge Who we are We're setting new standards in corporate finance. With a focused team of 30 — one in four of us a former founder — we combine deep expertise in finance, data science and AI to build THE platform for deal & advisory teams, strategy departments, auditors and banks. We're one of the fastest-growing startups in the DACH-region and now scaling internationally. Our ambition is clear: to set the global standard. Our Culture Ownership. You own your topics end to end, from idea to shipped. Strong opinions, loosely held. We argue hard about the right solution, then commit together. Simple beats clever. The simplest thing that solves the problem wins. We'd rather ship clear code than impressive code. Leave it better than you found it. Speed is a priority, but we don't trade it for technical debt that kills future velocity. We build simple, modular systems that are easy for the next person (or future you) to understand. Mistakes are a gift. We make mistakes and learn from them. The one thing we avoid is making the same one twice. Serious about the work, not about ourselves. We take our goals seriously, ourselves less so. 🔷 The role: Strategy / Corporate Finance Product Engineer (AI/Python) – Fintech Small team, high bar. You’ll sit between our clients, our engineering team and our finance team. You’ll turn client problems into solutions on our platform — and make sure they hold up in front of experts. Your responsibilities will include: Talk to our clients — strategy, M&A and corporate development teams — and understand how they work: which questions they need to answer and where today’s process breaks. Turn what these teams do by hand into workflows on our platform — for example market analysis, peer benchmarking or target screening. Own a part of the platform end to end — from the first client conversation to the shipped feature. Be the domain expert in the product — you make sure what we build reflects how a seasoned M&A or strategy professional would actually do it. 🔷 Qualifications - to be successful in this role, you will need: Must-haves We expect the motivation and ownership of a founder. You own problems end-to-end and care more about the user outcome than your ticket description. Structured problem-solver . You have experience talking to clients, understanding their problems and building solutions for them. You can explain financial logic to engineers and technical concepts to finance professionals. You’d rather build product than slides — and you’ve already built something others use. When you do an analysis twice, you start building a tool for it. 2+ years of full-time experience in strategy consulting, corporate development, M&A advisory, a fintech or similar. Corporate finance and strategy, hands-on — you’ve built valuation models, analysed financial statements and worked on strategic questions such as market, peer or target analyses, on real deals or projects. You build it yourself. You write Python that runs in production & ship on a shared codebase. You use AI/LLM tools to move faster, but you have the technical depth to audit their output and maintain high code quality. No "AI slop". Fluent German and English (C1 or higher). Nice-to-haves Own projects. Something you built outside of coursework or a job. Experience building LLM-powered features in production. You've taken data end to end — pulled it from somewhere (an API, a scraper, a database, a pile of files), cleaned it up, and built something on top. API and service design , clean enough that someone else can build on it. Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about ambition and how fast you learn than about a complete checklist. 🔷 What we offer Responsibility from day one : flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and the room to actually shape the product. Competitive total compensation : base salary + bonus + VSOP. Learning curve: one of the steepest you’ll find in Germany. Not an empty claim — ask the team. People: Build with experts from Big Tech, Silicon Valley, Investment Banking, and Hedge Funds. Setup: Munich, hybrid. Modern office, EGYM Wellpass, team events, tax-free benefits. Relocation: company apartment in Munich available on request. Hiring process Intro chat → Deep dive → Case Study & Team interviews → Offer. We value your time & move fast . Equal Opportunity We’re an equal-opportunity employer. This role is open to all genders (m/f/x). We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

items.desc: Product Intern, AI Credit & Lending Platform Hammersmith, London · Full-time · Five days a week in-office · Start ASAP LoanTube is hiring a Product Intern to help build our AI-powered credit and lending platform. We’re hiring with a long-term role in mind. You’ll start with an initial six-month internship, and our aim is for an exceptional performer to progress into a permanent, full-time Product role. About LoanTube Our platform processes 10,000+ applications a day across consumer and business lending. It combines credit bureau data, Open Banking and live lending criteria from 50+ lenders to match applicants with lenders. We’ve launched a WhatsApp journey that lets customers apply for a loan entirely through conversation, alongside our ChatGPT integration. What you'll do You’ll work directly with LoanTube’s Founder and CEO and collaborate with engineers to take product improvements from investigation through to release. Find where the platform can improve. Analyse application and lender data to understand where customers drop out, where matches fall short and which changes are worth making. Turn findings into product changes. Define the problem, write clear requirements, work with engineers to test and ship changes, and measure what happened. Build better AI application journeys. Test how the WhatsApp and ChatGPT journeys handle incomplete information, follow-up questions and edge cases. What you'll bring Hands-on product experience. You’ve helped build or improve a product and can explain the problem, what you personally owned and what happened as a result. Practical experience in credit or financial services. You’ve worked on lending, credit risk, consumer or SME finance, Open Banking, or a closely related area of banking or payments. Strong analytical skills. You can use data to investigate a problem and make a decision. Experience with SQL, Python or similar analytical tools is highly desirable. Your experience can come from employment, internships, startups, university projects or something you built yourself. You should be comfortable taking ownership of an open-ended problem, getting into the details and deciding what to do next. Role details Location: Hammersmith, London, five days a week in-office Type: Full-time internship Initial term: Six months, with a route into a permanent, full-time Product role based on performance Start: ASAP Right to work: You must have the right to work full-time in the UK for the duration of the internship. How to apply Apply via LinkedIn with your CV and a short example of a product you helped build or improve. Tell us what you owned, how you used evidence and what changed. If your credit or financial services experience comes from a different project or role, include a line about that too.

items.desc: KI, die in der Halle ankommt. Gebaut mit den Menschen, die dort arbeiten. Aufbau KI-Werkstatt (m/w/d) Viele Unternehmen reden über KI. Wir setzen sie ein, und zwar dort, wo es konkret wird: an der Werkbank, im Lager, in der Buchhaltung, an der Maschine. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Technik versteht, Menschen ernst nimmt und etwas aufbauen will, das bleibt. Wer wir sind Wir fertigen Interieur für die anspruchsvollsten Fahrzeuge der Welt, mit Holz, Lack, Leder und Chrom, vieles davon in Handarbeit. Unser Grundsatz ist, erst das Handwerk so gut wie möglich zu machen und es dann den Maschinen beizubringen. Unsere Roboter lernen bei uns Handwerk. Diesen Weg gehen wir jetzt in der ganzen Firma. Worum es geht In unseren Abteilungen wird jeden Tag abgetippt, abgeglichen, gezählt, gesucht und nachgefragt. Vieles davon kann heute KI übernehmen. Wir bauen dafür keine große Software von außen, sondern viele kleine Apps, die genau einen Ablauf lösen und miteinander sprechen. Dazu binden wir Technik ein: Kameras, die Teile erkennen und zählen, Scanner, Sensoren, Waagen, Maschinendaten. Du baust diese Werkstatt auf, als erste Person mit dieser Aufgabe im Haus. Bei uns verliert niemand seinen Arbeitsplatz durch KI. Wir nehmen den Menschen die Sacharbeit ab, damit Raum bleibt für das, was sie ausmacht: urteilen, gestalten, Handwerk, miteinander arbeiten. Wie du arbeitest Gemeinsam, nicht für andere. Du baust nichts am Schreibtisch, um es dann zu übergeben. Du setzt dich zu den Menschen, die die Arbeit machen, und entwickelst die Lösung mit ihnen. Sie wissen, wo es hakt, du weißt, was technisch geht. Ihr probiert, verwerft, verbessert. Am Ende steht ein Werkzeug, das sie verstehen und selbst weiterentwickeln, weil es auch ihres ist. Dein erstes halbes Jahr •⁠ ⁠Monat 1 - Finanzen: vom Rechnungseingang über Zahlungen bis zum Monatsabschluss. •⁠ ⁠Monat 2 - Einkauf: Anfragen, Bestellungen, Bestätigungen, Liefertermine. •⁠ ⁠Monat 3 - Lager und Halle: Buchungen, Bestände, Zählen mit Kamera und Scanner. •⁠ ⁠Danach: Qualität, Prüfung, Maschinen und jede Stelle, an der es hakt. Worauf es beim Bauen ankommt •⁠ ⁠Klein im Werkzeug, groß im Blick. Jede App löst einen Ablauf, alle zusammen ergeben ein System, keine Insellösungen. •⁠ ⁠Software trifft Hardware. Du verbindest KI mit dem, was physisch passiert, mit Kameras, Sensoren und Maschinen. •⁠ ⁠Sicher und nachvollziehbar. Rechte, Datenschutz, Sicherungen. Was du baust, hält auch an einem schlechten Tag, und jeder Schritt bleibt prüfbar. •⁠ ⁠Die Menschen bleiben verantwortlich. Wer die Arbeit heute macht, prüft, was die KI tut. Ihr seid ein kleines Team und arbeitet direkt mit dem Inhaber. Die Stelle gibt es nur vor Ort, weil die Arbeit dort passiert, wo die Menschen sind. Wen wir suchen Diesen Beruf gibt es noch nicht, also auch keinen festen Abschluss. Gut passen würden zum Beispiel eine Ingenieurin oder ein Ingenieur aus Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, eine Technikerin oder ein Techniker, oder jemand aus der Praxis, der sich das Bauen selbst beigebracht hat. Entscheidend ist, was du mitbringst: •⁠ ⁠Du hast schon etwas gebaut, das andere benutzen. Eine App, ein Skript, eine Steuerung, eine Auswertung. Du arbeitest mit Coding-KI wie Claude Code oder Codex, mit echtem Code, versioniert und so, dass ein anderer ihn weiterführen kann. •⁠ ⁠Du hast Freude an Technik zum Anfassen. Eine Kamera, ein Raspberry Pi, ein Scanner, eine Maschinenschnittstelle: Du willst sie zum Laufen bringen. •⁠ ⁠Du verstehst Arbeit. Du interessierst dich dafür, wie ein Monatsabschluss, eine Inventur oder eine Prüfung wirklich abläuft, und hörst zu, bevor du baust. •⁠ ⁠Du bist mental stark. Du bleibst ruhig, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, wenn Kollegen skeptisch sind oder wenn drei Dinge gleichzeitig brennen. Du führst dich selbst, setzt Prioritäten und bringst Dinge zu Ende, auch die letzten zehn Prozent. •⁠ ⁠Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen. Dein bester Moment ist nicht, wenn der Code läuft, sondern wenn eine Kollegin sagt: „Das haben wir gebaut.“ Wen wir nicht suchen Wer Lösungen allein entwickelt und dann übergibt, ist hier falsch. Ebenso wer Präsentationen über KI erstellt, ohne etwas zu bauen, oder wer bei Gegenwind das Interesse verliert. Was wir bieten •⁠ ⁠Sinn, den man sieht. Was du baust, verändert die Arbeit von Menschen spürbar, oft schon in der nächsten Woche. •⁠ ⁠Gestaltungsfreiheit. Du baust etwas auf, das es so noch nicht gibt, mit kurzen Wegen und direkter Entscheidung durch den Inhaber. •⁠ ⁠Echte Technik. Roboterzellen in der Lackiererei, eigene Apps, Kameras, Sensoren, dazu Budget für die Werkzeuge und KI-Dienste, die du brauchst. •⁠ ⁠Lernen auf höchstem Niveau. Du arbeitest an der Grenze dessen, was KI heute kann, in einer Fertigung für die anspruchsvollsten Kunden der Welt. •⁠ ⁠Ein stabiles Haus mit rund 100 Menschen, gesund und wachsend, mit eigenen Produkten in Vorbereitung. So bewirbst du dich Statt eines Anschreibens beantworte bitte drei …

items.desc: Nuestro Grupo es una referencia mundial en energía y servicios bajos en carbono. Junto con nuestros 96.000 empleados, nuestros clientes, socios y partes interesadas, estamos comprometidos en acelerar la transición hacia una economía neutra en carbono, a través de la reducción del consumo energético y soluciones más respetuosas con el medio ambiente. En ENGIE, cada persona tiene un papel clave en la aceleración de la transición energética. Marca la diferencia y vive una experiencia profesional con propósito. Enfréntate a retos apasionantes, crece en un entorno innovador, y construye una trayectoria que refleje quién eres realmente. ¡Únete a nosotros y sé parte de la aventura del siglo! Actualmente buscamos un Experto en DATA & AI para nuestra sede en Madrid. Misión La misión del Experto en Data & AI es participar en la identificación, diseño e implantación de soluciones basadas en datos e Inteligencia Artificial, impulsando la transformación digital de ENGIE mediante capacidades avanzadas de analítica, gobierno del dato, automatización e IA generativa sobre plataformas cloud y arquitecturas Lakehouse. Funciones Analizar las necesidades de las diferentes áreas de negocio en materia de gestión, análisis y explotación de datos, identificando oportunidades de mejora y casos de uso de analítica avanzada e Inteligencia Artificial. Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar soluciones de Data Analytics que contribuyan a la toma de decisiones basada en datos y a la generación de valor para el negocio. items.desc: We build and scale AI and data capabilities globally; advance AI and data training across Accenture; and develop cutting-edge methods for designing, building and delivering the most modern AI and data foundation in the technology stack and embedding AI and data across the enterprise, powered by Accenture’s Center for Advanced AI. Bring your innovative vision to Accenture! With your experience, you can reinvent entire industries while working with the world’s leading companies. Shape the future of business and technology by developing cutting-edge solutions that can create new value. Your role and opportunities Join Accenture’s Global Responsible AI team and help organizations design, deploy and operate AI responsibly, addressing the technical challenges emerging from traditional, generative and Agentic AI systems. You will: Design and assess Responsible AI architectures and technical governance solutions, defining evaluation and assurance approaches covering AI quality, safety, robustness, fairness, explainability, privacy, observability and ongoing monitoring. Evaluate traditional, generative and Agentic AI systems, performing model auditing, adversarial testing and technical assessments to identify vulnerabilities, potential bias, data leakage and other AI-related risks, and recommend appropriate technical controls. Develop Safe AI architectures and AIOps lifecycle practices, partnering with cybersecurity, model risk and engineering teams on AI threat modelling, guardrails, governance controls and mitigation strategies. Support Responsible AI projects end to end, contributing to client engagements, technical proposals, reusable reference architectures, playbooks, accelerators and governance evidence packs while acting as a trusted technical advisor to client teams and senior stakeholders. The position is based in Milan or Rome . The role may require travel depending on business needs and client requirements. Where compatible with project activities and company policies, hybrid working arrangements may apply. Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the job level is B2 under the Metalmeccanico (C011) National Collective Bargaining Agreement. The gross annual salary range is between 33.058,74€ and 46.700€. The Work: Join us to participate in Responsible AI projects from end to end — engaging clients, shaping innovative proposals from a technical standpoint, and delivering AI technical governance solutions. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, guiding organizations on how to deploy and run AI safely and can be expected to: Define AI evaluation and assurance methodological approaches covering quality, safety, robustness, bias, explainability, privacy and monitoring. Assess and design Safe AI architectures, AI system architectural practices, and AIOps lifecycle processes Perform model auditing and adversarial testing of traditional, generative and Agentic AI (using specialized market tools and custom assets), providing recommendations Partner with cyber, model risk and engineering teams on AI threat modelling, data leakage mitigation and adversarial testing. Shape proposals, reusable reference architectures, playbooks, accelerators and governance evidence packs. Work closely with AI and transformation teams to provide strategic guidance, support project delivery, and advise senior leaders. Evaluate algorithms for transparency, fairness, and reliability, manage AI-related risks, and turn them into opportunities for innovation and value creation. Contribute to shaping global AI standards, build insights on regulatory trends, and represent Accenture’s Responsible AI perspective. Drive responsible AI adoption, influence business outcomes, and help shape industry practices. Requirements & Skills : Experience in Responsible AI, AI Governance, and Artificial Intelligence, including Agentic AI Enterprise AI Architecture, and AIOps lifecycle Good knowledge of Python Fundamentals of AI Safety, threat modelling, guardrails, and AI observability Nice to have : Experience with AI model governance platforms of the major enterprise vendors Certifications in AI, cloud, security, architecture, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF or related standards. Publications, speaking or external thought leadership on Responsible AI or AI Safety

items.title: Image Processing Intern: AI-Assisted Tools for CalVal
items.card: You will join a stimulating environment, surrounded by passionate engineers, conducive to learning, innovation, and personal and professional development — and help build the future of space infrastructure. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, USA | Golden, USA | and Toulouse, France. Some of our awesome internship benefits:
items.desc: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is looking for an intern to join the End-to-End Validation & Performance (EVP) team and contribute to image-processing and calibration/validation (CAL/VAL) activities for Earth-observation missions. In this internship, you’ll explore how AIT captures and routine onboard imagery can support optical performance testing and radiometric calibration, and turn that work into an evaluated engineering prototype. Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station) Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027. About this role: Review DSNU, radiometric calibration, and relevant EVP processing and CAL/VAL practices Work with EVP engineers to identify suitable routine images, metadata, and reference calibration data; document data limitations and provenance Prepare a reproducible dataset and establish reference baselines, including a holdout evaluation strategy that avoids tuning and testing on the same acquisitions Implement a baseline estimator: a data-fit term combined with a regularizing prior Investigate additional AI/ML methods only where suitable training or validation data are available; compare them against the baseline rather than assuming they are superior Evaluate correction quality, residual fixed-pattern structure, stability across images, runtime, and failure cases Package the workflow as a prototype script or notebook with plots, quality checks, and an auditable record of inputs, parameters, and outputs Present findings and recommendations to EVP and CAL/VAL stakeholders; document what evidence would be needed before operational use The intern will gain experience in: Radiometric calibration and CAL/VAL for space-based optical imaging Push-broom image characteristics and PRNU/DSNU correction Applied optimization and, where appropriate, machine learning for image processing Experimental design, reference-data limitations, and quantitative performance assessment Building reproducible engineering tools and communicating technical evidence to mission teams Must Haves: Student in engineering, applied physics, remote sensing, image processing, data science, or a related field Fundamentals of signal or image processing and a strong interest in Earth observation Basic programming skills in Python and comfort working with scientific data Analytical mindset, rigor, and ability to document assumptions and limitations Interest in calibration, validation, sensor behavior, or image quality assessment Nice to Haves: Exposure to satellite imagery or remote-sensing data Experience with optimization, statistical estimation, or machine-learning evaluation Familiarity with image-analysis libraries and scientific Python tools Understanding of radiometric calibration or data-quality assessment What Can We Offer? You will join a stimulating environment, surrounded by passionate engineers, conducive to learning, innovation, and personal and professional development — and help build the future of space infrastructure. items.desc: Buscamos a un Machine Learning Engineer para un proyecto en banca 100% remoto Industrialización y MLOps: Despliegue, productivización y mantenimiento de pipelines de entrenamiento e inferencia batch para modelos de Machine Learning en Azure Databricks y PySpark, garantizando trazabilidad, reproducibilidad y escalabilidad. Modelado de optimización operativa: Integración y productivización de algoritmos de optimización matemática y heurísticas para la asignación eficiente de denominaciones de billetes, respetando restricciones logísticas y operativas de negocio. Gobierno y ciclo de vida de modelos: Implementación de flujos de registro, versionado de artefactos, auditoría y monitorización de drift mediante MLflow y herramientas corporativas de gobierno (Delphi). Migración y calidad de software: Refactorización de código exploratorio y notebooks a librerías modulares de Python, aplicando principios de testing unitario, control de excepciones, logging avanzado y tipado estático. Automatización y CI/CD: Configuración y mantenimiento de pipelines de integración y entrega continua (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Git) para automatizar el ciclo de vida del software y el despliegue de modelos. Resolución de incidencias y soporte N3: Diagnóstico de fallos en ejecución productiva, análisis de causa raíz ( root cause analysis ) y ejecución de planes de remediación operativa. Colaboración técnica multidisciplinar: Coordinación directa con equipos de Data Engineering, Plataforma Cloud, Data Science y Negocio para la definición de contratos de datos, SLAs y validación de casos de uso. Documentación técnica y operativa: Redacción de manuales de arquitectura, procedimientos de relanzamiento y contingencia ( runbooks ), y análisis de viabilidad ( trade-offs entre coste de cómputo y rendimiento).

items.desc: Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Coding Agent Research & Evaluations Job Type: Full-time Location: Remote The Role We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to help advance the evaluation and development of frontier coding agents. Sitting at the intersection of AI research, software engineering, and model evaluation, you will design the benchmarks, methodologies, and data systems that shape how next-generation coding models are measured and improved. Analyze model behavior and failure modes, identifying systematic weaknesses and translating findings into actionable improvements for training and evaluation. Build tooling and infrastructure that support large-scale experimentation, data generation, review workflows, and evaluation pipelines. Establish best practices for coding-agent assessment, ensuring methodological rigor, reproducibility, and measurement quality. Partner closely with researchers, engineers, and applied AI teams to design experiments and evaluate emerging model capabilities. Contribute to technical reports, benchmark studies, and client-facing research initiatives that communicate model performance and insights. Experience designing, reviewing, or validating technical assessments, benchmarks, coding tasks, or evaluation methodologies. Familiarity with large language models, coding agents, reinforcement learning, model evaluation, or related AI systems. Proven ability to build tooling, automate workflows, and improve technical processes through systematic experimentation. Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate model behavior and derive insights from complex technical systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate technical findings to diverse audiences. items.desc:
Introduction
 At ASML in Veldhoven, you will join a team working on advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies. Reticles are critical components in the lithography process, and their condition can influence the accuracy of semiconductor production. Monitoring reticle health currently requires extensive measurement efforts and valuable machine time. During this internship, you will investigate how artificial intelligence can extract meaningful insights from limited measurement datasets while maintaining reliable detection of reticle health changes. This internship offers a unique opportunity to combine machine learning, data science, and engineering in a highly innovative industrial environment.
 Your assignment
 During this internship, you will develop and evaluate machine learning approaches that help monitor reticle health more efficiently. You will work with historical measurement data and investigate how AI can provide reliable insights using significantly fewer measurements than traditional approaches. You will also explore how existing operational data can contribute to reticle health assessment. 
 Your main responsibilities will be:
 Analyze historical reticle measurement datasets and identify indicators of reticle health changes.
 Create training, validation, and independent test datasets for machine learning development.
 Develop and train AI and machine learning models using reduced measurement datasets.
 Compare AI model performance with established engineering analysis methods.
 Investigate the minimum amount of data required for reliable reticle health monitoring.
 Evaluate model robustness, uncertainty, and generalization to unseen datasets.
 Present findings and recommend efficient approaches for reticle health monitoring.
 This is a master’s thesis or non-thesis internship for minimum 6 months, minimum 4 days per week (2 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.
 Your profile
 To be suitable for the internship, you:
 Are preferably enrolled in a master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering field.
 Have experience with machine learning, artificial intelligence, and model development.
 Have programming experience in Python; experience with MATLAB is considered an advantage.
 Enjoy working with numerical, statistical, or spatial datasets and deriving meaningful insights from complex data.
 Are analytical, proactive, collaborative, and curious, with a strong interest in evaluating model performance and generalization.
 This internship is suitable for students who want to apply AI to a real-world engineering challenge. You will work with unique industrial datasets and collaborate with engineers and data specialists to develop innovative solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. Through this internship, you will gain hands-on experience in machine learning, data analysis, and model validation while contributing to more efficient and data-driven reticle health monitoring. No prior knowledge of lithography or semiconductor manufacturing is required.
 Other requirements you need to meet: 
 You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; 
 If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); 
 You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; 
 You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate.

items.desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
 Chez Medtronic, vous pouvez entamer une longue carrière d’exploration et d’innovation tout en aidant à soutenir l’accès aux soins de santé et l’équité pour tous. Vous dirigerez avec détermination en surmontant les obstacles à l’innovation dans un monde davantage connecté et compatissant. 
 Contexte 
 Au sein du département des Affaires Réglementaires, composé de six collaborateurs et un collaborateur aux Pays-Bas, ce qui lui confère une dimension internationale. 
 Le département intervient sur les dispositifs médicaux, dans le respect des exigences réglementaires applicables, notamment du cadre réglementaire européen.

 Vos missions

 Participer à la gestion des déclarations d’incidents. 
 Contribuer au suivi des échanges avec les clients, les distributeurs et les autorités compétentes. 
 Effectuer la mise à jour des contacts de matériovigilance et le classement des documents associés. 
 Assurer le suivi des activités du service. 
 2. Support aux Affaires Réglementaires 
 Contribuer à la collecte et à la gestion des documents nécessaires aux appels d’offres. 
 3. Automatisation et optimisation des processus 
 Participer au développement ou à l’amélioration d’outils automatisés (Excel, Power Automate ou autres). 
 Contribuer à l’optimisation de la gestion de la boîte mail des Affaires Réglementaires (tri automatique, catégorisation et suivi).

 Votre profil

 Vous souhaitez développer vos compétences dans un environnement international et découvrir les enjeux des Affaires Réglementaires et de la matériovigilance dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux. 
 Vous disposez des compétences suivantes : 
 Intérêt pour le secteur des dispositifs médicaux : vous êtes curieux(se) de découvrir les exigences réglementaires qui encadrent ce secteur. 
 Maîtrise d’Excel : vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils bureautiques et manifestez un intérêt particulier pour l’automatisation et l’optimisation des processus. 
 Anglais professionnel (niveau B1+ minimum) : vous êtes capable de comprendre des échanges professionnels, de participer à des discussions et de prendre part à des réunions en anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. 
 Vos qualités personnelles

 Curieuse et motivée , avec une réelle envie d’apprendre et de découvrir de nouveaux domaines.

Lieu : Vélizy-Villacoublay, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle. 
 Au sein de Thales, le Cloud Center of Excellence est au cœur de la transformation Cloud, Data et Intelligence Artificielle du Groupe. Cette organisation accompagne les métiers dans l’utilisation du Cloud, de la Data et de l’Intelligence Artificielle en développant des infrastructures sécurisées, des services et des produits adaptés aux besoins de l’entreprise. Dans ce contexte, l’équipe développe notamment des solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle et d’Intelligence Artificielle Générative destinées à améliorer la productivité et à soutenir l’innovation.
 En tant que Chef de Projet IA, vous serez en charge de :
 Piloter les initiatives d’Intelligence Artificielle, de la phase d’exploration jusqu’à la livraison, en garantissant leur alignement avec les objectifs métiers et leur faisabilité technique.
 Définir la vision, la stratégie, les feuilles de route et le périmètre des produits d’Intelligence Artificielle avec les responsables métiers et produits.
 Prioriser les initiatives selon leur valeur métier, leur faisabilité, les besoins utilisateurs et les dépendances associées.
 Coordonner les équipes pluridisciplinaires composées d’ingénieurs en Intelligence Artificielle, de data scientists, d’architectes Cloud et de parties prenantes métiers.
 Suivre les cycles de développement, les budgets, les ressources, les risques et les indicateurs d’adoption afin de garantir la création de valeur.
 Accompagner les équipes dans les pratiques agiles, l’expérimentation, l’amélioration continue et l’adoption des solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle.
 Votre profil:
 - Votre priorité est de piloter des produits d’Intelligence Artificielle de bout en bout, en conciliant enjeux métiers, besoins utilisateurs et faisabilité technique ?
 - Vous avez l’ambition de coordonner des équipes pluridisciplinaires et internationales pour accélérer le déploiement de solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle et d’Intelligence Artificielle Générative à l’échelle de l’entreprise ?
 - Vous avez envie de découvrir un environnement au croisement du Cloud, de la Data, de l’Intelligence Artificielle, de la gestion produit et des méthodes agiles ?
 Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en pilotage de produits et de projets d’Intelligence Artificielle et avez de l’expérience sur :
 Les architectures d’Intelligence Artificielle et d’Intelligence Artificielle Générative, les infrastructures Cloud et les environnements de calcul dédiés à l’Intelligence Artificielle, notamment les processeurs graphiques et les processeurs spécialisés pour l’Intelligence Artificielle.
 Le cycle de vie des produits d’Intelligence Artificielle, notamment le développement de produits minimum viables, l’expérimentation et l’itération.
 Les pratiques de gestion produit, de livraison et de priorisation dans un environnement agile ou de gestion par flux de valeur.
 La gouvernance des données, l’éthique de l’Intelligence Artificielle et la gestion du cycle de vie des modèles.
 La capacité à fédérer, communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés, accompagner le changement et coordonner des équipes internationales sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnaît ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
As part of our team, you will own the robotics AI architecture and technical hypotheses, selecting world-action and video-action models, VLA policies, embodied reasoning, or classical planning according to task, data, and execution constraints.
 You will design heterogeneous systems that connect learned models with Code-as-Policy programs, Graph-as-Policy structures, and reusable skills. You specify state and action representations, interfaces, execution checks, as well as recovery behavior.
 Additionally, you will implement and adapt models and agentic robot programs. You investigate predictive dynamics, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or feedback-driven skill refinement, then justify your choices with baselines and ablations.
 You will also define evaluation across simulation and physical rollouts, including held-out tasks, embodiment transfer, intervention rate, latency, recovery, and repeatability. In doing so, you distinguish first-attempt success from results achieved through retries.
 Furthermore, you will collaborate closely with the deployment engineer to turn the architecture into a functioning embodiment. Together, you diagnose model, planning, or control failures and revise the design based on measured robot behavior.
 Using the Agentic AI Software Factory, you will drive implementation and experiments while validating generated code and experimental conclusions. You maintain reproducible artifacts, versioned skills, and accountable release decisions.
Education: completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Control Engineering or a related field
 Experience and Knowledge: substantial hands-on contributions to robotics AI systems on physical robots, with defensible architecture decisions and reproducible results
 deep expertise in predictive world-/video-action modeling or agentic robot planning and Code-as-Policy, integrating learned and classical components; relevant experience may include GaP, CaP-X, or ASPIRE/ENPIRE-style feedback loops; comparable implementations are equally accepted, and mastery of every named framework is not required
 proven expertise in action grounding, temporal consistency, uncertainty, and failure recovery
 strong Python and PyTorch/JAX skills in training/adaptation, inference, and experiment design, combined with the ability to inspect C++ and robot-control interfaces
 demonstrated own code or model contributions, supported by meaningful baselines and measured hardware outcomes
 terminology familiarity or model-API integration alone is insufficient
 Personality and Working Practice: you are an architect who writes and debugs code, challenges weak assumptions, and follows ideas through to physical evidence
 Enthusiasm: building robot intelligence that combines prediction, reasoning and reliable execution
 Languages: very good spoken and written German and English

Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 The Simulation Services (SIM) unit is an organization within RCE Network Engineering Services. SIM is responsible for providing Simulators to product development within Networks R&D. These Simulators are used in product verification instead of real radios, real mobile phones and real core networks. The SIM responsibility includes development of internal solutions for Simulators, and sourcing of Simulators from external vendors.
 We are now looking for engaged developers to join us in Linköping, Sweden! You will join a team which collaborates with other SIM teams on other sites, also outside Sweden. The team you will join have the responsibility to secure strategic alignment of our pipelines with different teams, both inside and outside SIM. This team provides centralized support to the whole SIM organization by securing a functional development environment, flows and pipelines that help test our products in various stages. As a new member of the team, you will be involved in all the activities such as support, requirement analysis, system design, implementation, etc.
 What you will do: 
 As part of the team, you will contribute to the development and continuous improvement of SIM development environments, flows, and CI/CD pipelines. You will work closely with other teams to ensure efficient and reliable ways of developing, testing, and verifying products.
 The skills you bring: 
 MSc or BSc level in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or equivalent level of knowledge.
 Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/automation solutions.
 Knowledge of Cloud-Native principles (Docker, Kubernetes, Microservices, Helm).
 Linux and virtualization familiarity (KVM, Helm, OCP, VMware Tanzu).
 CI/CD and Version control experience (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub).
 Scripting and API skills (Python, Shell, Ansible, REST).
 Analytical and troubleshooting skills
 Interest and experience from Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning.
 Excellent speaking and writing skills in English
 What we are looking for: 
 We are looking for a developer who is curious, open-minded and isn’t afraid to take on complex problems.
 The skills to be ready to explore new opportunities as well as continuously learn and improve together with the team.
 A spirit of positiveness and creativeness with a can-do-attitude and the communication and networking skills
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams.

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity 
Forty percent of the world's mobile traffic is carried over Ericsson networks. Nobody thinks about that until it stops. A mobile network is how people call an ambulance, pay for lunch or find each other — invisible when it works, national news when it fails. That is the scale that a single line of our baseband code operates on. 
 We are now entering the 6G program, building it in Lund as a product heading for its first release. This is not a research demo, not a paper, but software that ships to the end user for real world applications. Decisions around how 6G technology operates are still open to explore. A radio has a fixed amount of time, spectrum and processing to spend, and it now has much more than one job to execute. Join in three years and you inherit this technology— join now, and you will be a part of shaping it. 
 We are looking for newly graduated engineers at the start of their career to build the first 6G product with us. 
 What you will do 
You will join a cross-functional team working in baseband software development: in the physical layer, where radio energy becomes data, and in the Layer 2 uplink and downlink processing chains that schedule and move user data. We will not pretend there is a long 6G delivery history to join; there is not. That is the point, and it is what makes this different from maintaining something finished. 
 The difficulty is real, and it is specific. Real-time C and C++ under microsecond deadlines, against 3GPP specifications, on multi-core DSPs, is unforgiving work. The same capability must also hold on two very different machines: Ericsson's own many-core baseband hardware, and standard commercial servers. What is cheap on one is expensive on the other. Making a single design work on both is an open problem here, not a solved one you would be maintaining. 
 We treat working with AI as an engineering skill to be learned rather than a tool to be handed out, and the scarce part of that skill is judgment: knowing which answer to trust, which to verify, and which to throw away is key. 
 The craft itself is classic baseband engineering, and it looks like this: 
 Take a feature from a question to shipped code — studies, systemization, design, implementation, test. 
 Read the 3GPP specification behind it and turn that into something a radio can actually meet. 
 Rework parts of a baseband that has shipped to hundreds of networks so that it carries 6G, without breaking what runs today. 
 Work against a standard that is still moving, and feed what you learn back into it. 
 Explore parts of a C++ code base far larger than anything at any university and find the three lines that matter. 
 Test it, improve the test environment you need in order to test it, and hunt the bugs that only appear on real hardware. 
 The skills you bring 
An MSc in computer science, electrical engineering, engineering physics, wireless communication or similar. 
 C or C++ close to the hardware, and enough mathematics to be unafraid of a signal. 
 Something you have initiated or taken ownership of, in your studies, at work, or in your own time. 
 Comfort working where the answer is not known yet. Much of this has not been done before, by anyone. 
 You do not need to be an expert in telecom — several people on these teams arrived from entirely different domains. We will teach you the standard; we cannot teach you curiosity.

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone.
