items.desc: Dassault Systèmes, « The 3DEXPERIENCE Company », développe depuis plus de 40 ans des solutions technologiques innovantes au service d’une industrie plus durable. Grâce à la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE et aux univers virtuels 3D, nous permettons aux entreprises et aux individus de concevoir des produits, des services et des expériences qui répondent aux grands défis de notre société. Vous rejoignez CATIA R&D, au sein de l’équipe CATIA 3D Master & Interactive Drafting, qui développe des applications dédiées à la conception et à la définition des produits industriels. Ces applications permettent notamment de créer et de présenter les informations nécessaires à la fabrication, à l’inspection et à la maintenance des produits : annotations, cotations, dessins techniques et spécifications géométriques. Dans le cadre de la stratégie Gen7, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer ces applications et à intégrer de nouvelles capacités d’intelligence artificielle, notamment au service de CATIA LEO, l’assistant virtuel dédié à l’ingénierie mécanique. Poste en CDI, basé à Vélizy Villacoublay (78) Vos missions : Contribuer à l’intégration de l’IA dans CATIA : participer au développement des fonctionnalités nécessaires à l’évolution de nos applications et à l’intégration de l’assistant virtuel CATIA LEO. Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs : analyser les usages et les enjeux métier afin de contribuer à la définition des fonctionnalités et à la rédaction des spécifications. Participer à la conception logicielle : prendre part aux choix de conception technique et aux évolutions de l’architecture existante. Développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités en C++ : concevoir des solutions fiables et adaptées aux besoins fonctionnels et à l’expérience utilisateur. Garantir la qualité des développements : réaliser les tests unitaires et contribuer à l’amélioration des performances, de la robustesse et de la maintenabilité du logiciel. Contribuer à l’amélioration continue : prendre en compte les retours des utilisateurs et participer à l’évolution des applications. Vos Qualifications Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs ou d’un cursus universitaire de niveau Bac+5 en informatique, avec une spécialisation en développement logiciel. Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de la programmation orientée objet, de l’algorithmique et de la conception logicielle, et possédez des connaissances en C++. Vous avez des notions en conception d’applications et en architecture logicielle. Vous vous intéressez aux applications de l’intelligence artificielle dans l’ingénierie, à la valorisation des données et à l’amélioration de l’expérience utilisateur. Vous savez analyser un problème, structurer votre raisonnement et proposer des solutions adaptées. Vous êtes à l’écoute des utilisateurs, appréciez le travail en équipe et aimez échanger avec des interlocuteurs aux expertises variées. Vous faites preuve de rigueur, de curiosité et d’autonomie dans la conduite de vos travaux. Des connaissances en mécanique, une première expérience de CATIA ou une pratique du développement d’applications 3D constituent des atouts. Vous maîtrisez l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, pour évoluer dans un environnement international. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc. Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc: 40 uur HBO / WO Medior / Senior NL Wat ga je doen als Data Scientist? Wil jij als Data Scientist een bijdrage leveren aan de energietransitie in Nederland? De energiemarkt verandert razendsnel en onze klanten lopen hierin voorop. Binnen de openstaande Data Scientist vacature zorg jij dat deze transitie van de grond komt. Ons doel is om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan deze digitale transformatie. Om dit te realiseren ga jij als Data Scientist aan de slag met uitdagingen als predictive maintenance, vergroten van inzicht in energiebesparende maatregelen en klantgedrag, fraudedetectie, voorspellen van energieverbruik en/of opwek en smart charging (elektrisch vervoer). Infiniot werkt aan maatschappelijke impact Bij Infiniot hebben we een strategische focus op energie & duurzaamheid. Wij zetten onze consultants in bij dynamische klanten die werken aan innovatieve oplossingen binnen de energietransitie en de vitale infrastructuur. Hierin werken wij aan projecten die maatschappelijke impact maken. Binnen ons team hebben wij een gevarieerde mix van data en software professionals die een hoge technische expertise in huis hebben. De onderlinge binding van ons team en het behouden hiervan is dan ook een grote prioriteit. Binnen onze organisatie zijn de lijntjes kort, wat ervoor zorgt dat wij snel in staat zijn om te schakelen en gemakkelijk onze kennis met elkaar delen. Hierin speelt ook de vitaliteit van onze medewerkers en duurzame mobiliteit een belangrijke rol. Denk aan elektrisch rijden, reizen met het OV en de bijdrage aan kennisontwikkeling op bijvoorbeeld scholen. Direct solliciteren op deze Data Scientist vacature? Als Data Scientist zul je Businesstoepassingen analysieren en datasets analyseren, complexe data inzichtelijk maken in dashboard of ander relevante inzichten Al Data Scientist zul je bovendien bruikbare Machine Learning & AI modellen creëren, zodat je met Data Science of Data Anlayse toegevoegde waarde kan leveren door het verschaffen van nieuwe inzichten. Daarnaast krijg je met jouw overtuigingskracht en enthousiasme je omgeving mee op het gebied van data analytics. Als Data Scientist werk je daarbij veel samen met onze Data Engineers. Solliciteer direct Wat breng je mee als Data Scientist? Je hebt minimaal 2-3 jaar werkervaring in Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Mining en deployment en optimalisatie van voorspellings- & scenariomodellen. HBO of WO afgeronde opleiding en relevante jaren ervaring (medior & senior niveau) in Wiskunde, Econometrie, Business Analytics, AI of een vergelijkbare opleiding. Of aantoonbaar door ervaring als Data Scientist gekregen. Je hebt kennis en ervaring met codingtools zoals bijvoorbeeld SQL en met R en/of Python. Je hebt kennis van data analytics tools, visualisatie en deep & machine learning Je kunt inzicht geven vanuit ruwe datastructuren en dat communiceren in begrijpbare taal, storytelling met data. Je hebt goede analytische vaardigheden Je bent niet bang om initiatief te nemen Juiste communicatie skills Beheersing Nederlands (B2 niveau) & Engels Wat kun je verwachten als Data Scientist of Data Analist bij Infiniot? Werken in een gemotiveerd team met ervaren professionals De mogelijkheid om in het boeiende energiedomein het verschil te maken Innovatieve opdrachten op het snijvlak van business en IT Een organisatie met de ambitie om marktleider te worden op het gebied van IoT in de kritische infrastructuur. Ondernemende omgeving waar jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk is. Een carrièrepad in data science met daarin doelgerichte training en coaching. En natuurlijk aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden. We werken volgens onze cultuurwaarden: korte communicatielijnen, informeel, ruimte voor innovatie, passie voor techniek, flexibel, ondernemend en hechte samenwerking. Dit vertaalt zich natuurlijk in een prettige werksfeer in een snel veranderend energielandschap. Er liggen concrete uitdagingen. Reageer op de Data Science vacature. Acquisitie door wervingsbureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld, wij werken met geselecteerde recruiters. Wat breng je mee als Data Analist? Je hebt minimaal 2-3 jaar werkervaring in business analyse, data analyse, data mining, datakwaliteit en data management. HBO of WO afgeronde opleiding en relevante jaren ervaring (medior & senior niveau) in Bedrijfskunde, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar. Of aantoonbaar door ervaring als Data Analist gekregen. Je hebt kennis en ervaring met data analyse, bent bekend met optimalisatie van businessprocessen op basis van data en inzichten. Je hebt kennis van data analytics, ETL, reporting, visualisatietools Je kunt inzicht geven vanuit ruwe datastructuren en dat communiceren in begrijpbare taal, storytelling is jou op het lijf geschreven. Je hebt goede analytische en consulting vaardigheden Je bent niet bang om initiatief te nemen Juiste communicatie skills Beheersing Nederlands (B2 niveau) & Engels

items.desc: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Jobbeskrivning Bakgrund Aktuell och tillförlitlig information om terräng och marktäcke är viktig för bland annat kartering, miljöanalys och lägesförståelse. I miljöer där befintligt kartunderlag är begränsat, inaktuellt eller saknas finns ett behov av metoder som snabbt kan omvandla tillgängliga bilddata till användbar geografisk information för att skapa en nulägesbild och fatta välgrundade beslut. Utvecklingen inom datorseende och maskininlärning skapar nya möjligheter att automatiskt analysera geospatial bilddata och identifiera olika typer av marktäcke. AI-baserade metoder kan exempelvis användas för att klassificera vegetation, vatten, bebyggelse, vägar och öppen mark och därigenom bidra till att skapa eller uppdatera kartunderlag i miljö med föränderliga förhållanden. Mål och syfte Syftet med examensarbetet är att undersöka och utvärdera AI-baserade metoder för automatisk klassificering av marktäcke från geospatial bilddata. Arbetet ska studera relevanta metoder inom Land Use/Land Cover (LULC), exempelvis bildklassificering och semantisk segmentering. Målet är att utveckla ett proof of concept för en eller flera metoder, utvärdera deras prestanda och begränsningar samt lämna rekommendationer för fortsatt utveckling och användning vid skapande och uppdatering av kartunderlag. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som Studerar på högskole- eller universitetsnivå inom exempelvis Datavetenskap, AI/ML, Systemvetenskap, mjukvaruteknik eller motsvarande ingenjörsutbildning Intresse för artificiell intelligens, digitalisering och informationshantering Erfarenhet av att använda AI som verktyg, exempelvis inom programmering och mjukvaruutveckling God kommunikativ förmåga i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Personliga egenskaper Självständig och initiativtagande Analytisk och nyfiken Strukturerad med god problemlösningsförmåga Kreativ och intresserad av att utforska nya arbetssätt och tekniska möjligheter Intresse för försvarsbranschen Du kommer ha handledare inom AFRY. Detta examensarbete kan genomföras som ensamarbete eller samarbete mellan två studenter, där en lämplig uppdelning i arbetsområden bestäms i samråd utifrån utbildningsinriktning och intresse. Om ni är två studenter som önskar skriva ihop – skicka då gärna in separata ansökningar med en kommentar om detta i er respektive ansökan. Har du en egen idé om ett examensarbete diskuterar vi gärna det och ser om det kan vara passande för vår verksamhet och identifierade behov framåt. Tidplan Uppstart efter överenskommelse, men förslagsvis mitten av januari 2027 och genomförande under våren (motsvarande 30 hp). Exjobbet utförs till största del på vårt huvudkontor i Solna, med viss möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Säkerhetsprövning: Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kan komma att genomföras då vi har säkerhetsklassad verksamhet inom Defense AFRY. Ytterligare information Exjobbet utgör en grund för en möjlig framtida anställning hos AFRY. Som anställd på AFRY erbjuder vi en modern arbetsplats i ett globalt sammanhang med framåtanda och trygghet i form av kollektivavtal och personalförmåner så som friskvårdsbidrag och en förmånsportal med en mängd rabatter. Vår personalklubb arrangerar sociala aktiviteter på och utanför kontoret. Allt från skidresor, sjunga i kör till att spela brädspel – det finns något för alla. Vårt arbete med mångfald är också ständigt pågående, en mix av personligheter och bakgrunder gör oss ännu starkare, mer kreativa och framgångsrika ute på marknaden. Dessutom finns det många sätt att vidareutveckla sig hos oss! Vi satsar på våra medarbetare och har individuella utvecklingsplaner där du får möjligheten att gå utvecklande kurser och certifieringar inom ramen för din tjänst och dina karriärmål. Nyfiken på att även gå traineeprogram? Läs mer här och anmäl intresse redan nu för start hösten 2027: Traineeprogram Defense Följ länk: https://afry.com/sv/traineeprogram-defense Vi vill att din ansökan består av ett personligt brev samt CV. Beskriv vem du är och vad som gör dig lämpad för detta exjobb hos AFRY! Sista ansökningsdag är 7 december 2026. Kontaktperson för frågor: Niklas Rickenberg, Systems Engineer Defense Infrastructure, niklas.rickenberg@afry.com Vi kan ej ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Sök via länken. På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. items.desc: Ben jij klaar voor de toekomst van Finance? Wil jij werken in een moderne financiële omgeving waarin AI en automatisering een belangrijke rol spelen? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om slimme systemen te monitoren, financiële processen te verbeteren en data om te zetten in waardevolle inzichten? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Bij delaware zijn we volop bezig met de digitalisering van onze financiële processen. Daarom zoeken wij een Finance Process & AI Analyst die verantwoordelijk wordt voor het monitoren, analyseren en optimaliseren van onze AI-gedreven financiële administratie. Jouw toekomstige baan! Als Finance Process & AI Analyst ben jij de schakel tussen Finance, processen en technologie. Onze AI-oplossingen nemen steeds meer administratieve werkzaamheden over. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze processen betrouwbaar, efficiënt en kwalitatief blijven functioneren. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse operatie en draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren en slimmer inrichten van processen. Je komt te werken bij delaware, een groeiend IT-consultancybedrijf met een sterke focus op innovatie en ontwikkeling. Jij kijkt verder dan traditionele Finance: je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI en automatisering, ontdekt verbanden in data, zoekt naar de oorzaak achter problemen en krijgt energie van innovatie en verandering. Vanuit ons Finance-team in Den Bosch help je mee aan de verdere digitalisering van onze financiële administratie. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Monitoren van AI-gestuurde processen voor factuurverwerking en financiële administratie Analyseren van uitzonderingen en afwijkingen die door AI-oplossingen worden gesignaleerd Verwerken en corrigeren van complexe of afwijkende transacties Bewaken van de kwaliteit en juistheid van financiële data en processen Signaleren van verbeterkansen en samenwerken met Finance en IT om processen verder te automatiseren Opstellen van controles en rapportages om de prestaties van AI-processen inzichtelijk te maken Ondersteunen bij maand- en jaarafsluitingen Adviseren van collega’s over financiële processen en systemen Beheren en bewaken van het subcontractorproces Opvolgen en optimaliseren van het Supplier Invoice Management-proces Ondersteunen van suppliermanagementprocessen Testen van nieuwe AI-functionaliteiten en automatiseringsoplossingen Waarin Maken wij het verschil? We care about our people! Samen werken we aan elkaars succes. Best Possible You-programma. Jij staat aan het roer van je eigen ontwikkeling en krijgt alle ruimte om daarin te groeien. Werken met de nieuwste AI- en automatiseringstechnologieën. Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringen. Een passend salaris dat aansluit bij jouw kennis en ervaring. Laptop en telefoon. Samenwerking met OpenUp. We vinden het belangrijk om te investeren in het welzijn van onze collega’s. Faciliteren in het aflossen van je studieschuld via een bruto-netto regeling. Een informele en collegiale werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Een actieve activiteitencommissie met regelmatig leuke events en teamuitjes. Kan jij onderstaande vragen met "ja" beantwoorden? Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Je hebt interesse in AI, automatisering en digitale technologie Je bent analytisch sterk en werkt nauwkeurig Je krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt initiatief Je bent leergierig en maakt nieuwe systemen snel eigen Ervaring met Power BI, Excel of andere analysetools is een plus Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal Wie wordt jouw nieuwe werkgever? De financiële administratie van morgen draait niet meer om het handmatig verwerken van facturen. AI neemt steeds meer repetitieve werkzaamheden over. Daardoor verschuift de rol van finance professionals naar controleren, analyseren, verbeteren en sturen. Bij delaware geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom investeren we volop in AI, automatisering en innovatie. Als Finance Process & AI Analyst speel jij hierin een belangrijke rol. Jij zorgt ervoor dat mens en technologie optimaal samenwerken en helpt onze financiële processen klaar te maken voor de toekomst. De afgelopen 20 jaar heeft delaware veel ervaring opgebouwd in de wereld van ERP en digitale transformatie. Met meer dan 6.000 collega’s wereldwijd en ruim 250 collega’s in Nederland helpen we organisaties dagelijks om technologie slim in te zetten. Onze cultuur is persoonlijk, ondernemend en gericht op samenwerken. We geven je veel vrijheid om mee te denken, initiatief te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Nieuwsgierig en wil je meer weten? Ga vandaag nog het gesprek aan met onze Recruiter Veronique. We vertellen je graag meer over de functie, het team en de mogelijkheden binnen delaware. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij werken voor onze werving uitsluitend samen met een aantal vaste recruitmentpartners.

items.desc: Financial Crime Product - Data Scientists & Engineers Alexander Barnes are partnered with a high-growth fintech building out its financial crime product capability across fraud, transaction monitoring, and screening. These roles sit within product and engineering, in the first line. You’ll either be defining how detection works, or building the systems it runs on. What you’ll be doing Building and improving detection systems across fraud and AML (card, banking, TM, screening) Working directly with transaction, auth, behavioural, and network data to identify patterns and signals Developing detection logic across rules, models, and AI Tuning systems continuously. False positives, detection coverage, operational load, customer impact Designing features and intelligence layers that improve how risk is detected Running deep analysis in SQL and Python. No reliance on dashboards Translating typologies into production-ready signals and decisioning logic Deploying and scaling models and rules in real-time systems Partnering closely with product, engineering, and compliance to evolve detection frameworks Where this role can sit Depending on your background, this leans into one of the following: Fraud Risk (Card / Banking) CNP, ATO, scams, APP, mule detection, onboarding abuse Working with auth data, payment flows, chargebacks, behavioural signals Transaction Monitoring (AML) Owning system performance. Rule effectiveness, typology coverage, backlog, false positives Working closely with ML models and monitoring frameworks Screening (Sanctions / PEP) Match quality, list coverage, tuning logic, global screening performance Detection Engineering / ML Systems Building monitoring frameworks from scratch Deploying models into production Scaling decisioning systems across large transaction volumes What we’re looking for Hands-on experience in fraud, AML, or financial crime risk Strong understanding of typologies and how they translate into detection logic Strong SQL. Complex queries, large datasets, no hand-holding Python for analysis and modelling (pandas, numpy; ML exposure expected) Experience building, tuning, or deploying detection systems (rules and/or models) Ability to think about systems end-to-end. Not just models, but performance and outcomes Comfortable working across product, engineering, and compliance Profiles that tend to work Fraud / risk data scientists from issuers, fintechs, or banks TM or screening specialists who understand system performance, not just policy Engineers who’ve built risk or monitoring systems at scale Investigators or law-side profiles who’ve moved into detection and pattern analysis What doesn’t work Ops-only or case handling backgrounds Compliance or policy profiles without data or system ownership Engineers with no exposure to financial crime or risk systems People who can’t show what they’ve built, tuned, or improved Why this role exists Most teams measure financial crime after it happens. This team is building the systems that detect it earlier, adapt faster, and scale properly.

items.desc: Plats Stockholm , På plats Upplägg Heltid Ansök senast 2026-11-24 I rollen som Data Scientist hos Consid i Stockholm får du möjlighet att utveckla både dina idéer och dig själv. Tillsammans med våra kunder arbetar du med avancerad analys, maskininlärning och AI för att lösa affärsutmaningar och skapa verkligt värde. Vi värderar dina personliga egenskaper och tror att du trivs med att arbeta kundnära där du får kombinera teknik, analys och verksamhetsförståelse. Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, analytisk och drivs av att hitta insikter i komplex data. Inom Consids affärsområde Data, AI och Analys hjälper vi våra kunder att bli verkligt datadrivna genom moderna dataplattformar, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar. I Stockholm är vi idag över 30 specialister inom dataområdet och nationellt är vi 115 kollegor som samarbetar tätt över hela landet. Efterfrågan på vår kompetens fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu fler Data Scientists som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens AI- och analyslösningar tillsammans med oss. Är detta något för dig? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi läser ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Din kompetens Minst 4 års erfarenhet som Data Scientist eller inom avancerad analys Erfarenhet av maskininlärning, statistisk modellering och prediktiv analys Goda kunskaper i Python och relevanta bibliotek för data science Erfarenhet av att bygga, utvärdera och produktionssätta modeller Erfarenhet av molnplattformar såsom Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Förmåga att kommunicera resultat och insikter till både tekniska och affärsmässiga intressenter Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift Meriterande Erfarenhet av generativ AI och stora språkmodeller (LLM) Erfarenhet av MLOps och modellförvaltning Erfarenhet av Databricks, Microsoft Fabric eller liknande plattformar Erfarenhet av konsultrollen och kundnära arbete Erfarenhet av att omsätta data och AI till affärsvärde Fördelar hos Consid Centralt kontor Din arbetsplats är en mötesplats med vackra lokaler som dessutom är centralt belägna med goda förbindelser. Utvecklas Hos oss finns möjlighet att testa det som du är intresserad av och utveckla din roll i den riktning du vill. Fantastiska kollegor Du får världens duktigaste, trevligaste och mest hjälpsamma kollegor. Jobba med det senaste Få stora möjligheter att arbeta med nya och moderna tekniker och arbetssätt. Vi erbjuder Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor. Trots vår storlek och snabba tillväxt lägger vi väldigt stort fokus på individen och den lokala kulturen. Ända sedan Consid grundades har ambitionen varit att skapa en arbetsplats som passar dig oavsett vilken fas i livet du befinner dig i. Vi är därför väldigt måna om att se varje individ och vara lyhörda för vad som är viktigt för just dig, din utveckling och din personliga situation. Som medarbetare hos oss delar du dina dagar med riktigt duktiga kollegor som mer än gärna byter erfarenheter, så väl lokalt som nationellt och internationellt. Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. Och massor av annat kul, förstås! En typisk Considare älskar att överträffa kunders och kollegors förväntningar, men värderar också en sund balans mellan privatliv och arbetsliv.

items.desc: Backend alapok. AI-fókusz. Nemzetközi e-commerce. Van már backend fejlesztői tapasztalatod, és egyre többször nyúlsz AI-eszközökhöz, amikor valamit meg akarsz építeni? Nálunk erre a tudásra építheted a következő lépésed. Olyan fejlesztőt keresünk, aki már dolgozott API-kkal, adatbázisokkal és szerveroldali logikával, közben pedig elkezdte felfedezni az AI-támogatott fejlesztés és a vibe coding lehetőségeit. Vannak stabil technikai alapjaid, szeretsz kísérletezni, és érdekel, hogyan tudsz ezekkel az eszközökkel gyorsabban, önállóbban megvalósítani egy ötletet. Egy nemzetközi e-commerce vállalathoz csatlakozol, ahol saját, már használatban lévő szoftvereink továbbfejlesztésén és új alkalmazások létrehozásán dolgozhatsz. A fejlesztéseid valós üzleti folyamatokat támogatnak, és közvetlenül segítik a csapat napi munkáját. Nem kell minden technológiát ismerned. Fontos viszont, hogy értsd az alapokat, utánajárj a problémáknak, és meg tudd ítélni, hogy az AI által javasolt megoldás valóban működik-e. Amit nálunk építhetsz Saját szoftvereink új funkcióit , a backend logikától a felhasználói felületig. API-kat és integrációkat , amelyek összekötik a rendszereinket és külső szolgáltatásainkat. Belső appokat és dashboardokat , amelyek egyszerűbbé teszik a csapat munkáját. E-commerce megoldásokat és automatizációkat , amelyek támogatják a napi működést. Új ötletekből prototípusokat , majd a bevált megoldásokból éles alkalmazásokat. A fejlesztés mellett tesztelésben, hibakeresésben és a meglévő megoldások továbbfejlesztésében is számítunk rád. Akkor passzolunk, ha Van már gyakorlati backend fejlesztői tapasztalatod munkából, gyakornoki pozícióból vagy komolyabb saját projektből. Legalább egy backend nyelvben vagy keretrendszerben magabiztosan mozogsz. Dolgoztál már API-kkal és adatbázisokkal, és érted egy webes alkalmazás szerveroldali működését. Elkezdtél AI-eszközökkel fejleszteni — például Cursorral vagy Claude Code-dal —, és szeretnél ebben tovább fejlődni. Az AI által generált kódot átnézed, teszteled, és szükség esetén javítod. Önállóan is utánajársz a feladatoknak, és tudsz kérdezni, amikor elakadsz. Fontos számodra, hogy amit építesz, mások számára is jól használható legyen. Pluszpont, ha Építettél már teljes alkalmazást AI-eszközök segítségével. Frontenden is feltalálod magad. Dolgoztál webshoppal, Shopify-jal vagy WooCommerce-szel. Ismersz automatizációs eszközöket, például n8n-t, Make-et vagy Zapiert. Van olyan saját projekted, amelyet már mások is használnak. Miért lehet ez a következő jó lépésed? Nemzetközi környezet: megismerheted egy e-commerce vállalat működését és technológiai kihívásait. Saját, működő szoftverek: valódi rendszereken mélyítheted a fejlesztői tudásodat. AI a napi munkában: üzleti feladatokon próbálhatod ki és fejlesztheted az új munkamódszereidet. Tér az ötleteidnek: számítunk a javaslataidra és a kreatív problémamegoldásodra. Látható eredmény: követheted, hogyan használják a fejlesztéseidet, és javíthatsz rajtuk a visszajelzések alapján. Mutasd meg, min dolgoztál Küldj egy rövid bemutatkozást és 1–3 projektet, GitHub-linket vagy demót . Írd meg, milyen backend technológiákkal dolgoztál, mire használsz AI-eszközöket, és mi volt a saját szereped a bemutatott projektekben. Különösen érdekel, mit építettél már az alap fejlesztői tudásod és az AI kombinációjával.

items.desc: En Zorraquino buscamos AI Maker con experiencia práctica y criterio para transformar ideas y retos de negocio en resultados tangibles, útiles y de valor utilizando inteligencia artificial. Una persona con mentalidad maker, capaz de combinar creatividad y tecnología para desarrollar soluciones, productos, diseños, automatizaciones o nuevas formas de trabajar. Puedes venir del diseño, el desarrollo, la creatividad, la estrategia u otras disciplinas: nos interesa qué has construido con IA, cómo lo has hecho y qué puedes aportar al equipo. Diseñamos marcas y productos digitales que generan valor real. Somos una consultora de diseño estratégico y digital, con más de 20 años de experiencia, que combina branding, diseño digital, experiencia de usuario y negocio para transformar la manera en la que las marcas conectan con las personas. Nuestra metodología integra creatividad, tecnología y pensamiento estratégico para ofrecer soluciones diferenciales, construyendo narrativas de marca coherentes y memorables que generan impacto en el negocio. Somos un equipo colaborativo, multidisciplinar y apasionado por el buen diseño. AI Maker Lo que harás Explorar las posibilidades de la IA. Investigar, probar y evaluar herramientas, modelos y nuevas tecnologías para identificar cómo pueden mejorar nuestra forma de trabajar y las soluciones que ofrecemos a nuestros clientes. Transformar ideas en soluciones. Entender los retos y necesidades de cada proyecto, identificar oportunidades de aplicación de IA y convertirlas en propuestas concretas que se puedan desarrollar y validar. Construir con IA. Combinar herramientas de IA generativa, plataformas no-code/low-code y otros recursos de tu especialidad para desarrollar soluciones, productos, diseños, asistentes, agentes, aplicaciones o automatizaciones. Automatizar procesos. Diseñar flujos de trabajo que simplifiquen tareas, conecten herramientas y permitan trabajar de forma más eficiente, tanto a nivel interno como en proyectos de cliente. Prototipar y experimentar. Crear prototipos que permitan probar una idea, contrastar su utilidad y aprender antes de invertir más recursos en su desarrollo. Aplicar la IA a la creatividad. Explorar nuevas formas de generar y desarrollar conceptos, contenidos, experiencias e ideas, combinando las capacidades de la IA con el criterio creativo y estratégico del equipo. Integrar la IA en los procesos de trabajo. Identificar oportunidades para mejorar los flujos de diseño, investigación, desarrollo y producción, creando herramientas y sistemas que faciliten el trabajo del equipo. Acompañar a los equipos y clientes. Compartir conocimientos, explicar posibilidades, ayudar a incorporar nuevas herramientas y facilitar la adopción práctica de soluciones basadas en IA. Medir, aprender y mejorar. Evaluar la calidad y utilidad de lo construido, recoger feedback y comprobar qué mejoras aporta para introducir ajustes y conseguir resultados de valor. Compartir lo aprendido. Documentar procesos, identificar buenas prácticas y contribuir a que el conocimiento sobre IA forme parte de la evolución de Zorraquino. Lo que buscamos Una persona con experiencia práctica y criterio para utilizar la IA, resolver problemas y conseguir resultados tangibles, útiles y de valor. Una persona curiosa, creativa y con mentalidad maker: te gusta probar, construir y convertir las ideas en algo tangible. Interés genuino por la inteligencia artificial y por explorar cómo puede transformar la creatividad, el diseño, los productos digitales y los procesos de negocio. Experiencia práctica utilizando IA generativa en proyectos profesionales o personales, con capacidad para explicar qué has construido, las decisiones que has tomado y los resultados que has conseguido. Capacidad para convertir ideas en resultados concretos utilizando IA, ya sean soluciones, productos, diseños, desarrollos, prototipos o automatizaciones. Conocimiento de herramientas como ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Lovable, n8n, Make u otras similares. No esperamos que domines todas: nos interesa especialmente tu capacidad para aprender, probar y elegir la herramienta adecuada para cada problema. Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mejora y convertirlas en soluciones útiles, viables y alineadas con las necesidades del negocio. Criterio para evaluar los resultados de la IA, detectar errores y decidir cuándo es necesario intervenir, ajustar o buscar otro enfoque. Capacidad para entender las necesidades de otras personas y trabajar de forma colaborativa con perfiles creativos, estratégicos y tecnológicos. Interés por aprender continuamente y compartir conocimientos con el equipo. Sensibilidad por la calidad, la privacidad, la seguridad y el uso responsable de la inteligencia artificial. items.desc: About Scrumconnect Consulting Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised for delivering impactful and innovative technology solutions across UK government departments. Our work has positively influenced the lives of over 40 million UK citizens. We are passionate about user-centred design, agile delivery and building digital services that make a real difference. Our teams work at the forefront of innovation, helping organisations transform and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that truly matter. About the role We are looking for a Data Scientist to turn complex public sector data into insight that shapes services and decisions. You will analyse data, build models and explain findings clearly to policy, product and technical colleagues. Key responsibilities ● Explore, clean and analyse large and complex datasets. ● Build statistical and machine learning models to answer real business and policy questions. ● Assess data quality and help define data standards and validation rules. ● Create clear visualisations and reports for non-technical audiences. ● Work with data engineers and architects to make models and analysis reproducible. ● Apply responsible and ethical use of data and AI, including bias and explainability. ● Work with user researchers, designers and product managers to make sure analysis meets real needs. ● Present findings to senior stakeholders and influence decisions. Essential skills and experience ● Proven experience as a data scientist in a commercial or public sector setting. ● Strong Python and SQL skills, including libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn. ● Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning methods. ● Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Python libraries. ● Experience using version control (Git) and writing reproducible code. ● Ability to explain technical findings in plain English. Desirable ● UK government or public sector experience. ● Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS or Databricks. ● Experience with natural language processing or generative AI. ● Knowledge of data ethics frameworks and data protection (UK GDPR).

items.desc: RealAdvisor is one of the leading digital platforms in the European real estate ecosystem. Founded in Switzerland, we now support 5,000+ real estate agencies and attract 10+ million users per year across Europe. We are scaling fast across multiple markets with a clear mission: help real estate professionals grow through data, transparency and smart technology. At RealAdvisor, we value ownership, autonomy and impact. Role Overview We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of our geospatial data products. This is not a model-tuning role. You will design, build, and operate the full data lifecycle behind our real-estate insights — from orchestrating complex pipelines on Kubernetes to delivering high-performance geospatial visualizations with Mapbox. This is a builder role. You should be as comfortable debugging an Airflow DAG as you are computing spatial statistics or optimizing analytical queries. You'll have full autonomy over a modern, high-performance stack: Orchestration & Operations: Airflow, Kubernetes, Docker Data Storage: Postgres (PostGIS) for spatial workloads; ClickHouse for large-scale analytics Programming: Production-grade Python Requirements Key Responsibilities End-to-End Pipelines: Design and deploy automated pipelines (ETL) using Airflow to ingest diverse datasets (Real Estate transactions, listings, geo-data) Geospatial Analytics: Compute advanced spatial metrics (e.g., pricing honeycombs, average prices per neighborhood) using PostGIS and Python Infrastructure Management: Maintain and optimize the Kubernetes environment where your pipelines and models run Visualization Engineering: Transform your analytical outputs into interactive map layers (Vector Tiles) that integrate seamlessly with Mapbox on our frontend What We're Looking For Truly Full-Stack (Data): You don't believe data scientists should stop at notebooks. You own infrastructure, deployment, and reliability because that's how real value is delivered Strong Geospatial Intuition: You understand projections, polygons, spatial joins, and how to visualize density and patterns effectively Engineering Mindset: You write clean, modular, maintainable Python code designed for production — not one-off scripts Experience: 3+ years in a Data Science or Data Engineering role, with hands-on ownership of production systems Infrastructure Proficiency: Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including debugging and troubleshooting live environments Database Expertise: Advanced SQL, especially with PostGIS or similar spatial extensions. Experience with ClickHouse is a strong plus Orchestration Mastery: Deep hands-on experience with Airflow for building and maintaining reliable data pipelines Fully remote role with flexible working hours Close collaboration with leadership and go-to-market teams International, ambitious, and collaborative team culture Benefits Fully remote role with flexible working hours Close collaboration with leadership and go-to-market teams International, ambitious, and collaborative team culture

items.desc: Contexte et ambition du recrutement Au sein d'une entreprise dans la rénovation énergétique, le Digital a pour fonction centrale d'utiliser la technologie pour résoudre les problèmes opérationnels concrets rencontrés par nos métiers. De nombreuses problématiques quotidiennes peuvent être radicalement améliorées grâce à l'automatisation, l'intelligence artificielle, de meilleures connexions entre nos logiciels (workflows, CRM) ou encore la création d'interfaces et d'agents IA spécifiques. Aujourd'hui, l'identification et la construction de ces solutions sont centralisées. Notre objectif est de créer une véritable capacité interne de Product Building autonome et réactive. Finalité du poste Votre rôle s'articule autour d'un cycle de création rapide et pragmatique : Problème métier → Compréhension du besoin → Conception de la solution → Prototype → Outil fonctionnel → Amélioration continue. items.card: Au sein d’EDF R&D, le département PRISME propose des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la performance et la sûreté des différents moyens de production d’électricité du groupe EDF. En particulier, le Groupe P17 GAIA héberge la compétence Probabilités et Statistiques pour les Phénomènes Physiques (PSPP) qui développe des méthodes et outils pour modéliser, quantifier et propager efficacement les incertitudes au sein
items.desc: Au sein d’EDF R&D, le département PRISME propose des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la performance et la sûreté des différents moyens de production d’électricité du groupe EDF. En particulier, le Groupe P17 GAIA héberge la compétence Probabilités et Statistiques pour les Phénomènes Physiques (PSPP) qui développe des méthodes et outils pour modéliser, quantifier et propager efficacement les incertitudes au sein de simulateurs numériques. Motivations : Certaines études de sûreté des installations nucléaires reposent sur des simulateurs numériques très coûteux, tels que les modèles de mécanique des fluides (CFD), dont une seule exécution peut nécessiter plusieurs jours de calcul. Ces simulateurs peuvent être considérés comme des fonctions « boîte noire », transformant des variables d’entrée incertaines en grandeurs de sortie. L’objectif de la propagation d’incertitudes est alors de caractériser statistiquement ces sorties (moyenne, variance, quantiles, etc.). Toutefois, lorsque seules quelques dizaines de simulations sont disponibles, les méthodes classiques de Monte Carlo fournissent des estimations trop imprécises. De nombreuses méthodes d’échantillonnage permettent d'améliorer l'efficacité de la propagation d'incertitudes : hypercubes latins, méthodes de quasi-Monte Carlo ou encore quadrature bayésienne (BQ). Dans la communauté CFD, la méthode du Deterministic Sampling (DS) est également utilisée pour estimer les premiers moments des sorties. Elle repose sur le choix d'un petit ensemble de points déterministes reproduisant les moments des variables d'entrée.Si ces méthodes peuvent améliorer la convergence par rapport à Monte Carlo, elles ne fournissent pas toujours de garanties théoriques sur la précision des estimations, notamment des intervalles de confiance. Par ailleurs, elles sont souvent principalement conçues pour estimer l'espérance, alors que d'autres quantités, comme la variance ou les quantiles, présentent également un intérêt pratique. L'objectif du stage est d'étudier et de comparer ces méthodes en contexte de données limitées, afin d'identifier les stratégies les plus efficaces et de développer des outils offrant des garanties sur les estimations. Le travail comportera trois volets : Étude méthodologique : analyser la méthode DS, la comparer aux approches classiques de quantification d'incertitudes et identifier ses hypothèses et son domaine de validité. Benchmark numérique : implémenter en Python la méthode DS et comparer différentes stratégies d'échantillonnage sur des fonctions analytiques. Les performances seront évaluées pour l'estimation de l'espérance, de la variance et des quantiles, en fonction de la taille de l'échantillon, de la dimension et de la régularité des fonctions. Étude théorique : explorer les garanties d'estimation associées à la quadrature bayésienne (BQ). Fondée sur les processus gaussiens, cette méthode fournit naturellement une incertitude a posteriori. Étudiant.e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur.e.s ou M2 (stage de fin d’études ou de césure) Compétences en mathématiques appliquées, probabilités & statistiques, programmation Python

items.desc: AI Engineer (Spatial Intelligence) Edinburgh, Scotland, UK | Onsite | Full-Time, Permanent A global technology company with one of the world’s largest R&D organisations is hiring an AI Engineer (Spatial Intelligence) for its Edinburgh research centre. The team is building the next generation of maps, powered entirely by edge AI. They are developing foundation models that run on consumer devices, understand the user’s physical surroundings and retrieve relevant local data, without relying on the cloud. As AI Engineer (Spatial Intelligence), you will work where multimodal foundation models, geospatial data and on-device inference meet. That means adapting LLMs and vision-language models to hardware limits, turning raw geospatial data into structures an LLM can reason over, and building fast retrieval across distributed spatial data. This is an applied research engineering role. You build working prototypes and demonstrators, and those results decide which spatial AI capabilities move towards consumer products. The role suits a Machine Learning Engineer, Applied ML Engineer, AI Research Engineer or Geospatial AI Engineer who wants to apply LLMs to the physical world rather than another text-only use case. Key Responsibilities Fine-tune, compress and deploy multimodal foundation models (LLMs and VLMs) for consumer-grade edge hardware and specialised spatial use cases. Design and prototype pipelines that turn geospatial data into structured, LLM-ready representations for spatial reasoning. Architect high-performance vector search and embedding-based retrieval over distributed spatial and geographic data. Build data pipelines that add real-time semantic context to mapping systems, known as thematic mapping. Develop agent-based workflows that combine models, retrieval and spatial tools into end-to-end systems. Build proof-of-concept demonstrators that test new model capabilities, and turn the results into clear technical recommendations. Evaluate model accuracy, latency and memory trade-offs on device, and drive decisions on architecture and deployment. Required Experience & Skills Essential PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering or a related technical field At least 2 years' of hands-on experience (in parallel to doctorate or since) fine-tuning or building on LLMs, foundation models or multimodal architectures such as vision-language models, beyond calling an API. Practical experience with geospatial data (maps, location or Earth-observation data) and/or vector embeddings and semantic search, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Strong Python skills, including building multi-step LLM or agent pipelines with orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen or Pydantic AI. A prototyping mindset: able to take an idea to a working demo quickly and judge whether it is viable. Desirable Deploying models under local hardware limits using ONNX, TensorRT or CoreML, including quantisation and other on-device optimisation. Building high-performance vector databases or approximate nearest-neighbour (ANN) search at scale. Background in remote sensing, LiDAR or point clouds, OpenStreetMap or mapping and location products. Recruiter’s Note The strongest candidates will combine hands-on LLM or multimodal work with real spatial data, for example a geospatial or remote-sensing ML researcher moving into foundation models, or an LLM/RAG engineer with mapping or location experience. On-device deployment experience is a strong plus, but it is not expected from everyone. By applying to this role you understand that we may collect your personal data and store and process it on our systems. For more information please see our Privacy Notice (https://eu-recruit.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/European-Tech-Recruit-Privacy-Notice-2025.pdf).

items.desc: RealAdvisor is one of the leading digital platforms in the European real estate ecosystem. Founded in Switzerland, we now support 5,000+ real estate agencies and attract 10+ million users per year across Europe. We are scaling fast across multiple markets with a clear mission: help real estate professionals grow through data, transparency and smart technology. At RealAdvisor, we value ownership, autonomy and impact. Role Overview We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of our geospatial data products. This is not a model-tuning role. You will design, build, and operate the full data lifecycle behind our real-estate insights — from orchestrating complex pipelines on Kubernetes to delivering high-performance geospatial visualizations with Mapbox. This is a builder role. You should be as comfortable debugging an Airflow DAG as you are computing spatial statistics or optimizing analytical queries. You'll have full autonomy over a modern, high-performance stack: Orchestration & Operations: Airflow, Kubernetes, Docker Data Storage: Postgres (PostGIS) for spatial workloads; ClickHouse for large-scale analytics Programming: Production-grade Python Requirements Key Responsibilities End-to-End Pipelines: Design and deploy automated pipelines (ETL) using Airflow to ingest diverse datasets (Real Estate transactions, listings, geo-data) Geospatial Analytics: Compute advanced spatial metrics (e.g., pricing honeycombs, average prices per neighborhood) using PostGIS and Python Infrastructure Management: Maintain and optimize the Kubernetes environment where your pipelines and models run Visualization Engineering: Transform your analytical outputs into interactive map layers (Vector Tiles) that integrate seamlessly with Mapbox on our frontend What We're Looking For Truly Full-Stack (Data): You don't believe data scientists should stop at notebooks. You own infrastructure, deployment, and reliability because that's how real value is delivered Strong Geospatial Intuition: You understand projections, polygons, spatial joins, and how to visualize density and patterns effectively Engineering Mindset: You write clean, modular, maintainable Python code designed for production — not one-off scripts Experience: 3+ years in a Data Science or Data Engineering role, with hands-on ownership of production systems Infrastructure Proficiency: Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including debugging and troubleshooting live environments Database Expertise: Advanced SQL, especially with PostGIS or similar spatial extensions. items.card: Vos Missions Sont Les Suivantes Analyser les besoins opérationnels et réaliser un état de l’art des solutions de traitement de données satellitaires. Déployer et évaluer des workflows d’IA sur différentes plateformes matérielles. Mesurer et analyser les performances des solutions étudiées à l’aide d’indicateurs adaptés. items.desc: Lieu : Toulouse, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants. Vous rejoignez l’équipe Chaîne Image Bord – Ingénierie Système et contribuez à l’innovation pour les futures missions d’ observation de la Terre . Vous participez à l’évaluation de solutions de calcul embarqué (logiciel et FPGA) destinées à traiter les données directement à bord des satellites. L’objectif est d’accélérer l’extraction d’informations utiles à partir des données acquises, notamment grâce à l’intelligence artificielle embarquée. Pour cela, vous utilisez des briques logicielles, des plateformes de prototypage et un simulateur fonctionnel de traitement et de transmission de données satellitaires. Vous analysez les gains de performance obtenus en termes de latence, de volume de données transmis et d’efficacité opérationnelle. Vos Missions Sont Les Suivantes Analyser les besoins opérationnels et réaliser un état de l’art des solutions de traitement de données satellitaires. Déployer et évaluer des workflows d’IA sur différentes plateformes matérielles. Mesurer et analyser les performances des solutions étudiées à l’aide d’indicateurs adaptés. Exploiter un simulateur PDHT pour évaluer l’impact du traitement embarqué sur les performances mission. Utiliser l’IA générative pour optimiser les analyses, la visualisation et la présentation des résultats. Documenter, présenter les travaux réalisés et proposer des axes d’amélioration. Votre profil Votre priorité est d'effectuer un stage de 6 mois ? Vous avez envie de découvrir les Vous êtes en bac+5 en école d’ingénieur ou équivalent en informatique ? Vous Avez Des Compétences En ingénierie système et architecture de systèmes complexes. Environnement Linux et développement Python. Intelligence artificielle, traitement d’images et IA générative. Edge Computing, conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes) et transmission de données (5G, ISL..). Esprit d’analyse, rigueur, curiosité, autonomie et créativité sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Le mot de l'équipe « Rejoignez une équipe d’architectes systèmes où votre autonomie et votre créativité seront mises à l’honneur ! Il n'est pas nécessaire de maîtriser l'ensemble des connaissances souhaitées pour postuler. Le contexte spécifique au spatial et l'utilisation détaillée des outils vous seront transmis sur place. Nous comptons sur vous pour proposer des solutions techniques et les expliquer clairement à des non-spécialistes. Vous aurez l’opportunité de développer vos compétences techniques tout en contribuant à un outil stratégique, dans un environnement où votre créativité et votre rigueur seront valorisées.» Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: Recognised on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 3,000 customers and ARR that has grown over 250 percent year over year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads. The company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla. We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey! About The Team The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. This includes the Agentic Data Stack, AI Functions, chDB, the in-Console copilot, and the AI/ML partnerships that distribute them — together with the shared components and expertise that let every other ClickHouse team ship AI in the surfaces they own. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced software engineers to join us, who will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the products that make ClickHouse the platform of choice for agents and data scientists. What You Will Do Feature Development: Design and implement AI-powered features across the full stack, from backend inference services to intuitive frontend interfaces within the ClickHouse Cloud platform. API Architecture: Create robust, scalable APIs that connect ClickHouse's database capabilities with modern AI/ML inference systems and external/internal AI services. Ecosystem Integrations: Implement and maintain integrations with the broader AI/ML ecosystem and standards, ensuring that ClickHouse as a technology works seamlessly with popular frameworks and tools. Technical Integration: Integrate models into production systems with proper monitoring, versioning, observability, and evaluation. Oncall: Participate in the daytime oncall rotation along with the rest of the team. ML Engineering: Own the ML pipeline end to end (data, training, evaluation), and fine-tune or train custom models when off-the-shelf ones fall short. Track the state of the art closely enough to apply what genuinely improves our products. What you will bring along 5+ years of software engineering experience in production environments Exposure to working directly with AI/ML technologies Experience integrating and deploying AI/ML models in production systems, including working with inference APIs and vector databases A high level of ownership and can drive features from concept to production with minimal supervision Ability to thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders Applied ML experience in Python (Jupyter, PyTorch, common ML libraries), hands-on with compute clusters (Ray, Slurm), and designs trustworthy experiments to drive architectural decisions Nice to have Familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly services related to AI/ML deployment Understanding of database systems and data processing pipelines, with ClickHouse experience being a significant plus Experience with embedding-based systems (retrieval, ranking, recommenders) and the representation-learning ideas underneath them Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Acquisirai, organizzerai e sincronizzerai dati multimodali provenienti da video, immagini, GPS e sensori. Svilupperai attività di pre-processing e post-processing su dati video e immagini. Esperienza nell’utilizzo di tecniche di intelligenza artificiale, reti neurali e deep learning . Esperienza in image processing e computer vision , preferibilmente applicate a dati video o immagini. Conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno a livello C1 e italiano a livello C2 o Madrelingua. Disponibilità a lavorare in modalità full onsite . Nice to have: Esperienza nella gestione di dati multimodali provenienti da video, GPS e sensori. Esperienza in ambito automotive, mobilità o sistemi basati su prototipi. Un ambiente in cui la fiducia è centrale e la crescita interna è valorizzata. Un solido sistema di formazione con Academy interna e moduli disponibili. Introduction
 The TWINSCAN Factory (TF) OE Quality department drives quality excellence and continuous improvement within ASML’s manufacturing environment in Veldhoven. In this Business Analytics | Artificial Intelligence internship: workflow optimization, you will explore how artificial intelligence can help teams work more efficiently and make better-informed decisions. You will identify opportunities to improve recurring activities and business processes through practical AI applications. By developing and validating proof-of-concepts, you will contribute to measurable operational improvements.
 Your assignment
 During this internship, you will investigate how AI and data-driven approaches can support operational and quality-related processes. You will analyze workflows, engage with stakeholders, and identify opportunities where technology can create business value. You will critically evaluate potential solutions and translate improvement opportunities into practical proof-of-concepts. Your main responsibilities will be:
 Analyze recurring activities, workflows, and business processes
 Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvement
 Research and evaluate suitable artificial intelligence and automation solutions
 Develop and validate proof-of-concepts using Python, data processing, and generative AI techniques
 Assess the feasibility, expected impact, and scalability of proposed improvements
 Present recommendations and insights to stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
 Support knowledge sharing and contribute to future AI initiatives within the department
 This is a bachelor/master non-thesis internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 3 days per week (2 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.
 Your profile
 To be suitable for the internship, you:
 Are pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field
 Have experience with Python, data processing, and generative AI
 Are able to analyze processes and identify opportunities for improvement
 Demonstrate an independent, analytical, and proactive working style
 Communicate effectively in English and collaborate with stakeholders from different backgrounds
 Experience with development environments, workflow automation, business intelligence, or data platforms is considered an advantage. This may include experience with tools such as Visual Studio Code (VS Code), Power BI, Power Automate, Power Query, Databricks, n8n, Lovable, or similar technologies. However, specific tool experience is not required.
 If you are excited about combining technology, process improvement, and business impact, this could be the right opportunity for you. Through this internship you will gain hands-on experience with AI applications, stakeholder engagement, workflow optimization, and operational excellence. You will help shape practical solutions that create measurable value while contributing to continuous improvement within ASML.
 Other requirements you need to meet: 
 You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; 
 If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); 
 You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; 
 You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.
 Do you want to know more about the internship allowance, visa support and applying for an internship at ASML? Read this page .

Job Description Summary 
At GE HealthCare, we are advancing precision health through innovative technologies. We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer with a strong focus on embedded systems to join our Pharmaceutical Diagnostics team supporting PET Products.
In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for our FASTlab and TRACERlab platforms, as well as contribute to the PC-based control software that operates these systems. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle, helping to deliver high-quality, reliable solutions in a regulated medical environment that directly impacts patient care. Our team embraces modern, AI-assisted development workflows using tools such as Claude and Codex.
This is a hybrid role based in Münster, Germany, with an expectation to work at least 3 days per week in the office to foster collaboration and innovation within the team. In addition, hands-on work with our FASTlab and TRACERlab systems in the lab is an essential part of this role.
At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define system requirements and contribute to software architecture and design.
 Translate requirements into robust, maintainable embedded firmware solutions (C-based) including testing and detailed documentation.
 Design, implement, and validate new features for both embedded systems and PC applications , ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards.
 Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude or Codex as part of our software development workflow while critically reviewing all AI-generated results to ensure they meet our quality and regulatory requirements.
 Execute and support verification and validation (V&V) activities to demonstrate product safety, performance, and reliability.
 Partner with service teams, customers, and hardware suppliers to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues in embedded control systems, performing root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, and software components.
 Apply Design for Reliability (DfR) principles and leverage Agile and Lean methodologies to drive continuous improvement.
 Work with global engineering teams to ensure consistency and reuse across software platforms.
 Collaborate with external hardware partners to ensure seamless hardware/software integration .
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline , or equivalent practical experience
 Significant experience developing embedded software in C for microcontroller-based systems
 Exposure to Windows-based application development (C#/.NET preferred) and willingness to contribute when required
 Strong understanding of embedded software architecture and design 
 Understanding of embedded electronics , including ADC/DAC, digital I/O, interrupts, PWM, motor control, and PID control systems
 Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, serial interfaces, and hardware diagnostic tools
 Familiarity with software configuration management and version control tools (e.g., Git, Azure DevOps)
 Practical experience in using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot) for software development, including the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Good English skills are essential, as English is our primary working language; good German skills (B2 or higher) are also required
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., medical devices, automotive, or similar)
 Knowledge of medical device software standards such as IEC 62304 and ISO 13485 
 Experience with unit testing for embedded C and CI/CD pipelines .
 Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) 
 Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces such as RS232, CAN, Ethernet, and TCP/IP 
 Familiarity with PIC32 microcontrollers and the IDE MPLAB .
 Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and component datasheets 
 Experience with Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) 
 Desired Attributes 
 Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative, global team environment 
 Strong customer focus with the ability to support field teams and resolve issues effectively
 Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills 
 High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability

Job Title
Reconstruction Algorithms Developer - MRI 
 Job Description
 As a Reconstruction Algorithms Developer – MRI , you will innovate new AI-based algorithms for MRI reconstruction, optimize reconstruction methods to improve image quality and performance and develop solutions that enable new clinical applications. You will join a global team of software and hardware engineers developing the next generation of MRI scanners, working closely across disciplines and geographical boundaries.
 Your role: 
 Innovate, specify, prototype, engineer, test, and document MR reconstruction algorithms.
 Bring clinical MR features from the research stage through advanced development into products by delivering high-quality software and documentation.
 Extend existing Philips MR software, with an emphasis on clinical functionality and usability, while collaborating cross-functionally across hardware, software, system integration and verification, marketing, and product applications.
 Maintain relationships with clinical sites and other teams within Philips to exchange knowledge and advance MRI applications.
 Contribute to conferences and file patent disclosures.
 You are part of 
 You will be part of the Business Unit Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) within Philips Healthcare, which is responsible for the marketing, product development, and lifecycle management of the entire clinical MRI portfolio.
 Within the Business Unit, you will join the R&D Software team, a global team highly committed to developing and delivering new clinical features to the market. This position is part of the Reconstruction group based in Best, the Netherlands.
 Want to learn more about the people and innovation behind our MR technology? Discover the Innovation spotlight , explore our work on multi-contrast 4D MR imaging for radiotherapy simulation and read about advances in MRI speed and precision with SmartSpeed Precise .
 To succeed in this role, you should have the following skills and experience: 
 A Master’s or PhD degree in Mathematics or a related field, with a strong focus on applied mathematics and numerical methods.
 Knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning.
 Knowledge of MR physics and MR imaging techniques.
 Experience with inverse problems and solving large systems of equations.
 Experience with MRI reconstruction algorithms or other physics-based reconstruction techniques.
 Hands-on experience with AI model development.
 Experience with relevant programming languages, such as C++ and Python.
 A creative and innovative mindset, with a strong drive to deliver high-quality results.
 Excellent English communication skills.
 Ability to collaborate and interact effectively in multidisciplinary teams.
 Ability to work effectively in a complex and highly regulated environment.
 A quality-minded and customer-focused approach.
 Ambition and a strong drive to continuously learn and develop your skills.
 Compensation & benefits 
 Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is EUR 50,750.00 - EUR 79,750.00. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Benefits include hybrid working, paid time-off, health and wellbeing benefits, learning and development opportunities.

 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

Clinical Research Associate
 Valencia, California 
 Join Advanced Bionics as a Clinical Research Associate and help support the successful execution of global medical device clinical studies from study start-up through close-out. In this role, you will work closely with investigative sites and cross-functional teams to support high-quality clinical research, maintain regulatory compliance, and contribute to studies that support innovative hearing healthcare technologies.
 Responsibilities
 Execute clinical studies from site start-up through study close-out in compliance with study protocols, ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, and applicable regulatory requirements.
 Conduct site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits (SQV, SIV, IMV, and COV).
 Support site activation, investigator training, study device accountability, and study close-out activities.
 Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned investigative sites and monitor site performance, enrollment, protocol compliance, and data quality.
 Identify and escalate study risks and ensure timely resolution of monitoring findings, data queries, protocol deviations, and safety-reporting requirements.
 Maintain accurate and inspection-ready clinical documentation, including TMF/eTMF and investigator site files, and support audits and regulatory inspections.
 Collaborate with Clinical Trial Management and cross-functional partners to support successful study execution and regulatory submissions.
 More about you
 Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or another related scientific discipline.
 Minimum 2 years of clinical research experience, including at least 1 year of independent site monitoring.
 Experience managing multiple clinical sites and working with CTMS, EDC, and eTMF systems.
 Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, clinical monitoring, site management, and data quality.
 Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and time-management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities.
 Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
 Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to study sites, conferences, and other study-related activities.
 Preferred qualifications include: a Master's degree or equivalent; ACRP-CRA, ACRP-CP, or SOCRA CCRP certification; experience with Class III medical device clinical trials, global multicenter studies, FDA IDE/PMA or EU MDR clinical studies; and knowledge of Risk-Based Monitoring/RbQM.

items.desc: Who we are ? Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools. The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment. Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes. A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components. Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework. Your main responsibilities will include : Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verification Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom The candidate must have a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, Python programming, data processing and analysis, and software engineering. They must also be fluent in English and able to develop, train, evaluate, test and document AI components within a collaborative environment. Experience in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP/LLM), graph learning, learning-guided search or the deployment of machine learning models would be an advantage. An interest in formal verification, cybersecurity, trustworthy AI, Docker and teaching activities would also be appreciated. The role also requires strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as a good team spirit. The candidate must be able to communicate clearly, explain technical concepts in layman’s terms, draft documentation and contribute to teaching activities.
