items.desc: Über die TU Darmstadt Die TU Darmstadt steht für exzellente und relevante Wissenschaft. Die tiefgreifenden globalen Veränderungsprozesse – von Energiewende bis zu Künstlicher Intelligenz – gestalten wir durch herausragende Erkenntnisse und zukunftsweisende Studienangebote entscheidend mit. Unsere Spitzenforschung bündeln wir in drei Feldern: Energy and Environment, Information and Intelligence, Matter and Materials. Als eine in der Metropolregion Frankfurt-Rhein-Main verankerte und sehr stark international geprägte Universität sehen wir uns den europäischen Werten und der europäischen Integration verpflichtet. Über unseren Bereich Ihre Mission: Sie sind Expert:in für wissenschaftliche Softwareentwicklung (Research Software Engineering, RSE) – und wollen Forschungssoftware nachhaltiger, wiederverwendbarer und robuster machen? Dann werden Sie Teil unseres Teams am Hessischen Kompetenzzentrum für Hochleistungsrechnen (HKHLR, www.hkhlr.de ) in der TU Darmstadt! Gemeinsam mit unseren Partner:innen in den hessischen Hochschulen bauen Sie ein standortübergreifendes RSE-Angebot auf: Sie entwickelen und pflegen Forschungssoftware, beraten Forschende zu guter Softwarepraxis, KI-unterstützter Softwareentwicklung, konzipieren Schulungen und tragen durch Ihre Arbeit maßgeblich zu nachhaltiger und glaubwürdiger Forschung in Hessen bei. Informationen zur Stelle Kennziffer: Kennziffer Eintrittsdatum: Besetzung Befristung: Befristung Umfang: Umfang Vergütung: Tarif Einsatzort: Einsatzort Bewerbungsfrist: Bewerbungsfrist Ihre Aufgaben Was Sie erwartet: Forschungsnahe Softwareentwicklung: Sie arbeiten eng mit Wissenschaftler:innen zusammen, entwickeln, pflegen und modernisieren Forschungssoftware – vom Refactoring gewachsener Codebasen über automatisierte Tests bis zur nachnutzbaren Veröffentlichung. Dabei setzen Sie auf Wartbarkeit, Wiederverwendbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit, damit Ihr Code nicht nur heute, sondern auch morgen Forschung beschleunigt. RSE-Beratung: Als Partner:in für Forschende an den hessischen Hochschulen analysiersen Sie bestehende Softwareprojekte, identifizieren technische Schulden und schlagen Lösungen vor – ob bei Softwarearchitektur, Testing und Dokumentation, der FAIR-konformen Bereitstellung von Software und Daten oder der effizienten Nutzung von HPC-Ressourcen für Simulation und KI. Schulungen & Wissensvermittlung: Sie konzipieren Workshops, erstellen Lehrmaterialien und verfassen Best-Practice-Guides von guter Softwarepraxis bis zur KI-unterstützten Softwareentwicklung – damit Forschende das volle Potenzial ihrer Software ausschöpfen können. Forschungstransfer: Sie veröffentlichen Erkenntnisse aus Ihrer Arbeit, präsentieren auf Konferenzen, betreuen Abschlussarbeiten und unterstützen die Wissenschaftskommunikation des HKHLR. Agile Zusammenarbeit: In interdisziplinären, standortübergreifenden Teams entwickeln Sie Lösungen, die Forschung voranbringen – ob bei der Umsetzung von DevOps-Praktiken, der Integration von KI in Forschungsworkflows oder der Weiterentwicklung von Simulationssoftware. Ihr Profil Was Sie mitbringen: Expertise in wissenschaftlicher Softwareentwicklung: Ein Masterabschluss oder eine Promotion in Informatik – oder ein natur-/ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung in der Entwicklung wissenschaftlicher Software Software-Engineering-Praxis: Erfahrung mit Methoden guter Softwareentwicklung wie Softwarearchitektur, automatisiertem Testen, Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und Packaging. Sie kennen die typischen Herausforderungen gewachsener Forschungssoftware – und haben Lösungen parat Programmierpraxis: Fundierte Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Programmiersprache (z. B. Python, C++, Fortran, Julia) – und die Bereitschaft, sich in neue Sprachen und Tools einzuarbeiten DevOps-Methoden: Erfahrung mit Versionskontrolle (Git), CI/CD-Pipelines (z. B. GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) und Containertechnologien (z. B. Docker, Apptainer) HPC- und KI-Kenntnisse: Erfahrung mit paralleler Programmierung, der Arbeit auf HPC-Systemen oder dem Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen in der Softwareentwicklung sowie Kenntnisse der FAIR-Prinzipien sind von Vorteil Leidenschaft für Wissensvermittlung: Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären – ob in Schulungen, Workshops oder Dokumentationen Teamplayer-Mentalität: Sie arbeiten strukturiert, serviceorientiert und haben Freude daran, Kolleg:innen und Nutzer:innen zu unterstützen. Kommunikationsstärke :: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift – für Beratung, Schulungen und Publikationen runden Ihr Profil ab Wir bieten Die Technische Universität Darmstadt bietet vielfältige und herausfordernde Aufgaben, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, aktuelle Technologien, gute kollegiale und partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit, bedarfsorientierte Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten und eine individuelle Personalentwicklung. Entfaltung und Gestaltung – ein umfassendes internes Weiterbildungsangebot sowie Möglichkeiten der Weiterqualifizierung und Entwicklung …

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day You're building the foundation of the Financial Planning & Analysis of tomorrow. As Enablement Specialist FP&A you own the enablement journey of the whole function: you design how FP&A learns to work with AI – the learning material and the training sessions in the teams – and you deliver it in person. You are part of the FP&A Transformation & Enablement team and report to its lead. You are the consultant and partner of the FP&A community: you understand their processes in depth, show them where and how AI tools fit along those processes, and help them integrate the tools so that the new way of working sticks. You also mentor the FP&A Leadership Team on enablement and personal productivity – so that the change is led from the top and visible in how our leaders work themselves. Your day moves between the teams, with whom you work on their real processes; the learning material and training sessions you create and run; the leadership team you mentor; the FP&A context and process landscape you help to build; and the market, which you watch continuously – new tools, new features, new ways of working – to bring the best of it into FP&A with innovative, pragmatic thinking. How You’ll Make an Impact Own and evolve the FP&A enablement journey: learning material, training sessions in the teams and community formats – from concept to delivery and continuous improvement Create learning material that works in daily business: guides, templates, demos and short formats colleagues can apply directly on their own processes Deliver training sessions and workshops in the FP&A teams – in person and virtually – and present complex topics clearly to groups from team level to leadership Mentor the FP&A Leadership Team on enablement and personal productivity: individual sessions on their own way of working with AI, and advice on how to lead the change in their teams Act as consultant and partner for the FP&A community: understand their processes, identify where AI tools create value and support colleagues in applying them Integrate tools along processes: translate a process into a sequence of AI-supported steps with commodity solutions such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and Power Automate, and show how the result changes the daily work Contribute to the FP&A context layer and the process landscape: bring what you learn in the teams into process documentation, context and standards Research as a core part of the role: scout new tools, features, approaches and ways of working, test them, and turn what works into guidance and learning material for FP&A Measure adoption and feedback across the journey and use it to sharpen formats and content Have fun doing cool, innovative stuff with great people – and get insights across the whole of FP&A What You Bring Experience in enablement, training, consulting, change management or business process roles, ideally in a corporate finance or controlling environment Very good process understanding: the ability to analyse how a process runs end to end and to redesign it with AI tools along the way Hands-on experience with commodity AI solutions – Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Snowflake Cortex Code or GitHub Copilot – and the ability to integrate them into existing workflows Strong presentation skills: confident in front of groups, able to explain technology in business language and to make people want to try it Strong communication and stakeholder skills across hierarchies, teams and regions, including the confidence to mentor senior leaders Experience in creating learning material and formats – from written guides to live demos and short videos Curiosity and innovative thinking: you follow the AI tool landscape closely, test new features early and translate them into practical use Structured, self-driven way of working with a strong sense for what moves an organisation Fluency in English; German is a plus About the Team Our Corporate Functions are essential in driving the company's strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across various departments, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you contribute to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external stakeholders, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Als juridisch adviseur AI & data science zorg je voor het verbeteren van de
items.desc: De politie zoekt adviseurs met een actieve houding die met hun juridische en/of achtergrond bijdragen aan het realiseren van gestelde doelen en resultaten op het gebied van data science en AI. Specificaties vacature Locatie(s): Nieuwegein Organisatieonderdeel: Staf Korpsleiding Vakgebied(en): Juridisch Niveau: HBO BACHELOR Wat ga je doen? Als juridisch adviseur AI & data science zorg je voor het verbeteren van de legitimiteit van de ontwikkeling en inzet van complexere algoritmes binnen de processen van de politie. Je adviseert en begeleidt dataspecialisten binnen de organisatie over de juridische en privacyaspecten, zowel vooraf als tijdens de ontwikkeling van algoritmes. Je adviseert over hoe deze aspecten kunnen worden gemonitord tijdens het gebruik van het algoritme in de politieprocessen. En je signaleert en adviseert over de aanscherping van de juridische kaders waarbinnen gewerkt wordt en tegelijk ook zorgen dat deze zo werkbaar mogelijk zijn voor de data science-specialisten. Vanuit je inhoudelijke deskundigheid en vaardigheden help je (bij-)sturing te geven aan de koers van veelal nieuwe ontwikkelingen in het politiewerk, specifiek op het terrein van digitale technologie. Vanuit je deskundigheid draag je bij aan het ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van een juridisch instrumentarium. Zorgen voor bewustwording en aandacht voor privacy en rechtmatigheid bij data specialisten is ook een onderdeel van je werk. Jouw inzet draagt bij aan het borgen van de transparantie en rechtmatigheid van complexe data toepassingen, je helpt bij het in beeld brengen van niet eerder erkende problematiek, het beantwoorden van bijbehorende juridische vraagstukken en het geven van (gevraagd en ongevraagd) advies. Je werkzaamheden spelen zich af in een politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving. Je bent in staat om snel een functioneel netwerk op te bouwen en werkt met collega’s uit diverse vakgebieden samen. Je werkt nauw samen met de juristen en privacy specialisten in de operationele politieregio's en het Politiedienstencentrum. Zij zijn primair aanspreekpunt voor juridische en privacy vraagstukken, maar zij kunnen terugvallen op jouw expertise en ervaring als het gaat om de bijzonderheden die komen kijken bij complexere algoritmes en toepassingen van kunstmatige intelligentie, zoals machine learning algoritmes. Tevens werk je nauw samen met de juristen van de staf Korpsleiding, in het bijzonder van de Afdeling Gegevensautoriteit. Het is hun verantwoordelijkheid om conform wetgeving beleidskaders op te stellen die aansluiten bij de politiepraktijk en erop toe te zien dat deze kaders worden gevolgd. Daarnaast voeren zij overleg met de ministeries ten aanzien van toekomstige wetgeving binnen het veiligheidsdomein en leveren zij een bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van rijksbrede standaards voor de informatiehuishouding en uitwisseling. Daarbij is jouw inbreng en expertise, die jij opdoet in de samenwerking met AI en Data Science specialisten, onontbeerlijk. Waar ga je werken? Formeel valt de functie onder de staf Korpsleiding in een tijdelijk werkconstruct maar zal op korte termijn een vaste plek in de organisatie gaan krijgen. Als veranderkundige lever je een bijdrage aan de AI-organisatie en specifiek Projectenteam AI (PTAI) dat een vaste plek in de organisatie gaat krijgen. De rol van veranderkundige heeft mogelijkheid tot een vast dienstverband en zal meegaan in de borging van het organisatieonderdeel. Uitvalsbasis van het team is de Ringwade Nieuwegein, maar ook werken aan de Hub50 in Utrecht en de Nieuwe Uitleg in Den Haag zal regelmatig voorkomen. De politie werkt uiteraard met online vergaderingen, waardoor je flexibel bent bij het indelen van je dag. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren jurist en adviseur met ruime kennis van en relevante werkervaring met de Wet politiegegevens en de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming. Je hebt aantoonbare relevante kennis en ervaring met ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitale technologie, zoals AI en Data Science. Je hebt aantoonbaar ruime ervaring met de detectie en behandeling van juridische vraagstukken die komen kijken bij de inzet, ontwikkeling, en evaluatie van AI algoritmes. Je bent bekend, en up-to-date, met zowel de Nederlandse als Europese (AI Act) wet en regelgeving rondom het gebruik van algoritmes en kan deze goed en praktisch vertalen richting ontwikkelaars en data scientisten. Je hebt daarbij een ijzersterk analytisch vermogen en je kunt je uitstekend schriftelijk en mondeling uitdrukken. Je ervaring met het schrijven van beleidsvoorstellen en adviezen komen hierbij goed van pas. Effectief ga je om met onzekerheid en veranderingen in de organisatie, de omgeving en jezelf. Je hebt zicht op wat er binnen de maatschappij en de politieorganisatie speelt en hebt overtuigingskracht en organisatievermogen. Je bent klantgericht, netwerkvaardig en verandergericht. Naast inhoudelijke kennis van AI en algoritmes vragen we ook om: hbo bachelor werk- en denkniveau* in Rechten of Toegepast Recht, …

Colleagues come to us with more ideas than we can build. Your job is to turn those ideas into well-founded
items.desc: Full-time / Part-time (min. 4 days per week) | 5 to 9 months Internship for HBO students About Edge We're the fast-moving real estate company headquartered in Amsterdam with offices across Europe. And we're not just developing, redeveloping, and investing in properties, we're architecting the future where healthier, smarter, and more sustainable buildings are the norm, not the exception. We're the team that shows up in hard hats and leaves with game-changing spaces, because ordinary buildings are for ordinary companies, and we're definitely not ordinary. Our Company Values: “We are Edge” Entrepreneurship ; We take initiative, think creatively, and embrace smart risk-taking to create lasting value and drive innovation. Drive; We are ambitious, focused, and resilient, always pushing forward with energy and determination to achieve meaningful results and bring the extra 20% that nobody expects but everyone remembers. Grounded; We remain practical, humble, and authentic, guided by integrity and committed to what truly matters: trust, respect, and strong, long-term relationships. Excellence; We hold ourselves to the highest standards, continuously striving to improve and deliver outstanding quality in everything we do. Are you the kind of person who brings these values to life? What is amazing about this job? You will join the IT team at our Amsterdam headquarters, a small team that runs a fully cloud-native Microsoft environment for all Edge offices across Europe. Edge is putting AI to work across the organisation, from Microsoft Copilot and Claude for every colleague to purpose-built AI tools for specific teams. Colleagues come to us with more ideas than we can build. Your job is to turn those ideas into well-founded projects. A colleague tells you they want tool X to be able to do Y; you find out what they really need, work out how a solution would function and turn it into a first project document and business case that decides whether we go ahead. You will use Claude as your working partner throughout, from preparing and running intake meetings to drafting the documents. Responsibilities As an IT Intern you will work with the IT team on: AI project intake: meet colleagues and teams across the business, using Claude to prepare, run and summarise intake meetings. Get from “I want tool X to do Y” to the actual problem worth solving. Project document and business case: turn each request into an initial project document: scope, users, expected benefits, effort, cost and risks, ending in a clear go or no-go proposal to the Head of IT. Solution logic: describe how a solution should work: the screens a user sees, the steps behind them and the data and rules that drive them, so the build team can pick it up without starting over. Testing and feedback: test the solutions we build against the original request, together with the people who will use them. AI adoption: help prepare AI workshops, showcases and short user guides so colleagues get the most out of the tools we provide. Overall support: help the IT team with day-to-day questions from colleagues, including basic troubleshooting. Competences / Skills relevant for the role Currently enrolled in the third or fourth year of an HBO programme in Business IT & Management, HBO-ICT, Business Administration (Bedrijfskunde), or a related field. The internship runs under an internship agreement with your school Strong interest in AI and experience using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your studies or work Hands-on mentality: you enjoy talking to people, asking the next question and getting things moving Logical and analytical thinker: you can break a process down into steps, rules and data Understanding of how a user interface ties into the logic and data behind it; you do not need to be a designer Familiar with Microsoft 365; experience with Power Platform, low-code tools or scripting is a plus Clear written and spoken communication in Dutch and English Able to work independently, handle multiple projects and keep stakeholders informed What We Offer An inspiring and dynamic work environment within an innovative international real estate company Your own portfolio of AI projects, from first request to business case Direct guidance from the Head of IT, and room to shape your internship or graduation assignment Hands-on experience with a modern, cloud-native Microsoft environment and the latest AI tools Room for personal growth and future career opportunities within Edge An expense allowance (onkostenvergoeding) of € 500 per month Would you like to know more or apply directly? Click on the ‘Apply online’ link, upload your cv and your motivation and we will come back to you as soon as possible.

Vi söker dig som tycker att tekniken bakom
items.desc: Är du tekniskt kunnig, gillar SEO och är nyfiken på hur AI förändrar framtidens sök? Då kanske du är den vi söker! Beyond Nordic är ett ungt, ambitiöst och växande företag inom outdoor och friluftsliv. Vi arbetar med e-handel på flera marknader i Norden och Europa och söker nu en tekniskt intresserad SEO-specialist som vill hjälpa oss att förbättra vår organiska synlighet. Vi söker dig som tycker att tekniken bakom en webbplats är minst lika intressant som det som syns på skärmen. Du gillar att analysera, felsöka, skriva kod och hitta smarta lösningar som gör skillnad. Hos oss får du arbeta praktiskt med teknisk SEO, moderna webbtekniker och utvecklingen inom AI-baserade söktjänster. Om tjänsten Som Technical SEO & AI Search Specialist arbetar du med att förbättra Beyond Nordics synlighet i sökmotorer som Google och Bing, men också i AI-drivna söktjänster som ChatGPT, Perplexity och Google AI Overviews. Arbetet har ett tydligt tekniskt fokus. Du kommer att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter, analysera webbplatsens prestanda och själv genomföra tekniska SEO-åtgärder. Vi arbetar med en modern headless e-handelslösning där Next.js/React används för frontend, Storyblok för innehållshantering och Centra som e-handelsplattform. Du kommer att ha kontakt med våra externa utvecklare vid större tekniska förändringar, men vi ser gärna att du själv kan genomföra många av de löpande förbättringarna. Tjänsten innehåller både praktiskt SEO-arbete, analys och planering av kommande förbättringar. Dina arbetsuppgifter Arbeta med teknisk SEO och löpande förbättringar av våra webbplatser. Optimera indexering, crawlability, metadata, canonical-taggar, XML-sitemaps och internlänkning. Arbeta med strukturerad data (Schema.org) för att förbättra hur sökmotorer och andra tjänster tolkar vårt innehåll. Identifiera och åtgärda tekniska SEO-problem. Genomföra kodrelaterade förbättringar i vår frontendmiljö. Arbeta med webbplatsens laddningstider, Core Web Vitals och tekniska prestanda. Förbättra vår tekniska SEO för olika språk och marknader, bland annat genom hreflang och internationell sidstruktur. Utforska och testa tekniska förbättringar för AI Search och GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Analysera sökresultat, organisk trafik och utveckling med hjälp av relevanta SEO-verktyg. Samarbeta med våra externa utvecklare kring förbättringar som kräver större tekniska förändringar. Vem söker vi? Vi tror att du har viss praktisk erfarenhet av teknisk SEO och en god förståelse för hur moderna webbplatser fungerar. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, men vi vill att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är lösningsorienterad och tycker om att lära dig nya saker. Du är bekväm med att arbeta självständigt, tar egna initiativ och gillar att kombinera analys med praktiskt arbete. Vi ser gärna att du har: Erfarenhet av teknisk SEO, gärna från e-handel. Goda kunskaper i HTML, CSS och JavaScript. Förståelse för React, Next.js eller liknande frontendtekniker. Förmåga att själv skriva och anpassa kod för tekniska SEO-förbättringar. Kunskap om hur indexering, rendering, webbplatsstruktur och strukturerad data påverkar SEO. Erfarenhet av Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog eller liknande verktyg. Ett analytiskt arbetssätt och intresse för att följa upp resultat. Nyfikenhet på AI och hur nya söktjänster förändrar förutsättningarna för SEO. Det är meriterande om du har: Arbetat med Next.js, Storyblok, Centra eller liknande headless-lösningar. Erfarenhet av internationell SEO och flerspråkiga webbplatser. Kunskaper inom API, Python eller automatisering. Erfarenhet av produktdata och teknisk SEO för e-handel. Testat eller arbetat med AI Search och GEO. Du behöver inte vara copywriter. Vi har andra personer som arbetar med textproduktion och innehåll. Vi söker framför allt dig som är bra på de tekniska delarna bakom en välfungerande och sökmotoroptimerad webbplats. items.title: Health Data Scientist
items.card: In this role you will develop and apply AI methods to electronic patient record data and linked retinal and other imaging data to develop, validate and apply models to predict health outcomes in people with diabetes. You'll investigate the impact of accelerated ageing on these outcomes, and whether commonly increasingly used diabetes drugs like Ozempic, Mounjaro and Dapagliflozin reduce biological ageing. You'll
items.desc: Closing date Saturday, 14 November 2026, 23:59 Salary £37,694 - £46,049 per annum Grade 7 Contract type Fixed Term Campus Ninewells Faculty/Directorate Faculty of Health Unit/Department Medicine Health Data Scientist Full-Time for up to 24 months Faculty of Health We are seeking two exceptional health data scientists to join the groups of Pearson (Faculty of Health, Department of Medicine) and Trucco (Faculty of Science, Engineering and Business, Department of Computing) at the University of Dundee. In this role you will develop and apply AI methods to electronic patient record data and linked retinal and other imaging data to develop, validate and apply models to predict health outcomes in people with diabetes. You'll investigate the impact of accelerated ageing on these outcomes, and whether commonly increasingly used diabetes drugs like Ozempic, Mounjaro and Dapagliflozin reduce biological ageing. You'll also work with linked molecular data - including genotyping array and proteomics. About the Role As a health data scientist you will join a team of clinicians with a long track record of working with population electronic health record (EHR) data (Pearson, Mordi) who work closely with colleagues from computing (Trucco, McKenna) with expertise in computer vision and AI image analysis. You will be expected to wrangle EHR data, and run frequentist and Bayesian statistical models, machine learning and deep learning models incorporating multimodal data. The strength, and challenge, of the data is the >25 years of longitudinal follow up and you will be expected to have or develop skills in longitudinal modelling, and development and validation of prediction models. The focus of this project is on biological ageing - with ageing clocks derived from retinal imaging, or proteomic analysis. We are interested in who has accelerated ageing, the clinical impact of accelerated ageing and whether routinely used drugs, like the GLP-1RA Ozempic, alter ageing rates. This work is a collaboration with Eli Lilly. Key Responsibilities Wrangling and curating electronic health record data and imaging data Developing, optimizing and validating models of biological ageing Developing and validating prediction models for ageing related outcomes Ensuring all code is fully annotated and available in a public repository e.g. github Writing and presenting reports and presentations to stakeholders Essential Excellent skills and demonstrable experience of AI and machine learning software development for data and image analysis, as well as use of current packages and languages e.g., Python and relevant libraries. Demonstrable experience in software projects involving healthcare data and image analysis via machine learning. Experience of healthcare data curation and processing in safe havens. Presentation skills: demonstrable experience of successful paper writing, conference and workshop presentations. Communication skills: excellent command of the English language and its use for successful, constructive interactions with other members of a research group as well as external collaborators, both academic and in companies. Desirable PhD in a numerate discipline Knowledge and expertise in SQL, R, Python, PySpark Knowledge and experience in analysing molecular data including proteomic and genomic data Experience of working with Bayesian statistical methods Active roles as a researcher in data science projects aimed to biomarker discovery UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) Requirements Any offer of appointment will be conditional upon the individual having, or being able to obtain, the right to work in the UK. Prospective applicants are encouraged to review UK Government immigration guidance to assess their eligibility to work in the UK, including consideration of visa options that may be available to them, prior to applying.

items.desc: Who are we? Hi, we’re Tails.com – we turn good days into great years for dogs and their humans. We're working towards longer lives for millions of healthy, happy dogs by providing tailored nutrition that adapts to each dog’s unique needs. It all starts with a few simple questions about their age, breed, zoomie level and tastebuds. From there, owners can create a personalised meal plan that's delivered to their door every month. No guesswork, no overwhelm. Just exactly the right care for every dog, every day. It's pretty clever stuff. As a certified B Corp, being a responsible business is built into how we work – upholding high social and environmental standards to create better walkies for generations to come. Now, we’re cooking up big plans. Having created an entirely new category in dog food, we have the backing of Purina – one of the world’s largest pet food companies. You’ll join a bunch of smart people working towards these same goals (and a bunch of very smart office dogs, all working on their own thing). Job Title Data Scientist Reporting of the role Reports to: Senior Analytics Manager Overview of the job The Data Scientist will own Tails.com's predictive modelling and machine learning work, with a primary focus on improving customer lifetime value (LTV) and driving more sustainable, profitable growth. They will build and develop models that help the business better understand which customers are likely to stay, spend and engage long-term, using these insights to improve acquisition strategies, customer retention and the overall customer experience. The role will work closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, Customer Experience & Retention, Product, Finance, Engineering and Data teams, taking ownership of projects from identifying opportunities and building models through to testing, implementation and measuring commercial impact. The focus isn't simply on building models, but on turning data science into practical business decisions that improve how Tails.com acquires and retains customers. 3 best things about the job 1. Ownership & influence: Own the predictive modelling and machine learning agenda, with the opportunity to shape the wider data science roadmap and influence business strategy. 2. items.desc: Overview We are seeking a specialist AI Assurance Practitioner to implement, operationalise, and deliver a proactive, risk-based AI Assurance Framework across complex, high-consequence operational and enterprise systems. As our client transitions toward continuous, proportionate AI governance, you will provide critical subject matter expertise to embed prescriptive AI assurance across the full capability lifecycle. Working directly with engineering and delivery teams, senior project owners, and enterprise risk authorities, you will ensure AI-enabled systems are safe, secure, ethical, and operationally effective. Key Responsibilities Policy Implementation & Operationalisation: Translate overarching defence AI policies, standards (such as JSP 936), and industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001) into practical, repeatable assurance processes, checklists, templates, and guidance. Intake, Triage & Risk Categorisation: Manage the intake and registration pipeline for emerging AI initiatives, assessing system context, consequence, and novelty to determine proportionate tiers of assurance. AI Ethical & Risk Assessments: Guide multidisciplinary delivery teams through system boundary definition, hazard identification, ethical impact assessments, control design, residual risk scoring, and formal risk ownership. Technical Evidence & Model Review: Interrogate AI system specifications, data provenance, training pipelines, model documentation, algorithmic bias assessments, and data sufficiency to constructively challenge incomplete evidence. Specialist Assessment Coordination: Scope and coordinate deeper technical assurance for high-risk capabilities, including model evaluations, adversarial robustness/red-teaming, and cyber/safety stress tests. Governance, Escalation & Reporting: Maintain the central AI assurance risk register, escalate critical residual risks through established governance boards, and compile evidence to support senior leadership assurance statements. Process Alignment & Integration: Align AI assurance workflows with established digital delivery mechanisms, Secure by Design (SbD) frameworks, safety cases, and technical test/trials pathways. Enduring Capability & Knowledge Transfer: Deliver coaching, guidance, and upskilling to internal delivery teams and emerging assurance personnel to build sustainable in-house AI evaluation capability. Requirements Essential: Security Clearance: Valid UK National Security Vetting SC Clearance with eligibility and willingness to undergo Developed Vetting (DV). Defence AI Standards: Practical working knowledge of UK Defence AI standards and policies (specifically JSP 936 or equivalent regulated sector frameworks). AI Risk & Governance: Proven track record conducting AI impact assessments, ethical risk evaluations, and establishing controls for algorithmic models and automated decision-making. Technical Understanding of AI/ML: Grounded technical comprehension of machine learning architectures, data pipelines, model drift, data provenance, validation metrics, and performance evaluation. Assurance & Compliance Frameworks: Exposure to emerging international AI standards and frameworks, such as ISO/IEC 42001 , NIST AI RMF, or IEEE standards. Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to act as an independent challenger while collaborating effectively across diverse teams: data scientists, systems engineers, safety managers, legal advisors, and senior operational stakeholders. Desirable: Experience with Secure by Design (SbD), system safety engineering, or defence test and evaluation processes. Hands-on experience planning or executing model red-teaming, adversarial testing, or synthetic data verification. Background working within UK Defence, national security, aerospace, or other high-reliability regulated sectors. items.desc: Experience Graduate Team Emerging Talent Business Unit Electricity Distribution Requisition No. 13381 City Bristol, GB, BS2 0TB Date posted 8 November 2026 Graduate Design Engineer, Electricity Distribution, Bristol About the Position We’re National Grid Electricity Distribution (NGED) , the owner and operator behind the electricity distribution systems for the Midlands, the Southwest of England and South Wales. Serving communities of more than 8 million people, our expert teams deliver heat, light and power for homes and businesses. National Grid employs over 29,000 people worldwide. We are building an inclusive workplace, a place to actively celebrate the cultures, personalities and preferences of our colleagues – who in turn help to build the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. Within NGED, the Engineering Design Team develops the detailed engineering solutions that enable the construction, upgrade and reinforcement of substations across the electricity network. Working on projects ranging from asset replacement to network expansion, the team prepares the designs, technical specifications and protection settings needed to support the safe, reliable operation of the network and the transition to a lower-carbon energy future. As a Graduate Design Engineer , you'll join our Engineering Design team and help ensure the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the electricity distribution network. Working with specialist engineers, you'll develop expertise in power system protection, analysing network behaviour and calculating the protection settings that help safeguard critical equipment from faults. You'll gain hands-on experience using industry-standard engineering tools and software while building a strong understanding of substation design, network operation and the technologies that support the UK's transition to a lower-carbon future. What You'll Do You'll help design and configure protection and control systems that support the safe operation of the electricity network. Analyse electrical network models and calculate protection and automatic voltage control (AVC) settings for equipment operating from low voltage up to 132kV. Configure protection relays and develop programmable protection logic to ensure equipment responds correctly during network faults. Support investigations into network faults and potential protection system maloperations, helping identify causes and lessons learned. Work with engineers across the business to support new customer connections, asset replacement projects and network reinforcement schemes. Develop skills in specialist software, including SINCAL, PSSE, Aspen, AutoCAD and protection relay configuration tools. Contribute to the design and specification of protection and control systems for substations across the electricity distribution network. Provide technical analysis and engineering support while developing your knowledge of network operation, power systems and substation design. Build towards becoming a specialist engineer, with support to pursue professional registration and Chartered Engineer (CEng) status. What You'll Need to Apply You'll need to achieve a minimum 2:2 in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a closely related engineering degree discipline. It doesn't matter when you graduated or whether you're currently studying towards your qualification. We're looking for graduates with a strong foundation in engineering, an interest in power systems and electrical networks, and an enthusiasm for developing specialist technical expertise. Experience with power system protection, network modelling, intelligent electronic devices (IEDs), coding or engineering analysis tools would be beneficial, but most importantly you'll be eager to learn, solve complex technical problems and contribute to the future of the electricity network. Please note: Due to the amount of travel required for this role, you must obtain a full, valid UK driving licence no later than 27th June 2027 (at least three months before your start date). If you progress to the assessment centre stage, you must have passed your driving theory test before attending and be able to provide evidence of this. items.desc: About the role Onodrim is building Europe's largest defence and industrial platform. We acquire specialist manufacturers in critical defence and dual-use supply chains, then invest behind their growth with capital, technology and operating know-how. OnodrimX is our internal R&D unit. It builds the products and technologies the platform needs and that no one in our supply chain makes yet – sensor, compute and communications systems that combine hardware, firmware and software – and takes them from concept through prototype to demonstration with real users. Software Engineers in OnodrimX write most of the code that makes those systems work. This is a generalist role in a small team. On one programme you'll be writing firmware for a sensor node and the pipeline that turns its data into detections; on another, the software that runs on a vehicle-mounted compute unit and talks to radios, other vehicles and a command-and-control system; on a third, the tooling that lets us test all of it in the field. You'll sit next to the hardware engineers, debug across the boundary, and be at the demonstrations when the system has to work. You'll report to the Head of R&D and work closely with the Programme Managers, our Forward Deployed Engineers and – as programmes mature – the engineering teams at the manufacturers we acquire, who will take what you built into production. What you'll do Build the software in the system. Write firmware and embedded Linux software for sensor and compute hardware, the services that run on it, and the data pipelines and processing that turn raw signals into something useful. Integrate across the boundary. Bring up new boards with the hardware engineers, write drivers and interfaces for radios, sensors and peripherals, and debug problems that live between the schematic and the code. Connect to the outside world. Implement the interfaces to tactical networks, command-and-control and situational-awareness systems, data platforms and partner equipment that our systems have to plug into. Own a work package. Take a sub-system from the programme plan, scope it with the Head of R&D, estimate it, build it, test it and integrate it on the milestone date. Make it testable. Build the tooling, simulators, logging and automated tests that let the team iterate quickly in the lab and trust what they take to the field. Support trials and demonstrations. Travel to test sites and customer demonstrations, keep the system running under real conditions, and feed what breaks back into the next iteration. Prepare for production. Keep builds reproducible, interfaces documented and configuration explicit so that a manufacturer can take the software over, flash it, test it and support it. Use the modern toolchain. Apply data platforms and LLM-based tooling where they make the team faster, and have a view on where they don't. Raise the bar. Review others' code, share what you learn, and help onboard the engineers who join after you. Requirements What you'll bring A degree in computer science, software or electrical engineering, or a closely related discipline – or an equivalent track record of shipped systems. 3+ years as a software engineer, with real experience on at least two of: embedded/firmware, embedded Linux and systems programming, data pipelines and signal or sensor processing, networking and protocols, backend services. Strong in a modern programming language and willing to learn whatever the platform needs. Familiarity with AI coding tools and ability to understand how to best make use of them Hands-on with hardware: you have brought up a board, read a datasheet, used a scope or logic analyser, and debugged a problem that turned out to be electrical. Comfort with Linux at the system level – build systems, cross-compilation, networking, performance – and with modern engineering practice: version control, CI, automated tests, code review. A builder's mindset: you prefer a working prototype this week to a complete design next month, and you finish what you start. Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken, with engineers and non-engineers. Willingness to travel within Europe for trials and demonstrations, with occasional travel to the US. Right to work in the UK, Switzerland or the EU, and eligibility for a national security clearance in at least one of our operating countries. Nice to have We operate our business in English but fluency in one or more additional European languages is beneficial. Experience with RTOS or bare-metal firmware on ARM microcontrollers, or with Yocto/Buildroot-style embedded Linux images. Signal processing or machine-learning experience on sensor data – detection, classification, tracking – including running models on edge hardware. Familiarity with radios and tactical networking: software-defined radio, mesh protocols, cellular modules, or tactical data links and situational-awareness tools. Experience integrating with enterprise data platforms, or building LLM-backed …

items.desc: About the role Onodrim is building Europe's largest defence and industrial platform. We acquire specialist manufacturers in critical defence and dual-use supply chains, then invest behind their growth with capital, technology and operating know-how. OnodrimX is our internal R&D unit. It builds the products and technologies the platform needs and that no one in our supply chain makes yet – sensor, compute and communications systems that combine hardware, firmware and software – and takes them from concept through prototype to demonstration with real users. Hardware Engineers in OnodrimX design and build the physical systems those products run on. This is a generalist role in a small team. On one programme you'll be designing the PCB for a low-power sensor node, writing the firmware that reads its sensors and talks to the radio, and designing the enclosure that keeps it alive in the ground for months; on another, packaging a compute-and-radio unit for a vehicle, with the power, thermal and connector design that implies; on a third, building the test rig that proves either of them works. You'll sit next to the software engineers, debug across the boundary, and be at the demonstrations when the hardware has to work. What you'll do Design the electronics. Own schematic capture, component selection, PCB layout and bring-up for sensor, compute and communications hardware – low-power mixed-signal boards, power supplies, interfaces to radios, sensors and peripherals. Write the firmware. Bring up boards, write drivers and the embedded code that reads sensors, manages power and talks to the rest of the system; work with the software engineers on where the firmware ends and their code begins. Design the mechanics. Own enclosures, mounts, sealing, thermal and connector design so the hardware survives the ground, the vehicle and the weather; design for the environment it will actually see. Build and test. Get prototypes made – in-house, with quick-turn suppliers or with a portfolio company – assemble and test them, and build the rigs and fixtures that prove performance, power and environmental robustness. Own a work package. Take a sub-system from the programme plan, scope it with the Head of Research & Development, estimate it, build it, test it and integrate it on the milestone date. Support trials and demonstrations. Travel to test sites and customer demonstrations, keep the hardware running under real conditions, feed what breaks back into the next revision, be able to demo the product. Prepare for production. Keep bills of materials sourceable, drawings and test procedures complete and design files in order, so that a manufacturer can take the product over and build it at scale; work with their engineers on the transfer. Manage suppliers. Run the PCB fabs, assemblers, machine shops, 3D-printing and component suppliers the programmes depend on; know lead times before they bite. Raise the bar. Review others' designs, share what you learn, and help onboard the engineers who join after you. Requirements What you'll bring A degree in electrical, electronic, mechatronic or mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline – or an equivalent track record of hardware you have designed, built and shipped. 3+ years as a hardware engineer, with real experience in at least two of: PCB design and bring-up, embedded firmware, mechanical and enclosure design, power and battery systems, RF or sensor front-ends. Fluent in a modern ECAD tool (Altium, KiCad or similar) and a mechanical CAD tool (SolidWorks, Fusion, Onshape or similar), and comfortable with C/C++ on microcontrollers. Hands-on with the bench: scope, logic analyser, soldering iron, 3D printer; you have debugged a board that didn't work and a part that didn't fit. Experience designing for a real environment – ingress protection, temperature, vibration, battery life – not only for the lab. A builder's mindset: you prefer a working prototype this week to a complete design next month, and you finish what you start. Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken, with engineers and non-engineers. Willingness to travel within Europe for trials and demonstrations, with occasional travel to the US. Right to work in the UK, Switzerland or the EU, and eligibility for a national security clearance in at least one of our operating countries. Nice to have We operate our business in English; knowledge of a European language other than English is beneficial. Low-power design experience – energy budgeting, sleep modes, energy harvesting – for long-duration unattended devices. Sensor front-end experience: geophones, microphones, accelerometers, magnetometers or similar, and the analogue chain behind them. RF layout and antenna integration experience, or work with cellular, LoRa, Wi-Fi or other radio modules. Experience taking a design through EMC, environmental or safety testing and into a manufacturer's hands – DFM, DFA, test procedures. Exposure to defence, …

La figura entrerà nel team di sviluppo e lavorerà alla progettazione e realizzazione di servizi AI, integrazioni con modelli generativi e applicazioni multimediali real-time. Cerchiamo una persona in grado di seguire l’intero ciclo di sviluppo: dall’architettura backend all’integrazione dei modelli AI, fino al deployment in produzione, con particolare attenzione a *prestazioni, scalabilità, latenza e costi di inferenza*. DI COSA TI OCCUPERAI Sviluppare servizi backend e applicazioni SaaS utilizzando Python, PHP/Laravel e Go. Progettare API REST, microservizi e integrazioni con piattaforme e servizi esterni. Integrare le API di OpenAI e Google Gemini, incluse funzionalità real-time. Implementare e distribuire modelli generativi di testo, immagini, audio e video. Progettare e ottimizzare pipeline di inferenza GPU con PyTorch, CUDA e TensorRT. Sviluppare funzionalità real-time tramite WebSocket, WebRTC, streaming e broadcasting audio/video. Gestire containerizzazione, deployment e pipeline CI/CD su Google Cloud, utilizzando Docker e Kubernetes. Monitorare e ottimizzare prestazioni, utilizzo delle risorse e costi dei servizi AI in produzione. COMPETENZE Esperienza concreta nello sviluppo e nella messa in produzione di applicazioni SaaS AI, con contributo diretto al backend e all’integrazione dei modelli. Solida esperienza nello sviluppo backend con Python e PHP/Laravel e conoscenza di Go. Esperienza nella progettazione e integrazione di API REST, inclusi autenticazione, gestione degli errori e processi asincroni. Esperienza pratica con le API di OpenAI e Google Gemini. Buona conoscenza dei principali modelli generativi e capacità di selezionare tecnologie e modelli in funzione del caso d’uso. Capacità di implementare e servire modelli AI, gestendo dipendenze, caricamento dei pesi, inferenza ed esposizione tramite API. Esperienza pratica con PyTorch e conoscenza di CUDA e TensorRT per l’esecuzione e l’ottimizzazione dell’inferenza su GPU. Familiarità con memoria GPU, latenza, throughput e tecniche di ottimizzazione come quantizzazione e batching. Esperienza con WebSocket e WebRTC e conoscenza dei principi di streaming e broadcasting audio/video. Conoscenza di Docker, Kubernetes e Google Cloud. Esperienza con Git e pipeline CI/CD per build, test e deployment automatizzati. Autonomia, capacità di analisi e attenzione alla qualità, scalabilità e manutenibilità del codice. COSTITUISCONO UN PLUS Esperienza con API AI real-time, sistemi conversazionali vocali e flussi audio/video a bassa latenza. Esperienza con avatar conversazionali, sintesi vocale e lip-sync. Esperienza con architetture SaaS multi-tenant, sistemi di metering e monitoraggio dei consumi e dei costi AI. Competenze full stack, utili ma non indispensabili. CHI CERCHIAMO Più che una conoscenza teorica dell’AI, cerchiamo qualcuno che abbia già affrontato i problemi concreti legati alla sua implementazione in produzione: latenza, affidabilità, scalabilità, utilizzo delle GPU, costi di inferenza e integrazione tra modelli e applicazioni real-time. Cerchiamo una persona autonoma, pragmatica e orientata alla soluzione dei problemi, interessata a lavorare su prodotti AI complessi e destinati a un utilizzo reale. Retribuzione: €30.000,00 - €40.000,00 all'anno Sede di lavoro: Ibrido/da remoto (Milano, Lombardia)

At IIT, we are committed to advancing human-centered Science and Technology to address the most urgent societal challenges of our era. We foster excellence in both fundamental and applied research, spanning fields such as neuroscience and cognition, humanoid technologies and robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and material sciences, offering a truly interdisciplinary scientific experience. Our approach integrates cutting-edge tools and technology, empowering researchers to push the limits of knowledge and innovation. With us, your curiosity will know no bounds. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering diversity in all its forms, creating an inclusive environment. We value the unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives of our people. By embracing diversity, we believe science can achieve its fullest potential. THE ROLE The Emergent Quantum Phenomena at the Nanoscale research unit is coordinated by Dr. Alessandro Principi. The research focuses on collective and emergent phenomena in quantum materials, encompassing strongly correlated quantum matter, topological systems, and unconventional phases of matter, including quantum spin liquids and other fractionalised phases. Particular emphasis is placed on low-dimensional systems, van der Waals heterostructures, and twisted materials. Within the framework of the project QuanTwist (Bando FIS3, CUP I53C25002150001), two positions are currently available to investigate the physics of (twisted) heterostructures of strongly correlated quantum materials. This is an exciting opportunity to pursue cutting-edge research in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment. The group's research activities range from analytical and semi-analytical investigations of fundamental models to theoretical calculations of experimentally observable properties in realistic quantum materials. A central objective is to establish connections between theoretical predictions and existing or upcoming experiments. Systems of interest include, but are not limited to, van der Waals materials and candidate quantum spin liquids. Within our group, researchers are encourage to develop independent research activities within the broader objectives of the research line. The group’s research benefits from interactions with theoretical and experimental groups studying quantum materials, strongly-correlated systems and van der Waals heterostructures. We have strong ties with the University of Manchester and collaborations with KIT, University of Wurzburg, TU/e, University of Sherbrooke, NUS, ICN2 Spain. Research will be conducted in collaboration with the PI and other members of the group. The position offers the opportunity to develop independent research directions within the broad field of quantum many-body physics, within the scope of the funding QuanTwist project. Within the research team, your main responsibilities will be to: Design models of 2D and twisted materials, as well as strongly-correlated and topological systems, and develop theoretical descriptions of emergent quantum phases. Use analytical and semi-analytical (field-theoretical, kinetic equation, mean-field, etc.) and/or numerical methods to study their properties, analysing in particular emergent quantum phases Entertain collaborations with other theoretical or experimental groups relevant to the project, in particular with the aim of connecting theory with existing or upcoming experiments. Participate in writing papers, present results to conferences. Develop related research directions and complementary approaches. ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS A PhD in Theoretical (Condensed Matter) Physics, or related areas of physics, such as quantum many-body theory, statistical physics, or quantum theory. Experience in analytical, semi-analytical methods (including field-theoretical approaches) and/or numerical approaches in quantum many-body theory, broadly intended, is desirable. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and publish scientific results. Good command of spoken and written English. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across teams. Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP BusinessObjects or BI tools is a plus. items.desc: About the role Onodrim is building Europe's largest defence and industrial platform. We acquire specialist manufacturers in critical defence and dual-use supply chains, then invest behind their growth with capital, technology and operating know-how. OnodrimX is our internal R&D unit. It builds the products and technologies the platform needs and that no one in our supply chain makes yet – sensor, compute and communications systems that combine hardware, firmware and software – and takes them from concept through prototype to demonstration with real users. Software Engineers in OnodrimX write most of the code that makes those systems work. This is a generalist role in a small team. On one programme you'll be writing firmware for a sensor node and the pipeline that turns its data into detections; on another, the software that runs on a vehicle-mounted compute unit and talks to radios, other vehicles and a command-and-control system; on a third, the tooling that lets us test all of it in the field. You'll sit next to the hardware engineers, debug across the boundary, and be at the demonstrations when the system has to work. You'll report to the Head of R&D and work closely with the Programme Managers, our Forward Deployed Engineers and – as programmes mature – the engineering teams at the manufacturers we acquire, who will take what you built into production. What you'll do Build the software in the system. Write firmware and embedded Linux software for sensor and compute hardware, the services that run on it, and the data pipelines and processing that turn raw signals into something useful. Integrate across the boundary. Bring up new boards with the hardware engineers, write drivers and interfaces for radios, sensors and peripherals, and debug problems that live between the schematic and the code. Connect to the outside world. Implement the interfaces to tactical networks, command-and-control and situational-awareness systems, data platforms and partner equipment that our systems have to plug into. Own a work package. Take a sub-system from the programme plan, scope it with the Head of R&D, estimate it, build it, test it and integrate it on the milestone date. Make it testable. Build the tooling, simulators, logging and automated tests that let the team iterate quickly in the lab and trust what they take to the field. Support trials and demonstrations. Travel to test sites and customer demonstrations, keep the system running under real conditions, and feed what breaks back into the next iteration. Prepare for production. Keep builds reproducible, interfaces documented and configuration explicit so that a manufacturer can take the software over, flash it, test it and support it. Use the modern toolchain. Apply data platforms and LLM-based tooling where they make the team faster, and have a view on where they don't. Raise the bar. Review others' code, share what you learn, and help onboard the engineers who join after you. Requirements What you'll bring A degree in computer science, software or electrical engineering, or a closely related discipline – or an equivalent track record of shipped systems. 3+ years as a software engineer, with real experience on at least two of: embedded/firmware, embedded Linux and systems programming, data pipelines and signal or sensor processing, networking and protocols, backend services. Strong in a modern programming language and willing to learn whatever the platform needs. Familiarity with AI coding tools and ability to understand how to best make use of them Hands-on with hardware: you have brought up a board, read a datasheet, used a scope or logic analyser, and debugged a problem that turned out to be electrical. Comfort with Linux at the system level – build systems, cross-compilation, networking, performance – and with modern engineering practice: version control, CI, automated tests, code review. A builder's mindset: you prefer a working prototype this week to a complete design next month, and you finish what you start. Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken, with engineers and non-engineers. Willingness to travel within Europe for trials and demonstrations, with occasional travel to the US. Right to work in the UK, Switzerland or the EU, and eligibility for a national security clearance in at least one of our operating countries. Nice to have We operate our business in English but fluency in one or more additional European languages is beneficial. Experience with RTOS or bare-metal firmware on ARM microcontrollers, or with Yocto/Buildroot-style embedded Linux images. Signal processing or machine-learning experience on sensor data – detection, classification, tracking – including running models on edge hardware. Familiarity with radios and tactical networking: software-defined radio, mesh protocols, cellular modules, or tactical data links and situational-awareness tools. Experience integrating with enterprise data platforms, or building LLM-backed …

items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION DM1-Hub aims to be the basis for the implementation of precision medicine aspects in Spain for the benefit of patients with Myotonic Dystrophy type 1 (DM1), prioritizing better diagnosis and optimization in the use of soon-to-be-available treatments. The DM1-Hub project brings together a group of 130 professionals in the areas of research and clinical monitoring of DM1. Together they form a multidisciplinary work team with extensive experience in this pathology at the research level, which includes predoctoral, postdoctoral and senior researchers, including renowned research groups in the field of rare neuromuscular diseases and DM1 in particular. Specifically, the team is made up of specialists in genomics, epigenetics, bioinformatics, biostatistics, proteomics, applied research and scientific dissemination. In turn, the team makes up an important network of around 70 health professionals (neurologists, neuropediatricians, neuropsychologists and nurses), in more than 50 hospitals in 10 different Autonomous Communities, who follow up with DM1 patients in their consultations. We are looking for a compromised enthusiastic and compromised nurse for DM1-Hub project. He/she would interact with nurses and other health professionals around Spain that will be doing the same tasks in another Autonomous Communities. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES The contracted professional will be responsible for coordinating and monitoring participants enrolled in the DM1-Hub project, including contacting adult and pediatric patients and organizing study visits across multiple participating hospitals in Barcelona. Key responsibilities will include collecting clinical information through telephone and in-person visits, administering clinical scales and assessments, assisting participants in completing patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs), entering and validating data in the REDCap database, and identifying and resolving missing data. The individual will also participate in regular meetings with DM1-Hub investigators and team members, manage the processing, labeling, storage, and shipment of biological samples to the IGTP-GRENBA laboratory, contribute occasionally to patient workshops and scientific events, and regularly report project Coordinate the DM1-Hub study visit staff, including the organization of training activities, ongoing supervision, and performance follow-up. Ensure the maintenance of study records, monitor data quality, and implement quality control procedures to guarantee the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of collected data. Contribute to the continuous improvement and updating of study protocols, including the identification and implementation of new clinical and research variables relevant to project objectives. Support the coordination of clinical trials conducted by the Neuromuscular Research Group at Hospital Universitari Germans Trias i Pujol, working closely with principal investigators, study coordinators, sponsors, monitors, and clinical staff. Coordinate participant recruitment activities, study visits, and follow-up schedules in accordance with study protocols and timelines. Verify compliance with study protocols, and resolve data queries, and conduct regular data quality reviews and monitoring procedures. Prepare study documentation for monitoring visits, audits, and inspections, ensuring that regulatory and study records are maintained appropriately. Coordinate the collection, processing, storage, and shipment of biological samples according to protocol-specific requirements. Act as a liaison between investigators, study participants, sponsors, contract research organizations (CROs), monitors, and healthcare professionals involved in clinical research activities. Support investigators in participant recruitment, retention, and follow-up processes. Participate in scientific research activities, including literature reviews, data analysis, interpretation of results, and preparation of scientific reports. Contribute to the preparation of abstracts, posters, oral communications, grant applications, and scientific manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals. Present study findings at national and international scientific meetings and congresses and actively contribute to the dissemination of research results. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external partners in the development of observational studies, patient registries, and clinical research projects related to neuromuscular diseases, including myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1). Participate in research strategy discussions and contribute to the identification of new research opportunities, study initiatives, and collaborative projects within the neuromuscular field QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Nurse degree Skills in blood extraction Used to work with patients (adults and children) 2 years of previous experience in hospital work Microsoft office skills Languages spoken and written: Spanish and Catalan (English …

items.desc: The multidisciplinary Pain Management Team at Wrightington, Wigan and Leigh NHS Trust enjoy good relationships with the Community Pain service and provides secondary care services on the Wrightington and Leigh sites. The successful applicant would be joining a dynamic team of consultants, one associate specialist, 2 specialist nurses, psychologists, occupational therapists and pain physiotherapists. Image intensifier and ultrasound guided pain interventions including radiofrequency ablation techniques are carried out in a dedicated treatment room with recovery on the adjoining ward by enthusiastic and experienced ward staff. A small office is adjacent to the treatment room for full IT administrative support. The Chronic Pain Team supports the Tertiary Referral Orthopaedic Hospital at Wrightington with a.o. procedures for post-surgical/neuropathic pain or genicular nerve radiofrequency ablation for arthritic knee pain. We provide a nurse led self-acupuncture service, Qutenza services, Botox for chronic migraines and Consultant Oral ketamine. There are regular Pain Management Programmes, Psychology and OT and Physiotherapy sessions. There is a full triage of all patients to direct supportive and treatment measures. There are regular scheduled full team clinical governments meeting. We would welcome and expect any member of our team to further our inclusive pain management and forge stronger/innovative relations with the community and our orthopaedic colleagues. Acute care is provided at the Royal Albert Edward Infirmary. This includes adults' and children's accident and emergency services, intensive care, women’s and children’s and a range of medical and surgical specialities. Wrightington Hospital is an elective Orthopaedic Specialist site and our Leigh Day Case unit is currently expanding its portfolio and increasing activity. The successful candidate will have a job plan developed to accommodate their special interests whilst also meeting the service requirements of the trust. Wrightington, Wigan and Leigh Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust are the proud providers of acute hospital and community services to the people of the Wigan Borough and surrounding areas. At WWL, we value our staff believing that ‘happy staff, makes for happy patients’. We have a recognised track record in staff engagement, and living our values ‘the WWL Way’. WWL are committed to placing the patient at the heart of everything we do, and in the provision of safe, effective care that acknowledges and ensures dignity. With this in mind we are seeking to recruit people who share our values and beliefs. On-Call Please note that senior positions (AFC band 8A or above) may be expected to participate in an on-call rota, if the role is predominantly operational. The post-holder will perform all the duties and have all responsibilities of a Consultant Anaesthetist with Interest in Pain Management. Clinical responsibilities within Anaesthesia: To provide elective and emergency perioperative anaesthetic management To maintain appropriate knowledge and skills to deliver anaesthesia To participate in Governance and Appraisal processes To participate in teaching medical and allied health professionals To work with other members of the multidisciplinary team Clinical responsibilities within the Chronic Pain Provision: To provide assessment and follow-up clinics for our Secondary Pain Service To provide pain clinic interventions To contribute to the running of this service as guided by the service lead. To work as part of a multidisciplinary team and support the running of the Pain Management Programme by appropriate referrals and delivering sessions to the group as needed. To understand and contribute to appropriate care pathways available for patients in the Pain Clinic and signpost accordingly. To work with the Lead Nurse, Clinical Lead or Senior Clinicians to ensure appropriate medical care pathways are in place, consistent with the pain clinic model for patients in treatment. To understand and follow the commissioned care pathways for patients ensuring appropriate treatments underpinned by professional evidence and guidance. (e.g. NICE guidelines, Royal Colleges, MHRA, Greater Manchester Commissioning Guidelines, GRFT) To have medical responsibility, in partnership with the Trust’s medical leads for all patients under the care of the pain service.

items.desc: About the role Develop and connect simulation models to help Tesco understand, evaluate and improve operations, including supply chain, and assess proposed changes before implementation. Working with experienced colleagues, contribute to distributed simulations that bring together models of different processes and systems, developing awareness of relevant interoperability standards and approaches. Build models at different levels of fidelity, learning to choose the appropriate detail for the business question, available data and computing needs. Use operational data and scenario experiments to validate models, explore trade-offs and inform decisions. Follow agile delivery methods and contribute to continuous integration and delivery practices, including version control, automated testing and repeatable deployment, to help maintain reliable simulation tools. You will be responsible for Building and maintaining simulation models using Python and relevant tools, drawing on simulation and data science skills. Creating models at different levels of detail, with guidance on choosing an approach that balances accuracy, available data and computing needs. Helping connect models so they can run together and exchange information, including across different tools or computers in distributed or federated simulation environments. Developing awareness of the standards and approaches used to connect simulations and applying them with support from experienced colleagues. Preparing and analysing operational data to set up models, identify gaps and represent real-world variation. Checking that models work as intended and comparing their results with real-world data and feedback from operational experts. Running repeatable experiments to assess proposed operational changes, including supply chain scenarios, and compare effects on capacity, cost, service and resource use. Explaining findings clearly, including the assumptions made, uncertainty in results and limitations of the models. Working in an agile team to plan and deliver tasks in manageable steps, respond to feedback and raise issues early. Writing clear, maintainable code and contributing to code reviews, version control, automated testing and reliable software releases. Taking responsibility for agreed tasks, asking for support when needed and developing my technical skills. You will need § Python programming, with the ability to write clear, structured and testable code. § Simulation modelling and an understanding of how to represent real-world processes at different levels of detail. § Data analysis and basic statistics to prepare model inputs, understand variation and interpret results. § Checking that models work correctly and produce results that are credible for their intended use. § An understanding of how separate models or software components can exchange data and work together. § Familiarity with version control, such as Git, and an awareness of automated testing and software delivery practices. § The ability to explain technical work clearly, document assumptions and work collaboratively. § An organised approach to solving problems, learning new methods and delivering tasks in an agile team. Whats in it for you? We’re all about the little helps. That’s why we make sure our Tesco colleague benefits package takes care of you – both in and out of work. Click Here to find out more! Annual bonus scheme of up to 20% of base salary. Holiday starting at 25 days plus a personal day (plus Bank holidays). Private medical insurance. 26 weeks maternity and adoption leave (12 months service required at the qualifying date) at full pay, followed by 13 weeks of Statutory Maternity Pay or Statutory Adoption Pay, we also offer 6 weeks fully paid paternity leave. Free 24/7 virtual GP service, Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and your family, free access to a range of experts to support your mental wellbeing. items.desc: Dutch speaking and writing proficiency is required! Ben jij klaar om als startend Data Scientist impact te maken met data en AI in de financiële wereld? Heb je een nieuwsgierige en analytische mindset en wil je leren hoe je technologie inzet om banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen toekomstbestendig te maken? Dan is het Data ScientistTraineeship van ITDS STAY de ideale kickstart van jouw carrière. In dit 18-maanden traject word jij opgeleid tot een data-gedreven intern consultant die complexe vraagstukken vertaalt naar slimme datagedreven oplossingen. Je ontwikkelt je tot een professional die een brug slaat tussen techniek en business. Na 18 maanden leren treed je in dienst bij een van deze grote namen in de financiële sector. Het volgende traineeship start op 1 december 2026. Schrijf je snel in! Het ontwikkeltraject bij ITDS STAY Je start met een intensieve 10-daagse bootcamp , waarin je wordt opgeleid in: Data-analyse & AI Domeinkennis over de financiële sector Soft skills zoals adviseren, presenteren, communiceren en persoonlijk leiderschap Daarna ga je direct aan de slag bij een toporganisatie in de sector. Je volgt maandelijks trainingsdagen, krijgt persoonlijke coaching en bouwt een stevig fundament als data-professional. Na 18 maanden kun je vast in dienst treden bij jouw opdrachtgever via de detavast-constructie. Wat je gaat doen als Data Scientist trainee Tijdens het 18 maanden durende traineeship werk je aan uitdagende dataprojecten binnen de financiële sector. Je leert hoe je data omzet in inzichten, voorspellingen en procesverbetering. Als Data Scientist trainee werk je met grote datasets: je analyseert en schonen data op, herkent patronen, trends en risico’s en zet statistiek en exploratieve data-analyse in om vraagstukken scherp te krijgen. Je bouwt en test machine-learningmodellen voor bijvoorbeeld risico-inschatting, klantgedrag, fraude of procesoptimalisatie, met Python en moderne ML-libraries, en past zowel supervised als unsupervised learning toe in praktijkcases. De uitkomsten vertaal je naar duidelijke inzichten in rapportages en dashboards (bijvoorbeeld in Power BI, Python of SQL), zodat collega’s en klanten direct met de resultaten verder kunnen. Daarnaast adviseer je over digitalisering en datagedreven werken binnen financiële instellingen en leer je presenteren, communiceren en samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams om échte business impact te maken. Met jouw analytisch denkvermogen, leergierigheid en technische basis groei je uit tot een professional die techniek inzet voor echte verbetering in de financiële sector. Dit breng jij mee Je hebt het profiel van een startend Data Scientist: analytisch, nieuwsgierig en communicatief sterk. Daarnaast breng je mee: Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in IT, Data Science, AI, Econometrie, Finance of een vergelijkbare richting; Interesse in innovatie en de financiële sector; Basiskennis van Python en/of SQL; Sterk probleemoplossend vermogen en leergierige houding; Vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; Woonachtig in Nederland. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Kies jij ervoor om het beste uit jezelf te halen? In je vak –en daarbuiten? Wij bieden de juiste arbeidsvoorwaarden om daarbij te helpen. Je werkt in een fijn team waarin we samenwerken, sparren en elkaars talenten benutten om voor de beste resultaten te gaan. Bovendien heb je een mooie thuisbasis in Amsterdam. Daarnaast bieden we: Salaris van €3.566 per maand (incl. vakantiegeld) vanaf dag één; Volledig betaald opleidingstraject inclusief officiële certificeringen; Maandelijkse trainingsdagen, coaching en intervisie; Projecten bij toporganisaties in de financiële sector; Uitzicht op een vast contract bij de klant na 18 maanden. Goed salaris 25 vakantiedagen Optie om 5 extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen Soepele werktijden Pensioenplan Laptop van de zaak Mobiele telefoon vergoeding Referral bonus Flexibel mobiliteitsbeleid Kantoor in Amsterdam Borrels ITDS Merchandise Career counselor Gezonde lunch Sportactiviteiten We leren je graag kennen: Herken jij jezelf hierin? En ben jij minstens zo ambitieus als wij? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Je kan direct contact opnemen met [recruiter info]. Nieuwsgierig geworden, maar liever eerst een kop koffiedrinken? Dat kan natuurlijk ook. We koppelen je graag aan één van onze consultants.
