items.card: What You'll Do You'll gain experience across a range of data, AI and digital disciplines, helping us use data to support the operation and development of the electricity network. Analyse data from across the business to help improve its quality, accessibility and value. Explore how data and AI can support the energy transition, from connecting renewable energy to managing critical infrastructure assets. Help design,
items.desc: About The Position Our IT & Digital function is using new and disruptive technologies to help improve how we do our job – through cloud computing, artificial intelligence or machine learning to name just a few. From IT support to data, security to new technologies, we partner with the business to achieve our overall vision to be at the heart of a clean, fair and affordable energy future. Within IT&D, the Electricity Transmission Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) Team provide IT&Digital strategic leadership for the Electricity Transmission Business, align IT&Digital strategies with business priorities, manage costs and service quality. Among the best practices that CIDO teams share and drive together are a 360-degree view of IT that includes IT and Digital needs, strategic roadmap planning, deployment of new capabilities, application rationalisation and simplification, service delivery and consumption management, and adoption of agile ways of working. As a Graduate Data Specialist , you'll join either our Data & AI team or our Digital Product team and gain hands-on experience across a variety of projects and business areas. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you'll learn how data and AI help us understand and maintain our assets, connect more clean energy to the grid, and make smarter, faster decisions across the business. Through a combination of meaningful project work, structured training and ongoing support, you'll develop a strong understanding of how data, AI and digital products support a critical national infrastructure organisation. By the end of the programme, you'll have built valuable technical and commercial knowledge and gained a clearer idea of where you'd like to specialise. What You'll Do You'll gain experience across a range of data, AI and digital disciplines, helping us use data to support the operation and development of the electricity network. Analyse data from across the business to help improve its quality, accessibility and value. Explore how data and AI can support the energy transition, from connecting renewable energy to managing critical infrastructure assets. Help design, build and improve data solutions, including cloud-based platforms, data pipelines and reporting tools. Create insights, dashboards and visualisations that help colleagues make informed business decisions. Support the responsible management of data by helping to improve data quality, governance, security and compliance. Trial and promote AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, helping colleagues adopt them safely and effectively. Collaborate with colleagues from across the business while developing your technical, analytical and project delivery skills through real-world projects. What You'll Need to Apply You'll need to achieve a minimum 2:2 in Maths, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Geography, Economics, Environmental Science or closely related degree discipline. It doesn’t matter when you graduated or if you are currently working towards your qualification. We're looking for graduates who are interested in data, AI and digital technologies, and keen to develop their skills through hands-on experience. You'll be interested in: how data, analytics and AI can help organisations solve problems, improve performance and make better-informed decisions. the energy sector, infrastructure or climate action, and the role data and AI can play in supporting the transition to a net zero future. developing technical skills in areas such as data analysis, data management, coding, data visualisation or AI technologies You’ll also need flexibility to travel other National Grid Offices within role and throughout your rotations as required. Location This role is based in Holborn, London and may offer flexible hybrid working, where possible. What You'll Get In Return We are proud to offer a starting salary of £38,289 with annual salary increases throughout the programme. As a first step in your career within the energy industry, our Graduate Programme offers a unique opportunity to develop your skills, gain valuable experience, and build a long-term career with National Grid. Alongside a tailored development programme designed to power your career at National Grid, you'll also enjoy a range of fantastic rewards and benefits, including: 26 days' annual leave, plus statutory holidays. A competitive pension scheme. Access to flexible benefits, including cycle-to-work and holiday buy/sell schemes. The opportunity to participate in our Sharesave and Share Incentive Plans. You’ll develop well-rounded skills through practical experience. A £2,000 joining bonus upon starting the programme. A £2,400 payment upon successful completion of the programme. An accommodation allowance of up to £200 per month as you move around the business during placements. Additional annual leave when moving between placements, plus support with relocating your personal belongings. Dedicated mentoring, regular feedback, networking …

items.desc: Postée le 09 nov. Lieu : Paris ou Grenoble Contrat : CDI Rémunération : A négocier Description du poste Ready to accelerate your career and help shape the future of Energy Tech? At Schneider Electric, we’re not just imagining the future of energy, we’re creating it. Recognized as the World’s Most Sustainable Company by TIME and Statista, we are your energy technology partner, electrifying, automating and digitalizing industries, businesses and homes to drive efficiency and sustainability for all. 12 months. Two missions. One global community. Not just another graduate program, this is an accelerator for your career. Our new flagship global talent program gives early-career engineers the opportunity to put AI and emerging technologies into action, tackle meaningful challenges and discover different parts of our organization through two six-month missions. Learn more: Energy Tech Accelerator Graduate Program Highlights Permanent contract: from day one Program duration: 12 months | 2 x six-month missions Start date: 1 March 2027 Your 12-month Accelerator journey Depending on your starting assignment, you may experience the two missions in either order. MISSION A | Invent the Future Your mission could take you into: Sustainability Advisory Services, Corporate Strategy or our AI Transformation Office, where you could contribute to: Explore what’s next: Research emerging trends, technologies and customers’ needs to uncover new opportunities and help our customers become more sustainable and efficient. Turn complexity into insight: Analyze data, structure strategic or sustainability challenges and help turn insights into recommendations. Make things better, faster: Analyze processes and identify opportunities to simplify, improve, and accelerate the way we work, creating greater business or operational impact. MISSION B | Deliver the Mission Together Your Mission Could Take You Into Software & Services, Innovation & Technology, Industrial Automation Or Commercial Operations, Where You Could Contribute To Put the customer at the center: Gather insights from users, experts and stakeholders to understand needs and help refine solutions. Turn technology into solutions: Contribute to digital offers and services and explore how software-defined solutions can improve customer experience and solve real problems. Explore AI as an enabler: Identify where AI could create value and connect technology with real business and customer needs. Start Big. Accelerate your potential Dedicated leadership development: Learning, mentoring, and career coaching to accelerate your leadership skills. Signature experiences: Global onboarding, a global hackathon and attending highly visible leadership or customer events. Global exposure: Build relationships across our international community, with opportunities for immersive international business travel Profil recherché Is this You? Curious and eager to understand how things work Analytical, with a passion for solving complex problems Excited by AI, digital technology and the energy transition Energized working across cultures, in a global environment Collaborative, adaptable and ready to step outside your comfort zone What You Need You graduated in 2024, 2025 or 2026, with at least a Master’s degree or equivalent qualification corresponding to five years of higher education (Bac+5 / European Qualifications Framework Level 7) ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics or a related discipline Your academic background includes exposure to AI, and you’re excited to apply into real-world challenges You already have the legal right to work in France. You can work and communicate effectively in English You are available to start in March 2027 There’s more than one path to great things Your degree matters. Your potential matters more. Whether through an internship, personal project, study abroad or nonprofit work, we want to know what drives you, how you learn, and what you are curious to explore next! Pour Postuler Join our new global Energy Tech Accelerator program. Apply online by 1 December 2026. Infrequent travel to the nearest GISI’s office will be on an as needed basis. Please note that although this role will be posted in various locations, there is only one role available. Reporting Lines The role reports to the Director, Client Innovation
items.desc: About GISI Ignite And Palladium GISI is a global, employee-owned family of companies focused on construction, infrastructure, earth and environment, and global development. items.desc: Fulltime werken in Tiel aan AI die klanten en collega’s vooruithelpt. IGEPA Nederland IGEPA Nederland heeft zich sinds de oprichting in 2009 ontwikkeld tot een van de grootste handelsbedrijven voor grafische producten in Nederland. Wij zijn onderdeel van de IGEPA Group, een toonaangevende Europese groothandel met 80 locaties actief in 29 landen. Van oorsprong was IGEPA een groothandel in papier en karton, inmiddels zijn wij totaalleverancier in Papier & Karton, Sign & Display, LFP-machines en Verpakkingsmaterialen. Onze kernwaarden diversiteit, service en meerwaarde zijn de basis voor succesvolle en langdurige samenwerkingen. IGEPA als werkgever Werken bij IGEPA Nederland betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van een hecht team van betrokken collega’s. We zijn een informele organisatie met een hands-on karakter. Een plek waar vakmanschap en werkplezier hand in hand gaan. Bij ons heeft iedereen invloed op het succes van het bedrijf en krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Wij stimuleren persoonlijke ontwikkeling, zijn mensgericht en denken met elkaar mee. Samen maken wij het verschil! Je werk Binnen Digital Commerce ontwikkel je met gebruikers, proceseigenaren en technische partners praktische AI-toepassingen. Je bepaalt vooraf eigenaarschap, nulmeting, KPI’s en opbrengst. Je brengt prototypes naar productie en koppelt oplossingen aan ERP, WMS en e-commerce. Je bewaakt veiligheid, privacy, kwaliteit en menselijke controle. Monitoring, gebruikersondersteuning, incidenten, onderhoud en verbetering horen bij jouw verantwoordelijkheid. De stack omvat Terraform, Azure, Python, Django, GitHub en geautomatiseerde tests. Streefdoel: minstens 90% van geplande stories binnen de inschatting opleveren; circa 10% van je tijd besteed je aan ontwikkeling. Jouw achtergrond Hbo/wo in een technische of kwantitatieve richting en 0–4 jaar relevante ervaring. Vertrouwd met de volledige ontwikkelcyclus; belangstelling voor logistiek, groothandel en procesverbetering. Vloeiend Nederlands, professioneel Engels en heldere communicatie met gebruikers. Je neemt initiatief, werkt samen, deelt kennis en vraagt feedback. ERP-, WMS- of e-commerce-ervaring helpt. Je krijgt Een passend salaris, pensioen, 30 vakantiedagen, thuiswerkmogelijkheden, reiskostenvergoeding, apparatuur naar keuze en ontwikkelmogelijkheden. items.desc: Every day, millions of people rely on transport to access the people, places and opportunities that matter most. At Arriva, we're shaping the future of passenger transport and investing in the people who will help lead it. We are one of Europe's leading passenger transport partners, helping people get to work, education, healthcare, family and the moments that matter. Operating across 11 countries, with around 35,000 colleagues and more than 1.5 billion passenger journeys each year, we're a business with the scale to make a difference and the ambition to keep moving forward. Through our Graduate Programme, we're looking for talented graduates who are curious, motivated to learn, and ready to grow their careers with us. If you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. The Graduate Opportunity As an Arriva Rail Services Graduate specialising in Digital and Innovation, you'll help explore how technology can improve the way Arriva's rail services operate, making journeys better for customers and creating efficiencies across the business. You'll work alongside colleagues who are driving innovation and digital transformation across the rail network. During the programme, you'll gain experience in areas such as digital technologies, artificial intelligence (AI), business intelligence (BI), data analytics, and process improvement. You'll develop an understanding of how digital solutions can solve real business challenges while building valuable technical and problem-solving skills for your future career. Location: This role is based at our Crewe depot and will require travel to York, Leeds, and Derby. The role operates on a hybrid basis, with a minimum of three days per week at the depot or another Arriva workplace. What We’re Looking For We're not expecting you to have all the answers. We're looking for graduates with curiosity, drive, and the confidence to keep learning. People who take ownership, build positive relationships, and want to make a meaningful contribution from day one. What matters most is your potential. We're looking for people who are eager to learn, motivated to grow, and ready to develop their Arriva Graduate EDGE. About You We're open to applications from graduates of all degree disciplines. We're particularly interested in people who: Are curious, proactive, and eager to learn Enjoy solving problems and thinking creatively Have strong communication and relationship-building skills Can analyse information and use data to support decision-making Enjoy working collaboratively with a range of stakeholders Are interested in business transformation, project delivery, and innovation Have an interest in commercial opportunities and digital technologies The Graduate Programme Alongside your role, you'll be part of our two-year graduate development programme, benefiting from structured learning, mentoring, exposure to senior leaders, and a connected graduate network across Arriva. The breadth of experience gained throughout the programme will help you develop the knowledge and skills needed to support digital innovation across the business. You may also have opportunities to undertake relevant learning and professional development in areas such as artificial intelligence, business intelligence, data analytics, digital technologies, and project management. Eligibility Requirements To be considered for this opportunity, you'll need: To be on track to achieve, or have already achieved, a degree (2:1 preferred, with strong 2:2 applications considered) The right to work in the UK permanently Availability to join the programme in September 2027 Willingness to travel where required in the UK If you have any questions about the role or the application process, please don't hesitate to get in touch with our Early Careers team. items.desc: Contexte Et Environnement De Travail Renault Group poursuit son engagement envers les jeunes au travers la formation par l’alternance et les stages. Réalisez votre stage au sein de Renault Group et transformez vos connaissances en compétences sur des projets concrets. Accompagné par un tuteur et d’équipes expertes, vous progressez vers votre diplôme dans un cadre exigeant et bienveillant. Une expérience utile, formatrice et porteuse de sens, quelle que soit la fonction. Face à la transformation des motorisations et au renforcement des objectifs environnementaux, l’industrie automobile doit anticiper sa conformité à la réglementation européenne sur les émissions de CO₂, dite « CAFE ». Au sein du Groupe Renault, vous placerez l’intelligence artificielle et la data science au cœur d’une mission prospective à fort enjeu stratégique. Vos Missions Rechercher et croiser différentes sources pour construire des scénarios de ventes automobiles entre 2028 et 2035. Analyser les volumes de vente par motorisation : électrique, hybride rechargeable, hybride et thermique. Intégrer les évolutions réglementaires concernant l’Union européenne, le Royaume-Uni et la Suisse. Estimer les données techniques clés (masse, émissions de CO₂) des véhicules vendus par les autres constructeurs. A l'aide de ces données techniques, Évaluer la trajectoire de conformité des constructeurs concurrents et la comparer à celle du Groupe Renault. La production de ces scénarios sera accélérée avec l’appui de l’IA, afin d’enrichir les prévisions moyen-long terme. Simultanément, l'IA alimentera les activités opérationnelles du Groupe Renault pour le pilotage de la conformité CO2 pour la période 2025-2027. Ce Que Ce Stage Vous Apportera Ce stage vous permettra d’approfondir votre connaissance des motorisations, du marché automobile et de la réglementation CO₂. Vous développerez également vos compétences en data science, intelligence artificielle, analyse prospective et automatisation. Qui êtes-vous ? : Vous préparez un diplôme d’ingénieur (ou équivalent) niveau Bac+5, en 4e ou 5e année d’études et êtes intéressé(e) par l’environnement et les outils IA et de simulation. Aptitudes obligatoires : compétences en data science, connaissances en intelligence artificielle, goût prononcé pour l’automobile et ses motorisations, capacités d’analyse et de synthèse, rigueur, curiosité et autonomie. Aptitudes appréciées : réglementation automobile, prospective, transition énergétique ou exploitation de données complexes.* Vous souhaitez participer à l’aventure de l’automobile de demain ? Rejoignez-nous ! 🚗💡

items.desc: Description du poste : Les Vision Transformers (ViT) atteignent d’excellentes performances sur de nombreuses tâches de vision, mais leur coût de calcul et leur empreinte mémoire compliquent leur déploiement sur des plateformes embarquées. Parmi les techniques permettant de réduire leur complexité, le pruning de tokens [1] vise à supprimer dynamiquement les tokens les moins informatifs, tandis que la quantification [2] réduit la précision numérique des poids et des activations. Ces deux approches sont cependant généralement étudiées séparément alors qu'elles sont complémentaires plutôt que concurrentes. Des travaux récents montrent qu’elles peuvent être fortement interdépendantes et gagner à être conçues conjointement [3,4]. Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? L’objectif de ce stage est de développer une méthode de pruning de tokens quantization-aware et hardware-aware. Le travail consistera d’abord à caractériser l’impact de la quantification sur la sélection et l’importance des tokens, puis à développer une stratégie de pruning tenant compte à la fois de leur contribution à la tâche et de leur sensibilité à la basse précision. L’objectif sera ainsi d’étudier la co-optimisation du pruning et de la quantification plutôt que leur application indépendante. La dimension hardware-aware visera à transformer les réductions de complexité algorithmique en gains réels sur la plateforme cible, notamment en termes de latence et d’empreinte mémoire. La granularité du pruning, la structure des tenseurs, le budget de tokens ainsi que le caractère dynamique ou statique de la stratégie seront étudiés en fonction de leur efficacité d’exécution et de leur compatibilité avec les kernels et le compilateur. Les développements seront intégrés dans Aidge, la plateforme de deep learning développée au laboratoire pour l’optimisation et le déploiement de réseaux de neurones sur systèmes embarqués. Le travail comprendra l’étude de l’état de l’art, le développement et l’intégration des méthodes proposées, puis leur validation sur cible en termes de précision, complexité, latence, empreinte mémoire et surcoût du pruning. Références: [1] Bercy, V., Poreba, M., Szczepanski, M., Bouchafa, S.: G2TM: Single-module graph-guided token merging for efficient semantic segmentation. In: Proceedings of the 21st International Conference on Computer Vision Theory and Applications (VISAPP), pp. 43–54. (2026). [2] Sassoon, J., Szczepanski, M., Poreba, M.: I-Segmenter: Integer-only Vision Transformer for efficient semantic segmentation. Journal of Systems Architecture 178, 103888 (2026). [3] Wang, X., Xia, Z., Lin, Z., Li, Z., Wang, Y.: QAPruner: Quantization-Aware Vision Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models. (2026). arXiv:2604.02816. items.desc: Au sein de la Direction des Achats de Stellantis, vous intégrerez une équipe internationale qui accompagne la transformation digitale des activités Achats. L'équipe exploite quotidiennement d'importants volumes de données afin de contribuer au pilotage de la performance fournisseurs, à l'analyse des coûts, aux décisions de sourcing et à l'excellence opérationnelle. Alors que l'Intelligence Artificielle et les plateformes de données avancées deviennent des leviers majeurs de performance, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire motivé(e) pour contribuer au développement de solutions innovantes permettant d'améliorer la prise de décision basée sur les données et d'automatiser certains processus métiers. Ce stage offre une opportunité unique de travailler aux côtés d'experts des Achats, de la Data, du Digital et de l'Intelligence Artificielle, tout en acquérant une expérience concrète sur des technologies et plateformes de pointe utilisées au sein de Stellantis. Vos missions L'objectif de ce stage est d'accompagner la transformation Data & IA des Achats en développant des solutions innovantes permettant d'améliorer l'analyse des données, l'efficacité des processus et la performance opérationnelle. Au cours de cette expérience, vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Analyser, structurer et enrichir les données Achats provenant de différentes sources afin d'en améliorer la qualité et l'exploitation. Développer des cas d'usage Data à l'aide de plateformes de données telles que Palantir Foundry et Snowflake. Concevoir et mettre en place des tableaux de bord et des indicateurs de performance afin d'accompagner la prise de décision au sein des Achats. Identifier des opportunités d'optimisation et d'automatisation des processus grâce aux technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Développer, tester et déployer des assistants et agents basés sur l'IA à l'aide de Microsoft Copilot et de solutions d'IA générative. Contribuer à l'analyse des données fournisseurs, des coûts, du sourcing et des activités opérationnelles afin d'identifier des opportunités de création de valeur. Collaborer avec les équipes Achats, Finance, Digital et Data afin de comprendre les besoins métiers et de les transformer en solutions concrètes. Participer à la documentation, à la formation des utilisateurs et à la promotion des bonnes pratiques Data & IA au sein de l'organisation. Contribuer à des projets pilotes et à des initiatives d'innovation visant à accélérer l'adoption de l'IA au sein des Achats. Profil Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac+4/5 dans l'un des domaines suivants : Data Science Intelligence Artificielle Informatique Ingénierie des données Analyse de données / Business Analytics Transformation digitale Vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois à partir de 2027. Qualités personnelles Vous Êtes Curieux(se) et passionné(e) par la Data et l'Intelligence Artificielle Doté(e) d'un bon esprit d'analyse et rigoureux(se) Proactif(ve) et orienté(e) solutions Organisé(e) et autonome Doté(e) d'un bon esprit d'équipe et d'excellentes capacités de collaboration À l'aise dans un environnement international Motivé(e) par l'apprentissage et l'innovation Compétences techniques Vous Disposez De Connaissances Dans Les Domaines Suivants Analyse et ingénierie des données Intelligence Artificielle et IA générative Modélisation et visualisation des données Automatisation des processus Concepts de Business Intelligence Vous êtes familiarisé(e) avec certaines des technologies suivantes : Palantir Foundry Snowflake Microsoft Copilot Agents IA et solutions d'IA conversationnelle Python SQL Power BI Microsoft Power Platform : Power Automate, Power Apps Services Data et IA de Microsoft Azure Durée du contrat 6 mois At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future.

items.desc: Estamos a procura de um/a ML Engineer!! 📍 Localização: Vila Nova de Gaia / Porto 🏠 Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido, 2 dias por semana no escritório 🚗 Setor: Mobilidade 💼 Experiência: 3+ anos 🗣️ Idioma: Inglês fluente, obrigatório 💵 Remuneração: Até 34.000€ brutos por ano 🚀 Sobre a oportunidade Desde a HAYS , estamos à procura de um(a) ML Engineer para integrar um projeto internacional no setor da Mobilidade. Procuramos um perfil com experiência prática na construção, deployment e operação de soluções de Machine Learning em produção , capaz de trabalhar ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos modelos e garantir soluções escaláveis, monitorizadas e fiáveis. 🎯 Principais responsabilidades Desenvolver e operar soluções de Machine Learning e AI em ambientes produtivos. Gerir packaging, model registry, deployment, retraining e rollback de modelos. Construir e manter pipelines de CI/CD e Continuous Training. Transformar código de Data Science em serviços e componentes reutilizáveis e preparados para produção. Desenvolver APIs e integrações para incorporar modelos de ML em sistemas de negócio. Trabalhar com MLflow para gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos. Desenvolver feature pipelines e trabalhar com Feature Stores. Candidata-te e vem construir soluções de AI que chegam realmente a produção! 🚀

items.desc: Who are we? Hi, we’re Tails.com – we turn good days into great years for dogs and their humans. We're working towards longer lives for millions of healthy, happy dogs by providing tailored nutrition that adapts to each dog’s unique needs. It all starts with a few simple questions about their age, breed, zoomie level and tastebuds. From there, owners can create a personalised meal plan that's delivered to their door every month. No guesswork, no overwhelm. Just exactly the right care for every dog, every day. It's pretty clever stuff. As a certified B Corp, being a responsible business is built into how we work – upholding high social and environmental standards to create better walkies for generations to come. Now, we’re cooking up big plans. Having created an entirely new category in dog food, we have the backing of Purina – one of the world’s largest pet food companies. You’ll join a bunch of smart people working towards these same goals (and a bunch of very smart office dogs, all working on their own thing). Job Title Data Scientist Reporting of the role Reports to: Senior Analytics Manager Overview Of The Job The Data Scientist will own Tails.com's predictive modelling and machine learning work, with a primary focus on improving customer lifetime value (LTV) and driving more sustainable, profitable growth. They will build and develop models that help the business better understand which customers are likely to stay, spend and engage long-term, using these insights to improve acquisition strategies, customer retention and the overall customer experience. The role will work closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, Customer Experience & Retention, Product, Finance, Engineering and Data teams, taking ownership of projects from identifying opportunities and building models through to testing, implementation and measuring commercial impact. The focus isn't simply on building models, but on turning data science into practical business decisions that improve how Tails.com acquires and retains customers. 3 Best Things About The Job Ownership & influence: Own the predictive modelling and machine learning agenda, with the opportunity to shape the wider data science roadmap and influence business strategy. Commercial impact: Work on high-impact projects around customer lifetime value, acquisition and retention, with a direct link between your work and business growth. Cross-functional exposure: Partner with teams across Marketing, Product, Finance, Customer Experience and Technology, seeing your work implemented across the business. Measures of success – In the first few months, you would have: Built strong relationships with key stakeholders across Performance Marketing, CRM, Product, Finance, Customer Experience and Technology. Developed a strong understanding of Tails.com's customer lifecycle, existing data infrastructure, models and commercial priorities. Taken ownership of the customer lifetime value modelling roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve existing predictions. Started developing and implementing predictive models to help improve customer acquisition, trial conversion and retention. Identified opportunities to embed data-driven insights into CRM and paid media activity, with clear testing plans to measure commercial impact. Roles & Responsibilities: Lifetime value, predicted lifetime value and acquisition signals Own our lifetime value model, building on the models and definitions we already have rather than starting again, and agree one definition of lifetime value, CAC and payback with Finance and Analytics Predict each new customer's lifetime value as early as possible after sign-up, from acquisition source, behaviour, dog and plan data and early engagement Send that prediction to our acquisition partners (such as Meta and Google) so they optimise towards customers likely to stay rather than cheap sign-ups, and check with Marketing and Engineering that the events we send are complete, timely and matched to the right customers Compare channels by the value their customers go on to create, not only cost per sign-up As the value work matures, help build marketing mix modelling that shows how spend across channels drives valuable customers, building on the measurement we already have Conversion and early-life retention Find where and why trial customers do not become paying customers, and test the changes that improve trial-to-paid conversion without relying solely on discounts Decide which new customers need extra support in their first months, what kind, and while there is still time to change the outcome, matching risk and value to the actions most likely to work Run controlled tests with CRM and Customer Experience & Retention that measure the extra conversion, retention and retained value they create Experiment standards Set the minimum test and holdout standards for this work, so every result can show what it caused Production and monitoring Deploy models to production with help from our …

Indem wir für eine moderne und leistungsfähige Infrastruktur sorgen, sichern wir die Verteilung von Strom und Gas in Dresden und Ostsachsen. Moderne Energieversorgung ist für uns Teamarbeit: über 4.000 Mitarbeitende der Unternehmensgruppe engagieren sich täglich gemeinsam für eine zeitgemäße Infrastruktur und die Energiedienstleistungen der Zukunft. items.title: Part-time Product intern - Data scientist/engineer
items.card: The role: Part-time Data scientist & Product intern We have collected millions of data-points by proactively engaging tens of tens of thousands candidates monthly talent in the industries finance, IT/TECH, construction, infrastructure and mgmt. consulting and this is where you come in. The capabilities are endless and your work will impact both top-line and bottom-line. Increased revenue and operational efficiency
items.desc: About Worko Group and how we are looking to impact in the industry Worko was founded in 2011 spending the first years innovating the business model of the Swedish and Norwegian recruitment-market. We came in as challenger in a very traditional recruitment industry. The industry is driven in an extremely transactional, reactive and manual way. That we believe is wrong and that’s why we re-think recruitment. Since 2021 we have been laying foundations and innovating our product by investing 30 MSEK in platforms to better position ourselves in the AI era. Now we are in the next phase of the company; scale. While others are only now waking up to the AI shift — burdened by reactive perspective and legacy systems — we’re scaling far ahead of the curve and are quickly becoming the market-leader by combining a unique product being both a service and platform. We have fierce competition both sides of the aisle; companies being traditional service players and newly built platform companies. We are aiming to solidify ourselves as a front-runner by continuing to deeply embed AI, machine learning and other technologies attached to modern ways-of-working in order to reach our mission - matching competence plans of businesses and candidates career-plans @ labor-market scale The role: Part-time Data scientist & Product intern We have collected millions of data-points by proactively engaging tens of tens of thousands candidates monthly talent in the industries finance, IT/TECH, construction, infrastructure and mgmt. consulting and this is where you come in. The capabilities are endless and your work will impact both top-line and bottom-line. Increased revenue and operational efficiency while at the same spreading happiness by reducing manual work-load to all the employees of the company 😊! You will have a access to a competence sharing from a very ambitious team, top coaching and training to succeed in your career at Worko. The previous intern working part-time at Worko is now the CFO of the company. We expect you to put in average of 20-40 hrs per week with high amounts of flexibility given your current educational situation. At least twice a week at the office – you will set up your schedule together with your manager at the beginning of every 2 month-period We will do our best to position ourselves as a attractive employer by offering competitive salary, personal development and lots of fun with the aim to hire you when you are done with your masters(or earlier – if need be) Tasks a) Conducting operational analysis b) Strategy execution – taking part in projects with sometimes tough deadlines and complex problem-solving c) LLM validation, implementation & ideation of more use-cases d) Coding – confident in at least one language and understand the key concepts of building with code About you and what we are looking for: a) Engineering | Business administration | Math, with1-2 years left until Masters degree b) Top GPA c) Previous internships in mgmt consulting, banks or enterprise level organizations is viewed as a plus d) Analytical | Problem-solver | Team-player

Com uma abordagem centrada no cliente, adaptamos cada solução às suas necessidades, criando valor a longo prazo. Juntos, transformamos desafios em oportunidades de sucesso! Estamos à procura de um Data Engineer - Machine Learning que seja motivado pelo crescimento, que goste de enfrentar desafios e que esteja pronto para assumir uma nova função. Requisitos: Entre 2 a 3 anos de experiência em Engenharia de Dados, incluindo participação em projetos com Machine Learning tradicional. Experiência sólida em Azure Databricks. Bons conhecimentos de Python, SQL e PySpark. Experiência com Azure Data Lake Storage e formatos como Parquet e Delta Lake. Experiência no ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de soluções de dados: ingestão, transformação, modelação e disponibilização. Experiência prática com bibliotecas de Machine Learning. Conhecimentos de preparação de dados, feature engineering, treino, validação e avaliação de modelos. Compreensão de conceitos como overfitting, data leakage, separação entre treino e teste e validação cruzada. Experiência na integração de modelos em pipelines de processamento e scoring em batch. Experiência com Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software. Capacidade de desenvolver soluções escaláveis, com atenção ao desempenho e aos custos de execução. Porque é que vais adorar trabalhar connosco: - Somos uma empresa dinâmica e em rápido crescimento que valoriza a colaboração, a criatividade e o apoio contínuo. Terás a oportunidade de progredir na tua carreira com planos de crescimento personalizados; - Oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar em projectos internacionais de grande relevo e impacto que te desafiam e inspiram; - Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho flexível e inclusivo, onde a inovação e as novas ideias são sempre bem-vindas; - Oferecemos remunerações competitivas e pacotes de benefícios, incluindo iniciativas de bem-estar e oportunidades de aprendizagem. Envia o teu CV para jobs@vextech.pt, queremos conhecer o seu verdadeiro potencial.

items.desc: En qualité d’Aviation Data Scientist (H/F), vous avez pour mission de concevoir et déployer des solutions innovantes de data science et d’IA pour notre plateforme Skybreathe. Au sein de l’équipe Science, vous contribuez à la conception, à la définition et à l’intégration d’agents IA capables de fournir des recommandations aux équipes opérations aériennes, et vous développerez également de nouveaux algorithmes pour optimiser la performance des avions. En nous rejoignant, vous contribuerez directement à accompagner les compagnies aériennes dans leur réduction d’émissions carbone. Activités & Responsabilités : Analyse et modélisation de données : Analyser les données de vol, les schémas de consommation de carburant et les indicateurs opérationnels afin d’identifier les axes d’amélioration pendant le vol. Optimisation de l’efficacité des vols : Créer des modèles de données pour réduire la consommation de carburant en analysant les trajectoires de vol, les données météorologiques, les performances des avions et les procédures opérationnelles. Conception et intégration d’agents IA : Concevoir, définir et intégrer des agents IA capables de fournir des recommandations exploitables aux équipes opérations aériennes. Résolution de problèmes collaborative : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Engineering, Product, et Customer Experience afin d’implémenter efficacement les solutions data et de répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs. Implémentation logicielle : Traduire les modèles de data science et les solutions d’IA en fonctionnalités prêtes pour la production. Amélioration continue : Faire preuve de curiosité et de proactivité pour approfondir notre connaissance du secteur aérien et des technologies émergentes en science des données. Exemples de projets sur lesquels vous pourriez travailler : Développer des méthodes d’analyse des causes de surconsommation aidant nos clients à identifier proactivement des améliorations dans leurs opérations. Concevoir des modèles de performance des avions afin d’optimiser leur consommation, et de recommander des actions de maintenance. Implémenter des agents IA permettant aux compagnies aériennes d’utiliser facilement notre plateforme Skybreathe. Profil recherché Nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses, enthousiastes, ouvertes d’esprit, innovantes, engagées et aimant les défis, désirant contribuer au développement de solutions qui révolutionnent le secteur de l’aviation grâce à des technologies avancées et une approche rigoureuse.🌍 Master en Data Science, Computer Science, Ingénierie aérospatiale ou similaire. Au moins trois années d'expérience en data science orienté produit, appliqué à des données temporelles , idéalement dans l'aéronautique. Anglais courant, et Français courant. Capacité à traduire des besoins produit et business en expérimentations et fonctionnalités. Bonnes compétences en programmation Python . Solides capacités d’ analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Bonne connaissance de l’ écosystème IA et Machine Learning Excellentes compétences en communication, avec la capacité d’ expliquer clairement des concepts techniques complexes à des interlocuteurs non techniques et à des clients. Sens du client , avec la volonté de comprendre et de répondre aux enjeux métiers grâce à la data science. Intérêt pour les opérations aériennes, avec la capacité d’apprendre rapidement des concepts tels que la gestion du carburant, la préparation des vols et les performances des avions et la sécurité. Une connaissance des sources de données aériennes (données de vols, données météo, données de performance des avions…) et systèmes (Flight Management System) sera valorisée. Une expérience avec les systèmes agentiques (conception d’agents, outillage, orchestration) sera appréciée. 🌟 Salaire & Conditions : 💶 Salaire fixe + prime annuelle (performance collective et prime vacances) En rejoignant OpenAirlines, vous allez : 🌱Jouer un rôle dans la création d’une industrie aéronautique plus durable. 🏢Travailler dans l’hypercentre de Toulouse. 🌴Changer d’environnement de travail 3 semaines par an grâce à notre politique “work from anywhere” 🧠Développer votre potentiel en participant à des conférences, des événements (DevFest, French Tech…), des cours en ligne (Udemy), le FedEx Day : 24 heures d’innovation en équipe, ou encore la promotion interne. 🚵Recevoir un forfait mobilité durable. 🧑 Bénéficier d’une mutuelle prise en charge à 60% par l’entreprise, incluant un forfait médecines douces. 👀Accéder à des avantages issus de notre CSE. 🤟Profiter d’activités uniques de team building. 🍾Célébrer les réussites par des fêtes incroyables et des after-work au bar du coin à la moindre occasion ! 🦸 Être accueilli par un binôme pour assurer une transition en douceur dans notre environnement de travail. 🐻 Avoir une mascotte : Viktor, un ours polaire de 2 mètres de haut qui veille sur nous. items.desc: ElringKlinger Kunststofftechnik verbindet Spitzentechnologie und Menschlichkeit, um Fortschritt in der Welt der Hochleistungskunststoffe zu gestalten. Seit über 60 Jahren entwickeln wir individuelle Lösungen – von Dichtungen über Schläuche und Halbzeuge bis hin zu Baugruppen und Wärmetauschern – und unterstützen Schlüsselbranchen wie Mobilität, Maschinenbau, Halbleiter- und Medizintechnik sowie die Energieerzeugung und -speicherung. An fünf Standorten auf drei Kontinenten engagieren sich rund 750 Mitarbeitende dafür, technische Exzellenz mit Verantwortung, Teamgeist und Mut zu neuen Ideen zu verbinden. Wir sind: powered by people . Du möchtest nicht nur über Künstliche Intelligenz und Digitalisierung sprechen, sondern sie dort einsetzen, wo sie im Arbeitsalltag echten Mehrwert schafft? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wir möchten die Möglichkeiten von Künstlicher Intelligenz und Digitalisierung gezielt nutzen, um bestehende Arbeitsabläufe weiterzuentwickeln, wiederkehrende Tätigkeiten zu vereinfachen und neue digitale Lösungen für den Arbeitsalltag zu schaffen. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, konkrete KI-Anwendungsfälle zu identifizieren und digitale Lösungen zu entwickeln und diese gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen in die Praxis zu bringen. Dabei erhältst du Einblicke in unterschiedliche Unternehmensprozesse und kannst eigene Ideen aktiv einbringen. items.card: In this role, you will take full end-to-end ownership of features - from analysing business requirements and reviewing real customer data to designing, building, testing, and deploying backend services on AWS. Additionally, you will work closely with product managers and cross-functional engineering teams to drive impactful solutions. Responsibilities & Duties Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)
items.desc: Team Summary Our client is a global smart-home security company (video doorbells, cameras, alarm systems) serving millions of households. And in the direction of improving customer support we build an AI-powered platform that processes 1,000+ customer-support conversations per hour. It detects the specific product problems customers face, links them to the right engineering tickets, and verifies with data whether each fix actually worked. We own its evolution end to end, with a focus on measurable results and an AI-first engineering workflow. Job Summary We are looking for a Software Engineer with solid experience building cloud-native services and data pipelines, alongside a proven track record of leveraging AI-driven development workflows. In this role, you will take full end-to-end ownership of features - from analysing business requirements and reviewing real customer data to designing, building, testing, and deploying backend services on AWS. Additionally, you will work closely with product managers and cross-functional engineering teams to drive impactful solutions. Responsibilities & Duties Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as the primary development workflow; review, test, and own all generated code Implement features and improvements in backend services and data pipelines that process conversation data Integrate LLM services (Amazon Bedrock) into existing workflows: prompts, structured outputs, validation, and retries Build and maintain integrations with external systems through REST APIs (e.g. Jira) Extend automated quality checks: add real cases to regression test sets, track accuracy metrics, compare results with the human baseline Review system outputs and real customer conversations, find why the system was wrong, and fix it Participate in technical discussions and contribute to specifications for your features Keep services reliable and observable (logging, metrics, alarms) together with senior engineers Write unit and integration tests, and participate in code reviews Collaborate with a distributed, cross-functional team and the product owner on daily priorities Qualifications & Skills Regular use of AI coding agents for development, with the ability to show work built that way (commercial or personal projects) 2+ years of commercial backend software development experience Programming skills in Python, Go, JavaScript and TypeScript for AWS CDK Hands-on experience with core AWS services (Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS, IAM, CloudWatch) Working knowledge of databases: PostgreSQL and/or DynamoDB; good SQL Experience building or maintaining data processing jobs or pipelines; understanding of idempotency and retries Experience integrating REST APIs Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic): prompts and structured outputs Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing Good understanding of data structures, design patterns, and clean code principles Good communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams Upper-intermediate (B2) written and verbal English We offer multiple benefits that include The environment of equal opportunities, a transparent and value-based corporate culture, and an individual approach to each team member Competitive salary packages with performance-based annual reviews Opportunity to receive a Performance Bonus for your individual achievements and a Loyalty Bonus recognizing your dedication to the company Employment under a Contract of Employment (HPP) in full compliance with Czech Labour Law Guaranteed paid vacation, public holidays, and medical leaves as per statutory regulations Full state health insurance and social security contributions as per statutory regulations Continuous growth and development opportunities through internal knowledge hubs, corporate courses, and free English classes High-end hardware and all necessary devices provided to ensure a comfortable and efficient work environment.

items.title: R&D Internship for Engineering Students – 6G and AI Focus
items.card: Responsibilities Want to be at the cutting edge of Research and Development in cellular Networks and AI? Join the Milan team, which is taking world-leading Keysight electronics products from wild ideas to proof of concept. As a student in Telecom, Software, or AI Engineering, you will be involved in the transformation of a test and measurement idea into the development of a proof of concept. You will be
items.desc: Overview Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Responsibilities Want to be at the cutting edge of Research and Development in cellular Networks and AI? Join the Milan team, which is taking world-leading Keysight electronics products from wild ideas to proof of concept. As a student in Telecom, Software, or AI Engineering, you will be involved in the transformation of a test and measurement idea into the development of a proof of concept. You will be collaborating with international colleagues from the 5G & 6G research facilities in Europe, where a young & dynamic team is settled. You understand or want to learn more about 6G? Do you want to apply your skills in solving real 6G challenges? Then this internship is for you! You will solve a broad range of Telecom problems in the 6G network test space. The work is of varying scope and complexity and will expose you to what engineers do daily in a research lab. We have different topics ranging from executing 5G/6G tests on our partners’ networks, running experiments to assess network performance, testbeds to create datasets for AI training, maintaining complex software/cloud/communication systems, running experimentation to assess AI performance, etc. The amount of work hours and weekly schedule is flexible and takes into account your study requirements. The project you work on will be part of an existing team project where you can cooperate with experienced engineers from multiple Keysight R&D centers all around Europe. The work can also be combined with your Bachelor's or Master's thesis projects as part of your education. Qualifications Enthusiastic Bachelor's or Master's level student Fluent in English (written and oral) Passionate about working on advanced test and measurement challenges Aspiring Telecom, Software, or AI/ML engineer eager to apply academic knowledge in real conditions Interested in investigating cutting-edge testing methodologies in cellular systems Must be studying at one of the local Milan universities No relocation package or relocation support offered Careers Privacy Statement***Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

items.desc: Pour une entreprise en pleine évolution, nous recherchons un(e) Integration Engineer – Process Automation & AI capable d'analyser, de connecter et d'optimiser les systèmes et processus internes. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la direction pour comprendre les besoins opérationnels et les transformer en solutions technologiques concrètes. Votre objectif : fluidifier la circulation des informations, automatiser les workflows et intégrer intelligemment l'IA pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'entreprise. Vos responsabilités Analyse des processus : comprendre les méthodes de travail existantes, identifier les inefficacités et proposer des améliorations. Intégration des systèmes : connecter les CRM, logiciels de gestion et autres outils internes pour centraliser et synchroniser les informations. Automatisation des workflows : concevoir et mettre en place des automatisations pour simplifier les tâches quotidiennes et limiter les interventions manuelles. Intégration de l'IA : identifier et exploiter les opportunités offertes par l'intelligence artificielle dans les processus métiers. Conception de solutions : traduire les besoins business en solutions IT concrètes, fiables et évolutives. Amélioration continue : assurer le suivi et l'optimisation des intégrations et automatisations mises en place. Votre profil Expérience en intégration de systèmes, automatisation de workflows ou optimisation de processus métiers . Bonne compréhension des environnements IT, des CRM et des échanges de données entre applications. Intérêt pour l' intelligence artificielle et ses applications pratiques en entreprise . Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de structuration et de résolution de problèmes. Capacité à comprendre les enjeux business et à proposer des solutions adaptées. Profil autonome, hands-on, proactif et orienté résultats . Excellente maîtrise du français indispensable. Ce qui fera la différence Expérience dans l'automatisation de CRM et de processus administratifs ou opérationnels. Connaissance des outils d'intégration et d'automatisation. Familiarité avec l'intégration de solutions d'IA dans des workflows existants. Capacité à challenger les idées et à apporter une véritable réflexion technique et business. Pourquoi rejoindre cette opportunité ? Un rôle transversal combinant process engineering, intégration IT et IA . Une collaboration directe avec les décideurs et une réelle autonomie. Des projets concrets avec un impact direct sur l'efficacité de l'entreprise. L'opportunité de construire et de faire évoluer un environnement digital intelligent et intégré. Vous aimez comprendre les processus, connecter les systèmes et transformer les idées en solutions concrètes ? Cette opportunité est faite pour vous.

items.desc: Vil du være med til at udvikle løsninger til en effektiv, digitalt understøttet og fremtidssikret administration? Og har du erfaring med at udvikle automatiseringsløsninger med RPA og AI? Derfor søger vi nu en konsulent til IT & Digitalisering i Vejen Kommune. Om stillingen Som RPA/AI-konsulent bliver du en vigtig drivkraft i arbejdet med at omsætte kommunens behov til stabile og værdiskabende automatiseringer. Du skal kunne se mulighederne i både RPA, integrationer og AI og samtidig forstå den kommunale virkelighed, hvor faglighed, datasikkerhed og driftssikkerhed skal gå hånd i hånd. Jobbet handler ikke kun om teknik, men også om at skabe løsninger i samspillet mellem teknologi, fagpersoner og forretning, og du trives lige så godt ude blandt brugerne som bag ved skærmen. Du vil blandt andet arbejde med: Afklaring og vurdering af automatiserings use-cases, herunder både RPA og AI, i tæt dialog med kommunens fagområder, så de rigtige projekter bliver prioriteret og omsat til løsninger med reel værdi. Udvikling og afprøvning af AI-baserede løsninger, herunder digitale assistenter og AI-agenter, samt vurdering af, hvor AI med fordel kan kombineres med klassisk automatisering. AI-området er under udvikling hos os, og du får mulighed for at være med til at forme udviklingen i kommunen. Visualisering og formidling af data i Microsoft Power BI, så indsigter bliver lettere at forstå og bruge i den fælles prioritering af digitale indsatser. Mulighed for formidling og undervisning på tværs af kommunen. Om dig Du kan enten have en udvikler/IT-baggrund eller have tilegnet dig tilsvarende kompetencer på anden vis kombineret med en anden relevant uddannelse. Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du: Har erfaring med et eller flere script- og/eller programmeringssprog, herunder Microsoft PowerShell, Python og html. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med AI-værktøjer, promptdesign, automatisering, procesanalyse eller udvikling af digitale assistenter. items.desc: Är du en systemutvecklare med stort intresse för Computer Vision, Deep Learning och/eller bildbehandling som vill kombinera konsultrollen med att tillsammans i ett team vidareutveckla ditt teknikområde på Combitech? Hos oss får du möjligheten att sprida dina kunskaper och bidra till att utveckla kollegor och medarbetare samt dela vår passion och stolthet i att kunna erbjuda våra kunder och partners, effektivare, säkrare och mer värdeskapande lösningar. Din roll som systemutvecklare inom Computer Vision Efterfrågan på Combitechs kompetens inom Computer Vision ökar, och våra uppdrag spänner från teknikstudier till implementerade lösningar. Du kan arbeta i ett av våra in-house-team, där vi tillsammans hjälper kunder att omsätta tekniska möjligheter till fungerande lösningar. Som utvecklare arbetar du exempelvis med mjukvara och ramverk för vision och AI samt med integrering av kameror och andra sensorer, antingen i uppdrag in-house eller ute hos kund. I vårt labb finns kameror och utrustning för bland annat 3D-sensorer, NIR och IR. Uppdragen kan omfatta hela kedjan från teknikstudier till implementering av visionsystem i robotceller, ofta i miljöer där nyfikenhet, uppfinningsrikedom och förmåga att få tekniken att fungera under begränsade förutsättningar är avgörande. Våra kunder finns idag inom branscher som till exempel försvar, fordon, medtech, återvinning och processindustri och vi ingår i flera projekt som exempelvis syftar till att öka säkerheten på våra vägar eller till att skapa ett mer motståndskraftigt samhälle. Combitech har lång erfarenhet och bred kompetens inom bildbehandling. Vi samarbetar nära med världsledande kunder och deltar aktivt i kompetensnätverk i Sverige och internationellt. Lokalt utvecklar vi vår kompetens genom återkommande träffar där vi studerar forskningsartiklar och genomför praktiska laborationer inom AI och Computer Vision. Vem är du? Du är civilingenjör eller har en motsvarande masterexamen eller forskarutbildning, tillsammans med några års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har goda programmeringskunskaper och erfarenhet av exempelvis Python, Matlab, C++ eller C. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av Computer Vision, automatisering och Machine Learning. Du motiveras av att använda teknik för att förbättra processer och lösa komplexa problem. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar aktivt till både kollegornas och verksamhetens utveckling. Det är meriterande om du även trivs med att ibland arbeta praktiskt, exempelvis med robotar, enklare prototyper eller tekniska demonstratorer. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Kom & gör skillnad För oss är våra medarbetare nyckeln till att bygga ett smart och motståndskraftigt samhälle. Vi vet att effekten av dagens teknik enbart kan nå sin fulla potential när det finns rätt människor på rätt plats som nyttjar den. Vi tror på kraften i kollektiv intelligens och erfarenhet - något som uppstår när individer med olika kompetenser och perspektiv möts. Därför prioriterar vi mångfald och inkludering, för vi vet att det är avgörande för att öka kreativitet, innovation, engagemang och välbefinnande. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss? Kolla in våra karriärsidor! Kontaktuppgifter: Jörgen Dahlqvist, jorgen.dahlqvist (@) combitech.com Vi undanber oss rekryteringssamarbeten.

items.title: Graduate Software Engineer/Mission Dev Engineer - London
items.card: What you'll do Work with high-frequency, high-volume hardware data from systems like rockets, nuclear reactors and supersonic aircraft Design and build features, integrations, data pipelines and applications, often working directly with users in the field Own projects end to end, from understanding the problem to building, deploying and supporting the solution, with mentorship from experienced engineers and domain
items.desc: About Nominal Engineers today are building some of the most ambitious machines humanity has ever seen. They should have AI that’s purpose-built for them. Nominal is building the Hardware Intelligence Platform that gives engineers increased visibility into complex physical systems, helps them make better decisions, and ultimately gets their products into the real world faster. It brings together the systems, data, intelligence, and applications hardware engineering requires to meet the AI moment. Hardware engineering teams use Nominal to simulate, test, manufacture, and operate the physical systems that keep the world moving, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation energy systems and robotics. Our customers span aerospace, defense, manufacturing, transportation, energy, and robotics. They include Anduril, Shield AI, Wisk Aero, Pratt Miller Motorsports, Antares, and Shinkei Systems, amongst others, alongside programs within the U.S. Air Force and Navy. Our team draws from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, Tesla, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence. We're a fast-moving team that owns problems end-to-end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software. Some of the world’s leading technology investors, including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Lux Capital, and Insight Partners, are backing Nominal’s ambition to change how machines are built and operated. We’re looking for engineers who want to take on hard problems and help make a new generation of world-changing hardware possible. London is our newest office, and we're building the team that will grow Nominal across the UK and Europe. Two tracks, one application We're hiring final-year students graduating in summer 2027 into two tracks. Both are full engineering roles; the difference is where you spend your time. Software Engineer. You build the platform every customer relies on. Most of your time goes into designing systems, writing code and solving hard technical problems, like storing, querying and visualising billions of data points from hardware tests. You'll still talk to users, but your focus is the product itself. You might lean this way if you like going deep on one problem, care about how systems are designed, and get satisfaction from building something many people use. Mission Development Engineer (forward-deployed software engineer). You work alongside customer engineering teams, often on site right next to where the hardware is built and testing. You immerse yourself in how they work and what they’re building, find the bottlenecks, and build software to fix it, then bring what you learned back into the core product. ﻿You might lean this way if you like variety, enjoy working directly with users, and want to see your code change how a rocket or reactor test runs next week. Not sure? Pick "open to both" when you apply. The interview process is largely the same for both tracks, and we'll help you decide before your final round. 🚀 What you'll do Work with high-frequency, high-volume hardware data from systems like rockets, nuclear reactors and supersonic aircraft Design and build features, integrations, data pipelines and applications, often working directly with users in the field Own projects end to end, from understanding the problem to building, deploying and supporting the solution, with mentorship from experienced engineers and domain experts Get working software in front of users early and iterate based on how they actually use it Help an early-stage team grow by onboarding new customers, expanding the product and shaping how we operate in London 🎯 Apply if… You're in your final year, graduating in summer 2027, and looking for a full-time graduate role You have strong core engineering skills and real hands-on experience, whether from placements, internships, personal projects, hackathons, societies or coursework You enjoy hard, open-ended problems and picking up unfamiliar systems quickly You want to see the people using what you build and know whether it's making a difference Your friends and coursemates would describe you as ambitious, resourceful and persistent ✨ Benefits/Perks 🏖️ Unlimited PTO and sick leave 🍽️ Free lunch, snacks, and coffee 🚀 Professional Development Stipend ✈️ Annual company retreat 🛠️ Hardware sensor stipend 📈 Employee-friendly equity terms 🏢 In-office 5 days per week All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Compensation The base pay range for this role is £86,000 – £120,000 per year.

items.desc: Witted Mavericks rakennettiin lupaukselle. Halusimme uudistaa ohjelmistokonsultointia tarjoamalla markkinoiden reiluimman ja läpinäkyvimmän palkkamallin kokeneille ammattilaisille. Kun katsomme, missä olemme nyt, on selvää, että onnistuimme. Aloitimme vuonna 2019, ja tänä päivänä olemme kasvaneet noin 60 konsulttiin, sekä meillä on toimistot Helsingissä ja Oslossa. Palvelemme sekä suuria että pieniä asiakkaita niin yksityisellä kuin julkisellakin sektorilla, ja etsimme jatkuvasti korkean tason osaajia vaativien asiakastoimeksiantojen pariin. Nyt haemme Data Scientistia liittymään Witted Mavericksin asiakasprojekteihin Etsimme kokenutta Data Scientistia, joka haluaa nähdä mallinsa tuotannossa eikä vain PowerPoint-kalvolla. Asiakkaamme toimivat esimerkiksi mediassa, vähittäiskaupassa ja finanssialalla. Yhteistä niille on, että datalla ja koneoppimisella ratkaistaan suoraan liiketoiminnan ydinkysymyksiä. Työssä rakennat ja viet tuotantoon koneoppimismalleja ja analytiikkaratkaisuja. Tehtävät vaihtelevat toimeksiannon mukaan: suosittelujärjestelmien kehittämisestä ja A/B-testauksesta kysynnän ennustamiseen, aikasarja-analytiikkaan ja valikoiman optimointiin tai paikkatiedon hyödyntämiseen laajoissa dataputkissa. Yhä useammin mukana on myös generatiivista tekoälyä ja LLM-ratkaisuja. Asiakkaamme edellyttävät nykyään AI-avusteista kehittämistä datakäsittelyjen luomisessa. Kokemus erilaisten tekoälytyökalujen hyödyntämisestä tuotantotason koodin luomisessa on tärkeää. Erityisesti arvostamme kokemusta agenttisten koodausalustojen käytöstä ja/tai rakentamisesta laajoissa tuotantoympäristöissä. Työskentelet asiakkaan tiimissä yhdessä data engineerien, kehittäjien ja liiketoiminnan kanssa. Keskeistä on, että ymmärrät liiketoiminnan todelliset rajoitteet ja osaat muuttaa ne toimivaksi mallinnukseksi. Rooli on kiinnostava, jos haluat tehdä data sciencea, jonka vaikutus näkyy: suositukset, joita miljoonat käyttäjät näkevät, tai ennusteet, joiden pohjalta tehdään oikeita ostopäätöksiä. Toimeksiannot ovat tyypillisesti pitkäkestoisia ja toteutetaan hybridimallilla, yleensä 2–3 päivää viikossa asiakkaan tiloissa pääkaupunkiseudulla. Mitä odotamme sinulta? Liiketoimintaymmärrystä ja yhteistyötä: Ongelmasta malliksi: Osaat pilkkoa epämääräisenkin liiketoimintaongelman ja valita siihen sopivan lähestymistavan. Mallin monimutkaisuus ei ole itseisarvo. Viestintä: Kerrot tuloksista ja niiden epävarmuuksista selkeästi myös ei-teknisille sidosryhmille. Tuotantoajattelu: Kannat vastuuta mallin koko elinkaaresta kehityksestä seurantaan. AI- ja ML-osaaminen: Tuotannossa olevat ML-mallit: Sinulla on näyttöjä malleista, jotka ovat olleet oikeassa käytössä, esimerkiksi suosittelujärjestelmistä, kysyntäennusteista, aikasarjoista tai optimoinnista. AI-työkalut: Tuotantotason kokemus agenttisesta kehityksestä (esim. Claude Code tai Github Copilot) Kokeilu ja mittaaminen: Hallitset A/B-testauksen ja mallien suorituskyvyn arvioinnin. GenAI / LLM: Kokemus LLM-ratkaisujen hyödyntämisestä osana dataratkaisuja on vahva plussa. Teknologiat ja työkalut: Ydinosaaminen: Tuotantotason Python ja SQL. Odotamme useamman vuoden kokemusta Pythonista oikeissa projekteissa. Data-alustat: Databricks/Spark, Snowflake tai MS Fabric. Pilvi/ML työkalut: AWS SageMaker, Azure ML tai GCP (Vertex AI) Plussaa: MLOps-osaaminen, rajapintojen toteutus malleille sekä paikkatieto (esim. PostGIS). Tässä roolissa vaatimuksena on sujuva suomen kielen taito. Mitä tarjoamme Markkinoiden reiluimman diilin. Kohtelemme sinua kumppanina, emme kuten vain työntekijänä. Uskomme, että kun sinä olet arvonluoja, sinun tulisi myös olla se, joka kerää työn hedelmät. Tarjoamme siis mallin, jossa korvauksesi on suoraan sidoksissa kädenjälkeesi – ilman keinotekoisia palkkakattoja: Reilu korvaus: Bruttopalkkasi on aina 50,7 % generoimastasi liikevaihdosta. Tämän tyyppisissä projekteissa palkkasi on n. 7 600–9 200 €/kk. Ei lasikattoja: Jos projektin arvo nousee tai teet enemmän töitä, se näkyy palkassasi välittömästi. Vuosittaisia palkkaneuvotteluja ei tarvita. Polku Witted Maverickiksi Ota yhteyttä (jos rekrytointimme ei ole jo ollut sinuun yhteydessä). Jutellaan: Tutustutaan yhdessä kahvikupposen äärellä etänä tai kasvotusten. Osaamisen varmistaminen: Varmistamme, että kovat ja pehmeät taitosi vastaavat hakemaamme Senior-tasoa. Myynti: Tiimimme esittelee profiiliisi asiakkaalle. Sinusta tulee Witted Maverick: Kun asiakas näyttää vihreää valoa, sopimus allekirjoitetaan. Witted Mavericksilla pääset aitiopaikalle Liittymällä meihin saat molempien maailmojen parhaat puolet: ohjelmistoalan freelancerin korvauksen sekä työsuhteen turvan ja edut. Myynti, työterveyshuolto, hallinto, työkalut – kaikesta pidetään huolta puolestasi, jotta voit keskittyä 100-prosenttisesti toimeksiantoosi. Witted Maverickin edut: Luottamus ja joustavuus: Olemme aikuisten ammattilaisten joukko. Emme mikromanageeraa. items.desc: Job Description Hur kan fysikbaserade modeller bli mer träffsäkra genom smartare parameteroptimering? I det här examensarbetet får du undersöka och utveckla metoder för att automatisera optimeringen av modellparametrar utifrån verkliga mät-data. Du får kombinera matematik, programmering och fysik för att utveckla och utvärdera lösningar på tekniska utmaningar inom stålindustrin. Placeringsort: Oxelösund. Om tjänsten Inom industrin är det inte alltid möjligt att mäta alla parametrar direkt. Därför används fysikbaserade modeller, exempelvis för att beräkna en plåts temperatur genom en värmebehandlingsugn. Modellerna bygger på fysikaliska samband men innehåller parametrar som behöver optimeras mot stora mängder mätdata. Ditt uppdrag blir att undersöka lämpliga metoder för automatisk eller halvautomatisk parameteroptimering, implementera en lösning och utvärdera resultatet. Arbetet genomförs under 20 veckor på masternivå under vårterminen 2027. Arbetet utförs i Oxelösund. Följande steg föreslås Genomföra en litteraturstudie och undersöka befintliga optimeringsmetoder. Identifiera och välja lämpliga metoder för parameteroptimering. Implementera metoderna i relevanta programmeringsmiljöer. Utvärdera och jämföra metodernas resultat. Sammanställa arbetet och presentera resultaten i en examensrapport. Om dig Du studerar på masternivå inom ingenjörsvetenskap, matematik, systemteknik eller statistik. Du har goda kunskaper inom matematik, statistik och optimering. Du har erfarenhet av programmering i C++ och Python. Du har ett intresse för fysikbaserad modellering och teknisk problemlösning. Du är analytisk, strukturerad och trivs med att arbeta självständigt med komplexa frågeställningar. Kontakta gärna Jimmy Pettersson, Rekryterande chef, jimmy.pettersson@ssab.com About Us Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil-free steel production and have committed to becoming largely fossil-free. items.desc: Who we are CEPA Study Abroad is a U.S. based study abroad organization that partners with schools to develop and run custom faculty-led programs in over 40 countries. CEPA was founded in 1997 and operates study abroad programs across Europe, including European Study Centers in France and Germany. Our main administrative offices are in Besigheim, Germany and Strasbourg, France. CEPA also partners with the CEPA Foundation to provide service-learning opportunities in Costa Rica, Peru, and Guatemala, programs that align with our organization’s commitment to environmental and humanitarian engagement. We are a small marketing team, very much mission and values driven, focused on building collaborative relationships and providing meaningful and challenging study abroad programs that enable students to broaden their global perspective, deepen their knowledge, and develop personally and professionally. We are committed to social responsibility and environmental sustainability and have been offsetting our carbon footprint since 2019. CEPA Study Abroad joined Terra Education in 2026, giving the organization the opportunity to expand its study abroad programs to additional destinations outside of Europe, working alongside our colleagues at Terra who have long-standing expertise in Africa, Asia and Central & South America. Your Role and Responsibilities For our team in Besigheim, we are looking for a motivated working student with an interest in IT, digitalization, and artificial intelligence, who is keen to gain practical experience in a modern, international work environment. In this role, you will not only contribute to ongoing IT projects but also actively support the implementation of new digital solutions and AI applications that are set to transform the way we work within the company. Your tasks Depending on your interests and current needs, you will support us with tasks including: Maintaining and further developing our Microsoft 365 environment Setting up and configuring hardware and software Providing first-level support to employees with technical questions Supporting IT projects and rollouts Analyzing, documenting, and automating workflows Implementing and using AI solutions such as MS Copilot Digitalizing and optimizing internal processes Researching and evaluating new technologies and AI applications Creating instructions, training materials, and documentation Working hours: up to 20 hours/week during the semester, more hours possible during semester breaks by arrangement. Duration of the contract: initially 6 months with the possibility to extend. What you bring to the table Currently enrolled in a degree program (ideally in your first semester) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Informatics, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable field of study in the Heilbronn, Ludwigsburg, or Stuttgart region Enthusiasm for digitalization, modern IT solutions, and AI technologies Practical and solution-oriented approach to work Interested in taking on responsibility to take on responsibilities and drive projects forward independently Excellent written and spoken German and English skills Friendly demeanor and enjoyment of working with international teams Current enrollment at a university What you can expect: Exciting practical experience in the future-oriented fields of IT, digitalization, and AI Participation in real projects with tangible benefits Direct insight into strategic digitalization initiatives High degree of autonomy and short decision-making processes Flexible working hours that can be combined with your studies International work environment with colleagues in Europe and the USA Modern IT infrastructure and the opportunity to actively shape new technologies Personal and professional development Optional: Provision of a furnished room in a shared apartment Why us? The Stuttgart/ Heilbronn region is currently developing into one of Germany’s most exciting hubs for AI and innovation. We want to actively leverage this environment and are looking for students who wish to put the knowledge gained from their studies and research into practice. At the same time, we offer the opportunity to play a direct role in the digital advancement of an internationally active company. Do you want to go beyond just studying AI—do you want to apply it in a real-world context? If so, we look forward to receiving your application. Terra Education Europe GmbH Weinstraße 3, 74354 Besigheim Benefits: Company events Flexible working hours Complimentary beverages Free parking Employee discount Work location: On-site, Besigheim Please apply via the portal and include your earliest possible start date. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity within our company. Requirements Candidates should have a background in data science or a related field, with an interest in practical AI applications in a professional setting.
