items.desc: Location: Copenhagen Do you want to work hands-on with modern cloud-based technologies, data engineering and AI, while helping turn complex data into solutions that create real business value? Join us as a Data Engineer to become part of an environment where knowledge is shared, and curiosity is encouraged. And work with tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Claude, Microsoft Azure, SQL and AI as you help develop the data platform that enables actionable insights, intelligent solutions and data-driven applications. “ You’ll get to contribute to solutions for a wide portfolio of customers - without compromising on flexibility and work-life balance. This also allows you to develop your expertise through challenging assignments and collaboration with experienced colleagues ,” says Brian Landbo, Manager, SmartX. Join an environment built around knowledge, collaboration and growth At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe that development happens when people learn and solve challenges together. You will become part of our ambitious and agile SmartX team where the pace is high and where we work with modern cloud technologies, data engineering, analytics and AI through our data platform. Develop our cloud-based data platform As a Data Engineer, you will work closely with analysts, developers and business stakeholders, play a central role in developing our cloud-based data platform, and help transform complex data requirements into robust solutions that deliver real value. You will work across data engineering and AI, while contributing to the foundations that make intelligent and data-driven solutions possible. More Specifically, You Will Develop and maintain data models Develop, optimize and quality-assure data pipelines in Snowflake Implement transformations, tests and documentation using dbt Ensure high data quality through automated testing and validation processes Work with Medallion Architecture and modern data warehouse principles Support the development of AI-based solutions and data-driven applications Experience With The Main Technologies You do not need to tick every box. We believe some of the best colleagues grow through curiosity, commitment and a genuine desire to learn. We are looking for a new colleague who enjoys solving complex problems and who is motivated by both technology and the value it can create. You thrive in a collaborative environment where professional dialogue and knowledge sharing are an important part of everyday work. And you enjoy continuously learning and exploring new technologies within data, AI and cloud platforms. Finally, We Imagine That You Have hands-on experience with and a solid understanding of Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse Have strong SQL and data modelling skills, including experience with dimensional modelling such as facts, dimensions and star schemas Have experience using dbt for data transformation and ETL/ELT processes Have worked with data validation, automated testing and documentation Have experience with Git and agile development processes Ready to build what comes next? Then we are happy to hear from you and urge you to hit that “Apply Now“ button. Apply today and make NTT DATA Business Solutions the place where you grow.

items.desc: Zespół Tax Technology and Transformation łączy kompetencje z obszaru technologii, danych, finansów i podatków. Jako Senior Consultant AI & Data będziesz identyfikować obszary wymagające usprawnienia, projektować praktyczne rozwiązania wykorzystujące dane i sztuczną inteligencję oraz wdrażać je wspólnie z klientami i zespołami projektowymi. Nie oczekujemy eksperckiej wiedzy podatkowej na początku współpracy. Ważniejsze są doświadczenie w projektach technologicznych lub transformacyjnych, dobra znajomość obszaru AI & Data oraz umiejętność przekładania potrzeb biznesowych na praktyczne rozwiązania. EY.AI - na tym stanowisku będziesz pracować z ekosystemem narzędzi, w którym agenci AI są partnerami w codziennej pracy doradczej. Wspólnie analizujecie przepisy, interpretacje i dane, automatyzujecie procesy i tworzycie dokumenty oraz rekomendacje dla klientów. AI jest tu elementem pracy operacyjnej, a nie dodatkiem. Twój zakres obowiązków: udział w projektach z obszaru AI, danych, analityki, automatyzacji i transformacji technologicznej; identyfikowanie możliwości wykorzystania danych i sztucznej inteligencji do usprawniania procesów podatkowych, finansowych i raportowych; analizowanie potrzeb biznesowych klientów oraz przekładanie ich na wymagania i koncepcje rozwiązań; projektowanie, rozwijanie i wdrażanie rozwiązań wspierających automatyzację, analizę danych i podejmowanie decyzji; przygotowywanie analiz, koncepcji, prototypów i rekomendacji dla klientów; analizowanie i porządkowanie danych pochodzących z różnych systemów i źródeł; wspieranie klientów na różnych etapach transformacji, od określenia potrzeb i wyboru rozwiązania po jego testowanie i wdrożenie; prowadzenie warsztatów, spotkań projektowych i prezentacji dla klientów; współpraca z zespołami biznesowymi i technologicznymi przy tworzeniu rozwiązań dopasowanych do potrzeb klienta; koordynowanie wybranych obszarów projektu oraz dbanie o jakość i terminowość realizowanych prac; przygotowywanie dokumentacji projektowej, materiałów analitycznych i prezentacji; wspieranie mniej doświadczonych członków zespołu i dzielenie się wiedzą; śledzenie trendów w obszarze AI, Data i transformacji cyfrowej oraz wykorzystywanie ich w projektach realizowanych dla klientów. Nasze wymagania: minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w projektach związanych z AI, danymi, analityką, automatyzacją, technologią lub transformacją procesów; doświadczenie w analizowaniu potrzeb biznesowych i przekładaniu ich na rozwiązania technologiczne; dobra znajomość zagadnień związanych z AI, analizą danych lub automatyzacją; doświadczenie w pracy z danymi oraz umiejętność formułowania na ich podstawie wniosków i rekomendacji; umiejętność przygotowywania analiz, prezentacji, dokumentacji i materiałów dla klienta; zdolność łączenia perspektywy biznesowej i technologicznej; bardzo dobre umiejętności analityczne i komunikacyjne; samodzielność, dobra organizacja pracy oraz umiejętność koordynowania powierzonych zadań; doświadczenie w pracy projektowej i współpracy z różnymi grupami interesariuszy; gotowość do bezpośredniej współpracy z klientami oraz prowadzenia warsztatów; bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego; wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane kierunki związane z technologią, danymi, ekonomią, finansami, zarządzaniem lub kierunki pokrewne. Dodatkowym atutem będzie: doświadczenie w projektach konsultingowych, transformacyjnych lub realizowanych bezpośrednio dla klientów; praktyczna znajomość rozwiązań z obszaru AI, analizy danych, automatyzacji lub technologii chmurowych; znajomość procesów finansowych, księgowych, podatkowych lub raportowych. Szukamy osoby, która interesuje się możliwościami wykorzystania sztucznej inteligencji i danych w biznesie, a jednocześnie potrafi spojrzeć szerzej na procesy, potrzeby klienta i cele projektu. W tej roli ważne będą swoboda poruszania się w tematach technologicznych oraz umiejętność współpracy z osobami nietechnicznymi. Nie musisz specjalizować się w jednym narzędziu ani posiadać doświadczenia we wszystkich wskazanych obszarach. Liczą się zdolność szybkiego uczenia się, analityczne podejście i gotowość do rozwijania kompetencji w obszarze Tax Technology. To oferujemy: udział w projektach dla polskich i międzynarodowych organizacji, łączących technologię, dane oraz procesy podatkowe, finansowe i raportowe; możliwość pracy nad rozwiązaniami wykorzystującymi sztuczną inteligencję, analizę danych i automatyzację; współpracę z konsultantami biznesowymi, ekspertami podatkowymi, analitykami i specjalistami technologicznymi; możliwość rozwijania kompetencji w zakresie prowadzenia projektów, koordynowania pracy zespołu i budowania relacji z klientami; różnorodność projektów pozwalającą zdobywać doświadczenie w nowych obszarach technologicznych i biznesowych; wsparcie merytoryczne i finansowe w …

items.desc: Depuis sa création, KLANIK s'est donnée pour mission de conjuguer expertise technologique et authenticité. Ce pari audacieux, né à Marseille en 2011, en France, s'est transformé en une aventure internationale qui compte aujourd'hui plus de 800 collaborateurs, des implantations dans 10 pays et des filiales innovantes. Nous rejoignons en 2026 le groupe ALTEN, acteur mondial de l'ingénierie et des services numériques. Notre rôle : recruter les meilleurs talents & les connecter à nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets digitaux. KLANIK est une société de conseil en informatique structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertises : Data & IA, DevOps Cloud Infra, Cybersécurité, Software, Produit Agilité Pilotage. Nos 800 talents ont des profils variés : tech (nos pôles d'expertises), opérationnels (fonctions commerciales et recrutement) et support. Au‑delà des métiers, KLANIK cultive un modèle profondément humain, qui dépasse les frontières : de la Belgique à la Colombie, nos valeurs résonnent. Une culture fondée sur le partage, l'exigence et la bienveillance - un collectif où chacun peut trouver sa place. En témoignent nos filiales : Klanik Esport : club Esport & agence de gamification; Korner : incubateur de startups tech; Kampus : organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi l'Act'In Klanik, rôles qui permettent à nos collaborateurs de faire vivre leurs passions au-delà de leurs missions. Notre culture est résumée par cette phrase, souvent apposée sous notre logo : Human-Made Technology. La tech oui, mais une tech humaine, qui diffuse un modèle où l'authenticité de chacun est la priorité. KLANIK, en tant que société à mission, croit en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de genre, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force qui contribue à notre succès. items.desc:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. 
This region service team is a customer experience-oriented team which is looking for a self-motivated talented engineer who can solve complex problems and have a vision to improvise the service support. 
We are looking for a skilled engineer who brings a mix of operations and networking expertise and shares our passion to change the way our customers operate. A systems engineer will be driving the opportunities to automate and simplify the daily operations and scales the organisational operations.
Key job responsibilities
- Work proactively to solve potential problems and inefficiencies. Communicate clearly and collaborate with others to deliver results with minimal supervision.
- Participating in 24/7 on-call rotation to troubleshoot high severity issues.
- Analysing dashboards and investigating metrics with the vision for improvements.
- Troubleshooting and diagnosing problems and working on solutions.
- Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and runbooks for documentation.
- Discuss radical new approaches to automate operational issues, assess risks and develop creative solutions. 
You will need to be a UK national and able to obtain and maintain a UK Government Security Clearance. Further details found here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels
A day in the life
WHAT DOES A SYSTEMS ENGINEER DO AT AMAZON?
Amazon has a collaborative, purposeful and enthusiastic environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a typical day engineers might dive deep into understanding the root cause of a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending the wrong way and consult with senior engineers at Amazon. We own our services and believe in making out-of-hours support as painless as possible. To achieve this, we implement Operational Excellence best practices and strive to automate manual processes.
Our Systems Engineering roles help engineers develop a broad range of skills. They utilise their Linux skills to troubleshoot, innovate fixes and workarounds, keep software up-to-date and provide data and metrics that help manage the capacity and efficiency of our services. They draw on their networking knowledge to identity and troubleshoot network connectivity issues. They communicate clearly and collaborate with others to deliver results. They are self-starters, comfortable dealing with ambiguity and change. They are customer-obsessed, always looking to understand customer pain points and find resolutions quickly and completely.
About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. 
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 12, 2026, 3:57PM Durée du contrat : 5 mois Depuis plusieurs années, l’équipe développe des solutions d’automatisation des mesures sur les réseaux WiFi. Ces mesures permettent par exemple d’analyser les performances radio ainsi que d’améliorer ou concevoir de nouveaux services pour les clients d’Orange. Dans ce cadre, ses ingénieurs travaillent à la conception d’une solution permettant d’effectuer des mesures radio dans des environnements indoor interfacée avec notre solution d’acquisition des données WiFi. Vous contribuerez à la mise au point de cet équipement, conçu pour être robuste, autonome et précis. Vous travaillerez à partir d’un robot mobile existant construit sur une base Raspberry Pi 4 et d’une carte Arduino. Son environnement logiciel repose actuellement sur Linux, Python et ROS, avec une évolution envisagée vers ROS 2. Votre mission pourra notamment consister à : Prendre en main le robot et son architecture matérielle et logicielle ; Faire évoluer la solution vers ROS 2 ; Optimiser la fiabilité, l'autonomie et la précision de déplacement du robot ; Étudier et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’évitement d’obstacles reposant sur le SLAM et Nav2 ; Évaluer la fusion des informations issues du SLAM et de Nav2 avec celles détectées par une caméra, afin de repérer en temps réel des obstacles absents de la carte ou non pris en compte par les filtres de navigation ; Spécifier une solution bas coût permettant d’ajuster en hauteur voire aussi orienter l’équipement de mesure transporté par le robot. Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Master 2 ou ingénieur dans un domaine lié à la robotique, à l’automatique, à l’informatique ou aux systèmes embarqués. Vous disposez de connaissances ou d’un intérêt marqué pour : La robotique mobile et ROS ou ROS 2 ; La programmation Python et les systèmes Linux, notamment sur Raspberry Pi ; L’électronique embarquée, le diagnostic de pannes et le contrôle de moteurs à courant continu ; La programmation de cartes Arduino ; Le traitement d’images et l’intelligence artificielle. Vos soft skills : Votre curiosité, votre rigueur et votre goût pour l’expérimentation vous permettront de mener des essais, d’analyser les résultats et de proposer des améliorations. Ce stage vous permettra de travailler sur un système robotique concret, au croisement de la robotique mobile, de l’électronique embarquée, du traitement d’images et de l’intelligence artificielle. Vous contribuerez à faire évoluer un équipement destiné à des activités de mesure et d’expérimentation dans des environnements indoor variés. L'indemnité mensuelle brute de stage proposée est comprise entre 1000 et 1500 eurosselon votre niveau d'études en cours. A cela s'ajoutent l'accès aux Activités Sociales et Culturelles proposées par votre Comité Social et Economique, l'accès subventionné au restaurant d'entreprise ou aux titres restaurant, ainsi que la prise en charge à hauteur de 50% de votre abonnement aux transports en commun. L’ambition de la Division Innovation d’Orange est de porter plus loin l’innovation du Groupe et de renforcer son leadership technologique. Ses équipes mobilisent leurs capacités de recherche pour nourrir une innovation responsable au service de l’humain, éclairer les choix stratégiques à long terme et contribuer à l’évolution de l’écosystème numérique. Au sein de cette division, vous rejoindrez à Belfort l’équipe Radio Engineering & Data Valorization (RDV). Depuis 25 ans, elle développe des expertises en mesure radio Wi-Fi, 4G et 5G, ainsi qu’en modélisation de la propagation indoor et outdoor. Elle conçoit également des solutions de sensing pour la détection de présence et la géolocalisation, et contribue à la conception et à la validation d’équipements Orange tels que les Livebox, les répéteurs et les décodeurs TV. Depuis plusieurs années, l’équipe développe également ses compétences en Data Science et en intelligence artificielle. Le stage s’inscrit dans cette dynamique, au croisement de la robotique mobile, de la mesure radio et de l’expérimentation en environnement indoor, résidentiel ou professionnel. Date de début souhaitée : Apr 12, 2027, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

items.desc: Paris, 75, FR ABOUT CFM Founded in 1991, we are a global quantitative and systematic asset management firm applying a scientific approach to finance to develop alternative investment strategies that create value for our clients. We value innovation, dedication, collaboration, and the ability to make an impact. Together, we create a stimulating environment for talented and passionate experts in research, technology, and business to explore new ideas and challenge existing assumptions. Your Role How Much History Does an LLM Need? Memory-Augmented Language Models for Financial Text Financial text about a company accumulates continuously over years. Today's language models typically process this history either by feeding in as much as fits in their context window, or by splitting it into independent chunks. Both approaches have well-known limitations, especially as history grows long and needs to stay historically consistent. This internship explores an alternative: building a compact, incrementally updated memory of a company's disclosure history, one that is updated as new documents arrive rather than fully re-read each time. The central question is twofold: Does a long disclosure history help understand or predict a company's future, compared to only recent information? If so, what is the best way to represent and maintain that history over time in a language model? Key Responsibilities Design and compare strategies for incrementally updating a compact memory representation as new documents arrive. Build comparison baselines, including a retrieval-based system. Evaluate the resulting representations both for faithfulness to the source documents and for usefulness on a downstream financial prediction task. Read and implement research papers (a significant part of the work). Your Skills Required Final-year engineering or Master's student in NLP, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or Computer Science. Strong Python skills, including PyTorch. Solid understanding of LLMs and sequence modeling. Ability to read and implement research papers. Fluent English Appreciated Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agent memory systems, or reinforcement learning for LLMs. Interest in financial applications (a bonus). Prior knowledge of finance is not required. French is a bonus. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. An overview of this role As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. What you’ll do Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems. Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools. Analyze software supply chain incidents and events. Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection. Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work. Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories. Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it. What you’ll bring Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them. Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs. Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code. Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud. Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen. Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends. Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience. Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu. You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough. About the team The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog. items.desc: Descriptif de fonctions La Communauté du Pacifique (CPS) principale organisation scientifique et technique du Pacifique, sert le développement de la région depuis 1947. Organisation internationale de développement, la CPS tient lieu de maison commune aux 27 États et Territoires qui la composent et en assurent la gouvernance. Œuvrant pour le développement durable au bénéfice des populations du Pacifique, l’Organisation intervient dans plus de 25 secteurs d’activité. La CPS est renommée pour ses connaissances et sa capacité d’innovation dans des domaines tels que les sciences halieutiques, la surveillance de la santé publique, les géosciences et la conservation des ressources phytogénétiques pour l’alimentation et l’agriculture. La Division pêche, aquaculture et écosystèmes marins (FAME) est composée de trois programmes : le Programme pêches côtières et aquaculture (CFAP) ; le Programme pêche hauturière (OFP) et le Programme écosystèmes marins (MEP). Le Bureau du·de la Directeur·rice offre un appui à la mise en œuvre de ces trois programmes et des projets transversaux, et fixe leur orientation stratégique. Œuvrant aux côtés des 22 États et Territoires insulaires océaniens, la Division peut compter sur un solide réseau de partenaires régionaux, infrarégionaux et nationaux du secteur marin. Les effectifs de FAME sont répartis entre la Nouvelle-Calédonie, les Fidji, les États fédérés de Micronésie, les Îles Salomon et les Tonga, la majeure partie de ses agents étant en poste en Nouvelle-Calédonie. Le·La Chargé·e de la gestion des informations et des bases de données halieutiques (pêches côtières) apportera des compétences stratégiques et techniques spécialisées en conception, élaboration, gouvernance et déploiement de systèmes de données sur les pêches côtières et l’aquaculture, notamment en ce qui a trait aux bases de données, aux plateformes numériques et aux solutions alimentées par l’intelligence artificielle (IA). Il·Elle appuiera une gestion reposant sur des données factuelles et renforcera les capacités dans l’ensemble des pays insulaires océaniens au moyen de systèmes de données innovants, normalisés et durables. Les principales responsabilités du poste sont les suivantes : Mettre sur pied et gérer des systèmes d’information et des bases de données nationales et régionales de grande qualité sur les pêches côtières et l’aquaculture et dispenser des formations à l’utilisation de ces outils. Grenoble INP – Ense3, UGA, est installée dans un bâtiment à haute performance énergétique sur la Presqu’île scientifique, est une école d’ingénieur·e·s proposant d’accompagner la transformation technologique et la maîtrise des ressources dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’eau et de l’environnement. Les projets phares : notre ambition est de devenir une école de référence pour sensibiliser les acteurs du monde socio-économique et accompagner les projets de transition énergétique et d’adaptation au changement climatique. L’école accueille plus de 1200 élèves (ingénieurs et masters), pour un effectif de 300 enseignants titulaires et vacataires et 50 personnels administratifs et techniques. Site internet : https://ense3.grenoble-inp.fr/ Mission Contexte / Mission principale L’ingénieur.e contribuera à la transformation et à la modernisation des enseignements en traitement et analyse d’images, notamment par l’intégration progressive de méthodes d’intelligence artificielle, d’apprentissage automatique et d’apprentissage profond. items.desc: Contexte Au sein de la direction Mobilité et Systèmes d'IFP Energies nouvelles, vous rejoindrez une équipe réunissant des compétences en mécanique des fluides numérique, thermique et thermomécanique. Historiquement reconnue dans les domaines de l'injection et de la combustion des moteurs thermiques, l'équipe développe aujourd'hui ses activités vers de nouveaux secteurs : propulsion spatiale, aéronautique, turbomachines, combustion stationnaire, systèmes cryogéniques et nouvelles technologies. Ces nouveaux domaines soulèvent des enjeux scientifiques et technologiques variés, notamment autour de la combustion stationnaire, des écoulements réactifs et diphasiques, des transferts thermiques et de l’analyse des turbomachines et systèmes propulsifs. L’objectif est de mobiliser la simulation numérique pour comprendre le fonctionnement de ces systèmes, identifier les phénomènes limitants et contribuer à l’amélioration de leurs performances et de leur conception. Mission(s) principale(s) et activités Vous prendrez en charge des études CFD appliquées à des systèmes thermo-fluidiques, thermodynamiques et propulsifs complexes, depuis l'analyse du besoin jusqu'à l'interprétation des résultats. À ce titre, vos principales activités seront de : Contribuer aux études portant sur les turbomachines à flux continu, la combustion stationnaire, la propulsion aérospatiale, les écoulements diphasiques, l'injection et les systèmes cryogéniques. Analyser les phénomènes physiques et les problématiques technologiques associés aux projets. Définir les méthodologies et stratégies de simulation, préparer les géométries, réaliser les maillages et mettre en œuvre les calculs. Exploiter les moyens de calcul haute performance et assurer le post-traitement des résultats. Évaluer la qualité et les limites des simulations, et confronter les résultats numériques aux données expérimentales disponibles. Mobiliser les résultats de simulation pour identifier les phénomènes limitants et proposer des pistes d'amélioration des composants. Collaborer avec les équipes spécialisées dans le développement de modèles physiques et avec les partenaires industriels. Contribuer au développement des méthodes et des pratiques de l'équipe, notamment par l'utilisation et le développement d'agents IA pour la mise en données et le post-traitement. Déplacements à prévoir Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et, selon les projets, à l’international, notamment pour des réunions avec les partenaires ou des conférences. Critères candidat Compétences techniques et aptitudes Vous maîtrisez la mécanique des fluides numérique et les différentes étapes d'une étude CFD : préparation géométrique, maillage, calcul parallèle, post-traitement et analyse physique des résultats. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des solveurs CFD industriels ou open source. La connaissance de CONVERGE constitue un atout. Une connaissance technologique des turbomachines à flux continu et de leurs principaux composants est particulièrement recherchée, afin de relier les résultats de simulation au fonctionnement et à l’amélioration des composants. Une expérience des écoulements diphasiques, des changements de phase ou des systèmes de stockage et de transfert de fluides cryogéniques constituerait également un plus. Une expérience des moteurs à combustion interne pourra également être valorisée lorsqu’elle est complétée par une expertise dans l’un des domaines prioritaires du poste. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous faites preuve de rigueur scientifique, d'autonomie et de curiosité. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et savez communiquer et partager vos connaissances. La maîtrise de l'anglais technique, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, est attendue. Langues Anglais (Courant) Diplôme(s), niveau d'études Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un doctorat en mécanique des fluides, énergétique, combustion, thermique ou dans un domaine équivalent. Expérience(s) professionnelle(s) souhaitée(s) Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle confirmée en CFD appliquée, acquise dans l'industrie, un organisme de recherche ou un environnement académique orienté vers les applications. Une expertise dans au moins l’un des domaines suivants est particulièrement recherchée : turbomachines et aérodynamique interne, combustion stationnaire et chambres de combustion aéronautiques, ou propulsion spatiale. Une expérience de l’injection, de la pulvérisation, de l’allumage ou des transferts thermiques constituera un complément apprécié. Information publication Accessible aux personnes porteuses d'un handicap : Oui

items.desc: Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and technical Product Owner to own and drive the product backlog and lifecycle for our D&I wireless and edge portfolio. In this role, you will act as the Content Authority for the backlog, bridging customer needs, industry standards, and R&D execution. You will partner closely with systems engineering, R&D, NPI (New Product Introduction), and global cross-functional teams to deliver secure, highly reliable industrial wireless and edge platforms for utility and critical infrastructure customers. Job Description Location: Massy or Hybrid in France with 3 days in Massy office Reports To: Senior Product Manager Segment: Grid Automation / Digital & Infrastructure (D&I) Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Backlog Ownership & Requirements Backlog Management: Own and maintain the product backlog; translate portfolio strategy and multi-year roadmaps into prioritized epics, features, and enablers. Content Authority: Make explicit trade-offs across scope, cost, schedule, and quality, ensuring a release-ready backlog ahead of each planning cycle. Requirements Definition: Translate customer insights, field feedback, and standards obligations into clear, testable system requirements—including non-functional requirements (coverage, latency, availability, cybersecurity, environmental ratings). Traceability & Change Control: Maintain requirements traceability and change control; assess and communicate the impact of scope changes on committed release plans. 2. Product Execution & Lifecycle Portfolio Ownership: Own backlog and release execution across wireless platforms, including: Private LTE / PLTE Core & RAN Wireless Edge devices and industrial IoT platforms Edge Applications for Distribution Automation (e.g., Smart RTU, protocol conversion) Broadband power line communications Microwave and narrowband radio systems R&D & NPI Partnership: Act as the "voice of the customer" to R&D and NPI program teams. Lead backlog refinement, support Program Increment (PI) Planning and NPI tollgate reviews, and validate delivered value against acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done. Architecture & Dependencies: Partner with System Architects to balance feature content against architectural/platform enabler work, managing cross-team and supplier dependencies. Release Rhythm: Pace release content to portfolio operating rhythms, including multi-generation product plans, business plans, and NPI cycles. Compliance & Security: Ensure product security, safety, certification, and type-approval requirements are integrated into the backlog (e.g., FCC/ISED/CE, 3GPP, IEC 62443, IEEE 1613). Sustaining & EOL: Prioritize sustaining content (field issues, firmware maintenance, security patches, obsolescence-driven redesign) alongside new development; support product End-of-Life and installed-base migration plans. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration Alignment: Drive alignment across Technology/R&D, Global Supply Chain (GSC), Sourcing, Services, Quality, and Commercial teams on backlog priorities and release commitments. Team Leadership: Partner with Technical Coordinators, Team Product Owners, and Scrum Masters to ensure team-level stories reflect customer needs and system intent. Business Strategy: Support the Senior Product Manager with business case inputs, cost targets, and pricing structures for new platform content, while contributing to competitive and technology analysis. 4. Commercial & Customer Engagement Voice of the Customer: Lead requirement workshops, pilots, field trials, and user acceptance testing with distribution utility and industrial customers. Sales Enablement: Support global commercial teams, ITO (Inquiry-to-Order), and OTR (Order-to-Remittance) with release content, roadmap clarity, configuration guidance, and technical support arbitration. Go-to-Market: Contribute to launch readiness, value propositions, sales enablement materials, and conference papers focusing on product and solution use cases. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in product ownership, product management, systems engineering, or technical development within the Utility/Industrial Communication segment in a multicultural environment. Domain Expertise: Prior experience in the telecom industry with a strong focus on wireless communications (e.g., PLTE/LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, microwave backhaul, mission-critical wireless networks, IP, Cloud). Agile Acumen: Demonstrated experience defining and prioritizing requirements and backlogs in an Agile or SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) environment. Global Collaboration: Proven experience working successfully with global teams and customers. Modern Tools: Experience using AI-driven tools for requirement drafting, data analysis, or process automation. items.desc: Date: 12 Nov 2026 Location: Zoetermeer, NL Company: Miniclip The UA & Monetisation Specialist independently manages and optimises user acquisition and monetisation initiatives across Miniclip’s mobile gaming portfolio. Building on foundational experience, this role requires the ability to execute campaigns, evaluate performance trends, and propose improvements with limited supervision. Operating with growing ownership, the Specialist ensures that campaigns, monetisation activities, and live-ops initiatives are delivered to quality standards and aligned with game performance goals. This role offers the opportunity to deepen expertise in performance marketing, in-game monetisation, influencer campaigns, and ad revenue management while contributing to strategic discussions and cross-team collaboration. What will you be doing at Miniclip? Monetisation & Revenue Growth Execute and optimise monetisation initiatives to support revenue growth and improve ARPDAU. Contribute to the planning and refinement of IAP strategies, promotions, and in-game events using data-driven insights. Conduct A/B tests and assist in evaluating changes to the in-game economy, pricing models, and monetisation features. Identify early opportunities to enhance player lifetime value, including deep spend mechanics. Own channel-level budget pacing and optimisation, ensuring efficient spending within assigned budgets. Support creative and audience testing efforts to strengthen funnel performance and user engagement. It will help our team better understand your motivation and what makes this role the right fit for you. About Miniclip Miniclip is a global leader in games and one of the world's biggest developers and publishers of mobile games, with a mission of unleashing the gamer in everyone. It distributes highly engaging games to a global audience of over 450 million monthly and 60 million daily active users across mobile, PC, console, social, and online platforms. Operating in 15 countries, Miniclip develops and launches games in multiple categories across its 22 studios. Founded in 2001 with an internationally recognised brand name, Miniclip has successfully grown a global audience across 195 countries and six continents. It has a unique understanding of the games space, developing and distributing a strong portfolio of over 60 high-quality mobile games globally. To date, Miniclip’s studios and companies have generated more than 12 billion downloads, including the following games: 8 Ball Pool, Subway Surfers, Golf Battle, Football Strike, Carrom Pool, OSM - Online Soccer Manager™, Football Rivals , Pure Sniper , Puzzle Page™, Head Ball 2, Motorsport Manager, Darts of Fury, Mini Football, Triple Match 3D™, Agar.io, PowerWash Simulator, Sudoku.com™, and We Are Warriors™. items.desc: We are looking for an enthusiastic, organised and dynamic individual to join our team at Berkshire and Surrey Pathology Services as Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Coordinator . This is a brand new post that has been established to support our ambitions to strengthen our research identity, visibility and operational capability. BSPS is a large network of NHS laboratories serving 7 NHS hospitals: Ashford & St Peter’s, Frimley Park, Royal Berkshire, Royal Surrey, Heatherwood, Wexham Park and East Surrey Hospital. You will be an organised person able to interact with multiple colleagues from different scientific, clinical, financial and administrative backgrounds to support the RDI Network Lead coordinate research activities across the pathology network. Amongst other duties, the post holder will be the main point of contact for researchers, industry and academics contacting the BSPS network, will consolidate peer-reviewed publications, develop the BSPS website research pages, work with partner trust RDI teams and have oversight of research income. Please note that interviews for this post will be conducted in person only. Remote or virtual interviews are not available, and candidates will be required to attend the interview at the specified location. The Research coordinator will act as a focal point for communication in relation to anything Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) related across the Berkshire and Surrey Pathology Services (BSPS) pathology network. This will include communication with Research teams of the BSPS partner organisations and research active scientists, clinicians and other colleagues across the network Within the network the research coordinator will be responsible for keeping track of documentation related to RDI, keep a record of on-going studies, keep an up to date library of peer-reviewed papers published by members of BSPS. The post holder will work closely with and provide support on-going to the BSPS RDI lead. The post holder will liaise with clinical research departments across the BSPS network, research support staff, scientists, finance staff and external stakeholders as required. The post holder will be expected to undertake duties in an independent manner without the need for direct supervision and be capable of using and taking initiative. To develop and maintain positive and constructive working relationships with peers and colleagues across BSPS and BSPS partner Trusts. Regularly has contact with Senior Managers, Clinicians, Directors, R&D teams and scientific and clinical colleagues within BSPS. Liaises with other staff and colleagues across BSPS and the five Partner Trusts at all levels. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The Post holder will coordinate RDI activity across the network. This will include; First point of contact for anyone contacting BSPS re RDI Maintaining the R&D section of the BSPS website Establish an organised process for R&D activity within and linked to BSPS Attendance and minute taking at BSPS RDI meetings and any other meetings required Work with the RID Lead and BSPS finance team to ensure appropriate reimbursement for RDI activities across the network Maintain an up to date library of peer-reviewed publications from BSPS The post holder will be based at the Royal Surrey Foundation Trust in Guildford and share an office with a friendly, supportive and active research team at the Bowel Cancer Screening South of England Hub on the Surrey Research Park. Because the role is for the entire pathology network the postholder will be expected to travel across the pathology network as required. Please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification to understand more about the opportunity this role presents you.

items.desc: Background At Motion Applied - Connected Intelligence (CI), we create cutting-edge wireless connectivity solutions that are transforming customer experience across the transport industry. We create solutions that improve service effectiveness and cost-efficiency for customers, delivering high-quality internet connectivity services. By applying our expertise, we deliver real benefits and pioneer a better future. Purpose of the Role You will investigate data from our connectivity products and live operations to identify patterns, define reliable analytical logic and help convert evidence into product features and automation. Your work will move beyond one-off reporting: you will create reusable measures, definitions, classifications and validation cases that software and data engineers can implement, test and operate in production. You will work across telemetry, network, location, device, service-performance and commercial data. You will turn loosely defined product or operational questions into measurable hypotheses and repeatable analyses, establishing what data, transformations and quality controls are required. Working with Product Managers, Systems Engineers, Software Engineers and Data Engineers, you will define and validate analytical logic. Data Engineers will provide or productionise data assets where appropriate, while you will own the analytical definition, evidence, test approach and refinement of the logic. You will use deterministic rules where reliability, explainability and repeatability are required, and apply statistical, machine-learning or large language model approaches only where they add demonstrable value and can be appropriately validated. Principal Accountabilities Investigate and structure new product insights Explore telemetry, network, location, device, operational and commercial datasets to identify useful patterns, behaviours, anomalies and product opportunities. Turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into measurable definitions, testable hypotheses and repeatable analytical methods. Assess data availability, quality, lineage and limitations, and define any additional data, transformations or reference datasets required. Clean, combine and validate data from multiple sources, documenting assumptions, definitions and methods so results are traceable and reproducible. Produce evidence and analytical logic that can be reused in products and operational processes, rather than only in presentations, dashboards or static reports. Convert findings into deterministic product logic Define the clear sequence from source data, to metric or classification, to observed event or behaviour, to a deterministic rule or product response. Specify thresholds, exceptions, precedence, confidence measures, edge cases and validation criteria clearly enough for engineering teams to implement and test. Compare candidate rules or models against historical and live operational outcomes, quantifying false positives, false negatives and areas of uncertainty where appropriate. Distinguish between deterministic logic, statistical inference, machine learning and LLM-based approaches, selecting the simplest reliable method that meets the need. items.desc: Reasonable is the applied AI research company building formal verification for post-human software development. Thanks to super-human AI capabilities, code generated by AI can be provably correct, resilient to failures and cyberattacks. At Reasonable, we are doing the research, training the models, and developing the products required to make this a practical reality. Achieving this creates a new paradigm for high accountability software development and unlocks the full potential of AI for professional engineers. We’re a compact, talent-dense technical team, with deep domain expertise in machine learning, formal verification and software system engineering. Our interns, like our full time members of technical staff, are outstanding . 10+ international olympiad medals among them, all excellent in their career stages, all thrown in at the deep end and succeeding. Far from working on isolated projects, our interns last year have contributed in a major way to our core research and development. Join us to develop the next frontier of formal reasoning and software engineering. Proof follows function. The Role As a Student Researcher, you will be embedded within an industry-leading team, working on projects that contribute directly to our work on formally-grounded software development, and/or frontier model evaluations and LLM agent post-training. Our Student researcher programs vary in duration from 12-24 weeks, and we are looking for two types: Ambitious Young Students in early years of Undergraduate: typically with a background in competitive programming, maths, or substantial side-projects PhD students in Formal Verification and/or Machine Learning You Will Take on a focused research project that connects to Reasonable's core work in machine learning and formal verification. We will shape the project with you on arrival Run real experiments that produce results worth publishing or open-sourcing: training runs, verification benchmarks, theoretical work, product development contributions Work alongside Ferenc and the wider team of technical staff members in mutual exchange: you bring your area of expertise, eagerness to learn, we bring practical production and research experience Be in the room for technical conversations that go beyond your project Work on-site, alongside the founding technical team in Budapest or London Requirements Research Students : Currently enrolled in a PhD or Research Masters programme in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field, and returning to your program after the internship Junior Students: Currently enrolled in early years of undergraduate, or in exceptional cases High School. Demonstrated track record of excellence in maths, programming or AI, such as olympiad results. Expertise in a relevant area of computer science, for example: Formal Language Processing, Machine Learning (especially LLMs, RL, other post-training methods), Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Mathematical Models of Program Semantics, Programming Language Theory, Design of Distributed Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field Extra-curricular interest in the intersection of machine learning, formal methods, and software engineering, even if your current work doesn’t touch it Bonus Points If You Have published at venues like NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, POPL, PLDI, CAV, or similar Have open-source contributions in relevant projects: LEAN, Verus, Rocq, training frameworks, or similar Are already working on the intersection of machine learning and formal methods This is a serious research program. If you fit the profile, apply. If you know someone who would be ideal, we always reward great introductions. Benefits Compensation: Generous compensation Location: Budapest, Hungary, or London, UK - we’re an on-site team World-class team and environment: an opportunity to build alongside deeply experienced founders, in a well-funded company that’s backed by industry leading VCs and angels including Oriol Vinyals, Zoubin Ghahramani, Jonathan Frankle and Guy Podjarny, amongst many others

items.desc: Level Up Your Career! At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space. At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5. Join The Team! Kwalee is seeking a talented Game Designer to join our mobile development team. In this role, you will design engaging gameplay mechanics, define progression systems, and balance economic models for mobile games while ensuring strong player retention and monetisation. This role is based onsite 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. Role Mission: Design fun, addictive and well monetised mobile games that appeal to a massive global audience. Bridge the gap between hyper-casual accessibility and deep mid-core progression loops to create Hybrid Casual success Own the creative vision and design execution of hybrid casual titles from initial concept through to live operations. Drive key product metrics (CPI, retention, and LTV) by balancing engaging gameplay with smart monetisation features. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Art, and Engineering) to transform data-driven insights into player-centric features. Deconstruct market trends to rapidly prototype and validate innovative new gameplay mechanics. What You'll Do: Use AI tools to quickly prototype and validate game concepts or feature ideas. Own the end-to-end design of new mobile titles, from initial high-level concept and rapid prototyping to balancing, launch, and live operations. Design intuitive, instantly satisfying core mechanics that appeal to a mass audience while keeping marketability (low CPI) in mind. Design well-considered, engaging levels for players, considering difficulty and pacing. Create clear, concise, and actionable Design Documentation (GDDs), wireframes, and flowcharts that align cross-functional teams. Architect deep meta-progression loops (e.g., collection systems, upgrading) that transform short-term engagement into long-term player retention. Design and balance complex virtual economies, ensuring a healthy ecosystem of currencies, resource scarcity, and rewards. Craft onboarding experiences and First Time User Experiences (FTUE) that minimise early churn and maximise player understanding. Design sophisticated hybrid monetisation systems that seamlessly integrate In-App Advertisements (IAA - rewarded videos, interstitials) and In-App Purchases (IAP) without disrupting the fun. Develop monetisation features such as Battle Passes, gacha systems, limited-time offers, and VIP reward tiers tailored for a casual audience. Analyse player telemetry and A/B test results to diagnose design flaws and iteratively optimise gameplay, monetisation, and retention KPIs. Mentor and guide junior designers, foster a culture of constructive feedback, and elevate the studio's overall design standards. What You'll Bring: Proven track record: Minimum of 3-5+ years of experience in mobile game design, with at least one successfully shipped commercial title (preferably in the Casual or Hybrid Casual space). Level Design Skills: A strong portfolio of shipped levels that shows a clear grasp of difficulty curves, onboarding, and moment-to-moment flow, with the ability to design, build and iterate on levels quickly using player data to improve completion, retention and monetisation. Hybrid Casual Expertise: Deep understanding of the hybrid casual business model, including the delicate balance between low-CPI marketability, high retention, and dual monetisation (IAA + IAP). Systems & Balancing Mastery: Exceptional skills in game balancing, economy design, and pacing, backed by advanced proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, or equivalent modeling tools. Prototyping Skills: Hands-on experience working directly in game engines (ideally Unity) to tweak, tune, and iterate on gameplay feel. Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to pitch concepts clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders. Preferred but not essential: Technical Edge: Basic scripting knowledge (C# in Unity) or experience setting up live-ops tools and remote config systems. items.card: What you'll do You will: Lead digital access, authentication, entitlements and discovery services for our electronic collections. Investigate complex access and discovery issues, using service data, user feedback and operational insight to identify recurring problems and lead improvements. Increase the visibility and discoverability of Open Access resources, ensuring they are effectively integrated alongside
items.desc: Our students and researchers rely on a growing range of digital resources, from academic journals and databases to specialist platforms and Open Access content. Behind that access is a complex network of suppliers, systems, authentication, entitlements and discovery services. We are looking for a Digital Access & Discovery Librarian to join the management of our Content Team and lead this important area of Library service delivery. This is an opportunity to combine specialist digital library expertise with people and service leadership, shaping how our digital collections are accessed and discovered and helping us continually improve the user experience. What you'll do You will: Lead digital access, authentication, entitlements and discovery services for our electronic collections. Investigate complex access and discovery issues, using service data, user feedback and operational insight to identify recurring problems and lead improvements. Increase the visibility and discoverability of Open Access resources, ensuring they are effectively integrated alongside purchased content. Manage and monitor electronic resource-related enquiries within the CRM, using data and insights to identify trends, improve services, enhance the user experience, and support evidence-based decision-making. Line manage team members within the Reading Lists and Metadata functions, coordinating operational resources and supporting colleagues to develop and deliver effective services. Work collaboratively with Library Digital colleagues, publishers, suppliers and platform providers to ensure our digital content and services work effectively for users. You will also support the Content Manager with wider team management and development, deputising where required, and keep abreast of developments across the sector, including emerging AI-enabled functionality. What we're looking for We're looking for someone who can bring: Experience and expertise in electronic resources and digital access, with a good understanding of authentication and discovery services. Experience of investigating and resolving complex access and discovery issues. Knowledge of Open Access and approaches to improving the visibility and discoverability of open content. The ability to lead, support and develop colleagues and coordinate resources effectively. Confidence working with publishers, suppliers and system providers. Strong analytical skills and an evidence-led approach to service improvement. The ability to translate technical issues into clear advice for colleagues and stakeholders. A collaborative approach and the confidence to contribute to wider team management and service development. Why join us? This role offers the opportunity to take real ownership of a specialist and developing area of Library service delivery. You'll combine hands-on professional expertise with management responsibility, work across Content and Digital teams, and have the scope to influence how our services develop as the digital information environment changes. You'll be joining a collaborative team with the opportunity to develop your professional and leadership experience while making a visible difference to how students and researchers discover and access the resources they need. What's in it for you? Competitive salary - and excellent pension scheme An impressive 32 days leave - plus bank holidays, additional time off at Christmas and the opportunity to buy even more! Flexible working - we support a culture of flexible and agile working to help you find the right balance Professional development - we offer a comprehensive package of training and development opportunities to help you achieve your full potential Our community - there's a real sense of belonging here at Salford. We value diversity, in backgrounds and in experiences. Our difference makes us stronger, and together we share a passion for improving students' lives The Perks! - MySalford, our online employee portal offers a wide range of lifestyle benefits and discounts A rewarding career - where everything you do will make a difference. To our students, our local community, and the world around you **Please note this opportunity may close early depending on applicant volume.**

items.desc: Generation AI: Your Career Starts Here. Where It Goes Is Up to You. Curious about AI? Excited by technology? Full of ideas you can't wait to put into practice? This is an opportunity to work on real challenges, experiment with emerging technologies and see what you're capable of. At Sofigate, we're looking for a small group of ambitious, curious, and driven talents to join Sofigate’s Generation AI -team in January 2027 . This is an opportunity for higher education students near graduation or just graduated, who are eager to put their skills into practice, learn fast, and build a career at the intersection of business, technology, and AI. You'll work alongside experienced professionals, tackle real business challenges, and have the freedom to explore where your strengths and interests can take you. If you have built something with AI, automated a boring task, written code just to see if an idea would work, created something nobody asked you to create, you may be just the person we are looking for. What Could You Be Working On? Imagine using artificial intelligence to uncover insights, improve decision-making, and discover possibilities in leading and managing organisations. That's just one of the opportunities we're currently exploring. Your projects could take you in many directions, from AI innovation and automation to business technology transformation. Some opportunities are already taking shape. Others haven't even been imagined yet. Depending on your interests, skills and the projects ahead, you could: Experiment with AI, automation, and other technologies to solve real problems. Help develop smarter business processes and technology solutions, including platforms such as ServiceNow. Work on customer projects or internal innovations and products that turn ideas into measurable results. Challenge how things are done and find better, smarter ways forward. Learn from experienced Sofigators, while taking increasing ownership of your work. One thing is certain: you won't be short of things to learn, explore, or get involved in. Who Are We Looking For? You might be studying computer science, business, industrial engineering, or something completely different. What matters is that you're at graduation, ready for full-time work , and excited to put your skills to the test. We're looking for people who bring: Curiosity that goes beyond the classroom. You're genuinely interested in AI, already experimented and created things with it and other technologies, and how they can change the way businesses work. Hands-on AI experience. You've gone beyond chatting with AI and started building with it. Maybe you've created an AI agent, developed a skill, or automated something just to see if you could. What matters is that you've turned curiosity into action. A get-things-done attitude. You take initiative, enjoy solving problems and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves. The courage to experiment. You ask questions, challenge assumptions and learn from things that don't work the first time. A willingness to learn and grow. You're independent when needed but know that great things are built together. Strong communication skills. You're comfortable working in English and Finnish. Why join us? AI is changing every industry. Businesses are searching for practical ways to create value, improve productivity and reinvent how they operate. At Sofigate, you'll have the opportunity to be part of that transformation from the very beginning of your career and create your path in the consulting world. How we work At Sofigate, we're helping organizations bridge the gap between business and technology. We call this Business Technology. We're neither a traditional management consultancy nor a software development company. Our mission is to help organizations create tangible business outcomes through technology, and increasingly through AI. You'll join an international, collaborative and low-hierarchy culture where initiative is encouraged and new ideas are welcomed. We believe diverse perspectives create better outcomes, and we want every Sofigator to have the opportunity to grow, contribute and shape the future of our company. Growth isn't just something we help our customers achieve. It's something we expect and support within our own community. What We Offer Challenging customer assignment opportunities, environment varying from large internationally operating companies to purposeful public organisations Opportunities for professional growth and development. Full 2.5 days/month of vacation accrual starting from the beginning of your employment Shareholder program, which allows you to be a part owner in Sofigate Extended healthcare insurance and a wellness programme that is available for all employees Work on meaningful challenges where AI and technology create real business impact. As an AI Adoption Intern in the Data & AI team of the Global Investment Center (GIC), you will help identify, design and structure the AI use cases that matter most to the business, and help build more scalable, data-driven ways of working across markets. You will work with business stakeholders to understand what problem AI should solve, what data, knowledge and systems it needs, and how it fits into the way people already work. Together with the teams who build and run these solutions, you will turn promising ideas into clear, well-defined use cases. The role also has a strong hands-on data side. You will work with data from across the organisation, help prepare and organise it, and turn it into insights that support better decisions. This is not a software engineering internship. It suits someone who is analytical, comfortable with data, good at bringing structure to open-ended problems, and curious about how AI can change the way a global organisation works. The team The Global Investment Center is at the heart of ING's ambition to build a single, scalable investment engine across markets. To support this, the GIC brings together expertise, information and capabilities from across ING's markets, so they can be shared and used more widely. You will join the Data & AI team, which works across the whole GIC to make this happen through better use of data, analytics and AI. right fit Describe what each solution should achieve, who will use it, and what data, knowledge and systems it needs Translate selected use cases into clear business requirements and help shape the GIC's AI roadmap Data analysis and preparation Work hands-on with data from different sources across the organisation Help prepare, structure and improve the quality of data for analysis and AI use cases Analyse data and translate findings into clear, practical insights Build visualisations and dashboards that make information easy to understand Knowledge and information for AI Help understand what information AI solutions need, and what is already available Contribute to organising information so AI tools can use it effectively Work with subject-matter experts to make sure AI solutions Excel, Python, SQL or Power BI A strong interest in applying AI to real business problems, beyond purely technical modelling Curiosity about generative AI and AI agents, including how to judge the quality of their outputs Able to bring structure to ambiguous, complex problems and take ownership of open-ended work Comfortable working with people from different professional and technical backgrounds, and translating between business needs and data or AI concepts Strong communication skills in English, written and spoken What We Offer A front-row seat to AI and data transformation in items.desc: We are ELCA, one of the largest Swiss IT tribe with over 2,300 experts. We are multicultural with offices in Switzerland, Spain, France, Vietnam and Mauritius. Since 1968, our team of engineers, business analysts, software architects, designers and consultants provide tailor-made and standardized solutions to support the digital transformation of major public administrations and private companies in Switzerland. Our activity spans across multiples fields of leading-edge technologies such as AI, Machine & Deep learning, BI/BD, RPA, Blockchain, IoT and CyberSecurity. In this 6-month internship starting in Spring 2027, you'll test whether sovereign, locally-run AI can reliably scope complex legacy data migrations so our clients can get accurate fixed-price offers. Your tasks Benchmark open-source LLMs that can be self-hosted on sovereign infrastructure against leading cloud models on three migration-scoping tasks: understanding schemas, extracting business rules and assessing data quality. Deploy and run candidate models locally with tools such as Ollama, vLLM or Hugging Face, and see how sovereign AI works in practice. Design and build a prototype agentic pipeline that analyzes legacy schemas, code and sample data on its own. Uncover hidden business rules in legacy systems, including .NET-based applications, that often only show up after in-depth analysis. Validate data consistency and quality, and assess the complexity of a representative legacy migration case. Generate automated effort and complexity estimates , along with step-by-step migration guidelines, from a locally-run model. Define criteria and best practices for when a local model is accurate enough to replace manual scoping in fixed-price migration bids. Evaluate and document the resource, cost and licensing trade-offs between self-hosted and cloud models. Shape how we scope one of our most frequently fixed-price-quoted services for clients with strict data sovereignty needs. What we offer A dynamic, collaborative workplace with a highly motivated, multicultural team working across international sites Monthly AI meetups with our expert AI team, where you can ask questions and move your topic forward The chance to make a difference in people's lives by building innovative solutions Internal coding events such as Hackathons and Brownbag sessions, plus our technical blog Monthly After-Works organized at each location About your profile You have a Bachelor or Master degree (EPFL, ETH, University) in Computer Science or related discipline You are comfortable programming in Python and SQL , and ideally have some familiarity with .NET-based systems You have worked with LLMs and, ideally, tried deploying them locally (e.g. Ollama, vLLM, Hugging Face) You are curious about agentic AI and keen to build and benchmark your own pipeline You have a basic understanding of database schemas and data quality You like to work in a structured way and to share your findings clearly You are fluent in written and spoken English, as well as German or French Application: Please attach your academic transcripts to your application. Applications without transcripts will not be reviewed. We believe in strong values and are convinced that diversity is the key to success. If you take on challenges with curiosity, motivation and drive, you've come to the right place! Let our motto inspire you: We make it work!

items.desc: Lieu : Palaiseau, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. Les approches impliquant de l’apprentissage profond ont, ces dernières années, montré des performances très intéressantes pour des problèmes de traitement du signal audio. La mise en place de ces approches passe par une phase d’optimisation ou entraînement en laboratoire sur des bases de données dites source les plus représentatives possibles des données qui seront rencontrées sur le terrain. Cependant, pour des raisons de confidentialité, de spécificités du capteur ou de conditions d’emploi, ces données d’intérêt, dites cible, sont souvent manquantes, non-labélisées ou en très faible quantité lors des phases d'entraînement initiales ; ce qui mène souvent à une perte de performances lors du déploiement. Il y a donc un besoin de mettre en place une adaptation dynamique directement sur le terrain ce qui implique une contrainte de frugalité en termes de données cible et de ressources computationnelles accessibles. L’objectif du stage sera de mettre en place une approche d’adaptation dynamique non-supervisée sur de nouvelles données arrivant continument sur le terrain dans la phase d’exploitation de l’algorithme. Les approches étudiées seront appliquées en priorité au problème de restauration de la qualité de la voix. Le stage est orienté recherche, le stagiaire réalisera un état de l’art scientifique et technique, participera à l’élaboration du protocole expérimental, proposera et comparera plusieurs approches pour répondre au problème posé.. Dans Ce Contexte, Vous Aurez Pour Missions Travailler en collaboration avec l'équipe de recherche : doctorants et chercheurs expérimentés Comprendre la problématique métier et mise en place d'un protocole expérimental et d’une implémentation académique pour la recherche ouverte Objectifs Prise en main de différentes méthodes état de l’art en rehaussement de la voix Développement en python d’une ou plusieurs méthodes innovantes pour pallier la problématique d’apprentissage continu pour compenser le domain shift entre les données d’entraînement initial et les données rencontrées lors de l'inférence. Dimensionner la solution pour être cohérente de la contrainte de frugalité en termes de données, d’annotations et de ressources de calcul disponibles sur le terrain. Participation à la vie du laboratoire (interactions avec d’autres stagiaires, participation aux séminaires de recherche hebdomadaires...) Soumission d'un article sur le travail fourni lors du stage Votre profil Vous avez envie de découvrir le domaine de la recherche ? Vous avez pour ambition de réaliser votre stage au sein de Thales ?
