items.desc: Would you like to help transform cutting-edge AI technologies into scalable, mission-critical solutions that strengthen the security of our nation and allies? In this role, you will develop, deploy, and operate the infrastructure behind our next-generation AI sensor platform while helping bring emerging technologies into real-world operation. Come and join us! We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes. As the need for rapidly deploying and scaling advanced technologies continues to increase, we are strengthening our capabilities to turn innovative solutions into reliable operational systems. Therefore, we are looking for an Experienced Platform Engineer to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology. The Terma Accelerator team has developed a number of technologies ready for implementation. We recognize, however, that the skills needed to do successful scaling, deployment, and operation of emerging technologies are different from the skillset needed to invent them. Therefore, we are building a new section of our team tasked with taking cutting edge prototypes and turning them into operational, scalable, and reliable force multipliers. Your role as part of the team As our new Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in operationalizing Terma’s next-generation AI sensor platform, taking cutting-edge technologies from prototype to scalable and reliable solutions. Working in a fast-paced environment, you will help develop, deploy, and operate the platform infrastructure as well as the projects connected to it. Your team also holds the responsibility for deploying our solution from Development, to Staging and into Production. You will develop and operate the infrastructure, so maintenance, monitoring, and alerting are key elements of success. You will become part of our Infrastructure Development team, consisting of dedicated engineers and specialists working closely with software, hardware, and infrastructure. We value collaboration, innovation, and emotional safety, creating an environment where ideas can be challenged, shared, and developed together. We care about the work we do and the people behind it. Technical skills matter, but your mindset matters even more. We are looking for someone with a strong DevSecOps mindset and a background in software development. If you consider yourself a team player who is open-minded, execution-oriented, and motivated by solving complex problems in a dynamic environment, you could be a great addition to our team. You communicate effectively with stakeholders across disciplines, collaborate naturally in cross-functional teams, and are comfortable aligning technical solutions with both operational and business objectives. How you will make a meaningful contribution In this role, you will contribute to a range of tasks across your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include: Helping design, develop, and mature a highly scalable and redundant platform capable of handling large data streams from multiple sensors, supporting AI/ML model training, deployment, and mission-critical operations with high performance and availability Driving initial platform deployments and system maturation activities, proving stability and operational readiness before partially transitioning responsibility to operations Collaborating with cross-functional teams and business development to define system requirements, establish project timelines, and ensure alignment with Terma's technical and commercial ambitions Operate, monitor, maintain, and continuously improve the department's on-premises compute platform, which supports large-scale data storage, AI model training, and application deployment across multiple environments Developing and maintaining architecture, design, and technical documentation, while staying current on relevant industry developments, emerging technologies, and cyber security trends. Bring your expertise into play To thrive in this role, we imagine that you bring some of the following qualifications: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, combined with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience, preferably as a Software Developer Strong expertise in Virtualization and Containerization platforms, Infrastructure as Code, and the configuration, scaling, and management of Kubernetes clusters Hands-on experience with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps Experience with monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions for Linux-based systems Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages Excellent problem-solving skills combined with strategic thinking, enabling you to set clear technical goals and drive robust, scalable solutions Hardware design for HPC clusters, including compute, storage, and networking, is considered an advantage. items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 10, 2026, 11:32AM Vous concevez, développez et maintenez le dispositif dédié au suivi de la conformité et des actions de sécurité. En transformant les besoins des équipes en outils de pilotage fiables et compréhensibles, vous facilitez le suivi des progrès, l’identification des points de blocage et la prise de décision. Vous améliorez l’efficacité opérationnelle du dispositif de conformité, notamment en fiabilisant et en automatisant la collecte, le traitement et la restitution des données et des preuves, y compris en exploitant pour cela les possibilitésde l’intelligence artificielle. Recueillir et analyser les besoins de reporting auprès des équipes conformité, sécurité et métiers. Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des rapports et tableaux de bord et autres outils de visualisation, par exemple systèmes de gestion de base de données orientés graphe. Identifier préparer, structurer et fiabiliser les données nécessaires au pilotage. Mettre en place des indicateurs pertinents pour suivre l’avancement des actions et le niveau de conformité. Automatiser et simplifier les processus de collecte et de restitution des informations, dans le respect des règles de sécurité et de confidentialité. Documenter les solutions développées et accompagner leur appropriation par les utilisateurs, en contribuant également à la création de modules de formation dédiés. Assurer la maintenance, la qualité et l’amélioration continue des tableaux de bord, y compris en intégrant de nouvelles sources de données Alerter sur les limites des données et contribuer à l’amélioration de leur qualité. Identifier, expérimenter et industrialiser des usages de l’IA et de l’automatisation pour simplifier la collecte, la qualification et la restitution des données et preuves de conformité. Vous êtes diplômé d’une école proposant un cursus cybersécurité, ou fort d’une expérience permettant de justifier la maitrise du socle de connaissance en sécurité. Vous avez une expérience significative en traitement et analyse de données, réalisation et tenue à jour de tableaux de bord. Maîtrise de Power BI, notamment de la modélisation des données, de la création de rapports et de la conception d’indicateurs. Bonne maîtrise de la préparation et de la transformation des données ; connaissance de Power Query et du langage DAX appréciée. Maitrise des environnements de développement et d’intégration logiciel continue CICD. Connaissances en cybersécurité et intérêt pour les sujets de conformité et de gestion des risques. Capacité à comprendre des exigences de sécurité ou réglementaires et à les traduire en indicateurs de pilotage. Rigueur dans le traitement des données et souci de leur fiabilité. Forte capacité à produire personnellement. Autonomie, sens de l’analyse et capacité à proposer des améliorations. Aptitude à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés et à vulgariser les résultats. Esprit de coopération, sens du service et orientation vers les résultats. Votre aisance relationnelle, l’envie d’accompagner et de partager vos connaissances, ainsi que la capacité à vulgariser font partie de vos atouts. Une contribution directe au pilotage de la conformité NIS2 et à l’amélioration de la sécurité du système d’information. Des échanges permanent avec les équipes cybersécurité d’Orange France et du Groupe. La possibilité de faire évoluer les outils de reporting et les pratiques de pilotage dans un environnement transverse. La Direction Technique d’Orange France (DTOF) veille à la qualité de ses réseaux, infrastructures et solutions techniques. Au sein de la Direction V360, la Direction Management Sécurité (DMS) pilote la cybersécurité de la DTOF, de la DSI et d’Orange France, grâce à ses équipes, son SOC et ses experts. L’équipe DMS/GOUV conduit des programmes stratégiques : gestion des actifs critiques, conformité NIS2, sécurité des fournisseurs, gestion des identités et des accès (IAM), CyberRating, sécurité et privacy by design. Elle contribue également à développer une culture de sécurité partagée. Dans le cadre de NIS2, elle accompagne les entités concernées dans leur mise en conformité et structure le suivi des exigences et des actions de sécurité. Elle fiabilise et industrialise la collecte des données et des preuves afin de consolider l’avancement, repérer les écarts et soutenir l’amélioration continue. Nous recrutons au sein de l’équipe Gouvernance une ou un Pilote de la conformité cybersécurité, chargé(e) de mettre en œuvre le dispositif qui accompagne le déploiement des programmes de conformité. Background: Teagasc is seeking to recruit a Research Technologist to support the delivery of the SAFER project, an international research project co-funded by the Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine (DAFM) through the European Partnership on Agroecology. The position will be based within the Agricultural Economics and Farm Surveys Department (AEFS) and will contribute to Teagasc's research on the economic, environmental and social sustainability of agroecological farming systems. SAFER is examining the performance and adoption of agroecological practices across European Living Labs. The Irish research focuses particularly on tillage systems and brings together economic, social and ecological research to assess the costs, benefits and wider implications of transitioning towards more agroecological farming practices. The work includes assessment of reduced/conservation tillage and organic farming systems and their associated economic, agronomic and ecological outcomes. The successful candidate will work as part of a multidisciplinary Teagasc research team, collaborating with agricultural economists, social scientists, tillage and organic farming researchers, ecologists and other project partners. The position will involve working with commercial farms participating in the Irish Living Lab and associated case-study research and will provide the opportunity to contribute to an innovative European research programme addressing the practical implementation of agroecological farming systems. The role will involve the collection, management and analysis of farm-level economic and socio-economic data, engagement with participating farmers and other stakeholders, and support for case-study and survey-based research. The successful candidate will work closely with Teagasc researchers and SAFER project partners to integrate socio-economic evidence with the wider agronomic and ecological research undertaken within the project and contribute to project reporting and dissemination. Support the cost-benefit analysis of agroecological practices and the implementation of the Irish economic ecological case-study research. items.desc: Type of position: Seconded National Expert Reference: EMA/SNE/11663 Job title: SNE/Scientific Specialist Deadline for applications: 01 December 2026 at 23.59 CET The European Medicines Agency is a decentralized body of the European Union with all its offices and Headquarters based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. Its core responsibility is the protection and promotion of public health through the evaluation and supervision of medicines. We are looking for National experts on secondment. This means staff from other European public-sector bodies can work at the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for short periods of time through the national expert on secondment (SNE) programme. The aim of this programme is to enhance and develop the relationship between European public administrations. SNEs serve a dual role: they bring their expertise to EMA and take back to their home administration the knowledge acquired during their period of secondment. SNEs remain in the service of their employer. Secondment is not equivalent to employment, nor does it lead to employment by EMA. Periods of secondment may last between six months and two years. This is renewable once or more, up to a total of four years. This announcement is governed by the Rules governing the secondment of national experts. For further information please visit our Careers portal. About this position: The Agency is looking to strengthen the support it provides to clinical trials through the secondment of national experts for a period of one to two years (renewable). The Agency is working with the National Competent Authorities (NCAs) for medicines and the European Commission to optimise the EU clinical trials environment and this is being coordinated through Accelerating Clinical Trials in the EU (ACT EU) the EU transformation programme for clinical trials. EMA also operates and develops the Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) and works with the NCAs and the Commission on the implementation of the Clinical Trials Regulation (CTR) including support to the Clinical Trials Coordination Group (CTCG). items.desc: Your mission At planqc , we are building scalable quantum computers based on neutral atoms — one of the most promising platforms for achieving real-world quantum advantage. As we expand our international presence and establish our operations in the United Kingdom , we are looking for a quantum error correction Engineer to join us at this exciting stage of our growth. As a Quantum Error Correction Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping planqc’s roadmap toward fault-tolerant quantum computation. You will design and analyze QEC schemes tailored to neutral-atom architectures, benchmark protocols under realistic noise models, and work hand-in-hand with our hardware, control, and algorithm teams to turn QEC research into concrete engineering milestones. This role sits at the interface of quantum physics, theory, and systems engineering, and is ideal for an exceptionally driven individual who is motivated to contribute to a challenge of generational significance. This is an opportunity to contribute to the development of our quantum technology while helping shape planqc's engineering presence in the UK. Your responsibilities Take ownership of selected QEC workstreams, driving design decisions on code choice, fault-tolerant protocols, and resource trade-offs. Contribute to planqc’s fault-tolerance roadmap, translating QEC research into concrete architectural and engineering milestones. Develop and analyze quantum error correction schemes tailored to neutral-atom architectures. Perform numerical simulations of QEC protocols and benchmark decoders under realistic noise models. Analyze trade-offs between different error correction schemes for the implementation of logical operations. Build and maintain simulation and benchmarking tools for logical circuits. Collaborate with quantum algorithm engineers to co-design quantum algorithms that leverage platform-specific features. Collaborate with hardware and control teams to implement fault-tolerant protocols aligned with system constraints. Stay up to date with advances in quantum error correction and contribute to internal knowledge sharing. Contribute to planqc's intellectual property and publish results in peer-reviewed journals. Represent planqc at conferences as in the broader quantum computing research community. What you bring A degree in physics, preferably with a focus on quantum science and technology. A solid background in quantum computing, quantum information, quantum many-body physics, or closely related fields. Provable ability to undertake high-quality scientific work. Experience with scientific computing (Python, Julia, or similar). Ability and willingness to work across theory and implementation, collaborating in a multidisciplinary team. Nice to have A PhD in a relevant field of quantum physics, with a strong track record of scientific publications. Prior experience in quantum error correction and coding theory: familiarity with stabilizer formalism, topological codes and qLDPC codes is very much appreciated. Experience with numerical simulation of stabilizer states (e.g. Stim) and decoding under circuit-level noise models. Familiarity with collaborative software development environments and tools (e.g. Git, code review, CI/CD workflows). Strong communication skills, with the ability to present results clearly and effectively. An understanding of neutral-atom platforms is an asset. What characterizes you You are highly motivated to contribute to an ambitious, long-term scientific and technological challenge. You bring curiosity and a willingness to engage with complex, open-ended problems. You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy working across disciplines and teams You are comfortable with change and open-ended challenges, where the right approach isn’t yet known. You are able to work independently while actively contributing to a collaborative research environment, including sharing knowledge across teams. Why join planqc At planqc, we are transforming pioneering research into practical quantum computing technology. Founded in Germany and built on world-class research in neutral-atom quantum computing, we bring together physicists, engineers and software specialists who share one ambition: developing scalable quantum computers capable of solving meaningful problems. Our expansion into the UK marks an exciting new chapter in this journey. By joining our UK team, you will have the opportunity to: Join at an early stage. Become part of our growing UK presence and contribute to its development. Work on cutting-edge technology. Build and improve neutral-atom quantum hardware at the forefront of quantum computing. Make a tangible impact. Take ownership of critical technical systems and see your contributions directly influence our technology. Collaborate internationally. Work alongside experienced scientists and engineers across our European teams. Grow with us. Develop your expertise and responsibilities as our technology and international …

A dedicated mentor will support you every step of the way, giving you the chance to explore different roles, engage in immersive experiences, and build a strong network with peers and industry leaders. You will join a team shaping the next generation of industrial AI at Siemens Energy, working on real-world challenges across energy systems, infrastructure, and large-scale operations. From day one, you will contribute to building intelligent solutions that turn complex data into actionable insights, helping to improve efficiency, reliability, and sustainability at scale. How You’ll Make An Impact As part of our Graduate Program, you are on the Siemens Energy team. You’ll share our purpose in energizing society by supporting customers with transitioning to a more sustainable world and work on real global issues, creating solutions that directly make an impact. Contribute to the development of Industrial AI services, including data pipelines, model services, and reusable components that enable scalable AI adoption across energy and industrial systems Work with real-world industrial and energy data to support high-impact use cases such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, performance optimization, and autonomous system insights. Support the integration of AI capabilities into production environments, ensuring reliability, scalability, and alignment with real-world operations and business processes Explore and help prototype next-generation AI applications, including agentic AI systems, intelligent automation, and robotics-enabled use cases that extend AI from insights to action What You Bring Strong foundation in machine learning, data science, or applied mathematics, with hands-on experience in Python and common ML frameworks Relevant experience through internships and/or working student roles is essential; additional permanent work experience of up to 36 months is welcome A master's or doctoral degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related quantitative field Minimum of 3 months of international experience gained through studying or working Excellent English skills to engage in a multicultural environment, with flexibility and willingness for international travel Corporate & Global Functions In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. As part of our Digital Products and Solutions Global Function, the Scalable Core team drives the foundational technologies and developer platforms that empower scalable and intelligent energy management solutions across Siemens Energy. We build reusable backend services, AI/ML platforms, and lifecycle tools to support cloud, on-prem, and edge deployments. Our mission is to enable teams to deliver intelligent solutions faster and with higher quality – through automation, developer experience, and scalable software foundations. Whether it’s through a streamlined Software Factory Console, advanced model lifecycle capabilities, or self-service deployment engines, we ensure that engineering teams can focus on solving energy challenges – not reinventing the wheel. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Stakeholder Engagement: Actively participate in discovery and requirement workshops, practicing a consulting mindset to communicate technical findings to business stakeholders and continue building the solution with a strong customer centric mindset. Operational Excellence: Contribute to project speed and efficiency by maintaining high-quality documentation and ensuring Built-in Quality Control in every line of code or analysis produced. Cross team collaboration: Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to: Business Analytics, Academy and Global Programs Business Apps & Product and Engineering Solution Architecture & Celonis Support The Qualifications You Need Academic Background: A recent graduate (or final year student) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field. items.card: you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. items.desc: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by BLP. Your Career Path in AI Transformation Consulting Our AI Transformation Consulting team has a clear path, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the impact you have had, and we are explicit about what the next step requires. AI Automation Specialist: Hands-on in the automation itself: you tune agents, run automation sprints and take on your first customers end to end. Typically you bring up to 2 years of experience. AI Transformation Consultant: You own a portfolio of live customers as their run lead, including health, growth and account economics. Typically you bring 3+ years in transformation consulting, process improvement or ERP process ownership. Principal AI Transformation Consultant: Our most complex and sensitive accounts, at executive level, and you coach the consultants and specialists around you. Typically you bring several years of leading process change at customers. Next steps: Lead an AI Transformation Consulting team, or become a Client Partner on our strategic accounts. Moves into Project Management or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them. Your Mission For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where our AI Transformation Consulting team sits. Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organization that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Our job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own. This is also where our AI meets the real world, and the real world is messy. When a customer goes live, our agents start processing their documents: invoices, order confirmations, delivery notes, in dozens of formats from thousands of suppliers, with layouts nobody has seen before. Most of it works immediately. The rest is where we come in. A concrete example. Our AI learns a customer's business logic from their own history. By reading how they have accounted invoices in the past, BLP infers the rules they have been applying and makes them explicit. Sometimes it cannot close the loop on its own, because the same kind of invoice was historically booked in two or three different ways and there is no consistent rule to find. In those cases BLP asks. It needs the answer once, and every future case follows it. Making sure that answer arrives, and that it is the right one, is our job. Done well, each of those conversations builds trust and removes a category of manual work permanently. As an AI Automation Specialist You are hands-on in the automation itself. You configure and tune the agents so they work for a specific customer, dig into exceptions until you find the actual cause rather than patching the symptom, and run automation sprints: the push after each go-live to the target automation rate, and focused sprints our customers book to take their automation further. You are in front of customers from early on: running the sessions that explain what a new capability does, taking the open questions our AI raises to the person who can decide them, and chasing down …

items.desc: Veitchi Group is a long-established, privately owned Scottish group operating across a range of specialist construction and related businesses. Our activities span flooring, screeding, interiors and fit-out, lightweight steel framing, building preservation, property repair and other specialist operations. We have been around for more than 100 years, but our focus is firmly on what comes next. We continue to invest in our people, systems and technology, and we believe AI and automation have the potential to significantly improve how our businesses operate. We are now looking for someone to join us and help turn that opportunity into something practical. Role Full Time/Permanent – Monday to Thursday 08:45am to 17:00pm & Friday, 08:45am to 16:00pm. Location: Glasgow Salary: Competitive The Opportunity We are looking for a practical, curious and technically minded AI & Automation Assistant to work alongside our IT Manager and the wider business. This is a hands-on role. You will not be sitting waiting for someone to hand you a software specification. You will spend time with the people doing the work, understanding their processes, identifying where time is being lost and then explore whether AI or automation can do some of that work for them. Initially, you will work closely with our Interiors business, mapping existing processes and identifying repetitive, manual and time-consuming activities that could potentially be simplified or automated. A particular focus will be using the Microsoft Copilot environment, Copilot Studio, Power Automate and other Microsoft technologies to develop AI agents and automated workflows that have a genuine application within the business. As your knowledge of Veitchi develops, the role will progressively work across other companies and functions within the Group. What You Will Be Doing Sit with employees and understand how they carry out their day-to-day work. Map existing business processes, workflows and information flows. Identify repetitive, manual or time-consuming tasks that could be simplified. Design, build and test AI agents to assist with those processes. Create automated workflows and practical tools using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Power Platform. Test new AI tools and technologies to determine whether they have a genuine application within our businesses. Improve and refine solutions based on feedback from the people using them. Work alongside the IT Manager and external technology partners to help connect information held across our various systems. Help explore opportunities for better Group-wide data, reporting and analysis. Document solutions so they can be supported, developed and replicated elsewhere within the Group. Help employees understand and adopt the new tools being introduced. Identify new opportunities rather than simply waiting to be told what to build. Assist the internal IT department with wider IT duties, including day-to-day support, learning how existing systems and solutions are structured, and providing holiday cover. What We Are Looking For We are deliberately keeping the route into this role broad. You may be a recent graduate, already working in IT or software, or have developed your skills largely through your own interests and projects.We are less interested in exactly how you learned it than in what you have done with it. Ideally, you will have already played with and built things using some of the following: Microsoft Copilot Copilot Studio Power Automate Power Apps / Power Platform Generative AI tools AI agents or agentic workflows APIs and system integrations SharePoint and Microsoft 365 Data, databases or reporting tools Process mapping or workflow automation We are not expecting you to be an expert in all of these. We are looking for somebody who has gone beyond simply reading about AI and has tried to make something work.That could be an agent, automation, a small application, an integration, a personal project or something you developed as part of your current job or education. What Matters To Us A proven interest or background in AI, agentic technology, automation or process mapping. Enjoy solving problems and figuring things out. Understands that the first step in automation is understanding the process. Is comfortable experimenting and occasionally getting things wrong. Can communicate with non-technical people. Can translate a business problem into a practical technical solution. Is naturally curious about new technology. Can work independently while knowing when to ask for help. Wants to develop their skills and knowledge as AI technology evolves. Gets satisfaction from making something simpler, quicker or better. Show Us What You Have Built Qualifications and experience matter, but we would also genuinely like to see what you have built. If you have developed an AI agent, automated a laborious process, connected two systems, created an application or found a clever way of using technology to save …

items.desc: Edvance, filiale d'EDF et Framatome, réalise les projets d'un nouveau nucléaire sûr et performant à travers le monde pour construire un avenir neutre en CO2. Son rôle : être l'architecte de l'îlot nucléaire des réacteurs de technologie EPR. Rejoindre le collectif Edvance c'est être acteur de projets nucléaires passionnants et contribuer à l'énergie de demain. Le service GCB (Génie Civil et Bâtiments) constitue le pôle de compétences techniques et fonctionnelles dans le domaine du génie civil, en support à l'ensemble des projets du nucléaire neuf en France et à l'international, pour la conception de l'ensemble des bâtiments de l'îlot nucléaire (spécifications, études, dimensionnement, approvisionnement, appui à la construction, maintenance...), dans le gros oeuvre et le second oeuvre. Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble : L'objectif du stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des outils basés sur le Machine Learning et l'Intelligence Artificielle capables d'automatiser des tâches d'ingénierie répétitives et chronophages. Le projet portera principalement sur les maquettes BIM liées au ferraillage, aux calculs d'ingénierie ainsi qu'aux processus de surveillance et de contrôle des données. Le stagiaire intégrera une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée d'experts BIM, d'ingénieurs structures et de développeurs logiciels. Les travaux contribueront à améliorer la productivité, la qualité des données, leur traçabilité ainsi que leur fiabilité, tout en garantissant le respect des exigences de gouvernance et de protection des données. Vos missions seront les suivantes : - Analyser et optimiser les processus d'ingénierie BIM à l'aide de solutions d'Intelligence Artificielle ; - Développer des outils Python et des modèles de Machine Learning appliqués aux données d'ingénierie ; - Mettre en place des contrôles qualité, des indicateurs de performance et des outils de suivi ; - Réaliser les tests, la validation et l'amélioration continue des solutions développées ; - Collaborer avec les équipes métiers et de développement dans un environnement Agile ; - Documenter les travaux réalisés et présenter les résultats aux parties prenantes. Si on parlait de vous : Actuellement en Bac +5 / 6, vous êtes étudiant(e) et préparez un diplôme en Intelligence Artificielle, Data Science ou Machine Learning. Ce stage peut aussi s'adresser à des étudiants en spécialisation Génie Civil ayant de solides compétences en programmation. Excellente maîtrise de Python et des principaux outils d'analyse de données et de Machine Learning (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.). Une connaissance des environnements BIM, de l'ingénierie des structures, du Data Engineering ou du MLOps constitue un atout. Capacité d'analyse, esprit de synthèse et goût pour la résolution de problématiques techniques complexes. Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et aptitude à travailler au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires. Vous avez un niveau d'anglais courant. Vous avez un niveau de français à l'oral comme à l'écrit qui vous permet de rédiger et d'interagir dans le cadre de vos activités professionnelles. Ce que nous vous proposons : - Des locaux neufs et collaboratifs qui permettent des moments de convivialité, accès à un restaurant d'entreprise sur place ou à proximité. - Vous bénéficieriez d'un accompagnement privilégié avec votre tuteur(trice) tout au long de votre stage. Vous ferez également partie de la communauté des étudiants d'Edvance (stagiaires et alternants). - Si votre niveau d'études est diplômant, vous aurez des opportunités d'embauche en CDI au sein d'Edvance et de la filière nucléaire. Quelle est la suite ? - Si votre profil retient notre attention vous serez contacté(e) par l'un de nos Chargés de recrutement - Notre processus de recrutement s'effectue en 3 étapes : entretien de recrutement RH, entretien(s) technique(s) et échange avec notre Coordinateur RH qui vous présentera le contenu de notre proposition d'embauche - A l'issue du process de recrutement, votre futur manager prendra contact avec vous pour préparer votre arrivée. À savoir, chaque candidat retenu sera soumis à enquête administrative ainsi qu'aux exigences de la règlementation « Export Control ». Chez Edvance, nous croyons en l'audace, la confiance et l'esprit collectif et favorisons un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. À ce titre, nous luttons contre toute forme de discrimination et ouvrons tous nos postes aux personnes en situation de handicap.

items.desc: Lieu du stage : Valbonne (Sophia-Antipolis, 06) Sujet : Développement en Machine Learning sur des données de bioproduction L'organisation "Precision Biology for Lifesciences & Healthcare" de Dassault Systèmes réalise une veille scientifique et technologique permanente ainsi que des prototypes logiciels pour évaluer l'applicabilité de nouvelles technologies et/ou des connaissances scientifiques. Cette équipe doit assurer à tout moment un haut niveau de compétences dans tous les domaines technologiques, biologiques et biomédicaux de l'entreprise, et doit préparer ses éventuelles diversifications et acquisitions. Au sein de l’équipe « Cell Therapy for Bioproduction », nous nous intéressons au développement de jumeaux virtuels de différents procédés biologiques. Le développement de ces jumeaux virtuels nécessite la construction de modèles mathématiques complexes représentant les comportements biologiques impliqués dans les procédés de bioproduction. Combinés à des algorithmes de Machine Learning et des modèles d’IA intégrant des données réelles, ces jumeaux virtuels représentent le processus biologique en prenant en compte aussi bien les systèmes connus que les données observées. En bioproduction, nous faisons face à différents défis, tant concernant la connaissance des processus biologiques en jeu que l’accès aux données. En effet, l’obtention des données est très coûteuse ; au-delà de la quantité (nécessaire pour entraîner des modèles d’IA), la qualité est primordiale. Vos missions En tant que stagiaire au sein de notre équipe, et en collaboration avec votre tuteur, vous contribuerez à relever ce défi. Vous commencerez par vous familiariser avec le domaine, les données disponibles et les algorithmes déjà existants via une étude bibliographique. Puis, à partir de code existant, vous implémenterez de nouvelles méthodologies capables d’améliorer les performances de prédiction du modèle. Vos Qualifications Actuellement en Master 2 / Bac+5 en Ecole d’ingénieur ou Université, vous vous spécialisez en Mathématiques appliquées et Machine Learning avec un intérêt pour l’application des mathématiques au monde du vivant et recherchez un stage entre 5 et 6 mois. Compétences techniques souhaitées : Modélisation mathématique Machine Learning et IA Data Sciences Excellent niveau en programmation Python et ses bibliothèques (connaissance des packages pandas, tensorflow, keras, pytorch) Des connaissances de base en biologie / données biologiques sont un plus Compétences professionnelles souhaitées : Créativité et esprit collaboratif dans le partage des idées avec les autres membres du département Autonomie et force de proposition pour la mise en œuvre du prototype Rigueur dans votre conduite technique du stage Pédagogie dans la présentation et explication des résultats du stage. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement collaboratif et innovant Collaboration internationale Diversité des technologies, produits et solutions Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. items.desc: Lieu du stage : Cesson-Sévigné (35) Au sein du département Recherche de Dassault Systèmes, vous intégrerez l’équipe de recherche Oncology Twin qui vise à projeter les technologies de traitement de données (imagerie, génomique, textuelles, etc.) dans la pratique médicale de demain. Dans le cadre d'un programme de recherche collaboratif, vous aurez l'opportunité de développer des technologies innovantes qui s'intégreront dans une solution future pour améliorer le diagnostic et offrir un soin personnalisé à chaque patient atteint de cancer. Vous intégrerez le projet de modélisation d'organoïdes, basé à l'agence de Cesson-Sévigné (proche de Rennes). Ce projet offre de nombreuses applications, notamment la modélisation de thérapies anticancéreuses innovantes, grâce à la construction de jumeaux numériques de tumeurs. Ces jumeaux virtuels permettent de réaliser des tests à grande échelle, réduisant ainsi considérablement le nombre d’expériences en laboratoire, en particulier sur les animaux. Ils ouvrent également de nouvelles perspectives en matière de thérapies personnalisées. L’intégration des technologies multi-omics et de l’intelligence artificielle (AI) révolutionne la modélisation cellulaire, ouvrant des perspectives inédites pour la compréhension des maladies complexes comme le cancer. Les AI Virtual Cells (AIVC) sont des modèles computationnels permettant de simuler le comportement des cellules et d’étudier leur réponse à des perturbations, telles que les traitements anticancéreux [1]. [1] Bunne, C., Roohani, Y., Rosen, Y., Gupta, A., Zhang, X., Roed, M., Alexandrov, T., AlQuraishi, M., Brennan, P., Burkhardt, D.B., et al. (2024). How to build the virtual cell with artificial intelligence: Priorities and opportunities. Cell 187, 7045–7063. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2024.11.015. Vos missions Dans ce cadre, l'objectif du stage sera de développer des modèles d'AIVC appliqués à l’oncologie, en combinant des données multi-omics et des méthodes avancées de Deep Learning. Ce modèle pourra être utilisé pour diverses applications, notamment l'identifications des mécanismes biologiques sous-jacents du cancer, la prédiction de la réponse des cellules aux traitements médicamenteux, afin de mieux comprendre les dynamiques tumorales. Le stage débutera par une revue de la littérature des modèles existants et leurs applications en oncologie, ainsi que d’un recensement des jeux de données multi-omics publiques utilisables. Un ou plusieurs modèles innovants seront ensuite implémentés et évalués. Vos Qualifications Actuellement en Master 2 / Bac+5 en Ecole d’ingénieur ou Université, vous vous spécialisez en informatique, bio-informatique, data science, ou équivalent et recherchez un stage entre 5 et 6 mois. Compétences techniques souhaitées : Une maîtrise du développement en Python et bibliothèques telles que PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, ainsi qu’une familiarité avec des architectures avancées de Deep Learning est indispensable. Des connaissances en biologie/santé sont préférables. Une sensibilité à la recherche sera un atout. Compétences professionnelles souhaitées : Curiosité scientifique Rigueur Esprit d’innovation et résolution de problèmes complexes Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Start your career with the Strategic Student Program (SSP) The Strategic Student Program (SSP) is our global internship program at Siemens Digital Industries Software. You will be mentored by experienced professionals, gain practical experience on real customer projects, and work with cutting-edge technologies that support the digital transformation of manufacturing industries. As an SSP intern, you will join an international student community, access structured learning through the Siemens Learning Hub, receive ongoing coaching, and contribute to meaningful projects within a global and diverse engineering team. What you'll be doing as part of the Next-Gen Ops Intelligence team in Rotterdam? A convincing answer is not always the right one. Help an AI operations assistant tell the difference. You will build on an existing AI-assisted operations prototype for a systems engineering simulation platform, exploring how it can weigh diagnostic evidence, choose useful follow-up checks, and recognize when a software developer or a support/DevOps engineer should take over. (Note: The project focuses on diagnostic support in controlled scenarios, not autonomous changes to live production services.) You will contribute to activities such as: Understand the evidence: Explore how the assistant uses logs, service states, and incident history. Identify missing, outdated, duplicated, or conflicting clues, and connect observations to the right incident and time window. Choose the next useful check: Prototype ways to weigh evidence and decide whether to reach a conclusion, investigate further, or ask for human input. Make additional checks useful, not just more numerous. Make conclusions clear: Connect each finding to the evidence behind it. Explain remaining uncertainty and give engineers a useful handover instead of a confident guess. Test what really improves: Build replayable incident scenarios and compare your approach with the existing assistant. Aim for fewer unsupported diagnoses without simply refusing difficult cases; measure usefulness, investigation cost, and response time. Integrate and demonstrate: Bring the method into the prototype and show it working end to end. Deliver reusable code, a repeatable evaluation, and an honest account of its strengths and limits. What we're looking for We are looking for final-year engineering or master's students in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied AI, or related technical disciplines. If you enjoy software development, Artificial Intelligence, automation, and solving technical challenges while working in an international engineering environment, we'd love to hear from you. Preferred Qualifications Programming experience in Python, Go, or TypeScript, and confidence with APIs, testing, and debugging. Curiosity about AI agents, cloud-native systems, and software reliability. Kubernetes or observability experience is helpful, not essential. A self-driven, structured approach to experimentation and the ability to explain technical findings clearly. The Software Engineer (Applied AI) at JobCloud builds AI capabilities, including agentic ones, into JobCloud’s Recruiting Process Platform products. The role is based in Porto, Portugal, and hybrid, with on-site attendance up to three days a week when business needs require it. Applied AI is a new team with one mission: build AI capabilities into the Recruiting Process Platform products. Data Science leads model building and training. The team owns product engineering from the first prototype to a commercial feature in production. As Software Engineer (Applied AI), you refine, build, test, deploy and maintain features end to end as part of your team. You need direction on what to build, but not on how to build it. You partner with engineers, Product and Design and work closely with upstream and downstream teams to take ideas from concept to production. This role suits engineers who enjoy chasing a bug across the frontend, backend and an AI-generated explanation that turns out to be fiction. You follow the evidence and share the satisfaction when it finally makes sense. WHAT IS JOBCLOUD HR TECH? JobCloud HR Tech is the Porto, Portugal based company of JobCloud, Switzerland’s number 1 job ads brand and the company behind jobs.ch and jobup.ch. We build software that helps companies spend their hiring budget efficiently and get their job ads in front of the right candidates. Millions of job seekers and thousands of companies use our platform to find each other. WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK AT JOBCLOUD? We work as one team of experts in our field. Our culture is inclusive and respectful, and it is built on openness and collaboration. Your skills and motivation count. Your skin colour, gender and beliefs do not matter to us. Come as you are. Our purpose is “Love what you do.” WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE? AI capabilities: Build AI capabilities, including agentic ones, from the first prototype to a commercial feature in production. Work with Data Science, who lead model building and training. Feature ownership: Own features end to end within the team, from refinement to production release. Code quality: Write production-ready code with testability, readability and maintainability in mind. Handle edge cases, failure paths and security implications without waiting for someone else to spot them. AI-assisted engineering: Work with AI assistants and coding agents where they deliver demonstrable value. Review and test their output, and keep full ownership of the code and its production outcomes. Delivery: Deliver predictably. Break features into realistic tasks and estimates and make dependencies visible. Communicate risks honestly and renegotiate early when delivery is at risk. Operations: Run what the team ships. Monitor production, strengthen observability and fix recurring issues at their root. Keep runbooks and documentation current. Product partnership: Work directly with Product Management and Design, and question gaps in requirements before building. Balance features against reliability, security, maintainability and cost. WHAT SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in a product-driven environment. Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants and coding agents, including verifying their output for correctness, security and quality. Solid foundation in system design and cloud-native development, including distributed or event-driven systems. Experience with TypeScript, Python or strongly typed languages. This includes designing, delivering and operating production applications or services. Business fluent in English. WHAT TECH STACK DOES JOBCLOUD USE? Languages: TypeScript, PHP, Python, Java and Kotlin Frontend: Angular and React.js Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Apache Kafka, etc. Tooling: GitHub (Actions, Copilot), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD and AWS, etc. Ways of working: Agile, Scrum, Roadmaps, etc. The full list is on JobCloud tech stack on StackShare. WHAT DO WE OFFER? Build AI capabilities, including agentic ones, in a new team, from the first prototype to a commercial feature in production. Freedom in how you build: you get direction on what to build, not on how to build it. Hybrid work in Porto, with on-site attendance up to three days a week when business needs require it. International collaboration: Work with colleagues across JobCloud’s international offices (Zurich, Geneva, Belgrade or Vienna) including regular visits to Switzerland. A working atmosphere built on trust, mutual support and team spirit. JobCloud is a kununu Top Company 2026. A personal training budget for your professional development. items.desc: Le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle appliquées aux Contrôles Non Destructifs a été identifié comme un axe stratégique pour renforcer la compétitivité d’Intercontrôle et accompagner l’évolution de ses métiers. La mise en œuvre de ces approches soulève toutefois plusieurs enjeux structurants : gestion de volumes importants de données, adaptation des outils d’annotation aux besoins métier, traçabilité et versionnement des jeux de données, suivi des expérimentations, reproductibilité des entraînements, gestion et comparaison des versions de modèles, dans la continuité des bonnes pratiques aujourd’hui regroupées sous le terme de MLOps. Ces enjeux dépassent donc la seule performance des algorithmes. Ils nécessitent de structurer progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée et des modèles d’IA, depuis l’acquisition et l’annotation jusqu’à l’entraînement, l’évaluation et l’exploitation. L’objectif est de disposer d’un socle commun permettant de capitaliser sur les développements IA, de les rendre réutilisables et de faciliter leur passage du prototype à un usage industriel. Dans ce contexte, Intercontrôle souhaite développer un POC logiciel permettant d’éprouver ces pratiques, d’en valider la pertinence sur des cas d’usage concrets et de disposer d’un démonstrateur capable d’en illustrer la valeur auprès des utilisateurs et des différentes parties prenantes. Le stage aura pour objectif de concevoir et développer un POC logiciel dédié aux problématiques de computer vision appliquées aux Contrôles Non Destructifs. Le prototype devra notamment permettre de : Définir une ontologie métier commune décrivant les analyses, composants inspectés, zones ou faces, défauts, acquisitions, annotations, métadonnées et résultats d’analyse ; Définir des standards de données permettant de structurer, tracer et versionner de manière homogène les données image et vidéo, dans une logique inspirée des pratiques MLOps ; Définir des interfaces et standards d’entrée/sortie communs permettant d’intégrer de manière modulaire les modèles de classification, de détection et de segmentation développés en interne ; Permettre l’intégration, l’entraînement, l’évaluation et la comparaison de différents modèles au sein d’une même plateforme ; Mettre en œuvre une démarche de développement assisté par des agents de codage, afin d’accélérer les itérations tout en garantissant la qualité et la maîtrise du code produit ; À l’issue des 6 mois, proposer un démonstrateur concret permettant d’éprouver les besoins, de recueillir les retours utilisateurs et de démontrer la valeur de ces pratiques avant leur intégration progressive dans les outils existants. Vous êtes en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou suivez une formation universitaire équivalente de niveau Bac +5, avec une spécialisation en informatique, génie logiciel, data science ou intelligence artificielle. Vous disposez d’un intérêt pour le développement logiciel, la structuration de données et l’intelligence artificielle. La maîtrise de l’ensemble des compétences ci-dessous n’est pas indispensable : votre capacité à apprendre rapidement, à expérimenter et à monter en compétences sera également déterminante. Compétences requises : Développement logiciel en HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Python et C# Connaissances en architecture logicielle (MVC, Plugin Architecture, Pipeline, etc.) et en conception d’applications modulaires Connaissances en Spec-Driven Development et capacité à formaliser des besoins fonctionnels et techniques Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : tests unitaires, documentation, qualité et maintenabilité du code Utilisation de Git et des workflows de développement collaboratif Utilisation d’agents de codage assistés par IA Conception et manipulation de bases de données relationnelles (SQL, PostgreSQL/SQLite), structuration de schémas et gestion de métadonnées Manipulation de données image et vidéo et connaissances en computer vision/deep learning (PyTorch, OpenCV) Compréhension des pratiques MLOps Autonome, rigoureux(se) et curieux(se), vous êtes capable de comprendre un besoin métier, de le formaliser et de le traduire en une solution logicielle concrète.

items.desc: Rebuild how insurance claims get handled inca ist ein AI-first TPA für die Schadenbearbeitung und arbeitet mit den größten Versicherern Deutschlands. Wir verkaufen keine Software, die Sachbearbeiter:innen unterstützt. Wir bearbeiten die Schäden selbst, end-to-end, mit Agentic AI und einem kleinen Team aus Expert:innen. Gegründet von drei ehemaligen BCG-Projektleitern und finanziert von Top-VCs, sind wir seit unserer ersten Finanzierungsrunde Anfang 2025 auf über 25 Leute gewachsen, und die Versicherer kommen auf uns zu. About the role Als AI Builder Intern baust du die Agenten, die die Arbeit machen, und wir gestalten das Praktikum rund um deine Stärken. Du nimmst einen echten Schadenprozess, zerlegst ihn und machst daraus ein KI-System, das produktiv läuft. Keine Spielprojekte: Was du baust, bearbeitet echte Schäden für echte Versicherer. Wenn du mit KI baust, weil du nicht anders kannst, ob mit Claude, Cursor, n8n oder etwas anderem, ist das dein Praktikum. What you will do Own a real project. Du übernimmst ein echtes Projekt, gern eines, das du uns gezeigt hast, und bringst es vom Prototyp zu etwas, das unser Claims-Team oder unsere Versicherungskunden wirklich nutzen. Build agents for real claims. Du verwandelst unübersichtliche Schadenarbeit in KI-Systeme: unstrukturierte Dokumente auslesen (Rechnungen, Fotos, Kostenvoranschläge, handschriftliche Formulare), Deckung gegen komplexe Versicherungsbedingungen prüfen, Plausibilitäts- und Betrugssignale erkennen, Kundenkommunikation entwerfen. Ship, measure, iterate. Du shippst, misst an echten Schäden und iterierst, bis es trägt, inklusive Evals, die uns zeigen, wann es das nicht tut. Work with the founders. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und, je nachdem wo dein Projekt liegt, mit Product, Engineering oder Operations. Show us what you've built Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und, wenn du hast, Links zu Projekten, die du mit KI gebaut hast. Das kann etwas sein, das inca weiterhelfen würde, oder ein Projekt, das dich einfach gepackt hat. Hauptsache, man sieht, wie du denkst. Ein GitHub-Repo, eine Demo oder ein kurzer Write-up reichen völlig, gern mit ein paar Zeilen dazu, worum es geht. Noch nichts zum Verlinken? Kein Problem, bewirb dich trotzdem. You might be a fit if Du baust mit KI, statt nur darüber zu reden, und hast schon Dinge geshippt, die funktionieren, auch wenn sie noch roh sind. Du denkst in Wirkung, nicht in Technologie, und kannst ein unübersichtliches Problem in eine klare Lösung zerlegen. Du suchst dir Arbeit, statt auf Aufgaben zu warten, und verantwortest Dinge gern bis zum Ende. Du sprichst mit Engineers genauso gut wie mit Versicherern. Chaos aus der echten Welt schreckt dich nicht ab, denn davon hat die Versicherungsbranche reichlich. Du kommunizierst klar auf Deutsch und Englisch. What we need Du studierst BWL, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder ein anderes quantitatives Fach im fortgeschrittenen Semester oder hast gerade abgeschlossen. Uns interessiert, wie du Probleme löst, nicht dein Studienfach. Außerdem bist du mindestens 6 Monate in Vollzeit verfügbar und hast eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland. How to apply Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und füge im Bewerbungsformular Links zu deinen Projekten hinzu. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Why inca Real AI, real responsibility. Du arbeitest vom ersten Tag an agentischen Systemen mit echten Nutzer:innen. Steep learning curve. Du lernst von innen, wie ein VC-finanziertes Startup aufgebaut wird, von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. No-bullshit culture. Direktes Feedback, viel Ownership und ein Team, dem es darum geht, Dinge umzusetzen. Founder exposure. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team. Berlin, hybrid. Büro in Berlin, hybrid-freundlich, regelmäßige Offsites. Wir sind schnell. Wenn du etwas gebaut hast, auf das du stolz bist, zeig es uns.

items.desc: Job Title Internship/Graduation Agentic AI Systems for Software Re-engineering Job Description Assignment type Internship/Graduation Start date February 2027 Assignment duration 6 months Location Veghel Education level Master Desired study Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering Language Dutch / English Description of assignment Modernizing software is one of the most challenging and time-consuming activities in software engineering. Upgrading existing systems affects architecture, dependencies, interfaces, testing and deployment standards simultaneously, consuming capacity that could otherwise go into new functionality. Generative AI already supports individual coding tasks, but this assignment explores taking automation to the next level by evaluating whether autonomous AI agents can handle complete end-to-end migrations. Using a representative, real-world software module as a case study, you will research, design, and demonstrate an agentic migration system. You will investigate how autonomous AI agents can understand, plan, implement, test, and validate a software migration while ensuring that every change remains reviewable, traceable, and under human control. Department description You will join the engineering team developing ADAPTO, Vanderlande’s shuttle-based automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS), within the Technology organization. ADAPTO enables fast and accurate order fulfillment for high-volume e-commerce and retail distribution centers worldwide. The team continuously improves ADAPTO and its software while collaborating closely with product management, engineering teams, and customer project teams. You will work on your research assignment fully embedded within an agile, multidisciplinary engineering team that is eager to explore AI-driven software development. Throughout the assignment, you will receive close guidance and support from two dedicated supervisors. Tasks/responsibilities Explore state-of-the-art Agentic AI and analyze its possibilities for large software migrations. Establish a baseline for a representative software module, covering architecture, tests, and build quality. Design a reference architecture for an agentic migration system using specialized AI agents. Build a proof-of-concept executing migrations in small, reviewable steps in an isolated environment. Evaluate autonomy levels, code quality, test results, human interventions, and overall effort. Your profile Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals in languages such as C#, Java, or Python, with Git experience. Interest in software architecture, software modernization, Generative AI, LLMs, and AI agents. Affinity with DevOps, CI/CD, and automated testing. Good written and spoken English communication skills. *Mandatory enrolment to a Dutch Education System & resident of The Netherlands What we offer A monthly internship allowance (based on a 40-hour work week) undefined undefined Full commuting allowance, including public transport, depending on whether you have access to free public transport or not On-site health center with gym Active employee communities and initiatives Excellent company restaurant and barista coffee bar Contact Do you recognize yourself in this challenging profile? Are you looking for an internship in our organization? Please fill out the application form and upload your resume and cover letter. For more information, contact us by e-mail internship@vanderlande.com.

items.desc: Dassault Systèmes, « The 3DEXPERIENCE Company », offre aux entreprises et aux particuliers les univers virtuels nécessaires à la conception d’innovations durables, capables d’harmoniser le produit, la nature et la vie. Chez Dassault Systèmes, nous encourageons les personnes à changer et à façonner le monde dans lequel nous vivons. Afin d’accompagner notre constante croissance et nos 250 000 clients dans le monde, nous recherchons un profil inspirant et passionné qui intégrera les équipes chargées de la mise au point d'IA Generatives en tant qu’ingénieur R&D IA. Cette équipe fait partie du département R&D Technologies V+R Expériences basé à Aix-En-Provence qui développe des technologies associant le Deep Learning, les méthodes d'IA Generative et la Géométrie Computationnelle classique. L’objectif du poste Ingénieur R&D Technologies Deep Learning consiste à mettre en œuvre des technologies d'IA Génératives afin de construire des Industry World Models, permettant d'ouvrir une compréhension multimodale et multifactorielle de processus industriels complexes et d'accélérer l'automatisation et l'accélération de processus d'ingénierie avancés. Prototyper les solutions techniques retenues et mettre en place des objets de test et des métriques pour les valider Industrialiser la solution définitive suivant les process DS et garantir son déploiement dans les produits du groupe en respectant les délais impartis. items.desc: Role Title: Korean AI Evaluator (Remote) Role Type: Full-time Location: Remote Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications 1. Korean Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Korean with a high degree of comp, as Korean is the focus language for this project. 2. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. 3. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. 4. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. 5. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. 6. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. 7. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. 8. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. 9. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. 10. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 11. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. 12. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: 1. In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: 2. Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. 3. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. 4. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. 5. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating". 6. Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. 7. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. 8. Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. 9. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience 1. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). 2. items.desc: Hey, wir sind Sunlab – schön, dass du vorbeischaust. Du bist Entwickler aus Leidenschaft schreibst keine Zeile Code mehr per Hand? Du weißt, wie du KI-Tools sinnvoll in Workflows integrierst, komplexe Probleme löst und aus Ideen funktionierende Applikationen machst? Perfekt. Genau danach suchen wir! Wir bei Sunlab verbinden Performance Marketing mit Technologie. Unser Inhouse-Development entwickelt individuelle Tools, intelligente Automatisierungen und technische Lösungen, die Prozesse optimieren und den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern. Dabei verschmilzt die künstliche Intelligenz mit unserer DNA. Ob im Terminal oder OpenCode, Visual Studio Code, etc., unser Stack basiert aktuell auf Claude, OpenAI und einer lokalen LLM (Nvidia Spark). Um unsere Mission weiter voranzubringen, suchen wir dich als AI Software Developer (m/w/d). Dein Verantwortungsbereich Agentic Coding: Du setzt LLMs ein um hochwertigen Code effizient zu entwickeln, bestehende Anwendungen zu erweitern und neue Features umzusetzen ohne dabei per Hand Code zu schreiben. Vom Prompt zum Produkt: Du machst aus Anforderungen und Ideen funktionierende Anwendungen. Dabei setzt du KI gezielt für Architektur, Implementierung, Debugging, Refactoring und Testing ein. Intelligente Automatisierung: Du identifizierst Prozesse, die sich mit KI und Code automatisieren lassen, und entwickelst dafür pragmatische, skalierbare Lösungen. KI-Integration: Du integrierst LLMs und passende APIs in bestehende Systeme und entwickelst beispielsweise intelligente Assistenten, datengetriebene Tools oder automatisierte Workflows. Qualität statt blindem Vertrauen: Du überprüfst KI-generierten Code, erkennst Schwachstellen und stellst sicher, dass deine Lösungen performant, wartbar und sicher sind. Tech-Stack weiterdenken: Du testest neue KI-Tools und Entwicklungsansätze, bewertest ihren praktischen Nutzen und bringst die besten Lösungen in unseren Arbeitsalltag. Know-how teilen: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Tech-Team neue Standards für KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung und hilfst dabei, das gesamte Team effizienter zu machen. Dein Background Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Software Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung mit fundiertem IT- und KI-Schwerpunkt und kannst eigenständig sauberen, funktionierenden Code schreiben – unabhängig davon, ob du dabei KI einsetzt oder klassisch entwickelst. Du nutzt KI-Coding-Tools bereits aktiv und weißt, wie du sie für komplexere Entwicklungsaufgaben einsetzt. Du kennst dich mit mindestens einer relevanten Programmiersprache aus, beispielsweise .NET/C#, Rust, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP oder einer vergleichbaren Sprache. APIs, Datenbanken, Git und grundlegende Softwarearchitektur sind für dich keine Fremdwörter. Du verstehst, dass KI-generierter Code nicht automatisch guter Code ist, und kannst Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen, testen und verbessern. Du hast Lust, neue Technologien auszuprobieren, dich schnell in unbekannte Themen einzuarbeiten und Lösungen eigenständig voranzutreiben. Du denkst pragmatisch, arbeitest strukturiert und hast einen hohen Anspruch an deine Arbeit. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und kannst dich in beiden Sprachen sicher über technische Themen austauschen und komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären. Deine Benefits Hybrides Arbeiten mit flexiblen Office-Tagen Rundum Versorgung im top modernen Headquarter am bayerischen Untermain, Fitnessraum, Gaming Room auf über 1.600 qm uvm. Flache Hierarchien & kurze Entscheidungswege Ein starkes Onboarding, regelmäßige Weiterbildungen & Konferenzen Also, bewirb dich noch heute und setze dich an unserer Seite dafür ein, unsere Kunden in die Pole Position zu bekommen. Wir freuen uns schon darauf, dich bald kennenzulernen. Julia und das Team von Sunlab PS: Du kannst uns auch einfach unter 06021 4228997 anrufen.

items.desc: About WeArisma WeArisma is a UK-based social and cultural intelligence platform. We detect brand content that nobody tagged, across video, audio and image, so brands see the full picture of how they show up online, not just the posts that mention them. Our clients include Gucci, Kering, Campari, L'Occitane and Shiseido, alongside financial institutions and sports and media organisations. With our relaunch as WeArisma.ai and our AI agent, Aura, we are moving from dashboards to answers built around each client's questions. The role This is a builder role for someone who wants to turn promising ideas into working software and help shape what we build next. As our Product Engineer, you’ll work closely with our COO, alongside our designer, our engineers and other teams across the business. You’ll combine hands-on development with the commercial judgement to focus on problems worth solving. You’ll write code and use AI development tools to build prototypes and internal tools in our separate application for testing new ideas. You’ll put working software in people’s hands, test it with users across the business and turn their feedback into a better next version. When a prototype proves its value, you’ll help establish how it could fit into the customer platform. You’ll also help choose where the team focuses its effort. You’ll learn our customer platform’s capabilities, workflows, data flows and technical constraints, then weigh new requests against existing plans and recommend what comes next. You’ll provide clear priorities, timely decisions and feedback. When plans shift, you’ll explain what changes for each team affected and why. Expect a roughly even split between hands-on building and shaping priorities to keep engineering delivery moving. Location: London, hybrid; UK-based Salary: £65,000–£80,000 per year, depending on experience Employment: Full-time, permanent Reports to: COO What you’ll do Help set priorities across the business. Work with the COO to assess incoming requests, weighing their value, urgency and fit with existing commitments. Discuss trade-offs with engineering and design, and agree what comes next and what can wait. Keep teams clear on decisions and changes. Review proposed solutions, make day-to-day decisions within agreed goals and secure timely input when needed. When priorities change, clarify what moves, what pauses and why, so everyone affected can plan their work. Build prototypes and internal tools. Develop working software yourself and improve existing tools, using AI development tools effectively. Turn ideas into useful solutions. Work with the teams behind each idea to understand the opportunity, explore possible approaches and use prototypes to test value before committing to wider development. Bring proven capabilities into the customer offering. Work with engineering and design to establish how validated prototypes should fit into the customer platform, including the user experience and data requirements. Test, debug and improve your tools. Gather user feedback, check that workflows deliver the intended result and follow improvements through in the prototypes and internal tools you build. What you’ll bring Your experience might come from software development, a startup or another broad technical role. We’re interested in what you have built and the judgement behind it. Practical development ability. You can build and improve web applications and internal tools, working with APIs and databases. You can show examples of working software you have personally developed. Product and technical judgement. You can learn how an existing platform works, understand engineering proposals and ask useful questions about feasibility, effort and user impact. Commercial judgement. You’re interested in why something matters to a customer or the business. You can weigh value, effort, urgency and complexity when deciding what is worth doing. Effective use of AI development tools. You use AI to accelerate development while understanding, testing and taking responsibility for the code you use in your tools. Ownership, collaboration and communication. You bring your own recommendations, balance requests from different teams and follow decisions through. You explain trade-offs clearly, keep people informed when plans change and adjust the level of detail for your audience. Nice to have Experience with B2B SaaS, data products or AI applications would be useful. How we work and what we offer You’ll have direct access to customer and business context, support as you learn the business and room to grow your ownership across product and technology. To apply: Send your CV and a brief example of a tool or prototype you personally built. Explain the need it addressed, the decisions you made and how feedback shaped the result.

items.title: AI Solution Developer
items.loc: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
items.card: you will turn the priorities in our AI Roadmap into reliable, well-designed solutions that people actually use. You will work directly with teams across the business to understand their needs, design the right solution, build and refine it, and take it all the way into production and adoption.
