items.desc: Zensai’s AI Office leads the company’s AI Roadmap, focusing on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that solve shared business challenges and create value across Zensai. As our AI Solution Developer , you will turn the priorities in our AI Roadmap into reliable, well-designed solutions that people actually use. You will work directly with teams across the business to understand their needs, design the right solution, build and refine it, and take it all the way into production and adoption. The AI Office is led by Maria, our VP of AI Office. You will work closely with the rest of the team and take ownership of AI projects from design and development through to successful implementation. One of your first projects could involve connecting customer emails, calls and support interactions to help our commercial teams identify customer risks, sentiment and growth opportunities earlier. Other projects will involve AI agents, intelligent workflows, internal tools and integrations across our business systems. What you’ll be doing Work directly with teams across Zensai to understand how they operate, uncover the real problem and define what a useful outcome looks like Design, build and deploy AI agents, AI-assisted workflows and intelligent automation solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem Connect systems and data through APIs, Model Context Protocol, integrations and data transformations Decide where AI creates value, where deterministic logic is more appropriate and how to balance technical possibilities with business needs Monitor solutions after deployment, handling failures, performance, cost and continuous improvement to keep them reliable and useful This is not a role focused primarily on model experimentation or AI research. It is for someone who enjoys solving business problems and building solutions that work reliably in production. What you bring Experience building and deploying software solutions that solve real business problems, with confidence working in Python Hands-on experience with large language models, AI-powered workflows, agent-based solutions and intelligent automation Experience connecting systems through APIs, Model Context Protocol, integrations and data transformation Solid hands-on experience within the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Azure, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Foundry or Foundry IQ Strong business understanding and clear communication: you can turn messy problems into practical solutions, explain complex technology to non-technical colleagues and take ownership through to production Meet the AI Office The AI Office works across Zensai and sits close to our CEO, reflecting the importance of AI to the company’s direction. The team brings together technical development, business enablement and implementation to help promising ideas become solutions that deliver real results. We are still establishing some of our processes and ways of working. You will have experienced colleagues to collaborate with and challenge, while also having the freedom to structure your own projects and influence how the team delivers solutions. The team is based across Copenhagen and Aarhus. This role is based in Copenhagen, with occasional travel to Aarhus so we can work and spend time together as one team. Process Apply in just a few minutes, no cover letter required. We review applications weekly and keep you updated throughout the process. Learn more about how we hire at Zensai here! The benefits! Full Flexibility : Work where and when you do your best! Morning person or night owl? Home office or office vibes? You decide. Learning: 10% of your working time dedicated to development. Built in, not squeezed in. Pension & Health: We’ve got you covered—literally. Enjoy a robust pension plan that includes life insurance, and coverage if life throws a curveball like loss of work capacity or serious illness. Plus, our health insurance takes care of hospital stays, surgeries, physical therapy—you name it. Peace of mind, sorted. Laptop & Company Phone: Stay connected with a Laptop & iPhone on us. Need a subscription? We’ve got that too. Lunch & Snacks: Feels more like fine dining when we go to lunch, including tasty meals, snacks, and drinks. Your taste buds will thank you! About Zensai Zensai is a global team of around 200 people across Europe, the US, and ANZ. We believe people should have the opportunity to keep learning, feel connected to their workplace, and do their best work. That’s why we created the Human Success Platform. Built into Microsoft 365 and powered by AI, it helps companies turn learning, engagement, and performance into a natural part of everyday work.

items.desc: Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten. Du bist Absolvent:in oder beabsichtigst, in Kürze dein Studium zu beenden? Unser Trainee-Programm im Team Consulting - Artificial Intelligence & Data ist dein perfektes Sprungbrett in eine Karriere mit Fokus auf datengetriebene Transformationen mit Unterstützung von künstlicher Intelligenz. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Trainee Cloud & Data - Dein Einstieg in Artificial Intelligence & Data (m/w/d) . Hard Facts für deinen Einstieg: Beginn: 01.04.2027 Dauer: 12 Wochen Trainingsprogramm in unbefristeter Festanstellung Bewerbungsschluss: Sonntag, den 14.02.2027 Standorte: Berlin , Düsseldorf , Frankfurt (Main) , Hamburg , Hannover , Köln , München und Stuttgart . Dein Impact: Als Trainee Cloud & Data for AI (m/w/d) gestaltest du die technologische Grundlage für die nächste Generation intelligenter Unternehmen. In unserem zwölfwöchigen Traineeprogramm tauchst du tief in moderne Cloud-, Data- und AI-Technologien ein und lernst, wie innovative Ideen zu produktionsreifen Lösungen werden. Anschließend steigst du direkt in Kundenprojekte ein und arbeitest gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Expert:innen an der Entwicklung skalierbarer Datenplattformen und AI-Anwendungen mit messbarem Mehrwert. AI & GenAI Engineering: Du entwickelst innovative AI-Anwendungen auf Basis von Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI und modernen AI-Frameworks und lernst, wie produktive Lösungen erfolgreich in Unternehmen aufgebaut werden. Agentic AI: Du gestaltest die nächste Generation AI-gestützter Anwendungen und entwickelst intelligente AI Agents, die komplexe Aufgaben übernehmen, Geschäftsprozesse unterstützen und Unternehmenssysteme miteinander verbinden. Modern Data Engineering & AI Foundations: Du konzipierst und entwickelst skalierbare Datenplattformen, Data Pipelines und moderne Datenarchitekturen, die Unternehmen dabei helfen, ihre Daten effizient zu nutzen und innovative AI-Lösungen zu ermöglichen. Modern Technology Stack: Du arbeitest mit aktuellen Technologien und Plattformen wie Databricks, Snowflake, Claude, Azure, AWS oder GCP und sammelst praktische Erfahrungen mit modernen Software-, Data- und AI-Engineering-Ansätzen. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Du bist nah an den neuesten Entwicklungen im Bereich Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering und Cloud-Technologien, evaluierst neue Tools und Frameworks und entwickelst dein Know-how durch Zertifizierungen, Trainings und Learning-on-the-Job kontinuierlich weiter. Dein Skillset: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Statistik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit technischem Schwerpunkt oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs Erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten, Hochschulprojekte oder eigene Projekte im Umfeld von Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Softwareentwicklung oder Cloud-Technologien Programmierkenntnisse in Python, SQL, Java oder Scala sowie Interesse an modernen Datenplattformen, Cloud-Technologien und der Entwicklung skalierbarer Daten- und AI-Lösungen Begeisterung für neue Technologien und die Motivation, dich mit den neuesten Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data Engineering und Cloud-native Architekturen auseinanderzusetzen und diese in der Praxis anzuwenden Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch (C1) und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift sowie Freude an agiler, teamorientierter Projektarbeit im Beratungsumfeld Deine Chance: Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits Work-Life-Balance durch Mobile Working & Teilzeit, EU Remote Working, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation, z. B. durch folgende Schulungen: „Microsoft Azure Data Engineer“ und „Google Cloud Platform Data Engineer“ Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke Bist du bereit? items.title: Security Operations Engineer, AWS Security Cloud Response
items.card: responsibilities. Key job responsibilities An ideal candidate should be able to accomplish most of the following: - Triage/assess security issues and engage with internal service teams to ensure timely remediation of issues, escalating internally as necessary to ensure appropriate levels of urgency and engagement. - Participate in efforts to promote security throughout the Company and build good working
items.desc:
Amazon is looking for a focused Security Engineer who can take on a leadership role in responding to security issues across the largest cloud provider in the world. The right candidate must thrive in high-pressure situations, think like both an attacker and defender, and drive relevant teams to take the right actions in the right timeframes to mitigate risks.
 We are looking for an individual who can balance technical risks against business risks and consistently drive for the right results. They must have the passion for engineering novel solutions to complex security challenges, and recognize and fill gaps in capabilities. The ability to quickly design and build internal-facing tools that enable scaled programmatic automation is a plus.
The successful candidate will have a good mix of deep technical knowledge and a demonstrated background in information security. We value broad and deep technical knowledge, specifically in the fields of cryptography, network security, software security, malware analysis, forensics, security operations, incident response, and emergent security intelligence.

items.desc:
Advertising at Amazon is a fast-growing, multi-billion dollar business that spans across desktop, mobile and connected devices; encompasses ads on Amazon and a vast network of hundreds of thousands of third party publishers; and extends worldwide. Traffic Quality, within Amazon Advertising, builds technology to detect invalid traffic (IVT) and ensure that Advertiser spend worldwide is directed towards human audiences and protected from ad fraud.
As the Security engineering team within Traffic Quality, we research programmatic advertising risk landscapes to build an understanding of existing and emergent threats. We build specialized techniques to detect and mitigate these threats, contributing to a robust Traffic Quality platform that is a bedrock of advertiser trust and saves hundreds of millions of dollars in ad spend that would otherwise be lost to IVT. The Security Engineering team is responsible for: (a) Targeted threat hunting, including on the dark web, to consistently stay updated on modus operandi and risks associated with advertising fraud, (b) Building sophisticated mitigation techniques through reverse engineering known software, identifying network layer signatures, and conceiving client-side scripting methods, and, (c) Collaborating with security teams across Amazon for sharing intelligence and devising durable detection techniques.
As a Security Engineer in the team, you are passionate about unraveling ad fraud tactics utilizing a diversity of highly specialized skills in reverse-engineering, deep packet inspection of network traffic, understanding of network security, operating systems and browser architectures. You accomplish your tasks by applying expert level knowledge to tools to understand not only what a particular piece of malware for perpetrating ad fraud can do but also how it does it. You work with internal security teams to identify and mitigate botnets, as well as leverage the ethical hacking community to obtain standard modus operandi, source code and tactics used by malware and botnets. The role requires influencing leaders across the company to improve our security bar and protect advertiser trust. A Security Engineer also works with other product and security teams to proactively identify problems and suggest approaches to solve them.
Given the high level of ambiguity in the advertising fraud space, and the need to prepare for unknown unknowns, your creativity, judgement and bias for action will all be key ingredients towards delivering the right results for advertising customers.

- Experience with AWS products and services

items.desc:
Do you want to make the invisible visible, turning complex model outputs into clear, actionable insights that shape how Amazon moves millions of packages?
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to own the analytics and explainability layer for Fulfillment Optimization systems that transform network-level plans into actionable signals, systems that tell fulfillment centers and trucks exactly how fast packages should flow, how capacity should be allocated, and how volume should be distributed across the network.
In this role, you will take loosely defined questions about model behavior, output quality, and business impact and refine them into analytical solutions that drive your team's decisions. You will design and own pipelines that decompose model outputs into interpretable signals across multiple planning and optimization systems, build dashboards and automated reporting that surface anomalies and inflection points, and develop the metrics that quantify how output shape and quality connect to fulfillment performance, transportation cost, and customer delivery promise. You will trace data lineage from the technical systems generating inputs through model transformation to downstream consumption, ensuring stakeholders understand not just what the numbers say but where they come from. You will work in SQL, Python, and AWS analytics services to deliver efficient, testable, and maintainable solutions that balance speed of delivery with long-term reliability.
What makes this role compelling is the direct line between your analysis and operational decisions. You are not reporting on historical trends. You are building the analytical foundation that tells us whether our models are producing the outcomes we expect and where opportunities exist to improve. You will partner with BIE and analytics teams across the organization to align on shared measurement approaches, connect your insights with broader network-level metrics, and enable self-service access to underlying data so stakeholders can explore without bottlenecks. You will collaborate with research scientists to validate model behavior, with engineering to instrument systems for observability, and with business stakeholders to recommend alternatives and anticipate future needs. If you enjoy refining loosely defined analytical problems, partnering across teams, and building the layer that connects model behavior to business outcomes, this is the role for you.
Key job responsibilities
- Design and own explainability frameworks that decompose model outputs across multiple Fulfillment Optimization systems into interpretable, actionable signals for science, engineering, and business stakeholders
- Build analytical pipelines and dashboards that monitor output shape and quality, detect anomalies, and quantify the relationship between model behavior and fulfillment performance
- Partner with BIE and analytics teams to align on shared metrics, enable self-service data access, and connect optimization insights with network-level reporting
- Trace data lineage from source systems through model transformation to downstream consumption, and translate findings into recommendations that inform team prioritization decisions
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Bachelor's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Job Description: 
 In order to support our team “Supp. Engineering Trsp./Miss. GE”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a
 Testability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m) 
 Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).
 The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. This is achieved by integrating diagnostic functions, sensors and standardized interfaces to ensure that fault identification, isolation and verification are performed with maximum speed, precision and cost-efficiency. The overall target is minimizing MTTR and diagnostic costs.
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

items.card: THE ROLE The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going. You
items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE ROLE

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

 - A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

 - You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

 - You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

 - Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

 - 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

 - Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

 - Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

 - Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.desc:
What You'll Do:
Build a deep understanding of Spotify’s label, publishing, lyrics, and audiobook contracts, how they’re implemented in our royalty systems, and how they flow into royalty calculations, downstream datasets, and reporting.
 Use the team’s internal AI tooling to configure contracts in Spotify’s royalty systems and test financial outputs for accuracy before sign-off from Commercial Accounting.
 Lead data analyses to answer royalty questions from internal teams such as Legal & Licensing and Finance, and from external partners such as rightsholders and back offices.
 Support month-end royalty close by reviewing checks, validating calculation outputs, and escalating risks or issues.
 Run month-end analytics, from generating the data and deck to providing commentary on fluxes, to support Content Accounting’s sign-off on final royalty figures.
 Help build new capabilities for the team, contributing directly to how our internal AI tooling evolves as Spotify’s business grows.
 Partner closely with Legal & Licensing, Commercial Accounting, Content Accounting, and Financial Engineering.
Who You Are:
You have a background in Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
 You have 1+ years of experience in a data analyst or technical operations role. Experience in a royalty-related role at a record label, digital service provider, or music publisher is a plus.
 You have strong technical and data analysis skills, such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, or Google Cloud Platform.
 You bring an AI-first approach to problem-solving and are excited to get hands-on building and evolving internal tooling.
 You’re curious about royalties and the music industry, and how Spotify pays the people who create content on our platform. Familiarity with label, publisher, or audiobook contracts, or with DSP data files, is a bonus.
 You’re organized and flexible, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
 You’re a coachable self-starter who enjoys learning new concepts and coordinating across teams to meet deadlines.
 You’re detail-oriented with a high bar for accuracy, because our numbers drive real payouts to rightsholders.
Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
As a Service Shopfloor Supervisor, you will lead daily operations in a highly regulated aviation environment, ensuring capacity, execution, and strict adherence to safety and quality standards across CoE service activities, including MRO and CRO for military and civil components. You will manage daily work assignments, approve time and attendance, and foster a strong team-oriented culture.
This role is responsible for driving shopfloor execution within established operating disciplines, standard practices, and procedures. You will lead lean transformation efforts, optimize processes, equipment, and material flow, and standardize methods to ensure reliable, consistent plant operations and production performance. 
 Job Description 
 Essential responsibilities: 
 Lead and promote a team-based organization focused on specialized, quick-turnaround repair services for internal and external customers
 Coordinate daily shopfloor activities, assigning work, monitoring progress, and ensuring safe and efficient execution across MRO/CRO cells
 Provide technical, quality and production leadership to assigned cells/teams, including support on plant systems, equipment and maintenance activities
 Provide leadership in the areas of training and development, equipment maintenance, process, and procedure implementation
 Communicate with internal/external customers to ensure that all commitments are met
 Provide total shop / group leadership in the attainment of goals with respect to safety, quality, cost, production and compliance
 Provide ongoing supervision and counseling for employees, guiding them in current positions and assisting with career development and training
 Work with customers, functional leaders, and internal staff to meet production and product support requirements
 Facilitate the leadership team in decision-making and problem solving and provide effective communication across the plant
 Provide technical, quality and production leadership to assigned Cells/Teams
 Support Shop Leader in the strategic planning of manpower, equipment and other resources
 Lead and sustain lean transformation initiatives on the shopfloor (e.g. value stream mapping, layout optimization, flow & pull systems, standard work, 5S, visual management)
 Use prior Process Engineering experience to define, validate and improve repair and production processes, including methods, routings, cycle times and tooling
 Partner with Engineering, Quality and Maintenance to improve process capability, reduce variability and ensure robust methods for both civil and military components
 Translate continuous improvement opportunities into structured projects, with clear targets, milestones and measurable impact on SQDC
 Coach the team in problem solving (e.g. PDCA, 8D, root cause analysis) and in the use of Lean and Six Sigma tools
 Be accountable for achieving safety, quality, delivery, cost and compliance targets (SQDC)
 Ensure full adherence to aviation legislation and EASA/EMAR Part 145 requirements, including documentation, traceability and configuration control
 Drive implementation and sustainment of standard work, procedures and visual management on the shopfloor
 Support the Shop Leader in strategic planning of manpower, equipment and other resources needed to sustain capacity and meet production plans
 Contribute to production planning and control, ensuring alignment between load, capacity and material availability
 Facilitate the leadership team in decision-making and problem-solving, and provide effective communication and coordination across the plant
 Required Qualifications: 
 High school diploma, with solid and proven experience in aircraft maintenance gained within EASA Part-145 approved organizations
 Significant experience in coordination or team management roles within technical environments (e.g. Team Leader, Supervisor, Workshop Manager), including managing complex and structured teams
 Hands-on experience in inspection activities, verifying compliance with airworthiness requirements, approved technical data and company procedures
 In-depth knowledge of EASA Part-145 regulations and of industry quality and safety standards
 Proven experience as a Process Engineer and/or Production Supervisor, with responsibility for process definition, industrialization and shopfloor leadership
 Strong knowledge of production, shop operations and production control in a manufacturing environment
 Solid technical understanding of plant systems, equipment and maintenance processes
 Strong ability to plan work activities and manage resources according to production priorities and deadlines
 Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Quality, Engineering, Production and Commercial teams
 Strong continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on standardization, waste elimination and SQDC
 Demonstrated experience leading lean transformation projects, including value stream mapping, layout optimization, standard work, 5S, …

items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 A propos de vos missions 
 L'ingénieur Data Scientist contribue au maintien et à l'amélioration de la qualité des produits fabriqués sur le site de fabrication de Rousset en suivant et optimisant la collecte des mesures réalisées sur les produits et les machines de la salle de fabrication au sein du service Qualité Production du site.
 La mission du poste: 
 Conçoit, réalise et industrialise des solutions/outils software visant l'amélioration de celui-ci sur demande des ingénieurs procédés de fabrication, process control, des fonctions centrales, ou suite à sa propre analyse personnelle. 
 Explore les solutions innovantes pour recouvrer la performance sur les points de vulnérabilité identifiés. 
 Garantit la qualité de la configuration du système de surveillance de fabrication par la définition et l'application rigoureuse des processus de sécurisation.
 Le poste le manière plus concrète: 
 Transforme des données brûtes en informations exploitables pour aider à prendre des décisions plus éclairées. 
 Aide à répondre à des questions comme "Que s'est-il passé ?" (descriptif) et "Pourquoi cela s'est-il? ( diagnostic) 
 Crée des rapports, des tableaux de bord intuitifs correspondant aux besoins des utilisateurs, des analyses sur des problématiques complexes en s'appuyant sur des outils informatiques decisionnels et des méthodes d'analyse descriptives, exploratoires et explicatives des données afin de faciliter la prise de décision et améliorer l'efficacité et l'efficience opérationnelle des processus de l'entreprise
 Intervient en tant qu'expert des bases de données pour integrér des solutions nouvelles qui permettent de piloter de manière plus moderne l'unité de production sans discutinuité de production. Pour cela, identifie les sources données, les collecte dans les bases, les fichiers, ou autres systèmes opérationels. Nettoie, filtre, manipule et transforme les données afin de les rendre utilisables.
 Veille technologique, formation: 
 Se tient au fait des dernières évolutions techniques (machine learning, IA Agentic,…), interagit avec les experts automation, IT, process control, sous-traitants/fournisseurs software avec qui il forme un réseau de travail.
 Identifie et se forme de manière autonome sur les langages dont il a besoin auprès d'autres experts ou en s'inscrivant à des formations ad hoc. Construit des supports de formations pour les utilisateurs et les dispense.
 A propos de vous 
 Diplômé.e d'un Master ou d'une école d'ingénieur
 Leadership sur la gestion des problématiques au travers notamment de l'organisation et la conduite de réunions.
 Capacité de synthèse, facilité de vulgarisation et de présentation de problématiques techniques.
 Expertise technique bases de données (extractions, mise en forme, présentations, analyse), en statistique et régulation.
 Expertise code (Python, SQL, PowerShell, data visualisation, …)
 Connaissance des technologies produites à Rousset et de l'organisation de la fabrication du domaine semi-conducteur.
 Capacité de communication orale et écrite avec les ingénieurs process fabrication et ses pairs des autres sites de part le monde.
 Anglais courant.
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. 
 Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous …

items.title: Application Engineer (F/M/X)
items.card: You will join a unique technology adventure where you will turn our sensors into working solutions in our customers’ systems. As an Application Engineer in the Applications Engineering team, your work will have a direct impact on the success of one of the most promising Deep Tech companies worldwide. The team The Applications Engineering team is the technical bridge between our event-based vision sensors and the
items.desc:
Location: Paris (75011)
 Contract: CDI (permanent), full-time
 Experience: Entry-level (0–2 years, internships and apprenticeships included)
 Start date: ASAP
 Why PROPHESEE?
 Prophesee is pioneering a new generation of machine vision inspired by the human eye and brain. Its breakthrough event-based vision technology enables machines to see and respond to changes with unprecedented speed and efficiency, serving demanding markets including industrial automation, aerospace and defense, autonomous systems, and IoT.
 You will join a unique technology adventure where you will turn our sensors into working solutions in our customers’ systems. As an Application Engineer in the Applications Engineering team, your work will have a direct impact on the success of one of the most promising Deep Tech companies worldwide.
 The team
 The Applications Engineering team is the technical bridge between our event-based vision sensors and the customers who build them into their systems, across industries including industrial automation, security and defense. We turn sensor capabilities into working solutions: we evaluate, prototype, implement and optimize side by side with our customers’ engineering teams. The position is based in our Paris office, with labs on site.
 Mission
 We are looking for a highly motivated to join the team as an Application Engineer with a focus on software and computer vision. The role sits at the intersection of customer engineering, application development and rapid prototyping: you will build demonstrators and proofs-of-concept, write vision software that runs on real hardware, and support customers’ technical evaluations through to integration.
 This position is ideal for a recent graduate with a broad technical foundation (software, optics, electronics, physics) who is strongest in software and computer vision and genuinely enjoys hands-on work. You will be the person who sets up the camera, writes the processing pipeline, tunes the lighting, collects data, debugs what goes wrong and explains the result clearly. Working closely with fellow application engineers and developers, you will master the full customer journey and have plenty of room to build deep expertise in event-based vision and machine vision. 
The role involves regular travel to customer sites and events, in France and internationally.
 Role description
 1. Prototyping and proof-of-concept development
 Build proof-of-concept demonstrators and prototypes that show what our sensors can do in concrete customer use cases, from first idea to working setup.
 Write, test and optimize software in C++ and Python for data acquisition, event and image processing, and computer vision algorithms.
 Assemble and adapt practical test setups (sensors, optics, lighting, mounts, embedded boards) and iterate quickly based on results.
 Turn successful prototypes into reusable sample code, tools and demo applications for the wider team and for customers.
 2. Customer engineering and technical support
 Support customers during evaluation and integration: set up evaluation kits, answer technical questions, and troubleshoot software, data and system-level issues.
 Join customer meetings and site visits to run demonstrations, capture recordings and test data, and validate system performance in real-world environments.
 Analyze application requirements such as speed, latency, dynamic range, resolution and field of view, and help recommend the right sensor, optics and software configuration.
 Reproduce customer issues in the lab and propose solutions involving processing pipelines, algorithm tuning or setup changes.
 3. Cross-functional collaboration
 Work with Sales and senior Application Engineers on the technical side of new opportunities.
 Share field feedback, recorded datasets and lessons learned with application development and product teams to improve our tools and inform the roadmap.
 Document recurring customer challenges, proven solutions and best practices in the internal knowledge base.
 Key deliverables
 Working prototypes, demo applications and proof-of-concept code, with clear documentation of setup and results.
 Technical reports from evaluations and customer visits, including measurements, findings and recommended next steps.
 Application notes, tutorials and training material for customers and internal teams.
 Live demonstrations and technical presentations for customer workshops and trade shows.
 Profile
 Education: Master’s degree (engineering school or university) in computer science, computer vision, electrical engineering, physics, mechatronics or a related field.
 Experience: entry-level; internships, apprenticeships or substantial academic projects count as relevant experience.
 Expertise & experience – required
 Solid programming skills in C++ and/or Python, with hands-on image processing, computer vision or data acquisition projects.
 Familiarity with core computer vision concepts such as filtering, segmentation, feature detection, …

We're looking for someone who demonstrates empathy, sound judgement, attention to detail and a confident approach to problem-solving, with experience or knowledge of complaint handling, regulatory requirements and delivering fair customer outcomes.
 Working within a fast-paced, customer-focused environment, you'll help to navigate a wide variety of complaint scenarios, systems and processes while ensuring compliance with Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) requirements, Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) expectations, Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) principles and relevant Vulnerable Customer guidance, contributing to positive customer experiences, fair outcomes and consistently high standards of complaint resolution.

 Required to evaluate Customer circumstance, inconvenience and distress in order to achieve an appropriate resolution from a wide range of potential options including but not limited to goodwill payments, write offs and non-monetary compensation.
 Negotiate on a regular basis with relevant business areas including external parties in order to reach an appropriate multi-partite resolution ensuring the best outcome for the customer.
 Manage the diagnostic and triage processes across multiple channels in order to effectively categorise, route and prioritise cases.
 Manage cases by accurately reporting and logging all actions through company systems in order to support root cause analysis and reporting requirements. 
 Accountable for sending all regulated correspondence to the customer within FCA timelines (e.g. acknowledgement letter, holding letter and final response letter).

La qualité du Wi-Fi domestique constitue l’un des leviers essentiels de cette ambition, mais elle dépend fortement de la couverture du logement, du nombre d’équipements présents et de leur configuration. Dans certains foyers, un seul routeur doit couvrir l’ensemble du logement ; dans d’autres, des répéteurs sont installés sans disposer d’une vision précise de leur positionnement ou de leur contribution réelle à la qualité du réseau. L’objectif de ce stage est de concevoir et d’alimenter un observatoire de la qualité de service Wi-Fi domestique à partir des données générées par les Livebox, les répéteurs Wi-Fi et les équipements connectés, dans le respect de la vie privée et des exigences du RGPD. Cet observatoire devra permettre de mieux caractériser les situations rencontrées dans les foyers, d’améliorer leur suivi et de soutenir la prise de décision, jusqu’à la formulation de recommandations concrètes pour les clients. Le stage s’articulera autour de trois étapes, approfondies et priorisées avec le ou la stagiaire : Définir les besoins opérationnels, en collaboration avec les experts Wi-Fi, les data scientists et les équipes produit d’Orange : situations à observer, indicateurs pertinents, niveaux de diagnostic attendus et solutions pouvant être proposées aux clients ; Transformer les données disponibles en indicateurs utiles, en s’appuyant sur les besoins identifiés lors de la première phase. Il s’agira notamment de caractériser l’écosystème Wi-Fi des foyers, de suivre la qualité de service et d’identifier les configurations ou situations susceptibles de nécessiter une action ; Exploiter ces indicateurs pour améliorer le diagnostic et la prise de décision, en construisant une typologie des situations rencontrées et en associant à chacune des recommandations actionnables : repositionnement d’un équipement, ajout d’un répéteur ou correction d’une configuration. Le ou la stagiaire analysera les données déjà disponibles et caractérisées dans l’environnement Orange, développera, si nécessaire, des méthodes statistiques et des modèles de machine learning, puis évaluera la pertinence des indicateurs et des recommandations produites. Cette évaluation sera menée d’abord hors ligne, puis, lorsque cela sera possible, dans le cadre d’un test terrain auprès d’une cohorte de foyers volontaires afin d’en mesurer l’impact réel. En lien étroit avec les ingénieurs spécialistes du Wi-Fi, les data scientists et les équipes produit, le ou la stagiaire contribuera ainsi à produire un socle d’indicateurs, de diagnostics et de recommandations susceptible de soutenir de futures industrialisations et d’améliorer l’expérience Wi-Fi des clients Orange. Vous préparez un diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master 2, dans les domaines des mathématiques appliquées, de la Data Science ou de l'informatique. Vous avez de solides connaissances en Python et êtes à l'aise avec son écosystème de librairies pour le traitement et l'analyse de données (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) et pour le machine learning (Scikit-Learn). La curiosité pour les systèmes et les réseaux (TCP/IP, Wi-Fi) est un plus très apprécié - aucune connaissance préalable en radio n'est exigée. Une première expérience d'un environnement cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) et un intérêt pour les enjeux éthiques et de confidentialité des données seront valorisés. Nous attendrons de vous de la rigueur scientifique, de la curiosité pour les données et des aptitudes à la recherche expérimentale. Ce sujet vous placera à l'intersection de la data science et des technologies de réseaux sans fil, sur un problème que chacun ressent chez soi. Vous travaillerez sur des données d'opérateur uniques par leur ampleur et leur granularité - le réseau vu de l'intérieur - encadrées par une expertise reconnue. Le stage vise un impact mesurable, au cœur du plan stratégique du groupe Orange « Trust The Future » : un diagnostic validé sur le terrain, des solutions susceptibles d'être industrialisées pour améliorer la qualité perçue par des millions de clients. Vous interagirez régulièrement avec nos ingénieurs radio, nos data scientists et les équipes produit, et vos contributions pourront donner lieu à des activités de valorisation (publications, poursuites en thèse). Vous rejoindrez les équipes d'Orange Innovation Networks, un pôle stratégique au cœur de …

As our Junior Data & AI Solution Developer , you will build the data connections, platforms and solutions that make this possible, working from the first conversation about a problem through to production. You will work closely with the team across projects and gradually take on greater ownership, with the opportunity to lead AI projects end-to-end, from idea and design through development, implementation and business adoption. Projects could include bringing different data sources into Microsoft Fabric, creating semantic models that give teams consistent figures, or connecting AI agents to reliable information. The work takes business understanding as well as technical skill: asking the right questions, explaining technical choices clearly and making sure what you build works reliably for the people using it. Create trusted, reusable data products and foundations that support analytics, AI and other solutions. Build and experiment with AI agents and agentic solutions that use business data, context and tools to support workflows and decision-making. Support solutions after deployment through governance, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement This is not a traditional data role focused primarily on reporting or maintaining pipelines. It is for someone who enjoys connecting data, platforms and applied AI to build solutions that create real business value and run reliably in production. What you bring A technical foundation in data engineering, data science, software development or a related field, gained through studies, work or hands-on projects. An interest in solving business problems, asking good questions and building solutions that work in practice. items.desc: Published : 2026-11-09 Department R&D Nils Foss Allé 1 3400 Hillerød Country Denmark Do you want to develop X-ray-based measurement systems? As our new R&D Scientist, you will help develop FOSS’ X-ray-based instruments. You will become a specialist in our DEXA technology and be part of the full development cycle, from early feasibility studies, through integrated product development, and all the way to handover to operations. What you will be doing As a leader within food analytics, FOSS has a global impact through solutions that ensure fair payment, enable optimized use of our agricultural resources, and detect adulteration and food safety threats. This is enabled by technologies with the right balance of performance, robustness, and price. You will become part of the team responsible for developing FOSS’ technologies within bioanalysis, FT-IR, and X-ray. The role requires both a drive for in-depth specialization within X-ray technology and an aptitude for interdisciplinary collaboration. You will work closely with another X-ray scientist as well as with data scientists, mechanical and electrical engineers, software developers, and departments outside R&D to develop complete solutions. A key part of the role is having a technical overview of the entire measurement system and understanding its interfaces with the rest of the instrument. In the early phases of a project, feasibility studies often involve a mix of first-principles understanding and small-scale lab tests to clarify technical risks and guide architectural choices for the detection system. In later project phases, development typically takes place in large, multidisciplinary teams. In addition, you will handle ad hoc tasks such as maintaining our current products and supporting our production and service departments. Finally, as safety is central to working with X-ray-based systems, your responsibilities will also include understanding regulatory requirements regarding radiation safety. Success in this role requires the ability to plan, coordinate, and communicate effectively with project members and stakeholders, along with a structured approach to troubleshooting. What we hope to see you bring You have an M.Sc. degree in engineering physics, physics, or similar and most likely a Ph.D. You have proven results from experimental work and experience with several of the following topics: X-ray technology, in particular absorptiometry Building instruments or experimental setups Data analysis in Python or Matlab Planning and executing experiments It is an advantage if you also have experience with cross-disciplinary work and/or communicating with other disciplines. As a person you are structured, self-driven, and collaborative. Why choose FOSS? We offer a motivating job in an international, dynamic, and innovative organization. We are market leaders within our field and very proud of the results we deliver. Innovation is the foundation for FOSS’ success and we therefore have a strong focus on R&D. FOSS is small enough that your work has real influence and big enough to offer career development. The daily work takes place in an informal and cross-disciplinary environment offering exciting tasks and the possibility to learn new things every day. The job is on-site at FOSS Innovation Center in Hillerød, Denmark. We would love to hear from you! If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to a purpose-driven organization, we would love to hear from you. Submit your application . If you have any questions, please contact Head of Bioanalysis, FTIR and X-ray Christer Zoffmann Bisgaard (+45 22164256 or czb@foss.dk). We look forward to receiving your application! FOSS is committed to maintaining an inclusive and diverse culture. You can help us sustain an unbiased recruitment process by not including photo and age in your application. FOSS Today, more than 8 billion people around the world are dependent on nutritional food. Tons of food being produced in a million different ways and under varying conditions, creating challenges all the way from field to fork. One of them, obviously, is the effect it has on climate change. FOSS helps the world’s 100 biggest food companies, and more than 40,000 others around the world navigate exactly that with intelligent, data-driven and innovative analytical solutions. We are making sustainability a better business, and we’re doing so as the global market leader in our field – improving food quality, minimizing food waste, ensuring food safety, and securing fair payment. Join a pioneering and innovative company in the food and agriculture industry. A company on a mission, with offices all around the world and 1,750 talented colleagues across 34 different countries.

items.desc: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai. What you'll work on You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work. Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions. Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks. Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements. Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs. Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. Help build AI agents for GPU engineering , enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements. Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation. What we're looking for We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems. Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm. Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks. Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads. Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results. Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering. Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable. A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required. Location and availability Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France. We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position. We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

Hoe ga jij bijdragen aan de energietransitie? Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van schaalbare dataplatformen en pipelines (batch en streaming), in Energietransitie-vraagstukken. Integreren van databronnen: IoT, netwerken, cloudservices, assetdata, ERP, CRM en open data. Optimaliseren van dataopslag, verwerking en ontsluiting voor dashboards, applicaties en analyses. Inrichten van CI/CD pipelines en geautomatiseerde testen voor dataproducten. Zorgen voor stabiele datakwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en performance. Intensief samenwerken met Data Scientists (modelontwikkeling & data-preparatie), Software Engineers (integratie & applicaties) en Security-experts (data governance, privacy, cybersecurity). Bijdragen aan invulling van Data Governance en security-standaarden. Waarom Infiniot? Infiniot werkt al ruim 10 jaar mee aan de energietransitie in Nederland. Door onze specifiek focus op energiesystemen werken wij vooral bij klanten in de vitale infrastructuren en energietransitie. Hierdoor hebben wij de kennis en zorgt onze unieke focus voor een omgeving met collega’s die pionier zijn op deze onderwerpen! We trainen in onze Energy Academy op nog meer verdieping op Energietransitie-kennis. Daarbij geloven wij dat data de motor is van de energietransitie . Bij Infiniot werk je aan oplossingen die het datafundament leggen voor oplossingen als: betrouwbaarder netbeheer, slimme infrastructuren en toekomstbestendige innovaties. We bieden ruimte voor innovatie, verantwoordelijkheid en persoonlijke groei – samen met collega’s uit Data Science, Software Engineering en Security. Wat breng je mee als Data Engineer? Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Data Engineer. Ervaring met cloudplatformen (Azure en/of AWS, evt. GCP). Kennis van moderne data-architecturen : event-driven, microservices, data lakes of lakehouses. Ervaring met streaming technologieën (Kafka, Pulsar, Flink, Spark Streaming). Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL (Scala of Java is een pré). Ervaring met relationele, NoSQL- en time-series databases. Ervaring met ETL/ELT -tools (zoals Matillion) Ervaring met Cloud data warehouses (zoals Snowflake) Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code (bijv. Terraform of Bicep) Ervaring met Databricks en DBT is een pré. Bekend met CI/CD en containertechnologie (Docker, Kubernetes). Affiniteit met datakwaliteit, security en schaalbaarheid. Oprechte interesse in techniek en de energietransitie Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams. Goede beheersing van Nederlands (minimaal C1) en Engels (minimaal B2). Wat kun je verwachten als Data Engineer bij Infiniot? Uitdagende projecten op het snijvlak van data, vitale infrastructuur, energietransitie en duurzaamheid. Werken in een gemotiveerd team met Data Scientists, Software Engineers en Security- experts. Moderne tooling en infrastructuur om mee te werken bij onze klanten. Veel ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling, training en certificering in onze Energy Academy. Keuze van eigen laptop Leaseauto, Businesscard en/of Mobiliteitsvergoeding Boven marktconform salaris en bonusregeling Hybride werken op onze kantoren in Eindhoven of Utrecht, flexibele uren en aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden. Regelmatig teamdagen en borrels met het hele team, interessante sprekers en leuke sportieve activiteiten We werken volgens onze cultuurwaarden: korte communicatielijnen, informeel, ruimte voor innovatie, passie voor techniek, flexibel, ondernemend en hechte samenwerking. Dit vertaalt zich natuurlijk in een prettige werksfeer in een snel veranderend energielandschap. Acquisitie door wervingsbureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld, wij werken met geselecteerde recruiters. items.desc: Do you want to contribute to improving human health? The Department of Laboratory Medicine consists of seven divisions that conduct both research and teaching. The department is involved in advanced research, encompassing both basic and applied research. All divisions operate in close collaboration with clinicians at the Karolinska University Hospital. The Division of Biomolecular and Cellular Medicine (BCM) focuses on the use of modified biomolecules, cells, and cell products as new therapeutic agents, as well as the identification and study of suitable biomolecular and cellular targets for therapy and diagnostics. The division is also connected to the Karolinska ATMP Center. The research group of the EL Andaloussi lab is tackling one of the most critical challenges in modern therapeutics: the efficient delivery of macromolecules to target cells in vivo. Despite major advancements in disease understanding and mechanism exploration, many promising therapeutic approaches remain inaccessible in clinical settings due to a lack of effective delivery systems. To address this, we focus on pioneering novel drug delivery technologies that enable the safe and efficient transport of proteins, RNAs, and gene editors to specific tissues. The lab has established expertise in engineering extracellular vesicles (EVs) such as exosomes, which are optimized for therapeutic delivery and targeting. In our efforts to push boundaries, we also explore other advanced delivery systems, including lipid nanoparticles, to address distinct therapeutic challenges. The lab’s therapeutics platform utilizes biological and synthetic nanoparticles for the targeted delivery of therapeutic agents in relevant cellular and animal models, identifying the most effective approaches for diverse applications. The Division of Biomolecular and Cellular Medicine is seeking a research assistant with a strong background and hands-on experience in nanoparticle analytics. This role is part of a recently established, grant-funded team led by André Görgens. Building on a decade of experience with a strong track record of assay and method development for extracellular vesicle characterization and process development, the Görgens lab is now aiming to develop a next-generation nanoparticle analytics and sorting platform in close collaboration with the EL Andaloussi lab. One of the main aims of the Görgens lab is to build a dedicated platform for the high-resolution analysis and sorting of Extracellular Vesicles through utilizing flow cytometric and orthogonal methods. Your mission We are seeking an ambitious researcher to develop methods for analysis and sorting of Extracellular Vesicles and other nanoparticles, with a focus on developing flow cytometry-based workflows and procedures, optimizing pre-analytical variables for body fluid and cell-derived Extracellular Vesicles as well as for synthetic nanoparticles, in context of development of next generation therapies and diagnostics. Your profile The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in biochemistry, biotechnology, bioinformatics, or process development in context of drug development or engineering, ideally with experience in nanoparticle flow cytometry and flow cytometric cell sorting, nanoparticle formulation, or related fields in nanoparticle preparation and analysis. The candidate must: Have a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related field, with ongoing or completed advanced studies in Medical Biotechnology or a similar area. Have hands-on experience in essential laboratory techniques, such as PCR, DNA/RNA extraction, molecular cloning, bacterial transformation, protein purification, western blotting, cytofluorimetric analysis, or immunofluorescence. Have hands-on experience and knowledge of flow cytometry-based methods (e.g., flow cytometry analysis or fluorescence activated cell sorting, in context of cells or nanoparticles. This also must include experience using fluorescent probes to label nanoparticles and knowledge of pre-analytical parameter choices). Have experience with other relevant analytical techniques (e.g., DLS, NTA, electron microscopy). Have relevant experience in production and formulation of biological or synthetic nanoparticles, e.g. in context of biomarker discovery or drug delivery. Be proficient in English, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with a passion for contributing to therapeutic advancements and tackling scientific challenges as well as the ability to work independently. What do we offer? A creative and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. Karolinska Institutet …

The applicant should have HCPC registration and experience of working in a radiotherapy physics department. The successful applicant will join a team of clinical scientists and practitioners involved with the delivery and development of the national proton beam therapy service which has been treating patients at The Christie since December 2018. The proton therapy team is required to support the development of new treatment sites, including clinical trials, whilst maintaining a treatment planning and dosimetry service for increasing patient numbers. All members of the team are encouraged to present new ideas to improve the service and will be supported to develop them by the whole team. Though previous proton experience is more than welcome we appreciate that as a highly specialised service in the UK, applicants may not have much experience in this area. Training and development will be provided for those looking for a new challenge and to build on existing radiotherapy experience. Physicists in the proton therapy physics team are involved with all aspects of the service including treatment planning and checking, machine QC, patient-specific verification and peer review of proton therapy cases with the wider multi-disciplinary team. Treatment planning is performed for both proton and photon treatments to be used in contingency scenarios. In addition there is the opportunity to undertake self-directed project work in alignment with the group’s overall objectives. We have a close working relationship with the University of Manchester’s proton research groups and other centres which provide opportunity for academic collaboration. Everyone in the team is encouraged to undertake further development and education and time will be protected within the work schedule to enable this. The proton therapy physics team includes physicists, radiographers and technologists who all play an active role in supporting and developing the proton service. We work very closely with other clinical teams such as treatment and pre-treatment radiographers and clinical oncologists to deliver the routine service and to collaborate on project work leading to presentation and publication. We have an active education programme to deliver teaching and training locally, nationally and globally. The team’s duties include early and late working, but flexible working and homeworking arrangements are supported to promote a healthy work-life balance for all team members. The Christie is one of Europe’s leading cancer centres, looking after more than 64,000 patients a year. We are based in Manchester and serve a population of 3.2 million across Greater Manchester & Cheshire, but as a national specialist around 25% patients are referred to us from other parts of the country. We are the largest radiotherapy provider in the NHS with one in 20 treatments delivered at The Christie. We have up to 15 linear accelerators operating across our network of sites. We operate the largest chemotherapy unit in the UK on our main site and treatments are also provided at 13 other networked sites, and in patients homes. And as a specialist tertiary surgical centre, we focus on rare cancers, complex procedures, and multidisciplinary approaches to cancer surgery, specialising in colorectal, peritoneal, gynaecological, urological and plastic surgery. We are also an international leader in research, with world first breakthroughs for over 100 years. We have been named by the UK’s National Institute for Health Research (NIHR), as one of the best hospitals providing opportunities for patients to participate in clinical research studies, with more than 800 studies open at any time, caring for over 3,000 patients. How can intelligence emerge when a brain and body interact, rather than being designed separately? A new Leverhulme Trust-funded project at the University of Reading, led by Dr Yoshikatsu Hayashi, will explore how intelligence could emerge from interactions between soft materials, a robotic body and its environment. Engineers usually design a robot’s controller and body separately, then connect them, i.e., brain controls body. Living organisms develop from a single cell. As an animal grows, without 'watch maker', its nervous system and body continually influence each other to adapt to changing environments. Body movement generates sensory feedback, which shapes the neural networks controlling future actions. Through this ongoing signalling, behaviours such as crawling, walking, and a goal-oriented behaviour can emerge. Neural communication fundamentally relies on the movement of charged particles called ions. Interestingly, ions also flow through water-rich hydrogels, where polymer networks can guide their movement. Could this provide a primitive form of electrical communication without neurons? Previous research demonstrated that electroactive gels could improve their performance in the computer game Pong through feedback, suggesting that soft matter can exhibit adaptive behaviour without living neurons. By exploring how brain-like control and body movement might emerge together from physical matter, the research aims to uncover fundamental principles of Physical AI and inspire future generations of intelligent soft robots. Curious about the science? Read about the fascinating 'Gel Brain' research in Nature: https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-024-02704-y Working with Dr Yoshikatsu Hayashi, you will develop and characterise electroactive hydrogel systems, integrate them with soft robotic platforms and sensorimotor feedback, and investigate the emergence of gait and goal-directed learning. The role provides opportunities for interdisciplinary research, computational modelling, international collaboration and high-quality publications. You will have: A PhD (awarded or near completion) in physics, engineering, soft matter, materials science, or a closely related field. Research experience in at least one of nonlinear dynamics, electroactive/active soft matter, soft robotics, or machine learning. Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively across disciplines. Experience with soft matter physics, hydrogels, multi-electrode measurements, embedded control, reinforcement learning or reservoir computing is desirable, but not all are required. items.desc: Associate Publisher Are you passionate about scholarly publishing and excited by the opportunity to shape the future of academic research? Would you enjoy building strong partnerships with editors, societies, and research communities while driving the development of a portfolio of influential journals? About our Team Our STMJ (Science, Technology, and Medical Journals) team publishes high-quality, peer-reviewed research that drives progress across scientific and medical disciplines. We collaborate closely with authors, editors, reviewers, and societies to ensure the integrity and impact of the published work. Through innovation in editorial workflows and publishing technology, we help global research communities discover, evaluate, and disseminate knowledge that advances science and improves lives. You will join a team of 10 publishers, led by a Publishing Director, who together look after around 150 journals in the life sciences or social sciences/economics space. About the Role As an Associate Publisher, you will manage a portfolio of journals and work closely with editors, editorial boards, societies, and research communities to support their development and long-term success. The role combines relationship building, strategic thinking, data analysis, and a strong interest in academic publishing and the evolving scholarly communications landscape. Responsibilities Follow the market. Keep up to date with developments in publishing and research, and identify where there are needs and opportunities for your journals and the communities that they serve. Set portfolio strategy. Use market knowledge and data analysis to develop a strategy that meets STMJ targets and keeps your journals competitive. You will need experience gathering, presenting and interpreting data. Develop the portfolio. Grow content through existing journals and through acquisitions, and look at new content formats, extensions and channels. Manage contracts with editors. Negotiate and manage contractual relationships with journal editors. Manage budgets. Look after the editorial fees budget. Build relationships. Stay in regular contact with editors and editorial boards, and engage with research institutes, societies, funding bodies and others in the research community. Contribute to wider projects. Take part in projects across STMJ and in other parts of Elsevier that need STMJ input. These might be pilots of a new product, service or business model, or improvements to how we work. Requirements Experience in publishing, ideally in scholarly journals is preferable, but not essential. Evidence that you have set goals and met them, and that your work made a difference to a journal or programme. Excellent networking and communication skills in English. The ability to adapt to change, manage several responsibilities at once, and work well both independently and with colleagues and customers at different levels, in different locations and from different cultures, often to deadlines. A data-driven approach and an interest in how publishing is changing. Financial and commercial awareness, and an eye for how a journal can develop. Good judgment when using AI tools, including knowing when output can be relied on and when it needs checking. Willingness to travel, on average 2 to 4 trips per year. Work in a Way That Works for You We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working Pattern Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. About the Business A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world. We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location. We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1-855-833-5120.
