items.desc: About the Team We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers. We're looking for a Junior Cybersecurity Specialist to join our Security Team . This role sits within the engineering direction of our cross-functional Security team, focused on identifying and helping mitigate security issues, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities related to corporate infrastructure. In this role, you'll work closely with infrastructure teams (Admins, NOC, OPS, IT Compliance) and business employees who require security-related help. We work in Agile (2-week sprints, grooming, planning, retro) and use Google Meet, Slack, TargetProcess and Confluence for teamwork. Working hours: Business hours, EET/EEST time zone. You'll work with a modern stack and grow within the company - including cloud and hybrid infrastructure, and AI applied to real security work. Tech Stack: Splunk, CheckPoint, Rapid7, AWS, OpenStack, Gitlab, K8s, Terraform, Ansible, Python, Linux, Windows, macOS. Tasks Proceed with requests and notifications related to the security (access management, security tool notifications, vulnerability assessment, etc.); Identify and help mitigate security issues, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities related to corporate infrastructure; Develop, implement new, and update existing security measures for the protection of corporate infrastructure; Support the identity and access management process; Formation of a knowledge base for the operation of products and services; Assist the security analytics with the incident response process; Collaboration with the Ops and Infrastructure teams in terms of asset security. Requirements 1+ year of experience in server administration, network engineering, site reliability engineering, infrastructure security, cloud security, or systems engineering; Knowledge of the Linux, Windows, and Mac operating systems and common OS hardening practices; Technical knowledge of network protection and network Device Hardening; Automation skills (Bash, Python); Understanding how computer attacks occur; Passion for developing in cybersecurity; Ability to work in a team, listen, and learn independently; Competent written and verbal communication skills (Russian C1 and English B1); Have a good analytical mindset for problem-solving. Nice to have Background in cybersecurity; Experience using AI tooling for technical/cybersecurity tasks; Experience in vulnerability analysis; Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, Chef, etc.); Understanding the tactics and techniques of intruders and how to defend against them. We offer Full-time remote work (service provider contract). Competitive compensation (EUR). Flexible working hours. Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.). Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency. A strong team of engineers. Positive and friendly atmosphere. With a team of 500+ creative and tech-driven people across the globe, Quadcode is the place where ideas turn into impact, where every project is a chance to grow, innovate, and make your mark. Join us today, and let's shape the future of fintech together! Note: All applications will be treated with strict confidence. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. #LI-JM1

Accompagner la transformation digitale Développer les usages Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot). Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation. Ingénieur en systèmes d'information, informatique industrielle ou génie industriel, vous justifiez d'au moins 5 années d'expérience en environnement industriel. Maîtrise de Microsoft 365 et des outils collaboratifs. Connaissance de Power BI, SQL ou Power Platform appréciée. Curiosité pour les sujets liés à l'automatisation et à l'intelligence artificielle. Notre environnement Sylob, Nibelis, Lucanet, Power BI, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, GEDIX (MES), NX, TopSolid et Mastercam. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste clé au cœur de la transformation numérique du groupe. Une forte proximité avec les équipes terrain et les directions. Des projets concrets avec un impact direct sur la performance des sites. Une grande autonomie et un périmètre d'action varié. L'opportunité de construire les futurs usages autour de la donnée, de l'automatisation et de l'intelligence artificielle.

items.desc: About VitVio VitVio is building AI-powered tools to simplify and streamline operating room workflows, so surgical teams can focus on what really matters—patient care. Our platform uses computer vision and context-aware AI to understand actions happening in the OR in real time. From automatically logging surgical stages to coordinating team readiness, we take on the administrative load so clinical staff don’t have to.‍ Our team has experience founding and scaling leading companies in adjacent industries. We're growing quickly, backed by top-tier investors, and working with some of the most respected hospitals in the US and Europe. About the Opportunity We're looking for a Fullstack Software Engineer who is a frontend specialist to join our experienced engineering team. This role blends deep technical work on the frontend with people leadership and offers the chance to build tools used directly in surgical care. This role is remote-first, and open to candidates based in Europe and the US, we prioritize talent over everything else. Some international travel is required to visit hospitals, observe workflows, and co-design with clinical users. What You’ll Do Like all our engineers, you will work across the stack on systems used by hospital staff in high-stakes environments. From RFD to deployment, you’ll take ownership of features, propose creative improvements, and ship clean, reliable code with confidence. As a frontend specialist, we will lean on you to define our frontend strategy to maintain high iteration speed while supporting a wide range of devices. You will ensure high quality in the frontend while facilitating contributions from all engineers. In your first 6 months, you will: Work closely with our design team to implement our design system Modularise the frontend code to make it testable and mobile-ready Mentor good frontend habits to onboard software team to the structures you are putting in place Deliver weekly enhancements or fixes with high quality and near-zero regressions Contribute to product development through structured feedback, prototyping, and testing Own and ship projects end-to-end across our product and machine learning teams You’ll work across a diverse stack: Frontend : React, TypeScript Backend : Elixir (Phoenix), C++ Infrastructure : GCP, GitHub Actions, NixOS Data : Postgres, ETL pipelines APIs : GraphQL, REST, integrations with healthcare systems (e.g. HL7/FHIR) Although we are looking for extensive frontend and mobile experience, we don’t expect you to have deep experience in each tool and language — but we’re looking for curiosity and adaptability. We support engineers in learning new tools as needed. So, if you don’t have experience with some of the tech above, no problem, we’d still love you to apply! You Might Be a Great Fit If You… You have architected and implemented highly maintainable and reliable web apps that work across devices You have built and maintained design systems Are a well-rounded engineer with experience and interest across the stack (our philosophy is for all engineers to contribute to all repositories) Are known for clean, reliable code and proactive communication Take the initiative: when something’s broken, you fix it or raise it Think in systems and edge cases, but you move quickly and pragmatically Thrive in team settings that value candid discussions, curiosity, and mutual respect Include the word ‘reactor’ in your application (to let us know you’ve read this) Find purpose in building software that solves real problems for real people We don’t expect you to know all of our stack or match every bullet here — we care more about how you think, learn, and collaborate. Benefits Early-Stage Equity Competitive salary Company laptop along with tools you need to succeed Learning & development budget Offsites and team-building events Flexible PTO Hiring Process Review: Submit your application First Call (30 min): A call with our CTO to talk through your current/past experience, your motivations and tell you more about VitVio. Meet with our CEO (30 min): You’ll speak to our CEO to see if the magic is there. Coding Interview (90 mins): You’ll be working with two of our team members through a coding exercise. Career Deep Dive (90 mins): Our CTO will go with you through your achievements and learnings of your career so far. Design Interview (90 mins): You’ll be showing us how you are working with designers and how you have solved design challenges in the past Offer

items.desc: Catégorie: Data Engineering Type: Temps Plein Localisation: Paris Astrelya est un cabinet de conseil franco‑suisse, en très forte croissance depuis sa création en 2017, spécialisé dans la transformation digitale, l’excellence opérationnelle et l’innovation technologique. Il est composé de plus de 300 experts passionnés. Le cabinet accompagne ses clients sur l’ensemble du cycle de transformation, depuis la phase de cadrage jusqu’à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, avec une expertise forte en Data/IA, Cloud, DevOps et méthodes agiles. Astrelya se distingue par un modèle fondé sur la proximité, la confiance et une culture humaine forte, qui place les collaborateurs au cœur de la création de valeur. Votre Mission : En tant que Machine Learning Platform Engineer (MLOps Engineer), vous intervenez au sein des équipes Data & IA de nos clients afin d’industrialiser, déployer et exploiter des solutions de Machine Learning à grande échelle. À la croisée des mondes Data Science, Data Engineering et DevOps, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la mise en production des modèles et la fiabilisation des plateformes ML. Concrètement, vous allez : Industrialiser les pipelines Machine Learning en automatisant les phases d’entraînement, de validation et de déploiement des modèles. Mettre en place des chaînes CI/CD/CT garantissant des mises en production fiables, reproductibles et sans intervention manuelle. Déployer et servir les modèles en production via des APIs temps réel, traitements batch ou architectures streaming. Containeriser les applications avec Docker et orchestrer les déploiements sur Kubernetes. Assurer le versioning des modèles, la gestion des environnements, ainsi que les mécanismes de rollback. Mettre en place le monitoring des modèles et des données afin de détecter les phénomènes de Data Drift et Model Drift. Surveiller les performances opérationnelles des modèles : latence, disponibilité, qualité des prédictions et consommation des ressources. Automatiser les stratégies de ré-entraînement en fonction des indicateurs de performance et des seuils métiers. Garantir la reproductibilité des expérimentations en versionnant les données, features, modèles et métriques. Optimiser les infrastructures de calcul et les coûts d’exploitation des plateformes ML (CPU, GPU, autoscaling, cloud). Mettre en œuvre les bonnes pratiques DevOps et SRE : tests automatisés, observabilité, alerting et gestion des incidents. Collaborer étroitement avec les Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers et équipes Cloud/DevOps. Participer à l’amélioration continue des plateformes Data & IA et à la définition des standards MLOps. Qui êtes-vous ? Vous disposez d’une expérience significative en MLOps, Machine Learning Engineering, Data Engineering ou DevOps appliqué à la Data. Vous maîtrisez Python ainsi que les pratiques d’industrialisation des modèles de Machine Learning. Vous avez une expérience concrète des environnements Kubernetes et Docker. Vous avez déjà déployé et maintenu des modèles de Machine Learning en production. Vous maîtrisez les concepts de CI/CD et l’automatisation des pipelines de déploiement. Vous êtes familier des problématiques de monitoring, d’observabilité et de gouvernance des modèles. Vous comprenez les enjeux liés au Cloud, à l’optimisation des coûts et à la scalabilité des plateformes Data. Vous appréciez travailler dans des environnements complexes nécessitant une forte collaboration transverse. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre capacité à résoudre des problématiques techniques à fort impact. La maîtrise de l’anglais professionnel constitue un réel atout. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un terrain de jeu pour progresser : Formations, certifications, coaching technique, communautés d’expertise (Data, Cloud, DevOps, IA…), participation à des projets innovants autour du Machine Learning, de l’IA Générative, des plateformes Data et de l’industrialisation des modèles. Un cadre de travail motivant : Projets stratégiques auprès de grands comptes, événements internes réguliers, afterworks, ateliers techniques, participation à des conférences et salons spécialisés (Big Data & AI Paris, Devoxx, Kubernetes Community Days, Data + AI Summit…). Un engagement RSE fort : Ecovadis Gold, signataire de la Charte pour la diversité, du Pacte des Nations Unies, et mise en place du mécénat de compétences. Votre futur process de recrutement : Entretien RH avec une de nos chargées de recrutement Test technique (échange avec un expert Data/Cloud ou étude de cas MLOps) Entretien final avec un de nos managers Chez Astrelya, nous construisons des solutions innovantes… mais surtout, nous construisons des parcours humains. Prêt(e) à rejoindre l’aventure ? Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. #recrutement #mlops #machinelearning #machinelearningengineer #platformengineering #kubernetes #docker #mlflow #cloud #devops #dataengineering #data #ia #artificialintelligence #astrelya

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Le Groupement Les Mousquetaires, ce sont 7 enseignes de la grande distribution portées haut et fort par plus de 3 000 chefs d'entreprise indépendants ! Ce sont aussi 150 000 collaborateurs mobilisés autour de notre modèle unique de producteurs et commerçants. Et nous en sommes fiers ! Dans toutes les fonctions au service des points de vente, de la logistique à l'immobilier, en passant par l'industrie agroalimentaire ou l'informatique, nos équipes font nos succès. Chez Intermarché & Netto (ITM AI) les enseignes alimentaires du Groupement, notre goût d'entreprendre, notre indépendance et la diversité de nos métiers nous permettent d'avoir un impact sur toute la chaîne de production pour répondre aux nouvelles attentes des consommateurs. Chaque jour, nos équipes réunissent leurs compétences autour de la table pour faire vivre notre mission : "Ensemble, agissons pour placer le mieux manger à la portée de tous". Envie de vous engager concrètement dans l'action avec nous pour relever nos défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain ? Parlons-en très vite ! Description du poste Au sein de la Direction E-commerce , nous recherchons un Data Analyst F/H en CDI. Rattaché(e) au Lead Product Analytics , vous accompagnez les équipes métiers dans l'exploitation et la valorisation de la donnée afin d'éclairer la prise de décision, piloter la performance et identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance. Véritable expert(e) de l'analyse de données, vous transformez les données brutes en insights actionnables et formulez des recommandations permettant d'accompagner les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles des métiers. Concrètement, quelles seront vos missions ? 1. Accompagner les métiers dans l'analyse et le pilotage de leur performance En collaboration avec les équipes Produit, E-commerce, Data et les différentes directions de l'entreprise. Réaliser des analyses approfondies afin d'identifier les facteurs de performance, les opportunités d'optimisation et les axes d'amélioration. Mesurer l'impact des actions, projets et évolutions produits mises en œuvre. Identifier les causes des écarts de performance et proposer des recommandations adaptées. Produire des analyses permettant d'orienter les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles. Accompagner les métiers dans la compréhension des résultats et la prise de décision fondée sur la donnée. 2. Concevoir et faire évoluer les outils de pilotage Construire, maintenir et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord et reportings sous Power BI. Définir, mettre en place et fiabiliser les indicateurs de performance. Garantir la cohérence, la qualité et la pertinence des données restituées. Automatiser les reportings et analyses afin d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle. Assurer une restitution claire et accessible des données auprès des utilisateurs. 3. Exploiter, fiabiliser et valoriser les données Interroger et exploiter les bases de données à l'aide de requêtes SQL. Collecter, structurer et consolider des données issues de différentes sources. Contrôler la qualité des données et identifier les éventuelles anomalies. Participer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques, outils et processus liés à la donnée. Qualifications Et si vos compétences venaient nourrir notre mission ? Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure Bac+5 en Data, Informatique, Statistiques, Mathématiques appliquées ou École d'Ingénieur, vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans l'analyse de données. Vous maîtrisez SQL et êtes capable d'interroger, manipuler et exploiter des bases de données volumineuses. Vous possédez une solide expérience en création de tableaux de bord et en datavisualisation, notamment sur Power BI. Vous connaissez les environnements Databricks et les outils modernes d'exploitation de la donnée. Vous êtes à l'aise avec l'analyse de données chiffrées, la construction d'indicateurs de performance et la mesure de résultats. Vous disposez idéalement d'une bonne connaissance des environnements e-commerce ou retail. Une expérience acquise en cabinet de conseil ou au sein d'une équipe Data constituera un réel atout. Votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre force de proposition seront des atouts essentiels à votre réussite. Une expérience dans les secteurs du e-commerce, de la grande distribution ou de la logistique serait un plus ! Informations supplémentaires Package : Statut Cadre Salaire fixe + 13e mois Prime sur objectifs Prime d'intéressement et participation 2 jours/semaine de télétravail Le siège des Mousquetaires, c'est : Plusieurs lieux de restauration Une salle de sport gratuite et un parcours santé Une conciergerie avec des services de pressing, coiffure, esthétique, ostéopathie, diététique... Un espace café avec Barista 80 hectares de forêts et de nombreux sentiers de promenade Accessibilité au site : en voiture ou navettes gratuites depuis Paris et lignes de bus depuis les gares de Brétigny-sur-Orge (91) et d'Évry (91). items.desc: Entreprise familiale fondée en 1933, nos locaux se trouvent situés à Baud, au cœur de la Bretagne. Depuis plus de 90 ans, nos équipes expertes et engagées conçoivent des solutions de transport et de logistique sur-mesure et durables , pour des entreprises qui font face à des enjeux complexes ou techniques. Notre adhésion de la première heure au groupement Astre nous permet de déployer nos solutions sur l’ensemble du territoire Français et européen, avec l’appui d’un réseau fort de plus de 120 PME indépendantes. Quelques chiffres : 93 ans d'expérience 120 salariés 68 ensembles routiers 3000 m2 de plateforme logistique Description du poste Dans le cadre d'un départ en retraite prévu pour juin 2027, nous recherchons notre futur Data Analyst (H/F), pour nos bureaux basés à Baud (56150). Sous la Direction du DAF, vous aurez pour missions principales de collecter, fiabiliser et transformer l’ensemble des données extra financières de l’entreprise en indicateurs stratégiques, au profit des Responsables de service et de la Direction. Pour cela, vous assurerez le suivi et développement des systèmes d’information, ainsi que du parc informatique de l’entreprise, au travers des fonctions suivantes : 1- Contrôle des données de performance : Collecter, analyser et contrôler les données extra financières (RSE, exploitation, RH, etc.), Construire et suivre les tableaux de bord et indicateurs, au travers du BI (Qlik), Rédiger, fournir et/ou présenter les rapports et analyses, aux Responsables de Services / la Direction, 2- Production interne de la qualité et des audits : Produire et suivre l’évolution des outils d’audit et de contrôle interne, Réaliser les audits et contrôles internes (CO2, Qualimat, Ecovadis, VSME, etc.), Rédiger, fournir et/ou présenter les rapports liés à la Direction, 3- Pilotage du Système d’Information : Piloter et développer le système d’information décisionnelle (Qlik), Piloter et animer les projets de développement SI, en lien avec le prestataire externe et collaborateurs internes, Accompagner les salariés à l’utilisation des outils numériques. Missions complémentaires : Suivre et piloter le parc informatique, en lien avec notre prestataire d’infogérance, Animer les campagnes de cybersécurité, Venir en soutien à la Direction Financière pour la production des budgets et / ou indicateurs financiers. Devenant ainsi la pierre angulaire des responsables de services et données de l'entreprise. Vous faites preuve d'un esprit logique et sens du service, au travers d'une rigueur et fiabilité reconnue. items.desc: Led by Rodolphe Saadé, the CMA CGM Group, a global leader in shipping and logistics, serves more than 420 ports around the world on five continents. With its subsidiary CEVA Logistics, a world leader in logistics, and its air freight division CMA CGM AIR CARGO, the CMA CGM Group is continually innovating to offer its customers a complete and increasingly efficient range of new shipping, land, air and logistics solutions. Committed to the energy transition in shipping, and a pioneer in the use of alternative fuels, the CMA CGM Group has set a target to become Net Zero Carbon by 2050. Through the CMA CGM Foundation, the Group acts in humanitarian crises that require an emergency response by mobilizing the Group’s shipping and logistics expertise to bring humanitarian supplies around the world. Present in 160 countries through its network of more than 400 offices and 750 warehouses, the Group employs more than 155,000 people worldwide, including 4,000 in Marseilles where its head office is located. Context: C-Voyages is the current solution within CMA CGM IS to manage the schedules & fuel consumption of over 680 vessels operated by the Group, as well as those operated by our Partners. C-Voyages is a highly business-critical and interconnected application providing dated voyages to multiple applications across various domains. Despite its central role, C-Voyages is an aging platform with performance and scalability limitations, unable to meet evolving business needs and ambitions. In this context, the Transfo Lines Ops department is launching the New Schedules System project, a strategic initiative aimed to address C-Voyages obsolescence and completely rethink the CMA CGM approach to schedules management. We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead this major organizational transformation initiative and ensure successful delivery and implementation of the target vision. items.desc: At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work. We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco. Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished. Why Verda Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits. 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team. A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem. As a Network Operations Engineer, you will ensure the reliability and operational readiness of Verda's production network supporting AI workloads. Working closely with Network Engineering, Data Center Operations, SRE teams, and external providers, you will troubleshoot incidents, execute maintenance, and drive improvements that keep our infrastructure running reliably at scale. This is a hands-on role combining network operations, troubleshooting, observability, and automation, with a strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities Network monitoring and observability: Improve dashboards, alerting, and telemetry using tools such as Grafana to enable proactive issue detection and faster resolution. Incident response and recovery: Troubleshoot production incidents, restore services, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements. Maintenance and lifecycle management: Plan and execute network maintenance, software upgrades, hardware replacements, and recovery procedures while minimizing service disruption. Vendor coordination: Manage support cases, escalations, repairs, RMAs, and spare inventory in collaboration with hardware vendors, colocation providers, and ISPs. Operational readiness: Ensure new deployments meet operational standards, including monitoring, documentation, support coverage, and handover requirements. Automation and continuous improvement: Develop runbooks, automate repetitive tasks, and improve network reliability, operational efficiency, and disaster recovery capabilities. Your key competencies Experience operating and troubleshooting production networks in data center, cloud, or AI infrastructure environments. Hands-on experience with network hardware, software upgrades, planned maintenance, and vendor support processes. Experience with network monitoring, alerting, and observability tools such as Grafana. Experience managing production incidents, participating in on-call rotations, and contributing to root cause analysis. Strong troubleshooting skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to make decisions under pressure. Proactive and ownership-driven mindset, with a focus on automation, reliability, and continuous improvement. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate across engineering teams and external providers. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and document operational processes clearly. Nice to have Experience with routing protocols, including IGP and EGP. Scripting or programming experience, preferably Python, for network automation. Experience with network modeling and source-of-truth platforms such as NetBox (DCIM/IPAM). Practicalities Location: Helsinki, Finland (3 days per week in the office) or Remote within the EU Employment type: Full-time and permanent What's next We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now. Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don't accept applications sent by email.

Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role As a PMO Operations Specialist , you'll play a central role in building and running the operational foundation of our growing Project Management Office (PMO). Working closely with the PMO Lead, you'll turn newly developed processes into practical, well-documented ways of working that are consistently adopted across dozens of active initiatives. You'll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the PMO, from weekly project reporting and portfolio data quality to project lead onboarding, training, and process improvement. You'll work across teams, including scientists, engineers, and project leads, helping make project management processes simple, effective, and accessible to everyone. Drive Portfolio Data Quality: Monitor project information, identify missing or inconsistent data, follow up with project leads, and ensure leadership and teams can rely on accurate portfolio reporting. Make PMO Processes Work in Practice: Translate newly designed PMO processes into simple, documented, and usable workflows that can be adopted consistently by project leads and non-PM colleagues. Lead Project Onboarding and Training: Coordinate onboarding for new project leads and deliver training on PMO processes, tools, reporting expectations, and ways of working to build confidence and self-sufficiency. Improve Processes and Efficiency: Identify recurring manual tasks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, helping streamline workflows and flag opportunities for automation. Drive Improvement Initiatives: Partner with the PMO Lead on selected PMO improvement projects, taking ownership of execution, coordination, documentation, and follow-through. Support Cross-Functional Collaboration: Prepare and support workshops, meetings, and working sessions, ensuring the right information is available, discussions stay organized, and agreed actions are followed through. Maintain Clear Documentation: Ensure PMO processes, project information, and supporting documentation are complete, accessible, and consistently maintained. Keep Things Moving: Proactively identify overdue actions, unclear responsibilities, and emerging gaps, escalating risks to the PMO Lead before they impact project delivery. You understand project management fundamentals and the importance of consistent reporting, reliable documentation, clear ownership, and effective coordination across multiple initiatives. You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, recurring deadlines, and large volumes of project information without losing sight of the bigger picture. You are comfortable translating processes and concepts into practical workflows, documentation, and guidance that people outside of project management can easily understand and adopt. You take an ownership-driven approach to your work, naturally identifying what's missing, unclear, or unfinished and proactively driving it toward resolution. items.desc: Cabot Corporation (NYSE: CBT) is a leading global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, USA. Our businesses deliver a broad range of products and solutions to customers in every corner of the globe, serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment and consumer industry sectors. We bring the power of innovative chemistry to solve customers' challenges today while preparing them to meet tomorrow’s needs. Our commitment to innovation is driven by a passion to advance our customers' businesses through our deep understanding of their applications and the global trends that impact their operations. If you do not meet every requirement, or your experience is slightly different than what we have listed, we still encourage you to apply! Die Cabot Aerogel GmbH stellt am Standort Frankfurt, Industriepark Höchst in einer verfahrenstechnischen Anlage Aerogel her. Hierbei handelt es sich um ein zukunftsweisendes Material, das auf Grund seiner hervorragenden Dämmeigenschaften in vielen neuartigen und nachhaltigen Produkten Verwendung findet. Der Einsatz von Aerogel ist unser Beitrag zur Gestaltung einer energie- und ressourceneffizienten Zukunft. Unser Werk gehört zur Cabot Corporation, einem global ausgerichteten Unternehmen mit Sitz in Boston, Massachusetts (USA). Cabot betreibt 40 Produktions-Standorte in 20 Ländern und beschäftigt weltweit ca. 4.500 Mitarbeiter. Für unseren Standort Frankfurt suchen wir einen Process Engineer (m/w/d) mit besonderem Interesse an Prozessoptimierung und Prozesssicherheit. In dieser Position erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, die verfahrenstechnischen Prozesse unserer Aerogel-Produktion kennenzulernen und sich gezielt in die Bereiche Prozessoptimierung, Projektunterstützung und Prozesssicherheit einzuarbeiten. Dabei übernehmen Sie schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und entwickeln sich zum verfahrenstechnischen Experten für die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und den sicheren Betrieb unserer Produktionsanlage. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören: Analyse von Prozessdaten zur Untersuchung von Abweichungen und Ermittlung von Optimierungspotenzialen Identifikation und konzeptionelle Ausarbeitung von Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung von Durchsatz, Anlagenstabilität und Herstellkosten Verfahrenstechnische Unterstützung von Investitions- und Änderungsprojekten von der Planung bis zur Inbetriebnahme Spezifikation von Änderungen der Programmierung des Prozessleitsystems Umsetzung der Cabot-Prozesssicherheitsstandards am Standort Koordination von Ursachenanalysen (RCA) sowie eigenständige Durchführung ausgewählter Analysen einschließlich Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen Koordination des Alarmmanagements einschließlich der Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen Mitwirkung bei PHAs (HAZOPs) und Durchführung von Sicherheitsgesprächen Weiterentwicklung von technischen Standards und Arbeitsprozessen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SHE, Produktion und Instandhaltung zur Unterstützung eines reibungslosen Betriebs Ihr Profil: Master-Abschluss in den Fachrichtungen Verfahrenstechnik / Chemieingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sie verfügen über ein fundiertes verfahrenstechnisches Grundwissen und überzeugen durch analytisches Denkvermögen, Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und die Bereitschaft, sich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Erste praktische Erfahrungen, beispielsweise durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eine erste berufliche Tätigkeit, sind von Vorteil. Weitere fachliche und persönliche Anforderungen: Ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein Problemlösungsorientierung Selbständige Arbeitsweise Kommunikationsstärke Deutsch: fließend in Wort und Schrift Englisch: sehr gute Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Wir bieten Ihnen: Vielseitige Aufgaben in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld Ein motivierendes Arbeitsklima mit einem kollegialen Team Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Eine unbefristete Festanstellung Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Zusatzleistungen (Altersvorsorge, Sachbezugskarte) sowie einen Leistungsbonus At Cabot, we bring the power of innovative chemistry and a spirit of partnership with our customers to advance solutions that will enable a sustainable future. items.desc: Build Europe's semiconductor future with us! You will drive the exciting greenfield setup of our brand-new local FA laboratory – overseeing the move-in, installation, and qualification of cutting-edge analytical equipment. Once operational, you will run advanced electron microscopes to analyze defect samples, support production tool qualifications, and troubleshoot process issues. This is a unique opportunity to blend high-level material science with practical, hands-on diagnostics to maximize the reliability of our products! Job Responsibilities 1. Lab Establishment: Lead the physical setup of the local Dresden FA Lab, including the installation, qualification, and initial calibration of advanced analytical instruments. 2. Physical Failure Analysis: Apply hands-on expertise using advanced microscopy and sputtering systems (including TEM, SEM, and FIB) to perform high-resolution sample characterization. 3. Root-Cause Investigation: Support fab engineers in diagnosing defect, yield, and reliability failures by providing timely, high-quality sample analyses. 4. Team Coordination: Train and functionally guide FA lab technicians in running routine sample preparation, standard monitoring, and continuous improvement tasks. 5. Process Improvement: Build and document specialized local knowledge regarding material structures, defect physics, and packaging failure mechanisms. 6. Production Continuity: Deliver on-duty laboratory coverage during holidays and occasional planned weekend overtime (approximately once per month) to support critical production issues. Are you passionate about investigating the microscopic root causes of complex technical challenges? As a Failure Analysis Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be the lead detective of our semiconductor fabrication facility in Dresden. Your profile Must-Have: 1. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Material Science, Physics, Nanotechnology, Electrical/Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 2. Hands-on Experience: Minimum of 1 year of practical experience operating advanced microscopy tools (such as SEM, TEM, or FIB). Note: Relevant master's thesis work, university research projects, or internships will be fully considered for ambitious fresh graduates. 3. Problem-Solving Mindset: A structured, detail-oriented approach to analysis with a passion for troubleshooting and technical forensics. 4. Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required. 5. Flexibility: Adaptability to evolving tasks in a dynamic startup/greenfield environment, and a readiness to support occasional weekend/holiday standby shifts. Nice-to-Have: 1. Prior experience in semiconductor failure analysis, wafer manufacturing, or cleanroom environments. 2. Knowledge of basic chemistry/etching processes for physical sample preparation. 3. Basic communication skills in German and/or Mandarin. Reasons to join ESMC Why Join ESMC? 1. Help build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. 2. Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan and the US. 3. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures. 4. Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration. 5. International onboarding including 9 months of training in Taiwan. More information Please apply with your English resume! About us Each journey starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC). We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential. At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.

items.desc: Nuclear fusion represents the ultimate clean energy solution. We are reviving a promising 1980s magnetic confinement reactor architecture, with a unique plasma stabilization mechanism. Modern technology resolves the historical power limitations of the concept, enabling stable, steady-state confinement and paving the way for scalable fusion power. We’re looking for a technical co-founder to the venture. This role presents an extraordinary opportunity to translate core scientific objectives into robust, operable, and scalable fusion hardware, while steering a high-impact commercial venture onto the global stage. The aim is to spin the company out of DSV over the coming months. Requirements As Chief Technology Officer, you will lead the technology and engineering roadmap, own the overall system architecture and subsystem integration. You will lead the translation of scientific requirements into safe, operable and progressively more capable fusion systems, from experimental machines toward a neutron source and eventual power plant. Key Responsibilities: Lead the technology and engineering roadmap. Own the architecture and integration of the experimental platform and supporting systems. Translate scientific objectives into engineering requirements, specifications and test plans. Lead the design, construction, commissioning and operation of experimental hardware. Direct the progression from research platform to neutron-source and reactor systems. Lead integrated reactor engineering and design optimization within the scientific envelope defined by the CSO. Ownership & Accountability: Own the system architecture, engineering integrity and demonstrated performance of the company’s integrated technology systems. Define engineering requirements, interfaces, operating envelopes and acceptance criteria. Own integration across relevant subsystems, including magnets, heating, vacuum, power, thermal management, structures, diagnostics, controls and data acquisition. Lead engineering trade-offs across performance, safety, reliability, cost, schedule, maintainability and scalability. Own design reviews, configuration management, engineering change control and technical decision records. Direct procurement, supplier selection, fabrication, assembly, installation and commissioning. Establish procedures for commissioning, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and system modification. Own operational readiness, machine protection, engineering safety and facility reliability. Establish a rigorous test, failure-investigation and corrective-action culture that converts technical setbacks into verified design improvements. Build and lead a lean engineering capability spanning internal contributors, contractors, suppliers and partners, while retaining system-level accountability. Jointly with the CSO, provide technical sign-off on experimental configurations, major development milestones and decisions at the science/engineering interface. Maintain an accurate, decision-ready view of engineering progress, cost, schedule, dependencies and technical risks for the CEO and founding team. Support external communications, fundraising, grant applications and technical due diligence when engineering expertise is required. Experience Demonstrated end-to-end leadership in the design, integration, commissioning or operation of a complex first-of-a-kind physical system, with direct responsibility for multidisciplinary interfaces and technical performance. Experience with a fusion device, plasma experiment, accelerator, neutron source or comparably complex scientific or industrial facility. Deep expertise in at least one relevant engineering domain such as magnet systems, RF or microwave heating, high vacuum, high-power electrical systems, cryogenics, controls or thermal management; combined with sufficient breadth to lead integration across the wider system. Strong systems-engineering capability across requirements, architecture, interfaces, verification, configuration control and staged technology maturation. Track record of resolving multidisciplinary integration failures under real cost and schedule constraints. Experience designing for safe operation, reliability and maintainability in complex experimental or first-of-a-kind systems. Demonstrated ability to incorporate safety and regulatory requirements into system architecture and engineering decisions from an early stage. Ability to lead multidisciplinary engineers, technicians, suppliers and specialist contractors. Ability to translate evolving scientific requirements into practical, testable and adaptable engineering solutions. Ability to communicate engineering decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. items.desc: Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field About the Role As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work. What You’ll Work On Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability. UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life. Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices. 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources. Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way. Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously. Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand. Your Profile You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices. You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes. You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures. You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation. You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware. You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions. You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface. You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design. You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich. Especially Valued Bonus Skills 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies. items.desc: Join SE3 Labs as UAV Software and Controls Engineer Lead the autonomy stack of our systems. Starting from custom firmware all the way to GCS plugins. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence. Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs), and we’re looking for a skilled, hands-on engineer who’s ready to bring these machines into the real world. About the Role As Drone Software and Controls Engineer , you will be working on the full-stack avionics development of our UAV fleet. From selecting the components to tuning and configuring the UAV, all the way to GCS development and autonomy orchestration. You will be the brain behind the fleet. You will be in the middle of the software and hardware team, mastering the integration of the two fields and bringing the final product to life. What You’ll Work On Architecture & Plan: Define and develop schematics for communication and integration of the software stack across all our systems. How does UAV A get a position from UGV B? How does Payload 1 inform UAV C that it needs to land? Prototype & Iterate: Build, rework, and test hardware with speed and precision, both in simulation and in flight. Develop better simulations and tools for faster iteration. Optimize & Troubleshoot: Analyse the full flow of information via simulation and real-world testing, including UAV to UAV, UAV to GCS or UAV to payload. Document with Purpose: Keep clear records of requirements, tradeoffs, test results, tuning procedures, and implementation rationale Validate in the Loop: Support hardware-in-the-loop and environmental validation workflows to ensure rugged, reliable implementations. Your Profile You hold a B.Sc. or higher in Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in avionics development, from component selection and firmware design to full system integration You’re confident with lab equipment (multimeters, scopes, spectrum analyzers, near-field probes) and use them to diagnose and debug with purpose You have a deep understanding of Autonomy principles and know how to develop and deal with low level issues in a UAV fleet. You’ve worked with PX4 and ArduPilot and know where to go in the code to get what you need. You’re experienced with QGC and know how to customise it to your will. You’re familiar with hardware-in-the-loop and environmental testing, and understand how designs fail in the wild You speak fluent English ; German is a strong plus Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfection. You iterate until it works. You love building things that last and love making them fly majestically.. Especially Valued Bonus Skills Architecture and software development skills. ArduPilot, PX4, or QGC open source contributor. Flying License A1-A3 Experience with multi-vehicle coordination. Perks & Benefits Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth Our Process Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other Technical Interview (45 min) : (We will deep diver into your experience and the role) Coding Interview(1 hr): (with our external coding partners) One site trial/case (1.5h) : let’s build and test a system together with our hardware team Team Dinner / Lunch : Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

items.desc: Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence. Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads. About the Role As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer , you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy. This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team. The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better. What You’ll Work On Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system. Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows. Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized. Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system. Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable. Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab. Your Profile Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches. You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field. You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems. items.desc: Athens, Greece | Full time | Home-based | R1579648 Overview IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. IQVIA has two teams focused exclusively on amplifying the patient’s voice and enhancing their experiences across their health journey: the Patient-Centered Solutions and Connected Technologies (PACT) team, and the Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient and Site Strategy (ILS & PASS) team. These teams work closely together to generate patient experience data (PED) through clinical outcome assessments (COAs; including digital health technologies), qualitative research, and patient preference research. The ILS & PASS team has a small group dedicated to thought leadership and COA instrument development. This “science team” is focused on (a) ensuring that sound scientific principles permeate through the research completed by the PACT and ILS & PASS teams, and (b) leading the development, validation, and qualification of COA instruments to collect reliable and interpretable data from patients in medicines development and routine clinical care. Candidates should demonstrate: (a) excellent written and oral communication skills including grammatical/technical writing skills; (b) critical attention and accuracy with details; and (c) strong individual initiative, organizing skills, and commitment to quality. Monitor animal health and promptly report any abnormalities to the Veterinary Team. Maintain animal housing systems, equipment and supplies. Support animal preparation, handling, transportation and pre-/post-operative care under veterinary supervision.
items.desc: Athens LifeTech Park (ALTP), the first biotech park in Southeastern Europe, founded with the vision to become a global catalyst for life science innovation, is now looking to hire a dedicated and reliable team member to serve as Assistant Lab Animal Technician. With the mission of advancing drug discovery & early drug development initiatives for the benefit of patients worldwide, ALTP hosts multiple activities essential to drug discovery & development, including a Preclinical CRO, a Clinical CRO, and a Biotech Incubator capable of hosting biotech companies. To meet our current corporate needs, we are looking to bring to our team an Assistant Lab Animal Technician for the Animal Research Facility of our Preclinical CRO, with sites in Pikermi and Spata . In this role, you will: Provide daily care, feeding and monitoring of laboratory animals. Ensure high standards of animal welfare, hygiene, cleaning and disinfection. Monitor animal health and promptly report any abnormalities to the Veterinary Team. Maintain animal housing systems, equipment and supplies. Support animal preparation, handling, transportation and pre-/post-operative care under veterinary supervision. Assist with research and training procedures, animal reception and acclimatization. Follow biosafety protocols and maintain accurate facility records. Please note that this position involves exposure to occupational hazards (chemicals, animal-derived allergens, animal waste, sharp objects, manual handling and lifting of heavy items, etc.). Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is provided, along with access to an occupational health physician. Your Qualifications: High School Diploma. Experience in laboratory animal care and handling. Basic computer skills (Microsoft Office). Ability to follow instructions and standard procedures accurately. Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a team. Ability to lift and move heavy objects. Flexibility to work weekends and public holidays when required. Ability to commute between the Pikermi and Spata facilities. Communicating effectively in both written and spoken Greek and English. Prioritizing teamwork and value collective success over individual achievements. Why Join Us: A competitive compensation package combined with additional benefits. Private Insurance for you and your family. Facilities with Parking inside, enticing restaurant and corporate bus. An extensive training program upon induction and throughout employment. Prospects for professional growth.

items.desc: Athens, Greece Company Overview Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately. Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific. Position Summary In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for users who need technical support. You will restore service, resolve combined first- and second-line issues across the Microsoft workplace environment, and retain ownership until resolution or an accepted handover. You will be successful if you combine clear customer communication with disciplined troubleshooting, accurate records and reliable shift handovers. What You'll Do Receive incidents and service requests through approved telephone, email, portal and monitoring channels Record, categorise, prioritise, assign and maintain tickets from initial contact through closure Diagnose and resolve issues affecting supported Windows devices, Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint and browsers Fulfil approved identity and access requests in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including passwords, accounts, groups and permissions Use approved remote-support, device-management and endpoint-security tools, and provide desk-side support when required Recognise priority, major and potential security incidents and initiate the correct escalation route promptly Coordinate with network, cybersecurity, application, infrastructure, identity and supplier teams until ownership is formally accepted Validate recovery with the user or service owner and record a clear, reusable resolution before closure Provide complete shift handovers covering active incidents, ageing work, service risks and commitments Maintain knowledge articles and identify recurring issues, avoidable demand and practical service improvements What You Bring Must Haves Practical experience providing first- or second-line support in a service desk, helpdesk or IT operations environment Working knowledge of supported Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365, Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID Ability to diagnose hardware, software, identity, access and connectivity issues methodically Confident use of an IT service management system and remote-support tools Strong customer service, accurate written records and calm prioritisation during service disruption Professional working proficiency in English; Greek or another customer language is advantageous Nice to Haves Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Defender for Endpoint, Azure or Windows Autopilot Experience supporting aviation, transport, defence, government or another operationally critical environment ITIL Foundation, Microsoft fundamentals or a relevant role-based certification Additional Eligibility Qualifications Ability to complete any additional customer, site, identity or privileged-access checks required for assigned duties. Availability to work the rotating three-shift roster, including nights, weekends and public holidays. Ability to follow Metrea, customer and site requirements for information security, data protection and access control. items.card: About the Role Minerex is looking for an early-career engineer or technician to join our engineering team, working on the development, manufacture and maintenance of electrical control equipment and engineering solutions for the water treatment industry. This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to develop practical engineering skills while building towards a more specialised role in automation and control
items.desc: About Minerex Environmental: Minerex Environmental is a leader in providing specialised environmental services, with a core focus on dewatering, over-pumping, water treatment , and environmental management for the construction, mining, and pharmaceutical industries. We offer innovative and sustainable solutions to water management challenges, ensuring efficient resource utilisation while minimising environmental impact. Our commitment to excellence and regulatory compliance ensures that we help our clients achieve operational goals while protecting ecosystems and maintaining the highest safety standards. About the Role Minerex is looking for an early-career engineer or technician to join our engineering team, working on the development, manufacture and maintenance of electrical control equipment and engineering solutions for the water treatment industry. This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to develop practical engineering skills while building towards a more specialised role in automation and control systems. Initially, much of your time will be spent fabricating, assembling, wiring, testing and maintaining electrical control equipment. As you develop your experience and understanding of our systems, you will progressively take on greater responsibility for PLC programming, automation, telemetry, data visualisation and the development of new engineering solutions. You will work closely with experienced engineers on a varied mix of workshop activities, software and control system development, research and development, and site-based engineering work. We are interested in people who enjoy practical problem-solving, want to understand how equipment works and are keen to develop their technical skills across both hardware and software. Key Responsibilities Electrical Equipment & Workshop Engineering Fabricate, assemble, wire and test electrical control panels, control boxes and associated equipment. Maintain, repair and modify electrical control equipment and systems. Install and configure electrical components, including relays, motor starters, sensors, instrumentation and control devices. Read and work from electrical drawings, wiring diagrams and technical documentation. Carry out functional testing, fault-finding and troubleshooting. Assist with improving equipment design, assembly methods, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Maintain high standards of workshop organisation, workmanship, safety and quality. Automation, PLCs & Data Visualisation Develop an understanding of the operation and configuration of PLC-based control systems. Assist with PLC programming, testing, troubleshooting and modification of control systems, progressing towards taking ownership of these activities. Work with sensors, instrumentation, telemetry equipment and remote monitoring systems. Develop and maintain system graphics, data graphs, dashboards, synoptics and interactive diagrams. Assist with integrating hardware, software and communications systems to provide reliable monitoring and control of equipment. Collect, interpret and present operational data to support equipment testing, fault diagnosis and performance evaluation. Contribute to the development and improvement of automated processes and control solutions. Research & Development and Site Support Assist with the design, prototyping, fabrication and testing of new equipment and technologies. Support engineering trials and practical investigations into equipment performance and process improvements. Assist with the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of equipment on site. Work with engineering and operational teams to identify issues and develop practical solutions. Record test results, prepare technical documentation and contribute to engineering reports. Support the development and continuous improvement of Minerex equipment and systems. About You We are looking for someone at the beginning of their engineering career who has a solid technical foundation, a practical mindset and an interest in developing into a broader electrical and automation engineering role. You may be a graduate engineer with some industry experience or a technician looking to expand your skills and progress into automation and controls. You will ideally have: A relevant qualification in electrical, electronic, automation, mechatronic or another related engineering discipline. Approximately 1–2 years of relevant practical experience in an engineering, manufacturing, maintenance or technical environment. An understanding of electrical systems and an interest in electrical controls and automation. A practical, methodical approach to assembling equipment, testing systems and solving technical problems. An interest in learning PLC programming, industrial communications and control system development. Good IT skills and an ability to work with technical software and data. Good attention to detail and a commitment to producing reliable, high-quality work. The …

items.desc: Job Description Engineering Summer Placement Company Entity Glanua Job Family Engineering Discipline/Role All Engineering Disciplines / Summer Placement Level Summer Placement Reports To Project Manager / Engineering Manager Location Ireland and the United Kingdom - office and project locations Summer Placement Highlights Voluntary summer placement: Applications are open to engineering students seeking practical experience during their semester break. Placement period: Placements run from the start of June to the end of August and are available in Ireland and the United Kingdom. All engineering subjects welcome: Students from any engineering discipline may apply. The host team and activities will reflect the student's studies, interests and available project work. About Glanua Glanua is a leading provider of innovative and sustainable engineering solutions for water, wastewater and bioresources infrastructure. We design, build, operate and maintain critical infrastructure for municipal and industrial clients, combining engineering expertise, specialist technologies and off-site manufacturing to deliver efficient, sustainable solutions. Our clients include major water utilities such as Uisce Eireann, Thames Water, Yorkshire Water and Affinity Water, alongside leading organisations in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, food and beverage and manufacturing sectors. Through our expertise in water and wastewater treatment, bioresources and resource recovery, we help protect the environment, safeguard water resources and support the transition to a circular economy. Headquartered in Galway, Ireland, Glanua has a talented team of people across Ireland, the UK, Portugal and the USA. Guided by our values of Respect, Collaboration, Accountability, Integrity, Excellence and Safety, we empower our people to innovate, develop their skills and reach their full potential while helping to create a cleaner, more sustainable planet. Role Purpose Applications are open for voluntary Engineering Summer Placements with Glanua in Ireland and the United Kingdom. The placement is intended for students who want practical engineering experience during their semester break and are available from the start of June to the end of August. The opportunity is open to students across all engineering subjects, including civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical, environmental, process, structural, energy, automation and related disciplines. Students will join a suitable office, design, project or site team according to their course, interests, location and available business needs. Summer Placement Experience You will work alongside experienced engineers and project colleagues on live water, wastewater, bioresources or supporting infrastructure activities. Your work will be supervised and matched to your stage of study, giving you an introduction to professional engineering practice, project delivery, safety and teamwork. This is a general summer placement advert rather than a rotational programme. Placements will normally remain with one host team and location, although occasional visits to another office, project or site may be required. Specific responsibilities will vary by discipline and project needs. Key Responsibilities Engineering and Project Support Support engineers with drawings, calculations, specifications, schedules, technical records or other project information under supervision. Help collect, organise and review project data, site information, supplier details or asset records for use by the host team. Prepare clear notes, trackers, presentations and document updates using approved templates and project systems. Take part in design reviews, planning meetings or coordination activities appropriate to your discipline and stage of study. Design Delivery and Site Exposure Learn how engineering designs are developed, checked and translated into safe, practical solutions for water and wastewater projects. Assist with supervised site visits, surveys, inspections, commissioning preparation or progress records where relevant to the placement. Support quality, environmental and health and safety requirements by following instructions, completing records and raising questions promptly. Work with colleagues from different engineering and project disciplines and observe how teams coordinate clients, suppliers and construction activities. Learning Safety and Team Contribution Complete the induction, mandatory safety training and any role-specific learning required before carrying out placement activities. Attend team briefings, ask questions and use feedback from engineers, supervisors and project colleagues to improve your work. Contribute to a practical improvement, research task, technical summary or project deliverable agreed with the host team. Keep an accurate record of learning and experience that may support academic reflection, a placement report or future career planning. Our Values At Glanua, our values shape how we work together …
