At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future. Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic experts. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations. As a Scientist, your role will be to perform advanced diagnostic testing and analysis, ensure the accuracy and reliability of laboratory results, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and contribute to the continuous improvement of lab procedures and quality standards. What You’ll Do: Perform a variety of complex sample preparation and analysis procedures to quantitatively measure pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical compounds in a variety of formulations and /or biological matrices for stability and analytical testing. Work with multiple functional groups to meet business needs. Plan and organize work with periodic supervision. Set up and maintain analytical instrumentation. Train in routine operation, maintenance and theory of analytical instrumentation, SOPs and regulatory procedures and guidelines. Ensure QA findings are addressed appropriately. Provide assistance and training for other team members. Problem solving, either independently or with assistance pertaining to extraction and/or instrumentation problems. Communicate project status to project leader. Perform work assignments accurately, and in a timely and safe manner. Review, interpret, and analyze data for technical, quality and compliance to protocols, methods, SOPs, client criteria and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) or Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Perform self and peer review of the data for accuracy and compliance with reporting requirements prior to submission to QA and issuance to customers. Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years). In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Demonstrated knowledge of multiple applicable techniques such as: HPLC, GC, MS, Dissolution Testing, Inhalation Testing, Biopharmaceutical Testing, Karl Fischer, UV-Vis, FT-IR, TOC Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word Proven ability to interpret data by performing trend analysis Proven ability in technical writing skills Ability to independently optimize analytical methods Proven problem solving and troubleshooting abilities Good written and oral communication skills Time management and project management skills Ability to work in a collaborative work environment with a team Working Conditions and Environment: Work is performed in a laboratory and/or a clinical environment with exposure to electrical office equipment. Occasional drives to site locations, occasional domestic travel. Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms. Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, radiation, toxic materials and hazardous waste. Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves. Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions. Physical Requirements: Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day. Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment. Occasional mobility needed. Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck. Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs. items.desc: Fondata nel 1956, Rodacciai si contraddistingue fin dagli esordi per la costante ricerca di nuove soluzioni tecniche e logistiche, per la soddisfazione del cliente e l’innalzamento degli standard qualitativi e di servizio. Rodacciai si presenta sul mercato con tutte le tipologie di prodotti finite in diverse composizioni e misure, dagli acciai inossidabili agli acciai automatici a quelli per saldatura e per viteria, tutti realizzati secondo diverse composizioni atte a soddisfare le differenti esigenze di lavorazione. items.desc: DESCRIPTION The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. Key job responsibilities As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for: 1. Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs 2. Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery 3. Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies 4. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies 5. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts About the team Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. items.card: You will develop low-dose, time-resolved TEM methods for beam-sensitive perovskites, including event-driven nanodiffraction with a nanosecond-resolution direct electron detector to track local electric fields and strain. You will apply these methods to gold-perovskite nanostructures, combining single-particle optical spectroscopy with in situ TEM under laser excitation to reveal how light-driven charge transfer
items.desc: Work Activities The Hybrid Nanosystems group and the Hybrid Solar Cells group at NWO-Institute AMOLF are looking for two PhD candidates to watch, in real time and at the atomic scale, how interfaces between halide perovskites and metals change under light and electrical bias, using a unique in situ transmission electron microscope (TEM). Halide perovskites are promising semiconductors for solar cells, LEDs, photocatalysis, and brain-inspired (neuromorphic) electronics. In almost every device they are contacted by a metal, and because the perovskite lattice is soft and its ions are mobile, these contacts are not static: defects migrate, bonds break and reform, and metal atoms can diffuse into the perovskite. These “living” interfaces can degrade a device or enable new functionality, yet how they evolve under operating conditions has never been observed directly. This project uses AMOLF’s in situ TEM, which is unique in its ability to apply light and electrical bias while imaging at atomic resolution, to watch these processes as they happen and link them to charge transfer and device performance. PhD position 1 – Hybrid Nanosystems group (Wiebke Albrecht). You will develop low-dose, time-resolved TEM methods for beam-sensitive perovskites, including event-driven nanodiffraction with a nanosecond-resolution direct electron detector to track local electric fields and strain. You will apply these methods to gold-perovskite nanostructures, combining single-particle optical spectroscopy with in situ TEM under laser excitation to reveal how light-driven charge transfer reshapes the interface. PhD position 2 – Hybrid Solar Cells group (Bruno Ehrler). You will design and fabricate lateral perovskite-metal devices that fit inside the TEM, measure their electrical and memristive behavior, and study in situ how bias and light drive ion migration and metal filament growth. You will extend drift-diffusion simulations to dynamically changing interfaces, connecting the observed atomic-scale changes to device function. The project is funded by an NWO Open Competition Domain Science (M-2) grant. The two PhD candidates will work closely together, with shared samples, joint experiments on the TEM, and regular meetings across both groups. The project further benefits from international collaborations with leading groups in perovskite materials, electron microscopy, nanoparticle synthesis, and computational imaging. Qualifications You have a MSc degree in physics, chemistry, nanoscience, or a related field. Work environment You will perform this research in the Hybrid Nanosystems group headed by Wiebke Albrecht (position 1) or the Hybrid Solar Cells group headed by Bruno Ehrler (position 2) at AMOLF. Both groups are part of AMOLF’s LMPV–Sustainable Energy Materials department, where about 50 scientists work on semiconductors for solar energy conversion and photocatalysis. The Hybrid Nanosystems group uses light as a tool to probe, program, and reshape nanomaterials. By combining advanced electron microscopy, single-particle optical spectroscopy, and electromagnetic simulations, we uncover how the atomic-scale structure of nanoparticles governs their response to light, and how light can drive these structures to transform. The Hybrid Solar Cells group focuses on perovskite materials science, both on the fundamental level and for device applications. By combining electrical and optical spectroscopy with drift-diffusion simulations, the group studies the dynamic nature of halide perovskites, from ion migration in solar cells to artificial synapses for neuromorphic computing. AMOLF is a part of NWO-I and initiate and performs leading fundamental research on the physics of complex forms of matter, and to create new functional materials, in partnership with academia and industry. The institute is located at Amsterdam Science Park and currently employs about 140 researchers and 80 support employees. www.amolf.nl Working conditions The working atmosphere at the institute is largely determined by young, enthusiastic, mostly foreign employees. Communication is informal and runs through short lines of communication. The position is intended as full-time (40 hours / week, 12 months / year) appointment in the service of the Netherlands Foundation of Scientific Research Institutes (NWO-I) for the duration of four years The starting salary is 3.115 Euro’s gross per month and a range of employment benefits. After successful completion of the PhD research a PhD degree will be granted at a Dutch University. Several courses are offered, specially developed for PhD-students. AMOLF assists any new foreign PhD-student with housing and visa applications and compensates their transport costs and furnishing expenses. More information? For further information about the positions, please contact Wiebke Albrecht (position 1): w.albrecht@amolf.nl, or Bruno Ehrler (position 2): b.ehrler@amolf.nl. items.desc: About this position Do you want to work with a unique group of colleagues and thrive on facing different challenges every single day? If so, the Reliable Structures lab team at the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research (TNO) is the perfect place for you! The Reliable Structures department focuses on understanding the structural behavior of infrastructure in the Netherlands. This knowledge is essential for keeping our infrastructure both safe and affordable. With our well-equipped laboratory, practical and theoretical expertise go hand in hand, enabling us to address even the most complex research questions. Would you like to contribute to this work? Read on to find out more. What will be your role? As a lab coordinator at the Delft Construction Innovation Lab (Delft BouwinnovatieLab), you act as the central hub, connecting: Researchers, who conduct complex and highly diverse tests; Project managers, who require cost estimates, schedules, and progress updates; Scientists, who develop test plans and analyze the resulting data; External parties, such as technicians who calibrate equipment or perform building maintenance. Your responsibilities will include: Gathering and coordinating cost estimates and project timelines; Developing and maintaining the schedule; Organizing and chairing the weekly lab team meeting; Booking equipment and facilities; Promoting continuous improvement, for instance through evaluations; Initiating informal gatherings for colleagues In short, you will work closely with a highly dedicated team to facilitate unique testing for a wide variety of projects. What we expect from you You are a practical and proactive professional who knows how to maintain an overview in a dynamic research environment. You easily navigate interactions between researchers, project managers, and scientists, and you take responsibility for ensuring that tests run smoothly. You take initiative, think in terms of solutions, and make sure that tasks are completed. Thanks to your organizational talent, client-focused attitude, and collaborative approach, you make a significant contribution to the successful execution of research within the Delft Construction Innovation Lab (Delft BouwinnovatieLab). You hold at least a bachelor’s degree (HBO level) and have experience in project management and/or conducting test procedures. You possess several years of demonstrable, relevant work experience. You are familiar with laboratory environments and the types of tests conducted within them. You can easily maintain an overview and are skilled at setting priorities. You have excellent communication skills and a client- and results-oriented mindset. You enjoy working as part of a team and proactively keep colleagues informed. You are capable of interacting professionally with clients—for example, when conducting tours of the lab. You are naturally curious and helpful, with an interest in complex experimental setups, hydraulics, sensors, measurement systems, data acquisition, and the execution of measurements. Finally, you have an excellent command of the Dutch language, both spoken and written. Proficiency in English is an advantage. items.desc: As a software developer within the Faculty of Geosciences at Utrecht University, you will work on the development of linking and bringing together existing research datasets and platforms. Your job This function specifically targets software development for the GeoFAIR project. The project aims to improve the discoverability, interoperability, and reuse of existing (inter)national infrastructure for data sharing (e.g. online data tools and portals, data standards, web viewers) by developing an integration layer through which their metadata can be harvested and searched. The resulting integrated connection services will be deployed in the Delta Enigma data infrastructure; the national access point for biogeomorphology research data: https://delta-enigma.nl/. In this role, you will work together with the task leader to explore and develop methods for data exchange using automated workflows. You can also contribute to (inter)national network and associated meetings if you are interested. This is what you will do: being involved in the entire process of making research data collected by sensors and generated in laboratories from rivers, estuaries and coasts easier to re-use; interacting with other developers and engineers internally within the project and externally at collaborators; using adopted (meta)data standards and existing data processing methods to develop new data transfer procedures contribute to designing a common metadata model and document mapping between the existing metadata standards, writing automated tests to ensure the quality of your software; involve project stakeholders to realize new features or make integration layers on top of the existing data infrastructures. Your qualities With the qualities below, you are the ideal candidate for this position. Required: You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a similar field; You have experience coding with Python; Experience with search engines and techniques (e.g. SOLR, Elasticsearch) and databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL); Experience with metadata harvesting and technologies such as JSON, XML, CSV; Experience with REST APIs or similar interfaces. Beneficial: Affinity with metadata standards and schemes such as DataCite and (Geo)DCAT, Affinity with metadata harvesting methods such as OAI-PMH; You have experience with software development in a Scrum team; Experience with automated software deployments (CI/CD), Docker and testing; Experience with GNU/Linux (Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL); Opensource software development attitude; You have good interpersonal skills and are able to explain concepts in a practical way; You have good Dutch and English language skills. items.desc: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs. What are you going to do? Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack. Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools. Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics. Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow. Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests. Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test. Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations. Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work. Qualifications Core Requirements: BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field. 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones. Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces. Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent. Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs. A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems. Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one. Bonus Points Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware. Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries. Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption. Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. You run Alaura day to day, you own what happens next, and you get real ownership in return. How we got here Three of us ( Marleen , Michael and Sharon ) kept circling the same problem: as a founder, you spend most of your time explaining your business to advisors and coaches. By the time someone has the full picture, the moment you needed the advice is long gone. So we started experimenting. Recording everything, analysing how decisions actually get made, and turning behaviour into something you can learn from. Then House of Founders happened: eight Dutch top founders, one villa in Cape Town, five days, AI as the ninth co-founder. Alaura was one of the companies built that week, and 1,200 entrepreneurs saw it at the launch event in Rotterdam. Since then we've built the product, put it in the hands of paying users and lined up the funding to grow. The three of us stay closely involved as founders and investors, but not day to day. That's the seat we're filling. What Alaura actually does Captures the meetings you lead with a small pendant, privately and encrypted Measures every conversation on 37 signals, rolled up into one daily Edge Score Coaches you with an evening reflection, a morning tip, an advisor you can chat with and a weekly report, against your own baseline Stays yours. Your conversations are never shared, not with your team and not with your board Two ways to buy it: Alaura for the individual leader (€149 per month or €1,490 per year, pendant included), and Alaura for Teams for leadership teams, with team insights, meeting dynamics and a quarterly review with a coach. What we're looking for You'll run Alaura as its operating co-founder, working side by side with our founding engineer. Concretely, you'll own things like: Sales and growth. Sell Alaura to founders and CEOs yourself, land the first Alaura for Teams customers, and build the pipeline from there Go-to-market. Positioning, pricing, campaigns, events and partnerships, tested fast and measured honestly Customers. Onboarding, retention and the daily feedback loop from users into the product Product direction. Decide with the engineer what gets built next, based on what customers actually do and pay for Operations and finance. Budget, runway, cash, suppliers and the pendant supply chain, so the company runs without the founders in the room Team and funding. Make the next hires and lead the next investment round together with the founders The plan is ambitious and concrete: grow monthly recurring revenue month over month and make Alaura profitable in 2027. You own that plan. You'll probably love this if you Have sold to founders, CEOs or leadership teams and closed the deals yourself Have built or run a startup or scale-up, as founder or in an early operating role, and know what it takes to go from first customers to a real company Are commercial and numbers-driven: you know your funnel, your churn and your runway without opening a spreadsheet Are AI-first in how you work, and use tools like Claude to move faster on everything from sales to finance Take ownership without waiting for permission, and want to be measured on results Have a network among founders and executives in the Netherlands Bonus points Experience with coaching, leadership development or HR tech Experience with B2B SaaS subscriptions, or with a product that combines hardware and software You speak Dutch and English fluently What we offer Real co-founder equity: up to 30% of Alaura, in three tranches of 10%, with 4-year vesting and a 1-year cliff Salary: €3,500 to €5,000 gross per month to start, stepping up to 115% and then 130% as we hit milestones together A running start: a product with paying users, a founding engineer, and funding for the next phase Founders behind you: direct access to three operator-founders who've built companies before, plus the Builders venture studio The seat: start in February 2027, on-site in Rotterdam and Amsterdam. This isn't a remote position. Sounds like you? Send us anything that shows how you build a business: a company you started, a market you opened up, numbers you moved. CVs are fine, but they're not what will convince us. If you know someone who is this person but isn't on the market, please connect us. The best intro wins a free year of Alaura. Alaura is a company, born out of House of Founders .

About the role ShipMonk is a fast-growing 3PL whose operations run 24/7 across Europe and the US. Our Security team covers compliance, incident response, identity, and security operations for the whole company. We're hiring an engineer who will work across all of these areas rather than specialize in one. Your time will be split roughly evenly between day-to-day operations and building the capabilities we don't have yet. AI is part of how we work. We expect you to adapt quickly and use AI tools to improve work efficiency and strengthen our company's security posture. What you'll do Security culture and practices: challenge existing development practices and drive a security-first mindset across engineering teams. Vulnerability management and penetration testing: identify and assess vulnerabilities in our applications through internal penetration testing. CI/CD security automation: build and maintain automated vulnerability discovery (SAST, DAST, dependency and secret scanning) in the CI/CD pipeline. Secure developer education: educate developers on secure coding practices so security issues are caught before code reaches production. Identity and access: own Okta security policies, Okta privileged access; audit integrated apps; run a regular access review cycle, secure access requests process. Incident response and investigations: triage, contain and analyse incidents; reconstruct timelines; provide evidence to Legal and HR; review reported phishing. Detection and monitoring: automatically read and process logs, and set up automated playbooks for our core tooling such as Okta, AWS, Snowflake, Google Workspace, and our ShipMonk app; build detection engineering and threat hunting capabilities. Cloud, SaaS and endpoint security: secure Google Workspace, SSO/SAML integrations and third-party OAuth apps; define MDM security baselines; give security input early in design decisions. Application security: understanding of vulnerabilities, patching, stakeholder management. Compliance and risk: support SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and ISO27001 security frameworks; coordinate penetration tests and follow up on remediation. Respond to customer security questionnaires; run vendor assessments and subprocessor management; maintain the risk register. AI-assisted security: use AI tools for investigations, log analysis, detection writing, automation and compliance work; help shape how the team uses AI safely and effectively. Awareness: run security communications, phishing simulations and tabletop exercises. What you bring 3+ years in security engineering, security operations or similar role Hands-on experience with incident response and log analysis. Strong IAM skills: Okta or a similar identity provider, SSO/SAML, MFA Experience securing cloud and SaaS environments such as Google Workspace, GCP, or AWS. Experience with a SIEM and writing detection rules. Scripting skills (Python or similar) and comfort working with APIs. Working knowledge of SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Hands-on use of AI tools such as LLM assistants or coding agents in daily work, alongside an agile mindset with a habit of learning and adapting. Fluency in English and the ability to push security work forward across teams. Nice to have: Vanta, Datadog, Snowflake, GitLab, or threat hunting experience. Why join You'll be building a security function, not maintaining one. Half your time goes to things we don't have yet: detection engineering, automated playbooks, threat hunting. You'll design them, pick the approach, and see them run in production. The scope is wide on purpose. You'll touch identity, incident response, cloud, compliance, and awareness in the same quarter, so you'll grow faster than in a team where one person owns one tool. Our stack is modern and real: Okta, AWS, Snowflake, Google Workspace, and our own ShipMonk platform, which runs warehouses across Europe and the US around the clock. We use AI in daily work, not as a slide in a strategy deck. You'll get room to try new tools for investigations, log analysis, and detection writing, and to help decide how the team uses them safely. We provide cutting-edge technology and a network of owned and operated fulfillment centers that empower high-growth ecommerce and DTC brands to stress less and grow more. With over 2,500 employees across five countries, we're on a mission to revolutionize fulfillment by providing everything from the fastest click-to-delivery and real-time inventory to custom solutions—all with a merchant - first mindset. Droplabs to krakowska firma, która stworzyła system sprzedaży biletów online, wykorzystywany przez największe firmy z branży Tours&Attractions&Activities, jak np. aquaparki, parki rozrywki czy inne atrakcje turystyczne. Naszym celem jest digitalizacja branży rekreacyjno-turystycznej aby wszystkim usprawnić dostęp do najciekawszych atrakcji. Naszymi klientami są m.in. Tatrzański Park Narodowy, Chochołowskie Termy czy Zoo Wrocław. Od 2023 roku propagujemy i wdrażamy w obiektach turystycznych strategię cen dynamicznych. Opieramy ją na własnych rozwiązaniach z zakresu uczenia maszynowego. Pomagają one przewidywać frekwencję i wyciągać maksymalną wartość z dostępności atrakcji w realiach danego sezonu, pogody i prowadzonego marketingu. Dzięki temu nasi klienci mogą podejmować decyzje w oparciu o dane, efektywniej zarządzać dostępnością i zwiększać przychody, a odwiedzający zyskują lepszy dostęp do atrakcji - samodzielnie podejmując decyzje odpowiadające ich preferencjom budżetowym i preferencjom co do terminu wizyty. Jako Junior Data Analyst w Droplabs dołączysz do zespołu analityki i będziesz pracować z prawdziwymi danymi, na których opierają się decyzje naszych klientów oraz rozwój produktu. Zadbasz o to, żeby dane trafiające do naszego systemu były kompletne i poprawne - od przygotowania danych klientów, przez ich wgrywanie, po analizę tego, jak użytkownicy korzystają z produktu. To dobre miejsce na start w analityce: uczysz się na realnych przypadkach u boku bardziej doświadczonych osób, a z czasem przejmujesz samodzielne analizy i rozwój dashboardów. Wymagania Analityczne myślenie, dokładność i sumienność - dostrzegasz, kiedy coś w danych się nie zgadza. Wykształcenie wyższe lub status studenta ostatnich lat na kierunku informatyka, matematyka, fizyka, ekonometria lub pokrewnym, w trybie umożliwiającym pracę w pełnym wymiarze godzin. Bardzo dobra znajomość Google Sheets lub Excela (formuły, tabele przestawne, filtrowanie i łączenie danych). Podstawowa znajomość języka Python w zakresie pracy z danymi (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). Podstawy statystyki. Doświadczenie w przygotowaniu, weryfikacji i analizie danych zdobyte w pracy, na stażu lub praktykach na stanowisku Data Analyst, Business Analyst lub podobnym albo w udokumentowanych projektach własnych, open-source lub studenckich. Ciekawość danych, proaktywne podejście i umiejętność jasnego przekazywania informacji o danych, także osobom nietechnicznym. Biegła znajomość języka polskiego oraz znajomość angielskiego umożliwiająca swobodne czytanie dokumentacji. Mile widziane Znajomość Amplitude. Znajomość pojęć związanych z e-commerce. items.desc: Sprzedawaj sprzęt, który pilnuje budów, dróg i obiektów strategicznych w 20 krajach Sprzedajesz sprzęt, który pilnuje budów, dróg i obiektów strategicznych w 20 krajach. Kupują go służby, wojsko, policja, samorządy i firmy ochrony, w Polsce i za granicą, także w dużych, nietypowych projektach. Rozwijamy dział handlowy w rodzinnej firmie liczącej 10-15 osób. Szukamy dwóch osób, z których każda może z czasem poprowadzić dział. Potrzebujemy kogoś, kto nie czeka na polecenia: widzi, co trzeba zrobić, ustala priorytety i dowozi temat do końca. Naszych produktów nauczymy Cię szybko, ale organizacji pracy, samodzielności i podejmowania decyzji oczekujemy od początku. Na start będziesz się zajmować sprzedażą Samodzielnym prowadzeniem jednego segmentu produktu CAMSAT: oferta, ceny, klienci i wyniki sprzedaży. Korespondencją i rozmowami z klientami i partnerami: ok. 80% po polsku, ok. 20% po angielsku z partnerami zagranicznymi. Usprawnianiem procesów sprzedażowych, także z wykorzystaniem narzędzi AI. Ścieżka do lidera: nauczymy Cię zarządzania Nie oczekujemy, że przyjdziesz jako gotowy lider. Dobry handlowiec nie zostaje liderem z dnia na dzień, dlatego u nas uczysz się tego krok po kroku, na prawdziwych sprawach: prowadzenia ludzi: jak dawać feedback, przekazywać zadania i wdrażać nowe osoby, prowadzenia projektów: jak ustalać priorytety i pilnować terminów oraz jakości ofert w zespole, trudnych rozmów i negocjacji z klientami, planowania sprzedaży działu, razem z właścicielem firmy. Do tego dofinansowujemy lub w całości opłacamy szkolenia z przywództwa i negocjacji. Nie zostajesz z tym sam/a: nowe zadania przejmujesz stopniowo, w tempie, które ustalamy razem. Czy wybierzesz tę ścieżkę, decydujesz Ty. Jak u nas pracujemy? Mówimy sobie wprost, co działa, a co nie. Oczekujemy tego także od Ciebie. Błąd zgłaszasz od razu, nie chowasz go. Jeśli nie zdążysz z terminem, mówisz o tym wcześniej, a nie po fakcie. Szukamy rozwiązań, nie winnych. Dbasz o dobrą atmosferę. Nasze wymagania Doświadczenie w sprzedaży lub obsłudze klienta B2B/B2G, najlepiej produktów technicznych, w tym samodzielne prowadzenie klienta od zapytania do zamówienia. Samodzielnie przygotowujesz oferty, zestawienia i raporty: w Excelu, w systemie CRM i z pomocą narzędzi AI (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT i inne). Samodzielność w organizacji pracy i ustalaniu priorytetów przy kilku tematach naraz. Język angielski na poziomie min. B2: swobodna komunikacja w mowie i piśmie, bez specjalistycznego słownictwa. Te umiejętności sprawdzimy w praktyce na spotkaniu w firmie. Mile widziane Plus dla Ciebie, jeśli potrafisz coś z tej listy. Im więcej pozycji masz na koncie, tym wyższe wynagrodzenie możemy zaproponować. Samodzielnie wyszukujesz firmy i osoby, które podejmują decyzje zakupowe (właściciele, dyrektorzy, szefowie działów), przez LinkedIn, internet i narzędzia AI, i budujesz z nich bazę potencjalnych klientów. Potrafisz otworzyć rozmowę z nowym klientem: piszesz krótką, trafną wiadomość na LinkedIn lub e-mail albo dzwonisz, docierasz do właściwej osoby i umawiasz pierwsze spotkanie. Wykształcenie techniczne. To oferujemy Ścieżkę do roli lidera działu handlowego: zaczynasz od własnych segmentów i projektów, a z czasem, jeśli zechcesz, możesz przejąć koordynację działu. Realny wpływ na firmę: u nas każdy pomysł jest analizowany, a duża część z nich wdrażana. Na tym stanowisku sam/a też o wielu rzeczach decydujesz. Bezpośrednią współpracę z właścicielem firmy. Dofinansowanie dojazdów do pracy; dogodny dojazd z Bydgoszczy (16 km) i Torunia (25 km), pociągi co ok. 40 min. Stabilne zatrudnienie w firmie z ponad 20-letnią historią: staż pracy wielu osób to 8-13 lat. Benefity dofinansowanie nauki języków dofinansowanie szkoleń i kursów brak dress code’u kawa / herbata parking dla pracowników paczki świąteczne dofinansowanie dojazdów do pracy możliwość uzyskania uprawnień Czego się u nas nauczysz Naszych produktów i techniki od strony praktycznej. Szkolenia produktowe prowadzą liderzy i właściciel firmy osobiście. Sprzedaży do służb, wojska, policji, samorządów i firm ochrony, w Polsce i za granicą, w tym prowadzenia dużych, nietypowych projektów. Naszych procesów i narzędzi (Pipedrive, ClickUp, Comarch ERP Optima, Premium AI), żeby z ich pomocą pilnować pracy całego działu. Rozwoju w wybranym kierunku: szkolenia wewnętrzne, dofinansowane lub w całości opłacone szkolenia zewnętrzne i dostęp do płatnych materiałów do nauki. Jak Cię wdrożymy Pierwsze tygodnie: od razu pracujesz na prawdziwych sprawach. Poznajesz produkty, ludzi w dziale i nasze procesy, które mamy opisane krok po kroku. Pierwsze miesiące: przejmujesz własne segmenty i kluczowych klientów, a razem z właścicielem firmy planujesz pracę działu. Kolejne miesiące: jeśli wybierzesz ścieżkę lidera, zaczynasz wspierać innych w dziale i stopniowo przejmujesz koordynację. Tempo ustalamy wspólnie: im szybciej wejdziesz w produkty i nasz sposób pracy, tym wcześniej przejmiesz rolę lidera. Jak przebiegnie rekrutacja Krok …

items.desc: Performance Specialist Cześć! Tu KERRIS - od 14 lat rozwijamy się jako agencja digitalowa łącząca kompetencje agencji kreatywnej i mediowej pod pod hasłem performance meets creativity. Pracujemy dla dużych marek, projektując kreatywne reklamy i komunikację w social media, za które co sezon zgarniamy kilka nagród. Nasz zespół Performance odpowiada za to, żeby kreatywne pomysły przekładały się na realne wyniki biznesowe, a jego główna specjalizacja to kampanie dla marek e-commerce. Skalujemy działania, mocno wykorzystując pracy automatyzację i AI. Szukamy osób, które chcą robić to razem z nami dla topowych polskich (i nie tylko) firm! Performance Specialist, czyli kogo szukamy? Osoby, która może o sobie powiedzieć, że jest specjalistą, ale rozumie, że performance marketing zmienia się szybciej niż kiedykolwiek i wymaga ciągłej nauki. Automatyzacja przejmuje bidding i targetowanie, a wartość przesuwa się w stronę ludzi, którzy potrafią z danych wyciągać wnioski dla biznesu klienta. Chcemy, żebyś zmieniał się razem z tym rynkiem, nie zamykał w jednej roli. Nie szukamy osoby, która tylko "wyklika" kampanie. Szukamy kogoś, kto: potrafi porozmawiać z klientem o jego biznesie, nie tylko o metrykach kampanii z danych wyciąga wnioski i proponuje działania, wykraczające poza sam paid jest ciekawy i chce się rozwijać, bo to, co dziś działa w performance, za rok będzie wyglądać inaczej Twój zakres obowiązków: Samodzielne prowadzenie kampanii performance dla klientów, przede wszystkim w Google Ads, Meta Ads i TikTok Ads; analiza danych z GA4, Looker Studio i DV360 oraz przekładanie ich na konkretne rekomendacje i działania; bieżąca optymalizacja kampanii i szukanie nowych możliwości skalowania wyników; bezpośrednia współpraca z klientami - rozmowa o wynikach, biznesie, wyzwaniach i dalszych kierunkach działań; formułowanie hipotez i rekomendacji na podstawie danych analitycznych oraz, tam gdzie są dostępne, również danych z eyetrackingu; współpraca z zespołem kreatywnym KERRIS przy planowaniu i testowaniu kreacji; współpraca z innymi zespołami KERRIS przy szukaniu możliwości wzrostu wykraczających poza sam performance; korzystanie z AI i automatyzacji jako naturalnego elementu codziennej pracy. Czego oczekujemy? na tym stanowisku niezbędne będą: minimum 2 lata doświadczenia w samodzielnym prowadzeniu kampanii performance; bardzo dobra znajomość Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, DV360, GA4 i Looker Studio; umiejętność analizy danych i wyciągania z nich konkretnych, biznesowych wniosków; proaktywność w szukaniu rozwiązań i testowaniu nowych kierunków; gotowość do bezpośredniej, partnerskiej rozmowy z klientem o jego biznesie - nie tylko o raportach, tabelkach i wynikach kampanii; samodzielność i ownership - zależy nam na osobie, która bierze odpowiedzialność za prowadzone projekty i aktywnie szuka sposobów na poprawę wyników; dobre odnajdywanie się w dynamicznym środowisku agencji digitalowej; bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie. Mile widziane: doświadczenie w Marketplace Ads; doświadczenie w pełnym wdrażaniu analityki i pracy na warstwie danych; doświadczenie we wdrażaniu lub testowaniu feedów produktowych; doświadczenie w pracy z e-commerce i markami, dla których performance jest istotnym elementem sprzedaży. Co oferujemy? pracę przy kampaniach dla topowych marek; możliwość realnego wpływania na sposób, w jaki rozwijamy kompetencje Performance w KERRIS; przestrzeń na własne pomysły, eksperymentowanie i szukanie nowych obszarów wzrostu; współpracę z zespołem kreatywnym - wierzymy, że najlepszy performance powstaje na styku danych i dobrego pomysłu; zespół, który inspiruje, motywuje i lubi to, co robi; lidera, który wspiera, rozwija i bawi; benefity: karta Multisport, pakiet WellBee, ubezpieczenie zdrowotne, udział w szkoleniach i konferencjach; pracę w modelu hybrydowym: 2 dni w biurze na ul. Burakowskiej, 3 dni zdalnie Wynagrodzenie 10 000 - 12 000 netto przy umowie B2B, lub ekwiwalent przy innej formie współpracy. Podeślij nam swoje CV i napisz kilka zdań o projektach performance, z których jesteś najbardziej dumny/dumna - szczególnie takich, w których udało Ci się nie tylko poprawić wyniki kampanii, ale realnie wpłynąć na biznes klienta. items.desc: Company Description InPost Group is Europe’s leading out-of-home delivery partner, making deliveries secure and convenient for millions of customers every day in more than 15 countries, including Poland, the UK, Italy, Spain, Portugal, and France. We operate under two brands: InPost and Mondial Relay. We provide a cost-effective and greener solution for merchants, offering customers greater convenience. At the heart of our business are the Automated Parcel Machines (aka Parcel Lockers), which we have been designing and producing in-house for years. At InPost Group, we believe that creating and sharing value with our stakeholders is about more than just financial returns. Thanks to the Parcel Locker delivery model, our growth contributes to the reduction of the carbon footprint by up to 75% compared to traditional courier deliveries, and we pursue an ambitious ESG program to increase our impact for a more sustainable world. This year, we will be delivering more than 600 million parcels using more than 25,000 lockers; our network and parcel volumes consistently grow year on year in every market we serve. Job Description The purpose of this role is to support a smooth, timely, and positive onboarding experience for newly hired employees. items.desc: About the Team We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers. We're looking for a Junior Cybersecurity Specialist to join our Security Team . This role sits within the engineering direction of our cross-functional Security team, focused on identifying and helping mitigate security issues, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities related to corporate infrastructure. In this role, you'll work closely with infrastructure teams (Admins, NOC, OPS, IT Compliance) and business employees who require security-related help. We work in Agile (2-week sprints, grooming, planning, retro) and use Google Meet, Slack, TargetProcess and Confluence for teamwork. Working hours: Business hours, EET/EEST time zone. You'll work with a modern stack and grow within the company - including cloud and hybrid infrastructure, and AI applied to real security work. Tech Stack: Splunk, CheckPoint, Rapid7, AWS, OpenStack, Gitlab, K8s, Terraform, Ansible, Python, Linux, Windows, macOS. Tasks Proceed with requests and notifications related to the security (access management, security tool notifications, vulnerability assessment, etc.); Identify and help mitigate security issues, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities related to corporate infrastructure; Develop, implement new, and update existing security measures for the protection of corporate infrastructure; Support the identity and access management process; Formation of a knowledge base for the operation of products and services; Assist the security analytics with the incident response process; Collaboration with the Ops and Infrastructure teams in terms of asset security. Requirements 1+ year of experience in server administration, network engineering, site reliability engineering, infrastructure security, cloud security, or systems engineering; Knowledge of the Linux, Windows, and Mac operating systems and common OS hardening practices; Technical knowledge of network protection and network Device Hardening; Automation skills (Bash, Python); Understanding how computer attacks occur; Passion for developing in cybersecurity; Ability to work in a team, listen, and learn independently; Competent written and verbal communication skills (Russian C1 and English B1); Have a good analytical mindset for problem-solving. Nice to have Background in cybersecurity; Experience using AI tooling for technical/cybersecurity tasks; Experience in vulnerability analysis; Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, Chef, etc.); Understanding the tactics and techniques of intruders and how to defend against them. We offer Full-time remote work (service provider contract). Competitive compensation (EUR). Flexible working hours. Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.). Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency. A strong team of engineers. Positive and friendly atmosphere. With a team of 500+ creative and tech-driven people across the globe, Quadcode is the place where ideas turn into impact, where every project is a chance to grow, innovate, and make your mark. Join us today, and let's shape the future of fintech together! Note: All applications will be treated with strict confidence. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. #LI-JM1

items.desc: Location: Wrocław Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: Nov 12, 2026 Job description Requisition ID: 1759443 Security Technology – Cloud Security Engineer Location: Wrocław / Katowice - 2 days in office / 3 days remote Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY. EY Technology: Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 1000 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust. Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value. The opportunity We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer to join our Security Technology Services Engineering team. In this role you will help design and deliver organization-wide secure development capabilities, including standardized CI/CD patterns that embed security tooling and quality gates, so teams can build and ship securely at scale. You will also contribute to cloud security engineering across Azure, AWS, and GCP, including CNAPP platforms such as Wiz, and support selective use of AI to strengthen security workflows and guide secure AI adoption. You will work alongside like-minded engineers, partner across technology and security teams, and help make security automated, consistent, and easier for developers to adopt. Your key responsibilities As an individual contributor, you’ll bring your engineering expertise into efforts which introduce new technologies and upgrade existing ones. Active project participation in new or integrated technologies as the Subject Matter Expert for the Information Security use cases pertaining to Cloud Security technology. You will be responsible for the design, engineering, implementation, and early life cycle support of systems and services within our EY multi-cloud environments. You will work closely with Teams across EY such as: Security Architects, Service Delivery, Security Operations, and Cyber Defense for the enablement of security solutions and services. You will also provide consulting services to other teams and act as a level four contact for operational issues. Provide technical oversight of Information Security technologies that fall under the team’s responsibilities, confirming they are operating within agreed service levels and at peak possible performance Represent the team in specific Project activities, including Leading projects and managing the activity of others towards successful completion. Engineer security solutions and services following all relevant EY standards and practices for On-Premises, Hybrid and Cloud-Based environments. Lead the design, implementation, testing of security solutions and services for a large or more complex project to its completion which includes production support and documentation. Take accountability for the design, delivery, and maintenance of new and existing security solutions or services, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards. Apply modern standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, security standards, design standards, to security solutions and services as appropriate. Improve existing security solutions and services in use by partnering with Security Architecture, Service Owners, and Security Operations. Drives automation and innovation across the security solutions supported. Work in a diverse, global environment and build strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically, and culturally dispersed organization. items.desc: Location : Europe (Remote) What is Vetric? Vetric is the intelligence behind the teams that stop crime online. Investigators, analysts and platform defenders use Vetric to see what bad actors do in the open, from fraud and impersonation to organized crime, terror networks and foreign influence, so they can act before harm spreads. Vetric doesn’t do that work itself but powers the people who do. The social and video intel runs inside customers’ own products, as a dependency their roadmaps are built on, which is why reliability and depth count for as much as coverage. Operating globally, Vetric serves industry leaders across more than 20 countries in cybersecurity, digital risk protection and public safety teams. ﻿ Why Vetric? Vetric is profitable from day one (fully bootstrapped - we haven’t raised external funding), and we’re building foundational technology - not chasing trends. Because this is infrastructure that matters, we operate with engineering discipline, strong ownership, and long-term thinking. We’re at a true inflection point: the team is now large enough to require real infrastructure, yet still small enough that what you build will define how things work for the next several years. This is infrastructure that matters and so is how we operate internally. You’ll be working with a sharp, focused team that takes engineering discipline seriously and is intentionally building an organization that matches the quality of its product. Position Overview We’re looking for a Security Researcher to join our Mobile Reverse Engineering team, working remotely from anywhere in Europe. You’ll reverse engineer some of the world’s most widely used Android apps, uncover how they really work, and build the tools that turn your findings into the data pipelines our customers rely on. Role & Responsibilities As a Security Researcher, your role will include: Reverse engineering major Android applications to extract strategic product intelligence. Working with tools such as Frida, JEB, Ghidra, IDA, and custom-built instrumentation frameworks. Analyzing obfuscation techniques, ARM-native binaries, and root/jailbreak detection mechanisms. Assessing architectural and functional changes across app versions. Developing internal tools and scripts to automate and scale static/dynamic analysis workflows. Analyzing TLS and HTTP/2 fingerprints. Extracting and reconstructing data structures such as Protobuf and GraphQL. Researching and developing bot detection evasion techniques. Analyzing RASP (Runtime Application Self-Protection) mechanisms. Analyzing hardware attestation mechanisms. Using AI tools to speed up and support the research process. Collaborating with engineering and intelligence teams to turn technical findings into actionable insights. Note: All research is conducted strictly within legal and ethical boundaries. We do not engage in hacking or unauthorized access. Requirements: Qualifications 3+ years in Android reverse engineering, mobile security research, or related low-level development roles. Strong proficiency in Android internals and Java, with working knowledge of Smali and APK structure. Scraping experience. Deep understanding of Frida and runtime manipulation techniques on Android. A curiosity-driven mindset with a passion for exploring undocumented system behaviors and edge cases. We’d be lucky if you had Familiarity with Typescript scripting for analysis automation. Experience with anti-analysis evasion, obfuscators, or commercial packers. Previous work with IDA Pro, Radare2, or other RE platforms. Web scraping, JavaScript deobfuscation, browser security analysis and fingerprinting We hire people, not just skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this role is a great fit for you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements.

items.card: About the role. You will: Design and produce high-quality graphic materials across print, digital and live event channels. items.desc: About Sollers Consulting Sollers Consulting is more than a consultancy and software integrator. As a company founded in 2000, our mission has been to transform the financial & insurance industries by helping them adapt to new technologies. The power of collaboration and the limitless potential of Sollers people are at the root of our success. We strive to be the best at what we do, both in the eyes of our team and our customers. We put people at the heart of every project. Join us and make Sollers be driven by… you! Markets and Media Our mission is to amplify Sollers’ growth and visibility. We’re dedicated to building our brand and positioning it globally. By fostering customer and media relations, conducting market research, organizing events, and enhancing internal communication, we play a significant role in the company’s expansion and success. About the role. You will: Design and produce high-quality graphic materials across print, digital and live event channels. The role requires responding promptly to requirements while maintaining quality and accuracy. Manage multiple simultaneous projects by confirming briefs, timelines, approvals and final deliverables with stakeholders. Work collaboratively with stakeholders to communicate realistic deadlines; manage feedback and provide clear creative rationale. Develop fresh, commercially aware ideas for seasonal campaigns, event themes, client communications and internal initiatives. Apply and strengthen brand guidelines across all internal and client-facing materials. Maintain consistency in typography, colour, iconography and identity across print, digital and physical formats. Prepare accurate final artwork for print and production, including specifications, version control and supplier-ready files. Maintain organized asset libraries, reusable templates and artwork archives to improve consistency and delivery speed. Adapt artwork for different formats and international markets. Accommodate translations, language length, local formatting conventions and cultural expectations. About the requirements. You need: Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a graphic design role within a corporate marketing team, delivering creative assets across digital, print, and live event channels. Proven ability to produce high-quality, on-brand design materials that support objectives and are delivered within agreed deadlines. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to assess, prioritize and manage multiple concurrent tasks while balancing quality, accuracy and speed of delivery. Experience in use of full range of graphic design tools, including AI, to support delivery, without compromising brand experience or quality of creative. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels, provide regular progress updates, and proactively identify and resolve potential issues or blockers. About the wishes. Nice to haves: Experience using motion graphic tools to deliver assets for use online and at events. Experience working in an international B2B technology provider or consultancy. About our promises. We can offer: Flexible working hours and a hybrid home office model (2-3 times per week in the office) as work-life balance is crucial at Sollers. A chance to be promoted twice a year and a clearly defined career path with salary forecast. Opportunities for growth with a training budget that you can use for courses and conferences. We also provide access to an online training platform and co-fund language classes. An internal coach to guide you through the onboarding, further training and career opportunities, plus a budget to be used for your lunches together. A chance to #domore for the planet and the community as part of Sollers Change Makers – our volunteering program. Lots of teambuilding activities, trips, hobby groups and cultural events to create a company powered by teamwork. Probably all the benefits you can think of! items.desc: At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple. The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf. Work closely with the agile team to learn the appropriate designs and practices to build Jamf products. Collaborate with experienced Engineers, Product Management and leadership to understand priorities and how those help us solve problems. This role is offered as hybrid with the expectation to be in Katowice office once or twice per quarter . We are only able to accept applications for those based in Poland and have sponsorship to live and work in Poland . #LI-Hybrid What you can expect to do in this role: Independently complete a majority of identified tasks from start to finish with high quality and collaborate with more experienced Engineers when needed. Efficiently use available tools with minimal. Demonstrate solid understanding of Engineering best. Ask the right questions, solve problems and build great. Partner with team to understand and communicate technical concepts with others in the organization (Technical Communication, Support, Product and Cloud). Perform well defined tasks with increasing independence and seeks guidance when needed from more experience Engineers. Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and purpose of the organization. Adhere to the highest moral, ethical and legal standards to deliver an environment that promotes respect, innovation and creativity. Support and promote a positive, inclusive workplace one in which the talents and strengths of our increasingly diverse workforce are welcomed, further developed and manifested in our work. What we are looking for: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field (preferred). A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered. Provide on-call support for services owned by the team, as part of a shared rotation schedule (required). Minimum 2 years of experience in developing enterprise grade software with understanding of testing and quality assurance processes (required). Minimum 2 years of experience in JVM application development (required). Experience and knowledge of Java and Spring (required), or Kotlin and Ktor (willingness to learn). Experience with frontend development, such as JavaScript with Angular or Vue, will be an advantage. Experience with and knowledge of microservices architecture (preferred). Strong knowledge of SQL databases (required). Experience with NoSQL databases, such as DynamoDB, will be an advantage. Knowledge of the following technologies will be an advantage: Kubernetes and Helm, AWS services, and observability tools (OpenSearch, Prometheus, Grafana). Experience with CI/CD and deployment tooling, including GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Docker, and Kubernetes (required). Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, will be an advantage. Understanding of service ownership and DevOps culture (required). Focus on software development best practices (required). Strong communication, analytical, and listening skills. Ability to work independently in a remote setting, with strong asynchronous communication skills. Strong written and oral English language skills. Why Jamf? Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024 Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News Our developers work in agile delivery teams to produce new features, improve software components, and are the subject matter experts for our Jamf product offerings. You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world. We constantly push the boundaries of technology, our developers support new innovations and OS releases the moment they are made available by Apple. Several Jamf engineers are named in patents and with team names like CatDog, ThunderSnow and Dalek you can expect to have some fun while building cutting-edge software. You will have the opportunity to work with a small and empowered team where the culture is based on trust, ownership, and respect. items.desc: Zbuduj z nami wieże, które zobaczysz potem na budowach i drogach Zbuduj z nami wieże, które zobaczysz potem na budowach i drogach. Nasze urządzenia pracują w 20 krajach, u służb specjalnych, wojska, policji i firm ochrony. Jesteśmy rodzinną firmą liczącą 10-15 osób. Szukamy osoby z doświadczeniem w montażu mechanicznym, która samodzielnie złoży konstrukcje ze stali i aluminium według rysunku. Na końcu jest gotowy element, na którym montujemy kamery. Montaż mechaniczny znasz z praktyki. Naszych urządzeń nauczymy Cię na miejscu. U nas nie stoisz przy taśmie: co kilka dni składasz coś innego. Co będziesz robić? Montujesz konstrukcje stalowe i aluminiowe według rysunków technicznych. Skręcasz, dopasowujesz i regulujesz elementy tak, żeby wszystko trzymało wymiar. Wiercisz, nitujesz i wykonujesz prace ślusarskie. Montujesz wieże z kamerami na przyczepach. Bierzesz udział w spotkaniach zespołu, na których Twoje uwagi z hali zmieniają projekt urządzenia. Wykonujesz proste prace przy okablowaniu. Jak u nas pracujemy? Odpowiadasz za to, co wychodzi spod Twoich rąk. Błąd zgłaszasz od razu, nie chowasz go. Lepiej poprawić go na hali niż u klienta. Jeśli coś nie zgadza się z rysunkiem albo nie zdążysz, mówisz o tym wcześniej. Mówisz wprost, co można zrobić lepiej, i spokojnie przyjmujesz uwagi. Dbasz o dobrą atmosferę. Nie odnajdziesz się u nas, jeśli czekasz, aż ktoś zauważy problem za Ciebie, albo traktujesz uwagi jak atak. Nasze wymagania Doświadczenie w montażu mechanicznym lub pracach ślusarskich. Samodzielne czytanie rysunku technicznego. Swobodna obsługa elektronarzędzi. Dokładność, bo nasze urządzenia mają działać bezawaryjnie. Mile widziane Każda z tych umiejętności to wyższa pensja na start. Uprawnienia na wózek widłowy. Nie masz ich? Wyślemy Cię na kurs. Doświadczenie elektryczne lub elektromechaniczne: lutowanie, kładzenie okablowania. Wykształcenie elektromechanik, elektryk, mechatronik lub pokrewne. To oferujemy Twój pomysł z hali naprawdę może zmienić nasze urządzenie. Zadania, które się zmieniają, zamiast pracy przy taśmie. Dofinansowanie dojazdów do pracy; dogodny dojazd z Bydgoszczy (16 km) i Torunia (25 km), pociągi co ok. 40 min. Wyślemy Cię na kurs na wózek widłowy i inne potrzebne uprawnienia. Bliski kontakt z przełożonym, u którego szybko dostaniesz odpowiedź albo pomoc. Stabilne zatrudnienie w firmie z ponad 20-letnią historią: staż pracy wielu osób to 8-13 lat. Benefity dofinansowanie szkoleń i kursów kawa / herbata parking dla pracowników paczki świąteczne dofinansowanie dojazdów do pracy możliwość uzyskania uprawnień Czego się u nas nauczysz Oczekujemy, że chcesz uczyć się nowych rzeczy. Nauczymy Cię: Montażu wież z kamerami i innych naszych urządzeń. Lutowania przewodów i składania wiązek kablowych. Czytania schematów elektrycznych naszych urządzeń. Montażu kamer przemysłowych. Pracy z narzędziami cyfrowymi i AI, które skracają codzienne zadania. Twoje wynagrodzenie rośnie z „klocków”. Każdy klocek to nowa umiejętność, którą wykonujesz samodzielnie, np. uprawnienia na wózek widłowy, składanie wiązek kablowych albo montaż kamer. Jak Cię wdrożymy Na start poznajesz nasze urządzenia, sposób montażu i zespół. Od pierwszych dni pracujesz przy prawdziwych zleceniach. Potem sam montujesz kolejne elementy. Przez cały czas masz przełożonego na miejscu, do którego przychodzisz z każdym pytaniem. Jak przebiegnie rekrutacja Krok 1. Aplikujesz przyciskiem. Załącz CV. Krok 2. Krótka rozmowa telefoniczna, 20-30 minut: kim jesteś, co umiesz, czego szukasz. Krok 3. Spotkanie u nas w firmie, ok. 2-3 godziny: rozmowa i krótkie zadanie praktyczne na hali. Zobaczysz, gdzie i z kim będziesz pracować. Pytaj o wszystko: to Twoja okazja, żeby sprawdzić nas tak samo, jak my sprawdzamy Ciebie. Krok 4. Decyzję przekazujemy w ciągu 48 godzin. Krok 5. Zatrudnienie: najpierw umowa o pracę na okres próbny (2-3 miesiące), potem umowa na rok, potem na czas nieokreślony. Od pierwszego dnia masz umowę o pracę. Jak aplikować? Chcesz złożyć z nami kolejną wieżę? Wyślij CV na praca@camsat.com.pl albo aplikuj przez nasze ogłoszenie na pracuj.pl. Wyślij CV Aplikuj przez pracuj.pl

items.desc: Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products—whether against heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals—and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. Our broad and evolving portfolio supports everything from global infrastructure modernization to the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles. We are currently looking for a Technical Service Specialist (m/f/d) – Coatings, Central Europe to join our team in Lodz, Poland. Responsbilities: Provide onsite technical support to customers Manage line trials to develop new business Partner with Area Sales Managers on solution-based selling Conduct plant/process audits and deliver improvement reports Manage technically driven accounts to grow business and retain customers Investigate and resolve quality issues Handle technical aspects of quality claims Build strong relationships with key accounts Deliver technical training programs (theoretical & practical) Liaise with suppliers and partners Contribute to the EMEA technical team Conduct Approved Applicator audits Manage the lab Requirements: Experienced professional with a proven track record in the powder coatings industry Strong technical and commercial understanding of coatings and chemical products Fluent in English and Polish with excellent stakeholder management skills Highly organized, self-motivated, and customer-focused Excellent communicator with strong networking and relationship-building abilities Dynamic and goal-oriented professional Strong communication and networking skills Working independently while being an effective team player Professional, ethical, and results-driven mindset Strong ability to represent and promote the Axalta brand Compensation The minimum salary for this position is 155,000 Zloty gross per year + Bonus plan. Overpayment is possible depending on qualifications and experience. Our Company: Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles. Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals. items.desc: Job Description As an Applications Engineer, you will join an Applications Engineering (AE) team that is responsible for supporting customers through their journey with Cognex. The AE team determines the right combination of Cognex products, lighting, optics and automation engineering for an optimal solution that fits within the customer’s defined budget and skillset. The AE team provides technical expertise to customers and collaborates with the Sales organization to influence the selling of Cognex products Essential Functions Provides application guidance for medium-complexity applications across Cognex products and prioritizes as necessary. For complex applications, may require the support of more experienced AEs. Provides standard integration of Cognex products with devices such as PLCs, PCs, or Controllers Performs standard troubleshooting for Cognex products and develops knowledge of peripheral technology Supports Sales with technical inputs when communicating with or visiting customers to help Cognex win. Shares findings with the AE community Responsible for maintaining business systems information in a timely manner for accurate reporting Provides product/customer feedback to AE Manager to improve products. Knowledge Develops a general technical knowledge of Cognex’s vision and sensor product families. General knowledge of image processing, optics and/or lighting for machine vision is desirable or can be developed quickly. General knowledge of industrial communication methods, networks, programming languages*, controls (installation, wiring, operability), PLCs, and/or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Programming languages may include: javascript, VB, VB.Net, C#, .Net, C++ General industry knowledge to include movement of product, understanding of motion control, robotics, and other automation equipment. General knowledge of controls engineering concepts such as installation, wiring, and operability from prior experience Working knowledge of MS Office applications. Windows based PC industrial connectivity in a lab and automation environment. Skills and Abilities Solid understanding of electro-mechanical solutions. Solid ability to conduct and troubleshoot onsite optimizations, perform trials, and conduct data analytics to improve performance on solutions. Solid ability to handle challenging customer situations. Solid interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively establish relationships, communicate, influence, and present to various stakeholders Solid presentation skills Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science; or an otherwise equivalent technical experience Typically requires a minimum of 2-4 years of experience in technical application development. Experience in a related or high-tech industry preferred. Ability to adapt to flexible working hours including the availability to work evening and weekend hours or varying work patterns depending on customer or project needs. Ability to be on-call and respond to customer emergencies. Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, sometimes on short notice. Travel will vary depending on region, time of year, and customer needs. Ability to work safely in industrial environments by strictly following safety guidelines and protocols (may vary per region/customer). This job has physical requirements including the ability to lift up to 50 pounds (appx. 23 kilograms). Must maintain customer confidentiality to protect confidential or sensitive customer information. Polish and English language proficiency (written and oral).
