items.desc: About the job The Partners for Projects (P4P) Trainee’s main mission is to participate in the framing, design, and follow-up phases of strategic global projects providing support to BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) Management in the transformation process, both locally and at Group level The P4P trainee will be acting as assistant and researcher and will support directly the project management team in intervention topics such as Industrialization, Transformation, ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance), Digital and AI (Artificial Intelligence), Data, among others Your Main Activities Are Perform quantitative and qualitative research and analysis to support ongoing technology projects and practices Create and take ownership of basic models and provide support to the development of business cases Prepare and participate in workshops and meetings using relevant techniques and providing insightful results Prepare and structure project presentations to clients Develop client-tailored solutions for previously structured problems Seek proactively to participate and help the team beyond the assigned duties Execute the tasks assigned respecting time schedule and deadlines Communicate and receive constructive feedback both in formal and informal ways Profile and Skills to Success Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Economy, or any related field Fluency in English, both oral and written Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint Great team spirit with motivation to learn and develop new skills Great communication skills with an empathic approach Problem-solving skills with an analytical approach #LI-Hybrid Why joining BNP Paribas? BNP Paribas, the European leader in banking and financial services in Europe, operates in 64 countries and has nearly 180,000 employees. The Group is structured around three operating divisions. Its business lines cooperate closely, as part of our integrated model, to meet the needs of all our clients in a coordinated manner: Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) , connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities; Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS) , brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses; Investment & Protection Services (IPS) , combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate. Our presence in Portugal In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates. Diversity and Inclusion Commitment BNP Paribas´ ambition is to cultivate an open and responsive environment for all that encourages collaboration and interaction. We demonstrate our commitment by actively contributing to the Group’s Diversity and Inclusion strategy and goals, in line with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As part of our local Corporate and Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal is committed to: Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees; Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard. To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society. Remote Working Conditions At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices. Commitment towards work/life balance Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life. To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page. Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered. In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

items.desc: Bilbao Posted 1 day ago At SATLANTIS, we develop advanced optical and space technologies with one purpose: solving global challenges from above. From our headquarters in Leioa (Bizkaia, Spain), we lead innovation in high-resolution Earth observation, satellite missions, and cutting-edge space systems. We are now offering the opportunity to join our Space Systems department as a Space Thermal & System Engineer, where you will contribute to the design, analysis, and verification of thermal architectures that ensure the performance, reliability, and mission success of our optical payloads and satellites. What’s in it for you Mission-driven engineering: You will contribute directly to the thermal design, performance, and reliability of systems that operate in real space missions, supporting Earth observation, strategic applications, and scientific exploration. Challenging, diverse projects: You will work on thermal design, simulations, satellite-level systems engineering, AIT, and mission-related activities, gaining hands-on experience across the full lifecycle of space systems. Growth and autonomy: You will learn from experienced engineers while gradually taking ownership of key thermal and system activities, with the trust and support to grow at your own pace. Flexible working hours: You will organize your schedule within a culture of autonomy and responsibility. Private health insurance: You will have access to comprehensive medical coverage that supports your wellbeing. Dynamic and collaborative environment: You will join a multidisciplinary team where learning, curiosity, and innovation are part of everyday work. Campus benefits: You will work within the UPV/EHU campus in Leioa, with access to facilities, services, and a vibrant research environment. Your mission As a Space Thermal & System Engineer, your purpose will be to design and validate the thermal architecture that ensures our payloads and satellites operate reliably across all mission phases. Your work will be essential to guaranteeing system performance, supporting spacecraft design, and enabling the success of multiple ongoing and future missions. You will also contribute to system-level engineering, satellite design, AIT activities, operational planning, and flight dynamics, gaining exposure to the full space engineering cycle. Tasks and responsibilities Primary focus: Thermal Architecture Design: define specific components, establish thermal budgets, select passive/active thermal control systems, and perform preliminary calculations. Component Selection: choose elements such as MLI/SLI, radiators, heaters, thermistors, thermal straps, heat pipes, cryocoolers, cold blocks, thermal interface materials, insulation materials, coatings, and paints. Detailed Design & Calculations: carry out design activities and thermal calculations from component level to top-level assembly. Simulation Analysis: interpret thermo-mechanical simulations and propose modifications or new solutions accordingly. Test Planning & Verification: prepare, support, and validate tests to verify thermal design performance. Documentation: generate preliminary investigation reports, detailed design reports, and PDR/CDR presentations. Thermal Simulations: perform simulations independently using ESATAN/ESARAD and transfer results to FEMAP. Secondary focus: Satellite & Mission Design: contribute to the definition and analysis of satellite missions. Systems Engineering: support system-level integration and coordination activities. Project Management: participate in planning, tracking, and execution of project milestones. Satellite Operations: provide input for satellite operation strategies and processes. AIT Engineering: collaborate in Assembly, Integration, and Testing activities. Flight Dynamics: contribute to mission analysis and flight dynamics engineering tasks. What will set you up for success Foundations in thermal design and analysis: Your knowledge in thermal modelling, simulations, or thermo-mechanical behaviour will help you contribute from day one and deepen your expertise as you face new engineering challenges. Hands-on attitude and problem-solving mindset: Your ability to approach complex technical problems with initiative, creativity, and persistence will allow you to excel in multidisciplinary space projects. Engineering background that supports growth: A degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering fields will give you the technical base to understand spacecraft systems and evolve into more complex responsibilities. Collaborative communication and adaptability: Your ability to work with different teams, contribute openly, and adapt to new tasks will help you thrive in an environment where responsibilities evolve with experience. Fluency in English: Speaking and writing English confidently will allow you to collaborate effectively in international contexts, share findings, and participate in design reviews. Basic programming knowledge: Familiarity with …

Long Description At AkzoNobel, we are looking for a Material Planner to join our Supply Chain team for the Decorative Paint Business Unit in Barcelona and play a key role in ensuring the availability of materials for our operations. Review the 12-week material outlook to ensure optimal stocking levels, considering storage constraints Ensure master data correctness & housekeeping of MRP & transactional data. items.desc: Hey there! We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission. About the role We're looking for an enthusiastic Junior User Researcher to join our growing team and work on Experiences research, uncovering opportunities around experience design and marketing. From museums in Mexico to sports competitions in Australia, your initial core task will be to make sure Fever gathers insightful, actionable post-experience feedback from attendees all over the world. This role is perfect for someone with a sharp eye for detail who feels comfortable working with broad and diverse groups of stakeholders. It carries a significant operational component: you'll keep our Post-Experience Survey running, gathering requirements from project teams, deploying surveys efficiently with our internal tools, and packaging and sharing the results. Once that's covered, you'll take on other projects and grow into a researcher who plans and runs studies with the right mix of qualitative and quantitative methods, and turns findings into clear, actionable insights that drive real product and business decisions. What you'll do Manage our proprietary post-experience feedback system, the core engine behind the insights the Experiences research team delivers to stakeholders across the company to track the quality and performance of our events. Engage with dozens of teams to understand the business questions that matter, and design post-experience feedback that answers them. Make sure feedback requests from colleagues and partners are delivered on time and accurately, while maintaining quality and comparability standards. Track live launches of our most strategic IPs and manage incoming requests for survey customisation. Oversee the set-up of new surveys, rigorously maintaining quality across all surveys launched globally in multiple languages. Work with partner teams such as Data and CRM to keep the feedback system and its related tools (e.g., data visualisation, email outreach campaigns) running smoothly. Deliver results to stakeholders through visualisation tools, helping them understand the relevant findings. Support partner-facing teams with analysis and storytelling, explaining methodology and how to interpret results. This means keeping oversight of dozens, sometimes hundreds, of Fever experiences every month. About you Must have skills: 2–3 years of professional experience. A proven track record in a role where attention to detail is key. Comfort keeping track of several groups of people at once and responding in a timely, professional way. You use AI tools where they help, and you own the accuracy of every output. It would be nice if you: Are comfortable communicating visually, making charts, slides, etc. Are proficient in at least one analysis tool or language (e.g., Excel, SPSS, SQL). Have previous experience in survey management, or in research more broadly. Speak both English and Spanish, and other languages too. Your growth trajectory In your first 3 months you'll get to know the post-experience feedback system inside out: how surveys are set up and deployed, the project teams that rely on them, and the partner teams you'll work with, such as Data and CRM. You'll take over day-to-day operations alongside the team and build up coverage across the experiences running each month. Between months 3 and 6 you'll reach the level of coverage we need, and start working on other projects. That's when you'll develop other core User Research skills, such as data analysis and presentation, other methods of data collection, and project definition. Benefits & Perks Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance. Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader. 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences. Home office friendly. Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with! Health insurance and other benefits such as …

items.desc: Hey there! We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission. What You'll Do: Own Zendesk configuration: triggers, automations, SLAs, routing, macros, forms and permissions, keeping the instance clean and well documented. Design routing and escalation flows across email, messaging, live chat and voice, so every request reaches the right person. Build and maintain Explore dashboards with clear, agreed KPIs, giving agents and leads self-serve performance views. Analyse ticket trends to spot root causes and opportunities to improve how we operate. Simplify agents' daily work through smarter workflows, automation and integrations, and train the team on tools. Support QA and workforce management with reliable tools, data and forecasting. Test new tools and AI features, measure their impact and track the return on what we invest in. Act as the main contact with Zendesk and other vendors. Lead support enhancement projects from start to finish when needed, working with Product, Engineering and Data from requirements to rollout. Who You Are: Must have 3+ years of hands-on Zendesk administration, ideally in a multi-brand setup. Strong Zendesk Explore skills. Proven experience managing projects end to end , from scoping to rollout and measurement. Background in support or CX operations. Analytical, tech-curious and quick to learn new tools. Fluent English and Spanish. Nice to have Experience with Zendesk AI, QA or Workforce Management. Zendesk Admin or Explore certifications. APIs, webhooks or automation tools (Make, Zapier); basic scripting. SQL or a BI tool. Experience with Airtable, Jira, Slack workflows or a CRM. B2B, marketplace or live-entertainment background. Why You'll Love It Here: Attractive compensation package with room to grow. 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher. Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt). Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance. Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes. Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration. Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan. Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons. Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location. Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office. Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

items.desc: Är du en erfaren C++-utvecklare som brinner för teknik och avancerad mjukvaruutveckling? Vill du arbeta nära den fysiska produkten och se resultatet av din kod i verkliga, högteknologiska fordon? Då kan det här vara en spännande möjlighet för dig! Din framtida utmaning Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med kvalificerad problemlösning och utveckling av inbyggd programvara i avancerade fordonsprojekt. Du blir en del av ett mindre, kompetent team med korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att påverka både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt. I rollen arbetar du med hela utvecklingskedjan, från tidig design och arkitektur till implementation, testning och färdig produkt. Du utvecklar robusta mjukvarulösningar, arbetar med realtidsfunktionalitet och optimerar prestanda och resursanvändning. Du samarbetar nära kollegor inom både mjukvara och hårdvara, där kodgranskning, kvalitet och teknisk problemlösning är naturliga delar av vardagen. En särskilt spännande del av arbetet är närheten till den färdiga produkten. Eftersom verksamheten är samlad på plats får du möjlighet att själv testa och verifiera din programvara direkt i fordonen. Den du är Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse och trivs med att arbeta med komplexa system där kvalitet, prestanda och tillförlitlighet är avgörande. Du har erfarenhet av C++ och en god förståelse för programmeringens grunder, exempelvis felsökning. Vi ser gärna att du har: Minst fem års erfarenhet av programmering (inkl. studier/hobby), främst i C++ Akademisk examen inom datavetenskap eller motsvarande Goda baskunskaper inom programmering, inklusive debugging och minneshantering Vana av Git och Linux. Det är extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av inbyggda system, realtidssystem eller utveckling av säkerhetskritiska produkter. Även kunskaper inom exempelvis multitrådning, nätverkskommunikation, Computer Vision, rendering, videokodning, maskininlärning eller spelmotorer är meriterande. Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och har lätt för att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska sammanhang. Du uppskattar att arbeta självständigt, tar gärna ansvar från idé till färdig lösning och trivs samtidigt med att utveckla idéer tillsammans med andra. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Vad du blir en del av Ett viktigt och spännande jobb i ett företag i stark långsiktig tillväxt! Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! Du kommer att få vara med när produkten blir till från idé till dess att den rullar ut till kund. Du kommer att få jobba med framtidens teknik i ett globalt företag där du har stora möjligheter till kompetens & karriärutveckling. BAE Systems levererar några av världens mest avancerade, teknikledande lösningar inom försvar, flyg och säkerhet. Vi har 100 000 kvalificerade medarbetare i mer än 40 länder. Genom att vi arbetar tillsammans med kunder och lokala partners, levererar vi produkter och tjänster med militär kapacitet, som skyddar människor och den nationella säkerheten samt säkrar viktig information och infrastruktur. BAE Systems Hägglunds fokuserar på utveckling, tillverkning, integration och support av ett brett spektrum av militära fordon till kunder över hela världen. Våra främsta produkter är medeltunga stridsfordon (CV90), bepansrade terrängfordon (BvS10), stöd och support samt elhybrida drivsystem för den civila marknaden. Pålitlig, Innovativ och Djärv är ledorden för vår verksamhet. Läs gärna mer om Örnsköldsvik och Höga Kusten på www.jobbaochlev.se/ - www.inspiration.ornskoldsvik.se - www.hogakusten.com/sv Kontaktperson Har du frågor kring tjänsten, är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef för Vehicle Information Systems, Jan Elfving, 0660-806 39 alternativt rekryteringskonsult Cathrine Lind, AxÖ Consulting, 070-577 06 18. Vi arbetar med försvarssekretess och exportkontroll, vilket innebär både legala krav samt speciella krav från våra kunder på oss som företag. Alla som anställs ska därför genomgå säkerhetskontroll och drogtest. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placeringsort Örnsköldsvik med möjlighet till visst distansarbete. Om du inte redan bor här, ser vi ser gärna att du blir en av alla som tagit steget och flyttat till Örnsköldsvik för jobb hos oss med möjligheten att kombinera karriär med allt som Höga Kusten har att erbjuda. Självklart erbjuder vi generöst flyttbidrag och goda villkor i övrigt. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan som vi ha senast 6 december! items.desc: Vill du utveckla mjukvara som används av tusentals människor och fordon varje dag? Vi söker Software Engineers till vårt Mobility-team i Göteborg, där du utvecklar system och tjänster hos ledande kunder inom fordonsindustrin. Som Software Engineer arbetar du i agila utvecklingsteam hos våra kunder inom bland annat backend- och molntjänster för fordonsdata, webbapplikationer, eller verktyg som utvecklings- och testorganisationer använder varje dag. Beroende på uppdrag och erfarenhet är detta en del av dina framtida arbetsuppgifter: Designa, koda och vidareutveckla applikationer, tjänster och verktyg. Skriva automatiserade tester, granska kod och bidra till en hållbar kodbas. Arbeta med CI/CD-flöden och följa koden hela vägen till produktion. Ta fram lösningar tillsammans med produktägare, testare och arkitekter. För seniora profiler: driva tekniska beslut och coacha mindre erfarna kollegor. Läs mer om vårt engagemang inom Mobility. Din bakgrund Civilingenjörs-, högskoleingenjörs- eller systemvetarexamen inom datateknik, mjukvaruteknik eller motsvarande. Minst 3 års erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling. Goda kunskaper i minst ett av språken Java, C#, Python, C++ eller TypeScript. Vana att arbeta med Git, kodgranskning och automatiserade tester. Erfarenhet av agilt arbetssätt, till exempel Scrum eller Kanban. Flytande engelska i tal och skrift. Svenska är ett plus. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Molnplattformar som AWS eller Azure. Containrar och orkestrering, till exempel Docker och Kubernetes. Webb- och API-utveckling, till exempel REST och React. Databaser, både SQL och NoSQL. Fordonsindustrin eller andra stora utvecklingsorganisationer. AI-stödd utveckling och nya verktyg. Bakgrundskontroll kan komma att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. Vem du är Du är självgående, lösningsorienterad och tar ansvar för din leverans och helheten. Du trivs med att lösa problem tillsammans med andra och vill utvecklas, både tekniskt och mot roller som tech lead, arkitekt eller specialist. Together Tech för hållbar produktutveckling Together Tech är ett teknikkonsultbolag som utvecklar produkter och tjänster tillsammans med våra kunder, både hos kund och i våra inhouse-projekt. Hos oss arbetar du tillsammans med andra ingenjörer som brinner för miljö och hållbarhet, alla med en vilja att skapa bestående lösningar med hjälp av teknik – eller som vi säger: Better World Tech! Din utveckling & vårt stöd Din utveckling och ditt välmående är viktigt för oss varpå vi erbjuder förmåner som stöttar dig och din karriär på bästa sätt: Trygg anställning med kollektivavtal. Friskvårdsbidrag på 4 000 kr per år samt rabatter på träningsaktiviteter. Sociala teamaktiviteter, från afterworks till sportaktiviteter. Individuella utvecklingsplaner och möjlighet att växa genom olika uppdrag och projekt. Kurser inom hållbarhet och andra områden inom ramen för din roll och dina mål. Utsedda till en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare 2026, 2025 och 2024 av Karriärföretagen. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag. Vill du veta mer om oss, besök gärna vår hemsida www.togethertech.com. För frågor om tjänsten, kontakta rekryterande ledare Claes Jonsson på telefon 0700-889729.

items.desc: Job Title IT Product Owner – Network Services, Lund Job Description Do you want to own the network services that keep a global company connected? As IT Product Owner – Network Services, you'll be responsible for how our network services are delivered from start to finish: service levels, suppliers, budget, lifecycle and continuous improvement. You'll combine technical depth with a strong service mindset. The role is based at our headquarters in Lund. Who is your future team? You'll join the IT Network team within our Infrastructure & IT Operations department. The team makes sure Axis' network infrastructure supports our position as the world leader in network video. You'll work closely with colleagues across the business, Infrastructure & IT Operations and Information Systems. They are skilled, dedicated people who share a passion for technology, innovation and doing great work together. What you'll do here as IT Product Owner – Network Services You'll own Axis' network services and make sure they deliver what the business needs, today and in the future. You'll connect the business, our network team and our suppliers, and your technical depth will let you have real discussions with all of them. The role has no direct reports, but it involves significant informal leadership: you'll guide and coordinate fellow engineers and set clear priorities for the service. In this role, you will: Make sure our network services meet agreed service level objectives (SLOs), and follow up on how the services perform Act as the escalation point for incidents and problems, drive improvements based on what we learn, and manage risks in line with our security policies and standards Manage suppliers and contracts and follow up on their delivery Build strong relationships with the business and internal stakeholders, and turn their needs into clear priorities and requirements Own the backlog and priorities, and drive agile ways of working together with the team Plan the lifecycle and roadmap of our network services, taking dependencies on other technology areas into account Who are you? Driven, structured and solution-oriented, and you enjoy the place where service delivery, business and technology meet. Close enough to operations to understand how our services actually perform. Have the overview to plan ahead and see the bigger picture, and you know when to dive into the details. A clear and confident communicator who naturally takes the lead in collaborative settings. You explain complex technical topics in a structured, easy-to-follow way, both verbally and in writing. Genuinely interested in what stakeholders need, and you turn it into clear requirements, priorities and decision support. You share your knowledge and help the people around you learn. We'd love to hear that you have: Solid technical knowledge of networking, such as routing, switching and network security, deep enough to lead discussions with teams, stakeholders and suppliers Experience of leading improvement or development initiatives for IT services or infrastructure A proven ability to guide and coordinate technical teams without formal managerial authority Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken Bonus points if you also bring: Swedish language skills Familiarity with financial planning for IT services, such as cost of ownership and forecasting Experience of leading contractual discussions with suppliers What Axis has to offer We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “fika” chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Axis Career Hub Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis Ready to Act? Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications. We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today! In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Joel Cedergren at joel.cedergren@axis.com Type of Employment Permanent Employment Posting End Date …

items.desc: Location: Malmö Department: Do It Yourself & E-commerce, Business Applications Hiring Manager: Marcus Brattström The role As Product Owner for E-commerce at Verisure, you will help shape and develop our e-commerce platform together with an experienced, distributed development team. You will connect business needs with technical delivery, create clear priorities and support collaboration between developers, architects, business stakeholders and other technology teams. The role also includes system ownership of Adobe Commerce/Magento, with responsibility for balancing new development with platform maintenance, security, quality and stability. You will join an international environment where collaboration, openness and learning from different perspectives are central to how we work. What you will be up to Own and prioritise the team’s backlog based on business needs and team capacity Translate business needs into clear requirements and realistic delivery plans Coordinate the day-to-day work of a distributed development team Facilitate planning, refinement, follow-ups and retrospectives Create alignment with stakeholders around priorities, timelines and dependencies Act as system owner for Adobe Commerce/Magento Ensure maintenance, security, incidents and technical improvements are included in planning Collaborate closely with the AEM team, architects and other dependent teams Good fit if you have A couple of years of relevant experience as a Product Owner or in a similar digital product or technical delivery role Experience owning and prioritising a software or digital product backlog Experience working closely with distributed development teams The ability to turn business needs into clear requirements and priorities Enough technical understanding to discuss integrations, APIs, releases, security and dependencies with technical colleagues Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills A structured, thoughtful and pragmatic approach Nice to have / technologies and areas we work with E-commerce and digital customer journeys Adobe Commerce/Magento Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) APIs and enterprise integrations System or application ownership Technical project management Platform lifecycle, security and incident management Jira, Azure DevOps, Scrum or Kanban Retail, DTC or subscription businesses You do not need experience in every area. We value curiosity, relevant experience and a willingness to learn. Should I apply? You may enjoy this role if several of these resonate with you: You enjoy bringing clarity and structure to complex topics You like connecting people across business and technology You listen to different perspectives and help turn them into shared priorities You enjoy working closely with development teams and technical specialists You are comfortable balancing customer needs with technical quality and long-term platform health You value collaboration, knowledge sharing and learning from others FAQ Do I need Adobe Commerce/Magento experience? No. It is valuable, but experience with another complex digital or e-commerce platform can be equally relevant. Do I need to be a developer? No. You should be comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, releases, dependencies and technical considerations, but you will work alongside developers and architects who provide deep technical expertise. Is this a strategic Product Manager role? Not primarily. The role is close to the development team and combines product ownership, delivery coordination and system ownership. What is the main challenge? Finding the right balance between new functionality, stakeholder needs, security, maintenance and the long-term health of the platform. Bottom line If you enjoy connecting people, business and technology, this is an opportunity to take broad ownership of an enterprise e-commerce platform while working closely with an experienced international team. You will help create clear priorities, support effective delivery and contribute to an e-commerce platform that continues to develop in a secure, reliable and sustainable way. About Verisure Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues. For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company's track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model. items.card: you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices are supported by robust clinical evidence and meet applicable requirements for clinical safety and performance. You will collaborate
items.desc: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position As a Clinical Evaluator at Cambio, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices are supported by robust clinical evidence and meet applicable requirements for clinical safety and performance. You will independently plan and conduct clinical evaluations while working closely with a cross-functional Clinical Evaluation Team combining expertise in the device, its intended use and the relevant clinical area. You will collaborate with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, Post-Market Surveillance, R&D, Product Management and Marketing. The role gives you the opportunity to work across the medical device lifecycle and contribute to both regulatory compliance and the continued development of our clinical evaluation processes. Your responsibilities will include: Plan, conduct and maintain clinical evaluations throughout the medical device lifecycle Develop and maintain Clinical Evaluation Plans and Clinical Evaluation Reports Conduct systematic literature reviews and critically assess clinical data and scientific evidence Evaluate clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk, integrating evidence from risk management, verification and validation, usability and other relevant activities Monitor emerging clinical evidence, identify residual clinical uncertainties and recommend, develop and conduct appropriate Post-Market Clinical Follow-up activities Support regulatory submissions and interactions with notified bodies We offer: The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art medical software that helps shape the future of healthcare Challenging and evolving clinical work as new technologies, including AI, raise the bar for clinical evidence, safety and performance The chance to influence how clinical evaluations are conducted at Cambio and contribute to the continued development of our clinical strategy About you You have a strong scientific and analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex clinical information and turning it into clear, well-founded conclusions. You are quality-conscious and attentive to detail, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities. At the same time, you enjoy working as part of a team and collaborating with people from different areas of expertise. You are a clear and adaptable communicator, able to explain complex topics in a simple and understandable way depending on your audience. At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together, and it is important that you recognize yourself in these values. Requirements Experience working with clinical evaluation of medical devices, either leading or contributing to the clinical evaluation process Experience working with the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) and relevant guidance documents Experience in systematic literature reviews and critical appraisal of clinical and scientific data Good understanding of clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk assessment Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and good communication skills in Swedish It's a bonus if you Have experience working with medical device software Have experience with Post-Market Surveillance (PMS), Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) or risk management Have experience with clinical research methodology, clinical investigation design or biostatistics Have experience assessing state of the art, benchmark devices or equivalence Have experience with scientific literature databases such as Embase or Medline Additional information: Place of employment : Linköping or Stockholm Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link. We look forward to receiving your application! Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! Nu söker vi ytterligare en Customer & Product Specialist som ska arbeta med både kundsupport och produktutveckling. Du får en kollega i samma roll och arbetar tätt med grundaren, som byggt SaaS-bolag tidigare, och med utvecklingsteamet. Det ger dig en bred inblick i hur ett SaaS-bolag drivs, från kundproblem och produktbeslut till AI och testning. Du har några års arbetslivserfarenhet, gärna från kundnära roller som support, customer success, kundservice eller implementation. Vi bryr oss mer om hur du tänker och hur snabbt du lär dig än om vilken titel du har haft. Det här kommer du att göra Ge kunderna snabb och personlig support Hjälpa nya kunder att komma igång med plattformen Felsöka tillsammans med utvecklingsteamet och följa ärendet tills det är löst Testa nya funktioner innan de släpps och se när något är onödigt krångligt för användaren Beskriva förbättringar så att utvecklarna kan arbeta vidare med dem Skriva hjälpmaterial och spela in korta instruktionsvideor Använda AI som arbetsverktyg för research, dokumentation, testning och analys Det här behöver du Du har erfarenhet av kundnära arbete, gärna i en digital eller teknisk miljö. Du får stort eget ansvar och stöd från dina kollegor när du behöver det. Med utvecklingsteamet samarbetar vi dagligen på engelska. Om Artigan Artigan är ett svenskt AI-first-bolag som bygger moderna SaaS-, app- och webblösningar för resebranschen. Vår plattform hjälper researrangörer att automatisera sådant som annars kräver mycket manuellt arbete, ge sina kunder bättre service och arbeta smartare. Vi är ett litet team, gillar korta beslutsvägar, och tror att kombinationen av bra produktförståelse, nära kundkontakt och modern AI kan förändra hur en hel bransch arbetar.

items.desc: Interested in a senior leadership role working in a stimulating and challenging environment? Group Treasury & Capital Management within Group Finance is seeking an experienced finance leader to serve as Treasurer for our EME and Life businesses. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence some of the most important financial decisions across Zurich’s EME and Life businesses. Working directly with senior business and finance leaders, you will help shape capital allocation, balance sheet strategy and shareholder value creation across a broad international portfolio. Operating at the intersection of strategy, finance and capital and liquidity management, this is a highly visible role with significant influence across multiple businesses and jurisdictions. You will bring a deep understanding of insurance balance sheets, strong commercial judgement, and the ability to influence decisions across multiple legal entities and stakeholder groups. If you are an experienced insurance finance professional with capital management and balance sheet management skills, this job may be for you. What you will do Serve as the primary Treasury and Capital Management partner to the EME and Life businesses, working closely with business CFOs and finance leaders to support strategic decision making and execution. Support business planning and strategic initiatives by ensuring capital, liquidity and balance sheet implications are appropriately reflected in decision making. Identify opportunities to improve capital efficiency, optimise liquidity positions and enhance returns on deployed capital across the EME and Life portfolio. Build a clear and comprehensive picture of each of the balance sheets in terms of regulatory capital requirements, liquidity, financial risk, leverage, return on capital and legal entity structure and identify opportunities to enhance balance sheet efficiency. Provide insight and challenge on matters relating to capital allocation and ensure the efficient deployment of capital across EME and Life balance sheets, balancing growth opportunities, risk appetite, and shareholder returns. Oversee capital and liquidity management activities across the portfolio of entities and ensure businesses remain appropriately capitalised and liquid under both business as usual and stressed conditions, whilst maximising dividends and other liquidity repatriations, where appropriate. Work closely with relevant balance sheet CFOs to identify and resolve all issues relating to Treasury and Capital Management and to ensure that relevant information and issues are escalated at local, regional and Group levels as appropriate. Monitor industry and marketplace developments, including regulatory developments and promote a market-leading approach to capital and liquidity management within EME and Life. Lead and develop a team of Treasury professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Build strong relationships across Group, regional, and local teams. What you bring Significant experience within insurance finance, treasury, capital management, corporate finance or related disciplines. Strong understanding of insurance balance sheets and value drivers. Experience working with insurance regulatory capital frameworks and capital management processes. Commercially minded with strong strategic judgements. Strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Solution-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment. Able to challenge constructively and influence without using formal authority You belong here. Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus, you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues. You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple. Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together. About Us Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees. For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience. Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. items.desc: Vacancy details Argentina|Costa Rica|MexicoArgentina|Costa Rica|Mexico RemoteRemote Recruiter Nataliia Olkhovska Nataliia Olkhovska n.olkhovska@svitla.com Role overview Svitla Systems Inc. is looking for a Cloud and Platform Engineer for the AI Pod for a full-time position (40 hours per week) in LATAM. Svitla’s Forward Deployed AI Engineering Pod is a small, senior team that works inside our client’s environment to take the client’s AI workflows into production one Workflow at a time, measuring the business result of each. The client pays a fixed monthly fee for working capability, not hours or headcount, and directs which Workflow the Pod works on. Each Workflow runs through Discover, Foundation, Build, Prove (shadow mode against live outcomes), and Operate (handover with runbooks, evaluation harness, and training), adapted from CRISP-DM, with the client’s own engineers shadowing throughout. The Pod has up to five people in any month. Three Continuous Roles stay with the client for the whole engagement so that accountability never changes hands: the Outcome Lead, the Forward Deployed Technical Lead, and the Cloud and Platform Engineer. Specialist Bench roles (for example, agent and MCP engineering, data and semantic engineering, integration, document AI, evaluation, security architecture, data science, and adoption) rotate in as the active Workflow requires. The initial term is three months, then month to month for as long as the backlog holds Workflows the client wants in production. Continuous Role people are Svitla’s reusable core: they carry what they learn to the next Pod, reuse Svitla’s connectors, evaluation harnesses, governance patterns, and deployment templates, and improve them. As the Cloud and Platform Engineer, you will own identity, deployment, and operations for the Pod. You will stand up and run the environments, infrastructure as code, pipelines, secrets, least-privilege access, observability, audit logging, and cost visibility inside the client’s cloud, and you will secure the early security and DevOps sign-offs that let a Workflow move from shadow mode to production without surprises. Requirements Experience running ML or LLM workloads in production on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including deployment pipelines, monitoring, and incident handling. Strong experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD (Terraform or equivalent, GitHub Actions or equivalent, and containers and Kubernetes or a managed equivalent), with examples of environments built from scratch. Hands-on experience with identity and access management: IAM policies, service accounts or workload identities, secrets management, and least-privilege design, with an audit or compliance review passed. Working knowledge of a modern data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar) and of how governed access (catalogs, row and column security) is enforced. Experience with observability for AI systems: tracing, logging, evaluation metrics, and cost telemetry, not only uptime. Enough Python and scripting to automate the platform and to read the Pod’s application code. A security mindset: threat modeling, network boundaries, data classification, and encryption as default settings rather than add-ons. Clear, concise runbooks and handover documentation. Will be a plus Experience with Google Cloud with Databricks, Azure OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock. Experience deploying and securing MCP servers, vector databases, or agent runtimes. FinOps practice and cost optimization for AI workloads. Experience preparing SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX, or PCI evidence. Responsibilities Stand up the Pod’s environments in the client’s cloud during Month 1: repositories, CI/CD, and dev, shadow, and production paths, all as infrastructure as code that the client keeps. Implement least-privilege access for people and agents: every agent is an identity with its own credentials, scopes, and joining and leaving controls, and reaches data only through the governed semantic layer and MCP surface. Own secrets management, key rotation, and the no-data-leaves-the-environment rule, including model provider and third-party API access. Build reproducible pipelines for data, model, prompt, and agent artifacts, with versioning and rollback. Put observability in from the first increment: tracing (for example, LangSmith or OpenTelemetry), evaluation and drift signals, audit logging of every agent action, and dashboards that the client’s operations team can read. Make run cost visible: model, API, compute, and storage cost per Workflow, reported monthly for the Value Ledger. Get the early security, compliance, and DevOps sign-offs from the client (architecture review, access review, and SOC 2 or regulatory evidence) so that the Prove gate is not blocked by a late finding. Write the runbook and the operations handover for each Workflow, and train the client’s team to run it. Maintain and improve Svitla’s reusable deployment templates, governance …

items.desc: Applications are open for a Teaching Laboratory Technician – Thermal post, at the Department of Physics, Oxford University. Oxford Physics is one of the largest and most eminent departments in Europe – pursuing forefront research alongside training the next generation of leaders in Physics. The Oxford Physics teaching laboratories broadly cover General Physics (Mechanics), Optics, Solid State Physics, Electronics, Electrostatics and Magnetism, Atmospheric Physics, Particle Physics, Nuclear Physics and Biophysics. As part of the degree course, we teach hands-on science to around 540 students across three years, with students moving between laboratories each term. We build and upgrade experiments between terms to keep the course relevant to our goal of training the next generation of leading scientists. We seek a versatile member of staff who will have particular responsibility, with minimal supervision, for the routine operation of one or two of the experimental areas during term time including maintaining and repairing equipment, assisting with experiments, projects, outreach events, and ensuring health and safety standards are observed. The role will also include broader duties and interactions with the other technicians, students, and demonstrators in the laboratory. The successful applicant must have a qualification to level 6 in the National Qualification Framework (e.g. NVQ level 6/ degree/graduate diploma) in engineering, physics, or similar, or relevant experience in lieu of these qualifications. Proven ability to troubleshoot and repair physics - or similar - laboratory experiments, ideally in an educational environment is essential, as well as proven levels of software literacy. Experience of scientific programming packages, e.g. Python or MATLAB would be desirable. This temporary role will be based in the Thermal and Condensed Matter Physics laboratories. The successful candidate will be required to assist with a relocation of those teaching labs. Start date no later than February 2027. For informal queries please contact Dr Jenny Barnes – jenny.barnes@physics.ox.ac.uk This is a full-time post, fixed term until 31 December 2027 The closing date for applications is noon on Friday, 4 December 2026 You will be required to upload a CV, Details of two referees and Supporting Statement as part of your online application. The Supporting Statement should include a cover letter and should also clearly describe how you meet each of the selection criteria listed in the job description.

About the job Job summary UKHSA is responsible for protecting every member of every community from the impact of infectious diseases and other health threats. We provide intellectual, scientific and operational leadership at national and local level, as well as on the global stage, to make the nations health secure. The Radiation, Chemical, Climate and Environmental Hazards (RCCE) Directorate provides evidence and advice to protect health from radiation, chemical, climate and environmental hazards. To support evidence-based health protection, RCCE undertakes research with universities and other partners, including through National Institute for Health and Care Research-funded Health Protection Research Units (HPRUs). The Toxicology Department conducts research on environmental hazards that underpins public health protection, chemical regulation and policy development, and provides expert advice to government departments, local authorities, partner organisations and the public. The Experimental Toxicology programme investigates the health effects of chemicals and environmental hazards, including nanoparticles, air pollutants, bioaerosols and microplastics, using in vitro and in vivo models. The role involves the provision of highly specialised skills such as molecular/cellular biology and associated data analysis, to support the work of the Experimental Toxicology Programmes and others within the Toxicology Department. Job description The postholder will carry out a range of scientific duties, including: Laboratory work and scientific functions, these will involve chemistry, mathematical modelling, biology, laboratory work, and engineering as appropriate. The assessment of measurements and the mathematical calculation of doses and other relevant quantities to support the work of the Experimental Toxicology and Analytical Toxicology Programmes within the Toxicology Department. The writing of technical reports incorporating the results of any measurements and modelling. The recording of the output of specialised scientific equipment, then reporting the results, either to other UKHSA staff or to external collaborators or customers. Routine maintenance checks on specialised laboratory facilities, and confirmation of the satisfactory operation of safety and warning systems. Some of these duties will entail working alone and unsupervised, while others will require supervision. The postholder will be expected to carry out accurate scientific work in accordance with established procedures and protocols, this will require understanding of the practices and protocols, and suitable training will be provided to achieve this. The postholder may be responsible for the use and maintenance of complex scientific equipment and will use a range of IT software including databases and software developed in house, these may be used for record keeping and the calculation of scientific information. The postholder will provide recommendations to line managers on potential improvements to technical protocols. Work will be carried out to deadlines specified in QA documentation or by line managers. The postholder will provide assistance in practical exercises and demonstrations of equipment. This list is not exhaustive. items.desc: We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity. From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas. As part of our engineering team, you’ll shape the platforms and tools that drive high-impact research - designing systems that scale, accelerate discovery and support innovation across the firm. As the organisation’s Security Data subject matter expert (SME), you will own the onboarding, tuning, stabilisation and evolution of security telemetry across cloud, hybrid and corporate environments. Alongside this specialist focus, you will contribute as a well-rounded Security Engineer, applying software engineering, automation and platform thinking to solve a broad range of security challenges. items.desc: We are looking for a Technical Specialist ( Product Engineer / Designer - Siemens Opcenter) to join our Global Supply Chain (GSC) Digital and Technology function. The GSC Digital and Technology function spearheads the implementation of integrated digital solutions and AI into the supply chain (including Smart Manufacturing, Enterprise Resource Planning – ERP - Evolution and broader supply chain technology and data capabilities). The role provides deep knowledge of standard platform capabilities and the custom functionality built within the organisation, helping engineering and support teams understand, maintain and evolve the solution safely. Acting as the functional subject-matter expert for Siemens Opcenter Execution Pharma and its use in manufacturing operations, the role focuses on functional architecture, system behaviour, configuration logic, custom extensions, integrations, troubleshooting, testing and validation support. Support system, integration, regression and validation testing for standard capabilities, custom functionality, Process Instructions (PIs) and related MES components. Ensure functional solutions meet GxP, Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP), data integrity and change-control expectations. Assess new Siemens Opcenter releases and capabilities, evaluate impact on existing standard and custom functionality, and recommend practical adoption or remediation actions. Lead technical-functional troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex configuration, workflow, PI, integration and custom-functionality issues. Create clear guidance, reusable technical-functional patterns and knowledge materials, and support knowledge transfer to internal teams and delivery partners. Contribute to design reviews and help maintain functional standards for Siemens Opcenter across the organisation. Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement. Own the functional design of PIs and workflows within the approved Opcenter architecture, recording design decisions and handing to architects for platform-level changes. Own release readiness for Opcenter changes, verify deployments, monitor after release and act to prevent recurrence of issues. What started as connecting people to short-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger - premium beach destinations, long-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks – and that’s just the beginning of our story. We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing. Powered by our deep-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating - delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more. Ready to build the future of travel with us? About the Role At On the Beach, we help millions of customers discover, plan and book their beach holidays. We’re looking for a hands-on Security Architect to help secure the systems behind those journeys. There’s a substantial job to do across our AWS and GCP environment. You’ll need to understand what we have, identify where improvements matter most and agree priorities with engineering and security colleagues. Some changes will take time. Others will need practical fixes to the systems we run today. You’ll lead security design and help teams put it into practice. That means getting into code and configuration, testing assumptions and staying involved through delivery. We’ll judge the work by whether the changes are adopted and address the problem. You’ll report to the Head of Architecture, who reports to the VP of Engineering. You’ll work alongside Architects, Principal Engineers and Staff Engineers, and with security leadership to connect technical decisions to business priorities and risk. This is a Principal individual contributor role. You’ll influence decisions, help other engineers develop and take responsibility for seeing agreed work through to completion. What you’ll be doing day to day We’re focused on improving our Security Posture across our entire estate. What you’ll do: Protect customer accounts, bookings and payments - Help teams secure the services our customers use and the connections we make to suppliers. Consider how those services could be attacked or misused. Lead security design decisions - Set out the options, explain the consequences and make a recommendation. Record important decisions and give teams guidance they can use. Translate, explain, and prioritise - Work with the business and engineering teams to make sure that business understands the security work that needs to be done, and engineering’s prioritisation matches the business needs. Improve cloud and identity security - Work with the Cloud team on access permissions, service identities, account and project structure, networking and logging across AWS and GCP. Make secure approaches easier to use. Work with Development and DevEx teams to build reusable designs, infrastructure modules and automated checks that fit how teams develop and deploy software. Lead threat modelling - Help teams identify what could go wrong, understand the impact and agree what needs to change. Follow up on actions and make any remaining risks clear to the people responsible for accepting them. Protect sensitive data - Help establish what data we hold, where it moves and who can access it. Design appropriate controls for access, encryption, secrets, retention and deletion. Support detection and incident response - Work with SecOps and Infrastructure teams on logging and the capabilities needed to investigate, contain and recover from incidents. Feed what we learn back into our designs. Advise the Workplace team. Help with security architecture for employee access, laptops and mobile devices, working with the teams that manage those services. You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience You’ll have a strong mix of technical skills and key behaviours needed in a busy, fast-moving technical environment that embraces change. You’ll report to the Head of Architecture, who reports to the VP of Engineering. You’ll work alongside other Architects, Principal Engineers, and Staff Engineers. Technical skills we’re looking for Cloud and containers - You have strong practical experience securing AWS or GCP environments, including access controls, networking and account or project structure. You understand Kubernetes security and can work across both cloud platforms. You don’t need equal depth in both. Hands-on engineering - You use code and configuration to understand how systems work. You can review application code, test a design and make targeted changes alongside developers. Our languages include C#, TypeScript, Python, Ruby and Rust. items.desc: Job Description Are You Ready to Make an Impact at RSSL? Join Our Mission to Transform Lives Through Science, Innovation and Collaboration RSSL (Reading Scientific Services Ltd) is a leading scientific services company providing analytical testing, consultancy, and training to the food, drink, pharmaceutical, and consumer goods industries. A wholly owned subsidiary of Mondelēz International, we combine deep scientific expertise with practical industry knowledge. Our Training & Consultancy division delivers specialist food safety, allergen management, microbiology, regulatory, and FMCG manufacturing compliance services - both as tailored consultancy for individual client challenges and as structured training programmes for teams at every level. We work with businesses of all sizes, from start-ups navigating regulation for the first time to established manufacturers strengthening their systems. RSSL manages all client relationships and administration, so our consultants focus on what they do best: delivering expert advice and training. Purpose of the Role To provide expert consultancy and training to RSSL's food industry clients on applied microbiology in FMCG manufacturing environments, HACCP system design and verification, and BRC Global Standard for Food Safety compliance. items.desc: Croydon CAMHS are pleased to advertise for a Band 7 12 month secondment Clinical Nurse Specialists within the Croydon CAMHS Crisis Team. Applications are welcome from Registered Nurses, Social Workers, Occupational Therapists, or equivalent registered professionals. About the service The CAMHS Crisis Team provides rapid assessment, formulation, and safety planning for young people presenting in A&E with acute mental health needs. Successful applicants will work closely with peers, the Clinical Service Lead, and wider multidisciplinary colleagues to ensure safe, timely, and compassionate care. The service currently operates: 08:00–22:00 Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 on Saturdays There are active plans to transition to a 24‑hour service, and once implemented, the post holder will be expected to participate in a night‑shift rota as part of their contracted hours. Role expectations The post holder will: Provide or advise on the delivery of high‑quality, safe, evidence‑based care for young people in crisis. Maintain consistently high standards of practice in line with Trust policies and professional registration requirements. Act as a positive role model, supporting the development of junior staff and contributing to clinical appraisal and supervision. Work collaboratively with internal and external partners to ensure effective crisis pathways and safe discharge planning. The successful applicant/s will Complete comprehensive bio‑psycho‑social assessments for young people presenting to Croydon University Hospital in mental health crisis, ensuring timely formulation and risk assessment. Develop individualised safety plans that reflect each young person’s individual needs, strengths, risks, and support network. Provide 7‑day follow‑up appointments for young people who have attended A&E in crisis, offering ongoing assessment, safety planning, and support during the immediate post‑crisis period. Lead and participate in discharge planning meetings, working collaboratively with acute hospital staff, community CAMHS teams, social care, and other relevant agencies to ensure safe and coordinated transitions. By coming to work at SLaM, you will gain experience of being part of an organisation with a rich history and international reputation in mental health care. You will have access to professional development and learning opportunities, and have the chance to work alongside people who are world leaders in their field. SLaM delivered more than 14,000 training experiences in 2014; providing an extensive range of learning opportunities for staff at all levels. In addition, our working relationship with King's Health Partners allows those working at the Trust to get involved in academic research. Key Responsibilities: They are expected to form a close working relationship with colleagues across relevant professional services The post holder will deliver, or advise on the delivery of, high quality safe crisis care, ensuring consistently high standards of practice and clinical excellence As a CAMHS Clinical Specialist you will; support the Clinical Service Lead and peers to promote and develop excellent clinical practice. You will be a positive role model to peers in the team through the practice of evidence-based care. You will be expected to support professional development through clinical appraisal and supervision and contribute to the ongoing educational programme for all staff, fostering a positive learning environment. items.desc: The closing date is 29th Nov 2026 Anticipated Interview date(s) 01/09./2026 Job summary The post holder will be a Registered Nurse/registered paramedic, with a broad general experience as a qualified professional. The successful candidate will act as an autonomous practitioner, within their boundaries of clinical practice with the freedom to make clinical decisions based wholly on their experience, knowledge, and analytical skills. They will require excellent communication skills and can work in a multidisciplinary environment under pressure. As a Clinical Supervisor, you will oversee each shift, providing shift management and clinical support to a team of Nurses, Therapist's, Senior Healthcare Support Workers, Assistant Practitioners, Paramedics and along with the Therapists, will have team responsibility for the caseload management of the patients. A key part of the role will be to liaise closely with other agencies and discharge or transfer the patient to other community services to maintain patient flow and prevent avoidable hospital admissions. The service responds to patients through Primary care/Ambulance service/A+E and other health-care professionals. Rapid Response is part of the Urgent Community Response Agenda which means the team responds to referrals with a 2-hour response, this is part of the new Urgent Community Response agenda. Main duties, tasks & skills required Rapid Response is a service which aims to meet patients' urgent care needs at home by providing urgent clinical, therapy or support interventions to keep a patient in their place of residence, which is key in improving patient outcomes, preventing avoidable hospital admissions and delivering NHS strategic priorities. The service is part of the new Urgent Community Response agenda and will respond within two hours of a referral to meet the UCR national guidelines. Part of the UCR agenda is to respond to non-injured patients who have fallen within two hours of referral. In line with national rollout of the two-hour standard, the UCR service is provided 8am to 8pm, seven days a week across Somerset. The Rapid Response service is provided between 8am to 11pm. The UCR service requires the submission of data returns to the Community Services Data Set to demonstrate the achievement of the two-hour standard. The team is made up of Admin, Healthcare Support Workers, Student Nurses/Occupational Therapists/Physio Therapists, Trainee Nursing Associates, Assistant Practitioners, Trainee Assistant Practitioners, Rehab Assistants, Paramedics, Registered Nurses, Occupational Therapists and Physiotherapists. Rapid Response has greater connections with the multidisciplinary networks such as Hospital at Home (ACP's), GPs, Health Coaches, Voluntary Sector, Social Care, Mental Health teams, Acute Colleagues, Community Nursing and Rehab Teams, Palliative care colleagues, Care agencies, ACPs, 111 OOHs and SWAST. About us At Somerset NHS Foundation Trust , we're committed to supporting our employees with a range of benefits designed to enhance your professional and personal life. We offer: Flexible working options to help you balance work and life NHS pension scheme for long-term financial security Generous annual leave allowance to recharge and relax A strong focus on career development to help you grow and achieve your potential Additionally, you'll gain access to our Blue Light Card , unlocking exclusive discounts on shopping, dining, and leisure activities, as well as NHS-specific perks to support you both inside and outside of work. We are proud to foster a diverse, skilled, and inclusive workforce , and we encourage applications from all backgrounds. Why Somerset? Somerset offers the perfect blend of idyllic countryside, outstanding areas of natural beauty , and breathtaking coastlines , with vibrant cities like Bristol , Bath , and Exeter just a short drive away - and only two hours to London . The region is home to excellent educational facilities , and with affordable housing compared to other parts of the country, it's a great place to build both your career and your future. Somerset truly has it all - the peaceful countryside and cosmopolitan city life, with something for everyone to enjoy.
