items.desc: Description About The Role Our coaching programmes span Communities, Club Football, Schools, and Special Projects, reachingover 6,500 young people every week across some of London's most underserved communities. Fromgrassroots community sessions and school clubs to Academy training and specialist inclusive provision, every programme is built on the same foundation of quality, inclusion and belonging. The Lead Coach plays a central role in bringing that to life. You are the person young people show up for, responsible for planning and delivering high-quality and impactful sessions across our programmes, working with young people ages 4 to 18 years. To succeed in this role, you'll be an experienced coach with a UEFA C qualification, a commitment to inclusive coaching, and the creativity and professionalism to deliver consistently across a wide range of settings and groups. Someone who understands that the relationships you build are just as important as the sessions you deliver, and that being a trusted, consistent adult in a young person’s life is one of the most valuable things a coach can be. You'll thrive in a fast-moving environment, take real pride in your work, and share our belief that every young person deserves a place to play, belong and progress. Our commitment to inclusion At Bloomsbury, belonging isn't just something we create for the young people we serve it's something we live as an organisation and is embedded into core values. We are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we work in, and we actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, and identities. We particularly welcome applications from women and people from underrepresented groups, who remain underrepresented in both the sport and charity sectors. We know that the best idea wins regardless of who it comes from, and we are proud to be building an organisation where everyone has a place to play, belong, and progress. Key Responsibilities Session Planning & Delivery: Plan and lead the delivery of regular coaching sessions across Communities and Special Projects programmes that intentionally support Bloomsbury Football’s impact goals and youth development outcomes. Create engaging, age-appropriate and inclusive session plans that cater to a wide range of abilities, promoting physical, social and emotional development. Deliver high-quality coaching that reflects Bloomsbury's dedication to purpose, belonging and progression on and off the pitch. Relationship Building & Communication: Create and maintain positive relationships with multiple stakeholders including young people, parents, partners and venue staff Communicate effectively and confidently with young children, parents and other stakeholders Represent Bloomsbury Football Foundation professionally at all times, embodying our mission to transform lives through the magic of football. Programme Development & Improvement: Contribute to the ongoing improvement of coaching quality and programme delivery Bring creativity and innovative ideas to sessions and the wider coaching team Be proactive and excited about getting involved with all that Bloomsbury Football has to offer Safeguarding & Professional Standards: Uphold Bloomsbury's commitment to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children and young people Maintain up-to-date safeguarding and first aid certification Work flexibly and professionally across different settings and venues including schools and external community venues Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Essential: UEFA C coaching qualification (or equivalent) Up-to-date Safeguarding and First Aid certificates Experience working with children and young people in a sporting or educational setting across a range of ages and abilities Ability to work across multiple venues and settings in Central London Flexibility to work mornings, evenings and weekends (up to 6 days per week) The right to live and work in the UK (we do not sponsor visas) Desirable: Experience delivering inclusive or specialist football provision (disability, refugee, or girls' football) Experience working in a charity or social enterprise UEFA B or above Benefits Modern office in Camden Markets with free gym membership and local market discounts. Regular staff socials. Opportunities to attend Premier League, WSL, FA Cup, League Cup, and Champions League football matches. Cycle to work scheme. Workplace pension scheme. 24 days holiday allowance, increasing by one day per year after two years’ service. Funding toward training and five days of fully paid study leave. Break roadmap priorities down into epics and user stories, and help plan what goes into each sprint. Weigh customer value, effort and dependencies when ordering work, and flag risks early.
items.desc: Overview Turn product ideas into well-scoped, well-designed features that nurseries use every day. At Ovivio, we build software that helps childcare and education professionals spend less time on administration and more time with children. In the UK, our nursery management platform supports nurseries and nursery groups with everything from enquiries, registers and funding to safeguarding, learning and parent communication, while NoodleNow, our e-learning platform, helps teams complete the training they need. We're looking for a Product Owner to turn our product priorities into features our engineering team can build with confidence. You'll join our Product organisation with a dedicated engineering team, working closely with our Product Manager, Product Designer and architects. You’ll have shared ownership on the backlog, scoping and prototyping features with the help of AI, and supporting the team through delivery, turning complex opportunities into well-designed solutions which customers proactively use. What you'll work on: Backlog & Prioritisation Shared ownership and maintenance of the product backlog for our nursery management platform and our e-learning platform - keeping it clear, ordered and ready for development. Break roadmap priorities down into epics and user stories, and help plan what goes into each sprint. Weigh customer value, effort and dependencies when ordering work, and flag risks early. Contribute to the roadmap with what you learn from customers and the team. Scoping & AI Prototyping Gather requirements from nursery managers, practitioners and colleagues in Customer Success and Sales. Write clear scopes, user stories and acceptance criteria, including edge cases, that engineers can build from with confidence. Use AI tools to draft specifications and build interactive prototypes, so ideas can be validated before development starts. Work closely with our designer to make sure features are intuitive, consistent with our design system and a pleasure to use. Sprint Delivery & Quality Be the go-to person for engineers during the sprint, answering questions quickly and keeping work unblocked. Take part in refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives. Run user acceptance testing and accept work only when it meets the agreed criteria. Work with the engineering lead to define the scope and timing of each release. Demo new releases to Customer Success, Marketing and Sales, so they’re ready to support customers. AI Features Scope AI-powered features, turning use cases into clear, testable requirements. Help define how these features stay accurate and safe when working with children's data. How you'll work You'll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly. You'll bring structure and calm to the team's day-to-day work, partnering with engineering leads who own technical design and implementation. Translate customer and business needs into clear technical and product priorities. Coordinate teams, manage dependencies and proactively resolve blockers. Balance customer value, commercial opportunities and technical complexity. Evaluate technical trade-offs together with engineers and architects. Align priorities and commitments within our Product, Technology and Marketing teams. Use AI as part of your everyday workflow, from requirements and analysis to specifications, prototypes and documentation. What success looks like Features go into development well scoped and well designed, engineers trust your stories, sprints run smoothly with few surprises, and what we release works the way customers expect. About you Proven delivery: You've led complex B2B software initiatives across multiple teams, from planning through launch and adoption. Strong ownership: You take responsibility, manage dependencies and drive initiatives to completion. Product judgement: You understand customer needs, prioritise effectively and make informed trade-offs. Technical judgement: You can evaluate technical trade-offs and constructively challenge engineers and architects. Attention to detail: You write precise requirements, think through edge cases and test thoroughly. AI proficiency: AI is part of how you work every day, and you know where it adds real value. You use it to automate as much repetitive work as possible, such as drafting user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases and release notes, summarising customer feedback, and building interactive prototypes or simple internal tools. You know what good output looks like: you review, fact-check and refine everything AI produces, so nothing generic or inaccurate reaches the team or our customers. You use AI responsibly, especially around sensitive data, and keep up with new tools and share what works. Eye for design: You care about usability and visual detail, know what makes an interface work and can build credible prototypes yourself. Hands-on experience with Figma and AI prototyping tools. items.desc: At CGI, we’re shaping the future of secure space technology, delivering innovative solutions that support critical Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities. As a Python Software Engineer within our growing Secure Space Systems business, you’ll help transform complex scientific and engineering data into secure, high-performance solutions that make a real difference. You’ll take ownership of meaningful technical challenges, explore creative approaches to emerging requirements and collaborate with talented professionals to deliver cutting-edge capabilities. From early-stage prototypes to fully developed solutions, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, the support to develop your expertise and the opportunity to contribute to projects at the forefront of space and defence technology. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is a hybrid position. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will design, develop and deliver secure, scalable Python microservices that process complex scientific and engineering data, supporting mission-critical space-based Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities. Working within an Agile environment, you will take ownership of technical solutions, from initial prototyping through to production-ready delivery, ensuring high standards of performance, security and reliability. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to solve evolving technical challenges, bringing fresh ideas and a pragmatic, delivery-focused approach to every project. Supported by experienced colleagues and a culture of continuous learning, you will have opportunities to explore emerging technologies, enhance development practices and contribute to the ongoing growth of CGI's Secure Space Systems business. Key responsibilities: Design & Develop: Build secure, scalable Python microservices to process complex scientific and engineering datasets. Innovate & Prototype: Develop proof-of-concept solutions and evolve them into robust, production-ready applications. Build & Integrate: Design and implement RESTful APIs using OpenAPI and JSON to enable reliable system integration. Test & Optimise: Implement automated testing and containerised deployment using Docker, ensuring high-quality, performant solutions. Collaborate & Deliver: Work within Agile teams using Scrum, SAFe and DevSecOps practices to deliver solutions against evolving requirements. Solve & Improve: Take ownership of technical challenges, identify opportunities for improvement and develop creative, practical solutions. Learn & Grow: Explore new technologies, share knowledge and contribute to a supportive, collaborative engineering environment. Required qualifications to be successful in this role To succeed in this role, you will bring strong Python development experience, particularly in building and testing containerised microservices and RESTful APIs. You will be adaptable, collaborative and comfortable solving complex technical challenges in fast-moving environments. A proactive approach to learning, excellent communication skills and a commitment to delivering secure, high-quality software will be essential. Essential skills and experience: Python Development: Strong commercial experience developing Python applications and microservices. Microservices & Containers: Proven experience building, deploying and testing containerised microservices using Docker. API Development: Recent experience designing and developing RESTful APIs using OpenAPI and JSON. Automated Testing: Strong understanding of automated testing practices and software quality assurance. Agile Delivery: Ability to work effectively within Agile development environments and adapt to changing requirements. Problem-Solving: Pragmatic, delivery-focused approach with the ability to solve complex technical challenges. Collaboration & Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to contribute effectively within multidisciplinary teams. Highly desirable: Experience working with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) technologies. Desirable: Experience with Apache NiFi or similar workflow automation technologies. …

items.desc: User Researcher - (UX/UI) Location: Edinburgh Grade: Consultant Employment Type: Permanent, Full Time Hybrid REQ003898 About XPS Group: XPS Pensions Group is no ordinary company. We've earned numerous awards and accolades, making us an industry leader in Pensions Consultancy. As the largest pure pensions consultancy in the UK, we are a team of approximately 2000 employees spread across 15 locations nationwide. Listed on the London Stock Exchange Main Market, we pride ourselves on our ability to think and act differently, offering expert advice to over 1600 pension schemes and administering pensions for over 1,000,000 members. About the Team: We are seeking an experienced, dynamic and ambitious professional to fill the role of User Researcher within our rapidly growing Client Communications Team. This role is to establish user research as a core capability within our pensions administration business - building a deeper understanding of the people we serve and ensuring that their needs shape the products and services we create across our digital platforms and audiences: pension scheme members, our clients (trustees, sponsors, and corporate stakeholders), and the administrators who serve them. This is a foundational, hands-on role. As well as conducting research, you will define the research standards, approaches, and ways of working that embed evidence into how we build digital products - working alongside our product designer and visual designer to keep product and design decisions grounded in user needs. Key Responsibilities: End-to-end research - Plan and deliver research, from defining the question through to insight and recommendations. Research methods - Use qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, usability testing, surveys, and observation, selecting the right approach for each question. Audience insight - Research the needs, behaviours, workflows, and experiences of members, clients, and administrators, including those with access needs and/or low digital confidence. Insight and synthesis - Turn research findings and product data into clear, actionable insight that informs product and service decisions. Research and design partnership - Work closely with product and visual designers to shape ideas and solutions from early exploration through to delivery. Inclusive and ethical research - Ensure research is accessible, ethical, and compliant with consent, safeguarding, and data protection requirements. Stakeholder influence - Communicate findings clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and champion the voice of the user across the business. Research portfolio - Manage multiple research activities, prioritising where research can add the most value. Research capability - Help establish pragmatic research standards, tools, and ways of working as the capability matures. Your Profile: Essential: Right to work in the UK. Degree, professional qualification, or equivalent relevant experience in user research or service design. Significant experience in user research, leading research from defining the question through to actionable insight and recommendations. Strong qualitative research experience, with the ability to select and apply appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods, and explain the rationale for the approach. Experience researching with diverse and sometimes hard-to-reach users, adapting approaches to different needs and contexts, including people with access needs or low digital confidence. Experience working collaboratively with product and design teams to influence product and service decisions. Experience conducting ethical and compliant research, including safeguarding and data protection. Ability to establish and improve research practices and ways of working would be beneficial. A background in pensions, financial services, or another regulated industry would be beneficial. Familiarity with AI and emerging research tools would be beneficial. Skills, abilities & personal qualities: Strong interpersonal, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to turn evidence into clear insight. Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and adapt to changing needs. Pragmatic and confident approach, with the ability to constructively challenge assumptions. Commitment to inclusive research and continuous professional development. What We Offer: Enjoy a competitive salary, annual discretionary bonus, and 25 days’ holiday with buy/sell flexibility. Benefits include pension matching, healthcare plans, life assurance, and retailer discounts. We support our team with a flexible benefits scheme, employee assistance, and digital GP service. Participating in volunteering events is encouraged with paid volunteer days available. Referral bonuses are offered for introducing suitable candidates to XPS. items.desc: We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity. From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas. As part of our engineering team, you’ll shape the platforms and tools that drive high-impact research - designing systems that scale, accelerate discovery and support innovation across the firm. Take the next step in your career. The role The Custom I/O team builds the storage technology that sits underneath much of our research. We are developing a new distributed storage platform, written in Rust, to give us greater scalability, performance and operational control. You will work closely with researchers and other engineers to understand how data is stored and accessed, and help shape the design of a platform that many teams depend on. AI is part of how every team here works, accelerating thinking and delivering impact. All colleagues are expected to bring AI into their daily workflows. Key responsibilities of the role include: Designing and developing core components of a distributed storage platform in Rust Building scalable, resilient and performant systems for large data workloads Collaborating with researchers and engineers to understand data access requirements Contributing to architectural decisions across distributed systems and data management Developing and optimising services that run in Kubernetes environments Integrating event-driven and streaming technologies, including Kafka, into the wider platform Promoting engineering best practice, code quality and thorough testing Who are we looking for? The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience: Commercial experience developing production systems in Rust A solid grounding in distributed systems and the trade-offs involved in designing them Experience building systems that handle large volumes of data reliably Experience with Kubernetes is beneficial Familiarity with event-driven or streaming technologies such as Kafka is desirable A collaborative approach and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to colleagues A commitment to testing, code quality and operational excellence Why join us? That's why we're not simply looking for people to fill a single, narrowly-defined role—we're looking for curious minds who want to build their future in

We'd love to hear from you. Cyber security is constantly evolving. New technologies emerge, adversaries adapt, and the ways organisations defend themselves change continuously. That's why we're not simply looking for people to fill a single, narrowly-defined role—we're looking for curious minds who want to build their future in cyber. Whether you're an early-career candidate exploring where your interests fit, or an experienced professional looking for your next challenge, you'll have the opportunity to develop skills across multiple cyber disciplines. You might find yourself analysing data, building software, developing investigative tradecraft, researching adversary behaviour, automating workflows, or creating new capabilities that help protect the UK's most critical organisations. Unlike many cyber roles that focus on a single specialism, our team bring together elements of cyber analysis, software engineering, data science, threat research and capability development. The result is varied, meaningful work that continues to evolve alongside both technology and the threat landscape. If you've ever been fascinated by how technology works, how cyber threats are uncovered, or how innovative tools can help solve difficult problems, there's a good chance you'll find a home here. Note: To apply for this role you must already hold the relevant DV Security Clearance. This job role can be based in Ipswich, London or Manchester. Due to security requirements, this role requires you to be located on site during your working hours. Mon-Fri 37.5. What you’ll be doing Depending on your skills, interests and experience, you may: Build tools and platforms that help cyber teams work more effectively. Explore large and complex datasets to uncover valuable insights. Develop automation and software that improves cyber operations. Research emerging technologies, threats and analytical techniques. Support investigations into sophisticated cyber activity. Create new capabilities that help defend the UK's critical infrastructure and government organisations. Collaborate with engineers, analysts, researchers and cyber specialists to solve challenging problems. Continuously learn and adapt as technologies, threats and opportunities evolve. No two careers in this space look identical —and that's part of what makes it interesting. You might be a good fit if you've ever found yourself asking questions like : How do cyber teams actually uncover threats? How do the tools behind modern cyber investigations really work? How do you build the technology that powers cyber investigations at scale? How do software, data and cyber security all fit together? How can we stay ahead of constantly evolving threats? How can I turn curiosity into real-world impact? How can I bring all my previous experience together into one impactful role? How will cyber teams evolve and adapt to the AI-revolution? You don't need to have all the answers already. We're looking for people with curiosity, enthusiasm and a willingness to learn. Essential Skills / Experience You don't need to be an expert in every area—we're looking for people who bring curiosity, potential and a genuine enthusiasm for technology and cyber security. A strong interest in cyber security, technology and solving complex problems. An analytical mindset with the ability to think logically and approach challenges in a structured way. A willingness to learn new tools, technologies and ways of working across cyber, software and data disciplines. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team. A proactive approach to learning, continuous improvement and personal development. An interest in understanding how technology, data and security can be used together to create meaningful outcomes. A growth mindset and enthusiasm for tackling unfamiliar challenges. Desirable Skills / Experience These skills and experiences are helpful, but not required. Experience with programming, scripting or software development through work, education or personal projects. Familiarity with data analysis, data visualisation or working with large and complex datasets. Exposure to cyber security concepts such as security operations, threat detection, incident response, risk management or vulnerability management. Experience using automation to improve processes, increase efficiency or solve technical problems. Familiarity with Linux, cloud platforms, databases, APIs or modern development practices.  Siemens Mobility ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
 Was tragen Sie bei? 
 Sie verantworten die erfolgreiche Durchführung von R&D-Projekten für Bahninfrastruktur im deutschsprachigen Raum und gestalten gemeinsam mit internationalen Entwicklungshubs z.B. in Indien, Ungarn und Tschechien die Weiterentwicklung unseres Projektgeschäfts.
 Dabei verbinden Sie die Leitung eines komplexen Projekts mit der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung eines Teams von Projektleitern (w/m/d) sowie der kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Methoden und Prozessen.

 We are Siemens 
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 
 Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Meshing Programmer to join our development team and help build the next generation of mesh generation and manipulation technologies that power advanced CAE and simulation applications. 
 This role combines C++ software engineering, computational geometry, numerical methods, and algorithm development. You will work on challenging problems involving large-scale discrete geometry and develop high-performance, scalable solutions used in engineering simulation workflows. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop meshing algorithms: Design, implement, and optimize algorithms for mesh generation, manipulation, refinement, quality improvement, and related geometric operations. 
 Build efficient data structures: Design robust data structures for large-scale discrete geometry, numerical analysis, and computational geometry problems. 
 Develop high-performance C++ software: Apply modern C++, object-oriented design, and sound software engineering practices to build scalable and maintainable components. 
 Solve complex computational problems: Translate mathematical and geometric concepts into efficient production-quality algorithms and software. 
 Optimize performance and scalability: Analyze computational and memory requirements and improve algorithms for large and complex engineering models. 
 Collaborate across teams: Work closely with software engineers, domain experts, and product teams in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality capabilities. 
 Drive technical excellence: Participate in design discussions, code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous improvement of the meshing technology. 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computational Science, or a related technical discipline. 
 Strong professional experience with C++ and object-oriented programming, including designing and developing complex software components. 
 Proven experience developing geometric, mesh generation, computational geometry, or mesh manipulation algorithms in an industrial, research, or academic environment. 
 Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, particularly for large-scale discrete geometry or numerical applications. 
 Strong mathematical foundation with knowledge of discrete geometry, numerical methods, computational geometry, or related areas. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into efficient software solutions. 
 Effective communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional software development environment. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Experience with parallel programming, including multithreading, MPI, or other high-performance computing technologies. 
 Experience designing data structures and algorithms for parallel or large-scale computational workloads. 
 Understanding of CAD/CAE software, mesh-based simulation, or engineering simulation workflows. 
 Experience with mesh quality, mesh optimization, geometry processing, or finite-element/finite-volume related concepts. 
 Experience with Agile/Lean software development, source control, code reviews, and automated testing. 
 Exposure to modern C++ standards, performance optimization, and profiling tools.

Développer de nouveaux outils d'optimisation et de simulation pour soutenir des opportunités commerciales innovantes (installation hybride solaire + stockage, etc.) ; Élaborer des prévisions de prix de l'électricité à court et à long terme. Master en ingénierie, en mathématiques appliquées, en informatique ou en science des données ; Expérience ou intérêt marqué pour le secteur de l'énergie ; Bonnes compétences analytiques, connaissance des techniques d'apprentissage automatique (Machine Learning) ; Une connaissance des modèles d'optimisation sous contrainte (LP, MILP) serait un plus ; Bonnes notions en Python avec une familiarité avec les bibliothèques de science des données (pandas, sklearn, keras, ...) ; Langue : Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français. Nous recherchons une personne proactive et curieuse, avec de bonnes capacités de communication et un fort appétit pour l'innovation et la collaboration internationale.

items.desc: The University Library is offering a full-time position as Data Scientist (all genders) starting as soon as possible. The position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for 24 months within the project "FAIR Corpus: A curated dataset for training and evaluating AI-Assistants for Research Data Management and Open Science" . The FAIR Corpus project is aimed to build the first openly licensed, high-quality dataset for training and evaluating AI-Assistants specifically focused on Research Data Management (RDM) and Open Science (OS). This corpus will contain thousands of curated documents, including data management plans, policies, training materials, standards, and open-access publications. It will be enriched with metadata and formatted for use in AI training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and retrieval-augmented generation. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Engagés à vos côtés, au service de vos enjeux critiques. Accélérer la transformation industrielle, en toute sécurité. Notre Business Unit Industrie accompagne les leaders des secteurs de l’aéronautique, de l’énergie et du transport dans la conception, la sécurisation et l’optimisation de leurs systèmes critiques. Avec plus de 700 collaborateurs en France et en Amérique du Nord, elle mobilise une expertise reconnue permettant la réalisation de projets innovants dans les domaines des systèmes embarqués, de la simulation numérique, de la cybersécurité, de la data intelligence et de la digitalisation des processus industriels. Rejoindre cette Business Unit, c’est transformer l’industrie avec des solutions à fort impact. Description Du Poste Nous recrutons un(e) Stage - Optimisation de l'exécution des modèles IA pour les systèmes robotiques pour rejoindre notre Business Unit INDUSTRIE au sein de l’agence Systèmes Embarqués Industriels et Cybersécurisés. Le Pôle de compétence SEIC contribue au développement de systèmes embarqués et industriels à fortes contraintes temps réel et de sûreté de fonctionnement ainsi qu’à leur mise en œuvre opérationnelle intégrant les concepts de sécurité. Contexte et Objectifs Dans la lignée des initiatives de CS Group d'intégration de l'IA appliquée aux systèmes embarqués, le stage visera concevoir et évaluer une stratégie d’ordonnancement permettant d’exécuter de manière optimale plusieurs modèles DNN concurrents d’une fonction de perception et de tracking avancé, en tenant compte de leurs périodes d’activation, des deadlines, des priorités, les ressources de calcul et du contexte opérationnel. Le système devra supporter des modes d’inférence synchrones ainsi que l’activation, la désactivation de certains modèles en fonction de l’évolution de la mission. Missions Principales Modéliser les chaînes d’inférence multi-DNN et leurs contraintes temporelles Formaliser la fonction de tracking sous forme d’un ensemble de tâches DNN périodiques, en caractérisant leurs temps d’exécution, fréquences et besoins en ressources. Étudier les interactions des exécutions de graphes synchrones ainsi que leurs impacts lors des transitions de modes et évaluer l’impact de la latence de bout en bout. 2 . Concevoir des stratégies d’ordonnancement dynamique des modèles DNN Développer et comparer des politiques d’ordonnancement permettant de déterminer au runtime quel modèles DNN à exécuter, à quel instant, avec quelle priorité et sur quelle ressource de calcul, tout en garantissant le respect des contraintes temporelles. Adapter l’ordonnancement au contexte opérationnel Définir et développer des politiques statiques capable de modifier au runtime des modèles DNN actifs, leurs fréquences et leurs priorités selon la situation rencontrée : apparition d’une cible, perte de tracking, phase de mission critique ou changement de ressources disponibles. Optimiser l’allocation des ressources CPU/NPU et garantir les deadlines critiques Étudier l’ordonnancement temporel et l’allocation des modèles (graphe de calculs) aux ressources de la cible hétérogènes afin de minimiser la latence et la contention mémoire (chargement des poids du modèles…) tout en maximisant l’utilisation des accélérateurs. Etudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de supervision et/ou de reconfiguration des graphes à exécuter en optimisant les politiques d’ordonnancement selon les scénarios avec des scénarios de repli. Évaluer et valider l’ordonnanceur sur un cas de tracking multi-DNN Implémenter un démonstrateur représentatif combinant plusieurs DNN de perception et de tracking et comparer différentes stratégies sous variations de charge, de contexte et de ressources disponibles. items.desc: Rejoignez-nous en Stage ! CEA Tech Corporate from CEA Tech on Vimeo . En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. Description du poste : Le stage se focalisera sur le développement et le déploiement du module de détection d'intention (modulaire, réaliste, discret et furtif) pour identifier, observer et analyser les intentions des cyberattaquants. La première phase du stage consistera à étudier l'architecture logicielle existante de la plateforme de déception, permettant notamment de tester ses fonctionnalités et d'évaluer ses critères de réalisme et de furtivité. Ensuite, vous développerez des modules spécifiques pour renforcer l'interactivité avec l'attaquant. Par exemple, vous développerez un module de détection d'intention (modulaire, réaliste, discret et furtif) pour identifier, observer et analyser les intentions des cyberattaquants. Vous pourrez également si le temps le permet travailler sur la génération et de déploiement dynamique de leurres numériques (faux serveurs, faux fichiers, etc.) en utilisant des outils de décision basés sur l'IA. Une fois les modules développés, la plateforme de détection sera mise en ligne et évaluée. Les données collectées seront ensuite analysées pour identifier des améliorations potentielles de la plateforme et pour enrichir la base de données d'entraînement des modèles IA. Ces données, complexes, seront agrégées dans un outil de supervision. Cet outil inclura des modules de visualisation 3D interactifs (en cours de développement par l'équipe DIGIT) afin de faciliter l'exploration de ces données complexes. Vous devrez ainsi adapter vos modules développés aux modules de visualisation. Profil du candidat Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Etudiant(e) en Master / Ingénieur(e), Spécialité : Informatique Vous avez des connaissances en cybersécurité : environnements SOC (Security Operation Center), les outils de détection, les techniques et les protocoles de sécurité. Vous avez des compétences dans les modèles d'IA décisionnelle et IA générative Vous avez des compétences en développement Full Stack (Python, JavaScript (Nodejs, ReactJs), Git, Docker, Docker compose. Vous êtes force de proposition. Vous avez une appétence pour l’innovation et les nouveautés. Vous savez communiquer sur vos travaux et expliquer votre démarche. Rejoignez-nous, venez développer vos compétences et en acquérir de nouvelles ! Vous avez encore un doute ? Nous vous proposons : L'opportunité de travailler au sein d'une organisation de renommée mondiale dans le domaine de la recherche scientifique, Un environnement unique dédié à des projets ambitieux au profit des grands enjeux sociétaux actuels, Une expérience à la pointe de l’innovation, comportant un fort potentiel de développement industriel, Des moyens expérimentaux exceptionnels et un encadrement de qualité, De réelles opportunités de carrière à l’issue de votre stage Un poste au cœur de la métropole grenobloise, facilement accessible via la mobilité douce favorisée par le CEA, Une participation aux transports en commun à hauteur de 85%, Un équilibre vie privée – vie professionnelle reconnu, Un restaurant d'entreprise, Une politique diversité et inclusion, Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. items.desc: Ben jij een software engineer met een passie voor AI? Vind je het leuk om slimme conversational oplossingen te bouwen énklanten te helpen om het maximale uit die technologie tehalen? Wil je werken met LLM's, agentic AI, prompting, integraties en voice-oplossingen binnen een innovatiefsoftwareplatform? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Bij Enreach bouwen we met DialoX aan een geavanceerdconversational AI-platform waarmee partners en klantenvoicebots, chatbots en messagingoplossingen ontwikkelen. Van AI-gestuurde klantenservice tot slimme voice-oplossingen binnen telefonieomgevingen: DialoX vormt de basis voor moderne klantcommunicatie. Door de groei van het platform en de toenemende vraag naarAI-oplossingen zoeken we een Conversational AI Engineer die technisch sterk is, graag bouwt én energie krijgt van het oplossen van complexe vraagstukken. DE FUNCTIE Als Conversational AI Engineer werk je dagelijks aanSmartApps & Skills binnen DialoX. Deze slimme bouwstenenworden gebruikt door partners en klanten om conversational AI-oplossingen te realiseren voor verschillendecommunicatiekanalen. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, onderhoudt bestaandetoepassingen en helpt bij het oplossen van complexetechnische vraagstukken. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijkerol in het toepassen van moderne AI-technologieën, waaronder Large Language Models (LLM's), prompt engineering, knowledge bases en agentic AI. Je werkt nauw samen met software engineers, Product Owners, supportteams, partners en klanten om ervoor tezorgen dat oplossingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar engebruiksvriendelijk blijven. Wat ga je doen? • Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van SmartApps& Skills binnen het DialoX-platform; • Bouwen van conversational AI-oplossingen voor chat-, voice- en messagingkanalen; • Ontwikkelen van integraties met externe systemen via API's, webhooks en andere koppelingen; • Schrijven en onderhouden van tests om functionaliteit enkwaliteit te waarborgen; • Onderzoeken, reproduceren en oplossen van complexetechnische vraagstukken; • Ondersteunen van partners en klanten bij het ontwerpen enverbeteren van hun DialoX-oplossingen; • Samenwerken met het Product Team om klantvragen enfeedback te vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; • Uitvoeren van code reviews en bijdragen aan technischestandaarden binnen het team; • Vastleggen van technische kennis, best practices enoplossingen. WERKEN MET AI AI speelt een steeds belangrijkere rol binnen DialoX. Daaromkrijg je veel ruimte om te experimenteren met en te bouwenaan moderne AI-functionaliteiten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: • Prompt engineering en optimalisatie van AI-gestuurdeoplossingen; • Het ontwikkelen van toepassingen op basis van Large Language Models (LLM's); • Het ontwerpen van agentic AI-oplossingen waarbijmodellen zelfstandig acties kunnen uitvoeren; • Tool- en function-calling voor AI-agents; • Het werken met knowledge bases en retrieval-oplossingen; • Het toepassen van moderne standaarden zoals Model Context Protocol (MCP); • Het evalueren en implementeren van nieuwe AI-mogelijkheden binnen het platform. Daarnaast werk je mee aan toekomstige ontwikkelingenbinnen DialoX, waaronder ondersteuning voor Lua alsaanvullende scriptingtaal binnen het platform. WIE BEN JIJ? Je bent een technisch sterke engineer die graag bouwt énnieuwsgierig is naar hoe AI-oplossingen in de praktijk wordentoegepast. Je vindt het interessant om complexe problemen uitte zoeken, bent communicatief vaardig en voelt je prettig in een rol waarin techniek, innovatie en klantcontactsamenkomen. Daarnaast breng je mee: • Minimaal 2 tot 3 jaar professionele ervaring als Software Engineer, Integration Engineer of vergelijkbare functie; • Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling in bijvoorbeeldPython, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java, C#, Elixir of vergelijkbare programmeertalen; • Ervaring met API-integraties, webhooks en externe systemen; • Ervaring met debugging en probleemanalyse binnenproductieomgevingen; • Praktische ervaring met Large Language Models en AI-oplossingen; • Ervaring met prompt engineering of AI-gedrevenapplicaties; • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlandsals Engels; • HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau. items.desc: Deine Aufgaben Du bist technischer Sparringspartner (m/w/d) für unsere Fachbereiche und übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in konkrete, datengetriebene Anwendungsfälle. Du konzipierst End-to-End Data & Analytics-Lösungen (von der Datenquelle bis ins Lakehouse und zur Visualisierung) und begleitest deren Umsetzung durch Entwicklerteams. Du validierst neue Ansätze durch hands-on Prototypen (PoCs/PoVs) und entwickelst teilweise auch eigenständig kleinere, maßgeschneiderte Daten-Lösungen für den produktiven Einsatz. Du identifizierst proaktiv Chancen für neue Datenprodukte und bringst deine Ideen (z. B. im Bereich Gen-AI) aktiv ein. Du arbeitest in agilen, internationalen Projekt- und Produkt-Teams. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine (Teil-)Produkte, hältst sie am Laufen und entwickelst sie im Sinne des Business-Werts kontinuierlich weiter. Dein Profil Du bringst ca. 3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Data & Analytics-Umfeld mit und brennst für Daten, Technik und die Wertschöpfungskette des Handels. Du bist ein proaktiver Teamplayer (m/w/d), der gerne den ersten Schritt macht, um eine Idee von der Konzeption bis zum Prototypen oder zur eigenen funktionierenden Lösung zu treiben. Dein Fundament bringst du aus einem Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Ausbildung mit Berufserfahrung mit. Moderne Architekturkonzepte wie Data Warehouse und Data Lakehouse sind für dich bewährte Praxis. AI-First Mindset: Du lebst AI-First Development in deinem täglichen Workflow – AI-gestützte Entwicklungs-Tools (z. B. OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot) nutzt du selbstverständlich, um Prototypen und Lösungen zügig auf die Straße zu bringen. Du bewegst dich sicher in unserem Tech-Stack. Du musst kein Experte in allem sein, bringst aber fundierte Erfahrung in einigen der folgenden Bereiche mit: Data & Analytics Basics: Python und SQL, Cloud-Plattformen: Idealerweise GCP (alternativ Azure), Managed Data Services: Databricks, Big Query (alternativ Snowflake), Data Processing & Orchestrierung: z. B. Spark, Airflow, BI & Visualisierung: z. B. MicroStrategy (jetzt Strategy), Looker, APIs & Open Source Tools: z. B. FastAPI, Gen-AI & AI-Assisted Analytics: z. B. Databricks Genie, LLM-Integrationen, RAG oder Agent-basierte Workflows Du sprichst eine Sprache, die jeder versteht – auf Deutsch und Englisch, egal ob im Management oder im Entwicklerteam.

items.desc: Dein Job im Überblick: Die Luzerner Kantonalbank verfolgt mit ihrer Strategie «LUKB30» eine klare Vision: Wir wollen die führende Kantonalbank im Bereich Datenanalyse und künstliche Intelligenz werden. Im Kompetenzzentrum Data, Analytics & KI gestalten wir die digitale Transformation der Bank. Als AI & ML Engineer treibst du die Konzeption, Entwicklung und den Betrieb skalierbarer ML- & GenAI-Use-Cases auf Basis der Azure-Databricks-Plattform voran. Wir suchen in Luzern eine:n AI & ML Engineer (w/m/d) Was du bei uns bewirkst: ML- & AI-Entwicklung: Konzeption, Entwicklung und Skalierung von ML-Modellen und AI-Use-Cases unter Verwendung interner Daten auf unserer Azure Databricks-Plattform. System-Integration: Nahtlose Einbettung von KI-Services in bestehende Applikationen und Geschäftsprozesse mittels APIs, Event- und Datenflüssen, CI/CD-Pipelines sowie passender Betriebsmodelle. GenAI Quality & Evaluation: Systematische Entwicklung und Qualitätssicherung von Prompts, Agenten-Workflows, RAG-Retrieval, Testsets und Evaluationsmetriken (inkl. Halluzinationskontrolle). Business Partnership: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen zur Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in nachhaltige, praxistaugliche technische Lösungen. Betrieb & Lifecycle Management: Überwachung, Pflege und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bestehender ML- und AI-Use Cases im produktiven Betrieb. Plattform & Governance: Aktive Mitwirkung in Governance- und Betriebsfragen im Umfeld einer modernen Enterprise-Daten- und AI-Plattform. Das bringst du mit: Abgeschlossenes Studium (FH/ETH/Uni) in Data Science, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation. Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Integration und Betrieb von ML- oder GenAI-Lösungen (z. B. Scikit-Learn/XGBoost, Tensorflow / PyTorch, SQL, Feature Engineering für klassisches ML oder RAG, Prompt Engineering, Agenten-Workflows, MLflow, Vector Databases für GenAI). Fundierte Kenntnisse in Python und SQL entlang moderner Software-Engineering Standards (Clean Code, Unit/Integration Tests, Code Reviews), Erfahrung mit Data Engineering (ETL/ELT, Datenmodellierung, APIs) sowie modernen DevOps/MLOps-Praktiken (z. B. Git, CI/CD, Databricks Asset Bundles). Erfahrung im Umgang von Bankdaten sind ein Plus. Erfahrung mit Azure Databricks; entsprechende Cloud- oder Databricks-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus. Themen wie Datenschutz, Modell-Sicherheit, Guardrails und Governance gehören für dich ganz selbstverständlich dazu. Erfahrungen im Bankenumfeld sind von Vorteil. Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch sowie Freude am Austausch an der Schnittstelle zwischen IT und Fachbereich. Deine Vorteile bei uns: Wir schaffen Raum für Ambition - mit offenen Türen, persönlicher Förderung und echtem Mitgestalten im Team. Dazu bieten wir dir attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen mit einer fairen Vergütung, attraktiven Personalkonditionen mit einer starken beruflichen Vorsorge. Mehr Ferien, bezahlte Feiertage sowie Möglichkeiten wie Ferienkauf oder Sabbatical schaffen zusätzlichen Freiraum. Flexible Arbeits- und Arbeitszeitmodelle - auch in Führungspositionen - unterstützen dich dabei, Beruf und Privatleben individuell zu verbinden. Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung fördern wir mit vielfältigen Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Und vor allem: Deine Ideen und dein Wissen sind bei uns gefragt - denn Mitgestalten gehört bei der LUKB dazu.

Je gaat onder andere Onderzoeken hoe de huidige WMS-data is opgebouwd en wordt gebruikt Verschillende manieren onderzoeken om data te structureren, zoals datawarehouses, dimensionele datamodellen en stermodellen Onderzoeken welke data-architectuur het beste past bij ons WMS Een toekomstbestendig datamodel ontwerpen Een representatieve dataset uit het WMS gebruiken om jouw oplossing uit te werken Jouw oplossing testen en de resultaten vertalen naar een concreet advies Uiteindelijk lever je een advies én een uitwerking op voor een BI- en AI-ready datafundament binnen ons WMS. Jouw vaardigheden Jouw kijk op vooruit gaan Je volgt HBO-ICT, bij voorkeur in de richting Data & AI, en zoekt een afstudeeropdracht waarin je onderzoek combineert met een concrete technische uitwerking. Je vindt het interessant om met data aan de slag te gaan en uit te zoeken hoe je van grote hoeveelheden gegevens bruikbare informatie maakt. Daarbij Heb je interesse in data, databases en Business Intelligence Vind je het leuk om grote hoeveelheden data te analyseren en structureren Vind je het interessant om verschillende technische oplossingen met elkaar te vergelijken Woon je op bereisbare afstand van Zevenaar Beheers je de Nederlandse taal Wat wij jou bieden Zo helpen we jou vooruit Wij bieden jou alle ruimte om van jouw afstudeeropdracht iets goeds te maken. Tijdens je afstudeeropdracht krijg je de tijd om echt in het vraagstuk te duiken. En natuurlijk hoef je het niet allemaal alleen uit te zoeken. Om je heen werken collega's die dagelijks bezig zijn met software en automatisering voor logistieke omgevingen. Je Kunt Rekenen Op Goede begeleiding tijdens je afstudeeropdracht Iedere week een vast moment met jouw begeleider Veel ruimte om zelfstandig aan jouw onderzoek en oplossing te werken Een prettige en informele werkomgeving Flexibiliteit en ruimte om je eigen ideeën in te brengen Een stagevergoeding van €500 per maand

items.desc: We’re Vstorm - a boutique AI Agent engineering consultancy specializing in process automation and transformations based on Agentic AI. Organizations around the world - from the USA, through Europe, to the Middle East - rely on our expertise to move from AI experimentation to real implementations that deliver measurable business results. For our innovative approach to applying artificial intelligence in business, we have been recognized by EY, Deloitte and Forbes . We collaborate with global brands such as Intel, Mercedes, and leading self-publishing organizations in the UK. Vstorm is the first-ever partner of PydanticAI , and the first consulting company to join the Agentic AI Foundation - giving our engineers direct exposure to the ecosystem shaping the future of Agentic AI. Today, we’re expanding our A-players team and looking for an Agentic AI Engineer who wants to work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology, real business problems, and long-term product thinking. Who You Are You have 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, building applications end to end, not just models. You’ve built and shipped LLM-based applications to production, including agentic systems with tools and orchestration. You’ve worked with frameworks like PydanticAI, LangChain or LlamaIndex, or built your own. You know how to build validation and evaluation pipelines for LLM-based systems. You have strong backend skills: Python, REST APIs (e.g. FastAPI), relational databases, and vector databases (e.g. Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant). You can take an application from code to production: Docker, CI/CD, and designing and deploying architecture on at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure). Agentic coding is part of your daily workflow. You’re comfortable talking directly to clients and turning their needs into technical decisions. You work with Git and follow solid engineering practices: clean code, code reviews. You speak and write English at B2/C1 level. How You Work Clear thinking. You break complex problems down to their foundations, structure your reasoning well, and notice the details that matter. Ownership. You feel responsible for the outcome, not just the task. You set a high bar for yourself and keep raising it. Teamwork. You back the best idea, even when it isn’t yours. You jump in where the team needs help. You give feedback openly and constructively, and you treat feedback you receive as a chance to improve. Nice To Have Frontend experience: enough to build simple UIs yourself. Experience with security and compliance requirements (e.g. SOC 2). Direct experience with PydanticAI. Contributions to open-source AI or ML projects. You're located in Wrocław, Poland or can easily commute from time to time to the office :) What We Offer B2B or UZ contract with competitive monthly compensation - hourly rate up to 130 PLN (rate defined individually, based on experience and impact). We’re remote by default, but at the same time, we value real human connection: we often work in hybrid mode and regularly meet to build a strong team… and have some fun :). Flexible working hours - we’re focused on trust, ownership, and outcomes. Long-term collaboration - we don’t hire for single projects, we build stable, expert-level teams. Up to 8000 PLN gross annual personal budget - fully yours to invest in learning, tools, conferences or anything that supports your growth and lifestyle. Daily collaboration with highly experienced AI engineers, including PhD-level specialists. Space and support to create and contribute to open-source projects, co-author research papers, technical articles, and thought leadership content, as well as experiment with your own ideas and transform them into real initiatives. Access to and influence over our internal knowledge base - Vstormpedia, continuously developed and enriched by the team - knowledge that stays, evolves, and compounds inside Vstorm. Ready to apply? Here's What The Process Looks Like Initial interview - approx. 30 min - our People & Operations Manager, Agnieszka will call to tell you more about the position and our projects, learn more about your background and experience so far, and check if we're a good fit for each other. Technical interview - approx. 1-1,5h - an in-depth interview with one of our Tech Leads to properly evaluate your theoretical and practical knowledge, your skills and experience. CEO interview - approx. 1h - a final meeting with Antoni, our CEO. Decision - hopefully, we make you an offer and you accept it! :) PS. We don't ghost! Clear communication and relevant feedback has great value to us, so we'll keep you informed during the whole process. Wymagania Oczekujemy Oferujemy

items.desc: Hoe jij onze klanten blij maakt: Bij bol geloven we dat AI de toekomst van creatief werk is. Als stagiair AI-innovatie & creatieve technologie werk je mee aan projecten die de grenzen verleggen van wat AI kan. Door slimmere tooling en snellere creatieve processen te bouwen, help je ons relevantere, aansprekendere en innovatievere content te maken voor onze miljoenen klanten, collega’s en partners. Samen ontdekken we de mogelijkheden die ontstaan uit de combinatie van creativiteit en technologie. De grootste uitdaging: Hoe zet je de nieuwste AI-technologieën om in echte creatieve waarde voor een merk als bol? Dat is jouw grootste uitdaging. Je duikt in onze creatieve tools, bouwt je eigen toepassingen en ontdekt waar ruimte is voor innovatie. Daarbij onderbouw je jouw ideeën met een sterke case en help je bepalen hoe we AI inzetten in onze dagelijkse en toekomstige creatieve processen. Je bewaakt hierbij altijd de creativiteit en merkconsistentie. In deze rol krijg je veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en inspiratie om te experimenteren. Wat je doet als stagiair AI-innovatie & creatieve technologie: Je doet ervaring op in een divers team van tech- en AI-specialisten, engineers, creatives, en copywriters. Van B2C- en B2B-campagnes tot interne tools en communicatie: je werkt aan AI-projecten die op allerlei plekken binnen bol gebruikt worden. Je helpt ons slimme tools te verkennen, creatieve experimenten uit te voeren en alles daartussenin te bouwen. Je werkt nauw samen met creatives, developers en AI-specialisten binnen burobol. Je werkt aan AI-innovatieprojecten, van het eerste idee tot een werkend prototype. Je ontwikkelt en verbetert onze eigen interne AI-tools om workflows slimmer, sneller en schaalbaarder te maken. Je vertaalt je ideeën naar duidelijke concepten, business cases of voorstellen. Waarom jij het verschil kunt maken: In deze stage krijg je de unieke mogelijkheid om AI-technologie te koppelen aan de creatieve praktijk. Je zult kansen gaan identificeren en deze omzetten in proof of concepts. Hierbij krijg je alle ruimte om te experimenteren en zelfstandig op onderzoek uit te gaan. Jouw frisse blik en nieuwsgierigheid zal ons helpen om de grenzen van creatieve technologie te verleggen. Wat neem jij mee? Je bent per 1 februari 2027 fulltime (5 dagen per week) beschikbaar voor ten minste 5 maanden. Je bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage. Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding en staat ook tijdens je stage ingeschreven bij je onderwijsinstelling. Hier kom je te werken: Als stagiair AI innovatie & creatieve technologie sluit je je aan bij burobol, het in-house creatieve bureau van bol. Binnen burobol maak je deel uit van het AI-team, waar we dagelijks onderzoeken hoe generatieve AI ons kan helpen om betere, snellere en meer schaalbare content te maken. Je doet ervaring op in een divers team van creatives, copywriters, engineers en AI-specialisten die samenwerken op het snijvlak van merk, technologie en innovatie. Is dit iets voor jou? Techpionier: Je vindt het geweldig om generatieve AI te verkennen en wilt ontdekken hoe die toegepast worden in de praktijk. Nieuwsgierige trendwatcher: Je wilt altijd alles weten over de nieuwste digitale tools en experimenteert graag met nieuwe software. Probleemkraker: Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor uitdagingen en denkt kritisch na over mogelijke oplossingen. Is dit niets voor jou? Theorie boven praktijk: Je verdiept je liever theoretisch in AI-concepten dan dat je daadwerkelijk prototypes bouwt, test en snel leert van wat niet werkt. Bang voor het onzekere: Je kiest liever voor sterk gestructureerde, voorspelbare taken dan voor open creatieve experimenten. Eindeloze perfectionist: Je neemt liever maanden de tijd om één concept te perfectioneren dan dat je snel test en leert. We zijn trots op onze B Corp-certificering en werken elke dag hard aan verdere verbetering. Onze jaarlijkse bonus is gekoppeld aan duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen, en we staan voor gelijkheid en gelijke kansen voor iedereen. Voordelen van het hebben van een blauw hart 29 dagen: om op te laden Reiskosten: OV, auto, parkeren & opladen geregeld Pensioen regeling: 75% premie inleg €550 per maand: Stagevergoeding

items.desc: Wie das Engineering der Zukunft aussieht, erforschen wir am Fraunhofer-Institut für Entwurfstechnik Mechatronik IEM in Paderborn – gemeinsam mit starken Partnern und viel Leidenschaft für Technik. items.desc: Organisation NAVAL GROUP Acteur international du naval de défense, Naval Group est partenaire des États dans la maîtrise de leur souveraineté maritime. Grâce à des savoir-faire et des moyens industriels exceptionnels, il conçoit, réalise, intègre, maintient en service et modernise des sous-marins, des navires de surface et des drones ainsi que leurs systèmes, leurs armes et leurs équipements, jusqu'à la déconstruction. UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL POSITIF Implantés sur 9 sites en France et dans 17 pays, nous valorisons un environnement de travail agréable, favorisant la diversité des profils, l'esprit d'équipe et le bien-être. Cela se concrétise par une mixité sociale, des accords pour la qualité de vie au travail, un engagement dans le développement professionnel via la formation continue et l'implication des collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans la mise en œuvre collective de notre stratégie de responsabilité sociétale de l'entreprise (RSE). NOS CHIFFRES CLEFS 17 170 collaborateurs et collaboratrices 4,6 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires Description Du Poste VOS MISSIONS : Le site de Cherbourg accueille des activités d’étude, de conception et de construction de sous-marins pour la Marine nationale et les clients internationaux, jusqu’à leur démantèlement et déconstruction. Le stagiaire est intégré à l'équipe Data Management & BI, dans la division Sous-Marin. Dans le cadre de nos activités de maitrise de la qualité des données, nous souhaitons mener un projet dont la vocation sera de confronter d'une part les données techniques déjà renseignées dans nos bases de données produits, aux spécifications documentaires décrivant nos produits afin d'assurer une cohérence entre les deux, et d'autre part consolider d'éventuelles données manquantes par le biais de ces analyses. Ce projet nécessitera la mise en oeuvre de techniques IA (OCR, classification , ...) et de compétence BI pour la restitution des résultats sous forme d'indicateurs. Par ailleurs, nous sommes également amenés à produire des indicateurs de pilotage très visuels (type cartes dynamiques). La production de telles cartes sur la base d'un existant type "image" est longue et fastidieuse à réaliser manuellement. Aussi le stagiaire pourra être amené à travailler sur des outils d'aide à la génération automatique de cartes dynamiques dans un format exploitable par notre technologie BI. Les entretiens de recrutement vous permettront d’échanger avec le manager du pôle et ainsi d’en apprendre davantage sur l’ensemble de vos missions. Profil ET VOUS ? Vous êtes en études dans le domaine de l'IA et de la Data et vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois en 2027 : ce poste est fait pour vous ! NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT Après réception de votre CV, si votre profil retient notre attention, l'un de nos recruteurs vous contactera pour un entretien téléphonique. À l'issue de ce premier échange, vous pourrez être contacté·e pour passer un entretien (physique ou visioconférence) avec le manager du service concerné. Enfin, dès que nous aurons fait notre choix final, vous en serez informé·e dans les plus brefs délais. LES AVANTAGES NAVAL GROUP : - Une gratification est prévue selon le niveau et le diplôme préparé - Un comité social et économique (CSE) dynamique proposant des activités sociales et culturelles - Un environnement de travail agréable et un accès à un restaurant d'entreprise avec une participation de l'employeur - Une prise en charge des frais de transport possible (50% du titre de transport en commun) Date prévue de prise de fonction : 01/03/2027

items.desc: Job Requirements Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst van de industrie en AI? Zoek jij een stage waarin je niet alleen meekijkt, maar écht impact maakt? Kijkt hoe handmatige werkzaamheden kunnen worden geautomatiseerd. Onderzoekt hoeveel tijd en werkuren hiermee bespaard kunnen worden. Bijdraagt aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van belangrijke bedrijfsdata. Meedenkt over het inzetten van AI voor automatisering van meldingen en rapportages. Een extra uitdaging: een deel van deze data wordt gecontroleerd tijdens audits door externe partijen. Jouw werk heeft dus direct invloed op de kwaliteit van onze processen. items.card: You will translate educational and product requirements into dependable AI behaviour, build the services and agent workflows behind it, and take changes from experimentation through to production. Responsibilities Prompt engineering and tuning Own extensive prompt development, testing and continuous refinement across our AI
items.desc: We are looking for an AI Engineer to build and improve the AI experiences across our education platform, including personalised tutoring, test preparation, college guidance, research and writing support. This is a hands-on engineering role with a substantial focus on prompt development and tuning. You will translate educational and product requirements into dependable AI behaviour, build the services and agent workflows behind it, and take changes from experimentation through to production. You will work closely with the CTO, product team, subject specialists and software engineers. Responsibilities Prompt engineering and tuning Own extensive prompt development, testing and continuous refinement across our AI features, improving accuracy, relevance, clarity, tone and consistency. Design system prompts, reusable templates, few-shot examples, tool instructions and structured output schemas. Refine how agents ask questions, explain concepts, provide feedback and guide students through tasks. Manage the context supplied to models, including conversation history, learner profiles, activity, current workspace and relevant documents or school information. Analyse real conversations and feedback with product and education specialists. Turn ambiguous requirements and recurring failure cases into measurable improvements. AI agents and application engineering Build and maintain Python services, conversational agents and workflows that use tools, retrieve information, generate reports and take authorised actions through platform APIs. Integrate LLM providers and supporting services; evaluate model choices and configure routing, token budgets, streaming and fallbacks. Develop retrieval and grounding approaches that give AI responses the relevant information and preserve source attribution where needed. Connect AI workflows to learner state, task management and platform events. Implement explicit business rules, permissions and reliable execution for actions that change user data. Evaluation and production quality Build evaluation datasets and automated prompt regression tests covering answer quality, educational usefulness, factual accuracy, tool use and multi-turn behaviour. Version prompts and model configurations, compare changes against a baseline, and document results so releases can be reviewed and reproduced. Investigate production failures and improve observability, error handling, retries and recovery. Monitor latency, token usage, cost and task completion. Test prompt injection, inappropriate requests and other adversarial inputs. Implement guardrails and appropriate uncertainty handling for a platform used by students. Requirements Strong Python engineering skills and experience building, testing and maintaining production services and APIs. Practical experience shipping LLM applications, with examples of substantial prompt tuning and evidence of how you measured improvements. Experience with tool calling, structured outputs, conversational state, context management and agent orchestration. An understanding of retrieval, embeddings and grounding, and when these approaches help solve a product problem. A systematic approach to evaluation and debugging, including the ability to distinguish prompt failures from data, model, integration or application issues. Strong written English and the ability to turn complex product and educational requirements into precise instructions and clear technical decisions. Ownership of delivery, sound judgement about quality, latency and cost, and effective collaboration with technical and non-technical colleagues. Nice to have Voice, image or other multimodal AI experiences; model fine-tuning or small-model classification and routing. TypeScript, event-driven systems, cloud deployment, Docker and AI evaluation or observability tooling. Education technology, AI tutoring, assessment, feedback generation or personalised learning. We offer Fully remote. No office, no commute. We work asynchronously where we can and synchronously where we must. You'll have meaningful overlap with the both founder and CTO (London) and the rest of the team across London and the US. Professional growth opportunities and career prospects 25 days plus public holidays and standard employer contribution depending on location. Any subscription you want - Claude Max, ChatGPT Pro, whatever your stack needs. About Dakota Dakota.Education is building the world's most exciting new education brand. We make AI-native products that teach K–12 students to read, write and think, and help US high schoolers prep for the SAT and write college essays that sound like them. We've partnered with Penguin Random House, HarperCollins and MIT Technology Review. Our advisors come from College Board, ACT, Stanford and Dartmouth. We're a Google Accelerator alumna. We have a clear, opinionated view: the answer to the reading recession and the college admissions arms race isn't another app — it's an education company, built for this …

items.desc: Tirocinio in Interazione Persona–Computer (HCI) – Progetto AI-native Interamente da remoto · Inizio: 1° dicembre 2026 · Durata: 3 mesi Chi siamo L’AI sta diventando autonoma. L’essere umano è ancora legato allo schermo. Synaptix.AI, con sede a Firenze, sta sviluppando una piattaforma AI-native per dirigere e supervisionare flotte di agenti AI attraverso un’interazione vocale naturale. Il progetto permette di parlare con il proprio computer attraverso il telefono: delegare attività, chiedere aggiornamenti e guidare gli agenti mentre lavorano sul computer, ovunque ci si trovi. L’obiettivo è consentire una collaborazione continua: intervenire e prendere decisioni in tempo reale oppure lasciare lavorare gli agenti e riprendere la conversazione quando serve. Stiamo sviluppando anche l’estensione di questa interazione agli occhiali smart. La nostra direzione è semplice: più libertà, più tempo per le persone, mantenendo il controllo sul lavoro degli agenti. Il tirocinio Cerchiamo una persona interessata a contribuire alla ricerca, alla progettazione e alla prototipazione di nuove modalità di interazione tra persone e agenti AI. Il percorso unisce Human–Computer Interaction, sperimentazione con utenti e sviluppo di prototipi , con attività e obiettivi formativi definiti in base alle competenze iniziali e svolti con l’affiancamento del team. Di cosa ti occuperai Progettare scenari d’uso e flussi di interazione per delegare attività agli agenti, ricevere aggiornamenti, approvare azioni e consultare risultati. Contribuire alla realizzazione di prototipi di interfacce vocali e mobili, curando la chiarezza del dialogo, la gestione degli errori e la possibilità di intervenire durante l’esecuzione. Per i profili tecnici, sviluppare piccoli componenti software e sperimentare integrazioni con API, modelli linguistici e servizi di riconoscimento e sintesi vocale. Preparare e svolgere, insieme al team, interviste e test di usabilità per comprendere come le persone interagiscono con gli agenti e ne supervisionano il lavoro. Raccogliere e analizzare dati qualitativi e quantitativi: feedback, errori, tempi di risposta, comprensione delle azioni e difficoltà incontrate. Documentare risultati e prototipi, traducendo le osservazioni in proposte concrete di miglioramento. Chi cerchiamo La ricerca è rivolta principalmente a laureate e laureati in Informatica, Ingegneria informatica o percorsi analoghi . Prendiamo in considerazione anche laureate e laureati in Psicologia e Filosofia , con un interesse concreto per l’intelligenza artificiale, l’interazione persona–computer, il linguaggio, i processi cognitivi e la sperimentazione con strumenti digitali. Per tutte le candidature cerchiamo capacità analitiche, curiosità, precisione, disponibilità a imparare e capacità di collaborare e documentare il proprio lavoro da remoto. È utile una buona conoscenza dell’inglese per leggere documentazione tecnica e scientifica. Competenze tecniche e metodologiche Per i profili informatici, cerchiamo basi operative in: Programmazione in Python e/o JavaScript/TypeScript . Utilizzo e integrazione di API REST , gestione di dati JSON e comprensione delle architetture client–server. Uso di Git , debugging e documentazione del codice. Sviluppo di interfacce web con HTML e CSS ; la conoscenza di React costituisce un elemento preferenziale. Sono inoltre apprezzate esperienze, anche universitarie o personali, in: Modelli linguistici, agenti AI e interfacce conversazionali. Riconoscimento e sintesi vocale, interazioni in tempo reale e integrazione tra voce, telefono e dispositivi indossabili. Prototipazione con Figma o strumenti analoghi. Ricerca con utenti, progettazione di esperimenti, test di usabilità e analisi dei dati. Per i profili provenienti da Psicologia e Filosofia , valorizziamo in particolare le competenze nella ricerca, nell’analisi del linguaggio e del ragionamento, nei processi cognitivi e nello studio della fiducia e del controllo nell’interazione con l’AI. Le competenze saranno valutate in relazione al percorso di ciascuna persona: non è necessario possedere tutte quelle elencate . Modalità e prospettive Modalità: interamente da remoto. Avvio: 1° dicembre 2026. Durata: tre mesi. Percorso formativo: partecipazione allo sviluppo di un progetto concreto, con affiancamento e confronto con il team. Al termine del tirocinio potrà essere valutata un’ assunzione con una componente di equity aziendale , ossia una partecipazione al capitale della società, con condizioni da concordare in fase di inserimento. Come candidarsi Invia la candidatura tramite LinkedIn, allegando il CV e una breve presentazione del tuo interesse per il progetto. Puoi aggiungere un progetto universitario o personale, una tesi, un portfolio, un repository GitHub o un esempio di ricerca che aiuti a comprendere il tuo approccio e le tue competenze.

Qu'attendons-nous de vous? Réalisation d’un état de l’art sur la détection de décalibration Conception d’un classifieur binaire calibré / décalibré pour une caméra stéréo, puis extension au couple caméra-microphones Évaluation du détecteur face à des méthodes de référence réimplémentées En fonction des attendus de votre école, les objectifs et livrables pourront être ajustés. # Cea-List Profil du candidat Vous préparez un diplôme d’école d’ingénieur ou un M2 dans le domaine du traitement du signal, de la vision par ordinateur, de la robotique ou de l’intelligence artificielle. Vous êtes passionné(e) par la recherche scientifique et technologique et êtes reconnu(e) pour votre curiosité, votre proactivité et votre prise d’initiative. Vous possédez de bonnes bases en apprentissage automatique et en apprentissage profond, ainsi que des connaissances en traitement d’images et/ou de signaux audio. La maîtrise de Python est attendue ; des notions en calibration de capteurs ou en systèmes multi-capteurs constituent un atout.
