R&D Software Functional Analyst - Medacta Applied Solutions: Due to the high growth and commitment to technology, Medacta Applied Solutions, a Software Company of the Medacta International Group based in Milan, is seeking for a Functional Analyst / UX & Requirements Engineer to join our software development team. This team is responsible for creating preoperative planning software for orthopaedic surgeries. The selected candidate will work closely with Product Managers, software developers, QA, and other stakeholders to identify, formalize, and document software requirements, transforming user and clinical needs into clear functional specifications, wireframes, and logical flows. This role is key to ensuring that software features are well-defined, unambiguous, and verifiable, contributing to higher product quality, more accurate development estimates, and reduced rework during implementation. The Functional Analyst will also support verification activities, ensuring that implemented features meet the intended requirements. The candidate will be responsible for managing the following activities: collaborate with Product Managers and stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and refine software requirements based on user, clinical, and business needs; translate requirements into clear functional documentation, including: user stories and functional specifications; wireframes and UI mockups; logical flow diagrams and state diagrams. define and document edge cases, error scenarios, and exceptional conditions, with particular attention to usability and safety; act as a functional reference point for the development team, clarifying requirements during implementation; participate in verification and validation activities, reviewing implemented features to ensure alignment with documented requirements; support QA activities by contributing to acceptance criteria and test scenarios; maintain documentation consistency throughout the software lifecycle, managing updates and changes to requirements. Soft Skills excellent communication skills both written and oral; problem-solving mindset and proactive approach; ability to translate complex requirements into clear and structured documentation; proactive attitude and sense of ownership; awarness of the importance of teamwork and collaboration in multidisciplinary environments; ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a regulated and quality-driven context. items.desc: Byondis is an independent, fully integrated biopharmaceutical company in Nijmegen, the Netherlands. We are engineering antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) to tackle cancer and other difficult to treat diseases. Our teams combine expertise in disease biology, linker-drug technology and antibody-drug conjugation to design targeted cancer medicines. Our Nijmegen campus brings together preclinical and clinical development, in-house GMP manufacturing capabilities and regulatory affairs. As a Regulatory Affairs Specialist, you will work directly with the scientists and manufacturing colleagues whose data you use to write clinical trial dossiers. Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities As Regulatory Affairs Specialist, you will join a small and dedicated RA team supporting early development and clinical-stage programs. The team interprets regulatory requirements, prepares and maintains submission documentation, and coordinates Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs) across different regions. Your work will cover CMC, nonclinical and clinical topics for both biological products and small molecules. You will work in multidisciplinary project teams and interact with colleagues across the company, regulatory authorities and CROs. Your responsibilities include compiling and maintaining regulatory documentation, such as IMPDs, IBs, DMF/ASMF and API documentation, and supporting scientific advice activities. You will coordinate the timely availability of documents for CTA submissions and responses to questions from authorities. You will also keep up to date with relevant regulatory requirements and advise project teams on how to apply them. Desired Skills and Experience Your CV and motivation letter should show that you have: A Master’s or preferably PhD degree in life sciences, chemistry or a related discipline; At least five years of relevant experience in Regulatory Affairs, preferably in early clinical development; Experience with ADCs. We also welcome small-molecule experience combined with exposure to biologics during your studies or career. Hands-on experience writing CMC and nonclinical sections of clinical trial dossiers and familiarity with the EU Clinical Trials Regulation. CTIS training or experience is helpful. Experience with CTA submissions in other regions is a strong advantage; Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively, coordinate multiple activities and deliver high-quality work within challenging timelines; The ability to maintain a broad overview while also paying close attention to detail; A proactive, pragmatic, and hands-on approach, with the curiosity to learn new topics and the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables; The ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders; Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain regulatory topics clearly and translate regulatory requirements into practical recommendations; Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn new digital tools and systems. Why Join Byondis? On our Nijmegen campus, you’ll work directly with the scientists and manufacturing colleagues developing new cancer medicines. Having research, development and clinical manufacturing on one site means you can discuss the data with the people who generated them and see how your dossier supports a medicine’s move into clinical trials. You’ll take responsibility for the regulatory work on your own project and work closely with the Head of Regulatory Affairs. In a small team, you’ll have room to ask questions, contribute ideas and broaden your experience across the quality, nonclinical and clinical aspects of drug development. items.desc: Ypenburg Den Haag Hbo bachelor 32 - 36 uur Schaal 10 / €3.496 - €5.535 (bruto) Onderzoek / wetenschap, (Data)analyse Solliciteer voor 30 november 2026 Dit ga je doen Hoe kan de informatie uit forensisch onderzoek aan planten, dieren en micro-organismen door het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut effectief worden gebruikt binnen strafrechtelijk onderzoek? Dat is dé vraag waar je als onderzoeker binnen het onderzoeksteam “Niet-humane Biologische Sporen (NHBS)” mee aan de slag gaat. Ben jij in staat om tools te ontwikkelen om een breed scala aan data te ontsluiten en te analyseren, zodat collega’s deze informatie kunnen toepassen in forensisch (zaak)onderzoek? Ben je daarnaast creatief en nauwkeurig om binnen ons team databases te vullen en te ontsluiten voor het bepalen van de bewijskracht? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Als Bio-informaticus/Data Engineer binnen het team Niet-humane biologische sporen (NHBS) werk je mee aan onderzoek aan sporen die afkomstig zijn van andere levensvormen dan de mens. Dit kunnen zowel zichtbare sporen van planten en dieren als met het blote oog onzichtbare sporen zijn, zoals diatomeeën en bacteriën. Dit onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd in het kader van strafrechtelijk onderzoek in levensdelicten, zedenmisdrijven, drugszaken, maar bijvoorbeeld ook bij overtreding van de flora- en faunawetgeving. Niet-humane biologische sporen kunnen worden gebruikt om een verband aan te tonen tussen voorwerpen in het bezit van een verdachte en de plaats delict. Ook kunnen deze sporen helpen bij het verifiëren van scenario’s en bepalen van tijdslijnen. De sporen kunnen echter ook zelf het hoofdonderwerp in een strafzaak zijn, bijvoorbeeld bij het onderzoek aan biologische drugs, vergiftigingen en de illegale handel in beschermde planten- en diersoorten. Je schrikt niet terug voor uitgebreid experimenteren. Het werk bestaat uit ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van nieuwe bioinformatica pipelines voor het analyseren en interpreteren van genetische gegevens van microbiomen, diatomeeën, schimmels, planten, dieren (eDNA). Hierbij is data van DNA-technologie zoals “massive parallel sequencen” maar ook vanuit geautomatiseerde analyse van microscopische preparaten jouw belangrijkste onderzoeksmateriaal. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen, onderhouden en uitbreiden van de data-infrastructuur van NHBS. Dit is nodig voor het vergaren, opslaan en verwerken van data. Hiervoor is kennis nodig over hoe de data vergaard is, welke (technische) issues er aan dergelijk verkregen data kan kleven, en wat er met de data bereikt moet worden (data analyse) en wat niet. Door deze kennis is optimale verbinding tussen lab en data scientists geborgd. Binnen het NFI zijn meerdere datalabs verenigd in een data science gilde, waarbinnen kennis uitgewisseld wordt. Daarnaast is er ruimte om samen met andere Python Developers en Data Scientists aan aanvullende uitdagende forensische data science-vraagstukken te werken. items.desc: About the role With our firm believe that we are part of a clean energy future, we are realizing positive environmental impact by replacing fossil fuel sources with renewable sources for the energy needs of our clients and stakeholders. Sunrock is expanding their proposition, by sustainable smart energy solutions. This is where this role comes in. As Quantitative Trading Analyst within the Energy Trading team you will play a pivotal role in improving the business. As we’re growing at a high pace, not only in volume but also developing new products and countries, the complexity of our business is rapidly increasing. In this role, you’ll be building parts of our growing business, where you can also take responsibility over the end result. It doesn’t end with a good recommendation – we like to take ownership and really make our ideas work. Your responsibilites As a (Quantitative) Trading Analyst, you will be co-responsible for trading and optimizing our solar assets and battery energy storage in the energy market. You will co-develop trading strategies, statistical models, and decision support tools, collaborating closely with the IT department. Next to that, you will participate in the execution and monitoring of the day-to-day trading operations (currently being set-up), related to forecasting, trading/bidding processes and the (real-time) dispatch of solar and battery capacity. You will participate in day-to-day forecasting and trading operations. You will monitor and analyze short-term power market prices (spot, intraday, imbalance, reserve) and markets developments. You will develop (quantitative) trading strategies, optimize the production forecast using statistical methods and develop decision support tooling, working closely within the team and with other Sunrock teams (Data & IT, Finance, Asset Mgmt., etc.). Set-up relevant performance reports, evaluate (forecasting and trading) performance and propose improvements. items.desc: Wij geloven dat het succes van Voordeeluitjes.nl afhangt van de mate waarin de website aansluit bij de wensen en behoeften van onze doelgroep. De UX Designer/Researcher is binnen het Digital Experience Team, onderdeel van de afdeling e-commerce, de drijvende kracht achter het achterhalen van de wensen en behoeften van onze gebruikers. Daarnaast vertaal je deze behoeften samen met het team naar relevante designs voor zowel experimenten als de ontwikkeling van nieuwe functionaliteiten en digitale producten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met specialisten op het gebied van CRO, UX/UI design, webanalyse en frontend-development om de algehele klantervaring te verbeteren. Je neemt zelfstandig het voortouw in grotere ontwerptrajecten, bijvoorbeeld voor ons loyaliteitsprogramma of een mobiele app. Daarbij denk je mee vanaf de eerste vraag en werk je ideeën uit tot concrete, gebruiksvriendelijke ontwerpen die samen met development gerealiseerd kunnen worden. In deze functie ligt er zowel focus op design als UX Research. De verhouding in uren tussen design en research zal gedurende het jaar verschillen, afhankelijk van de prioriteiten en behoeften. Wij werken datagedreven en hebben een sterke focus op experimenteren (A/B-testen). We gebruiken data om hypotheses te vormen en deze met A/B-testen te valideren. Naast het verbeteren van onze bestaande website werk je aan grotere productontwikkelingen, waarbij je onderzoek, data en ontwerp inzet om onderbouwde keuzes te maken. Een belangrijk doel is om veel te leren over onze gebruiker en die inzichten te vertalen naar betere digitale producten en kwalitatief goede experimenten. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je je kunt identificeren met onze visie op optimalisatie van ons platform. Wat ga je doen? In je werkzaamheden op design zal jij je vooral bezighouden met: het vertalen van business requirements en data-inzichten naar relevante designs; het zelfstandig uitwerken van complexere gebruikersflows en nieuwe functionaliteiten: van eerste concept en wireframes tot een uitgewerkt UI-design; het maken van (high-fidelity) prototypes en het waar nodig valideren hiervan onder gebruikers; het afstemmen van ontwerpen met stakeholders en developers, waarbij je ontwerpkeuzes onderbouwt en tijdens de realisatie betrokken blijft bij de kwaliteit van de gebruikerservaring; het samen verbeteren van designprocessen, design systems etc.; het delen van je kennis en het geven van constructieve feedback, waarmee je ook je minder ervaren UX-collega helpt zich verder te ontwikkelen. In je werkzaamheden op research zal jij je vooral bezighouden met: het proactief identificeren van kansen voor nieuwe onderzoeken met directe collega’s binnen het DX-team en andere stakeholders. Met als doel de gebruikerservaring te verbeteren op onze website, maar ook in onze uitingen in nieuwsbrieven en in offline print; het zelfstandig of in teamverband voorbereiden en uitvoeren van kwalitatieve en kwantitatieve onderzoeken en het analyseren en interpreteren van de uitkomsten; het vertalen van onderzoeksresultaten naar duidelijke aanbevelingen en het rapporteren en presenteren van deze resultaten aan interne stakeholders; het helpen omzetten van inzichten naar hypotheses, testideeën en relevante designs; het opzetten van nieuwe feedback-surveys, het analyseren van sessie-opnames en het actief delen van de inzichten met betrokkenen; het beheren van de hele aanmeld- en communicatieflow in ons Voordeeluitjes.nl Gebruikerspanel: je organiseert de werving van participanten en zorgt ervoor dat participanten alle benodigde informatie krijgen rondom hun deelname aan onze onderzoeken; het actief houden van onze database met deelnemers in het gebruikerspanel en het initiëren van acties om nieuwe panelleden te werven; het actief meewerken aan het professionaliseren, uitbreiden en verbeteren van onze UX Research-activiteiten om de algehele gebruikerservaring verder te verbeteren; het evangeliseren van UX binnen de organisatie: je deelt inzichten buiten het Digital Experience Team om diep in de organisatie het bewustzijn van klantgedrag te vergroten. Én je bewaakt te allen tijde dat de behoeften van onze gebruikers centraal staan bij de ontwikkeling en verbetering van onze digitale producten en diensten. Waarom jij dit wilt Werken bij ons is allesbehalve standaard. In onze branche staat plezier centraal, en dat merk je direct! Dit betekent lachen met collega’s, aandacht krijgen en geven, profiteren van voordelen en stap voor stap groeien. Zo voelt je werk niet alleen waardevol, maar leuk van begin tot eind. Samen plezier maken is belangrijk Elk jaar een paar dagen weg met de hele club. Uitjes, sportevents, de welbekende vrijmibo en de jaarlijkse barbecue. Een hechte club collega’s waar sfeer minstens net zo belangrijk is als resultaat Werken op een plek waar het teamgevoel centraal staat. De aandacht die je verdient Vertrouwen en vrijheid om je kennis en kunde op jouw manier toe te passen Collega’s die écht naar elkaar omkijken …

En wil je die ideeën niet alleen bespreken, maar ook echt uitproberen? Dan zoeken we jou. Zo kan jouw werk eruitzien Je laat AI honderden supportvragen en gebruikersfeedback van gemeenten doornemen. Binnen een paar uur heb je in kaart waar onze klanten op vastlopen. ’s Ochtends voer je een gesprek met gebruikers. Tegelijkertijd bouw je met AI een werkend prototype, dat je diezelfde dag nog laat testen. Je werkt aan software die zelf meedenkt in het traject met de inwoner. Bijvoorbeeld een schuldenoverzicht dat zich vanzelf vult op basis van een slimme analyse van bankafschriften. Of je zorgt dat een inwoner die nog moeite heeft met Nederlands, het verhaal in de eigen taal kan delen, zonder dat de hulpverlener die taal spreekt. Waarom dit werk ertoe doet Bij Kred’it geloven we dat iedere inwoner recht heeft op financiële rust, en op ondersteuning die bij hen past om daar te komen én te blijven. Onze software helpt professionals in de schuldhulpverlening daar elke dag bij. Als Product Owner zorg jij dat AI daaraan bijdraagt: in je eigen werkproces én in je productdomein. Een baan waarin je echt impact hebt op de omzet en de klantervaring van onze webshops Ruimte om te experimenteren met nieuwe tools en AI-toepassingen Een goed inwerkprogramma zodat je snel zelfstandig aan de slag kunt Een fijne werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam 20% personeelskorting, op de Omoda- en Assemcollectie Een gezellig team, waar hard werken en gezelligheid hand in hand gaan Dit ben jij Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau Je hebt 2-3 jaar ervaring met het zelfstandig opzetten, uitvoeren en analyseren van A/B-testen Je werkt makkelijk met een A/B-testtool zoals VWO Je hebt ervaring met AI-toepassingen en wilt ze gebruiken om het testprogramma naar een hoger niveau te tillen Je blinkt uit in proactiviteit, je ziet iets wat beter kan en zet het proactief op de agenda, nog voordat iemand erom vraagt Je neemt eigenaarschap over je project, van eerste idee tot livegang, en behoudt het overzicht Je hebt ervaring met gebruikerstesten en haalt daar goede testideeën uit Je bent analytisch sterk en trekt de juiste conclusies uit data, je kent je weg in tooling als GA4 en Mopinion Je hebt commercieel inzicht en kiest de tests die het meeste opleveren Je legt resultaten helder uit en krijgt collega's makkelijk mee Je volgt de ontwikkelingen in CRO, AI en e-commerce en vertaalt die naar nieuwe werkwijzen Join Team Digital Experience! Je komt terecht in een enthousiast team dat dagelijks werkt aan de beste online klantervaring, van UX en design tot webanalyse, online merchandising en development. Je valt onder onze CRO lead. We helpen elkaar, leren van elkaar en testen samen wat werkt. Klinkt dit als jouw ideale baan? dan snel! Wij zijn benieuwd naar jou en misschien tot gauw! Lianne Wensveen Lianne.wensveen@omoda.nl

items.desc: Location: Gdańsk Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: Nov 10, 2026 Job description Requisition ID: 1760132 Dział Audytu w EY Polska to miejsce, w którym poznasz praktyczną stronę biznesu, współpracując z klientami z różnorodnych branż, od produkcji, farmacji i infrastruktury po telekomunikację, media, bankowość i ubezpieczenia. Wspólnie analizujecie dane finansowe, przeszukujecie regulacje oraz wykorzystujecie różnorodne narzędzia, aby podnosić jakość, spójność i efektywność pracy audytowej. Job Description Drive the development of IT infrastructure by designing, implementing, and optimizing automation solutions for operating systems and hybrid cloud environments. This role is responsible for creating tools and automations that resolve root causes and enhance the daily work of the Systems Engineering team. The overall goal is to increase operational efficiency, enable focus on strategic projects, and introduce modern, self-service IT solutions across the organization. Responsibilities: Design, test, implement, and maintain advanced scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) and applications that automate administrative and operational tasks in the IT infrastructure. Analyze high-potential automation areas and lead projects that improves team's velocity, including optimization of existing tools. Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale using Terraform and Ansible, ensuring solutions are reusable, maintainable and reliable. Manage virtualization platforms and hypervisor infrastructure, ensuring performance, reliability and efficient resource utilization. Perform compute capacity planning, anticipating infrastructure needs and ensuring sufficient resources for current and future workloads. Develop, integrate, and manage tools for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), proactive monitoring, and support CI/CD practices across systems. Collaborate with the Core Infrastructure team and share knowledge on automation strategies and tools. Create and maintain technical documentation for implemented automation tools and processes. Work closely with the ITSECOPS department and other internal teams to gather requirements and successfully implement automation solutions. Continuously improve processes and tools by exploring new technologies and implementing innovative, industry best practices in IT automation. Qualifications At least 3 years of experience in IT process automation, programming, or advanced systems administration. Advanced knowledge of at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, PowerShell). Proven experience designing, building, and deploying automation tools in production environments. Proven hands-on experience with Terraform and Ansible, including designing reusable modules, roles, and managing Infrastructure as Code in production environments. Practical experience administering virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere), including resource management, performance optimization and capacity planning. Understanding of high availability, fault tolerance and infrastructure resilience principles. Good understanding of software engineering principles, version control systems (e.g., Git, Perforce), and practical experience with CI/CD tools and concepts. Experience in administering operating systems (Windows Server, Linux) and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP). Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Prometheus, and visualization platforms (Grafana). Highly developed analytical thinking and the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with an openness to diverse working styles and perspectives. Initiative, a proactive approach, results orientation, and high standards for work quality. Working proficiency in both Polish and English. Additional Information Working mode In-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland. Remote work from within Poland is possible for selected candidates. Relocation to Poland is required for those residing abroad. items.desc: ENERAL PURPOSE : To support Axalta Refinish Color Marketing with color support in multiple Refinish mixing machine qualities. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES: Functions of this position include but are not limited to: Adjusting the color position of a formula. This will be accomplished by using both spectrophotometer or visual shading skills. Knowledgeable on customer facing color retrieval systems to demonstrate best practices and to access and load new or existing formulas. Work with Isocyanate paint chemistry. Be capable of spraying panels following specific spray procedures using mainstream refinish paint shop spray equipment. Knowledgeable in the level of color accuracy that is accepted by our customers to verify Axalta variant color positions. Be knowledgeable and utilize relevant functions within the Mobius and Global Color Analytics database. Be able to work with and communicate with all levels of customers. Maintain high levels of safety awareness. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: Be able to determine if a color is in an acceptable tolerance for optimized and targeted colors. Must be able to demonstrate the proper usage of Axalta spectrophotometers and all their functional applications. Must become proficient in the color knowledge of Spies Hecker, Standox, and Cromax solvent and waterborne systems. A working knowledge of all Axalta Refinish color related products and systems is essential. Possess basic math skills to correctly balance a formula using tint tables. Be a team-oriented person with strong interpersonal skills. Be able to plan, schedule and prioritize work activities. Must be able to present data in written and computer-based presentation style and formats. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Successfully pass the Farnsworth/Munsell 100 Hue or comparable color vision test. Need to have a working knowledge of MS Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Must have a working knowledge of paint preparation and finished product acceptability characteristics as defined by our customers/industry (i.e. – appearance orange peel, spray ability, mottle, color match etc.) SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS : Must be able to work in certain physically challenging conditions. Working in a customer’s place of business can be a very challenging endeavor. The non-Axalta environment will keep the coordinator on his “safety toes” while obtaining and or supplying important color data. Workload might vary depending on current tasks. English fluency is required. The annual salary for this role will be 130,000-140,000 PLN (taken into consideration qualifications, skills and experience to position incumbent within that range) The incumbent will be eligible to participate in the Axalta bonus and benefits plan for Poland. Our Company: Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles. Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals. Axalta may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review. Recruitment Fraud Alert : We take candidate safety seriously. If you believe you’ve encountered a fraudulent job posting claiming to represent our company, please include a link or screenshot and report it to TA-Support-Center@axalta.com. This is an active opening for which we are recruiting to fill immediately.

items.desc: UNIQLO Management Candidate (UMC) Graduate Programme Lead the Future of Retail At UNIQLO, we believe clothing should be simple, high-quality, functional, and built to last, in order to make everyone’s life better. That's the heart of LifeWear. The UMC Graduate Programme is a 12-month accelerated leadership journey designed for ambitious graduates ready to shape the future of one of the world's most dynamic global retailers. Expect a fast pace, a steep learning curve, and the chance to make a real impact in a business landscape that is always evolving, and where your contributions and ideas truly matter. What You'll Gain Throughout the year, you'll be supported by team members, managers and senior leaders who’ve been where you are and are determined to fast-track your career. Mentoring and direct communications with your COO Training in store operations, finance, people management and more Participation to the UNIQLO Europe Leadership Convention in London A network of diverse and supportive colleagues united by a shared purpose Programme Structure Months 1–4 | Discover the Business & Master the Foundations You'll begin by immersing yourself in the engine of UNIQLO: our stores. Your learning will happen directly on the shop floor rather than in an office setting. This is where you'll build a deep understanding of our customers, our products, and what makes our operations world-class. You'll learn and master: Customer service Product deliveries & replenishment Omni-channel & checkout operations Onboarding and training new starters Product category management Months 5-6 | Step into Leadership As a supervisor, you'll begin leading teams on the shop floor, influencing performance, and owning your first commercial responsibilities. This stage develops your leadership stance, building trust, driving results, and bringing out the best in the people around you. You'll take on: Team coordination & daily planning Developing the performance of your colleagues Operational excellence and customer satisfaction Ownership of a key subdivision, ensuring day to day performance Months 7–12 | Drive the Business In your final rotation, on top of maintaining a strong presence on the shop floor as an assistant manager, you'll work alongside the Store Manager to influence commercial decisions and operational strategy. You'll be responsible for: Sales analytics & KPI performance Inventory & commercial planning Layout optimisation & store standards Workforce planning aligned with sales forecasts Team development & succession planning What We Offer: Competitive salary, guaranteed bonus & group profit sharing Full-time permanent contract 30% staff discount across all Fast-Retailing brands Two paid volunteer days per year Opportunities for fast career progression at the end of the programme (Eligibility for promotion every 6 months) Locations: Warsaw Minimum Requirements: Bachelor's or master's degree with permanent work authorisation in Poland (Student visa is not accepted) Ready to start full-time end of February or end of August 2027 Minimum B2 level in English and Polish Flexible to work varied shifts across five days per week, including weekends, opening, or closing shifts, and public holidays Selection Process: Step 1: Online Assessments Step 2: In Person Group Assessment Centre (If you apply to multiple markets, you will need to attend just one assessment centre) Step 3: Online Individual Interview Step 4: Final Interview If you want to find out more what our UMCs do on a daily basis, click on the link below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IOOMDphhzRg Commitment to Inclusion and Data Protection UNIQLO is an inclusive employer, and welcomes applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability or other characteristics. We are dedicated to safeguarding your privacy and personal information; please refer to our privacy policy for details on our recruitment process. Recruitment Security Notice All official UNIQLO job postings will redirect you to our official careers page on Workday for application submission. The only exception is for roles advertised in Germany via the HeyJobs platform. UNIQLO takes recruitment security seriously and is committed to protecting the process from misuse. Stay alert and apply only through verified sources. #LI-POST

items.desc: Who we are We strive to make cities the best ever places to live, by advancing an industry that moves over 1 billion people each day. We are transforming our business by driving the industry norm and challenging ourselves, fostering a culture of internal and external collaboration, and building on our unique engineering capabilities to optimize existing and create new products and solutions for our customers that cater to real mobility needs. TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility. We provide engineering that keeps the world moving, including design, installation, and maintenance of elevators, escalators, walkways, lifts, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators – including multi-brand modernization and service any place, any time. With TK Elevator’s AI and digital solutions there are no longer any limits to urban mobility. TK Elevator became independent following its separation from the thyssenkrupp group in 2020. The company achieved sales of €9.2 billion in fiscal year 2024/2025. With around 50,000 employees, 25,000 service technicians and over 1,000 support centers globally, we are moved by what moves people. TKE – Move Beyond. What we expect You translate elevator drive requirements into control architecture, algorithms, interfaces and acceptance criteria, considering motor–inverter dynamics. You design and tune current, torque and speed control for induction and permanent-magnet motors, including PWM, estimation and fault response. You model and simulate motors, inverters and control loops using MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS or equivalent, supporting MIL/SIL/HIL verification. You implement control firmware in embedded C/C++ or automatically generated code on real-time MCU/DSP platforms, ensuring deterministic execution. You integrate sensing, ADC/PWM synchronization, feedback, communications and protections, considering DC-link, regeneration, power-stage and thermal limits. You validate inverter–motor performance on test rigs and elevator prototypes, diagnose hardware/control issues and coordinate solutions with multidisciplinary teams. Who we are looking for Degree in Electrical, Industrial, Electronics, Automation or Control Engineering, or a comparable discipline. Strong foundations in control theory, signal processing, power electronics, electrical machines and motor-drive dynamics. Practical experience with motor-control algorithms (FOC, PWM, current/torque/speed regulation), modelling and real-time implementation. Knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink or PLECS, model-based development, automatic code generation and embedded C/C++. Experience with MCU/DSP platforms, ADC/PWM, interrupts, timing, numerical robustness and laboratory inverter–motor testing. Ability to work across hardware, controls and firmware teams and communicate in English; HIL, elevator drives, CAN or IEC 61800/EN 81 are valued. This position can be filled in Spain (Mostoles) or Germany (Esslingen). What we offer Health and Safety –Highest standards and a wide range of health promotion and healthcare activities Flexibility –We support, for example, through flexible yet regulated working hours and remote working options Collaboration & diversity –Collegiality is of huge importance – we treat everyone with respect and appreciation Development –Individual support to help you get started in your new job as well as training and education programs to help you develop professionally and personally Creative leeway –We offer an environment in which you can try out new solutions in a no-blame-culture Sustainability –We act with responsibility and environmental awareness Work environment –We have modern workplaces and IT equipment, subsidized lunchtime meals in the canteen, free parking and discounted public transport tickets Contact Please apply online in English, including your notice period and salary expectation . items.desc: At Axpo, Switzerland's largest producer of renewable energy and a pioneer in European energy markets, we're building the digital twin ecosystem for our substations and powerline networks — and we need someone exceptional to lead the charge. This isn’t a “make models and move on” role. You’ll be creating living digital replicas of critical energy infrastructure — enabling smarter decisions, predictive maintenance, and a future-ready grid. If you want your BIM expertise to have real-world impact at scale, this is it. Your Mission: Create high-fidelity Digital Twins and As-Is BIM models of substations and powerlines from point cloud survey data and asset documentation — meeting Axpo’s exacting standards. Integrate multi-source data (GIS, ERP, CAD) into unified BIM models that serve as a single source of truth for our energy assets. Architect and maintain a standardized BIM component library for substations and powerlines — setting benchmarks for digital representation. Deliver IFC exports with clean schemas and rigorous data structures that ensure smooth interoperability across platforms and stakeholders. Collaborate across disciplines with specialists in IFC, Revit, and beyond — ensuring model consistency, quality, and interoperability. Drive model-based quantity take-offs and cost calculations, turning geometry into actionable intelligence. Participate in internal hackathons to push for innovation in automation and process optimization of modeling practices. What Makes You the Right Fit: A background in BIM modelling in the engineering or infrastructure field. Revit proficiency backed by hands-on experience and a portfolio that proves it. At least 3 years of dedicated BIM modeling for infrastructure projects. Deep fluency in OPEN BIM, IFC schema, and the full BIM process landscape: Use Cases, Quality Control, CDE, EIR, BEP — you don’t just know the acronyms, you live them. Good English communication skills — written and spoken. You’re self-driven, collaborative, and thrive in cross-functional teams. What Sets You Apart: Autodesk Certified Professional or equivalent BIM/Revit certifications. Support the SISO in establishing and implementing an effective information security management system and program. 9. Oversee vendor, contract, and change management activities related to cybersecurity, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and compliance standards. 10. Design and implement targeted phishing campaigns and user awareness programs in collaboration with business functions, fostering a culture of cybersecurity and risk consciousness. 11. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate cybersecurity into business processes and initiatives across all projects and programs. 12. Continuously assess and enhance IOM’s global security posture, including the evaluation of cybersecurity maturity across systems and processes. 13. items.desc: Group presentation We strive to make cities the best ever places to live, by advancing an industry that moves over 1 billion people each day. We are transforming our business by driving the industry norm and challenging ourselves, fostering a culture of internal and external collaboration, and building on our unique engineering capabilities to optimize existing and create new products and solutions for our customers that cater to real mobility needs. Who we are TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility. We provide engineering that keeps the world moving, including design, installation, and maintenance of elevators, escalators, walkways, lifts, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators – including multi-brand modernization and service any place, any time. With TK Elevator’s AI and digital solutions there are no longer any limits to urban mobility. TK Elevator became independent following its separation from the thyssenkrupp group in 2020. The company achieved sales of €9.2 billion in fiscal year 2024/2025. With around 50,000 employees, 25,000 service technicians and over 1,000 support centers globally, we are moved by what moves people. TKE – Move Beyond. What we expect You translate elevator drive requirements into control architecture, algorithms, interfaces and acceptance criteria, considering motor–inverter dynamics. You design and tune current, torque and speed control for induction and permanent-magnet motors, including PWM, estimation and fault response. You model and simulate motors, inverters and control loops using MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS or equivalent, supporting MIL/SIL/HIL verification. You implement control firmware in embedded C/C++ or automatically generated code on real-time MCU/DSP platforms, ensuring deterministic execution. You integrate sensing, ADC/PWM synchronization, feedback, communications and protections, considering DC-link, regeneration, power-stage and thermal limits. You validate inverter–motor performance on test rigs and elevator prototypes, diagnose hardware/control issues and coordinate solutions with multidisciplinary teams. Who we are looking for Degree in Electrical, Industrial, Electronics, Automation or Control Engineering, or a comparable discipline. Strong foundations in control theory, signal processing, power electronics, electrical machines and motor-drive dynamics. Practical experience with motor-control algorithms (FOC, PWM, current/torque/speed regulation), modelling and real-time implementation. Knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink or PLECS, model-based development, automatic code generation and embedded C/C++. Experience with MCU/DSP platforms, ADC/PWM, interrupts, timing, numerical robustness and laboratory inverter–motor testing. Ability to work across hardware, controls and firmware teams and communicate in English; HIL, elevator drives, CAN or IEC 61800/EN 81 are valued. This position can be filled in Spain (Mostoles) or Germany (Esslingen). Contact Please apply online in English, including your notice period and salary expectation . Do you have a disability and would like to work with us? Then we look forward to your application! As a signatory of the Charter of Diversity, TK Elevator is committed to a prejudice-free and diverse working environment with equal opportunities. Although we are not completely barrier-free yet, we are working every day to improve ourselves. Let’s overcome barriers together and work on individual solutions that work for you. items.desc: Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research? The Institute of Environmental Medicine (IMM) is a department at Karolinska Institutet and an interdisciplinary research institution within the broad field of environmental medicine. IMM conducts cutting edge research within the areas of environmental and occupational medicine, toxicology, physiology, epidemiology, and biostatistics with the aim to clarify how environmental and lifestyle factors affect our health and which role genes have. IMM also serves as a scientific advisor to public authorities within the area of environmental medicine and IMM scientists participate in national and international expert groups. A position as Laboratory Engineer is now available in the Small Molecule Mass Spectrometry Core Facility, Unit of Integrative Metabolomics. Your mission As part of the expansion of our analytical core facility, we are seeking a Laboratory Engineer to work in the Small Molecule Mass Spectrometry Core Facility (KI-SMMS) at the Institute of Environmental Medicine (IMM) at Karolinska Institutet. In this role, you will perform your work with a high degree of independence, executing tasks based on applied guidelines and established practice within our facility. Your duties will encompass the entire analytical pipeline — including sample and instrument preparation, data processing, and reporting following the established protocols. You will also participate in the establishment of the new targeted spatial metabolomics service from the core facility. While you will work within existing routines and frameworks, the tasks are often analytical and evaluative in nature. For more complex cases or novel challenges, you will collaborate with and anchor your decisions with a superior. You will have the opportunity to work in a modern custom-built analytical facility with multiple mass spectrometers and associated equipment. This is a unique opportunity for an enthusiastic self-starter to play a critical role in executing and improving technical protocols for small molecule mass spectrometry, as well as contributing to the development of new analytical workflows. As part of our research group, you will see your work translated into high-profile scientific discoveries across Karolinska Institutet, Karolinska University Hospital, and the broader scientific community. Your profile The successful applicant is a highly motivated individual who possesses the theoretical and practical knowledge required to manage diverse analytical and organizational tasks, with a special focus on LC-MS/MS analyses. We are looking for the following skills: Education: Minimum of MSc training in analytical chemistry, biomedical analyses, biotechnology or equivalent extensive experience within the field. Technical Autonomy: Working knowledge of analytical laboratory instrumentation and equipment as well as general data handling, with the ability to perform tasks independently according to set routines. Specific experience in LC-MS/MS for small molecule analysis is a must. Communication: Proficiency in written and spoken English, with the social skills required to work both as a self-sufficient "case officer" of your projects and as a collaborative team member. Organization: Proven organizational skills, as well as ability to establish priorities and meet deadlines. Characteristics regarded as an advantage: Quality & Documentation: Proven experience drafting SOPs and technical laboratory protocols, as well as working within regulated environments. Tissue Preparation & Digital Imaging: Documented training and hands-on experience in tissue cryosectioning for spatial omics or mass spectrometry imaging (MSI), combined with practical knowledge of automated slide scanners and digital image processing software. Software: Working knowledge of data processing workflows and statistical tools (e.g., R/RStudio), alongside practical experience with Waters instrument software (e.g., MassLynx and TargetLynx). We are looking for someone who is thorough, responsible and works well with others. We place great emphasis on personal qualities. What do we offer? A creative and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. Karolinska Institutet is also a state university, which entitles you to several good benefits through our collective agreement. And you get to practice freely in our modern wellness facilities, where trained staff are on site. items.desc: Vill du arbeta med preklinisk forskning, med stöd av kompetenta och trevliga kollegor i en internationell miljö? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor? Välkommen att söka anställning som forskningsassistent på Uppsala universitet. Institutionen för medicinska vetenskaper är en stor klinisk institution med ca 250 anställda och över 900 personer som är anknutna via Akademiska Sjukhuset. Institutionen har en bred forskningsprofil med starka forskargrupper inom en rad områden. Forskningen äger rum i nära anslutning till den kliniska verksamheten vid Akademiska sjukhuset och omfattar såväl grundläggande studier kring sjukdomsorsaker som utveckling och utvärdering av förbättrad diagnostik och nya behandlingsmetoder. Mer om institutionens verksamhet finns på https://www.uu.se/institution/medicinska-vetenskaper/. Arbetsuppgifter Arbetet omfattar bioinformatik och maskininlärning med fokus på leukemi och precisionsmedicin. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att planera, utveckla, implementera och utvärdera maskininlärningsmodeller för klassificering av leukemisubtyper utifrån molekylära data. Arbetet innefattar även utveckling och tillämpning av bioinformatiska analysmetoder och arbetsflöden för analys av storskaliga molekylära data, med målet att förbättra diagnostik och subtypsklassificering av leukemi. Kvalifikationskrav Doktorsexamen inom molekylär medicin, bioinformatik eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant för tjänsten. Doktorsexamen ska vara avlagd senast vid tillträdet. Dokumenterad vetenskaplig produktivitet i form av publikationer i internationella, sakkunniggranskade vetenskapliga tidskrifter. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att utveckla, anpassa och utvärdera maskininlärningsmetoder för klassificeringsproblem. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av conformal prediction för kvantifiering av osäkerhet i prediktionsmodeller. Erfarenhet av bioinformatiska analyser av RNA-sekvenseringsdata (RNA-seq), inklusive encells-RNA-sekvensering (single-cell RNA-seq). Erfarenhet av bioinformatiska analyser av DNA-metyleringsdata. Erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera bioinformatiska analysflöden enligt nf-core-standarder. Mycket god förmåga att självständigt planera, organisera, genomföra och dokumentera bioinformatiskt och vetenskapligt arbete. Mycket god förmåga att analysera, tolka och kommunicera vetenskapliga resultat i tal och skrift. Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt. items.desc: Vill du arbeta i gränslandet mellan moln, utveckling och cybersäkerhet? Vi söker en erfaren DevSecOps Engineer som vill vara med och bygga moderna, automatiserade och säkra tekniska miljöer i komplexa utvecklingsprojekt. Här får du en bred teknisk roll där du arbetar både hands-on och långsiktigt med plattformar, automation och säkerhet tillsammans med erfarna utvecklare och ingenjörer. Om rollen Som DevSecOps Engineer arbetar du som konsult i tekniskt avancerade utvecklingsprojekt. Du kommer in i miljöer där stabila utvecklingsflöden, hög grad av automation och säker infrastruktur är avgörande för att teamen ska kunna utveckla och leverera effektivt. En central del av rollen är att skapa och vidareutveckla den tekniska plattform som utvecklingsteamen arbetar mot. Det kan innebära allt från att automatisera infrastruktur och bygga pipelines till att utveckla containerplattformar och säkerställa att rätt säkerhetsmekanismer finns på plats. Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med: Utveckling och förbättring av CI/CD-flöden Cloudmiljöer i Azure, AWS och/eller GCP Infrastructure as Code med exempelvis Terraform och Ansible Containerbaserade lösningar med Docker och Kubernetes Automation och scripting i Bash och Python Identitets- och behörighetshantering samt säkra hantering av credentials och secrets Monitorering, loggning och felsökning av komplexa miljöer Integrering av säkerhet och automatiserade kontroller i utvecklingsprocessen Rollen ger dig möjlighet att arbeta både operativt och strategiskt och att påverka hur miljöer, verktyg och arbetssätt utformas. Om dig Vi söker dig som har arbetat några år inom DevOps, Cloud eller DevSecOps och som vill fortsätta utvecklas inom säkerhet och automation. Vi ser gärna att du har: Minst tre års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet Erfarenhet av någon av de större molnplattformarna Azure, AWS eller GCP God förståelse för CI/CD och automatiserade utvecklingsflöden Erfarenhet av versionshantering och repository-/artifact management, gärna med Bitbucket och Artifactory Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform eller Ansible Erfarenhet av Docker och Kubernetes Kunskaper i Bash och/eller Python Förståelse för säkerhet i moderna cloud- och utvecklingsmiljöer Goda kunskaper i engelska och svenska Det är meriterande om du har arbetat mer fördjupat med exempelvis cloud security, IAM, secrets management, säkerhetsskanning eller Policy as Code. Kunskap inom ramverk och standarder som NIST, CIS Benchmarks eller ISO 27001 är också positivt, liksom erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling eller relevanta certifieringar inom cloud, Kubernetes eller cybersäkerhet. Som person är du tekniskt nyfiken och gillar att förstå hur olika delar av en miljö hänger ihop. items.desc: Vill du lära dig prata flytande AWS? (...och sedan kunna förklara det för någon som inte gör det?) Som junior utvecklare i början av din karriär letar du säkert efter en arbetsgivare där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas långsiktigt. Vi tänkte därför kort och gott berätta hur du kan utvecklas på Alto. Vi är ett mindre, oberoende AWS-bolag i Stockholm (Advanced Tier Partner) med kunduppdrag på allt från nystartade startups till etablerade tech-bolag. Vi designar och bygger säkra och skalbara system. Vi är förändringsbenägna, självständiga, nyfikna, vetgiriga och har roligt på vägen. Och vi gillar att fira framgångar! Vad du kommer att göra Hos oss får du chansen att växa in i din roll på riktigt. Som junior förväntas du inte att kunna allt. Du kommer att ha tillgång till en senior kollega - ett dedikerat bollplank, för att bygga vidare på din tekniska kompetens. Du är med och utvecklar projekt från start där du får praktisk erfarenhet samt stöd med att utveckla säkra och skalbara molnlösninar på AWS. Vem vi letar efter Du har en akademisk bakgrund och har jobbat 1-2 år i branschen, gärna som utvecklare, konsult eller i en liknande teknikroll. Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift. Då flera av våra kunduppdrag innefattar samhällskritiska system med säkerhetsklassning är även svenskt medborgarskap är ett formellt krav för rollen. Kanske saknar du formella certifieringar idag men det viktiga är att du vill bli AWS-certifierad. Att få dig dit är vårt löfte till dig. Vi erbjuder dig: Korta beslutsvägar. Möjlighet till delägarskap. Chansen att prägla Altos kultur och struktur i en fas där varje medarbetare gör verklig skillnad. Roliga uppdrag inom den senaste AI/Cloud tekniken. Livslångt lärande, enkelhet och omtanke På Alto delar vi kunskap. Vi hoppas att du vågar ställa frågor och delar med dig av dina egna insikter. I gengäld lovar vi en trygg miljö och kul miljö där vi sponsrar din egen fortsatta utbildning och självklart bekostar dina AWS-certifieringar. Vi firar stort som smått, analyserar problem utan prestige och bjuder varandra på tekniska djupdykningar. Vi erbjuder en stark företagskultur som bygger på omtanke, enkelhet och livslångt lärande, där alla blir sedda, hörda och accepterade som den man är. Vi har ett trevligt kontor på Slottsbacken där det bjuds på tekniksnack och onsdagsfrukost. Vi värdesätter flexibilitet och att du kan styra din egen tid men tror också på värdet att ses och samarbeta fysiskt under veckorna. Start: Februari 2027. Vår rekryteringsprocess är enkel. Du ansöker genom att svara på några frågor och varken CV eller personligt brev behövs. Vill du presentera dig i videoformat, kul! Men inte heller det är något krav. Kontakta rekryteringsansvarig vid frågor: linda.stuve@alto.se (Erbjudanden från rekryteringsföretag är ej intressant)

items.desc: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: R&D Unit Lead __ Your Role and Responsibilities At ABB, we are dedicated to enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future through innovative electrification solutions. We are now looking for a Product Certification Specialist to join our team. Whether you already have experience within product certification or want to develop your expertise in this area, this role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with product development, standards, and compliance in a global environment. In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring that our products meet relevant national and international standards and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with colleagues across R&D, Product Management, Quality, and other functions to support successful product launches and maintain compliance throughout the product lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include: Leading and coordinating certification activities for new low voltage products, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and regulations. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to collect, review, and maintain the technical documentation required for certification submissions. Working closely with certification bodies, testing laboratories, and regulatory authorities to obtain approvals and support market access. Monitoring certification requirements and regulatory developments in target markets and assessing their impact on new and existing products. Managing renewals and updates of existing certifications, ensuring continued compliance throughout the product lifecycle. Supporting internal stakeholders with certification-related expertise and contributing to continuous improvements of certification processes and ways of working. Living ABB's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Qualifications for the Role We believe you are an organized and proactive team player who enjoys collaborating with different stakeholders and driving tasks forward. You have a strong interest in technical compliance, standards, and product development. To be successful in this role, you likely have: A degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field. Experience working in an R&D, product development, testing, quality, or similar technical environment. An interest in or experience of product certification, standards, compliance, or regulatory requirements. The ability to structure and manage multiple activities while meeting deadlines. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders in an international environment. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is considered an advantage. Willingness to travel occasionally when required. A strong awareness of Health, Safety and Environment (HSE), with a commitment to creating a safe workplace. It is considered a merit if you have: Previous experience with product certification. Knowledge of international standards and certification processes related to low voltage products or electrical equipment. Experience working with certification bodies, testing laboratories, or regulatory authorities. What’s in it for you? We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. More about us ABB Electrification is a global leader in electrification solutions, enabling safe, smart and sustainable power distribution from source to socket. With a strong focus on innovation and quality, we support customers across industries in improving energy efficiency, reliability and safety while contributing to a more sustainable future. Our Electrification business combines deep technical expertise with a global footprint, offering products, systems and digital solutions that meet the highest standards of performance and compliance. By joining ABB Electrification, you will be part of a collaborative and international environment where engineering excellence, responsibility and long‑term value creation are at the core of everything we do. items.desc: ️ What We Do Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing. Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow. Who We Are Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world. At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish. To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for an experienced Structured Originator to join us. ‍ About The Role As Structured Originator, you’ll turn complex energy opportunities into carefully structured, executable transactions. You’ll understand how the words in a contract translate into value—and know how to negotiate an agreement that balances commercial opportunity with risk. You’ll lead the structuring and valuation of bespoke, long-term deals, including flexibility purchase agreements (FPAs) for Flower-developed battery energy storage projects, buy- and sell-side power purchase agreements (PPAs), hedging contracts and non-standard optimization agreements. Working closely with our origination team, you’ll help shape opportunities and take a leading role in negotiations. The lines aren’t rigid, though: you’ll also bring your own relationships and market insight, keep a finger on the pulse of the industry and help identify larger deals. You’ll be comfortable leading substantial contract negotiations independently, while bringing colleagues together to get the best outcome. Your counterparties will include utilities, trading houses, independent power producers and infrastructure investors. Your work will help Flower secure contracted revenues and create long-term, risk-adjusted value across our portfolio. What You’ll Do Structure, value and execute complex energy transactions, partnering with origination and other teams from initial opportunity through to signing Build and maintain relationships with sophisticated counterparties, using your network and market insight to help identify larger opportunities Lead or co-lead negotiations, draft term sheets and work cross-functionally on long-form agreements that support project financing requirements Develop pricing and valuation models, assess embedded optionality and transaction risks, and shape appropriate risk allocation, hedging and credit mitigation Prepare transaction papers for investment and risk committees, and contribute to Flower’s valuation standards, contract frameworks and commercial strategy Who You Are You’re a strong negotiator who can see both the detail in a contract and the commercial opportunity behind it. You’re comfortable owning complex discussions with senior counterparties, but you know that the best deals also depend on close collaboration internally. We believe you have: Several years of experience in structuring, origination, trading or valuation, with a proven track record of executing complex energy transactions Deep experience negotiating sophisticated contracts such as tolling agreements, buy- and sell-side PPAs, optimization agreements and hedging contracts An established network in the energy industry and a good understanding of where larger opportunities may emerge Advanced financial modelling and valuation skills, including long-dated and option-based structures, as well as a strong understanding of market, volume, credit and operational risk Solid knowledge of Nordic and wider European power and flexibility markets, and experience with project-financed transactions A degree in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics or another relevant quantitative field, and fluency in English You may have gained your experience at a utility, IPP, trading house, investor or advisory firm, or in investment banking. Swedish language skills and a CFA, FRM or equivalent qualification are a plus.

För kunds räkning söker vi en systemutvecklare med erfarenhet av CAD/PLM-miljöer och ett stort intresse för programmering, integrationer och teknisk problemlösning. Om uppdraget Du blir en del av kundens CAD-förvaltning och arbetar i ett tvärfunktionellt team tillsammans med systemutvecklare, metodutvecklare, applikationsspecialister och lösningsarkitekter. Teamet ansvarar för utveckling, integration och förvaltning av affärskritiska CAD- och PLM-lösningar, med fokus på moderna arbetssätt och Model Based Definition (MBD). I rollen arbetar du med att utveckla och vidareutveckla funktionalitet i CAD-applikationer, servermiljöer och systemintegrationer. Du får stöd av erfarna specialister inom systemutveckling och arkitektur och har möjlighet att bidra till långsiktiga tekniska förbättringar. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Utveckla och anpassa funktionalitet i CAD- och PLM-applikationer. Utveckla skript och program för automatisering och effektivisering. Arbeta med systemintegrationer och API, exempelvis REST och SOAP. Bidra till utveckling och förvaltning av server- och databasmiljöer. Delta i teknisk problemlösning, felsökning och förbättringsarbete. Omsätta verksamhetskrav till tekniska lösningar i nära samarbete med kravställare, metodutvecklare och arkitekter. Bidra till stabila, säkra och effektiva CAD/PLM-lösningar. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av några av följande områden CAD/PLM-plattformar: CATIA V5, ENOVIA eller VPM. 3DEXPERIENCE. Siemens NX eller Teamcenter UA. Systemutveckling och tekniska miljöer: Programmering och automatisering med exempelvis VBScript, VB.NET, JavaScript, Java, Shell/KornShell, CAA, C++ eller C#. Windows, UNIX/Linux eller AIX. Server- och databasmiljöer, exempelvis Oracle och SQL. Systemintegrationer och API-utveckling. Grundläggande nätverksförståelse, autentisering (LDAP/AD), certifikat och IT-säkerhet. CI/CD, automatiserad testning och versionshantering. PLM-processer och produktdata: Produktstrukturer (BOM). Konfigurationsstyrning och ändringshantering. Produktlivscykelprocesser inom PLM/PDM. Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av molnlösningar och molnbaserade plattformar. Du behöver inte behärska samtliga tekniker ovan. Vi värdesätter relevant erfarenhet, teknisk förståelse och viljan att utvecklas inom området. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med tekniska utmaningar och har förmågan att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till hållbara tekniska lösningar. Du arbetar självständigt när det behövs, men uppskattar också nära samarbete med kollegor från olika kompetensområden. Vi lägger stor vikt vid din problemlösningsförmåga, ditt engagemang och din vilja att bidra till teamets gemensamma resultat. Låter detta som ett intressant uppdrag? Sök redan i dag eller kontakta oss så berättar vi gärna mer. Vi behöver en ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev på svenska som matchar vår kunds krav. Kunden kan fatta beslut tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag som är verksamma inom konsult och rekryteringsbranschen. Vi är verksamma inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter bl.a sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller deras vardag. Vid anställning tillämpar vi kollektivavtal.

items.desc: Kravanalytiker inom energi och samhällskritisk ITOm uppdraget Vi söker en kravanalytiker till en aktör inom energisektorn för ett långsiktigt uppdrag inom samhällskritisk IT och utvecklingen av det svenska elnätet. Du fungerar som en viktig länk mellan verksamhet, projektorganisation, utvecklingsteam och leverantörer och säkerställer att tekniska lösningar möter verksamhetens behov och krav på kvalitet och säkerhet. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Leda och genomföra kravinsamling, behovsanalys och kravdokumentation. Ta fram funktionella och icke-funktionella krav för komplexa IT-system. Arbeta agilt med user stories, acceptanskriterier, MVP och backloghantering. Säkerställa kravspårbarhet från verksamhetsbehov till utveckling, test, verifiering och leverans. Samverka med verksamhetsexperter, utvecklare, arkitekter och leverantörer. Bidra till utveckling av datadrivna och beräkningsintensiva applikationer i säkerhetskänsliga miljöer. Vi söker dig som uppfyller följande skallkrav Har högskole- eller universitetsutbildning om minst 180 hp inom IT, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller elektroteknik, alternativt minst 10 års arbetslivserfarenhet av kravanalys och kravhantering för IT-system. items.desc: Konsert Strategy & IP is a leading consultancy at the intersection of business strategy, technology and intellectual property. Founded in Gothenburg in 2006, we work with some of the world's largest technology-intensive companies, close to the leaders who decide where to compete and how to win through technology and IP. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group. Like every consultancy, we are adapting to an environment that AI is reshaping. Much of the research, analysis and preparation that used to fill a project team's weeks can now be done by machines. Our clients face the same shift from the other side. Their strategy, technology and IP functions are under a clear mandate to work faster and leaner with AI. But today's landscape of point tools depends on the user to supply the context, and without it the tools speed up the doing without improving the thinking. What clients still need is sound judgment, grounded in the right context. That is where the real value of AI lies: not in faster work, but in better, more reliable and more impactful decisions. So rather than defend the old consultancy model, we are rebuilding ours around that: consultants who work inside our clients' organizations, supported by an AI platform that holds the client's context. That platform is Sapivia. We are now growing our in-house tech team, to make sure we have the capabilities under our own roof to take Sapivia to the next level. What we are building: Sapivia Sapivia is Konsert's AI platform. At its core is the context layer: a client-specific knowledge graph that holds the context every decision depends on. How the business, its technology and its intellectual property connect, what depends on what, and the reasoning behind the decisions already made. We have built that picture for clients by hand for twenty years; Sapivia captures it, keeps it alive and makes it available to people and AI alike. Our consultants build the context layer together with the client. The client's own people, Konsert's forward-deployed strategists and the AI tools the client already uses can then reason and act on the same picture, one that grows richer over time. Sapivia is already in use with clients, starting in IP, where the need is sharpest. But the same picture answers the questions every technology company has to ask: which technologies matter, where to compete and how to turn knowledge into advantage. That is where we are taking it next. The Konsert tech core team We are building a small tech core team: a handful of engineers with complementary skills. The team is led by a Tech Lead and sits in Gothenburg, next to the consultants who deploy Sapivia with clients. Build work happens in close collaboration with those consultants, several of whom spend part of their time in the team, so the domain expertise and the client's reality are in the room when we build. We work in an agile way with shared ownership: everyone is close to the users, effort goes where it is needed, and the team ships several times a week and owns the result together. Development runs in close alignment with Konsert's leadership team, with short paths to user input and quick decisions. The tech core team has a central voice in how Sapivia is shaped. Around this core, we scale with external developers and the Rouse Group's technology organization. Questions we are working on right now Giving AI the right context is only the start. Turning that context into decisions that large companies can rely on raises questions that few teams have answered yet. These are some of the ones we are working on now. They are open questions, not tickets, and you will help answer them. How do we assure the quality of AI responses at scale, when the right answer is often a matter of judgment? How do we best combine deep domain knowledge with what the models already know? How do we make a rich, connected body of knowledge feel simple and intuitive to work with? How do we give large organizations precise control over who sees what, across regions, teams and many users? How do we shorten the path from prototype to production code, while keeping the freedom to experiment? The role: Backend Developer You bring the backend and platform foundations to the core team: APIs, data models and services that can grow, built in Azure with CI/CD. Our clients are large corporations and their security requirements are part of what it takes to sell the product, so secure by default is a way of working, not a phase. You work on the data layer, including the context graph the applications run on, on tenant isolation and access control, and on how AI features are served and scaled. What you bring Several years (likely 5+) of professional experience as a software engineer Strong backend development in .NET and C# and in TypeScript and Node Experience designing and running multi-tenant systems, with data isolation, role-based access control and audit logging treated as first-class concerns Experience …

items.card: About the Role X Shore’s existing CAD models and assemblies don’t fully reflect what’s actually being built on the factory floor — data has drifted from production reality, making it hard to trust drawings, plan rework, or hand off clean information to manufacturing. We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to audit and rebuild that CAD data, get it aligned with how boats are actually produced, and then move on to
items.desc: Mechanical Engineer “Make X Shore’s CAD data something production can build from without guessing. Audit and rebuild assemblies, align them with the factory floor, and then help design the next-generation boat.” About the Role X Shore’s existing CAD models and assemblies don’t fully reflect what’s actually being built on the factory floor — data has drifted from production reality, making it hard to trust drawings, plan rework, or hand off clean information to manufacturing. We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to audit and rebuild that CAD data, get it aligned with how boats are actually produced, and then move on to design work on X Shore’s next-generation boat platform. This is a hands-on role in two phases. First, you’ll dig into existing CAD, correct what’s out of sync with production, and work closely with the shop floor to close the gap between design intent and built reality. Once that foundation is solid, you’ll shift into forward-looking platform design for future boats. You’ll report to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager and be based on-site in Nyköping. Key Responsibilities Audit existing CAD models and assemblies for accuracy, completeness, and structure Rebuild or correct CAD data that no longer reflects what’s actually being built in production Align CAD assemblies and drawings with current production reality, working directly with the shop floor Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and manufactured parts Maintain clean, well-structured CAD/PDM practices going forward Support production with drawings, tolerances, and design clarifications during rework and manufacturing Once alignment work is complete, contribute to the design and detailing of X Shore’s next-generation boat platform Collaborate with electrical, production, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure designs are manufacturable Required Qualifications Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience 3-5+ years of experience in mechanical design, ideally in a manufacturing environment Expert-level SOLIDWORKS proficiency — this is a must-have, including assemblies, drawings, and PDM Demonstrated experience auditing, cleaning up, or rebuilding CAD data and assemblies Comfortable working directly with production to resolve build discrepancies Fluent in English; Swedish is a plus Ability to work on-site in Nyköping Desirable Qualifications Experience with composites and/or metals typical of marine or automotive manufacturing Background in boat building, automotive, or another complex hardware environment Familiarity with GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis Experience contributing to a new product platform from early concept through release Personal Qualities Detail-oriented and methodical, comfortable untangling messy legacy data without losing momentum. Equally at home on the shop floor verifying fit as at a CAD workstation. Takes ownership, follows through, and communicates clearly across engineering and production. Success Metrics (First 12 Months) CAD data and assemblies for existing boats are audited, corrected, and aligned with what’s built in production Production has accurate, trustworthy drawings and models to work from Discrepancies between design and manufactured parts are identified and resolved Meaningful contribution made to next-generation boat platform design Location & Structure On-site at X Shore Factory & HQ, Nyköping. Reports to the Mechanical Engineering & Analysis Manager.
