Engineering
 Hub Manager for the Swiss European Digital Innovation Hub (F/M/D) 80%-100%
 80-100% 
 Permanent 
 Schwyz 
 Apply for this job 
 Facing the challenges of our time 
 Help us grow and be more impactful! 
 Your mission
 With the support of the steering committee, you will manage Raisehub.swiss, the Swiss European Digital Innovation Hub dedicated to accelerating the adoption of artificial intelligence, robotics and advanced digital technologies by SMEs, start-ups and public sector organisations in Central Switzerland, Ticino and Bern.
 As hub manager, you will support the coordination, implementation and further development of the hub activities and you will drive its mission. You will contribute to the successful operation of the one-stop-shop model structured around the four EDIH pillars: innovation ecosystem and networking, training and skills development, test-before-invest, and access to finance. The position contributes to strengthening the digital maturity, competitiveness, AI readiness and trustworthy technology adoption capacity of organisations across the Raisehub.swiss region.
 You will work at the interface between CSEM, the Raisehub.swiss consortium partners, end-users, regional economic development actors, public organisations and the other Swiss and European EDIH network stakeholders.
 As an AI-focused hub, Raisehub.swiss aims to become a living example of how AI tools can transform daily operations. As Hub Manager, you will have the mission to shape this transformation hands-on exploring, testing and implementing AI-enabled ways of working that make the hub smarter, faster and more efficient.
 Your responsibilities 
 Manage and support the implementation of Raisehub.swiss activities, work packages, milestones, deliverables.
 Manage the collaboration among the consortium partners and facilitate the interaction between the hub’s consortium and companies, public organizations, and other stakeholders. Act as interface between the hub and the regional industry and public organizations and promote the hub activities and services among them, with particular focus on Central Switzerland.
 Drive the adoption and use of AI tools in the hub operations (website, CRM, administration)
 Support the organization of workshops, training activities, innovation events, networking activities and provide AI and digital coaching to the regional industry.
 Coordinate and execute project planning, monitoring, reporting, financial and administrative follow-up, quality assurance, risk management and compliance with the Swiss and European funding requirements, project documentation.
 Contribute to the continuous strategic development of the EDIH ecosystem – at national and international level
 Contribute to project communication, branding, and marketing activities.
 Your profile 
 Academic background in business, engineering, computer science, digital technologies, innovation management, project management, or a related field.
 Know-how 
 Experience in stakeholder- and customer-facing activities, networking, outreach, acquisition and onboarding of end-users and customers, with the ability to connect hub services to concrete user needs.
 Experience in professional project management, involving 10+ consortium partners, preferably in publicly funded research and innovation contexts; experience with European projects is an advantage.
 Experience in defining and implementing digital and AI strategies. Prior experience in consulting or engineering services is an advantage.
 Hands-on experience with AI-supported project management and administration tools, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams meeting intelligence, Planner/Project, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, or comparable platforms.
 Experience with data-driven project monitoring: dashboards, KPI tracking, milestone monitoring, risk detection, budget follow-up and decision-support reporting using tools such as Power BI or comparable solutions.
 Interpersonal skills 
 Excellent communication skills in Swiss German and English, with Italian as an advantage.
 Proactive, reliable and structured working style.
 Strong organisational awareness and skills.
 Ability to keep an overview in complex multi-partner, multidisciplinary environments.
 Strong collaborative mindset.
 Ability to work independently.
 Take initiative and communicate effectively across disciplines, regions and stakeholder groups.
 CSEM mission and values 
 We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
 At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
 Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 850 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 550 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 300 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1000 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Si ambiciózny/a? Máš v sebe ducha obchodníka? Rád/rada kominukuješ? Máš bankovú prax? Ak si odpovedal/a na všetky otázky áno, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku pre VÚB!
Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
Ako si šikovný/á, toľko si aj zarobíš.
A okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Na pozícii Osobný poradca/poradkyňa klienta bude Tvojou úlohou:
 starať sa o nadštandardných klientov,
 predávať všetky bankové produkty a služby z portfólia VÚB banky,
 aktívne (telefonicky i osobne) oslovovať súčasných a zároveň aj potenciálnych klientov banky zo segmentu nadštandardných klientov,
 vyhľadávať rôzne obchodné príležitosti.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás: 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti:
 minimálne 2 roky bankovej praxe
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš minimálne 2 roky bankovej praxe,
 máš ukončené minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,
 Ťa baví komunikovať,
 si priateľský/á a vieš pracovať individuálne aj v tíme,
 máš v sebe ducha obchodníka,
 chceš hľadať to najvhodnejšie riešenie pre klientov,
 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)

items.desc:
. 
 Overview 
 Entrerai in un team dedicato a progetti di Digital Asset e Tokenizzazione, occupandoti di soluzioni per emissione, custodia e regolamento di asset tokenizzati. Lavorerai su piattaforme DLT, custody, smart contract Ethereum e Polygon, contribuendo alla progettazione e all'evoluzione di soluzioni innovative. Avrai l'opportunità di approfondire temi regolatori come MiCAR, DORA e DLT Pilot Regime e collaborerai con Risk, Compliance e Architettura. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Progettare e implementare applicazioni software per piattaforme di Digital Asset (Java/Python), con componenti di interazione con reti DLT (nodi, smart contract, wallet) 
 Analizzare in autonomia i flussi di emissione, custodia e regolamento di asset tokenizzati, individuando criticità tecniche e di processo 
 Valutare la fattibilità tecnologica ed economica di soluzioni di custody e tokenizzazione (Omnibus Wallet, asset segregation, key management) 
 Progettare specifiche per applicativi a supporto di Travel Rule, KYC/AML e monitoraggio on-chain (es. Chainalysis, Notabene) 
 Formalizzare proposte di evoluzione dell'architettura delle piattaforme Digital Asset, in coerenza con MiCAR e DORA 
 Supportare code review, standard di sicurezza (audit smart contract) e pratiche di sviluppo del team 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software 
 Laurea ad indirizzo informatico-scientifico (Informatica, Matematica, Fisica, Ing. Informatica) 
 Ottima padronanza dell'inglese e degli strumenti Office 365 
 Conoscenza avanzata di Java (Spring) e/o Python, con esperienza di integrazione con reti blockchain 
 Conoscenza di tecnologie DLT/Blockchain (Ethereum, Polygon, reti permissioned) e relativi meccanismi (account abstraction, gas fee, custody) 
 Conoscenza di smart contract (Solidity o equivalenti) e best practice di audit e sicurezza 
 Familiarità con i principi normativi MiCAR, DLT Pilot Regime e DORA applicati ai sistemi IT 
 Conoscenza di Git, sistemi a gestione eventi (Kafka, Nifi, Flink), DB SQL/NoSQL e GCP 
 Esperienza con strumenti Agile (JIRA) e capacità di mentoring verso profili junior 
 Costituisce titolo preferenziale aver svolto percorsi di studio e/o lavoro in ambito internazionale. 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

 The Debt Capital Markets team, London branch, is responsible for origination and execution of public and private bond and Sukuk offerings for sovereign, corporate and FI borrowers with primary focus on the UK and Emerging Markets. 
 What you’ll be doing 
 Key responsabilities will be: 
 Help prepare market updates and proposals for clients 
 Analyse vast economic/financial data from various sources and produce brief reports 
 Support more senior staff in drawing up marketing presentations, evaluations and all other documents supporting the desk’s activities 
 Support more senior members of the team in all the quantitative analysis within the operational phases of DCM transactions 
 Support senior members of the team with origination activities in the UK and Emerging Markets by keeping track of political and economic developments in the relevant countries and updating more senior team members where appropriate 
 Provide operational and logistical support within the transactions / prospect transactions 
 Who we are looking for 
 If you wanto to turn your passion into a career and you possess the following qualities, apply and join our team: 
 1–3 years of exeperience in the role 
 Previous finance related experience / Internships in Debt Capital Markets, Debt Advisory, Corporate Finance or similar (sell side is preferred) 
 Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word, knowledge of Bloomberg is an advantage 
 Knowledge of fixed income products 
 Strong interest in global financial markets 
 Bachelor degree in Finance related field 
 Comprehensive knowledge of global financial markets

 English proficiency (minimum B1 level CEFR); knowledge of an additional Emerging Markets language is an advantage

Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2200 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 800 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1 800 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch je možnosť získať adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak pre Vás nie sú bankové a investičné produkty neznáme pojmy, máte v sebe ducha obchodníka, rád/rada komunikujete a dokážete klientom pomôcť nájsť to najideálnejšie riešenie, ste skvelý typ na osobného bankára/bankárku pre VÚB!
Čakajú Vás u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
Na pozícii Osobný bankár/bankárka bude Vašou úlohou:
 starať sa o Magnifica klientov,
 identifikovať potreby klientov, analyzovať ich požiadavky a hľadať pre nich tie najideálnejšie riešenia,
 poskytovať odborné poradenstvo v oblasti produktov a služieb existujúcim a potenciálnym klientom z portfólia afluentných klientov,
 budovať si s klientmi dôverný vzťah,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov!

 Minimálne dosiahnuté vzdelanie 
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti 
 banková prax
 Počet rokov praxe 
 2

 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máte minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov,
 viete aktívne využívať MS Office a nebojíte sa virtuálneho prostredia,
 Vás baví komunikovať a dokážete pomôcť klientom s nájdením optimálneho riešenia,
 Vám bankové a investičné produkty nie sú cudzie,
 máte argumentačné schopnosti a obchodného ducha,
 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 výhodou je anglický jazyk a vzdelanie ekonomického zamerania.

 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Búrame hranice tradičnej práce! Ponúkame Vám jedinečnú príležitosť pracovať z pohodlia Vášho domova, nech ste kdekoľvek!
 Čo to znamená? 
 U nás na Digitálnej pobočke sa stretávame s rôznymi situáciami, pri ktorých ukazujeme svoju superschopnosť nájsť správne riešenie pre našich klientov. Našou úlohou však nie je len kvalitne vybaviť ich požiadavku. Klienta chceme počúvať, porozumieť jeho potrebám a vedieť mu aktívne ponúknuť produkty a riešenia, ktoré mu dávajú zmysel. 
 Digitálny agent je preto nielen človek, ktorý klientovi pomôže, ale aj poradca, ktorý dokáže rozpoznať obchodnú príležitosť a premeniť ju na riešenie užitočné pre klienta.

Tieto osobné stretnutia nám dávajú možnosť lepšie sa spoznať, zdieľať si svoje nápady, užiť si tímového ducha a upevniť našu spoluprácu. My, vo VÚB, veríme, že takáto kombinácia ti prinesie to najlepšie z oboch svetov :-)

items.desc:
Bankunk az olasz Intesa Sanpaolo Csoport leányvállalata. Univerzális hitelintézetként a hazai pénzpiac egyik meghatározó szereplőjeként több mint 45 éves tapasztalattal rendelkezünk. Folyamatosan keressük az innovatív, ügyfeleinkre szabott megoldásokat, melynek kollégáink is aktív részesei. Ha fontos számodra a nemzetközi háttér, a barátságos és szerethető légkör, és egy olyan munkahelyet keresel, ahol a fejlődésed és jólléted tényleges figyelmet kap, ne várj tovább! 
 Feladatok, amikben szakértővé válsz: 
 Szakmai segítségnyújtásban a fiókba érkező lakossági ügyfelek számára. 
 Pénzügyi tanácsadásban számlák, megtakarítások és fedezetlen hitelek kapcsán. 
 Digitális banki csatornák (mobilalkalmazás és internetbank) ismertetésében és használatuk támogatásában. 
 Az ügyfelek igényeinek megismerésében és az azokhoz illeszkedő termékek ajánlásában . 
 Az értékesítési és az ügyfélkiszolgálási folyamatokhoz kapcsolódó adminisztratív feladatok ellátásában. 
 Szükség esetén a valuta- és forintpénztáros kolléga helyettesítésében . 
 Neked való mindez, ha: 
 Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel. 
 Az elmúlt 5 évben foglalkoztál ügyfélkezeléssel és értékesítéssel . 
 Kifejezetten a bankszektorban szeretnéd építeni a karriered. 
 Igényled a folyamatos tanulást és fejlődést . 
 Szívesen foglalkoznál korszerű pénzügyi termékekkel és digitális megoldásokkal . 
 Kiemelkedő kommunikációs készséggel rendelkezel és könnyedén teremtesz kapcsolatot különböző típusú ügyfelekkel. 
 Saját sikereiden túl, szem előtt tartod a csapatod céljait is. 
 Előnyök: 
 Banki termékek értékesítésében szerzett tapasztalat. 
 Valuta- és forintpénztárosi végzettség. 
 Pénzkezelési tapasztalat. 
 Értékeljük a tehetséged: 
 Éves bruttó 500 000 Ft-os cafeteria keretet biztosítunk, melyet gyakorlatilag minden jól ismert elemre felhasználhatsz. 
 Próbaidő után kamatmentes lakáscélú hitelfelvétel lehetősége is adott lesz. 
 Beilleszkedési bónusszal ismerjük el a kezdeti időszak kihívásaiban tanúsított kitartásodat: fél éves és egy éves munkaviszonyodat egyaránt bruttó 150 000 - 150 000 Ft-tal jutalmazzuk a szabályzatban megadott feltételek teljesítése esetén. 
 Teljesítményed alapján negyedévente bónusz kifizetésben részesülhetsz . 
 Támogatjuk testi és lelki jól-léted: 
 Egészségbiztosítási szolgáltatást nyújtunk. 
 Anyabankunknak köszönhetően, súlyos betegségek esetén térítésmentes második orvosi szakvélemény és kezelés nemzetközi orvos szakemberek által . 
 Pszichológiai tanácsadás a Szakértő Segítség Program keretén belül. 
 Nyári szünetekre táborok támogatása. 
 Banki, partneri kedvezmények vásárlásokra és egyéb szolgáltatásokra . 
 Csatlakozz hozzánk, mert: 
 Egy nemzetközi bankcsoport magyar leányánál biztos munkahelyed lesz . 
 A munkatársaiddal minden problémára megoldást találtok majd, hiszen a támogató közösség nálunk alap. 
 Számunkra fontos a szakmai fejlődésed, ezért széleskörű képzés palettát nyújtunk minden munkavállalónak. 
 Online és személyes programokkal színesítjük a hétköznapokat. 
 Fióki nyitvatartás: 
 Hétfő 10:00-18:00 
 Kedd 10:00-18:00 
 Szerda 10:00-18:00 
 Csütörtök 10:00-18:00 
 Péntek 10:00-18:00 
 Szeretnél többet megtudni arról, hogy milyen nálunk tanácsadóként dolgozni a mindennapokban? Látogass el a Karrier a fiókhálózatban oldalunkra is! 
 Légy te is CIB-es, hogy megtaláld a helyed!

items.desc:
Mi smo tim od gotovo 3000 koleginica i kolega širom Srbije. Slavimo jedinstvenost i negujemo kulturu otvorenog feedback-a, jer samo tako možemo rasti i razvijati se zajedno.Deo smo Intesa Sanpaolo, jedne od vodećih bankarskih grupa u Evropi, na tržištu Srbije smo 20 godina i poslujemo u više od 90 gradova naše zemlje. Verujemo da bez snažnih pojedinaca nema ni snažnih timova, ali i da samo jaki timovi mogu biti pravi oslonac i temelj za svaki individualni uspeh. Zajedno, svakodnevno brinemo o potrebama više od 1,3 miliona klijenata, gradeći čvrste odnose poverenja zasnovanih na ekspertizi i znanju. 
 TI SI ODLIČAN KANDIDAT ZA OVU POZICIJU AKO POSEDUJEŠ: 
 Najmanje IV stepen stručne spreme
 Izraženu analitičnost, sistematičnost i preciznost u radu
 Sposobnost obrade i interpretacije podataka i predstavljanja jasnih zaključaka
 Dobro poznavanje MS Office alata, posebno Excela i PowerPointa
 Razvijene organizacione i komunikacione veštine
 Proaktivnost, odgovornost i inicijativu u rešavanju problema
 Sposobnost saradnje sa različitim timovima i spremnost na timski rad
 Radoznalost, istraživački pristup i želju da razumeš šta stoji iza poslovnih rezultata
 Otvorenost za nove ideje, učenje i prilagođavanje promenama
 TVOJE PREDNOSTI BI MOGLE DA BUDU: 
 Iskustvo u bankarskom sektoru ili poslovima analize i podrške prodajnim aktivnostima
 Poznavanje bankarskih proizvoda i usluga, potreba klijenata i osnovnih principa poslovanja sa fizičkim licima
 Iskustvo u pripremi poslovnih analiza, izveštaja i prezentacija
 Poznavanje Power BI alata i rada sa većim bazama podataka
 Razumevanje prodajnih procesa i načina funkcionisanja poslovne mreže
 Znanje engleskog jezika
 Interesovanje za razvoj poslovnih modela i unapređenje procesa rada
 Afinitet ka analizi poslovnih rezultata i identifikovanju mogućnosti za unapređenje
 ŠTA OVA ULOGA PODRAZUMEVA:
 Analizu klijentske baze, prodajnih rezultata i ključnih pokazatelja poslovanja
 Pripremu analiza, izveštaja i prezentacija koje predstavljaju osnov za donošenje poslovnih odluka
 Učešće u praćenju i analizi rezultata prodajnih inicijativa i kampanja, uz identifikovanje odstupanja i mogućnosti za unapređenje
 Podršku u razvoju i implementaciji novih servisnih modela, poslovnih procesa i prodajnih pristupa
 Učešće u inicijativama usmerenim na unapređenje iskustva klijenata
 Učešće u analizama segmentacije klijenata, kontakt politike i upravljanja portfolijima savetnika
 Praćenje realizacije poslovnih inicijativa i pripremu predloga za unapređenje njihove efikasnosti
 Prikupljanje, obradu i sistematizaciju povratnih informacija iz poslovne mreže
 Operativnu i analitičku podršku u organizaciji i realizaciji aktivnosti usmerenih na unapređenje poslovnih performansi
 Saradnju sa različitim organizacionim delovima banke u sprovođenju projekata i poslovnih inicijativa
 Učešće u pripremi materijala, smernica i alata koji zaposlenima u poslovnoj mreži olakšavaju primenu novih modela rada
 Zašto baš Banca Intesa? 
 Svojim kolegama smo omogućili fleksibilno radno vreme i rad od kuće, kao i odlične prilike za razvoj kroz eksterne obuke, interne radionice i talent programe. Talentovanim kolegama pružamo priliku za internacionalnu karijeru. Brinemo o balansu, podstičemo zdrave životne navike i gradimo atmosferu dobre timske saradnje i podrške. Učestvujemo na brojnim sportskim aktivnostima i takmičenjima, kao i volonterskim aktivnostima u okviru programa „Intesa od srca“. Deci naših zaposlenih pružamo priliku da steknu dragocena međunarodna iskustva i razviju svoje veštine i talente, kroz učešće u sportskim takmičenjima i letnjim kampovima za decu.
 Ako ste spremni da napravite sledeći korak u svojoj karijeri i pridružite se timu u kojem se vaše ideje, stručnost i doprinos istinski cene, voleli bismo da vas upoznamo. Prijavite se danas i zajedno sa nama oblikujte budućnost.

At Nokia, the Sales Operations team supports business leaders with actionable insights, analytics, and reporting. items.desc: Nous connaître : Leader français de la protection incendie et expert en solutions sur mesure, Uxello propose des installations adaptées à chaque type de risque lié au feu dans des environnements spécifiques et de haute technologie. Uxello est né en 2013 de la volonté de VINCI Energies de fédérer les activités sécurité incendie du Groupe sous une bannière commerciale commune. Uxello, c’est avant tout de multiples entreprises à taille humaine partageant une démarche RSE ambitieuse et dynamique : écoresponsabilité, transparence, éthique, innovation sociale… autour de valeurs fortes qui se renforcent davantage chaque année telles que l’innovation, la sécurité et le bien vivre ensemble. Découvrir notre métiers Découvrir Uxello en vidéo Ton rôle : Au sein des équipes support et opérationnelles, tu contribueras à l'identification, la conception et au développement de solutions innovantes basées sur l’IA et l'automatisation. Tu travailleras sur plusieurs projets visant à réduire les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et à améliorer l'exploitation des données de l'entreprise. Automatisation du processus de relance des impayés : créer une solution permettant de suivre les créances clients et de générer automatiquement les relances adaptées aux différentes échéances. Automatisation des plannings des techniciens vérificateurs : développer un outil permettant d'automatiser l'organisation et le suivi des interventions. Digitalisation des rapports d'intervention de nos techniciens vérificateurs : simplifier et moderniser la gestion, la mise à jour et le suivi des rapports réalisés sur le terrain. Exploitation automatisée des rapports terrain : identifier et structurer automatiquement les informations issues des rapports d'intervention afin de faciliter le traitement des non-conformités et la préparation des devis. Développement d'assistants métiers basés sur l'IA : participer à la création de solutions permettant d'accompagner le traitement de sujets juridiques, administratifs et de communication. Exploration de nouveaux usages de l'intelligence artificielle : réaliser une veille sur les évolutions de l'IA générative et identifier de nouveaux cas d'usage applicables aux métiers de la Protection Incendie. Parce qu'il s'agit d'une démarche d'innovation, tu seras également encouragé·e à proposer tes propres idées et expérimenter de nouvelles approches ! A propos de toi ? Tu es étudiant·e en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en formation spécialisée en intelligence artificielle, data science ou automatisation. Tu es reconnu·e pour : ✔ Ta curiosité et ton intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies. ✔ Ta capacité à apprendre rapidement et à explorer des sujets variés. ✔ Ton autonomie et ton esprit d'initiative. ✔ Ton goût pour la résolution de problèmes concrets. ✔ Ta capacité à proposer des idées et à les transformer en solutions opérationnelles Tu souhaites découvrir l'univers VINCI Energies, rejoindre une équipe à taille humaine et gagner progressivement en autonomie ? Alors ce stage est fait pour toi ! Nous te proposons : Une expérience responsabilisante au sein d’une entreprise à taille humaine Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer tes compétences Une immersion concrète dans le pilotage financier et la gestion d’une entreprise De réelles perspectives pour construire la suite de ton parcours au sein d’Uxello et de VINCI Energies Rémunération et avantages : Stage de 6 mois Gratification : 11,21 € / heure Titres restaurant : carte Swile d'une valeur de 12 €, dont 4,80 € de part salariale Remboursement à 100 % des transports en Île-de-France Uxello attache une grande importance à la diversité et aux principes de non-discrimination. Cette offre est naturellement ouverte à toutes et tous. Dans un monde en évolution permanente, VINCI Energies accélère la transition environnementale en concrétisant deux mutations majeures, numérique et énergétique. Ses équipes déploient des technologies et des solutions multitechniques sur mesure, de la conception à la réalisation, l'exploitation et la maintenance. Ancrées dans leurs territoires, agiles et innovantes, ses plus 2 100 entreprises sont au cœur des choix énergétiques de leurs clients, de leurs infrastructures et de leurs process pour les rendre chaque jour plus fiables, plus efficients et plus durables. VINCI Energies vise une performance globale, attentive à la planète, utile aux hommes et solidaire des populations.

items.desc: Stage de fin d'études (Bac+5) – Développeur Full-stack Intégration et mise en production de fonctionnalités IA Toloxa est une start-up toulousaine (créée en janvier 2025, incubateur Nubbo) qui développe un assistant IA de diagnostic et de réparation pour tout type d'équipement. Il s'adresse aux services SAV, mainteneurs, installateurs et fabricants. Notre but : réduire les tickets entrants, limiter les déplacements sur site et rendre les techniciens, même juniors, autonomes plus vite. Nous avons déjà des clients et des déploiements sur site. Ton sujet Notre équipe R&D prototype en continu de nouvelles fonctionnalités. Entre un prototype qui marche en démo et une fonctionnalité fiable utilisée par des clients, il y a tout un travail d'ingénierie : architecture, tests, performances, déploiement, documentation. Ton objectif est de prendre en charge l'industrialisation d'une ou plusieurs fonctionnalités issues de la R&D, du prototype jusqu'à la mise en production. Le sujet précis sera défini avec toi en début de stage, selon tes envies et les priorités du moment (par exemple : la désignation de pièces sur un schéma, l'interaction vocale ou le mode hors connexion). Ce projet sera ton fil rouge, et la base de ton rapport et de ta soutenance. Ce que tu vas apprendre - Passer d'un prototype à un produit : ce qui change entre un code qui marche et un code fiable, maintenable et déployé. - Travailler sur toute la stack d'un produit IA : API Python asynchrone, bases de données (dont vectorielles), front React/TypeScript, intégration de LLM. - Les bonnes pratiques d'une équipe de dev : revues de code, tests automatisés, CI/CD, conteneurisation, monitoring. - Le fonctionnement d'une start-up deeptech, au contact direct des clients, dans l'écosystème IA toulousain (ANITI). Profil recherché Tu es en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou de Master en informatique. Tu as envie de voir ton code tourner en production et servir de vrais utilisateurs, tu aimes autant le back que le front, et l'IA t'intrigue. Ce qu'on attend de toi : - bases solides en Python ; - notions de développement web front-end (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS), idéalement avec React ; - première pratique de Git ; - curiosité, rigueur et envie de travailler en équipe. Un plus (sinon tu apprendras avec nous) : programmation asynchrone (asyncio, aiohttp), API REST et WebSocket, MongoDB, bases vectorielles (Qdrant), stockage S3, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, tests automatisés (pytest, Vitest, Playwright), première expérience avec les LLM ou l'IA générative (API OpenAI, Pydantic AI, RAG…). Modalités - Début : février/mars 2027, durée 6 mois - Lieu : ANITI, B612, 3 rue Tarfaya, 31400 Toulouse - Tutorat par l'équipe technique, en lien étroit avec l'équipe R&D, et accompagnement pour le rapport et la soutenance - Gratification de stage selon la réglementation en vigueur - 35h par semaine, semaine de 4 jours possible avec l'accord de l'établissement - Télétravail ponctuel possible après la période d'intégration - Possibilité d'embauche à l'issue du stage Candidature Envoie ta candidature à recruit.2@toloxa.com. Si tu as un GitHub ou des projets d'école ou perso, joins-les, même s'ils sont imparfaits. Rémunération : à partir de 4,50€ par heure Avantages : Travail à domicile occasionnel Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (31400 Toulouse)

Dans le cadre de notre développement et de la digitalisation progressive de notre organisation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire polyvalent(e) dans les domaines de la gestion, de l'administration et des outils numériques / intelligence artificielle. Amélioration des processus et transformation numérique / digitalisation de l'entreprise grâce à l'intelligence artificielle. items.desc: La Direction Actuariat Groupe est composée de trois pôles : Provisionnement Vie, Provisionnement Non-Vie et Analyse de Modèles. Le pôle Analyse de Modèles a notamment pour mission la validation indépendante du modèle interne de SCOR utilisé pour le calcul du SCR du Groupe et des entités européennes, le développement du cadre de gestion du risque de modèles, ainsi que la coordination de certaines revues de calculs en formule standard. Il contribue au déploiement de méthodologies harmonisées d’évaluation et de gestion des risques au sein du Groupe. Dans le contexte du développement des usages de l’intelligence artificielle, l’équipe renforce ses travaux de validation des modèles d’IA et l’intégration des risques spécifiques à l’IA dans le Model Risk Management Framework de SCOR. Sous la supervision des responsables de l’équipe Analyse de Modèles, le ou la stagiaire participera à des travaux concrets de validation de modèles d’intelligence artificielle, avec une attention particulière portée à la robustesse, à la performance, à l’explicabilité et à la maîtrise des risques. Contribuer à la validation indépendante de modèles d’IA et de machine learning développés ou utilisés au sein du Groupe. Analyser les données, les choix méthodologiques, les hypothèses, les métriques de performance et les limites des modèles. Concevoir et réaliser des tests de robustesse, de stabilité, de sensibilité, de biais et, selon les cas d’usage, d’explicabilité. Évaluer la qualité de la documentation, la reproductibilité des résultats et la traçabilité du processus de développement. Identifier les risques et limites des modèles, formaliser les constats et proposer des recommandations de remédiation proportionnées. Contribuer à l’évolution des méthodes, outils et standards de validation applicables aux modèles d’IA, notamment aux modèles génératifs et aux grands modèles de langage lorsque pertinent. Participer à la revue des scorecards et des informations enregistrées dans OpenPages, l’outil interne d’inventaire et de gestion du risque de modèles. Restituer les analyses de manière claire et synthétique aux équipes Model Analysis, Data Science, Tech & Data, Risk Management et aux propriétaires de modèles. Solides bases en data science, machine learning, statistiques et méthodes quantitatives. Bonne maîtrise de Python et des bibliothèques usuelles d’analyse de données et de machine learning Une première expérience académique ou professionnelle portant sur le développement, l’évaluation ou la validation de modèles d’IA est appréciée. Intérêt pour la validation indépendante, la gouvernance de l’IA, l’explicabilité, les biais, la robustesse et le risque de modèles. Rigueur scientifique, esprit critique, autonomie, curiosité et capacité à documenter clairement les travaux réalisés. Bonnes capacités de communication et aptitude à présenter des analyses techniques à des interlocuteurs variés. Bon niveau d’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Education requise Élève en deuxième ou troisième année d’école d’ingénieurs (type ENSAE, ENSIMAG, Centrale, Telecom…), recherchant un stage de 6 mois. Spécialisation ou forte orientation en data science, intelligence artificielle, machine learning, statistiques ou mathématiques appliquées. As a leading global reinsurer, SCOR offers its clients a diversified and innovative range of reinsurance and insurance solutions and services to control and manage risk. Applying “The Art & Science of Risk,” SCOR uses its industry-recognized expertise and cutting-edge financial solutions to serve its clients and contribute to the welfare and resilience of society in around 160 countries worldwide. Working at SCOR means engaging with some of the best minds in the industry – actuaries, data scientists, underwriters, risk modelers, engineers, and many others – as we work together to find solutions to pressing challenges facing societies. As an international company, our common culture is defined by “The SCOR Way.” Serving both to build momentum that drives the Group forward and as a compass to guide our actions and choices, The SCOR Way is anchored by five core values, reflecting the input of employees at all levels of the Group. We care about clients, people, and societies. We perform with integrity. We act with courage. We encourage open minds. And we thrive through collaboration. SCOR supports inclusion and the diversity of talents, and all positions are open to people with disabilities.

items.desc: Chi Siamo La storia del Gruppo Dallara inizia nel 1972, quando l’Ingegner Giampaolo Dallara, dopo importanti esperienze lavorative in Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini e De Tomaso, fonda la "Dallara Automobili da Competizione" a Varano de' Melegari, un piccolo paese vicino a Parma. Oggi, il Gruppo Dallara è composto da oltre 950 Persone Dallara ed è una delle più importanti realtà nel settore della progettazione, sviluppo e produzione di vetture da competizione ad alte prestazioni. Dallara è l’unico fornitore dei campionati: IndyCar, IndyNXT, Formula 2, Formula 3, EuroFormula, Formula E e Super Formula. Inoltre, sviluppa e produce alcune delle vetture che si sfidano nei campionati WEC e IMSA ed offre consulenza in altri campionati, incluso il mondo NASCAR. Dall'inizio degli anni 2000, Il Gruppo Dallara fornisce consulenze specialistiche e assistenza professionale a costruttori e squadre corse per sviluppare vetture sia da competizione che stradali. Infine, negli ultimi anni, il Gruppo Dallara ha iniziato a collaborare allo sviluppare soluzioni per il settore aerospaziale. Il ruolo Nel ruolo di Junior Software Engineer entrerai a far parte dell’area Software Development di Dallara Automobili, azienda del Gruppo Dallara specializzata nella progettazione, realizzazione di pre-serie e test per le 3 Business Unit aziendali (Racing, Automotive e Aerospace). In questa posizione ti occuperai dello sviluppo software delle soluzioni in house del Gruppo Dallara, partecipando a progetti di sviluppo per applicazioni che hanno lo scopo di automatizzare i processi aziendali. Avrai l’opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente giovane e stimolante utilizzando moderne tecnologie che spaziano da framework web a strumenti per l’analisi di dati telemetrici e partecipare a progetti di ricerca inerenti al Machine Learning e all’Intelligenza Artificiale. Cosa stiamo cercando Laurea Triennale o Magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o in ambito affine; Buona conoscenza della Object Oriented Programming; Conoscenza di GIT e degli strumenti di versionamento del codice; Buona conoscenza della programmazione Client-Server e Web; Buona conoscenza di uno dei linguaggi C#, C++ o GoLang; Conoscenza di base di Flutter; Conoscenza di base di Docker e della programmazione a micro-servizi; Conoscenza di base dei sistemi operativi Linux e Windows; Attitudine al lavoro in team e al problem solving; Curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. I nostri valori Umiltà Vogliamo fare bene il nostro lavoro con passione, determinazione e competenza, valorizzando gli errori, condividendo la conoscenza e superando con resilienza le difficoltà, consapevoli che il più grande pericolo è credere di sapere. Lealtà Crediamo nella parola data, nel rispetto tra le persone e degli impegni presi; vogliamo sviluppare legami fondati sull’onestà, la fiducia e la serietà dei rapporti umani. Curiosità Vogliamo fare meglio ciò che abbiamo sempre fatto con prontezza, entusiasmo e amore del sapere, sfidando ciò che esiste in modo nuovo e flessibile con la continua disponibilità ad imparare. Cosa offriamo Programma di welfare olistico – Comunità Dallara; Accesso a percorsi formativi qualificati; Internal Job Posting; Policy Smart-Working; Flessibilità oraria. Luogo di lavoro Varano de’ Melegari (PR)

items.desc: the performance of technology Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende rol als Electrical System Engineer bij ingenieursbureau VIRO? Electrical System Engineer Echt Als Electrical System Engineer bij VIRO werk je aan het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en integreren van elektrische en mechanische systemen binnen complexe machines en producten. Je maakt deel uit van multidisciplinaire projectteams. Hierbij ben je betrokken van conceptontwikkeling en basic engineering tot detailed design en implementatie. Een goede balans tussen learning on the job, coaching door ervaren collega's en gerichte trainingen zorgt ervoor dat je jezelf continu kunt ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied. Wat ga je doen? Vertalen van complexe technische specificaties, tekeningen en elektrische schema's naar praktische en innovatieve oplossingen voor het ontwerpen en routen van elektrische en mechanische componenten. Zelfstandig of in teamverband ontwerpen, uitwerken en optimaliseren van de routing en positionering van kabels, kabelbomen, connectoren en componenten binnen complexe machines en systemen. Bepalen van effectieve aansluitingen en aansturingsmethoden, waarbij rekening wordt gehouden met factoren zoals ruimtegebruik, warmteafvoer, trillingen, maakbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Gebruikmaken van 3D CAD-software, zoals Siemens NX en/of Creo, voor het ontwerpen, modelleren en controleren van technische oplossingen. Toepassen van relevante technische normen en voorschriften en analyseren van technische vraagstukken om tot passende oplossingen te komen. Onderhouden van contacten en samenwerken met klanten, leveranciers, fabrikanten en multidisciplinaire projectteams. Proactief meedenken over innovatieve oplossingen en verbeteringen, initiatief nemen en zelfstandig met voorstellen komen. Flexibel inspelen op veranderende projectbehoeften en de ambitie tonen om jezelf, je technische kennis en het projectteam verder te ontwikkelen. Vereisten Wat vragen wij van jou? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting Mechatronica, Elektrotechniek, Elektronica-ICT, Elektromechanica of vergelijkbaar Affiniteit met zowel mechanische als elektrische systemen en componenten Kennis van elektronische ontwerpen, hardware en elektrische componenten Ervaring met of interesse in elektrische schema's, eendraadschema's, meerdraadschema's en cable overviews Kennis van EPLAN is een pre Ervaring met 3D CAD-software zoals NX en/of Creo, of de motivatie om dit te leren Kennis van relevante normen, richtlijnen en standaarden binnen elektrotechnische en mechatronische ontwerpen Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal VIRO VIRO vestiging Echt is een bruisende en ambitieuze vestiging waar een enthousiast team samenwerkt en elkaar helpt wanneer dat nodig is. Er is een informele sfeer waar collega's regelmatig samen activiteiten ondernemen. Of het nu gaat om een gezellige gameavond, een sportieve hardloopsessie, het genieten van een biertje, er is altijd ruimte voor gezelligheid. We moedigen initiatief aan, stimuleren persoonlijke ontwikkeling en betrekken iedereen bij het meedenken over de groei en ontwikkeling van onze vestiging. Interesse Als je na het lezen van de vacature geïnteresseerd bent in deze functie, reageer dan gerust. Wij behandelen dit als een sollicitatie van de kandidaat zelf. #LI-MS1

items.desc: Engineering - Leuven | Just now You will be a member of the Materials, Transfer and Assembly group (MATA) which is responsible for developing processes requested by the process integration departments running imec’s CORE and CMORE programs. What you will do Miniaturization of system size is a driving force in most electronics applications. The continuous scaling of IC’s, and the advent of more compact system integration technologies make this possible. Within its affiliation programs and bilateral initiatives, imec contributes to the state of the art in a significant manner. Thanks to recent advances in 3D integration, wafer-level packaging and MEMS, novel types of components with small form factors and an increased number of functionalities are emerging. These novel components also require new packaging solutions. To support the growing interest in these activities, we are looking for a Process Engineer. You are a member of the Materials, Transfer and Assembly group (MATA) which is responsible for developing processes requested by the process integration departments running imec’s CORE and CMORE programs. You work in a group of about 30 people with whom you interact daily. You will work in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with Researchers, Scientists, Hardware Engineers, Operations, Equipment Vendors, Industrial Assignees, Device and Process experts. You will be responsible for assisting the R&D engineers in process development on various clean room tools related to die-to-wafer bonding, temporary bonding debonding, lamination and singulation with the focus on 3D-heterogeneous/packaging applications (3D integrated systems, image sensors, photonics, biomedical devices, quantum computing,...). For this, you work mainly in the cleanroom, and you are supported by experienced technical staff to carry out standard operations. More specifically, you will: Define, organize, set up and validate new processes (singulation, lamination, die-bonding). Look for specific metrology solutions to characterize these processes. Actively contribute to the research programs (e.g. 3D program, imagers & specialty component program, quantum computing program) and joint development programs with external partners. Work cross-functionally with the integration/process support/hardware teams and industrial partners. Report about your work to internal and external partners. Start fundamental research activities on new materials needed for new projects and perform characterization and failure analysis of materials used. Interface with device engineers and researchers to identify future needs and trends. Coordinate and implement the non-standard work in IMEC’s fab organization together with fab process engineers and the pilot line. This includes coordination of the transfer of developed processes and tools to support and operational teams. Start-up of new equipment. You will be coached on-the-job by senior researchers. What we do for you We offer you the opportunity to join one of the world’s premier research centers in nanotechnology at its headquarters in Leuven, Belgium. With your talent, passion and expertise, you’ll become part of a team that makes the impossible possible. Together, we shape the technology that will determine the society of tomorrow. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and proud of our open, multicultural, and informal working environment with ample possibilities to take initiative and show responsibility. We commit to supporting and guiding you in this process; not only with words but also with tangible actions. Through imec.academy, 'our corporate university', we actively invest in your development to further your technical and personal growth. We are aware that your valuable contribution makes imec a top player in its field. Your energy and commitment are therefore appreciated by means of a market appropriate salary with many fringe benefits. Who you are You preferably have a master’s degree in chemistry, physics, material Science or engineering. Foundry or OSAT experience in wafer-to-wafer bonding and semiconductor materials background including characterization / FA is beneficial. You will actively participate in cross-functional teams and projects when required, utilizing scientific and engineering skills to enhance the team capability. You are an enthusiastic and creative team player with strong networking, communication and reporting skills who likes to work in a multicultural team of imec researchers, PhD students and industrial researchers and will have frequent interactions with clients. You work autonomously, well-organized, with good attention to detail and you set high standards in everything you do. You are interested in working hands-on in a clean room environment. Since your job consists of a variety of activities, depending on the needs of the imec research programs, a flexible attitude towards your tasks is required. Given the …

Votre rôle s’articule autour de trois axes : Développer et interconnecter Développer et maintenir des connecteurs, APIs (REST / GraphQL / SOAP) et pipelines de données pour faire dialoguer des systèmes hétérogènes (ERP, CRM, bases de données, applications tierces). Implémenter des flux d’intégration orientés événements et messages asynchrones (patterns EAI, routage, transformation de messages). Intégrer les briques d'interconnexion au sein d’écosystèmes ESB / plateformes d'intégration et de services Cloud (Azure, GCP ou AWS). Appliquer les standards stricts de sécurité applicative (authentification OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, gestion des secrets, chiffrement en transit et au repos). Fiabiliser, tester et exploiter Assurer la résilience des flux (gestion des reprises sur incident, dead-letter queues, observabilité et monitoring temps réel). Garantir la qualité logicielle par des tests automatisés complets (unitaires, intégration, mocks d'APIs, tests de contrat) et l'intégration dans des pipelines CI/CD. Rédiger la documentation technique (contrats d’interface OpenAPI, schémas de flux, guides d’exploitation). Collaborer et progresser en équipe Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs back-end/front-end, les architectes data/solution et les Product Owners en méthodologie Agile. Contribuer à l’estimation des chantiers techniques et au choix des outils d'interconnexion les plus adaptés. Participer à la veille technique sur les nouveaux frameworks d’intégration, les microservices et l'outillage DevOps. Votre environnement technique Langages & Frameworks : Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), Python, Node.js ou C# .NET. Intégration & Messaging : Apache Camel, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, écosystèmes ESB / iPaaS. Web Services & APIs : REST, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenAPI / Swagger, passerelles d'API (API Gateways). Cloud & Serverless : Microsoft Azure (Azure Service Bus, API Management, Functions, Logic Apps) ou équivalents AWS / GCP. Architecture : Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Microservices, Patterns EAI, architectures découplées. DevOps & Qualité : Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), Postman, SonarQube. Sécurité : OAuth 2.0, JWT, OpenID Connect, protocoles TLS/mTLS, OWASP. Votre profil Issu(e) d’une formation en informatique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience significative en développement logiciel avec une forte composante en interfaçage et intégration de systèmes. On parie que vous cochez aussi ces cases : Vous avez une solide expérience dans la conception et l'implémentation d'APIs et de mécanismes de messages asynchrones. Vous maîtrisez les problématiques de transformation de données (JSON, XML, Avro, Protobuf) et la gestion des flux à fort volume ou haute criticité. Vous avez un bon sens du diagnostic technique pour identifier et résoudre rapidement les goulots d’étranglement ou les ruptures de flux. Vous appréciez le travail en squad Agile, faites preuve de curiosité technique et savez communiquer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme fonctionnels. Pourquoi Smile Management de proximité par des pairs favorisant l’échange et un parcours d’évolution sur-mesure. Montée en compétences continue : accès à des plateformes e-learning, financement de certifications (Cloud, éditeurs d'intégration), communautés de pratique internes. Vie d’équipe : événements réguliers, hackathons, salons tech, afterworks et moments conviviaux. Les prochaines étapes Premier contact : échange de 20-30 min avec Sofia pour partager vos attentes mutuelles. Entretien de parcours : échange approfondi sur vos expériences et réalisations. Entretien technique : échange métier avec un expert en architecture & intégration. Et si les feux sont au vert, nous serons ravis de vous intégrer à l'équipe !

items.desc: Wat ga je doen? Bij Bnode transformeren we de manier waarop we data inzetten om onze operationele efficiëntie te verbeteren, de klantervaring te versterken en innovatie te versnellen. We investeren in een modern, schaalbaar en veilig dataplatform waarmee teams binnen onze organisatie hoogwaardige dataproducten kunnen ontwikkelen en gebruiken. We zijn op zoek naar een Data Platform Engineer om ons centrale Data-team te versterken en mee te bouwen aan de technologie achter onze datagedreven toekomst. Jouw rol Als Data Platform Engineer bouw, optimaliseer en beheer je ons enterprise dataplatform. Je combineert cloud engineering, automatisering en DataOps om betrouwbare, veilige en schaalbare oplossingen te realiseren. Je werkt nauw samen met de Data Platform Lead, Data Architects en Data Engineers om ons platform verder te ontwikkelen, processen te automatiseren en teams binnen Bnode optimaal met data te laten werken. Wat ga je doen? Ons cloudgebaseerde dataplatform bouwen, onderhouden en optimaliseren met AWS en Snowflake . Oplossingen voor data-ingestie, transformatie en orkestratie ontwikkelen en beheren met technologieën zoals dbt en Airflow . Cloudinfrastructuur opzetten en beheren met Terraform en Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . CI/CD-pipelines ontwikkelen en onderhouden om tests, deployments en platformbeheer te automatiseren. Herbruikbare templates, frameworks en automatiseringstools ontwikkelen met Python en SQL . Veilig toegangsbeheer, rolgebaseerde toegangsrechten, encryptie en datagovernancecontroles implementeren. De prestaties, betrouwbaarheid, schaalbaarheid en kosten van het platform monitoren en optimaliseren. Samenwerken met engineering-, architectuur- en securityteams om technische uitdagingen op te lossen en het platform continu te verbeteren. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een hands-on engineer met een sterke expertise in cloudtechnologie en dataplatformen, een analytische ingesteldheid en een passie voor automatisering. Jouw technische achtergrond Een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Informatica, Data Engineering of een aanverwante richting, of gelijkwaardige ervaring. Minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring in Data Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DataOps of een vergelijkbaar domein. AWS: Sterke ervaring met cloudinfrastructuur en cloudservices. Snowflake: Ervaring met cloudgebaseerde dataplatformen, dataopslag en dataverwerking. Terraform: Praktische ervaring met Infrastructure as Code. Python & SQL: Sterke programmeer- en scriptingvaardigheden. CI/CD & DevOps: Ervaring met Git, geautomatiseerde deployments en DevOps-praktijken. Data Engineering: Kennis van frameworks voor data-ingestie, transformatie en orkestratie. Cloud Security: Kennis van IAM, rolgebaseerd toegangsbeheer en principes rond gegevensbescherming. Extra troeven Ervaring met dbt, Airflow, Dagster, Docker of Kubernetes . Kennis van PySpark, OpenMetadata of tools voor datagovernance. Ervaring met monitoring, observability en optimalisatie van cloudkosten. Vertrouwdheid met GDPR, ISO 27001 en frameworks voor databeveiliging. Je hoeft niet elke technologie binnen onze omgeving te beheersen. We hechten vooral belang aan een sterke technische basis, leergierigheid en de bereidheid om nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken. Jouw persoonlijke vaardigheden Sterk analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen. Zelfstandig kunnen werken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Een samenwerkingsgerichte houding en duidelijke communicatie. Flexibiliteit, nieuwsgierigheid en een servicegerichte mindset. Talen: Vloeiend Engels is vereist. Kennis van Nederlands en/of Frans is een pluspunt. Wat krijg je van ons? We willen dat jij je bij ons even welkom voelt als dat langverwachte pakje aan de deur. Dat je een competitief bruto maandsalaris krijgt, dat spreekt voor zich. Daarnaast kan je ook rekenen op: Maaltijdcheques van €10 per gewerkte dag Hospitalisatie-, groeps- en invaliditeitsverzekeringen Een smartphone abonnement met 25GB data Een flexibel verloningsplan, waarmee je voordelen op jouw maat kiest. Een bedrijfswagen, fietsleasing, openbaar vervoer, extra vakantiedagen,… de keuze is aan jou. De mogelijkheid om toe te treden tot het Federaal Mobiliteitsplan Work/life balans, dankzij onze flexibele uren en de mogelijkheid om van thuis te werken 20 dagen wettelijk verlof, aangevuld met 7 dagen extra wettelijk verlof Een eindejaarspremie, prestatie gebonden bonus en dubbel vakantiegeld Kortingen bij meer dan 100 Bpost-partners #Bpost #Bnode #LI-DNI Terug naar het overzicht

From our roots in electronic meal, eco, and gift vouchers, we’ve evolved into a comprehensive Reward Management System, offering smart, flexible, and human-centered salary solutions. Assist in developing customer engagement processes and tools that ensure smooth interactions with Monizze. Work closely with management and team leaders, including the Sales team, to develop strategies that support the growth of the Account management team and the platform. items.desc: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree. Experience with data analysis and signal quality testing. Preferred qualifications: 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. Experience working with large-scale data processing pipelines. Experience with data analysis and statistical thinking enabling you to rigorously evaluate metrics, tune algorithms and make data-motivated decisions. Experience designing clean Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and interfaces that integrate cleanly with multiple upstream services. Familiarity or strong interest in signal processing, machine learning frameworks or biometric classification workflows. Strong code health advocacy, with experience writing comprehensive integration tests for complex logical state machines. About the job Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The team is the central decision engine for Content ID, YouTube’s world-leading rights management platform. The team builds and operates the complex, real-time pipeline that orchestrates a suite of upstream signals from classic audio/visual fingerprinting to facial, speech and generative biometrics (e.g., LikenessID), as well as complex fictional and universe tracking (e.g., CharacterID). The team computes the authoritative, final claiming verdicts at a massive scale. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Responsibilities Leverage multi-modal signals (e.g., visual/audio/melody matching) to generate highly accurate content claims. Identify unauthorized Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) reuse of human likeness (e.g., facial/voice), animated characters and fictional universes alongside classical copyright. Detect Content ID bypass tricks and identify bad references used for illicit monetization while protecting innocent creators. Build, run and maintain both our core quality systems and the underlying infrastructure that powers them. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. items.desc: Meet Our Recruiter Matthew Mills Managing Director 07493 267443 matthew@mfkrecruitment.co.uk About the Role Full Stack Python Developer Salary : £60,000 to £80,000 Location : West London Working arrangement : Predominantly office and customer-site based, with some remote working available Employment : Permanent, full-time MFK Recruitment is recruiting a Full Stack Python Developer for an innovative UK technology company developing advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions for defence, security and other demanding real-world environments. The company specialises in computer vision, perception and autonomy, combining modern deep learning with neuroscience-inspired technology to create accurate, robust and reliable AI systems. MFK Recruitment has successfully recruited four Engineers to this company over the past five years, and all four are still with the business. This speaks volumes about the company’s culture, technical challenges and long-term opportunities. Full Stack Python Developer role The Full Stack Python Developer will build applications that allow customers to use advanced computer vision technology within real operational environments. Rather than developing the AI models themselves, you will create the intuitive, high-performance software through which users can search, analyse and enhance imagery and video, compare outputs from different AI models and visualise detection and performance statistics. You will also integrate these applications and AI capabilities with existing customer systems, infrastructure and operational workflows. You will work closely with Python, C++ and AI Engineers, as well as customers and end users, helping to shape products from initial concept through to deployment. This role offers genuine influence over software architecture, technology choices and product direction. The position is predominantly office and customer-site based in West London, although some remote working will be available. Full Stack Python Developer responsibilities Design and develop modern, responsive full stack applications. Build intuitive user interfaces for complex AI and computer vision workflows. Develop applications for image analysis, video review and AI visualisation. Create tools for generating and managing Machine Learning training datasets. Integrate AI capabilities and applications with existing customer systems. Develop software interfaces and integrated workflows that improve existing processes. Work with customers to understand their infrastructure, technical requirements and operational needs. Collaborate with Python, C++ and AI Engineers throughout the development lifecycle. Contribute to software architecture, technical direction and technology choices. Build scalable, maintainable and well-tested production software. Support demonstrations, field trials and secure customer deployments. Essential experience At least three years of commercial full stack development experience. Strong Python development skills. Commercial experience using Django and/or Flask. Front-end development experience using HTML5, CSS and JavaScript. Experience integrating different software applications, APIs or customer systems. Experience developing integrated workflows and understanding data flows between systems. Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB. Experience delivering reliable, production-quality software. Strong software engineering practices, including Git, automated testing, code reviews and CI/CD. The ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Desirable experience Data-lake or lakehouse technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Databricks, Snowflake or AWS Lake Formation. Image or video visualisation, enhancement, rendering or tagging applications. GIS or geo-referenced imagery. Event-driven architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams or AWS services. Experience integrating AI, Machine Learning or computer vision products. Unreal Engine 5. Agile or Scrum delivery. Defence, security, government or another regulated environment. Experience working within a growing technology company. A degree or postgraduate qualification in Computer Science or an equivalent technical subject. Security clearance Candidates must be eligible to obtain UK BPSS and Security Check clearance. Existing clearance would be advantageous but is not essential for every appointment. Applicants for SC clearance are normally expected to have lived in the UK for the previous five years. A shorter period of UK residency or time spent overseas will not automatically prevent clearance, but eligibility will be assessed individually by the sponsoring authority.

items.desc: Would you like to help support research and development in a supportive and collaborative environment? The Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University is seeking a new employee to support researchers in the development and implementation of large simulation models that describe ecological processes in the agricultural landscape as well as wider societal interactions, such as consumer behavior. The overarching framework of the work is the Danish Green Transition. This fixed position is available with a starting date of 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is based on a 37 hour work week. Depending on the nature of the role and its responsibilities, periods of high workload may occur, during which overtime should be expected. You will become part of Section for Agricultural Biodiversity, where you will work closely with researchers, and technical and administrative colleagues. Your tasks Designing, coding and testing simulation models in close dialog with researchers Preparing visualisations and analyses of model outcomes to guide iterative model development Preparing reports to funders and contributing to grant applications with data, plots, analyses and writing Your profile We expect that You have an MSc or PhD in the Life, Technical or Social sciences You have experience with a project-oriented work schedule You have experience with scientific programming (e.g., in C++ and NetLogo) You have good English skills, and you thrive in an inclusive multi-cultural and diverse working environment You are motivated by working on projects, where the overall aim is to support the Green Transition You are able to work on your own Who we are At the Department of Agroecology, our main goal is to contribute to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network. The department consists of nine research sections with around 350 highly skilled employees, of which approximately 50% are scientific staff. More information can be found here. We believe in encouraging inclusion, acceptance, and understanding by employing staff who bring unique perspectives to our department. What we offer A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do. An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines. A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs. An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions. An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas. Living and working in Denmark Subsidised childcare and free education from primary school through university. Universal healthcare for you and your family as residents. Five weeks of paid holiday per year. Generous parental leave – up to 52 weeks shared between parents, with full or partial salary. Place of Work The place of work is Ole Worms Alle 3, Department of Agroecology, Faculty of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University. Contact Applicants seeking further information can contact Senior Scientist Niels Holst (e-mail: niels.holst@agro.au.dk) Formalities Salary and terms of employment follow the collective agreement for academics in the state. Depending on experience, the employment will be as an academic employee at basic salary level 4-8 or as a special consultant with remuneration in accordance with Appendix 4 of the collective agreement. Aarhus University wants to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for everyone, and we want a culture where everyone can develop and develop. We see equality and diversity as a resource and therefore encourage everyone interested to apply. Applications are submitted via Aarhus University's recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

items.desc: Your Journey from March to the Graduate Programme You will join us on 1 March 2027, with the option to start either part-time or full-time. During your first months, you will become part of the SAP Technology team, contribute to internal and client-facing work, and build a strong foundation in SAP, consulting and delivery. From August 2027, you will transition to full-time and join the next Nordic SAP Graduate Programme, continuing your development through a structured mix of on-site learning, self-study and on-the-job training. You will be paired with a buddy and a mentor for continuous guidance and support, while building a powerful network of colleagues across the Nordics. The journey includes: Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark Consultant Academy: Kick things off by mastering the essential consulting toolkit at our Technology & Transformation Academy in Denmark based on an 18 months program. You’ll learn the Deloitte way of collaborative problem-solving. SAP Bootcamps: You will receive an introduction to SAP S/4HANA alongside other graduates from across the Nordics. You will participate in two bootcamps held at various locations in Europe, offering a comprehensive overview of SAP’s functional areas. The bootcamps culminate with deep-dive training sessions combining your newly acquired theoretical knowledge with practical, hands-on exercises in SAP S/4HANA. Live Project Experience: This is where the magic happens. You’ll join a project team and put your new skills to the test on a real client engagement, experiencing firsthand what it means to be a consultant. SAP Certifications: As an SAP consultant, you will engage in self-study during your graduate program to prepare for and pass one or more SAP certifications that are relevant within your area of work. Overall, you will contribute to client engagements from March while building the experience needed to get the most from the Nordic SAP Graduate Programme beginning in August 2027. You will help clients transform their technology landscapes with SAP S/4HANA and develop towards a career as an SAP technology consultant. Qualifications What you bring to the team: You have a high level of written and oral proficiency in English and Danish. You are ambitious, curious and eager to learn, with a clear interest in technology and how it can solve business challenges. You can communicate technical topics clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical colleagues and clients. You are a team player and have experience collaborating with others, for example through a student job, internship or university project. You have completed, or will complete before 1 March 2027, a relevant master’s degree or other formal education within areas such as computer science, software engineering, information technology, data science, business analytics, engineering or a related field. You are a natural problem-solver who can break down complex technical challenges into clear, actionable solutions. The position is in our Copenhagen office – the right to live and work in Denmark is required. You are willing to travel, as we work in a hybrid setup for many of our clients in the Nordics and Europe. It is a bonus if you also have: An understanding of ERP systems and/or SAP. Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages, such as Java, JavaScript, Python, SQL or ABAP. Familiarity with databases, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, software development, data engineering or analytics. Experience from a student job, internship, thesis or project where you applied technology to a practical problem. What we offer You will get the opportunity to work with and learn from some of the best and brightest minds in the technology and consulting space. You will be a part of a dynamic, ambitious, and fun group of people who always put each other first, and have a strong focus on well-being, inclusion, and community. We place a strong emphasis on feedback and provide opportunities to build a solid foundation for both professional and personal development. Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team. Additional Information Do you want to be part of our team? Tell us where you see yourself making the greatest impact within SAP Technology. We are particularly interested in candidates motivated by one or more of the following areas: SAP architecture and cloud Application development and automation Data, analytics and data engineering Integrations and APIs Technical delivery, testing and operations Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team. Send your application, CV, and grade transcript by 01.01.2027. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.
