Work here has outsized leverage: fix a pipeline in Data Connect and the improvement is felt across the whole platform. We're hiring a Data Engineer to help build and run that platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role — you'll own delivery of pipelines and platform features end-to-end within your area, working under the direction of the Lead Data Engineer rather than setting platform architecture yourself. It's a strong fit if you've got a couple of years of production data engineering experience and want to grow into more ownership over time, with senior engineers around you to learn from rather than being the most senior person in the room from day one. What you'll work on Pipelines and ingestion — build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that turn carrier, shipment, invoice and ERP data into the canonical Data Connect model; work on document data extraction (OCR/parsing for airway bills, POs, commercial invoices); extend carrier and ERP integrations and help onboard new data sources; implement data contract checks, validation and reconciliation so downstream teams can trust what they consume Platform and data quality — keep the pipelines you own within their performance and quality SLAs; when something breaks in your area, you can typically run it down in a couple of hours, not days; contribute to dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) to a design set by a senior/lead; follow the team's standards for testing, version control and observability Collaboration — work closely with the Lead Data Engineer, Data Scientists and Software Engineers on pipeline design; As a Simulation Consultant - Port Design , you will combine logistics, modelling, programming and consultancy to help ports and terminals around the world operate smarter, more efficiently and more sustainably. You will work on challenging international projects where your analysis directly supports our clients in making operational, design and investment decisions. What you will do as Simulation Consultant - Port Design As a Simulation Consultant - Port Design at Portwise, you will work on consultancy projects focused on designing and improving the operational efficiency of container and bulk terminals around the world. Together with a team of technical professionals, you will investigate complex logistics systems using advanced simulation models. You will help answer questions such as: What is the best terminal design? How can available resources be used most efficiently? What are the advantages and disadvantages of different handling systems? And how can terminal operations become more sustainable? You will translate quantitative analysis into clear insights and recommendations for our clients. Your responsibilities include: Develop project-specific simulation models using our simulation object library and configure these models to accurately represent and analyse client operations. Run and compare scenarios and operational strategies , assessing factors such as capacity, resource utilisation, handling systems and operational efficiency. Analyse simulation results and translate quantitative data into clear conclusions, insights and recommendations for our clients. Advise clients and present your findings , explaining complex simulation outcomes clearly and supporting clients in making informed design and operational decisions. Contribute to the further development of our simulation object library and occasionally visit logistics terminals to gather input, investigate operations, present findings or support the implementation of improvements. As you develop within Portwise, there are opportunities to grow into more specialised roles based on your interests and skills, for example as a project manager, expert developer or team coach. Where you will work At Haskoning, an international consulting engineering company for the natural and built environment. Driven by our purpose Enhancing Society Together , our 7,000 professionals provide clients with sustainable, world-class solutions. As our new Simulation Consultant - Port Design , you will become part of the Portwise team in Delft, the Netherlands . Portwise specialises in simulation-based consultancy for complex logistics operations, with particular expertise in container and bulk terminals. Simulation has been at the heart of Portwise's work from the beginning. By combining advanced simulation technology with extensive knowledge of automation, logistics and terminal operations, we help clients investigate complex design and operational decisions before they are implemented. You will work in an international and dedicated team on projects for clients around the world. Through the Portwise Academy , you will also have the opportunity to further develop your knowledge of logistics design, container and bulk terminals, simulation and related consulting skills. What you bring You enjoy analysing complex systems and approaching problems in a structured and meticulous way. You are comfortable working independently as well as collaborating with colleagues and are able to turn technical analysis into insights that clients can understand and use. For this role, you bring: An academic master's degree in a relevant field , providing you with a strong analytical foundation in areas such as modelling, programming, data science, operations research, engineering or logistics. Experience with programming and mathematical or simulation software , enabling you to build, analyse and improve quantitative models of complex operational systems. A strong interest in logistics and operational systems. Experience with or knowledge of port logistics is an advantage, as many of our projects focus on container and bulk terminal operations. A high level of proficiency in written and spoken English , as you will work in international project teams and communicate findings and recommendations to clients around the world. The ability and willingness to work in an international consultancy environment , including occasional travel to client sites and logistics terminals. Experience with Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation is an advantage and would enable you to get up to speed with our simulation environment more quickly. items.desc: Embedded Software Engineer - Quantum Networks The Netherlands is one of the leading countries in quantum technology with QuTech at its heart. Join our team as an Embedded Software Engineer at our research centre and help us shape the quantum future. Job description As an Embedded Software Engineer at QuTech, you will be part of the Open Access Team within the Quantum Internet Division. The team works closely with research groups, engineers, and support staff, as well as with research and engineering teams across Europe through the Quantum Internet Alliance (QIA), a partnership of more than 50 organisations working together to build a quantum internet in Europe. The Open Access Team is working to develop shared Open access infrastructure for quantum internet research and development. The goal is to provide tools and facilities that help researchers, technology developers, and end users accelerate progress across Europe. One example is QI-Lab, a quantum hardware emulation platform recently developed at QuTech that enables hardware-in-the-loop quantum network experiments using a desktop. Our goal is to release QI-Lab as an open-source experimentation platform that can be used by the wider quantum internet community. In this role you will work closely with researchers and engineers to develop, maintain and improve the platform and make it usable for a wider community. On a daily basis your responsibilities will be: Develop new features for our quantum hardware emulation platforms and maintain and improve the existing codebase. Work on the embedded parts of the stack, including RTOS programming and integration on platforms with real-time constraints, adapting the design as new research challenges arise. Integrate and control lab instruments and FPGA-based hardware from software, and debug issues at the hardware/software boundary. Prepare QI-Lab for open-source release: packaging, versioning, automated testing and handling contributions from outside QuTech. Write documentation, examples and onboarding material, and support researchers at QuTech and QIA partners using the platform. Work with experimentalists and fellow engineers to design and run experiments that demonstrate hardware/software integration and the functionality of the stack. Collaborate with engineering and research teams at QIA partner organizations across Europe, including occasional on-site visits. Job Requirements We are looking for a motivated junior to mid-level Embedded Software Engineer, ideally with around two years of relevant experience and a master's degree in Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. We would be particularly interested in candidates who have: Experience developing software in C/C++ and Python. Familiarity with low-level software (e.g. peripheral firmware, serial communication) and with development on Linux. Ability to explain technical choices clearly to physicists, engineers and external users, in English. Enjoyment of working in multidisciplinary teams across organizations. If you are eager to further develop these skills, we would be happy to support your growth. Nice to have: Experience with RTOSs, SoCs, or FPGA development (VHDL/Verilog) or FPGA-based instruments. Experience controlling lab or test equipment from software (e.g. SCPI/VISA, vendor SDKs, custom protocols). Comfort with oscilloscopes, logic analysers and similar debugging tools. Experience with open-source projects, technical documentation, or CI pipelines. Familiarity with Agile ways of working. Interest in physics experiments; exposure to quantum technology or optics is a plus but not required. We look forward to receiving applications from all qualified candidates and are committed to creating an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity. We believe in the power of an inclusive organizational culture and think it is important that everyone can be themselves. Whether it concerns age, gender, religion, sexual orientation, cultural background: everyone is welcome! TU Delft (Delft University of Technology) Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference. For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow. These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future. At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional. Working at TU Delft means joining an international community of professionals …

items.desc: SpareBank 1 Utvikling Hammersborggata 11, 0181 Oslo Om jobben Lagre favoritt Stillingstittel Data Engineer Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 5 Arbeidsspråk Norsk Vis flere detaljer Søk senest søndag 29. november Som den viktigste teknologipartneren i SpareBank 1-alliansen leverer vi mobilbank, infrastruktur og datatjenester som gir over én million brukere og bedrifter trygghet og forutsigbarhet. Vi brenner for å ta i bruk kraften i data for å skape gode opplevelser for bankene og produktselskapene våre. Nå skalerer vi opp satsingen og søker fem data engineers som vil være med å forme datalandskapet, arkitekturen og verktøyene våre fremover. I SpareBank 1 Utvikling er vi bankenes og produktselskapenes viktigste teknologipartner. Vi utvikler alt fra mobilbank og infrastruktur til avanserte plattformtjenester. Hos oss blir du en del av Data og Innsikt - et miljø på rundt 35 dyktige data engineers, data plattform engineers, data analyster og data scientister som jobber inn i tverrfaglige team og deler kunnskap, sparrer og løser komplekse utfordringer sammen. Hva gjør oss annerledes enn andre arbeidsplasser? Fagtid: Vi setter av tid til egenutvikling, eksperimentering og kompetansedeling. Hos oss er kontinuerlig læring en del av driftshverdagen, ikke noe du må skvise inn på kveldstid. Mennesket og samarbeidet i sentrum: Vi tror på at de beste løsningene skapes sammen. Vi bruker blant annet parjobbing for å dele innsikt, gjøre opplæringen trygg og heve kvaliteten på koden. Inhouse med ekte påvirkningskraft: Du får stor frihet til å forme arkitekturen og bidra inn i moderniseringen og forvaltning av nye dataprodukter. Stor skala, men nærhet til brukeren: Du får bryne deg på datamengder i toppklassen i norsk målestokk, samtidig som samfunnsoppdraget vårt er merkbart: Trygghet og god økonomisk oversikt for folk over hele landet. Vi eksperimenterer og tilpasser oss: Vi er nysgjerrige på moderne arbeidsmetodikker. I det siste har vi eksperimentert med parjobbing på dataområdet. Dette kan du lese mer om her: Kan man parprogrammere på dataområdet? | by Ruben Gudmundsrud | SpareBank 1 Utvikling | Oct, 2026 | Medium Hvordan vil hverdagen din se ut? Som Data Engineer hos oss blir du en nøkkelspiller i oppbyggingen og videreutviklingen av vår skybaserte data- og analyseplattform - selve fundamentet for innsikt, modellering og beslutninger i alliansen. Du vil blant annet: Utvikle og forvalte robuste, skalerbare dataprodukter og pipelines i skyen. Automatisere og optimalisere dataintegrasjoner og ETL-prosesser. Jobbe med moderne verktøy som Snowflake, dbt og Python . Samarbeide tett i tverrfaglige team for å skape reell verdi. Hvem trives hos oss? Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig, strukturert og trives i et miljø der man støtter hverandre. Du motiveres av å bygge smidige løsninger som gjør hverdagen enklere for andre, og du liker å bryne deg på data i stor skala. Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med: SQL, datamodellering og ETL/ELT-prosesser. dbt eller tilsvarende moderne transformasjonsverktøy. Ingen kan alt, og det forventer vi heller ikke. Vi legger største vekt på din læringsvilje, hvordan du samarbeider, og din evne til å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger. Om du kjenner deg igjen i mesteparten av det som står over, vil vi veldig gjerne høre fra deg! Hva tilbyr vi deg? Fast ansettelse i et raust, trygt og sterkt fagmiljø. Vi har avsatt tid til kompetanseheving i arbeidstiden, også kjent som fagtid Konkurransedyktige betingelser, samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Fine lokaler midt i Oslo sentrum med treningsrom, hyggelige sosiale soner og sommertid. En bedriftskultur som verdsetter balanse mellom jobb og fritid. Nysgjerrig? Søk da vel! Dersom du ønsker å bli litt mer kjent med oss eller stillingen før du søker, eller hvis du har noen spørsmål, er du hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt med Ruben Gudmundsrud, seksjonsleder Data og Innsikt, på 47337376 eller ruben.gudmundsrud@sparebank1.no. Du kan også lære mer om hvem vi er og hvordan vi jobber på karieresiden vår eller på LinkedIn, Instagram eller Medium! Hos oss er det enkelt å søke - du trenger bare å laste opp en CV og skrive noen ord om hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss. Vi ønsker å fortsette å representere mangfoldet i den norske befolkningen, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke på stillingen. Vi anbefaler at du er tidlig ute med å søke da vi kjører løpende vurderinger til denne stillingen. I SpareBank 1 Utvikling har vi norsk som arbeidsspråk - gode norskkunnskaper er derfor en forutsetning for å kunne jobbe hos oss. I forkant av ansettelse gjennomføres en bakgrunnssjekk for å blant annet verifisereopplysninger som kommer frem av CV og tilgjengelig dokumentasjon. Stillingen vurderes som kritisk og det vil også gjennomføres en Sårbarhetssamtale i forkant av ansettelsen. Bakgrunnssjekk gjennomføres av Semac AS etter at kandidat er orientert om og har godkjent det. Om bedriften I SpareBank 1 Utvikling gir vi over …

items.card: Job description Python · structural engineering calculations · remote-friendly · start ASAP MindPal builds custom, AI-powered software, mostly for manufacturing and construction companies. Our developers don't just write code: they understand how much a feature saves or earns for the client and talk to the client's experts directly. We are looking for a Python developer to cooperate with us on a project for a client
items.desc: Remote 40 - 70 PLN /hour Job description Python · structural engineering calculations · remote-friendly · start ASAP MindPal builds custom, AI-powered software, mostly for manufacturing and construction companies. Our developers don't just write code: they understand how much a feature saves or earns for the client and talk to the client's experts directly. We are looking for a Python developer to cooperate with us on a project for a client in the construction sector. The project turns structural engineering calculations, today kept in Excel, into tested Python code running on a server. Engineers rely on these numbers, so every result has to be right, and stay right after every change. Scope of services Port structural engineering calculations from Excel spreadsheets into clean, readable Python code. Deploy the calculation modules on a server so the client's application can use them. Build automated checks (e.g. pytest regression suites) that verify results after every change to the application. Compare code results with the original spreadsheets and hand calculations, and flag any discrepancy early. Consult assumptions and edge cases directly with the client's engineers, in English. Document formulas, units and assumptions so every result can be traced back to its source. Requirements 1–3 years of commercial experience with Python , or an engineering background with substantial Python projects (e.g. calculation tools or a computational model built for a thesis). Comfortable reading structural engineering calculations: loads, internal forces, cross-section checks. A civil, structural or mechanical engineering background is a strong plus. Experience turning spreadsheet logic into code, and a habit of checking that the numbers still match. A QA mindset: you write automated tests as part of the work, not as an afterthought. Meticulous and self-driven: you own the result and say early when something does not add up. Good English (B2+) for discussing calculations with engineers. Nice to have Familiarity with Eurocodes or structural software such as Autodesk Robot Structural Analysis or FEM tools. NumPy, pandas, openpyxl or similar libraries. FastAPI or Flask, Docker, CI/CD. Using AI tools in your workflow, together with a clear way of verifying what they produce. What we provide in cooperation B2B cooperation preffered (other type of cooperation also possible), rate: 40–70 PLN net + VAT / hour , depending on experience and contrac type. Remote cooperation, with on-site project coordination in Gliwice possible as needed. Cooperation framework agreed with you, taking your availability into account. Some calls with the client's team take place between 16:00 and 19:00 (Polish time) and are scheduled in advance. Start as soon as possible. Access to technical consultations and knowledge sharing with experienced developers and the client's engineers. Direct contact with domain experts: you see how your code is used and what it is worth to the client. Additional cooperation options, such as access to selected partner services, if agreed separately. How we cooperate We care about Ownership, Results, Discipline, Transparency, Speed, Craftsmanship and Partnership with our clients (mindpal.co/about-us). In this project that means tests written every day, problems reported early, and calculations you are ready to sign. Recruitment process Short call with People Operations (15–20 min): formalities, English, availability. Technical conversation (45–60 min), including a short practical task. Business and values conversation (20–30 min): how you approach problems and results.

items.card: you will perform internal quality reviews of processed warranty claims to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistent application of John Deere warranty policies and procedures. You will identify errors, trends, and improvement opportunities and work closely with internal Warranty teams to support high-quality claim processing. Your responsibilities: Perform internal quality reviews of processed warranty claims
items.desc: There are over 8 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW. Due to the development of John Deere Business Service Center, we are currently seeking candidates for the position of: Warranty Quality Representative Poznań, Poland As a Warranty Quality Representative, you will perform internal quality reviews of processed warranty claims to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistent application of John Deere warranty policies and procedures. You will identify errors, trends, and improvement opportunities and work closely with internal Warranty teams to support high-quality claim processing. Your responsibilities: Perform internal quality reviews of processed warranty claims and supporting documentation to verify accuracy, completeness, and compliance with warranty policies and procedures. Review claim information and related case documentation to identify processing errors and inconsistencies. Identify quality issues, determine root causes, and provide clear, constructive feedback to internal Warranty teams. Gather and analyze quality data to identify recurring issues, trends, and opportunities for process improvement. Collaborate with internal Warranty teams to support consistent claim processing, communicate findings, and improve overall quality. Our requirements: English language skills at B2 level or above Degree in Business, Technology, Agricultural Sciences, Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required. Relevant professional experience and demonstrated technical expertise will also be considered. Strong attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to review information and identify errors and inconsistencies. Good Excel skills and confidence working with data, with an interest in AI tools and process automation. Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and constructive feedback. Nice to have: Basic understanding of machinery and technical documentation. What we offer: Employment contract. Strong support for work-life balance, including flexible working hours (start time between 7:00 and 10:00 AM) and a hybrid work model at Business Garden in Poznań. Opportunities for professional development within the company, with strong support for internal career growth. Employee referral program. Additional vacation days based on length of employment. Holiday allowance when taking at least 2 weeks off. Daily use of English in a friendly international working environment. Private medical care, life insurance, sports card, meal allowance, language courses, a social fund budget, and various additional fun events in our office. Free access to our e-learning platform, featuring over 1,000 courses. Please attach an English version of your CV. We welcome applicants for who they are and value the unique perspectives, experiences, and strengths each person brings. We are committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive workplace where everyone can feel welcome, supported, and able to contribute.

We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are. Group Summary: Magna is an innovative leader in the development and manufacturing of high quality complete seating systems. Our solution includes seating structures, mechanisms and hardware, as well as foam and trim products for global automotive, heavy truck and bus industries. Our capabilities include market and consumer research; full concept development; design and engineering capabilities; testing, validation and world-class manufacturing. Our award-winning seating solutions are developed from consumer research, finding the ease of operation to be comfortable, convenient and connected. Job Responsibilities: Job Description: Magna Seating, one of the world's leading automotive suppliers, is looking for a Junior Controller for the newly established Controlling Shared Services Center. The person in this position will be responsible for supporting controlling activities in various business areas, collaborating with financial teams, and preparing financial reports. Responsibilities: Supporting the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports. Participating in projects aimed at improving financial processes and reporting. Performing month-end close process for a manufacturing entities Monitoring and ensuring compliance with reporting controls and standards: SOX, internal policies, accounting standards. Reviewing and ensuring the accuracy and completeness of financial reports and journal entries. Monitoring completion of close and post-close activities with emphasis on timeliness and quality. Reviewing flow of processes and identifying areas for improvements and enhancements. Propose and support implementation of routine tasks in controlling Requirements: A university degree in finance, economics, or related fields. Professional experience in finance or controlling will be an additional asset. Knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS/US-GAAP) will be an advantage. Very good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel; knowledge of SAP (FI/CO), BI will be an additional asset. Very good command of English, both spoken and written Analytical thinking skills and the ability to work in a team. Independence, responsibility, and good organization of work. We Offer: Interesting and diverse work in a dynamic team. Opportunities for professional and personal development in an international environment. Attractive employment conditions and benefits package. Hybrid work model (3 days in the office / 2 days remotely). Friendly work atmosphere and support from experienced professionals. Awareness, Unity, Empowerment: At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law. AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies. Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making. If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team. Worker Type: Regular / Permanent Group: Magna Seating

items.desc: ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL — we're the tech-powered growth partner for ecommerce brands, running 12+ owned fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, the UK, and Europe so our merchants can stress less and grow more. About the role ShipMonk is a fast-growing 3PL whose operations run 24/7 across Europe and the US. Our Security team covers compliance, incident response, identity, and security operations for the whole company. We're hiring an engineer who will work across all of these areas rather than specialize in one. Your time will be split roughly evenly between day-to-day operations and building the capabilities we don't have yet. AI is part of how we work. We expect you to adapt quickly and use AI tools to improve work efficiency and strengthen our company's security posture. What you'll do Security culture and practices: challenge existing development practices and drive a security-first mindset across engineering teams. Vulnerability management and penetration testing: identify and assess vulnerabilities in our applications through internal penetration testing. CI/CD security automation: build and maintain automated vulnerability discovery (SAST, DAST, dependency and secret scanning) in the CI/CD pipeline. Secure developer education: educate developers on secure coding practices so security issues are caught before code reaches production. Identity and access: own Okta security policies, Okta privileged access; audit integrated apps; run a regular access review cycle, secure access requests process. Incident response and investigations: triage, contain and analyse incidents; reconstruct timelines; provide evidence to Legal and HR; review reported phishing. Detection and monitoring: automatically read and process logs, and set up automated playbooks for our core tooling such as Okta, AWS, Snowflake, Google Workspace, and our ShipMonk app; build detection engineering and threat hunting capabilities. Cloud, SaaS and endpoint security: secure Google Workspace, SSO/SAML integrations and third-party OAuth apps; define MDM security baselines; give security input early in design decisions. Application security: understanding of vulnerabilities, patching, stakeholder management. Compliance and risk: support SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and ISO27001 security frameworks; coordinate penetration tests and follow up on remediation. Respond to customer security questionnaires; run vendor assessments and subprocessor management; maintain the risk register. AI-assisted security: use AI tools for investigations, log analysis, detection writing, automation and compliance work; help shape how the team uses AI safely and effectively. Awareness: run security communications, phishing simulations and tabletop exercises. What you bring 3+ years in security engineering, security operations or similar role Hands-on experience with incident response and log analysis. Strong IAM skills: Okta or a similar identity provider, SSO/SAML, MFA Experience securing cloud and SaaS environments such as Google Workspace, GCP, or AWS. Experience with a SIEM and writing detection rules. Scripting skills (Python or similar) and comfort working with APIs. Working knowledge of SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Hands-on use of AI tools such as LLM assistants or coding agents in daily work, alongside an agile mindset with a habit of learning and adapting. Fluency in English and the ability to push security work forward across teams. Nice to have: Vanta, Datadog, Snowflake, GitLab, or threat hunting experience. Why join You'll be building a security function, not maintaining one. Half your time goes to things we don't have yet: detection engineering, automated playbooks, threat hunting. You'll design them, pick the approach, and see them run in production. The scope is wide on purpose. You'll touch identity, incident response, cloud, compliance, and awareness in the same quarter, so you'll grow faster than in a team where one person owns one tool. Our stack is modern and real: Okta, AWS, Snowflake, Google Workspace, and our own ShipMonk platform, which runs warehouses across Europe and the US around the clock. We use AI in daily work, not as a slide in a strategy deck. You'll get room to try new tools for investigations, log analysis, and detection writing, and to help decide how the team uses them safely. About ShipMonk ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL; we're a growth partner for merchants . We provide cutting-edge technology and a network of owned and operated fulfillment centers that empower high-growth ecommerce and DTC brands to stress less and grow more. With over 2,500 employees across five countries, we're on a mission to revolutionize fulfillment by providing everything from the fastest click-to-delivery and real-time inventory to custom solutions—all with a merchant - first mindset. Why ShipMonk? We believe in building for the long term, and our success is powered by five key differentiators that help us become true partners to our merchants. Global Fulfillment …

Tworzymy rozwiązania z obszaru software, embedded systems i zaawansowanej inżynierii, pomagając klientom rozwijać produkty i systemy wykorzystywane w rzeczywistym świecie. Będziesz pierwszą osobą odpowiadającą wyłącznie za jakość. Zadaniem tej roli jest przekładanie zachowania modeli AI na mierzalne kryteria jakości, danych jakościowych na decyzje produktowe, a obserwacji z testów w terenie na priorytety badawcze. Testujesz zarówno oprogramowanie na sprzęcie, jak i to, jak brzmi wynik, a Twoja ocena ma realny wpływ na produkt. Budujesz jakość od podstaw. To pierwsza dedykowana rola QA, więc strategia testów, kryteria wydań, korpusy testowe i stanowiska akustyczne powstaną z Twoim udziałem. Twoje decyzje wpływają na to, co trafia do klienta. Definiujesz kryteria wydań dla kolejnych wersji SDK, a Twoje dane stoją za decyzjami go/no-go. Łączysz inżynierię, AI i produkt. Przygotowywanie i uruchamianie planów testów regresji dla każdego wydania: zakres, przypadki testowe, kryteria zaliczenia, wykonanie na sprzęcie docelowym i raportowanie. Ocenę jakości odtwarzanej mowy wyćwiczonym uchem i rzetelną metodą: zrozumiałość, naturalność, zachowanie tożsamości mówiącego, artefakty i opóźnienie end-to-end. Ocenianie jakości tak, jak słyszy ją użytkownik, a nie tylko tak, jak raportuje ją metryka, oraz uzasadnianie stanowiska, gdy te dwie oceny się rozchodzą. Przekazywanie zespołowi AI obserwacji z terenu wraz z dowodami, np. o warunkach hałasu, zachowaniu mikrofonów, opóźnieniach i przypadkach brzegowych personalizacji. W Etteplan szukamy Speech Data Engineera, który przejmie odpowiedzialność za pozyskiwanie danych głosowych dla technologii AI naszego klienta, od wyboru dostawców i protokołów nagrań, przez kontrolę jakości, po zgodność z GDPR. Rola w skrócie Obszar: pozyskiwanie i kontrola jakości danych głosowych (speech data operations, data engineering) Kluczowe technologie: Python, pipeline'y audio i metadanych, wersjonowanie zbiorów danych Główne zagadnienia: zarządzanie dostawcami danych, protokoły nagrań, kontrola jakości, GDPR i dane biometryczne, licencje i pochodzenie danych (provenance), współpraca z badaczami AI Środowisko: zbiory danych mowy w wielu językach, zewnętrzni dostawcy nagrań, zespół badawczy AI O projekcie i Twojej roli Dołączysz do zespołu klienta, który buduje działającą w czasie rzeczywistym, lokalnie na urządzeniu technologię audio AI. Przekształca ona szept, mowę bezgłośną i napiętą w czysty, naturalny głos, bez udziału chmury i z opóźnieniem pozwalającym na rozmowę. Technologia jest licencjonowana producentom sprzętu. Modele klienta wymagają mowy, której standardowe zbiory danych nie obejmują. Istniejące korpusy to głównie mowa czytana i dźwięczna, nagrywana w cichych pomieszczeniach przez osoby mówiące normalnie, a produkty klienta działają na mowie szeptanej, bezgłośnej i napiętej, w warunkach rzeczywistych. Dane te pozyskiwane są przez wyspecjalizowanych partnerów w wielu językach, a Ty odpowiadasz za to, jak dobrze są zaprojektowane, pozyskane i sprawdzone. Wybierasz dostawców i zarządzasz nimi, piszesz protokoły, według których pracują, kontrolujesz jakość dostaw i prowadzisz pipeline, który sprawia, że wynik jest użyteczny. Jeśli szukasz roli czysto związanej z systemami rozproszonymi, to nie ta. Jeśli chcesz odpowiadać za zbiór danych od początku do końca i zobaczyć, jak zmienia wyniki modeli, to właśnie ta. Dlaczego warto? Pracujesz nad problemem, którego nikt jeszcze nie rozwiązał. Nie istnieje gotowy podręcznik pozyskiwania mowy bezgłośnej w dobrej jakości i na dużą skalę, a Ty pomagasz go napisać. Odpowiadasz za zbiór danych od początku do końca. Widzisz, jak Twoja specyfikacja, kontrola jakości i decyzje o licencjach przekładają się na wyniki modeli. Masz krótką drogę od swojej pracy do gotowego produktu. SDK klienta trafia do urządzeń konsumenckich, a korpus decyduje o tym, jak dobrze brzmi wynik. Pracujesz w małym zespole, przy jednym stole z badaczami i dyrektorem produktu (CPO). Osoba odpowiedzialna za dane ma bezpośredni wpływ na decyzje. W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za: Pozyskiwanie zbiorów danych mowy od zewnętrznych firm zajmujących się zbieraniem danych: wybór dostawców, umowy zakresowe (SOW), standardy akceptacji, harmonogramy dostaw i budżety. Ustalanie specyfikacji paneli tak, aby każdy język był zrównoważony pod względem wieku, płci, akcentu i typu głosu, oraz sprawdzanie dostaw względem tych specyfikacji. Dbanie o to, aby dostawcy uczciwie płacili uczestnikom i jasno ich informowali. Pisanie protokołów nagrań dla każdego języka, według których działają dostawcy: zestawy tekstów, długość sesji i instrukcje dla mówców. Definiowanie macierzy przechwytywania (urządzenia, typy mikrofonów, odległość i warunki hałasu), tak aby korpus odzwierciedlał rzeczywiste użycie. Szacowanie skali każdej kolekcji: liczba mówców (w tym akcenty i emocje), godziny, zrównoważenie i koszt. Budowę i prowadzenie ścieżki przyjmowania danych (ingest) z automatyczną walidacją częstotliwości próbkowania, kanałów, przesterowań, głośności, stosunku sygnału do szumu, aktywności głosowej i wyrównania. Utrzymywanie schematu metadanych dla wielu języków, dostawców i sprzętu nagraniowego. Wersjonowanie zbiorów danych, pisanie notatek o wydaniach i zapewnianie powtarzalnych podziałów bez wycieku mówców między zbiorami. items.desc: We’re looking for a motivated student, recent graduate, or junior engineer who wants to develop their career in ship stability and naval architecture. You don’t need years of professional experience. What matters most is a solid technical foundation, analytical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, support stability calculations for various types of vessels, and gain hands-on experience in international shipbuilding projects. Key accountabilities Supporting the preparation of hydrostatic and stability calculations for various types of vessels. Assisting in the analysis of vessel weight, buoyancy, centers of gravity, and loading conditions. Supporting the development of stability models and technical documentation. Participating in intact and damage stability analyses under the guidance of experienced engineers. Assisting in the preparation of tank arrangements and watertight subdivision documentation. Learning how to apply classification society rules and international maritime regulations. Collaborating with engineers from different disciplines to develop safe and efficient vessel designs. Skills & experience Student or graduate of Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related technical field. Basic understanding of hydrostatics, buoyancy, and ship stability principles. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Willingness to learn and develop technical competencies. Good command of English (minimum B2). Polish language proficiency at least C1. Ability to work effectively in a team. Nice to have: First experience gained through internships, university projects, or engineering-related work. Familiarity with ship stability calculation software or CAD tools. Basic knowledge of intact and damage stability. Interest in shipbuilding and offshore engineering. Previous professional experience is not required. We welcome applications from students and recent graduates. What we offer Participation in prestigious international engineering projects with a high level of complexity. Opportunities for professional and technical development in an international environment. Support and knowledge sharing from experienced engineers. Work from Alchemia’s modern office in Gdańsk. Flexible working hours – start your workday anytime between 7:00 AM and 9:00 AM.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION The International Seller Services organization develops solutions, including the software platform and applications that drive demand generation, customer acquisition, seller integration, customer relationship management, and order management functions to enable our selling partners expand their business and operate across multiple Amazon stores globally. We are looking for a User Experience Designer who will work with Product Management, Engineering (science & tech), other product and business teams across Amazon to help us design experiences that will become a co-pilot in the growth journey of tens of thousands of Seller Partners as they sell on Amazon stores across Europe. The ideal candidate is a passionate yet pragmatic designer who can gather and synthesize customer data, behaviors, motivations and preferences to propose new solutions. You are experienced at combining qualitative and quantitative data and practices, and are expert at telling a cohesive story with your findings. You are responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open and collaborative peer environment. You have global perspective and experience leveraging diverse market and customer needs, educating a core product and business teams with this knowledge. In this role you will work closely with business stakeholders, software engineers and product teams to deliver complex, high quality, scalable products deployed around the world. Key job responsibilities Identify seller needs and design delightful solutions with measurable impact. Work with product team to develop high-level requirements. Create process flows, wire frames, and visual design mock ups as needed to effectively conceptualize and communicate detailed interaction behaviors. Develop and maintain detailed user-interface and interaction specifications. Present and defend design recommendations to partners, stakeholders, and senior leadership for review, feedback, and approval. Work with Tech teams to ensure a seamless implementation of designs and make trade-offs when needed while without compromising on core experience. A day in the life A Designer in this role is responsible for designing tools that will highly impact Amazon Selling Partners in Europe to provide excellent service and support to Amazon customers. This designer will meet regularly with representatives from product and engineering teams to gather product priorities, align on goals, interact with sellers to gather insights, design creative solutions, collaborate with partner UX teams and present concepts to cross-functional partners. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Experience in delivering design solutions as a UX designer or interaction designer Have an online portfolio or samples of work on resume, demonstrating experience creating great end-to-end, user-centered design solutions and patterns, across desktop and mobile devices Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar Bachelor's degree PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in mass-market consumer web / mobile products Experience working in a collaborative team and working directly with developers for implementation of designs Experience acquiring user data (e.g., conducting usability studies, performing user research) and creating personas and journey maps Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. items.desc: Job Information Number WEBWW-2026-000111 Job function R&D Job type Full-time Location Lliçà d'Amunt Country Spain About the Position Introduction Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong. Overview Performs statistics and data management support in accordance with applicable regulations and company policies and procedures, working closely with the R&D team. The position requires a degree of coordination and communication between the individual and the project team members including vendors. Occasionally interfaces with all levels of the organization. Responsibilities Key Accountabilities Supports the conduction of all research and development efforts with appropriate statistical planning, maintaining data and analytical integrity. Supports statistical aspects of regulatory submissions from design of clinical studies to support 510Ks and PMAs to analysis and reporting of results. Supports the company in meetings with regulatory agencies and prepare oral/written responses to statistical questions raised by regulatory agencies. Serves as a statistical analysis subject matter expert for assigned projects. Makes recommendations to resolve scientific problems encountered during experimental procedures to improve productivity of results. Ensures activities are consistent with project critical path, and responds appropriately to changing priorities or schedules. Collaborates in both in-house and external activities related to statistical programming and to the application of statistics. Collaborates with R&D, QC and Manufacturing departments for a continuous improvement system, but also on solving short-term problems. Provides statistical analyses in comprehensive written reports or sampling plans, as appropriate. Must be able to communicate statistical interpretation, approach and analysis in an understandable manner to people with little or no knowledge of statistics. Networking / Key Relationships This position requires cooperation with different company departments but especially with R&D Team, working together with scientists and occasionally managers and Directors. Qualifications Minimum Knowledge & Experience Required for the Position Education Required: Bachelor's degree (Diplomatura) or Master's degree in statistics or related sciences. Degree may be substituted by relevant skills and work experience. Valuable: Any additional degree higher than that required in the previous section. Knowledge in the biological or related sciences. Experience Four (4) years previous, if not, this statistician experience could be substituted by scientific/in vitro diagnostic research experience. Additional Skills / Knowledge Proficiency in basic software tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Knowledge of SAP preferred. Proficiency in R statistical programming is required. Languages: Fluency in Spanish or Catalan. Advanced knowledge of English (reading, speaking and writing). Skills & Capabilities The ideal candidate for this position will exhibit the following skills and competencies: Attention to detail and accuracy. Able to apply specialized statistical methods and theoretical knowledge to tasks within one area of expertise. Good teamwork and interpersonal skills. Ability to interact with other colleagues inside and outside project team. Oral and written communication skills. Time management skills in order to work on several different projects at the same time and prioritize tasks. Good analytical skills. Ability to work independently. Well organized, able to handle large data sets, and communicate results, problems, and progress to the supervisors, and within the group as required. Ability to adapt to R&D flexible and changing environment. Technical capacity to review data and reports and documents that are compliant with current company procedures. Reflects values of Werfen and Biokit in the quality of work and working relationship. Travel Requirements Sporadic travel will be required, not more than 10% of time. If you are interested in constantly learning and being challenged on a daily basis, we encourage you to submit your resume or CV. Werfen appreciates and values diversity. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer M/F/D/V. www.werfen.com

Best in class Join our very diverse team of sensory scientists, food technologists, statisticians, psychologists, sociologists, strategic thinkers, marketeers, field managers, technicians and other sensory and research experienced colleagues. We're proud to be part of the Eurofins Group World-leader in Testing for Life. Job Description Main duties and requirements The Fieldwork Co-ordinator is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of international fieldwork projects within SAM, either through InterCo or when fieldwork is outsourced to external suppliers. Acting as the key liaison between clients, internal stakeholders, and fieldwork partners, the role ensures projects are delivered efficiently, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Responsibilities include project planning and tracking, supplier management, budget oversight, issue resolution, performance reporting, audit support, and the identification and sharing of best practices to drive operational excellence. Project Planning and Feasibility Cost InterCo fieldwork using established ratecards or in collaboration with InterCo colleagues. Source, evaluate, and obtain quotations from external fieldwork suppliers when necessary. Recommend and appoint external suppliers based on project requirements, budget, quality standards, and capacity. Project Delivery & Management Manage the day-to-day delivery of projects from commission through to completion of data collection. Coordinate project kick-off meetings with all relevant stakeholders. Develop and maintain detailed project plans and timelines, monitoring progress against key milestones. Monitor recruitment performance against agreed quotas and project specifications. Ensure fieldwork is delivered on time, within budget, to the required quality standards and in line with client expectations. Manage project changes, including updates to timelines, scope, quotas, or recruitment requirements. Proactively identify project risks and implement mitigation plans to minimise impact on project delivery. Escalate project issues and delivery risks as appropriate. Stakeholder & Client Management Act as the central point of contact between clients, research teams, fieldwork teams and external suppliers. Provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. Liaise with research teams and clients to resolve any fieldwork issues to ensure smooth project execution and high levels of client satisfaction. Supplier Management Develop and maintain relationships with fieldwork suppliers across multiple markets. Monitor supplier performance against agreed service levels, timelines and quality standards. Conduct post-project evaluations and provide feedback where appropriate. Maintain awareness of supplier capabilities, strengths, and market coverage to support future project requirements. Support the onboarding, evaluation, and ongoing performance management of fieldwork suppliers. Financial & Performance Management Monitor project budgets and supplier costs, escalating concerns where necessary. Raise purchase orders and support the processing of supplier invoices. Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement Support audit activities to ensure adherence to agreed processes and quality standards. Ensure project documentation and supplier activities comply with company processes, information security requirements, and applicable data protection regulations. Identify and promote best practice, sharing learnings and improvements across internal teams. Qualifications Graduate level qualification (or equivalent experience). Strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. High level of attention to detail and organisational ability. Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment with time sensitive deadlines.

items.card: The Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute (IJC) is a comprehensive cancer research center dedicated to conduct research and drive innovation in the epidemiological, preventive, clinical, translational, and basic aspects of leukaemia and other hematologic malignancies, with the final aim of finding a cure for these diseases. items.desc: The Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute (IJC) is a comprehensive cancer research center dedicated to conduct research and drive innovation in the epidemiological, preventive, clinical, translational, and basic aspects of leukaemia and other hematologic malignancies, with the final aim of finding a cure for these diseases. It was created in 2010, and since then has experienced an exponential growth. The IJC is also part of the network of Excellence Research Centers of Catalonia (CERCA) and was accredited as a Severo Ochoa Center of Excellence by the Ministry of Science, Innovation, and Universities in 2024. Since 2018, the Institute has also been accredited by the Scientific Foundation of the Spanish Association Against Cancer (FCAECC) Additionally, IJC is one of the centers integrated into the Institut de Recerca Germans Trias i Pujol (IGTP) accreditation as Accredited Health Research Institute (IIS) by the Carlos III Health Institute (ISCIII) . The IJC's main headquarters is located within the Can Ruti Biomedical Campus, alongside other leading biomedical institutions, providing direct access to cutting-edge scientific and technological facilities, as well as complementary community services. The IJC has six locations integrated into reference hospitals : Hospital Germans Trias i Pujol, Hospital Clínic, Hospital Sant Pau, Hospital Josep Trueta, Hospital del Mar and Hospital San Joan de Déu. This facilitates close collaboration between basic and clinical researchers, fostering translational research that integrates basic science with clinical practice in clinical settings. The Josep Carreras Leukemia Research Institute is looking for a Laboratory Technician for the Chromatin, metabolism and cell fate group, led by Dr. Marcus Buschbeck in our Can Ruti Campus. RESEARCH DESCRIPTION Myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN), myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS), and acute myeloid leukemia (AML) are related malignant disorders of the bone marrow that disrupt normal blood cell production. MPNs are typically chronic diseases characterized by excessive proliferation of relatively mature myeloid cells, such as in polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, and primary myelofibrosis, and may progress over time to AML. MDS are marked by ineffective and dysplastic hematopoiesis, leading to cytopenias and an increased risk of transformation to AML, particularly in older patients. AML represents the most aggressive end of this disease spectrum and is defined by the rapid accumulation of immature myeloid blasts that replace normal marrow function, causing severe anemia, infections, and bleeding, and requiring urgent treatment. The Laboratory technician will be involved in several projects in the Buschbeck lab with the focus on multi-omic approaches to identify and characterize new drug targets and validate them in vitro and in vivo. MAIN RESPONSABILITIES Perform tasks within the Buschbeck lab focused on studying blood diseases. Support of the lab manager and other group members in multiple research projects. Implement experimental methods in molecular biology, biochemistry and genomics (ATAC-seq, RNA-seq etc.). Execute in vitro assays using both established cell lines and primary cells. Utilize specialized analytical systems, including flow cytometry. Conduct procedures with experimental animals following ethical and institutional guidelines. Support with experimental mouse colonies maintenance and mouse experimentation-related operations. WHAT WE NEED Professional degree as Laboratory technician (FPGS Laboratorio clínico y biomédico, Anatomia patológica or similar) or Degree (BSc/MSc level) in Biochemistry, Biology, Biotechnology or a related discipline (e.g. Biomedicine, Biomedical Sciences). Essential requirement: Accredited training (FELASA or equivalent, e.g. functions A/B/C) for working with laboratory animals, and at least two years of experience in mouse experimentation (do not apply if you don’t have that!). High motivation for biomedical research. Experience in tissue culture (cell lines and primary cells), and molecular biology and biochemistry techniques. Fluent English (all protocols and guidelines are in English). Experience in basic computer tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Pro-active, responsible and well-organized person. Attitude to learn and work independently. Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with other team members. WHAT WE OFFER Temporary contract (Indefinido por actividades científico-técnicas). This contract is supported/financed by “Subvencions per al finançament de projectes de recerca en medicina personalitzada EP PerMed, 2026-2028”, grant SLD173/26/000001 from the Departament de Salut (Generalitat de Catalunya)” Full-time contract. Training and development opportunities. Incorporation in a multinational and highly collaborative team. Mixed basic and clinical research environment of the Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute. Measures to reconcile work and family life …

Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled S4/HANA Consultant specializing in Logistics to design, implement, and optimize critical business processes within our SAP ecosystem. As an S4/HANA Logistics Consultant , you will be a pivotal member of our team, responsible for translating complex business requirements into robust, scalable SAP solutions. You will engage in the full project lifecycle, from initial concept and blueprinting through configuration, testing, go-live, and post-implementation support. This role demands a proactive individual who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and external partners to ensure project success and alignment with strategic objectives. We are looking for a professional who thrives in a dynamic environment, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and improve. You will be instrumental in driving the adoption of best practices, optimizing system performance, and ensuring data integrity across our logistics operations. This position offers significant opportunities for professional growth, allowing you to deepen your expertise in cutting-edge SAP technologies and contribute to high-impact projects that shape the future of our organization. Key Responsibilities Design, configure, and implement SAP S/4HANA Logistics modules (e.g., MM, SD, LE, WM, TM) to meet business requirements. Conduct detailed business process analysis and gather requirements from key stakeholders. Develop functional specifications for custom developments, enhancements, and integrations. Perform system testing, including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Provide expert support for incident resolution, problem management, and change requests. Create comprehensive documentation, including blueprints, configuration guides, and training materials. Lead or participate in workshops and training sessions for end-users and super-users. Stay current with SAP S/4HANA innovations and industry best practices in logistics. Collaborate with technical teams on data migration, interfaces, and system performance optimization. Qualifications Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations and/or support in Logistics modules. Strong functional knowledge of at least two core SAP Logistics modules (e.g., MM, SD, LE, WM, TM). Ability to analyze complex business problems and design appropriate SAP solutions. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Experience with full project lifecycle implementations (from blueprint to go-live). Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. SAP certification in relevant S/4HANA Logistics modules is a plus. Familiarity with Agile methodologies is preferred. Additional Information What do we offer you? B2B or employment contract Remote within CET Time zone. Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects. items.desc: IT-avdelningen vid Stockholms universitet består av ca 120 medarbetare som har ett övergripande ansvar för Sveriges största universitetets IT-miljö. Det innebär bl a att utveckla/förvalta/driftsätta och övervaka plattformar, system och tjänster som stödjer akademi, utbildning, forskning och förvaltning. Vill du arbeta i en miljö där kunskap står i centrum och där din expertis inom IT-säkerhet blir avgörande för att skydda forskning, studenter och samhällets utveckling? Vi söker nu en IT-säkerhetsspecialist som vill bidra till att säkra Stockholms universitets digitala miljö – idag och för framtiden. I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist ingår du i sektionen för Informations- och IT-säkerhet, SIITS, på IT-avdelningen. Du kommer att arbeta i en grupp som har fokus på IT-säkerhet och som arbetar för att hålla all IT på Stockholms universitet trygg och säker. Sektionen ansvarar för att säkerställa att universitetets samtliga IT-system uppfyller ställda krav på IT-säkerhet, belysa eventuella risker samt utforma och införa tekniska eller administrativa säkerhetsåtgärder. I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist agerar du andra linjens stöd i IT-säkerhetsprocesser och arbetar taktiskt förebyggande och ansvarar för att analysera krav, utforma och införa rutiner, processer och anvisningar inom området. Du kan också komma att bidra som stöd och expert i det operativa arbetet med att identifiera, värdera, analysera och agera på cyberhot mot Stockholms universitet. Mer information om oss finns på: IT-avdelningen. Arbetsuppgifter I rollen som IT-säkerhetsspecialist ansvarar du för att: Delta i sektionens arbete med att stödja den operativa verksamheten med expertkunskap från en taktisk nivå. Samarbeta med IT-tekniker, Incident Manager eller andra team för att utreda och hantera incidenter. Utföra initial triagering och bedömning av potentiella hot, inklusive indikatorer på intrång (IoC). Kontinuerligt bevaka loggar, nätverkstrafik och säkerhetssystem (t.ex. SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR) för att upptäcka misstänkta aktiviteter. Underhålla och optimera SOC-verktyg (SIEM, logghantering, EDR, IDS/IPS) för bättre täckning och effektivitet. Stötta projekt och ärenden som har behov av IT-säkerhetskompetens. Vägleda och följa upp de åtgärder som vidtas med anledning av identifierade sårbarheter från t ex säkerhetsgranskningar i samarbetet med förvaltningsorganisationen. Bidra i omvärldsbevakning inom IT-säkerhet, analysera, förmedla och rekommendera relevanta säkerhetsåtgärder kopplat till aktuella händelser, hot och sårbarheter. Granska lösningsförslag och tekniska lösningar. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har: Akademisk utbildning alternativt av arbetsgivaren bedömd motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av IT-säkerhetsarbete där du har haft en liknande roll. Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat under press. Kunskap om logghantering, SIEM-verktyg och EDR-lösningar. Förståelse för vanliga attacker och hot (malware, phishing, DDoS, insider threats). Grundläggande kompetens inom digital forensik och incidenthantering. Förmåga att analysera loggar och identifiera avvikelser. Erfarenhet av Windows-, Linux- och molnplattformar (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud). God förståelse för nätverksprotokoll (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S). Goda kommunikativ förmåga i både svenska och engelska, tal och skrift. God förmåga att dokumentera och kommunicera. Meriterande: Certifieringar såsom Security+, CEH, GSEC, GCIH, GCIA, GMON, GCDA, GSOC, GDSA, GCFR, eller liknande. Praktisk erfarenhet av incidenthantering, sårbarhets- och övervakningsarbete. Erfarenhet av arbete i en SOC, CERT eller liknande miljö. Tidigare erfarenhet som systemadministratör, nätverkstekniker eller liknande. Kunskap i script/programmering (t.ex. Python, PowerShell, Bash) för automatisering. Kunskap om ramverk som NIST CSF v2 och MSB:s metodstöd. Erfarenhet av offentlig verksamhet, gärna från högskola eller universitet. Personliga egenskaper: Analytisk och problemlösningsorienterad. Förmåga att arbeta lugnt och metodiskt under press. Noggrann, strukturerad och dokumentationsvan. Samarbetsinriktad men även självgående. Nyfiken på nya tekniker och hottrender. Om anställningen Anställningen gäller tills vidare på heltid med sex månaders provanställning. Stockholms universitet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi erbjuder Hos oss får du dynamiken i samspelet mellan högre utbildning och forskning som gör Stockholms universitet till en spännande och kreativ miljö. Du arbetar i en internationell miljö och får förmånliga villkor. Universitetet ligger beläget i Nationalstadsparken med goda förbindelser till city. Stockholms universitet värnar om att vara en arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika rättigheter och möjligheter för alla. items.desc: SEB is a leading northern European financial services group and one of the largest IT employers in the Nordics. We are looking for an experienced and driven Network Security Specialist with a strong background in firewalls and network security. As the banking industry continues its digital transformation, secure and resilient network services are more critical than ever. Our engineers play a key role in protecting SEB's infrastructure while enabling innovation and business growth. If you are passionate about network security and want to work with large-scale, business-critical environments, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. We are now looking for a Network Security Specialist to strengthen our team, with a focus on Firewalls, Routing/Switching and proxy technologies. About the role Design, implement, maintain and continuously improve SEB's global firewall infrastructure. Manage and develop network security services, including firewall policies, rule reviews, segmentation and security architecture. Troubleshoot and resolve complex network and security incidents across firewalls, routing, switching and proxy environments. Collaborate with architects, security teams and infrastructure specialists to ensure secure and scalable network solutions. Support SEB's cloud transformation by integrating network security solutions across on-premises and cloud environments. Drive standardization, automation and operational improvements to increase efficiency and reduce risk. Participate in security reviews, change implementations and lifecycle management of network security platforms. To thrive in this role, we believe you have Required: Solid hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting firewalls in large enterprise environments. Strong knowledge of network security concepts, including: Firewall management Network segmentation NAT VPN technologies Access control policies Experience with routing and switching technologies Understanding of proxy technologies and secure access solutions. Experience working with complex and business-critical network infrastructures. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Meritorious: Experience with automation and scripting using Python, Ansible or similar tools. Experience with cloud networking and security in AWS, Azure or GCP. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. Experience with Linux environments and Git-based development workflows. Experience in leveraging AI-powered tools to drive tangible improvements in operations, security, and automation. Relevant certifications such as Check Point CCSA/CCSE, CCNP, or equivalent. Experience of Network analysis What We Expect: A collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning from others. A proactive mindset with a strong focus on security, quality and operational excellence. Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks and deliveries. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams and technical domains. A genuine interest in continuously improving processes, security and operational efficiency. Availability Requirements: Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation during evenings and weekends. Participation in planned Service Windows and Contingency Tests throughout the year. What we offer Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment International opportunities and working environment Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits Do you want to be part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from. Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than November 24, 2026. If you have questions about the position, please contact Kenneth Eriksson Ehlers, hiring manager, at kenneth.eriksson-ehlers@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email. Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks. SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment. The employment is covered by collective agreements signed between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet. Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts. sebgroup.com/career bit.ly/SEBcareer .

items.desc: Vill du fortsätta utvecklas och vara med och forma framtidens mjukvara? På Nexer söker vi erfarna systemutvecklare som brinner för teknik, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och vill vara med och bygga lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Vi söker dig som har din styrka inom frontend, backend eller fullstack , och som arbetar med exempelvis Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript eller TypeScript . Du behöver inte kunna allt. Vi vet att riktigt duktiga utvecklare ofta har sina specialområden. Det vi värdesätter är en stark teknisk grund, nyfikenhet och viljan att fortsätta utvecklas. Som konsult hos Nexer får du möjlighet att arbeta med spännande teknik och varierande uppdrag hos några av Göteborgsregionens mest intressanta företag och organisationer. Vad kan du komma att arbeta med? Våra uppdrag spänner över flera branscher, från offentlig sektor till internationella produktbolag. Du kan exempelvis arbeta med att: Utveckla moderna webbapplikationer med React, Angular eller Vue Bygga skalbara backend-tjänster och API med Java, .NET eller Node.js/TypeScript Utveckla integrationslösningar och distribuerade system Designa och vidareutveckla affärskritiska applikationer och digitala tjänster Arbeta med molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP Bygga och driftsätta lösningar med Docker, Kubernetes och moderna CI/CD-flöden Påverka arkitektur, teknikval och arbetssätt tillsammans med team och kund Vissa uppdrag har ett tydligt fokus på frontend eller backend, medan andra innebär arbete över hela stacken. Vi har också uppdrag för dig som vill ta ett större tekniskt ansvar som exempelvis Tech Lead eller arkitekt. Gemensamt är att vi söker utvecklare som vill mer än att bara lösa nästa ticket. Du vill förstå problemet, diskutera lösningen och bidra till att bygga något som håller över tid. AI förändrar hur vi utvecklar mjukvara Vi befinner oss mitt i en stor förändring av hur mjukvara utvecklas. AI har redan blivit en naturlig del av många utvecklares vardag, och vi tror att förmågan att använda tekniken på ett klokt sätt kommer att bli allt viktigare. Därför söker vi dig som är nyfiken på AI och gärna utforskar hur nya verktyg kan förbättra ditt arbete. Kanske använder du redan GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude eller liknande verktyg för att skriva, analysera, felsöka eller testa kod. Har du dessutom experimenterat med AI-agenter, agentiska arbetsflöden, MCP eller egna AI-integrationer tycker vi att det är extra intressant. Du behöver inte vara AI-specialist. För oss är det viktigare att du vill lära dig, vågar testa nya arbetssätt och samtidigt förstår vikten av att kunna granska och ta ansvar för resultatet. Vi tror att framtidens bästa utvecklare inte bara är duktiga på att skriva kod, utan också på att förstå vilka problem som behöver lösas och hur tekniken bäst används för att lösa dem. Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som har minst fem års professionell erfarenhet av systemutveckling och känner dig trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du har gedigen erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av följande områden: Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript och moderna ramverk som React, Angular eller Vue Backend: Java, Spring Boot, C#/.NET eller Node.js/TypeScript Fullstack: Kombinationer av frontend- och backendutveckling där du är bekväm med att arbeta över hela stacken Vi tror också att du: Har god förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur, API, databaser och integrationer Värdesätter ren, testbar och underhållbar kod Har erfarenhet av agila utvecklingsteam och moderna utvecklingsprocesser Trivs med att samarbeta, dela kunskap och diskutera tekniska lösningar Är nyfiken på hur AI och nya tekniker förändrar utvecklarrollen Kommunicerar mycket väl på både svenska och engelska Som konsult behöver du också uppskatta variation, kunna sätta dig in i nya verksamheter och känna dig bekväm med att diskutera tekniska frågor tillsammans med kunden. Extra intressant är det om du har erfarenhet av Teknisk ledning, exempelvis som Tech Lead eller arkitekt Domain Driven Design (DDD), Clean Architecture eller liknande arkitekturmönster Molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP Docker, Kubernetes och DevOps Eventdrivna system, exempelvis med Kafka Säkerhet, autentisering och identitetshantering Testautomation och kvalitetssäkring Tillgänglighet och användarcentrerad utveckling AI-drivna utvecklingsprocesser eller integration av AI i applikationer Du behöver självklart inte ha erfarenhet av allt ovan. Det viktigaste är vad du är riktigt bra på, vad du vill utvecklas inom och vad du kan bidra med. Varför Nexer? Hos oss får du variationen och utvecklingsmöjligheterna i konsultrollen, men med tryggheten i en fast anställning och ett team bakom dig. Vi arbetar med kunder inom många olika branscher och har långsiktiga samarbeten som ger möjlighet att hitta uppdrag där både din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner kommer till sin rätt.
