items.desc: Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov. Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad. Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder. Arbetsbeskrivning Till en större offentlig organisation söker vi en Senior systemutvecklare som kommer att tillhöra en verksamhet med ansvar för verksamhetskritiska IT-system. Konsulten kommer att arbeta med utveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning av dessa system. Arbetet omfattar att analysera och omsätta verksamhetens behov och krav till hållbara, säkra och effektiva tekniska lösningar. Arbetsuppgifter I rollen ingår bland annat att: Utveckla nya system och lösa tekniska utmaningar. Förbättra och vidareutveckla befintliga system, bland annat genom uppdatering av äldre plattformar och deltagande i moderniseringsarbete. Arbetet omfattar både frontend- och backendutveckling. Arbeta med mobila lösningar och Windowsmiljöer samt andra tekniska miljöer som krävs för att systemen ska fungera. Samverka med andra team kring systemintegrationer, säkerhetskrav och leveranser med hög kvalitet. Felsöka, diskutera tekniska lösningar med kollegor och bidra med innovativa idéer. Vara en förebild i teamet samt coacha och stötta mer juniora kollegor. Bidra till utveckling och förbättring av teamets testautomatisering. Arbeta med kontinuerliga förbättringar av arbetsprocesser och prioriteringar samt bidra till teamets gemensamma utveckling. Stödja teamets agila arbetssätt och Scrum-aktiviteter. Ha kontakt med användare för att förstå deras behov och vardagliga arbetssituation, och därigenom bidra till att utveckla ändamålsenliga lösningar. Kvalificeringskrav (skallkrav) Minst 9 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av systemutveckling, företrädesvis med Java. Minst 3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av nativeutveckling för iOS-plattformen med Swift. Aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av samarbete i agila team med flera olika kompetenser. Minst 2 års erfarenhet av arbete på en IT-avdelning inom offentlig sektor. Erfarenhet av att utveckla lösningar som riktar sig till fler än 1 000 användare. God förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska. Meriterande kompetens (börkrav) Plattformar och verktyg: Windows, Linux, Jenkins, GitOps och OpenShift. Frontend: Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript och Struts. Databaser: MySQL eller motsvarande. Säkerhet: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS). Övrigt: Spring Boot, prestandaoptimering, testautomatisering samt AI/ML. Ytterligare meriterande erfarenheter: Erfarenhet av rollen som Scrum Master. Erfarenhet av arbete inom säkerhetsklassad verksamhet. Erfarenhet av arbete inom rättsväsendet. Erfarenhet av arbete inom offentlig sektor. Uppdragsperiod Startdatum: 22 december 2026 eller snarast möjligt efter godkänd registerkontroll. Slutdatum: 22 december 2027. Option för förlängning: Till och med 22 december 2028. Uppdragsgivaren kan nyttja hela eller delar av optionsperioden. Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder. Låter det intressant? items.desc: Job Requirements About the team As a Backend Engineer, you will build and run the services that connect Disney guests to new experiences across the company. The systems you work on talk to teams and platforms well beyond our own codebase. We write Go and we run on AWS. That is the shape of the work today, and everyone on the team has a say in where it goes next. You will build APIs, model data and take part in the trade-offs that keep our services reliable under real traffic. You will own features end to end, from design through to running them in production, with senior engineers alongside you when a problem gets hard. You will write down your reasoning so others can follow it and challenge it. You will work with the teams whose systems we depend on, inside Disney and outside it. You will ask questions early and make the decisions that are yours to make. One of our engineers describes the work and the team in this Life at Disney story: Leveling Up Video Gaming Experiences at Disney What you will do You design and build HTTP APIs and event consumers in Go, and you own their data models. You take part in resilience and rollout decisions and write down the reasoning, so the team can follow and challenge it. You own what you ship in production: the dashboards, the alerts, the follow-up. You give and take code review that makes the code and the people better. You improve the codebase, the tooling and the pipeline a little every week. We think you bring You have a few years of professional experience building backend services in production in a typed language. We write Go. It does not need to be on your CV, but you should be glad to make it your daily language. Rust, C#, Java, Kotlin or server-side TypeScript transfers well. You have worked with relational data and at least one of message streams or queues, and you have seen them fail. You test your own work and write clearly about it. You go deep on things nobody asked you to learn, and you have changed your mind about a technical belief. You enjoy working closely with others, including people who do not write code. You want to grow, and you want to help the people around you grow too. Nice to have: AWS, OpenAPI code generation, OIDC or Terraform. We will teach you the rest. Where you will be This role is remote. You can work from Sweden / Denmark / Norway / Finland. Travel may be required a few times per year, typically around 2–4 trips annually, depending on your location. Travel may include destinations within the Nordics as well as other countries. Disclaimer This position is with The Walt Disney Company Nordic AB, which is part of a business we call Disney Consumer Products. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

items.desc: Vill du leda och forma moderna dataplattformar – på riktigt? Hos Chief får du möjligheten att utveckla din expertis i ett innovativt sammanhang där vi tillsammans med våra kunder formar framtidens datadrivna lösningar. Som konsult är du vårt ansikte utåt och skapar konkret affärsvärde hos våra kunder. Vi söker nu en senior Produktägare inom Data som vill driva roadmap, prioritera krav och affärsvärde samt bygga skalbara dataprodukter i uppdrag hos våra kunder i Stockholm eller Örebro . Om rollen Som Produktägare ansvarar du för att driva och prioritera utvecklingen av en central dataplattform. Du sätter riktning, äger backloggen och säkerställer att rätt dataprodukter byggs – med tydlig koppling till verksamhetens behov och mål. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan affär och teknik, i nära samarbete med stakeholders, arkitekter och data engineers. Prioriterar backlog och roadmap för dataplattformen Driver kravarbete från behov till konkret lösning – från discovery till färdiga user stories Säkerställer att krav är tydliga, prioriterade och förankrade hos både verksamhet och utveckling Säkerställer att dataprodukter stödjer analys, BI och AI-use cases Arbetar nära utvecklingsteam (data engineers, arkitekter) Fattar prioriteringsbeslut och skapar struktur i komplexa miljöer Följer upp leverans, användning och affärsnytta Rollen ger dig möjlighet att påverka riktningen för strategiskt viktiga dataplattformar i organisationer med höga ambitioner inom data och AI. Vem söker vi? För att trivas i denna roll är du kommunikativ, analytisk och drivande . Du har en förmåga att ta ägarskap och hitta kreativa lösningar som skapar värde för både verksamheten och teknikteamet. Du är prestigelös och brinner för att förstå och forma datadrivna lösningar . Du är konsultmässig i ditt arbetssätt: lyhörd, lösningsorienterad och professionell, med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter och bygga förtroende. Vi ser att du: Har minst 5 års erfarenhet som Produktägare eller liknande roll Har arbetat med dataplattformar, dataprodukter eller data mesh Har god teknisk förståelse för dataflöden, arkitektur och system Är van att arbeta agilt (Scrum, Kanban) Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska Det är starkt meriterande om du har: Har erfarenhet av AI, machine learning eller avancerad analys Erfarenhet som projektledare Har arbetat nära data engineers eller utvecklingsteam Vilka är Chief? Chief är en ledande aktör i konsultbranschen med en stark familjär kultur där teknik och ledarskap möts. Hos oss får du: Uppdrag med verklig påverkan inom digitalisering, data och AI En miljö där vi satsar på din utveckling genom mentorskap, utbildning och certifieringar Ett starkt lokalt team – med globala möjligheter via Alten Group Vi kombinerar det bästa av två världar: den personliga kulturen i ett mindre bolag och möjligheterna i en global koncern. Vill du vara med och forma framtidens datadrivna lösningar? Då är vi rätt plats för dig! Skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev, eller något annat innovativt som uppfyller samma syfte. Intervjuer och återkoppling sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Vill du veta mer om Chief och rollen? Kontakta oss eller läs mer på vår karriärhemsida! Kontaktpersoner: Joshua George, TAP-teamet joshua.george@alten.se

items.desc: Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research? Robust data infrastructure, reproducibility, and standardized computational pipelines are the backbone of modern biological research. As part of SciLifeLab, a unique nation-wide research infrastructure and research community, the CRISPR Functional Genomics unit at Karolinska Institutet is looking for a Research Infrastructure Specialist in Bioinformatics and Data Stewardship Your mission You will spend roughly half of your time on building and maintaining reproducible pipelines for the in-depth analysis of high-throughput CRISPR gene-perturbation data. The remaining half will be dedicated to routine data administration throughout the data lifecycle, including metadata annotation, FAIR compliance for data sharing, and long-term archiving. Within this allocation, you will also support CFG and its users with day-to-day data analysis, management, and project delivery. More specifically, you will engage in the following areas: Pipeline Engineering & Quality Control: Implement, benchmark, and maintain containerized workflows (e.g., Nextflow/Snakemake) to automate standard QC of pooled CRISPR screens – standard readouts, single-cell based readouts, and soon optical pooled screening readouts. Hit Calling & Statistical Frameworks: Apply statistical models and algorithms to prioritize candidate hits across pooled CRISPR screening datasets, including base-editing datasets. Metadata Curation & Archival Infrastructure: Design and enforce structured metadata schemes, manage raw and processed data uploads to public/institutional repositories, and establish audit-ready archiving procedures to maintain long-term FAIR compliance. User Consultation & Project Management: Conduct technical consultations with external and internal research groups to define analysis requirements, troubleshoot user data issues, and deliver clear summary reports and interactive visualizations. Internal Computational Support: Maintain webpages and support the team in all computer- and virtual environment-related tasks. Eligibility requirements For employment as Research Infrastructure Specialist at Karolinska Institutet, the eligibility requirements stated in the Guidelines for non-teaching positions at Karolinska Institutet are applied in relation to the established profile of employment. To be eligible for an employment as Research Infrastructure Specialist the applicant must have demonstrated research expertise and been awarded a PhD or a qualification from a foreign higher education institution deemed equivalent to a Swedish PhD. The applicant must also have demonstrated technological and methodological expertise. In addition to these minimal requirements, eligible candidates need to meet the following requirements: PhD in Bioinformatics or Molecular Biosciences with at least three years of full-time wet-lab experience, and at least three years of full-time computational work. Proven track record in analyzing pooled CRISPR screening data, as well as single-cell data and spatial omics datasets with and without a perturbation context. Experience in image analysis and segmentation for OPS/spatial transcriptomics is viewed favourably. Proficiency in Python, R, and Unix/Linux (Bash) for omics data processing, quality control, statistical modeling, and interactive data visualization (e.g., Shiny or HTML-based dashboards). Experience with backend databases/UI, drive releases, CI/CD, deployment, and production readiness of scientific applications. Practical skills in High-Performance Computing (HPC) such as NAISS, or cloud environments using version control, containerization, and automated workflow managers. Experience with version control, Git/Github, structured code, and automated testing. Strong commitment to routine data administration, metadata tracking, and enforcing strict institutional compliance for FAIR data sharing and long-term archival. Fluency in English (written and spoken) with a client- and service-oriented approach to supporting researchers, managing user projects, and documenting computational pipelines. Familiarity with applying off-the-shelf biological foundation models and integrating LLMs/agentic workflows to automate routine bioinformatics tasks and data curation is advantageous. Assessment criteria Experience or expertise in any of the following areas will be considered an advantage, with particular emphasis placed on candidates who demonstrate a strong commitment to service, infrastructure maintenance, and routine data stewardship: Routine Data Stewardship & FAIR Compliance: Demonstrated experience in enforcing structured metadata schemas, handling routine bulk data submissions to public/institutional repositories, and maintaining strict, audit-ready data archives. Pipeline Maintenance & Execution: Proficiency in maintaining, troubleshooting, and executing existing containerized workflows (Snakemake, Nextflow, Docker/Singularity) for standard quality control. …

items.desc: By joining Bio-Techne, you’ll join a company with a powerful and positive purpose of enabling cutting-edge research in Life Sciences and Clinical Diagnostics. Bio-Techne, and all of its brands, provides tools for researchers to further treat and prevent disease worldwide. Pay range: CHF72,500 - CHF116,180 Placement within the salary range will vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity considerations. Job Summary The Junior QA/RA Engineer will support the Quality & Regulatory Affairs team at Bio-Techne’s Tolochenaz site for a 6-month fixed-term assignment starting January 2027. The role will help maintain and improve the Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001, and support regulatory compliance for life-science products under applicable chemical and product regulations. The role requires a good understanding of quality and regulatory principles in a regulated manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will handle day-to-day QMS activities, including non-conformity and CAPA management, document and change control, supplier evaluations. They will also contribute to technical documentation, labelling and product compliance topics such as CLP and safety data sheets, and help collect and report quality data for KPI. This individual will act as a practical point of contact on quality and regulatory questions for internal teams, turning requirements into clear, workable guidance. The role will work closely with Production, Research and Development, Supply Chain and Product Management to ensure timely resolution of quality issues and drive continuous improvement of processes and compliance. Key Responsibilities Support QA/RA team with the Quality Management System (QMS) of the company, to ensure compliance with ISO9001 Being the owner of some QMS processes Assist QA/RA and customer support team in complaint handling Assist the QA/RA team for the follow-up of quality processes (CAPA, KPI, Technical Documentation) Responsible of the technical documentation of some products Support QA/RA Team with Regulatory Affairs activities, to ensure Bio-Techne products meet all necessary regulatory requirements Work regularly with other departments to make sure product development meets quality and regulatory requirements Reporting to the QA/RA Manager on a regular basis Required Qualifications A degree in a Life sciences/Engineering related field and/or a certificate in Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs Understanding of quality and regulatory standard. Professional experience with ISO9001 or other QMS norms (ISO13485, …) in life-science environment English: Full professional fluency, French optional Skills At least 1 year of experience with mechanical devices, microfluidic chips and/or chemicals Autonomous and resourceful, able to deliver results with limited supervision Adaptable and comfortable in a fast-changing environment Enjoys working with people across different functions and disciplines Well organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple priorities and meet deadlines Fluent in written and spoken English; French and/or German is a strong plus Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Bio-Techne is committed to product quality, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, minimising environmental impacts and conserving natural resources. Environmental and quality management is an integral core value and a vital part of the Bio-Techne culture. Why Join Bio-Techne: We offer competitive wages along with extensive benefits for employees and their families. We invest in our employees’ financial futures through retirement programs and an employee stock purchase plan. We help our employees develop their careers through mentorship, promotional opportunities, training and development, internship programs, and more. We offer an international and diverse working environment, enriched by employee resource groups; volunteer and charity events; and employee events that build a culture of caring and belonging. We foster a culture of empowerment and innovation, where employees feel valued and encouraged to bring their new ideas to the table. Bio-Techne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. To protect the interests of all, Bio-Techne will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than a candidate application. Any unsolicited resumes sent to Bio-Techne will be considered Bio-Techne property. items.desc: INTERNATIONAL TELECOMMUNICATION UNION ITU is the leading United Nations agency for information and communication technologies, with the mission to connect the world. To achieve this, ITU manages the radio-frequency spectrum and satellite orbits at the international level, works to improve communication infrastructure in the developing world, and establishes global standards that foster seamless interconnection of a vast range of communication systems. ITU applies a zero-tolerance policy against all forms of harassment. ITU is committed to diversity and inclusion within its workforce, and encourages all candidates, irrespective of gender, nationality, religious and ethnic backgrounds, including persons with disabilities, to apply to become a part of the organization. Achieving gender balance is a high priority for ITU. Software Engineer Vacancy notice no: 2454 Sector: BR Department: IAP Country of contract: Switzerland Duty station: Geneva Position number: R24/P3/584 Grade: P3 Type of contract: Fixed-term Duration of contract: 2 years with possibility of extension Recruitment open to: External Application deadline (Midnight Geneva Time): 11 January 2027 ORGANIZATIONAL UNIT The Radiocommunication Bureau (BR) is responsible for the application of the Radio Regulations and for technical and administrative support of ITU World and Regional Radiocommunication Conferences, Radiocommunication Assemblies and Study Groups. The Bureau also carries out the international regulatory processes for registration of frequency assignments and satellite orbits and assists administrations in their coordination and implementation of frequency spectrum and orbit requirements as well as in resolving cases of harmful interference. It provides the specialised technical secretariat for the work of the Radiocommunication Study Groups and the Radiocommunication Assembly in the development of recommendations for spectrum utilisation and radio system characteristics. The BR is organised into four Departments: Space Services Department, Terrestrial Services Department, Informatics, Administration and Publications Department and the Study Groups Department. The Informatics, Administration and Publications Department (IAP) comprises of fourDivisions: Space Applications Software (SAS), Terrestrial Applications Software (TAS), Common Software Platform Division (CSP) and Business Operations and Planning Division (BOP). The Department is responsible for the development and maintenance of software and related tools used by the BR as well as software adapted for national frequency management units, providing the necessary user support for the areas concerned. It carries out studies related to policies for the technologies to be used for the information and computational systems within the BR and with administrations in the fields of management of the radio frequency spectrum and the various satellite orbits. The Department is responsible for managing all aspects of the BR's operations, including the development of BR operational plans, organizational support of ITU-R conferences and meetings, BR project management processes and procedures, BR text editing and publications, as well as promotion and membership. The Department is also responsible for human resources management and planning for the BR. ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT The post is located in the Common Software Platform Division (CSP) of the Informatics, Administration and Publications Department (IAP), Radiocommunication Bureau (BR). The incumbent contributes to the design, development, modernization and operation of software supporting the technical examination of frequency assignment notices and related regulatory processing, in accordance with the Radio Regulations and applicable ITU-R Recommendations. The incumbent works under the supervision of the Head of the Common Software Platform Division. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop and deliver complete applications end-to-end web and/or desktop clients, back-end services, APIs, and data stores from requirements gathering with domain experts through documented production deployment. items.desc: We are seeking a Lab Engineer to keep our materials synthesis and characterisation lab running reliably: maintaining and troubleshooting equipment, installing new systems, and managing our relationships with equipment manufacturers. Our scientists own the methods; you will make sure the equipment and facilities behind them are dependable and ready to use. You will be joining a small, highly ambitious team of world-renowned engineers, AI researchers, and materials scientists. We move fast and value people who are energised by that. What You'll Do Provide day-to-day equipment support: routine preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting issues as they arise. Set up our maintenance schedules, following progressive maintenance principles including owning spare parts inventory and purchasing strategy. Install and commission a wide range of lab synthesis and analysis equipment in partnership with the scientists who own the methods. Be our point of contact with OEMs for repairs and troubleshooting, establish and coordinate service contracts, and attend FATs at OEM sites for larger systems. Keep the lab’s robotic and automated analysis systems running at their best, from routine maintenance to diagnosing faults and improving performance. Look after lab services, including compressed gases (Ar, N₂) and chiller cooling water. Take ownership of selected instruments or experiments and maintain SOPs, maintenance logs and risk assessments. Skills & Qualifications Several years of hands-on experience maintaining and installing lab or industrial equipment, across a breadth of systems including analytical instruments and robotics/mechatronics. Working knowledge of mechanical, pneumatic, robotic, electrical and electronic systems, compressed gas systems (including Ar/N₂) and plumbing/water systems for chillers. A strong understanding of how a lab facility is built and put together. Experience working with OEMs on repairs, service contracts and equipment acceptance. A relevant engineering qualification is preferred, but not required with sufficient experience. Nice to Have Experience with any of our instrument domains: high vacuum, XRD, SEM, high-temperature metallurgy, or optical characterisation. Background in field service, semiconductor manufacturing, scientific instrumentation, or national laboratories. Familiarity with ionising radiation safety requirements. Experience in a startup or fast-moving research environment. Why Join Us Own the reliability of a broad range of advanced equipment across synthesis, characterisation and automation. Collaborate with world-class researchers across materials science, robotics, and AI. Help build a lab from the ground up: the processes, the culture, and the capabilities are yours to help shape. items.desc: Your mission At planqc , we are building scalable quantum computers based on neutral atoms — one of the most promising platforms for achieving real-world quantum advantage. As we expand our international presence and establish our operations in the United Kingdom , we are looking for a (Senior) Quantum Hardware Engineer to join us at this exciting stage of our growth. You will play a central role in bringing our quantum systems from concept to reality. Working at the intersection of atomic, molecular and optical (AMO) physics and engineering, you will take ownership of critical subsystems within our quantum computing platform, driving them from design through integration and operation. As part of our growing UK team, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across our international locations, combining cutting-edge research with practical engineering to develop robust, scalable quantum hardware. This is an opportunity to contribute to the development of our quantum technology while helping shape planqc's engineering presence in the UK. We are looking for experimental physicists who enjoy building complex systems, taking ownership and working in an ambitious, highly collaborative environment. Your responsibilities Take ownership of a key subsystem of our neutral-atom quantum computer, such as optical subsystems, laser distribution or quantum processor operation. Design, build and optimise high-performance experimental setups for neutral-atom quantum systems. Integrate your subsystem into the wider quantum computing platform, ensuring reliable and consistent operation. Collaborate closely with colleagues across physics, software, mechanical and electrical engineering to deliver integrated technical solutions. Drive continuous improvements in system stability, performance, reliability and scalability. Contribute to system architecture decisions and technical roadmap discussions. Work closely with our international engineering teams, sharing knowledge, expertise and best practices. Contribute to the development of our UK engineering activities as we establish and grow our local presence. What you bring A PhD in AMO physics, experimental quantum physics or a closely related discipline, or equivalent relevant research experience. Strong hands-on experience with lasers, optical setups and experimental quantum systems. Demonstrated experience designing, building, troubleshooting and operating complex experimental setups. Technical expertise in one or more of the following areas: Optical tweezer arrays and atom arrays Rydberg atoms or alkaline-earth atoms Ultracold atoms, trapped ions or ultra-high vacuum (UHV) systems High-numerical-aperture imaging and addressing systems Frequency- and amplitude-stabilised laser systems Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges and drive solutions independently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a practical, hands-on approach. Confidence working collaboratively across different technical disciplines and international teams. Nice to have Programming experience, particularly Python for experiment control, automation or data analysis. Experience with electronics, control systems or laboratory automation. Mechanical design experience, including CAD. Experience transitioning experimental research setups into reliable, scalable engineering systems. Previous experience in a commercial R&D, deep-tech or startup environment. Experience collaborating across geographically distributed engineering teams. What characterizes you You are a builder. You enjoy turning ambitious scientific ideas into working experimental systems. You take ownership. You are comfortable making decisions, solving problems and driving technical topics forward. You are curious and pragmatic. You combine scientific rigour with a hands-on, solution-oriented mindset. You are collaborative. You enjoy working with specialists from different disciplines and sharing knowledge. You are adaptable. You feel comfortable in an evolving environment where processes and structures are still developing. You are motivated by impact. You want to see your work contribute directly to the development of real-world quantum technology. Why join planqc At planqc, we are transforming pioneering research into practical quantum computing technology. Founded in Germany and built on world-class research in neutral-atom quantum computing, we bring together physicists, engineers and software specialists who share one ambition: developing scalable quantum computers capable of solving meaningful problems. Our expansion into the UK marks an exciting new chapter in this journey. By joining our UK team, you will have the opportunity to: Join at an early stage. Become part of our growing UK presence and contribute to its development. Work on cutting-edge technology. Build and improve neutral-atom quantum hardware at the forefront of quantum computing. Make a tangible impact. Take ownership of critical …

items.desc: The Hewitt Fertility Centre is seeking to appoint a medical laboratory assistant to join our highly skilled and dedicated team of 35 scientists. We provide the very best in patient care and offer a full range of therapeutic and diagnostic treatments (Including diagnostic, cryopreservation and donation programmes). The Hewitt Fertility Centre offers the very latest technologies for all patients treated in our state-of-the-art laboratories. Successful applicants should be personable with excellent communication skills. To assist the scientific team in the provision of diagnostic and therapeutic Andrology services provided by the Hewitt Fertility Centre. Ensuring compliance with the HF&E Act and HFEA Code of Practice (current edition) and all other prevailing legislation. To maintain a high-quality andrology service and to follow ISO 15189 standards to maintain UKAS accreditation. Assisting the scientific team to ensure efficient running of the diagnostic andrology service. This is a patient facing role that encompasses patient pathway and experience, stock management and equipment maintenance. Liverpool Women’s NHS Foundation Trust delivers the highest standards of care for women, babies and families. Each year we deliver over 7,500 babies, carry out over 49,000 gynaecological inpatient and outpatient procedures, care for over 1,000 poorly & preterm new-borns, perform around 1,000 IVF cycles and have over 4,000 genetic appointments taking place. We believe that this along with a strong dedication to research & innovation makes us the specialist health provider of choice in Europe for women, babies and families. We have some of the leading experts in their field, which has been showcased on national TV and news, making our teams famous across the world for professionalism, skill & compassion. The Trust is constantly innovating and evolving its services to provide the most cutting edge and modern care possible. As well as developing services on our current site we have long-term aspirations for the future. We have recently launched a number of new strategies which provide a detailed long-term plan for our services. Check out why Liverpool Women’s NHS Foundation Trust is a great place to work using the links below: Video: https://vimeo.com/556197652 Online brochure: https://www.liverpoolwomens.nhs.uk/media/4121/recruitment-pack-great-place-to-work-16pp-v4-final.pdf Main duties and responsibilities 1. To assist the Andrologists (and Embryologists) in the provision of diagnostic and therapeutic Andrology services provided by the Hewitt Fertility Centre. 2. To greet patients attending the Andrology Laboratory. 3. To effectively obtain requisite identifying information and other information from patients. 4. To arrange appointments, directly and by telephone, for patients attending the Andrology Laboratory 5. To prepare casenotes and packs for patients requiring sperm freezing. 6. To pull, track and file casenotes needed by the laboratories for treatment and audit purposes. 7. To receive, and appropriately direct, semen samples (produced on and off-site) from patients attending the Andrology Laboratory. 8. To receive, and appropriately direct, blood samples from patients attending the Hewitt Fertility Centre or other departments within the organisation. 9. To register patients on relevant systems in order to create appointments for patients prior to preparing and sending out packs for GP referrals, appropriate for post vasectomy, vasectomy reversal or fertility patients for Hewitt Fertility Centre and satellite centres. 10. To liaise directly and by telephone with the Andrologists, other members of the Hewitt Fertility Centre staff and hospital staff ensuring that information is conveyed to colleagues accurately and in a timely manner. 11. To consult the shared Andrology email inbox frequently on a daily basis ensuring urgent queries are dealt with in a timely manner. 12. To undertake the formal witnessing of procedures as required by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. 13. To perform a daily audit of all equipment to ensure that they are functioning correctly and within critical parameters. To assist with the maintenance of laboratory equipment and cleaning of the embryology and andrology laboratories. 14. To use relevant computer systems within the Hewitt Fertility Centre and trust wide. 15. To assist in the audit requirements of the Andrology and Embryology Laboratories. 16. items.desc: Job Title: Biomedical Scientist – Stem Cell / Cellular Therapy Laboratory Band 5 | HCPC Registered Biomedical Scientist An exciting opportunity has arisen for an HCPC registered Biomedical Scientist to join our stem cell transplant and Cellular Therapy Laboratory. This is a highly specialised role within an established Haematology/Oncology stem cell transplant and cellular therapy programme. Working in an HTA-licensed and JACIE-accredited laboratory, you will help deliver a vital clinical service supporting patients receiving haematopoietic stem cell transplants and advanced cellular therapies. The laboratory receives, tests, processes, stores and issues a wide range of cellular therapy products, including autologous and allogeneic haematopoietic progenitor cells. This includes products processed for cryopreservation, as well as fresh products issued directly for clinical use. The service also supports Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products, including CAR-T and TIL therapies, through the production of starting materials, and the storage and issue of final products for patient treatment. This is not a routine bench-based or research laboratory post. You will work across clean room facilities, cryogenic storage areas, and clinical environments, including wards and apheresis areas, to collect and deliver cellular products. This provides a unique opportunity to see the direct impact of laboratory work on patient care and to play an essential role in the treatment pathway. The post holder will participate in all aspects of the work of this specialist laboratory which provides a comprehensive service to the Haemato/Oncology transplant programme within the Trust. The cellular therapy laboratory team receives haematopoietic progenitor cells collected by apheresis, bone marrow and cord blood and processes and/or stores these for therapeutic use. Additionally, the laboratory calculates, processes and stores donor lymphocyte doses and is involved in clinical trials and treatments employing cellular therapies such as CAR-Ts. As a member of the laboratory team, the post holder will assist with cleaning and regular environmental testing of the clean room to ensure a suitable environment for the processing of stem cells and will also be involved in maintenance of the cryogenic facility. Traceability of cells from donor to recipient is of utmost importance so the post holder will be required to work with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail. The post holder will liaise with stem cell transplant programme clinical and ward staff, and work closely with colleagues in Immunophenotyping who perform stem cell enumeration and Microbiology who read environmental testing plates and cultures. The transplant programme is accredited by JACIE and holds a Human Tissue Authority licence for human application. The post holder will be expected to participate fully in meeting regulatory requirements and contribute to quality improvement within the department. The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust is a world-leading cancer centre. Our role is to offer our patients the best cancer care available anywhere in the world, and to continue to make a global contribution to finding better ways of diagnosing and treating cancer. We employ over 4,500 staff in a diverse range of careers including nursing, medical, science, radiography, pharmacy, occupational therapy, finance and administrative services. We have two hospitals – one in Chelsea, London, and one in Sutton, Surrey – as well as a Medical Daycare Unit in Kingston Hospital. At The Royal Marsden, we deal with cancer every day, so we understand how valuable life is. When people entrust their lives to us, they have the right to demand the very best. That's why the pursuit of excellence lies at the heart of everything we do. At the heart of the hospital is our dedicated team. We offer a stimulating and dynamic working environment, a wide range of staff benefits, learning and development opportunities and clear career pathways. There are opportunities to work flexibly across a range of areas and specialities and we welcome flexible working requests from point of hire to support employees work life balance. We are looking for employees who aspire to excellence, share our values and can play a crucial role in our on-going achievements. items.desc: Job Description UKI Finance RP Finance Data Scientist The practice Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role. Purpose of the role Advances the Decision Intelligence capability from driver-based planning and package configuration towards ML-driven forecasting. Owns the forecasting models from problem framing and data preparation through model validation, production integration, monitoring and adoption. The role works alongside the Planning & Performance Management practice and extends the range of propositions the practice is able to take to market, combining statistical rigour with finance-process understanding and decision-ready explanation. Responsibilities Build forecasting models on client financial and operational data, covering revenue, cost, cash, demand signals and underlying drivers, using appropriate classical, econometric, machine-learning or deep-learning approaches rather than a single preferred method. Prepare and validate multi-source data, engineer internal and external drivers, address seasonality and structural change, and model hierarchical relationships across products, entities, geographies or cost centres. Design rigorous back-testing and time-series cross-validation, compare against transparent benchmarks, and evaluate accuracy, bias, stability, calibration and business impact; reconcile forecasts across hierarchies where required. Run scenario and sensitivity analysis to a standard that supports CFO-level interrogation, including stress cases, uncertainty ranges, forecast interventions and causal or counterfactual analysis where appropriate. Produce variance explanation and commentary capable of withstanding challenge from an FP&A team, including plan-versus-actual decomposition, driver attribution, explainability, confidence and limitations. Integrate models into the client planning cycle and EPM platform to support operational adoption, working with Data and ML Engineers on pipelines, APIs, model registry, versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and controlled override workflows. Work with AI Engineers where forecasting intersects agentic workflow, including proactive variance alerting, hypothesis ranking and draft narrative generation, while retaining appropriate finance review and approval. Document methods, data, assumptions, model limitations and validation evidence, and measure whether the solution improves decision quality, planning efficiency or forecast performance in use. Essential experience Depth in time series and forecasting methods, spanning classical and modern approaches, with the judgement to select appropriately, including seasonality, external regressors, rolling horizons and model trade-offs. Python and the associated analytical stack, with experience of production or near-production deployment, together with SQL, Git, testing and reproducible analytical or ML pipelines. Strong understanding of forecast evaluation, including time-series cross-validation, back-testing, benchmark selection, error and bias metrics, uncertainty and stability over time. Experience working with large, multi-source datasets and implementing input, output and consistency checks that address data-quality risk in forecasting pipelines. Ability to explain model behaviour to a finance audience and defend underlying assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and the practical implications for decisions. Ability to work with FP&A, operational and technical stakeholders to align models with planning calendars, business assumptions, adoption workflows and measurable outcomes. At least 4 years’ relevant professional experience Desirable FP&A or financial planning domain knowledge, including driver-based planning, rolling forecasts, management reporting or variance analysis. Causal inference or uncertainty quantification, Bayesian or probabilistic forecasting, hierarchical reconciliation, optimisation or simulation. MLOps or cloud data-science experience using platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure ML, SageMaker or …

items.desc: About the role We’re looking for an experienced AI Education and Adoption Specialist to help colleagues get real value from the technology they use every day, with particular focus on AI. You’ll join our central Education and Adoption team as we build a joined-up, project-aligned approach to training, communications and adoption, and you’ll bring practical experience that helps shape how we do it. You’ll work alongside project teams so that training, communications and support are planned alongside each rollout wherever possible, rather than added at the end. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract. The role is based in Colchester, with travel to other offices as needed, and reports to the Head of Education and Adoption. What you’ll do Plan and deliver adoption activity for AI tools, including Copilot, Jylo, Lexus Protégé, CoCounsel and Leexi, taking colleagues from awareness to confident, responsible everyday use. Help colleagues use AI safely, within our policies and confidentiality obligations. Work with legal and business services colleagues to understand how people work and identify practical AI use cases. Run adoption activity across several projects at once, alongside project teams, prioritising where your time has most impact. Work with project and team leads to agree what good looks like within the time available, and be clear about trade-offs. Run training in person and online, from induction and rollouts to refresher sessions and role-specific learning. Write clear guides, short videos, e-learning, newsletters, prompt examples and tips that colleagues will actually use. Support pilots and releases with communications, feedback gathering and follow-up. Measure what’s working using usage, attendance and feedback data, and report on barriers and next steps. Support our champions network and keep training records accurate. What you’ll bring At least three years in technology training, digital adoption or change, ideally in a law firm or professional services setting. A working understanding of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot, including their limits and risks in a legal environment. A curious, hands-on approach to AI: you try new tools yourself, learn what works and what doesn’t, and turn that into practical guidance for colleagues, with the judgement to know which developments in a fast-changing field matter to their work. Strong Microsoft 365 knowledge. Experience working alongside project teams to a delivery timetable. Experience managing competing priorities across several projects, and the judgement to decide what matters most when time is short. Excellent written and spoken communication, with the confidence to work with colleagues at every level. Knowledge of instructional design and how to measure learning and adoption. Desirable Experience of legal technology systems such as NetDocuments, Clio Operate or Intapp. A recognised training qualification. Experience of change frameworks such as ADKAR or Prosci. Interested? If you're excited by the potential of AI, enjoy helping people develop new skills and want to play a central role in driving technology adoption, we'd love to hear from you. Details Type Fixed Term - Full Time Office Lawfront Colchester Office Location Colchester Salary Description Competitve Job Function IT - IT Training

items.desc: About us STRATOS builds the commercial digital twin that large industrial companies run on. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI. The role Build the core product that every STRATOS client runs on. You take what our Forward Deployed Engineers learn on the ground and turn it into features, tools and agents that work across every deployment. You ship weekly and see real users pick them up. What you'll do Build and ship product features that commercial teams at our clients use every day, from data models to user interfaces Turn one-off solutions into reusable product, working with FDEs and Commercial Product Managers on what keeps coming up across clients Build front ends, APIs and agents in TypeScript and Python, on Palantir Foundry and our own services Own what you ship, including how it's tested, deployed and monitored Improve the product by talking to users and watching how features get used You might be a fit if you Have 2+ years building and shipping production software Write strong TypeScript (React or similar) and Python Care about the user and can turn messy feedback into a clean feature Like owning a feature from idea to production rather than one slice of it Want to build product at a profitable, fast-growing company where your work is visible Nice to have Palantir Foundry, OSDK or custom widgets Data engineering with PySpark or SQL Building LLM-powered features or agents B2B SaaS or enterprise product experience Why engineers join us Big clients, small team. Some of the biggest names in industry, served by a team of 40. Your work reaches their leadership in weeks, not years. Own the stack. We fully control our stack and choose our tools. No committees, no tickets passed between five teams, no egos. Built to last. Profitable, founder-led and majority founder-owned, backed by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel), with our Series A still ahead of us. That means growth on our terms and real upside for early joiners. Learn from people who've done it. Founders who have run a $1B business, plus people from Palantir, McKinsey and BCG, all in the same room. In person, on purpose. Three days a week together in Farringdon. Fast feedback, fast decisions and fast shipping. items.desc: Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. Target Openings 2 What Is the Opportunity? At Travelers, we're focused on expanding the application of data and analytics beyond managing risk, helping businesses increase their productivity and efficiency and enabling great experiences for our customers and brokers. The Business Insights Delivery team aims to enable the business by building solutions that turn data in to insights with well-designed data assets and effective, compelling dashboards and visualisations. As an Analyst in Business Insights Delivery, you will support others within your assigned team and projects, while developing your data and insurance industry knowledge and building professional relationships across the enterprise. Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion. What Will You Do? Learn how to develop automate, compile, and prepare reports, dashboards, cubes, etc. a) Collection of data b) Integration of that data c) Development Developing knowledge of Business Intelligence products and tools. Learn how to complete root cause analysis. Learn how to perform solution design functions. Participate in the development of project plans and carries out assigned tasks. Assist in the execution of unit and integration testing; complete system testing as directed. (Completed with specific guidance on tasks to be completed and how to complete tasks). Validate results of the test with others Support the transition and production process; develops documentation for all deliverables before moving to production so that it can be supported on ongoing basis. Supports the creation of specification documents suitable to build production ready business intelligence reports and self-service tools Any other What our ideal candidate will have? Basic knowledge of Microsoft suite, SQL, statistical packages or other programs used to retrieve and analyze data. Written and verbal communication skills with the ability to pay attention to detail and effectively convey information to peers. Ability to follow through on tasks/projects. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. General knowledge of Data Analysis / Science concepts. What is a Must Have? Bachelor's degree in Data Science; Data Analytics or STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or a related field. Experience and/or proficiency working with programming language(s). Employment Practices Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. items.desc: We are seeking a Software Product Engineer to join our multidisciplinary team in London. You will design, build and maintain software across our product stack, from device-adjacent Rust and C++ through product services, internal tools and user-facing applications built with React and Tailwind CSS. We do not expect expertise in every technology. We are looking for solid engineering fundamentals, credible experience at both the systems and application ends of the spectrum, and the curiosity to learn where the product needs you. Requirements Scope and autonomy At this level, you are expected to own the delivery of well-defined product problems, navigate occasional ambiguity and help define requirements and plan delivery with support from the team, while becoming increasingly effective across unfamiliar parts of the stack. What you will do Cross-stack delivery: Build product features across Rust, C++, APIs, and React/Tailwind interfaces, selecting the right level of the stack for the problem. System integration: Create clean, testable interfaces between low-level control systems, product logic and user-facing applications. Product development: Translate evolving technical and user needs into pragmatic, reliable capabilities for our instruments, SDK and internal tooling. Production ownership: Take responsibility beyond initial implementation, including testing, debugging, documentation, observability, deployment support, reliability improvements and learning from failures. Collaboration: Work closely with product, embedded, R&D and hardware colleagues; participate actively in design discussions and code reviews. Physical product development: Work directly with our instruments in the lab, using logs, instrumentation and structured investigation to reproduce and resolve software and system issues. Learning and experimentation: Explore unfamiliar parts of the stack and use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate learning, prototyping and delivery. What we are looking for Required Professional engineering experience: Demonstrable experience shipping and supporting software, with strong fundamentals in design, version control, testing, debugging and code review. Breadth across the stack: Hands-on experience in at least one systems-oriented language such as Rust or C++, plus experience with web or application technologies such as React, TypeScript or similar. Depth in every technology is not required. Learning agility: Evidence that you can become productive in unfamiliar technologies and are motivated by working across boundaries. Product mindset: Comfort balancing technical quality, reliability and maintainability with pragmatic, user-centred delivery. Comfort with ambiguity: Able to make progress as requirements evolve through user feedback, experiments and learning from the behaviour of physical systems. Collaborative working: Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively across software, hardware, product and research disciplines. Engineering judgement with AI: Practical, positive experimentation with AI development tools while retaining the ability to reason about, test, debug and take ownership of the resulting code. Foundations: Strong software engineering fundamentals demonstrated through professional experience, education or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Frontend depth: Experience with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS or desktop/web application development. Systems and devices: Experience with Rust, C++, embedded or device-adjacent software, SDKs or hardware integration. High-integrity systems: Experience or interest in reliability and traceability requirements, including 21 CFR Part 11, GLP, ISO 27001 or ISO 17025. Data and intelligence: Experience with SQL, computer vision, ML techniques, local data capture or cloud integration. Domain interest: Experience in acoustics, robotics, scientific instruments or life-sciences lab automation. What success looks like In your first 6–12 months, we would expect you to: Product delivery: Ship meaningful, reliable product functionality and support it in use. Cross-stack growth: Contribute productively in more than one part of the stack and become effective in unfamiliar technologies when needed. System understanding: Develop a clear understanding of how device software, product logic, data and user-facing applications work together. Engineering improvement: Make a tangible contribution to reliability, testing, tooling, documentation or developer experience. Collaboration & engineering practice: Work effectively across disciplines, sharing knowledge and contributing to code reviews, testing, documentation and other practices that improve the quality and maintainability of our software. Benefits How we think about AI-assisted development We value engineers who actively explore how AI coding assistants, agents and AI-supported analysis can improve their effectiveness, and who can give examples of using them in real development work. …

items.desc: r We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join HydraB in Oxford and build the data foundations behind analytics across the whole Group. If you’ve built production pipelines yourself, enjoy messy real-world data, and can explain what you’ve built to someone who’s never written a line of SQL, this one’s for you. The UK’s zero-emission transport sector is being built right now. HydraB is at the centre of it - developing the vehicles, hydrogen infrastructure, power systems and energy services that move decarbonisation from ambition to operational reality across bus, coach, fleet and energy markets. That means a lot of data. Vehicle telematics, chargers, energy systems, hydrogen production and fleet operations, all feeding into a platform built on Microsoft Azure and Snowflake. We also work closely with WTech, the Wright Technology and Research Centre at Queen’s University Belfast, on machine learning and advanced modelling. The data is there. We need someone to make it reliable, joined up and trusted. This is a hands-on engineering role with real autonomy and plenty of variety. You’ll own the pipelines and models that the business and our research partners rely on, and you’ll have the freedom to shape how things are built. You’ll support teams right across the Group, from engineering and operations to commercial. There’s no shortage of appetite for good data here, so you’ll help decide what matters most and explain trade-offs in plain English. Reporting to the Head of Data Engineering, this is a permanent role based in Oxford a minimum of 3 days a week (more time on site is welcome). ’ Build and run production pipelines that bring in, clean and join up real-world data from vehicles, chargers, energy systems and operations Design data models in Snowflake that power reporting, Total Cost of Ownership modelling and WTech’s machine learning research Deploy and manage data resources in Azure, with orchestration, monitoring and alerting so failures get spotted fast Help shape a scalable architecture (medallion-style raw, curated and consumption layers) as the platform grows Agree data contracts and metric definitions with researchers and business teams, so everyone works from the same numbers Work with teams across the Group to understand what they need, agree priorities and be clear about what can be delivered and when Turn technical detail into something a commercial or operations lead can understand and act on Keep documentation clear and improve how we build, test and ship data ’ Have hands-on, commercial data engineering experience, with production pipelines you’ve built and supported yourself Are strong in Python and SQL, and write clean, tested, maintainable code Have worked with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including designing downstream data models Have used a cloud platform, ideally Azure, and orchestration tooling like Azure Data Factory, Airflow or Prefect Have a STEM or quantitative background and can engage confidently with researchers on modelling assumptions Can explain a technical problem to a non-technical stakeholder without losing them Enjoy working with a range of stakeholders, building trust and helping them prioritise what matters most Are comfortable working autonomously and taking ownership from a loose brief A background in telematics, transport, automotive, energy or heavy industry dbt for in-warehouse transformation and testing CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) Experience working with research institutions or academic partners Exposure to machine learning pipelines or supporting data science teams Pension items.desc: Torbay and South Devon Foundation Trust is offering the opportunity to combine a rewarding job in oncology with an unrivalled lifestyle in the heart of one of the most beautiful areas of the country. We are looking to recruit a clinical fellow, initially on a 12month fixed term contract with the possibility of the posts becoming substantive. The post holder will be responsible for delivering general internal medicine expertise on the oncology ward, and support the delivery of the acute oncology service across the trust through leading the development on an oncology day case emergency service (ODEC). Candidates are not expected to have received specialist training in oncology but should demonstrate enthusiasm to deliver new ways of working to improve the quality of care offered to patients receiving cancer care at Torbay. The post-holder will work closely with the wider oncology team, comprising of consultant oncologists, specialist registrars, speciality doctors and the existing nurse led acute oncology service. We encourage post holders to take an active role in research and development and to participate in the teaching programs of the department. The post holder will work primarily in the in-patient setting however there will be opportunities for developing an interest in the Non-Site Specific/Malignancy of Unknown Origin clinics. The main duties of the post will be to: Work with the senior management team to develop, implement, and evaluate new pathways of same day care for patients on active cancer treatments Provide general medicine expertise on the oncology ward Support shared decision making, advance care planning and discharge planning for in-patients on the oncology ward Provide education and training on issues related to general medicine, multimorbidity and geriatric syndromes for the wider multidisciplinary cancer teams Nationally, there is increasing focus on Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC). In many acute hospitals there are now dedicated oncology SDEC models which can potentially avoid unnecessary overnight admission with early input from acute oncology team. This new post is dedicated to developing this service for the local population of Torbay. Referrals are anticipated to be primarily from the dedicated telephone triage service supporting known patients having active treatment but will also aim to stream patients from ED and AMU. Why Work With Us Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust is an Integrated Care Organisation providing acute health care services from Torbay Hospital, community health services and adult social care. The Trust runs Torbay Hospital as well as five community hospitals, stretching from Dawlish to Brixham. Torbay Hospital is a medium-sized, progressive and innovative District General Hospital providing acute services to South Devon with a 10-bedded Critical Care Unit, six general theatres, three orthopaedic theatres and a day surgery unit. We provide services in most specialties within Torbay but have close working relationships with Royal Devon University Healthcare (Exeter and North Devon) and University Hospitals Plymouth. We have around 500,000 face-to-face contacts with patients in their homes and communities each year and see over 78,000 people in our A&E department annually. We serve a resident population of approximately 375,000 people, plus about 100,000 visitors at any one time during the summer holiday season. The role involves methods and software development to support the development of our software and nuclear data products, perform complex technical analyses and deliver technical training. The nuclear industry is moving away from traditional reactor designs towards new small modular reactor (SMR) and advanced modular reactor (AMR) designs, claiming improved safety features and lower build costs. The medical world is using new radiation therapies such as proton beam therapy and flash radiotherapy to treat complex cancers. The space industry is pushing the envelope on future mission profiles, increasing demands on shielding capabilities for both people and equipment. These new concepts bring exciting new modelling challenges and require the introduction of innovative approaches in mathematics, physics, engineering and software development. The ANSWERS® Software Service has, for almost 40 years, provided customers with high quality software and consultancy services in nuclear criticality, reactor physics, radiation shielding, dosimetry and nuclear data. ANSWERS codes are widely used in more than 30 countries around the world. Our global customer base helps us to stay at the forefront of nuclear code use and develop solutions that can be applied to all reactor systems and all stages of the fuel lifecycle. The insights gained from our interactions with customers are embedded in the software and applications we develop, used around the world, across our full range of engineering services. ANSWERS are looking for an enthusiastic and innovative individual with strong experience in Monte Carlo simulations to work in a variety of technical teams, developing and maintaining our state-of-the-art computational analysis codes, and assisting with analysis work for a broad range of established and cutting-edge reactor designs, clinical treatments and space shielding applications. This role will present excellent opportunities for an individual looking to deepen their skills and experience in radiation transport physics. This knowledge will be applied on projects in nuclear engineering, medical physics and space shielding. The projects will provide professional development in leading technical work and collaborating with industry, academia and the international community, from small teams to large interdisciplinary projects. This role will be based at either our Dorchester or Warrington offices, with the opportunity to travel to client sites, conferences and workshops etc. as required. items.desc: Recruitment incentive/Golden Hello : £20K We are seeking to appoint an innovative and dynamic Consultant in Stroke Medicine to be involved in the delivery and development of stroke and TIA services across Herefordshire. Stroke and TIA services in Herefordshire and Worcestershire have changed significantly over the last 10 years, with centralisation of Hyper Acute and Acute stroke services in Worcestershire at the Worcestershire Royal Hospital site in 2013 and the integration of hyper acute (6 bedded HASU), acute and rehabilitation stroke services at the Hereford Hospital site. These changes have resulted in improvements to stroke services across the Integrated Care System. Hereford Hospital has consistently achieved a SSNAP A or B rating. The post will be key to delivering the ICS vision for stroke and TIA services across Herefordshire and Worcestershire. The individual will work with senior colleagues and executives in the development of an integrated service model for stroke and TIA across the ICS. Wye Valley NHS Trust, on behalf of the ICS, is therefore seeking to recruit a Consultant in Stroke Medicine to contribute energy, quality and ideas to the delivery and development of this critical clinical service, working closely with the clinical, nursing and therapy teams in Hereford to deliver face to face and remote clinical and consultant expertise. Take responsibility for own actions and decisions within the empowerment limits agreed by the consultant team lead and Clinical Director. Contribute to the development of services and staff, participating in teaching of medical undergraduate and doctors in training. Contribute to the departmental audit, research and patient safety and quality agenda. Perform any other duties that considered necessary for the efficient working of the service and mutually agreed to be relevant to the post as the pattern of service evolves. Required to cover for colleagues during normal periods of leave. Professional supervision and management of junior medical staff. The remainder of the appointee's professional time will be deployed flexibly on other clinical duties, administration, teaching, research, clinical audit etc. Wye Valley NHS Trust is a member of an NHS Foundation Group with South Warwickshire NHS FT , the George Eliot Hospital NHS Trust and Worcestershire Acute Hospitals NHS Trust. Located on the border with Wales in the shadow of the Black Mountains, we provide acute and community services across Herefordshire and into parts of Powys and run Hereford County Hospital and the community hospitals in Bromyard, Leominster and Ross-on-Wye. Worcestershire is our neighbouring county. The post holder will be required to travel between sites. We are a progressive and forward looking trust with ambitious plans to improve quality and integrate patient pathways through close collaborative working with our partners to deliver the quality of care we’d want for our family and friends. items.desc: The department of Thoracic Surgery at Wythenshawe Hospital is recruiting a Locum Consultant Thoracic Surgeon, to work alongside our specialised and experienced Thoracic Surgical, Respiratory and Oncology team in the Lung Cancer Directorate. The post is a whole-time equivalent position at Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust and based at the Wythenshawe Hospital Site. Applicants should have substantial experience in general thoracic surgery, including trauma/ minimally invasive techniques and managing patients with thoracic malignancies and pleural disease. The post is to join 8 substantive appointments within the multi-specialty Directorate of Lung Cancer & Thoracic Surgery. There is a major focus on early detection, accelerating access to thoracic surgery, thoracic trauma, and delivering expansion of the GM Lung Cancer Screening Programme. The Department of Thoracic Surgery is one of the largest in the UK with access to a high-volume complex practice supported by a nationally leading multidisciplinary team. Extensive opportunities exist for service development, education and research and applicants should expect to have substantial experience and track record for delivery. Applicants should also possess a clear philosophy on their potential contribution to augment and advance the current departmental standards and activity. The team operates a ‘Consultant of the Week’ model, with responsibility for the daily triage of referrals, listing schedule review, and daily Board & Ward Rounds. All Consultants will have access to outpatient clinics, a broad MDT portfolio (including lung cancer, mesothelioma, airway management, sarcoma, emphysema) and 1.5 flexible operating days per week over 8 weeks. Participation in the thoracic surgery on-call rota, ward cover, and management of admissions from A&E, general wards, the major trauma centre and inter-hospital transfers is expected. The post holders will be actively involved in the organisation, preparation and delivery of the MDTs and have collective responsibility for delivery of accelerated pathways. As part of this post along with other colleagues, the post holders will provide support and guidance to the team consisting of specialist registrars, senior clinical fellows, specialist nurses, physiotherapists, OT, Dietician, lung physiologists, and other junior medical staff. The appointees will take an active role in medical education and will be expected to take on the role of educational/ clinical supervisor for trainees, as well as being encouraged to participate in teaching undergraduates and postgraduates, and to participate in departmental audit, research, governance, and service development. The post-holder will have 1.5 SPAs per week to facilitate these activities.
