Qualität messbar machen. Du baust Evals, Datasets und automatisierte Prüfungen, mit denen wir vor jedem Release wissen, ob ein Agent richtig arbeitet. „Das Modell kann das schon“ ist bei uns eine Hypothese, die ein Eval prüft. Wissen auffindbar machen. Du bereitest Dokumente, Regelwerke und Wissen so auf, dass Agenten sie zuverlässig finden und korrekt zitieren. Lösungen wiederverwendbar machen. Eignet sich eine Lösung für mehr als einen Use Case, machst du daraus eine Komponente der Plattform. Verantwortung übernehmen. Du verantwortest deine Lösungen von der Anforderung bis zur Übergabe an den Kunden. Wie wir arbeiten. Projektteams auf Zeit. Wir haben keine festen Teams, sondern Vorhaben. Jedes hat genau eine verantwortliche Person, ein Team, ein Ergebnis und ein Enddatum. Prompts sind Code. Its assessments cover more than 130,000 companies across 175 countries, and large international corporations use them to evaluate the environmental, social and ethical performance of their suppliers. The role sits within its AI Center of Excellence, a team of more than 20 scientists and engineers. This is an engineering position It does not include model development. Responsibilities Model productionisation: turn data science models into optimised, production-grade services, and work with scientists through the handover process. ML pipelines: design and maintain end-to-end pipelines that apply MLOps and LLMOps best practices. Monitoring: set up performance monitoring, drift detection and alerting for models in production. Infrastructure: manage infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines and containerised deployments. Engineering standards: help define and maintain the team’s engineering practices. Requirements At least 6 years of experience in ML engineering, including experience from before the generative AI era A background in software or backend engineering Proven experience deploying, serving and monitoring ML models in production Advanced proficiency in Python Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and observability tools Experience with MLflow and with relational and non-relational databases Cloud experience, preferably with Azure (Azure ML, Azure Foundry, Bicep) and Databricks Experience working with data scientists to deliver models to production Eligibility to work in Spain (visa sponsorship is not available) Who should apply? Experienced ML engineers with a software engineering background who have built and maintained ML systems in production, ideally in a product-led, fast-paced environment. The role suits candidates who want to focus on the engineering and infrastructure that bring models into production rather than on developing the models themselves. Nice to have: production experience with Azure or Databricks, and contributions to open-source projects.

items.desc: A Wattek Solutions está a recrutar um(a) AI / Machine Learning Engineer para uma equipa de Framework e Research, responsável por construir, treinar e colocar em produção diferentes tipos de modelos de Machine Learning em serviços partilhados por várias áreas de produto. Vais trabalhar com Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow ou scikit-learn e serviços de IA em cloud, com práticas de MLOps. Requer 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, 3 em Machine Learning e inglês fluente. Principais responsabilidades: Construir, treinar e avaliar diferentes tipos de modelos de ML, como classificação, regressão, séries temporais, deteção de anomalias ou visão computacional. Desenvolver pipelines de ML em Python e colocar modelos em produção através de APIs, cloud endpoints ou batch pipelines. Monitorizar modelos em produção, com versionamento, experiment tracking e retreino quando necessário. Contribuir para soluções com LLM e levar projetos de IA da prova de conceito à produção, com Product Owners e equipas de engenharia. Requisitos obrigatórios: Engenharia de software: pelo menos 5 anos de experiência profissional, com microserviços e bases de dados. Machine Learning: pelo menos 3 anos de experiência hands-on, com Python forte para dados, modelos e pipelines. Modelos: experiência a construir, treinar e colocar em produção pelo menos 2 tipos de modelos de ML além de LLM/RAG, com PyTorch, TensorFlow ou scikit-learn. Cloud e MLOps: deploy de modelos em Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud, com Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD e monitorização em produção. Comunicação: inglês fluente. Requisitos valorizados: C#/.NET ou Java/Spring Boot. LLMs: Transformers, Hugging Face ou prompt engineering. Model drift, feature stores ou model registries. Certificações de cloud ou IA, ou experiência com dados regulados. Modelo híbrido no Porto, com 4 dias por semana no escritório.

items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Stripe’s Education Partnerships team creates meaningful learning and engagement opportunities for students. We collaborate with educational institutions and community partners to design experiences that welcome students and help them explore future possibilities.
 The team plans and delivers education initiatives and events of varying sizes, including the Stripe Young Scientist and Technology Exhibition (YSTE), University of Limerick’s Immersive Software Engineering (UL ISE), and Irish Mathematical Trust (IMT).
 What you’ll do 
 As an Education Partnerships Coordinator, you’ll help bring Stripe’s education events and initiatives to life. You’ll work closely with the program lead and internal and external partners to design student experiences, coordinate events, and ensure that participants feel welcomed and supported.
 This role offers the opportunity to build expertise in education programming and event delivery while gradually taking on more complex projects and responsibilities.
 Responsibilities 
 Create and project manage meaningful experiences for the student community through events and other engagement activities

The ProServe Deal Structurer will be expected to collaborate with AWS Strategic Customer Engagement (SCE) teams, ProServe Account Executives, Delivery Consultants and Account Teams to drive customer success and business growth. This is a fast-paced environment, requiring adaptability and the ability to manage multiple complex engagements in parallel, often with tight timelines. 
Your experience in selling services within the technology/consulting sector, will equip you with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for customers. You will demonstrate proficiency in technical architecture, solutioning and migration programs. Your success will be measured by bookings, revenue, deal margin and cycle time.

- Co-own the sales-to-delivery handover so the engagement is delivered as sold.
- Advocate for the customer while managing AWS commercial and delivery risk.
A day in the life
As a Principal ProServe Deal Structurer, your day will involve shaping the strategic direction for AWS’s most significant and complex enterprise customers across EMEA. You’ll collaborate with high-level internal stakeholders, including Sales, Solutions Architecture, and ProServe leadership, to drive innovation and cloud adoption strategies that align with your customers’ long-term business goals. A significant portion of your time will be spent leading strategic engagements with C-level executives and ProServe teams, using your deep expertise to influence enterprise-wide cloud transformations.
You will lead the development of advanced tools and solutions that not only accelerate the pre-sales cycle but also set new standards for how AWS services are delivered across large-scale enterprises. Furthermore, you will play a critical role in expanding the organizational capability of AWS strategic programs by defining best practices, setting strategic priorities, and mentoring senior technologists.
About the team
Principal ProServe Deal Structurers at AWS are the strategic masterminds behind cloud transformations, setting new standards across industries. With unmatched technical expertise and leadership, they drive large-scale initiatives that deliver extraordinary business value for our most critical enterprise customers. As architects of the future, they lead complex customer engagements, crafting innovative solutions that push the boundaries of what’s possible. They also play a crucial role in defining AWS’s strategic direction, ensuring we remain at the forefront of cloud technology.

items.desc:
The Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to join our team. We build and operate the network and services that enable Amazon Fulfillment Centers, Middle and Last Mile facilities, including Air hubs, and PrimeNow to deliver packages to Amazon retail customers. From two million square foot automated robotics fulfillment centers to small last-mile delivery stations in emerging markets, these networks are the backbone of Amazon Operations. Hundreds of thousands of associates rely upon these networks at thousands of locations, and are critical to the delivery of shipments to Amazon retail customers.
Our mission is to design, deploy, and enable networks that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security and cost, enabling Fulfillment and Logistic operations to deliver on time, every customer order. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to create next-generation network products. The team is focused on creating in-house networks from leveraging open source tools and projects. We partner closely with IT support teams to ensure that simplicity in our product designs translate to operational readiness in the field. Information security rigor is at the core of everything we do. You will tackle complex, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. It is expected that you will be technically pioneering, while at the same time being balanced and pragmatic in your approach. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot and make a positive impact on millions of people.
The right candidate will have demonstrated experience leading large projects and have an expert level technical background in current networking technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or multiple priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will anticipate bottlenecks, influence external vendors and internal team roadmaps, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.
Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Development Engineer you will be expected to:
- Write code for our most demanding, cross-functional networking projects.
- Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight-forward solutions.
- Fully and completely comprehend system inter-connections and limitations.
- Effectively research and benchmark Amazon technology against other systems in the industry.
- Contribute intellectual property through patents.
- Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.
A day in the life
You will partner with Network, Software and Systems development Engineers to deliver automation for building and decommissioning the network infrastructure. Additionally create new tools or improve existing ones for network operators.
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience with distributed systems at scale

- Experience working in an Agile environment

items.desc:
At our lab in Hamme, Belgium, we are looking for a Work Preparator to join our Production Department. Depending on industry background and regional terminology, this role may also be recognized as a Manufacturing Process Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Production Engineer, Process Planning Engineer, or Production Readiness Engineer.
The Mechatronics team builds full-stack innovation that ensures fulfillment and delivery network safety, speed, optimization, sustainability and value. We tackle big goals for the Amazon business and work hard to make automation history through invention, problem-solving, and highly-engaged teams. We are a global organization, with research and development labs based in Hamme, Belgium, Boston, MA (US) and Milan, Italy. Our development portfolio is focused on automation solutions in packaging, labeling, sortation and material conveyance that provide broad extensibility across Amazon businesses.
At our lab in Hamme, Belgium we are looking for a Work preparator position within our production departement.
As a Work Preparator, you are the crucial link between the production department and cross-functional project teams. You are responsible for preparing, planning, and monitoring both internal production processes and external deliveries. You ensure seamless execution of production activities within a machining environment where processes such as turning, milling, welding, and sheet metal are applied to manufacture parts.
Key job responsibilities
Production Planning & Coordination
• Plan and monitor internal production planning for machining processes (turning, milling, welding, sheet metal)
• Create detailed production routings that provide the shop floor with correct production steps and specifications
• Coordinate with external suppliers to track delivery dates and align with project timelines
• Order raw materials for internal production and manage inventory levels
Technical Feasibility & Engineering Collaboration
• Work closely with engineers from the start of projects to assess the manufacturability of parts
• Identify potential issues and define solutions to ensure smooth production
• Translate technical drawings into feasible production processes based on thorough knowledge of machining techniques
Project Collaboration & Communication
• Represent the production department in multiple concurrent projects
• Monitor project planning and provide production input to keep the schedule clear for all departments
• Work closely with the project team to thoroughly prepare projects before they go into production
• Proactively escalate potential bottlenecks or delivery risks
Analysis & Calculations
• Perform pre-calculations of production times to support accurate project planning
• Perform post-calculations to analyze actual versus planned performance
• Identify improvement opportunities based on production data
Technical Knowledge (Essential)
• Thorough knowledge of machining production processes:
o CNC Turning
o CNC Milling
o Welding (various welding techniques)
o Sheet metal
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP experience is a strong plus)
• Understanding of production capacity planning and scheduling principles
Internal job description
- Knowledge of mechanical production processes (e.g., milling, turning, welding…)
- Knowledge of ERP systems, SAP is a plus
- Experience in Microsoft Office

- Ability to work independently

- Communication skills in Dutch, both verbal and written

Are you an Solutions Engineer that wants to design the next generation of world-class fulfillment centers and logistics systems across the globe? At Apple, we believe that innovation flourishes in an environment where ideas are challenged, collaboration is encouraged, and technology is pushed to its limits. This environment is only possible when diverse minds come together, bringing unique perspectives and experiences. Our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could accomplish here! Join Apple and help us make the world a better place.
As an SRE on our team, you'll own the reliability, performance, and scale of the distributed storage and data platform systems that power Apple's services. You'll debug replication and consensus failures, tune systems at petabyte scale, and write production code that operates the platform. We firmly believe in ownership, with software engineers accountable for the code they write.
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) organisation builds and provides systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple’s services — iCloud, iTunes, Siri, and Maps. Our team builds and operates the data platform infrastructure behind them, keeping petabyte-scale workloads fast, resilient, and reliable.

You'll work on storage engines, distributed consensus, and data-flow internals, partnering with development teams on system-wide architecture rather than individual components.
Experience in managing and scaling large-scale distributed systems in a private or hybrid cloud environment.
Comfortable designing, writing, and releasing production code in languages such as Go or Python.
Able to debug and reason about how distributed systems fail and perform at scale.
Willingness to take part in on-call rotations and incident response to keep critical systems healthy.
Contributions to distributed-systems internals, open-source data infrastructure, or storage/database engines.
Experience defining SLIs/SLOs, building observability, and using error budgets to drive reliability decisions.
A good grasp of Unix internals and networking fundamentals.
Experience with data migration, disaster recovery, or capacity planning at scale.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ?
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut !
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’ une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture.
 Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage en Digital & IA – Gestion du Système Qualité (BMS) (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d'Airbus. Vous rejoindrez le département QN en charge du système de gestion de la qualité ( Business Management System – BMS), le cadre de référence unique offrant une vision globale des activités pour optimiser les modes de travail, satisfaire nos clients et garantir la conformité aux normes aéronautiques mondiales.
 Votre stage consistera à soutenir l'architecture du BMS et son infrastructure numérique ( digital backbone ), en définissant sa vision moyen terme et en pilotant des projets d'intelligence artificielle et d'analytique appliqués à la qualité.
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois , débutera idéalement au premier semestre (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée).
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 ● Définir la vision à moyen terme du socle numérique du BMS : 
 Cartographier les liens entre l'architecture BMS (organisations, processus) et l'architecture numérique d'Airbus (applications, données).
 Établir l'état des lieux ( as-is ) de l'infrastructure numérique et de son écosystème.
 Contribuer au plan de gestion de l'obsolescence via un benchmark des solutions internes existantes et le recueil des retours d'expérience utilisateurs.
 Explorer l'intégration des technologies émergentes (IA, data analytics) au sein des processus de gestion du BMS.
 ● Déployer et enrichir des projets concrets (« Quick Wins ») en IA et Analytics : 
 Mettre en œuvre et enrichir les fonctionnalités de l'application interne d'IA « Augmented BMS ».
 Analyser la conformité et la cascade des exigences normatives (EN9100 / EN9110).
 Développer un assistant de conception pour proposer des moyens de conformité documentaires transverses.
 Votre tuteur vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : 
 ● Maîtrise de l'architecture d'entreprise et des systèmes de gestion intégrés (BMS) dans l'aéronautique. 
 ● Application concrète de l'IA générative et de l'analyse de données aux processus de gouvernance et de conformité (normes EN9100/EN9110). 
 ● Gestion de projet transverse et pilotage des relations avec des parties prenantes multifonctionnelles.
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure : 
 Vous êtes actuellement en Bac+5 (Master 2, dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou équivalent) en Informatique, Data Science ou Gestion des Systèmes d'Information .
 Vous possédez idéalement les compétences suivantes : 
 ● Compétences techniques : 
 ○ Maîtrise des technologies numériques, de l'analytique et des outils d'Intelligence Artificielle.
 ○ Notions ou vif intérêt pour l'architecture des systèmes d'information, les processus et le management de la qualité aéronautique.
 ○ Compétences en gestion de projet méthodologique. 
 ● Soft Skills : 
 ○ Vision globale, esprit d'analyse et curiosité pour le fonctionnement opérationnel de l'entreprise.
 ○ Aisance relationnelle, excellente communication et aptitude à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés.
 ○ Proactivité, autonomie et force de proposition. 
 ● Langues : 
 ○ Anglais : Courant / Négociation (environnement de travail international)
 ○ Français : Courant
 Notre processus de recrutement : 
 Votre candidature sera analysée attentivement par notre équipe de recrutement. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo. Suite à cette étape, si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager pour un entretien.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 In order to support our engineering team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a 
 Aeroelastics Engineer (d/f/m) 
 Who we are 
 We are a diverse team of 18 engineers in Bremen, bound by a shared passion for aeroelastics. Our work sits at the very heart of aircraft design, making every trade-off count. We are ambitious in what we achieve together, but we firmly believe high-impact engineering goes hand-in-hand with a healthy work-life balance, mutual support, and the unique backgrounds every teammate brings to the table. 
 What is our mission 
 We deliver flutter stability analyses while accounting for flight control laws across development and certification (EASA/FAA requirements) for both nominal and system failure cases. Furthermore, we provide dynamic master models and unsteady aerodynamics models for dynamic analyses across all Airbus aircraft types within our international organization. 
 Your location 
 Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 As part of our aeroelastics team, your main activities will include: 
 Assembling structural, mass, unsteady aerodynamic, and flight control system models to generate comprehensive flutter models. 
 Ensuring the physically accurate modeling of dynamic aircraft systems, focusing on the linearization of flight control laws and associated actuators. 
 Supporting flight vibration tests, evaluating test data, and validating or updating theoretical models against real flight data. 
 Performing modal analysis, vibration, and aeroelastic stability calculations to support aircraft design, optimization, and certification. 
 Developing innovative technologies and analysis methods related to active flutter control and dynamic loads alleviation. 
 Continuous process improvement: reviewing and enhancing calculations, tools, interfaces, and methods to stay at the cutting edge.
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Solid engineering foundation: A degree (or equivalent practical background) in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline. 
 Core physics knowledge: A good understanding of aeroelastics, coupled with an interest in flight control laws or dynamic systems. 
 Collaborative mindset: Strong communication skills in English to work smoothly across our international Airbus network. (German skills are a nice bonus, but we are happy to support you in learning!). 
 Problem-solving curiosity: An analytical mindset, comfortable breaking down complex multi-physics challenges into practical engineering solutions. 
 Bonus points (Great to have, but not mandatory): 
 Familiarity with flutter control concepts, systems engineering, or flight testing. 
 Practical scripting/coding experience (e.g., Python, MATLAB, or similar). 
 Organizational experience in project coordination or supplier interfaces. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

 Your location

Job Description: 
 Vous êtes passionné(e) par les essais (en vol et au sol) et vous souhaitez développer des compétences multi engineering?
Vous souhaitez acquérir une expérience pratique des technologies les plus récentes ?
Vous voulez participer aux activités d'ingénierie de la prochaine génération d'avions? 
 Alors le poste de Test means 3D Mock-up Integrator (h/f) pourrait être idéal pour vous! 
 Vous rejoindrez le domaine du centre d'essai dans l'organisation d'ingénierie et vous ferez partie d'une équipe intégrée ayant une vue globale sur la définition et l'installation des moyens d'essai.
Pour ses nouveaux développements et ses modifications majeures, AIRBUS effectue des essais au sol et en vol pour vérifier et valider la conception avant la certification. La communauté des moyens d'essais est l'un des domaines d'ingénierie d'Airbus avec une approche globale E2E (spécifier, concevoir, construire).
Notre équipe est en charge des moyens d'essais pour les activités vols et sols à Toulouse.
 Dans ce cadre, vous serez en charge, tout d'abord, de toutes les activités liées à l'intégration de la DMU pour tous les programmes, puis vous serez le point focal pour tous les outils utilisés par les concepteurs avec une approche transnationale.
 Vous serez responsable de : 
 Gérer les revues DMU
 Réaliser les activités QC1 et QC2
 Pilotage des fournisseurs (pour les activités QC et DMU-I)
 Intégration DMU (gestion des normes, mise à jour de la bibliothèque, arbre CATIA)
 Être le point focal pour l'ensemble des outils de conception (ESI/FE tous programmes)
 Participer au déploiement de tout nouvel outil Airbus au sein des équipes (design, business, ...)
 Etre un référent pour l'utilisation des outils de conception
 Recueillir les besoins pour soutenir la création de nouveaux outils
 Votre profil: 
Vous êtes familier avec le Toolset d'Airbus.
Vous êtes autonome, curieux et proactif.ve.
Vous êtes ouvert d'esprit et synthétique avec la capacité de prendre du recul par rapport aux activités et de proposer de nouvelles idées.
Travailler chez Airbus implique de travailler dans un environnement international, vous devez donc être capable de communiquer facilement en anglais. (Le français est obligatoire)
Vous avez une bonne expérience de la gestion des fournisseurs et êtes capable de passer d'un sujet à un autre en gardant un bon esprit d'équipe.
 Une bonne connaissance du développement d'outils et de la programmation serait un plus.
 OUTILS : 
CIRCE/GILDA - PRIMES CCM
AXIOM/SEE XP - APS
VPM - 3D EXP
CATIA V5
PDM
3D JUMP
EBAM
IPM
VUE DU PRODUIT
 Are you passionate about testing (flight & ground) and do you want to develop multi engineering competences? 
 Do you want to get hands on experience of the newest technologies? 
 Do you want to be part of the engineering activities for the next generation of aircraft? 
 Then the Test means 3D Mock-up Integrator (h/f) position could be the ideal role for you. 
 You will join the test center domain in the engineering organization and you will be part of an integrated team having the global view on test means definition and installation.
 For its new development and major modifications, AIRBUS performs ground and flight test to verify and validate the design before certification. Test means community is one of the Airbus Engineering domain with a global E2E approach (specify, design, build).
 Our team is in charge of test means for flights & grounds activities in Toulouse.
 Within this scope, you will be in charge of, first, all DMU integration related activities for all programs, then be the focal point for all toolset used by the designers with a transnational approach.
 In this position, you will be responsible for: 
 Managing DMU reviews
 Performing QC1 and QC2 activities
 Supplier Steering (for QC & DMU-I activities)
 DMU integration (Standard management, library update, CATIA tree)
 Being the focal point for the complete design toolset (ESI/FE all programs)
 Participating to deploy any new Airbus tool within the teams (design, business, …)
 Being a referent for design tool use
 Gathering needs to support new tool creation
 Required skills: 
 You are familiar with Airbus Toolset.
 You are autonomous, curious and proactive.
 You are open minded and synthetic with capability to step back from activities and propose new ideas.
 Working in Airbus implies to work in an international environment, as such you shall be able to communicate easily in English. (French is mandatory)
 You have good experience in supplier management and able to move from a subject to another keeping a good team spirit.
 Good knowledge of tool development and programming would be a plus.
 TOOLS: 
 CIRCE/GILDA - PRIMES CCM
 AXIOM/SEE XP - APS
 VPM - 3D EXP
 CATIA V5
 PDM
 3D JUMP
 EBAM
 IPM

Job Description: 
 At the Airbus Helicopters site in Donauwörth, we are looking for reinforcement for current and future projects at the earliest possible start date for an 
 Additive Layer Manufacturing Design & Stress Specialist (m/w/d)
Your Location 
 At the Donauwörth site on the banks of the Danube near Augsburg, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the flight-ready product. Experience with us how they take off and land at our own flight test center. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive compensation and individual supplementary benefits, e.g., corporate pension models, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing) or employee discounts at partner companies in accordance with our applicable guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave according to collective agreement; work-life balance (flexitime, mobile working, part-time, job sharing, sabbatical). 
 Easy Career Advancement: Excellent training opportunities and international, group-wide development perspectives. 
 Well-being at the Workplace: Company doctor; comprehensive health services (sports courses, prevention programs, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, partially local daycare near the site. 
 Diversity Unites: Working in a diverse environment with over 140 nationalities, where exchange, support, and diversity are actively lived. 
 Your Tasks and Responsibilities 
 Component Identification and Screening: Active identification of suitable components and integrated systems for additive manufacturing application. 
 Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM): Execution of DfAM activities, topology optimization, and functional integration to optimize weight and performance. 
 Structural Analysis and Strength Verification (Stress): Performing calculations and FEM analyses for dynamically loaded and fatigue-critical AM components taking into account specific material properties. 
 Cross-functional Collaboration: Close alignment as technical interface between Design, Stress, the Reference Manufacturing Shop (RMS), Material & Processes (M&P), and external partners. 
 Certification and Quality Standards: Support in complying with and developing aviation-specific regulations (EASA/FAA). 
 Knowledge Transfer and Standardization: Participation in the Community of Practice for Additive Manufacturing, supporting upskilling measures, and contributing to the development of engineering standards. 
 Knowledge Sharing and Consulting: Active sharing of expertise as well as technical consulting and support for engineering colleagues on complex additive manufacturing topics. 
 Cooperation with Science and Research: Close exchange and collaboration with universities, colleges, and research institutes to evaluate new technologies and methods. 
 Benchmarking and Market Observation: Conducting benchmarks and technology comparisons to identify best practices and future innovation trends. 
 Required Knowledge and Qualifications 
 Completed Master's degree (M.Sc.) in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable qualification. 
 Several years of relevant engineering experience in the aerospace industry. 
 Several years of experience in Design / Structural / Stress analysis. 
 Results-oriented mindset characterized by a high degree of personal responsibility, motivation, and commitment. 
 Design for AM (DfAM): Specific knowledge and methodical know-how in structural design for additive manufacturing processes. 
 Materials and Fatigue Understanding: Sound knowledge of AM materials and their mechanical behavior in dynamically loaded components. 
 Digital Tools (3DX / DDMS): Familiarity with modern PLM and CAD systems in the context of digital definition. 
 Certification and Quality Standards: Understanding of aviation-specific regulations (EASA/FAA) for additive components. 
 Strong communication skills, team spirit, and the ability to inspire people. 
 A pragmatic approach to solving complex challenges. 
 Structured working method and clear presentation of complex topics. 
 Business fluent in German and English. 
 Willingness to travel internationally. 
Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal development with tailored development solutions. 
 Take your career to the next level and apply now online !

Job Description: 
 We are launching a new position at Airbus Portugal GBS!
 Responsibilities - your mission 
 Work together with internal and external stakeholders (most frequently with Airbus’ legal and compliance officers), anticipate their needs, and offer tailored e-Discovery solutions across a spectrum of legal, dispute resolution (litigation and arbitration), compliance, and regulatory matters. 
 Handle and oversee every stage of the e-Discovery process, from collections, through processing and review, to productions and reporting (internally and externally). 
 Liaise with and supervise the work of external services providers, including vendors, contract lawyers, and other third parties. 
 Carry out legal document review, to assess substance, to make privilege determinations, and / or for regulatory purposes (including export control regimes). 
 Build, train, and oversee the work of review teams as well as ensure quality and efficiency of the document review process. 
 Prepare and deliver internal reports, presentations, and trainings. 
 Maintain and expand technical proficiency in the field of e-Discovery and in related areas. 
 Follow developments and best practices in e-Discovery across all major blocks or jurisdictions (e.g., EU, US, UK) to help ensure that Airbus maintains its lead and innovative edge in this area. 
 Requirements - our ideal candidate will have 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 Have a Law degree up to 5 years of work experience, on a legal, compliance, regulatory, or document review function. 
 Be fluent in English. 
 Demonstrate good communication skills, orally and in writing. 
 Be a team-player and enjoy working with others. 
 Be flexible and keen to work in an international environment. 
 Be able to structure and prioritize your workload. 
 Have a genuine interest in the field of e-Discovery. 
 Supplemental (not obligatory) requirements 
 Be fluent in one or both of French and German languages. 
 Having command of additional languages. 
 Prior experience working in a collaborative team environment. 
 Collections and processing prior experience and use of relevant software. 
 Be familiar with technology-assisted review. 
 Prior work in a large company, an international law firm, or a specialised e-Discovery advisor. 
 Benefits - what’s in it for you 
 The chance to work in a multicultural environment. 
 The opportunity to grow your skills and capabilities thanks to our Airbus learning offer (digital solutions, classroom sessions, certified training....) and career opportunities across the globe. 
 A hybrid working model, allowing you to combine onsite and offsite work. 
 A modern office at Lisbon’s Parque das Nacoes, well connected to public transportation. 
 A motivated and enthusiastic team with whom to grow, build, and shape the AGBS together. 
 An intense and exciting onboarding experience. 
 You will be fully part of a specific division sitting inside Airbus’ cutting-edge and integrated legal and compliance team and will be exposed to complex and varied legal matters, often involving multiple actors and jurisdictions. 
 You will work closely with various members of the legal and compliance team located in Toulouse, France, in particular the ones involved in litigation, investigation and compliance matters. 
 Work in a balanced environment: Beyond the many benefits offered to its employees, joining Airbus is also the guarantee of a respectable work-life balance. items.desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
As a R&D Engineer I at Medtronic Articulating Technologies, you will get the opportunity to develop advanced medical devices in order to enable next generation surgical procedures. You will gain knowledge and experience covering the full engineering domain of product and process development from conceptual design up to market introduction and scale-up. 
In a team of engineers, you will work on design, development and testing of surgical instruments and the development of their related manufacturing processes. You will improve product performance and manufacturability by calculating, modelling, prototyping and testing. Additionally, by developing processes to a world-class performance level by means of lean six sigma, you will help optimizing cost and consistency. Furthermore, you will get the chance to master high-tech manufacturing processes such as laser cutting, cleaning, laser welding and assembly. During the traineeship, you will be part of our talented team of specialists, and you will learn from our experts who will help you to develop yourself towards your role as Manufacturing or Research and Development Engineer. 
 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned: 
 Perform engineering analyses, calculations, and modelling to evaluate product performance, reliability, and manufacturability.
 Support development and optimization of manufacturing processes, including technologies such as laser cutting, laser welding, cleaning, and assembly.
 Build and test prototypes, execute experiments, and analyze results to support design improvements and technical decision-making.
 Assist in designing surgical instruments and related components, supporting new product development from concept through verification and market introduction.
 Collaborate with cross functional teams (engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain) to ensure successful product and process development.
 Show entrepreneurial mindset be eager to learn and dare to fail fast
 Required Knowledge and Experience :
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering/applied physics/Industrial Engineering or similar
 Mastering the Dutch and English language
 You have a hands-on mentality, eager to learn, flexible and a strong team player
 Looking at questions from different perspectives, daring to bring less obvious solutions and strong analytical skills is natural for you

items.desc:
About the job
 Turn product intent into the technical work that moves AI compute forward.
 As a Technology Owner, you will help component-based software teams deliver clear, prioritised and meaningful outcomes. You will connect product intent, engineering delivery and cross-team coordination.
 Your work will support software that spans bare metal silicon through to the machine learning tools stack. You will make complex systems easier to plan, explain and deliver.
 You will own component backlogs, shape roadmaps, refine epics and stories, and support sprint and PI planning. You will also surface dependencies, risks and trade-offs early.
 This role suits someone who brings calm, clarity and momentum to technical teams. You will help engineers focus on the work that matters most.
 The team and culture
 You will work with component-based software teams across Graphcore’s engineering organisation. These teams build across the full AI compute stack, from silicon-level software to ML tools.
 Work happens through clear planning, practical discussion and fast feedback. You will help teams visualise progress, involve the right people and make delivery risks visible early.
 Decisions are shaped by product outcomes, technical evidence and team insight. You will encourage open challenge, protect focus and enable empowered decision-making.
 Responsibilities and Duties 
 Own and Shape the Component Backlog 
 Create and maintain team roadmaps for the Program Increment (PI) and long term plan to help visualise the current backlog and communicate status and progress to all stakeholders. 
 Translate feature-level intent into actionable component-level work and feedback team intent and challenges to help shape the features with the Technical Product Manager. 
 Maintain a clear, prioritised backlog of Epics and Stories for your component team. 
 Ensure all work is clearly linked to higher-level product outcomes. 
 Support Delivery Across Sprints and Planning Increments 
 Actively support sprint planning, reviews, demos, providing visual outputs that demonstrate progress against the plan, learnings and changes. 
 Involve the team in the right discussions to ensure desired outcomes are realistic, and the team’s ability to deliver them are clearly communicated. 
 Ensure the backlog is sufficiently maintained to prepare for PI planning, identifying dependencies and risks early and aligning with other teams on the scope taken into planning. 
 Ensure your team’s work aligns with agreed PI objectives. 
 Coordinate Across Teams 
 Work closely with other Technical Product Owners, Technical Product Managers, and Technical Leads to manage cross-team dependencies. 
 Coordinate early with QA and Performance teams to support integrated delivery. 
 Help ensure integration and system behaviour are planned. 
 Champion Quality, Collaboration, and Trust 
 Define clear component-level acceptance criteria and support readiness for integration and release. 
 Contributing to a growing community of practise developing ways of working to find the best way to deliver 
 Encourage open discussion, early risk-sharing, and constructive challenge.

Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. 
 Les bancs de mesures étudiés dans le cadre du poste ont été développés afin d’évaluer des architectures de capteurs à fibres et de LiDAR haute résolution. Ils permettent notamment d’étudier les perspectives offertes par des sources lasers nouvelle génération développées par des partenaires académiques et industriels. Ces sources se distinguent par une modulation large bande, rapide et linéaire de la longueur d’onde, propriété cruciale pour l’élaboration de capteurs haute performance. La large bande des signaux mesurés, indispensable pour des mesures rapides, résolues et sans ambiguïtés, génère naturellement un flux de données volumineux. Il devient alors essentiel de concevoir des outils performants pour la visualisation, le traitement et le contrôle en temps réel de ces acquisitions.
 La mission aura pour objet le développement d’une couche applicative gérant les échanges de données entre les différents modules logiciels du système, l’implémentation d’une solution de visualisation continue et temps-réel du traitement des acquisitions et la consolidation d’une interface graphique pour le paramétrage des mesures. Les outils développés seront testés tout au long de la mission lors de campagnes de mesures représentatives, en étroite collaboration avec les chercheurs des deux laboratoires.
 On se basera sur une première couche fonctionnelle de traitement du signal déjà développée. Cette chaîne d’acquisition et de traitement repose sur des plateformes combinant GPU et des cartes d’acquisition/génération haute performance. Grâce à des compétences en C/C++ et idéalement à des notions en programmation GPU (CUDA, OpenGL, Vulkan).
 Dans ce cadre, de nouveaux modules logiciels seront développés selon deux axes principaux :
 L’affichage temps-réel en continu des données de mesures : Le principal défi est le choix des données à afficher, du type de représentation à privilégier ainsi que la gestion des flux de données en parallèle avec le traitement et l’écriture en continu. Ce choix devra être fait en fonction des besoins opérationnels des chercheurs, afin d’assurer la meilleure lisibilité des données tout en garantissant un affichage sans perte d’information. Les calculs étant réalisés sur GPU, il sera opportun d’utiliser le processeur graphique afin d’accélérer l’affichage afin de le rendre le plus réactif possible. Un mécanisme de rejeu pourra être mis en place pour permettre de stopper l’affichage ou naviguer dans l’historique des enregistrements, sans pour autant perturber les enregistrements en cours.
 Vous pourrez être force de proposition quant à la plateforme à privilégier pour assurer l’opérabilité et la pérennité des bancs de mesure, en cohérence avec les besoins et contraintes de l’environnement de recherche.
 L’implémentation d’une interface de contrôle :
 Pour permettre à l’utilisateur de sélectionner et configurer les différents modules de traitement déjà développés, une interface graphique intuitive et évolutive devra être créée, adaptée aux spécificités du banc d’acquisition (cartes d’acquisition/génération, chaîne de traitement GPU). Votre implication dans la compréhension fonctionnelle des modules existants sera essentielle pour identifier les paramètres à ajuster et concevoir une interface flexible adaptée aux besoins spécifiques des chercheurs.

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 Based in Barcelona, this role sits at the heart of Helsing's robotics engineering function, responsible for driving the mechanical architecture, design, and development of next-generation robotic systems. You will own complex electromechanical systems from concept through to production, ensuring platforms are robust, scalable, and built for real-world deployment. Working closely with electrical, firmware, and software engineers, you will bring both technical depth and cross-functional leadership to a team building some of the most consequential technology in European defence
 The day-to-day
 • Lead the detailed design and integration of complex robotic subsystems, including high-precision actuators, structural chassis, and dynamic motion systems, translating high-level concepts into robust 3D assemblies and comprehensive engineering drawing packages.
• Drive cross-functional integration with electrical and software teams to ensure seamless packaging, cable routing, and thermal and sensor integration, resolving technical challenges across the full development cycle.
• Define material selection strategies and fabrication methods, conducting FEA, stress analysis, and tolerance stack-up analysis to ensure designs meet rigorous functional, cost, yield, and lead-time requirements.
• Establish and advocate for mechanical engineering best practices, including modelling standards, GD&T drawing controls, and technical documentation, raising quality across the team.
• Critically evaluate system architectures in design reviews, identifying risks and delivering high-impact solutions that optimise performance and manufacturability from prototype through to production ramp-up.
 You should apply if you 
 • Have shipped complex robotic, mechatronic, or automated systems to market, with a verifiable track record of ownership across the full product development cycle.
• Bring expert-level proficiency in 3D CAD modelling, ideally SolidWorks, combined with deep knowledge of GD&T for precision manufacturing environments.
• Have applied structural and thermal FEA, static simulations, and tolerance stack-up analysis to solve real engineering problems in production-grade systems.
• Have worked extensively across diverse manufacturing processes, including CNC machining, injection moulding, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing, in high-mix or low-to-medium volume environments.
• Communicate complex technical decisions with clarity to cross-functional stakeholders, from firmware engineers to programme leadership, driving alignment without sacrificing rigour.
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 • Experience architecting high-performance, high-power-density actuators and advanced mechatronic systems for legged robotics platforms.
• Background working in agile, small-scale mechanical design teams, with direct experience taking full technical ownership from early concept through to serial production.
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

items.desc:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich/Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

 - Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

 - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

 - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

 - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

 - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

 - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a demonstrated track record of 5+ years of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

 - Are fluent in both German and English

 - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

 - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions.

We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure.

Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents.

The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked.



What you will do

 - Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration

 - Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems

 - Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance

 - Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems



Requirements

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




ABOUT THE TEAM


In our Professional and Financial Services Business unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI, and use it to help our clients navigate a rapidly changing landscape.


We develop and embed AI solutions which help financial institutions become more efficient, enhance customer experience, and find the commercial upside in uncertain markets. Within the constraints of a highly regulated industry, we see so much opportunity for impactful innovation and are proud to set the gold-standard for marrying technical excellence with safe deployment.




ABOUT THE ROLE



As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and scale AI-powered systems that solve unique challenges for global clients. 



This is an opportunity to take ownership of the entire stack, turning sophisticated machine learning outputs into high-impact, production-ready solutions that drive real-world transformation.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



 - Creating reliable, reusable, and scalable frontend and backend architectures to enable the seamless delivery of advanced AI systems.

 - Leading engineers within cross-functional teams—alongside Data Scientists and Product Managers—to deploy technically sophisticated, high-impact software.

 - Designing and architecting robust project frameworks that maintain a balance between rapid prototyping and long-term maintainability.

 - Acting as a technical authority for full-stack development within your delivery unit to ensure best practices are met.

 - Providing deep technical expertise to customers, helping them navigate complex requirements and architectural scoping.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



 - You bring extensive experience in TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks like React or Vue, paired with a strong eye for intuitive UI/UX design.

 - You possess solid backend development skills in Python or TypeScript frameworks (such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django) and are comfortable managing the full application lifecycle.

 - You are experienced in deploying software within cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP, ideally using containerisation tools like Docker.

 - You demonstrate a scientific and pragmatic mindset, testing assumptions and balancing big-picture vision with the technical details required for execution.

 - You thrive in autonomous, fast-paced environments where you can take full ownership of problems and collaborate directly with clients to define technical strategy.

 - You are a compelling communicator who enjoys working in a team-oriented culture and has a relentless drive to learn and apply novel technologies.




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS



 1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

 2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes) 

 3. System Design Interview (90 minutes) 

 4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)






OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 



A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

 You will join a small team of experts managing the PostgreSQL and MySQL databases supporting the LHC experiments, accelerator operations and organisation-wide services. You will help build and automate a modern, highly available database platform, with training and mentoring to grow your skills.
 Functions: 
 As a Database Infrastructure Engineer in the Databases and Analytics Group, your main activities will consist of: 
 Operate and improve production PostgreSQL (and MySQL) databases: troubleshooting, upgrades, migrations, patching and scaling.
 Help design, deploy and run highly available database setups with automated failover.
 Automate provisioning, configuration and routine operations using scripting and infrastructure tools.
 Monitor databases for performance, stability, availability and security.
 Contribute to backup, disaster recovery and service continuity strategies.
 Support application developers in diagnosing database and query issues.
 Document procedures and share knowledge within the team.
Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computing Science, or a science discipline (e.g., Physics) with significant computing content, or a related field.
 Experience: 
 Hands-on experience (typically 2+ years, including internships or substantial projects) administering relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, in a professional environment.
 Good troubleshooting skills: performance analysis, query tuning, replication, backup and recovery.
 Knowledge of SQL, and scripting in Python or shell for automation.
 Good understanding of Linux systems and an interest in database infrastructure, reliability and automation.
 Familiarity with high availability, replication, clustering, backup/recovery or infrastructure automation would be an advantage..
 Experience with technologies such as Patroni, Consul, HAProxy, PgBouncer, Kubernetes or configuration-management tools is welcome, but not required ..
 Ability to troubleshoot technical problems, learn new technologies and work collaboratively with infrastructure and application teams.
 Technical competencies: 
 Administration of databases architectures
 Knowledge of operating systems: such as Linux,
 Knowledge of programming techniques and languages SQL, Python, shell.
 Architecture and design of ICT systems: interest in designing resilient, distributed infrastructure
 Behavioural competencies: 
 Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.
 Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.
 Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.
 Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.
 Learning and Sharing Knowledge: keeping up-to-date with developments in own field of expertise and readily absorbing new information.

 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions-Core (MCAPS) accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.
 The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization, an organization within MCAPS-Core, is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across Account Team Unit, Specialist Team Unit, and Customer Support Unit to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.
 Support for Mission Critical (SfMC) is the team Microsoft’s most critical customers rely on when failure is not an option.
We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to join the Mission Critical team, working alongside our senior architects on the repeatable intellectual property they deliver to those customers. Your focus is making that IP better: integrating AI so each delivery takes less effort, sharpening the risks it exposes, and making what the customer receives clearer and more useful. The work spans reliability and operational readiness, AI behavior drift and integrity, operational controls, consumption and unit cost, and output quality. During your ramp, you are not accountable for customer delivery; your customer exposure is structured observation alongside senior architects, which is how you build toward customer readiness.
 This opportunity will allow you to develop deep hands-on skills in AI and Azure engineering, learn how repeatable IP is designed, tested and shipped to a global delivery team, and build the technical judgment that leads to Mission Critical customer work. This role is 100% onsite at a Microsoft office.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Responsibilities 
 With direct coaching and guidance from more experienced peers:
 Improve the repeatable IP our architects already deliver: integrate AI so each delivery takes less effort, sharpen the risks it exposes, and make the customer-facing output clearer and more actionable.
 Contribute to on-call rotations to ensure a high quality of service for the critical incidents created by Support for Mission Critical customers.
 Turn field feedback into improvements: reproduce the reported problem in a lab, make the correction, write the check that proves it is fixed, and record what changed and why.• Build and test the automation, queries, prompts, agents and templates that let a deliverable be executed consistently by many architects rather than rebuilt each time.
 Run the defined analysis behind a deliverable, such as behavior drift and integrity baselines, consumption and unit cost, or output quality scoring, validate the result against the documented method, and escalate anything that looks wrong.
 Write the material that makes IP usable by someone else: delivery guides, runbooks, worked examples, test data and acceptance checks.
 Act as customer zero for our own AI tooling and agents, stress-testing them internally before they are used in any customer environment, and reporting what breaks.
 Build Mission Critical, Azure and AI platform depth through structured onboarding, accreditation, teach backs and supervised observation of senior architect delivery, incorporating coaching feedback as you progress toward customer readiness.
 Builds familiarity around how to execute work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures
 Qualifications 
 • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field OR equivalent experience.
 Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

• Technology Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications)
