items.title: ServiceNow Integration & API Engineer (f/m)
items.card: Designs, develops, and maintains robust, secure, and high-performance interfaces connecting the enterprise ServiceNow platform with external systems across Bosch (SAP, Microsoft Azure/Entra ID, corporate Data Lakes, monitoring tools, and partner applications). Serves as the platform's hands-on authority for both inbound and outbound integrations, leveraging native ServiceNow capabilities including IntegrationHub,
items.desc:
Designs, develops, and maintains robust, secure, and high-performance interfaces connecting the enterprise ServiceNow platform with external systems across Bosch (SAP, Microsoft Azure/Entra ID, corporate Data Lakes, monitoring tools, and partner applications). Serves as the platform's hands-on authority for both inbound and outbound integrations, leveraging native ServiceNow capabilities including IntegrationHub, Scripted REST APIs, Flow Designer integration actions, MID Server clustering, and Service Graph Connectors. Partners with platform architects, security officers, and external system owners to ensure all data flows adhere to the "Configure First, Customize Last" principle, operate asynchronously without impacting platform performance, and comply with enterprise security and data privacy mandates.
 Inbound & Outbound API Development 
 Scripted REST APIs: Design and implement custom, versioned Scripted REST APIs, enforcing strict JSON schema validation, and error handling.
 Outbound Integrations: Configure and script outbound integrations
 IntegrationHub & Spokes: Develop custom IntegrationHub actions, data stream actions, and spokes using Flow Designer and the ServiceNow Spoke Generator; configure and maintain out-of-the-box spokes for enterprise systems.
 API Versioning & Deprecation: Manage API lifecycles, ensuring backward compatibility, clear deprecation notices
 Enterprise Data Ingestion, ETL & Staging 
 Import Sets & Robust Transform Engine (RTE): Build and maintain high-volume Import Set tables, staging schemas, and Transform Maps; leverage the Robust Transform Engine (RTE) and Integration Commons for complex data transformation.
 Service Graph Connectors (SGC): Implement and tune Service Graph Connectors and Integration Hub ETL (IH-ETL) to ingest external asset, inventory, and configuration data directly into CSDM 5.0 and CMDB tables via the Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE).
 Infrastructure, MID Server & Gateway Connectivity 
 MID Server Management: Configure, monitor, and optimize MID Server clusters, capabilities, and IP ranges to ensure reliable communication with on-premises networks and restricted manufacturing domains.
 Enterprise Gateway Alignment: Partner with corporate API Management teams (Enterprise MCP servers, Azure APIM, Apigee, or Kong) to register ServiceNow endpoints, configure rate-limiting, and enforce corporate proxy and firewall policies.
 Integration Security & Governance 
 Authentication & Secrets: Implement and govern secure authentication mechanisms: OAuth 2.0 (Client Credentials, Authorization Code flows)
 Data Sanitization & Privacy: Enforce logging hygiene, ensuring API keys, bearer tokens, passwords, and unencrypted PII
Experience & Qualifications: 
 Overall Experience: 2 to 5 years in enterprise software development or integration engineering, with at least 1 to 3 years of dedicated, hands-on integration development on the ServiceNow platform.
 ServiceNow Integration Stack: Deep expertise in Scripted REST APIs, IntegrationHub, Flow Designer Actions, Import Sets, Transform Maps, and Connection & Credential Aliases.
 Performance Engineering: Proven experience designing high-throughput, data ingestion pipelines
 Tooling: Proficient with API testing and debugging tools (Postman, SoapUI, cURL, Insomnia) and version control via Git.
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
 Certifications: 
 Mandatory / Required: 
 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
 ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
 Highly Desirable: 
 Micro-Certification: IntegrationHub or Flow Designer.
 At least one CIS credential (e.g., CIS - Customer Service Management, CIS - ITSM, or CIS - Discovery).
 Beneficial: 
 Cloud integration or API certification (Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, AWS Certified Developer, or MuleSoft Certified Developer).
 ITIL 4 Foundation.

items.desc:
Voor ons filiaal in Geel zoeken we momenteel een Audicien - Audioloog ! 
 Wil jij als audicien/audioloog de meest geschikte hooroplossing vinden voor onze klanten en zo hun levenskwaliteit en gezondheid verbeteren? 
Wil jij terechtkomen in een warm team, met toffe collega’s die kwaliteit vooropstellen? 
Wil jij jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en daarin gestimuleerd en ondersteund worden? 
 Ja, ja, en nog eens ja? 
Met je diploma Audiologie (BA of MA), een RIZIV nummer op zak én een stevige portie empathie sta jij te popelen om iedereen die ons hoorcentrum binnenkomt, verder te helpen. 
 Herken jij je hierin: 
 Variatie in je job maakt je gelukkig - Iedere dag en iedere klant zal verschillend zijn
 Oog voor detail, dat heb jij – En dat zal van pas komen bij het uitvoeren van verschillende geavanceerde audiometrische testen om de meeste geschikte hooroplossing voor te stellen
 Verantwoordelijkheid nemen is voor jou een evidentie – Wij kunnen op beide oren slapen, jij volgt het gehele proces op van A tot Z
 Commerciële feeling komt vanzelf – Je zet je in om te zorgen voor een uitnodigend hoorcentrum waar mensen zich welkom voelen
 Je bent een geboren netwerker – Je bouwt de nodige professionele contacten op met NKO-artsen en huisartsen.
 Nog steeds enthousiast? 
Weet dat je komt werken bij de marktleider van hooroplossingen in België, met meer dan 270 hoorcentra in België en meer dan 70 jaar expertise, die op zijn beurt behoort tot de Sonova Group, de belangrijkste fabrikant van hooroplossingen ter wereld.
 Bovendien bieden wij je: 
 Een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur, met start zo snel mogelijk. 
 Extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, ADV-dagen, groepsverzekering en hospitalisatieverzekering, een GSM, en een bedrijfswagen.
 Verder krijg je ook een gepersonaliseerd ontwikkelingsplan met kwalitatieve coaching en feedbackmomenten om je professionele vaardigheden te ontwikkelen.
 De garantie dat je écht een verschil kan maken voor mensen met gehoorverlies. Hoe geweldig is dat?
 #LI-TW1 
 #Lapperre

Entdecke, was du bei der KUKA Group bewegen kannst. 
 Die KUKA Group bietet ein enormes Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere voranzutreiben, deiner Leidenschaft zu folgen und dein Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Automatisierungsspezialisten und bieten globale Möglichkeiten in Bereichen wie Robotik, Automatisierung, Logistik, Softwarelösungen und Elektronik. Wenn du ein Macher bist, ein Visionär mit kühnen Ambitionen und dir Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Respekt wichtig sind, dann bist du hier bei KUKA Group auf Erfolgskurs.
 Hier bewirkst du etwas 
 Als Application Engineer übernimmst du die eigenverantwortliche Konzeption und Planung von Kundenapplikationen in der KUKA-Software für autonome mobile Roboter.
 Ein wichtiger Faktor dabei ist die strukturierte kontinuierliche Erfassung und interne Kommunikation der Kundenbedürfnisse zur kundenorientierten Weiterentwicklung der Software für AMR.
 Weitergehend bist du für die Beratung und Unterstützung bei AMR-Software-Problemstellungen, für interne und externe Kunden sowie für die Inbetriebnahme und Optimierung von KUKA AMRs beim Kunden verantwortlich. 
 Ein weiteres Aufgabengebiet ist die Anbindung der entwickelten Kundenapplikation in das Kundennetzwerk als auch die Unterstützung bei der Definition und Realisierung von Schnittstellen zwischen Kunden-Systemen und KUKA AMR-Systemen.
 Ein wichtiger Aspekt ist dabei die Bereitstellung von AMR-Software-Fachwissen für Vertriebskollegen, Partner und Kunden wie auch die Unterstützung von Applikationsingenieuren sowohl intern wie auch bei Partnern.
 Dabei koordinierst du Aufbauten im Haus selbstständig und wickelst die Inbetriebnahme beim Kunden ab. 
 Gleichzeitig unterstützt Du bei der Produktweiterentwicklung, einerseits durch einen transparenten Kommunikationsaustausch zum AMR-Produktsupport und andererseits durch die Implementierung & Evaluierung von Bugfixes und neuen Features 
 Angebotserstellungen, Konzeptdurchsprachen und Abstimmungen mit Kunden, Fachbereichen, Integratoren und Endkunden sind ein weiterer Part deine Tätigkeit.
 Die Einsatzstandorte fährst Du mit Deinem Dienstwagen an, der Dir auch zur privaten Nutzung zur Verfügung steht 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Die Basis deines Profils bildet dein abgeschlossenes Studium bzw. deine Technikerausbildung der Fachrichtung Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder Informatik.
 Darauf aufbauend hast du mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme von automatisierten Systemlösungen.
 Dabei greifst du idealerweise auf deine fundierten Kenntnisse von AMR/AGV-Systemen inkl. Mounted Arm AMR’s zurück.
 Vorteilhaft wären Erfahrungswerte in Bezug auf Netzwerktechnik, Server, WLAN Parametrierung, MQTT, Rest API, usw. 
 Du zeichnest dich durch deine Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Kundenorientierung tagtäglich aus. 
 Dein Profil wird durch deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie deine Bereitschaft zu Reisen abgerundet. 
 Ein Führerschein der Klasse B (alt Kl.3)
 Unser Versprechen an dich 
 Unsere Kultur ist tief in unserer Leidenschaft, Robotik und Automatisierungslösungen für jeden zugänglich und einfach nutzbar zu machen, verwurzelt. Das Ergebnis? Wir machen das Leben der Menschen einfacher und sicherer, überall auf der Welt. Vielfalt ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – und wir schätzen jeden einzelnen unserer klugen und kreativen Köpfe. Wir ermutigen jeden, sich bei der Arbeit voll und ganz einzubringen, und fördern so ein Umfeld, in dem Inspiration, Fachwissen und persönliches Wachstum gedeihen können. Unser gemeinsames Ziel? Wir wollen Großes erreichen und innovative, positive Veränderungen anstoßen - nicht nur innerhalb der Automatisierungsbranche, sondern auch über deren Grenzen hinaus. Im Gegenzug legen wir großen Wert darauf, eine unterstützende, fördernden und fürsorgliche Umgebung für alle zu schaffen.
 Vorteile und Leistungen 
 Als Teil unseres Engagements für das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten wir eine Reihe umfassender Vorteile und Leistungen. Von wettbewerbsfähigen Gehaltspaketen über flexible Arbeitszeiten bis hin zu beruflichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten - wir wollen einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz für die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten. Es ist uns wichtig, die harte Arbeit und das Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden anzuerkennen und zu würdigen, und unsere Zusatzleistungen spiegeln dies wider. Unser Ziel ist es, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt, motiviert und inspiriert fühlen, ihr Bestes zu geben. Sei dabei und profitiere davon, Teil eines Teams zu sein, dem das Wohl und Wachstum seiner Mitarbeitenden am Herzen liegt.

items.desc:
Entdecke, was du bei der KUKA Group bewegen kannst.
Die KUKA Group bietet ein enormes Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere voranzutreiben, deiner Leidenschaft zu folgen und dein Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Automatisierungsspezialisten und bieten globale Möglichkeiten in Bereichen wie Robotik, Automatisierung, Logistik, Softwarelösungen und Elektronik. Wenn du ein Macher bist, ein Visionär mit kühnen Ambitionen und dir Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Respekt wichtig sind, dann bist du hier bei KUKA Group auf Erfolgskurs.
 Am österreichischen Standort in Steyregg konfigurieren wir Robotersysteme für nahezu alle Branchen – von der Fahrzeugindustrie bis zur Medizintechnik. Darüber hinaus bieten wir unseren Kunden mit Simulationen und Machbarkeitsstudien in unserem Testzentrum sowie einem breiten Trainingsangebot im hauseigenen College erstklassigen Support in der robotergestützten Automatisierung.
 Make an impact 
 Du berätst bestehende und zukünftige Kund:innen umfassend zu technischen Lösungen, Produkten und Dienstleistungen im Bereich Robotik und Automatisierung. 
 Du betreust Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen, unter anderem Automotive, Elektronik, Pharma, Lebensmittel sowie weiteren Industriebereichen. 
 Du entwickelst Strategien zur Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen und zur Erschließung neuer Marktsegmente und setzt diese aktiv in deinem Vertriebsgebiet um. 
 Du baust das Vertriebssegment weiter auf und übernimmst die aktive Neukundenakquise. 
 Du bist die wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kund:innen und den internen Teams und sorgst für eine professionelle, lösungsorientierte Zusammenarbeit. 
 Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und begleitest den gesamten Vertriebsprozess - von der ersten Beratung über die Verhandlung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. 
 Du verstehst die technischen Anforderungen einer Roboterzelle und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen passende Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen. 
 What you need to succeed 
 Du hast eine technische Ausbildung auf HTL-,FH- oder Universitätsniveau abgeschlossen, zum Beispiel in Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. 
 Du verfügst über Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise im Umfeld Automatisierungstechnik, Robotik oder industrieller Fertigung. 
 Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. 
 Idealerweise befindet sich dein Wohnort in Salzburg, um nah an deinen Kunden zu sein oder du bist bereit, die Vertriebsregion regelmäßig zu betreuen ( Vorarlberg, Salzburg und Tirol). 
 Du hast Freude an der Beratung von Kund:innen, erkennst ihre Anforderungen und entwickelst daraus überzeugende technische Lösungen. 
 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, verbindlich und mit ausgeprägter Abschlussorientierung. 
 Unser Versprechen an dich
Bei KUKA steht die Leidenschaft für Robotik und Automatisierung im Mittelpunkt. Wir schaffen Lösungen, die das Leben weltweit einfacher und sicherer machen. Vielfalt, Inspiration und persönliches Wachstum prägen unsere Kultur – gemeinsam wollen wir Innovationen vorantreiben und eine unterstützende Arbeitsumgebung bieten.
Vorteile und Leistungen
Wir bieten attraktive Gehaltspakete, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dein Einsatz wird geschätzt und belohnt – in einem Umfeld, das Motivation, Wertschätzung und persönliche Entfaltung fördert. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, dass sich unsere Mitarbeiter:innen nicht mit Mindeststandards zufriedengeben müssen - und das gilt auch für uns. Deshalb bieten wir ein Mindestgehalt in Höhe von € 4.000,-- an. Je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung ist eine Überzahlung möglich.
DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) 
Wir leben Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit: Bei uns zählt dein Talent, nicht deine Herkunft oder Überzeugungen. KUKA ist ein Ort, an dem du authentisch sein kannst und deine Stärken einbringen darfst.
Gehe mit uns auf die Reise!
Wenn du dir vorstellen kannst, dass eine Karriere bei der KUKA Group das Richtige für dich sein könnte, würden wir uns freuen, von dir zu hören. 
Talent Acquisition Manager: Tina Wolf

items.desc:
Where do people love what they do, and being great at what they do? 
 At Swisslog, that’s where! Our teams are the heart of a world-leading Robotics company that’s harnessing the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We’re transforming performance and efficiency for customers across the globe, giving them the vital edge in their markets.
 Make an impact 
 Resident Engineer, Derby. Working rotating 12-hour days and nights. Company benefits to include private healthcare and company contributory pension scheme. 
 Breakdown and planned preventative maintenance on a variety of automated machinery, to include cranes; conveyors; robots, bagging machines and autostore. 
 To undertake scheduled repairs in accordance with the manufacturers recommendations and industry standard practices. 
 Prioritise system faults. 
 To ensure quality of output at all times. 
 To accurately record all work undertaken. 
 Involvement in continuous improvement projects. 
 Comply with Health & Safety legislation at all times. 
 What you need to succeed 
 An apprentice trained Electrical Engineer or equivalent qualification. 
 Experience of working with automated machinery is ideal, however it is not essential as training will be provided. 
 Happy to work at heights. 
 This is a customer facing role, so you must be able to communicate effectively at all levels. 
 Experience of working with a CMMS system. 
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.
 About Swisslog 
 Swisslog is shaping the future of intralogistics. As part of the KUKA Group, we work on the latest technologies that are reimagining the world of logistics. We’re a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries, serving some of the world's largest and most exciting brands. Together, we’re implementing smart and innovative approaches - including flexible robot-based and data-driven automation solutions that are transforming the supply chain. So join our team and share your unique perspective.
 Join the journey! 
 If you think a career with Swisslog could be what you are looking for, we´d love to hear from you.
 We´re looking forward to receiving your application!

Nekünk a csúcstechnológiás gyártás. Neked szakmai büszkeség. 
 Csatlakozz hozzánk a mobilitás jövőjébe vezető úton, ahol a kiváló csapatmunka és a fejlett technológia találkozik! Debreceni üzemünkben nem csupán autókat szerelünk össze; mi a modern autózásról alkotott álmokat valósítjuk meg: elsőként indítjuk el a teljesen elektromos Neue Klasse modellek gyártását. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik részesei akarnak lenni a BMW márka megújulásának.
 Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Elektromos karbantartó technikusa , kulcsfontosságú szerepet töltesz be abban, hogy az üzemekben elhelyezkedő robotizált gyártó sorok rendszereinek hibáit elhárítod.
 Ismerd meg a karbantartási területet és a csapatot: 
 BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Karrier | Munkakörök | Karbantartás 
 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – magasan automatizált, robotokkal ellátott gyártósor, melyeknek a beállításában és üzemeltetésében nagy szereped lesz.
 Csapat – 8-10 fős csapat tagjaként a termelési csoportvezetőkkel és folyamattechnikus kollégákkal részt veszel a karbantartási feladatok végrehajtásában.

 Work environment – a highly automated production line equipped with robots, where you’ll play a major role in setup and operation.

 Maintenance – you’ll perform maintenance tasks, optimize production equipment, PLC programs, robots, and conveyor systems to prevent technical failures that could halt production.

 Education – A secondary-level qualification in electrical engineering, electronics, automation, or mechatronics.

 Work schedule – willingness to work in multiple or rotating shifts. 
 Language skills – native Hungarian speaker; no foreign language skills required. 
 Accuracy - attentive to detail, able to analyze problems systematically. 
 Sense of responsibility – able to work responsibly both independently and in a team.

 Problem solving and situation analysis – able to remain calm even when working at a fast pace, and calmly analyze and solve any problematic situation.

 .

Tendrás la oportunidad de diseñar y construir configuración, desarrollo, pruebas y despliegues; en nuevos proyectos o evoluciones de los sistemas desarrollados por TGT.

items.desc:
¿Quiénes somos? 
 TBS es Tech, Brands y Stories y, si somos lo que hacemos, en TBS somos muchas cosas. 
 Somos una productora, somos una agencia, somos una creadora de contenidos. Nos encanta el entretenimiento, y nos mueve montar, crear, contar buenas historias. Es lo que hacemos en las tres verticales que dan sentido a nuestro nombre. 
 Somos Tech, porque ofrecemos servicios técnicos y de broadcast para las mejores competiciones deportivas, eventos y programas de entretenimiento. Brands porque somos agencia creativa, de branded content y eventos. Stories porque generamos contenido con las mejores historias y formatos. 
 De cada historia hacemos una experiencia, y toda experiencia la vivimos como una buena historia. 
 Somos TBS, y con solo tres letras, somos capaces de hacer mucho. 
 Área de la Vacante 
 Estamos buscando Producer especializado en rodajes para gestionar la producción de piezas audiovisuales de Brands: branded content, campañas, vídeos corporativos, entrevistas, spots, piezas digitales, documentales de marca y contenidos para eventos. La persona seleccionada será responsable de convertir el planteamiento creativo en un plan de rodaje viable, coordinando equipos, proveedores, localizaciones, talento, permisos, logística, presupuesto y entrega de materiales. 
 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones? 
 Entre tus principales funciones destacan: 
 Analizar brief, guion, tratamiento, escaleta o propuesta creativa para definir necesidades reales de producción. 
 Planificar preproducción, rodaje y cierre: calendario, equipo humano, equipo técnico, localizaciones, permisos, talento, logística y entregables. 
 Elaborar órdenes de rodaje, call sheets, listados de necesidades, planes de desplazamiento, horarios, contactos y documentación operativa. 
 Buscar, comparar, negociar y coordinar proveedores de cámara, sonido, iluminación, arte, maquillaje, estilismo, casting, localizaciones, transporte, catering, postproducción y servicios auxiliares. 
 Gestionar localizaciones, permisos de rodaje, accesos, seguros, autorizaciones, transportes, dietas, alojamientos y contingencias logísticas. 
 Coordinar equipos creativos, técnicos, cliente, talento y proveedores durante preparación y rodaje. 
 Controlar presupuesto de rodaje, gastos, extras, anticipos, aprobaciones, desviaciones y cierre económico. 
 Supervisar derechos de imagen, música, archivo, marcas, localizaciones, materiales de terceros y condiciones de uso cuando aplique. 
 Asegurar la correcta transferencia, inventariado y entrega de materiales a postproducción. 
 Cerrar el proyecto con documentación, incidencias, gastos reales, proveedores utilizados y aprendizajes. 
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Formación: 
 Se valorará titulación o formación en Producción audiovisual/Publicidad, o experiencia equivalente. 
 Idiomas: 
 Valorable inglés nivel intermedio. 
 Experiencia: 
 Se valorará experiencia: 
 Producción de rodajes audiovisuales, branded content, publicidad, contenidos corporativos, piezas digitales o campañas. 
 Coordinando proveedores, equipos técnicos, talento, localizaciones y permisos. 
 Capacidad para resolver incidencias durante rodajes y tomar decisiones operativas rápidas. 
 Publicidad, ficción, documental, true stories, entrevistas, contenidos de marca o campañas con múltiples piezas. 
 Red de proveedores audiovisuales y equipos técnicos. 
 Experiencia en rodajes con cliente presente y gestión de necesidades en set. 
 Conocimientos Técnicos: 
 Valorables conocimientos: 
 De flujos de producción y postproducción audiovisual. 
 Manejo solvente de hojas de cálculo, documentación y herramientas colaborativas. 
 D e cesiones de imagen, música, archivo, derechos y entregables para diferentes canales. 
 Ventajas de formar parte de nuestro equipo: 
 Cuidamos la flexibilidad , posicionándonos como referente en nuevas formas de trabajo , horarios, jornadas y medidas de conciliación. 
 Seguro de accidentes . 
 Ayuda comida y complementos especiales , según convenio. 
 Posibilidad de acceso a paquete retribución flexible.

 Contarás con descuentos exclusivos por ser empleado de Telefónica en diferentes productos y servicios. 
 Acceso gratuito a formación de idiomas (Inglés, Alemán y Portugués) así como a la Universidad de Telefónica y diversos cursos de la plataforma E-learning. 
 Podrás estar a la última en digitalización (Oficina Digital, Analítica del Dato, Automatización e Inteligencia Artificial).

 Te integrarás en el núcleo de la Ciberinteligencia, dentro de la Dirección de Ciberdefensa Global de la Dirección de Seguridad Digital. Tu misión no será solo detectar amenazas, sino interpretar el tablero global . 
 Buscarás identificar, analizar y difundir inteligencia que permita anticipar movimientos de actores adversarios, comprendiendo la intersección entre la técnica y el contexto geopolítico para fortalecer la postura defensiva de Telefónica y blindar la toma de decisiones estratégicas. 
 Serás una pieza clave en la evolución de nuestras capacidades de Ciberinteligencia (CTI), actuando como el puente entre la realidad técnica (SOC, CSIRT, Red Team) y la visión de riesgo global, transformando datos complejos en resiliencia organizativa frente a un panorama de amenazas en constante cambio. 
 ¿Qué capacidades buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 Mentalidad de analista: Curiosidad insaciable por entender cómo funciona el mundo, las dinámicas de poder global y cómo estas se traducen en vectores de ataque digitales. 
 Arsenal técnico: Dominio avanzado de herramientas de análisis de datos y plataformas de inteligencia, con capacidad para navegar en la superficie y profundidad de la red. 
 Pensamiento crítico: Conocimiento de técnicas de hacking, forense digital, ingeniería de detección y análisis de código malicioso 
 Comunicación estratégica: Capacidad para sintetizar complejidad técnica en briefings ejecutivos y narrativas claras que permitan tomar decisiones rápidas y precisas. 
 Autonomía y rigor: Capacidad comprobada para gestionar proyectos complejos de forma independiente en entornos de alta presión y plazos ajustados. 
 Ética profesional: Integridad absoluta y discreción en el manejo de información sensible y clasificada. 
 Idiomas: Español nativo/fluido y un nivel de inglés avanzado capaz de redactar informes técnicos y estratégicos con precisión. Se valorarán conocimientos de portugués y alemán. 
 ¿Cómo contribuirás con tus capacidades al propósito del rol? 💼 
 Programa de inteligencia: Ayudaras en el diseño de los procesos de ciberinteligencia, detectando gaps de visibilidad y expandiendo capacidades que mantengan a Telefónica un paso por delante de los adversarios. 
 Análisis de fuentes complejas: Liderarás la recolección y el procesamiento de inteligencia mediante diferentes dominios como OSINT aplicando metodologías de análisis estructurado para convertir el ruido de múltiples fuentes en inteligencia accionable. 
 Respuesta ágil y discreta: Proveerás inteligencia táctica y operativa en tiempo real para neutralizar amenazas emergentes, entendiendo si el ataque es un evento genérico o una operación dirigida con objetivos específicos. 
 Ingeniería de detección: Optimizarás y automatizarás casos de uso, integrando la inteligencia generada directamente en las herramientas de seguridad para transformar el conocimiento en defensa automática. 
 Vigilancia del panorama global: Mantendrás un radar activo sobre TTPs, actores de amenazas (APTs), campañas y vulnerabilidades críticas, evaluando el impacto potencial basándote en la coyuntura global actual. 
 Producción de inteligencia: Generarás productos de inteligencia en los tres niveles (estratégico, operativo y táctico), definiendo el ciclo de vida de los IOCs y asegurando que la información llegue al decisor adecuado en el momento preciso. 
 Soporte en crisis: Actuarás como el referente de inteligencia para el CSIRT y el Red Team durante incidentes críticos, aportando el contexto necesario para priorizar riesgos y acelerar la remediación. 
 Sinergia multifuncional: Coordinarás esfuerzos con SOC, Arquitectura y otros departamentos para alinear la defensa técnica con los objetivos de negocio y la seguridad global. 
 Medición de Impacto: Definirás y reportarás métricas de madurez y desempeño del programa de CTI, trazando roadmaps de mejora continua basados en datos. 
 Mentoría Técnica: Actuarás como referente y mentor para analistas junior, fomentando una cultura de aprendizaje …

 The Associate Optometrist (OD) ensures all patients receive the highest quality eye and vision care as well as their general health and well-being. As a primary health care provider, you will use your extensive, ongoing training to examine, diagnose, treat and manage diseases, injuries and disorders of the visual system, eye and associated structures.  Strives to exceed expectations on all Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance expectations
 Helps ensure the brand is known as the leading optical provider within the community
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 
 Graduate of accredited School or College of Optometry

 DPA and TPA certified
 Knowledge of current Optometric technology and practices

If you’ve worn a pair of glasses, we’ve already met. 
 We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over 150 countries access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products (such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions), iconic brands that consumers love (such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear and Costa), as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences (such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò and the GrandVision network), and leading e-commerce platforms. 
 Join our global community of over 190,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry. 
 Discover more by following us on LinkedIn ! 
 Your #FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica 
 Are you willing to pioneer new frontiers, foster inclusivity and collaboration, embrace agility, ignite passion, and make a positive impact on the world? Join us in redefining the boundaries of what’s possible. 
 Your role 
 The Application Engineer is responsible for planning, conducting, and coordinating complex tests, providing technical 2nd level support, supporting the sales department, and serving as a central interface between our customers and internal departments. International travel is required. 
 Main responsibilities: 
 Independent planning, execution, documentation and analysis of individual tests to validate new products. 
 Investigation of complex issues, including the necessary troubleshooting. 
 Derivation of optimization measures and recommendations, e.g., release/block decisions, design changes, or process improvements. 
 Drive company-wide product standardization in close alignment with the global AE organization. 
 Prepare and conduct customer demonstrations and machine acceptances. 
 Support the service colleagues and customers with difficult and urgent machine problems. 
 Create and update documentation for Satisloh technicians and customers. 
 Ensure regular communication with key accounts and represent customer interests within our company. Be the voice of the customer! 
 Advise Rx productions to work more efficient, e.g. reduce reject rate or increase throughput. 
 Contribute your field experience to development projects. 
 Support the R&D department during the complete development phase. 
 Main requirements: 
 Technical Diploma or Engineering degree with relevant experience
 Strong analytical and communication skills in Italian and English. 
 Willingness to travel frequently. 
 Motivation to learn and grow in a technical environment. 
 Problem-solving mindset and customer-oriented attitude. 
 Highly valued: knowledge of ophthalmic lens production processes (hard coating, anti-reflection, sun coating). 
 Preferred: previous experience in ophthalmic or solar lens manufacturing environments 
 Recruiting process: 
Our recruitment process may vary; If you are selected, you will be contacted by our recruiters to guide you through the specific steps for your application. 
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitment​ 
 We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

Privredna banka Zagreb d.d. je društvo čija je vizija biti uzor i centar izvrsnosti u području financijskog poslovanja u Hrvatskoj. Temelj našeg uspješnog poslovanja su naši zaposlenici, koji aktivno sudjeluju u modernom razvoju banke i kreiranju stalnih promjena. PBZ, kao inovativna i suvremena banka i koja je usmjerena na interni razvoj, pruža okolinu u kojoj se možete razviti u smjeru u kojem želite. Univerzalni način kako ostvariti karijeru kod nas nije nepoznanica: učinkovitim radom, ostvarivanjem ciljeva, kontinuiranim razvojem kompetencija,odgovornim organizacijskim ponašanjem, prihvaćanjem različitosti, timskim doprinosom i osobnom proaktivnošću.  Pružanje profesionalne usluge klijentima o bankarskim proizvodima i uslugama.
 Identificiranje i razumijevanje financijskih potreba klijenata te pružanje stručnih savjeta i rješenja.
 Obavljanje transakcija i mjenjačkih poslova - rad s gotovinom.
 Aktivno sudjelovanje u postizanju prodajnih ciljeva.
 Svakodnevna suradnja s kolegama iz različitih dijelova Banke i timski rad.

 VSS/VŠS iz područja financija, ekonomije ili srodnog područja (prednost).
 Iskustvo u bankarstvu ili prodaji je poželjno, ali nije nužno.
 Potrebne vještine i znanja 
 Razvijene komunikacijske vještine.
 Preciznost i posvećenost detaljima.
 Visoka razina stručnosti i predanosti pružanju vrhunske usluge klijentima i prodajne vještine.
 U Privrednoj banci Zagreb prepoznajemo vaš talent, pružamo vam vrhunske uvjete za profesionalni razvoj i želimo zajedno s vama stvarati nove vrijednosti. Ako ste ambiciozni i motivirani te želite napraviti izazovan iskorak u karijeri – javite nam se.

items.desc:
Mi smo tim od gotovo 3000 koleginica i kolega širom Srbije. Slavimo jedinstvenost i negujemo kulturu otvorenog feedback-a, jer samo tako možemo rasti i razvijati se zajedno.Deo smo Intesa Sanpaolo, jedne od vodećih bankarskih grupa u Evropi, na tržištu Srbije smo 20 godina i poslujemo u više od 90 gradova naše zemlje. Verujemo da bez snažnih pojedinaca nema ni snažnih timova, ali i da samo jaki timovi mogu biti pravi oslonac i temelj za svaki individualni uspeh. Zajedno, svakodnevno brinemo o potrebama više od 1,3 miliona klijenata, gradeći čvrste odnose poverenja zasnovanih na ekspertizi i znanju. 
 TI SI ODLIČAN KANDIDAT ZA OVU POZICIJU AKO POSEDUJEŠ: 
 Višu/Visoku stručnu spremu (ekonomija, finansije i bankarstvo)
 Minimum dve godine radnog iskustva u oblasti bankarstva, na istim ili sličnim pozicijama
 Poznavanje bankarskog poslovanja i proizvoda
 Odlično znanje engleskog jezika (pisana i usmena komunikacija)
 Iskustvo u radu sa privrednim subjektima
 TVOJE PREDNOSTI BI MOGLE DA BUDU: 
 Diploma ekonomskog fakulteta
 Iskustvo u radu sa klijentima
 Sklonost ka timskom radu i novim saznanjima
 ŠTA OVA ULOGA PODRAZUMEVA: 
 Identifikovanje potencijalnih klijenata, pripremu adekvatne ponude, organizovanje prezentacija i sastanaka sa klijentima
 Edukaciju klijenata u pogledu korišćenja proizvoda i usluga banke, a u cilju ostvarenja dugoročne saradnje
 Predstavljanje i prodaju proizvoda i usluga banke, za delegirani segment malih i srednjih preduzeća kroz aktivnu akviziciju
 Uspostavljanje odnosa sa potencijalnim klijentima, kroz pružanje adekvatnih informacija i usluga, na profesionalan način i u skladu sa dobrom poslovnom praksom
 Pripremu, planiranje i organizovanje sastanaka sa potencijalnim klijentima na dnevnom nivou, u cilju prepoznavanja njihovih potreba i prezentovanja proizvoda i usluga koje mogu zadovoljiti potrebe klijenta
 Pribavljanje potrebne dokumentacije od klijenata, obradu zahteva, pripremu ugovora i prateće dokumentacije koja se odnosi na konkretne predmete, samostalno ili u saradnji sa saradnikom za poslovanje sa malim i srednjim preduzećima
 Identifikovanje mogućnosti za razvoj poslovanja i unapređenja konkurentnosti ponude banke, na bazi informacija sa tržišta
 Zašto baš Banca Intesa? 
 Svojim kolegama smo omogućili fleksibilno radno vreme i rad od kuće, kao i odlične prilike za razvoj kroz eksterne obuke, interne radionice i talent programe. Talentovanim kolegama pružamo priliku za internacionalnu karijeru. Brinemo o balansu, podstičemo zdrave životne navike i gradimo atmosferu dobre timske saradnje i podrške. Učestvujemo na brojnim sportskim aktivnostima i takmičenjima, kao i volonterskim aktivnostima u okviru programa „Intesa od srca“. Deci naših zaposlenih pružamo priliku da steknu dragocena međunarodna iskustva i razviju svoje veštine i talente, kroz učešće u sportskim takmičenjima i letnjim kampovima za decu.
 Ako si spreman da napraviš sledeći korak u svojoj karijeri i pridružiš se timu u kojem se vaše ideje, stručnost i doprinos istinski cene, voleli bismo da te upoznamo. Prijavi se danas i zajedno sa nama oblikuj budućnost.

items.desc:
Dobro došli u Intesa Sanpaolo Banku, Banku koja brine o svemu što vam znači. 
 Intesa Sanpaolo Banka d.d. BiH, članica je PBZ Grupe koja je također dio Intesa Sanpaolo Grupe jedne od najvećih bankarskih grupa u Evropi. 
 Intesa Sanpaolo u 12 zemalja regiona centralne i istočne Evrope i mediteranskog bazena, posluje kroz svoje direktne banke podružnice putem 1.400 poslovnica i sa 8,4 miliona klijenata. 
 Intesa Sanpaolo Banka je komercijalna banka i nalazi se među vodećim bankama na tržištu Bosne i Hercegovine. 
 Pruža sve vrste bankarskih usluga u domaćoj i inostranoj valuti sa širokim portfolijom usluga namijenjenih za korporativno bankarstvo i stanovništvo. Banka posluje kroz 5 glavnih regionalnih podružnica i 44 operativne jedinice, posjeduje rasprostranjenu mrežu bankomata i POS uređaja. Prisutna je na cijelom području BiH. 
 Opis poslova 
 Obavljanje poslova po svim proizvodima/uslugama iz nadležnosti poslovnice/šaltera izuzev ograničenja po kreditnim proizvodima. Odgovoran za primjenu Zakona o sprječavanju pranja novca i financiranja/finansiranja terorizma, za dosljedno pridržavanje internih akata Banke. 
 Odgovoran je za opremu i novac s kojim manipulira, te za obavljanje pozadinskih poslova.
 Davanje informacija o depozitnim proizvodima stanovništva, te primanje i realizacija zahtjeva klijenata za otvaranje/zatvaranje svih vrsta depozitnih računa.
 Svi poslovi i aktivnosti vezani za kartične proizvode stanovništva kao i kreditni poslovi. 
 Pružanje usluga savremenog bankarstva (internet, elektronsko i mobilno bankarstvo) kao i nformisanje klijenata, ugovaranje jednokratnih ili trajnih naloga.
 Poslovi domaćeg i inozemnog platnog prometa kao i mjenjački poslovi 
 Zaprimanje deviza, naplate naknada i isplate po odobrenju.
 Ostali zadaci po nalogu nadređene osobe.
 Potrebno iskustvo 
 Prethodno radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim pozicijama jer poželjeno, ali ne i obavezno.
 Potrebne vještine, kvalifikacije i znanja 
 Poželjna VSS ili SSS ekonomskog smjera.
 Poznavanje rada na računaru (MS Office) i osnovno poznavanje engleskog jezika.
 Spremnost na rad u dinamičnom okruženju i sposobnost jasnog i logičnog rasuđivanja.
 Razvijene komunikacijske vještine te sklonost radu u timu, strukturiranost, organiziranost, proaktivnost i usmjerenost na rezultat.
 Ukoliko ste proaktivni, motivisani, dobro organizovani, fleksibilni, volite raditi u timu i ispunjavate kriterije potrebne za rad na pojedinim radnim mjestima u okviru Pravilnika o organizaciji i sistematizaciji Intesa Sanpaolo Banke Bosna i Hercegovina, biće nam drago da vas upoznamo i ponudimo radno mjesto u timu naše Banke, koji svakim danom postaje sve veći i jači

Join us as a Talent Partner supporting one of our Business Units, where you will play a pivotal role in driving talent, leadership, culture and organisational effectiveness priorities that fuel business success and create an exceptional employee experience. 
 About the Role 
 As Talent Partner, you will be the go-to expert embedded within the Business Unit, dedicated to unlocking people potential and translating business strategy into meaningful people outcomes. You will partner closely with senior leaders and leadership teams to drive talent decisions, succession planning and organizational capability priorities. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and rolling up their sleeves to make things happen. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design together with the business and coordinate the implementation of the talent strategy, measure outcomes and ensure successful adoption by business leaders 
 Imagine the future of work, how the business and roles will evolve, as well as the capabilities required for the future to ensure the organization gets ready for what comes next and secures/develops the necessary talent 
 Design and facilitate the Talent Review sessions for the leadership teams, including succession planning , talent pipelining and leadership pipeline development 
 Lead end-to-end employee engagement survey processes — communicating, coordinating and analysing results, providing actionable insights and monitoring follow-up actions to ensure a quality employee experience 
 Embed inclusion as a fundamental pillar of all Talent Management processes within the Business Unit, staying connected to the latest Inclusion initiatives and ensuring they are integrated meaningfully 
 Stay ahead of the curve on Talent projects across areas such as performance culture, strategic people planning and capability development 
 Operationalise Talent & Culture group processes across the Business Unit, taking clear personal ownership and accountability for implementation in partnership with relevant peers and colleagues 
 Interpret and leverage people data and analytics — including Swiss Re-wide surveys and other sources — to diagnose root causes of talent and learning challenges and drive evidence-based solutions 
 About the Team 
 Our team partners with leaders across Life and Health Reinsurance, Asset Management and EMEA countries. We play a critical role in enabling the success of these functions by ensuring our people, leaders and organisation are equipped to meet current and future business challenges. We work closely with business leaders and HR colleagues to shape talent strategies, strengthen leadership pipelines, foster an inclusive culture and build the capabilities needed for long-term success. We are a collaborative, high-performing team that blends strategic thinking with pragmatic execution — always with a sharp focus on business impact. If you value both big-picture thinking and getting things done, you'll feel right at home here. 
 About You 
 You are a commercially minded talent and people professional who genuinely enjoys partnering with leaders, solving complex organisational challenges and turning data into action. You bring a compelling combination of strategic thinking, strong stakeholder management and a deep passion for developing people and organisations. You are curious, credible and confident — able to influence at senior levels while remaining grounded in practical delivery.

 Proven experience in talent management , organisational effectiveness, leadership development, learning, culture and/or inclusion — with a track record of delivering measurable impact

 Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into practical people solutions , with strong analytical skills and experience using people data and insights to inform and influence decision-making

 Experience supporting organisational transformation, change management or strategic workforce planning initiatives 
 Background in consulting, organisational development or a related advisory capacity 
 Excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills , with confidence engaging and influencing senior stakeholders …

 Sanofi è un’azienda della salute, innovativa e globale guidata da una ragion d’essere: sfidare i 
 confini della scienza per migliorare la vita delle persone. 
 La Global Business Unit General Medicines continua il suo percorso di crescita investendo prioritariamente in aree ad elevato bisogno terapeutico, Diabete di Tipo 1 e Trapianti, nelle quali, con impegno, ricerca clinica innovativa e acquisizioni strategiche, è possibile portare ai pazienti opzioni di trattamento efficaci in patologie ad alto impatto e nelle quali concretamente giocare un ruolo fondamentale per tutto il comparto salute. 
 In questo contesto la Franchise Trapianti, in rapida espansione negli ultimi anni, è alla ricerca di un/una Clinical Science Associate da inserire nel proprio organico all’interno di un gruppo ambizioso, agile e innovativo, che gioca per vincere e vuole fare la differenza per migliorare la vita delle persone sottoposte a trapianto. 
 Responsabilità principali: 
 Il/la Clinical Science Associate sarà il responsabile e il riferimento primario per l’azienda dell’area geografica assegnata nel campo dei trapianti di cellule staminali emopoietiche e di organo solido. 
 Garantirà l’efficacia dell’informazione e della comunicazione scientifica di più alto livello in area trapianti e agli interlocutori di riferimento, al fine di raggiungere gli obiettivi del territorio di competenza, nel rispetto del codice deontologico, del modello organizzativo adottato dall’azienda e delle strategie aziendali.

 L’area geografica di competenza sarà: Emilia-Romagna, Toscana, Umbria, Marche 
 La risorsa ripoterà al Commercial Lead e avrà le seguenti responsabilità: 
 Garantire l’efficacia dell’informazione e della comunicazione scientifica multicanale in merito ai prodotti assegnati e ai customer di riferimento (target medico) al fine di raggiungere gli obiettivi del territorio di competenza, nel rispetto del codice deontologico e delle strategie aziendali; 
 Massimizzare le performance di ingaggio attraverso una strategia multicanale, affiancando alla promozione sul territorio l’utilizzo di strumenti da remoto nel rispetto delle customer journey definite, al fine di assicurare una customer experience in linea con le indicazioni aziendali; 
 Conoscere i processi, i meccanismi chiave e le dinamiche nelle aree territoriali e negli account assegnati, garantendo una massima collaborazione tra funzioni centrali aziendali e stakeholder territoriali, nel campo dei trapianti di cellule staminali emopoietiche e trapianti di organo solido, sempre nel pieno rispetto della legge, del codice deontologico e del modello organizzativo adottato; 
 Garantire un forte approccio data driven per incrementare continuamente la conoscenza dei customer di riferimento; 
 Attuare, nell’ambito delle strategie aziendali e delle regole deontologiche, attraverso un approccio di comunicazione multicanale, un’efficace comunicazione e informazione scientifica sui prodotti, in grado di ottenere il consenso del medico sui vantaggi terapeutici dei farmaci: curando le relazioni professionali con i medici e assicurandone il costante aggiornamento scientifico sui prodotti Sanofi;

 Description and Requirements
 Descrizione e requisiti 
 Se vuoi cambiare il volto dell'energia, stiamo cercando un/una " Logistic Specialist " da inserire nel nostro team 3SUN di "Logistic and Material Management"! 
 Con chi lavorerai 
 Farai parte del team di Logistic Management di 3SUN che si occupa di assicurare la gestione efficiente e sicura delle attività logistiche e di magazzino, coordinando i flussi di materiali e prodotti, monitorando le performance operative e supportando il processo decisionale tramite analisi dei dati. 
 Avrai l'opportunità di lavorare con un team composto da 10 risorse che seguono le differenti attività in funzione degli ambiti Logistic and Material Management 3Sun di riferimento. 
 Cosa farai 
 In questo ruolo, all’interno del team ti occuperai prevalentemente delle seguenti attività: 
 Gestire tutte le operazioni logistiche inbound, outbound e internal handling, compresi i trasporti tra i magazzini interni ed esterni; 
 Garantire l’integrità e la contabilità dell’inventario; 
 Sviluppare le strategie per ottimizzare il flusso dei materiali, in relazione ai kpi del gruppo ed a criticità quali over stocking e/o out of stocking; 
 Monitorare e analizzare i KPI’s per identificare le aree di miglioramento e implementare le misure correttive; 
 Gestire i contratti con 3PL relativi ai servizi di logistica interni ed esterni, monitorando i livelli di performance dei fornitori, con particolare focus sui costi, sulla qualità e sulla sicurezza; 
 Gestire e coordinare le attività del team garantendo il rispetto delle priorità e degli obiettivi dell’unità; 
 Interfacciarsi continuamente con i team di material planning e produzione per la pianificazione delle attività. 
 Cosa porterai 
 Requisisti minimi ne cessari per questo ruolo sono:
 Competenze richieste: 
 Contract Management, logistica, supply chain e warehousing; 
 Capacità di analizzare e rappresentare i dati tramite l'utilizzo degli strumenti informatici (Excel, Power Point, Power BI, SAP E4E); 
 Analisi dei dati e Statistical Forecasting, incluso Microsoft Excel e Power BI, ERP (SAP E4E); 
 Implementazione di sistemi di reporting con KPI. 
 Esperienza professionale richiesta : conoscenza dei fondamentali di Supply Chain, Gestione logistica, Internal Handling e Warehouse Management. 
 Soft skills richieste: 
 Capacità di lavorare in team in ottica di processo; 
 Orientamento al risultato; 
 Capacità comunicative e relazionali; 
 Responsabilità, Time Management e gestione delle priorità; 
 Proattività, curiosità intellettuale e spirito di iniziativa; 
 Problem Solving & Decision making. 
 Istruzione, competenze linguistiche e altre informazioni pertinenti : 
 Laurea, preferibilmente in Ingegneria; 
 Buona padronanza della lingua inglese 
 Perché unirsi a noi? 
 Contratto di lavoro: Contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato, inquadramento 1° livello, Appendice al CCNL Elettrici 18 luglio 2022 disciplina speciale attività di cui art. 1, lettere e), f) e DAV, CCNL elettrici 
 Range salariale annuale: 40.000 € - 43.000 € 
 Opportunità di sviluppo: continuous learning e percorsi di sviluppo ed empowerment 
 Benefici previsti: Fondo Integrativo Sanitario, fondo pensione complementare, welfare aziendale per una migliore conciliazione vita-lavoro (supporto alla genitorialità, congedi parentali extra ecc.) 
 Altri benefici: vantaggi con offerte e convenzioni dedicate (buoni pasto, viaggi, trasporti, sport, cultura, energia ecc.) 
 Sede: Catania 
 Diversità, equità, inclusione e processo di selezione 
 Questa opportunità è aperta a tutte e tutti, abbiamo a cuore l'”unicità” di ciascuno perché crediamo che i differenti punti di vista, la pluralità di esperienze e prospettive siano un motore fondamentale per l’innovazione. 
 In Enel, valorizziamo diversità, equità e inclusione come pilastri della nostra cultura e in quanto ispirano ambienti di lavoro aperti, dinamici e collaborativi, capaci di generare un autentico senso di appartenenza. Li integriamo in ogni fase della gestione delle persone, incluso il processo di selezione, che progettiamo su misura per ogni ruolo, con l’obiettivo di riconoscere e valorizzare i talenti, le competenze e le storie di ciascun candidato e candidata. 
 Il processo di selezione prevede un primo colloquio conoscitivo con il team Recruiting, seguito da un incontro tecnico con la linea di business di riferimento. 
 Se il tuo profilo è in linea con i requisiti del ruolo, ti contatteremo per condividere tutti i dettagli sulle fasi successive del processo. 
 Cerchiamo persone che incarnino i nostri valori: fiducia, …

items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Internal Control Specialist (Technology Risk) 
 Adyen is looking for an Internal Control Specialist with a focus on technology risks in our Amsterdam office. 
 You will join the global Internal Control team and will contribute to advance Adyen’s fast growth. You are experienced in risk management and internal control and have the ability and eagerness to operate proactively and independently in a complex and fun global environment. 
 You will mainly focus on assessing and strengthening Adyen’s global technology processes and internal control framework, to meet internal and external expectations and to enable controlled growth. You will support the company in building a great business, preserving the company culture and achieving its long-term goals by taking our risk management to the next level. 
 We don’t hide behind email, instead we pick up the phone. This is one of the values in our Adyen Formula, which is the foundation of our strong culture and an essential guiding principle for the way we work. We always ask why, are critical, don’t just tick the box and always look for improvement and automation. These are some of the values incorporated in the Adyen way of being in control, promoted by the Internal Control team globally.
 What you’ll do: 
 Strengthen and manage the global internal control framework and support management on internal control matters.
 Evaluate Adyen’s processes, risks, controls and technology to identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
 Coordinate and perform testing of controls, and report on the effectiveness of Adyen’s risk and control systems.
 Manage requests from regulators and auditors to ensure successful audit cycles (e.g. SOC1/SOC2 audits).
 Create a network and be a trusted advisor for the business and management.
 Collaborate with your peers from the Internal Control team in managing the global internal control framework and contributing to various projects.
 Who you are: 
 Relevant working experience (approximately 4-7 years) within an IT audit, IT risk management or internal control function.
 Experience with IT risk management and designing and testing of IT controls (experience within the payments industry is not required).
 Knowledge of IT processes, IT risks and building internal control frameworks.
 Able to operate comfortably and independently within a fast-paced global environment.
 Critical thinking skills and eagerness to comprehend emerging internal and external developments and execute accordingly.
 Eager to work in an innovative technology company within the financial sector.
 Good communication and stakeholder management skills
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.desc:
Join our global Cybersecurity Central Coordination team and help turn Information Security governance into effective action across Continental regions, locations and business functions. As Cybersecurity Central Coordinator , you will translate policies, standards and regulatory requirements into coordinated activities and measurable outcomes.
You will connect central, regional and local Cybersecurity stakeholders, strengthen security awareness and compliance, and create transparency on risks, incidents and improvement measures.
 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 • Coordinate Cybersecurity activities across assigned regions, locations and business functions.
• Support the implementation of Information Security policies, standards and service-management processes.
• Monitor Cybersecurity services and agreed service levels and follow up on delivery issues.
• Maintain dashboards and reports covering compliance, risks, incidents and improvement actions.
• Coordinate remediation of audit findings and support risk assessments and security controls.
• Contribute to Information Security roadmaps, standards, solution concepts and operating-model improvements.
• Support Cybersecurity projects by tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions.
• Facilitate stakeholder collaboration, knowledge sharing, awareness, training and phishing-resilience activities.
• Support provider, portfolio and sourcing activities and assess relevant market and technology trends.
• University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a comparable qualification.
• +3 years of experience in Cybersecurity or Information Security.
• Strong knowledge of Cybersecurity governance, processes, service management and risk management.
• More than 3 years experience in coordinating cross-functional and international stakeholders.
• Experience in project or process coordination and collaboration with service providers.
• Ability to translate legal, regulatory and business requirements into practical actions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
• Business-fluent English and excellent communication skills.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC or ISO 27001 are an advantage.

items.title: Engineer, Reliability Engineering
items.card: responsibilities: Early engagement in new technology developments to understand technical risks with regards to device design and manufacturing process risks as well as customer expectations. De-risking of novel electrochemical and semiconductor devices through reliability testing utilizing industry standard testing but also through the development of bespoke stress tests and lifetime acceleration techniques.
items.desc:
About Analog Devices 
 Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .
 The Team: 
 The Intrinsic Reliability ( i Rel) Group is responsible for ensuring Product/Process Lifetime Robustness at ADI. This is achieved by investigating the intrinsic reliability of devices/circuits and sensors. The i Rel Group employs a range of engineering disciplines including electronics, physics and materials experts. The group is split across two locations namely, ADLK (Limerick, Ireland) and ADSV (San Jose, CA). The successful candidate will reside in ADLK.
 The Position: 
 The position to be filled is for a P2 Intrinsic Reliability Engineer. The engineer will be responsible for characterizing novel technologies such as electrochemical biosensors and magnetoresistive sensors through device reliability testing.
 Main responsibilities: 
 Early engagement in new technology developments to understand technical risks with regards to device design and manufacturing process risks as well as customer expectations.
 De-risking of novel electrochemical and semiconductor devices through reliability testing utilizing industry standard testing but also through the development of bespoke stress tests and lifetime acceleration techniques.
 Development of statistical lifetime models to evaluate technology robustness.
 Collaboration with failure analysis and process/product development teams to localize and understand root cause of failures.
 Attendance at industry leading device/circuit reliability conferences and adoption of industry State-of-the-Art best practices.
 Required skills: 
 Bachelor’s degree in chemistry/physics/material science or related field at a minimum. Master’s degree or relevant early career work experience is an advantage.
 Ability to multitask and pivot between multiple priorities is essential.
 Strong teamwork, interpersonal and communication skills are essential, coupled with a demonstrated ability to work at a high level of performance independently and as part of a team.
 Knowledge of reliability engineering is an advantage.
 Experience with Python/JMP for modelling of lifetime data is an advantage.
 For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

items.desc:
Sunsave | Product Engineer (Mid-Level / Senior) | London, United Kingdom (Holborn) | ONSITE (hybrid, 3 days/week in office) | Full-time
Sunsave is building what replaces your energy supplier. Customers switch to solar and a battery with nothing to pay upfront: kit, install, finance and long-term protection in one package, and the battery trades energy on the grid every day to push their bills towards zero. Founded in 2022, £113m Series A (equity and debt) in 2025, more than 3x growth last year, nearly 90 people.
I lead engineering and data science. Software runs every step of the customer journey: the quote, the finance application, the contract, the install and the battery trading. You'd join a small squad on one area: acquisition (website, quote, finance, contract), installation, in-life (customer app, monitoring, maintenance) or energy (battery optimisation and grid trading).
Product engineers here own problems end to end, from working with the people who use what they build to running it in production. Agents do a lot of the implementation. We expect you to use them every day, delegate the implementation but never the thinking, and own every line you merge. We offer finance and hold customer data, so correctness, auditability and security matter a lot.
Experience: 2+ years running production software for mid-level, 6+ for senior. TypeScript, NestJS, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL and AWS are a plus but not required. Right to work in the UK required.
The interview is built for how we work. No leetcode. A ~45 min async review of a pull request written with AI, then a ~90 min live session where you shape and build a small problem close to our work with your own AI tools.

 In addition to strong Linux system engineering skills, the role requires solid working knowledge of container platforms, particularly Kubernetes, to support modern, containerized workloads alongside traditional infrastructures. 
 The position sits within the Engineering (L3) function and includes participation in 24/7 on-call rotation, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and support for production GO-LIVE and major change activities.

 Linux Engineering & Platform Design 
 Design, build, and evolve enterprise Linux platforms in on-premises and/or cloud environments

 Support technology lifecycle management, upgrades, and obsolescence planning 
 Container & Kubernetes Platforms

 Support containerized workloads running on Kubernetes in on-premises and/or cloud environments 
 Perform troubleshooting of container, pod, node, and networking issues 
 Collaborate with platform, middleware, and application teams on container onboarding and runtime requirements 
 Apply security best practices for containerized environments 
 System Administration & Operations (L3) 
 Provide L3 support for Linux and container platform-related incidents 
 Perform advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis in production environments 
 Support BAU / Run activities, including incident, problem, and change management 
 Participate in maintenance windows, patching cycles, and major infrastructure changes 
 Security, Hardening & Compliance 
 Perform Linux system hardening in line with internal security standards and industry best practices 
 Support security hardening and configuration validation for Kubernetes environments 
 Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements 
 Collaborate with Security and Audit teams during assessments and remediation activities 
 Automation & Infrastructure as Code 
 Design, implement, and maintain automation and Infrastructure as Code solutions 
 Use configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible 
 Contribute to Terraform or similar IaC frameworks 
 Support automation for OS provisioning, configuration, and container platform operations 
 Performance, Monitoring & Capacity 
 Monitor Linux and Kubernetes platform health, performance, and capacity 
 Identify performance bottlenecks and implement tuning and remediation actions 
 Support proactive capacity planning and availability risk identification 
 Collaboration & Cross-Team Integration 
 Collaborate with network, storage, middleware, security, and application teams 
 Support application onboarding on both VM-based and container-based platforms 
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance reliability and operational efficiency 
 What you'll need to succeed
 Strong hands-on experience as a Linux System Administrator / Engineer in enterprise environments 
 In-depth knowledge of enterprise Linux distributions (e.g. RHEL, Oracle Linux or equivalents) 
 Solid operational experience with Kubernetes platforms (cluster operations and troubleshooting) 
 Understanding of container concepts (Docker / OCI containers, images, registries) 
 Experience supporting mission-critical production systems 
 Proficiency with automation and configuration management tools (Ansible, Terraform or similar) 
 Solid scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar) 
 Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills 
 Preferred / Nice to Have 
 Experience with high-availability or clustering solutions (Pacemaker, Corosync) 
 Exposure to cloud platforms (GCP, Azure)

 Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines

 The Cloud Engineer role involves orchestrating the onboarding of public cloud services, implementing advanced automation using tools, optimizing cloud resources for efficiency, and leading the execution of cloud infrastructure projects. This position requires a strong technical background in continuous integration, security practices, and infrastructure-as-code, coupled with a dynamic and engaging approach to navigating the challenges of a fast-paced, innovative environment. 
 What you'll be doing
 Onboard public cloud services and engineer new features for adopted services;
 Manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform;
 Develop and maintain automation scripts for provisioning, scaling, and managing cloud resources;
 Implement continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines;
 Implement security best practices and compliance and company policies and guidelines related to cloud;
 Set up monitoring tools to track system performance, availability, and incidents;
 Monitor public cloud resources and optimize configurations for cost and performance;
 Provide on-call support for cloud services and infrastructure;
 Resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, create post-mortem documents and implement preventive measures;
 Collaborate with development and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of applications;
 Share knowledge and updates about cloud services and features to the internal developer community;
 Monitor cloud costs and analyze usage to optimize spending (FinOps cycle);
 Working as SDU (Secondary Delivery Unit), plan, organize, and manage all phases of cloud infrastructure provisioning chain, ensuring successful delivery in compliance with UniCredit processes;
 Infrastructure setup and configuration using infrastructure as code approach on cloud platforms (i.e. Azure, GCP);
 What you'll need to succeed
 1-3 years of experience 
 Extensive cloud engineering and tier 3 operational support experience with one of the leading cloud providers (AWS, Google, Azure). 
 Ability to troubleshoot complex problems using native tools embedded in the cloud platforms or external components like Dynatrace and Splunk. 
 DevOps/coding skills in at least one of: Python or Terraform. 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
 Analytical and problem-solving mindset. 
 Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and drive the evolution of specific areas of services. 
 Striving for the elimination of manual operational processes to promote a DevOps oriented software delivery model. 
 Experience with REST APIs to support integration of infrastructure, cloud, and platform as a service technology. 
 Experience with containers and container orchestration, Kubernetes, and Docker, including lifecycle management of containers. 
 Knowledge of web security, identity, and networking protocols. 
 Prior experience with implementing enterprise cloud management platforms. 
 Security: Knowledge of cloud security best practices and access management (IAM), encryption, and compliance standards. 
 Automation Scripting: Skills in scripting languages like Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automating tasks and workflows. 
 Database Management: Understanding of cloud-based database services and how to manage data storage efficiently. 
 Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines to automate the testing and deployment of applications. 
 What you'll get in return
 #MakeInnovationHappen : Chance to make an impact in terms of transformation 
 #UnlockYourPotential : Join a young and stimulating environment 
 #ComeAsYouAre : Working within a global team 
 #UnlockYourPotential : Play a role of autonomy with high visibility and exposure 
 #BalanceLifeAndCareer : Flexible working hours & working hybrid;
 A professional but still friendly work environment ; 
 #EnjoyTheBest: Access to our Benefits platform with a dedicated budget that you will be able to use, in order to choose the most suitable benefits for you;
 Healthcare insurance ;

 Career in a leading international banking group , build on the diversity of its strong local roots;

items.desc: B&A Consulting è una Software House e Digital Company specializzata in soluzioni ICT, sviluppo software e consulenza tecnologica. Per un progetto enterprise siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Machine Learning Engineer con esperienza nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di soluzioni Machine Learning e Generative AI, con particolare focus su LLM, RAG, embedding e ricerca vettoriale . La persona selezionata contribuirà allo sviluppo e all'evoluzione di servizi ML production-ready, occupandosi sia della componente modellistica sia dell'integrazione delle soluzioni all'interno dell'architettura applicativa. Attività Le principali attività riguarderanno: progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni di Machine Learning e Generative AI ; sviluppo e integrazione di sistemi basati su LLM ; implementazione di architetture RAG – Retrieval-Augmented Generation ; gestione e utilizzo di embedding e sistemi di ricerca vettoriale; sviluppo di servizi e microservizi in Python tramite FastAPI ; containerizzazione delle applicazioni tramite Docker e/o Podman ; integrazione delle soluzioni ML con database e componenti applicative; utilizzo di PostgreSQL e pgvector per la gestione e ricerca di rappresentazioni vettoriali; implementazione e utilizzo di algoritmi k-NN ; attività di validazione e calibrazione statistica dei modelli; analisi delle performance e delle metriche di errore; applicazione di tecniche di calibrazione, inclusa la regressione isotonica ; collaborazione con i team tecnici durante le fasi di sviluppo, integrazione e rilascio. Competenze tecniche Il/la candidato/a ideale possiede: almeno 4 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Machine Learning Engineering, Data Science, MLOps o analoghi; ottima conoscenza di Python ; esperienza concreta con LLM ; esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni RAG ; conoscenza e utilizzo di embedding ; esperienza nello sviluppo di servizi e microservizi tramite FastAPI ; esperienza con Docker e/o Podman ; conoscenza delle tecniche di calibrazione statistica dei modelli Machine Learning ; esperienza con regressione isotonica ; capacità di effettuare validazione dei modelli e analisi delle metriche di errore ; conoscenza di PostgreSQL ; esperienza con pgvector o tecnologie equivalenti per la ricerca vettoriale; conoscenza degli algoritmi k-NN ; buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata; Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria delle Telecomunicazioni, Cybersecurity o discipline affini. Soft skills Completano il profilo: capacità di analisi e problem solving; autonomia operativa; approccio data-driven; capacità di lavorare su problematiche tecniche complesse; proattività; precisione; predisposizione al lavoro in team; orientamento alla qualità delle soluzioni. Dans le cadre de sa campagne de stages, AXA recrute un stagiaire en actuariat – pricing Auto (F/H). Les compétences recherchées sont les suivantes : Rigueur et sens de l’analyse. Proactivité, curiosité et autonomie. Capacité à vérifier la pertinence des résultats. Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux. Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier par exemple : D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ; D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ; D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ; De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ; Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue ! VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !) La diversité et l'inclusion au cœur de notre recrutement : tous nos postes sont ouverts à toute personne compétente. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous ! Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking". Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : depuis 2020, nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ?
