items.desc: Outdoora è una startup che organizza tour in bici auto-guidati. I clienti prenotano un'esperienza, ritirano la bici presso uno dei nostri partner e partono con la nostra app, che li guida lungo il percorso con navigazione GPS vocale. Il prodotto è composto da tre parti: App mobile per i ciclisti: navigazione, attivazione del tour, contenuti lungo il percorso Pannello admin per gestire tour, prenotazioni e partner Portale partner per i noleggi e i negozi che consegnano le bici Le prenotazioni arrivano anche da piattaforme come GetYourGuide e Viator, integrate tramite Bókun. IL RUOLO Cerchiamo una persona che entri nel team tecnico per 15-20 ore a settimana e ci aiuti a far crescere la piattaforma. Non cerchiamo un aiuto temporaneo: vogliamo qualcuno che cresca con noi nel lungo periodo, con la prospettiva di un ruolo full-time. Nel quotidiano ti occuperai di: sviluppare nuove funzionalità e risolvere bug su backend, app e portale lavorare su task ben definite, con autonomia crescente mantenere e migliorare le integrazioni con i sistemi di prenotazione partecipare alla code review e alla pianificazione delle attività I progetti su cui vogliamo lavorare nei prossimi mesi: un sistema intelligente di gestione delle prenotazioni, che smista ogni richiesta al partner giusto in base a disponibilità e zona automazione delle prenotazioni presso i partner, per esempio la prenotazione delle bici a seguito di un ordine agenti AI di assistenza clienti per rispondere alle domande più frequenti prima e durante il tour creazione automatica dei tour a partire dalle tracce GPS, e generazione delle tracce stesse con l'aiuto dell'AI Se ti interessano questi temi, potrai contribuirvi in prima persona. COSA CERCHIAMO Cerchiamo qualcuno con esperienza pratica sul nostro stack, per poter essere operativo in poco tempo. Requisiti: buona conoscenza di Python e Django (modelli, API REST, Django admin) esperienza con React Native (app iOS e Android) oppure con React e Next.js (frontend web) uso quotidiano di Git e familiarità con pull request e code review capacità di lavorare in autonomia, gestire le proprie ore e comunicare in modo chiaro buona conoscenza dell'italiano e dell'inglese tecnico Costituiscono un plus: esperienza sia con React Native sia con React/Next.js esperienza con LLM, agenti AI o API di modelli linguistici esperienza con mappe e dati geografici (Mapbox, tracce GPX, GPS) conoscenza di Material UI, AWS (S3) e Heroku integrazioni con API di terze parti, pagamenti (Stripe) o sistemi di prenotazione passione per la bici e il turismo outdoor COSA OFFRIAMO Compenso: 1.300-1.500 € netti al mese, in base all'esperienza comprovata e alle ore concordate Impegno: part-time, 15-20 ore a settimana, con orari flessibili Sede: full remote Contratto: collaborazione coordinata e continuativa (co.co.co.). Non è richiesta la partita IVA. Durata iniziale di 12 mesi, al termine dei quali valuteremo insieme il passaggio a un contratto da dipendente full-time Periodo iniziale di prova di 4 settimane, con obiettivi chiari La possibilità di lavorare su un prodotto reale già usato dai clienti, e di contribuire allo sviluppo dei nuovi progetti di AI Un team piccolo, con contatto diretto con i founder e un impatto concreto sulle decisioni tecniche COME CANDIDARSI Invia a info@outdoora.app, con oggetto "Candidatura Sviluppatore part-time": 1. il tuo CV 2. il link al tuo profilo GitHub o a progetti su cui hai lavorato, in particolare con Django o React Native 3. qualche riga su di te: quante ore puoi dedicare e quando potresti iniziare Il processo di selezione prevede un colloquio conoscitivo e alcune task pratiche, simili al lavoro che svolgerai con noi, per valutare competenze tecniche e modo di lavorare. Ogni task richiede al massimo 2 ore. La selezione si concluderà entro novembre 2026, con inizio del lavoro il prima possibile. Annuncio rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77 e D.Lgs. 198/2006). Retribuzione: €15.400,00 - €18.200,00 all'anno Sede di lavoro: Da remoto

items.desc: Company Description Shaping the Future of Automotive Engineering Applus+ IDIADA is a global leader in automotive engineering, offering a dynamic and rewarding career opportunity for professionals passionate about shaping the future of mobility. As a TOP Employer certified company with over 3500 professionals from more than 24 countries, we provide a diverse and inclusive work environment that fosters innovation and growth with colleagues from over 55 nationalities contributing to a safer, more efficient, and sustainable vehicles. Why join us? Enjoy a highly flexible hybrid work model in a company that takes care of the employees’ wellbeing, offering work-life balance benefits such as subsidized canteen, free language courses, transport and coaching services. Join a company that has a deep commitment to sustainability and push yourself to reach your full potential in a dynamic and challenging setting that values innovation and expertise. Come & join us on the road to success. Job Description Reporting to the Manager, he/she will be involved in carrying out Testing Projects focused mainly on the study of the structural durability and abuse performance of the vehicles . The Test Engineer will be in charge of the execution of the testing projects which he/she will be assigned for and will act as window person with the client. The successful Test Engineer has a self-starting mentality, enjoys working hands-on on a variety of projects simultaneously and understands how to achieve a high level of "client" satisfaction from technical and quality points of view. In particular, the Test Engineer will be in charge of the following responsibilities and duties : Vehicle Instrumentation Set-Up Activities: Installation and configuration of sensors and measurement equipment prior to Road Load Data Acquisition (RLDA) campaigns using sensors like wheel force transducers, accelerometers, strain gages, string potentiometers etc. and data loggers systems. Functional checks of sensors and acquisition systems (HW + SW). Execution of preliminary measurement checks according to agreed procedures. Road Load Data Acquisition: Development and execution of the testing campaign, including test matrix definition, data download, sorting, and validation. Instrumentation debugging and issue resolution during RLDA activities. Analyse the collected test data and check for data integrity. Work in close collaboration with vehicle technicians, instrumentation and design teams. Write test reports to document results of testing and to communicate issues found. Maintain a clean and organized work environment. The role will be based onsite in the Headquarters of one IDIADA's client close to Bologna (Italy). Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering 1+ years of experience in vehicle-level testing projects related to the activities described in Job Description section. Technical Competencies: Test Equipment Expertise: Proficient use and handling of test equipment including: Wheel force transducers Accelerometers Strain gauges String potentiometers Data acquisition systems (Siemens Simcenter SCADAS, Quantum, eDAQ) Software Proficiency: Data acquisition and analysis platforms (Siemens Simcenter, Siemens TestLab) Programming and analytical tools (MATLAB, Python) Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication abilities Experience writing formal procedures, plans, and technical reports Comfortable leading client meetings and presenting test results with technical depth Fluent in Italian and English (written and spoken) Soft Skills: Proactive – shows eagerness in learning & finding ways to meet deliverables without dependency. Curiously investigate everything – ability to solve problems analytically, creatively and collaboratively. Lead with confidence – thought leaders who empower those around them. Learn by doing – an entrepreneurial mindset that’s driven by hands-on experimentation. Embrace resilience – seeing every challenge as a learning opportunity and invitation to grow. Additional Information WHAT ARE THE PHASES OF THE SELECTION PROCESS? Here's your roadmap: 1st: Submit your application and complete our screening questions. 2nd: Quick chat with HR or flexible pre-recorded interview to complete on your schedule. 3rd: Interview with the hiring team and complete English and attitudinal assessments. 4th: Receive your offer and begin your onboarding journey. Let's start this adventure together! Applus IDIADA is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion . We don’t put limits on you, so don’t put limits on yourself either. There is a place for everyone.

We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together. Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. items.desc: The Company 3Brain is a Swiss deep tech company working on cell-electronic interfaces that link biological networks to computers via custom-made semiconductor microchips. Our mission is to empower life scientists to probe intelligent networks, accelerate biomedical discoveries for the benefit of patients, and create a future more exciting than the present. Our interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers are constantly pushing the boundaries of engineering for life’s complexities. We are ambitious, fast-growing and love to explore. The company’s cutting-edge products are used in laboratories and pharma companies worldwide. 3Brain is headquartered in Switzerland nearby Zurich, has a Discovery Unit and production site in Genova, Italy, and an operational unit in the US. More info: http://www.3brain.com/about.html . Job description 3Brain is looking for a full-time Software Developer for its Italian office having experience in .NET projects. This position is intended for a mid-level developer with solid hands-on experience in the required technologies and a practical understanding of how different software solutions, data models and systems interact. The role will be pivotal within the Software Integration team, which focuses on integrating software solutions for the company’s and customers’ needs at the level of ERP systems and in connection with external systems. This position also requires hands-on design, coding and maintenance of the software suite. Main responsibilities: Design, develop and maintain high-quality software code in different programming languages, ensuring reliable data flow between databases, back-end services and user-facing applications. Analyze company and customer needs, participate in requirements discussions, and translate functional requirements into clear technical solutions for ERP integrations, APIs and external system interfaces. Coordinate with internal software, product and technical teams to ensure that integration solutions are consistent with the overall software architecture and product requirements. Contribute across the relevant technology stack, including front-end components, APIs, back-end services, databases, server-side logic and integration layers, with a practical understanding of how these elements support business and customer workflows. Develop maintainable, scalable and production-ready solutions using appropriate development environments, version-control workflows and modern software development practices, with attention to performance, reliability and long-term maintainability. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including use cases, design notes, API specifications, data-flow descriptions and implementation guidelines. Develop and execute test protocols, including unit tests, for software applications, APIs and integration workflows before release or deployment to users. Contribute to testing, verification and continuous improvement of software modules, including ERP-related features, instrument-control interfaces and integrations with external systems. Troubleshoot, fix errors and improve software performance, data consistency and user experience across internal tools, customer-facing solutions and connected software systems. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or similar. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in each of the following technologies: C#, ASP.NET, SQL, GIT, HTML/CSS and JavaScript. Experience with TypeScript, Angular, Python and NoSQL. Experience developing and integrating REST APIs, web services or similar interfaces between internal and external software systems. Practical experience with relational databases, data models, queries and data exchange between software applications. Collaborative problem-solving ability, action-oriented and results-focused. Excellent English language skills. Applicant must have an EU residence permit. Additional Qualifications Experience, or at least strong interest, in ERP systems, business workflows, process automation or internal software tools. Candidates experienced with DevExpress eXpressApp Framework (XAF) are strongly preferred. Experience with Agile development methods and with backlog management tools (e.g., JIRA). What We Offer A dynamic and stimulating work environment driven by a desire to build transformational technologies to help others. A fast-growing company with plenty of opportunities for personal growth and development. Working place: Genova, Italy . It is a wonderful Mediterranean city with and incredible history, located at the heart of nearby world-renowned places Cinque Terre or Milan, the fashion and business hub of Italy.

It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability. ABOUT WFP The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks. At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves. To learn more about WFP, visit our website: https://www.wfp.org WHY JOIN WFP? WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate. WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment. WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities. A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe. We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement). JOB TITLE: Research Analyst Consultant TYPE OF CONTRACT: Regular Consultant UNIT/DIVISION: Office of Evaluation (OEV) DUTY STATION (City, Country): Rome, Italy DURATION: 11 Months BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT: The WFP Evaluation Policy (2022) aims to contribute to global knowledge and support decision-making and Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) achievement at the global, regional, and national levels. It ensures that evaluation evidence consistently and comprehensively informs decisions on WFP policies, strategies, plans, and programmes. The Evaluation Policy and its amendments mandate the Office of Evaluation (OEV) to commission and manage a range of evaluation types—including Country Strategic Plan, Corporate Emergency, Policy, Strategic, and Synthesis evaluations—to generate evidence that assesses performance and informs decision-making on WFP policies, strategies, plans, and programmes. Centralized evaluations (commissioned by OEV) serve a dual purpose of accountability and learning and are conducted in accordance with UNEG norms and standards to ensure independence, credibility, and utility. Each centralized evaluation is managed by an evaluation officer and, where possible, supported by a research and data analyst. The analyst provides essential analytical and operational support across the evaluation cycle, including data analysis; process management; knowledge management of evaluation data and documents; preparation of terms of reference; quality assurance of evaluation deliverables; and coordination of the evaluation process and stakeholder engagement. The current and projected OEV programme of work and evaluation portfolio require the existing workforce of Research Analysts within OEV’s Analytics and Research Unit (ARU). Research Analysts operate with a high degree of autonomy, reporting to the Head of ARU and functionally to the evaluation managers responsible for the evaluations to which they are assigned. ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Centralized evaluations: Research and data analysis The research analyst will conduct research and data analysis for a minimum of four Centralized Evaluations (CE) comprising of policy, strategic and country strategic evaluations at varying stages of implementation including the partnership strategic evaluation; corporate emergency evaluation of WFP’s response in Palestine and the evaluation of Egypt and Haiti CSPs. The allocation of evaluations may be subject to changes during the course of the consultancy. items.desc: Imagine joining a role where you directly impact the performance, efficiency, and continuous improvement of tissue converting production processes. As a Process Engineer, you will support the entire manufacturing flow across machine assembly, line-up and testing, driving process optimization through data analysis, problem-solving, and close collaboration with production teams. In this position, you will act as a key link throughout all the production process, spending significant time on the shopfloor to understand processes firsthand, identify improvement opportunities, and support production teams in achieving safety, quality, delivery, and productivity targets. If you enjoy combining analytical thinking with practical field activities and are passionate about operational excellence, this is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on business success while developing your career in a dynamic manufacturing environment. Your responsibilities Spend significant time on the shopfloor supporting production department (machine assembly, line-up and testing) in achieving operational, quality, and delivery objectives Analyze production data and KPIs to identify improvement opportunities and support decision-making processes Lead and coordinate continuous improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing manufacturing processes Collaborate with production supervisors, quality, engineering, planning, purchasing, and project management to ensure efficient production flows and successful project execution Support process standardization activities and contribute to the development and implementation of best practices across production operations Expectations for you Master or Bachelor's Degree in Technical field (Management, Mechanical, Robotics or Automation Engineering) Solid analytical aptitude and confidence with manufacturing processes, Lean Manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies Previous experience in manufacturing, process engineering, industrial engineering, production, or continuous improvement roles is a plus Proficiency in MS Office; experience with ERP systems and BI tools is considered a plus Advanced English proficiency Strong communication skills Enjoy working both in an office environment and on the shopfloor, interacting directly with production teams Experience in tissue converting machinery or related industrial equipment manufacturing is a plus To succeed in this role You will combine strong analytical capabilities with a hands-on approach to manufacturing operations. Success in this role requires the ability to understand production challenges firsthand, translate data into actionable improvements, and effectively collaborate across multiple functions. You will be proactive in identifying improvement opportunities, solving operational issues, and supporting a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. Your ability to balance technical analysis with practical execution on the shopfloor will be fundamental in driving sustainable results and supporting business performance. We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value More information Please apply by November 29. items.desc: Job Requirements Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. Apply now for the position of Start-up Engineer (m/f/d) for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Systems . We are looking for two candidates: one in Northern Italy and one in Southern Italy. Your role: You will bring cutting-edge MRI systems to life across Italy, running hands-on start-ups and checking the magnet, gradient systems, RF coils, cooling systems and safety devices. You will test control and imaging software and make sure our systems integrate seamlessly with hospital IT environments (e.g., PACS, RIS). You will help ensure that every system meets the highest standards of safety, compliance and image quality, carrying out safety inspections and quality tests in line with applicable standards and legal requirements. You will sharpen your problem-solving skills by performing technical clarification, fault analysis and troubleshooting, and by managing spare-part ordering during commissioning. You will document your work through detailed test and validation reports and acceptance documentation, and ensure a smooth handover to the responsible service organization. You will be part of a collaborative network, working closely with external service providers, local project managers, customers, and teams at headquarters and in the factory. Work Experience You hold a technical diploma, or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Biomedical Engineering or a comparable engineering discipline (e.g., Electronic, Electrical, or Clinical Engineering). Ideally, you have 3-4 years of professional experience in the installation, maintenance, or service of medical devices or complex technical systems – ideally in diagnostic imaging. You are eager to learn and to be trained in the installation and commissioning of MRI systems and motivated to grow your technical expertise within a structured development path. Basic knowledge of medical device hardware and software, IT interfaces (e.g., PACS, RIS), and relevant safety standards and regulations is an advantage; prior exposure to MRI systems is a plus but not required. You have an analytical and structured way of working, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive, customer-oriented mindset, combined with good teamwork and communication skills. You are flexible and willing to travel frequently across Italy and work at changing locations; a valid Class B driving license is required. You are fluent in Italian and have a good command of English. Benefits In accordance with our commitment to pay transparency and equal opportunity, we provide a clear breakdown of the financial package for this role: The position is regulated by the Chemical-Pharmaceutical National Collective Labor Agreement (CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico), qualifica Impiegato. The base salary for this position typically ranges from € 38.000 to € 50.500 gross per year. The final offer will be tailored based on your individual skills, experience and specific location. Performance Bonus: this role is eligible for a variable incentive plan linked to specific achievements (5%) Total Rewards: beyond the base pay, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including flexible working, health insurance, company car and pension scheme. We are deeply committed to your growth, providing continuous learning opportunities with a dedicated budget for both technical advancement and soft skills development. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways. items.desc: Chi è ENGIE ENGIE mette al centro delle sue attività (elettricità, gas naturale, efficientamento energetico e servizi) lo sviluppo sostenibile, per far fronte alle sfide della transizione energetica verso una low carbon economy: accesso ad un'economia sostenibile, mitigazione e adattamento al cambiamento climatico e ottimizzazione delle risorse. Chi cerchiamo? Un/una Manutentore Multidisciplinare da inserire presso la sede di Milano , nell’ambito della Global Business Unit LOCAL ENERGY INFRASTRUCTION, divisione Industries Energy Projects. ENGIE nell’ambito della linea di business Industries Energy Projects , si impegna a rendere l’impresa un luogo sostenibile ed efficiente offrendo soluzioni su misura dedicate ai servizi, agli spazi e alle persone (Facility Management) e lavori di realizzazione e manutenzione (Construction). Tutto questo è possibile grazie alla presenza globale, all'esperienza, e alla sua solidità economica. ENGIE è infatti in grado di finanziare qualsiasi intervento energetico che migliori le performance del cliente, garantisca innovazione, ottimizzazione dei consumi energetici e riduzione delle emissioni di CO2. Che cosa farai? Nel Ruolo di Manutentore Multidisciplinare riporterai al manager di riferimento e, in coordinamento con il team Industrial & Facility Energy Services, ti occuperai delle le attività di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria relative all’impiantistica civile e industriale dei presidi del Cliente a te assegnato. Quali saranno le tue responsabilità? Attività di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria su impianti elettrici di bassa e media tensione; Conduzione e manutenzione di impianti elettrici; Manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria su linee di distribuzione, impianti elettrici a servizio degli impianti tecnologici, gruppi frigoriferi e gruppi di continuità (UPS); Realizzazione di lavori straordinari su impianti elettrici; Presa in carico e soluzione ticket legati ai disservizi impiantistici; Gestione sistemi di supervisione e sistemi informatici di manutenzione; Assistenza ai tecnici delle ditte subappaltatrici. Perché tu? Diploma tecnico e/o esperienza pregressa nel ruolo di almeno 3 anni con focus settore elettrico; Conoscenza funzionamento PLC, sistemi di supervisione e controllo degli impianti; Conoscenza degli schemi elettrici, simbologia e linguaggio tecnico; Conoscenza informatica di base; Preferibile il possesso di attestazione PAV/PES; Ottime capacità relazionali e di team working; Alto livello di autonomia Disponibilità a reperibilità e orario flessibile (7-19); In ENGIE, ogni talento ha un ruolo fondamentale nell’accelerare la transizione energetica. Contribuisci a fare la differenza e vivi un’esperienza professionale ricca di soddisfazioni. Affronta sfide stimolanti e costruisci un percorso di carriera che rispecchi davvero chi sei. Unisciti a noi e partecipa all’avventura del secolo! La retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) prevista per il ruolo è compresa tra €28.000 e €36.000, in base all’esperienza e al livello di seniority. Perché scegliere Engie? Lavorare in ENGIE, gruppo multinazionale, significa avere un'ampia varietà di possibilità di carriera in oltre 30 paesi. Ma significa anche mettere la comunità al centro della tua vita professionale e contribuire a un vero cambiamento nel corso di una carriera stimolante. Il nostro impegno è chiaro: sosteniamo un modello sociale che concilia la performance economica con l'impatto positivo sulle persone e sul pianeta. Scommettiamo sul potere della collettività e agiamo come parte di una comunità impegnata a sconvolgere e reinventare il futuro. Diversità e inclusione sono al centro della nostra cultura aziendale. ENGIE si impegna a combattere tutte le forme di discriminazione in materia di occupazione, accesso alla formazione e promozione. Pertanto, l'integrazione e il sostegno di giovani, adulti, persone con disabilità, senza alcuna distinzione di genere, etnia o religione, sono priorità fondamentali della politica delle risorse umane. Le Certificazioni EDGE e UNI PDR 125/22 conquistate, dimostrano tale impegno. items.desc: ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel is an international collective with the aim of nurturing shared well-being through unique, high-profile architectural solutions worldwide. Founded in 2000 by Antonio Citterio and Patricia Viel, the studio is currently enhanced by the creativity of more than 200 professionals and the leadership of 13 partners. From urban planning to residential and mixed-use developments, from corporate campuses to public buildings and hotels, each ACPV ARCHITECTS project embodies a new vision where nature and the noblest human aspirations can find new centrality. Posizione: We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Junior Material Researcher with an interest in materials, architecture and interior design. The role is primarily focused on providing operational and organizational support to the Studio's design teams and assisting with the daily management of the Materials Library. Working closely with designers and under the guidance of senior colleagues, the Junior Material Researcher will support the collection, organization, cataloguing, and updating of material samples, as well as the research and retrieval of product information and technical documentation. The position may also be offered as an internship, depending on the candidate's background and previous experience. The role will involve a range of activities including: Receive, label, catalogue, archive, and organize material samples from suppliers and manufacturers. Keep the Materials Library tidy and updated, ensuring samples are returned to their proper place after meetings, presentations, and project reviews. Assist designers in finding and retrieving material samples and product information for ongoing projects. Contact suppliers and manufacturers to request samples, catalogues, technical specifications, and product documentation. Update and maintain the physical and digital database of materials, products, and suppliers. Support the preparation of material boards, moodboards, and presentations for project teams. Assist in collecting and organizing technical and qualitative information on materials and products. Carry out basic research on materials, finishes, products, and manufacturers based on the needs of the design teams. Support the organization of supplier meetings and showroom visits. Help collect and organize information for internal updates on new materials, products, and industry events. Requisiti: Degree in Architecture, Interior Design or a related field. Previous experience in a similar role will be considered a plus; candidates with limited experience will also be considered. Interest in materials, architecture and interior design Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Proactive attitude and ability to work collaboratively. Good command of spoken and written English. Ability to work effectively in an informal and dynamic workplace. Altre informazioni: ACPV is committed to create a better working environment supporting workforce diversity. All applications for vacant positions will be welcomed and will be considered on the relative merits, regardless of color, nationality, ethnic origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, religion, or belief.

As part of the IT team, you will work closely with the IT Lead and engineering leads to understanding their needs and translating them into reliable, scalable and efficient
items.desc: Job Summary We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to build, operate, and continuously improve the engineering platform that enables our engineering teams to do their best work. You will be responsible for the tools and infrastructure that support our software, firmware and FPGA development activities, including source code management, CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure, license servers, and engineering applications. As part of the IT team, you will work closely with the IT Lead and engineering leads to understanding their needs and translating them into reliable, scalable and efficient technical solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of our engineering platform and help shape and develop our DevOps capabilities as the organization continues to grow. Key Responsibilities: Run and improve our GitHub Enterprise Cloud setup: repositories, permissions, GitHub Actions and self-hosted runners. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for software, firmware, and FPGA projects, together with the engineering teams. Operate our Linux build and compute servers (Ubuntu), including automation, monitoring and capacity planning as teams grow. Run our license servers (FlexLM, for tools such as Ansys and AMD/Xilinx Vivado) and keep license capacity in step with demand. Support engineering tooling such as CAD/PDM, and help new projects start with a ready-made, standard setup. Automate everything that repeats, using infrastructure as code and configuration management. Work with our Information Security team on secure pipelines, secrets management and access control. Requirements Technical Qualifications Required 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, build/release or platform engineering role. Hands-on experience with CI/CD, ideally GitHub Actions, and with Git workflows. Experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management, such as Ansible or Terraform. Scripting in Python or Bash to automate your own work. Comfortable working directly with engineers, turning their needs into practical solutions. Nice to have Experience with build systems for embedded, firmware or FPGA work (for example CMake, Yocto, Vivado in CI). Experience running FlexLM or other engineering license servers. Knowledge of containers (Docker) and artifact storage. Familiarity with CAD/PDM systems such as SOLIDWORKS PDM or Siemens Teamcenter. Experience with Azure or the Microsoft cloud stack (Entra ID). Dutch is a plus. Benefits Why Join KRUSH Labs? This is an exceptional opportunity to bring your own daring concepts to life. What sets KRUSH Labs B.V. apart is our ability to bridge the gap between theoretical research and real-world application. Working alongside top talent brings your expertise to a new height. Our Engineers are passionate researchers and PhD scientists who are driven to bring real impact. We build solutions for specific needs. We work to address existing hardware specific challenges of a client to ensure they receive practical, high-performance solutions.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. About the team Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. As a Business Analyst for Cash and Intraday Liquidity Management, you connect Treasury, operations and technology to design new capabilities from concept through implementation. Your work will help automate and centralise operational processes while further strengthening ING’s intraday liquidity management capabilities. The team You will join the Cash and Liquidity Management Expert Team within Payment & Settlement Services (PSS), part of the PSS COO organisation. The CLM service manages the intraday liquidity of all ING Bank entities and develops and maintains the operational model used to manage, determine and analyse cash and liquidity positions. Working in an international team across Amsterdam, Bucharest and Manila, you will collaborate with Product Leadership, Customer Journey Experts, Operations, Finance, Risk, Group Treasury Front Offices, engineers, IT integrators and architects worldwide. You will report to the CLM Service Owner. Key Responsibilities Roles and responsibilitiesYou will turn complex liquidity challenges and data into clear requirements and implementable solutions aligned with the functional roadmap. Your key responsibilities include: Shape new intraday liquidity management capabilities with Treasury, Operations and Technology, from the initial business problem through implementation. Translate the CLM and intraday liquidity management roadmap into functional designs, business requirements, process flows, business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria. Define requirements for real-time liquidity positions and views, monitoring across relevant hierarchy levels, payment flow control, liquidity usage monitoring and intraday liquidity forecasting. Analyse payment, settlement and account flows to determine their impact on intraday liquidity positions and how these should be represented in the solution. Define the information and business logic needed to calculate and present liquidity positions accurately, working closely with technology teams. Lead workshops with Group Treasury Front Offices, Operations, Risk, Finance, architects and Technology, clearly documenting requirements, decisions and open points. Connect liquidity experts and engineering teams by making complex Treasury, liquidity, payment and settlement concepts accessible to colleagues without specialist domain knowledge. Guide requirements through development, testing and implementation, keeping delivered functionality aligned with the intended business outcome. Identify dependencies, functional gaps and design decisions across liquidity management, payments, settlement and related systems Who Are We Looking For? We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you remain curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we will support you in developing into an even more impressive version of yourself. Bring at least five years of relevant experience in cash and liquidity management, intraday liquidity management, payments or settlement within a bank; or at least two years of relevant banking, payments, Treasury or Business Analysis experience, combined with strong analytical ability and a clear ambition to develop deep Treasury expertise. Apply strong Business Analysis and functional design skills to turn complex or initially ambiguous needs into implementable solutions. Draw on experience designing or implementing new banking capabilities or applications, preferably in situations where processes and requirements were not yet fully defined. Communicate complex Treasury, liquidity, payment and settlement concepts clearly to both specialist and non-specialist stakeholders. Analyse problems precisely, use facts to guide decisions and pay close attention to detail. Take initiative, assume ownership and constructively challenge assumptions by asking the right questions. Build productive relationships with stakeholders across business, operations, risk, finance, architecture and technology. Collaborate openly across an international team while remaining resilient and reliable under time pressure. Hold an academic degree, preferably in finance, economics, business, technology or a related field. Bring experience in data analysis, automation or programming as an advantage. Wij zoeken een resultaatgerichte en technisch sterke Product Owner Data & AI Platform voor de ART Data & AI! In deze fulltime functie geef je richting aan de ontwikkeling van onze platformvoorzieningen voor Data, Datamanagement en AI en zorgt ervoor dat teams binnen en buiten de ART Data & AI kunnen beschikken over een betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig platform. Als Product Owner ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en het beheer van meerdere strategische platformvoorzieningen: Het bestaande Data Warehouse-platform op basis van SQL Server. Het nieuwe Enterprise Data Platform op basis van Microsoft Fabric. Het Datamanagement Platform op basis van Microsoft Purview, inclusief metadata, lineage en datakwaliteit. De AI-runway voor het ontwikkelen, deployen, monitoren en beheren van AI modellen. Het AI-platform voor modelbeheer, orchestration en integratie van AI-oplossingen. Groeipad Hoe jouw groeipad eruitziet hangt af van hetgeen jij zelf wilt, maar wij denken dat je in ieder geval: Een sleutelrol vervult in de realisatie van de Data- en AI-strategie van De Goudse. Verantwoordelijk bent voor platformen die de basis vormen voor alle schaalbare dataproducten en AI-oplossingen binnen de organisatie. Werkt op het snijvlak van business, technologie, architectuur en governance. Samenwerkt met een ambitieus team van Data Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Architecten, Data Scientists en Analytics Professionals. Veel ruimte krijgt om de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform en de rol zelf vorm te geven. Dit is je team Samen met de Scrum Master en een multidisciplinair DevOps-team werk je aan oplossingen die cruciaal zijn voor de uitvoering van onze Data- en AI-strategie. Je werkt nauw samen met de SAFe Product Manager, Architecten en andere Product Owners en onderhoud een goede samenwerking met Architectuur en ICT. Daarnaast lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van Data Governance, en het schalen van Dataproducten en AI oplossingen binnen De Goudse. De functie rapporteert aan de Manager Data & AI. Waar gaat jouw hart sneller van kloppen? Hieronder lees je waar wij naar op zoek zijn. Maar we horen ook graag waar jij naar op zoek bent. Waar word jij blij van? Salaris van € 4.602 tot € 7.246 bruto (o.b.v. 38 uur), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Vakantiegeld, 13e maand en een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. De mogelijkheid om flexibel thuis te werken. Werken in een moderne omgeving waar Data & AI een strategische pijler vormt. Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, opleiding en certificering. Werken aan innovatieve technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Purview, Databricks, AI Foundry, Copilot Studio en andere platformen. Waar worden wij blij van? Het vertalen van strategische doelstellingen naar een concrete roadmap en backlog. Het maken van afwegingen tussen innovatie, continuïteit, risico's en technische schuld (technical debt). Inhoudelijke kennis van data- en AI-platformen Ervaring met data-platformen en cloud-technologie. Begrip van platformontwikkeling, integraties en schaalbare architecturen. Kennis van Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server, Azure en datamanagement is een pre. Affiniteit met AI, Machine Learning, MLOps en AI-management is een pre. Stakeholdermanagement & samenwerking Samenwerken met business stakeholders, architecten, DevOps-teams, Risk Management en Compliance. Nauwe samenwerking met de Architectuur en onze ICT en organisatie. Organisatiesensitiviteit en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen. Leiderschap & eigenaarschap Leidinggeven aan een DevOps-team zonder hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid. Besluitvaardigheid, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid. Een coachende en dienende leiderschapsstijl. Agile & Lean-Agile expertise Ervaring als Product Owner binnen een Agile of SAFe omgeving is een pre. Bekendheid met PI Planning, backlogmanagement en waarde gedreven prioritering. Focus op het realiseren van concrete businesswaarde. Hij richtte een overloop in als kantoorruimte en bracht de eerste polissen rond op de fiets. Sindsdien is ons bedrijf enorm gegroeid en is er veel veranderd. items.desc: Job Description Voor de afdeling Data & Analytics op het Servicekantoor in Amersfoort zijn we op zoek naar een Analytics Engineer voor 32 tot 36 uur per week. Data krijgt pas waarde als mensen begrijpen wat ze ermee kunnen. Als Analytics Engineer zorg jij ervoor dat complexe data wordt vertaald naar betrouwbare en begrijpelijke informatie. Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare analytische datamodellen en dashboards waarmee zorgprofessionals, beleidsmakers en management inzicht krijgen in wat er gebeurt en waar verbetering mogelijk is. Daarbij combineer je technische diepgang met begrip van de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie. Zo help je Philadelphia om data daadwerkelijk te gebruiken voor betere besluitvorming en uiteindelijk betere zorg en ondersteuning. Ben jij de gedreven en enthousiaste Analytics Engineer die wij zoeken? Word jij blij van datamodellering, BI, innovatie en het vertalen van complexe informatiebehoeften naar betrouwbare oplossingen? En wil je met jouw werk indirect bijdragen aan goede zorg en ondersteuning voor onze cliënten? Lees dan verder… Wat ga je doen? Als Analytics Engineer zorg je ervoor dat zorgprofessionals, beleidsmakers en analisten kunnen vertrouwen op begrijpelijke, consistente en actuele informatie. Je bouwt voort op de data die door Data Engineering beschikbaar wordt gesteld en transformeert deze naar analytische datamodellen, datamarts en dashboards voor rapportage, analyse en data science / AI. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige levenscyclus van deze datamodellen en informatieproducten: van ontwerp en ontwikkeling tot publicatie, monitoring, onderhoud en doorontwikkeling. Daarbij pas je principes uit softwareontwikkeling toe, zoals versiebeheer, geautomatiseerd testen, CI/CD, herbruikbaarheid en documentatie. Samen met Data Engineers, Data analisten, Data Scientists, de Data Architect, Data Governance en business eigenaren: Ontwerp, ontwikkel en onderhoud je analytische datamodellen en datamarts; Transformeer en combineer je beschikbare brondata tot gestructureerde en herbruikbare datasets voor rapportage, analyse en data science; Ontwikkel, beheer en verbeter je dashboards, semantische modellen en andere informatieproducten in het BI-portaal; Vertaal je informatiebehoeften, definities en functionele eisen samen met de business eigenaar naar passende datamodellen en dashboards; Ontwikkel je geautomatiseerde tests en kwaliteitscontroles op volledigheid, actualiteit, juistheid, consistentie en technische stabiliteit; Pas je Git, code reviews, versiebeheer en CI/CD toe en draag je bij aan ontwikkelstandaarden; Optimaliseer je datatransformaties, datamodellen, queries en dashboards voor optimale performance en onderhoudbaarheid; Documenteer je datamodellen, transformatielogica, dashboards, definities, metadata en data lineage; Pas je geldende richtlijnen toe voor informatiebeveiliging, privacy en autorisatie binnen datamodellen en dashboards; Bevorder je standaardisatie, hergebruik, kennisdeling en best practices voor modellering, dashboarding, testen en documentatie; Jij maakt van beschikbare data betrouwbare en herbruikbare informatie. Daarmee leg je de verbinding tussen het dataplatform, de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie en de dashboards en dataproducten die daarop worden gebouwd. Over ons Als Analytics Engineer ga je werken voor Philadelphia Zorg. Bij deze landelijke en vooruitstrevende dienstverlener in de zorg werken meer dan 7.500 professionals op zo’n 600 locaties. Vanuit het Servicekantoor in Amersfoort (300 medewerkers) worden ondersteunende diensten geleverd aan de verschillende locaties op het gebied van personeel, financiën, planning, administratie, bedrijfsinformatie en ICT. Samen werken we aan innovatie door de beste dienstverlening te ontwikkelen, nieuwe technische mogelijkheden toe te passen en te investeren in mensen, onderzoek, scholing en huisvesting. Door de ambities van de organisatie en de veranderingen in de sector is het een dynamische omgeving. Het Data & Analytics team (15 medewerkers), onderdeel van de afdeling Digitale Transformatie & ICT, positioneert zich als een strategische en tactische partner die de organisatie adviseert en ondersteunt bij het ontsluiten van waarde uit data, zodat deze een cruciale rol kan spelen in effectievere besluitvorming, verbeteren van onze processen en een nog hogere kwaliteit van zorg. Er wordt intensief samengewerkt met management en de gebruikers. Over jou Je combineert sterke technische vaardigheden met analytisch en conceptueel vermogen. Je kunt informatiebehoeften doorgronden en zelfstandig vertalen naar betrouwbare, begrijpelijke en onderhoudbare datamodellen en dashboards. Je werkt nauwkeurig, denkt kritisch mee en neemt eigenaarschap voor zowel ontwikkeling als beheer. Daarbij stem je gemakkelijk af met technische collega’s én met business eigenaren en gebruikers. Je kijkt continu hoe het pricingproces slimmer kan, bijvoorbeeld door werkzaamheden te standaardiseren en te automatiseren met behulp van AI. Pricing Engineering & Quality Assurance is een relatief nieuw vakgebied binnen ons team. Denk aan het opstellen van technische standaarden, het verbeteren van kwaliteitscontroles en het toekomstbestendig inrichten van ons pricingplatform en datafundament. We zoeken een ervaren collega die zelfstandig aan de slag kan, initiatief neemt en technische mogelijkheden weet te vertalen naar praktische oplossingen voor de business. Wat ga je doen? Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de doorontwikkeling en het beheer van ons pricingplatform en werkt samen met BI aan een betrouwbaar datafundament. Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn: Beheren en doorontwikkelen van het pricingplatform: je werkt met Azure en Azure Synapse en stemt wijzigingen en afhankelijkheden af met Actuariaat, BI, IT en platformteams. Ook begeleid je migraties en zorg je dat collega’s weten wat er verandert. Ontwikkelen van herbruikbare oplossingen: je bouwt en optimaliseert Python-modules, notebooks, functies en datasets voor pricinganalyses. Zo help je pricinganalisten om sneller analyses uit te voeren en afwijkingen te signaleren. Het vakgebied Pricing Engineering & Quality Assurance is nog volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarom de ruimte om technische standaarden en werkafspraken verder vorm te geven en collega’s te helpen bij het gebruik van Azure-oplossingen. Je werkt samen met je scrumteam in sprints van drie weken. Afhankelijk van je werkzaamheden werk je in Apeldoorn, Tilburg of vanuit huis. Je werkt minimaal één dag per week op kantoor in Apeldoorn en neemt ongeveer twee keer per jaar deel aan een planningsdag in Tilburg. Wat maakt deze functie interessant? Directe impact: je werkt aan pricing, een kernproces van een van de grootste schadeverzekeraars van Nederland. Jouw oplossingen helpen om tarieven goed onderbouwd vast te stellen en afwijkingen sneller te signaleren. Techniek én business: je duikt in code, maar denkt ook mee over de toepassing ervan. Je ziet direct wat jouw werk betekent voor het pricingproces. Ruimte om mee te bouwen: Pricing Engineering & Quality Assurance is nog volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt de kans om technische standaarden, kwaliteitscontroles en werkwijzen verder vorm te geven. Een betrokken team: je werkt samen met ongeveer vijftien pricinganalisten en pricing engineers. We zijn laagdrempelig, delen graag kennis en werken samen aan het beste resultaat. Met ongeveer vijftien collega’s werk je aan de pricing van zakelijke schadeverzekeringen van Centraal Beheer, Interpolis en Avéro Achmea. Je werkt samen met productmanagers, pricing analisten, data analisten, data scientists, business intelligence en scrum masters. Je werkt minimaal één dag per week op kantoor in Apeldoorn. items.card: you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual
items.desc: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. Your Profile MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus). Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship. Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal). Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis. Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation. Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team. Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. What We Offer: At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance) Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage. Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

items.desc: Scheveningen Engineering Medior Houd jij ervan om software te ontwikkelen voor gave innovatieve technische toepassingen zoals onbemand en autonoom varende systemen? Werk jij graag samen in een klein en hecht team? En hou jij graag het overzicht over het gehele systeem? Dan is deze functie als software engineer wat voor jou! Over Demcon Bij Demcon Unmanned Systems (DUS) ontwikkelen en produceren we geavanceerde, elektrisch en hybride aangedreven onbemande autonome vaartuigen (USV’s) voor inspectie-, monitoring- en onderhoudstoepassingen voor ondiepe binnenwateren tot complexe offshore omgevingen. Onze USV’s zijn modulair en worden op maat ontworpen, gebaseerd op eigen technologische innovaties in autonome navigatie, USV-besturingssysteem, remote operating centers en systeemintegratie. We bieden flexibele en toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor uiteenlopende sectoren, waaronder maritieme aannemers, overheden, defensie en veiligheidsdiensten. Als onderdeel van de Demcon Group profiteren we van de slagkracht en multidisciplinaire expertise van een toonaangevend technologiebedrijf. Ons eigen team bestaat uit bevlogen professionals die samenwerken aan hoogwaardige en innovatieve systemen. Daarmee dragen we bij aan een veiligere, efficiëntere en duurzamere wereld op én rond het water. Wat ga je doen? In deze functie werk jij aan de ontwikkeling van de software voor de onbemande voertuigen en autonome navigatie technologieën. Je werkt hands-on mee in de ontwikkeling van diverse softwareprojecten, je weet hoe je uitdagende problemen moet aanpakken en houdt van het ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten. Je houdt het overzicht, bewaakt de kwaliteit en helpt teamgenoten bij de ontwikkeling. Je zal onder andere werken aan het maken van nieuwe, en het onderhouden van bestaande drivers voor diverse apparaten aan boord van de USV (denk aan motoren, lieren, gyro stabilizers, radar en GPS-systemen). Daarnaast werk je mee aan de softwareontwikkeling vanaf simulatie tot implementatie en onderhoud van de systeem functionaliteiten zoals de autopilot, mission planner, sensor data acquisitie. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde technische hbo- /wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Computer Science, Natuurkunde, Elektrotechniek, Luchtvaart- en ruimtevaarttechniek, Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 3-5 jaar (werk)ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, het liefst binnen verschillende projecten; Enthousiasme, je bent geïnteresseerd in de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van onbemande en autonome systemen; Ervaring met real time operating systems; Ervaring met versiebeheer (Git); Analytische kwaliteiten en je bent in staat zelfstandig te werken; Ervaring in C/C++; Bekend met diverse embedded communicatieprotocollen zoals UART, CAN en modbus; Je bent gewend te werken met Linux; Nice to have: Achtergrond in computer vision en/of robotics is een pré; Ervaring in computernetwerken; Ervaring met ROS2; Ervaring met het debuggen van problemen op de grens van de soft- en hardware; Ervaring met PLC's/Codesys; Wat bieden we jou? Bij Demcon werk je aan technologie die ertoe doet. In een informele organisatie met ruimte voor initiatief en een prettige samenwerking met gedreven collega’s bouw je mee aan oplossingen voor vandaag én morgen. Daarbij is er oprechte aandacht voor jou als mens, en stimuleren we werkplezier en een gezonde werk-privébalans. Verder kan je rekenen op onder andere: 8% vakantiegeld met de keuze om dit uit te laten betalen in mei of per maand met je salaris; 25 Vakantiedagen en 6 ATV dagen o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen; Gedeeltelijke thuiswerkregeling Trainingen en programma’s via de Demcon Academy voor je persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling; Goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven; Fietsplan/leasefiets regeling; Vitaliteitsprogramma met o.a. leuke sport clinics, vers fruit, workshops en een werkplek-check; Actieve personeelsvereniging (maandelijks wisselende activiteiten en een jaarlijks Demcon-weekend). Heb je nog vragen over deze functie? Heb je vragen over deze functie? Neem dan contact op via 088 – 115 20 00. Wil je solliciteren? Werken bij IKEA, betekent werken in een wereld aan ideeën. Een wereld die door onze eigen collega’s wordt omschreven als een werkplek waar iedereen welkom is en je jezelf kan zijn. Waar we met elkaar het verschil maken voor zoveel mogelijk mensen en de planeet. Maar ook een werkplek waar je zelf je carrièrestappen bepaalt en waar veel ruimte is voor jouw praktische creativiteit en ideeën. En dat alles terwijl je werkt in een fijn team met collega’s die altijd voor je klaarstaan en je helpen wanneer dat nodig is. Let's connect (title) Wie je bent Let´s connect Een échte enthousiasteling. Met veel energie loop jij door de winkel en zie je precies welke klanten hulp nodig hebben. Daardoor ben jij hen vaak nét een stapje voor waardoor je direct duidelijk maakt dat je graag helpt, luistert en meedenkt. Wat je nog meer nodig hebt: Een open houding waarmee je alle bezoekers even makkelijk benadert. Inzicht in verschillende computerprogramma’s. Je hoeft onze interne systemen niet te kennen maar kan hier wél makkelijk je weg in vinden. Verder kan je 12 uur per week werken. Bij IKEA werken we flexibel, zodat we er zijn op de momenten die er toe doen voor onze klanten. In deze rol werk je daarom vooral in de avonden doordeweeks en in het weekend. Je diensten starten doordeweeks vanaf 17:00 uur en eindigen uiterlijk om 21:30 uur. Op zaterdag kan je dienst ingepland worden tussen 08:00 en 19:00 uur en op zondag tussen 08:00 en 18:00 uur. We vinden het belangrijk dat werk en privé in balans zijn, daarom kun je twee doordeweekse avonden blokkeren waarop je niet wordt ingepland. Je rooster stemmen we af op jouw beschikbaarheid en aantal werkdagen dat past bij jouw contracturen. Je weet het altijd 4 weken van tevoren. Dit uurloon is inclusief een 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld. Deze worden standaard in december en mei uitbetaald, maar je kunt er ook voor kiezen om deze maandelijks te ontvangen. Een collectieve bonusregeling. Deze wordt jaarlijks vastgesteld en bedraagt maximaal 150% van je bruto maandsalaris. Reiskosten voor het openbaar vervoer worden 100% vergoed. Woon je binnen een straal van 5 tot 20 km van de IKEA-vestiging? Dan kan je ook kiezen voor een leasefiets. Reis je toch met de auto? Dan krijg je een tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten tot maximaal 243 euro per maand. 15% personeelskorting bij alle IKEA-winkels in Nederland. items.desc: Work at THUAS Do you have an affinity for research in cyber security for Network & Systems Engineering for agentic AI pentesting, cyber resilient systems or autonomous systems? And are you a researcher with an education completed at master level with a specialization in cyber security, combined with international and industrial experience? Then we’re looking for you! For the Network & Systems Engineering Cyber Security research group, we are looking for a junior researcher. The research group is part of the Centre of Expertise Cyber Security at The Hague University of Applied Sciences. Read more about Centre of Expertise Cyber Security. What does the work of a Junior Researcher Cyber Security look like? As a researcher within the Centre of Expertise Cyber Security, you’re closely involved in the execution of various International and National research projects on cyber security with a strong technical focus. This includes projects on AI-based pentesting, cyber resilient infrastructures and autonomous systems and requires demonstrated skills in the areas of offensive security, architecture and security of systems, networks and applications. Under the supervision of a senior researcher, you will perform research activities in your technical field of expertise with the aim to improve the effectiveness of offensive security methods, defensive techniques for countering cyber-attacks and reducing attack surface. The candidate is expected to be able to conduct scientific research and has experience with international and industrial working environments. In addition, the candidate forms the link between practice, research, and education. Responsibilities: Conduct research under supervision of a senior researcher in the Network & Systems Engineering Cyber Security group; Contribute to International collaborative research and partnership programs with internal and external public and private partners involved; Support in the research programs the efforts of student assistants and student assignments to fit the program needs; Contributes to internal and external communication for the dissemination of research results for the benefit of the professional field and education; Contributing to the definition of future research programs with close involvement of AI experts and senior researchers. What do we expect from you? We are looking for a curious and analytical early-career researcher who enjoys practical problemsolving, can work collaboratively and is motivated to learn. You do not need to be an expert in both agentic AI and autonomous systems; a relevant foundation, some initial knowledge and a willingness to develop are important. A completed master’s degree, or close to completion, in cybersecurity, computer science, software engineering or a related technical field. Basic to intermediate programming skills, preferably in Python. Experience with Java or scripting is an advantage. A foundation in cybersecurity, such as network and system security, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, secure software or security architectures. Some knowledge of AI, machine learning, large language models or AI agents—or a strong interest in learning how these technologies can be applied in cybersecurity. Familiarity with Linux and networking; experience with tools such as Nmap, OpenVAS, Kali Linux, Docker or version-control systems is an advantage. An interest in autonomous systems, robotics, drones, embedded/connected systems or simulation is an advantage, but is not essential. The ability to work systematically, critically assess technical results, document experiments, and communicate findings clearly. A collaborative attitude and willingness to work with students, researchers, and external partners in an international, practice-oriented environment. The following are considered advantages, not strict requirements: Participation in Capture the Flag (CTF) exercises or cybersecurity competitions. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent frameworks, AI-tool integrations or automated security workflows. Experience with vulnerability management, risk prioritisation, reporting or responsible human-inthe-loop AI workflows. Experience with autonomous or robotic systems, UAVs/drones, simulation environments, or cyberphysical systems. Experience with scientific research, technical reports, publications, or collaboration with industry. This is what you can expect from us First and foremost, it's important that you are able to enjoy your work. In addition, we offer you: A temporary appointment of 1,0 fte, 40 hours per week, for one year. A salary between € 3.667,97 and € 5.154,67 gross per month (scale 9) for a full-time work week. 8% vacation allowance. Guaranteed end-of-year pay of 8,3%. An extensive leave arrangement. items.desc: Solenergi Norge AS Gruvevegen 30A, 2580 Folldal Om jobben Lagre favoritt Stillingstittel Systemingeniør (IoT/energi), Rondekraft Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Arbeidsspråk Norsk Vis flere detaljer Søk senest tirsdag 1. desember Vil du bygge fremtidens plattform for intelligent energidrift, beredskap og cybersikkerhet? Solenergi Norge AS søker en dyktig systemingeniør til prosjektet Rondekraft, der vi utvikler en ny standard for drift, overvåkning og beredskap av solenergi, og batterianlegg. Vi bygger på erfaring fra mer enn 600 leverte solcelleanlegg over hele Norge, og kombinerer kunstig intelligens, sanntidsovervåkning, cybersikkerhet og en bemannet driftssentral, for å sikre stabil energiforsyning, økt produksjon og styrket beredskap. Utviklingen av Rondekraft er delvis finansiert av offentlige tilskuddsmidler, og forskningsmidler. Om stillingen Som systemingeniør får du hovedansvaret for å videreutvikle den tekniske plattformen, de tekniske funksjonene og infrastrukturen i Rondekraft. Du blir en nøkkelperson både nå, mens løsningen bygges, og i årene etterpå, når plattformen er i drift og skal skaleres, forbedres og følges opp mot stadig flere anlegg. Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver Videreutvikle den tekniske plattformen, KI-funksjonene og infrastrukturen. Konfigurere, og integrere invertere, batterier og sensorer over Modbus RTU, og Modbus TCP. Utvikle, og forbedre lokal kunstig intelligens, driftsovervåkning, avviksvarsling og prediktivt vedlikehold. Ivareta cybersikkerhet og sikker, kryptert datakommunikasjon på lukket nett. Drifte, overvåke og videreutvikle løsningen etter hvert som den rulles ut i stor skala. Vi ser etter deg som har God kjennskap til Modbus RTU (RS485), og Modbus TCP. Erfaring med sensorer, og sensorintegrasjon. Kunnskap om, og praktisk erfaring med AI/KI. Forståelse for IT- og datasikkerhet, gjerne med erfaring fra cybersikkerhet i nettverk med utstyr i felt. Relevant høyere utdanning, eller tilsvarende erfaring, innen elektro, automasjon, kybernetikk eller data. Evne til å jobbe selvstendig, strukturert og løsningsorientert. Erfaring med oppsett, og drift av VPN-løsninger er en fordel i denne rollen. Det samme gjelder erfaring med solenergi, batterianlegg, edge-enheter eller elsikkerhet (NEK 400). Dette er fordeler, men ikke krav. Vi tilbyr En sentral teknisk rolle i et innovasjonsprosjekt med reell samfunnsnytte, og betydning for det grønne skiftet. Stor faglig frihet, og mulighet til å forme løsningen fra bunnen av. Fleksibel arbeidshverdag med hybrid, og hjemmekontor. Det er ikke et krav å sitte fast på kontoret i Folldal. Et kompetent, og engasjert fagmiljø. Konkurransedyktige betingelser etter kvalifikasjoner, og erfaring. Søknadsfrist 1. desember 2026. Vi behandler søknader fortløpende, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke så snart som mulig. Om bedriften Solenergi Norge AS leverer komplette, driftssikre og lønnsomme solcelleanlegg for landbruk, næring og industri. Vi skreddersyr anleggene for den enkelte kunden, for mest mulig økonomisk, bærekraftig og kortreist strømproduksjon. Stadig flere kombinerer solceller med batteri, slik at de får bedre beredskap og trygg strøm også når nettet svikter. Vi leverer svært effektive kvalitetsprodukter med høy teknologistandard, og jobber med kvalifiserte og erfarne norske monteringspartnere. Nå tar vi neste steg med Rondekraft, vår nye plattform for intelligent energidrift og beredskap. Rondekraft kombinerer kunstig intelligens, sanntidsovervåkning og en bemannet driftssentral for å øke produksjonen, redusere nedetid og styrke beredskapen i anlegg med solceller og batteri. Solenergi Norge AS ble etablert i 2018 med hovedkontor i Folldal, og har i dag 7 medarbeidere. Vi har et stort partnernettverk, Solenergipartnerne, med ni bedrifter som stadig vokser. items.desc: About the Role We are looking for a Product Designer who combines strong design craft, product thinking, and a hands-on approach to AI-powered design workflows to create digital products that truly matter. This is a mid-level, hands-on role where you will work closely with product owners, engineers, and other designers to create intuitive, visually compelling digital products aligned with user needs and business goals. We value designers who are curious about emerging technologies, actively experiment with AI tools, and know how to use them to explore ideas, prototype faster, and improve the design process. You will take ownership of selected parts of projects, contribute to discovery and delivery, and continue developing your product thinking with the support of other team members. What You Will Be Responsible For Contributing to the end-to-end product design process, from discovery and ideation to high-fidelity UI design and developer handoff. Translating user needs, business requirements, and product goals into intuitive and visually compelling digital experiences. Creating user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and polished UI designs for web and mobile applications. Using AI-powered tools to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and iteration while maintaining high design quality. Experimenting with emerging AI tools and design workflows to improve efficiency and bring new ideas into the design process. Designing data-heavy web interfaces for internal users: tables, filters, forms, dashboards, statuses, and role-based views. Participating in discovery workshops, ideation sessions, and discussions with stakeholders - turn business reality into clear structures. Presenting design concepts and clearly explaining design decisions to internal teams and business partners. Working with existing design systems and contributing to their continuous improvement. Taking ownership of assigned design tasks, incorporating feedback, and continuously improving solutions throughout the product development process. Contributing to the improvement of internal design practices, tools, and ways of working. Preferred Skills & Qualifications Minimum 3+ years of experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design supported by a portfolio showcasing your design process and problem-solving skills. Experience designing digital products, including mobile and web applications, including practical experience with AI-assisted prototyping and development tools, and designing AI-powered features or products. Experience designing complex web applications (enterprise, B2B, SaaS, or internal tools).
