Zaczynaliśmy od listków do prania, dziś rozwijamy coraz szerszą gamę produktów i działamy na kilku europejskich rynkach. Łączymy e-commerce, mocny performance marketing, innowacyjny produkt i szybkie tempo działania. Nie chcemy robić rzeczy „tak, jak zawsze robiła je branża”. Testujemy, szukamy nowych rozwiązań i stale podnosimy poprzeczkę- zarówno w produktach, jak i w marketingu. Budujemy zespół osób, które lubią mieć wpływ, działać samodzielnie i widzieć realne efekty swojej pracy. Szukamy Creative Marketing Specialist! Szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiadać za strategię i koncepty kreatywne naszych reklam płatnych . Kogoś, kto potrafi spojrzeć na produkt, klienta, konkurencję i wyniki kampanii, a następnie odpowiedzieć: „Co powinniśmy powiedzieć w kolejnej reklamie, komu i w jaki sposób?” Będziesz szukać insightów, wymyślać angle, hooki i koncepty, pisać scenariusze oraz briefować grafiki i video. Potem będziesz patrzeć na wyniki i decydować: co rozwijamy, co zmieniamy i co testujemy dalej. To rola dla osoby, która chce mieć realny wpływ na wzrost marki, a nie tylko wykonywać kolejne briefy. Za co będziesz odpowiadać? Creative Strategy- od insightu do reklamy analizujesz klientów, ich potrzeby, problemy, obiekcje i motywacje zakupowe, szukasz nowych angle’i komunikacyjnych dla naszych produktów, tworzysz koncepty reklamowe do Meta Ads i innych kanałów paid social, wymyślasz hooki, headlines, copy i CTA , piszesz scenariusze do UGC, reelsów, video ads i landing page, tworzysz briefy dla grafików, montażystów i kreatorów UGC. Research i inspiracje analizujesz reklamy konkurencji i innych marek DTC, regularnie korzystasz z Meta Ads Library, TikTok Creative Center i innych źródeł inspiracji, obserwujesz trendy w reklamie i social media, szukasz nowych formatów i sposobów komunikowania produktów, potrafisz przełożyć trend na reklamę, która pasuje do marki i ma konkretny cel sprzedażowy. Performance Creative Nie kończysz pracy w momencie, gdy reklama zostanie opublikowana. Patrzysz na wyniki i zastanawiasz się: który hook zatrzymał uwagę, który angle najlepiej konwertuje, dlaczego konkretna kreacja działa, którą część reklamy warto zmienić, jakie kolejne warianty możemy stworzyć. Na podstawie danych tworzysz następne hipotezy i koncepty. Nie tworzymy jednej reklamy i czekamy. Testujemy, uczymy się i iterujemy. Współpraca z performance marketingiem Będziesz blisko współpracować z osobami odpowiedzialnymi za kampanie Meta Ads. Jakiej osoby szukamy? Kogoś, kto: ma bardzo dobre wyczucie reklamy i social mediów, naturalnie analizuje, dlaczego dana reklama działa, potrafi pisać mocne hooki i proste komunikaty sprzedażowe, interesuje się psychologią konsumenta, rozumie różnicę między „ładnym contentem” a performance creative , potrafi łączyć kreatywność z danymi, działa szybko i lubi testować, jest samodzielny/a i proaktywny/a, potrafi zamienić luźny pomysł w konkretny brief, rozumie e-commerce i ścieżkę zakupową klienta, nie boi się AI i wykorzystuje je do researchu, ideacji, analizy czy przyspieszania swojej pracy. Nie interesuje nas szczególnie to, jaki dokładnie tytuł masz teraz na LinkedIn. Możesz być: Creative Strategist, Creative Marketing Specialist, Performance Creative Specialist, Content Specialist, Copywriterem, Content Creatorem, Social Media Specialistą, Marketing Specialistą. Liczy się przede wszystkim sposób, w jaki myślisz o reklamie. Szczególnie docenimy, jeśli: masz doświadczenie w e-commerce lub DTC, pracowałeś/aś z Meta Ads, tworzyłeś/aś reklamy nastawione na sprzedaż, znasz UGC od strony konceptowania i briefowania, potrafisz interpretować podstawowe metryki reklamowe, korzystasz z Meta Ads Library i TikTok Creative Center, interesuje Cię direct response marketing, potrafisz wykorzystać AI do pracy kreatywnej i researchu, masz własny system zbierania inspiracji, reklam, hooków i insightów. Co oferujemy? Pracę w środowisku, w którym kreacja jest realnym motorem wzrostu , a nie dodatkiem do performance marketingu. Twoje pomysły nie będą kończyć jako prezentacja w folderze. Będziesz widzieć, jak reklamy trafiają na rynek, jak reagują na nie klienci i które koncepty naprawdę napędzają sprzedaż. Dajemy Ci: Realny wpływ na komunikację Natulim - od pierwszego insightu i hooka po gotową kampanię. Dostęp do prawdziwych danych performance - dzięki temu nie zgadujesz, co działa. Testujesz, analizujesz i rozwijasz najlepsze koncepty. Dużo przestrzeni na własne pomysły – nie szukamy osoby, która tylko realizuje gotowe briefy. Szybkie tempo działania – dobry pomysł może szybko zamienić się w reklamę i trafić do testu. Możliwość eksperymentowania z nowymi formatami, UGC, AI, trendami i sposobami …

This is a great opportunity to deepen your expertise in risk modelling and learn more about complex models and financial products used in banking. items.desc: W Betacom wspieramy klientów w transformacji cyfrowej, łącząc kompetencje biznesowe i technologiczne. Wierzymy, że sukces projektu zaczyna się od właściwego zrozumienia potrzeb biznesowych i przełożenia ich na efektywne rozwiązania systemowe. Dlatego szukamy osoby, która nie tylko sprawnie analizuje wymagania i projektuje rozwiązania, ale również potrafi budować relacje z klientami, prowadzić warsztaty oraz skutecznie komunikować się z interesariuszami na różnych poziomach organizacji. Jeśli potrafisz łączyć świat biznesu i technologii, zapraszamy Cię do naszego zespołu jako Analityka Biznesowo-Systemowego / Analityczkę Biznesowo-Systemową . Jak wygląda codzienna praca? Analiza wymagań biznesowych i systemowych: Zbieranie, analiza oraz dokumentowanie wymagań we współpracy z klientem, użytkownikami biznesowymi i zespołem projektowym. Prowadzenie warsztatów analitycznych: Organizowanie i moderowanie spotkań z interesariuszami w celu identyfikacji potrzeb biznesowych oraz definiowania oczekiwanych funkcjonalności. Modelowanie procesów i projektowanie rozwiązań: Tworzenie modeli procesów biznesowych w BPMN oraz dokumentacji systemowej w UML, obejmującej przypadki użycia, diagramy sekwencji i modele danych. Analiza integracji systemowych: Projektowanie i dokumentowanie integracji pomiędzy systemami z wykorzystaniem API REST/SOAP, wymiany plików oraz komunikacji asynchronicznej. Wsparcie realizacji projektów: Ścisła współpraca z programistami, testerami, architektami i kierownikami projektów w zakresie doprecyzowania wymagań oraz walidacji dostarczanych rozwiązań. Zarządzanie zmianą i backlogiem: Analiza wpływu zmian na zakres projektu, utrzymywanie backlogu oraz wspieranie procesu priorytetyzacji wymagań. Prezentacje i szkolenia: Prezentowanie funkcjonalności systemu klientom oraz prowadzenie szkoleń dla użytkowników końcowych. Wsparcie procesów sprzedażowych: Udział w analizie zapytań RFI/RFP, przygotowywaniu koncepcji rozwiązań oraz szacowaniu pracochłonności. Szukamy Ciebie, jeśli: Masz minimum 4 lata doświadczenia na stanowisku Analityka Biznesowo-Systemowego po stronie dostawcy usług IT. Realizowałeś(-aś) projekty dla klientów z sektora finansowego, ubezpieczeniowego lub administracji publicznej. Samodzielnie prowadzisz analizę wymagań oraz tworzysz dokumentację biznesową i systemową. Praktycznie wykorzystujesz BPMN 2.0 oraz UML (przypadki użycia, diagramy sekwencji, aktywności, modele danych). Projektowałeś(-aś) i analizowałeś(-aś) integracje systemowe wykorzystujące REST, SOAP, JSON, XML oraz OpenAPI/Swagger. Znasz SQL na poziomie umożliwiającym samodzielną analizę danych i diagnozowanie problemów. Korzystasz z technik zbierania wymagań, takich jak warsztaty, wywiady, user stories czy kryteria akceptacji. Pracowałeś(-aś) z narzędziami takimi jak Enterprise Architect, Jira, Confluence, Visio lub Draw.io . Wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI wspierające analizę, dokumentowanie wymagań lub pracę projektową. Mile widziane: Znajomość przepisów Prawa zamówień publicznych oraz doświadczenie w pracy z dokumentacją SWZ/OPZ. Doświadczenie z systemami klasy ECM, DMS lub BPM . Udział w projektach związanych z automatyzacją procesów biznesowych (RPA, AI). Znajomość procesów biznesowych w sektorze ubezpieczeniowym lub administracji publicznej. Doświadczenie w projektach migracyjnych lub chmurowych. Podstawowa znajomość języka Java lub innego języka programowania. Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi warsztatowych, takich jak Miro . Doświadczenie w analizie zapytań RFI/RFP oraz szacowaniu pracochłonności. Doświadczenie w mentoringu młodszych analityków. Mile widziane certyfikaty z zakresu analizy biznesowej, modelowania procesów i zarządzania wymaganiami (np. IIBA, IREB, BPMN, UML, PSPO I) Oferujemy: Stabilność i elastyczność: współpracę w oparciu o umowę o pracę lub kontrakt B2B oraz elastyczny model pracy. Rozwój zawodowy: dostęp do szkoleń, konferencji oraz dofinansowanie certyfikacji. Pakiet benefitów: prywatną opiekę medyczną, kartę sportową, program rekomendacji pracowników oraz inicjatywy integracyjne. Dołącz do Betacom i twórz rozwiązania, które realnie wspierają rozwój biznesu naszych klientów. Czekamy na Twoją aplikację!

This hands-on, collaborative approach enables tailored recruiting solutions that create lasting value for clients. Our flagship product, biodegradable laundry detergent sheets , offers a simpler and more sustainable alternative to traditional laundry detergents. We currently operate across several European markets, and our growth is driven by a DTC, data-driven and performance-oriented approach , combining Shopify, acquisition, content, CRM and a culture of continuous experimentation. We are a young, international and remote-first team , where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in Poland , a strategic market for Natulim. To support this ambition, we are looking for a Creative Strategist for Poland who can take ownership of the market and build the creative growth engine behind it. Our ambition is to become Europe’s leading brand in eco-friendly cleaning , building a strong, innovative DTC brand that stays close to its consumers. Our flagship product, biodegradable laundry detergent sheets , offers a simpler and more sustainable alternative to traditional laundry detergents. We currently operate across several European markets, and our growth is driven by a DTC, data-driven and performance-oriented approach , combining Shopify, acquisition, content, CRM and a culture of continuous experimentation. We are a young, international and remote-first team , where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in Poland , a strategic market for Natulim. To support this ambition, we are looking for a Creative Strategist for Poland who can take ownership of the market and build the creative growth engine behind it. The Role We are looking for someone who is highly creative, performance-driven and strongly business-oriented to drive Natulim’s growth in the Polish market. Ensure consistency between acquisition campaigns and the customer journey. Identify opportunities to improve retention, reactivation and LTV . Collaborate with the relevant teams to maximize the value generated by each customer. Adapt CRM messaging and communications to the linguistic and cultural specificities of the Polish market. 5. Whether your interests lie in research, engineering, or process development, our thesis projects offer an opportunity to explore new ideas, gain valuable industry
items.desc: Are you passionate about science, technology, and innovation? At QPharma , we offer exciting thesis opportunities for students who want to apply their academic knowledge to real-world challenges within pharmaceutical development and manufacturing. Whether your interests lie in research, engineering, or process development, our thesis projects offer an opportunity to explore new ideas, gain valuable industry experience, and contribute to the development of future pharmaceutical solutions. Investigation of Solid-State Properties and Internal Structural Changes in Silicone-Based Drug Delivery Systems and Their Impact on Drug Release Performance Thesis Aim The objective of this thesis is to improve the understanding of factors influencing drug release performance from silicone-based drug delivery systems. Particular focus will be placed on the solid-state properties, API crystallinity, and internal structural changes that may occur during the manufacturing and storage of silicone-based matrices. The study aims to identify material characteristics associated with drug release variability, including acceptable, elevated, and reduced release profiles, and to establish potential links between matrix properties and release behavior. Project Description Silicone-based matrices manufactured at different time points and using different API lots will be characterized using a range of complementary analytical techniques to identify changes in API solid-state properties and matrix microstructure that may influence drug release performance. Analytical results will be compared with available in vitro release (IVR) data to explore relationships between solid-state characteristics, morphology, and release behavior. The findings are expected to improve the understanding of the mechanisms driving drug release variability and help identify critical material attributes associated with drug release performance. The study will include: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) to evaluate thermal behavior and crystallinity. X-ray Powder Diffraction (XRPD) to identify and characterize crystalline phases. Thermogravimetric Analysis/Loss on Drying (TGA-LOD) to investigate volatile content, potential hydrate and anhydrous forms of the API, and material stability. Micro-Computed Tomography (Micro-CT) to visualize the internal structure of the matrices and detect potential crystal formation or structural changes. Requirements A successful candidate should have an interest in pharmaceutical formulation development and a good understanding of solid-state characterization techniques, such as thermal analysis, diffraction methods, and imaging methods. Experience with these methods is considered an advantage. How to apply: Does this thesis project sound interesting to you? We would love to hear from you! If you are curious, motivated, and eager to put your knowledge into practice, we encourage you to submit your application by December 20, 2026 Join us at QPharma and get the opportunity to explore real-world challenges within pharmaceutical development. We offer an inspiring and collaborative environment where new ideas, knowledge, and innovation come together to shape the future of pharmaceutical solutions. items.desc: Ready to find your path? Try new things. Share experiences. And discover what you truly enjoy. In a rapidly changing technical landscape with numerous opportunities, we need people who shows the way and gathers us as a team. Together we create value to keep people and society safe. Your role Your role as a specialist in Data-Centric Architecture Your role is to pivot our data strategy from application-centric silos to a unified, data-centric ecosystem. This role is essential The ability to maintain a single, consistent version of the truth is critical. Without a robust semantic framework, the data remains fragmented. Expectations We expect you to lead the design and implementation of ontologies and semantic layers. You will own and define the metadata management strategy as well, ensuring that data is not only stored but is discoverable, traceable, and governed. Your focus will be on creating flexible architecture. The main purpose with the Specialist role is to act as a technical leader within the designated technical area. That means driving the development of the technical area, anticipating future trends and directions, understanding risks and opportunities and most important of all, drive and advocate for necessary change. External and international relations are essential parts to gather insights, co-create and increase knowledge. This includes relations with academia, partners as well as customers. While assigned to a specific line organization, Specialists work for the benefit of Saab as a whole. Appointments are made for a three-year term (2026-2028), with at least 20% of your time dedicated to specialist activities. As part of the Specialist program, you will meet and interact with other specialists at Saab. Every year there is an inspirational Surveillance Specialist Day, and you will also have the opportunity to engage in mentorship programs and courses to enhance your skills and knowledge. You will develop and maintain a written specialist plan, outlining your vision and strategy for your technical area, in dialogue with your manager and other stakeholders. You regularly communicate your plan and vision, to inspire, share insights and push boundaries. Your profile Who you are You are a rare hybrid: a strategic architect who is equally at home in a high-level stakeholder meeting as you are in a code editor. You believe that great architecture is only as good as its implementation, and you possess the technical discipline to build the semantic layers and ontologies you design. You are a "builder" at heart, someone who finds satisfaction in transforming a theoretical data model into a production-ready, scalable system. Your skills and knowledge You bring a deep, hands-on mastery of data-centric technologies. You don't just understand ontologies; you have experience with technologies such as RDF, OWL, and/or SHACL. You are proficient in querying and manipulating complex data structures using for example SPARQL and/or GraphQL. You have a strong command of programming to build the glue code and APIs that make a semantic layer functional. Your experience with metadata management isn't just theoretical; you have built automated pipelines for metadata extraction and you might have integrated data catalogs into active development workflows. You are comfortable with Graph databases and you might even know how to optimize them for performance at scale. Specific requirements For this position, a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics or a related technical field is essential, along with a proven portfolio of implemented data architectures. You must be proficient in version control (Git) and familiar with CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure. Fluent communication in Swedish and English, both verbal and written, is essential for collaborating with our teams. You are a curious and collaborative engineer who enjoys learning, sharing insights, and being inspired by others. You communicate in ways that create understanding and drive positive changes, while developing both your own competence and that of those around you. You may already take the lead in some situations or be ready to grow into it and you enjoy supporting others in contributing and developing. You take an interest in understanding the broader business context, including customers, competitors, products, priorities, and financial considerations. As a specialist, you will contribute your expertise and perspective to driving the transformation and competitiveness of our Surveillance capabilities. This specialist assignment offers an opportunity to broaden your experience, add variation to your everyday work, and support your long‑term career development. You build trust through open communication with teams, customers, and project stakeholders, contribute ideas, and take initiative to identify opportunities and work more efficiently helping both people and our organization move forward. items.desc: Application Deadline: Nov. 22, 2026 Stockholm On-site Job Description Are you an aspiring Management Consultant eager to work on strategically important projects for leading clients in the financial services sector? Do you want to help banks, insurers and other financial institutions navigate complex business challenges and drive meaningful change? Then join us at KPMG! When working at KPMG, you will be part of a global organization and work across a variety of areas, together with competent and inspiring colleagues. Within Transformation & Risk Consulting, we have several teams specializing in the financial services sector, offering opportunities to work with complex business challenges and contribute to the transformation of the industry. Financial Services at KPMG KPMG’s Transformation & Risk Consulting (TRC) area brings together more than 140 colleagues across complementary transformation, risk and advisory capabilities. Within TRC, several teams specialize in the financial services sector, comprising approximately 90 professionals working with banks, insurers, wealth managers and associated companies. Together, these teams combine industry knowledge with specialist expertise to help financial institutions navigate complex challenges, manage change and create lasting business value. Our work spans strategic and operational topics, from developing strategies and designing new ways of working to strengthening risk management and navigating regulatory changes. Our teams We are currently looking for new colleagues to join three of our teams working within the financial services sector: Finance & Operational Transformation – supports financial institutions in transforming their finance, technology and operational capabilities to improve performance, efficiency and business value. The team works across strategy development, target operating models, process and organizational transformation, digitalization and technology-enabled business change. Combining financial, operational and technology expertise, the team helps clients simplify complex operations, modernize ways of working and build more efficient, scalable and future-ready organizations. Risk & Regulatory Transformation – helps financial institutions navigate an increasingly complex risk and regulatory environment while transforming how risk and compliance are managed across the enterprise. Combining risk and regulatory expertise with transformation capabilities, the team supports clients in interpreting regulatory change, assessing its impact, strengthening governance and controls, and implementing new processes, data and technology. The focus is on building sustainable, efficient and technology-enabled risk and compliance capabilities that are embedded in the organization and support broader strategic objectives. Financial Risk & Modelling - supports financial institutions in quantifying and managing risks. The team specializes in the development, calibration, validation and review of quantitative models used for capital adequacy, solvency, accounting and risk management purposes. Combining technical expertise with regulatory knowledge and an understanding of model governance, the team helps financial institutions ensure robust models and maximize their business value. Our team is primarily based in Stockholm, Göteborg and Malmö. What do we offer? From day one, you will be supported by structured learning, hands-on client work, and experienced colleagues who will help you grow as a consultant. During your first years at KPMG, you will be a part of our advisory-wide learning and development program. In the program, you will acquire knowledge about all business sectors, industry trends and KPMG’s key clients. You will learn about our tools and methods, gain deep knowledge about our capabilities and delivery models, while also improving your leadership and sales skills. Together with other KPMG colleagues you will be working on exciting client engagements, and you will get a mentor and a dedicated performance manager supporting you in your career. items.desc: Job Description At IKEA, the product range is our identity. Every textile product we create should be safe, compliant, affordable and designed for the many people. As legislation, standards and customer expectations continue to evolve, we need people who are curious about what comes next and motivated by turning complexity into opportunities. That's why we're looking for a Product Requirement Specialist within Textiles to join us on our journey. As a Product Requirement Specialist (PRS), you help IKEA understand and prepare for existing and future product coordinating stakeholders in relevant working groups and forums, e.g. PRIO groups. Be responsible to influence, relevant to the IKEA range, new and existing legislations, regulations, and standards, within assigned area(s) and when relevant, to maintain a network of stakeholders in external alliances, e.g. standardization, organizations and academia. You will work closely with colleagues across the value chain while building networks with external stakeholders, including standardization organizations and industry partners. Through these collaborations, you will contribute to influencing legislation, regulations, and standards relevant to the IKEA range. If you are energized by understanding what is happening beyond today's requirements and curious about how future developments may shape tomorrow's products, this could be the role for you. You are passionate about textiles and motivated by helping others understand complex topics. We believe you have: University degree in Textile Engineering or Textile Technology Knowledge of textile materials and relevant standards, regulations, or product requirements. Experience from product development, requirement management, compliance, or another relevant part of the value chain. Strong analytical skills and the ability to assess and interpret complex topics. The ability to communicate complex issues in a clear and engaging way. Experience collaborating with many stakeholders and building strong networks. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and driven by continuous learning. You want to use your expertise to make a difference and contribute to a better everyday life for the many people. Additional Information At IKEA, you'll have the opportunity to combine deep specialist knowledge with collaboration, learning, and influence. You'll join a global environment where your expertise helps us understand change, prepare for the future, and continuously improve the way we develop our products. If you're passionate about textiles, fascinated by how requirements shape products, and excited by the opportunity to influence what comes next, we'd love to hear from you. This is a permanent position and it´s placed in Älmhult, Sweden. We look forward to receiving your application – CV and answer to the below question – in English latest by November 15, 2026. What made you interested in this role and enticed you to apply? What experience do you have that you believe will be beneficial for you in this role? Please note that we are continuously interviewing candidates. We do not accept applications sent directly via email. We look forward to hearing from you! If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact hiring manager Stefan Svensson +46 723 528 706. For questions regarding the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact recruiter Christina Appelqvist, +46-766-113408

items.desc: Job Description WHAT YOU’LL DO Join the Supply Chain organization and play a key role in the In-Season Optimisation area. You’ll work with Gen-AI technologies and leverage SQL, programming tools, and BI best practices to deliver actionable insights and optimize product performance. You will: Translate business processes and objectives into data-driven insights, helping the organization understand performance and make strategic decisions throughout the value chain. Support the analysis and optimization of replenishment, helping improve how, when, and how much stock is replenished to stores to increase product availability while maintaining healthy inventory levels. Analyze and support the optimization of inventory movements across the supply chain, including warehouse-to-warehouse stock movements, to ensure stock is positioned where it is needed. Understand how cross-functional initiatives and programs impact what we do and the decisions we make. Translate large volumes of data into actionable insights that guide strategic decisions across fashion retail and supply chain. Define, monitor, and visualize key KPIs to drive transparency and measure impact. Lead data modelling conversations to ensure optimal data structures and model performance within your product area. Act as the go-to analytics expert within your business and product team, collaborating end-to-end on data-driven business development, value realization and business case validation. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You’ll be part of a truly international and cross-functional team, working closely with Business Process Leads, Data Scientists, Business Experts, and Product Managers. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do; our team brings together diverse backgrounds and perspectives to solve complex challenges and create real value for millions of customers across global markets. We work in an agile setup that encourages experimentation, continuous learning, and open dialogue. WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with… A degree in Economics, Business, Supply Chain, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Experience in analytics roles, ideally within retail, fashion, supply chain, or other data driven environments. Experience working with inventory management, or supply chain optimization is a plus. Proficiency in SQL, Python, or R. Experience with modern data tools and development practices, such as Git, Dataform, or dbt, is a plus. A solid understanding of analytical methods applied to real-world data problems. Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or similar. And people who are… Strategic thinkers with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for solving complex problems. Curious and eager to learn, with a genuine interest in the fashion industry and how data can help solve real business and supply chain challenges. Clear communicators who can transform data into compelling stories and practical recommendations. Team players who thrive in collaborative, agile environments and are comfortable working with a range of stakeholders. WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. We offer all our employee’s attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a 25% staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 30 days holiday We offer a collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance H&M Incentive Program Wellness benefit 4000kr/year Benifex Benefits Portal Community with activities JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. items.desc: Vill du utveckla smarta digitala lösningar och vara med och påverka framtidens system i ett företag med stark framåtanda? På Sydställningar satsar vi på att stärka vår interna IT-kompetens och vidareutveckla våra digitala arbetssätt. Nu söker vi en engagerad och lösningsorienterad systemutvecklare som vill vara med och driva vår fortsatta digitala utveckling. Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera tekniskt utvecklingsarbete med verksamhetsnära samarbete, stort eget ansvar och möjligheten att se dina lösningar skapa konkret nytta i organisationen. Därför ska du välja Sydställningar Sydställningar grundades 1980 och är idag en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom byggnadsställningar och väderskydd. Med cirka 300 medarbetare arbetar vi varje dag för att skapa säkra och effektiva arbetsplatser för våra kunder. På Sydställningar är våra värderingar en naturlig del av vardagen. Vi är ett företag med stark framåtanda, stort engagemang och korta beslutsvägar, där säkerhet, laganda, ansvarstagande och professionalism genomsyrar vårt arbete. Genom prestigelöst samarbete, hög kvalitet och en ständig vilja att utvecklas skapar vi tillsammans en arbetsplats där både människor och verksamhet kan växa. Som systemutvecklare hos oss får du en betydelsefull roll i vår fortsatta digitala utveckling. Du får arbeta med system som används i verksamheten varje dag och möjlighet att påverka hur våra tekniska lösningar utformas och utvecklas. Om rollen Som systemutvecklare hos Sydställningar blir du en del av vår IT-avdelning och arbetar nära vår IT-chef, som också är projektledare för utvecklingsprojekten. Vi befinner oss i en spännande utvecklingsfas där vi vill bygga upp och stärka vår interna kompetens inom systemutveckling. Du får en central roll i arbetet med att utveckla, förvalta och förbättra våra egenutvecklade system. Arbetet omfattar både vidareutveckling av befintliga lösningar och utveckling av nya system, från idé till färdig leverans. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med verksamheten, där du får möjlighet att förstå behov, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta dessa till användarvänliga och effektiva tekniska lösningar. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Utveckla och underhålla våra egenutvecklade system med .NET, C# och React/TypeScript. Utveckla nya funktioner och system från idé till driftsättning och uppföljning. Arbeta med Azure och molnbaserade driftmiljöer, exempelvis App Service, Container Apps och virtuella maskiner. Hantera versionshantering, automatiserade byggen och driftsättning via Azure DevOps. Samarbeta med verksamheten för att förstå behov och omsätta dessa till tekniska lösningar. Dokumentera system, kod och tekniska lösningar samt bidra till säkra och hållbara arbetssätt. Bidra med idéer och förbättringsförslag inom systemutveckling och digitalisering. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för programmering och systemutveckling och som motiveras av att skapa lösningar som gör skillnad. Du är analytisk, strukturerad och har en god förmåga att självständigt driva ditt arbete framåt. Du trivs med att ta ansvar, lösa problem och sätta dig in i nya tekniska utmaningar. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra. Du kan förklara tekniska lösningar på ett begripligt sätt och tycker om att arbeta nära verksamheten. Vi tror att du uppskattar en varierad roll där du får kombinera självständigt utvecklingsarbete med samarbete, problemlösning och möjligheten att påverka tekniska vägval. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper, ditt engagemang och din vilja att bidra till vår fortsatta utveckling. Vi söker dig som har: Eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling, datateknik eller motsvarande kunskaper förvärvade genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Yrkeserfarenhet av systemutveckling i produktionsmiljö. Goda kunskaper i C#, .NET, HTML, CSS och SQL. Erfarenhet av React och TypeScript. Praktisk erfarenhet av Azure och dess vanligaste resurser. God förståelse för Git, versionshantering och driftsättning. Erfarenhet av att självständigt utveckla, testa och driftsätta funktioner eller system. God förståelse för systemarkitektur, designmönster och kodstandarder. Förmåga att felsöka och lösa tekniska problem självständigt. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och goda kunskaper i engelska. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: Azure DevOps. SQL Server och datamodellering. Microsoft Entra ID och Microsoft 365. Systemintegrationer och automatisering av arbetsprocesser. Vi erbjuder dig: En utvecklande och varierad tjänst med stort eget ansvar. Möjlighet att påverka tekniska lösningar och framtida utvecklingsprojekt. En modern teknikmiljö med .NET, React, TypeScript, Azure och Azure DevOps. Nära samarbete med IT-chefen och korta beslutsvägar från idé till genomförande. En arbetsplats med engagerade …

items.desc: Vill du utveckla tekniska lösningar som gör nytta för andra människor? Nu söker vi två systemutvecklare till vårt Integration Competence Center (ICC). Vi välkomnar olika erfarenheter och tekniska bakgrunder och söker särskilt dig som har gedigen erfarenhet och kan bidra med tekniskt ansvar i teamet. Rollen som systemutvecklare På vårt ICC arbetar vi med att utveckla, förvalta och driftsäkra integrationer mellan de många IT-system som används inom Region Jönköpings län. Våra lösningar möjliggör informationsflöden inom bland annat hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik och administrativa verksamheter – från remisshantering och invånartjänster till realtidsinformation för bussar och tåg. Som systemutvecklare hos oss arbetar du framför allt med systemintegration, vilket innebär en bredare roll än traditionell systemutveckling. Du utvecklar och vidareutvecklar integrationer, ofta i mindre och varierande uppdrag, men arbetar också med felsökning, övervakning, driftsupport och teknisk förvaltning. Du är delaktig i hela kedjan från utveckling till drift och bidrar även till att utveckla våra tekniska plattformar och verktyg. Vi arbetar främst med Apache Camel och MuleSoft, med Java som en viktig grund. Vår miljö är huvudsakligen Windowsbaserad, men vi rör oss också mot containerteknik och Linux. Vi använder bland annat Git, Jenkins, Nexus och ActiveMQ och utforskar aktivt hur AI-stödda verktyg kan effektivisera vårt arbete. Du blir en del av ett team med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar och hur arbetet planeras och fördelas. Här får du arbeta med varierande tekniska utmaningar och lösningar som gör konkret nytta i samhället. För en av tjänsterna ingår även att förvalta och vid behov vidareutveckla några av regionens egenutvecklade Java-system. Erfarenhet av att sätta sig in i befintlig kod och göra anpassningar i etablerade system är därför värdefull. Vi avser att rekrytera två systemutvecklare. Vi erbjuder tillsvidareanställningar på heltid med placering i Jönköping. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Din blivande arbetsplats IT-centrum ansvarar för IT-verksamheten i Region Jönköpings län. På ICC blir du en del av ett team med kompetens inom bland annat systemutveckling, arkitektur och projektledning. Vi arbetar nära verksamheterna och andra delar av IT-centrum. Vi arbetar strukturerat med kvalitet och förbättringar. IT-centrum är kvalitetscertifierat enligt SS-EN ISO 9001 och miljöcertifierat enligt SS-EN ISO 14001. Vill du veta mer om oss? Besök oss på LinkedIn och Instagram: IT-centrum, Region Jönköpings län: Översikt | LinkedIn Instagram Din profil Vi söker dig som har en god teknisk grund inom systemutveckling, gärna med erfarenhet av Java och systemintegration. Erfarenhet av Apache Camel, MuleSoft, API-utveckling, meddelandehantering eller drift och felsökning av servermiljöer är meriterande. Det viktigaste för oss är ditt tekniska intresse, din problemlösningsförmåga och din vilja att lära dig nytt . Du trivs med att förstå hur system hänger ihop, felsöka komplexa problem och växla mellan utveckling, teknik och förvaltning. Du är nyfiken på nya arbetssätt och tekniker och tycker om att ta ansvar och hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra. Vi värdesätter erfarenhet, men också eget driv och engagemang. Du behöver inte kunna alla våra tekniker från början – viktigare är att du har rätt grund, är initiativrik och vill utvecklas tillsammans med teamet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vårt erbjudande till dig Hos oss får du ett meningsfullt arbete där dina insatser bidrar till samhällsviktiga verksamheter. Du får också möjlighet att påverka din egen roll och bidra till hur vårt egenutvecklingsteam utvecklas framöver, inte minst när det gäller AI och framtidens mjukvaruutveckling. Region Jönköpings län är en kunskapsintensiv organisation med goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling. IT-centrum tillämpar flexibel arbetsplats, vilket innebär möjlighet att utföra en del av arbetet på distans. Vi arbetar aktivt för en god arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv. Som medarbetare hos oss inom Region Jönköpings län får du tillgång till våra anställningsförmåner. En del av dem ökar din grundtrygghet, andra sätter lite guldkant på vardagen. items.desc: Kravanalytiker – Vattenfall Vi söker en erfaren kravanalytiker till ett spännande uppdrag hos Vattenfall i Stockholm. Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av kravanalys och kravhantering och som är skicklig på att navigera i komplexa och föränderliga verksamhets- och IT-miljöer. Du kommer att arbeta nära verksamhetsrepresentanter, produktägare, UX, utvecklare och testare för att förstå behov, utmana antaganden och omsätta verksamhetsmål till tydliga, genomförbara och spårbara krav. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med olika kompetenser där du får en viktig roll i att skapa samsyn mellan verksamhet och IT och säkerställa att lösningar möter affärsmål, användarbehov och tekniska förutsättningar. Om uppdraget I rollen som kravanalytiker arbetar du genom hela leveransprocessen, från initial behovsanalys och kravdialoger till refinement, implementation och uppföljning. Du ansvarar för att facilitera kravdialoger, analysera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dessa till tydliga, konkreta och testbara krav. Du fungerar som en viktig brygga mellan verksamhet och IT och hjälper olika intressenter att nå en gemensam förståelse för mål, prioriteringar och beroenden. Med ett pragmatiskt och hands-on arbetssätt bidrar du aktivt till teamets framdrift och säkerställer att krav är begripliga, genomförbara och skapar avsett affärsvärde. Du förväntas även identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och bidra till att utveckla metoder och arbetssätt inom kravhantering och leveransprocesser. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Facilitera och leda workshops och kravdialoger med verksamhetsrepresentanter, intressenter och utvecklingsteam. Identifiera, analysera och dokumentera verksamhetsbehov samt omsätta dessa till tydliga, konkreta och testbara krav. Analysera och dokumentera funktionella och icke-funktionella krav med fokus på affärsvärde. Driva kravarbete från behovsanalys och refinement till genomförbara lösningar redo för implementation. Agera brygga mellan verksamhet och IT genom att översätta verksamhetsbehov till konkreta och tekniskt genomförbara lösningar. Säkerställa kvalitet, spårbarhet och rätt detaljnivå genom hela kravprocessen. Skapa samsyn mellan intressenter samt hantera beroenden och komplexa frågeställningar. Arbeta nära produktägare, UX, utvecklare och testare i det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet. Säkerställa att krav och leveranser möter verksamhetens mål, användarbehov och tekniska förutsättningar. Bidra till att vidareutveckla metoder, arbetssätt och kvalitetsprinciper inom kravhantering och identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter i leveransflöden. Kvalifikationer – skallkrav Vi söker dig som har: Flera års erfarenhet som kravanalytiker, Business Analyst eller i en liknande roll. Erfarenhet av kravanalys och kravhantering i komplexa organisationer eller digitala produktmiljöer. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att facilitera workshops och kravdialoger med intressenter från både verksamhet och IT. Gedigen erfarenhet av att analysera och dokumentera funktionella och icke-funktionella krav. Erfarenhet av kravhantering i agila och tvärfunktionella utvecklingsmiljöer. Stark analytisk förmåga, sinne för detaljer och ett strukturerat arbetssätt med fokus på kvalitet och spårbarhet. God förståelse för systemflöden, integrationer och tekniska beroenden. Förmåga att samarbeta effektivt med utvecklingsteam och översätta verksamhetsbehov till genomförbara lösningar. Erfarenhet av att tillämpa och förbättra etablerade metoder och arbetssätt inom kravhantering. Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller företagsekonomi, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera och dokumentera på både svenska och engelska. Meriterande Erfarenhet från energi-, kraft- eller infrastruktursektorn. Vem vi tror att du är Du har några års erfarenhet av virtualisering och kan ta en teknisk lösning från idé till produktion. Du vill hellre automatisera bort ett återkommande problem än att lösa det manuellt en gång till. Du är nyfiken på hur saker fungerar under huven, och delar gärna med dig av vad du kommer fram till. Mycket av det du bygger ska användas av andra team, så du förklarar dina vägval på ett sätt som landar även hos den som inte kan plattformen lika väl som du. Du har eftergymnasial utbildning inom teknik/IT, eller motsvarande kunskap från arbete inom infrastruktur. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av drift av ex Openstack eller motsvarande Vad den här tjänsten innebär: . Du arbetar i ett team som tillsammans ansvarar för SVT:s virtualiseringsplattform. Den används av stora delar av organisationen och måste fungera dygnet runt, året om. Tyngdpunkten i din roll ligger på utveckling och automation: du skriver koden som gör att plattformen sköter sig själv, bygger verktyg, självbetjäningsflöden och API-integrationer åt våra utvecklingsteam, och deltar i arkitekturarbetet kring compute, nätverk och lagring. Du är också med och formar vägen bort från VMware. Arbetet är varierande, med allt från akuta driftstörningar tillsammans med teamet till projektarbete och förvaltning av befintliga system. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placeringsort Stockholm och med tillträdesdatum snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. Anställningen förutsätter en godkänd säkerhetsprövning. Anställningen innebär att du blir krigsplacerad på SVT. Har du frågor om anställningen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Head of Hosting Alexandra Jonsson. items.desc: The opportunity Are you an engineer who wants to turn analysis and improvement ideas into real results on the factory floor? At EFESO, we work side by side with leading industrial companies to improve manufacturing performance and build sustainable Operations Excellence capabilities. We are looking for a junior Management Consultant to join our MAKE Practice in Stockholm. You will work with experienced colleagues and client teams to understand operational challenges, analyse losses and turn insights into measurable improvements. We are looking for someone with a strong analytical foundation, first-hand experience from a factory environment and a genuine interest in manufacturing. Industrial AI is increasingly part of how we work, so curiosity about data, analytics and AI is important, but previous AI experience is not required. What you will do Work alongside experienced consultants and client teams in manufacturing environments Analyse operational performance and identify improvement opportunities Support Operations Excellence projects and implementation activities Contribute to areas such as Lean, WCOM, TPM and performance improvement Use data and AI-enabled tools to strengthen analysis and problem solving Gradually take on more responsibility as your experience grows Is this you? You are likely to bring: 0–3 years of relevant professional experience A Master's degree in Industrial Engineering & Management, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering or similar Experience from a factory or manufacturing environment, for example through employment, an internship, summer job or thesis project Strong analytical and problem-solving skills A genuine interest in manufacturing, Operations Excellence and new technology Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset Fluent English and Swedish are required. The role includes travel to client sites, primarily within the Nordics, and is based in Stockholm. Being close to colleagues and learning together is an important part of your first years at EFESO. Why EFESO Nordics? At EFESO, you will learn by doing. You will work close to our clients' operations, combining structured problem solving with hands-on implementation and learning from experienced industrial consultants. You will develop your Operations Excellence capabilities while gaining exposure to how data and Industrial AI are changing manufacturing. Interested in building your consulting career where industrial performance is actually created? We would like to hear from you. About us EFESO Nordics is part of EFESO Consulting Group which is a global consulting company specialized in Operations Strategy, Performance Improvement and Industrial AI. In the Nordics, we are 40 consultants working both locally and globally with our 1000 colleagues side-by-side with clients to accelerate their transformation towards short term results and future-proof operations – always built on knowledge, responsiveness and proven methods and models. We work with industry leaders in industries such as: forest & packaging, discrete manufacturing, food & beverage, private equity and services & utilities. EFESO Nordics is a pioneer in management consulting in Sweden, as our origins are from one of Sweden’s oldest management consultant companies founded in 1960.

A practical
items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. Description of the workplace The Diagnostic Radiology research group conducts research related to clinical medical imaging. LUCI (Lund University Cancer Imaging) is an interdisciplinary group of researchers and healthcare professionals with a primary focus on innovative clinical imaging methods in breast cancer diagnostics, particularly the use of artificial intelligence[DM1] -based breast cancer screening. The group is based at Skåne University Hospital (SUS) in Malmö. Both Diagnostic Radiology and LUCI are led by Professor Sophia Zackrisson and comprise researchers from diverse professional backgrounds as well as technical staff. More information is available here. Magnus Dustler, Associate Professor of Radiology, conducts research in several areas, including the application of artificial intelligence in breast imaging. In collaboration with the newly established Hybrid Intelligence group at LUSEM, led by Senior Lecturer Blerim Emruli, as well with the collaboration of Professor Dagmar Monett Diaz from HWR Berlin (Berlin School of Economics and Law), we are currently investigating how the use of AI as a decision-support tool affects radiologists’ learning and skills development. Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive working environment characterized by mutual respect and consideration. We strive to create a workplace that is both stimulating and supportive of professional development for all team members. We continuously work to provide favorable conditions for job satisfaction, growth, and participation. We are dedicated to ensuring both physical safety and a healthy psychosocial work environment. What We Offer Lund University is a public authority, which means that you are entitled to special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the University’s website about being employed at Lund University: Work with us Work duties and areas of responsibility As an Assistant Researcher, you will be responsible for conducting a study on how AI tools for mammography image interpretation are used, and how they should be used, in education and clinical practice. The study consists of three components: A literature review of different strategies for the use of AI in radiology and breast imaging, as well as how the use of AI in other fields has influenced learning and skills development. A practical image interpretation experiment in which medical students are recruited and trained to interpret mammography images either with or without the support of AI tools. The same students will subsequently review mammography images with or without AI assistance. A particular focus will be the effect of false-positive and false-negative cases. A practical study in which experienced radiologists review images where AI support is presented in different ways, in order to investigate how the presentation of information affects interpretation performance. Qualifications The following qualifications are required for the position: PhD in Medical Radiation Physics, Medical Image Analysis, Radiology, or a closely related relevant field. items.desc: What we do at Blykalla Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com. What you’ll get to do Our team at Blykalla is looking for a materials specialist with deep expertise in fuel cladding, fuel-cladding interaction and irradiation effects. You will define how our cladding behaves inside the core, how the cladding reacts chemically with uranium fuel on the inside and liquid lead on the outside, and how the material changes under neutron irradiation. Your work decides which cladding we can qualify, and how to get the data needed. You join the materials team as the technical owner for qualifying the fuel cladding. The cladding is the first barrier around the fuel, and it must keep its integrity for the full core life in a hot, irradiated, liquid-metal environment. You will work closely with the fuel, core design, and safety analysis teams as well as research institutions across Europe and the US. Responsibilities Own the technical basis for the cladding material and its corrosion-protective layer, from specification through qualification. Assess and test fuel-cladding chemical interaction with uranium fuel, including carbon and nitrogen transport. Assist with the irradiation programme to ensure all needed data is gathered. Interpret post-irradiation examination data on hardening, embrittlement, swelling, irradiation creep and helium effects. Turn test results into design limits and lifetime models, together with the core design and fuel teams. Map nuclear codes and standards, such as ASME Section III Division 5, onto cladding qualification, and contribute to the safety case for licensing with SSM and NRC. Write and review technical reports and data packages and keep the team manager and other projects updated on progress, challenges and risks. Who you’ll get to work with The Materials Specialist sits in the Materials Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Head of Materials. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla. Who you are You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are: Master’s degree or PhD in materials science, nuclear engineering or a related field. Proven experience with fuel cladding materials for fast reactors or other advanced reactors, including fuel-cladding chemical interaction. Solid understanding of irradiation effects in steels and how they translate into design limits and qualification requirements. Hands-on experience of microstructural analysis. Experience working with test reactor operators, research institutes or suppliers on material development. Fluency in English, spoken and written. Swedish is an advantage. Nice to have Experience with various fuel systems. Knowledge of liquid metal corrosion and liquid metal embrittlement. Experience with ferritic, FeCrAl or oxide-dispersion-strengthened steels, or with thermal spray and laser cladding of tubes. Familiarity with ASME, RCC-MRx and nuclear quality assurance requirements such as NQA-1. Experience with fuel performance or materials modelling. Salary range is flexible based on candidate profile, our band is from 57 000 - 75 000 sek/monthly. Location This position is for our office in Stockholm. So, what do you think? Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Materials Specialist and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements. We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply! You will work across a variety of projects, disease areas, and data sources, contributing to the generation and interpretation of real-world evidence in Europe and beyond. You will collaborate closely with physicians, medical registries, and leading pharmaceutical companies to translate complex data into actionable insights that inform clinical and regulatory decision-making. Unique data access: Work with exclusive real-world datasets and medical registries across Europe Science meets consulting: Operate at the intersection of rigorous analytics and strategic thinking, combining a scientific mindset with a client-oriented, consulting approach High-impact projects: Collaborate with leading global pharmaceutical companies on strategically relevant evidence generation Entrepreneurial culture: Flat hierarchies, fast decision-making, and direct exposure to clients and senior experts Flexibility: Remote-friendly setup with a high degree of autonomy and trust Innovation-driven environment: Leverage real-world evidence to help shape and develop next-generation digital health solutions About us At Rewoso, we specialize in the generation of high-quality real-world evidence to support clinical, regulatory, and strategic decision-making in healthcare. On a day-to-day basis, we work with real-world data from European medical registries—to design & develop statistical approaches, and translate data into actionable insights in close collaboration with physicians and pharmaceutical partners. items.desc: We are seeking a state-registered Healthcare Scientist with expertise in Microbiology and/or Analytical Chemistry, particularly HPLC and LC-MS/MS, and a strong interest in the clinical application of infection management and antimicrobial chemotherapy. Applicants should hold an MSc and/or PhD and be HCPC registered as either a Clinical Scientist or Biomedical Scientist within Clinical Microbiology, Clinical Biochemistry, or a related discipline. The Antimicrobial Reference Laboratory (ARL), based in Bristol provides a nationally recognised antimicrobial assay service to NHS and private healthcare providers. The laboratory offers a comprehensive range of antibacterial, antifungal, and antiviral therapeutic drug monitoring assays, alongside specialist clinical advice on the interpretation and application of results. The ARL is based within purpose-built pathology laboratories and forms part of Infection Sciences, The laboratory is staffed by a multidisciplinary team comprising Clinical Scientists, Senior Biomedical Scientists, and support staff, and operates within a UKAS ISO 15189 accredited quality management system.. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced scientist to contribute to a nationally recognised service at the forefront of antimicrobial monitoring, clinical interpretation, and assay development. To participate in the provision of effective and high quality clinical and analytical services in antimicrobial therapeutic drug monitoring, as provided by the Antimicrobial Reference Laboratory (ARL). Participate in the ARL clinical validation rota alongside Clinical and Biomedical Scientists, providing result interpretation, responding to clinical and technical enquiries, and contributing to the Saturday morning rota. To undertake, independently or collaboratively, research activities that contribute to the advancement of Medical Microbiology and the scientific principles underpinning the specialty, with a particular focus on antimicrobial chemotherapy. To support the supervision, training, and professional development of staff and participate in the department’s educational activities. To ensure all data is processed correctly and stored in the appropriate electronic or paper-based format, in line with local and national policies. On a rotational basis and under the direction of the Operations Manager, contribute to the daily operation of the laboratory, including staff management, administrative duties, and attendance at departmental and cross-departmental meetings to ensure the effective delivery of the service. Bristol NHS Foundation Trust brings together more than 28,000 staff to deliver over 160 clinical services across thirteen hospital locations, operating from three main sites at Southmead, Bristol city centre and Weston. With an annual turnover of £2.3 billion, we are now one of the largest NHS trusts in the United Kingdom. Our hospitals are spread across Bristol and Weston, join us and you can enjoy the very best of both worlds; city living within a stone’s throw of the countryside or beside the seaside, both with easy access to all that the South West has to offer. Bristol NHS Foundation Trust values all people as individuals. As an equal opportunities employer actively working towards a diverse workforce we aim to recruit and retain a workforce which represents the rich diversity of the local population at all levels and are committed to designing our services around the needs of individual patients and those around them. Anonymous information will be used from your application in order to ensure we’re meeting our pledge. For a more detailed job description and main responsibilities, please refer to the job description document attached to this vacancy.

items.desc: About Fleetcraft We're building the critical infrastructure for the next generation of aircraft. Aerospace demand is surging. OEMs have decade-long backlogs, new manufacturers are racing to market, and the industry is hundreds of thousands of technicians short. The world needs more aerospace capacity, but the systems used to maintain and manufacture aircraft are slow, manual, and barely changed in decades. Fleetcraft is the full system to operate and manage aircraft maintenance. Our agents already work alongside technicians and controllers in 10+ maintenance organisations across 4 continents. They capture the repair as it happens and turn expertise into intelligence the whole operation can use. Our seed was led by Susa Ventures, alongside Liquid 2 VC, early backers of Anduril and Stoke Space. You'll work with a team that has helped launch airlines and put satellites into orbit, and with an aviation advisory board whose members have run major aircraft OEMs, led airworthiness at Gulfstream, and overseen training facilities that educate a quarter of all aircraft mechanics in the US. The role As a Deployment Strategist , you’ll own customer implementation end-to-end. You’ll translate complex operational requirements into AI-solutions, work hands-on with customers to drive adoption, and turn what you learn in the field into sales and engineering priorities. This is a highly hands-on, high-ownership role. You’ll spend time in our office with the team, but also on-site with customers in hangars, maintenance facilities, and manufacturing environments, around the world. You’ll work directly with technicians, operators, managers, and executives to understand their workflows, deploy Fleetcraft into live environments, and make sure the product becomes mission-critical. What we're looking for We’re looking for someone with exceptional learning velocity, commercial instinct, and technical competence. You should be pragmatic, intentional, and very structured. Aerospace experience is not required - the ability to learn quickly, adapt, and handle complex implementations with high emotional intelligence. You should be technically fluent enough to understand AI and software systems and commercially curious enough to understand what drives customer value. 2+ years in consulting, technical implementation, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles in enterprise B2B. AI-native: You already use AI extensively in your work, experiment constantly, and instinctively find ways to move faster with it. Technically fluent: You can hold your own with engineers and translate customer needs into actionable engineering requirements. High emotional intelligence: Equally comfortable earning the trust of CEOs, IT directors, senior engineers, aircraft technicians, and pilots. Structured and resourceful: Able to manage multiple deployments, solve complex problems, and bring clarity to ambiguous situations. Bias to action: You take ownership, learn quickly, and prioritise getting things done over perfect plans. What we offer £75k–£110k salary plus meaningful early-stage equity. A small, high-trust team where your decisions move the whole company forward. Relocation support if needed. Modern tools, real-world impact in a regulated industry, and the chance to define how AI transforms aerospace from the ground up. If you're energised by building production AI systems that solve hard, real-world problems - and you want the ownership and pace that only comes from being early at something important, we'd love to talk. Interview process Initial screening interview with a co-founder (30 min) Technical interview (45 min) Take home project In-person meeting (1 hr) After the in-person meeting we check references and then make an offer. We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Fleetcraft is an equal opportunities employer.

items.desc: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will initially join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a strong security focus, and it will become more security focused over time. Much of the work is compliance and assurance: building and running the tooling that checks our cloud estate against our security standards, writing the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one, gathering the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and our other obligations, and supporting the audits that depend on it. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Strengthen access and identity controls o Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. o Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. o Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. Extend our platform standards beyond AWS o Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. o Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. items.desc: We are seeking committed practitioners who wish to further their studies by training with South West CYP IAPT in Systemic Therapy. We are offering two funded places on the Systemic Practitioner CYP-IAPT course. The successful candidates will work within community CAMHS, delivering evidence-based systemic interventions for children and adolescents experiencing depression, self-harm, and/or conduct disorder. One post is likely to be based in East Cornwall for most of the training and the other will be based in Mid/West Cornwall. Both roles may involve travel between clinics. The course runs for one year, January to December, funded by Health Education England. You will study at the University of Exeter two days per week and work in a children’s mental health service for 2–3 days per week. We welcome applicants from a range of professional backgrounds who have CAMHS experience and relevant competencies and registration in children’s mental health. Please note: If you are an internal candidate and wanting to apply for this position as a secondment opportunity. Before applying, please ensure you have discussed the post with your current line manager and obtained their agreement to support your release for the duration of the secondment. Please note: This opportunity is open to internal candidates within West ICA specialist CAMHS team , Cornwall Partnership Foundation Trust. If you do not currently work for this NHS organisation, your application will not be considered at this time. EXPECTED START DATE: 5th January 2027 and candidates will need to register for the course by December 2026. This is a training role within the Child and Young Persons Improving Access to Psychological Therapies Programme (CYP-IAPT). The post-holders will work within Cornwall CAMHS service at Cornwall Partnership Trust, providing systemic interventions whilst undertaking a programme of training for these roles at the University of Exeter. Systemic therapy explores relationships and involves working with family members and sub-systems to safely explore difficult emotions and thoughts and emotions, to understand each other’s experiences and perspectives. The training and supervisory experience will equip the learners to deliver evidence based systemic interventions in either eating disorders or community CAMHS. Learners will gain a critical and reflective understanding of the CYP IAPT model of service change, outcome monitoring, and fundamentals of systemic approaches working with children and families. This clinical practise will complement and enhance the knowledge gained from the university as you will be given the opportunity to learn a range of systemic techniques and interventions under the supervision of highly specialised family and systemic practitioners. We’re an NHS community and mental health provider Trust based in Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly. We deliver community and hospital-based care to improve people’s physical and mental health. We also provide specialist support to people with dementia or a learning disability. We are a people organisation and people matter to us. As part of the team, you'll help support the health and wellbeing of the people who live and visit this beautiful part of the UK. Over 4,000 people make up the Trust. This includes doctors, nurses, therapists, plus admin and support staff. We work in people's homes, in community clinics and bases. Some staff work from one of our 13 community hospitals. Our aspiration is to have great people, provide great care, be a great place to work and a great partner. Just over 532,000 people live here. A third of people who live in Cornwall are supported by acute hospital services in Devon. As a result, we also work closely with our partners in Devon. In the summer, and during other holidays lots of people choose to visit the area. This increases the numbers of people who use our services. For full information of the roles and responsibilities of this role, please see the attached job description and person specification.

items.desc: This exciting and innovative role sits at the heart of CAMHS, helping to ensure children, young people and families receive the right support, at the right time, in the right place. As a CAMHS Specialist Practitioner , you will play a pivotal role in enhancing patient flow, reducing delays in care, and supporting smooth transitions across services. Combining specialist clinical expertise with strong coordination and system-navigation skills, you will work collaboratively with children, young people, families, multidisciplinary colleagues and partner agencies to ensure timely access to care, effective discharge planning and positive clinical outcomes. The role offers a unique opportunity to influence pathways across CAMHS, driving efficient, high-quality and person-centred care while maintaining a strong clinical focus. Why this role is exciting Key role in shaping patient flow and reducing waiting times. Opportunity to influence system-wide pathways across CAMHS and partner agencies. Balance of service development and direct clinical work. Collaborative multidisciplinary environment with strong professional support. Chance to improve access, experience and outcomes for children, young people and families. 1. Lead on the coordination of patient flow across the CAMHS community pathways, ensuring timely access and discharge planning. 2. Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to identify barriers to discharge and implement solutions. 3. Support and advice teams on recording care pathways effectively on epjs and monitor recording reports. 4. Monitor caseloads, length of stay, last contacts and service capacity to support effective resource allocation and reduce waiting times. 5. Liaise with external agencies and services to facilitate smooth transitions and continuity of care. 6. Provide clinical oversight and support to practitioners managing complex discharge cases. 7. With senior colleagues, evaluate and review the therapeutic strategic outcomes for the team and set aims and objectives and the monitor practice to assure quality standards of care. 8. Establish and maintain evidence-based practice in the assessment and treatment of young people in crisis or needing intensive and/or crisis intervention. South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust (SLaM) provide the widest range of NHS mental health services in the UK as well as substance misuse services for people who are addicted to drugs and alcohol. We work closely with the Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology and Neuroscience (IoPPN), King's College London and are part of King's Health Partners Academic Health Sciences Centre. There are very few organisations in the world that have such wide-ranging capabilities working with mental illness. Our scope is unique because it is built on three major foundations: care and treatment, science and research, and training. 1. Assume responsibility for own case list and case management of children, adolescents and families who are determined to be at high risk. 2. Provide primary CAMHS assessments, other specialist assessments and risk assessments to identify and diagnose the cause of emotional and behavioural problems in children and young people. 3. Formulate care plans, based on the primary CAMHS assessment. Design, write and share a copy of the care plan with children, young people and their carers. 4. Carry out the care plan using evidence-based models of psychological and psychotherapeutic interventions. 5. Participate and lead in joint complex assessments with other disciplines and other agencies and provide reports for referrers, families and other agencies as required, including 'witness of fact' court reports where appropriate. 6. Assess safeguarding issues for each case and refer concerns to Child Protection teams. 7. Maintain good relationships and clear lines of communication with other professional agencies and departments, providing specialist advice and support where appropriate.

items.desc: We are pleased to be able to offer an exciting opportunity to join the Primary Care and Partnerships team within the Eastbourne Neighbourhood Mental Health Team (NMHT) as a Mental Health Practitioner (MHP) This role will be part of a team of Mental Health Practitioners working into the newly formed NMHT's. You will be part of the core team working alongside the Specialist Adult Service, Specialist Older Adult Service and VCSE Partners. You will be closely aligned and work with colleagues within GP practices as well as Health in Mind (NHS Talking Therapies- NHS TT). The MHP role will provide a critical function in triaging referrals into the service as well as those in NHS TT, providing timely and consistent assessments, brief interventions and onward referral as required. Liaison with key stakeholders and third sector organisations also forms part of this role. This post offers the Trust's £2,000 Golden Hello or Relocation Incentive for Band 6 Nurses & Practitioners, (pro rata and subject to terms and conditions; please see attached Protocol Document for full details). It is essential that you are a registered Mental Health Professional (Mental Health Nurse, Social Worker or Occupational Therapist). Your role will include carrying out assessments, brief interventions, triage, onward referrals to Secondary or Urgent Care Services (if this is needed) and signposting advice. The successful applicant should have excellent clinical skills in assessment, risk assessment and as well as strong communication skills. You will be working closely with a range of professional groups, including Mental Health Practitioners based within GP surgeries, NMHT colleagues, partner organisations, VCSE providers, and other aligned services within the Neighbourhood as well as NHS Talking Therapies Teams.
