items.desc: This is a very exciting opportunity for an experienced Dietitian to support the development, implementation, continuous monitoring, and improvement of the Active Together Programme. The overall purpose of this role is to lead, deliver, and sustain the success of the dietetic element of the Active Together Programme at Airedale. This role includes working under the guidance of the Therapy Operational Manager for the Active Together Programme to ensure Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and milestones are achieved. The Dietitian will also ensure the effectiveness and sustainability of the dietetic component of the service ensuring the delivery of evidence-based practice, and better outcomes for patients, through clinics, and group education sessions. The successful candidate will also be a part of the friendly and supportive wider Active Together service which includes Physiotherapists, a Psychologist, and a Fitness Instructor with opportunities for peer support, CPD and provision of clinical supervision. Please note this role requires the post-holder to have access to a car to attend clinics, group workshops, and meetings in the local area. Airedale NHS foundation trust are working collaboratively with Yorkshire Cancer Research to implement the Active Together prehabilitation and rehabilitation model to individuals diagnosed with cancer. The Active Together programme will run alongside the existing treatment pathways to ensure patients are optimally prepared for treatment and beyond. It aims to maximise resilience to treatment, improve longer term health, minimise side effects and empower patients to be partners in their healthcare. This is a funded 5-year programme which will have staged implementation into all relevant cancer pathways. Currently the service is working with patients diagnosed with colorectal, breast, lung, and renal cancers. The Post Holder will: Support the implementation of the cancer prehabilitation services, in conjunction with the Active Together team, and service manager. Coordinate dietetic input to patients referred into the Active Together Service. This includes one to one clinic appointments, and group workshops. Provide leadership for an evidence-based dietetic pathway for patients with a cancer diagnosis, with curative intent, across multiple cancer pathways. Provide highly specialist, evidence-based dietetic advice, teaching and supervision to other members of the Active Together Service and the wider MDT. Be responsible for the development of guidelines, protocols and procedures that ensure patient safety. We are delighted to offer a wide range of benefits to employees including: Cycle to Work Travel Scheme Childcare Vouchers with Salary Sacrifice Onsite Nursery Buying and Selling Annual Leave Car Leasing Employee Assistance Programme Employee Health and Wellbeing Extensive Reward Scheme Counselling Service Financial packages including Vivup and Wagestream Staff Networks, Enable, Rainbow, Gender, Race Equality Ecoaware & Admin Network. Our values: We understand that it’s down to the hard work, effort and dedication of our staff that makes a difference for our patients. Our people really do make our Airedale experience – we take pride in fostering a friendly, effective and caring work environment. Our values are part of our DNA, which are: Committed to Quality of Care Compassion Working together for patients Improving Lives Everyone Counts Respect and Dignity Got questions before you apply, please contact the recruiting manager to find out more. Refer to the attached job description for further information. Enquiries about the this role are also encouraged by email, telephone, virtual or a face to face meeting.

items.desc: ContractTypeAndDuration Full Time, Permanent The role Position: Audiology Partner New Business Opening in: Didcot Salary: Up to £50,000 Basic + 50% Profit as Dividends Our business opening opportunities. Specsavers are looking for an Audiologist or Hearing Aid Dispenser to become the New Store Partner, Director, and Business Owner. Grow your own business, look after your customers, serve your community, create an asset for your family’s future and enjoy the profits of all your hard work. This opportunity is a new audiology business within an existing Specsavers Optics store. The role will require you to build the business and team from the ground up. It requires an initial investment to purchase the shares, you will receive a guaranteed salary and collect profits as dividends. Your focus will be on growing the customer base and building a successful team. Why Didcot? Specsavers Didcot is a thriving and well-established business that has been serving its community since 2005. Both Optical Directors have been part of the journey from day one, creating a strong culture, loyal customer base and a highly experienced team. Our most recent Great Place to Work survey gave us a score of 95%!!! Situated in the heart of one of Oxfordshire's fastest-growing towns, the store benefits from excellent transport links, with Didcot Parkway station just a five-minute walk away and direct connections to major cities across the South, alongside regular bus routes to surrounding towns and villages. This is a particularly exciting opportunity for an ambitious Hearcare Joint Venture Partner, as the business is at a transformational stage in its audiology journey. Rapid population growth, increasing demand for hearing care and significant investment in facilities have created the ideal conditions to establish Didcot as a thriving audiology hub in its own right. With a newly equipped audiology room (fitted in June 2026), six optical consulting rooms, a bright, modern store following a major refit three years ago, and a dedicated team of 32 colleagues, including 2 trainee HCAs and an apprentice audiologist fully funded by the business, the foundations for growth are already in place. We are looking for a partner who shares our ambition and vision to lead the next phase of expansion and build an audiology service to match our successful optical services. Why Choose Specsavers? As an Audiology Partner, you'll enjoy the freedom to run your own business while benefiting from dedicated support. You'll have ongoing assistance from our expert support office teams and existing Optics and Retail partners, ensuring you have everything you need to succeed. We’re looking for a passionate, ambitious, and hard-working Audiologist or Hearing Aid Dispenser, ready to continue to lead and grow the existing Audiology business. You are the heartbeat of your growing business, you will serve your community, and you will create a lasting asset for your family. Essentially, you can look after your customers and take care of your teams, while we look after you. As a partner, you will: Build and develop your own team. Be the driver for clinical and retail excellence. Look after your customers and serve your community. Make critical, everyday decisions. As a partner, you will get: Security of a guaranteed competitive salary. Increased income from business profit as dividends. Access to cutting-edge clinical technology and outstanding opportunities for professional development to reach your ambitions. Generous benefits including medical, dental, pension, and more. As a partner, you will have: HCPC registration as an Audiologist or Hearing Aid Dispenser. Right to work in the UK Passion about maintaining high-quality clinical and retail standards. Ability to blend leadership, business acumen, and clinical skills effectively. About Joint Venture Partnership We’re a family-run business, with a small-company feel but totally-global stature. Each of our businesses follows our Joint Venture Partnership model. Partners are ‘A’ shareholders in charge of the day-to-day running of the business. This means you’ll receive the profits and enjoy the capital growth, as well as a market salary and other benefits from our joint venture business entity, to give you that extra bit of security. Find Out More If you’re ready to take the next step in your audiology career and make a lasting difference in your community, we want to hear from you. or contact us at partnerattraction@specsavers.com to discover why you would be a perfect fit for this incredible opportunity. Stay connected Salary: Key information Location Didcot Area of interest: Audiology Partner Contract type: Permanent Apply by 24th November

items.desc: SPECIMEN RECEPTION MEDICAL LABORATORY ASSISTANT - AfC BAND 2 - 17.5 hours per week Applications are invited from a dynamic, motivated, reliable and enthusiastic person to join the Specimen Reception Team at the Royal Surrey Foundation Trust in Guildford as a Medical Laboratory Assistant (MLA). An MLA is the first point of contact therefore good communication skills, a friendly and approachable personality and the ability to demonstrate excellent customer relations are therefore essential. You should have good attention to detail, manual dexterity, excellent IT skills, the ability to work well under pressure and a good secondary education in English, Math's and Science. This role is not a training role, therefore no previous lab experience is necessary and full training will be provided. Duties include receipt, checking and sorting of specimens, labelling and preparation for analysis, inputting patient and test data into the laboratory computer system, handling telephone enquiries, distribution of pathology consumables, as well as general office duties such as photocopying and filing. The specimen reception service operates 8am to 7pm Monday to Friday and 9am to 4.30pm Saturday, Sunday and Bank Holidays. The Pathology service at the Royal Surrey is part of Berkshire & Surrey Pathology Services, a joint venture between Ashford and St Peter’s NHS Foundation Trust, Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust, Royal Berkshire NHS Foundation Trust, East Surrey Hospital and Royal Surrey County Hospital NHS Foundation Trust providing a wide range of analytical, diagnostic, interpretive and consultative services to hospitals, clinics and GPs. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. We are a friendly and dynamic team, made up of psychology, psychiatry, family therapy, DBT/CBT and child psychotherapy. Enhanced clinicians hold a small though complex caseload, supporting families, young people and their networks where there may be significant trauma, complex risk and social adversity. There will be opportunities to join our fortnightly family therapy clinic should the post holder wish to develop their systemic practice. We have much innovative practice in the service such as Open Dialogue, parent groups, reflective practice and QI projects and we would welcome participation and/or development of other clinical initiatives. Working as part of the Early Years SEND Team, you will support the delivery, embedding and continuous improvement of the Experts at Hand offer across the borough. You will provide specialist advice, coaching, modelling and practical support to early years providers, helping them strengthen inclusive practice, identify children’s needs at the earliest opportunity and implement effective support strategies. Working closely with settings, families and multi-agency partners, you will help ensure that children with SEND aged birth to five can access high-quality, inclusive provision within their local community and achieve the best possible outcomes. About Enfield Council Enfield is one of London’s most diverse and vibrant boroughs, serving a growing community with high aspirations for all children and families. We are committed to creating an inclusive borough where every child has the opportunity to thrive, regardless of their needs or circumstances. Through our SEND Reform Programme and Experts at Hand model, we are investing in early intervention, collaboration and workforce development to improve outcomes for children and young people with SEND. Joining Enfield Council means becoming part of a forward-thinking organisation that values innovation, partnership working and continuous improvement, while placing children and families at the heart of everything we do. You will have substantial knowledge of inclusive practice, early identification processes and assess-plan-do-review approaches, together with the ability to advise, coach and empower practitioners to build confidence and capability. We are looking for someone who has experience of working at a senior level within early years provision, schools or specialist support services and who can develop positive relationships across a wide range of settings and partner agencies. You will possess excellent communication and influencing skills, be confident contributing to multi-agency discussions, and demonstrate resilience, professionalism and a solution-focused approach when working with families and professionals. A strong understanding of SEND legislation, safeguarding responsibilities and inclusive practice is essential, alongside a commitment to improving outcomes for children and their families. What We Offer This is an exciting opportunity to influence and shape inclusive practice across a diverse and expanding early years sector while contributing to a high-profile programme of SEND improvement. As part of a supportive and collaborative team, you will have opportunities to develop your expertise through ongoing professional learning, specialist training and participation in borough-wide SEND and inclusion initiatives. You will work alongside experienced professionals across education, health and care services, contributing to innovative approaches that make a real difference to children and families. In addition to Enfield Council’s comprehensive employee benefits package, we offer flexible and hybrid working arrangements where service needs allow, access to professional development opportunities, regular supervision and support, and the opportunity to be part of a borough-wide commitment to achieving excellent outcomes for children with SEND through early intervention and inclusive practice. items.desc: Job summary Lincolnshire Primary Care Network Alliance (PCNA) is seeking motivated Project Officers to support transformation programmes across primary care and the wider health and care system. Working with the Project Manager, you will coordinate projects including the Obesity Pathway Innovation Programme (OPIP), Neighbourhood Clinical Leadership Programme and Left Shift programme. You will support project delivery by maintaining plans, tracking milestones, coordinating meetings, preparing papers and minutes, managing action logs and risk registers, and helping collect and report project information. You will work with PCNs, GP practices, clinical leads, the ICB and wider partners, building relationships and supporting effective communication. We are looking for someone with excellent organisational and communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities. You will be proactive, adaptable and confident using digital systems, with an interest in project delivery and improving health and care services. This is a full-time, 37.5-hour per week position, offered on a fixed-term contract until 31 March 2029 . Please be aware that there are 2 posts available for this role. For more details regarding the role and how to apply, please visit NHS jobs www.jobs.nhs.uk/candidate/jobadvert/A6056-26-0001 Completed application forms and CVs should be submitted to the PCNA team at lisa.burns22@nhs.net by Friday 4th December 2026. Interviews are scheduled to take place on Wednesday 16th December 2026. Applicants should ensure they are available on this date. Main duties of the job The Project Officer will provide project coordination and administrative support across PCNA's portfolio of transformation programmes, working closely with the Project Manager and wider project teams. Key duties will include: Supporting the development, maintenance and monitoring of project plans, timelines and delivery schedules. Tracking project milestones, progress and deadlines, highlighting delays, risks and issues. Coordinating project meetings, workshops and events, including preparing agendas, papers, taking minutes and following up actions. Maintaining accurate project documentation, action logs, risk registers and decision records. Collecting, maintaining and reporting project information to support performance monitoring and programme updates. Liaising with PCNs, GP practices, clinical leads, the ICB and external partners to support effective communication and collaboration. Supporting the implementation of programme activities across OPIP, Left Shift and the Neighbourhood Clinical Leadership Programme. Using digital systems, including monday.com, to maintain project records and monitor delivery. Identifying issues, supporting problem-solving and contributing to continuous improvement. The postholder will need to be organised, proactive and adaptable, with strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities while supporting the successful delivery of projects. About us Lincolnshire Primary Care Network Alliance (PCNA) is a collaborative organisation bringing together all 14 Primary Care Networks (PCNs) and 81 GP practices across Lincolnshire, providing a collective voice for primary care and supporting the development of innovative, integrated and sustainable health and care services. We work closely with GP practices, PCNs, clinical leaders, NHS commissioners, healthcare providers, local authorities and wider voluntary and community sector partners to strengthen collaboration, improve services and respond to the needs of local communities. Our work focuses on supporting service transformation, developing new models of care, improving access to services and promoting more joined-up working across primary, community and secondary care. We are committed to innovation, continuous improvement and making the best use of the skills, expertise and resources available across the health and care system. PCNA is an evolving and ambitious organisation, delivering a growing portfolio of programmes and initiatives, including neighbourhood clinical leadership, service transformation and innovative approaches to delivering care closer to home. Joining PCNA offers an opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking, collaborative organisation where you can contribute to meaningful change and help shape the future of primary care and neighbourhood working across Lincolnshire. Job Description Job Description We're looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored. This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale. You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on: Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data. Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring. Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation. Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains. What will you be working on? You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer. The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective? Your immediate impact will be to: Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data. Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents. Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation. Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts. Qualifications What do you need? Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in any language. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability. Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale. Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple. Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction. Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns. items.desc: Purpose of the role The Harlequins Foundation wish to appoint a Foundation Mentor to assist in the development, planning and delivery of our Try Time programme. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the skills required to organise and deliver the Try Time programme, supporting participants to develop the essential skills and reintegrate the students successfully back into their mainstream setting. The Foundation delivers a diverse educational pathway, offering opportunities from Level 1 through to degree-level study. However, we recognise that qualifications alone do not fully prepare young people for future success. Within our Try Time alternative provision, we focus on developing the wider skills, behaviours, and confidence needed to thrive beyond the classroom. Through targeted, supportive programmes, we enable participants to build resilience, improve engagement, and gain the practical and personal skills required to progress towards sustained education, training, or meaningful employment. As a Foundation Mentor, you will play a vital role in the development and delivery of the Try Time programme. It is essential that you have exceptional knowledge of societal issues that affect the groups that you will be working with and understanding the importance of the impact of the work that you will deliver. The successful candidate will act as a positive role model, creating a safe, engaging, and supportive environment for participants while contributing to the effective delivery of programme activities. Key Responsibilities: Key responsibilities include but are not limited to: Support on the delivery and ongoing development of our Try Time programme, which is delivered in two formats: o Try Time Off-Site Programme: A structured alternative provision programme delivered at The Stoop, providing intensive support focused on engagement, personal development, employability skills, wellbeing, and educational re engagement. This is followed by a reintegration period, during which participants are supported to transition successfully back into their mainstream educational setting. o Try Time In-School Intervention: A targeted early intervention programme, delivered in-school, supporting students who may be at risk of disengagement through mentoring, personal development activities, and tailored interventions designed to improve attendance, behaviour, confidence, and engagement with learning. Build positive and professional relationships with programme participants, acting as a mentor and role model. Act as an ambassador for Harlequins Foundation and promote its values through all interactions. Support young people to develop confidence, resilience, communication skills, emotional regulation, and positive behaviours. Assist in the planning and delivery of classroom-based learning, personal development workshops, employability sessions, and practical activities. Support on becoming a recognised Local Authority approved alternative provision in Hounslow, Richmond and Kingston. Monitor participant attendance, engagement, and progress, recording relevant information accurately and promptly. Contribute to the collection of programme data and evidence for monitoring and evaluation purposes. Work alongside school staff, referral partners, and Foundation colleagues to ensure participants receive appropriate support. Maintain high standards of safeguarding, health and safety, and participant welfare at all times. Ensure all Foundation policies and procedures are followed. items.desc: About Zego At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor. If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. Purpose of the role Complaints are where things get real - the customer is already frustrated or in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences. As a Complaints Handler, you'll own a caseload of customer complaints from acknowledgement through to final response. You'll investigate thoroughly, reach fair outcomes, and explain them clearly, all in line with DISP and Consumer Duty - and you'll take pride in getting it right for the customer first time. You'll report to the Complaints Team Leader and work closely with teams across Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to get to the right answer and fix the root cause. Case Handling Own and resolve a caseload of customer complaints following initial acknowledgement Investigate each complaint thoroughly, analysing all the facts and related documentation Gather the information you need from internal teams and external partners Draft Final Response Letters that are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation Keep customers informed throughout and manage expectations along the way Stay in control of your workload by actively monitoring and updating case management systems Quality & Compliance Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across every case Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases to your Team Leader promptly Support complaints reporting to management, senior leaders, QA assessors, and Compliance Collaboration Work with Claims, Fraud, Customer Support, and Sales to resolve complaints and address root causes Contribute to feedback sessions, process improvement discussions, and complaint trend insight What you will need to be successful Essential Proven experience handling complaints end to end within an FCA-regulated environment, ideally motor insurance. Working knowledge of DISP and Consumer Duty as they apply to complaint handling. Clear, concise written communication, and the emotional intelligence to handle difficult conversations well. An analytical, organised approach - you can balance multiple priorities and deliver within SLAs. You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable. Desirable Experience of ShareDo or equivalent case management systems. The Zego ways of working Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new. Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact. items.desc: As a Tyrone International install & field service engineer you'll be responsible for the installation, servicing, maintenance and repair of our UK and International customers aggregate and sand recovery wash plants, water treatment facilities and related heavy machinery. Highlight continuous improvement opportunities to generate cost savings, improved installation methods and process improvements. Our average fee is $150,000 . We're hiring Delivery Consultants to find the people these firms are competing to hire. You won't be responsible for winning clients. Your focus is finding exceptional candidates for live roles and guiding them through to an offer. No recruitment experience is needed. This could be your first career role, or a move from sales, hospitality, customer service, research or any other target-driven job. What the work involves A trading firm might need a C++ engineer who can make a trading system faster, or a researcher who can find patterns in market data. You'll learn what that person looks like, where to find them and how to get them talking. Most aren't looking, and many work at AI labs, Big Tech or rival trading firms. You'll: Search LinkedIn Recruiter, our database and other sources for top engineers and researchers Approach them by phone, email and LinkedIn, and give them a reason to listen Understand their experience, motivations and what it would take for them to move Put forward strong candidates with a clear case for why they fit Prepare them for interviews, gather feedback and manage offers through to placement Keep accurate records and work closely with the team to fill roles Who this will suit You're competitive, you keep score, and a "no" doesn't ruin your afternoon. You're ambitious and want a career where results decide what you earn. You can read people, ask good questions and keep up with very clever ones. You'll need the curiosity to learn a technical market fast. There's no degree requirement. Training and progression You'll get structured training in recruitment, sourcing and negotiation, with daily coaching from a founder who still recruits. You'll learn the quant finance and trading tech market inside out. There's no fixed ladder. We're early in our growth, so the openings are real: account management, leading the delivery team, opening new regions or building a new role vertical. Progression is based on performance, not time served. What you get £24k-£30k basic, with £50k+ realistic in year one and six figures+ in year two Uncapped commission on fees averaging $150k Incentive trips and bonuses Structured training and daily founder coaching Roles at elite US hedge funds and trading firms from day one Recruitment technology and equipment to support your work. Working at Alpha Tech Group We're a small team in Paulerspury. You'll work directly with the founder, get honest feedback and see the effect of your work. The atmosphere is informal; the expectations are clear. The honest bit You'll spend most of your day on the phone. People don't always reply, some say no, and some change their minds at offer stage. Our market is the US, so you'll work UK hours but need to be willing to work into the evening for calls. How to apply Apply with your CV. Include an example of a time you were behind on a target or hit a setback, and what you did about it. The interview includes a short practical exercise. We'll explain the basics first, so no recruitment knowledge is needed. Let us know if you need any adjustments to the process. Pay: £26,500.00-£32,000.00 per year Benefits: Company events Company pension Free parking Gym membership On-site parking Work Location: In person

items.desc: Contract User Researcher / Service Designer We are recruiting for a User Researcher / Service Designer to join a focused three-person squad alongside a Tech Lead and a Product Analyst, refining, validating, and sizing discovery epics to give executive leadership the confidence to fund and greenlight initiatives into full delivery for one of our clients. AND Digital is a technology company focused on accelerating digital delivery and dedicated to closing the digital skills gap. Since 2014, we have partnered with organisations to build better digital products and stronger digital teams. Our client is transitioning to a focused house-of-brands model underpinned by a commitment to deliver a modern luxury experience across all digital and physical touch points. While high-level customer journeys have been established, the underlying operational processes and technical systems required to deliver a frictionless experience remain fragmented. Problem Definition & Use Cases: Translate discovery findings into structured use cases and problem statements, tying solved customer and dealer pain points directly to the client's modern luxury design principles. Stakeholder Facilitation: Plan and facilitate collaborative workshops with central service design peers, commercial teams, and retail network stakeholders to pressure-test assumptions and validate end-to-end feasibility. Discovery-to-Delivery Partnership: Partner daily with the Product Analyst to develop evidence-backed business cases, and collaborate with the Tech Lead to ensure proposed user experiences match technical and integration realities (e.g., Salesforce platforms, core integration middleware, and local dealer CRMs). Expected Outcomes By the end of this refinement phase, leadership will have a clear, evidence-based view of the customer, operational, and system considerations underpinning each recommended initiative. Skills & Experience Proven track record planning and conducting user research, observational field studies, and qualitative/quantitative insight synthesis. Strong background in service design and UX design within complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise ecosystems. Experience designing multi-layered services where consumer-facing digital touchpoints intersect with B2B or franchise operations (such as automotive retail, dealership networks, or distributed sales models). Proven ability to synthesise complex, ambiguous inputs into clear, scannable service blueprints, user flows, and actionable use cases. Confident workshop facilitator skilled at navigating differing viewpoints across central corporate teams, local markets, and technical teams. Collaborative mindset with experience working in tight-knit discovery pods alongside product analysts and technical architects. Compelling presentation skills, enabling senior enterprise stakeholders to clearly understand trade-offs, visualise opportunities, and make confident delivery decisions.  AI en software veranderen industriële automatisering in hoog tempo. Nieuwe technologie biedt volop mogelijkheden, maar de echte uitdaging is bepalen waar die technologie waarde toevoegt voor de klant. Precies daar kom jij in beeld. 
 Als Technical Consultant AI & Automation krijg je binnen Siemens Nederland een nieuw en groeiend technologiedomein om commercieel verder te ontwikkelen. Je werkt met onderwerpen als Industrial AI Suite, Engineering Agent, SIMATIC AX en Industrial Edge. Denk aan een modernere, softwaregedreven manier van automation engineering, AI-ondersteuning voor engineers en oplossingen die de wereld van lokale systemen en de cloud dichter bij elkaar brengen.
 Veel van deze onderwerpen zijn nog relatief nieuw voor klanten én salescollega’s. Dat maakt deze rol interessant: je stapt niet in een verkoopgebied waar alles al is uitgedacht. Je bouwt expertise op in nieuwe technologie en helpt die te vertalen naar relevante toepassingen en commerciële kansen bij industriële klanten. Daarvoor hoef je geen programmeur of diep technisch specialist te zijn. Juist de combinatie van technologie, commercie en klantcontact staat centraal.
 Wat ga je doen? 
 Je gaat samen met Account Managers én zelfstandig in gesprek met klanten en ontdekt waar AI, software en moderne automation commerciële kansen bieden.
 Je ontwikkelt klantvragen en eerste interesse tot concrete opportunities met een heldere waardepropositie.
 Je helpt Account Managers nieuwe AI- en softwareonderwerpen bij hun klanten te herkennen en effectief te positioneren.
 Je brengt zakelijke en technische klantvragen samen en koppelt deze aan passende oplossingen uit het portfolio.
 Je presenteert nieuwe technologie helder en overtuigend aan zowel management als technische gesprekspartners.
 Je ondersteunt het salesproces met inhoudelijke en commerciële argumentatie, onder meer bij onderhandelingen en deal closure.
 Je volgt ontwikkelingen bij klanten, in de markt en bij concurrenten en vertaalt relevante inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.
 Je brengt feedback uit de markt terug naar de betrokken portfolioteams.
Jouw achtergrond 
 Je krijgt energie van nieuwe technologie en bent nieuwsgierig naar wat ermee mogelijk is. Natuurlijk betekent dat dat jij al goed weet en uitprobeert wat AI nu kan betekenen én wat er nog allemaal aankomt. 
 Je neemt initiatief, probeert dingen uit en leert snel van wat je ontdekt. Tegelijkertijd ben je toegankelijk en praktisch ingesteld, pak je graag eigenaarschap en wacht je niet af tot een kans vanzelf ontstaat. Daarvoor stap je gemakkelijk op mensen af, stel je goede vragen en vind je het leuk om samen met verschillende collega’s iets nieuws verder te brengen. Je hoeft niet alles vooraf te weten: je vindt het juist leuk om je snel in nieuwe onderwerpen te verdiepen en je expertise verder uit te bouwen.
 Wat breng je mee?
 Hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in technologie, IT of bedrijfskunde.
 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in solution sales, portfolio sales, business development of productmanagement binnen een technologiegedreven omgeving.
 Je hebt je actief verdiept in AI, naar de mogelijkheden én grenzen om te begrijpen hoe AI concrete waarde kan creëren. 
 Affiniteit met software en automatisering, aantoonbare ervaring met industriële software is een pré.
 Ervaring met klantgesprekken en het identificeren en ontwikkelen van commerciële opportunities.
 Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk en overtuigend over te brengen aan verschillende typen gesprekspartners.
 Goede professionele beheersing van Nederlands en Engels; een extra taal is een pré.
 Je bent meer dan je cv en hoeft dus niet ieder vakje af te vinken. Heb je een commerciële of productbasis, krijg je energie van klantcontact en wil je eigenaarschap pakken in een speelveld waarin AI, software en industriële automatisering samenkomen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.
 Ons aanbod 
 Een veelzijdige rol binnen Siemens waarin je werkt aan innovatieve technologie en volop ruimte krijgt voor eigen initiatief, verantwoordelijkheid en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
 Een fulltime of parttime dienstverband van minimaal 32 uur per week.
 Een flexibel keuzebudget (Benefits Budget) van 13,85% en een elektrische leaseauto.
 Flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en een moderne digitale werkomgeving. Vanwege het klantgerichte karakter van deze functie verwachten we dat je minimaal drie dagen per week op kantoor of bij de klant aanwezig bent.

 Szoftverarchitektúra és műszaki megoldások tervezésében való részvétel.
 Követelmények elemzése és lebontása implementálható megoldásokra.
 Deklaratív felhasználói felületek tervezése és fejlesztése Qt-ban (QML).
 Technikai egyeztetések a nemzetközi fejlesztőcsapattal.
 Kódreview és minőségbiztosítási tevékenységek.

 Hibaanalízis és problémamegoldás komplex rendszerekben.

 Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel informatikai, villamosmérnöki vagy hasonló műszaki területen.
 Van legalább 2 év C++ fejlesztésben szerzett tapasztalatod.
 Magabiztos, kommunikációképes angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel szóban és írásban.
 Jártas vagy deklaratív felhasználói felületek fejlesztésében (pl. QML vagy más deklaratív UI-technológia).
 Van tapasztalatod Linux célplatformra való fejlesztésben.
 Munkád során használtál már szkriptnyelvet (pl. Python, Ruby vagy JavaScript).

 Érdeklődsz a vasúti rendszerek és szabványok iránt.

items.desc: Job Description At PA Consulting, we are expanding our AI team in Utrecht. We are currently looking for AI Engineers who are motivated by hands-on work with AI solutions and who want to ensure that AI creates real value for organisations across a variety of industries. We are looking both for AI Engineers with a few years of experience who are ready to take the next step in their careers, and for more experienced AI specialists who want to apply and further develop their technical capabilities in business-critical client projects. We are seeking colleagues with a practical, implementation-focused approach to AI and a passion for turning ideas and experiments into demonstrations and production-ready solutions for our clients. You thrive in ambiguous environments where innovation is encouraged, bringing a builder mindset and strong software engineering foundations to translate client requirements into practical technical solutions. In this role, you will have the opportunity to: Implement AI solutions in real-world settings Advise clients on how AI tools can be technically matured and scaled Help bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions You will become part of an ambitious and curious team where learning, enthusiasm for technology and a strong sense of community are highly valued. AI is a strategic growth area for PA, and there will be significant interest in your expertise, both in client engagements and across the wider organisation. We expect you to actively share your knowledge and be able to communicate complex technical topics in a clear and accessible way, including to colleagues and clients without a technical background. At PA, we work across the entire AI lifecycle, from ideation and experimentation to fully implemented solutions, with a strong focus on quality, responsible AI and scalability. Projects vary, but they all share one common principle: AI is not a goal in itself, but a means of solving real business challenges for our clients. Your work will include: Designing, developing and testing AI and Generative AI solutions to address specific business needs Experimenting with and applying modern AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG architectures and agent-based solutions Integrating AI models with data, APIs and existing technology landscapes, designing cloud-native solutions on major cloud service providers (such as Azure, GCP) Contributing to AI architecture, quality assurance, evaluation and the responsible use of AI Sharing knowledge and learning collaboratively within PA’s active AI community Developing production-grade software using modern engineering practices and agile delivery methodologies Designing and building robust data pipelines and data engineering architectures to support AI/LLM applications. You will join a supportive and highly skilled environment where you are not expected to know everything from day one, but where you will be given the opportunity to develop quickly through real projects, coaching and hands-on learning. Qualifications We are recruiting at several levels, so we encourage you to apply whether you have a few years of experience after graduation or many years of professional experience. We are particularly interested in candidates who have: Professional experience working with AI, Generative AI, machine learning or data science Hands-on experience developing and experimenting with AI solutions, for example using LLMs, RAG or agent-based approaches Experience programming in Python or another relevant language A good understanding of how AI models can be integrated with data, APIs and existing technology environments Familiarity with cloud-based AI technologies, for example Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform The ability to understand business challenges and translate them into practical AI solutions The ability to collaborate across disciplines and communicate technical concepts in an understandable way A relevant degree in areas such as Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field Fluent in both English and Dutch* Please note that, to be considered for this role, you must be fluent in Dutch and based in the Netherlands. What We Offer A steep learning curve combined with a supportive, feedback-driven culture The opportunity to work hands-on with both emerging and established AI technologies Close collaboration with talented colleagues across the Netherlands and globally The chance to further develop your skills with a lot of freedom, both in breadth and depth Additional Information If this sounds like the right challenge for you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact: Marie Witterseh Rasmussen (Talent Acquisition) at: Marie.WittersehRasmussen@paconsulting.com Please submit your CV and application (in English) through our career site. items.card: Vos missions Comprendre les besoins et participer à l'élaboration de solutions fonctionnelles (nouvelles fonctionnalités ou faire évoluer les existantes) Rédiger les documents de spécifications détaillées Concevoir et documenter les choix techniques Planifier votre travail Développer de nouveaux composants logiciels sur la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE (modèle de données, algorithmes) avec le niveau de qualité requis
items.desc: Dassault Systèmes, « The 3DEXPERIENCE Company », offre aux entreprises et aux particuliers les univers virtuels nécessaires à la conception d’innovations durables, capables d’harmoniser le produit, la nature et la vie. Chez Dassault Systèmes, nous encourageons les personnes à changer et à façonner le monde dans lequel nous vivons. Afin d’accompagner notre constante croissance et nos 250 000 clients dans le monde, nous recherchons un profil inspirant et passionné qui intégrera l’équipe R&D responsable des comportements de cycle de vie en tant que AI Engineer. L’équipe fourni des composants d’infrastructures pour supporter les implémentations applicatives des agents IA. L’objectif est de communaliser, standardiser les besoins communs. Cette équipe travaille en collaboration avec plusieurs autres équipes de développement en France et à l’étranger. Poste à pourvoir en CDI, basé à Vélizy-Villacoublay (78). Dans ce contexte vous devrez comprendre les enjeux et besoins provenant de secteurs industriels diverses (automobile, aéronautique…), afin d’y apporter une solution fonctionnelle adaptée. Cette solution devra être implémentée de façon robuste et performante en s’appuyant sur la logique et l’infrastructure 3DEXPERIENCE. Vos missions Comprendre les besoins et participer à l'élaboration de solutions fonctionnelles (nouvelles fonctionnalités ou faire évoluer les existantes) Rédiger les documents de spécifications détaillées Concevoir et documenter les choix techniques Planifier votre travail Développer de nouveaux composants logiciels sur la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE (modèle de données, algorithmes) avec le niveau de qualité requis (robustesse, performance) Développer des tests automatiques Collaborer quotidiennement avec votre écosystème Dassault Systèmes en France et à l’étranger (fournisseurs technologiques, applications, équipes d’industrialisation et de support client) Vos Qualifications De formation ingénieur, vous maîtrisez l’approche objet du développement, et les langages Java et python. Une première expérience en Machine Learning Une expérience de développement sur des logiciels Dassault-Systèmes (CATIA, ENOVIA...) et de la V6 ou de la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE est un atout supplémentaire. Première expérience du développement d'applications utilisant de grands modèles de langage et connaissance des frameworks tels que LangChain et LangGraph Expérience pratique des API REST Maîtrise de l’anglais écrit et parlé Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.title: CS27 BAC+5 - Stage - Data Scientist (H/F)
items.card: Vos Missions L'objectif principal du stage est d'intégrer et de modéliser les données d’incidentologie dans une base de données orientée graphe. Plus précisément : Data exploration: Analyse des données d’incidentologie existantes (fault logs, reports, maintenance records) pour identifier les entités clés, les relations et la sémantique. Schema refinement: Définition d’un schéma en graphe avec des contraintes
items.desc: Contexte Et Environnement De Travail A la direction de la Qualité, au sein de l’Incidentologie, vous rejoindrez une équipe dédiée à l'amélioration continue de la gestion des incidents, visant l’excellence opérationnelle et la satisfaction de nos clients. Véritable carrefour entre la Qualité, l’ingénierie, les usines, le service après-vente et les enquêtes de satisfaction, notre équipe traite, consolide et met en valeur des données issues de multiples sources pour orienter les actions d’amélioration continue et enrichir l’expérience utilisateur. Dans l’univers dynamique du multimédia et des services connectés, l’intégration continue de nouvelles technologies embarquées et externes façonne un écosystème en constante évolution, où innovation, proactivité et réactivité sont essentielles. Le stage fait partie d'un projet de recherche en cours chez Renault qui explore comment le raisonnement symbolique et le machine learning peuvent être combinés pour créer des outils de diagnostic de nouvelle génération. L'objectif global est d'exploiter la “structured domain knowledge” et les "data-driven models” pour une détection plus rapide et plus précise des anomalies. Le projet utilise des données automobiles réelles (rapports d'incidents, onboard sensor logs, documentation technique) pour construire une représentation unifiée des données d’incidentologie à utiliser pour les requêtes analytiques et les tâches de raisonnement. Vos Missions L'objectif principal du stage est d'intégrer et de modéliser les données d’incidentologie dans une base de données orientée graphe. Plus précisément : Data exploration: Analyse des données d’incidentologie existantes (fault logs, reports, maintenance records) pour identifier les entités clés, les relations et la sémantique. Schema refinement: Définition d’un schéma en graphe avec des contraintes d'intégrité reprenant la structure et la sémantique des données d’incidentologie (ontologies, règles d’experts, bases de connaissances métiers). Data cleaning: Pré-traitement des données brutes pour garantir leur qualité. ETL pipeline: Conception d’un workflow scalable pour l'importation de données. Use cases: Démonstration de l'utilité de la base de connaissances en graphe grâce à des requêtes révélant des relations significatives entre les incidents dans le but de les classifier, les prioriser et d’appuyer des algorithmes de machine learning. Qui êtes-vous ? Étudiant(e) en informatique, data science, ingénierie ou domaine connexe. Connaissances en intelligence artificielle et en machine learning ainsi que des notions de bases de données orientées graphe. Esprit analytique et capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes. Vous êtes curieux(se), inventif(ve) et doté(e) d’un excellent sens relationnel pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés (ingénierie, après-vente ou autres partenaires internes). Autonome et rigoureux(se), vous disposez d’une forte capacité d’analyse ainsi que d’un excellent niveau d’anglais écrit et oral. Une appétence pour l’univers automobile et les services connectés constitue un atout supplémentaire ! Envie de faire partie de l’aventure ? Postulez dès maintenant et construisez avec nous l’industrie automobile de demain ! 🚗💡

items.title: Stage : Traitement par IA de données multimodales pour l'analyse de causes racines
items.card: Contexte L'équipe Intelligence Artificielle & Data du pôle Ingénierie numérique de la direction Systèmes de Propulsion a pour mission de mener les projets Intelligence Artificielle & Data pour les différents métiers en conception, analyse, qualité et simulation numérique sur les composants de chaîne de traction, en développant et déployant les méthodologies et outils. Ces livrables permettent aux métiers partenaires
items.desc: Contexte L'équipe Intelligence Artificielle & Data du pôle Ingénierie numérique de la direction Systèmes de Propulsion a pour mission de mener les projets Intelligence Artificielle & Data pour les différents métiers en conception, analyse, qualité et simulation numérique sur les composants de chaîne de traction, en développant et déployant les méthodologies et outils. Ces livrables permettent aux métiers partenaires de répondre à leurs problématiques d'aide à la décision et d'amélioration de la productivité pour des enjeux qualité, coût, délai, prestation en se basant sur les données disponibles notamment issues des roulages de véhicules instrumentés, des véhicules connectés des clients, des simulations numériques et des différents systèmes IT. Dans le cadre de la transformation numérique des processus d'analyse qualité, l'équipe développe actuellement une application d'assistance à l'analyse des causes racines (Root Cause Analysis - RCA) basée sur l'Intelligence Artificielle. Cette solution vise à accélérer l'identification des causes racines de problèmes techniques en exploitant les connaissances contenues dans différents documents métier. Objectifs Développer un module d'analyse documentaire multimodale, exploitant des modèles d'IA générative (LLM : Large Language Model) et de vision par ordinateur, pour identifier et extraire de l'information utile à partir de documents techniques multi-formats (PDF, PowerPoint, images, documents bureautiques). Structurer les informations collectées afin de les rendre exploitables par un assistant virtuel d'analyse des causes racines. Activités/attendus Lors De La Mission Analyse des besoins, Étude de l'état de l'art des technologies d'IA générative, d'analyse documentaire, et de vision par ordinateur, Développement des fonctions de traitement (extraction, classification, synthèse, ...) des documents multimodaux, Rédaction des guides utilisateur et développeur. Profil Étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur ou Master avec spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou Traitement des Données. Connaissances en Python, IA générative, LLM (Large Language Model), NLP (Natural Language Process), Computer Vision (Deep Learning). Intérêt pour les problématiques industrielles, qualité et analyse des causes racines. Curiosité, autonomie et capacité à proposer des solutions innovantes. Chez Stellantis nous évaluons les candidats selon leurs qualifications, leurs mérites et les besoins du métier Nous accueillons les candidatures des personnes de tout genre, âge, ethnie, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle, et handicap. La diversité de nos équipes nous permettra de mieux appréhender l'évolution des besoins de nos clients et de notre environnement futur. Durée du contrat 6 mois At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future.

items.desc: STAGE - Data Scientist (H/F/X) Stage de 6 mois à débuter en Janvier 2027* VOUS NOUS CONNAISSEZ DEJA, C'EST SÛR Vous avez déjà consommé nos produits (peut-être) sans le savoir ! Le Groupe Bel est un acteur majeur de l'alimentation à travers des portions de bien manger laitières, fruitières ou végétales, et l'un des leaders mondiaux du secteur des fromages de marque. Son portefeuille de produits différenciés et d'envergure internationale tels que La Vache qui rit®, Kiri®, Babybel®, Boursin®, Pom'Potes® ou GoGo squeeZ®, ainsi qu'une trentaine d'autres marques locales, lui ont permis de réaliser en 2024 un chiffre d'affaires de 3,7 milliards d'euros. Certifié Happy Trainees 2026, on est recommandé par près de 95% de nos alternants et stagiaires. #IWorkForAllForGood Dans le cadre de sa politique sociale, le Groupe Bel est ouvert à toutes les compétences et s’engage à mener une politique handicap volontaire et durable . LOCALISATION Le stage est basé au sein du siège mondial, à Suresnes. MISSIONS Au sein de l'équipe Data & Analytics, sous la direction du Tech Lead Data Science, le stagiaire en Data Science travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Data ainsi que les métiers. Il sera responsable du développement autonome de projets liés à l'analyse des données, tout en contribuant à la rédaction des standards de l'entreprise. Ce stage offre une opportunité unique d'acquérir une expérience pratique dans le domaine de la Data Science au sein d'une entreprise internationale. Responsabilités Collaborer avec le Tech lead Data Science pour comprendre les besoins en matière d'analyse de données. Développer et mettre en œuvre des projets de Data Science de manière autonome : Maîtriser les différentes disciplines d'un projet de data science, incluant les statistiques classiques, la modélisation, l'optimisation et la data visualisation. Recueillir et cadrer les besoins avec les métiers, et échanger avec les parties prenantes durant les différentes étapes de projet. Maîtriser toutes les étapes d'un projet de modélisation : de la compréhension des modèles de machine learning et deep learning à leur mise en œuvre. Participer à la rédaction de standards et de bonnes pratiques en matière d'analyse de données. Contribuer à l'analyse et à la visualisation des données pour soutenir les initiatives de l'entreprise. Effectuer des recherches et des analyses pour résoudre des problèmes spécifiques liés à la Data Science. Être capable de traiter des sujets industriels, par exemple dans les domaines de la R&D (data scraping pour l’équipe Taste & Flavor pour de l’analyse avancée de leurs données) et de la fabrication (récupération et le traitement des données provenant des capteurs et/ou des machines afin d'expliquer et de prédire les arrêts ou les pannes potentielles). PROFIL Être en fin d'études dans le domaine de la Data Science, de l'Informatique, des Mathématiques Appliquées Maîtriser les langages de programmation Python et SQL. Connaître les principes de déploiement des modèles en production. Connaitre les principes d'API et de versionning type Git. Avoir une approche très orientée solution et business. Connaitre les best practices de développement appliqué en data science. Avoir des connaissances sur les principes de cloud sous Google Cloud Platform (GCP). La connaissance du domaine agroalimentaire et de la recherche et développement est un plus. Posséder d'excellentes compétences en communication et être capable de travailler efficacement au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire. Vous maîtrisez l'anglais professionnellement Ce stage offre une opportunité exceptionnelle d'acquérir une expérience pratique dans le domaine de la Data Science au sein d'une entreprise innovante et en pleine croissance. Le stagiaire en Data Science jouera un rôle clé dans le soutien des initiatives de l'entreprise en matière d'analyse de données, tout en contribuant à l'élaboration de standards et de bonnes pratiques. NOS ATOUTS Gratification mensuelle de 1300 à 1500€ brut selon votre niveau d’études 65% de remboursement de titre de transport (Passe Navigo) Politique de télétravail Restaurant d’entreprise Des événements Campus jeunes talents (atelier carrière, afterworks, conférences…) Qu'en est-il de mon développement ? Plus qu’un diplôme, nous recherchons des personnalités en phase avec notre état d'esprit. Vous redoutez le stage photocopie/préparation du café ? Pas chez nous ! Chez Bel, vous prendrez des responsabilités et apprendrez à devenir autonome sur les missions confiées. La bienveillance est notre mot d’ordre ! Nous entretenons des liens de proximité entre tous les managers et les stagiaires. Nous fêtons les succès et l’erreur est acceptée ! Nous prônons le fait que travail et plaisir riment ensemble. L’enthousiasme et l’optimisme sont de rigueur chez nous. Rejoignez-nous vite et postulez dès maintenant !

Il s’agit par exemple des remises de gaz (go-around) ou des attentes en circuit avant l’atterrissage (holdings). Mieux les anticiper aide les compagnies à réduire leur consommation de carburant et leurs émissions de CO₂ . Missions Principales Mener une étude de data science de bout en bout : état de l’art, choix de méthode, modélisation ML, benchmark et implémentation. Recueillir le besoin auprès des équipes internes pour cadrer le cas d’usage et l’approche à retenir. Analyser des données de vol issues de plusieurs sources : enregistreurs de vol, données de planning et ADS-B (positions d’avions diffusées en temps réel). Concevoir, développer et valider des solutions pragmatiques, en combinant data science et physique du vol. Présenter régulièrement vos résultats en interne et documenter votre approche. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses, enthousiastes, ouvertes d’esprit, innovantes et engagées, qui aiment les défis et veulent contribuer au développement de solutions qui révolutionnent le secteur aéronautique grâce à des technologies avancées et une approche rigoureuse. Actuellement en Master avec des composantes en mathématiques appliquées et data science, vous recherchez un stage de 5 à 6 mois à compter de mars 2027. Très bonne maîtrise de Python . Expérience en data science et statistiques appliquées , avec les bibliothèques Python associées. Au moins un projet de machine learning mené de bout en bout (données, modèle, évaluation), en cours ou en stage. Solides connaissances en aéronautique et en opérations aériennes. Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais : vous lirez des articles scientifiques et rédigerez de la documentation en anglais. Vous aimez avancer seul sur un sujet exploratoire, proposer des pistes et les tester avec rigueur. En rejoignant OpenAirlines, vous allez : 🌱 Jouer un rôle dans la création d’une industrie aéronautique plus durable. 🏢Travailler dans le centre-ville de Toulouse , avec des équipes à l’international. 🧠 Développer votre potentiel en participant à des cours en ligne (Udemy) et au FedEx Day : 24 heures d’innovation en équipe, ou encore la promotion interne. 🤟Profiter d’activités uniques de team building. 🍾Célébrez les réussites par des fêtes incroyables et des after-work au bar du coin à la moindre occasion ! 🐻 Avoir une mascotte : Viktor, un ours polaire de 2 mètres de haut qui veille sur nous. Processus de recrutement : Préqualification RH Entretien avec votre tuteur et le Head of Science. Ils vous en diront plus sur OpenAirlines, et apprendront à mieux vous connaître, votre parcours et vos centres d’intérêt. Nous ferons de notre mieux pour vous donner une réponse et un feedback constructif rapidement. Chez OpenAirlines, l’inclusion et la diversité sont nos priorités. Nous recrutons des talents avec leurs différences et leur personnalité.

items.desc: Role: Data Scientist Type: Hybrid Location: Leeds As a Data Scientist, you'll take on a high-impact role, acting as a critical thinker and problem solver within a leading insurance business. You'll apply your technical expertise and innovative thinking to tackle complex challenges, identify opportunities and influence data driven decision making across the business. You'll work across a variety of business functions, managing multiple priorities and delivering everything from ad hoc analysis through to predictive and prescriptive models. Your work will contribute directly to developing the organisation's data culture and enabling evidence-based decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment. A key part of the role will be communicating the commercial value of your analytical solutions, ensuring that insights translate into meaningful business outcomes. You'll join an established, award winning data team with a strong track record of innovation, including delivering pioneering AI driven solutions within the insurance market. The team is committed to exploring new technologies and applying data science to solve real-world business challenges. Key Responsibilities Apply industry standards, emerging methodologies and empirical research to develop meaningful business insights and support strategic decision-making. Deliver end to end data science solutions, from understanding complex business challenges and designing analytical approaches through to development and implementation. Work with a variety of datasets, including large and small internal and third-party data sources. Apply machine learning and Generative AI techniques to identify opportunities, solve business problems and improve decision-making. Collaborate with data scientists and wider technical disciplines, including engineering, product and business teams. Work closely with the wider data and analytics community, sharing knowledge and contributing to the delivery of business value through analytics. Technical Skills & Experience Strong understanding of statistical analysis, machine learning and wider data science techniques. Experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, modelling and problem-solving. Working knowledge of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, AI-assisted development tools and agentic AI workflows. A solid grounding in statistical concepts and their practical application. An interest in emerging data science, machine learning and AI technologies, with a willingness to continually develop technical knowledge. Experience working within small, cross-functional teams to deliver analytical and data science projects. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and analytical findings to both technical and non technical stakeholders. An appreciation of software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, code reviews and reproducible development workflows Exposure to cloud platforms, ideally Google Cloud Platform (GCP), would be beneficial. Previous experience within insurance or financial services would be advantageous, but is not essential. Equal Opportunity Statement SPG Resourcing is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace which values and benefits from the diversity of the workforce we hire. We offer reasonable accommodation at every stage of the application and interview process.

You'll join an established, award winning data team with a strong track record of innovation, including delivering pioneering AI driven solutions within the insurance market. The team is committed to exploring new technologies and applying data science to solve real-world business challenges. Key Responsibilities Apply industry standards, emerging methodologies and empirical research to develop meaningful business insights and support strategic decision-making. Deliver end to end data science solutions, from understanding complex business challenges and designing analytical approaches through to development and implementation. Work with a variety of datasets, including large and small internal and third-party data sources. Apply machine learning and Generative AI techniques to identify opportunities, solve business problems and improve decision-making. Collaborate with data scientists and wider technical disciplines, including engineering, product and business teams. Work closely with the wider data and analytics community, sharing knowledge and contributing to the delivery of business value through analytics. Technical Skills & Experience Strong understanding of statistical analysis, machine learning and wider data science techniques. Experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, modelling and problem-solving. Working knowledge of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, AI-assisted development tools and agentic AI workflows. A solid grounding in statistical concepts and their practical application. An interest in emerging data science, machine learning and AI technologies, with a willingness to continually develop technical knowledge. Experience working within small, cross-functional teams to deliver analytical and data science projects. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and analytical findings to both technical and non technical stakeholders. An appreciation of software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, code reviews and reproducible development workflows Exposure to cloud platforms, ideally Google Cloud Platform (GCP), would be beneficial. Previous experience within insurance or financial services would be advantageous, but is not essential. Equal Opportunity Statement SPG Resourcing is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace which values and benefits from the diversity of the workforce we hire. We offer reasonable accommodation at every stage of the application and interview process.

items.desc: VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS Envie de rejoindre une équipe dynamique qui valorise l’innovation et la créativité, et de relever de nouveaux défis ? Dans le cadre de sa campagne de stages, AXA recrute un stagiaire en actuariat – pricing Auto (F/H). Au sein du service de tarification Auto, vous contribuerez à un projet stratégique de refonte du tarif appliqué à la souscription de nouveaux contrats Auto. Les principaux objectifs de ce stage sont les suivants : S’approprier et mettre à jour le tarif Auto existant (variables tarifaires et étapes de calcul). Contribuer à la refonte du tarif Auto en intégrant des approches innovantes pour mieux refléter la réalité du risque. Évaluer l’impact du nouveau tarif sur la rentabilité du produit. Analyser la cohérence et la robustesse du tarif. Participer à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de la refonte tarifaire. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes étudiant en Master 2 d’actuariat ou de data science et souhaitez effectuer un stage de 6 mois au sein d’AXA à partir de février 2027. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en statistiques et en assurance. Vous maîtrisez la programmation en Python et/ou en PySpark et avez une bonne connaissance des modèles de machine Learning. Les compétences recherchées sont les suivantes : Rigueur et sens de l’analyse. Proactivité, curiosité et autonomie. Capacité à vérifier la pertinence des résultats. Connaissances en tarification IARD et en data science (machine Learning). Maîtrise courante de Python et d’Excel Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description, rejoignez-nous ! POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux. Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier par exemple : D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ; D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ; D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ; De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ; Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue ! VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !) La diversité et l'inclusion au cœur de notre recrutement : tous nos postes sont ouverts à toute personne compétente. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous ! Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking". Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : depuis 2020, nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ?
