items.desc:
You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures.
 You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries.
 You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities.
 Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across McKinsey’s QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact.
 Based in the London or Munich office, you will be part of QuantumBlack Labs and the Robotics and Physical AI team, a group of engineers, scientists, product managers, and machine learning specialists building a first of its kind physics AI capability that accelerates and scales how the world designs and builds physical systems.
 Advanced graduate degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in computational mechanics, materials science, mechanical/aerospace/nuclear engineering, computational physics, or a closely related engineering or physical science field required; significant industry or national laboratory experience in applied simulation or scientific machine learning may apply
 2+ years of relevant professional experience building and deploying data solutions
 Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data engineering and experience writing robust, production-grade code, including deploying code across environments
 Proven experience building end-to-end data pipelines and platforms for Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence, covering data preparation, embeddings generation, vector search, and system integration using modern frameworks (Spark, dbt, LangChain)
 A strong foundation in system design, data storage, and reliability with commonly used data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PSQL, etc.) and data engineering tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark, dbt, etc.)
 Hands-on experience with MLOps/LLMOps principles, including CI/CD for data workflows, automated agent evaluation (LangSmith, Opik, Langfuse), and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
 Experience building systems with different data formats (structured vs unstructured) and data processing methods (streaming vs batch) and deploying across major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.
 Commercial client-facing or senior stakeholder management experience is beneficial.
 Experience using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) is a plus.
 Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., manufacturing facilities, etc.) 
 Business level language fluency skills, both verbal and written, in English and German (for Munich), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

items.title: Medical Operations - Netherlands
items.card: About the Role We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team , you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide. This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives,
items.desc:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
 About the Role
 We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team , you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide.
 This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe.
 What You Will Do
 Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts.
 Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers.
 Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration.
 Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events.
 Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support.
 Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem.
 Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant.
 Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling.
 What You Bring
 Clinical experience in healthcare (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice).
 Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments.
 A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.
 Strong communication skills - equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians.
 Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.
 Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment.
 Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments.
 Fluency in Dutch and English
 Bonus Points
 Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).
 Background in healthtech or SaaS.
 Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations.
 Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.
 Location
 We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Leiden with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed.
 How to Apply
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
 Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
 First interview with our NL Country Director
 Follow up interview with of our NL Medical Operations team lead
 Working Day - Join us in the Leiden office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
 Culture at Tandem
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

items.desc: Job description Vill du arbeta med stora och komplexa datamängder och omvandla dem till insikter som gör verklig skillnad? Vi söker en nyfiken och tekniskt driven Data Engineer som vill bygga skalbara datalösningar, identifiera mönster i data och skapa rätt förutsättningar för avancerad analys, maskininlärning och AI. Du kommer att arbeta nära andra data scientists, utvecklare, systemingenjörer och verksamhetsexperter för att omvandla data från olika system och källor till strukturerad, tillgänglig och användbar information. En del av våra uppdragsgivare kräver svenskt medborgarskap och fullständiga kunskaper i svenska, så det är ett krav. Som Data Engineer får du ett tekniskt helhetsansvar för att samla in, bearbeta, strukturera och tillgängliggöra stora datamängder. Du arbetar med både strukturerad och ostrukturerad data och utvecklar lösningar som ska fungera stabilt i produktionsmiljö. Olika arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat att vara: Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara datapipelines. Bearbeta stora mängder strukturerad och ostrukturerad data. Utveckla ETL- och ELT-flöden från flera interna och externa datakällor. Identifiera mönster, avvikelser, trender och samband i komplexa dataset. Skapa datamodeller och data products för analys-, AI- och verksamhetsbehov. Arbeta med batchbearbetning och strömmande data i nära realtid. Säkerställa datakvalitet, spårbarhet, tillgänglighet och informationssäkerhet. Optimera dataflöden med fokus på prestanda, skalbarhet och kostnad. Samarbeta med data scientists kring machine learning, prediktiv analys och AI-lösningar. Bidra till arkitektur, tekniska vägval och moderna arbetssätt inom DataOps och MLOps. Bygga en effektivare verktygskedja med hjälp av AI, samt säkerställa högre SW kvalitet Basic qualifications Vi söker dig som har Relevant högskole-, civilingenjörsexamen eller Lic/PhD inom datateknik, IT, matematik, teknisk fysik eller mekatronik. Några års erfarenhet av data engineering, backendutveckling eller utveckling av dataplattformar. Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL. Erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och Databricks. Erfarenhet av Apache Spark eller PySpark för distribuerad bearbetning av stora datamängder. God förståelse för ETL/ELT, datapipelines, datamodellering samt data lakes och data warehouses. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora, komplexa och heterogena dataset. Förmåga att analysera data och identifiera mönster, avvikelser och förbättringsmöjligheter. Erfarenhet av Git, CI/CD och automatiserade leveransflöden. God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska. Preferred additional skills, personal traits and experience Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande: Machine learning, deep learning eller generativ AI. Azure Machine Learning eller MLflow. LLM-applikationer, RAG-lösningar eller AI-agenter. LangChain, LlamaIndex eller motsvarande AI-ramverk. Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Kafka eller Informatica. Kubernetes, Docker och Infrastructure as Code. MLOps, modellövervakning och driftsättning av ML-modeller. Realtidsdata, IoT-data, telematik eller industriella dataströmmar. Grafana, Power BI eller andra verktyg för visualisering och analys. Data mesh, data products och distribuerade dataarkitekturer. Arbete med data i fordonsindustrin, tillverkningsindustrin, försvarsindustrin eller andra tekniskt komplexa miljöer. Du är analytisk, strukturerad och nyfiken på vad som döljer sig i stora datamängder. Du nöjer dig inte med att flytta data från en plats till en annan, utan vill förstå informationen, upptäcka mönster och skapa lösningar som ger mätbar verksamhetsnytta. Du trivs i komplexa tekniska miljöer, tar ansvar från idé och arkitektur till implementering och drift och har förmåga att förklara tekniska samband för både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter. We offer Är du redo att omvandla stora datamängder till värdefulla insikter och framtidens intelligenta lösningar? Skicka in din ansökan och berätta hur du har arbetat med datapipelines, avancerad analys och moderna molnbaserade dataplattformar. More information Peter Hedberg, +70 3402246 peter.hedberg@sigmatechnology.com Position Data Engineer med fokus på Big Data, AI och avancerad analys Company Sigma Technology Embedded Solutions Location Göteborg, Sweden Competence area Software development, Digitalisation Publication date 2026-11-10 Expiration date 2027-01-29 Contact Peter Hedberg, peter.hedberg@sigmatechnology.com, +703402246 Apply

items.desc: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be the technical lead for developing NVISO's Cyber Exposure offering. You will define how Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation work together through clear processes and responsibilities, and guide the technical decisions that make the service work for our clients. You will be the expert clients and colleagues turn to for the complete picture: which assets matter, where they are exposed, who needs to act and whether remediation has worked. You will design the processes, integrations and reporting that connect these questions, lead complex customer engagements and help other consultants deliver the service. You will advise on hardening and help clients establish ownership, remediation targets and a process that fits their IT operations. You will also shape what we build next. Starting from our existing Vulnerability Management capabilities, you will develop the technical roadmap towards Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and assess where Attack Surface analysis, exposure validation and Quantum Readiness belong in the offering. This gives you room to propose solutions, build prototypes and test them with clients before turning them into repeatable services. Typical responsibilities include: Defining the technical architecture and delivery approach for the Cyber Exposure offering, connecting Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation, with clear roles and governance; Leading technical delivery on customer engagements, advising on remediation and hardening, resolving design and integration problems and reviewing the quality of our work; Linking vulnerability findings to asset inventories, CMDBs, cloud environments, business services and owners, and resolving gaps in coverage and data quality; Designing remediation processes with owners, priorities, SLAs, escalation, risk acceptance and closure checks, aligned with Change Management and supported by ITSM, Patch Management and other remediation solutions; Building reporting that shows clients their exposure and remediation progress, with clear priorities for technical teams and reliable measures of coverage, ageing, SLA performance and accepted risk for management; Advising on secure configurations and hardening baselines for infrastructure and cloud environments, reducing unnecessary exposure and proposing compensating controls when patching is not immediately possible; Keeping up with developments in Exposure Management and evaluating AI and agentic solutions through targeted pilots to improve existing approaches to prioritization, remediation guidance and reporting. You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions; Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping; Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. You will help decide which capabilities are ready to become services and what we need to deliver them well. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience; Strong practical experience in Vulnerability Management, including scanning platforms, prioritization based on asset criticality and exploitability, and remediation processes, with the ability to guide technical decisions on customer engagements; Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking and cloud environments, with practical experience advising on secure configurations, hardening baselines and compensating controls; Experience connecting security findings with asset inventories, CMDBs or Asset Management platforms, including ownership mapping and improving data quality; Experience designing security dashboards and management reports that make priorities, progress and data limitations clear; Experience designing remediation processes across security and IT teams, including ownership, SLAs, exceptions and Change Management. Familiarity with ITSM and remediation platforms is expected; scripting and API skills are an advantage; Ability to design a solution …

items.desc: IS THIS YOU? Is full ownership of an app the perfect next step in your growth trajectory? Do you feel like AI is giving product managers superhuman powers? Then you know the feeling. You move faster than the organization around you, and you are done waiting for permission. At Myner, you don't need permission to run ahead - you have the agency to fly instead. ABOUT MYNER Stop waiting. Start growing. Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Myner transforms that data into the fuel that powers our Agentic Flywheels for consumer brands — always-on, continuous loops that both create and validate new product concepts, marketing campaign ideas and more. Legacy market research delivers studies and reports; Myner delivers breakout sales growth. Finally, our founder-CEO has already built and exited a unicorn in this industry and his plans for Myner are even more ambitious. Get yourself ready for explosive growth! THE MYNER APP The Myner app (https://mynerapp.com) is where consumers share their data with us, with their full consent, and get rewarded for it. They scan receipts, answer surveys and complete small missions, and every contribution pays off: they can cash out in money, crypto or even physical gold. So yes, they can literally turn their data into gold. The app plays out as a Wild West gold rush game, and it's built to be fun to come back to, not a chore. We're live in the US today on our way to building a global panel. As Product Owner, your customers are the people using the app: you make sure they enjoy it, trust it and feel rewarded for every contribution. You bring product ideas to life, and engineering makes sure they scale. Scope management is a skill: you know when to extend and when to cut. Today we release a meaningful app version every 2–3 weeks, and expect just 1–2 as the engineering team grows. English: near-native is the level we're looking for, where you can express yourself without problems. Self-managed: you plan your own time; make commitments and meet your own deadlines. You will contribute to observation quality evaluation, assimilation methodology development, and seek to enhance our systems with Machine Learning techniques. You will play a key role in advancing ECMWF’s operational forecasting systems and contribute to research projects (JOHN and IM4CA) under the Horizon Europe EU framework. About the Active Sensing Team This role is in the Active Sensing Team of the Earth System Assimilation Section, part of ECMWF’s Research Department. It has responsibility for the exploitation of in-situ (surface-based, aircraft, balloon) measurements and active satellite systems (RADAR and GNSS). In this particular role, the successful candidate will also work closely with colleagues specializing in atmospheric composition, data assimilation, machine learning and operational evaluation. Your responsibilities You will: Work closely with the Observations team in the Forecast & Services Department to establish the real-time observation ingest and data flow for new observation streams, both for meteorological parameters and atmospheric composition, particularly for greenhouse gases in the framework of the JOHN and IM4CA projects Adapt the existing ECMWF systems to make additional use of these new observations in a research context and evaluate the impact on analyses and forecasts Where appropriate, migrate observations from research use to deployment in ECMWF’s operational systems used to produce weather and atmospheric composition predictions What we are looking for We are looking for someone who brings solid scientific expertise with the assimilation of observations in Earth system prediction systems. You understand data assimilation principles and have the technical expertise needed to contribute to advancing our operational forecasting systems. You will bring: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical understanding with practical data assimilation development A rigorous and proactive approach to improving methods and code An ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different areas, supported by clear communication skills Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work when timelines are constrained An ability to efficiently document your work Your profile Education An advanced university degree, or equivalent professional experience, in a relevant field Essential Experience and Knowledge Demonstrated experience with atmospheric data assimilation methodologies, such as variational methods, Kalman Filters, or data driven machine learning approaches A broad understanding of satellite and in-situ observations of the atmosphere Experience working with and maintaining large collaborative scientific codes, as well as agentic coding tools Desirable Experience and Knowledge Experience with NWP and / or atmospheric composition data assimilation Experience coding and conducting experiments in high-performance computing environments Knowledge of tools and processes for software management and software quality Candidates must be able to work effectively in English. A good knowledge of one of the Centre’s other working languages (French or German) is an advantage. If you feel that you have the motivation and many of the skills for this role but don't meet precisely all of the criteria listed above, we still encourage you to apply. About the projects The IM4CA project IM4CA (https://im4ca.eu/) is a large Horizon Europe project with 27 partners focused on improving our understanding of regional and global sources and sinks of atmospheric methane in the past, present, and future. ECMWF’s role is to use the knowledge and datasets on methane sources and sinks that become available during the project to improve the representation of methane in the operational CAMS greenhouse gas services. The JOHN project The JOHN (https://john-project.eu/) project will support the implementation of WMO’s Global Greenhouse Gas Watch (G3W) by assessing and improving the global greenhouse gas observing system, exploring emerging technologies, and developing priorities for future investment and monitoring. One of ECMWF’s roles is to adapt the CAMS data assimilation system to allow for the assimilation of in situ observations of atmospheric composition species. The exploitation of radiocarbon observations in the IFS - with focus on Europe - will also be assessed. Tasks As Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be the technical lead for developing NVISO's Cyber Exposure offering. You will define how Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation work together through clear processes and responsibilities, and guide the technical decisions that make the service work for our clients. You will be the expert clients and colleagues turn to for the complete picture: which assets matter, where they are exposed, who needs to act and whether remediation has worked. This gives you room to propose solutions, build prototypes and test them with clients before turning them into repeatable services. Typical responsibilities include: Defining the technical architecture and delivery approach for the Cyber Exposure offering, connecting Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation, with clear roles and governance; Leading technical delivery on customer engagements, advising on remediation and hardening, resolving design and integration problems and reviewing the quality of our work; Linking vulnerability findings to asset inventories, CMDBs, cloud environments, business services and owners, and resolving gaps in coverage and data quality; Designing remediation processes with owners, priorities, SLAs, escalation, risk acceptance and closure checks, aligned with Change Management and supported by ITSM, Patch Management and other remediation solutions; Building reporting that shows clients their exposure and remediation progress, with clear priorities for technical teams and reliable measures of coverage, ageing, SLA performance and accepted risk for management; Advising on secure configurations and hardening baselines for infrastructure and cloud environments, reducing unnecessary exposure and proposing compensating controls when patching is not immediately possible; Keeping up with developments in Exposure Management and evaluating AI and agentic solutions through targeted pilots to improve existing approaches to prioritization, remediation guidance and reporting. You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions; Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping; Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. You will help decide which capabilities are ready to become services and what we need to deliver them well. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience; Strong practical experience in Vulnerability Management, including scanning platforms, prioritization based on asset criticality and exploitability, and remediation processes, with the ability to guide technical decisions on customer engagements; Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking and cloud environments, with practical experience advising on secure configurations, hardening baselines and compensating controls; Experience connecting security findings with asset inventories, CMDBs or Asset Management platforms, including ownership mapping and improving data quality; Experience designing security dashboards and management reports that make priorities, progress and data limitations clear; Experience designing remediation processes across security and IT teams, including ownership, SLAs, exceptions and Change Management. You’ll work closely with Product and our Data & ML Platform teams to improve the user and agentic experience of our platforms, as well as upskilling and enabling new users of the platforms. This isn't a pure platform engineering role and it isn't a pure data engineering role. We also don’t expect you to know everything on this list just yet, but a desire to learn and develop your skills is needed. Że jeden przeoczony błąd w kalkulacji to nie kolejne zgłoszenie w backlogu, tylko faktura, przelew czy deklaracja, na której ktoś naprawdę polega. I wyobraź sobie, że coraz większą część kodu tej aplikacji współtworzy już Agentic AI, a to Ty mówisz ostatnie słowo, czy wszystko działa tak, jak powinno. Tak właśnie wygląda ta rola. Jako Quality Engineering Expert w naszym zespole staniesz na czele inżynierii jakości nowej generacji: weryfikacji i automatyzacji systemów, w których kod powstaje we współpracy ludzi i agentów AI. Twoim celem będzie dbanie o to, by aplikacje klasy ERP, które budują stabilność polskiej gospodarki, były bezwzględnie stabilne, deterministyczne i zgodne z regułami biznesowymi. Pracujesz w zwinnych zespołach i konwojach, w paradygmacie AI-native: wykorzystujesz agentów do wielokrotnego przyspieszenia procesu QA, a jednocześnie jesteś kluczową instancją weryfikującą to, co wygenerowały modele. Nie będziesz tu odhaczać scenariuszy – będziesz współtworzyć to, jak wygląda Quality Assurance w epoce sztucznej inteligencji. Jeśli ciekawi Cię, gdzie AI naprawdę pomaga, a gdzie potrafi się pomylić, i lubisz to sprawdzać – szukamy właśnie Ciebie. Profil stanowiska Posiadasz min. 5 letnie doświadczenie w testowaniu złożonych aplikacji biznesowych (mile widziane systemy klasy ERP/CRM). Biegłość w budowaniu frameworków testowych E2E i API (np. Playwright, REST-assured) Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi AI w wytwarzaniu oprogramowania (np. Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, frameworki do automatyzacji oparte o LLM) i chęć eksperymentowania z nimi na co dzień. Doświadczenie w testach wydajnościowych i obciążeniowych systemów przetwarzających duże wolumeny danych transakcyjnyc. Wybitnie analityczne i krytyczne myślenie – umiejętność precyzyjnego wychwytywania halucynacji, cichych błędów logicznych i anomalii ukrytych w z pozoru nienagannym kodzie wygenerowanym przez AI. Twoje zadania Weryfikacja determinizmu i logiki biznesowej aplikacji klasy ERP: Skrupulatna walidacja spójności danych biznesowych – testowanie, czy nowa aplikacja generuje w 100% identyczne rezultaty kalkulacyjne i transakcyjne co legacy core. Testy regresyjne i integracyjne w trybie hyper-delivery: Utrzymanie stabilności architektury w warunkach błyskawicznego tempa dostarczania funkcji przez nasze zespoły i konwoje. Audyt UX/UI & Design System: Weryfikacja zgodności interfejsów tworzonych przez modele z przyjętym Design Systemem i standardami dostępności. Automatyzacja AI-Native: Tworzenie zaawansowanych frameworków testowych (E2E, API) z wykorzystaniem agentów AI do generowania kodu testów. Nadzór nad kodem generowanym przez AI: Wyłapywanie edge-cases, nieoptymalnych struktur danych oraz potencjalnych luk logicznych i bezpieczeństwa powstałych w procesie generowania kodu. Dla Ciebie Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych. System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy. Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura). Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace. Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT. Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe. items.desc: Company Description Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change. By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses. From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters. Job Description As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division. WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth. Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership. About the Role We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the reliability of the WTW ResQ insurance reserving product across its desktop application lifecycle. The role covers functional and regression testing, GUI testing, integration testing and support for releases and production fixes. The QA Engineer will act as an independent quality advocate within the engineering team, using evidence, product knowledge and customer perspective to constructively challenge requirements, assumptions and implementation decisions. They will help the team deliver features that provide the strongest quality and customer outcomes, rather than limiting QA to validating completed work. Key Responsibilities Create and maintain test scenarios based on product requirements, customer workflows, identified risks and observed behaviour Perform functional, regression, integration and GUI testing for desktop application changes. Engage early in feature discovery and refinement, helping the team identify risk, ambiguity, edge cases and customer-impacting behaviours before development is completed. Verify application behaviour across relevant configurations and supported versions. Test workflows involving application interfaces, data and integrations. Support testing of packaging, installers, deployment and release candidates. Record defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence. Work closely with engineers to investigate defects, challenge incomplete or insufficient fixes. Provide an evidence-based quality assessment for release readiness, clearly communicating unresolved risks and constructively challenging release decisions where the available evidence does not support an acceptable level of quality. Contribute to post-release validation and learning. Help identify opportunities to improve test coverage and make quality checks repeatable. Maintain test documentation and contribute to knowledge transfer and product documentation. Use approved agentic coding tools to draft test scenarios, derive boundary cases from requirements, suggest regression areas, generate test data ideas and summarize defect patterns; validate suggestions before using them. Collaborate with the team to ensure sustainable run of scrum ceremonies, including when needed, planning, estimation, refinement, reviews and retrospectives; facilitate follow-up and help resolve blockers. Qualifications Experience in software quality assurance for business applications. Practical experience with functional and regression testing. Experience testing desktop applications and GUI workflows. Ability to create clear test cases and defect reports. Understanding of software development and release processes. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and effective collaboration with developers and stakeholders. items.title: Myner App Product & Growth Owner
items.card: THE ROLE Drive the growth and success of the Myner app. You will own the product experience for everyone who uses the app. You decide what gets built and when. WHAT YOU WILL OWN The app is our primary data source: it is foundational to everything we do as a company, and everything we build for clients depends on the quality of our panel. This is NOT a utilitarian app, it's intentionally a game first. Designing flows
items.desc: IS THIS YOU? Is full ownership of an app the perfect next step in your growth trajectory? Do you feel like AI is giving product managers superhuman powers? Then you know the feeling. You move faster than the organization around you, and you are done waiting for permission. At Myner, you don't need permission to run ahead - you have the agency to fly instead. ABOUT MYNER Stop waiting. Start growing. Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Myner transforms that data into the fuel that powers our Agentic Flywheels for consumer brands — always-on, continuous loops that both create and validate new product concepts, marketing campaign ideas and more. Legacy market research delivers studies and reports; Myner delivers breakout sales growth. Finally, our founder-CEO has already built and exited a unicorn in this industry and his plans for Myner are even more ambitious. Get yourself ready for explosive growth! THE MYNER APP The Myner app (https://mynerapp.com) is where consumers share their data with us, with their full consent, and get rewarded for it. They scan receipts, answer surveys and complete small missions, and every contribution pays off: they can cash out in money, crypto or even physical gold. So yes, they can literally turn their data into gold. The app plays out as a Wild West gold rush game, and it's built to be fun to come back to, not a chore. We're live in the US today on our way to building a global panel. As Product Owner, your customers are the people using the app: you make sure they enjoy it, trust it and feel rewarded for every contribution. THE ROLE Drive the growth and success of the Myner app. You will own the product experience for everyone who uses the app. You decide what gets built and when. WHAT YOU WILL OWN The app is our primary data source: it is foundational to everything we do as a company, and everything we build for clients depends on the quality of our panel. This is NOT a utilitarian app, it's intentionally a game first. Designing flows and experiences that make data collection feel like play is at the heart of owning this product. Product drives engineering: you decide what gets built and when, so roadmap creation and prioritization is where you make the biggest difference. You build, too: this is an AI-first company, so you build your own tools, experiments and AI harnesses (with help where needed). You don't just move tickets and wait for developers. You bring product ideas to life, and engineering makes sure they scale. Scope management is a skill: you know when to extend and when to cut. Cutting corners is fine, but they can bite back as we scale, so you need a strong sense of which ones to cut. Measure everything: we see immediately how people react to new features and iterate fast. Today we release a meaningful app version every 2–3 weeks, and expect just 1–2 as the engineering team grows. Support is part of the product: you own and manage customer support for our panelists, with the access and tooling to serve them well. The app store rating is one of your core KPIs, and it's shared across teams. Growth is yours: you are responsible for managing our agency partner to drive new user acquisition, along with all internal efforts to manage and improve user retention. WHAT YOU BRING Builder: you have built products people use, and you have something to show us. Cross-functional mindset: you work across teams naturally and never build walls around your own area. Good judgment and taste: you make sound decisions, care how things look and feel, and are highly regarded for this special talent. AI-first: you use AI every day in your work, from research to specs to prototypes. Data-driven: you trust what the numbers show, and a single bad review doesn't throw you off course. Gamification: you have worked on gamified products, not necessarily mobile, but more than leaderboards and streaks. Prioritization: you know what matters now, say no easily, and are comfortable cutting corners when it's the right call. Communicator: you explain things clearly, inside the team and to everyone else. English: near-native is the level we're looking for, where you can express yourself without problems. Self-managed: you plan your own time; make commitments and meet your own deadlines. Team lead: you have led teams of engineers and designers before. NOT A FIT Department walls: you prefer owning your own area over working cross-functionally. Here, the app, the data, engineering, user support and client needs all connect. Feature factory: you'd rather ship features than measure their impact. We decide based on data, not opinions. No eye for UI / UX: you leave the look and feel to designers. In this role, taste and judgment on UI and UX are essential. Pace: you prefer the rhythm of a large enterprise. We are a startup that tries things quickly and iterates a lot. Change: you get frustrated when plans …

Python experience and the ability to translate ambiguous client needs into clear technical architectures and roadmaps. Effective communication skills, adapting to audiences from CISOs to business teams. Our clients span different industries and sizes, from some of the world's biggest brands to fast-growing smaller businesses. We give engineers real technical ownership. You'll be the technical lead on
items.desc: About the role You'll design and deliver the data pipelines and platforms that drive our clients' decision-making, working directly with them to turn business questions into production-ready systems on Google Cloud. Our clients span different industries and sizes, from some of the world's biggest brands to fast-growing smaller businesses. We give engineers real technical ownership. You'll be the technical lead on your own projects and client accounts, trusted to make the calls and own the outcome. You'll also be part of an engineering team that reviews each other's work and pitches in across projects. On your accounts, you'll work day to day with fifty-five's consultants and data scientists. You'll combine strong SQL, Python and cloud engineering with sound technical judgement, using AI tools to build faster and to a higher standard while keeping full ownership of what you deliver. What you'll do Design, build and operate scalable data pipelines, data models and end-to-end solution architectures on GCP (BigQuery, Python, dbt, Airflow, Dataform), balancing reliability, maintainability, performance and cost. Own technical delivery on your projects and accounts, from scoping to production: making the design decisions, managing risks and dependencies, and communicating trade-offs clearly. Own the quality of what we deliver, with rigorous validation, automated testing, observability and data-quality controls built into production pipelines, and lead the diagnosis and fix when production issues come up. Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex to build faster and improve testing, checking their output critically and staying accountable for the result. Share what works with the team as demos, docs and reusable patterns. Work with clients, consulting and data science teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions and turn business needs into pragmatic designs, and explain your reasoning to technical and non-technical people. Raise the team's engineering standards through design and code reviews, strong testing practices and clear documentation. What you'll bring Excellent SQL and strong Python skills. Proven experience designing, building and operating reliable data pipelines, data models and cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome), with transformation and orchestration tooling such as dbt, Airflow or Dataform. Strong software engineering practices: Git-based workflows, code review, automated testing and CI/CD. Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in your day-to-day work, and the judgement to know when to rely on them and when to verify. The ability to break down ambiguous problems, see the business challenge behind a task, make well-reasoned decisions, and prototype and pitch ideas for what we could build for clients. Excellent client-facing communication and confidence leading delivery independently: running several client projects at once and re-prioritising as client needs change, solo or within a larger project team. Desirable experience Infrastructure as code (Terraform), cloud IAM, and secure handling of client data. Applied data science (exploratory or statistical analysis), and dashboarding tools such as Looker or Power BI. Marketing platforms and an understanding of marketing data. About the company Part of The Brandtech Group, fifty-five is a data company helping brands collect, analyse and activate their data across paid, earned and owned channels to increase their marketing ROI and improve customer acquisition and retention. Headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Hong Kong, New York and Shanghai, fifty-five is a certified Google Partner company and was named by Deloitte as one of the fastest-growing tech firms in Europe, thanks to its unique technology approach combining talent with software and service expertise. If this sounds like you, please get in touch! We look forward to meeting you. In return, we are pleased to offer you the following benefits: Being part of a multicultural, dynamic and fast-growing team Continuous (and certified) training on the digital ecosystem and technologies (initial training for all new employees, followed by recurring training sessions) Private medical coverage through AXA Transport for London monthly travel card allowance The flexibility to work remotely for part of the week 25 days holiday per year, in addition to UK bank and public holidays Company pension plan Company-sponsored sporting and social activities Monthly Codecademy subscription - reimbursable upon completion of chosen training path fifty-five encourages diversity and is committed to guaranteeing equal treatment of all applications, regardless of gender, age, origin, sexual orientation, state of health or political or religious opinion.

items.desc: About Digital Futures Digital Futures is an AI services and software company that specialises in accelerating AI transformation and enabling AI governance for enterprise and government. The Role Digital Futures is mobilising a forward-deployed team to work alongside Anthropic's Applied AI team, embedding directly with a strategic client to accelerate enterprise adoption of Claude. You will collaborate closely with business and technology teams to ship production AI applications that solve real-world problems, working hands-on with users and delivery teams inside the client's environment and iterating quickly based on their feedback. This is a hands-on build role, not an advisory one. Using Claude Code and the Claude API, you will design, build and evaluate agentic systems that make sense of complex workflows and legacy data, and own the quality of what they produce. Governance is integrated from day one, with every output evidenced and validated by domain specialists, and you will capture repeatable deployment patterns so that capability can be scaled and transferred to client teams. We expect our forward-deployed engineers to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity and maintain high standards of safety and reliability in regulated environments. Key Responsibilities Agent design and build Design and build the five discovery agents (requirements, estate, lineage, data quality and documentation) using Claude Code and the Claude API, delivering artefacts such as MCP servers, sub-agents and agent skills under read-only, governed and logged access. Engineer agents that trace transformation chains through SAS, SQL, Hive, Spark and shell code, infer field semantics from code, naming, constraints and usage, and detect where source, derivation or meaning changed over time. Contribute to joint architecture reviews with the bank's data platform and security teams and Anthropic's Applied AI team, covering agent design and the evaluation plan, and present early test results at architecture checkpoints. Evaluation and quality Build the evaluation harness: ground-truth sets from specialist-validated entries, calibrated confidence scoring, failure analysis and regression testing as corrections accumulate. Ensure every generated entry carries evidence links, provenance, a confidence score and a named reviewer, written to the evidence store and audit log. Use data profiles (null rates, value distributions by period) to test inferences against the data itself, reducing entries that are plausible but wrong. Close the loop with weekly specialist validation sessions, so that corrections feed back into the agents' working context and accuracy improves throughout the engagement. Reuse and capability transfer Package the agents, evaluation harness and playbook as a reusable toolkit that applies to further entities and data stores with minimal change, codifying repeatable deployment patterns with Anthropic's Applied AI team. Pair with the bank's engineers, transferring capability so that future data stores can be addressed by bank teams with Digital Futures support rather than dependence. Experience and Profile Production experience building agentic systems with large language models, with demonstrable depth in Claude Code and the Claude API, including tool use, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), sub-agents and agent skills. Evaluation of LLM output where accuracy is material: harness design, ground-truth construction, confidence calibration and systematic failure analysis. Experience building systems whose output is validated, evidenced knowledge rather than code, with feedback loops that make them more accurate as specialists review them. Delivery experience in enterprise financial services, ideally a Tier 1 bank, including working within security tollgates, change control and third-party access constraints. Fluency reading legacy data code (SAS, SQL, HiveQL, PySpark, shell and scheduler scripts) well enough to reason about derivation logic and its history. Python to production standard and a disciplined Git-based workflow. Experience with data lineage tooling, knowledge graphs or graph databases is desirable. A previous forward-deployed or client-embedded engineering role, with the autonomy to thrive under ambiguity in complex organisations. The ability to explain design choices, limitations and residual risk clearly to model risk, security and senior stakeholders. Benefits We offer a competitive salary. items.desc: 🎾 BreakPointCRM is building the execution layer for AI-native sports clubs. Sports clubs still run on fragmented systems: manual follow-ups, disparate messaging apps, disconnected spreadsheets, and inefficient booking processes. AI has entered the space, but mostly as a disconnected tool sitting outside the real work. That is not enough. The real shift is turning club management into an AI-native engine: where CRM, commercial automation, and multi-channel communications are connected in one controlled layer, allowing clubs to retain players, automate tasks, and drive revenue through agentic AI and advanced analytics. BreakPointCRM is building that layer. Our platform gives clubs a workspace where agents can manage inbound leads, track player engagement, orchestrate communications, and operate seamlessly under human supervision. We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to build the infrastructure behind that. What you’ll build You will work directly with the core team to build agentic and core engineering infrastructure for real commercial workflows. This means: Developing core platform features using Next.js (App Router) and Node. Designing large-scale AI agents leveraging LLMs like Gemini. Building robust agentic systems, vector databases, and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) with custom tools. Designing and integrating external APIs and serverless architectures. Optimizing multi-tenant system performance and scalability for rapid growth across the EU and USA. Collaborating on product UI decisions to implement critical UX friendly flows. This is not a normal full-stack role. Expect uncertainty. The frontend and product surface matter, but the biggest need is infrastructure and execution speed: data models, systems engineering, deployment, and systems thinking. Your job is to accelerate our technical velocity and push the boundaries of AI-driven racket sport marketing automation. What we are looking for You might be a fit if you: Are excellent at TypeScript, Next.js, and modern system architecture. Have built real software on SQL databases, ideally PostgreSQL and AWS RDS. Understand REST APIs, serverless computing, and CI/CD pipelines. Have designed end-to-end AI agents incorporating memory, RAG, and custom tools. Use AI coding tools aggressively in your own workflow (Claude Code, Codex, Herdr, etc.) but do not confuse speed with sloppiness. Possess a creator's mindset with the initiative to deploy and iterate ideas rapidly. Have about a year of professional experience, preferably in a fast-paced startup environment. Care deeply about sports and technological innovation. Are a problem solver who owns their work end-to-end while being autonomous. You do not need to be a professional athlete. You do need to care about understanding complex commercial workflows deeply enough to automate them responsibly. Our stack We currently work with: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Workers, AWS, Drizzle, Docker, and Vercel AI SDK. You do not need to have used every tool. You need to be able to reason from first principles and learn fast. How we work BreakPointCRM is a dynamic, intense company built around leverage. We believe the future of sports club management won't be bloated software suites. It will be powered by people with extreme ownership using breakpoint to do the work of much larger racket clubs. We value autonomy, proactivity, and attention to detail. We offer a flexible, hybrid environment (Based in Madrid, with office space in Barrio de Salamanca) where you will have high-impact participation in technical decisions. Why join You will join at the moment where BreakPointCRM is moving into rapid deployment: real clubs, real workflows, real infrastructure problems, real opportunity. If we are right, every serious racket sport club in the world will need an intelligent CRM layer to drive their business. We are building it. How to Apply Send felix@breakpointcrm.com : Something hard you have built. The most complex system you have owned or designed. A short note on how you currently use AI in your engineering workflow. Anything that shows unusual agency or a strong technical mindset.

items.desc: Position: Data Scientist – AI Engineering (Mid-level) Department: Logistics Tech – Data Science & AI Reporting to: Data Science Manager Location: Amsterdam, Berlin Hybrid role: 3 days a week from our office & 2 days working from home Full/Part time: Full time Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About This Role As a Data Scientist – AI Engineering, you will help build and run the AI agents that support the people who keep our delivery network moving. These are production, user-facing agents that help users resolve issues and take actions in real time, across multiple markets and languages. Your mission is to make these agents measurably better and safe to change. You will build, evaluate, and monitor LLM-powered agents end to end: from designing agent behaviour and tools, to building the evaluation harness that tells us whether a change is an improvement, to the observability that tells us how the agent behaves in production. You will work closely with Product, Backend Engineers, Operations colleagues, and the other Data Scientists on the team. These are some of the key components to the position: Agent Development: Build and improve components of our agent systems — prompts and workflows, tool use, and handover to humans. Translate operational requirements into agent behaviour that is reliable and testable. Agent Evaluation: Build and maintain evaluation suites for agents: datasets built from real conversations and scenarios, LLM-as-a-judge and deterministic metrics, and end-to-end tests of tool-using agents. Run offline experiments to compare models, prompts, and agent designs, and use the results to make clear ship / don't-ship recommendations. Help move us towards automated and well-grounded online evaluation. Observability & Monitoring: Instrument agents with tracing, structured logging, and quality metrics. Build and maintain dashboards and alerts covering quality, latency, cost, and failure modes. Analyse production traces and historical conversations to find regressions and the next best improvement. Production Standards: Ship agent changes safely — well-tested Python, code review, version control. Be mindful of production rules, data privacy and security. Data Analysis: Use SQL and Python to analyse large volumes of conversation and operational data, define and track quality and business metrics, and quantify the impact of agent changes. Actionable Insights: Translate evaluation and monitoring results into clear recommendations for the team and stakeholders, using data visualisation where it helps. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with Backend Engineers, Operations and Product to expand what our agents can do, and contribute to a growing internal community of people building user-facing agents at JET. Process Improvement: Spot opportunities to automate evaluation, testing and release workflows, and make contributions to them. What will you bring to the team? Hands-on experience building and shipping user-facing AI agents in production — LLM-based systems that real users interact with, where reliability, latency, safety and graceful handover to humans matter. Practical experience with agent evaluation: building evaluation datasets, defining metrics, using LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing agents, and running offline and online experiments to compare prompts, models or agent designs. Practical experience with agent observability and monitoring: tracing and debugging multi-step agent runs, defining quality/cost/latency signals, and building dashboards and alerts for LLM systems in production (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or similar tooling). Experience with agent frameworks (e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, or similar), tool use / MCP, and multi-step or multi-agent designs. Strong Python and SQL; good software engineering habits — typing, linting, unit tests, Git, CI/CD, code review. A solid data science foundation: statistics, experiment design, and the ability to reason about whether an observed change is a real improvement. Comfortable working independently on well-defined problems, knowing when to ask for guidance, and communicating results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: experience with feature flags and staged rollouts, containerised deployments (Docker/Kubernetes). At JET, This Is How We Play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. items.desc: Lieu : Sophia Antipolis, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Au coeur de la Silicon Valley de la région PACA, notre site regroupe nos activités développe des sonars de pointe équipant les sous-marins et les bâtiments de surface ainsi que des activités de services numériques. Pionnier dans le domaine des produits de simulation, le site mobilise une expertise approfondie en acoustique et en traitement du signal. Sur le site de Thales DMS Sophia Antipolis , vous serez intégré à la Direction des Offres et vous serez rattaché au Responsable Performance des Offres. Nous recherchons un stagiaire ingénieur pour concevoir un Proof of Concept (POC) visant à capitaliser les données des offres passées afin de fédérer ces informations et les rendre exploitables pour des modèles prédictifs ou des assistants IA. Vous Serez Intégré(e) à La Direction Des Offres Et Collaborerez Avec Les Développeurs De Thales AI Companion Pour Extraire et structurer les données des offres précédentes Automatiser la génération de documents types (ex : registres de risques, matrices de conformité, plannings, etc.) Tester des solutions pour la future mise en œuvre des outils d’analyse prédictive. Vos Principales Missions Seront Les Suivantes Comprendre l’écosystème de Thales et les besoins Cartographier les outils existants : Identifier les sources de données (ex : Appels d’Offres, documents d’analyses des offres, modèles documentaires Chorus, synthèses des devis) et leurs formats. Analyser les limites des outils actuels (ex : silos de données, manque de standardisation). Recueillir les besoins : Échanger avec les Responsables des Offres pour cerner leurs attentes (ex : "Comment réutiliser les Retours d'Expérience ?", "Quels documents prioriser ?"). 2 . Développer un POC de capitalisation Extraire et structurer les données : Automatiser l’extraction des informations clés depuis les documents (ex : registres de risques, déclinaisons du contrat aux package, matrices de conformité, chiffrages). Nettoyer et normaliser les données pour les rendre exploitables (ex : format JSON, base de données vectorielle). Créer des assistants IA : Développer des connecteurs pour Thales AI Companion afin de générer automatiquement des documents types (ex : registres de risques, matrices de conformité). Tester des prompts optimisés pour COPILOT afin d’améliorer la qualité des réponses (ex : "Quels sont les risques récurrents pour ce client ?"). 3 . Préparer l’industrialisation Valider la faisabilité : Tester la compatibilité des solutions avec les workflows de développement IA. Identifier les verrous (ex : confidentialité des données, maintenance des modèles). Documenter et recommander : Rédiger un guide utilisateur et un manuel technique pour les outils développés. Proposer une roadmap pour une généralisation (ex : intégration dans Thales AI Companion, formation des équipes). items.desc: JOB TITLE: MEDIOR AI ENGINEER — LLMOPS & RUN FOR AI AGENTS AND RAG (AZURE / KUBERNETES) LOCATION: BRUSSEL BELGIUM LANGUAGES REQUIRED: DUTCH,FRENCH,ENGLISH CONTRACT DURATION:04/01/2027 - 31/12/2027 WORK MODE: HYBRID MODE(FULL TIME 2- 3 DAYS ONSITE PER WEEK) JOB DESCRIPTION Context Client (Brussels public transport operator) is building several employees- and customer-facing AI services, serving our customers and employees across the organization. These range from retrieval-based assistants to AI agents that call tools and business systems on behalf of users. The AI services are built and run on our STIB AI Platform. The first services go live from December 2026, and more will follow in 2027. Your Roles and Responsibilities We are recruiting a Medior AI Engineer to join the AI Centre of Excellence (Digital Innovating & AI - delivery team) and own the Run phase of our AI services in production. You take over each service from the Senior AI Engineers who built it, and you keep it reliable, measured, secure and cost-efficient over time. You will work alongside STIB’s internal AI Platform Architect, two Senior AI Engineers (Build), the business and content owners of each service, and client's IT operations teams. The AI Platform runs on a hybrid operating model: managed Azure services (Microsoft Foundry with the OpenAI model family for LLM and embeddings, Azure AI Search, Azure API Management, Azure AI Content Safety) combined with self-hosted open-source components on AKS (agent orchestration in Python with Lang Chain, ingestion pipeline), with MLflow on Databricks for evaluation and tracing (Open Telemetry). The Digital Innovation / AI CoE team owns Infrastructure-as-Code for all application-scoped Azure resources, using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. What you will deliver Activities will vary from service to service. Typically, you will: operate the AI services in production: monitor availability, latency and errors, handle incidents and service requests, analyse root causes, then fix or escalate keep answer quality under control: run and maintain evaluation sets (golden sets) with business content owners, track answer quality, non-answer rate and user feedback, and detect and investigate quality regressions operate the ingestion pipelines: incremental refresh, failed documents, index health, and onboarding of new content sources or business domains within existing connectors operate agent integrations: monitor tool and integration calls to business systems, handle failures and timeouts, and review action logs and exceptions for agents that act on users’ behalf manage change safely: model version upgrades and retirements, prompt and configuration changes, dependency and security updates, each validated against the evaluation sets before release follow run cost: token consumption and cost per service, alerting on drift and proposing optimisations maintain the Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps artefacts, and keep the DEV, TST, ACC and PROD environments consistent apply data protection rules: trace retention, erasure and access restrictions, as defined in each service’s data protection impact assessment maintain runbooks and documentation, and report service health to service owners and the AI CoE on a regular basis deliver small enhancements and fixes; structural changes and new features stay with the Build team. SKILLS Azure DevOps Azure Kubernetes Service - AKS Azure OpenAI Service Lang Chain LLM / Large Language Models Python RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Terraform Vector databases Questions Have you personally operated or supported an LLM application (RAG, agent or document processing) in production for at least 6 months? (if answer to Q1 is “Yes”) Please describe the application, its user volume, what you monitored, and your role in incidents and changes. Maximum 200 words. Have you personally investigated a quality issue or incident in an LLM application or AI agent using traces or logs? (if answer to Q2 is “Yes”) Please describe one case: the symptom, how it was detected, the root cause, the fix, and what you changed to prevent it from happening again. Maximum 200 words. Have you run or maintained evaluations of an LLM application, for example re-running test sets after a model or prompt change? (if answer to Q3 is “Yes”) Please describe the metrics, how the test sets were maintained, and how the results influenced release decisions. Maximum 200 words. Have you personally deployed changes to Kubernetes workloads (manifests or Helm charts) and Terraform code through CI/CD pipelines on Azure? (if answer to Q4 is “Yes”) Please give one concrete example. Maximum 150 words. This role requires on-site presence in Brussels 2 to 3 days per week. Are you willing and able to commit to this schedule?

items.desc: Introductie Onderwijs verzorgen en onderzoek uitvoeren verandert snel. Dit betekent grote ambitieuze programma’s, continue vernieuwing, veel en juiste informatievoorziening en het leveren van uitstekende kwaliteit. Generatieve AI biedt nieuwe mogelijkheden voor onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Binnen Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam ontwikkelen we AI-diensten waarmee medewerkers en studenten deze technologie effectief, veilig en verantwoord kunnen inzetten. Binnen de dienst EDIS bouwen we aan een team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwikkelen, beschikbaar stellen en beheren van AI-toepassingen. We zoeken een Application Specialist die gebruikers helpt om o.a. de mogelijkheden van AI optimaal te benutten en zorgt dat onze (AI-)diensten aansluiten op hun behoeften. Functieomschrijving Je komt te werken binnen het domein Generic IT Services van de dienst EDIS van de EUR. Als Application Specialist speel je een cruciale rol bij het ondersteunen van gebruikers bij het effectief en verantwoord inzetten van diensten die gebruikt kunnen worden voor o.a. het werken met generatieve AI. Het grootste gedeelte van jouw werkzaamheden is het helpen van het realiseren van AI-usecases, configureren AI-assistenten en kennisbronnen en je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de geleverde diensten. Je werkt nauw samen met de ontwikkelaars en engineers binnen het team, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de technische ontwikkeling van het platform en de applicaties. Je combineert kennis van AI-technologie met inzicht in gebruikersbehoeften en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe mogelijkheden worden vertaald naar praktische en betrouwbare toepassingen. De belangrijkste werkzaamheden: AI-usecases realiseren: gebruikers begeleiden bij het formuleren van hun behoeften en deze vertalen naar functionele AI-oplossingen. RAG-kennisbronnen beheren: opzetten, configureren en onderhouden van kennisbronnen en datasets, inclusief documentselectie, metadata, actualiteit en toegangsrechten. Kwaliteit bewaken: testen en beoordelen van AI-antwoorden op juistheid, relevantie, betrouwbaarheid en bruikbaarheid en verbeteringen doorvoeren binnen de beschikbare functionaliteit. AI-diensten beheren: verzorgen van functionele configuraties, autorisaties, gebruikersbeheer en het analyseren en oplossen van functionele problemen. Gebruikers ondersteunen: adviseren, begeleiden en trainen van medewerkers en teams bij het effectief en verantwoord inzetten van generatieve AI. Doorontwikkeling stimuleren: gebruikersfeedback verzamelen, verbeterkansen signaleren en functionele wensen afstemmen met de ontwikkelaars en engineers. Gebruik monitoren: analyseren van gebruik, incidenten en gebruikerservaringen en op basis daarvan verbeteringen voorstellen. Veilig en verantwoord gebruik borgen: toepassen van richtlijnen voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging, datakwaliteit en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Kennis vastleggen en delen: documenteren van configuraties, werkwijzen en gebruikersinstructies en bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het team. Functie-eisen Je beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau en hebt affiniteit met generatieve AI en digitale dienstverlening. Je bent analytisch, technisch nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om samen met gebruikers praktische oplossingen te realiseren. Daarnaast breng je mee: Ervaring met het configureren, implementeren of beheren van applicaties of digitale diensten. Kennis van en bij voorkeur praktijkervaring met generatieve AI, LLM's en chatbotplatformen. Ervaring met prompting en het configureren van AI-assistenten of vergelijkbare toepassingen. Kennis van of affiniteit met RAG en het gebruik van kennisbronnen binnen AI-toepassingen. Basiskennis van informatiebeveiliging, privacy en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Het vermogen om gebruikerswensen te vertalen naar functionele oplossingen en verbeteringen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling. Het is een pre als je ervaring hebt met: Azure OpenAI of vergelijkbare generatieve AI-platformen. Het configureren van AI-workflows en custom chatbots. RAG-oplossingen en het beheren van kennisbronnen. Het testen en evalueren van de kwaliteit van LLM-antwoorden. ITIL-processen en Agile/Scrum-werkwijzen. Competenties Analytisch: je doorgrondt gebruikersvragen en vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen. Nieuwsgierig: je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen AI en onderzoekt hoe deze kunnen worden toegepast. Klantgericht: je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en helpt hen verder. Kwaliteitsbewust: je hebt oog voor betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en continuïteit. Samenwerkingsgericht: je werkt effectief samen met gebruikers, ontwikkelaars en andere specialisten. Zelfstandig: je neemt initiatief, stelt prioriteiten en draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werkzaamheden. Pragmatisch: je zoekt naar haalbare oplossingen binnen de mogelijkheden van de beschikbare AI-diensten. Arbeidsvoorwaarden We bieden je een internationaal georiënteerde en afwisselende baan in een enthousiast team, met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden …
