items.desc: About DocHeart DocHeart is building the Operational Control Layer for Logistics. Logistics operations are complex. Work is spread across emails, documents, operational systems and people, while exceptions and changing circumstances are part of everyday reality. DocHeart brings this together in one intelligent operational layer that understands what is happening, organizes the work and helps teams take the right action. We combine AI, workflow automation and human decision-making to help logistics companies run their operations with more control and significantly less manual work. We are building a scalable logistics coordination platform, not a collection of customer-specific automations. We are an early-stage startup with real customers across Europe, and we build the product while we scale. The upside: a lot of ownership, direct contact with customers and product decisions, short feedback loops, and real influence on how our technology and our company develop. It is also genuinely early: priorities shift, specs are often something you shape yourself, and you will sometimes improve on something we built fast last quarter. If you want to build the product and the company at the same time, you will love it here. The role We are looking for a software engineer who turns real customer problems into product that logistics teams depend on every day. This is deliberately a combined role: you do customer implementations and you build the product. Roughly speaking, part of your time goes into getting DocHeart live and working inside a customer's operation, and part goes into turning what you learn there into platform capabilities. The two feed each other, and that is the point, not a compromise. You will work across customer implementations and the DocHeart platform, building backend capabilities, integrations, workflow logic and document-processing functionality. A requirement may start with one customer, but your job is to understand how it should fit into the wider platform and how we avoid solving the same problem again for the next one. We use AI coding agents extensively, and what great engineering looks like with them is still being invented. You will help define it here. With Claude Code and similar tools you will ship far more than a traditional team would, and the technical judgement you add on top is what turns that speed into something customers can rely on. You delegate execution to an agent and keep the judgement, the architecture and the ownership yourself. That combination is the craft, and it is a new one. What you will work on Python backend services and APIs Workflow and dossier logic Document ingestion, extraction and validation Integrations with customer systems Asynchronous processing and failure handling Reusable product capabilities emerging from customer implementations Testing, debugging and production issues Improving existing architecture as the platform scales How we work Own the result You take a problem through to production. You care about the whole arc: edge cases, failure scenarios, testing, maintainability and what happens after deployment. When something breaks, you treat it as a chance to make the system permanently better. Get the most out of AI Coding agents are part of your normal development workflow. You are good at giving them context, breaking down problems, directing their work and reading what comes back. You have an eye for the strong abstraction, the right assumption and the simplest design that holds, and you steer the agent towards it. And you can talk anyone through the result: why the implementation is right, which assumptions it rests on, how it was tested and what you would watch after release. See the whole system You are fluent in APIs, databases, asynchronous systems and application architecture, so you can see where a change lands across the whole platform. You enjoy the moment two customer requirements turn out to be one capability, because that is where a single well-built feature starts paying off for every customer after it. And you have the instinct for which small change deserves a second look before it goes out. Bring a growth mindset The tooling, the product and the craft are all moving fast, and that is the fun part. You look for feedback rather than wait for it, pick up unfamiliar domains and systems quickly, and treat every customer implementation as a chance to get sharper. We will invest in your growth, and we expect you to make the team better as you go. Ship fast, ship proud We love engineers who move quickly and get working software in front of real users. You have a feel for which shortcuts buy real speed, you build things you are happy to put your name on, and you get a kick out of seeing your work used in a live operation the same week. Here, momentum and quality are the same skill. Your background 3–7 years of professional software engineering experience Strong Python and backend development experience Experience building APIs and …

items.desc: Pourquoi a-t-on besoin de vous ? Vous contribuerez au développement, à l’industrialisation et au déploiement à grande échelle de solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle pour les différents métiers et pays du Groupe. Au Sein De L’équipe, Vous Occuperez Le Rôle De Data Scientist (H/F). À Ce Titre, Vous Aurez Les Responsabilités Suivantes Concevoir et développer des solutions d’IA répondant aux besoins métiers, en utilisant des techniques avancées de Machine Learning, NLP, Deep Learning et Generative AI. Participer à la conception fonctionnelle et technique des solutions IA, en collaboration avec les Tech Leads et les différentes équipes IT intervenant dans le projet (CRM, ERP, plateformes IA, etc.). Développer, tester et améliorer les modèles et algorithmes, en portant une attention particulière à leur performance, leur robustesse et leur capacité à être industrialisés. S’appuyer sur les fondations et standards technologiques du Groupe, notamment ceux portés par l’équipe AI Foundations (Group IT), en favorisant la réutilisation des composants et assets existants. Contribuer à la création de composants IA réutilisables et au passage à l’échelle des solutions dans plusieurs pays ou métiers. Participer à l’industrialisation et à la mise en production des solutions en collaboration avec les équipes techniques concernées. Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l’intégration, le déploiement et l’adoption des solutions développées. Contribuer au suivi et à l’amélioration continue des produits IA en production, ainsi qu’à la mise en place de leur support. Selon les produits et votre expérience, vous pouvez être amené(e)€ à avoir le rôle de « Technical Product Owner » pour les produits IA construits. En complément de ces missions, une réelle appétence pour la compréhension des enjeux métiers, la gestion de projet et le travail avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires sera fortement appréciée. Notre équipe ayant vocation à travailler avec des interlocuteurs internes basés en France comme à l’international, la maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est indispensable. Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ? Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs ou d’une formation scientifique de haut niveau (École Polytechnique, Centrale, Mines, ENS ou équivalent). 3 à 5 ans minimum dans des fonctions de Data Scientist, avec une expérience démontrée dans le développement et l’industrialisation de solutions d’IA. Excellente maîtrise du Machine Learning, des statistiques, des probabilités et de la modélisation prédictive et descriptive. Solide maîtrise de Python et SQL, avec une expérience pratique des frameworks modernes de Machine Learning et d’IA (par exemple scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch). Bonne maîtrise des approches Generative AI / LLM, notamment RAG, agents et évaluation des modèles. Expérience d’un environnement Cloud et capacité à travailler avec des data pipelines et des architectures data/AI industrialisées. Bonne maîtrise des pratiques de développement logiciel : Git, CI/CD, tests, versioning et bonnes pratiques de code. Bonne compréhension des architectures IT, APIs, intégration des solutions, sécurité et contraintes d’entreprise. Capacité à développer des visualisations et dashboards permettant de transformer les résultats analytiques en insights exploitables. Excellentes capacités de communication, avec la faculté d’expliquer simplement des sujets complexes aussi bien à des équipes Data/IT qu’à des responsables opérationnels ou des dirigeants. Profil structuré, autonome, pragmatique et capable de travailler efficacement dans des équipes multidisciplinaires. Forte orientation business et impact, avec la capacité à partir d’un besoin métier, identifier l’approche AI adaptée et contribuer à sa transformation en une solution créatrice de valeur. On vous en dit plus sur nous Saint-Gobain est un leader mondial de la construction durable. Présent dans 81 pays avec 162 000 collaborateurs, le Groupe conçoit, produit et distribue des matériaux et services pour les marchés de la construction. Ses solutions, développées dans une dynamique d’innovation permanente, contribuent à la rénovation des bâtiments, à la construction légère et à la décarbonation de la construction et de l’industrie. Saint-Gobain est guidé par sa raison d’être: «Making the world a better home». Dans le cadre de l’ambition portée par la Chief AI Officer Groupe, Saint-Gobain renforce sa capacité à développer, industrialiser et déployer à grande échelle des solutions d’IA. Les AI Factories régionales et le Group IT travaillent de manière complémentaire pour assurer cette capacité de développement, en combinant la proximité avec les besoins des pays et des métiers et la mutualisation à l’échelle du Groupe. Ensemble, ils contribuent à transformer les cas d’usage transformationnels prioritaires en solutions robustes, réutilisables et déployables à grande échelle. items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Quality Engineer Bij Sogeti krijg je de ruimte om je expertise in Quality Engineering verder te ontwikkelen en impact te maken in een wereld waarin AI zich razendsnel ontwikkelt. Want hoe zorg je ervoor dat AI-oplossingen niet alleen slim zijn, maar ook betrouwbaar, veilig en verantwoord? Als AI Quality Engineer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je combineert jouw kennis van Quality Engineering met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen Generative AI en Agentic AI en werkt aan innovatieve projecten waarin kwaliteit, governance en vertrouwen in AI centraal staan. Samen met je collega’s binnen onze Core Quality Engineering community zorg je ervoor dat AI-oplossingen niet alleen technisch goed functioneren, maar ook voldoen aan eisen op het gebied van betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, compliance en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Zo help je organisaties de kansen van AI optimaal te benutten, met oog voor de risico’s. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Als AI Quality Engineer ontwerp en implementeer je AI-ondersteunde test- en kwaliteitsoplossingen. Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert onder andere AI-agents, prompts, promptflows en guardrails. Daarbij pas je Context Engineering toe om AI-oplossingen steeds verder te verbeteren. Je test en valideert AI-oplossingen op betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, robuustheid en mogelijke bias. Ook voer je risicoanalyses uit voor AI en GenAI-toepassingen en beoordeel je AI-gedreven bedrijfsprocessen op kwaliteit, effectiviteit en beheersbaarheid. Daarnaast evalueer je Retrieval Augmented Generation-oplossingen, databronnen en kennisbanken op juistheid, volledigheid en actualiteit. Je automatiseert testprocessen met GenAI-tools en AI-gedreven testdesign, valideert AI-guardrails en toetst oplossingen aan compliance, security en Responsible AI-richtlijnen. Je draagt bij aan de observability van AI-systemen en adviseert klanten over Quality Engineering, AI-governance en de verantwoorde toepassing van AI binnen softwareontwikkeling en bedrijfsprocessen. Zo maak je direct impact: je helpt organisaties niet alleen om de mogelijkheden van AI optimaal te benutten, maar ook om erop te kunnen vertrouwen. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf als AI Quality Engineer Je maakt deel uit van één van de grootste Quality Engineering & Testing-divisies van Nederland, met meer dan 500 professionals. Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op Een vast contract voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week, met een beloningsbudget tot € 5.900 bruto per maand, inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsvergoeding; Je kiest de manier van reizen die het beste bij je past, zoals een elektrische leaseauto, een kilometervergoeding, een NS-Business Card of een combinatie daarvan; We stimuleren een actieve levensstijl en bieden daarom een fietsleaseplan via Lease a Bike; 26 vakantiedagen met optie tot bijkopen, een onkostenvergoeding en een jaarlijkse bonus vanaf C-Grade; Met onze Benefits at Work krijg je kortingen bij webshops zoals bol.com, HEMA en Wehkamp, én voordeel op activiteiten, elektronica en meer; Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan; Ruimte om bij te dragen aan een duurzamere toekomst via een duurzaamheidsbudget en flexregelingen; Aandacht voor (mentale) gezondheid, met initiatieven zoals OpenUp, ouderschapstrainingen, vitaliteitswebinars en een korting op je sportabonnement; Toegang tot inspirerende events zoals Women@Sogeti en SoPlay, waar tech en verbinding samenkomen. items.title: Software Engineer, Agentic Systems Engineering - ThousandEyes
items.card: You will have the opportunity to experiment with emerging technologies, learn from real-world usage, and turn promising ideas into reliable tools used by engineering teams across the organization. Your Impact As a Software Engineer You Will Design, build, test, and operate AI-powered tools and services for software developers. Develop agentic workflows, reusable skills, tool integrations, and orchestration
items.desc: Please note that we operate a hybrid working model and this role will require you to work from our offices in Oeiras at least 2 days a week. Meet the Team Cisco ThousandEyes is a Digital Experience Assurance platform that empowers organizations to deliver flawless digital experiences across every network—even those they don’t own. Powered by AI and an unmatched set of cloud, internet, and enterprise network telemetry, ThousandEyes enables IT teams to proactively detect, diagnose, and remediate issues before they affect end-user experiences. ThousandEyes is deeply integrated across the Cisco technology portfolio and beyond, delivering AI-powered assurance insights within Cisco’s Networking, Security, Collaboration, and Observability products. Our team develops internal AI-powered tools that help software engineers work more effectively across the development lifecycle. We build agentic workflows, reusable skills, integrations, and supporting platforms that make it easier for developers to understand complex codebases, implement changes, improve quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks. We are a collaborative, product-minded engineering team working at the intersection of software development, developer experience, and applied AI. You will have the opportunity to experiment with emerging technologies, learn from real-world usage, and turn promising ideas into reliable tools used by engineering teams across the organization. Your Impact As a Software Engineer You Will Design, build, test, and operate AI-powered tools and services for software developers. Develop agentic workflows, reusable skills, tool integrations, and orchestration capabilities. Integrate AI tools with source control, CI/CD systems, issue trackers, documentation platforms, and internal developer environments. Build backend services and APIs that are secure, observable, reliable, and easy to maintain. Apply software engineering practices to manage the non-deterministic nature of AI systems, including evaluation, testing, monitoring, and feedback loops. Work directly with developers to understand their workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and iterate based on real-world feedback. Contribute to technical design discussions and help evolve the architecture of our AI development platform. Improve engineering processes, documentation, and operational practices across the team. Minimum Qualifications Software development experience using Python. Experience designing, building, testing, and operating backend services or developer-facing tools. Hands-on experience designing and implementing APIs within distributed software architectures. Practical experience using or developing with large language models, AI coding tools, or agentic AI systems. Experience working with Git, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery workflows. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional team. Experience developing AI agents, reusable skills, tool-calling integrations, prompts, evaluation frameworks, or agent harnesses. Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, context management, and model evaluation. Experience building internal developer platforms, command-line tools, IDE integrations, or engineering productivity tooling. Knowledge of Kotlin, Java, Go or TypeScript. Understanding of Kubernetes, containers, and modern cloud deployment practices. Experience with observability, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices. Familiarity with relational, document-based, or vector datastores. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Your focus is simple: build great AI solutions that people will actually use. If you're curious, pragmatic and love taking ideas from concept to production, we'd love to hear from you.

items.title: Data Engineer / IA
items.card: Vos missions : Écouter & cadrer : vous aidez les équipes Data et métier de nos clients à clarifier et formaliser leurs besoins (BI, ML, GenAI…) et à les traduire en exigences techniques. Construire & optimiser : vous concevez, développez et optimisez les pipelines de données dans le cloud, avec les outils et frameworks adaptés aux contraintes du client : volumétries, fréquence d'ingestion, streaming, sécurité,
items.desc: Professional French is a mandatory requirement for all members of the Kiiro teams. Chez Kiiro , nous accompagnons nos clients, de la scale-up aux grands comptes, dans la valorisation de leurs données. En tant que Data Engineer , vous construisez les fondations de nos clients : vous cadrez, vous développez, vous industrialisez, vous transmettez. Vous ne serez pas seul.e : rejoignez une équipe Data habituée au travail à distance, et vous vous appuyez sur nos partenariats Databricks et AWS . Vos missions : Écouter & cadrer : vous aidez les équipes Data et métier de nos clients à clarifier et formaliser leurs besoins (BI, ML, GenAI…) et à les traduire en exigences techniques. Construire & optimiser : vous concevez, développez et optimisez les pipelines de données dans le cloud, avec les outils et frameworks adaptés aux contraintes du client : volumétries, fréquence d'ingestion, streaming, sécurité, gouvernance. Migrer & moderniser : vous mettez en place ou aidez à la migration de datalakes / data warehouses / lakehouses vers des plateformes Cloud ou SaaS (Databricks en tête !). Rendre la donnée exploitable par l'IA : vous construisez les fondations dont les cas d'usage GenAI et ML ont besoin : qualité et fraîcheur des données, catalogue et lineage, exposition de corpus pour du RAG, recherche vectorielle, feature stores, pipelines d'inférence temps réel ou batch. Industrialiser : vous faites passer les produits à composante Data Science / GenAI du notebook à la production : tests, monitoring, coûts maîtrisés, traçabilité des données consommées par les modèles, gestion des accès aux corpus sensibles. Fiabiliser : vous collaborez avec les équipes de développement et d'architecture pour garantir l'intégrité, la qualité et la sécurité des données. Rester en veille & évangéliser : l'écosystème bouge très rapidement. Vous partagez ce qui mérite vraiment d'être adopté, en interne comme chez le client 🦸‍♂️ Côté interne : Partenariats : vous soutenez nos partenariats Databricks & AWS. items.desc: About DocHeart DocHeart is building the Operational Control Layer for Logistics. Logistics operations are complex. Work is spread across emails, documents, operational systems and people, while exceptions and changing circumstances are part of everyday reality. DocHeart brings this together in one intelligent operational layer that understands what is happening, organizes the work and helps teams take the right action. We combine AI, workflow automation and human decision-making to help logistics companies run their operations with more control and significantly less manual work. We are building a scalable logistics coordination platform, not a collection of customer-specific automations. We are an early-stage startup with real customers across Europe, and we build the product while we scale. The upside: a lot of ownership, direct contact with customers and product decisions, short feedback loops, and real influence on how our technology and our company develop. It is also genuinely early: priorities shift, specs are often something you shape yourself, and you will sometimes improve on something we built fast last quarter. If you want to build the product and the company at the same time, you will love it here. The role We are looking for a software engineer who turns real customer problems into product that logistics teams depend on every day. This is deliberately a combined role: you do customer implementations and you build the product. Roughly speaking, part of your time goes into getting DocHeart live and working inside a customer's operation, and part goes into turning what you learn there into platform capabilities. The two feed each other, and that is the point, not a compromise. You will work across customer implementations and the DocHeart platform, building backend capabilities, integrations, workflow logic and document-processing functionality. A requirement may start with one customer, but your job is to understand how it should fit into the wider platform and how we avoid solving the same problem again for the next one. We use AI coding agents extensively, and what great engineering looks like with them is still being invented. You will help define it here. With Claude Code and similar tools you will ship far more than a traditional team would, and the technical judgement you add on top is what turns that speed into something customers can rely on. You delegate execution to an agent and keep the judgement, the architecture and the ownership yourself. That combination is the craft, and it is a new one. What you will work on Python backend services and APIs Workflow and dossier logic Document ingestion, extraction and validation Integrations with customer systems Asynchronous processing and failure handling Reusable product capabilities emerging from customer implementations Testing, debugging and production issues Improving existing architecture as the platform scales How we work Own the result You take a problem through to production. You care about the whole arc: edge cases, failure scenarios, testing, maintainability and what happens after deployment. When something breaks, you treat it as a chance to make the system permanently better. Get the most out of AI Coding agents are part of your normal development workflow. You are good at giving them context, breaking down problems, directing their work and reading what comes back. You have an eye for the strong abstraction, the right assumption and the simplest design that holds, and you steer the agent towards it. And you can talk anyone through the result: why the implementation is right, which assumptions it rests on, how it was tested and what you would watch after release. See the whole system You are fluent in APIs, databases, asynchronous systems and application architecture, so you can see where a change lands across the whole platform. You enjoy the moment two customer requirements turn out to be one capability, because that is where a single well-built feature starts paying off for every customer after it. And you have the instinct for which small change deserves a second look before it goes out. Bring a growth mindset The tooling, the product and the craft are all moving fast, and that is the fun part. You look for feedback rather than wait for it, pick up unfamiliar domains and systems quickly, and treat every customer implementation as a chance to get sharper. We will invest in your growth, and we expect you to make the team better as you go. Ship fast, ship proud We love engineers who move quickly and get working software in front of real users. You have a feel for which shortcuts buy real speed, you build things you are happy to put your name on, and you get a kick out of seeing your work used in a live operation the same week. Here, momentum and quality are the same skill.  Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 Deal Pricing is a dedicated global function that provides deal pricing expertise, financial insights, and deal support for negotiated users to Stripe's global Go-to-Market teams. We work to ensure deals create economic value for Stripe by establishing the deal commercial framework for a scaling sales organization, actively supporting large or complex deals, and providing pricing insights and feedback to sales, finance, and product leaders. Deal Pricing frequently works with cross-functional business partners across Operations, Finance and Strategy, and Product and there's constant collaboration with Deal Pricing colleagues across all regions.

 Help refine frameworks and processes to evaluate deals and manage pricing activities.
 Maintain up-to-date pricing benchmarks and contribute to team analytical design and production efforts, using this data to enhance our pricing philosophy.
 Who you are

 Excellent financial modeling, verbal, and written communication skills
 Experience using LLMs and AI agents to conduct research, analyses, and automate work

items.title: AI/ML Internship: Self-Improving AI Agents for Cybersecurity, SEAR
items.card: In this role, you will contribute to this effort: building on existing work towards creating agents and methods that design, evaluate, and improve their own harness. Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture organization is responsible for the security of every Apple product. AI is rapidly changing how cybersecurity work gets done. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most
items.desc:
AI agents have reached the point where they find real vulnerabilities in software. How well they do depends heavily on the harness around the model: its tools, scaffolding, model choice, memory, and orchestration. Hand-tuning these harnesses does not scale, and agents that improve their own harnesses are still largely unexplored especially for security-related tasks. In this role, you will contribute to this effort: building on existing work towards creating agents and methods that design, evaluate, and improve their own harness.
Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture organization is responsible for the security of every Apple product. AI is rapidly changing how cybersecurity work gets done. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most sophisticated operating systems, that means ensuring that we make full use of AI's capabilities while maintaining high-quality standards. This internship focuses on developing methods for automatically improving AI agents for security tasks.
During this internship, you will work with some of the best security researchers in the world to apply AI to real-world security problems and to develop new AI methods. We are looking for students in AI/ML with an interest in agentic AI who want to take on the hard, open problems that cybersecurity offers. No prior experience in cybersecurity is required.
Security tasks are a distinctive setting for agentic self-improvement. (a) Success is highly verifiable but rare. (b) The search space is vast and the horizons are extremely long. (c) They are grounded in real-life codebases that constantly evolve. These properties make security both a demanding test and a rich source of signal for continuously improving agents automatically. While base models provide the basis of an agent's capability, the harness around them has a large effect on many of the required attributes.
The goal of this internship is to experiment with new self-improvement methods on real-world security problems. You will study how to automatically improve harnesses on cost, performance, robustness, and how to feed-in signals from the software development lifecycle into that process. Novel ideas will be required to tackle these challenges. Code and the agent's environment constantly evolve: fixes for past issues may not lead to future ones, and the harness must keep evolving. Because agents are non-deterministic and successes are sparse, telling signal from noise is both critical and hard. Solving these challenges calls for novel techniques that draw on state-of-the-art LLM research, active learning, black-box optimization, software engineering practice, and program analysis.
Currently doing a degree in one of the following fields: machine learning, AI, software engineering, computer science, security, or a related field.
Experience building, experimenting with, and evaluating agentic AI systems (e.g., with LangChain, LangGraph, OpenHands SDK, Pi).
Strong software engineering skills in Python, and experience with agentic coding.
Autonomous drive, a collaborative mindset, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
Experience with building and evaluating agentic software-related tasks (e.g., vulnerability research), agentic self-improvement, or memory.
Knowledge of statistics and black-box optimization methods.

 As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you will report to the Head of the Electric Propulsion Section, under the Propulsion, Aerothermodynamics and Flight Vehicles Engineering Division, Mechanical Department, Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality.
 Your role will encompass technology research and development (R&D) and project support in the field of electric propulsion. The Electric Propulsion Section is responsible for conveying its technical domain contribution to systems engineering, operations engineering and multidisciplinary technological developments.
 In addition, the Section supports technology harmonisation and leads the definition of the technology development roadmaps for future activities.

items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Framatome recherche actuellement des profils : Les équipes de Framatome conçoivent et fournissent des équipements, des services et du combustible pour les centrales nucléaires. Depuis plus de 60 ans, Framatome répond aux enjeux majeurs des opérateurs électriciens du monde entier, grâce à un portefeuille complet de solutions et de services. Nos activités permettent d’améliorer la disponibilité et la compétitivité de leurs installations, tout en renforçant leurs conditions de sûreté. Les métiers de Framatome s’articulent autour de 5 grands pôles : La conception de centrales, La fourniture de la chaudière nucléaire, La conception et la fabrication des composants et des combustibles, L’intégration des systèmes de contrôle-commande, La prise en charge et la maintenance de tous types de réacteurs nucléaires. Nos 23000 salariés participent chaque jour à la fourniture d’un mix-énergétique bas-carbone toujours plus sûr, plus propre et plus économique. \n\n Au sein du service Contrats & Projets France, vous intégrerez l’équipe Quality Events, en charge du traitement des événements qualité et des non-conformités de fabrication affectant les produits combustibles destinés à l’industrie nucléaire. Le traitement de ces événements nécessite de collecter et d’analyser des informations techniques provenant de différents interlocuteurs, d’identifier et formaliser les causes des événements, puis de constituer des dossiers de traitement structurés et argumentés à destination notamment des clients. Dans un contexte de développement de l’utilisation de l’Intelligence Artificielle et des outils numériques au service de la Qualité, l’équipe dispose déjà de premiers outils d’assistance à la rédaction basés sur l’IA. L’objectif du stage sera d’accompagner l’équipe Quality Events dans l’amélioration, la fiabilisation et le déploiement de ces outils afin d’automatiser autant que possible certaines étapes de constitution et de rédaction des dossiers d’analyse des événements qualité, tout en garantissant la pertinence et la qualité des documents produits. À ce titre, en collaboration étroite avec les membres de l’équipe Quality Events, vous serez amené(e) à : vous familiariser avec le processus de traitement des événements qualité et des non-conformités produit ; comprendre la structure, le contenu et les exigences associés aux dossiers d’analyse des événements qualité ; analyser les pratiques actuelles de collecte d’informations, d’analyse et de rédaction des dossiers ; prendre en main, évaluer les outils d’IA déjà existants au sein de l’équipe ; identifier leurs limites et proposer des améliorations permettant d’accroître la pertinence, la fiabilité et la qualité rédactionnelle des contenus générés ; travailler sur l’optimisation des instructions données aux outils d’IA (prompt engineering), notamment pour obtenir des documents techniques structurés, factuels et adaptés aux exigences du domaine nucléaire ; développer ou contribuer au développement de nouveaux outils informatiques d’aide à l’analyse et à la rédaction ; tester les solutions sur des cas représentatifs ou des événements qualité déjà traités et comparer les résultats obtenus avec les dossiers de référence ; proposer des méthodologies permettant de fiabiliser et standardiser l’utilisation des outils par les membres de l’équipe ; contribuer à la génération, la relecture et l’amélioration de documents techniques en français et en anglais ; formaliser les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation et accompagner leur appropriation par l’équipe. Vous préparez une formation de niveau Bac+4 / Bac+5, en école d’ingénieur ou cursus universitaire, avec une orientation qualité, génie industriel, mécanique, matériaux, procédés ou domaine technique équivalent. Une première sensibilisation à la qualité industrielle, à l’analyse des causes ou aux problématiques de non-conformité constitue un atout. Au-delà de votre formation, nous recherchons avant tout un profil ayant : un goût prononcé pour les outils numériques et les technologies d’Intelligence Artificielle ; de très bonnes capacités rédactionnelles, indispensables pour analyser de manière critique les contenus produits par l’IA et obtenir des documents techniques clairs, précis et structurés ; de bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse ; de la curiosité et l’envie d’expérimenter de nouvelles méthodes de travail ; de la rigueur, un esprit critique et une attention particulière à la fiabilité des informations ; une capacité à comprendre des sujets techniques et à les restituer de manière claire ; un bon niveau d’anglais écrit, permettant de travailler sur des dossiers et documents techniques en anglais ; une appétence pour le développement d’outils informatiques, l’automatisation ou la …

items.desc: Short Description SPREAD builds Engineering Intelligence for complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes and industrial manufacturers one connected view of their product data, and Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch and Rheinmetall already run it. We are backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia and Salesforce, won the SPARK AI Innovation Award, and made LinkedIn's Top Startups in DACH list. Role: Getting a first meeting with an engineering director at an OEM is the hardest step in our funnel, and this role owns it. You sit between Business Development and Revenue Operations, report to our Head of Revenue, and work every day with the BDRs and Account Executives. Half your time goes to pipeline, which means finding the right accounts and people and building the plays that reach them; the other half goes to the engine behind those plays, which you build with Claude Code rather than by hand, so the sales team spends its hours in conversations instead of research and data entry. Your work counts when it turns into meetings and pipeline, not when another dashboard ships. The person we picture did BDR or SDR work, liked the tooling and the process more than the cold calls, and now builds agents because they want to. Turn our Account News feed, which scores news, hiring and leadership changes every night, into meetings with the people those signals point to. Build account maps, contact scores and segments for campaigns and events, so every play starts from the right twenty people rather than the right two thousand. Run Clay enrichment triggered from Salesforce, so reps get emails, phone numbers and titles without asking anyone. Build the AI agents the sales team uses every week (meeting prep, account research, post-call Salesforce updates, outreach drafts) and win adoption through short demos, an agent of the week, and fixing whatever made people stop using one. Extend our GTM dashboard, a Next.js app on Vercel that reads Salesforce, with the funnel, BDR activity and account penetration views Business Development needs. Keep the funnel data in Salesforce clean, from leads and contacts to campaigns, activity capture, and attribution, so the numbers in every pipeline review hold up. Run the content engine for sales, from the Brand Hub to the tooling that turns Product Marketing's material into decks, films and one-pagers a rep can send the same day What success looks like in the first 12 months After 3 months, two outbound plays are live end to end with reported conversion, Clay enrichment and the BD funnel view are yours, and you write our first touches yourself. After 6 months, the BDRs run a play library without you, the whole sales team uses one of your agents every week, and qualified pipeline traces back to your plays. After 12 months, you are the person everyone asks "how do we get into this account?", and the top-of-funnel engine runs every week without a push. Your Experience Must-have 2 to 4 years in B2B go-to-market as a BDR, SDR, growth or sales ops hire at a startup or scale-up. Meetings you booked yourself, so you know what a good first call feels like from the rep's side. Automations in Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make that other people relied on Something you shipped with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or a similar AI coding tool, and daily work with Claude or ChatGPT. Salesforce at a working level, meaning reports, fields, list views and basic flows. A habit of running experiments (hypothesis, small test, numbers, next step) and a preference for launching something rough on Tuesday over polishing it for a month. Fluent German and English, since most of our outreach goes to German engineering leaders. Strong plus SQL or SOQL, Python or TypeScript. Salesforce admin experience, or time in Salesloft, Apollo, or HubSpot. Experience selling to automotive, manufacturing, or engineering-software buyers. A side project, newsletter, or LinkedIn presence that shows you can create demand Why SPREAD? You sell AI for engineering to the biggest names in automotive and industry, with a product that customers run in production. Our reps already work with Claude agents, and you build the next ones, so what you ship on Monday is in front of the sales team by Wednesday. You have a direct line to the founders and the sales leaders, and your plays get discussed rather than filed. items.desc: We are looking for an Earth Observation Solutions Engineer to join TERMA's team supporting EUMETSAT's Destination Earth Data Lake (DEDL) service in Darmstadt, Germany. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to one of Europe's most ambitious digital initiatives, working at the intersection of Earth Observation, cloud technologies, data engineering and Artificial Intelligence. About Destination Earth and the Data Lake: Destination Earth (DestinE) is a flagship initiative of the European Union aimed at developing highly accurate digital replicas of our planet. These Digital Twins will help monitor, simulate and predict interactions between natural phenomena and human activities, supporting better-informed decisions on climate change and environmental challenges. As part of this initiative, EUMETSAT is responsible for the Destination Earth Data Lake (DEDL), which provides federated access to data and digital twin services, alongside advanced cloud computing and AI/ML capabilities for users across Europe. The Role: As an Earth Observation Solutions Engineer, you will play a key role in the evolution of the DEDL architecture, data services and AI/ML capabilities. Working closely with EUMETSAT's technical teams and the wider DestinE community, you will help improve data access and interoperability, develop AI/ML-ready data pipelines and enable scalable processing across cloud and High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments. Your main responsibilities will include: Assessing and improving DEDL architecture, data flows, services and integration mechanisms. Supporting data federation, API standardisation, metadata harmonisation and interoperability. Contributing to the integration and validation of AI/ML services, platforms and demonstrators. Developing reproducible, AI/ML-ready data pipelines using Earth Observation and climate datasets. Supporting MLOps workflows, including data orchestration, experiment tracking, model management and deployment. Enabling scalable processing across cloud and HPC environments, including distributed computing and GPU resources. Advising users and data scientists on EO data access and AI/ML workflows. Preparing technical documentation, code examples and service reports, while collaborating with customer technical teams. What You Bring: A university degree (or equivalent) in Remote Sensing, Geoscience, Computer Science, Physics or a related field. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on experience with satellite EO, EUMETSAT, Copernicus or meteorological data. Strong Python programming skills and experience with scientific data-processing libraries such as Xarray, Dask and GDAL. Good knowledge of EO data formats and standards, including NetCDF, GRIB, Zarr, COG, STAC and OGC. Experience with cloud platforms, data lakes, distributed data architectures and data federation. Practical experience in data engineering and preparing datasets for AI/ML applications. Familiarity with MLOps tools such as Airflow, MLflow and Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies. Experience with containerised environments, particularly Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of HPC, distributed processing and scalable computing. Strong communication, technical documentation and stakeholder-management skills. Excellent command of English. Desirable Experience: Experience with Destination Earth (DestinE) and the DEDL service portfolio (HDA, ISLET, STACK and HOOK). Familiarity with AI Factories, Data Labs and Digital Twin environments. Experience with Slurm-based HPC, GPU orchestration and hybrid cloud infrastructures. Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD and end-to-end system integration. Experience with LLM-based applications, AI agents and MCP implementations. Previous involvement in ESA, EUMETSAT, Copernicus or European Commission projects. Working Location: This is a full-time position based at EUMETSAT's premises in Darmstadt, Germany , offering the opportunity to work directly within an international and highly specialised technical environment. What can Terma offer: At Terma, we consider skilled employees, enthusiasm and job satisfaction as the very foundation of our success and as a prerequisite for the development of the “best-in-class” solutions that Terma provides. We lead the way in applying new technology, offering a wide range of growth opportunities for each individual and emphasizing mutual respect across the board in our workplace. Terma offers you a pleasant working environment at the customer site, where you will be able to take on challenging tasks and responsibilities in a highly professional company. items.desc: Benvenuti in Fruttital Srl , azienda leader in Italia nella distribuzione di prodotti ortofrutticoli freschi di qualità eccellente. Siamo parte del Gruppo Orsero e il nostro mondo è vivace , sfidante e ricco di connessioni internazionali . Il Gruppo Orsero opera in tutta l'Europa mediterranea generando un fatturato di 1,7 miliardi di euro. Per il nostro team business solution siamo alla ricerca di un/una AI Solutions Engineer , che contribuirà allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative basate sull'intelligenza artificiale, integrando modelli linguistici, dati aziendali e applicazioni software a supporto dei processi di business. Lavorerai allo sviluppo di soluzioni digitali e applicazioni AI-driven, contribuendo a rendere i dati e le tecnologie sempre più accessibili e utili per il business. In particolare, ti occuperai di : Progettare e sviluppare agenti AI, automazioni e assistenti intelligenti basati su modelli linguistici (LLM, es. Claude), integrandoli con i dati e i sistemi aziendali; Sviluppare e mantenere server MCP (Model Context Protocol), per consentire agli strumenti AI di interagire con il modello semantico e le informazioni aziendali; Collaborare con il team Data alla definizione del modello semantico, contribuendo alla strutturazione di metriche, definizioni e regole di calcolo; Testare e validare le risposte generate dagli strumenti AI, verificandone l'accuratezza e la coerenza rispetto ai dati e ai report ufficiali; Progettare e sviluppare applicazioni web full stack a supporto dei processi aziendali, occupandoti sia del front-end sia del back-end; Implementare servizi e API REST per l'integrazione tra applicazioni e sistemi, utilizzando tecnologie quali Node.js, .NET, Java o Python; Integrare le soluzioni sviluppate con i sistemi aziendali esistenti, tra cui ERP, gestionali HR e piattaforme di terze parti; Seguire l'intero ciclo di vita del software, dalla raccolta dei requisiti alla progettazione, sviluppo, test e rilascio, garantendo qualità del codice, documentazione, sicurezza e performance. Requirements Il/la candidato/a ideale ha maturato 2-3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software , preferibilmente in ambito full stack o back-end, ed è interessato/a ad approfondire le applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale nei processi aziendali. In particolare, sono richieste: Esperienza nello sviluppo software e nella progettazione di applicazioni; Familiarità con l'utilizzo di modelli linguistici tramite API (es. Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), con particolare riferimento a prompt engineering, tool use e valutazione delle risposte; Buona conoscenza di Python o TypeScript e di almeno un framework front-end moderno (React, Angular o Vue); Conoscenza dei database relazionali, in particolare SQL Server e linguaggio T-SQL, e dei principi di progettazione delle API REST; Conoscenza di base dell'ambiente cloud Azure, con particolare riferimento ad Azure Functions e Blob Storage; Familiarità con sistemi di versionamento del codice (Git e TFVC) e strumenti di sviluppo assistito dall'intelligenza artificiale (es. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code). Costituiscono titolo preferenziale: Conoscenza del protocollo MCP (Model Context Protocol); Esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni basate su LLM e nell'integrazione di strumenti AI con sistemi e dati aziendali. Completano il profilo capacità di problem solving, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie, autonomia operativa e predisposizione alla collaborazione e al lavoro in team. Benefits Inserimento in un contesto internazionale e dinamico, all'interno di un Gruppo in continua evoluzione; Opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi legati all'intelligenza artificiale e alla trasformazione digitale; Possibilità di contribuire concretamente allo sviluppo di nuove soluzioni tecnologiche a supporto del business; Orario di lavoro dal lunedì al venerdì; Possibilità di lavorare in modalità smart working. Sede di lavoro: Milano, Verona o Albenga. Range retributivo: 32.000€ - 42.000€ Il range retributivo non rispecchia pienamente le tue aspettative? Non lasciare che questo ti fermi: candidati comunque! Valuteremo con interesse il tuo profilo. Sei pronto/a a entrare nel mondo #FruitAdventurers? Il Gruppo Orsero promuove le pari opportunità e accoglie con favore le candidature di tutte le persone, nel rispetto del D.lgs. 198/2006. Le selezioni sono aperte a candidati e candidate di ogni età, genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, disabilità e convinzione personale.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents or agentic workflows. Experience with Freshworks automation, integrations or endpoint vulnerability management. As an Anaplan EPM Expert / Solution Architect, you will combine your Finance and FP&A knowledge with hands-on Anaplan expertise to translate complex business requirements into scalable planning solutions. You will work directly with Finance leaders, FP&A teams and business stakeholders, taking ownership of solution design and implementation while contributing to the development of our broader EPM capability. EY.AI: In this role, you will work in an environment where AI agents are part of the team and everyday project delivery. You will use solutions tailored to your role and area of expertise to analyse data, generate recommendations and design solutions. This will help you move more efficiently from analysis to action and build a competitive advantage for our clients. Your scope of duties Leading or contributing to end-to-end Anaplan implementations, from requirements gathering and solution architecture through model build, testing, deployment and hypercare. Designing scalable Anaplan solutions covering areas such as: Financial Planning and Analysis; budgeting and forecasting; P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow planning; workforce planning; OPEX and CAPEX planning; revenue and commercial planning; scenario and driver-based planning; management reporting. Translating Finance and business requirements into functional and technical solution designs. Building and optimising Anaplan models, modules, lists, hierarchies, calculations and UX pages. Defining model architecture, data structures and integration requirements. Ensuring that solutions follow Anaplan modelling standards and are scalable, maintainable and performant. Working with CFO organisations and FP&A teams to understand existing planning processes, pain points and improvement opportunities. Challenging existing planning approaches and helping clients move from spreadsheet-driven processes to integrated and driver-based planning. Connecting technology implementation with broader Finance Transformation objectives rather than treating Anaplan solely as a technical implementation. Supporting clients in designing target planning processes, governance models and reporting structures. Identifying opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy, planning efficiency and management decision-making. Owning individual Anaplan workstreams or leading complete implementation projects, depending on your experience and seniority. Facilitating requirements-gathering and solution-design workshops with Finance and business stakeholders. Acting as a trusted advisor to FP&A leaders, Finance Directors and CFO organisations. Coordinating functional consultants, Model Builders, data and integration specialists, and client teams. Leading or supporting user acceptance testing, operational readiness, go-live and hypercare. items.desc: We're looking for a Student Digital Designer with an AI Focus to join our Hive student lab and explore what happens when great design, curious minds and AI come together. Hive is Humblebee's multidisciplinary student lab. It's a place to experiment, challenge assumptions, learn by doing and turn promising ideas into digital services people actually want to use. This time, we're putting AI at the heart of what we build. Not just as a tool to help us work faster, but as part of the service itself. Think intelligent features, AI-powered experiences and agents that can take on meaningful tasks and create real value for users. We're looking for someone who loves exploring ideas, understanding people and making things tangible. Someone who sees design as more than making things look good, and is curious about how AI creates new possibilities for products, services and interactions. Someone who enjoys moving between user insights, creative exploration and hands-on prototyping to shape experiences that feel useful, intuitive and delightful. Sound like your kind of challenge? What is Hive about? Together with a partner company, the Hive team will explore an opportunity space, uncover real user needs and identify where an AI-powered digital service could make a difference. You'll be part of a small student team consisting of Software AI Engineers, Designers with an AI focus and AI tools. Together you'll combine technical exploration, user insights and creative thinking to take an idea from the first question to a tangible, testable service. The goal isn't to add AI just because we can. It's to find the right problems to solve and design the right experiences around them. What will you be doing? At Humblebee, we believe in learning by doing. You'll be involved throughout the process, from exploring early ideas to designing and testing a working digital service. Here's what that might look like: Explore the problem. Work with the team to understand users, their needs and the opportunities worth pursuing. Imagine new possibilities. Explore how AI can create new ways for people to interact with digital services. Think beyond traditional interfaces and challenge what a digital experience could look like when AI becomes part of it. Design AI-powered experiences. Shape how people interact with intelligent features, LLMs and AI agents. Explore how to make AI-powered services feel useful, understandable, trustworthy and intuitive. Prototype with AI. Use AI tools as a natural part of your design process. Experiment with AI-assisted prototyping, generate ideas, explore different directions and bring concepts to life faster than ever. Make ideas tangible. Move between sketches, user flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes. Work closely with Software AI Engineers to explore what's technically possible and turn promising ideas into working experiences. Prototype, test and iterate. Get ideas into users' hands early, learn from what happens and keep improving what you design. Create something delightful. We care about the details. The goal isn't just to make something that works, but to create a useful, intuitive and well-crafted digital experience that people enjoy using. You won't be expected to know everything from day one. But we do hope you're curious, willing to experiment and excited to explore what design can become in an AI-driven world. Who are you? You might be a student in interaction design, UX/UI design, service design or product design . What matters most is that you have a good understanding of design principles, an interest in UI design and design systems, a passion for understanding people, and a genuine curiosity about AI. We want someone who's genuinely interested in how AI is changing the way we design digital services and what new possibilities that creates. You enjoy experimenting, making ideas tangible and learning by doing. You're comfortable not having all the answers and see prototyping as a way to think, explore and learn. You won't be doing it alone You'll work right in the heart of the Humblebee office, surrounded by people who design, build and rethink digital services every day. You'll also get a personal mentor from our team of experienced Humblebees, matched to your skills. You'll have room to experiment, make mistakes, ask questions and learn from people who are just as curious about the future of digital products as you are. The practical stuff Period: January 25 - May 28. Location: Our office in Gothenburg. Time commitment: In previous Hive projects, students have dedicated 80% of their time to the project and used the remaining 20% to work on their thesis. If you're looking to connect your studies or thesis to a real-world project, we're open to exploring how that could work. Compensation: Please note that this is an unpaid internship. Humblebee is a multilingual company, so please send your application in English. We're looking forward to meeting you and seeing what we could design …

Done.green builds technology that makes sustainable energy installations easier, including EV chargers and home batteries. Our platform is serving customers from brands such as Tesla, Volvo and Charge Amps in Sweden, and we’re expanding into more countries. At the heart of our operations is our Flutter app, used by both customers and installers to manage installations. Make our Flutter app clearer and easier to use for both customers and installers, while making changes elsewhere in the platform when that’s what solving the problem requires. Improve the factory . Connect product decisions to our business goals and longer-term strategy as we grow across markets. Our aim is to let agents handle more of the repetitive development work, giving us more time to understand problems and design better solutions. As writing code becomes faster, deciding what to build becomes even more important. You’ll also help us improve how we work with the Software Factory, alongside Frederik, who leads its development. Think creatively about user value while considering what makes sense for the business over time. This is a mid-level role but we are also open to junior engineers. Backend: Firebase / Google Cloud, Firestore and TypeScript + Effect + Node.js Cloud Functions. The app is your primary product responsibility, and you’ll use the whole stack to deliver the right solution. What you’ll get Ownership of features and direct contact with the people using them. Close collaboration with the founders, experienced engineers and operations. The chance to help shape both our product and how we build software. Stock options as part of the compensation Apply Tell us briefly why this role appeals to you and show us something you’ve built. What problem were you trying to solve, what did you choose to build, and why? We’d love to hear what you learned from the people using it and, if you used AI agents, how you guided and checked their work.

items.desc: Job Description YOU ARE As a hands-on AI Infrastructure Architect, you are an experienced engineer with several years in infrastructure engineering who now takes on more complex, higher-impact work designing and optimizing the AI and machine learning infrastructure that powers real-world applications. Working alongside senior architects and engineers — and increasingly leading your own workstreams — you apply proven skills in coding, testing, configuring, deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting AI systems and the infrastructure they run on. Day to day, you architect and optimize infrastructure components, write and review code and deployment scripts, design and tune cloud and on-premises compute resources such as GPU clusters and distributed training environments, deploy AI systems and models into production, and build and optimize data pipelines that feed AI and ML workflows. items.desc: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. A bit about us: We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision. We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. Role Overview We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own the security of Orbital's product: the AI agent our customers use, the platform it runs on, and how we build both. Our customers are law firms and real estate businesses. They trust us with confidential transaction documents, and they ask hard questions about how we protect them. Our product is an AI agent that reads those documents, calls tools and runs code on a lawyer's behalf. That brings the usual cloud security work and a newer set of risks: prompt injection, agents acting on untrusted input, and attackers using AI to move faster than before. You'll be our first in-house product security engineer, taking on work we have so far relied on contractors for. You'll build security into the product rather than review it from outside: you'll decide how we rate a vulnerability and how fast we act on it, build the automated systems that find and fix issues before an attacker does, and set the security bar that engineering builds to. You'll work alongside our product engineers, with the authority to require changes across teams on security grounds, independent of any one team's delivery deadlines. An information security lead will own company-wide policy, compliance and customer assurance, and you'll work closely with them. You won't start from zero. Our AWS environment follows the Well-Architected Framework, with GuardDuty, Security Hub, encryption at rest and scoped credentials in place, and we hold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments to our customers. What we need is someone to own it, find the gaps, and raise the standard as the company and the threat landscape grow. You'll get a chance to Build an automated security harness. Put agents to work on our product: continuous red-team and blue-team loops that probe the agent, the platform and our code, find vulnerabilities, and propose or ship the fix. Manual review should be justified when required and automatic harness improvement is expected. Own vulnerability management end to end. Define how we classify severity and the response time each level demands, so a critical CVE gets fixed the same day. Automate patching, dependency and image scanning, and make sure findings reach an owner and get closed. Secure an AI agent in production. Threat-model how our agent handles untrusted documents, emails and web content, and the tools and sandboxes it uses. Design defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and test them. Make security part of how we build. Review designs and changes that touch authentication, tenant isolation, secrets and data handling. Turn recurring findings into automated checks so the protection holds without depending on someone remembering. Respond to security incidents. Lead the technical response when something goes wrong: containment, investigation and the fix. Build the technical side of our breach playbooks with our information security lead, and run the review afterwards. Choose and run our security tooling. Evaluate and roll out a cloud security platform (such as Wiz) and the detection, alerting and logging we need across AWS and Azure. As our only product security specialist, use tooling and AI agents to cover more …

items.desc: Développement et évaluation d’un Virtual Companion scientifique basé sur les LLMs et les systèmes agentiques Les avancées récentes des modèles de langage à grande échelle (LLMs) et des systèmes d’intelligence artificielle agentique ouvrent de nouvelles perspectives pour l’assistance aux activités scientifiques. Au-delà des assistants conversationnels classiques, les agents d’IA sont désormais capables de raisonner sur des problèmes complexes, rechercher et analyser des informations, utiliser des outils logiciels, exploiter différentes sources de données et coordonner plusieurs tâches afin d’atteindre un objectif. Dans ce contexte émerge le concept de Virtual Companion scientifique, un partenaire numérique capable de collaborer avec un chercheur tout au long d’un processus scientifique : exploration de l’état de l’art, analyse de publications et de données, formulation d’hypothèses, préparation d’expériences, utilisation d’outils scientifiques, interprétation des résultats et génération de synthèses ou de recommandations. Un tel système doit cependant aller au-delà de la simple interaction avec un LLM. Il nécessite notamment des mécanismes de raisonnement, de planification, de mémoire, d’accès aux outils et aux données, d’orchestration de tâches et d’interaction humain–IA , tout en assurant la traçabilité et la fiabilité des résultats produits. Objectifs du stage L’objectif principal du stage est d’étudier, concevoir et développer un prototype de Virtual Companion scientifique capable d’assister un utilisateur dans la réalisation de différentes tâches liées à une démarche de recherche scientifique. Le stage visera dans un premier temps à analyser l’état de l’art des agents scientifiques basés sur les LLMs et des nouvelles architectures agentiques. Cette étude permettra d’identifier les principales capacités nécessaires à un Virtual Companion scientifique ainsi que les architectures et technologies permettant de les implémenter. Dans un second temps, vous proposerez et développerez une architecture permettant au Virtual Companion de comprendre un objectif scientifique, décomposer un problème en différentes tâches, rechercher et exploiter des informations, utiliser des outils ou des données et interagir avec le chercheur lorsque son expertise ou sa validation est nécessaire. Enfin, le prototype développé sera évalué sur plusieurs scénarios représentatifs d'activités scientifiques afin d’étudier sa pertinence, sa fiabilité, son autonomie et la qualité de la collaboration entre l’humain et le système. Vos missions État de l’art Étudier les approches récentes autour des LLMs, des agents autonomes, des AI Scientists et des systèmes de type AI Co-Scientist. Analyser les architectures agentiques permettant le raisonnement, la planification, la mémoire et l’utilisation d’outils. Étudier les approches multi-agents et les mécanismes de coordination entre plusieurs agents spécialisés. Identifier les méthodes permettant l’intégration du chercheur dans la boucle de décision ainsi que les mécanismes de traçabilité et d’explicabilité. Conception du Virtual Companion scientifique Identifier les principales fonctions nécessaires à l’accompagnement d’une démarche scientifique. Définir une architecture permettant de combiner LLMs, mémoire, outils, données scientifiques et mécanismes d’orchestration. Définir les interactions entre le Virtual Companion, les éventuels agents spécialisés et le chercheur. Mettre en place des mécanismes permettant au système de solliciter la validation ou l’expertise humaine lorsque nécessaire. Développement d’un prototype Implémenter le Virtual Companion scientifique à l’aide de technologies récentes basées sur les LLMs et les systèmes agentiques. Intégrer différentes capacités telles que la recherche documentaire, l’analyse d’informations, la génération d’hypothèses, l’utilisation d’outils ou l’analyse de résultats. Développer des mécanismes de mémoire et de gestion du contexte permettant au système de suivre une activité scientifique sur plusieurs étapes. Permettre au Virtual Companion d’orchestrer plusieurs tâches ou agents spécialisés selon le problème traité. Expérimentation et évaluation Définir plusieurs scénarios scientifiques permettant d’évaluer le prototype. Comparer différentes architectures ou stratégies d’orchestration. Évaluer notamment la qualité des résultats, la robustesse, le coût, le temps d’exécution, la traçabilité et le niveau d’intervention humaine nécessaire. Identifier les limites du système et proposer des pistes d’amélioration. Résultats attendus À l’issue du stage, les principaux résultats attendus sont : un état de l’art des Virtual Companions scientifiques et des systèmes agentiques appliqués aux activités de recherche ; une architecture de référence décrivant les différentes capacités du Virtual Companion et leurs interactions ; un prototype fonctionnel démontrant plusieurs capacités d’assistance scientifique ; plusieurs scénarios expérimentaux permettant d’évaluer …

items.desc: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen. Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung. Deine Aufgaben Als Praktikant:in im Tech Venture Development bei Enpal Energy arbeitest du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Geschäft mit smarter Technologie skalieren? Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Virtual Power Plant. Wir vernetzen Haushalte mit ihren Solaranlagen, Speichern und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Kraftwerk und handeln ihren Strom smart am Energiemarkt. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Ops und Tech. Dabei bringst du AI-Lösungen, die unser virtuelles Kraftwerk skalierbar machen, vom Prototyp in den echten Betrieb. Eigene Projekte: Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eigene Projekte, von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsfindung bis zum Go-live. AI Agents & Automatisierung: Du übersetzt Business Needs in konkrete Lösungen. Du baust Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit No-Code-, Low-Code- und AI-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb. Impact messbar machen: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust Dashboards und lieferst damit die Grundlage für Entscheidungen. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, unter anderem Ops und Tech, und treibst Initiativen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran. Dein Profil Du studierst an der Schnittstelle von Business und Tech, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder hast in Studium und Praktika beide Welten kennengelernt. Du hast mindestens ein relevantes Praktikum abgeschlossen, z. B. in einem Start-up, in der Beratung oder im Venture Building. Du arbeitest gern mit Tools wie Claude, Cursor, Airtable, Make, n8n, Power BI, Snowflake oder SQL oder arbeitest dich schnell in neue Technologien ein. Du denkst analytisch und findest pragmatische Lösungen, die auf Fakten beruhen. Du übernimmst Ownership und wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du bist mindestens 4 Monate verfügbar. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 20 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.
