items.desc: Date Posted: 2026-10-20 Country: France Location: FR-OCC-BLAGNAC-BAT CASS ~ 4 Ave Didier Daurat ~ DAURAT Position Role Type: Unspecified Avec 80 000 salariés répartis sur plus de 250 sites dans le monde et un chiffre d’affaires de 26, 2 milliards de dollars, Collins Aerospace se positionne en leader sur le marché des solutions de technologies avancées et intelligentes pour l’industrie mondiale de l’aéronautique et de la défense. Chez Collins nous redéfinissons l’aérospatial ! Présente en France depuis 1959, Collins Aerospace Avionics et Mission Systems en France conçoit, développe et produit des solutions innovantes et de hautes intégrités pour ses clients des secteurs aéronautique et défense. Centre d’excellence du groupe Collins Aerospace dans les domaines de l’avionique (conduite de vol, communication et navigation, sécurité des vols) et des solutions de communications (des très basses fréquences aux communications satellitaires), Collins Aerospace Avionics et Mission Systems en France accompagne ses clients en Europe et dans le monde tout au long du cycle de vie des produits ; depuis les phases de Recherche et Développement (R&D), jusqu’à leur exploitation, en s’appuyant sur l’expertise de ses équipes d’ingénierie, de gestion de programmes, de production, de distribution et de maintenance. Missions : Utilisation de l’Intelligence Artificielle (IA) dans les activités de certification avionique. Dans le domaine de l’aéronautique, le développement de systèmes et équipements avioniques est soumis à des standards (DO-178C pour le logiciel/software, DO-254 pour le matériel/hardware, ARP-4754B pour les systèmes), définis comme moyens de conformité acceptables aux exigences règlementaires internationales. Les processus décrits dans ces standards nécessitent la production, la vérification et la justification de nombreux documents techniques (plans, spécifications, rapports de vérification, etc.). Les activités et les démonstrations de conformité sont rassemblées dans des résumés de conformité (Accomplishment Summaries), documents soumis pour approbation aux autorités de certification compétentes. Il est donc très important d’apporter beaucoup d’attention à la rédaction de ces documents. Cependant, le travail de synthèse est lourd et long, compte tenu de la grande quantité d’informations à récolter, trier, analyser, et valider. L’émergence de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour soutenir ces activités en automatisant certaines tâches de compilation, d’analyse et de vérification documentaire, tout en maintenant les exigences de traçabilité et de rigueur règlementaire. L’objectif du stage est d’étudier et de prototyper des outils d’assistance basés sur l’IA générative augmentée par récupération (RAG) pour faciliter les activités de certification avionique. Parmi les nombreux sujets que l’on peut imaginer, un des axes proposés sera d’étudier la compilation automatique d’un résumé de conformité (Accomplishment Summary) en exploitant des modèles d’IA pour identifier, extraire et synthétiser les informations clés issues de multiples sources documentaires (plans, rapports, matrices de traçabilité, revues, etc.). Le stage s’organisera en différentes phases : Phase 1 : L’analyse des besoins et contraintes de certification avionique. Phase 2 : L’identification des cas d’usage pertinents pour l’IA générative. Phase 3 : Le développement d’un prototype d’outil d’assistance à la rédaction du résumé de conformité, incluant la mise en place de l’environnement ainsi que de la base documentaire associée. Phase 4 : L’évaluation des performances et des limites de l’approche. Phase 5 : La formalisation des résultats sous forme d’un manuel utilisateur détaillé et la présentation des résultats à l’ensemble du service. Durée du stage : 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027 en présentiel sur le site de Blagnac Profil : Master Formation : Ecole d’ingénieur en informatique Compétences clés : Compétences en développement Logiciel, langages de Scripting (Python) et en solutions d’IA en local (TensorFlow, Pytorch, Ollama, ...). Compétences dans la manipulation de Large Language Models (LLM) et en traitement du langage naturel (NLP). Connaissance conseillée du contexte aéronautique, des systèmes embarqués et des processus de certification avionique (DO-178C, DO-254, ARP-4754B). Esprit d’analyse, curiosité technologique, autonomie, capacité à travailler en équipe. items.desc: Vil du udvikle AI-løsninger til millioner af brugere? Så er du måske vores nye kollega. I Jyske Bank arbejder vi bl.a. med at udvikle og integrere AI i vores digitale løsninger på tværs af netbank, mobilbank og vores websites. Vi ser ikke AI som et lag mellem mennesker, men som en teknologi, der kan forbedre relationen og øge kundeværdien. Vi søger en AI-udvikler med solid erfaring, som får en central rolle i udviklingen af vores udviklingsteams. Hver måned anvender flere millioner mennesker Jyske Banks digitale services. Derfor har vi brug for endnu en kollega, der kan være med til at sikre, at vores løsninger ikke bare fungerer – men bliver endnu mere intelligente og skaber værdi for vores kunder. Jobbet – til dagligt I det daglige vil du være en del af et af vores AI-teams, hvor vi arbejder med at udvikle og implementere intelligente løsninger, der understøtter både kunder og rådgivere. Du får en central rolle i design, udvikling og implementering af den generative del af projekterne. Du bidrager både til tekniske beslutninger, eksperimenter, produktionssætning og hjælper med at omsætte forretningsbehov til løsninger, der skaber værdi for kunder og rådgivere. Du kommer blandt andet til at: Designe og implementere AI-løsninger baseret på LLM’er, RAG og AI-agenter. Udvikle og evaluere prompts, guardrails og AI-assisterede beslutningsmodeller. Etablere framework for AI-evaluering, kvalitetssikring og måling af AI-output. Integrere AI-løsninger med eksisterende API'er, datakilder og procesværktøjer. Facilitere discovery af use cases og afklaring af business value vs. teknisk feasibility. Sparre med Full-stack udviklere, UX’ere, arkitekter, forretningsspecialister og vores andre enheder, der arbejder med AI. Området og afdelingen I det daglige vil du være i vores område Digital Salg og Relation i Silkeborg, hvor vi arbejder med digitalt salg, innovation og udvikling i vores kundevendte digitale kanaler – net- og mobilbank og vores websites. Der arbejdes ikke bare med hver kanal, men også alle de services, applikationer og systemer, der binder dem sammen og beriger dem. Afdelingen i området er ”Digital Innovation”, der samarbejder med forskellige udviklings- og strategiske enheder i banken om at forbedre og udvikle vores digitale univers. Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team, hvor AI-specialister, softwareudviklere, UX-designere og forretningsspecialister arbejder tæt sammen. Teamet forener solid teknisk kunnen med en nysgerrig og eksperimenterende tilgang, så idéer hurtigt bliver til konkrete løsninger med tydelig forretningsværdi. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du har: Erfaring med sikkerhed, compliance og governance omkring AI Erfaring med agentiske AI-løsninger Erfaring med dokumentanalyse og kvalitetskontroller Erfaring med cloud-native arkitektur Minimum 5 års erfaring med softwareudvikling Personlige egenskaber: Kan omsætte komplekse teknologier til konkrete forretningsmæssige gevinster Pragmatisk og leveranceorienteret Dygtig facilitator og sparringspartner Trives i tværfaglige teams og arbejder med kompetenceforankring Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI eller tilsvarende enterprise LLM-platforme. RAG-arkitektur Store dataplatforme som Databricks, Google BigQuery eller lignende Agentic AI / Agent-arkitekturer Context Engineering – Caching strategier, memory management og tokenoptimering Privacy og regulering angående sikker håndtering af data i AI-løsninger Du har praktisk erfaring med cloud services og backend udvikling AI-evaluering og teststrategier Ansøgning I Jyske Bank koncernen mener vi, at diversitet skaber bedre beslutninger og relationer samt et mere varieret arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder aktivt for inklusion og lige muligheder og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge. Ansøgningsfristen er den 25 november. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet. HR-partner Line Elkjær Poulsen og leder Nisaani Karunaharan vil tage sig af ansøgningerne. Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV og en kort motivation for, hvorfor netop denne rolle tiltaler dig.

items.desc: About Digital Futures Digital Futures is an AI services and software company that specialises in accelerating AI transformation and enabling AI governance for enterprise and government. The Role We are looking for an experienced consultant who can design the architecture, build working systems, and take them from demo to a scaled, governed deployment inside a regulated financial institution. This is a hands-on build role, not an advisory one. The successful candidate will combine practical agentic AI engineering with knowledge graph and entity-resolution experience, and will be comfortable operating within a bank’s control environment. Key Responsibilities Architecture design - Design and deploy agentic AI workflows to automate investment sourcing, market research, due diligence and document generation. - Design and maintain a venture intelligence knowledge graph covering companies, founders, investors and transactions. - Define AI architecture, data governance, provenance and quality standards across internal and external data sources. Agent development - Develop AI agents to analyse companies, markets and investment opportunities using structured and unstructured data. - Build automated diligence workflows that extract, validate and synthesise information from pitch decks, financials, research reports and industry databases. - Develop portfolio intelligence capabilities to monitor performance, financing activity, competitive developments and strategic risks. - Integrate with approved internal and external data sources, including CRM, market data and portfolio management platforms. Production and governance - Deploy and optimise RAG, agent orchestration and knowledge graph services within the bank’s approved technology environment. - Implement monitoring and evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, quality, cost and operational performance. - Ensure solutions are secure, auditable and reproducible. Experience and Profile - Strong experience in software, AI or data engineering, including the design and delivery of production-grade solutions. - Proven track record of building and deploying agentic AI systems in production environments. - Strong Python development and API integration experience. - Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic search and retrieval systems. - Familiarity with MCP and related tool integration standards. - Experience deploying solutions on AWS or GCP. Benefits We offer a competitive salary. Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing and development. This includes: - Group Life Assurance - Virtual GP and Online Physiotherapy - Confidential Helpline/Employee Assistance Programme - Wellbeing Studio & Digital Gym - Discounted shopping cards, e-vouchers & cashback offers - Percentage discounts & savings on brands online & in store - Statutory pension contribution - salary exchange scheme - 30 days annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays Why Join Us Digital Futures consultants deliver solutions across the full data and AI transformation lifecycle, from strategy, analytics and engineering through to adoption, governance and assurance. We’re focused on creating opportunity in the age of AI. Joining Digital Futures means joining an organisation making a real impact in delivering an AI-first future, at whatever stage of your career.

items.desc: Hey du! Du möchtest nicht einfach mit bestehenden Anwendungen arbeiten, sondern moderne AI-gestützte Lösungen von Grund auf mitgestalten? Du hast Lust, deine technische Expertise einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dabei maßgeblich zu prägen, wie wir AI zukünftig sinnvoll in unseren Anwendungen und Prozessen einsetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bei ambelin dreht sich alles um unsere Mieterinnen und Mieter. Unser Ziel ist es, Wohnen neu und vor allem mieterorientiert zu denken. Wir wollen sicherstellen, dass alle, die bei uns wohnen, das Gefühl haben, sich auf uns verlassen zu können – jederzeit. Mieterzufriedenheit ist für uns nicht nur ein Schlagwort, sondern unsere Mission. Unseren Mieterinnen und Mietern ist es insbesondere wichtig, dass wir Anliegen effizienter bearbeiten, schneller auf Fragen reagieren und noch bessere Lösungen bieten. Damit wir unsere Mission weiter vorantreiben können, möchten wir Prozesse mithilfe von AI schneller und intelligenter aufbauen. Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als AI Software Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren internen und externen Umsetzungsstakeholdern moderne Anwendungen und AI-gestützte Lösungen über den gesamten Lifecycle – von der Konzeption und Architektur über die Entwicklung bis hin zum produktiven Einsatz und der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung. Du hast die Möglichkeit, neue Ideen einzubringen und mitzugestalten, wie wir beispielsweise LLMs, AI Agents und andere AI-Technologien sinnvoll in unsere Produkte und Prozesse integrieren. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Levin , unserem Head of Technology, vor Ort in Berlin zusammen und hast die Möglichkeit, perspektivisch die technische Ownership für unsere AI-gestützten Anwendungen und deren Architektur zu übernehmen. DEINE MISSION: Du entwickelst neue Anwendungen und Lösungen auf Basis unserer zentralen Datenplattform , gestaltest deren Architektur und begleitest sie von der Idee bis zum skalierbaren, produktiven Betrieb. Du konzipierst AI-gestützte Lösungen , zum Beispiel mit LLMs, RAG-Systemen oder AI Agents. Du arbeitest hands-on an der Backend- und Integrationsentwicklung und entwickelst unsere Anwendungen gemeinsam mit internen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie externen Engineering-Partnerinnen und Partnern weiter. Du hinterfragst und prüfst technische Konzepte, Architekturentscheidungen und Aufwandsschätzungen unserer externen Stakeholdern und sorgst für eine technisch saubere Umsetzung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Anwendungen zuverlässig und nachhaltig betrieben werden – mit automatisierten Tests, Code Reviews, CI/CD, Monitoring und guter Dokumentation . Du behältst Themen wie Sicherheit, Datenschutz, Zugriffskontrolle im Blick und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern in technische Lösungen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, gestaltest unsere technische Architektur und den Einsatz von AI aktiv mit und baust perspektivisch gemeinsam mit uns internes Engineering-Know-how auf. DAS BRINGST DU MIT: Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und hast Anwendungen bereits über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg mitentwickelt und produktiv betrieben . Du hast bereits Anwendungen oder Features mit AI entwickelt und produktiv eingesetzt – zum Beispiel mit LLMs, RAG, AI Agents oder vergleichbaren Technologien. Du verstehst nicht nur, wie man ein AI-Modell anbindet, sondern kannst AI-Lösungen sinnvoll in eine skalierbare und sichere Anwendungsarchitektur integrieren . Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-nativer Entwicklung mit, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure. Du kennst dich mit Themen wie Deployment, CI/CD, Testing, Monitoring, Security und dem zuverlässigen Betrieb von Anwendungen aus. Du fühlst dich in der Backend-Entwicklung zu Hause und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit Python sowie dem Design und der Entwicklung von APIs und Integrationen mit. Du kannst technische Konzepte und Architekturentscheidungen kritisch hinterfragen und deine Empfehlungen verständlich begründen. Du arbeitest gerne hands-on, übernimmst Verantwortung und hast gleichzeitig Lust, technische Themen strategisch mitzugestalten. Du kannst gut mit externen Entwicklungsstakeholdern zusammenarbeiten und behältst dabei Qualität, Architektur und langfristige Wartbarkeit im Blick. Du hast bereits mit modernen Frontend-Technologien gearbeitet, zum Beispiel TypeScript oder einem modernen Framework . Du kennst Workflow-Enablement-Tools und hast Erfahrung darin, technische Lösungen auch für andere Teams gut nutzbar zu machen. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (mind. B2 Niveau) und Englisch und kannst dich auch mit internationalen bzw. englischsprachigen Projektbeteiligten souverän zu technischen Themen abstimmen. Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung , da bei uns viel im direkten Austausch vor Ort passiert. DAS BIETEN WIR: ambelin - ein Zuhause zum Wohlfühlen, das gilt nicht nur für unsere Mieter und Mieterinnen. Damit auch du dich bei uns wohlfühlst und wir …

Wir kreieren echten, messbaren Mehrwert – und stehen dafür ein. items.desc: Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses. If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey. The Role Zühlke is building its AI Factory: a production line for software in which AI agents turn an approved requirement into a verified change. People set the target, agents do the work, people assure the result. No agent approves, merges or deploys. Every quality gate produces evidence, and a named person decides. As an Agentic Software Engineer you join the core team that builds this system, takes it into client projects and pushes it to production. You own the outcome: what you build is used by client teams and delivers the value it was built for. You design the agents, the workflows that connect them and the gates that check their output. That includes the harness the agents work in and the loops that run until a gate lets the result pass. You will also build agents and agentic workflows beyond software delivery, for clients and for Zühlke itself. Tools and models change every few weeks in this field. We build on standard interfaces so that components can be swapped, and we expect you to enjoy that pace. How You Will Make an Impact Design and build multi-agent workflows with clear hand-offs, durable state and explicit failure handling. Engineer agent loops that refine, plan, implement and review until an independent, default-fail evaluator lets the result pass. You define stop conditions, retry budgets and which model runs which step. Engineer the context agents work with: tools and knowledge access over code, documentation and domain, using MCP. Engineer agent harnesses: instruction files (AGENTS.md), skills, custom agents, hooks and CI checks, each concern in the right layer. Rules that must always hold go into tests and hooks, not into prompts. Implement spec-driven development with traceability from requirement to code and test. Build quality gates that run deterministic checks first, then evals and AI judgement, and end with a human decision backed by evidence. The checker is never the producer: a separate test agent writes hidden acceptance tests. Harden agents against prompt injection and run them in isolated sandboxes with least-privilege access. Make agent behaviour observable and auditable: an audit trail of agent decisions, cost per task and lead-time metrics. This trail is the evidence that governance rules such as the EU AI Act ask for, from human oversight to logging. Work directly with client teams to take agents, harnesses and loops into their projects and push them to production. Own the value after go-live: agree with the client what a capability should deliver, measure whether teams use it and whether it delivers, and close the gap when it does not. What Is Important to Us At least seven years of professional software engineering, with a track record of owning code quality in production systems. You have built a working agentic system yourself, at work or in your free time, and use it to build software. In our selection process you demo it to the team, as a repository or live. Hands-on experience with agent orchestration: multi-agent workflows, hand-offs, state and failure handling. Experience with agent frameworks such as Claude Agent SDK, Azure AI Foundry or LangGraph. Experience with context engineering and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with evals as quality gates and with guardrails against prompt injection, and with tracing agent runs in tools such as Langfuse. Working knowledge of responsible AI and AI governance, for example the EU AI Act obligations on human oversight, logging and documentation. Harness engineering for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex: you have written instruction files, skills, custom agents and hooks that a team relies on. Loop engineering: you have built agent loops with an independent evaluator, stop conditions and cost limits, and you can explain why a loop failed. Strong programming skills in Python or TypeScript; Java or .NET is a plus. Solid CI/CD and Git practice. Experience with GitLab, containers and Kubernetes is a plus. You write clean, tested, well-structured code. Prototypes that only work in a demo are not enough for …

items.desc: Labhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products, including Invoice Fly and Summary AI, are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first. We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. About the Role: We’re bringing AI Agents into Summary AI and Invoice Fly, and you’ll be the one building them from scratch. This isn’t a role where you join an existing system and pick up tickets. You’ll own the whole cycle: decide what to build, design the architecture, implement it, measure how it performs with real users, and keep iterating until it works. These won’t be thin wrappers around an LLM. You will build multi-agent systems that do real work for millions of users, and you’ll build the foundation underneath them: orchestration, tool use, context management, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls. What You’ll Do Design and build our agent architecture from the ground up. Ship agentic features into Summary AI and Invoice Fly. Set up evaluations to measure quality, catch failures, and guide improvements. Iterate quickly based on real usage and data. Track the latest models, tools, and techniques, and bring the best ones into our products. About You: You have 5+ years of experience building production systems. You’ve built agents that real people use, and you know what it takes to make them reliable. You take full ownership, from a blank page to production and beyond. You make the architecture decisions yourself and see them through. You know how to evaluate AI systems, not just build them, and you use data to decide what to fix next. You keep up with AI. You try new models and tools as they come out, and you know which ones are worth adopting. You ship fast and iterate, without lowering the bar on quality. You communicate clearly with everyone you work with. You explain technical tradeoffs clearly, listen to what each team needs, and keep everyone aligned. Problem-solving and product focus: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges. Eye for detail and a product-first mindset, with a passion for creating exceptional user experiences. Self-driven, entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects. Excellent communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience with subscription apps or mobile products Contributions to open-source AI tooling What we Offer: Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week. Flexible working hours. High-end equipment for your development. Permanent contract with competitive compensation. A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment. Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges. Hiring Process Initial Interview: Meet with our Talent Acquisition Lead to discuss your background and fit for the role. We’ll also ask you to share your proudest projects. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep dive into your experience. Technical Assessment: Showcase your expertise through a practical task. Final Interview: A conversation with our leadership team to align on vision and expectations. Offer: Join our team and lead the development of our future-shaping apps! You should Know: Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them. Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 Supportability Decisions is a Dublin-based engineering team within Supportability Engineering, part of Risk Engineering. We own the “how a business sells” side of Supportability: determining whether a user’s declared business, web presence, account configuration, and observed transaction behaviour align with Stripe’s standards.
 Our core domain includes transaction-laundering detection and decisioning, web-presence and URL-policy controls, and low-quality e-commerce detection. We consume the signals and evaluations that support decisions in these spaces and convert them into evidence-based and auditable determinations that can be shared with the rest of the Supportability platforms.
 The pitch is: join a high-ownership team solving some of Stripe’s hardest risk problems. We build technology that helps Stripe distinguish legitimate businesses from bad actors at scale, combining sophisticated engineering, AI-assisted investigation, and meaningful real-world impact.
 What you’ll do
 You will own a meaningful part of a risk-decisioning problem from investigation and design through implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. You will help build both the domain capabilities and the modern agentic infrastructure required to make Supportability decisions consistent, stateful, explainable, and appropriate to the business, product, and moment in time. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s experience, this may include:
 Responsibilities
 Building the Supportability Decision Layer: a durable service and API through which automated systems, agents, and human reviewers can request, produce, retrieve, and understand canonical decisions.
 Developing the infrastructure that enables agentic investigations to synthesize policy, business identity and history, product context, risk appetite, and multiple assessment signals into explainable, confidence-calibrated decisions.
 Improving the transaction-laundering agent’s policy grounding, evidence quality, risk tiering, precision and recall, and use of behavioural, dispute, and other relevant signals.
 Designing durable decision state and history, including traceability from supporting evidence through reasoning and applied consequence, and validity and refresh policies that prevent stale outcomes from persisting.
 Building governed, reusable configuration and integration patterns that adapt decision capabilities across products, partners, countries, and permitted risk appetites without creating bespoke systems for each use case.
 Building reliable backend workflows on shared Supportability and Risk Platform infrastructure.
 Making complex risk decisions explainable to reviewers and affected users.
 Using data and feedback from outcomes, appeals, and corrections to improve decision quality while balancing the identification of bad actors against avoiding unnecessary harm to legitimate businesses.
 Modernising URL enforcement, including when and how URL checks run, reducing unnecessary review volume and user friction, and supporting migration away from legacy systems.
 Expanding shared SAE/SPO decisioning foundations, including due-diligence support and product-scoped remediation and appeal capabilities.
 Improving the Process Orchestration Framework and moving workflow code into more maintainable platform packages.
 Contributing to future work in automated LPM URL screening, low-quality e-commerce detection, wider web intelligence, and active test charges.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements
 2 - 7 years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)
 You work effectively across the stack from top to bottom, comfortably navigating codebases with different languages and tools
 You're equally comfortable shipping user-facing experiences as you are writing custom queries to analyze experiment results
 Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job, so our interview process is language-agnostic)
 Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
 Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial

Job Description: 
 ​Airbus International Services (AIS) is a subsidiary wholly owned by Airbus Helicopters, the world-leading rotorcraft manufacturer. AIS is based in Dublin, Ireland.
 Established in 2010, Airbus International Services has been supporting Airbus Helicopters, Airbus Commercial, Airbus Defence & Space, ATR and Satair, with high quality services delivered by experienced and highly skilled professionals deployed worldwide (50+ countries). 
 AIS has three business lines, dedicated to supporting our groupwide customers: 
 Helicopter Technical Operations supporting Airbus Helicopters; 
 Aircrew Assistance supporting Airbus Helicopters and ATR; 
 Airplane Operations supporting Airbus Commercial, Airbus Defence and Space, ATR, Satair; 
 AIS’s Technical Support activity offers versatile and innovative solutions to our customers regulatory and business needs. Our strong customer-focused ethic coupled with our reactivity and flexibility will help our customers excel. 
 Our services are provided exclusively to Airbus Group entities and affiliates. 
 We are looking for a Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (LAME) B2 with a current type rating H145 D2-D3 to join our Helicopters Operations Department in diverse locations around the world. 
 Roles and responsibilities 
 The role and responsibility of the LAME B2 is to provide Airbus Helicopters worldwide customers with Technical Assistance for their H145 D2-D3 helicopters fleet. 
 The LAME B2 is an avionic specialist holding at minimum the H145 D2-D3 type rating on a valid EASA Part 66 
 A CAA UK Part 66 licence is a plus 
 The LAME holds an EASA Part 66 in order to provide technical support as follow: 
 Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance tasks in accordance with applicable and approved documentation (AMM / RDAS / SB / other OEM documentation, ) 
 Rectification of all defects reported. 
 Ensure zero defect post inspection/retrofit. 
 Provide field services support locally 
 Carry out on-the-job training of customer’s personnel, when requested 
 Answer to questions asked by on-site customers related to the performance of the maintenance tasks (iaw. the agreed maintenance plan), 
 Give feedback in the set-up of the maintenance planning (monthly and weekly planning), 
 Assist customer’s maintenance personnel in understanding and in the use of technical publications, work report & work order from Part M

items.desc: En tant que développeur au sein de l?équipe Data & AI, le Développeur IA Agents SDLC construit, déploie et maintient des agents IA ainsi que des orchestrations multi-agents pour les programmes d?ingénierie. À partir d?un framework agentique existant et d?une bibliothèque d?agents, le développeur étend et améliore ces actifs afin d?en faire des outils robustes et réutilisables, adaptés aux processus et aux pratiques d?ingénierie de chaque programme. Le poste combine le développement logiciel pratique avec une collaboration étroite avec les ingénieurs V&V, les responsables de programme et les développeurs, dans l?environnement approuvé comprenant GitHub Copilot, GitLab Duo et les outils IA associés. Responsabilités principales? Construire des agents : concevoir, développer, tester et déployer des agents IA soutenant les activités d?ingénierie tout au long du SDLC, notamment l?analyse des exigences, le développement, la revue de code, la vérification et validation (V&V), ainsi que la documentation. ? Construire des orchestrations : concevoir des workflows multi-agents, chaîner les agents, acheminer les tâches, gérer le contexte partagé et les transferts, gérer les défaillances et conserver les étapes de revue et d?approbation humaine lorsque nécessaire. ? Étendre les actifs existants : comprendre le framework agentique existant et la bibliothèque d?agents, réutiliser leurs interfaces et modèles, et améliorer les capacités et la fiabilité plutôt que de repartir de zéro. ? Travailler avec des équipes et programmes cloisonnés : prendre en compte les différents processus, priorités et niveaux de maturité, identifier les besoins communs et consolider les capacités réutilisables sans perdre les exigences propres à chaque programme. ? Collaborer avec les ingénieurs V&V, responsables de programme et développeurs : animer des ateliers de travail, comprendre les tâches et contraintes d?ingénierie, et les traduire en comportements d?agents, exigences d?intégration et critères d?acceptation testables. ? Intégrer les outils d?ingénierie : développer dans les environnements GitHub Copilot, GitLab Duo et autres outils approuvés ; connecter les dépôts, pipelines CI/CD et IBM ALM RDNG, EWM et ETM via les API prises en charge, les protocoles MCP (Model Context Protocol) et A2A (Agent-to-Agent), lorsque cela est applicable. ? Industrialiser et maintenir les agents : appliquer les tests automatisés, des évaluations reproductibles, le contrôle de version, le packaging, le déploiement et la supervision ; appliquer le principe du moindre privilège d?accès, protéger les données confidentielles, maintenir la traçabilité entre exigences et tests, et documenter le fonctionnement ainsi que le transfert de connaissances. Compétences obligatoires? Diplôme de niveau Master en informatique ou en ingénierie logicielle. ? Expérience pratique avérée dans la construction et le déploiement d?agents IA et d?orchestrations multi-agents au-delà des preuves de concept, incluant l?extension d?un framework agentique existant et d?une bibliothèque d?agents. ? Développement pratique basé sur les LLM : frameworks d?agents, appels d?outils (tool calling), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering et context engineering. ? Solides bases en ingénierie logicielle : Python, développement et intégration d?API, Git, tests automatisés, packaging et code maintenable. ? Expérience pratique avec GitHub Copilot, GitLab et GitLab Duo, les workflows CI/CD et l?intégration sécurisée d?agents ; compréhension des protocoles MCP et A2A ainsi que des capacités des plateformes concernées. Compétences souhaitées? Expérience dans l?adaptation d?agents SDLC à des programmes d?ingénierie et à des pratiques V&V, y compris les processus spécifiques aux programmes et les éléments de preuve d?acceptation. ? Expérience avec GitHub Copilot, GitLab Duo, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI ou des services similaires approuvés pour le développement et le déploiement d?agents. ? Expérience pratique de mise en ?uvre de serveurs ou clients MCP, d?interopérabilité A2A et de connecteurs vers IBM ALM ou d?autres outils d?ingénierie. ? Expérience dans l?évaluation de la fiabilité des agents et systèmes multi-agents, la gestion des risques d?injection de prompts, la mise en ?uvre de contrôles d?approbation humaine et le soutien à la conformité Responsible AI. ? Expérience dans l?exploitation de bibliothèques d?agents réutilisables, incluant la gestion de configuration, l?observabilité, la gestion des versions et l?adoption auprès de multiples équipes. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience. Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network. Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents. About the team You'll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams. Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement. Why this role exists Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents. This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time. The role As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers. You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes. Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value. What you will do Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on. …

You'll also play a leading role in AI innovation and development, helping to shape, prototype and evaluate analytical agents, intelligent workflows and AI-enabled products. Working alongside product owners and delivery teams, you'll compare models, tools and design approaches against agreed measures of quality, accuracy, robustness, cost and user value. items.desc: IS THIS YOU? Is full ownership of an app the perfect next step in your growth trajectory? Do you feel like AI is giving product managers superhuman powers? Then you know the feeling. You move faster than the organization around you, and you are done waiting for permission. At Myner, you don't need permission to run ahead - you have the agency to fly instead. ABOUT MYNER Stop waiting. Start growing. Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Myner transforms that data into the fuel that powers our Agentic Flywheels for consumer brands — always-on, continuous loops that both create and validate new product concepts, marketing campaign ideas and more. Legacy market research delivers studies and reports; Myner delivers breakout sales growth. Finally, our founder-CEO has already built and exited a unicorn in this industry and his plans for Myner are even more ambitious. Get yourself ready for explosive growth! THE MYNER APP The Myner app (https://mynerapp.com) is where consumers share their data with us, with their full consent, and get rewarded for it. They scan receipts, answer surveys and complete small missions, and every contribution pays off: they can cash out in money, crypto or even physical gold. So yes, they can literally turn their data into gold. The app plays out as a Wild West gold rush game, and it's built to be fun to come back to, not a chore. We're live in the US today on our way to building a global panel. As Product Owner, your customers are the people using the app: you make sure they enjoy it, trust it and feel rewarded for every contribution. THE ROLE Drive the growth and success of the Myner app. You will own the product experience for everyone who uses the app. You decide what gets built and when. WHAT YOU WILL OWN The app is our primary data source: it is foundational to everything we do as a company, and everything we build for clients depends on the quality of our panel. This is NOT a utilitarian app, it's intentionally a game first. Designing flows and experiences that make data collection feel like play is at the heart of owning this product. Product drives engineering: you decide what gets built and when, so roadmap creation and prioritization is where you make the biggest difference. You build, too: this is an AI-first company, so you build your own tools, experiments and AI harnesses (with help where needed). You don't just move tickets and wait for developers. You bring product ideas to life, and engineering makes sure they scale. Scope management is a skill: you know when to extend and when to cut. Cutting corners is fine, but they can bite back as we scale, so you need a strong sense of which ones to cut. Measure everything: we see immediately how people react to new features and iterate fast. Today we release a meaningful app version every 2–3 weeks, and expect just 1–2 as the engineering team grows. Support is part of the product: you own and manage customer support for our panelists, with the access and tooling to serve them well. The app store rating is one of your core KPIs, and it's shared across teams. Growth is yours: you are responsible for managing our agency partner to drive new user acquisition, along with all internal efforts to manage and improve user retention. WHAT YOU BRING Builder: you have built products people use, and you have something to show us. Cross-functional mindset: you work across teams naturally and never build walls around your own area. Good judgment and taste: you make sound decisions, care how things look and feel, and are highly regarded for this special talent. AI-first: you use AI every day in your work, from research to specs to prototypes. Data-driven: you trust what the numbers show, and a single bad review doesn't throw you off course. Gamification: you have worked on gamified products, not necessarily mobile, but more than leaderboards and streaks. Prioritization: you know what matters now, say no easily, and are comfortable cutting corners when it's the right call. Communicator: you explain things clearly, inside the team and to everyone else. English: near-native is the level we're looking for, where you can express yourself without problems. Self-managed: you plan your own time; make commitments and meet your own deadlines. Team lead: you have led teams of engineers and designers before. NOT A FIT Department walls: you prefer owning your own area over working cross-functionally. Here, the app, the data, engineering, user support and client needs all connect. Feature factory: you'd rather ship features than measure their impact. We decide based on data, not opinions. No eye for UI / UX: you leave the look and feel to designers. In this role, taste and judgment on UI and UX are essential. Pace: you prefer the rhythm of a large enterprise. We are a startup that tries things quickly and iterates a lot. Change: you get frustrated when plans …

Solution Architect – Dynamics 365 CE, Copilot & AI Help shape the future of intelligent business applications – and play a key role in growing our Dynamics 365 CE business. At twoday, we are looking for an ambitious and forward-thinking Solution Architect who combines deep technical expertise with a passion for Microsoft Copilot, AI, Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), and Power Platform. This is more than a traditional Solution Architect role. You will play a central role in shaping the future of our CE business within twoday Business Applications, helping us strengthen our market position, expand our capabilities, and develop the next generation of intelligent business solutions. We are looking for someone who can connect technology, customer needs, and business opportunities. Someone who enjoys designing and delivering innovative solutions, but who also wants to influence how we develop our business, evolve our offerings, and create value for our customers. What will you get to work on? As our Solution Architect, you will combine technical leadership, customer advisory, and business development. Your key responsibilities will include: Microsoft Copilot & AI: Lead the architecture and implementation of intelligent business solutions using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem. Help customers rethink workflows and unlock new opportunities through AI-driven automation. Dynamics 365 CE & Power Platform: Design scalable and integrated solutions across Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, and related technologies, ensuring that business requirements are translated into sustainable technical solutions. Strategic Development of Our CE Business: Help define the future direction of our CE business within twoday Business Applications. Identify opportunities for growth, new capabilities, customer segments, and services that can strengthen our position in the market. Development and Evolution of Offerings: Take an active role in creating new offerings and further developing our existing portfolio. Transform emerging technologies, customer challenges, and market trends into commercially relevant, scalable, and repeatable solutions. Business Expansion & Customer Opportunities: Collaborate with sales, consultants, and leadership to identify opportunities within existing and new customer relationships. Contribute to presales activities, solution positioning, and initiatives that support the growth of our CE business. Customer Advisory & Solution Architecture: Act as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them understand the opportunities within Dynamics 365, Copilot, and AI. Translate business challenges into innovative solutions that deliver measurable value. Innovation & Technical Leadership: Explore emerging Microsoft technologies, evaluate new use cases, and help turn ideas into production-ready solutions with the right architecture, security, governance, and scalability. Help define the next chapter of our CE business One of the most exciting aspects of this role is the opportunity to influence where we take our Dynamics 365 CE business over the coming years. Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, and the continued evolution of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform are creating new opportunities for how organizations manage customer relationships, automate processes, and engage with their customers. We want to be at the forefront of that development. You will work closely with colleagues across Business Applications to help shape our future capabilities and identify where we can create the greatest value for our customers. This means looking beyond individual projects and contributing to the bigger picture: What should our CE business look like in the next two to three years? items.desc: NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Join us as a Finance Engineer Join our finance team and treat the finance stack as a product to build, not just operate. You will own the data, workflows, agents, and controls that move finance towards a near-real-time operating rhythm, and free the team, including the CFO, to spend their time on decisions instead of manual data work. This role suits someone with a solid finance foundation and a builder's instinct to automate a process rather than just document it. What you'll work on Our finance function has outgrown manual spreadsheet work and point solutions stitched together by hand. This role changes that, and you will shape how finance runs. In this role, you will: Own the end-to-end stack of tools, platforms, and processes that finance runs on, and make the build-versus-buy calls on what to automate in-house and what to configure from a vendor. Design, build, and maintain AI agents and internal tools that do finance work directly, such as variance explanations, a largely self-drafted monthly review, and forecast scenarios, so people review the work instead of doing it by hand. Find repetitive, manual finance workflows, such as data pulls, reconciliations, and report assembly, and automate them. If a task is done twice, write a workflow. If the workflow is run twice, turn it into an agent. Connect finance systems to each other and to source data, such as ERP, HR, and usage and revenue data, so numbers flow automatically instead of being reconciled across tools. Lead the design, scaling, and maintenance of BI infrastructure, data pipelines, and analytics platforms across all financial metrics and entity reporting. Build controls into every automation and agent, with a traceable path from output back to source data and approval gates before anything posts to the ledger. Take ownership of finance automation and AI initiatives, working with guidance from finance leadership at first and independently as you grow into the role. What we're looking for If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. Here is what we are looking for: A finance background strong enough to understand core processes (close, AP/AR, FP&A, and reporting) and spot where the real pain points are. This is not an accountant role. Strong technical fluency across modern SaaS platforms, APIs, and data tools, with the ability to configure, connect, and automate systems without being a professional software engineer. Hands-on experience, or strong aptitude, building with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, custom GPTs, or agentic AI to produce working workflows, agents, or internal tools, not just prompts. Experience working with data using SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet logic, and reasoning about how data structures connect across systems. Experience shipping a small working tool quickly instead of writing a long spec, and automating a process rather than just documenting it. Experience explaining automated systems and their outputs to non-technical finance stakeholders, in writing and in person. Nice to have: Experience in a finance engineer, analytics engineer, or BI engineer role, ideally at a high-growth tech or SaaS company. Experience with a modern, cloud-native ERP. Scripting ability in Python, Apps Script, or SQL, even without a formal engineering background. Experience building dashboards, semantic layers, and modern BI solutions in tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI, Streamlit, or Tableau. Why join NestAI Work alongside over 200 engineers and scientists, including 60+ PhDs. People who've built AI platforms, autonomous systems, and defence technology across Europe. items.title: Embedded Linux Engineer (Yocto Specialist)
items.card: The Role Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it. This is an in-house ownership
items.desc: About Genesis Genesis is a physical AI lab and full-stack robotics company building general-purpose robots, with teams in Paris and the Bay Area. Our people have built some of the most widely used platforms in robotics research including the open-source Genesis simulator, pioneered generative simulation and led foundation-model work at some of the world's leading AI labs. We own the whole stack: hardware, embedded systems, simulation, data and robot foundation models. The Role Every Genesis robot runs on a custom jetson thor compute board and every piece of software we write: control, perception, learned policies, depends on the Linux image underneath it. We are looking for a senior engineer to own that image end to end: build it, ship it to the robot, keep it updatable, and make it easy for the rest of the team to compile and deploy on top of it. This is an in-house ownership role. You will be the reference for embedded Linux at Genesis, working closely with our embedded, robotics and application-software engineers in Paris and with our hardware partners. The job is to provide a reliable, well maintained and up to date os image, customized to our needs. What You'll Do Build, own and maintain the production Yocto/OpenEmbedded distribution for our robot's custom board: BSP, kernel, device tree, rootfs, toolchain and custom layers. Bring up new hardware on NVIDIA Jetson-class platforms, integrating drivers and peripherals. Including hands-on debugging of components such as Wi-Fi, cameras, audio devices and buses on the physical robot. Own the full image lifecycle: reproducible builds, versioned releases, secure and robust over-the-air (OTA) updates, and long-term maintenance as hardware and software evolve. Deliver a development kit and workflow (SDK, cross-compilation, deployment tooling) so engineers can build and ship their software onto the robot quickly. Integrate GPU and AI-accelerator inference stacks so that our models run efficiently on the robot. Speed up the team's build and CI pipeline for image generation and validation. Builds are long, so caching and automation matter, as well as removing unnecessary dependencies. Document the system and make it approachable, so the image is never again a black box that only one person (or contractor) understands. Your First Three Months Build a custom Yocto image for the robot's custom boards. Flash, boot and validate it on real hardware, working through driver and integration issues on-site. Set up the cross compilation workflow, caching, CI automations to streamline the robotics team work What You'll Bring Passion for your craft and demonstrated excellence in embedded Linux engineering. 5+ years of hands-on embedded Linux experience, including shipping at least one Yocto-based image to production not only a prototype. Proven ownership of an image through its lifecycle: maintenance, release management and remote/OTA updates. Deep experience with Yocto internals: layers, recipes, BitBake, machine and distro configuration, SDK generation. Strong board bring-up and low-level debugging skills: kernel configuration, device trees, drivers, boot chain. Hands-on experience with the NVIDIA Jetson family (JetPack / L4T, meta-tegra) or comparable embedded GPU platforms. Knowledge C++ and Python packaging systems and how to deal with cross-compilation. The ability to explain how your work fits into the wider build, development and deployment system. Exceptional ownership and initiative, with the judgment to choose workable solutions for our current stage over the theoretically ideal one. Bonus Experience integrating GPU / AI-accelerator inference (CUDA, TensorRT or similar) on embedded targets. Background in robotics, drones, connected devices or other products with custom hardware. Experience working with chip vendors or ODMs. Familiarity with secure boot, real-time kernel tuning (PREEMPT_RT) or OTA frameworks such as Mender, RAUC or SWUpdate. French and English. Mandarin is a plus. You'll Thrive Here If You Enjoy being the go-to person for a critical system and making it easier for others to use. Unblock teammates' requests quickly and pragmatically, and know when "good enough to ship" is the right answer. Stay patient and methodical when a single build takes two hours and a bug only shows up on hardware. Like startup flexibility: changing priorities, short feedback loops and work that ranges from kernel to tooling.

items.desc: JOB DETAILS Type of contract : Consultant Contract Level : Level 2 - Middle Hiring Unit : Sciences Sector (SCS) Duty Station : Paris Work location : On site Duration of contract : 8 months Hiring open to : External candidates Application deadline (Midnight UTC+2 Time) : 23/11/2026 UNESCO Core Values: Commitment to the Organization, Integrity, Respect for Diversity, Professionalism BACKGROUND The Research, Governance and Diplomacy (RGD) Section within the Division of Ethics, Research and Technology (ERT), Sciences Sector of UNESCO supports global efforts to strengthen science, technology and innovation (STI) systems, science-policy interfaces, scientific cooperation, ethical governance of emerging technologies, open science, scientific literacy, the right to science, scientific freedom and public engagement with science. As part of these efforts, the RGD section is coordinating the four-yearly monitoring of the 2017 UNESCO Recommendation on Science and Scientific Researchers (RS|SR). To support the monitoring of the Recommendation, the RGD Section is recruiting a Consultant to contribute to the creation of an online dashboard drawing on the 62 national reports on the implementation of the RS|SR submitted in 2025. The dashboards will present among others country profiles, comparisons (between countries and regions and against the 10 RS|SR key areas), data aggregation, and brief analysis, pointing to trends and common challenges. The dashboard will also include a global map and graphic presentations. The RS|SR dashboard will build on the conceptual and technical approach developed for the UNESCO Open Science Dashboard, launched in 2026, with a view to ensuring coherence across UNESCO's science monitoring frameworks and facilitating comparative analyses where relevant. The dashboard may at a later stage be integrated into a revamped and redesigned UNESCO Global Observatory of Science, Technology and Innovation Policy Instruments (GO-SPIN) platform, thereby contributing to a consolidated ecosystem for monitoring and reporting on UNESCO normative instruments in the field of science. ASSIGNMENTS In accordance with the UNESCO Programme and Budget 2026-2027 (43 C/5), specifically under Major Programme II: Natural Sciences and Major Programme III: Social and Human Sciences, and in support of Output 3.1.SC ("Member States supported in strengthening Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) ecosystems and their access for all, including the most vulnerable populations, to advance open science, gender equality in science, evidence-based policymaking, and science literacy") and Intersectoral Output 5.3.SHS ("Capacity of Member States, key stakeholders, public awareness and public engagement enhanced on freedom and safety of scientists and scientific research, taking into account gender equality and emergency settings"), the consultant will contribute to the development of a dashboard architecture, data model, and visualization framework for reporting on the implementation of the 2017 Recommendation on Science and Scientific Researchers (RS|SR). Under the overall authority of the Assistant Director-General for Sciences (ADG/SCS), the guidance of the Director of the Division for Ethics, Research and Technology (ERT), and the oversight of the Chief of Section, the consultant will report to the Programme Specialist responsible for the implementation of the UNESCO Recommendation on Science and Scientific Researchers. Long Description In this context, the consultant shall: a) Analyse and validate quantitative and qualitative data from 62 Member State reports provided by UNESCO on the implementation of the RS|SR received in the context of the 2025 monitoring exercise, ensuring alignment with the survey against which national reports were prepared. b) Prepare the datasets, metadata and country profiles (for all 62 countries), comparisons (between countries and regions and against the 10 RS|SR key areas), data aggregation, and brief analysis on trends and common challenges required to populate the RS|SR monitoring dashboards drawing on the Open Science Platform/open science dashboards. Long Description c) Liaise with the dashboard developer (to be specified by UNESCO) to ensure the compatibility with the RS|SR data model, metadata and indicator structure; the Open Science Platform/open science dashboards (and, if applicable, the GO-SPIN platform), and validate dashboard outputs against analytical requirements. d) Provide technical contribution on communication about the RS|SR dashboards through the production of appropriate communication tools (including powerpoint presentations, briefs, visuals, web content, etc.) and the convening of promotional workshops targeting different audiences. e) Liaise with the contractor responsible (to be specified by UNESCO) for the preparation of an analytical report, drawing on country reports on the RS|SR, to ensure consistency between the findings of the analytical report and the data presented …

Elle participera au développement, à l'intégration et à la mise en service des systèmes de contrôle des télescopes TILT, ainsi qu'à la conception et à l'implémentation des outils logiciels nécessaires à l'acquisition, au traitement et à l'analyse des données d'observation. L'objectif est de développer une chaîne d'observation automatisée, depuis le pilotage des instruments jusqu'à la détection et à la caractérisation des flashs lunaires, afin de contribuer aux objectifs scientifiques du projet LISTEN-FLASH. L'Activité Piloter la robotisation et l'automatisation des télescopes TILT, en assurant le développement, l'intégration et la validation des systèmes de contrôle des montures, des axes de pointage et des encodeurs. Développer et maintenir les logiciels de pilotage des télescopes et des équipements associés : moteurs, encodeurs, caméras, systèmes de mise au point et dispositifs auxiliaires. Mettre en œuvre les interfaces de communication entre les différents équipements et les systèmes informatiques de contrôle. Développer les outils logiciels d'acquisition, de synchronisation, de stockage et de gestion des données provenant des caméras scientifiques. Développer et optimiser les logiciels de traitement des images astronomiques, notamment pour la détection automatique des flashs d'impact lunaires. Participer à la validation des algorithmes de détection, à la caractérisation des événements observés et à la constitution d'une base de données de flashs lunaires. Assurer l'intégration, les tests, la calibration et la validation des systèmes matériels et logiciels sur les sites d'observation. Participer à la mise en service, à l'exploitation et à l'amélioration continue des installations robotisées. Documenter les développements logiciels et matériels et contribuer au transfert des outils vers les autres membres du projet. Systèmes automatisés, contrôle-commande et interfaces entre équipements. Intelligence artificielle, apprentissage automatique et systèmes autonomes. Notions d'astronomie observationnelle et de traitement d'images souhaitées. Compétences techniques Très bonne maîtrise des langages Python et C/C++. Expérience en développement logiciel et intégration de systèmes informatiques et électroniques. Connaissance des protocoles de communication et de commande d'instruments (interfaces série, USB, Ethernet ou équivalentes). Expérience en acquisition, traitement et analyse de données. Connaissance des systèmes Linux et des environnements de développement associés. Compétences en développement d'agents intelligents (AI agents), notamment pour l'automatisation de tâches, l'orchestration de logiciels et d'instruments, et le développement de systèmes autonomes. Connaissance des architectures d'agents utilisant des modèles de langage (LLM), des outils externes et des interfaces de programmation (API). Des compétences en électronique, microcontrôleurs, systèmes embarqués ou pilotage de moteurs et d'encodeurs seraient particulièrement appréciées. Une expérience en traitement d'images, en apprentissage automatique et en développement d'algorithmes de détection serait un atout. items.desc: The Company At EnOcean, we are passionate about driving innovation and creating IoT solutions that positively impact our world. We pioneered batteryless, energy-harvesting wireless sensors and built platforms that enable efficient sensing, tracking and data-driven solutions across industries such as building automation, logistics, healthcare and industrial IoT. Our platforms combine large-scale data processing with AI-enabled analytics and automation to deliver reliable, customer-centric solutions. We turn complex telemetry and operational data from energy-efficient devices and connected systems into actionable insights, with transparency, robustness and long-term maintainability. Security, data protection and the responsible use of advanced technologies, including AI, are integral to how we design, build and operate our systems. #LI-Hybrid The Role & You As a Software Engineer – Backend / Data Platform (m/f/d) you will work on the core of EnOcean's cloud platform: the services, data pipelines and shared platform capabilities that sit underneath several products. You will join a small, close-knit team, where you can see the effect of your work in production. This role suits an engineer with some years of experience who is ready to take ownership of features and small services, with senior colleagues and architects close by for design discussions and review. It is a good step for someone who wants to grow towards senior engineer, with room to deepen your expertise in data platforms, architecture or technical leadership. We also use AI as part of how we build software. Some of our code is drafted with the help of coding agents working from written specifications, which makes writing clear specifications, sound judgement and careful review as valuable as writing code yourself. You do not need to be an expert: curiosity and the willingness to learn this way of working are what count, and we will support you with training, time to experiment and colleagues to learn from. The position can be based in Munich, Germany (EnOcean GmbH) (permanent contract), or Utrecht, the Netherlands (Undagrid B.V.) (one-year contract, intended to become permanent). We are recruiting for one role and will hire one candidate. The employment contract will be concluded with the local entity at the selected location. The role is advertised in both countries. Please apply only once and indicate your preferred location. What you’ll be doing Build and maintain backend services and platform components used across multiple applications, mainly in TypeScript. Work on high-throughput, time-series-oriented data paths: ingestion, streaming, storage and querying for large device fleets. Contribute to event-driven pipelines and to the public API, including its documentation. Write clear specifications and acceptance criteria, and work with AI coding agents where they help: scope the task, guide the agent, and review the result. Review code, whether written by colleagues or by agents, for correctness, security, performance and fit with the architecture. Apply secure-by-design principles in everyday work, and take part in CI/CD, releases and diagnosing production issues. items.desc: IS THIS YOU? Is full ownership of an app the perfect next step in your growth trajectory? Do you feel like AI is giving product managers superhuman powers? Then you know the feeling. You move faster than the organization around you, and you are done waiting for permission. At Myner, you don't need permission to run ahead - you have the agency to fly instead. ABOUT MYNER Stop waiting. Start growing. Myner is building the world’s first global consumer omni-panel: a unified, always-on stream of what people buy, consume, watch and think. Myner transforms that data into the fuel that powers our Agentic Flywheels for consumer brands — always-on, continuous loops that both create and validate new product concepts, marketing campaign ideas and more. Legacy market research delivers studies and reports; Myner delivers breakout sales growth. Finally, our founder-CEO has already built and exited a unicorn in this industry and his plans for Myner are even more ambitious. Get yourself ready for explosive growth! THE MYNER APP The Myner app (https://mynerapp.com) is where consumers share their data with us, with their full consent, and get rewarded for it. They scan receipts, answer surveys and complete small missions, and every contribution pays off: they can cash out in money, crypto or even physical gold. So yes, they can literally turn their data into gold. The app plays out as a Wild West gold rush game, and it's built to be fun to come back to, not a chore. We're live in the US today on our way to building a global panel. As Product Owner, your customers are the people using the app: you make sure they enjoy it, trust it and feel rewarded for every contribution. You bring product ideas to life, and engineering makes sure they scale. Scope management is a skill: you know when to extend and when to cut. Today we release a meaningful app version every 2–3 weeks, and expect just 1–2 as the engineering team grows. Support is part of the product: you own and manage customer support for our panelists, with the access and tooling to serve them well. The app store rating is one of your core KPIs, and it's shared across teams.
