items.desc: Job Description Contractify and Legile are two Belgian legaltech companies in the same group. Togetherwe build one platform: contract management plus AI that reads and analyses legaldocuments. It runs in production and is used daily by hundreds of customers. We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer to own the AI layer of that platform: retrieval,orchestration, the prompts and models behind document comparison, clause extraction,redrafting and anonymisation, and the evaluation that tells us whether it works. Much ofthat knowledge sits with external partners today. Your job is to bring it in-house and buildon it. Why this role Our users make decisions based on what the system returns. A hallucination is a risk. Amissed clause is a problem for a lawyer. The foundations are there: multi-tenant setup, RAG, document comparison,anonymisation, a growing customer base. What is missing is one person who understandsevery pipeline end to end, measures quality, and decides when a new model or approachis worth it. You work in one product and development team across Contractify and Legile,with one backlog, next to the full-stack engineers who take your work to production. What does your day look like? Retrieval: how the platform finds the right passages in large volumes of legal text:chunking and embedding strategies, vector and hybrid search that handles cross-references and defined terms. Target: recall above 85% and latency under 500 ms onmore than 10,000 Belgian legal documents. Orchestration and agents: the workflows that chain LLM steps for documentcomparison, clause extraction, redrafting and anonymisation, plus a multi-agent setupthat monitors legal and regulatory changes and alerts only when it matters. Domain-specific models: build annotated legal datasets with our in-house legalexperts, using as little of their time as possible, and use them to test and adapt modelsfor clause comparison, citation accuracy and multi-turn Q&A. Decide with data whenfine-tuning beats prompting. Prompts and models: version and test the prompts and model settings behind each pipeline. Evaluate new models and decide when to switch. Evaluation: build the evaluation setup for retrieval quality, hallucination detection and regression testing on real documents, so "is the AI getting better?" has a number behind it. Document understanding and integrations: OCR and layout analysis, structured extraction, anonymisation of personal data before it reaches a model, and a plugin architecture that connects the AI layer to several document management systems. Predictive compliance (R&D): explore whether contract data, a graph database and time-series models can flag compliance risks early. Internal AI agents: we are building agents and automations for our own sales, marketing and customer success teams with an external partner. You are the technical owner on our side: where they run, how they are secured, and how they keep running once the partner steps back. Knowledge: take over the AI/ML knowledge from our external partners, document it, and be the person the team turns to for LLM, retrieval and evaluation questions. AI-native development: you use AI coding tools daily for coding, requirements and tests. The team is being coached on this; you help build the shared assets (skills,guardrails, agent workflows) and keep them up to date afterwards. What do we offer you? A competitive salary package Real R&D, partly funded by Flemish innovation grants (VLAIO) A live product with real users: your work is visible from day one Ownership of the AI core: your choices on retrieval, orchestration and evaluation shape the roadmap In-house legal experts who validate what the AI produces Hybrid work from our Ghent offices and home work Learning budget: conferences, courses, certifications Part of a larger technology group, with the network and career options that come with it. Job Requirements What are we looking for? Your technical skills 3+ years building LLM-based applications, retrieval systems or NLP for real users, with strong Python Hands-on RAG experience: chunking, embeddings, vector search (pgvector or similar), hybrid search, re-ranking An LLM orchestration or agent framework, and a view on when not to use one Experience evaluating AI systems: retrieval metrics, hallucination detection, regression sets At home in a production codebase: Git, PR reviews, tests, Docker, cloud You use AI coding tools daily and can show how they make you faster without lowering quality Your soft skills You are pragmatic about AI. You can read a paper on retrieval and have a working version running the same week, then measure whether it helped. When someone says "the AI sometimes gets this wrong", you build the test set before youbtouch the prompt. You have opinions on prompts, models and evaluation, and changebthem when the data says so. You don't need to be a lawyer, but legal text should interest you rather than put you off. Your degree Master's in Computer Science or AI, …

items.desc: Job description As an AI Engineer at Faktion, you'll work on a wide variety of projects across industries like manufacturing, finance, and operations. You don't just build prototypes. You do deep engineering, ship to production, and make sure what you build actually gets adopted and used. We are hiring a highly motivated AI Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You will work closely with software engineers, and product managers to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that drive measurable impact for our customers. Some key responsibilities: Designing and implementing end-to-end AI solutions spanning GenAI, classical ML, computer vision, and agentic systems, tailored to the specific needs of enterprise customers. Translating ambiguous customer problems into concrete technical architectures, engaging directly with clients to define requirements and align on objectives. Developing and deploying production-ready AI backends using tools like Python, FastAPI, and Docker, with a strong focus on reliability and scalability. Building and maintaining evaluation pipelines, including LLM-as-a-Judge agents, to ensure continuous quality assurance from development through to production. Developing and maintaining MLOps pipelines, including data preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, and monitoring. Conducting research to stay current with the latest advancements in generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and deep learning, and identifying opportunities to apply them for our customers. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure AI solutions align with broader business goals and customer expectations. Developing clear and concise documentation, including technical specifications and presentations, to communicate complex AI concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Providing technical mentorship and guidance to junior team members. Job requirements You have a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. A Master's or PhD is a strong plus. You have solid hands-on experience building and deploying AI systems, whether GenAI, classical ML, computer vision, or a combination. You are proficient in Python and have experience with relevant frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, LangChain, or LangFuse. You are comfortable working across the AI stack, from prompt engineering and RAG architecture to model training, evaluation pipelines, and cloud deployment. You are familiar with cloud-based platforms and services, such as Azure. You have experience with containerisation tools such as Docker and API development frameworks such as FastAPI. You possess strong problem-solving skills and can think critically and creatively to develop innovative AI solutions. You have strong communication skills and can effectively convey complex technical concepts to a diverse audience. You possess a proactive mindset and can work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in native Dutch and English (French is a plus). Following experiences are a plus: Showing your passion through GitHub repos, open-source contributions, or prior engagements in Kaggle competitions. Experience with computer vision techniques such as synthetic data generation, object detection, or image segmentation. Experience with MLOps tooling, including CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform. Exposure to agentic frameworks and multi-agent system design. Publications in relevant AI/ML conferences and journals. Experience in one of our focus domains: Data Quality, Retail, Manufacturing, Finance. We offer: A rewarding salary package that includes additional perks like a company car and fuel card or a mobility budget, comprehensive hospitalisation, group insurance, and a top-tier laptop and smartphone. Benefit from a company culture that stimulates both individual and team development, fostering professional growth. Utilise your innovation budget for engaging in exciting, educational, and challenging open-source projects within your guild. Participate in team-building activities and gatherings, a great opportunity to unwind and engage with our vibrant team initiatives. A flexible hybrid working policy to choose where, how, and when you want to work. At Faktion we build AI, and we use it thoughtfully in our own processes too. During your application, AI tools may help us with practical steps, like checking that your documents came through complete. They never decide who moves forward: every application is read by a real person on our team, and every decision is made by a human. Curious how this works, or how your data is handled? Just ask, we're happy to explain.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 Location: Welwyn/UK 
 Duration: 12 months 
 FTE: ~30 - 50% to work alongside your studies. 
 Type: Temporary Roche Employee 
 In Pharma Development Strategy and Delivery (PSD) , our mission is clear: to translate Roche Strategies into PD priorities and deliver our portfolio (Molecule & Molecule Enabling Programs) with excellence. 
 We see ourselves and our partners as a team that can only reach its full potential together. Driven by this collaborative spirit, our expertise, and an enterprise mindset, we create an environment where ideas grow and new ways of doing things are realized, accelerating the PD portfolio and delivering medicines to patients faster.
 The Opportunity 
 The PSD functions are global teams in R&D that are looking to improve their internal activities and ways of working: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of our organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces with groups and functions across PD. 
 To support our digitalization journey, we are looking for a talented and driven Digital, Agentic graduate with a passion for eliminating wasteful and mundane tasks through innovative technology. In this role, you will be instrumental in enabling our organization’s transformation to Agentic AI by building agentic solutions for our internal business challenges. 
 You will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and business process analysis, ensuring our internal activities operate in a seamless, automated, and data-driven ecosystem. 
 As part of a global team, you will collaborate with experts coming from IT and PSD contributing to build solutions that enhance the productivity of our internal tool service and support teams, while maintaining the highest standards of data integrity, privacy, and security. 
 This role offers a unique opportunity to gain real-world exposure to late stage drug development and bring meaningful improvements to how we do our work. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identify Automation Opportunities: Act as an internal consultant, interviewing/working with end users in PSD, analysing historical information/data to scope and propose potential AI tools that could streamline daily tasks. 
 Business Process Analysis and Requirements Gathering: Seek input from the PSD functions to pinpoint recurring operational delays or pain points where automation and AI could provide benefits. Provide a technical perspective on how challenging the solutions would be to build and maintain to inform decisions on prioritisation of use cases. Analyze, map, and define requirements for specific use cases. Partner with the PSD functions to evaluate the value and scalability of solutions before starting any building beyond proof-of-concepts 
 Agentic AI Solutions: Combine your technical knowledge in Agentic AI, our internal systems and data architectures, and work with business experts and IT colleagues to build and enable scalable agentic solutions. 
 Responsible AI & Compliance: Build and implement all solutions in line with Roche's defined AI standards, including Human-in-the-Loop design, ethical AI principles, and the use of approved technology only. Maintain strong awareness of data privacy and GxP requirements given the sensitivity of working within a pharma R&D environment, ensuring solutions are compliant, auditable, and safe to scale. 
 Secure & Compliant Working Practices: Follow Roche's guidelines for secrets/credential management & confidentiality when building & testing solutions, escalating any data security or privacy concerns to the lead for review. 
 Data Modernization: Support our digitalisation efforts by driving the standardization and migration of data from legacy systems/tools to AI-ready modern architectures for scalability and performance. 
 Documentation: Ensure robust documentation to ensure sufficient details of technical development and testing are available for others to pick up and use in the future. 
 Partner & Collaborate with the PSD AI Squad: Participate in global teams across our organization in support of digitalisation initiatives, working with PSD leaders and IT professionals to bring value to our organization at scale. Ensure transparency on progress and risks identified with the Squad and PSD leadership. 
 System Awareness: Develop and maintain an awareness of the Roche organization and key organizational drivers. Work within existing Roche procedures to drive progress.

items.title: Data Historian System Owner
items.card: About the Role We are looking for a Data Historian System Owner to lead the operational reliability, maintenance, and long-term evolution of our site Data Historian landscape across Basel and Kaiseraugst. In this role, you will oversee key operational and monitoring systems, including Aveva PI Platforms and Rotronic Monitoring Systems (RMS) ensuring high availability, system performance, and regulatory compliance
items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Data Historian System Owner to lead the operational reliability, maintenance, and long-term evolution of our site Data Historian landscape across Basel and Kaiseraugst. In this role, you will oversee key operational and monitoring systems, including Aveva PI Platforms and Rotronic Monitoring Systems (RMS) ensuring high availability, system performance, and regulatory compliance while supporting our site's digital maturity in line with the PT Strategy. You will bridge IT and OT domains and support end-to-end Make Assess Release (MAR) processes in a dynamic pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 
 The Opportunity: 
 System Operations & Management: Oversee the daily operations of site Data Historian systems to guarantee high availability, reliability, and robust performance. Systems in scope include PI Monitoring Systems and Platforms for Basel and Kaiseraugst, as well as Rotronic Monitoring Systems (RMS) across both sites. 
 Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Plan and execute routine maintenance, updates, and system upgrades. Promptly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to the Data Historian infrastructure. 
 Architecture & Strategy Alignment: Oversee the IT/OT technological landscape and its integration across the site, supporting the digital maturity goals of the PT Strategy and end-to-end Make Assess Release (MAR) processes. 
 Optimization & Innovation: Design and implement performance optimization strategies to enhance data collection, retrieval, and analytics. Stay abreast of emerging Data Historian technology trends and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Process Owners, process engineers, IT teams, Business Integration Managers, and Technical Product Leads to align technical capabilities with operational requirements and business opportunities. 
 Compliance & Documentation: Maintain strict adherence to GxP standards, Safety, Health and Environment (SHE) regulations, and internal company policies. Ensure comprehensive documentation of system configurations and operating procedures. 
 Who you are: 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biology, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (Master’s or PhD is a plus). 
 Professional Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in global and complex business environments, with proven IT/OT domain expertise in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, particularly within manufacturing and Technical Operations. 
 Technical Expertise: Proficiency in Data Historian platforms, specifically Aveva PI and Rotronic RMS . Solid understanding of SQL databases, network infrastructure, and industrial communication protocols. Practical experience working with data visualization and analytics tools. Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical technologies and processes, including digital plant, shop floor automation, quality lab systems, and overall system architecture integration. 
 Methodology & Mindset: An entrepreneurial problem solver who applies lean and agile principles, focusing on pragmatic solutions and a "Reuse before Buy before Make" philosophy. 
 Soft Skills & Leadership: Strong negotiation, analytical, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across global and local levels. Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, foster trust, and champion a speak-up culture. 
 Language Proficiency: Proficient in both German and English . 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

As Apple's EMEIA business continues to scale across distribution, carrier, retail, and enterprise channels as well as Services the Credit team's judgement
items.desc:
The Worldwide Finance organisation is a key strategic partner across all of Apple's businesses, and the Credit team sits right at the centre of that mission — protecting the balance sheet while enabling Apple's channel and enterprise partners to grow with us. As Apple's EMEIA business continues to scale across distribution, carrier, retail, and enterprise channels as well as Services the Credit team's judgement directly shapes how confidently and quickly the business can expand into new markets and partnerships, making this a function where sound analysis has an outsized, visible impact.
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. At Apple, we craft products and experiences people once couldn't have envisioned and now can't imagine living without. If you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, a career with Apple might be your ideal job. Just be prepared to dream big!
We believe that collaboration is one of our key strengths, and every day we will connect you with your peers and colleagues, at one of the most diverse companies in the world. As an individual, you'll be a key player within the function.
Based in London, this is an opportunity for a highly analytic credit risk specialist to join the EMEIA Credit team, helping ensure robust, commercially sound credit decisions that support the continued growth of Apple's business across its distribution, carrier, and retail partner network in the region.
Bachelor degree required; preference in business with concentrations in accounting, finance and economics
Formal credit training from corporate bank, credit rating agency or multinational corporate credit.
2–5 years of credit and risk analysis experience, preferably within a bank, finance institution or rating agency focused on illiquid credit-related investment analysis.
Commercial credit and risk assessment experience, with sound judgement in applying it to real customer situations.
Understanding of sovereign and FX risks across emerging and developed EMEIA markets.
Strong financial statement analysis skills and a solid grasp of core credit dynamics.
Developing negotiation skills, with the ability to balance risk mitigation against stakeholder interests.
Working knowledge and familiarity of evaluating risk mitigation instruments such as bank guarantees, standby letters of credit and corporate guarantees, with a willingness to build deeper expertise in their legal and operational mechanics.
Comfortable working across functional teams and contributing a clear, well-reasoned Credit perspective on multi-team projects.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, able to present credit analysis and recommendations concisely within Apple and to customers' finance teams.
Experience analysing telecommunications, distribution, or retail industry segments, a strong plus.
Trade credit assessment / collections experience, a plus.
SAP systems, Tableau, SQL and an interest in automated AI workflows would be a plus.
Intellectually curious, confident, adaptable, with strong time management skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
The Technology & Innovation Center (HTIC) is GE HealthCareʼs global innovation engine, operating through two major hubs (Niskayuna, NY, USA & Bangalore, India) with a highly specialized, multidisciplinary team spanning imaging physics and systems, microelectronics, AI, biosciences, electromagnetics, robotics, materials science, and advanced system engineering. HTICʼs purpose is to drive disruptive innovation that delivers step-change performance improvements in current platforms while pioneering next-generation and cross-segment technologies that lead to new business opportunities. HTIC also proposes and wins external grant awards, typically from the US government (NIH, BARDA, ARPA-H, etc.). The organization’s redefined operating model, culture, and governance are enabling greater agility, stronger clinical and business segment partnerships, and the acceleration of disruptive solutions that position GE HealthCare to drive the future of healthcare.
As a Technician in the Superconducting Magnet team at HTIC, you will carry out a broad range of complex engineering assignments supporting the development of novel superconducting magnet prototypes, including magnet coil winding, cold mass build-up, and cryostat assembly. Assignments may include but are not limited to set-up and operation of data acquisition equipment, execution of experiments, troubleshooting of hardware/test systems, documentation and reporting of test results. The Superconducting Magnet Technician also supports compliance and quality activities within the lab and serves as a technical resource for other team members. 
 Job Description 
 Job Responsibilities 
 Apply initiative and independent judgment to build, evaluate and improve complex magnet assemblies and test setups from conceptual descriptions and ideas.
 Collaborate with the team to identify potential failure modes in advance and carry out advanced troubleshooting across multiple interacting variables, driving thorough root cause analysis, and lasting solutions.
 Propose and execute experiments and diagnostic tests to develop conclusions and solutions. 
 Will have opportunities to take the lead on hardware evaluations, planning and executing them using knowledge of magnet construction, system operation, and specialized engineering tools, with guidance from engineers and scientists.
 Communicate recommendations that improve design, manufacturing process, reliability, functionality, serviceability, and workflow, including input on externally sourced components and materials.
 Own day-to-day operational responsibilities spanning EHS, purchasing, inventory control, workspace organization, documentation, and task prioritization.
 Work with the management team to lead and deploy technical and EHS training plans, as needed.
 Comply with EHS regulations and policies.
 Requirements/ Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in engineering or technology related field or Associate's degree with 5 to 7 years' experience in electromagnetic coil or electronics winding. 
 Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to understand and address root causes of mechanical issues in magnet fabrication in investigational prototypes.
 Ability to draw accurate conclusions from test data, malfunctions, or deviations, and coordinate implementation of corrections to the existing design or process
 High proficiency in interpreting and explaining complex technical information.
 Adaptable to changes to work priorities and design decisions
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Demonstrated ability to work effectively both within a collaborative team setting, and independently.
 Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. You will need to have valid, on-going authorization to work in the U.S.
 Must be willing to work out of an office located in Niskayuna, NY.
 Desired Characteristics 
 Hands-on experience in superconducting magnet coil winding, magnet cold mass and cryostat assembly.
 Hands-on experience in developing instrumentation and data acquisition systems (DAS), such as National Instruments LabVIEW based DAS system.
 Strong team player who prioritizes collective performance.
 Demonstrated ability to originate and follow through on ideas.
 High levels of curiosity and independent thinking.
 Strong interpersonal skills.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Un poste d'ingénieur modélisation et simulation est ouvert au sein de l'équipe "Mission Algorithms & Analyses". Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique de 13 ingénieurs spécialisés dans la conception d'algorithmes de planification pour les systèmes d'observation de la Terre. Vous serez intégré au département TSEGM « Mission & Control Engineering & Products », dans la direction « Upstream Ground Systems » (TSEG) d’Airbus D&S – Space Systems Engineering (TES).
 Vous piloterez le développement de simulateurs de performance pour les besoins de furturs programmes d'observation et d'écoute Vous serez garant de la qualité de ces logiciels et du respect dans la conception des normes, règles et politiques internes. Vous aurez en charge la réalisation des bilans de performance mission, et serez en interface directe avec les ingénieurs systèmes responsables de nos programmes d'observation de la Terre. Vous serez amenés à échanger régulièrement avec d'autres équipes métier, afin de consolider les bilans de performance des systèmes.
 Vous contribuerez à des propositions techniques en réponse à appel d’offres de nos clients commerciaux ou de Défense. Vous serez impliqué dans la capitalisation de nos compétences techniques et métier. Vous serez amené à coordonner des activités techniques : suivi de l’avancement, gestion du budget, encadrement des activités en interne et en sous-traitance.
 Vous serez régulièrement sollicité pour présenter les résultats d'analyses et faire le lien avec les programmes opérationnels et les opportunités d'industrialisation.
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.
 Missions principales et responsabilités : 
 Vous serez responsable des activités principales suivantes :
 Pilotage du développement de simulateurs représentatifs des systèmes opérationnels et des analyses de performance associées,
 Validation de nouveaux concepts de programmation mission,
 Mise en place d’outils permettant le suivi des tâches et assurant la qualité du logiciel,
 Interface avec le système, la BU, nos partenaires externes, les équipes d'ingénierie sur les sujets liés à la performance mission,
 Rédaction de rapports de performance et présentation de résultats d'études,
 Rédaction d'URD et de manuel utilisateur des simulateurs,
 Interactions régulières avec les ingénieurs systèmes, les architectes mission, les spécialistes métier (SCAO, QI et autre),
 Amélioration continue de l’environnement de développement, proposition et mise en place d’outils permettant le suivi des tâches et assurant la qualité du logiciel,
 Participation à la rédaction de réponse à appel d’offres, au chiffrage d'activités et à la mise en place de planning,
 Revue et cross-validation des performances mission produites par nos partenaires.
 Compétences requises : 
 Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
 - Titulaire d'un diplôme d’ingénieur généraliste avec une spécialisation dans les systèmes spatiaux,
 - Une expérience de 7 ans minimum dans le domaine des systèmes d'observation de la terre avec une connaissance des contraintes liées à la planification/l'opération de ces systèmes,
 - Une expérience en tant que product owner ou scrum master sur du développement logiciel avec la coordination d'une équipe de développeurs,
 - Maitrise du langage Java et C++ ainsi que de l'environnement et des outils de développement associés (Eclipse, Maven, Git, Docker, Artifactory, CI/CD, ...),
 - La connaissance du langage Python est un plus,
 - Goût prononcé pour le travail en équipe et de fortes qualités humaines : bon relationnel, adaptation, proactivité, curiosité, autonomie, rigueur, communication orale et écrite,
 - Compétences linguistiques : Niveau de négociation en anglais.

items.desc:
Lieu : Ymare, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Notre site, proche de Rouen, se démarque grâce à nos équipes de conception visionnaires, d'intégration et d'installation pour les radars civils. Nous repoussons les limites avec des sous-ensembles hyperfréquences de pointe, spécialement conçus pour le domaine militaire. 
 Dans le cadre du développement de ses radars multi-fonction de dernière génération, notre secteur Radars Multi Fonctions (MFR) cherche un(e) Architecte afin de renforcer l'équipe "Design Authority". Les produits sur lesquels vous opérerez seront les radars Ground Fire et Sea Fire. 
 Votre mission se décline sur 2 axes :
 Vous êtes le référent écoconception du secteur MFR . A ce titre, vous proposez des évolutions des architectures radars, de leur développement et/ou de leur usage, en vue de trouver le meilleur équilibre entre les exigences environnementales, sociales, techniques et économiques. Vous assurez un rôle de conseil et d’alerte auprès de l’équipe Design Authority, notamment sur les thématiques suivantes :
 Conformité aux normes environnementales (ex : REACh, RoHS)
 Réduction de l’empreinte carbone et de la consommation d’énergie
 Sélection de matériaux durables
 Vous êtes le point de contact de la Design Authority auprès des équipes de production des radars Ground Fire et Sea Fire, basées à Ymare (76). Dans ce cadre, vos missions sont :

items.desc:
As a Hardware Verification Engineer - Charging Systems (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring the performance, safety and reliability of our charging solutions for hearing devices.
 You will combine hands-on electronics testing with Python-based test automation, developing test setups and verification methods that bring our products through development and towards market readiness. Working at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and system verification, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to turn complex technical requirements into robust, measurable and reliable solutions.
 This is an opportunity to take ownership of verification activities throughout the product lifecycle while contributing directly to products that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.
 More about the role 
 Design, build, calibrate and continuously improve test setups and measurement benches for the verification of charging solutions
 Develop and maintain automated verification frameworks and test scripts, with a strong focus on Python
 Plan and execute experiments to assess charging behavior, power management, performance and safety mechanisms under realistic usage conditions
 Translate system requirements, design specifications and risk analyses into effective test conditions, test cases and test procedures
 Investigate test failures, analyze measurement data, identify root causes and collaborate with development teams to drive corrective actions
 Process, visualize and document test and measurement data to provide clear evidence of product performance and verification results
 Collaborate closely with hardware, embedded software and system engineers as well as Test Managers, external partners and colleagues across different sites
 More about you 
 BSc or MSc degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field
 Around 3–6 years of experience in verification and testing of electronic systems, ideally combining hardware and embedded firmware
 Strong Python skills for test automation, data processing and analysis
 Hands-on experience developing custom test setups using Raspberry Pi, Arduino or similar MCU-based platforms, combined with solid electronics and measurement know-how
 Practical experience troubleshooting electronic devices and a structured approach to root-cause analysis and problem solving
 A proactive, quality-focused and collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently in an international, cross-functional environment
 Excellent English communication skills; German skills are an advantage
 Experience with medical device development, C#, MATLAB, test management or relevant safety and regulatory standards is considered an advantage.
 More about what we offer 
 As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

items.desc: REQ-10124600 12/11/2026 IT Engineering Madrid, Spain ING Hubs At ING Hubs Spain we are looking for a Junior AI Engineer Your role and work environment. We're looking for an enthusiastic AI Engineer with a passion for cybersecurity and emerging technologies. This role is ideal for someone who is highly motivated to specialize in the secure adoption of AI and Agentic AI at enterprise scale. You will be part of a team that shapes how ING securely designs, deploys, and governs AI solutions by developing security capabilities, best practices, and controls that enable responsible AI innovation across the bank. AI Security & Safety Team This position is part of the AI Security & Safety Team, a newly established team within Global CISO responsible for enabling the secure and responsible adoption of AI across ING. The team monitors emerging AI developments and risks, research industry best practices, validates security standards, and collaborates with policy bodies, regulators, industry forums, research institutions, and universities to stay at the forefront of AI security and safety developments. The team translates these insights into practical security standards, guidance, and capabilities that help ING securely design, deploy, and operate AI and Agentic AI solutions at scale. CISO organization The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) protects ING's information, technology, and digital services against cyber threats while enabling secure innovation across the bank. The organization brings together capabilities across Identity & Access Management (IAM), Security Detection & Response (SDR), Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), and Attack Surface Management (ASM) to strengthen ING's cyber resilience, manage security risks, and support the secure adoption of emerging technologies, including AI. As Frontier AI capabilities continue to advance, ING is investing in dedicated expertise to understand their impact on cybersecurity, strengthen the bank's security posture, and ensure AI and Agentic AI solutions are designed, deployed, and operated securely at scale. The AI Security & Safety Team acts as the CISO's centre of expertise for AI security and safety. How to Succeed as a member of AI Security & Safety team? You combine a passion for software engineering skills with AI and cybersecurity. You stay current with advances in Frontier AI and are able to turn emerging technologies into practical, secure, and scalable solutions for ING. You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership from idea to deployment, and actively contribute to building AI security capabilities, standards, and best practices across the organization. You can effectively bridge software engineering, AI innovation, and security, helping ING adopt AI and Agentic AI safely and responsibly at scale. As an AI engineer, What to expect? Develop AI-powered applications and proof of concepts using frontier AI models, commercial AI services, and open-weight models. Evaluate, benchmark, and monitor AI systems to assess their capabilities, limitations, risks, and security implications. Design and implement solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI patterns. Build secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions aligned with security and governance requirements. Als AI Developer bouw je AI-toepassingen voor opdrachtgevers in onder andere de zorg, financiële sector, overheid en het onderwijs. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar werkende oplossingen en bent betrokken van concept tot implementatie. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwikkelen van AI-applicaties, API's en services met Python. Bouwen van RAG-systemen en datapipelines voor slimme informatieontsluiting. Integreren van LLM's, zoals OpenAI- en Anthropic-modellen, in bestaande software. Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van AI-oplossingen binnen cloudomgevingen. Samenwerken met andere developers en AI-specialisten binnen DevOps-teams. Denk aan AI-chatbots voor interne kennisdeling, intelligente documentanalyse of RAG-systemen die complexe informatie snel toegankelijk maken. Wat krijg je van ons? Bij Dev Talents werk je volgens het midlance-model. Je profiteert van een aantrekkelijke beloning, vrijheid in je werk en de zekerheid van een vast dienstverband. Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 7.500 en € 10.000, op basis van het midlance-model. Direct een vast contract. Zelf invloed op je opdrachten, werktijden en werklocatie. Onbeperkt aantal vakantiedagen. Opleidingen en trainingen via de House of Talents Academy. Een community van meer dan 60 senior developers en AI-specialisten. Technische kennissessies, kennisdeling en gezellige activiteiten met collega's. Wat breng je mee? Je bent een ervaren developer die verder kijkt dan alleen de technologie. Je denkt mee over de beste oplossing, experimenteert met nieuwe AI-toepassingen en weet hoe je deze vertaalt naar betrouwbare software. Daarnaast heb je: Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in softwareontwikkeling of data engineering. Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met AI, machine learning of LLM's. Sterke Python-kennis, bijvoorbeeld met FastAPI, LangChain of Pandas. Ervaring met LLM-platforms zoals OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot of Anthropic. Ervaring met Docker, Kubernetes en cloudplatforms zoals AWS, Azure of Google Cloud. Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau en uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands. Ervaring met NLP, deep learning of data-analyse is mooi meegenomen. Werken bij Dev Talents Bij Dev Talents vind je een thuisbasis voor developers die willen blijven groeien. Je werkt zelfstandig aan uitdagende AI-projecten, maar kunt altijd sparren met ervaren vakgenoten. Geen micromanagement of standaard carrièrepad, maar persoonlijke aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling. We delen kennis, organiseren technische sessies en geven je de ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te ontdekken. Jij bepaalt welke richting je op wilt. Wij helpen je daar te komen. This is the moment for a new status quo: Just as autonomous driving will disrupt how we build cities, organize our days, and live our lives, so will we shift our whole reality around food. Our Team is backing a paradigm shift in one of humanity’s most important sectors with the sharpest minds in Robotics, AI, Engineering and Culinary, collaborating closely with industry-leading partners to revolutionize every aspect of the food service experience. Join us as we forge ahead, crafting a future where the art of cooking and the science of technology converge to create a world that thinks differently about food than it has for thousands of years – a world where food means something new. About the Role Design the mechanical modules of the next generations of our robotic kitchens and take them from first sketch to serial production. You will own entire modules and subsystems, from concept through prototyping and validation to release, and see your designs run in real commercial kitchens. You will work across Robotics, Electrical, Software, Culinary and Operations, and help shape how we engineer as we move from innovation to commercial scale. Your Daily Business Own one or more modules end to end, from early concepts and prototypes through validation and release. Design, test and release mechanical components and subsystems for our robotic kitchen. Drive DFM with suppliers and partners and manage the industrialization of your parts and assemblies. Work with Robotics, Electrical, Culinary, Production and Operations to deliver robust designs that scale. Improve existing modules for performance, manufacturability and cost. Write technical documentation, test plans and risk assessments, including FMEA and operability analysis. Help define our internal engineering standards and development processes. Base Qualifications A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 2–5 years designing mechanical systems and assemblies for complex mechatronic products, ideally for serial production. Strong parametric CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred) and the ability to produce manufacturing-ready technical drawings. Hands-on knowledge of manufacturing processes such as sheet metal, welding, 3D printing, injection molding and casting. A proven track record in prototyping, testing and validating mechanical systems, in both product innovation and production scaling. An AI-native way of working: AI tools are a natural part of your daily work, from exploring design concepts and running analyses to writing documentation. Familiarity with relevant norms, compliance standards and safety/risk analysis. A structured, solution-driven and entrepreneurial way of working, plus excellent English. Preferred Qualifications Experience with flow simulation and optimization of HVLS fans, axial fans, coolers, exhausts and air circulators. Experience in food-tech or commercial hardware. Kinematic design experience. German language skills. Our Offer Competitive Compensation: Competitive compensation package with stock option opportunities for full-time employees. Work-Life Balance: Regular team events, hybrid work setup, 2 months/year remote work (Worcation), unlimited vacation days, and a corporate pension plan. Personal Development: Personal budget for training, in-house trainings, and growth opportunities in a fast-paced environment. Mobility: Monthly budget for mobility or other expenses, a subsidized Dance Mobility Subscription for E-Bike/E-Moped, and bike leasing via JobRad. Well-Being: Discounted Urban Sports Club membership and Wellhub for a variety of well-being offerings.

items.desc: KCYS Castleisland 28 hours per week - A panel will be formed for part time posts as they become available and for the relief panel Job Summary UBU - Your Place Your Space project is a KCYS managed service funded under the Department of Education and Youth through Kerry Education & Training Board (KETB). The service identifies, recruits and engages targeted young people aged 10 to 24 years of age in areas of rural North Kerry, Tralee, Killarney, Castleisland and Listowel. Each project aims to provide young person centred out of school supports to young people in their local communities to enable them to overcome adverse circumstances and achieve their full potential by strengthening their personal and social competencies. UBU Project Workers develop and deliver youth work programmes and supports for predetermined, targeted young people (under the UBU Scheme) in the area. The post holder is an exceptional individual who endeavours to make a difference in the lives of young people and their families by promoting a culture of integrity and compliance within KCYS and by operating in line with our organisational mission, vision and values. Key Duties & Areas of Responsibility will include: Youth Engagement and Programme Delivery Identify and engage young people in the community who fall within the prescribed UBU target groups through outreach and engagement with schools, community organisations and other stakeholders. Develop and implement youth work programmes and supports tailored to the needs of targeted young people aged 10–24 in line with UBU service requirements. Plan and deliver a range of youth work methodologies including centre-based programmes, outreach work, detached youth work, structured drop-ins, group work and one-to-one supports. Develop strategies and interventions that support young people to strengthen their personal and social competencies and overcome adverse circumstances. Advocate for young people and promote youth participation methodologies, representing young people on both formal and informal platforms where appropriate. Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation In collaboration with the UBU Co-ordinator, develop and maintain work plans and timetables ensuring that at least 70% of working time is dedicated to direct face-to-face engagement with young people. Contribute to the development and quarterly updating of the project Logic Model to provide an overview of UBU-funded activities and outcomes. Evaluate programme delivery and youth work interventions using relevant project evaluation systems and quality standards. Support the planning and reporting processes of Kerry Community Youth Service (KCYS) and the UBU programme. Administration, Recording and Reporting Maintain accurate records of youth engagement, programme delivery and outcomes in line with organisational procedures and UBU reporting requirements. Prepare and submit information for Quarterly Planning and Progress Review Meetings and other reports as required by the KCYS UBU Co-ordinator. Adhere to required tools, templates and guidance to ensure all work is documented appropriately, and participate in testing new reporting systems where required. Undertake general administrative duties including report writing and record management. Partnership, Networking and Advocacy Build and maintain positive relationships with local communities, agencies, schools and services to support the identification and engagement of targeted young people. Participate in internal and external networks, interagency meetings, structures, training and events relevant to the role. Identify opportunities to enhance services and resources for young people, including pursuing funding opportunities where appropriate. Compliance, Governance and Organisational Responsibilities Ensure compliance with organisational policies and procedures including safeguarding, GDPR, health and safety and ethical practice. Being vigilant and adhering to KCYS procedures concerning the neglect or abuse of children with reference to Children First guidelines and procedures. Work in accordance with relevant quality frameworks including the National Quality Standards Framework (NQSF) and UBU programme requirements. items.desc: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it's Daniel Ricciardo's Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth's Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt's running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day. We're a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world's most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we'd love to explore how you can join us. Taking ownership and driving impact Being open to change and feedback Being passionate about our mission and our customers. Your Mission As a Minerals Expert within the Natural History & Finds category, part of the Collectables Supercluster, you will strengthen the quality and commercial performance of our Minerals auctions. You will use your specialist knowledge to curate authentic, attractive specimens, deliver a transparent auction experience, and drive buyer engagement. You will also help grow and diversify our global seller base, identify new commercial opportunities, and contribute to category-wide initiatives that support long-term growth. What You'll Do Curate high-quality Minerals auctions by evaluating specimens for authenticity, rarity, quality, and commercial appeal, ensuring accurate descriptions, strong photography, and realistic estimates. Drive commercial performance through informed curation decisions, competitive pricing, and the identification of valuable specimens and emerging market opportunities. Expand and diversify our seller base by partnering with Sales and Business Development to recruit new sellers, reactivate inactive sellers, and develop supply across new regions. Leverage your industry network to build relationships with miners, dealers, collectors, and specialist suppliers, unlocking new sources of supply and commercial opportunities. Lead category initiatives including special auctions, targeted seller activations, supply expansion projects, and cross-category opportunities within Natural History & Finds. Shape category strategy by using market insights, auction data, and specialist knowledge to identify growth opportunities and improve curation standards and processes. Collaborate across teams to support auction visibility, attract bidders, share expertise, and maintain professional relationships with sellers and internal stakeholders. What You'll Bring Deep expertise in Minerals, including mineralogy, geological contexts, specimen quality, rarity, authenticity, pricing, and market values. At least 5 years of professional experience in the Minerals trade, whether as a dealer, curator, collector, academic specialist, or commercial expert. An established industry network of Mineral dealers, miners, collectors, and specialist suppliers, with the ability to identify and develop new sources of supply. Strong commercial judgement, with experience in seller engagement, deal-making, auctions, or marketplaces, alongside an understanding of online buyer behaviour and curation best practices. An independent, proactive approach, with the ability to lead projects, identify opportunities, and contribute to shared category goals. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work across teams, build professional relationships, and resolve disputes constructively. Good digital literacy and fluency in English, with the ability to work in a fast-paced online environment. Additional languages and knowledge of Fossils, Meteorites, or other Natural History fields are an advantage. How We Work Work remotely as part of the Natural History & Finds category within the wider Collectables Supercluster. Collaborate closely with fellow Experts, Account Managers, Business Development, Marketing, and the Category Lead to achieve shared commercial and category goals. Take ownership of projects and initiatives while contributing to improvements in team processes, curation standards, and ways of working. Share specialist knowledge and market insights across Minerals, Fossils, Meteorites, and Archaeological Finds to support cross-category opportunities. Where You'll Be This is a 100% remote role based in one of our European locations: Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, or the United Kingdom. Why You'll Love Working with Us Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business. Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression. A culture of connection defines us . We're a passionate, …

items.desc: CBRE Business Services Organisation (CBRE BSO) is a part of CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com. Business Transformation Expert About the Role As a Business Transformation Expert, you will be the execution backbone of the Business Transformation Office (BTO). You will support Transformation Leads across the full project lifecycle — from discovery and analysis, through design, to delivery and post-go-live stabilisation. Your focus will be on coordination, documentation, data gathering, tracking and reporting, ensuring that transformation initiatives run smoothly, on time, and with high-quality artefacts. This is a hands-on role for someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented, and eager to develop into a future Transformation Lead. What You'll Do 1. Project Coordination Coordinate day-to-day activities across assigned transformation workstreams, tracking tasks, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and risks. Maintain project plans, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), action trackers, and decision logs. Organise and prepare workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder meetings — including agendas, pre-reads, logistics, and follow-ups. Capture accurate meeting minutes, decisions, and action items; follow up with owners to ensure timely closure. Support onboarding of new team members and external consultants to the project environment (tools, templates, ways of working). 2. Documentation and Process Artefacts Draft, format, and maintain transformation documentation: process maps, SOPs, RACI matrices, playbooks, business requirement documents, and knowledge transfer materials. Support process discovery by shadowing SMEs, taking structured notes, and translating them into first-draft process maps (BPMN) or narrative descriptions. Maintain the BTO template library, ensuring standards, version control, and consistency across projects. Prepare and format executive presentations, status decks, and steering committee materials under the guidance of Transformation Leads. Ensure all project artefacts are stored, tagged, and accessible in the agreed repositories (SharePoint, Teams, project tools). 3. Data, Tracking and Reporting Collect, clean, and consolidate operational and financial data required for baselining, business cases, and benefit tracking. Support the preparation of business cases by gathering inputs, populating financial models, and running basic sensitivity analyses under supervision. Produce weekly and monthly status reports, dashboards, and KPI trackers for individual projects and the BTO portfolio. Track realised savings, efficiency gains, and automation benefits versus baseline; flag deviations early. Maintain the BTO project pipeline and portfolio tracker, keeping status, RAG, milestones, and financials up to date. What You'll Need 2–4 years of professional experience in a PMO, business analyst, process improvement, transformation support. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders. High attention to detail and a genuine care for the quality of documentation and data. Solid proficiency in MS Office and comfortable using GenAI tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude) to accelerate research, drafting, and analysis. items.desc: Job Description: Summary The Privacy Officer is responsible for overseeing all activities related to the development, implementation, and maintenance of the organization’s privacy program in accordance with applicable data protection laws and internal policies. This role ensures the company’s compliance with privacy regulations (such as GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, or others) and fosters a culture of accountability and transparency regarding personal data use. The Privacy Officer serves as the subject matter expert on data protection issues and is a key liaison between legal, compliance, IT, information security, HR, marketing, and other departments to ensure privacy is integrated into all operations. Duties and Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the company’s privacy governance framework, including policies, procedures, and controls. Conduct regular reviews and updates of the privacy program to reflect changes in laws, regulations, and best practices. Monitor and interpret relevant global, national, and local privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) and advise the business accordingly. Oversee the data breach response process, including investigation, documentation, mitigation, notification, and remediation. Collaborate with Legal, IT, and Information Security to manage and report data breaches in compliance with applicable laws. Ensure company practices align with regulatory requirements and industry standards for data protection. Develop and deliver training programs for employees on privacy practices, policies, and legal obligations. Promote privacy awareness across the organization to embed a privacy-by-design culture. Lead Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for new or updated products, systems, or processes. Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and present a summary of identified risks along with proposed mitigating measures to the Data Protection Officer (DPO). Escalate relevant issues to the General Counsel, in accordance with escalation protocols. Advise staff on privacy-related matters and provide training to increase internal knowledge in this area. Act as the primary point of contact for regulatory authorities (e.g., Data Protection Authorities) and manage regulatory filings and reporting as required. Monitor Privacy mailbox. Review clients’ contracts from a data privacy perspective. Ensure data processing agreements/addendums (DPAs) and standard contractual clauses (SCCs) are in place where appropriate. Acts as the primary point of contact with our appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO). Oversee and manage requests from data subjects (e.g., access, deletion, correction, restriction, and portability). Ensure timely and compliant responses to data subject access requests (DSARs) and inquiries. Assist in performing GDPR/Data Privacy risk assessments and monitoring with other compliance and control functions, results are shared with Leadership on quarterly steering call as well as line of business leadership. Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit functions, ensuring timely follow-up on audit findings and exception remediation. Provide guidance to executives, staff, and employees on data privacy aspects. Participate in a multifaceted educational awareness and training program that focuses on the elements of the compliance program, policies, and procedures Ensure compliance with information security and privacy policies, procedures and workflows that refer to privacy or security breach incidents. Work closely with departments such as Legal, IT, Information Security, HR, Sales and other departments to embed privacy requirements into day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives. Advise product and technology teams on privacy-by-design and data minimization strategies. Evaluate third-party vendors for privacy compliance, contract negotiation, and ongoing oversight. Participate in the remediation exercises as required. Participate in strategic projects at the organizational level as required. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in law, Business, IT, or a related field. Advanced degree (Master of Laws (LLM), Master of Science (MSc) in Data Privacy, Data Protection, etc.) is a plus. Minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in privacy or data protection roles (total professional experience: 5–10 years; relevant privacy/data protection experience: minimum of 3–5 years within the total experience, specifically in roles focused on privacy or data protection) Proven experience in implementing and managing data privacy programs. Familiarity with regulatory regimes such as General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) / California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and others relevant to the business. Strong knowledge of global privacy laws and frameworks. Preferred Qualifications One or more of the following preferred: Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP/E, …

Job Summary As a Domain Consultant (DC) for Next-Gen Trust Security (NGTS), you are the premier technical subject matter expert for Palo Alto Networks' Machine Identity Management portfolio. Following our integration with CyberArk, you will lead the technical charge in transforming how enterprises manage cryptographic trust. You will be responsible for defining technical solutions that secure critical business imperatives, evangelizing our "better together" integration of Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) and Zero-Touch Public Key Infrastructure (ZTPKI) within the Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) platform. You will serve as the technical bridge between the Network Security teams and Identity stakeholders, ensuring that enforcement systems (NGFW/SASE) stay synchronized as certificate lifecycles compress. Your Impact: Technical Win Leadership: Lead Proof of Value (PoV) engagements and technical validations for NGTS, ensuring a high technical win rate by demonstrating operational resilience and outage elimination. Solution Architecture: Design unified cryptographic governance models within Strata Cloud Manager that align certificate operations with network enforcement. Strategic Execution: Identify critical projects and actions required to achieve a customer's desired security end-state; eliminate sales obstacles through creative and adaptive problem-solving. Market Evangelism: Act as a thought leader on the "Cryptographic Reset," educating CISOs and VP-level stakeholders on the risks of 47-day certificate lifecycles and the path to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). Product Advocacy: Share industry experience regarding customer usage patterns to provide feedback to product teams on how to make NGTS/MIM easier for customers to adopt fully. Strategic Discovery: Conduct deep-dive discovery sessions to uncover unmanaged or "rogue" certificates using network-native discovery tools. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Solutions Consultants (SCs), Account Managers, and the CyberArk MIM Specialist team to build and execute account-based pursuit strategies. Platformization: Drive the adoption of Secure Flex credits by showing customers how to consolidate siloed CLM/PKI tools into a centralized control plane. Qualifications Professional Background: 5+ years of Sales Engineering or Consulting experience with a proven track record in a cybersecurity software vendor. Deep Domain Expertise: Extensive experience in Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), PKI architecture (ZTPKI, Microsoft ADCS), and SSL/TLS protocols. Technical Proficiency: Experience with automated provisioning (ACME, SCEP), Cloud-native connectors (Azure, GCP, AWS), and hardware/virtual security appliances. DevOps & Modern Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with DevOps tools (Terraform, Git, Kubernetes, Ansible) and container technologies (Docker) is a significant benefit. Network Security Foundation: Strong understanding of NGFW, SASE, and GlobalProtect architectures, particularly how they handle decryption, inspection, and certificate-based authentication. Consultative Selling: Proven ability to simplify complex cryptographic concepts into business-value outcomes (e.g., preventing service outages). items.desc: About Mini Athletics Mini Athletics delivers high-energy, story-led sports sessions that help children fall in love with moving. Every club is an “adventure” — one minute we’re explorers, the next we’re superheroes — and the children buy in because the coach brings it to life. We’re now hiring coaches to lead after-school clubs across Cambridge, every weekday . The Role You’ll deliver 1-hour after-school sessions for children aged 4–8 in primary schools around Cambridge. This is not a “stand at the front and talk” coaching job. The best Mini Athletics coaches are physical describers — you show it, shape it, model it, exaggerate it, and make it make sense in a child’s body (not just in their head). What You’ll Do Lead fun, structured, story-led after-school sessions (ages 4–8) Bring the adventure to life: big energy, big character, big engagement Demonstrate movements clearly and confidently (we want showers , not talkers) Help children build confidence, coordination, listening and teamwork — without it feeling like “PE” Manage behaviour in a positive, upbeat way so every child can thrive Set up and pack away simple equipment safely Communicate professionally with school staff and parents when needed Who We’re Looking For You’ll be a great fit if you: Are happy to act silly , be loud (when needed), and stand out — for the children’s benefit Can step outside your comfort zone and commit to the role (even if it feels a bit mad at first) Have naturally high energy and can keep it going for a full session Prefer demonstrating over explaining: children copy what they see Enjoy working with 4–8 year olds and understand they learn through doing Are reliable, organised and professional with schools No sports qualifications needed. If you can bring the energy and coach in a way that children feel and understand , we can teach you the rest. Why Coaching 4–8 Year Olds Makes You a Stronger Coach Coaching this age group gives you a foundation that transfers to any sport, any age, any level. Why? Because children don’t learn by being talked at — they learn through clear demonstrations, simple cues, and physical understanding . If you can coach 4–8s well, you can coach anyone. items.desc: About Academy Royale International Academy Royale International (ARI) runs award-winning academic summer schools for students aged 10 to 18. Since 2004, more than 50,000 students from over 175 nations have studied with us, living and learning on campus at colleges of the University of Oxford and the University of Cambridge, and at Marlborough College. Our students go deeper into subjects they love, from medicine, law and engineering to artificial intelligence, business and English language, in discussion-led classes with expert tutors. We hold the 2024 King's Award for Enterprise for International Trade and have won three Queen's Awards for Enterprise. items.desc: At ING Hubs Spain we are looking for a Junior AI Engineer Your role and work environment: We're looking for an enthusiastic AI Engineer with a passion for cybersecurity and emerging technologies. This role is ideal for someone who is highly motivated to specialize in the secure adoption of AI and Agentic AI at enterprise scale. You will be part of a team that shapes how ING securely designs, deploys, and governs AI solutions by developing security capabilities, best practices, and controls that enable responsible AI innovation across the bank. AI Security & Safety Team This position is part of the AI Security & Safety Team, a newly established team within Global CISO responsible for enabling the secure and responsible adoption of AI across ING. The team monitors emerging AI developments and risks, research industry best practices, validates security standards, and collaborates with policy bodies, regulators, industry forums, research institutions, and universities to stay at the forefront of AI security and safety developments. The team translates these insights into practical security standards, guidance, and capabilities that help ING securely design, deploy, and operate AI and Agentic AI solutions at scale. CISO organization The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) protects ING's information, technology, and digital services against cyber threats while enabling secure innovation across the bank. The organization brings together capabilities across Identity & Access Management (IAM), Security Detection & Response (SDR), Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), and Attack Surface Management (ASM) to strengthen ING's cyber resilience, manage security risks, and support the secure adoption of emerging technologies, including AI. As Frontier AI capabilities continue to advance, ING is investing in dedicated expertise to understand their impact on cybersecurity, strengthen the bank's security posture, and ensure AI and Agentic AI solutions are designed, deployed, and operated securely at scale. The AI Security & Safety Team acts as the CISO's centre of expertise for AI security and safety. How to Succeed as a member of AI Security & Safety team? You combine a passion for software engineering skills with AI and cybersecurity. You stay current with advances in Frontier AI and are able to turn emerging technologies into practical, secure, and scalable solutions for ING. You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership from idea to deployment, and actively contribute to building AI security capabilities, standards, and best practices across the organization. You can effectively bridge software engineering, AI innovation, and security, helping ING adopt AI and Agentic AI safely and responsibly at scale. As an AI engineer, What to expect? Develop AI-powered applications and proof of concepts using frontier AI models, commercial AI services, and open-weight models. Evaluate, benchmark, and monitor AI systems to assess their capabilities, limitations, risks, and security implications. Design and implement solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI patterns. Build secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions aligned with security and governance requirements. Share knowledge and insights to advance the organization's understanding of AI technologies, opportunities, and risks. What do you bring? Education & experience Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. 2+ year experience n AI Engineering, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, or a related discipline. Core technical stack Advanced Python, SQL, PyTorch/TensorFlow (SAS is an advantage) Familiar with software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code quality, software architecture, and distributed systems design. GenAI & data capabilities Exposure to LLMs, generative AI or AI applications development Familiar with HuggingFace (Transformers, PEFT), LangChain/LlamaIndex, Vector Stores (FAISS/Vertex Search), designing and optimising RAG pipelines. Familiar with frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar. Interest in emerging AI protocols and standards, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, tool-calling, and multi-agent architectures. Platforms & engineering Familiar with cloud platforms such as Azure, GCP, AWS. Experience with Azure DevOps (Git, Pipelines) Familiar with end-to-end pipelines (data → model → deployment) Way of working Conformable working in Agile/Scrum teams Strong willingness to learn and continuously develop your skills Collaborative mindset and good communication skills What do we offer? Ce projet consiste à explorer l'apport du machine Learning aux systèmes de contrôle aérien, et plus précisément dans l'exploitation des données de vol et de contrôle. Dans ce cadre, l’objectif de ce stage est de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre une solution permettant de structurer, centraliser et valoriser des informations, afin de faciliter leur exploitation et de préparer de futurs usages en analyse de données et en intelligence artificielle. Gagnez en autonomie en portant vos idées de la recherche jusqu’à leur mise en œuvre, aux côtés d’experts passionnés. Chez CS, nous offrons : Une expérience collaborateur enrichissante, portée par un environnement de travail conçu pour favoriser la flexibilité, l’autonomie et le bien-être au quotidien. items.desc: Internship contract | Belval | 6 Months Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that processes regulatory documents and serves as a critical tool for compliance analysis. You will contribute to create a multi-layered system with real performance requirements and measurable impact Code Development (60%): · Enhance the retrieval algorithm by implementing adaptive weighting based on query characteristics · Add comprehensive document validation pipeline with format detection, quality scoring, and automatic preprocessing · Implement advanced chunk optimization strategies. · Build evaluation frameworks to systematically measure retrieval performance · Optimize vector database indexing pipeline for faster document ingestion Research & experimentation (25%): · Test different embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline · Explore cross-lingual capabilities for multilingual EU regulatory documents · Research and prototype graph-based retrieval for document relationships · Experiment with multi-agent systems and workflow orchestration platforms. System integration (15%): · Enhance the Streamlit interface with advanced filtering and search capabilities · Integrate new LLM backends and optimize prompt engineering · Implement comprehensive logging and monitoring for production deployment Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now! Education · Advanced degree (Master’s or Bachelor’s final year) in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, NLP, Information Retrieval, or related quantitative field with strong ML coursework Experience and skills Must Have: · Strong Python programming (you'll be reading and modifying 1000+ lines of existing code) · Understanding of vector spaces, cosine similarity, and basic ML concepts · Experience with at least one ML framework (scikit-learn, transformers, etc.) · Familiarity with data structures and algorithms · Git proficiency for collaborative development Highly valued: · Previous work with LangChain, or similar retrieval systems · Experience with NLP libraries (spaCy, NLTK, transformers) · Understanding of information retrieval concepts (BM25, TF-IDF, relevance scoring) · Experience with Streamlit or similar web frameworks · Knowledge of evaluation methodologies for ML systems Language skills • Fluency in English (and French), both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.
