Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Engagés à vos côtés, au service de vos enjeux critiques. Accélérer la transformation industrielle, en toute sécurité. Notre Business Unit Industrie accompagne les leaders des secteurs de l’aéronautique, de l’énergie et du transport dans la conception, la sécurisation et l’optimisation de leurs systèmes critiques. Avec plus de 700 collaborateurs en France et en Amérique du Nord, elle mobilise une expertise reconnue permettant la réalisation de projets innovants dans les domaines des systèmes embarqués, de la simulation numérique, de la cybersécurité, de la data intelligence et de la digitalisation des processus industriels. Identifier les besoins métiers des responsables d'activité. Définir l'architecture d'une solution d'assistance basée sur l'IA. Développer des outils permettant : l'analyse automatique des indicateurs de pilotage ; la synthèse de données issues de différentes sources ; la génération de tableaux de bord intelligents ; l'identification des risques et opportunités ; la formulation de recommandations d'actions. Évaluer les performances et la pertinence des résultats obtenus. Travaux envisagés Phase 1 : Analyse du besoin Recueil des besoins auprès des responsables d'activités. Rédaction d’un document de spécification technique et fonctionnelle (avec identification des cas d’usage) Phase 2 : Veille technologique LLM, RAG. Agents IA. Techniques d'analyse prédictive. Phase 3 : Développement des outils Construction d'une base de connaissances. Développement d'agents IA métiers. Intégration des données issues : Excel ; SharePoint ; Teams ; outils de gestion de projet (comme PowerBI) ou autres. Phase 4 : Validation Cas d'usage réels. Comparaison avec les méthodes actuelles. items.desc: Software Engineer AI & Automation — CDI Paris 3 à 6 ans d'expérience | IA, automatisation, delivery client Le contexte Un cabinet de conseil historiquement positionné sur les secteurs pharma, biotech et industrie a lancé une toute nouvelle business unit dédiée à l’IA. L’idée : ne plus se contenter de recommander des solutions, mais les construire. L’équipe est aujourd’hui composée de trois personnes, un directeur, une responsable commerciale et un lead tech. Nous recrutons le quatrième membre. Ce n’est pas une ESN . Il n’y a pas de mission en régie, pas de solo chez le client. Les projets sont en forfait, les équipes sont internes, et ce qu’on livre tourne vraiment chez les clients. Ce que vous ferez concrètement Une partie du temps, vous êtes chez le client. Vous participez aux ateliers pour comprendre les processus métier, identifier ce qui coince, estimer ce qu’on peut automatiser et ce que ça rapporte. Vous travaillez avec des interlocuteurs qui ne sont pas développeurs, vous devez comprendre leur métier avant de proposer quoi que ce soit. L’autre partie du temps, vous codez. Vous prenez un périmètre en main de bout en bout : spécification, développement, tests, déploiement, documentation. Vous intégrez des LLM, vous construisez des agents, vous livrez des applications qui servent à quelque chose. Les solutions que vous développez alimentent progressivement notre software factory, des briques réutilisables qu’on peut redéployer chez d’autres clients sur des problématiques similaires. Vous travaillez en direct avec le lead tech, qui reste impliqué dans la conception et le code. Vous n’êtes pas seul, mais vous tenez votre périmètre. Ce qu’on cherche Vous êtes développeur. Pas consultant pur, pas data scientist, pas chercheur. Vous savez lire du code, en écrire, le déboguer et l’expliquer. Python est votre langage principal. Vous avez construit des APIs, travaillé sur du fullstack, utilisé Git et Docker au quotidien. Vous avez déjà intégré des LLM ou construit des pipelines RAG dans un projet livré à de vrais utilisateurs. Vous savez que ça ne s’arrête pas au prototype, vous avez géré la mise en production, les ajustements, la maintenance. Vous avez une expérience du développement agentique, sans dépendre d’un seul provider. Vous choisissez l’outil en fonction du problème, pas l’inverse. Vous utilisez les agents de développement (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) dans votre workflow, mais vous restez responsable de ce que vous livrez. La qualité du code et la cohérence architecturale, c’est votre affaire. Et vous aimez parler à des clients. Pas obligatoirement tout le temps, mais vous n’avez pas peur de rentrer dans la compréhension d’un métier que vous ne connaissez pas encore. Le profil 2 à 6 ans d’expérience, formation ingénieur ou équivalent en informatique ou génie logiciel. Une expérience en ESN, cabinet tech ou startup B2B avec livraison chez des clients réels. Anglais opérationnel. Basé IDF, à l’aise avec le présentiel. Rémunération : 45 000 à 60 000 € selon profil. CDI. Paris 16e.

Misión Te incorporarás al Centro de Excelencia de IA Generativa de Banco Sabadell, un entorno de innovación donde explorarás, evaluarás e impulsarás las capacidades de inteligencia artificial que marcarán el futuro de la organización. Serás una figura clave en la identificación de nuevas oportunidades tecnológicas, colaborando con equipos técnicos y de negocio para transformar tendencias emergentes en soluciones reales con impacto. Actuarás como referente interno en IA Generativa, ayudando a orientar decisiones estratégicas sobre modelos, arquitecturas y capacidades de nueva generación. Trabajarás de primera mano con las tecnologías más avanzadas del mercado, participando en iniciativas relacionadas con agentes inteligentes, capacidades multimodales, Small Language Models (SLM), modelos de contexto extendido y estrategias de soberanía tecnológica. Tu contribución será decisiva para definir la evolución de la estrategia de IA Generativa de Banco Sabadell en los próximos años, identificando y validando aquellas tecnologías capaces de generar un impacto tangible en la experiencia de cliente, la eficiencia operativa, la productividad corporativa y la transformación del negocio. Responsabilidades Liderar pruebas de concepto y pilotos tecnológicos sobre nuevas capacidades de IA Generativa para evaluar su viabilidad técnica y potencial de adopción Explorar nuevas tecnologías de IA Generativa y valorar su aplicación en casos de uso reales dentro del Banco Definir metodologías corporativas de evaluación, certificación y benchmarking de soluciones de IA Generativa Diseñar métricas y pruebas que permitan comparar modelos y evaluar aspectos como calidad, precisión, robustez, seguridad o coste Evaluar arquitecturas avanzadas como GraphRAG, Hybrid RAG, LongRAG, Agentic RAG y Corrective RAG, así como capacidades multimodales, long-context models y Small Language Models Colaborar con equipos de negocio, arquitectura, desarrollo, seguridad y gobierno del dato para garantizar la correcta adopción de las capacidades evaluadas Calificaciones Licenciatura o Ingeniería en disciplinas STEM (Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Telecomunicaciones, Física o similares) Se valorará formación de postgrado en Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning, Ciencia de Datos o disciplinas afines Habilidades requeridas Buscamos una persona con experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa y especial interés por entender cómo funcionan los modelos, cómo compararlos y cómo decidir qué tecnología es la más adecuada para cada caso de uso. items.desc: Stage de fin d’études : AI Engineer (H/F) Quickscale AI, Paris (hybride) Stage de fin d’études | Durée : 6 mois | Début : dès que possible | Gratification : 1 700 à 1 800 € brut par mois QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Fondé en 2023 à Paris, Quickscale AI est une société de conseil spécialisée dans le développement d’agents IA sur mesure pour des secteurs exigeants : finance, juridique, conformité, marketing. Nous aidons nos clients à concevoir et déployer des solutions d’IA fiables, auditées et réellement utilisées en production. Notre équipe combine excellence technique, rigueur scientifique et sens produit. Nous croyons à une IA utile, explicable et responsable, au service de la transformation des organisations. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l’avenir de l’IA en Entreprise ! VOTRE RÔLE En stage de fin d’études, vous rejoignez une squad de consultants qui mettent l’IA agentique en production chez nos clients. Vous développez des agents IA aux côtés de profils seniors, et vous participez à toutes les étapes d’un projet, du besoin métier jusqu’à la production. Concrètement, votre rôle couvre : le développement de systèmes agentiques (LLM, RAG, multi-agents, évaluation) ; la participation au delivery chez nos clients, du cadrage jusqu’au déploiement ; le suivi des sujets internes du cabinet, dont Quickscale Agents ; l’accompagnement des équipes métier dans l’adoption des solutions. Vous travaillez en équipe, avec un tuteur et un lead technique. Vous prenez rapidement des responsabilités réelles, et vous proposez des idées sans attendre qu’on vous les demande. VOS MISSIONS Conception et développement Comprendre un besoin métier et participer à sa traduction en solution agentique. Développer des agents IA : tool calling, workflows multi-étapes, RAG, intégration aux systèmes du client. Participer aux choix d’architecture avec le lead technique. Appliquer les standards techniques et les bonnes pratiques du cabinet. Delivery et industrialisation Participer à la mise en production des solutions (CI/CD, conteneurs, sécurité). Mettre en place des tests et des outils de suivi de la qualité des agents. Mesurer sur les données réelles du client la qualité, le coût et la latence. Améliorer les agents à partir des retours des utilisateurs. Relation client Participer aux ateliers de cadrage avec les équipes métier. Présenter des démonstrateurs et l’avancement de vos travaux. Accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des solutions. Projets internes Suivre et faire avancer les sujets internes du cabinet, en lien avec l’équipe. Travailler sur Quickscale Agents : nouvelles fonctionnalités, amélioration de la qualité et prise en compte des retours des utilisateurs. Exemples de projets Banque d’investissement : agent pour analystes crédit sur infrastructure GPU self-hosted. Luxe : agent qui raisonne sur le catalogue, les stocks et les boutiques. Secteur public : plateforme d’inférence LLM souveraine à grande échelle. Grande consommation : analyse d’insights consommateurs pour arbitrer un portefeuille de marques. Formation et transmission Participer à la création du contenu de nos formations en IA générative et agentique. Partager vos apprentissages avec l’équipe lors des revues techniques. R&D et innovation Suivre l’évolution des modèles, des agents et des outils d’évaluation. Transformer vos apprentissages en démos, composants et accélérateurs réutilisables. Prendre part à nos travaux de R&D sur les architectures agentiques (ex : self-learning agent), menés dans le cadre de notre statut de Jeune Entreprise Innovante (JEI). VOUS ÊTES AU BON ENDROIT SI VOUS AVEZ … Compétences techniques Une formation d’excellence : dernière année de Grande École d’Ingénieurs (Rang A/A+) ou de parcours universitaire scientifique de haut niveau, avec une convention de stage de fin d’études. Une première expérience concrète des LLM ou des agents IA : stage, alternance ou projet personnel, idéalement avec un système réellement utilisé. De solides bases en développement : Python, idéalement un autre langage comme TypeScript, ainsi que Git et Docker. Un français courant et un anglais professionnel. Un vrai sens de l’initiative : vous avancez même quand le sujet est flou, et vous proposez sans attendre qu’on vous le demande. L’esprit d’équipe : vous savez demander de l’aide et signaler tôt un blocage. L’envie de construire une IA utile et fiable, et l’exigence de ne rien livrer dont vous ne seriez pas fier. Une communication claire et structurée : vous savez expliquer un sujet technique à un interlocuteur non spécialiste. Une première exposition au conseil ou à la finance, au luxe, à la grande consommation ou au secteur public : c’est un plus. Posture et savoir-être Vous êtes curieux et vous vous appropriez vite un sujet métier. Vous êtes à l’aise à l’oral et vous aimez expliquer. Vous êtes proactif et force de proposition. Vous êtes exigeant sur la qualité de ce que vous livrez. Vous aimez le travail en équipe, la variété des sujets et le partage. POURQUOI …

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une Factory et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale. Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées. Description du poste NEXTON recrute un AI Engineer H/F, en CDI , à Paris ! Ton futur environnement de travail : Tu interviendras au sein de l'équipe AI Platform de l' AI Factory , qui construit et opère la plateforme agentique d'un grand groupe (socle unique sur lequel sont créés, déployés et exploités les agents IA). Tes missions : Au sein de l'équipe, tes missions seront les suivantes : Construction de la plateforme : Développer et faire évoluer les briques du socle agentique : orchestration d'agents, connecteurs MCP, skills, mémoire, gestion des prompts et garde-fous. Concevoir et industrialiser des agents : configuration des prompts, des tools, des connexions MCP et des guardrails. Concevoir et industrialiser les chaînes de RAG : ingestion, découpage, indexation, recherche et évaluation de la pertinence. Intégrer la plateforme aux sources de données et aux systèmes du groupe, notamment Snowflake et les APIs internes. Industrialisation et mise en production : Déployer les services sur AWS, avec conteneurisation, infrastructure as code et pipelines d'intégration et de déploiement continus. Mettre en place l'observabilité : logs, traces, métriques, alertes et suivi de la qualité des réponses. Construire les jeux d'évaluation et les tests automatisés des agents, pour mesurer les régressions avant chaque livraison. Assurer le run : traiter les incidents, améliorer la performance et la fiabilité, réduire la latence et les coûts. Accompagnement des utilisateurs de la plateforme : Aider les équipes AI Products et Business Science à porter leurs produits sur la plateforme. Appuyer les AI Builders sur les sujets techniques et rendre les briques du socle réutilisables et documentées. Contribuer aux revues de code et aux choix d'architecture de l'équipe. Qualifications Tu justifies d'une expérience de 4 ans minimum en ingénierie logicielle , dont une expérience réelle de mise en production d'applications à base de LLM, ainsi que d'une expérience de projets cloud et d'architectures en microservices. Tes qualités et compétences techniques indispensables sont les suivantes : Langages : Python. Frameworks : FastAPI, LangGraph / LangChain ou équivalent. Cloud AWS : Bedrock, ECS, S3, DynamoDB. Data : Snowflake, SQL. IA générative : RAG, agents ReAct, MCP, recherche sémantique et embeddings. Architecture : Conception d'API REST, microservices, OAuth2 et OIDC, injection de dépendances. Observabilité : Tracing distribué, logs structurés. Outils : Docker, Poetry, Git, CI/CD GitLab. (Seront également appréciés : TypeScript, Next.js, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, Kinesis, AWS Batch, bases vectorielles, workflows agentiques, fine tuning ou hébergement de modèles, Jira, ainsi qu'une expérience sur une plateforme interne mutualisée, dans les médias/télévision/streaming ou une sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité, de confidentialité et de conformité des données). Tes qualités et compétences transverses sont les suivantes : Vision plateforme & exigence technique : Capacité à travailler sur un socle partagé, avec des exigences de qualité, de sécurité et de maintenabilité. Communication : Français et anglais courants (les équipes étant réparties sur plusieurs pays) et capacité à expliquer un choix technique simplement. Esprit d'équipe et autonomie : Autonomie et goût du travail en équipe. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ? Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année : ▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours. ▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences. ▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser. ▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir. ▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce. ▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté. Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous ! NEXTON

items.desc: We are seeking a talented and experienced AI Engineer with a background in Data Science, Machine Learning, Backend development, or equivalent to join our professional services team of over 60 engineers, headquartered in Israel. The position is available full-time. This remote-first role focuses on Generative AI, specifically working with advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) and building AI agents. You'll work with state-of-the-art foundation models through platforms like AWS Bedrock and GCP Vertex AI to develop innovative GenAI applications and scalable AI infrastructure for our clients. The Mission At Opsfleet, we don't just "wrap" LLMs; we build autonomous, production-grade agentic systems. We are seeking an Engineer who understands that the future of AI isn't a single prompt, but a complex, stateful ecosystem of collaborating agents. You will be responsible for designing the cognitive architectures that allow multiple agents to negotiate, self-correct, and execute complex workflows in production. Core Responsibilities Agentic System Design: Architect and deploy complex Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) that move beyond basic RAG into autonomous reasoning, planning, and execution. Context Orchestration: Design and implement dynamic Context Management strategies, including sliding windows, semantic summarization, and token-efficient pruning to maintain long-term coherence without exceeding model limits. Tool-Use & API Synthesis: Expertise in Function Calling and Tool Definition ; specifically creating standardized interfaces using MCP for agents to interact with external APIs, databases, and local environments. Orchestration & Frameworks: You will be responsible for designing and implementing robust state-handling for long-running agentic tasks using LangChain , LangGraph , Agno , Strands , ADK , etc. Safety & Guardrails: Design and implement Production Safety Measures , including output sanitization, hallucination triggers, and autonomous circuit breakers to ensure reliability in high-stakes environments. Memory & Personalization: Build sophisticated memory layers that manage User Preferences and historical context, ensuring agents provide personalized, context-aware interactions over time. System Evaluations: Define and implement rigorous requirements for Agentic Evaluation , benchmarking trajectory consistency, tool-calling accuracy, and reasoning logic. Technical Stack & Requirements Software Design: 5+ years of Python experience with a focus on Modular Architecture and clean code principles. Agentic Frameworks: Expert-level proficiency in modern orchestration frameworks ( LangChain , LangGraph , Agno , Strands , ADK , etc.). Cloud Infrastructure: Deep experience with AWS Bedrock or GCP Vertex AI for enterprise-scale model deployment and agent hosting. Communication Standards: Hands-on experience with MCP for connecting agents to diverse data sources and tools, and A2A for cross-agent collaboration. Vector & Graph Databases: Proficiency in using Knowledge Graphs and vector storage to ground agentic reasoning and provide structured organizational memory. Preferred Qualifications Agent Engine Mastery: Direct experience working with AgentCore architectures and native Agent Engines (AWS Bedrock Agents / GCP Vertex AI Agent Engine). Multi-Modal Expertise: Experience building agents capable of synthesizing information across Text, Vision, and Video sources. The "Agentic Mindset": You can explain the difference between a linear chain and a directed acyclic graph (DAG), and you know exactly when an agent is the right tool vs. a simple workflow. The Reviewer’s Eye: Experience conducting deep technical reviews of AI implementations, identifying architectural bottlenecks or "lazy" agent logic. Production Battle Scars: You’ve dealt with agents getting stuck in infinite loops or hallucinating tool-calls, and you know how to build the infrastructure to prevent it. AI-Native Delivery (nice to have): Experience with Software Factories or the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC), meaning agentic pipelines where coding agents plan, write, test and review code with engineers in the loop. Why Opsfleet? Define Agentic Autonomy: You aren't just following tutorials; you are architecting the blueprint for how autonomous systems reason, collaborate, and execute. You will set the industry standards for agentic maturity, moving beyond simple task-execution into complex, self-correcting cognitive architectures. Complex Projects: Work on everything from internal coding agents to massive client-facing multi-agent orchestrators. Remote-First: A culture built by engineers, for engineers Employment: Full-time position (40 hours/week) Benefits: • Potential career paths • Collaborative remote team environment • Opportunity to contribute to open-source GenAI initiatives and research publications

items.desc:
If you want to explore the frontier of AI and prove what it can do, alongside great engineers and ambitious customers, we'd love to hear from you. 
You will be a Prototyping Architect in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering) team, based in Paris. 
- You are a hands-on AI builder who combines deep technical expertise with excellent interpersonal skills, helping enterprises across France and Europe South turn their most ambitious ideas into working technology proofpoints on AWS, with generative AI and agentic systems at the core of what you build.
- You work at the intersection of emerging technology and real customer problems. You take an ambiguous business challenge and co-build a real technical implementation of the solution, bringing generative AI, agentic systems, and cloud-native architectures together into a working prototype that proves what is possible on AWS.
- You thrive in ambiguity. Your customers are navigating generational technology shifts, foundation models, autonomous agents, intelligent automation, and you help them cut through the noise, make crisp technical decisions, and move fast. You work backwards from customer outcomes, you insist on the highest standards in design and delivery, and you grow at the frontier of the field.
- You spend most of your time hands-on-keyboard, pair-programming with customer engineers and alongside Prototype Engagement Managers, Solutions Architects, Specialists and partners. You deliver multi-week engagements that de-risk transformation and accelerate customers' paths to production. Just as importantly, you leave the customer's team more capable than you found them, transferring the skills and reusable foundations they need to take the solution forward themselves. 
This role is based in Paris, with French and English used day to day, and supports customers across France and the Europe South region. 
Key job responsibilities
● You partner with the Prototype Engagement Manager and local stakeholders across France and Europe South to technically qualify and scope new prototype opportunities.
● You support customers' agentic transformation with AWS, translating concrete business use cases into buildable prototypes and accelerating the path from idea to measurable business value and production adoption.
● You lead the design and implementation of prototype architectures, working alongside prototyping architects, solutions architects and other stakeholders, with a focus on Generative AI and agentic technologies (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon SageMaker).
● You deliver 3 to 6 week hands-on prototype projects with customers and partners in agile, collaborative development engagements.
● You drive continuous technical enablement and knowledge transfer to the customers and partners you work with, including modern AI-assisted development practices (AI-DLC, coding assistants such as Kiro and Claude Code).
● You develop and present technical demonstrations to senior business and technical leaders, and document your projects as appropriate, including the prototype report and path-to-production recommendations.
● You collaborate proactively with the wider AWS community, such as Solutions Architects and Service and Solution teams, to ensure the best possible customer outcomes during engagements.
● You develop reusable technical assets from your engagements and share them across the PACE, EMEA and worldwide AWS builder community.
A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship …

Job Description: 
 Im Bereich MIS Development / Maintenance ED & FCAS (TASDM4) der Airbus Defence & Space GmbH in Manching haben wir uns auf IT Lösungen spezialisiert, die die Aufrechterhaltung der Lufttüchtigkeit für fliegende Waffensysteme garantieren sollen um somit einen sicheren Betrieb im operationellen und technisch­/­logistischen Bereich zu ermöglichen. Unsere jahrelange Erfahrung im Betrieb und Support dieser Systeme bei internen und externen Kunden unterschiedlichster Plattformen war der Antrieb für die Entwicklung eines modularen und plattformunabhängigen Bodenunterstützungssystems MOSS (Maintenance and Operation Support Solution), welches in der ersten Ausbaustufe den Betrieb, die Instandsetzung und die Flugzeugwartung des Eurofighters weiterhin sicherstellen soll.
 Das RPAS Logistic Management Information System (RLMIS) ist der Entwicklungszweig von MOSS für das im März 2022 gestartete europäische Entwicklungsprogramm Eurodrone (MALE RPAS). Sich ändernde Rahmenbedingungen, neue operationelle Szenarien und Technologien sind nur ein Teil der Änderungen, die in die Weiterentwicklung von MOSS einfließen werden.
 Wenn Sie sich dieser großartigen Herausforderung stellen möchten – seien Sie dabei. Wir suchen zur Verstärkung des Teams einen 
 Softwarearchitekt für Bodenunterstützungssysteme (d/m/w) . 
 Ihre Kernaufgabe liegt neben dem Entwurf der MALE RPAS spezifischen Architektur auch in der Harmonisierung mit MOSS zur Erweiterung der Gesamtarchitektur.
 Dein Standort 
 Manching ist eine aufstrebende Gemeinde, die ein vielfältiges Freizeit- und Kulturangebot bietet. Hier können Sie die Lebensqualität auf dem Land genießen und dennoch die Annehmlichkeiten der nahegelegenen Städte nutzen.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 We are looking for a key player to transform our technological roadmaps into reality by identifying strategic public funding opportunities, building collaborative consortia, and securing public financing for our R&T projects in Spain. 
 The position is functionally attached to the Head of Engineering Spain (EBST) and reports operationally to the Research and Innovation Leader in Spain (ETR). 
 Your working environment: 
 You will be based in Getafe, co-located with other divisions of the Airbus Group. The primary advantage of this location is to foster cross-divisional synergies. You will also be in close contact with AH facilities in Albacete. 
 You will interact regularly with all other organisations of EBS & ET and within AH (strategy, business, finance, HR, communication, legal...). 
 Your challenges: 
 Funding Intelligence & Strategy: Actively monitor, analyze, and map European (e.g., Clean Aviation, Horizon Europe, EDF), National (e.g., CDTI, MINTUR, SEPIDES, Ministry of Defence/DGAM/PLATIN), and Regional funding landscapes to identify strategic financing opportunities for Airbus Helicopters España. 
 Capture & Bidding Management: Lead and drive the capture strategy and preparation of high-quality proposals for public funding, industrial investment, and procurement calls (including R&D grants, CAPEX/industrialization funds, and PPI), ensuring full alignment with our technology roadmaps. Prepare and complete the bidding dossier in complementarity with other research activities performed by AH in Europe. 
 Strategic Lobbying & Influence: Actively lobby, influence, and align external public and private stakeholders to defend Airbus Helicopters' technological roadmap and strategy. 
 Consortium Building & Alliances: Lead the early-stage setup of proposals and build collaborative consortia, establishing and maintaining relationships with key industrial partners, SMEs, universities, and research centers in Spain and Europe. 
 Handover & Coordination: Seamlessly coordinate with the colleagues in charge of R&T projects execution to ensure a smooth transition of proposals from capture to formal contract signature. Support project execution and justification when necessary. 
 Technology Alignment: Coordinate globally with AH R&T teams and the Engineering Centres of Competence (CoCs) to map their technological roadmaps and capabilities against available funding mechanisms. Communicate in an appropriate way to various internal stakeholders. 
 IP Protection: Under the guidance of the Head of IP, ensure that early-stage consortium agreements and proposal structures safeguard Airbus Helicopters' Intellectual Property rights. 
 Your profile: 
 Experience: More than 10 years of professional experience, with at least 5 years directly dedicated to R&D public funding capture in high-tech, defense, or aerospace sectors. 
 Technical Background: Strong aeronautical technical background combined with a solid understanding of complex engineering systems and technology roadmaps. 
 Network & Relationships: Extensive and pre-existing network within national and European funding bodies (specifically requiring established contacts within the Spanish Ministry of Defence, DGAM, and DIGEID/PLATIN, alongside other relevant entities like CDTI or MINTUR), as well as with key aerospace and defense sector companies in Spain and Europe. 
 Funding Expertise: Proven track record in navigating European programs (Clean Aviation, Horizon Europe, EDF) and National/Regional funding mechanisms (such as CDTI or MINTUR). Experience in collaborative R&D grants is essential. Knowledge of Public Procurement of Innovation processes (PPI) is a plus. 
 Mindset & Teamwork: Innovative mindset with a strong "team player" attitude, demonstrated capacity to work in cross-organizational contexts and influence heterogeneous teams. 
 Autonomy: Ability to drive complex capture campaigns and orchestrate multi-partner consortia autonomously . 
 Language & Culture: Spanish speaker (native) with a deep understanding of Spanish institutions and fluent in English (negotiation level). 
 Integrity: A strong commitment to acting with integrity and identifying compliance risks to protect the company's reputation. 
 Travel: Availability to travel at a national and European level. 
 This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

items.desc: Vous aimez créer des agents IA, connecter des outils et transformer des besoins complexes en solutions utiles ? Venez expérimenter vos idées dans une organisation réelle. Le réseau Interasso, réunissant DSD, HANDISD et FANTAS.IA , recherche une personne pour développer des solutions d’intelligence artificielle au service de projets associatifs : inclusion, coopération, développement durable et coordination des équipes. Votre mission Participer à tout le cycle de développement : comprendre les besoins, construire une première version, la tester avec les utilisateurs et l’améliorer à partir des retours du terrain. Vous pourrez notamment : Créer et orchestrer des agents IA utilisant des LLM, des API et des outils collaboratifs. Automatiser des tâches : recherche d’informations, analyse documentaire, suivi de projets, aide administrative ou préparation de dossiers. Relier les solutions aux outils utilisés par les équipes : Google Workspace, bases de données, n8n, Make ou autres outils pertinents. Décomposer des besoins complexes en étapes réalisables et définir des priorités. Tester les solutions en conditions réelles , repérer les erreurs et évaluer leur utilité. Recueillir les retours d’expérience et développer les versions V2 et V3 . Documenter les réalisations et faciliter leur prise en main par des personnes non techniques. Le profil recherché Vous avez déjà réalisé un projet en développement ou en IA, y compris personnel ou étudiant, et vous souhaitez aller jusqu’à son utilisation concrète. Nous recherchons : Des compétences en programmation, notamment Python ou JavaScript, et en intégration d’API. Une compréhension des LLM, de leurs possibilités et de leurs limites. Un intérêt pour les agents IA, l’orchestration de workflows et l’automatisation. Une capacité à comprendre un fonctionnement associatif et à dialoguer avec différents métiers. De l’autonomie, de la curiosité et un esprit d’équipe. De la réactivité sur les créneaux convenus, des engagements réalistes et le respect des délais annoncés. Le réflexe de signaler rapidement un blocage et de proposer une solution. Une attention à la confidentialité, aux droits d’accès et à la fiabilité des résultats. La connaissance du RAG, des bases vectorielles ou des architectures multi-agents serait un plus. Une démarche agile et concrète Un besoin priorisé → une première version utilisable → des tests terrain → des retours d’expérience → des améliorations. Les objectifs et les échéances sont définis ensemble selon vos disponibilités. Chaque réalisation doit pouvoir être démontrée, testée et transmise à l’équipe. Organisation basée à Montpellier , avec une participation à distance possible et des rencontres selon les projets. Durée, rythme et disponibilités à convenir ensemble. Collaboration avec les responsables associatifs et les utilisateurs des solutions. Un environnement attentif à la diversité des parcours et des fonctionnements cognitifs. You will provide advanced guidance and technical leadership across major security-related initiatives within a large-scale European institutional environment. Authentication Systems & Protocols: Enforce robust security policies and secure authentication mechanisms utilizing SAML, OpenID Connect, and OAuth protocols. DevSecOps & Automation: Integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security templates, and design Python/Bash automation scripts to connect security platforms and audit compliance. Cloud Networking & Application Security: Define and review secure cloud architectures (Azure, AWS), deploy Cloud Application Firewall solutions (WAF), and secure internal applications exposed to the Internet. Cyber Defense & Security Operations: Contribute to cyber-defense operations, interfacing with SOC and CSIRT units, supporting endpoint security, PKI, and security assessment infrastructure. Vulnerability Assessment & Posture Management: Assess security settings across IT applications and components, analyze logs, interpret vulnerability findings, and propose actionable remediation plans for system owners. Reporting & Institutional Collaboration: Deliver actionable Cyber Threat Information (CTI) and concise executive reports to senior management, system owners, and technical stakeholders. Profile Profile & Requirements What do you need to succeed in this position? Education & Qualifications: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. At least one recognized ICT Security professional certification is strictly required (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CEH, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect / Security Operations Analyst). Professional Experience: Minimum of 6 years of relevant professional IT security experience. Cyber-Defense Track Record: At least 3 years of operational and technical experience in cyber-defence, including deployment or operation of a SOC, CSIRT, Security assessment platform, or technical Security infrastructure (PKI, endpoint protection, etc.). Leadership Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience as a technical leader or team leader for major security-related projects. Core Technical Expertise: Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, SAML/OpenID/OAuth, RBAC, MFA, Conditional Access, WAF, Cloud Networking (Azure/AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code. Scripting & Development: Solid scripting and programming capabilities (Python, Bash, or Java) for workflow automation and API connectivity. Communication & Soft Skills: Outstanding analytical mindset, leadership, autonomy, and commitment to increasing institutional cybersecurity maturity. Ability to chair multi-lingual technical workshops and deliver high-impact presentations. Languages: Complete professional fluency in English (both written and oral) is mandatory. Professional command of French is considered a strong asset. Our offer: A particularly attractive salary package, with many additional benefits, to attract the best of you. A professional and stimulating work environment in the field of telecommunications. Multiple career opportunities within a changing group, advanced training in new technologies, rich and recognized expertise. Your application will be treated with confidentiality. We would be very happy to organize a first appointment to talk to you about this opportunity and consider your next career development. Send us your CV

items.desc: For our Global Equity platform, we are looking for a talented European Equities Analyst for the consumer sector to provide research to several European and global equities teams based in Europe. What you will do Act as an industry expert, able to clearly explain fundamental trends, the drivers of earnings and returns, and the most appropriate valuation methods for the sector. Provide formal coverage of the sector, focusing on highlighting areas of change and/or interest where the best investment ideas are most likely to be generated. Discuss high-conviction investments and present best ideas through timely buy/sell investment reports and presentations at internal meetings. Compare and contrast the broad universe of consumer and consumer-related stocks across various subsectors, including retail, luxury goods, consumer services and others, providing additional value to the stock selection process for European and global equity funds. Provide ongoing coverage of stocks held in the portfolios, updating models and making recommendations that contribute to overall performance. Identify new investment ideas and maintain coverage of large and larger benchmark constituents not held in the portfolios. Participate in marketing and client service meetings as required. What you bring 5 to 10 years of investment experience analysing European and global equities, ideally gained in an international investment management firm. All cap investment experience preferred with a proven track record of alpha generation. A passion for investing with high convictions (stock, sectors, countries) within a clear risk framework and with a sustainability mindset (ESG). Strong data, analytical and financial modelling skills; the ability to promote investment ideas proactively to portfolio managers. A detailed working knowledge of European companies in the consumer and consumer-related stocks across a range of subsectors sectors, either currently or in the recent past. Although the preference is for candidates with experience of the buy-side, sell-side experience may be considered where the candidate can demonstrate the ability to pick stocks successfully. Excellent academic qualifications including a university degree plus a professional qualification; preferably an MBA, Chartered Accountant and/or alternatively a CFA and ideally an ESG CFA module. Smart, quietly self-confident and decisive; with strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral. Multi-regional perspective with an interest in global cultures and willingness to travel. Strong social values with an interest in environmental and ethical considerations. Self-starter, hard-working and well organized; lots of initiative, drive, energy, enthusiasm and proactive in the promotion of new ideas. Collegiate by nature; ability to work on multiple products across different teams - Growth, Core. BiC SRI / Conviction, Dividend/Value - as part of a close-knit team with a common goal. Intellectual curiosity and openness to new technologies, including AI-driven tools and applications that can enhance investment research, idea generation, productivity and the development of quantamental investment approaches Good relationship management skills and the ability to engage with clients. items.desc: Background: Veolia is Ireland’s leading environmental services company. We provide a comprehensive range of energy, waste and water solutions and are dedicated to carbon reduction, protecting the environment and building the circular economy. We offer all employees a benefits package as standard which includes full VHI cover, pension and education assistance. When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life. We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture. Construction Site Agent Location: Cavanhill, Co. Louth Contract Type: Permanent Weekly Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:30am to 4:30pm Overview of the role This is a Construction Site Agent within the Water/Waste Water Industry. The project involves heavy civils, deep excavations, temporary works in the form of sheet piling/ cofferdam/dewatering and pipework installation. It includes the construction of large insitu concrete water tanks and the building enclosure is a steel frame with blockwork and cladding. The role involves leading the construction team and subcontractors on site and will have the responsibility to put H&S of site personnel at the top of the agenda. The role will interact with the following departments: Veolia Design and Project Management Teams, Client, Operations on site, Contractors and sub-contractors. Within a supportive, friendly and challenging environment, you will get to work on exciting projects, whilst learning from a diverse team of talented people and leading experts. What’s more, you’ll be provided with the freedom to push boundaries and constantly learn and develop your skill-set. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work on projects across a wide range of sectors, including industrial, pharmaceutical, healthcare and municipal. This is a site based position dependent on the successful applicant, but the incumbent may be required to travel to other Veolia sites, plants and offices throughout Ireland. Day to Day Role Manage, operate and run all site activities on behalf of Veolia. items.desc: Hunter Douglas is the world's leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we've defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally. We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours? Position Overview We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our EMEA IT team in Rotterdam. Reporting to the Head of Data Science, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining and optimising our data infrastructure and pipelines, helping create reliable data foundations for analytics, data science and wider business decision-making. You'll work closely with Data Science and stakeholders across the business, integrating data from multiple sources and making sure it is accessible, well-structured and ready to support advanced analytics and machine learning. What You'll Be Doing Designing, developing and maintaining scalable data pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources. Developing and optimising ETL/ELT processes and automated data workflows. Building and maintaining reliable data models and structured datasets for analytics and data science. Maintaining and improving data platforms, databases, data warehouses and cloud-based services. Implementing data validation, monitoring and quality controls to improve data accuracy and reliability. Working closely with Data Science to prepare and optimise datasets for advanced analytics and machine learning. Troubleshooting pipeline failures, data integrity issues and performance challenges. Collaborating with technical and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective engineering solutions. Continuously improving our data infrastructure, tooling and engineering practices. What We're Looking For A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or a related technical discipline. Equivalent professional experience may also be considered. Typically 4–6 years of relevant experience in data engineering, software engineering or a closely related technical role. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience developing and managing ETL/ELT pipelines and automated data workflows. Experience with relational databases, data warehousing and data modelling. Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. Experience working with APIs and integrating data from different systems and sources. Experience with version control tools such as Git. Familiarity with orchestration and workflow automation tools such as Airflow, Dagster or similar. A good understanding of data quality, governance, security and modern data engineering practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams. Why Hunter Douglas? Direct impact on product cost, value, and profitability Work on physical, high-volume products used by millions across Europe International collaboration within a global, product-driven organization If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health. Job Description Join a leading pharmaceutical transformation program and play a key role in shaping complex non-SAP landscapes during large-scale carve-out, divestiture, and business transformation initiatives. We are seeking an experienced Non-SAP Architect with a strong background in the pharmaceutical/life sciences sector to lead application separation, integration, and customer development activities across global operations. Design integrations between SAP and non-SAP platforms. Support customer development initiatives, including custom applications, interfaces, reporting, and automation solutions. Drive data migration, application rationalization, and system decommissioning activities. Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and R&D functions. Ensure compliance with GxP, CSV, Data Integrity, and cybersecurity requirements. Qualifications Required Experience 8+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Technical Architecture. Proven experience delivering carve-out, separation, or transformation programs within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry. Strong understanding of regulated environments and compliance frameworks such as: GxP GAMP 5 FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Annex 11 Data Integrity requirements Experience with one or more of the following: Salesforce Veeva Vault ServiceNow Microsoft Dynamics 365 Azure Snowflake Databricks MuleSoft Boomi Informatica Strong expertise in integrations, APIs, middleware, and enterprise data architecture. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA transformation programs in pharma environments. TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification. Azure, AWS, or GCP certifications. Experience with Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing, or Commercial pharmaceutical systems. At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients. Hiring Philosophy: We value employees who push boundaries through innovation, navigating diverse client needs in ever-evolving environments, with a commitment to continuous learning both for themselves and their colleagues. We cultivate an environment where every individual can thrive and flourish through meaningful connections, extended learning, motivation, and support to experiment with new and innovative approaches, including taking risks. We see feedback as providing individuals with the information and tools they need to develop their strengths and overcome challenges. Feedback is a gift, and inspiring individuals is our competitive advantage! Shape you own journey - How far will you take yourself?

items.desc: Job Title: Network Security Engineer Location: Sheffield, South Yorkshire (S1 / Hybrid) Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Salary: £56,000 – £60,000 per year + Annual Performance Bonus & Benefits Schedule: Monday to Friday About the Role We are seeking a highly analytical, technical Network Security Engineer to join our enterprise IT and network infrastructure team in Sheffield. Operating out of our modern technology hub near St Paul’s Place and the Sheffield Digital Campus (S1), you will design, deploy, harden, and maintain secure enterprise networks, perimeter defenses, and hybrid cloud connectivity across South Yorkshire and the UK. In this hands-on engineering role, you will safeguard critical enterprise infrastructure—implementing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), managing next-generation firewalls, optimizing SD-WAN architectures, and defending core network assets against emerging cyber threats. Key Responsibilities Firewall & Perimeter Security Administration: Configure, manage, and optimize enterprise next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet FortiGate, Check Point, or Cisco Firepower), Intrusion Prevention/Detection Systems (IPS/IDS), and Web Application Firewalls (WAF). Network Architecture & Segmentation: Design and enforce network micro-segmentation, VLAN isolation, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and Zero Trust principles across data centers, branch offices, and cloud environments (Azure / AWS). Secure Connectivity & VPNs: Implement and maintain encrypted site-to-site IPsec VPNs, remote access SSL VPNs, SD-WAN deployments, and BGP/OSPF routing security protocols. Threat Detection & Vulnerability Remediation: Monitor network traffic logs via SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk), conduct regular network vulnerability assessments, apply firmware patches, and remediate configuration weaknesses. Tier-3 Escalations & Incident Response: Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex network security incidents, conducting packet-level traffic analysis (Wireshark), root-cause analysis (RCA), and rapid threat containment. items.desc: Descrizione azienda MC Engineering è una dinamica società di consulenza informatica , con sedi a Torino, Milano, Roma, Bari, Trieste e Firenze. Lavoriamo a stretto contatto con realtà innovative nel mondo ICT, portando avanti progetti che spaziano tra vari settori. Per noi, le persone sono al centro di tutto : puntiamo su un continuo aggiornamento, sulla crescita costante e sull’ eccellenza , per affrontare insieme sfide innovative e fare la differenza nel nostro settore. Posizione Cosa farai con noi? Come AI Engineer , entrerai a far parte di un team impegnato in progetti innovativi in ambito Banking, contribuendo alla progettazione e allo sviluppo di funzionalità basate su Intelligenza Artificiale generativa e Machine Learning. Ti occuperai della realizzazione di componenti per l'elaborazione e la ricerca di informazioni provenienti da fonti eterogenee, come documenti, codice, log ed eventi, e dell'integrazione di modelli e servizi AI all'interno delle applicazioni aziendali tramite API. Contribuirai inoltre allo sviluppo di assistenti intelligenti e flussi agentici a supporto dei processi aziendali e delle attività di sviluppo software. Sperimenterai soluzioni per l'individuazione di anomalie e variazioni nei dati, occupandoti anche della valutazione della qualità e dell'affidabilità dei risultati attraverso attività di test, analisi dei casi limite e monitoraggio. Collaborerai con i team di progetto, contribuendo alla documentazione delle soluzioni realizzate e al miglioramento continuo delle funzionalità sviluppate. Requisiti Competenze richieste Esperienza nello sviluppo con Python e familiarità con Git. Conoscenza dei fondamenti di Machine Learning e Generative AI, inclusi Large Language Models (LLM) e tecniche di Prompt Engineering. Esperienza o conoscenza pratica di architetture RAG, Information Retrieval e sistemi di ricerca su documenti e basi di conoscenza. Capacità di lavorare con dati strutturati e non strutturati, come documenti, codice, log ed eventi. Conoscenza delle API REST e capacità di integrare modelli e servizi AI con applicazioni e strumenti aziendali. Familiarità con la valutazione dei risultati dei modelli, attraverso test, monitoraggio e gestione di errori o output non affidabili. Capacità di collaborare con team di sviluppo e di documentare le soluzioni realizzate. Nice To Have Esperienza con sistemi di orchestrazione di agenti AI e funzionalità di Tool Calling. Competenze nell'analisi dei log, Anomaly Detection e analisi di serie temporali. Conoscenza di pipeline di streaming e strumenti come Kafka e OpenSearch. Esperienza nell'integrazione con piattaforme e strumenti aziendali, come Jira, Confluence e GitHub. Conoscenza di sistemi legacy. Lingua inglese Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, livello B2 Modalità e/o Sede di Lavoro Modalità ibrida, con presenza presso la sede di Milano un giorno a settimana. Completano il profilo Capacità di analisi e problem solving, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e attitudine alla sperimentazione. Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, precisione, capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari e orientamento alla qualità e all'affidabilità delle soluzioni sviluppate. Altre informazioni Cosa offriamo Inserimento in organico con un inquadramento commisurato all’esperienza professionale pregressa e una retribuzione in linea con le reali capacità del candidato. Se sei una persona appassionata di tecnologia, desiderosa di guidare l’adozione dell’intelligenza artificiale nello sviluppo software nel settore CPG, questa è l’occasione che fa per te! Unisciti a MC Engineering: dove le idee diventano innovazione! Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei DLgs 215/03 e 216/03. CHAMP’s solutions, marketed under the Cargospot and Traxon brands, serve over 200 airlines and GSAs, connecting them with approximately 3,000 forwarders and GHAs worldwide. Headquartered in Luxembourg, CHAMP operates offices in London, Zurich, Frankfurt, Manila, Singapore, and Atlanta. At CHAMP, you'll build intelligent solutions used across the global air cargo industry. As part of our Cargo Management team, you'll develop AI-powered products, create production-ready AI/ML services, and help drive the next generation of automation through our AI Hub. If you're passionate about software engineering, emerging technologies, and solving complex business challenges, we'd love to meet you. Join CHAMP’s Cargo Management team and help shape our AI powered products, where agentic AI and RAG-powered automation solve real-world air cargo challenges. Good software engineering fundamentals (API design, testing, version control, and writing maintainable code). Hands-on experience building AI/ML-powered features (ideally LLM-based like RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or vector search). Strong curiosity and self-direction. Knowledge of coding design patterns. Experience with SCRUM practices. Interest in or knowledge of the air cargo and logistics industry. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 2–4 years of professional software development experience. Proven experience building AI/ML features, whether in production, serious side projects, or a previous role. Experience integrating business systems or supporting e-commerce, wholesale or multi-company operations. WHAT WE OFFER An independent and versatile role in a fast-growing international organisation. The opportunity to develop practical AI solutions that create measurable value across multiple European business units. Personal development and career growth opportunities. Training and coaching support. A supportive international team that works together and celebrates successes. A market-competitive salary and benefits package aligned with MegaGroup’s employment conditions in Poland. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? Build useful AI and connect it to the business. Apply now and help MegaGroup turn promising ideas into secure, scalable and dependable solutions as our new AI Engineer .

items.desc: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen. Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich “Generative AI” aus und suchen dafür dich, um gute Software für Kunden zu bauen, die relevante Probleme löst. Was dich erwartet Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines. Du nutzt und verarbeitet Daten über Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, APIs, Cloud-Speicher und Legacy-/Unternehmenssysteme, damit AI-Anwendungen mit relevanten Informationen arbeiten, um für den Kunden echten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, dein bestehendes Know-How auf neue Herausforderungen anzuwenden. Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzung von GenAI-Anwendungen und deren Integration. Du teilst dein Wissen gerne, z. B. auf Konferenzen, Meetups oder in Fachartikeln. Du nutzt Open Source zur Problemlösung und lässt Verbesserungen und Erweiterungen zurückfließen. Du hast einen Blick auf den GenAI-Markt und die Weiterentwicklung von Technologien und Trends. Das solltest du mitbringen Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder IT-Beratung. Erfahrung mit RAG- oder RAG-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken und LLMs. Grundkenntnisse in probabilistischem Testen mit Testsets und Qualitätssicherung mit Metriken. Du hast Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden (wie etwa bei der Beratung oder im Pre-Sales). Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch auf C1+ Niveau sowie konversationssicheres Englisch. 1-2 Mal im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um Kunden und Kolleg:innen persönlich zu treffen, stellt kein Hindernis für dich dar. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 65.000 € bis 75.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden. Kein 08/15: Bei unseren AI-Projekten sind Forschungsgeist und Experimentierfreude gefragt, da wir innovative Konzepte verproben, um Lösungen mit hohem Kundennutzen zu schaffen. Lass dich inspirieren: Arbeite mit einem der führenden Köpfe auf dem Gebiete der generative Artificial Intelligence - unserem CTO Johann-Peter Hartmann Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiterentwickelst. Wir arbeiten selbtsorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir schaffen den Rahmen, den du brauchst, um gut arbeiten zu können. Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Expert:in nach außen sichtbar wirst. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst . Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück ist kein Problem. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? Schreib uns eine Email an bewerbung@mayflower.de

items.desc: Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Security AI Engineer to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Managed Security Services domain. About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact. Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover. Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Security AI Engineer who wants to make a difference in our Managed Security Services domain. Managed Security Services Truesec helps customers globally with Attack Prediction Services, Vulnerability Management Services and Managed Detection & Response services for IT and OT environments. Our services are all delivered by skilled security analysis teams that conducts 24/7 attack monitoring, threat hunting, threat intelligence analysis, and threat remediation. Our team of experts works tirelessly to identify and prevent cyber breaches, and to help increase our customers’ proactive cybersecurity defenses. Our goal is to be an extension of our customers’ IT organizations, customizing a combination of capabilities and tooling, tailored to prevent cyber attacks in the most efficient way. The Role As a Security AI Engineer in Managed Security Services, you will help shape the next generation of security operations. You will turn operational SOC needs into secure, production-ready AI solutions across alert analysis, enrichment, orchestration and response. You will work closely with SOC analysts, service architects, security engineers and developers to ensure that AI-powered automation and agentic workflows create measurable value while keeping human expertise and operational control at the center. Design, develop and improve AI and deterministic agents and agentic workflows for SOC operations. Build prompts, tools, knowledge sources, RAG capabilities and integrations across security platforms, internal systems, APIs and AI services. Evaluate solution quality, accuracy, security, reliability and operational impact before production use. Lead AI-supported security solutions from technical design and experimentation through production deployment and continuous improvement. Your Potential Background You are an experienced AI, machine learning or data engineer with a strong understanding of cybersecurity and modern SOC operations. You enjoy turning complex operational needs into practical, production-ready AI solutions. You combine hands-on engineering experience with sound security judgment, can explain technical design decisions clearly and are comfortable guiding colleagues in a cross-functional environment. Required Skills: Strong experience in data engineering, machine learning or applied data science, including working with data pipelines, data and feature preparation, model development, evaluation and production-oriented ML workflows. Strong software engineering, scripting and integration skills using Python, PowerShell, APIs or comparable technologies. Practical understanding of cybersecurity engineering, SOC operations and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, XDR or SOAR. Experience taking secure technical solutions from design and experimentation into reliable production use. Experience mentoring engineers, guiding technical decisions and helping operational teams Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience designing, developing and evaluating AI agents, LLM-based applications, RAG solutions or comparable AI-powered workflows. Experience with prompt engineering, agent orchestration, knowledge grounding, tool integration and AI evaluation frameworks. Experience with Microsoft security technologies, cloud platforms or workflow orchestration. Knowledge of threat detection, threat hunting, incident response or security data engineering. Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit. Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field. So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

items.title: Applied AI Engineer
items.card: The role and why it matters You will build the tools and LangGraph workflows that let agents query live plant data, call physics-based models, search documentation and show results as live charts and tables in Next.js. items.desc: Build AI agents that help run real mines and processing plants: agents that query live sensor data, call physics-based models and flag problems before people notice them! About IntelliSense.io At IntelliSense.io, we are pioneering the future of industrial decision intelligence. Our platform is trusted by Tier 1 and Tier 2 global mining leaders and cutting-edge secondary metal recycling operations. We combine digital twins of individual industrial processes with AI agents for machines and humans, including role-specific solutions like a "Digital Metallurgist" or "Digital Geologist", predictive ambient agents, and a 24/7 site memory that survives shift changes and staff turnover. As an AI-first company, we harness intelligence across everything we do to cut time-to-value and scale rapidly. The role and why it matters You will build the tools and LangGraph workflows that let agents query live plant data, call physics-based models, search documentation and show results as live charts and tables in Next.js. You will also help build ambient agents that monitor industrial sites 24/7, with tracing and evaluation so they are safe to rely on. You bring modern Python (async, type hints), hands-on experience building an LLM agent or tool-calling app, SQL and RAG, good engineering habits, and curiosity beyond Python. Mentorship from senior engineers; mining knowledge not required. What You'll Do Build the tools our agents use: querying time-series, relational, graph and vector data (Postgres, MongoDB, Neo4j, Qdrant), RAG over documentation, and integrations with services such as Slack, Notion and ClickUp. Design and improve multi-agent workflows in LangGraph, including prompts, few-shot examples and agent configuration. Connect agents to our domain models for grinding, flotation and thickening circuits. Help build generative UI in Next.js with the Vercel AI SDK, so agents can show live charts, tables and widgets. Contribute to ambient agents that monitor the health of industrial sites and of our platform. Add tracing, evaluation and monitoring so agent reasoning is transparent, reliable and safe for industrial use. Help colleagues across the company use and improve our agents. What You'll Bring You will ideally have a Master’s preferred in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field. Your technical skills should include: Modern Python: Strong foundation in Python (3.12+), specifically async/await and type hinting. Agentic Mindset: You’ve moved beyond simple prompts and are excited by the challenge of state management, tool-calling, and reliability in LLM systems. Full-Stack Curiosity: You are happy to dive deep into a Python backend but also open to investigating new APIs and data formats, shipping a React component, or tweaking a Dockerfile. First-Principles Thinking: You enjoy breaking down complex problems and are comfortable working in a field where the best practices change every week. Signal vs. Noise: You possess the critical thinking to separate first-principles engineering from marketing hype. Operational Rigor: An interest in building production-grade software with clean code, unit tests, and thoughtful documentation. What We Offer Unlimited holidays: we trust you to manage your time and your energy. True flexibility: work in a way that brings out your best results. Direct mentorship from senior engineers defining the architecture of industrial agentic systems. A diverse team spanning the UK, Ireland, Spain, Chile, Saudi Arabia, Australia and beyond. Location Cambridge, hybrid. Our process A short call with our People team, a technical interview about a project you have built, a take-home exercise (3-4 hours) with a review session, a conversation with the team, and references. All stages can be held online. We endeavour to complete the hiring process in approximately 8 weeks. Inclusion We want our teams to reflect the range of people who use and are affected by our technology. We welcome applications from everyone and will make reasonable adjustments at any stage: just tell us what you need. If you meet most, but not all, of the essentials, we would still like to hear from you.

 The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. items.desc:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. 
You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

What You’ll Do:
Client Strategy: Lead consultative selling to inspire clients and demonstrate how Spotify can achieve their business goals.
 Business Development: Proactively identify and cultivate high-potential customer relationships across diverse verticals to grow a robust sales pipeline.
 Sales Propositions: Craft and present effective sales propositions, leveraging the latest platform innovations, research, and key insights.
 Sales Targets: Own and exceed ambitious revenue goals through strategic, entrepreneurial approaches that drive sustainable growth.
 Strategic Insight & Reporting: Deliver actionable insights and detailed performance reports, analyzing campaigns to recommend improvements.
 Product Expertise: Stay ahead of Spotify’s product innovations, identifying cross-selling opportunities to help clients succeed.
 Pipeline Development: Skillfully manage multiple complex conversations, prioritizing engagements with efficiency using relevant software tools.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Data teams to create comprehensive strategies and optimize platform effectiveness
Who You Are:
Knowledgeable: You bring a minimum of 5+ years of experience managing pipelines and driving revenue in a digital advertising tech environment. Experience in audio advertising and with Agency Holding Companies (Havas, Publicis, WPP, Dentsu, OMC…) are a plus.
 Organized & Self-Reliant: You excel in a dynamic environment, independently handling varied demands with confidence.
 Articulate: You are an effective communicator, clearly expressing both your stakeholders’ needs and your own.
 Intrinsically Motivated: You are driven by your own goals and always aim to beat your personal best.
 Success and Target Driven: You thrive on exceeding targets and making a tangible impact.
 Team-Oriented: You believe in collaborative success, eager to learn from your peers and share your expertise.
 Fluent French and English language, spoken and written is required
Where You’ll Be:
This role is based in our London office.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
 We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week and are open to periodic travel across France for client meetings, events, and team collaboration.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
