items.desc: Donnez la bonne énergie à votre avenir, formez-vous avec RTE ! RTE est le gestionnaire du réseau français de transport d’électricité. En charge du plus grand réseau haute et très haute tension d’Europe, nous avons la responsabilité de garantir à plus de 67 millions de consommateurs, aux industries et aux distributeurs, une alimentation électrique fiable, 24h/24. En coulisse, plus de 10 000 hommes et femmes orchestrent en temps réel l’équilibre entre production et consommation d’électricité, conduisent les flux, réalisent la maintenance des installations, innovent, mais aussi pilotent les projets qui transforment le réseau, main dans la main avec les territoires. Notre moteur collectif : mettre nos expertises au service de l’intérêt général et d’un futur durable où l’électricité sera la principale énergie. RTE place la santé et la sécurité de ses collaborateurs, prestataires et partenaires au premier plan, en faisant de la prévention des risques un pilier de sa culture d’entreprise. Convaincus que la diversité est une richesse, nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, y compris celles de personnes en situation de handicap, pour construire des équipes représentatives d’une société pleinement inclusive. Investi d'une mission de service public, RTE respecte le principe de neutralité religieuse et politique. Description du poste Lieu : Lyon 7ème Durée et/ou période du stage : Stage de fin d'études ou de césure de 6 mois, à compter de début 2027 (idéalement mars 2027) En tant que stagiaire, vous intégrerez le Centre de Projets Réseau Terrestre (CPRT) de Lyon au sein de la Direction Projet Terrestres de RTE (DPT), responsable de la réalisation des investissements sur le réseau électrique de la région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Vous serez rattaché(e) au Pilote Sécurité du Centre, qui travaille également pour la mission nationale sécurité de DPT. Au sein du Centre, la sécurité et la qualité lors des interventions sur chantiers constituent des priorités absolues. Chaque année, plusieurs centaines de Visites de Sécurité (VSE) sont réalisées auprès des prestataires et intervenants. Face à la multiplicité et à l'hétérogénéité des données disponibles (opérations à risques similaires des autres projets, analyses de risques génériques et spécifiques de la revue de sécurité amont, référentiels sécurité contractuels, historiques des visites et retours de contrôle, plannings de coordination des opérations, documents d'accès aux ouvrages électriques, accidentologie,...), l'enjeu est de doter les acteurs de terrain d'un outil intelligent capable de cibler instantanément les points de contrôle prioritaires avant chaque visite et d'aider à la planification desdites visites. En tant que véritable tête de pont pour cette innovation, vous aurez pour mission de concevoir et développer un prototype opérationnel d'agent IA générative destiné à optimiser la préparation et la pertinence des visites de chantiers, avec une perspective de déploiement à l'échelle nationale. Pour mener à bien ce projet, vous bénéficierez d'un double accompagnement : le sponsor métier sécurité du centre et l'appui méthodologique et technique des experts en Intelligence Artificielle de RTE (Direction Données Intelligence Artificielle et Analyses - DIA2), tout en capitalisant sur des briques existantes de proximité technique. Accompagné(e) de votre tuteur, vos missions s’articuleront autour des axes suivants : Cadrage du besoin et cartographie des données d'entrée ainsi que des formats de sortie : identifier et qualifier les sources documentaires pertinentes (textes, schémas, plannings, bases SharePoint, comptes-rendus de contrôleurs, historiques prestataires et analyses de risques,...) tout en définissant les règles de gouvernance, de confidentialité et d'intégration sécurisée sur serveurs internes. Structuration de la base de connaissances : concevoir les pipelines d'ingestion et d'indexation de documents techniques hétérogènes en lien avec les standards et recommandations du département DIA2. Développement du prototype d'agent IA (LLM (grands modèles de langage) / RAG (pour Retrieval-Augmented Generation ou génération à enrichissement contextuel)) : implémenter la solution capable de croiser les caractéristiques d'un chantier (nature de l'opération, phase en cours, antécédents, typologie de risque) avec les retours d'expérience et constats sécurité de chantiers comparables. Génération automatisée de synthèses opérationnelles : paramétrer l'outil pour délivrer aux visiteurs une fiche de préparation synthétique et ciblée en moins de quelques minutes (points de vigilance critiques, questions clés à poser, focus qualité/sécurité selon l'intervenant). Tests utilisateurs, validation terrain et capitalisation : éprouver le prototype auprès des visiteurs de chantiers à Lyon, mesurer les gains en pertinence et en temps de préparation, puis formaliser le retour d'expérience et le cadre de déploiement pour un essaimage au niveau national. items.desc: We are looking for a motivated Data Science Analyst to join our team and support the development of data-driven solutions, analytics and reporting capabilities. This opportunity is ideal for a professional with experience in Python, data analysis and data processing who is interested in working with diverse datasets, developing analytical solutions and contributing to data science and automation projects. Working closely with technical and business teams, you will help transform complex data into meaningful insights, support data modelling initiatives and contribute to the development of scalable data solutions. We will count on you to: Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Python, Flask and FastAPI. Build production-ready AI/LLM solutions, including REST APIs, WebSocket streaming, authentication and integration with external systems. Develop and optimize Large Language Model (LLM) applications using GPT and open-source models, including prompt engineering and model evaluation. Build and maintain RAG pipelines, vector search solutions and AI agent workflows using tools such as pgvector, MCP and function calling. Integrate internal and external data sources, databases and APIs into AI-powered applications. Work with SQL Server and PostgreSQL, optimizing database schemas, queries and data handling processes. Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques using frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras and Scikit-learn. Monitor and evaluate AI model performance, including response quality, latency, cost efficiency and hallucination mitigation. Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting and continuous improvements to ensure code quality, reliability and security. What you need to have: Around 2 years of experience in a corporate IT environment, with exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Python development. Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with Flask and FastAPI. Good understanding of software design, debugging, performance optimization and backend development. Solid knowledge of SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including database design, indexing, query optimization and ORM tools such as SQLAlchemy. Experience or practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI integrations and related development frameworks. Understanding of security, privacy and compliance best practices in software development. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work independently, collaborate with distributed teams and maintain technical documentation. What makes you stand out: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or containerized application deployments. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions. Basic JavaScript knowledge for application integration or tooling. Why join our team? We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work, and supportive leaders; We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact for colleagues, clients, and communities; Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being; A yearly budget and the opportunity to build your flexible benefits package (up to 20% of your annual salary); 30+ days off (including legal days, birthday, public holiday replacements, and benefits options); Performance bonus scheme; Matching charity contributions, charity days off, and the Pay it Forward charity challenge; Core benefits: Pension, Life and Medical Insurance, Meal Vouchers, Travel Insurance. items.desc: Vous rejoindrez l’équipe 3DEXPERIENCE Brand Services, un groupe d’experts spécialisés au sein de Dassault Systèmes, dont la mission est d’accompagner les clients industriels dans l’adoption réussie de la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE, une suite cloud couvrant notamment la Data Science, l’Intelligence Artificielle et l’analytique industrielle. L’équipe se situe à l’intersection du développement logiciel, de la data science et de l’accompagnement des clients. Il ne s’agit ni d’une équipe commerciale, ni d’un intégrateur informatique généraliste, mais d’un centre d’expertise au niveau de la marque, qui définit les bonnes pratiques, accompagne les partenaires de déploiement dans le monde entier et prend directement en charge les déploiements les plus complexes ou les premiers cas d’usage de leur catégorie. Vos missions En tant que stagiaire spécialisé en agents IA et Data Science, votre mission principale consistera à créer et améliorer des outils : vous développerez et perfectionnerez des outils d’IA de pointe permettant aux équipes Services de gagner du temps et en efficacité lors des déploiements chez les clients. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe à un moment où un Software Consultant permanent des Services est déjà en charge de cette thématique. Vous bénéficierez ainsi d’un interlocuteur expérimenté avec lequel construire et développer les solutions, plutôt que de partir d’une page blanche. Création et amélioration d’outils : Il s’agit de votre mission principale. Vous concevrez, développerez et ferez évoluer des composants réutilisables basés sur des agents d’IA, tels que : Des accélérateurs de déploiement ; Des assistants de configuration ; Des outils de préparation des données ; Des utilitaires pour les pipelines de Machine Learning. L’objectif sera clairement de réduire les tâches manuelles ainsi que le temps nécessaire aux interventions auprès des clients. Exposition aux projets de déploiement : vous travaillerez aux côtés de consultants seniors sur des déploiements réels, afin de comprendre directement les difficultés et les points de blocage rencontrés lors des projets clients. Cette immersion permettra de s’assurer que les outils développés répondent à des problématiques concrètes et opérationnelles, plutôt qu’à des besoins purement théoriques. Principales activités Concevoir et prototyper des outils basés sur des agents d’IA, notamment pour la préparation des données, l’automatisation des pipelines de Machine Learning et l’accélération des workflows, afin de réduire les temps de déploiement et les efforts de configuration manuelle. Améliorer et fiabiliser les outils et prototypes existants développés par l’équipe, afin de les rendre suffisamment robustes pour être réutilisés à plus grande échelle par les différents partenaires de déploiement. Documenter les méthodes, architectures et bonnes pratiques liées aux outils développés, et contribuer à l’enrichissement de la boîte à outils interne de l’équipe ainsi que de sa bibliothèque d’assets VTaaS (Virtual Twin As A Service). Accompagner les consultants seniors et le Software Consultant des Services lors de projets clients réels, afin d’intégrer les contraintes opérationnelles rencontrées sur le terrain dans les choix de conception des outils. Mesurer et présenter les gains en temps et en effort de déploiement obtenus grâce aux outils développés. Vos Qualifications Étudiant(e) en Master 2 / dernière année d’études (Bac+4/5) en informatique, Data Science ou dans une discipline d’ingénierie connexe. Compétences techniques Solides connaissances académiques en Machine Learning et modélisation statistique. Bonne maîtrise de Python ; des connaissances en SQL ou en frameworks de Data Engineering sont un plus. Connaissances académiques des LLM (Large Language Models) et des frameworks d’IA agentique tels que LangChain, AutoGen ou équivalents. Capacité à construire des pipelines de données de bout en bout, depuis l’ingestion des données jusqu'à la production des résultats du modèle. Connaissance des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (gestion des versions, documentation, etc.) : les outils développés devront pouvoir être réutilisés par d’autres collaborateurs après la fin du stage. Qualités personnelles Autonomie suffisante pour prendre en charge un périmètre de travail défini, avec un accompagnement régulier mais sans supervision constante. À l’aise dans un environnement en contact indirect avec les clients : vous pourrez notamment participer à des sessions aux côtés d’équipes techniques de grands groupes industriels. Curieux(se) et adaptable, dans un domaine qui évolue très rapidement. Capable de documenter son travail au fur et à mesure, avec l’objectif que les développements réalisés continuent à être utiles après la fin du stage. Motivations et centres d’intérêt Un réel intérêt pour les applications concrètes de l’IA dans le monde professionnel, au-delà de la théorie. Une motivation à voir les outils développés réellement adoptés et utilisés, et pas uniquement …

En collaboration avec le Team Lead AI Services , les architectes et les Business Analysts, vous traduirez les besoins métier en solutions fiables s’appuyant notamment sur les Large Language Models (LLM) , le RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) et les workflows agentiques . IA responsable : Mettre en œuvre des mesures de protection de la vie privée, de transparence, de traçabilité et de supervision humaine conformément aux exigences des projets, en collaboration avec les équipes sécurité et conformité. Collaboration : Documenter les décisions techniques et contribuer aux estimations des solutions, aux études de faisabilité et aux démonstrations. Appliquer le bonnes pratiques de développement sécurisé, notamment en matière d'authentification, de contrôle des accès et de gestion des secrets. FastAPI et API REST : Maîtrise de la conception d’API, de la validation des entrées, de l’authentification et de la gestion cohérente des erreurs. LangGraph : Maîtrise des états, nœuds, mécanismes de routage, persistance, mémoire, gestion des défaillances et workflows human-in-the-loop. LangChain : Expérience avec l’intégration d’outils, le prompting, les sorties structurées et l’intégration de LLM. Face à la multiplicité et à l'hétérogénéité des données disponibles (opérations à risques similaires des autres projets, analyses de risques génériques et spécifiques de la revue de sécurité amont, référentiels sécurité contractuels, historiques des visites et retours de contrôle, plannings de coordination des opérations, documents d'accès aux ouvrages électriques, accidentologie,...), l'enjeu est de doter les acteurs de terrain d'un outil intelligent capable de cibler instantanément les points de contrôle prioritaires avant chaque visite et d'aider à la planification desdites visites. En tant que véritable tête de pont pour cette innovation, vous aurez pour mission de concevoir et développer un prototype opérationnel d'agent IA générative destiné à optimiser la préparation et la pertinence des visites de chantiers, avec une perspective de déploiement à l'échelle nationale. Pour mener à bien ce projet, vous bénéficierez d'un double accompagnement : le sponsor métier sécurité du centre et l'appui méthodologique et technique des experts en Intelligence Artificielle de RTE (Direction Données Intelligence Artificielle et Analyses - DIA2), tout en capitalisant sur des briques existantes de proximité technique. Accompagné(e) de votre tuteur, vos missions s’articuleront autour des axes suivants : Cadrage du besoin et cartographie des données d'entrée ainsi que des formats de sortie : identifier et qualifier les sources documentaires pertinentes (textes, schémas, plannings, bases SharePoint, comptes-rendus de contrôleurs, historiques prestataires et analyses de risques,...) tout en définissant les règles de gouvernance, de confidentialité et d'intégration sécurisée sur serveurs internes. Structuration de la base de connaissances : concevoir les pipelines d'ingestion et d'indexation de documents techniques hétérogènes en lien avec les standards et recommandations du département DIA2. Développement du prototype d'agent IA (LLM (grands modèles de langage) / RAG (pour Retrieval-Augmented Generation ou génération à enrichissement contextuel)) : implémenter la solution capable de croiser les caractéristiques d'un chantier (nature de l'opération, phase en cours, antécédents, typologie de risque) avec les retours d'expérience et constats sécurité de chantiers comparables. Génération automatisée de synthèses opérationnelles : paramétrer l'outil pour délivrer aux visiteurs une fiche de préparation synthétique et ciblée en moins de quelques minutes (points de vigilance critiques, questions clés à poser, focus qualité/sécurité selon l'intervenant). Tests utilisateurs, validation terrain et capitalisation : éprouver le prototype auprès des visiteurs de chantiers à Lyon, mesurer les gains en pertinence et en temps de préparation, puis formaliser le retour d'expérience et le cadre de déploiement pour un essaimage au niveau national. items.desc: Company Description At Lifebit, we carve our own path. Trusted by Governments and world-leading pharma institutions and funded with $70m, we are on a mission to harness the power of connected data and bring precision medicine to life globally. The key to saving human lives is providing researchers across the globe with the right data to develop more precise drugs faster. Generating large amounts of biomedical data has become relatively straightforward. The challenge now is finding, accessing and analysing this sensitive data stored across thousands of disconnected locations. It is frustrating and painfully difficult for researchers. Lifebit has created a patented, federated technology that brings analysis and computation to where data resides. This enables researchers to run analyses on multiple, distributed datasets in-situ, avoiding the risky movement of highly-sensitive data. Our Federated AI Platform is trusted by federal agencies, national health systems, and global pharma to securely unlock sensitive biomedical and real-world data at scale. We help federal health institutions modernize data utilization and analytics in highly protected environments, supporting mission-critical federal programs and transforming how secure health data drives public health and research. Our technology is unmatched and momentum is on our side - and we need an exceptionally strong team to help boost Lifebit to incredible new heights. Your Impact As an AI Engineer, you will be at the forefront of bridging the gap between massive, decentralized biomedical datasets and life-saving insights. You won't just be building "standard" models; you will be co-architecting AI that functions within a federated ecosystem, where privacy and security are paramount. You will own the development and deployment of machine learning models—ranging from Large Language Models (LLMs) for clinical note extraction to predictive analytics for genomic research—ensuring they are optimized for our unique federated architecture. Your work will directly empower researchers to identify drug targets and disease biomarkers faster than ever before, transforming how the world approaches precision medicine. Your Role and Responsibilities Agentic Architecture & Orchestration Design and implement autonomous AI agents using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen to handle complex, multi-step scientific queries. Develop sophisticated reasoning loops (e.g., ReAct, Plan-and-Execute) that allow agents to decompose high-level research goals into actionable sub-tasks. Build and optimize Advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines that integrate structured clinical data and unstructured scientific literature. Tool-Use & Execution Create and maintain "tools" for AI agents, enabling them to safely interface with Lifebit’s federated APIs, SQL databases, and bioinformatic execution engines. Implement secure, sandboxed code-interpreter capabilities, allowing agents to write and execute Python or R code for data visualization and statistical analysis. Fine-tune LLMs for specific function-calling and tool-use accuracy within the life sciences domain. System Reliability & Guardrails Develop robust evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-a-judge) to measure agentic performance, truthfulness, and safety in a clinical context. Implement "Human-in-the-loop" (HITL) patterns to ensure high-stakes scientific decisions are always reviewed by domain experts. Partner with Security teams to ensure agents operate within strict data privacy boundaries, preventing prompt injection or unauthorized data egress in federated nodes. Collaboration & Scaling Work with Product and UX teams to design intuitive interfaces for interacting with agentic systems (e.g., conversational research assistants). Scale agentic workloads in production using Kubernetes, ensuring low-latency reasoning and efficient token usage. Requirements Education: BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a highly quantitative field (PhD preferred). Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience as an AI or ML Engineer, building a validated real product, ideally within a product-led biotech, health-tech, or SaaS company. Technical Stack: Deep proficiency in Python and Typescript and standard ML frameworks (e.g., Langfuse, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Scikit-learn). NLP/LLM Expertise: Proven experience working with Large Language Models, including fine-tuning, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures. Cloud & Infrastructure: Familiarity with AWS/Azure/GCP and experience deploying models in Docker/Kubernetes environments. Domain Knowledge: It is a plus to have experience working with biological, genomic, or clinical data is a significant advantage. Autonomy: A self-starter mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive AI projects from concept to production without constant oversight. items.desc: HOLYWATER TECH — це технологічна компанія, яка створює розважальні продукти на перетині людської творчості та штучного інтелекту. Вони є прикладами ШІ-нативних платформ, що переосмислюють способи сторітелінгу та дають змогу будь-кому стати творцем. Екосистема продуктів HOLYWATER TECH включає: → My Drama — стримінгову платформу вертикальних серіалів, №1 серед європейських та американських компаній у ніші → My Passion — цифрову бібліотеку книг №1 у понад 10 країнах світу → My Muse — платформу ШІ-генерованих серіалів, що відкриває нову еру сторітелінгу ___________________________________________________________________________ HOLYWATER TECH сьогодні — це: понад 100+ млн завантажень застосунків стратегічне партнерство з FOX Entertainment х2 рази — щорічне зростання компанії за 2024-2025 роки 30+ міжнародних нагород, зокрема Muse Creative, W3, Telly, Runway AI Film Festival, Lovie понад 100 млн годин переглянутого та прочитаного користувачами контенту провідні позиції у своїх нішах на ринках США та Європи ___________________________________________________________________________ Ми створюємо нові формати, історії та будуємо світ, де єдине обмеження — людська уява. І зараз шукаємо AI Enginner, який готовий/-а долучитися й творити його разом із нами. Твоя місія: Побудова агентських пайплайнів, що перетворюють ідею на готовий епізод серіалу без ручних етапів між сценарієм, генерацією та монтажем. Переведення робочих прототипів (MVP, PoC) у продакшн-реді системи з веб-інтерфейсом, якими користується вся команда. Проєктування єдиної Knowledge Base, доступної одночасно людям і агентам, як основи для спільної роботи різних департаментів. Швидка інтеграція нових генеративних моделей (відео, текст) у продакшн одразу в день їх релізу. Пошук і впровадження нових архітектур агентських систем: multi-agent workflows, tool calling, memory, guardrails, self-recovery. Аналіз патернів у зверненнях користувачів до агентів та автоматизація типових сценаріїв без участі людини. Скорочення часу і ручної редактури на кожному етапі виробництва контенту — від сценарію до фінального монтажу. Постійний моніторинг нових моделей, технік і практик у генеративному AI та їх швидка адаптація в продакшн. ___________________________________________________________________________ Для цього знадобляться такі навички та досвід: 3-4+ років на позиції engineer/developer. Досвід роботи з Typescipt, Nest.js та Next.js. Досвід з PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker. Розуміння Observability. Продакшен досвід з Agentic AI Architecture: проєктування автономних агентів, ієрархічного планування, оркестрації multi-agent систем, динамічних воркфлоу, tool execution та персистентного стану з використанням TypeScript і LangGraph.js/Mastra. Досвід з AI Memory & Knowledge Architecture: GraphRAG, векторні бази даних, Neo4j, графи знань, entity resolution, семантичний пошук та довготривала пам'ять агентів. Досвід з мультимодальним генеративним AI: оркестрація LLM, vision-language моделей та моделей генерації відео; автоматизована оцінка якості, візуальна консистентність, ітеративна регенерація та human-in-the-loop архітектури. Досвід впровадження Agentic AI systems — multi-agent workflows, tool calling, MCP, RAG, state/memory, structured outputs, evaluations, guardrails і recovery. Досвід роботи з генеративним відео — video generation models/API, асинхронні медіапайплайни, FFmpeg, забезпечення consistency та автоматичний quality control. Буде перевагою: Python для AI/ML-прототипів і роботи з моделями Fine-tuning, LoRA, PyTorch GPU infrastructure та inference optimization Computer vision, lip-sync, character consistency Knowledge graphs і hybrid RAG ___________________________________________________________________________ Що отримаєш від нас: Швидке професійне зростання. Ми будуємо середовище, де розвиток — норма: лекції, бібліотеки, хакатони, школи. Компенсуємо профільне навчання й вивчення будь-якої мови, зокрема української. Формат роботи на твій вибір. Можеш працювати вдома, в офісі на київському Подолі чи у Львові (генератори, укриття, обіди, снеки — all inclusive), або ж за кордоном — маємо кілька офісів і там. Техніку та сервіси. Все, що треба для роботи. Відпочинок. 20 днів відпустки + на офіційні свята та безлімітні лікарняні. Турботу про тіло та менталку. Компенсуємо спорт, медстрахування в Україні (після випробувального), послуги корпоративного лікаря і підтримку ментального здоров’я& ___________________________________________________________________________ Чому з нами класно? Реальний вплив. Твої рішення впливають на 100+ млн користувачів — їхній досвід, емоції та час, який вони проводять у продукті. Жива культура. Ми створюємо середовище, де можна експериментувати й пробувати щось нове. Середня оцінка відповіді на питання «Наскільки тобі подобається працювати в HOLYWATER?» за результатами eNPS — 9,23/10. Автономність. Ми довіряємо рішенням команди: мінімум мікроменеджменту, максимум простору для ініціативи й впливу. Сильні люди поруч. Ми постійно челенджимо …

items.desc: Description About InfoGroen For more than 30 years, InfoGroen has helped landscapers, green space contractors and tree nurseries run their businesses more efficiently. Our integrated software gives customers a firm grip on their processes, projects, revenue and margins. As the market leader in automation for the green sector, we keep investing in innovation, expertise and long-term customer relationships. Now we're bringing AI into our products and into the way we build software. The Opportunity: AI Developer We're looking for an AI Developer who uses AI to build better software, faster. You'll own features in our software suite from design to production. You'll use agentic AI to prototype, test, debug and refactor, and help bring AI features to our customers. It's a hands-on builder role for a developer who wants to own outcomes and shape what AI-driven development looks like here. Location: Boskoop, Netherlands (hybrid) Hours: 40 hours per week What You'll Own Feature development and ownership Build, test and ship new features end to end: frontend, backend and integrations Turn business requirements into working software independently, using agentic AI where it helps Maintain a prioritized backlog of improvements, bugs and AI workflows, and drive them to production Clarify scope, edge cases and expected behavior with colleagues in support, consulting and product AI in our products Build AI features for our customers and smart automation inside our software Integrate LLMs and other AI services into production safely and reliably Test AI features against real customer situations and improve them based on usage Agentic AI in the development process Design and integrate AI agents for prototyping, automated testing and validation, debugging, performance analysis and refactoring Review agentic AI output against product goals, code standards and security requirements Keep expanding what AI agents handle, for efficiency and reliability Share what works and help colleagues use AI in their own work Reliability and continuous improvement Troubleshoot production issues and deliver fixes safely and efficiently Improve performance, stability and code quality over time (refactors, tests, cleanup) Document workflows, technical decisions and AI agent behavior What We're Looking For Professional fluency in Dutch and English, spoken and written Off the charts curiosity and work ethic. 3–5 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent strong project-based work Daily, hands-on use of AI-assisted or agentic development tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot), and the ability to show what they deliver for you Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript Experience building production applications with React and Next.js (routing, SSR/SSG, API routes, data fetching) Backend experience with Node.js and/or Python (REST APIs, authentication, third-party integrations) Working knowledge of databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB), including schema design and querying Familiarity with testing practices and frameworks (Jest, Playwright or Cypress) Comfort with Git, pull requests, code reviews and collaborative workflows Solid understanding of web fundamentals: HTTP, authentication, caching, security and performance. Strongly Preferred Experience designing, building or supervising agentic AI tools in software development Experience with LLM integration and prompt engineering in production systems Experience modernizing an established, mature codebase Experience deploying and operating apps on cloud platforms (Vercel, AWS, GCP, Azure or Docker) Experience with CI/CD pipelines, logging, monitoring and automated testing. Why InfoGroen? Help shape how AI changes the way we build software, with real ownership of outcomes A small, product-focused team that ships often and iterates fast, with little bureaucracy and short lines A culture that encourages experimenting with agentic AI while holding a high bar for quality A well-equipped office in Boskoop, known as the “Proeftuin van Holland” (Holland’s horticultural showcase), with the option to work from home when the work allows Room for professional development and training within an international group Fun team outings and great coffee Join Us Already using AI tools daily and want to build real products with them? Send your CV and a short motivation to john.willemsen@infogroen.nl, or call +31 (0)172 235 444 if you'd like to talk first. We use AI-powered tools (including transcription and automated note-taking) during portions of our interview process to support a consistent and thorough candidate experience. Candidates who require alternative accommodation may request it at any stage of the recruitment process. Fluent Software Group is committed to building diverse, equitable, and inclusive teams. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and all qualified applicants will be considered without regard …

items.desc: 3DEXPERIENCE Value X est une équipe d'innovation dont la mission est de transformer l'intelligence artificielle, la connaissance et les capacités de la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE en méthodes de travail plus rapides et plus efficaces. Nous concevons des prototypes de nouvelles approches « AI native » pour améliorer les opérations internes, la relation client et le délai de création de valeur. Vous aiderez l'équipe 3DEXPERIENCE Value X à explorer et prototyper de nouvelles façons « AI native » de gérer les processus internes de Dassault Systèmes. Vos missions Vous travaillerez sur des cas d'usage opérationnels réels, identifierez où l'IA peut simplifier ou transformer nos façons de travailler, et expérimenterez les technologies et approches les plus prometteuses. Vous explorerez des concepts innovants tels que les agents IA, les architectures agentiques, la génération augmentée par recherche documentaire (RAG), les graphes de connaissances, la connaissance structurée (OKF), les protocoles MCP et A2A, les grands modèles de langage et les technologies d'IA émergentes, et les combinerez pour construire des prototypes concrets. Votre objectif sera de tester ce qui fonctionne réellement, de comparer différentes approches, d'en mesurer la valeur et de nous aider à définir des modèles réutilisables qui pourront ensuite être déployés à l'échelle de Dassault Systèmes. Profil recherché Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) en informatique, intelligence artificielle, science des données, génie logiciel ou dans une filière d'ingénierie proche. Vos Qualifications Bonne compréhension de l'IA générative et des grands modèles de langage. Fort intérêt pour les agents IA, la génération augmentée par recherche documentaire, les graphes de connaissances et les architectures agentiques. Bonnes compétences en programmation, de préférence en Python. Connaissances de base sur les interfaces de programmation (API), l'intégration logicielle et les architectures applicatives modernes. Capacité à apprendre rapidement et à expérimenter de nouvelles technologies et de nouveaux outils de développement. Solides capacités d'analyse et curiosité pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels concrets. Capacité à transformer des idées en prototypes simples et fonctionnels. Bonnes qualités de communication et capacité à travailler avec des équipes techniques comme métier. Niveau d'anglais professionnel. Une expérience avec les protocoles MCP et A2A, Git, les bases de données vectorielles, les outils de développement d'agents, les interfaces de programmation des grands modèles de langage, l'automatisation des flux de travail ou les logiciels d'entreprise serait un plus, sans être obligatoire. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc. Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

Екосистема продуктів HOLYWATER TECH включає: → My Drama — стримінгову платформу вертикальних серіалів, №1 серед європейських та американських компаній у ніші → My Passion — цифрову бібліотеку книг №1 у понад 10 країнах світу → My Muse — платформу ШІ-генерованих серіалів, що відкриває нову еру сторітелінгу ___________________________________________________________________________ HOLYWATER TECH сьогодні — це: понад 100+ млн завантажень застосунків стратегічне партнерство з FOX Entertainment х2 рази — щорічне зростання компанії за 2024-2025 роки 30+ міжнародних нагород, зокрема Muse Creative, W3, Telly, Runway AI Film Festival, Lovie понад 100 млн годин переглянутого та прочитаного користувачами контенту провідні позиції у своїх нішах на ринках США та Європи ___________________________________________________________________________ Ми створюємо нові формати, історії та будуємо світ, де єдине обмеження — людська уява. І зараз шукаємо AI Enginner, який готовий/-а долучитися й творити його разом із нами. Твоя місія: Побудова агентських пайплайнів, що перетворюють ідею на готовий епізод серіалу без ручних етапів між сценарієм, генерацією та монтажем. Переведення робочих прототипів (MVP, PoC) у продакшн-реді системи з веб-інтерфейсом, якими користується вся команда. Проєктування єдиної Knowledge Base, доступної одночасно людям і агентам, як основи для спільної роботи різних департаментів. Швидка інтеграція нових генеративних моделей (відео, текст) у продакшн одразу в день їх релізу. Пошук і впровадження нових архітектур агентських систем: multi-agent workflows, tool calling, memory, guardrails, self-recovery. Аналіз патернів у зверненнях користувачів до агентів та автоматизація типових сценаріїв без участі людини. Скорочення часу і ручної редактури на кожному етапі виробництва контенту — від сценарію до фінального монтажу. Постійний моніторинг нових моделей, технік і практик у генеративному AI та їх швидка адаптація в продакшн. ___________________________________________________________________________ Для цього знадобляться такі навички та досвід: 3-4+ років на позиції engineer/developer. Досвід роботи з Typescipt, Nest.js та Next.js. Досвід з PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker. Розуміння Observability. Продакшен досвід з Agentic AI Architecture: проєктування автономних агентів, ієрархічного планування, оркестрації multi-agent систем, динамічних воркфлоу, tool execution та персистентного стану з використанням TypeScript і LangGraph.js/Mastra. Досвід з AI Memory & Knowledge Architecture: GraphRAG, векторні бази даних, Neo4j, графи знань, entity resolution, семантичний пошук та довготривала пам'ять агентів. Досвід з мультимодальним генеративним AI: оркестрація LLM, vision-language моделей та моделей генерації відео; автоматизована оцінка якості, візуальна консистентність, ітеративна регенерація та human-in-the-loop архітектури. Досвід впровадження Agentic AI systems — multi-agent workflows, tool calling, MCP, RAG, state/memory, structured outputs, evaluations, guardrails і recovery. Досвід роботи з генеративним відео — video generation models/API, асинхронні медіапайплайни, FFmpeg, забезпечення consistency та автоматичний quality control. Буде перевагою: Python для AI/ML-прототипів і роботи з моделями Fine-tuning, LoRA, PyTorch GPU infrastructure та inference optimization Computer vision, lip-sync, character consistency Knowledge graphs і hybrid RAG ___________________________________________________________________________ Що отримаєш від нас: Швидке професійне зростання. Ми будуємо середовище, де розвиток — норма: лекції, бібліотеки, хакатони, школи. Компенсуємо профільне навчання й вивчення будь-якої мови, зокрема української. Формат роботи на твій вибір. Можеш працювати вдома, в офісі на київському Подолі чи у Львові (генератори, укриття, обіди, снеки — all inclusive), або ж за кордоном — маємо кілька офісів і там. Техніку та сервіси. Все, що треба для роботи. Відпочинок. 20 днів відпустки + на офіційні свята та безлімітні лікарняні. Турботу про тіло та менталку. Компенсуємо спорт, медстрахування в Україні (після випробувального), послуги корпоративного лікаря і підтримку ментального здоров’я& ___________________________________________________________________________ Чому з нами класно? Реальний вплив. Твої рішення впливають на 100+ млн користувачів — їхній досвід, емоції та час, який вони проводять у продукті. Жива культура. Ми створюємо середовище, де можна експериментувати й пробувати щось нове. Середня оцінка відповіді на питання «Наскільки тобі подобається працювати в HOLYWATER?» за результатами eNPS — 9,23/10. Автономність. Ми довіряємо рішенням команди: мінімум мікроменеджменту, максимум простору для ініціативи й впливу. Сильні люди поруч. Ми постійно челенджимо …

items.desc: AI Engineer £65,000 - £75,000 | Remote / Hybrid Manchester | Permanent Want to build AI that actually makes a difference, rather than another proof of concept that never sees production? We're working with an ambitious, private equity-backed financial services group that's investing heavily in AI to transform how its businesses operate. With hundreds of advisers across the UK, they're building an AI-first technology platform designed to make complex mortgage processes faster, smarter and more efficient. They're now looking for an AI Engineer to take ownership of the data, knowledge and retrieval systems powering their AI assistant. This is a genuinely hands-on opportunity where you'll have real ownership, work closely with a small innovation team and see your work used by hundreds of people across the business. The opportunity The business is developing an intelligent AI assistant that combines lender criteria, client information, business rules and historical case data to help mortgage advisers make better decisions and process cases more efficiently. Your job is to make sure the AI has access to the right information, retrieves it accurately and continues to improve. You'll own the journey from raw data through to the context an LLM uses to generate reliable answers. What you'll be doing Building and maintaining production data pipelines using Python, SQL and APIs. Developing and improving LLM and RAG-based systems. Integrating new data sources and optimising how information is structured, indexed and retrieved. Building evaluation frameworks to measure AI accuracy, reliability and performance. Investigating inaccurate AI responses and fixing the underlying data or retrieval issues. Establishing data governance processes to ensure information is accurate, secure and compliant. Working closely with engineers, product teams and business users to drive adoption and continuous improvement. What we're looking for We're particularly interested in engineers who combine strong data engineering fundamentals with genuine hands-on experience of LLMs and retrieval systems. You'll ideally bring: Strong commercial experience with Python, SQL, APIs and production data pipelines . Hands-on experience building LLM / RAG solutions . Personal projects count if you can demonstrate what you've built. An understanding of embeddings, retrieval strategies, context engineering and AI evaluation. Experience working with cloud-based technologies. AWS Bedrock and LangGraph would be particularly relevant but experience of similar tools would work too. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex data and AI issues. The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Experience within financial services, mortgages or other regulated environments would be useful, but isn't essential. Why consider it? £65,000 - £75,000 salary. Remote working arrangement. The opportunity to build and shape a production AI platform with a genuine business use case. Real ownership of the data and AI architecture rather than simply maintaining someone else's solution. Direct exposure to an ambitious innovation team with significant investment behind it. The chance to work on technology that will be used by hundreds of professionals. A business actively investing in AI as a core part of its future strategy. Interested? If you're a Data Engineer who has moved into AI, or an AI Engineer with strong data engineering foundations, this could be an excellent next step. You don't need to have worked in financial services. What matters is that you understand how to make LLM-powered systems accurate, reliable and genuinely useful in production. Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation.

items.desc: GenAI Functional Analyst Role Overview In an Agile organization, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team (Marketeers, Analysts, Process Engineers, etc.), acting as the bridge between business and technical profiles within the Automation Squad on (Gen)AI topics. As a Functional Analyst, you will analyze and translate requirements and processes into specifications. You will propose end-to-end solutions as part of the team, ensuring they meet business needs and are cost-efficient. Through an iterative and adaptable approach, you will challenge requirements and specifications. By applying an MVP way of working, you will ensure rapid time to market and immediate value creation. Experience Proven experience as an analyst on implementations of GenAI changes within a corporate organization. Proven experience with Generative AI technologies and applications such as Azure AI and AWS. Technical Skills & Requirements AI Functional Knowledge: 3–5 years of experience. AWS: 3–5 years of experience. Trilingual EN/FR/NL: Fluency in English, French and Dutch (either French or Dutch can be at a lower level). Belgian Energy Sector: 3–5 years of experience. Python Scripting: 3–5 years of experience. Key Competencies Strong communication skills, essential for translating technical concepts related to GenAI to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to foster collaboration and build relationships across diverse teams. Demonstrated maturity in stakeholder management, with a focus on outcomes and value. Ability to challenge experienced AI engineers and analysts with a critical mindset. Knowledge of Generative AI principles, including how models such as Large Language Models (LLMs) work. Prompt Engineering and guardrail management skills. Basic or confirmed AWS AgentCore technical skills. Knowledge of Agentic AI within M365 and MS Copilot Studio. Familiarity with data analytics concepts and tools. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, particularly for working with AI models and data manipulation. Ability to analyze, evaluate and visually represent (Gen)AI results. Knowledge of different measurements and KPIs related to (Gen)AI. Main Responsibilities & Deliverables Analysis and preparation of functional specifications. Automation and industrialization of activities. Analysis, evaluation and visualization of Generative AI results. Collaboration with business and technical stakeholders to define and implement end-to-end GenAI solutions. Assignment Details Location: Brussels, Belgium.

items.desc: Job Description: Senior AI Engineer Job Overview: We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join a Framework and Research team developing shared services and technical components used across several product areas. The role combines applied Machine Learning, Generative AI and software engineering. You will design, fine-tune, evaluate and deploy AI/ML models, develop LLM-based solutions and integrate AI capabilities into cloud-native applications. You will work across the full AI solution lifecycle, from proof of concept and data analysis through to production deployment, governance and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Translate business requirements into functional applications and AI/ML solutions. Design, fine-tune, evaluate and deploy AI/ML models for real-world use cases. Develop and refine prompts for LLM-based applications. Experiment with model parameters such as temperature and top-p. Work with GPT, Transformers, Hugging Face and related AI frameworks. Build proofs of concept using Jupyter notebooks and similar research tools. Analyse datasets and assess model performance using suitable evaluation methods. Develop AI pipelines covering data preparation, model execution, testing and deployment. Design and integrate AI capabilities into business applications and shared technical services. Work with cloud AI services such as AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, Azure Machine Learning or equivalent services. Apply AI governance, guardrails, auditing and secure usage practices. Protect data and APIs through appropriate security and privacy controls. Design cloud-native architectures for AI and software solutions. Support production deployment, observability and ongoing model or service improvements. Collaborate with Product Owners, software engineers, data specialists and other stakeholders. Conduct code reviews and contribute to technical standards. Mentor team members and share knowledge across the engineering community. Document AI approaches, model decisions, system architecture and operational procedures. Experience Required: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field. At least 2 years of professional experience in Machine Learning, Generative AI or Data Science. Strong Python development experience. Hands-on experience with AI/ML model development, fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment. Experience with prompt engineering and LLM frameworks or tools. Practical knowledge of GPT, Transformers, Hugging Face or equivalent technologies. Experience working with AWS AI services, such as SageMaker or Bedrock, or equivalent Azure services. Good knowledge of software development, databases and system design. Experience building and integrating AI solutions into applications or technical platforms. Understanding of AI governance, guardrails, auditing, API security and data privacy. Excellent problem-solving skills. Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments. Nice to have: Experience building production-grade AI solutions. Experience across multiple model families, including non-LLM Machine Learning models. Exposure to MLOps, experiment tracking, model versioning and model monitoring. Experience with AI governance frameworks. Cloud or AI certifications from AWS or Microsoft Azure. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and DevOps or CI/CD pipelines. Experience with C# and .NET/.NET Core. Experience with Java and Spring Boot. Experience with Jupyter, Databricks, MLflow or similar tools. Experience working with regulated, sensitive or business-critical data.

items.title: STAGE - IA Agentique : Créer une expérience de R&D unifiée et interactive (F/H)
items.card: Vos missions L’objectif du stage sera de concevoir et prototyper un système d’information intelligent et interactif permettant de construire et d’explorer ce R&D Digital Twin. Vous travaillerez à la fois sur les dimensions architecture, données, Intelligence Artificielle et expérience utilisateur , avec l’objectif de proposer une expérience capable d’agréger, structurer et restituer dynamiquement la connaissance
items.desc: Au sein de l’organisation R&D de Dassault Systèmes, vous rejoindrez une équipe travaillant sur de nouvelles expériences permettant de mieux capitaliser, connecter et exploiter la connaissance produite par les activités de développement . Les informations essentielles à la R&D sont aujourd’hui réparties dans de multiples environnements : documentation technique, dépôts de code, spécifications, tickets, discussions, résultats d’expérimentation ou encore contenus produits par les différentes équipes. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons explorer le concept de R&D Virtual Twin : une représentation numérique, structurée et dynamique de l’écosystème R&D, permettant de connecter les projets, composants logiciels, fonctionnalités, équipes, documents, expérimentations et décisions techniques. L’ambition est de transformer cette connaissance distribuée en une expérience unifiée et interactive , permettant aux développeurs et aux équipes R&D de comprendre rapidement un projet, naviguer dans son historique, identifier les informations pertinentes et explorer les relations entre les différents éléments qui composent son environnement. Vos missions L’objectif du stage sera de concevoir et prototyper un système d’information intelligent et interactif permettant de construire et d’explorer ce R&D Digital Twin. Vous travaillerez à la fois sur les dimensions architecture, données, Intelligence Artificielle et expérience utilisateur , avec l’objectif de proposer une expérience capable d’agréger, structurer et restituer dynamiquement la connaissance R&D. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Définir un modèle de connaissance permettant de représenter et relier projets, composants, fonctionnalités, équipes, documents, expérimentations et décisions techniques ; Développer des mécanismes de collecte, transformation et synchronisation d’informations provenant de sources hétérogènes ; Étudier des représentations telles que les Knowledge Graphs, vues temporelles ou cartographies interactives de projets et composants ; Concevoir des mécanismes de recherche, navigation et exploration de la connaissance ; Exploiter les Large Language Models et technologies d’IA pour rechercher, synthétiser, contextualiser et mettre en relation les informations disponibles ; Développer les services backend et APIs permettant d’exposer cette connaissance aux différentes expériences ; Concevoir et développer un widget Full-Stack interactif permettant de visualiser et explorer dynamiquement le R&D Digital Twin ; Expérimenter de nouvelles formes d’interaction combinant visualisation, navigation et langage naturel. L’objectif final sera de démontrer une nouvelle expérience de capitalisation de la connaissance R&D, transformant des informations distribuées en une représentation structurée, navigable, contextualisée et directement exploitable par les équipes de développement. Vos Qualifications Étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en Master 2, avec une spécialisation en informatique, Intelligence Artificielle, Data Science, Software Engineering ou domaine connexe. Bonnes compétences en développement Full-Stack , avec une maîtrise de technologies Web modernes telles que TypeScript / JavaScript, React, Vue.js ou équivalent . Bonne maîtrise de Python et expérience dans le développement de services backend, APIs et manipulation de données. Connaissances en Intelligence Artificielle et Large Language Models , notamment autour de problématiques telles que le RAG, embeddings, recherche sémantique, tool calling ou systèmes agentiques . Un intérêt ou une première expérience autour des Knowledge Graphs, bases de données graphes, systèmes de recherche ou représentation de connaissances est apprécié. Capacité à concevoir une expérience utilisateur permettant de rendre accessibles des informations complexes à travers des interfaces interactives et des visualisations de données . Intérêt pour les problématiques de Software Engineering, architecture logicielle et environnements R&D complexes . Autonomie, curiosité technique, capacité à prototyper rapidement et à évoluer dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international . Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement collaboratif et innovant Collaboration internationale Diversité des technologies, produits et solutions Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all …

items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Solutions Architecture team works with our largest, most complex users to understand their technical requirements and map those to Stripe technology.
 As a Solutions Architect, you will partner with Sales to technically qualify new business opportunities, demonstrate the art of the possible with the Stripe Platform, and design robust technical solutions to enable payment transactions, manage money movements and simplify financial operational processes.
 What you’ll do 
 You are an experienced technologist with a blend of technical depth and strong business consulting skills. You can write code, but prefer to spend your time working with users to create Stripe solutions to support customer business objectives in complex, mission critical environments. You will think strategically about the art of the possible for the user’s business, and be able to clearly articulate that in a way that informs and builds confidence in Stripe’s technology.
 You should be able to engage and motivate cross-functionally both internally and within our customer’s organisations at all levels, from Cx to Product Engineering. You will have a track record of delivering exceptional customer results as part of a pre-sales team, but a history of deep technical work that gives you the ability to be credible with any audience.
 Responsibilities 
 Engage with Chief Technical Officers, engineering leads, and other technical leads at key users to share technology roadmaps, demonstrate the latest innovations, and define a solution strategy to solve problems.
 Lead technical discussions and solution deep dives with users on the value Stripe can provide to them.
 Serve as an advocate for your customers internally, to ensure their needs are represented with product engineering and to influence product direction and priorities.
 Create technical content (reference architectures, demos, etc.) to share with users as well as speak as a thought leader at industry conferences. 
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 7+ years work experience or equivalent in any mixture of roles including pre-sales, technical architecture (application, technical, systems, integration), technical consulting, application delivery or technical engineering role, with at least 2 years in a customer facing pre-sales role.
 Possess strong technical knowledge in software architecture, have breadth across technology stacks with deep hands on skills, and comfortable talking about technical concepts and explaining how they work, both from a product feature and API architecture perspective.
 Ability to write code.
 Experience with large enterprise customers.
 Strong verbal and written communication abilities, including presenting to large audiences in both German and English.
 Preferred qualifications 
 A background in payments systems and e-commerce solutions is a plus but not a requirement.

 As a Solutions Architect, you will partner with Sales to technically qualify new business opportunities, demonstrate the art of the possible with the Stripe Platform, and design robust technical solutions to enable payment transactions, manage money movements and simplify financial operational processes.
 What you’ll do 
 You are an experienced technologist with a blend of technical depth and strong business consulting skills. You can write code, but prefer to spend your time working with users to create Stripe solutions to support customer business objectives in complex, mission critical environments. You will think strategically about the art of the possible for the user’s business, and be able to clearly articulate that in a way that informs and builds confidence in Stripe’s technology.
 You should be able to engage and motivate cross-functionally both internally and within our customer’s organisations at all levels, from Cx to Product Engineering. You will have a track record of delivering exceptional customer results as part of a pre-sales team, but a history of deep technical work that gives you the ability to be credible with any audience.
 Responsibilities 
 Engage with Chief Technical Officers, engineering leads, and other technical leads at key users to share technology roadmaps, demonstrate the latest innovations, and define a solution strategy to solve problems.
 Lead technical discussions and solution deep dives with users on the value Stripe can provide to them.
 Serve as an advocate for your customers internally, to ensure their needs are represented with product engineering and to influence product direction and priorities.
 Create technical content (reference architectures, demos, etc.) to share with users as well as speak as a thought leader at industry conferences. 
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 7+ years work experience or equivalent in any mixture of roles including pre-sales, technical architecture (application, technical, systems, integration), technical consulting, application delivery or technical engineering role, with at least 2 years in a customer facing pre-sales role.
 Possess strong technical knowledge in software architecture, have breadth across technology stacks with deep hands on skills, and comfortable talking about technical concepts and explaining how they work, both from a product feature and API architecture perspective.
 Ability to write code.
 Experience with large enterprise customers.
 Strong verbal and written communication abilities, including presenting to large audiences in both German and English.
 Preferred qualifications 
 A background in payments systems and e-commerce solutions is a plus but not a requirement.

items.desc:
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
The NextGen Security Automation team is looking for a skilled and driven Software Development Engineer (SDE II) to build autonomous security solutions that protect Amazon’s customers. As an SDE II, you will leverage AI/ML technologies to automate detection, analysis, and response across proactive, offensive, and defensive security at scale. Your work will directly enhance Amazon’s security posture by improving detection capabilities, strengthening guardrails, and advancing automated security tools.
Key job responsibilities
Design and develop AI/ML-driven security automation systems to detect and mitigate threats at scale.
Build and maintain scalable applications that enable real-time threat detection and response.
Collaborate with security teams to enhance existing security practices, guardrails, and tooling.
Develop automated detection systems integrated into Amazon’s security infrastructure.
Research and prototype new security solutions, evaluating design approaches for technical feasibility.
A day in the life
Your day kicks off sipping your morning coffee while diving into the future of autonomous security at Amazon. You're not just coding - you're architecting intelligent systems that drive proactive, offensive, and defensive security at Amazon scale. Working alongside top security engineers and scientists, you're building automated systems that will protect millions of customers across one of the world's largest tech ecosystems. Every line of code you write helps safeguard Amazon's vast digital landscape. It’s a fast-paced environment where you’ll work with advanced technology to build security solutions that protect millions of Amazon customers.
About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
Training and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
The NextGen Security Automation team builds AI-driven security solutions that protect millions of Amazon customers while ensuring strong data governance. We thrive on innovation, collaboration, and solving complex security challenges at scale. DEI is central to our work - we believe diverse perspectives drive stronger solutions. With a focus on automation and intelligence, we push boundaries to keep Amazon’s customers and their data secure.
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience in professional, non-internship software development
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Minimum 6+ years of experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience with AWS Services including EC2, Lambda, S3, …

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Technical Product Owner- Sites, SHE & Sustainability 
 Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world. 
 At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events. 
 Introduction 
 As a Technical Product Owner, you will define the long-term product vision while simultaneously translating complex business processes into requirements tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of the Product Roadmap. 
 The responsibility of RDT Site, SHE & Sustainability spans across the Business Functions Sustainability, Group SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) and the Sites Network, consisting of the large multi-functional sites Mannheim, Penzberg and Ludwigsburg in Germany; South San Francisco, Indianapolis, Pleasanton and Santa Clara in the US; Rotkreuz, Basel/Kaiseraugst and Roche Forum Buonas in Switzerland as well as the global functions Global Capital Investment, Real Estate & Facility Management, Global Data & Digital Solutions and Site Network Strategy. 
 The technology stack of Product Sites supports the solutions of following capabilities: 
 General Site Services & IoT 
 Fixed Asset Strategy, Portfolio & Project Engineering 
 Facility Management & Real Estate 
 Site Logistics, Supply and Disposal 
 Driven by the mission to ensure employees and business functions operate in safe, attractive, and sustainable environments with a unified experience, this role is primarily responsible for defining product vision and strategy. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of technology solutions for a subset of the aforementioned capabilities. Achieving success in this position requires attention to detail along with the ability to balance both global and local business priorities. 
 The Opportunity: 
 Define & Drive Product Vision: Own the end-to-end lifecycle, strategy, and strategic roadmaps for technology solutions within the Site, SHE, and Sustainability capabilities. 
 Translate Ambiguity into Action: I ndependently manage and translate complex, ambiguous business processes and technical requirements into actionable implementation plans and solution roadmaps. 
 Lead Complex Problem Solving: Perform thorough domain research and root cause analysis to deliver comprehensive requirements that guide selection and implementation of optimal solutions. 
 Maximize Business Impact: Proactively identify needs-solution discrepancies and propose creative enhancements that deliver measurable, strategic business value. 
 Serve as a Trusted Advisor: Cultivate strong relationships across diverse cross-functional teams, leveraging deep domain knowledge to align stakeholder expectations with business objectives. 
 Facilitate Strategic Collaboration: Organize and lead workshops, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and establish tailored stakeholder engagement strategies across functional areas. 
 Manage Multi-Solution Complexity: Evaluate product decisions across broader, interconnected solution environments, systematically balancing immediate needs with long-term impacts. 
 Balance Global & Local Priorities: Strategically align technology solutions with overarching global goals while maintaining agility to address local site operational needs. 
 Who you are: 
 …

In this high-impact, networked leadership role, you will empower local teams to drive SHE excellence, lead the regional networks, and streamline SHE management systems in the region. Join a purpose-driven
items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 As our Safety, Security, Health and Environment (SHE) Business Partner for Western Europe & South Africa (WESA) , you will connect our global SHE organization (Group SHE) with technical sites and commercial affiliates across the region, championing our commitment to deliver patient outcomes at no cost to the planet. In this high-impact, networked leadership role, you will empower local teams to drive SHE excellence, lead the regional networks, and streamline SHE management systems in the region. Join a purpose-driven environment where your strategic influence, agility, and collaborative mindset help shape a healthier, more sustainable future. 
 The Opportunity 
 Drive Strategic Regional Alignment: Serve as the primary regional partner for technical sites, commercial affiliates, and new acquisitions, translating global SHE strategies into impactful local initiatives. 
 Champion Simplification & Operational Excellence: Standardize and streamline SHE management systems across the region, removing operational barriers and driving continuous improvement. 
 Empower People & Build Capability: Support the hiring, onboarding, and career growth of SHE professionals, fostering high-performing teams and developing functional talent. 
 Foster Collaborative Networks: Establish thriving regional communities of practice to facilitate knowledge sharing, benchmark mature sites, and align with cross-functional business partners. 
 Advocate & Influence: Partner closely with divisional and business leaders to embed SHE as a core management responsibility while voicing regional priorities and needs within Group SHE. 
 Lead Dynamic Initiatives: Contribute flexibly as both an agile project leader and a subject matter expert across key regional and global safety, health, resilience and environmental initiatives. 
 Who you are 
 Education & Core Experience: You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or Natural Sciences, alongside at least 8 years of practical experience across Safety, Health, Security, Business Continuity, or Environmental Protection. 
 Leadership & Site Expertise: You bring 4+ years of leadership experience in SHE, backed by a proven track record of implementing health and safety programs in R&D or manufacturing environments. 
 Networked Leadership: You excel in matrix organizations, demonstrating outstanding stakeholder engagement and the ability to inspire, guide, and influence without direct authority. 
 Strategic Problem-Solver: You thrive in complex, fast-changing environments, applying an aptitude for radical simplification and pragmatism to balance near-term operational needs with long-term strategic vision. 
 Collaborative & Growth-Oriented: You bring a courageous, open-minded approach, an experimental mindset, the drive to proactively engage with stakeholders and exceptional communication skills in English (German is an asset). 
 We look forward to your application! 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
