Job Description: 
 Chez Airbus Atlantic, on façonne l’aéronautique de demain ! 
 Nous vous proposons de rejoindre Airbus Atlantic , leader industriel mondial en matière d'aérostructures, de sièges pilotes et de fauteuils passagers de classe affaires et de première classe. Nous innovons sans cesse pour définir de nouveaux standards d’excellence industrielle. Nous préparons le futur pour une industrie aérospatiale compétitive et durable. 
 Etes-vous notre prochain Préparateur (All Gender) ? 
 🎯 Votre mission 
 Au sein de notre site de Rochefort , vous intégrerez l'équipe Manufacturing Engineering (ME) . Vous aurez en charge la gestion d’éléments avion ( A330 ). 
 Vous serez principalement en interaction avec les métiers du Bureau d’études (BE), de la qualité, des méthodes, de l’outillage et de la production. 
 Garantir : Accompagner le produit tout au long de sa fabrication afin d’assurer les livraisons aux niveaux attendus en termes de coûts, de qualité et de délais, tout en veillant à l'application des règles et référentiels liés au métier ME. 
 Optimiser : Définir et mettre à jour les gammes, nomenclatures, temps de fabrication, outillages requis et fiches d'instruction d'assemblage selon les processus applicables. 
 Collaborer : Faire l'interface technique avec le BE pour intégrer les contraintes de fabrication, et soutenir le quotidien de l’atelier (résolution de problèmes, routines, amélioration continue). 
 🛠️ Votre profil (Ce qui fera la différence) 
 Vous avez minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans l’industrie , idéalement dans une fonction liée aux méthodes (d’assemblage ou logistique) ou à l’industrialisation. 
 Dynamique et innovant, votre capacité naturelle à communiquer vous permet d’être disponible, à l’écoute mais aussi force de proposition au sein du métier et de l'équipe multi technique. 
 Vous vous exprimez avec clarté et savez adapter votre communication en fonction de vos audiences. 
 Vous avez à cœur de travailler en équipe, de partager votre savoir, d’apprendre et de grandir auprès de vos collègues. 
 Vous maitrisez les outils CATIA et SAP. 
 Poste non cadre. 
 💎 Notre entreprise 
 Boostez votre carrière : Un accompagnement sur-mesure et mobilité interne boostée. 
 Équilibre vie pro/vie perso : Bénéficiez de 6 semaines de congés payés et de RTT. 
 Package attractif : Plan d’épargne salariale, actionnariat salarié et une mutuelle individuelle ou familiale. 
 Engagement au quotidien : Incitation financière à la mobilité durable (vélo, covoiturage, transports) et opportunité de participer à des projets caritatifs et sociaux stimulants. 
 Qualité de vie : Restaurant d’entreprise et un CSE dynamique (loisirs, culture, vacances). 
 Culture inclusive : La diversité fait partie de notre ADN. 
 ✈️ Le site de Rochefort 
 Le site Airbus Atlantic de Rochefort est spécialisé dans l'assemblage d'éléments de fuselage pour les familles A320, A330, A350, A400M, F8X et G7500. Il produit aussi des sièges pilotes pour les avions commerciaux tous programmes confondus, les avions d’affaires, les avions militaires et les hélicoptères civils et militaires. Enfin, il conçoit et fabrique des fauteuils passagers Première Classe et Classe Affaires commercialisés sous la marque STELIA Aerospace. 
 Pour en savoir plus : vidéo

 Analyse de votre candidature par nos recruteurs. 
 Entretien vidéo différé (HireVue). 
 Questionnaire de personnalité. 
 Entretiens Manager et RH pour confirmer le "match" technique et humain.

Permanent -----

Professional

Manufacturing Engineering <JF-MA-ME>

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Un poste d’ Architecte Plateforme IT pour les Segments Sol (h/f) vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Defence & Space à Toulouse.
 Secteur en fort développement, les segments sol sont la partie visible de nos systèmes spatiaux et de défense. Les volumes de données générées et les besoins en traitement toujours grandissants de ces systèmes exigent que nos plateformes soient innovantes, stables et fiables.
 Vous rejoindrez le Centre de Compétences (CoC) « Customer Cloud/IT platforms Engineering & Solutions ​ » . La mission principale de cette entité est de concevoir et livrer des plateformes IT intégrées et sécurisées (incluant le matériel, le réseau, la virtualisation, la conteneurisation ainsi que les services applicatifs).
 Le Centre de Compétences « Customer Cloud/IT platforms Engineering & Solutions » est sollicité par l’ensemble des Business Unit (BU) d’Airbus Defence and Space.
 Les enjeux sont multiples:
 Conseiller les architectes du système complet dans la définition des besoins,
 Conseiller les équipes de développement dans le respect des bonnes pratiques Cloud-native,
 Dimensionner et designer des plateformes évolutives en adéquation avec les besoins métier exprimés,
 Optimiser le design en prenant en compte l’ensemble des contraintes
 Ce poste vous permet de développer vos compétences techniques dans les domaines suivants : Environnement Cloud-Native, Automatisation des déploiements (Terraform Ansible), infrastructures IT (hardware, réseau, virtualisation, orchestration de conteneurs, stockage), sécurité du système d'information, et de les valider en passant les certifications correspondantes (CKA, CKS pour Kubernetes ou GIAC pour la SSI par exemple).
 L’infrastructure étant le socle de tout système IT, ce poste vous permet également de développer vos compétences dans le domaine des segments sol et la coordination de projet.
 Ce poste nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.
 Tâches et responsabilités : 
 Vos missions et responsabilités consisteront à concevoir des plateformes au travers des activités principales suivantes :
 Interface avec les clients (internes ou externes) et les fournisseurs
 Analyse des besoins et établissement de la conformité,
 Participation active au développement continu de notre ligne de solution de référence interne,
 Rédaction des spécifications d'interfaces,
 Contribution au dossier de spécifications système, dossier d'architecture système,
 Dimensionnement et optimisation des budgets d'infrastructure (multi-millions d'euros) et accompagnement des achats pour l'acquisition des plateformes,
 Prise en compte des problématiques de disponibilité et d’obsolescence,
 Supporter l’intégration des plateformes conçues.
 Pour atteindre ces objectifs, vous serez amené(e) à mettre en place les activités suivantes :
 Communication avec l’équipe ingénierie,
 Prise en compte des contraintes budget, planning et légales
 Design de prototypes permettant de conforter les choix d'architecture,
 Simulation des choix pressentis d'architecture pour confirmer le design,
 Veille sur les nouvelles technologies IT,
 Contribution aux activités de R&D et R&T.
 L’ensemble de ces activités sont menées dans le cadre de projets opérationnels structurés (planning, budget, livrables).
 Compétences requises 
 Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
 Titulaire d'un diplôme d’Ingénieur ou équivalent en informatique/IT, Système d’information, ou une discipline apparentée,
 Connaissances approfondies des principes de design d’une infra IT et de sa sécurisation comprenant : 
 Hardware (serveur, CPU, RAM, GPU, NIC, TDP, conso, …) 
 Réseau (switch, firewall, routeur, VLAN, overlay, …) 
 Operating Systems (Linux, Windows) 
 Virtualisation (KVM, VMWare, Nutanix, XCP-NG, Proxmox, …) 
 Orchestration de conteneurs (Kubernetes, Rancher, OpenShift, Docker, Podman, …) 
 Stockage (Ceph, iSCSI, NFS, …) 
 QoS / SLA 
 Connaissance de l’environnement Cloud-native (Kubernetes et tout l’écosystème CNCF),
 Connaissance des principaux cloud privés (e.g VMWare, Nutanix, Suse Virtualisation, XCP-NG, Proxmox…),
 Connaissance des principaux services IT (IAM, DNS, NTP, Logs, Supervision, Antivirus…),
 Connaissance de l’Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et des outils tels que Terraform, Ansible, ClusterAPI,
 Niveau d’Anglais intermédiaire (B1 minimum, capacité à intervenir dans des meetings avec des clients anglophones),
 Français courant obligatoire,
 Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle mettant en œuvre des technologies similaires.
 Vous avez les compétences relationnelles suivantes : 
 Autonomie, curiosité, force de proposition,
 Capacité à challenger les besoins,
 Capacité à travailler en équipe,
 Capacité à communiquer au sein de l’équipe, mais aussi vers les clients et fournisseurs,
 Capacité à l’autoformation,
 Capacité à faire preuve de discipline et de respect.

Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Le Campus de Gennevilliers est le cœur des activités de conception, de développement et de soutien des grands systèmes de défense : radiocommunications, réseaux et systèmes d’infrastructure résilients, communications par satellite, combat collaboratif et cybersécurité. Situé au nord de Paris, il est rapidement accessible en transports en commun. 
 Au sein du service "Waveform Embedded Processing", nous intervenons sur les postes radio réalisés par SIX, pour l'ensemble des gammes de transmission (VLF, HF, V/UHF, SHF, EHF) et différents types de liaisons (aéronautiques, navales, terrestres, Satellites). Nous concevons et implémentons les logiciels couches physiques (algorithmes traitement du signal) et Lower MAC. Leurs intégrations sont réalisées sur cible DSP ou GPP avec des contraintes embarqués et temps réel fortes puis avec la radio.
 Pour répondre à ces challenges, nous sommes 35 personnes (des développeurs, des intégrateurs, des architectes logiciels, des SwEM et IVQM) répartis sur les sites de (Gennevilliers et Cholet).
 Naturellement, nous encourageons le partage des connaissances et la montée en compétence au sein de l’équipe avec des projets variés pour de nombreux cas d’emplois au sein des produits SIX.
 Vous intégrez les équipes MODEM en charge des développements couche physique et Lower MAC pour le segment des communications satellites ou LOS. Les équipes sont à tailles humaines (2 à 3 personnes pour la plus petite), 6 à 8 pour l’équipe de développement la plus importante.
 Dans le cadre de votre poste, vous êtes :
 Responsable techniquement de l'architecture logicielle et de sa cohérence avec celle de la solution. L’architecte logiciel se coordonne avec l'Architecte de la solution et le PDA afin de s'assurer que la déclinaison "top-down" de la solution est cohérente avec la stratégie logicielle, les contraintes de sélection de COTS & OSS et la réutilisation de composants.
 S'assure que la stabilité de l'architecture logicielle est maintenue tout au long du cycle de vie de l'offre jusqu'à la livraison;
 Dirige et coordonne les études d'architecture logicielle;
 Approuve les choix techniques, technologiques et méthodologiques pris dans le respect de l'architecture logicielle approuvée;
 Garantit le respect des standards, de la politique de reuse et des plans de développement produits;
 Coordonne la définition produit et l'évaluation des compromis entre les aspects coûts, exigences client et possibilités technologiques;
 Prépare les dossiers de conception et de justification (SSDD, D&JF)
 Fournit la connaissance de l'état de l'art des architectures logicielles en prenant en compte les développements futurs;.
 Pilote les développements technologiques.
 Réalisé les développements logiciels qui lui sont confiés
 Votre profil :
 De formation Ecole d’ingénieur, filière informatique embarquée temps réel, v ous avez 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel embarqué/temps réel, idéalement sur des processeurs de type DSP ou GPP (Cortex A7 ou A8 par exemple) 
 Ce que vous savez faire : 
 Concevoir en objet des programmes en C++
 Les intégrer sur cibles embarqué temps réel,
 Reconnaitre et utiliser des designs patterns
 Estimer les complexités des algorithmes traitement du signal
 Analyser les besoins et proposer des architectures logiciels pour répondre au user goal de nos développements
 Debugger sur cible grâce à une sonde JTAG
 Savoir utiliser des outils de développement : gestionnaire de code source (Git) et workflow de tickets ou faits techniques ( JIRA par exemple).
 Ce que l’on reconnait chez vous : 
 Rigueur
 Capacité à travailler en équipe,
 Une grande curiosité
 Une forte capacité d’apprentissage et d’adaptation
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! 
Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense …

items.desc:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity. Our EMEA organization translates OpenAI’s global mission and strategy into meaningful local impact, working across Growth, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance.

About the Role

As Strategy and Operations lead, you will develop country strategies, identify the most important market opportunities and barriers, align cross-functional teams around a focused set of priorities, and personally drive initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

This is an individual-contributor role. The primary focus is Consumer, with opportunities to create adjacent impact across B2B. You will go deep in a small number of priority markets while building approaches that can scale across EMEA.

This is not a strategy-only role. The successful candidate will combine rigorous analysis and market judgment with urgency, hands-on execution and the ability to influence without formal authority.

This role is based in Munich or Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Build country strategies: Develop plans, priorities and forecasts for key European markets and translate company strategy into practical local action.

 - Drive growth and conversion: Use data, customer insight and experimentation to improve acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion and monetization.

 - Lead market expansion and localization: Identify opportunities, build scalable launch frameworks and determine where products and go-to-market should adapt.

 - Turn strategy into execution: Personally move initiatives from diagnosis and prioritization through delivery, measurement and iteration.

 - Lead cross-functional teams: Align Product, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Partnerships, Finance, Research, Operations and Compliance around shared outcomes.

 - Represent regional insight: Ensure European market and customer perspectives shape global roadmaps and decisions.

 - Measure and scale impact: Define success metrics and determine when a successful local approach should be replicated.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 10 years + of experience in growth, strategy, business operations or quantitative analytics with meaningful responsibility for outcomes.

 - Have developed country, regional or multi-market strategies and translated them into focused execution plans.

 - Bring exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, including forecasting, financial modeling and growth metrics.

 - Can show examples of personally taking initiatives from insight through launch and measurement.

 - Understand European markets while maintaining a regional and scalable perspective.

 - Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and influence teams without formal authority.

 - Operate with high ownership and urgency in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments.

 - Have a deep interest in AI and alignment with OpenAI’s mission.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

items.desc:
About the Team

The Intelligence & Investigations Engineering team builds systems that detect, analyze, and disrupt abuse across OpenAI’s products. We partner closely with the Child Safety team and cross-functional groups to protect users while advancing OpenAI’s goal of developing AI that benefits everyone.

About the Role

As a Fullstack Engineer focused on child safety, you’ll build data-intensive, AI-powered applications and infrastructure that enable operators and investigators to work effectively and responsibly. You’ll adapt quickly in ambiguous, fast-moving environments to deliver well-crafted, reliable tooling for high-severity safety work.

*Candidates should understand this role involves exposure to sensitive and egregious content.

In this role, you will:

 - 7+ years of experience as a software engineer

 - Prototype, build, and maintain intelligence systems that detect, triage, and enable efficient human review of possible high severity harm

 - Work hand in hand with operators and investigators, designing and delivering systems that enable them to do their work faster, more accurately, and more safely.

 - Develop across the stack: UIs, services, pipelines, and anything else required to solve the problems we face.

 - Interact with partners across Product Policy, Platform Integrity, Safety Systems, and Research

 - Contribute to the team’s technical strategy, especially for child safety related tools and systems

 - Report on impact in a data-driven fashion

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a strong software engineering foundation and enjoy owning systems end-to-end—from infrastructure and data ingestion to frontend tooling

 - Are energized by working at the frontier of AI capabilities, integrating new models and APIs into practical systems

 - Have experience building and operating large-scale data pipelines or search/retrieval systems

 - Are proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, and familiar with tools like Spark, Kafka, Flink, data warehouses, and SQL

 - Take a product-minded approach, design with user workflows in mind, and iterate quickly based on feedback

 - Favor pragmatic solutions and can ship in hacky, low-support environments when needed

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and open-ended problem spaces with evolving goals

 - Have prior experience working on engineering for high-severity harms

 - Bring intuition for the pain points and workflows of operations and investigative teams, and curiosity about solving complex investigations

 - Bonus: prior knowledge of child-safety-specific challenges such as secure handling of quarantined content and reporting to NCMEC

items.desc:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
 The Strategic Sourcing Analyst is a role responsible for driving end-to-end sourcing events, commercial negotiations, and contract structuring across key technology spend categories, including IT infrastructure, software, IT services, and staffing agencies. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, owning the entire sourcing lifecycle from initial market analysis and RFP execution to final contract drafting and vendor onboarding, ensuring optimal value and mitigated risk for the business.
 “Negotiates high-value tech contracts and ensures we only pay for delivered results” 
 Responsibilities 
 Lead single-source negotiations and competitive RFPs across multiple technology and services spend categories.
 Negotiate and secure favorable tier discounts, pricing models, and commercial terms with key technology and service vendors.
 Structure complex Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring that agency fee disbursements are strictly tied to measurable delivery milestones and performance metrics.
 Standardize contractor rate cards and implement labor caps across all staff augmentation and external consulting engagements.
 Conduct comprehensive market analysis to inform sourcing strategies and benchmark pricing.
 Draft, review, and refine contract terms in close collaboration with Legal, Security, and Finance teams.
 Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, aligning sourcing strategies with broader organizational goals.
 5+ years of proven experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or vendor management, with specific expertise in technology categories (Cloud, SaaS, IT Services, Staffing). 
 Exceptional negotiation skills with a history of driving cost savings and favorable commercial terms. 
 Deep understanding of contract structures, particularly in milestone-based SOWs and standardized labor rate cards. 
 Strong analytical skills to evaluate market trends, pricing models, and total cost of ownership. 
 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.
 Comfortable managing end-to-end sourcing processes without relying on heavy, legacy ERP systems.
 Important information for candidates 
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
 Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

items.desc:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
 The Strategic Sourcing Analyst is a role responsible for driving end-to-end sourcing events, commercial negotiations, and contract structuring across key technology spend categories, including IT infrastructure, software, IT services, and staffing agencies. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, owning the entire sourcing lifecycle from initial market analysis and RFP execution to final contract drafting and vendor onboarding, ensuring optimal value and mitigated risk for the business.
 “Negotiates high-value tech contracts and ensures we only pay for delivered results” 
 Responsibilities 
 Lead single-source negotiations and competitive RFPs across multiple technology and services spend categories.
 Negotiate and secure favorable tier discounts, pricing models, and commercial terms with key technology and service vendors.
 Structure complex Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring that agency fee disbursements are strictly tied to measurable delivery milestones and performance metrics.
 Standardize contractor rate cards and implement labor caps across all staff augmentation and external consulting engagements.
 Conduct comprehensive market analysis to inform sourcing strategies and benchmark pricing.
 Draft, review, and refine contract terms in close collaboration with Legal, Security, and Finance teams.
 Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, aligning sourcing strategies with broader organizational goals.
 5+ years of proven experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or vendor management, with specific expertise in technology categories (Cloud, SaaS, IT Services, Staffing). 
 Exceptional negotiation skills with a history of driving cost savings and favorable commercial terms. 
 Deep understanding of contract structures, particularly in milestone-based SOWs and standardized labor rate cards. 
 Strong analytical skills to evaluate market trends, pricing models, and total cost of ownership. 
 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.
 Comfortable managing end-to-end sourcing processes without relying on heavy, legacy ERP systems.

items.desc:
Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Álvaro, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich ! 
 First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Who Are We? 
 Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units. 
 In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions. 
 If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale. 
 What Can You Expect? 
 As a Software Asset Management Specialist - Governance, you will have the opportunity to: 
 Define and continuously evolve the SAM Governance framework, including policies, standards, processes, ownership and accountability, and controls. 
 Establish governance mechanisms that enable effective management of software cost, risk, compliance and value. 
 Provide strategic SAM advice for software investments, renewals, contracts, technology decisions and major vendor relationships. 
 Own the SAM governance data framework, ensuring data quality, consistency, transparency and fitness for decision – making across software assets, entitlements, consumption and financial information. 
 Define and monitor SAM KPIs, dashboards and management information, translating complex data into actionable insights, risks, opportunities and recommendations for stakeholders. 
 Drive continuous improvement of SAM data sources, processes and automation to increase reliability and reduce manual effort. 
 Challenge software consumption, purchasing and renewal decisions to maximize value and minimize unnecessary spending. 
 Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, IT, Security, Architecture and Business Units to ensure SAM considerations are embedded into relevant decision processes. 
 Lead improvements in SAM processes, data quality, automation and reporting, leveraging technology and AI, where appropriate. 
 Define and monitor governance KPIs, demonstrating measurable business impact. 
 Complete SAM activities, and support daily activities in the function, when required. 
 Define and lead the SAM communication strategy, ensuring the key messages, risks, opportunities, policies and decisions are clearly communicated to stakeholders at the appropriate level. 
 What Makes You a Great Fit? 
 We’re not seeking perfection, but we believe you’ll be a strong fit if you bring most of the following experience and capabilities: 
 Technical and SAM expertise 
 6+ years of relevant experience in Software Asset Management within large, complex enterprise IT environments, including hands-on software portfolio and governance responsibilities. 
 Strong knowledge of software licensing terms, restrictions and optimization opportunities, with hands-on effective license position calculations for at least one Tier 1 or Tier 2 vendor such as Microsoft, IBM, Oracle, Broadcom, Cloud Software Group, SAP or Adobe. 
 Experience with SAM tools, ideally Flexera One, advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities, and proven delivery of cost optimization, risk reduction and compliance improvements. 
 Experience managing SAM data quality, dashboards and reporting, plus practical adoption of AI solutions and automation in SAM. 
 Governance, financial and stakeholder management 
 Proven experience developing or implementing governance frameworks, policies, processes and controls, and defining measurable KPIs. 
 Ability to work across IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture and Business Units, influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority. 
 Strong financial and commercial acumen, including software cost impact, P&L calculations and accruals. 
 Personal skills 
 Strategic and analytical thinking, attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations. 
 Strong communication, networking and negotiation skills with internal stakeholders and software vendors. 
 Effective organisation, productivity, time and project …

items.card: Responsibilities: Platform Strategy & Architectural Roadmap Architectural Vision: Define and maintain the target architecture, reference patterns, and multi-year technology roadmap for the corporate ServiceNow platform and owns technical debt reduction roadmaps New Capability Evaluation: Evaluate major ServiceNow family releases and Platform emerging capabilities (e.g. Workflow Studio, IntegrationHub, App Engine,
items.desc:
Serves as the enterprise design authority for the corporate ServiceNow platform ecosystem, defining the architectural vision, technical standards, and multi-year platform roadmap. Owns the Common Service Data Model (CSDM 5.0) strategy, integration architecture, and technical governance to ensure all solutions across ITSM, ITOM, CSM, and custom applications remain secure, performant, and upgrade-resilient. Partners with Product Stream Managers, Lead Developers, and corporate enterprise architects to translate complex business demands into scalable platform capabilities while strictly preventing customization sprawl.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Platform Strategy & Architectural Roadmap 
 Architectural Vision: Define and maintain the target architecture, reference patterns, and multi-year technology roadmap for the corporate ServiceNow platform and owns technical debt reduction roadmaps
 New Capability Evaluation: Evaluate major ServiceNow family releases and Platform emerging capabilities (e.g. Workflow Studio, IntegrationHub, App Engine, Platform Intelligence, NowAssists) to advise leadership on adoption, licensing implications, and technical readiness.
 Integration & Security Architecture 
 Integration Patterns: Design secure, scalable integration patterns for connecting ServiceNow with enterprise systems (SAP, Azure Entra ID, Microsoft 365, internal Data Lakes, and monitoring tools).
 API Governance: Enforce standardized REST/SOAP integration contracts, webhook handlers, and IntegrationHub spoke usage
 Platform Security & Least Privilege: Architect security role mappings, Access Control Lists (ACLs), encryption standards, and scoped application boundaries, ensuring zero unauthorized privilege escalation and full compliance with corporate security and data privacy mandates (GDPR, AI Act).
 Governance & Technical Authority 
 Technical Review Board (TRB): Act as the core decision authority on the platform TRB, evaluating incoming solution designs, approving architectural spikes, and enforcing the "Configure First, Customize Last" principle.
 Pre-Approved "Paved Roads": Create and publish reusable architectural blueprints, and standard templates that allow development squads to build with autonomy and velocity.
 Squad Enablement & Coaching: Guide and coach Lead Developers across distributed squads, ensuring that implementations adhere to enterprise platform standards.
Experience & Qualifications: 
 Experience: 6+ years in enterprise software development, with at least 4 to 5 years of deep, hands-on ServiceNow development and a proven track record of technically leading delivery teams.
 Technical Mastery: Expert-level JavaScript and ServiceNow architecture; deep expertise across Flow Designer, complex Scripted REST APIs, Service Portal architecture, and scoped application isolation.
 Engineering Leadership: Demonstrated experience driving code quality standards, automated testing (ATF), and managing CI/CD pipelines (ServiceNow CLI, Git, Update Set batching).
 Domain Breadth: Strong working knowledge of CSDM 5.0, ITIL 4 processes, and modern AI/agentic integration capabilities.
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
 Certifications: 
 Required: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), and at least one Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS - ITSM, Discovery, or Customer Service Management).
 Preferred: ITIL 4 Managing Professional / Foundation, or Agile/Scrum certification (PSM / SAFe).

items.desc:
As a Marketing Data Domain Owner , you will be responsible for establishing consistent marketing data standards, ensuring data quality and enabling reliable data usage across marketing channels and systems.
 You will be part of a global, cross-functional environment where your expertise will directly contribute to strengthening our marketing data capabilities.
 Your tasks: 
 Take ownership of the global marketing data schema, taxonomy and naming conventions across marketing channels and systems in close collaboration with the Business Digital Organization.
 Define and maintain marketing data standards, KPIs, data quality rules and adoption requirements to ensure consistency across the organization.
 Ensure marketing data structures support effective segmentation, reporting, attribution and activation across different marketing use cases.
 Translate business needs into prioritized data product requirements and align them with technical platform roadmaps and delivery teams.
 Review and approve campaign, event and attribute structures when integrating new marketing data sources and channels.
 Conduct regular data governance reviews and monitor compliance with established standards across regions and marketing touchpoints.
 Establish data quality thresholds and escalation procedures to identify and address structural anomalies and deviations.
 Develop, maintain and communicate the global marketing data dictionary and governance guidelines to support consistent implementation.
 Collaborate with global and regional marketing teams, technical experts and other data domain owners to drive alignment and adoption of common data standards.
Education: University degree in Business Informatics, Data Science, Marketing, Economics or a related field with a strong quantitative focus.
 Experience: 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in Marketing Data Governance, Data Management or Digital Marketing Analytics, with a proven track record in developing marketing taxonomies, tracking and data collection frameworks, and data quality standards. Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDP), Marketing Automation systems or Product Information Management (PIM) tools is a strong plus.
 Data Governance & Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of marketing data models, schemas, tracking structures and taxonomy standardization. Ability to define and implement data quality rules and metrics, identify structural inconsistencies and translate marketing business requirements into technical data specifications in collaboration with Data Engineers and Data Scientists.
 Personality: Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, with the ability to structure complex and diverse requirements into scalable solutions. A proactive and independent working style, combined with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to align cross-functional teams across different organizational levels.
 Languages: Fluent English, both written and spoken (C1/C2 level), enabling effective communication and collaboration in an international environment.

items.desc:
The Enterprise Application Assurance Architect is part of the IT Enterprise Architecture (EA) team and is responsible for ensuring the security of Sonova’s application landscape. The role ensures that new and existing applications meet information security requirements and that risks are properly identified, documented, and managed according to Sonova’s security standards and regulatory expectations. 
 The position focuses on assessing applications, identifying security design gaps, and recommending architectural controls aligned with enterprise architecture principles and security directives. 
 More about the role : 
 Drive the evolution of enterprise security architecture in alignment with EA principles and security standards. 
 Perform security assessments for new applications, major changes, and vendors (including custom and SaaS solutions). 
 Review security documentation (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, pen-test reports, architecture diagrams) and assess risks. 
 Identify security gaps and recommend risk-based remediation and security-by-design controls. 
 Document recommendations and support the risk management process, escalating issues when required. 
 Contribute to the Enterprise Architecture Review Board with security recommendations. 
 Collaborate with architects and cross-functional teams (Security, Legal, Data Privacy, IT Infrastructure, SecOps). 
 Support continuous improvement of security assessment processes and provide insights on risk trends and compliance. 
 More about you : 
 10+ years of IT experience, including security architecture or security engineering in enterprise environments. 
 Degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Business IT, or equivalent experience. 
 Security certification (e.g., CISSP, CISM) or equivalent professional experience. 
 Strong knowledge of security architecture, risk and compliance alignment, and audit-ready controls. 
 Broad understanding of application and integration security (IAM/PAM, cloud, data, network security, logging/monitoring, vulnerability management). 
 Experience reviewing technical security documentation and performing vendor or third-party security assessments. 
 Strategic thinker aligning business, risk, and security architecture. 
 Strong communicator simplifying complex security topics. 
 Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach. 
 Collaborative leadership in matrix environments. 
 Continuous learning mindset. 
 Professional proficiency in English. 
 More about what we offer : 
 As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

items.desc:
Entdecke, was du bei der KUKA Group bewegen kannst. 
 Die KUKA Group bietet ein enormes Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere voranzutreiben, deiner Leidenschaft zu folgen und dein Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Automatisierungsspezialisten und bieten globale Möglichkeiten in Bereichen wie Robotik, Automatisierung, Logistik, Softwarelösungen und Elektronik. Wenn du ein Macher bist, ein Visionär mit kühnen Ambitionen und dir Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Respekt wichtig sind, dann bist du hier bei KUKA Group auf Erfolgskurs.
 Hier bewirkst du etwas 
 Koordination der SPS- und Roboterinbetriebnahme in der Planungsphase und auf der Baustelle bis zur Endabnahme für den Anlagenbau im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik 
 Personalplanung und Führung von internationalen Teams
 Betreuung und Koordination von Lieferanten und Partnern gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam
 Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden vor Ort
 Kostenmanagement, Terminverfolgung und Reporting
 Beurteilung von technischen Problemen und Erarbeitung von Lösungsvorschlägen 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Ingenieur/Meister/Techniker oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
 Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und in der Mitarbeiterführung
 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme im Bereich des automatisierten roboterbasierten Anlagenbaus 
 Ausgeprägtes Planungs- und Organisationstalent
 Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen
 Gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Fremdsprachen von Vorteil vorzugsweise chinesisch
 Hohe Kundenorientierung
 Hohe weltweite Reisebereitschaft (>= 80 %) mit Fokus auf den europäischen Raum. Konstante Aufenthaltsdauer von 3-18 Monaten bei einem Projekt mit regelmäßigen bezahlten Heimfahren (alle 2-4 Wochen). Deshalb Augsburg als Wohnort nicht zwingend notwendig
 Unser Versprechen an dich 
 Unsere Kultur ist tief in unserer Leidenschaft, Robotik und Automatisierungslösungen für jeden zugänglich und einfach nutzbar zu machen, verwurzelt. Das Ergebnis? Wir machen das Leben der Menschen einfacher und sicherer, überall auf der Welt. Vielfalt ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – und wir schätzen jeden einzelnen unserer klugen und kreativen Köpfe. Wir ermutigen jeden, sich bei der Arbeit voll und ganz einzubringen, und fördern so ein Umfeld, in dem Inspiration, Fachwissen und persönliches Wachstum gedeihen können. Unser gemeinsames Ziel? Wir wollen Großes erreichen und innovative, positive Veränderungen anstoßen - nicht nur innerhalb der Automatisierungsbranche, sondern auch über deren Grenzen hinaus. Im Gegenzug legen wir großen Wert darauf, eine unterstützende, fördernden und fürsorgliche Umgebung für alle zu schaffen.
 Vorteile und Leistungen 
 Als Teil unseres Engagements für das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten wir eine Reihe umfassender Vorteile und Leistungen. Von wettbewerbsfähigen Gehaltspaketen über flexible Arbeitszeiten bis hin zu beruflichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten - wir wollen einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz für die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten. Es ist uns wichtig, die harte Arbeit und das Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden anzuerkennen und zu würdigen, und unsere Zusatzleistungen spiegeln dies wider. Unser Ziel ist es, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeitenden wertgeschätzt, motiviert und inspiriert fühlen, ihr Bestes zu geben. Sei dabei und profitiere davon, Teil eines Teams zu sein, dem das Wohl und Wachstum seiner Mitarbeitenden am Herzen liegt.
 DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) 
 Der Kern unserer Überzeugung liegt darin, einander mit Freundlichkeit, Aufgeschlossenheit und gegenseitigem Respekt zu begegnen, mit dem Ziel, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle befähigt fühlen, ihr authentisches Selbst bei der Arbeit einzubringen. KUKA ist ein Unternehmen, das sich für Chancengleichheit einsetzt. Jede Bewerbung wird bei uns mit Sorgfalt und Bedacht behandelt - ohne Rücksicht auf deine Herkunft, deinen Bildungshintergrund, dein Alter, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung oder deine religiösen oder politischen Überzeugungen. Wenn du bei KUKA einsteigst, bieten wir dir viele Möglichkeiten, deine Motivation und Individualität einzubringen. 
 Gehe mit uns auf die Reise! 
 Wenn du dir vorstellen kannst, dass eine Karriere bei KUKA das Richtige für dich sein könnte, würden wir uns freuen, von dir zu hören.

items.desc: About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Role Overview: Based in Amsterdam, this globally scoped Corporate Systems Engineer role helps manage, maintain, and scale IT Services’ cloud and internally hosted infrastructure, with a primary focus on Linux and the flexibility to work across other platforms as needed. You’ll join the IT Services Infrastructure team, which is expanding its corporate infrastructure offerings, and contribute hands-on to Linux server and container-based solutions, AWS-native technology, and improved DevOps practices. You’ll work with IT Services engineering teams and collaborate with IT Support, IT Security, senior IT Services leaders, external consultants, and end users. Key Job Responsibilities and Duties Operate, maintain, and scale Linux-based corporate infrastructure and internal hosted services; contribute to container-based and cloud infrastructure solutions. Identify technical debt, operational bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and opportunities to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, latency, and efficiency. Respond to production incidents, mitigate user impact within agreed service levels, investigate root causes, and contribute to post-incident reviews and lasting fixes. Improve observability by reviewing system performance and capacity, defining useful metrics and alerts, and partnering with engineering teams on monitoring improvements. Apply Linux security baselines and infrastructure best practices; document system architecture and maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and recovery procedures. Evaluate and explain infrastructure design options, including their cost, business and technical trade-offs, and implications for existing systems; communicate recommendations and changes clearly to stakeholders. Role Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree. 3–5 years of relevant job knowledge and hands-on experience implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex Linux server environments. Experience maintaining infrastructure through automation and configuration management; examples include AWS Systems Manager, Puppet, Ansible, or Chef. Strong scripting proficiency in Python and Bash, and experience automating Linux packaging, deployment, updates, and patching. Experience managing systems on cloud platforms and a good understanding of infrastructure technologies such as security, virtualization, and networking. Ability and willingness to work across Linux-focused responsibilities and other relevant platforms and services as needed. Experience with Windows servers and distributions or platforms such as CentOS, RHEL, or Oracle Linux. Experience with GitLab, Git, Terraform, AWS, Azure, SaaS, or AI-related technologies. Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Implementation Engineer 
 As an Implementation Engineer at Adyen, you will partner with fast-growing and enterprise businesses to design, integrate, and scale how they use Adyen’s payment platform.
 This role sits at the center of complex technical delivery and pre-sales collaboration, where you help merchants make architectural decisions that directly impact performance, scalability, and global expansion. You’ll work on complex integration challenges where design decisions shape how global merchants operate at scale.
 This position is based in Paris, and the ideal candidate is both consultative and technical.
 We are looking for candidates with strong experience in APIs, integrations, and technical delivery. You will act as the primary technical partner for merchants, owning projects from solution design through to successful launch.
 What you’ll do: 
 Deliver end-to-end implementation projects from solution design through to go-live
 Design and help merchants build high-performance, API-based integrations for complex systems.
 Partner closely with Sales during pre-sales to shape solutions, assess feasibility, and support technical discussions with prospective merchants
 Act as the primary technical partner for merchants, guiding architecture and integration decisions
 Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Project Management to drive the best outcomes for merchants
 Guide merchants through technical design decisions, testing, and production readiness
 Improve delivery quality by sharing best practices and helping elevate team knowledge
 Support a culture of growth by sharing knowledge and helping others unblock and succeed
 Act as the voice of the merchant internally, translating customer needs and pain points into actionable insights for Product and Engineering
 Advocate for improvements in Adyen’s products and integration experience based on recurring merchant challenges and feedback
 Who you are: 
 6+ years of experience in technical consulting, integrations, or software engineering
 Deep understanding of APIs and experience working across frontend and backend systems
 Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments
 Solid communicator who can lead technical discussions and build credibility with both technical and business stakeholders
 Proactive builder who takes initiative to see projects through to completion.
 Pragmatic approach focused on working, scalable solutions
 You proactively share best practices to help the team grow and to ensure merchants deliver high-quality, reliable integrations
 Fluent in French and English
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Paris office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.desc:
About PROPHESEE 
 Prophesee is the inventor of the world’s most advanced neuromorphic vision systems. The company developed a breakthrough event-based vision approach to machine vision that enables dramatic reductions in power consumption, latency, and data processing requirements. By mimicking how the human eye and brain work, Prophesee’s patented Metavision® sensors and algorithms reveal information that is invisible to traditional frame-based sensors. 
 Prophesee’s technology is transforming applications across industrial automation, aerospace and defense, autonomous systems, IoT, AR/VR, and mobile. 
 Headquartered in Paris, Prophesee has offices in Grenoble and Shanghai. 
 Job background 
 This position is based in Paris. 
 We are looking for a passionate individual who demonstrates initiative, takes ownership, respects commitments, and exhibits a high level of autonomy and spirit of innovation. The ideal candidate would be a multitasking and creative digital IC/ASIC verification engineer. You will be accountable for developing tests and for verifying complex digital circuits to be integrated in the digital part of the neuromorphic vision sensor. Moreover, you will be defining coverage points and metrics. You will have the responsibility of building block and top level random constrained test benches, creating directive tests for verification and coverage closure, running simulations, regressions and debugging failures working closely with design engineers. 
 The day-to-day working environment is a small but impacting Digital Front End IC team (~7-10 people). You will be in contact with plenty of other engineering fields (Analog IC team, Systems Team, Software Algorithm team, etc..) and will also participate in silicon bring-up in laboratory when back from foundry. 
 Job details 
 Define and implement verification methodologies. 
 Define block and top-level random constrained test benches. 
 Run simulations (on RTL and netlist). 
 Implement regression tests 
 Define signoff methodologies. 
 Support analog team in setting up mixed-mode simulations. 
 Prepare detailed written specifications, verification plan, test protocols and test reports. 
 Coverage: Setup flow, evaluate, report, enhance, signoff 
 Work in close collaboration with the whole R&D team. 
 Contribute to the support activities for any technical post-sales issues. 
 Keep up to date with new standards and general market information in the Industry. 
 Participate in Technology / Supplier / Tool Selection 
 Participate in developing methodologies and flow efficiencies. 
 Travel requirements 
 up to 10% of the working time 
 Required qualifications, experience, and skills 
 Education 
 MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or similar 
 Experience 
 8+ years of hands-on experience in Digital IC design verification. 
 Required skills and experience 
 C++, System C, python, shell scripting, Linux utilization 
 System Verilog and UVM methodology. 
 Hardware description languages (Verilog/VHDL) and RTL design flow. 
 SVA and/or PSL. 
 Experience in simulation and debugging tools such as Cadence IES or Mentor Graphics Questa. 
 Experience in functional and code coverage. 
 Experience with versioning tools (Git, SVN, ...) 
 Experience in task estimation and planning awareness 
 Experience with Continuous Development (CD) and Continuous Integration (CI) flow and tools 
 Preferred skills 
 FPGAs/ASICs design. 
 Experience in image/vision sensor processing, USB, I2C, MIPI protocols. 
 Experience in DFT verification. 
 Experience in formal verification. 
 Experience in gate level simulation (GLS) 
 Experience with Firmware verification, development 
 Language skill : fluent oral and written communication in English is mandatory 
 Personal skills 
 Strong problem-solving skills, strong analytical skills. Flexible to dynamic environments and fast changing technologies. Passionate about technology. This person must work well with other engineers in a team environment. Good sense of autonomy. Must be pragmatic and self-motivated to complete a task even if it is outside of just the “well known” realm. “Can Do Attitude” is preferred.

Je bouwt mee aan de VRT AI Workspace: één herkenbare, veilige ingang waar
items.desc: Wat mag je verwachten van deze opdracht? VRT zoekt een freelance AI Agent & Automation Engineer die meebouwt aan hoe VRT AI en automatisering inzet in de bredere organisatie. De opdracht situeert zich op het kruispunt van AI, automatisering, data en softwareontwikkeling. Je vertaalt concrete noden en opportuniteiten naar werkende oplossingen. Je bouwt mee aan de VRT AI Workspace: één herkenbare, veilige ingang waar medewerkers AI-oplossingen bouwen, ontdekken en gebruiken. Je ontwikkelt en ontsluit er zelf AI-agents, gekoppeld aan relevante kennisbronnen en bedrijfssystemen. Je werkt hands-on aan integraties, herbruikbare componenten, tests en productierijpe oplossingen, met aandacht voor toegangsbeheer en betrouwbaarheid. Via API-integraties en connectors integreer je AI-agents met Microsoft 365, waaronder SharePoint en Teams, Dataverse en andere bedrijfssystemen. Je koppelt LLM’s aan relevante kennisbronnen via knowledge grounding en retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Je ontwikkelt agentic workflows. De opdracht vraagt aandacht voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, toegangsbeheer, governance, lifecycle management en herbruikbare patronen. Je begeleidt oplossingen van eerste prototype tot productie en werkt samen met collega’s uit Data & AI, IT en de betrokken businessdomeinen. Je werkt binnen de afdeling Data & AI, meer bepaald in het team Organisatie. Vaste kantoordagen zijn op maandag en donderdag in de gebouwen van de VRT in Brussel. Wat verwachten we van jou? Je bent een technisch sterke bouwer die vage ideeën vertaalt naar concrete oplossingen en ze zelf realiseert. Je combineert inzicht in businessnoden met praktijkervaring in AI, automatisering, integraties en softwareontwikkeling. Je hebt ervaring met generatieve AI en LLM’s, AI-agents of conversational AI, Copilot Studio of een vergelijkbaar agentplatform, prompting/context engineering, RAG, knowledge grounding en tool calling. Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met het testen en evalueren van LLM-oplossingen en het beveiligen van agents tegen onder meer prompt injection. Ervaring met Power Automate, Microsoft 365-integraties, API’s, connectors, Dataverse of vergelijkbare databronnen en softwareontwikkeling in bijvoorbeeld Python of TypeScript/JavaScript is welkom. Kennis van REST API’s, JSON, SQL, Git, authenticatie en autorisatie is belangrijk. Ervaring met Azure of een vergelijkbaar cloudplatform is een troef. Je stelt vooraf de juiste vragen, licht technische keuzes begrijpelijk toe aan niet-technische collega’s en werkt vlot samen met business en IT. Je kijkt verder dan het prototype: beheer, veiligheid, onderhoud en schaalbaarheid tellen mee. Je deelt kennis en bouwt graag herbruikbare oplossingen. Je hebt een bachelor- of masteropleiding in IT, computerwetenschappen, software engineering of informatica, of gelijkwaardige ervaring. Je hebt enkele jaren relevante ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, automation en/of AI-development. Certificaten zoals PL-400/AB-400, AB-410 of AB-100 zijn een plus, maar aantoonbare praktijkervaring weegt zwaarder. Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands. Wat bieden wij jou? Je werkt mee aan oplossingen die medewerkers doorheen de hele organisatie ondersteunen. De opdracht biedt ruimte om te experimenteren met nieuwe AI-technologieën en om mee de AI- en automation fundamenten van VRT vorm te geven. Je draagt bij aan strategische doelstelligen van VRT. Je komt terecht in een dynamische, snel ontwikkelende omgeving met toffe collega’s. Je werkt op key strategische doelstellingen van de VRT die ieder domein aangaan. Je krijgt een voltijds contract voor een freelance opdracht via tussenpersoon en dit voor 1 jaar. In onderling overleg is verlenging mogelijk (Max. 3 maal verlengbaar). De opdracht wordt gegund aan 1 of meer partijen. Interesse ? Dit is een zelfstandig contract via tussenpersoon. De VRT maakt voor dit selectieproces gebruik van de diensten van MSP-partner Solvus. Voor deze opdracht krijg je bijgevolg een contract aangeboden met Solvus, niet rechtsreeks met VRT. Als je op ‘Solliciteren’ klikt word je doorgestuurd naar de marktplaats van ‘Connecting-Expertise’. Maak een leveranciersaccount aan of log in op de marktplaats als je al een account hebt. Klik linksboven in het menu op de tab “requests & proposals”. Klik vervolgens op de tab “received requests” waar je een overzicht van je aanvragen kan terugvinden. Zoek in het overzicht op VRT[referentienummer] (bv: VRT123456). Via de tab “create a proposal” in de aanvraag is het mogelijk om een offerte met je CV en motivatiebrief in te indienen. https://www.connecting-expertise.com/login-landing-page/login-page VRT zet zich actief in om een inclusieve omgeving te voorzien voor alle medewerkers. We zijn er als publieke omroep voor iedereen in Vlaanderen, daarom vinden we het belangrijk om in ons personeel ook de diversiteit te zien die onze samenleving rijk is. Iedereen verschillend, iedereen welkom!

items.desc: Client Partner IA – ETI & Grands comptes (F/H) Schémas directeurs, gouvernance et déploiement d'agents IA. CDI · Paris, hybride (télétravail possible) · Fixe + variable non plafonné · Rattaché à Dimitri Mechai, co-fondateur. Idoption en bref Idoption est un cabinet d'intégration IA indépendant, créé en novembre 2025 par deux anciens directeurs commerciaux. On fait passer les organisations de l'expérimentation à l'adoption : des agents IA branchés sur leurs processus métiers, en production en quatre semaines, avec un ROI mesuré. 10 M€ de chiffre d'affaires : notre cap d'ici quatre ans 81 % d'adoption chez Applium en 29 jours –97 % de temps passé sur l'enrichissement de prospects chez Apiday Clients : de l'agroalimentaire à la santé, comme Maison Richard, Echosens, Saint Jean (les ravioles), Applium ou Apiday. Partenaires : Dust, Microsoft, OpenAI et Anthropic, avec des consultants certifiés Claude, Dust et Microsoft Copilot. Pour y arriver, on emmène Idoption vers l'ETI et le grand compte. C'est votre rôle. Le poste Pas de jours-hommes vendus au téléphone. Pas de prestations sur étagère. Vous êtes l'interlocuteur de confiance des DSI, des directions de la transformation, des DAF et des directions générales. Vous comprenez où est leur valeur, et vous repartez avec une mission signée. Vous portez nos missions de conseil en amont : Schémas directeurs IA : état des lieux de la stack et des données, cartographie et priorisation des cas d'usage, trajectoire budgétaire et ROI à 24 mois. Gouvernance et choix de plateforme : benchmark des plateformes (Dust, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI…), charte d'usage, cadrage juridique et social (AI Act, RGPD, CSE), comités de pilotage IA. On est agnostiques, et ça se voit dans nos recommandations : on conseille ce qui marche pour le client, y compris quand l'IA n'est pas la bonne réponse. Ces cadrages ouvrent la suite : déploiement d'agents, formation des équipes et du COMEX, accompagnement dans la durée. Vous ouvrez le compte, et vous le faites grandir. Votre quotidien 1. Ouvrir les portes Vous appuyer sur nos SDR (les Éclaireurs), qui vous décrochent des rendez-vous qualifiés, et prospecter en direct vos comptes cibles. Développer un portefeuille d'ETI (200 à 2 000 salariés) et de grands comptes : industrie, agroalimentaire, santé et biotech, IT et ESN, retail, services financiers. Vendre en co-selling avec nos partenaires (Dust, Microsoft, Anthropic, OpenAI) et notre réseau d'éditeurs et d'intégrateurs. Construire des relations durables avec les DSI, les CDO, les directions métiers et les directions générales. 2. Cadrer et convaincre Mener les rendez-vous de découverte : maturité technologique, organisationnelle et sécurité. Rédiger des propositions solides : enjeux, démarche, livrables, gouvernance, calendrier, budget. Les défendre devant un comité de direction ou un comité d'engagement. 3. Lancer et faire grandir Lancer chaque mission en binôme avec l'équipe delivery (Ian, Benjamin, Clovis, Robin…). Repérer, dès le schéma directeur, les chantiers de déploiement (build) et d'accompagnement récurrent (run). Suivre vos comptes dans la durée (land & expand). Vous êtes la bonne personne si… Vous avez la rigueur d'un consultant et l'instinct de closing d'un commercial grands comptes. Vous avez 4 à 7 ans d'expérience en cabinet de conseil IT ou management (Wavestone, BearingPoint, Sia Partners, Niji, Devoteam…). Vous savez expliquer un LLM, une architecture d'agents, le RAG ou le MCP à une DAF, sans jargon. Un objectif de chiffre d'affaires vous motive. Vous connaissez les cycles de vente complexes (2 à 4 mois) et une méthode de qualification comme MEDDPICC. Vos propositions sont claires, structurées et soignées. On les lit jusqu'au bout. items.desc: Thames Valley Integrated Care Board is looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to lead the design, build and operation of our new AWS Bedrock platform, applying agentic AI to the corporate aspects of the ICB. This is a corporate-facing role: your focus will be on driving efficiency, quality and automation in the day-to-day roles and processes the ICB performs — from administrative and operational workflows through to knowledge management and decision support — rather than clinical or direct care systems. You'll design, build and maintain secure agentic AI systems, copilots and intelligent automation services, ensuring their safe, governed and effective adoption across the organisation. You'll be building the ICB's new agentic AI capability from the ground up, with a direct mandate to drive efficiency and automation across the corporate functions that support 2.5 million people across Buckinghamshire, Oxfordshire and Berkshire. Location: One of Thames Valley ICB's offices Function: Connected Care Infrastructure Directorate: Strategy & Commissioning Designing, building and maintaining agentic AI systems, copilots and intelligent automation services on AWS Bedrock. Applying agentic AI to corporate processes across the ICB to drive efficiency, quality and automation. Developing orchestration pipelines, prompt engineering frameworks, APIs and workflow automation supporting corporate and operational use cases. Implementing safeguards including monitoring, observability, evaluation, audit logging and human-in-the-loop controls. Working with operational leaders across the ICB to identify high-value automation opportunities and ensure solutions are trusted and effective. Providing technical leadership on AI architecture, integration and deployment approaches. Ensuring compliance with NHS standards, information governance and responsible AI principles. Supporting business cases, governance papers and programme reporting. We value and promote diversity and are committed to equality of opportunity for all. We believe that the best employers are those that reflect the communities they serve. We want to increase the diversity of our NHS leadership and particularly encourage applications from women, people from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, LGBT communities, younger candidates and from people with lived experience of disability, who we know are all under-represented in these important roles. We are committed to delivering a trustworthy, flexible and responsible staff culture. At our Organisation, our selection process ensures we recruit candidates with the right skills and values. We monitor AI use in applications and remain alert to misuse that misrepresents abilities. You must declare any AI use when submitting your application. The Agentic AI Engineer – Connected Care & Intelligent Automation will play a lead technical role in the design, development, deployment and operational management of secure, governed and scalable agentic artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities across Thames Valley ICB’s Connected Care ecosystem. The post holder will develop intelligent automation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks and AI-enabled workflow solutions to support population health, operational improvement, commissioning, service transformation and clinical decision support. Working under the direction of the Head of Connected Care – Data Platform, Integration & AI, the post holder will provide technical leadership in the safe adoption of AI technologies, ensuring compliance with NHS standards, information governance, clinical safety, transparency and ethical AI principles. The role will support the delivery of NHS priorities by enabling staff productivity, reducing unwarranted variation, improving access and supporting proactive, person-centred care through intelligent systems that augment decision-making rather than replace professional judgement. You'll be an experienced AI/ML engineer with hands-on experience of applying agentic AI and automation to real business processes. You'll have: A degree or master's in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, software engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent senior experience. Extensive experience designing and deploying AI, machine learning or agentic AI systems in production environments. Experience with LLMs, orchestration frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), APIs and automation technologies. Experience with AWS Bedrock or equivalent cloud AI platforms is desirable. Knowledge of information governance, cyber security and responsible AI approaches. The ability to translate corporate and operational needs into effective, well-governed AI-enabled.

items.desc: Belgium > Leuven Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential. As a (Senior) Engineer, Equipment Engineering at ASM, you will play a key role in the development, installation, integration, and reliable operation of advanced semiconductor equipment within our R&D environment in Leuven, Belgium. You will work hands-on with new and first-of-kind equipment, partnering closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to bring new technologies from initial build and installation through testing and stable operation. This is an ideal opportunity for an engineer with strong semiconductor equipment experience who enjoys hands-on problem solving, complex troubleshooting, and working at the forefront of new technology development. What you will be working on Support the installation, integration, upgrade, and qualification of advanced R&D semiconductor equipment. Support testing and validation of new equipment and hardware configurations. Perform hands-on troubleshooting and root cause analysis across mechanical, electrical, vacuum, gas delivery, robotics, and equipment control systems. Maintain stable and reliable operation of R&D equipment, maximizing tool availability and performance for development activities. Partner closely with Hardware, Electrical, Process, Software, Facilities, and Safety teams throughout equipment development and integration. Develop and improve BKM and documentation for equipment operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and recovery. Identify recurring equipment issues and drive corrective actions and longer-term reliability improvements. Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on equipment reliability, maintainability, safety, and usability. Ensure all equipment activities are performed in accordance with applicable safety standards and procedures. What we are looking for Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. For consideration at Senior Engineer level, typically 5+ years of relevant semiconductor equipment experience in an R&D, lab, field service, or manufacturing environment. Strong hands-on experience with semiconductor equipment installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, or system integration. Good understanding of semiconductor equipment systems, including vacuum, gas delivery, pneumatics, electrical systems, robotics, and equipment controls. Experience working in a cleanroom or semiconductor laboratory environment. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to systematically identify and resolve complex equipment problems. Comfortable working in a fast-moving R&D environment where equipment and processes are continuously evolving. Strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams. What sets you apart Hands-on experience with thin-film deposition equipment, particularly ALD, PEALD, PECVD, CVD, or similar vacuum-based semiconductor platforms. Experience with RF/plasma systems, vacuum technology, gas delivery systems, electro-pneumatic controls, robotics, motion control, or embedded equipment controllers. Experience taking equipment from installation and first power-on through qualification and stable R&D operation. A proactive, hands on approach with a genuine interest in understanding how complex equipment works and how to make it perform better. Apply today to be part of what’s next. We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect. To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
