items.desc: Who we are ? Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools. The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment. Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing both potential attacks and the strategies that defenders can adopt in response. Attackers may exploit sequences of vulnerabilities to compromise a system, while defenders may react through countermeasures such as access restrictions, system reconfigurations, or Moving Target Defense mechanisms. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. This approach allows the verification of security properties, such as the preservation of confidentiality and integrity, as well as the synthesis of defensive strategies against known attack scenarios. A central challenge of the project concerns the scalability of formal verification when applied to realistic cybersecurity scenarios. To address this issue, VITAMIN-C investigates symbolic and abstract model-checking techniques, together with a modular architecture supporting the integration of different verification engines. Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of formal verification techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on formal modelling of cybersecurity scenarios, strategic model checking, development and optimisation of verification algorithms, and their integration into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in experimental evaluations using cybersecurity benchmarks and industrial use cases, contributing to the development of a practical verification tool. Your main responsibilities will include : Carry out R&D work in formal methods and cybersecurity verification Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom The candidate must have a sound knowledge of formal methods, transition systems, verification algorithms and software development. They must be able to design, test and document research software in a collaborative environment, and have a good command of English. Skills in temporal or strategic logic, model checking, symbolic methods, SAT/SMT and multi-agent systems would be an advantage. Experience in cybersecurity, attack graphs, Python/C++ programming, Docker or distributed systems would also be an asset. The candidate must demonstrate good team spirit, rigour, organisational skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as strong communication and technical writing skills. Education and experience : Master’s degree (Bac+5) or equivalent; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+4) with at least 4 years’ experience; or a Bachelor’s degree (Bac+3) with 6 years’ experience; or a two-year higher education qualification (Bac+2) with 10 years’ professional experience. Why join us? You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from : 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT) flexible working hours (depending on department activity) telecommuting 1 to 3 days/week possible 75% public transport pass reimbursement Proximity to numerous sports facilities, concierge service, underground parking, in-house catering, etc. Good to know: our social security contributions are lower than in the private sector Remuneration details: Indicative remuneration range (excluding the variable annual bonus): €33,614 – €43,000 gross per annum, depending on profile and experience, as defined by our legal framework. Investigation et sécurité Cloud Réaliser des investigations de compromission sur les environnements AWS, Azure et GCP. Exploiter et corréler les journaux de sécurité des plateformes Cloud. ServiceNow et plateformes CTI. Scripting : Python, PowerShell. Langages de requêtage : KQL et SPL. CE QUE NOUS ATTENDONS DE VOUS Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons un professionnel qui fait preuve : D'autonomie dans la conduite d'investigations complexes. De curiosité technique et d'une réelle capacité d'analyse. D'un esprit d'initiative et d'une posture de force de proposition. D'une capacité à partager son expertise et à faire progresser collectivement l'équipe. Un point essentiel de la mission : en dehors des périodes de gestion d'incidents, vous consacrerez votre activité au Threat Hunting, à l'amélioration des cas d'usage de détection, à la veille opérationnelle et à l'identification de nouvelles opportunités d'amélioration continue.

items.desc: Your mission Join us in safeguarding the sustainability of space operations through advanced space situational awareness (SSA) technologies. As part of our team, you will develop cutting-edge collision avoidance algorithms, enhance space situational awareness, and innovate tools for satellite operators. Your expertise in data science and physics will help us detect, predict, and mitigate orbital risks, ensuring safe and sustainable space exploration. Your tasks and responsibilities You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of aerospace engineers, data scientists, and software developers to integrate and optimize third-party sensor data sources within our SSA platform. Your contributions will directly enhance the accuracy, automation, and scalability of our orbital risk management solutions. Integrate third-party data sources into our platform, working closely with providers to seamlessly onboard their data. Develop, implement, and optimize high-precision algorithms for orbit propagation, orbit determination (OD), sensor fusion, covariance modelling, and uncertainty quantification. Develop methods to fuse data from diverse sources into one common image of the space debris environment. Conduct validation and verification (V&V) campaigns to benchmark and refine algorithmic performance against ground truth datasets. Work closely with software engineers to transition prototype algorithms into scalable, production-ready solutions. Your profile Must-have: M.Sc. or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Space Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field, or have prior work experience in the field of SSA/SST and related. A minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience is required. However, candidates with outstanding profiles may be considered with at least 3 years of experience. Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of astrodynamics, orbital mechanics, and flight dynamics. Experience in scientific programming using at least one of the following languages: Java, Fortran (90+) or Python. Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and research-driven environment. This position is only open to candidates currently based in Germany or willing to relocate. Valid working permit for Germany/EU. Nice-to-have: Hands-on experience with space surveillance and tracking (SST) systems, including sensor tasking and catalog maintenance. Experience working with space agencies or private space companies in the SSA/SST field. Familiarity with space surveillance and tracking systems. Understanding of space policy and compliance frameworks. Experience with AI/ML applicationsfor anomaly detection, pattern recognition, or orbit prediction in SSA applications. Interest in contributing to the sustainability of space and long-term spaceflight operations. Why us? With a lean hierarchy and small working groups, you define your own way of work including flexible work hours. Work on groundbreaking space sustainability challenges with a team of top-tier engineers and scientists. After your on-boarding time in Braunschweig, you can choose between staying in our office (what we prefer), working remote (within Germany) or a hybrid approach. Enjoy technical freedom. Influence system architecture, research methodologies, and data integration approaches. Grow continuously with access to training budgets, industry conferences, and networking opportunities. items.desc: We are building talented teams that tackle real world challenges every day and help us to achieve our goal to prepare the grid to carry up to 80% of Ireland’s electricity from renewable sources. We are proud to be a certified Great Place to Work, recognised for our culture built on trust, collaboration and inclusion. At EirGrid you will find supportive teams, opportunities to grow and meaningful work. We also offer secure employment with a range of flexible and family friendly working policies to support your life and wellbeing. If you want to know more about what EirGrid has to offer you, visit Life at EirGrid. If you are ready to make an impact and grow your career in a purpose-led organisation, your journey starts here. The Team The Transmission Power System Planning (TPSP) team is responsible for undertaking two key remits, namely Network Planning and Access Planning. The Network Planning remit ensures future system integrity and reliability of the Irish transmission system, taking a holistic view of the drivers of system needs and identifying the appropriate network reinforcement to meet these needs in a timely manner while ensuring compliance with the Transmission System Security and Planning Standards (TSSPS), Grid Code, and other relevant standards. The Access Planning remit ensures that all eligible customers (generation, demand, interconnection, or system services) obtain a connection method that adheres to connection policy and relevant standards. The remit also includes leading technical engagements with the customers and feeding into future connection policy The Opportunity The Transmission Power System Planning Function are now seeking an expert in power system analysis to act as a technical authority, leading and co-ordinating a range of advanced and specialized power system analysis to support the future development, performance, and reliability of the Irish transmission system. The successful candidate in the role of Power System Analysis specialist, will be to act as a subject matter expert and thought leader in the various technical studies required to carry out our remit in line with our license obligations. You will be expected to scope, lead, and co-ordinate technical analysis for a range of technical phenomena using a variety of advanced power system study software packages. You will be expected to be proficient in these software packages, as the role-holder will provide training for the team as required. In your role, you will co-ordinate and drive complex studies and detailed technical investigations and be able to collaborate with multi-discipline teams to achieve cross-functional goals that supports the technical inputs in the developments of Irish transmission system. You will also be well-versed in articulating technical concepts and analytic outcomes to non-technical audiences. You will be expected to build effective relationships with and influence both internal and external stakeholders to ensure that the technical issues facing the transmission network are identified and resolved as we continue to transform the power system in Ireland. You will support the Head of Function and Managers of Transmission Power System Planning in communicating business plan goals, objectives, and providing technical input and insights to help drive Eirgrid’s mission. As a Power System Analysis specialist, you will act as a thought leader in power system analysis, driving complex investigations into critical phenomena such as: Power flow, Short-circuit, and System Stability analysis Grid-forming and control interaction studies Electromagnetic Transient (EMT) analysis Sub-Synchronous Torsional Interaction (SSTI) Temporary Overvoltages (TOVs) Transient Recovery Voltages (TRVs) Harmonics and system stability You will manage and deliver high-impact studies using advanced software tools (e.g., PSSE, PowerFactory, PSCAD), provide expert training internally, and represent EirGrid at key external forums. Your expertise and experience will be vital in helping the Transmission Power System Planning function respond to new and unknown challenges, providing pragmatic solutions to problems, and assisting the Head of Function and Managers of Transmission Power System Planning function in communicating these solutions to internal and external stakeholders. Knowledge, Skills, and Experience The Successful candidate will demonstrate: A degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (or equivalent), with typically 12–15+ years of progressive experience in the power industry. A holistic understanding of transmission systems, grid operations, and the evolving energy landscape in Ireland is essential. Deep Technical Expertise Proven mastery in power system planning and operation, including the challenge of integrating interconnectors and renewable energy sources into the Irish power system. Demonstrated proficiency in advanced power system analysis using industry-standard tools such as PSSE, PowerFactory, …

items.desc: Hey! Nice to see you! Let’s share our stories to get to know a bit better…. We are business and technology enthusiasts constantly hungry for new challenges, self-, and development and nothing motivates us more than great software products and happy customers. At Incubly, we believe that great people want to work with great people, so we started to build a company that would attract great minds and allow us to achieve everything without feeling that we work but just having fun. We are now working with a leading company in critical infrastructure management to transform how underground utilities are protected and maintained. With their innovative software platform, they have been helping organizations prevent damage and improve safety during excavation projects. Through this partnership, we are driving the future of infrastructure safety—using advanced data analysis and technology to create smarter, safer, and more efficient communities. Now, we are looking for a Data Architect to join their team and help shape this mission. Your daily responsibilities Design and develop a unified data model covering asset, inspection, incident, geospatial, and consequence data across multiple products, applying medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and defining the semantic layer for downstream applications, reporting, and risk models. Model data for probabilistic risk models, ensuring all required input attributes have clearly defined sources, transformation paths, and data-quality expectations. Design cross-product entity resolution and ingestion patterns for batch, streaming, and CDC sources, including schema evolution and slowly changing dimensions. Design the shared geospatial data layer, including pipeline centerlines, consequence areas, right-of-way corridors, and parcel data, as well as linear referencing and dynamic segmentation. Define data governance standards covering cataloging, metadata, lineage, data quality, validation, and access control, ensuring end-to-end traceability and appropriate tenant isolation. Work closely with data engineers to translate architectural designs into production pipelines, review implementations, and contribute hands-on to schema deployment and transformation logic when needed. Collaborate with application engineers and data scientists to define how data is consumed through serving layers, feature stores, and APIs. Support performance and cost optimization through appropriate partitioning, clustering, file layout, and compute sizing. Work with subject-matter experts to translate business and regulatory requirements into data structures, participate in design reviews, and maintain clear architecture documentation, diagrams, and data dictionaries. We need you to have 5–8 years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, or senior data engineering, including ownership of a non-trivial data model. Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, SQL Warehouses, and pipeline orchestration. Strong understanding of lakehouse and medallion architecture, dimensional modeling, and semantic layer design. Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python or PySpark. Experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure preferred). Practical experience with CDC, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), schema evolution, and data-quality frameworks. Working knowledge of data governance, including cataloging, lineage, classification, access control, and encryption. Strong documentation, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical solutions. Would be great if you have Experience designing geospatial data models and working with GIS tooling, spatial joins, and linear referencing. Familiarity with multi-tenant platforms, data residency requirements, or regulated environments. Experience with metadata and lineage tools such as Microsoft Purview or equivalent platforms. Experience modeling data for machine learning or probabilistic risk models and designing semantic layers for BI consumption. Databricks or cloud data certifications. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude Code. Familiarity with pipeline or utility asset data, asset integrity concepts, and regulatory reporting requirements. Experience migrating data from legacy desktop or spreadsheet-based systems. Our Technology Stack Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog Azure SQL, Python, PySpark Lakehouse and Medallion Architecture GIS and geospatial data technologies Our offer In addition to great company and challenging projects, we can offer much, much more Agile and friendly atmosphere, non-violent communication and full respect for diversity Hybrid work model from our office at 24 Piłsudskiego Street, Łódź Remuneration on B2B Contract: 1.400 - 1.600 PLN net/ MD

items.desc: Location: Warszawa, PL, 00-841 Company: Allegro sp. z o.o. Team: Technology Contract Type: Employee This advertisement was written by a real human being. A team of data nerds is looking for people who share the same passion for data and have a patience to work with other people. If you are an experienced professional with a passion for product analysis and a knack for understanding customer needs - bingo! As a Product Analyst you'll play a key role in shaping our products and driving strategies that resonate with our Customers. We are looking for people who: have an experience working as a Product Analyst / Data Analyst or similar, have proficiency in using SQL, have basic programming skills in Python to automate analyses and data processing, be able to cooperate with many stakeholders, while developing effective and clear ways of communication, have experience in various types of analyses. Among others cohort analysis, trend analysis, customer path analysis, attribution analysis, retention analysis, clickstream data analysis, A/B Testing, have the ability to independently formulate hypotheses, design and conduct analyses, have experience in analysing large datasets and presenting findings and recommendations, know how to build an insightful dashboard in BI Tools (e.g. LookerStudio), know English at a minimum level of B2 (both speaking and writing), experience in e-commerce will be considered as an additional asset. In your daily work, you will handle the following tasks: You will analyze large datasets to discover patterns and dependencies that impact key areas for the company. You will demonstrate how user behaviors and attitudes shape and evolve. You will participate in the creation of business solutions and your recommendations will help shape Allegro. The results of your analyses will provide guidance to people in the organization on making the shopping experience for Allegro customers exceptional. What's in it for you: Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work. Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results. Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms). A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories. A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers). English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job. A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here. #goodtobehere means that: You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA. You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create. You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job. You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support). You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers. You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning. You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about! Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro! Don’t wait until you join us! Let's meet online! Get to know our team, take a peek at our office life and check out what else we do at Allegro.

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as a Concrete Tower Structures Designer at Siemens Energy, where you will play a pivotal role in advancing our SG7.0 and SG7.X hybrid concrete tower portfolio. Imagine leading the detailed structural design and numerical modeling of pre-stressed and post-stressed concrete structures, ensuring a seamless transition to optimized future designs. You will engage in executing cost-out actions while balancing structural integrity and dynamic behavior throughout the product lifecycle. Your expertise will directly contribute to the in-house CREST hybrid concrete tower development, making a significant impact on our mission to innovate in the energy sector. How You’ll Make an Impact Design and analyze complex pre-stressed, post-stressed, pre-cast, and in-situ concrete tower structures and foundations. Perform fatigue design and dynamic behavior calculations to ensure long-term operational reliability of cracked and uncracked concrete structures. Apply international design standards, including Eurocodes, Model Codes, and ACI, to guarantee regulatory compliance and successful certification. Develop linear and non-linear finite element models (FEA) using Abaqus or Ansys to analyze complex load cases and conduct soil-structure interaction analyses. Identify and implement cost-out actions and design optimization activities for the SG7.0, SG7.X, and CREST hybrid concrete tower portfolios, providing technical support during the construction phase. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. At least 5 years of professional experience in concrete structures design and foundation design, with a preference for experience in wind turbine generator development or heavy industrial structures. Strong skills in structural engineering and concrete design, including pre-stressed and post-stressed concrete design, as well as high-performance and fiber-reinforced concrete technology. Proficiency in finite element analysis (FEA) using Abaqus or Ansys, with experience in linear and non-linear structural modeling and fatigue calculations. Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture and fermentation Experience in GMP bioprocessing environments, including qualification (IQ/OQ). We unite two category-defining portfolios - ThingWorx and Kepware (formerly part of PTC) and Proficy (formerly part of GE Vernova) - to transform industrial manufacturing, at scale. With $350M in annual revenue, a global footprint across a range of industries, a legacy customer base, and our intelligent data connectivity systems and AI solutions, we are one of the world's largest independent software companies focused on industrial operations - here to power the future of manufacturing. OUR MISSION Enabling the world's industrial producers to do the right thing Plugs, across every shift, every plant, every day. We help manufacturers prosper by equipping them with software-defined, data-driven production systems that elevate quality, accelerate cycle times, improve resilience, and enable sustainable profit growth. We move with pace and purpose , favoring good decisions made quickly. And we win the right way … together , holding ourselves to the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and respect. These values shape how we hire, lead, and hold each other accountable, every day. Job Description About the Role: A Curriculum Developer is responsible for the consistent design, development and deployment of technical and solution training for Velotic, its channel, partners and customers. This position reports to the Curriculum Leader, Velotic Education Services and works integrally with associated teams to deliver our curriculum plan. This will include select duties as designer, content developer, and editor. Developer whose work demonstrates passion for the success of the customer (student). Why this is a Once-In-A-Career opportunity: Lead in a market undergoing significant disruption and growth from cloud migration to edge intelligence to AI-powered industrial automation. Join a culture defined by ambition, authenticity, speed, teamwork, and the belief that manufacturing can meaningfully improve the world. Competitive benefits, compensation and long-term impact on how the world’s industrial companies operate, automate, and innovate.

items.desc: Do našeho AI týmu hledáme kolegu či kolegyni se zájmem o generativní AI, vývoj moderních technologických řešení a jejich praktické využití u klientů. Nemusíš mít za sebou roky praxe ani vlastní produkční AI systém. Hledáme především dobré programátorské základy, zvídavost a chuť učit se při práci na reálných projektech. Co tě u nás čeká? Spolupráce na návrhu a vývoji AI aplikací pod vedením zkušenějších kolegů – od prototypů až po části produkčních řešení Příprava dokumentů a dat pro RAG, experimentování s prompty, modely a nastavením retrievalu Tvorba menších backendových komponent, API integrací a automatizací v Pythonu Příprava testovacích a evaluačních sad a vyhodnocování kvality výstupů AI aplikací Hledání příčin chyb, zlepšování vlastního i AI generovaného kódu a učení se prostřednictvím code review Účast na konzultačních a discovery schůzkách s klienty a pomoc s převodem byznysových potřeb do technického zadání Spolupráce s AI týmem, sdílení poznatků a postupné přebírání samostatnějších úkolů Co od tebe očekáváme? Dobré základy softwarového vývoje; zkušenosti můžeš mít z práce, studia nebo vlastních projektů Pokročilá znalost Pythonu – typování (Pydantic, mypy/pyright), async a testování v pytestu Základní orientace v LLM a zájem učit se pracovat s AI agenty a RAG; zkušenost ze školního, osobního či pracovního projektu je výhodou, nikoli podmínkou Backendové základy: návrh REST API, SQL a datové modelování, autentizace a autorizace, Docker, Git a CI/CD Ochota učit se testovat AI aplikace, pracovat s evaluacemi a přemýšlet o bezpečnosti a ochraně dat Analytické myšlení aschopnost hledat jednoduchá a praktická řešení místo automatického použití LLM Velmi dobrá znalost češtiny a angličtiny pro komunikaci v týmu a s klienty Spolehlivost, aktivní přístup, ochota ptát se a schopnost srozumitelně vysvětlit vlastní postup Výhodou je zkušenost s: Vlastním, školním nebo pracovním projektem využívajícím LLM, RAG nebo AI agenty Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry nebo Azure AI Search Dockerem, CI/CD nebo základními DevOps postupy LangGraphem nebo podobným frameworkem, případně MCP Nástroji pro observabilitu LLM aplikací, například Langfuse nebo LangSmith TypeScriptem nebo jiným backendovým jazykem Co nabízíme? Spolupráci na plný nebo zkrácený úvazek, převážně on-site v moderních kancelářích na Pankráci Spolupráci se zkušeným týmem, pravidelnou zpětnou vazbu a prostor rychle se učit Zapojení do reálných projektů pro klienty z různých odvětví s rozsahem odpovědnosti odpovídajícím tvým zkušenostem Praktickou zkušenost s moderními AI nástroji, Pythonem, RAG a agentními workflow Možnost postupně přebírat samostatnější úkoly a profesně růst v AI engineeringu Rozsah spolupráce a rozvržení pracovní doby dle dohody Pravidelná školení, interní sdílení znalostí a jazykové kurzy Další benefity podle zvolené formy spolupráce Firemní akce, sportovní aktivity a teambuilding Připoj se k nám a ukaž, co v tobě je! Těšíme se na tvůj životopis!

items.desc: Il Gruppo GECAL INFORMATICA Srl e ALTAIR SYSTEMS , società di consulenza informatica che opera nel settore IT dal 1985, su tutto il territorio nazionale ed internazionale, per ampliamento del team cerca un* AI ENGINEER Richiesta la disponibilità di lavorare IN IBRIDO SU MILANO Responsabilità Progettare e sviluppare funzionalità basate su intelligenza artificiale generativa e machine learning. Realizzare componenti per elaborare e ricercare informazioni in documenti, codice, log ed eventi. Integrare modelli e servizi AI nelle applicazioni aziendali tramite API. Contribuire allo sviluppo di assistenti e flussi agentici a supporto dei processi aziendali e di sviluppo software. Sperimentare soluzioni per individuare anomalie e variazioni nei dati. Valutare qualità e affidabilità dei risultati attraverso test, analisi dei casi limite e monitoraggio. Collaborare con i team di progetto e documentare le soluzioni realizzate. Competenze richieste Esperienza di sviluppo con Python e familiarità con Git. Conoscenza dei fondamenti di machine learning e AI generativa, inclusi LLM e tecniche di prompt engineering. Capacità di lavorare con dati strutturati e non strutturati, come documenti, codice, log ed eventi. Conoscenza di API REST e capacità di integrare modelli o servizi AI con applicazioni e strumenti aziendali. Familiarità con la valutazione dei risultati dei modelli e con test, monitoraggio e gestione di errori o risultati non affidabili. Capacità di collaborare con team di sviluppo e di documentare le soluzioni realizzate. Costituiscono un plus : esperienza con orchestrazione di agenti e tool calling; analisi di log, anomaly detection o serie temporali; pipeline streaming e strumenti come Kafka o OpenSearch; integrazioni con Jira, Confluence e GitHub; conoscenza di sistemi legacy. Le persone interessate possono inviare la propria candidatura con autorizzazione ai sensi del dlgs. 196/2003. La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. In ottemperanza al Regolamento UE n.16/679 (General Data Protection Regulation, o "GDPR"), Gecal Informatica S.r.l. La informa che, in caso di contatto, i suoi dati personali saranno ricevuti ed archiviati, verranno da noi utilizzati esclusivamente per attività di Ricerca e Selezione del Personale e non saranno condivisi con nessun altro, tranne che con le Aziende che ci incaricano di svolgere delle ricerche. items.desc: Akkodis è un leader globale nel mercato dell'ingegneria e della ricerca e sviluppo, che mira ad accelerare l'innovazione e la trasformazione digitale utilizzando la forza dei connected data. Con la passione per la tecnologia e il talento, il gruppo, composto da più di 50.000 ingegneri ed esperti digitali e con un fatturato di €4bn, offre una profonda esperienza intersettoriale in 28 paesi tra Nord America, EMEA e APAC. Akkodis vanta un’esperienza quarantennale e un forte know-how in settori tecnologici chiave come la mobilità, i servizi software e tecnologici, la robotica, i test, le simulazioni, la sicurezza dei dati, l'intelligenza artificiale e l'analisi dei dati. La combinazione di competenze informatiche e ingegneristiche porta a un'offerta unica di soluzioni end-to-end, con quattro linee di servizio - Consulting, Solutions, Talents e Academy - per supportare i clienti nel ripensare ai loro processi di sviluppo prodotto e di business, migliorare la produttività, ridurre al minimo il time-to-market e dare forma a un domani più smart e sostenibile. La divisione Automotive e Transportation è leader in Italia nello sviluppo dei veicoli software-defined vehicles, guidando l’innovazione verso requisiti, operazioni e funzionalità completamente gestite da software. Forniamo soluzioni avanzate per la connettività dei veicoli, attraverso lo sviluppo di infrastrutture, il monitoraggio intelligente, l’IoT e l’architettura cloud, senza dimenticare l’ attenzione alla sicurezza informatica nello sviluppo di applicazioni end-to-end. Nell’ottica di un potenziamento della divisione, ricerchiamo una figura di: AI Engineer Entra a far parte della nostra divisione Automotive e Transportation, un gruppo di oltre 300 consulenti che operano in Italia e circa 8.000 a livello globale. La nostra forza è da sempre l’integrazione delle nostre competenze, che ci permettono di avere una visione a 360° del mondo Auto. Quale sarà il tuo contributo in Akkodis? items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Rejoindre NEXTON, c'est intégrer une entreprise où convergent l'esprit d'un cabinet de conseil, la créativité d'une agence et la dynamique d'une ESN ! Grâce à notre expertise, nous accompagnons des clients grands comptes et des pure players tels que SNCF, Orange, et BNP Paribas dans leurs stratégies d'évolution et d'innovation digitale. Fondée en 2011, NEXTON réunit aujourd'hui une équipe de plus de 450 experts spécialisés dans le digital, le design, l'agilité, le produit et le développement. Ensemble, ils créent un écosystème riche en connaissances et en compétences diversifiées. Description du poste NEXTON recrute un Ingénieur Intelligence Artificielle H/F , en CDI , à Paris ! Ton futur environnement de travail : Nous recrutons pour l'un de nos grands comptes clients du secteur agroalimentaire. Au sein d'une équipe Data et Innovation dynamique, tu interviendras en étroite collaboration avec le responsable Data Science et les équipes techniques. Ton rôle sera central pour faire le pont entre l'ingénierie logicielle et les technologies d'IA générative afin d'industrialiser des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée. Tes missions : Réaliser l'audit technique de l'existant en matière d'intelligence artificielle et émettre des recommandations d'architecture stratégiques. Reprendre, consolider et fiabiliser les prototypes développés par l'équipe pour les transformer en solutions robustes et maintenables en production. Concevoir et implémenter des architectures de génération augmentée par récupération (RAG) adossées à des bases de données vectorielles. Développer des agents autonomes capables d'interagir efficacement au sein de l'écosystème data. Concevoir et exposer des API performantes avec FastAPI pour interconnecter les services d'IA. Exploiter le framework de raisonnement et d'orchestration ReAct pour fluidifier la prise de décision et l'exploitation des données. Mettre en place des graphes de connaissances et optimiser les requêtes SQL complexes pour l'interrogation de la data. Garantir l'application des meilleures pratiques de software engineering (qualité de code, tests, CI/CD, documentation technique) appliquées à l'IA. Qualifications Environ 4 ans d'expérience minimum en ingénierie logicielle, dont idéalement 1 à 2 ans spécifiquement en ingénierie de l'intelligence artificielle. Maîtrise approfondie de Python et des frameworks de développement IA tels que LangChain et LangGraph. Solide expertise dans la conception d'architectures RAG, la manipulation de bases de données vectorielles et la création d'agents autonomes. Excellente maîtrise de FastAPI pour le développement d'interfaces de programmation et pratique du pattern ReAct orienté data. Très bonnes compétences en SQL et appétence démontrée pour les graphes de connaissances. Rigueur technique, esprit critique, sens de l'organisation et goût pour le travail collaboratif en équipe pluridisciplinaire. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi choisir NEXTON ? Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année : ▶ Des communautés dynamiques pour t'accompagner dans ton parcours. ▶ Des Meet Up pour développer tes compétences. ▶ Des formations pour te réinventer et progresser. ▶ Des événements sportifs et festifs pour t'épanouir. ▶ Un forfait mobilité durable pour faciliter ton quotidien et encourager la mobilité douce. ▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté. Prêt à nous rejoindre ? Rencontrons-nous ! NEXTON

items.desc: À propos de DEEP DEEP est né de la fusion de DIGORA, EBRC, ELGON et POST Telecom (B2B) . Notre ambition : devenir l’acteur référent des services et solutions numériques innovants et responsables pour les entreprises en France, au Luxembourg et à l’international. Nos collaborateurs accompagnent chaque jour nos clients autour de leurs enjeux IT : Cloud, infrastructures, Data, IA, cybersécurité et services managés . Chez DEEP, vous évoluerez dans un environnement à taille humaine, au sein d’un groupe solide, avec la possibilité de contribuer directement au développement de notre activité en France. DEEP déploie une offre de services complète à ses 450 clients en France : supervision des infrastructures, projets data et IA, hébergement cloud, cybersécurité. En partenariat avec OVHcloud et CleverCloud, DEEP a été retenu par la Commission européenne pour construire le futur cloud souverain européen. Chez DEEP, l’IA ne reste pas dans les slides. items.desc: Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Als Automation & AI Integration Engineer help je bepalen hoe AI en automatisering binnen de organisatie worden ingezet. Je werkt op het kruispunt van AI, automatisering, data en softwareontwikkeling en vertaalt concrete noden naar werkende oplossingen. Je werkt aan oplossingen die medewerkers in de hele organisatie ondersteunen en helpt de fundamenten voor AI en automation verder vorm te geven. Je bouwt mee aan een AI Workspace: één herkenbare en veilige ingang waar medewerkers AI-oplossingen kunnen bouwen, ontdekken en gebruiken. Je ontwikkelt en ontsluit AI-agents die gekoppeld zijn aan relevante kennisbronnen en bedrijfssystemen. Je werkt hands-on aan integraties, herbruikbare componenten, tests en productierijpe oplossingen, met aandacht voor toegangsbeheer en betrouwbaarheid. Via API-integraties en connectors verbind je AI-agents met Microsoft 365, waaronder SharePoint en Teams, Dataverse en andere bedrijfssystemen. Je koppelt LLM's aan relevante kennisbronnen met knowledge grounding en retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Je ontwikkelt agentic workflows. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, toegangsbeheer, governance, lifecycle management en het gebruik van herbruikbare patronen. Je begeleidt oplossingen van het eerste prototype tot productie. Je werkt samen met collega's uit Data & AI, IT en de betrokken businessdomeinen. De vaste kantoordagen zijn maandag en donderdag. Je werkt op die dagen in Brussel. Jouw profiel Je bent een technisch sterke bouwer die onduidelijke ideeën vertaalt naar concrete oplossingen en ze zelf realiseert. Je combineert inzicht in businessnoden met praktijkervaring in AI, automatisering, integraties en softwareontwikkeling. Je ontwikkelt AI-gebaseerde toepassingen en hebt ervaring met generatieve AI, LLM's, AI-agents of conversational AI. Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft Copilot Studio of een vergelijkbaar agentplatform, prompting en context engineering, RAG, knowledge grounding en tool calling. Je kunt LLM-oplossingen testen en evalueren en agents beveiligen tegen onder meer prompt injection. Je ontwikkelt software in Python of TypeScript/JavaScript en werkt met API-integraties. Je voert programmeeropdrachten vlot uit: coderen, testen en debuggen. Je hebt ervaring met data- en/of analytics engineering. Je kunt open-source AI-platformen zoals LibreChat of Open WebUI opzetten, configureren en beheren, inclusief deployment, SSO en koppelingen met LLM-providers. Je hebt ervaring met Power Automate, Power Apps en Power Platform. Je werkt volgens een Agile ontwikkelingsmethodiek. Je kent REST API's, JSON, SQL, Git, authenticatie en autorisatie. Je hebt ervaring met Azure, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse of vergelijkbare cloud- en databronnen. Je begrijpt AI-verbruiksmodellen, zoals tokens en Copilot credits, en kunt het verbruik opvolgen en optimaliseren. Je stelt vooraf de juiste vragen, licht technische keuzes begrijpelijk toe aan niet-technische collega's en werkt vlot samen met business en IT. Je kijkt verder dan het prototype: beheer, veiligheid, onderhoud en schaalbaarheid maken deel uit van je aanpak. Je deelt kennis en bouwt graag herbruikbare oplossingen. Je hebt een bachelor- of masteropleiding in IT, computerwetenschappen, software engineering of informatica, of gelijkwaardige ervaring. Je hebt enkele jaren relevante ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, automation en/of AI-development. Certificaten zoals PL-400/AB-400, AB-410 of AB-100 zijn een plus. Aantoonbare praktijkervaring weegt zwaarder. Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands. Aanbod Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding). (Freelance is ook mogelijk)

items.title: AI Native Software Engineer
items.loc: Saint-Herblain, Pays de la Loire, France
items.card: you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so.
items.desc: You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme. Key Responsibilities Architect and govern production-grade agentic systems at enterprise scale: multi-agent orchestration across complex environments, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, memory management, and programme-level lifecycle observability Define RAG pipeline standards across engagements: establish chunking and embedding strategies, set quality benchmarks, and ensure metric-backed tradeoff decisions are documented and transferable Set multi-LLM integration standards: vendor-agnostic architecture by default, fallback routing and cost governance as standard design practice across providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models Own LLMOps at programme scale: eval strategy, prompt governance, observability tooling standards, safety monitoring and cost controls across multiple concurrent systems Lead client engineering engagements at senior level — facilitate architecture design sessions, lead proof-of-concept delivery, and drive alignment between client technology leadership and delivery teams Shape and publish reusable patterns, accelerators, and engineering standards that scale across the practice and reduce ramp-up time on new client engagements Own the measurement framework for agentic system quality: define accuracy, latency, safety, and cost metrics; present programme-level AI impact in business terms to senior client stakeholders Basic Qualifications Significant years of software engineering experience in production environments Practical hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment — non-negotiable Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent — at production depth, not tutorial level Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm) Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure People lead responsibilities: experience managing, developing, and performance-managing a team of engineers; setting individual development plans and conducting career conversations

En nous rejoignant à Gémenos, vous intégrez un site localisé entre mer et collines provençales, regroupant nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques et nos activités de défense alliant à la fois ingénierie et production, et favorisant un environnement de travail collaboratif et convivial.

 Vous participez à la conception et au prototypage d’un pipeline combinant transcription de la parole, analyse visuelle, extraction d’images et OCR afin d’exploiter efficacement différentes sources d’information. 
 Vous évoluez dans un environnement d’experts en intelligence artificielle, cybersécurité, automatisation, biométrie, cloud computing et architecture des systèmes. En nous rejoignant, vos missions sont :
 Concevez et prototypez un pipeline d’IA transformant des contenus vidéo en connaissances exploitables par un système RAG.

 Développez des méthodes de segmentation, d’embedding et d’indexation tenant compte des horodatages. 
 Alignez les différentes sources d’information afin de permettre une recherche fiable et traçable.

 Évaluez la précision et les performances globales du processus développé.

 Vous souhaitez effectuer un stage d'une durée de 6 mois de derniere année d'école d'ingénieur. 
 Vous effectuez une formation en informatique et développement logiciel, à dominante intelligence artificielle ou vision par ordinateur. 
 Vous avez des compétences sur :
 Python et JavaScript 
 Frameworks d’IA (OpenAI SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, Transformers, PyTorch, RAG) 
 Traitement vidéo et audio (OpenCV, FFmpeg, Whisper) 
 Vision par ordinateur, OCR et intégration d’API WebService (REST/JSON) 
 Curiosité, autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes et esprit d’analyse sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnaît ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
During your assignment, you will collect, structure and preprocess engineering knowledge sources such as technical documents, specifications, test reports and structured datasets.
 You will evaluate suitable Databricks-native and open-source tools (e.g. RAG, Text-to-SQL, AI Agents, Vector Search, Genie) for different types of engineering content.
 Based on this, you will design and implement natural language workflows on Databricks that allow hardware engineers to query both documents and structured data.
 To deliver reliable, source-grounded answers, you will apply prompt and context engineering and ensure result quality and traceability (e.g. citations, evaluation, guardrails).
 Additionally, you will collaborate closely with hardware engineers to understand use cases and iteratively improve the solution.
 Finally, you will communicate progress and findings through visualizations, short presentations and technical documentation.
Education: master studies in the field of Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Control Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, or a comparable technical field with good grades – a combination of engineering domain knowledge and AI/data skills is ideal
 Experience and Knowledge: practical knowledge of large language models and Generative AI concepts such as RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt and context engineering, or AI agents
 solid programming skills, ideally in Python and SQL
 engineering background as a plus
 experience with Databricks (e.g. Vector Search, Genie, Mosaic AI Agent Framework, MLflow), LangChain, LlamaIndex or other Generative AI frameworks as an advantage
 understanding of heat pump technology and operating principles as an asset
 Personality and Working Practice: you are curious and self-driven, bringing a structured approach and strong communication skills to engaging with engineers from different backgrounds, understanding their needs and translating them into technical solutions
 Work Routine: we offer you the opportunity to work in a hybrid setup with regular on-site presence
 Enthusiasm: passionate about bridging AI and hardware engineering and making complex technical knowledge easily accessible through natural language
 Languages: very good in English
Start: according to prior agreement
 Duration: 6 months
 Requirement for this internship is the enrollment at university. Please attach your CV, transcript of records, enrollment certificate, examination regulations and if indicated a valid work and residence permit.
As a global company, we are legally required to comply with applicable EU and U.S. (re-)export control and sanctions regulations. This means that for certain, particularly sensitive positions, we may only hire individuals who have undergone an additional legal screening. This position is one such sensitive role. We will therefore ask you for additional information required for this screening as the application process continues. You can find information about the processing of your data in our Privacy Notice for the application process.
 Diversity and inclusion are not just trends for us but are firmly anchored in our corporate culture. Therefore, we welcome all applications, regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity.

items.desc: Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bij PwC werk je dicht bij de klant en de mensen die de oplossing gebruiken. Je onderzoekt hoe hun processen werkelijk werken, brengt een nog onduidelijk probleem terug tot iets dat je kunt bouwen en vertaalt feedback uit de praktijk direct naar werkende software. Je schrijft productiecode, bouwt integraties en brengt oplossingen naar productie. Je wacht niet tot alle requirements zijn uitgewerkt, maar stelt vragen, maakt aannames expliciet en bouwt snel een eerste versie om met gebruikers te toetsen wat daadwerkelijk werkt. Waar je terechtkomt Binnen het Data & AI Consulting-team van PwC Nederland werk je aan complexe vraagstukken bij ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, financiële instellingen en grote commerciële opdrachtgevers. Je helpt klanten om generatieve AI niet alleen te verkennen, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van hun processen, applicaties en dagelijkse werk. Forward deployed betekent bij ons dat je regelmatig dicht op de praktijk van de klant werkt. Je spreekt met gebruikers en domeinexperts, werkt met echte data en bestaande systemen en ontwikkelt de oplossing samen met het klantteam. Maar, je begint niet vanaf nul: we nemen onze AI-versnellers en frameworks mee naar de klant en versterken daarmee onze eigen producten. Afhankelijk van de fase van het traject werk je bij de klant, op ons kantoor in Amsterdam of vanuit huis. Belangrijk om te weten wat deze rol níet is. Je bent geen consultant die alleen analyseert en adviseert, geen sales engineer die vooral demo’s bouwt en geen software engineer die uitsluitend vanuit een uitgewerkt backlog werkt. Je bent en blijft een engineer. Je schrijft productiecode en bent aanspreekbaar op wat je bouwt, dus we meten je niet af op je PowerPoint slides en beschermen je focustijd. Tegelijk ga je zelf naar de bron. Samen met onze consultants spreek je met gebruikers, onderzoek je data en processen en stel je aannames ter discussie. Ons werk is pas geslaagd als de oplossing technisch werkt én in de dagelijkse praktijk waarde oplevert. Dit ga je doen Je werkt van een nog niet volledig uitgewerkt klantvraagstuk naar een AI-oplossing die in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt gebruikt. Je combineert discovery, software-engineering en klantgerichte delivery. Concreet: Je onderzoekt samen met gebruikers het echte probleem. Je brengt processen, knelpunten, data en bestaande systemen in kaart en vertaalt een nog onduidelijke klantvraag naar heldere requirements, succescriteria en een eerste leverbare stap. Je bouwt en toetst snel een eerste werkende oplossing. Met echte gebruikers en realistische data test je aannames en ontwikkel je GenAI-oplossingen met bijvoorbeeld LLM’s, RAG, agents en reguliere softwarecomponenten. Je integreert de oplossing in de klantomgeving. Je bouwt API’s, datastromen, authenticatie en koppelingen met bestaande applicaties en systemen. Daarbij maak je bewust de afweging wanneer AI waarde toevoegt en wanneer reguliere softwarelogica beter past. We werken voor klanten waar security, privacy en compliancy van levensbelang zijn (zoals banken en ministeries). Snel naar productie gaan is daar een uitdaging. Jouw rol is om met onze teamleden de discussie aan te gaan met security-officers en architecten. Je helpt hen in te zien hoe we op een veilige en verantwoorde manier die eerste versies live kunnen krijgen. Je brengt de oplossing betrouwbaar naar productie. Je zorgt voor geautomatiseerde tests, evaluaties, security, CI/CD, monitoring en logging. Je blijft betrokken bij livegang en stabilisatie en draagt bij aan het oplossen van technische blokkades in de klantomgeving. Je verbetert op basis van gebruik en maakt lessen herbruikbaar. Je verzamelt feedback, meet kwaliteit en gebruik, begeleidt de technische ingebruikname en vertaalt terugkerende patronen naar herbruikbare componenten, evaluatieframeworks en implementatieaanpakken. Je staat er niet alleen voor . Hoewel je als FDE de technische leiding neemt over de AI-oplossing, werk je nauw samen met onze gespecialiseerde data-engineers, architecten en consultants. Jij focust op de AI-logica, integratie en de developer experience van de oplossing, terwijl je collega’s zich op de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur en de organisatorische adoptie richten. Je maakt daarbij steeds een bewuste afweging tussen AI en reguliere softwarelogica. Niet ieder probleem heeft een LLM of agent nodig. Waar je mee werkt Onze stack varieert per klant en per vraagstuk. Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer werk je regelmatig in een technische omgeving die je niet zelf hebt gekozen. We zoeken daarom een sterke technische basis, brede nieuwsgierigheid en het vermogen om nieuwe tools snel eigen te maken. AI-applicaties bouwen: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic en SQL. Voor RAG en agentic AI gebruiken we bijvoorbeeld LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP, embeddings en vector stores zoals Azure AI Search of pgvector. Integreren en naar productie brengen: Microsoft Azure is ons meest …

items.desc: CONTEXT: AETHER aims to be the key partner for intrapreneurial projects in Belgium, and we want to reinforce our partnerships with key actors in the services sector, who are facing interesting challenges regarding the reliable operation of AI services for employees and customers. Projects are ongoing to ensure that employees and customers can use AI assistants and agents with reliable answers and dependable connections to business systems. If you're keen to support intrapreneurs and see this opportunity as a way to grow your own intrapreneurial or entrepreneurial leadership, we are looking for a medior AI Engineer to strengthen our team of Project Partners. TASK DESCRIPTION: As an AETHER Project Partner embedded within the project team, your objective will be to take over AI services from the engineers who built them and keep them reliable, measured, secure and cost-efficient in production. The services include retrieval-based assistants and AI agents that use tools and business systems on users' behalf. Initial services enter production before the assignment starts, with further releases planned during 2027. You will work alongside an internal AI Platform Architect, two Senior AI Engineers responsible for development, business and content owners, and IT operations teams. The platform combines managed Azure services with self-hosted open-source components on AKS. It uses Microsoft Foundry with the OpenAI model family for LLMs and embeddings, Azure AI Search, Azure API Management and Azure AI Content Safety. Agent orchestration uses Python and LangChain, alongside an ingestion pipeline. MLflow on Databricks supports evaluation and tracing with OpenTelemetry. The delivery team manages Infrastructure-as-Code for application-scoped Azure resources using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. Key responsibilities might include: Activities will vary from service to service. Typically you will: Operate AI services in production: monitor availability, response times and errors, handle incidents and service requests, analyse root causes, then fix or escalate issues. Keep answer quality under control: run and maintain evaluation sets, or golden sets, with business content owners; track answer quality, non-answer rates and user feedback; detect and investigate quality regressions. Operate ingestion pipelines: manage incremental refreshes, failed documents, index health and the addition of new content sources or business domains through existing connectors. Operate agent integrations: monitor tool calls and connections to business systems, handle failures and timeouts, and review action logs and exceptions for agents acting on users' behalf. Manage change safely: validate model version upgrades and retirements, prompt and configuration changes, and dependency and security updates against evaluation sets before release. Follow operating costs: track token consumption and cost per service, set alerts for unexpected changes and propose optimisations. Maintain Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps artefacts, and keep DEV, TST, ACC and PROD environments consistent. Apply data protection rules: manage trace retention, erasure and access restrictions as defined in each service's data protection impact assessment. Maintain runbooks and documentation, and regularly report service health to service owners and the AI governance team. Deliver small enhancements and fixes; structural changes and new features remain with the development team. PROFILE: Medior AI Engineer able to take ownership of production operations for AI agents and RAG services. Intermediate proficiency in vector databases, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure OpenAI Service, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Terraform, Python, LangChain and LLMs (Large Language Models). Native or bilingual proficiency in Dutch and French, and full professional proficiency in English. Available for an assignment in Brussels, Belgium, from 4 January 2027 to 31 December 2027, lasting approximately 11 months. An entrepreneurial experience or ambition is a plus, including extra-professional or extra-academic activities. OUR VISION: Success in industry often relies on key individuals who demonstrate intrapreneurial leadership — those who continuously initiate, transform, and pursue excellence. The best way to develop this strength is through ad interim projects, i.e. working as a consultant with established intrapreneurs in international companies, to support their major expansion or improvement initiatives regarding governance, studies, or operations. Since 2014, AETHER has been managing these opportunities for outstanding consultants in key international groups, as these offer greater learning opportunities with multi-million impacts. Please share your CV and we will check if this demand is the current best opportunity for your career as a consultant. INSPIRE | LEAD GROWTH | CREATE IMPACT

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Engagés à vos côtés, au service de vos enjeux critiques. Accélérer la transformation industrielle, en toute sécurité. Notre Business Unit Industrie accompagne les leaders des secteurs de l’aéronautique, de l’énergie et du transport dans la conception, la sécurisation et l’optimisation de leurs systèmes critiques. Avec plus de 700 collaborateurs en France et en Amérique du Nord, elle mobilise une expertise reconnue permettant la réalisation de projets innovants dans les domaines des systèmes embarqués, de la simulation numérique, de la cybersécurité, de la data intelligence et de la digitalisation des processus industriels. Rejoindre cette Business Unit, c’est transformer l’industrie avec des solutions à fort impact. Description du poste Nous recrutons un(e) Stage - Développement d'agent IA pour la vérification et validation de logiciels critiques pour rejoindre notre Business Unit INDUSTRIE au sein de l’agence Systèmes Embarqués Industriels et Cybersécurisés. Le Pôle de compétence SEIC contribue au développement de systèmes embarqués et industriels à fortes contraintes temps réel et de sûreté de fonctionnement ainsi qu’à leur mise en œuvre opérationnelle intégrant les concepts de sécurité. Contexte et objectifs Dans la continuité des travaux de CS GROUP sur l’intégration de méthodes d’IA dans les projets critiques et certifiables, ce stage vise à étudier et développer un framework permettant d’assister et d’orchestrer des workflows métier de Vérification & Validation (V&V) appliqués à des projets DO-178C. L’objectif sera de formaliser différents scénarios de V&V sous forme de workflows déterministes et traçables, puis d’étudier l’intégration de harnais agentiques capables de déléguer certaines tâches à des agents spécialisés utilisant notamment des LLM, du RAG et des outils métier. Une attention particulière sera portée à la structuration des données échangées entre agents, aux règles de délégation, aux boucles de contrôle et à la conservation des éléments de preuve nécessaires aux activités de V&V. Vos missions : 1. Formaliser les workflows métier et les scénarios V&V DO-178C Analyser les activités de spécification, revue, vérification, test, traçabilité et couverture afin de les formaliser les workflows explicites (étapes, rôles, entrées/sorties, règles métier, critères d’acceptation et points de contrôle). Identifier pour chaque scénario les tâches déterministes et celles pouvant être assistées par l’IA ou une validation humaine. 2. Définir l’architecture du harnais agentique et les mécanismes de délégation Concevoir une architecture d’orchestration permettant de décomposer un workflow métier en tâches spécialisées et de les déléguer à différents agents, outils ou fonctions déterministes. Définir les règles de déclenchement, de délégation, d’escalade, de validation et de terminaison des boucles agentiques. 3. Structurer les données et le contexte manipulés par les agents Définir des structures de données intermédiaires, typées et traçables permettant aux agents de manipuler exigences, spécifications, tests, résultats, éléments de couverture, preuves et relations de traçabilité. Mettre en place une représentation de l’état du workflow permettant de conserver le contexte, l’historique des décisions, les artefacts produits et les éléments nécessaires aux itérations successives des agents. 4. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen. Architect AI-augmented IAM capabilities, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration patterns, adaptive access control, predictive threat detection, identity analytics and intelligent workflow automation. Establish reusable frameworks, engineering standards and guardrails for scalable, resilient, maintainable, observable, secure and operationally supportable IAM automation and AI capabilities. Design and maintain secure CI/CD, DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code patterns using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, ARM templates or equivalent technologies, with appropriate testing and deployment controls. items.desc: University Hospital Southampton is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us Job Title: Research & Development (R&D) Specialist Data Analyst Contract Type: Permanent Please be advised that this vacancy may close earlier than stated if we receive a large number of applications. This is an exciting opportunity to join our growing Data & AI team within the Research & Development department at University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust, as a Senior Research Analyst. Working within the Southampton Emerging Therapies and Technologies (SETT) Centre, you will combine advanced analytical and data engineering expertise with line management responsibilities, leading a group of analysts and data engineers to deliver high-quality research data projects. Our team supports clinical and academic research through the extraction, processing and analysis of routinely collected healthcare data, developing innovative tools and infrastructure to expand research capacity and improve patient outcomes. The SETT Data & AI team works to drive future transformation in patient care through the streamlined extraction of high quality data at scale, and the application of state of the art analytical techniques to drive research. By developing a data landscape friendly to research, we aim to expand Trust-wide research capacity and improve patient outcomes through helping to shape the future of medicine. This is a creative and rapidly evolving unit within the hospital’s R&D environment, and successful candidates will have the exciting opportunity to help shape its direction and long-term aims. As one of the largest acute teaching Trusts in England, we offer learning and development opportunities to help you achieve the career you aspire to. UHS is rated ‘Good’ by the CQC and in the latest national NHS Staff Survey, we were in the top 10 acute trusts for staff engagement and for staff recommending the hospital as a place to work or receive care. We support flexible working and will consider requests taking into account the needs of the service. UHS employees are able to access a range of NHS discounts, are entitled to a minimum of 35 days paid holiday (pro rata), and we offer a generous pension scheme. Southampton is an attractive place to live and work situated on the south coast, with an international airport and direct trains to London. The New Forest National Park and beaches of the Jurassic coast are also right on our doorstep. The city offers living costs 30% lower than London and 17 schools rated outstanding by Ofsted. We believe that using technology wisely shows strong time management and commitment to innovation. However, personalising your recruitment application to highlight your unique skills and experiences is crucial. You will support project development and delivery, maintain high technical standards, and contribute to the ongoing improvement of the team's capabilities and working practices. The Data & AI team works closely with clinical and academic researchers across University Hospital Southampton and partner organisations, supporting a diverse portfolio of research projects using routinely collected healthcare data. Our work ranges from developing automated data extraction and transformation pipelines to undertaking advanced analytical studies, building innovative research tools and improving the infrastructure that enables research at scale. Through this work, we aim to expand research capacity, support scientific discovery and ultimately improve patient outcomes. items.desc: Context AETHER aims to be the key partner for intrapreneurial projects in Belgium, and we want to reinforce our partnerships with key actors in the services sector, who are facing interesting challenges regarding the reliable operation of AI services for employees and customers. Projects are ongoing to ensure that employees and customers can use AI assistants and agents with reliable answers and dependable connections to business systems. If you're keen to support intrapreneurs and see this opportunity as a way to grow your own intrapreneurial or entrepreneurial leadership, we are looking for a medior AI Engineer to strengthen our team of Project Partners. Task Description As an AETHER Project Partner embedded within the project team, your objective will be to take over AI services from the engineers who built them and keep them reliable, measured, secure and cost-efficient in production. The services include retrieval-based assistants and AI agents that use tools and business systems on users' behalf. Initial services enter production before the assignment starts, with further releases planned during 2027. You will work alongside an internal AI Platform Architect, two Senior AI Engineers responsible for development, business and content owners, and IT operations teams. The platform combines managed Azure services with self-hosted open-source components on AKS. It uses Microsoft Foundry with the OpenAI model family for LLMs and embeddings, Azure AI Search, Azure API Management and Azure AI Content Safety. Agent orchestration uses Python and LangChain, alongside an ingestion pipeline. MLflow on Databricks supports evaluation and tracing with OpenTelemetry. The delivery team manages Infrastructure-as-Code for application-scoped Azure resources using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. Key Responsibilities Might Include Activities will vary from service to service. Typically you will: Operate AI services in production: monitor availability, response times and errors, handle incidents and service requests, analyse root causes, then fix or escalate issues. Keep answer quality under control: run and maintain evaluation sets, or golden sets, with business content owners; track answer quality, non-answer rates and user feedback; detect and investigate quality regressions. Operate ingestion pipelines: manage incremental refreshes, failed documents, index health and the addition of new content sources or business domains through existing connectors. Operate agent integrations: monitor tool calls and connections to business systems, handle failures and timeouts, and review action logs and exceptions for agents acting on users' behalf. Manage change safely: validate model version upgrades and retirements, prompt and configuration changes, and dependency and security updates against evaluation sets before release. Follow operating costs: track token consumption and cost per service, set alerts for unexpected changes and propose optimisations. Maintain Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps artefacts, and keep DEV, TST, ACC and PROD environments consistent. Apply data protection rules: manage trace retention, erasure and access restrictions as defined in each service's data protection impact assessment. Maintain runbooks and documentation, and regularly report service health to service owners and the AI governance team. Deliver small enhancements and fixes; structural changes and new features remain with the development team. Profile Medior AI Engineer able to take ownership of production operations for AI agents and RAG services. Intermediate proficiency in vector databases, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure OpenAI Service, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Terraform, Python, LangChain and LLMs (Large Language Models). Native or bilingual proficiency in Dutch and French, and full professional proficiency in English. Available for an assignment in Brussels, Belgium, from 4 January 2027 to 31 December 2027, lasting approximately 11 months. An entrepreneurial experience or ambition is a plus, including extra-professional or extra-academic activities. Our Vision Success in industry often relies on key individuals who demonstrate intrapreneurial leadership — those who continuously initiate, transform, and pursue excellence. The best way to develop this strength is through ad interim projects, i.e. working as a consultant with established intrapreneurs in international companies, to support their major expansion or improvement initiatives regarding governance, studies, or operations. Since 2014, AETHER has been managing these opportunities for outstanding consultants in key international groups, as these offer greater learning opportunities with multi-million impacts. Please share your CV and we will check if this demand is the current best opportunity for your career as a consultant. INSPIRE | LEAD GROWTH | CREATE IMPACT
