items.desc: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours. About The Role The Media Data Platform (MDP) team is looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join a growing squad building MDLZ's in-house media ecosystem. You will design and deliver data pipelines, integrations, and AI-driven solutions that ingest, transform, and activate data from external media platforms — enabling smarter media investment decisions at global scale. The role sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams across Marketing & I&A Products. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and optimise data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve media data from external platforms (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social media, measurement partners) using Python, Databricks, GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow), and AWS. Develop and deploy AI/ML models and LLM-based workflows — including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration — to generate media performance insights and activation intelligence. Build and maintain APIs and backend services that surface media data and AI-generated insights to business users and downstream applications. Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for pipelines and models to ensure reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency in production. Collaborate with Product Owners, Engineering, and Architects across Marketing & I&A Products to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable technical solutions. Contribute to platform architecture decisions including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerisation (Docker), and CI/CD practices. Write clean, tested, well-documented code; participate in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and knowledge-sharing across the team. How You Will Contribute We Are Looking For Candidates With Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade data pipelines or applications. Hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery, DBT, Cloud Storage) and AWS, plus Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog). Solid understanding of data engineering — ETL/ELT, SQL, data modelling, and working with structured and unstructured data at scale. Exposure to AI/ML engineering — LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agent-based architectures. Experience with data integration patterns: REST APIs, streaming, orchestration (Airflow/Cloud Composer), and DBT. Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, CI/CD, testing, Docker, and Terraform. Strong communication skills; able to work cross-functionally and translate technical topics to business stakeholders. Intellectual curiosity and a bias for learning in a fast-moving data and AI environment. Nice to Have Experience in media data engineering and adtech integrations (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social platforms, Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI). Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem (MLflow, Feature Store, Genie). Exposure to NLP or multimodal AI. Experience with monitoring/observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch). Prior experience in a CPG/FMCG environment. The responsibilities of this position are performed within the framework of a regional business model that is defined and managed by Mondelēz Europe GmbH, Switzerland . No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary At Mondelez Europe, we are proud, not only of the iconic brands we make, but also of the people who make them. Our delicious products are created in 52 plants across Europe by more than 28,000 passionate people. We are the top maker of chocolate and biscuits and a leading maker of gum and candy. We make sure our powerful global brands and local jewels like Cadbury, Milka and Alpen Gold chocolates, Oreo, belVita, LU and Tuc biscuits get safely into our customers hands—and mouths. Great people and great brands. That’s who we are. Join us on our journey to continue leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Job Function Technology Product & Platform Management Job Sub Function Technical Product Management Job Category Scientific/Technology All Job Posting Locations: Lisbon, Portugal, Madrid - Lafinca, Milano, Italy Job Description Role Overview The AI Operations Analyst manages day-to-day operational analysis and monitoring for AI applications and AI agents, helping maintain reliable, secure, transparent, and cost-effective services. The role combines hands-on investigation, dashboard and reporting ownership, incident coordination, and continuous improvement of established operational processes. The analyst takes ownership of assigned operational activities across observability, consumption reporting, incident triage, audit evidence, and service readiness. The role works with AI Operations engineers and partner teams to investigate issues, recommend improvements, and implement approved changes within defined access and change-management controls. The analyst also supports solution design by contributing operational insights and practical requirements for monitoring, supportability, and cost visibility. The role does not own the end-to-end lifecycle management of agents or AI products, platform architecture, or final security and compliance approvals. Agent design, development, functional evaluation, release content, product evolution, and retirement decisions remain with the Agent Factory and the relevant AI product teams. items.desc: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours. About The Role The Media Data Platform (MDP) team is looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join a growing squad building MDLZ's in-house media ecosystem. You will design and deliver data pipelines, integrations, and AI-driven solutions that ingest, transform, and activate data from external media platforms — enabling smarter media investment decisions at global scale. The role sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams across Marketing & I&A Products. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and optimise data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve media data from external platforms (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social media, measurement partners) using Python, Databricks, GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow), and AWS. Develop and deploy AI/ML models and LLM-based workflows — including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration — to generate media performance insights and activation intelligence. Build and maintain APIs and backend services that surface media data and AI-generated insights to business users and downstream applications. Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for pipelines and models to ensure reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency in production. Collaborate with Product Owners, Engineering, and Architects across Marketing & I&A Products to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable technical solutions. Contribute to platform architecture decisions including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerisation (Docker), and CI/CD practices. Write clean, tested, well-documented code; participate in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and knowledge-sharing across the team. How You Will Contribute We Are Looking For Candidates With Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade data pipelines or applications. Hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery, DBT, Cloud Storage) and AWS, plus Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog). Solid understanding of data engineering — ETL/ELT, SQL, data modelling, and working with structured and unstructured data at scale. Exposure to AI/ML engineering — LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agent-based architectures. Experience with data integration patterns: REST APIs, streaming, orchestration (Airflow/Cloud Composer), and DBT. Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, CI/CD, testing, Docker, and Terraform. Strong communication skills; able to work cross-functionally and translate technical topics to business stakeholders. Intellectual curiosity and a bias for learning in a fast-moving data and AI environment. Nice to Have Experience in media data engineering and adtech integrations (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social platforms, Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI). Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem (MLflow, Feature Store, Genie). Exposure to NLP or multimodal AI. Experience with monitoring/observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch). Prior experience in a CPG/FMCG environment. The responsibilities of this position are performed within the framework of a regional business model that is defined and managed by Mondelēz Europe GmbH, Switzerland . No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary At Mondelez Europe, we are proud, not only of the iconic brands we make, but also of the people who make them. Our delicious products are created in 52 plants across Europe by more than 28,000 passionate people. We are the top maker of chocolate and biscuits and a leading maker of gum and candy. We make sure our powerful global brands and local jewels like Cadbury, Milka and Alpen Gold chocolates, Oreo, belVita, LU and Tuc biscuits get safely into our customers hands—and mouths. Great people and great brands. That’s who we are. Join us on our journey to continue leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Job Type Regular Software & Applications Technology & Digital

Join Amazon's Global Materials Science (GMS) organization as we pioneer the future of sustainable e-commerce packaging. As an Advanced Materials Engineer based in the EU, you'll serve as the critical link between our European and North American materials science operations, driving materials development tailored to the EU supplier base while harmonizing global materials strategies across regions. Embedded alongside our automation hardware development teams, you'll ensure that packaging materials and automation systems are co-developed for seamless integration.
This is a hands-on, technically broad role spanning pulp and paper manufacturing, packaging converting operations, tape and adhesive systems, coatings, and packaging automation equipment. You'll conduct laboratory research, characterize materials properties, establish specifications, and work directly with EU-based suppliers to bring novel materials from concept to production, while serving as the conduit to align materials globally, simplify where possible, and solve for region-specific requirements driven by regulation, material supply availability, and operational differences.
Key job responsibilities
Materials Development & Innovation:
- Lead laboratory research and development of packaging materials including paper substrates, adhesives, tapes, coatings, and alternative fiber technologies, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations.
- Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of packaging materials and converting processes.
- Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility, with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability.
- Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment.
- Evaluate and develop tape, adhesive, and coating systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions.
EU Materials Strategy & Global Alignment:
- Serve as the primary conduit between EU and NA materials science teams, driving global alignment on materials specifications while identifying opportunities to harmonize and simplify across regions.
- Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base, including paper mills, converters, adhesive manufacturers, tape producers, and coating suppliers, and how it differs from the North American supply landscape.
- Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks.
- Balance global standardization with regional customization, driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation.
- Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GMS strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines.
Automation Hardware Integration:
- Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput.
- Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization, translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters.
- Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, tape applicators, labelers) and how materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds.
- Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings.

- Establish correlations between fundamental materials properties and operational performance in fulfillment environments, with emphasis on how EU-specific substrates and converting conditions affect outcomes.
- Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations.
- Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven …

Missions principales oContribuer à la mise à jour des politiques et des procédures IT ; oContribuer à l'amélioration continue des documents de conformité ; oParticiper à la mise en oeuvre de tableaux de bord intelligents combinant Power BI et fonctionnalités d'IA ; oAnalyser les processus existants de gouvernance, de conformité, de gestion des risques et de reporting au sein du Group IT Governance afin d'identifier les opportunités d'optimisation, de simplification, de standardisation et d'automatisation grâce à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies numériques. oAnalyser les processus existants afin d'identifier les opportunités d'automatisation et de gains d'efficacité grâce à l'IA ; oParticiper à la conception, au développement et à l'amélioration d'agents IA destinés à optimiser les activités de gouvernance, de conformité, de gestion des risques et de contrôle interne ; oConcevoir et maintenir des prompts, workflows et cas d'usage IA répondant aux besoins métiers et de gouvernance ; oAssurer une veille technologique sur les innovations en matière d'IA, d'automatisation et de gouvernance des systèmes d'information ; oContribuer aux actions de communication interne sur la conformité et les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance IT. Descriptif du poste Votre équipe et votre environnement Vous intégrez une équipe jeune et dynamique présente en France, en Allemagne et en Tunisie. Vous travaillerez dans un contexte technique innovant au sein d'une équipe multiculturelle et multilingue passionnée par les nouvelles technologies et les environnements numériques. Les compétences que vous développerez oDéveloppement d'une expertise hybride en IT Governance, Data Analytics et Intelligence Artificielle. oMise en oeuvre de solutions innovantes combinant Intelligence Artificielle, automatisation de processus et Business Intelligence. oAcquisition de compétences en AI Governance, gestion des risques liés à l'IA et utilisation responsable des technologies d'intelligence artificielle. oConformité réglementaire et contrôle interne liés aux activités IT. oEsprit d'analyse et de synthèse, communication professionnelle et travail en équipe. oExposition aux cadres réglementaires et aux normes de référence du secteur, tels que DORA, les Lignes directrices de l'EBA, la gestion des risques ICT, NIS2, ISO 27001 ainsi que les cadres de gouvernance de l'intelligence artificielle (IA). Profil et compétences recherchées Prérequis oEtudiant(e) 2ème année de Master / 3ème année du Cycle d'ingénieur en Informatique, Intelligence Artificielle, Data Science ou IT Management ; oMaîtrise ou bonne connaissance des outils de Data Analytics et Data Visualisation (Power BI, Tableau, Excel avancé) ainsi que des concepts de modélisation et d'analyse de données ; oExcellente maîtrise de Python et solides compétences en développement logiciel, incluant l'exploitation d'APIs, le traitement et l'analyse de données, ainsi que l'intégration de systèmes et d'applications. oMaitrise des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle et d'automatisation : LLM, IA générative, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Agents IA (Agentic AI), Machine Learning, RPA ou technologies similaires. oBonnes capacités d'analyse et de rédaction ; oLa maitrise du français et de l'anglais est indispensable, l'allemand est un plus. Pourquoi Oddo BHF ? Chez ODDO BHF, nous avons le privilège de compter plus de 60000 clients, investisseurs institutionnels, entreprises, partenaires de distribution et grands clients privés dont nous conseillons, gérons et investissons les actifs financiers. Notre mission est de les faire fructifier via nos quatre métiers : Banque Privée, Gestion d'Actifs, Banque de Financement et d'Investissement, Service et Technologies Bancaires. Ancrage européen, esprit entrepreneurial, pluralité d'expertises : ces atouts nous permettent de proposer des expériences professionnelles uniques, via des parcours variés et des opportunités de mobilités multiples et transverses en Europe. Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous vous accompagnons lors du process de recrutement et une fois recruté(e), pour adapter et/ou faciliter au mieux votre vie au sein de l'entreprise. N'hésitez pas à poser …

items.desc: Résilians est un acteur national de référence de l’après-sinistre, en plein développement. Chaque jour, partout en France, nos équipes interviennent en première urgence pour sauvegarder, sécuriser et réparer les biens touchés par des sinistres — incendie, dégât des eaux, recherche de fuite, événement climatique — puis pour les remettre en état. Fort de plus de 30 ans d’expérience, Résilians s’appuie sur des métiers complémentaires, un ancrage territorial fort et une culture technique exigeante pour accompagner durablement ses clients et les sinistrés, y compris dans les situations les plus sensibles et complexes. Mission principale L’IA générative est déjà entrée dans nos projets : base de connaissances interne, agents sur une plateforme low-code IA, automatisation de processus dans nos outils. Résilians crée aujourd’hui le poste d’Ingénieur IA pour généraliser ces usages à l’ensemble du groupe. Rattaché au Directeur des Systèmes d’Information, vous accélérez l’intégration de l’IA dans nos outils (ERP métier, GED, outils web, plateformes d’échange avec les assureurs). Vous générez des gains de productivité mesurables et faites de l’IA un réflexe pour tous les métiers : agences, gestion de chantier, comptabilité, achats, RH, relation client. Missions Construire la feuille de route IA du groupe Aller à la rencontre des directions et des agences pour comprendre leurs processus et leurs irritants Détecter les cas d’usage IA à fort potentiel (traitement documentaire, rédaction, recherche d’information, automatisation, analyse de données) Aider à l’évaluation de chaque cas d’usage : gain attendu, faisabilité, coût, risques Construire et tenir à jour une feuille de route IA priorisée avec la DSI Mesurer l’adoption et les gains de productivité, et en rendre compte à la direction Traduire les besoins en solutions techniques Formaliser les besoins métiers en spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques exploitables par les développeurs Concevoir l’architecture des solutions IA (choix des modèles, RAG, agents, prompts, intégrations) Réaliser des prototypes (POC) rapides pour valider la valeur avant industrialisation Décider, avec la DSI, entre développement interne et recours à un partenaire Piloter l’intégration de l’IA dans les outils de l’entreprise Piloter les projets IA de bout en bout : cadrage, planning, suivi, recette, mise en production Intégrer l’IA dans nos outils existants (ERP, GED, outils web, bureautique) via API et connecteurs Coordonner les équipes internes (développement, infrastructure, projets, métiers) et les prestataires Suivre la qualité des réponses des solutions IA en production et les améliorer en continu Identifier et piloter les partenaires techniques Assurer une veille sur les solutions, modèles et éditeurs du marché (dont les offres d’IA souveraine) Consulter, comparer et sélectionner les partenaires lorsque le développement interne n’est pas pertinent Suivre leurs livrables, leurs coûts et le respect des engagements Former et faire adopter l’IA Concevoir et animer des formations aux bons usages de l’IA, adaptées à chaque métier Animer un réseau de référents IA dans les directions et les agences Rédiger des guides pratiques, bibliothèques de prompts et supports d’auto-formation Garantir un usage sûr et conforme de l’IA, en concertation avec le RSSI Définir, avec la direction, les règles d’usage de l’IA (charte, données autorisées, outils validés) Veiller à la conformité RGPD et AI Act ainsi qu’à la maîtrise des coûts d’usage Identifier et prévenir les risques cyber propres à l’IA (fuite de données, injection de prompt, outils non autorisés) Profil Formation Bac +5 (école d’ingénieurs, master ou école de commerce) en informatique, IA, data science ou systèmes d’information 2 à 5 ans d’expérience, dont au moins une mise en production de solutions d’IA générative en entreprise ; une expérience en DSI, en conseil ou au contact des métiers est un plus Maîtrise de l’IA générative (LLM, prompt engineering, RAG, agents) et connaissance des principaux modèles, fournisseurs et modes d’hébergement Pratique d’une plateforme d’orchestration ou low-code IA (Dify, n8n ou équivalent) Compétences techniques : Python et/ou PHP, API, SQL, environnement SI d’entreprise (ERP, GED, Microsoft 365) Capacité à analyser des processus métiers variés, rédiger des spécifications, piloter un projet (Agile, cycle en V) et construire un business case Sensibilité à la sécurité des données, au RGPD et à l’AI Act Pragmatisme, pédagogie, curiosité, autonomie, rigueur et capacité à convaincre

items.desc: ControlUp is a leader in Digital Employee Experience (DEX), evolving IT operations with agentic AI to deliver Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) and a digital workspace that runs itself. Our platform transforms millions of real-time signals into intelligent action, bridging the gap between deep visibility and automated remediation. We turn "IT headaches" and employee frustration into self-healing operations, allowing organizations to move beyond reactive troubleshooting toward a future where technology works seamlessly in the background. We’re here to ensure the workday runs without disruptions. No tool sprawl, no wasted time, and no friction. Just technology that works for people, not against them, so they can stay focused on what they do best. One platform. One powerful shift in how work flows. A bout the Role: We are looking for a builder: an engineer who takes an idea or a rough prototype and turns it into a production-grade product that customers use. You own a feature end to end, from the customer problem to backend, data, UI, release and measurement. You use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) every day, and you build LLM-powered features into the product itself. What You’ll Own: Take new compliance capabilities from idea to production in weeks, not quarters. Build data pipelines that join vulnerability, patch and device data from several sources (our agent, scanners like Tenable/Qualys/Rapid7, patch catalogs) into one accurate picture. Design and ship AI features: explaining risk in plain language, prioritizing what to fix first, generating audit evidence, agents that remediate safely. Own quality in production: correctness of findings, monitoring, alerting, and no silent failures. Work directly with customers and field teams, and turn their problems into shipped product. Measure impact after release and iterate. What You’ll Bring: 5+ years in product management, with a track record of building products from 0 to 1 that reached real users. A product person who builds: proven ability and experience creating working products yourself with AI tools, across all the technologies a feature needs. Experience working directly with customers: talking with them, understanding their needs, and delivering solutions that answer those needs. Experience in vulnerability management: scanners, CVE/CVSS/KEV, and how a finding becomes a fix on the endpoint. Full-stack ownership: backend (Python, Go, C# or Node.js), data (SQL, large datasets), and enough frontend (React/TypeScript) to ship a complete feature. Production experience in the cloud (AWS or Azure), CI/CD, observability. Daily use of AI coding tools, and at least one LLM / RAG / agent feature you shipped to production. Ownership and speed: you prefer shipping to meetings, and you measure yourself by what reached customers. Fluent English (B2+). You don’t need to know every technology on this list. We care more that you are agile: you pick up whatever a feature needs while you build it, and you ship. Strong plus: Security or compliance domain: vulnerability management, CVE/CVSS/KEV, patch management, CIS benchmarks, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence, GRC tools. Endpoint or IT operations: Windows/macOS agents, RMM, MDM/Intune, SCCM. Founding engineer or early-startup experience. Side projects or open source you built and launched yourself. Why You’ll Love It Here: We know every job description says "fast-paced" and "collaborative." Here’s what that actually looks like for us: Global, Not Isolated: You’ll work with a diverse team spanning the US, EMEA, and Israel. We’re known for our vibrant social culture, and once a year, the entire global company comes together for a major offsite to reconnect in person. Meaningful Impact: Make a real impact from day one, working with cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced, global environment. Collaborative & Growth-Driven: Join a collaborative, empowering culture where learning and professional growth are encouraged. True Flexibility: We offer a hybrid model. We care about the output of your expertise, not the hours you spend in a specific chair. Ready to join? Apply now and help us shape the future of IT and employee experience. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.desc: Basée à Lille, Lyon, Nantes, Grenoble, Marseille, Paris et Bruxelles, Insitoo Freelances est une société du groupe Insitoo, spécialisée dans le placement et le sourcing des Freelances IT et Métier. Depuis 2007, Insitoo Freelances a su s?imposer comme une référence en matière de freelancing par son expertise dans l?IT et ses valeurs de transparence et de proximité. Actuellement, afin de répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous recherchons un Développeur python (H/F) à Lille, France. Les missions attendues par le Développeur python (H/F) : Construire et opérer le moteur RAG (Build & Run) Concevoir, développer et exploiter les services backend et les API du moteur RAG, en Python (FastAPI). Construire des pipelines d'ingestion scalables : connecteurs vers les sources d'entreprise, extraction/parsing de documents PDF, Office, HTML et numérisés, stratégies de découpage (chunking), vectorisation (embeddings), synchronisation incrémentale. Optimiser la recherche d'informations (retrieval) : recherche vectorielle et hybride, réordonnancement (reranking), réécriture de requêtes, filtrage par métadonnées, recherche multilingue couvrant les différentes filiales et pays du groupe. Garantir la gestion des droits d'accès au niveau des documents, la protection des données et la traçabilité (auditabilité). Mesurer et améliorer la qualité : métriques de recherche et de réponse (rappel, précision, fidélité/faithfulness, ancrage/groundedness), jeux de données de test, évaluation continue en production avec les services d'évaluation dédiés. Rendre le moteur RAG adapté aux agents (« agentic-ready ») Exposer le moteur RAG sous forme d'outils et de serveurs MCP, afin que les agents puissent interroger et exploiter la base de connaissances de l'entreprise avec les autorisations appropriées. Mettre en ?uvre des patterns de recherche agentique : recherche multi-étapes, planification de requêtes, recherche augmentée par des outils. Fournir des SDK, templates, plugins et documentations permettant aux équipes produit (et à leurs propres agents de code) d'intégrer leurs bases de connaissances en quelques minutes. Travailler selon une approche « Agent-First » Utiliser quotidiennement des agents de développement IA (ex. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) et leur déléguer l'implémentation, les tests, le refactoring, les migrations et la documentation, tout en restant pleinement garant du résultat. Rédiger des spécifications claires et découper les projets en tâches bien délimitées pour les agents, orchestrer plusieurs agents en parallèle et relire rigoureusement leur production. Rendre les dépôts de code optimisés pour les agents : fichiers d'instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md), compétences/skills, environnements reproductibles, tests automatisés solides et garde-fous CI. Diffuser les bonnes pratiques au sein de l'équipe et de la communauté transverse dédiée aux capacités IA, et contribuer à mesurer leur impact sur la vitesse et la qualité de livraison. Profil recherché5+ ans d'expérience en développement backend, avec une solide maîtrise de Python (FastAPI, programmation asynchrone), une réelle expertise en conception d'API et une expérience des systèmes distribués. Véritable expertise en IA / ML : bases solides en traitement automatique du langage naturel (NLP) et en recherche d'information (embeddings, similarité vectorielle, métriques de classement et de recherche), compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement des LLM, capacité à évaluer et optimiser la qualité de la recherche et de la génération. Profil candidat: Compétences techniques et fonctionnelles attendues : Anglais - Expert - Indispensable FastAPI - Expert - Indispensable Python - Expert - Indispensable

items.desc: About Behavox Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are. We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. About the Role The Front Office Subject Matter Expert is an experienced individual contributor in the Subject Matter Expert (SME) team. The role is the primary owner of one or two related asset classes and makes sure that the Behavox Financial Data Model (BFDM) and the Unified Risk Taxonomy (URT) reflect how trading desks, venues and regulation actually work. The URT is the common language for risks across preventive controls (such as conflicts of interest and conduct) and detective controls (such as trade and communications surveillance). Working with little day-to-day instruction, the role defines asset class data specifications, turns market abuse typologies into scenarios for Polaris, the Behavox trade surveillance product, and advises product, engineering and data science teams. It supports the revenue team in client meetings, demos and requests for proposal (RFPs) alongside a senior SME or the manager, but does not lead engagements with high-profile prospects or regulators on its own. The role is AI-native: it works with AI agents and agentic workflows, not only chat assistants, specifying requirements for agent-based pipelines and validating their outputs through structured data models and Git-based workflows. This is a remote friendly opportunity. Typical background: Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a front office role, in market surveillance, or with front office data at an exchange, trading venue, market data provider or trading technology vendor. Languages: English required; other languages a strong plus. Agentic workflows: hands-on experience is a plus. Location: open for a remote candidate within Italy. What You'll Bring: Asset class markets – Practitioner-level knowledge of at least one of: commodities and environmental products; digital assets and event contracts; fixed income and structured products; equities and funds; foreign exchange and money markets. This includes instruments, venues, trading conventions and pricing. Front office workflows – Understanding of how execution, sales, research and risk functions operate on a trading desk, including order handling, quoting and hedging. Market abuse typologies – Knowledge of behaviors such as insider dealing, spoofing and layering, wash trading, front running and benchmark manipulation, and how they appear in trade, order and market data. Financial markets regulation – Working knowledge of trading conduct rules, such as the EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR), the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II), and US rules of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Structured data modelling – Understanding of trade, order, market and reference data, their quality issues, and modelling concepts such as entities, schemas, validation rules and versioning. What You'll Do: Asset class data specification – Defines BFDM fields, schemas and validation rules for owned asset classes, and checks data outputs against them. Surveillance scenario design – Turns market abuse typologies into Polaris risk scenarios, anchors them to regulatory enforcement cases, and validates their outputs with engineering and data science. Risk taxonomy maintenance – Maps owned asset classes to URT risk situations and regulatory requirements, and keeps coverage current. Client engagement support – Answers front office, data and surveillance questions in client meetings, demos and RFPs alongside the revenue team, and produces SME-reviewed collateral. AI-native, agentic ways of working – Writes clear specifications for agent-based pipelines, reviews and validates their outputs, and contributes changes through Git-based workflows in GitLab. What We Offer: A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation Highly competitive compensation with 100% bonus pay already integrated Benefits include individual career development budget for your learning and growth Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule About Our Process: We take Talent …

Job Description As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. Qualifications What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. items.desc: Stage AI Engineer – IA générative & agentique – Paris – 1 500 €/mois | 6 mois 📍 Le contexte Equancy est un cabinet de conseil et réalisation spécialisé dans la transformation data & IA, basé à Paris, Casablanca et Dubaï. Nos clients sont de grands groupes français et internationaux, comme LVMH, Chanel, VINCI, Colas ou Volkswagen. On les accompagne du cadrage de leurs besoins jusqu'à la mise en production des solutions. Pour accompagner la croissance de notre activité, on cherche un ou une stagiaire AI Engineer pour rejoindre l'équipe IA générative et agentique, pendant 6 mois, dès que possible. 🚀 Tes missions Développement IA générative & agentique - Participer au développement d'applications basées sur des modèles génératifs (LLM, modèles de diffusion) pour des besoins métier variés : assistants conversationnels, agents de processus… - Implémenter des stratégies de context engineering : templates, structured prompting, function calling - Développer des pipelines agentiques et participer au développement d'agents : outils, plugins et services MCP, de l'agent simple au système multi-agents - Mettre en œuvre le RAG de bout en bout : ingestion, chunking et métadonnées, requêtage, hybrid search et reranking Intégration technique - Consommer et intégrer les APIs de services cloud IA (Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI et Gemini, AWS Bedrock) : modèles, agents ou outils - Développer des APIs backend : REST/JSON, OpenAPI, notions d'authentification JWT/OAuth2 - Contribuer à la mise en place d'architectures applicatives cloud-native - Participer à l'intégration des solutions d'IA générative et agentique dans des outils métier existants Industrialisation & bonnes pratiques - Contribuer à la qualité du code : tests, documentation, revues de code - Participer aux déploiements et à la mise en production des applications - Appliquer des garde-fous : sécurités déterministes, validation des sorties structurées, protections contre le prompt injection - Mettre en œuvre les bonnes pratiques de sécurité, de performance et d'observabilité - Mettre en place une observabilité de base (logs structurés, métriques de latence et d'erreurs) et diagnostiquer les incidents - Contribuer à un golden set et aux tests de non-régression des prompts et du RAG - Utiliser les outils d'agentic coding comme Claude Code pour accélérer les développements, de la maquette à l'application complète Apprentissage & veille - Te former en continu aux nouveaux outils, modèles, frameworks et patterns d'IA générative et agentique - Participer à la veille technologique et aux retours d'expérience internes 🎯 Ton profil Indispensable - Formation Bac+5 (M2) en informatique, avec une spécialité data et/ou IA - Une première expérience en data science, data engineering ou développement logiciel (stage, alternance ou CDI) - Très bon niveau en Python et bonne connaissance des pratiques de développement (CI/CD, Docker…) - Maîtrise de Git - Des connaissances sur les LLM et leurs APIs, le prompt engineering et les outils pour implémenter une RAG - De l'appétence pour les enjeux business et métier : tu sais prendre du recul sur ce que tu construis et à quoi ça sert - Anglais professionnel Un plus - Des bases en JavaScript ou TypeScript - La connaissance d'outils low-code/no-code d'orchestration de processus agentiques (n8n, Copilot Studio, Make, Zapier) - La compréhension du fonctionnement des modèles génératifs : pré-entraînement, fine-tuning, quantization, PEFT… 💡 Ce qu'on t'offre - Une exposition à toute la chaîne d'un projet IA, du cadrage à la mise en production - Une proximité forte avec les directeurs et les associés - Une équipe internationale - Des locaux au WeWork Jules Lefebvre, à côté de Saint-Lazare : un bâtiment historique, de grands espaces et une vue panoramique sur Paris - 2 jours de télétravail par semaine, avec équipement fourni et allocation mensuelle pour les frais - Des activités sportives et la conciergerie WeWork 🔄 Le process - R1 : 1er échange avec notre TA, un questionnaire de 10 questions pour évaluer tes connaissances techniques - R2 : Entretien métier + test technique 📌 Infos pratiques - Contrat : stage de fin d'études (M2), 6 mois - Démarrage : dès que possible - Gratification : 1 500 €/mois - Lieu : Paris (Saint-Lazare), en hybride avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine Equancy s'engage pour l'inclusion et accueille les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap. La mission te parle ? Postule directement via cette annonce, on prendra contact rapidement.

items.desc: Crear una demo con un LLM es sencillo. Diseñar un sistema de agentes fiable, observable, seguro y preparado para integrarse en un entorno de negocio es otro reto. En NTT DATA buscamos una persona con experiencia en IA generativa y desarrollo de software para impulsar casos de uso en el sector asegurador. Participarás en todo el ciclo: descubrimiento, diseño técnico, prototipado, evaluación, integración y evolución en producción. Trabajarás con agentes, arquitecturas RAG, LLMs y cloud para construir soluciones útiles, medibles y escalables. Tendrás interlocución con equipos de negocio, datos, seguridad y cumplimiento, porque la calidad de una solución de IA no depende solo de su respuesta: también depende de que pueda utilizarse con confianza. NTT DATA combina la escala de una compañía tecnológica global con equipos cercanos, especializados y orientados a resolver retos reales. Aquí podrás profundizar en tecnologías emergentes sin perder de vista el impacto que generan. Tu día a día Diseñar y desarrollar agentes y sistemas multiagente end-to-end, incluyendo herramientas, estado, flujos de decisión, guardrails e intervención humana cuando sea necesaria. Definir arquitecturas RAG con recuperación híbrida, embeddings, reranking, gestión de contexto y criterios de calidad adaptados a cada caso de uso. Diseñar marcos de evaluación y observabilidad de soluciones LLM: calidad, coste, latencia, trazabilidad, errores y evaluación humana. Integrar soluciones de IA en servicios productivos mediante APIs, contenedores, prácticas de CI/CD y arquitecturas basadas en servicios o eventos. Identificar y mitigar riesgos asociados a la IA generativa, como alucinaciones, inyección de prompts, confidencialidad y uso inadecuado de la información. Colaborar con perfiles de negocio, datos, seguridad y cumplimiento para priorizar casos de uso según impacto, viabilidad y riesgo. Compartir conocimiento técnico y, cuando proceda, acompañar a perfiles con menor experiencia en su desarrollo profesional. Lo que buscamos en ti Al menos 2 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo de software, IA, datos o automatización, con experiencia demostrable en Python e IA generativa. Dominio de Python para construir soluciones modulares y mantenibles, integrar APIs, bases de datos y servicios externos, y aplicar logging, manejo de errores y testing. Experiencia práctica trabajando con LLMs: selección y consumo de modelos, prompt engineering avanzado, salidas estructuradas, restricciones y validaciones. Experiencia diseñando flujos RAG y aplicando conceptos como embeddings, recuperación híbrida, reranking y gestión de contexto. Conocimiento práctico de frameworks de agentes como LangChain, LangGraph, ADK u otros equivalentes. Experiencia en AWS y/o GCP, incluyendo despliegue y operación de servicios, gestión de identidades, secretos, permisos, almacenamiento, cómputo, contenedores y monitorización. Experiencia integrando y desplegando servicios con herramientas como FastAPI, Docker y pipelines de CI/CD. Capacidad para evaluar la fiabilidad de una solución LLM mediante trazas, métricas, conjuntos de evaluación y revisión humana. Autonomía para proponer y defender soluciones técnicas, con criterio para equilibrar impacto, complejidad, coste y riesgo. Será un plus si además… Has trabajado en sectores regulados, como seguros, banca o salud. Conoces procesos aseguradores: suscripción, siniestros, fraude, recobros, productos, atención a clientes o cumplimiento. Tienes experiencia con bases de datos relacionales, NoSQL y vectoriales. Conoces prácticas de MLOps, gobierno del dato, seguridad aplicada a IA o cumplimiento normativo. Has facilitado sesiones de descubrimiento con negocio o acompañado técnicamente a otras personas del equipo. Has trabajado con servicios gestionados de IA y machine learning en cloud. Conoces protocolos de interoperabilidad para agentes como MCP (Model Context Protocol) o A2A (Agent-to-Agent) . Lo que encontrarás Un reto técnico completo: diseñarás soluciones de IA generativa con exigencia de producto, integración, seguridad y operación; no solo pruebas aisladas. Proyectos vinculados a procesos reales del sector asegurador, donde la precisión, la trazabilidad y la confianza son determinantes. Modalidad de trabajo híbrida en Madrid. Espacio para evolucionar tu especialización en agentes, RAG, evaluación de LLMs y arquitectura cloud, colaborando con perfiles multidisciplinares. Un entorno de aprendizaje continuo, movilidad interna y desarrollo profesional, dentro de equipos que combinan ambición tecnológica y cercanía. Si te motiva resolver los problemas que aparecen después del prototipo —calidad, contexto, integración, seguridad y escalabilidad—, queremos conocerte. En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad. …

items.desc: Do you want to connect our systems and put AI to work where it creates real value for the business? At Nine United, our brands run on a landscape of strong platforms: D365 Finance & Operations, PIM, DAM, B2B and commerce, CRM, Power BI and a growing number of partner solutions. Their full value only comes when they are connected well. Like a good piece of furniture, the quality lies in the joints. We also believe AI can change how we work, from handling orders and invoices to enriching product data and supporting our colleagues in their daily tasks. As part of our IT strategy, we are strengthening both our integration and AI capabilities. We are looking for a consultant who can build the connections that hold our platforms together and help us turn AI from potential into practice. YOUR ROLE - CONNECTING PLATFORMS AND PUTTING AI TO WORK You will be our go-to person for integrations and a driving force in our AI initiatives across Nine United and our brands. You will work closely with your colleagues in IT, who are responsible for ERP, master data, PIM/DAM, commerce and Power BI, as well as with the business and external partners. You will see the whole picture: how data flows between systems, where processes can be automated, and where AI can make a real difference. You will: Design, develop and maintain integrations between D365 F&O and our surrounding platforms, such as PIM/DAM, B2B/commerce, CRM, logistics partners and other suppliers. Help define and develop our integration architecture and standards, so new integrations are built consistently and can scale. Identify, prioritize and implement AI use cases together with the business. Examples include document processing, product data enrichment, AI agents and assistants, and intelligent automation of manual workflows. Build AI-powered solutions on top of our data and integrations, and take them from proof of concept to stable operation. Contribute to our AI platform choices, governance and responsible use of AI, including data security and compliance. Drive adoption by training, inspiring and supporting colleagues across the organization, so AI is actually used in daily work. Monitor, troubleshoot and improve existing integrations and solutions, with a focus on stability and transparency. Document integrations, data flows and AI solutions, so knowledge is shared and not tied to a single person. WE IMAGINE THAT YOU Must have: Have several years of experience with system integrations in an ERP-heavy environment, ideally with D365 F&O (data entities, OData, DMF, business events). Have hands-on experience with integration and API technologies, e.g. Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure Functions or similar. Have practical experience with AI and automation, and have built solutions with tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI services or large language models through APIs. Have a solid understanding of data structures and data quality, and know that both integrations and AI are only as good as the data behind them. Are curious and pragmatic. You can separate hype from value and explain AI in plain language to non-technical colleagues. Are good at coordinating with internal teams and external suppliers, without losing track of the overview or the progress. Nice to have: Experience with Power Automate and the wider Power Platform. Experience with AI agents, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Knowledge of PIM, DAM, e-commerce platforms and EDI Experience with integration monitoring and DevOps. WHAT WE OFFER We support our employees in creating a healthy work-life balance and offer, among other things, an employee healthcare programme and a delicious and healthy lunch scheme. The tone is informal and reflects the fact that we are an organisation made up of people from diverse backgrounds, where there is a close and approachable relationship between employees and management. We offer an exciting workplace with challenging and varied tasks, as well as plenty of opportunities to shape your own working day. WHY JOIN NINE UNITED? You will be part of a global organization with strong brands and ambitious growth plans, where IT plays a key role in how we work and grow. You will get real influence on how our platforms are built and used, and you will work closely with colleagues responsible for Master Data, ERP, Finance, B2B, PIM, DAM, Commerce and Power BI. We have high ambitions, a short way from idea to action, and room for both professionalism and humor. You will report to Karsten Ø. Kristensen, CIO. WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU If you have any questions about the position, please contact Karsten on +45 42 82 01 55 or at karsten.kristensen@nineunited.com. Please upload your short application in Danish or English and CV as soon as possible. We evaluate applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. items.desc: Turn business questions and data into practical AI solutions. As a Junior AI Engineer, you will combine data analysis, machine learning and modern AI engineering to generate reliable business insights and build scalable applications. You will work with business and domain experts to understand their needs, explore and validate data, communicate clear recommendations, and help translate promising ideas into production-ready solutions. The role has three complementary pillars: Data Analysis & Business Insights, Machine Learning & Generative AI, and Software & Cloud Engineering. You will receive guidance while progressively taking ownership of analytical, development, testing, deployment and documentation activities. Data Analysis & Business Insights Use SQL and Python to explore, combine, clean, filter and validate data and answer business questions in a reliable, repeatable way. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, correlations, anomalies and data-quality issues. Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, hypotheses and measurable outcomes. Apply statistical methods and effective visualizations to validate findings and communicate them clearly. Independently investigate unfamiliar datasets, ask the right questions and select an appropriate analytical or machine-learning approach. Explain evidence, model drivers, reliability, assumptions, limitations and potential bias to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Produce concise analytical notes that document conclusions, limitations and actionable recommendations. Work closely with domain experts to gather context, respectfully challenge assumptions, validate conclusions and document decisions. Machine Learning & Generative AI Build, test and explain practical machine-learning solutions, including regression, classification, clustering and similarity analysis. Use anomaly-detection and forecasting techniques to identify unusual patterns and estimate future outcomes. Contribute to Generative AI and LLM-based applications, including prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions and basic agentic workflows. Assess the quality and suitability of AI outputs using appropriate evaluation methods and business criteria. Prototype and validate AI solutions with business stakeholders before further industrialization. Software & Cloud Engineering Develop maintainable Python components and contribute to reliable AI applications. Contribute to deploying, monitoring and maintaining AI solutions in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure. Apply software-engineering, DevOps and MLOps practices, including Git, testing, CI/CD and reproducible experimentation. Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers and business experts throughout the solution lifecycle. Create clear technical documentation and contribute to team knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Your Profile Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience. Internships, academic projects and personal AI or data projects are valued. Good foundation in Python and common data-analysis or machine-learning libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn. Working knowledge of SQL and experience analysing structured datasets. Understanding of statistics, data validation, machine learning and effective data visualization. Strong interest in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and modern AI architectures. Ability to connect analytical findings to business questions and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch is a strong asset. Technologies you may work with Python, SQL, pandas, scikit-learn and data-visualization libraries. LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI. Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Search, vector databases, graph databases and knowledge graphs. Databricks, including catalogue structures and AI/ML capabilities. Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines and MLflow. What will help you succeed Business curiosity: you seek to understand the underlying business question before selecting a technical approach. Critical thinking: you check assumptions, explore alternative explanations and validate conclusions against evidence. Problem solving: you can structure ambiguous problems and learn unfamiliar technologies or datasets quickly. Collaboration: you work constructively with engineering, data and business colleagues. Communication: you document your work clearly and adapt explanations to the audience. Quality and ownership: you test your work, pay attention to detail, ask for support when needed and follow through on commitments. You do not need to master every technology listed above. items.desc: About The Opportunity Job Type: Permanent Application Deadline: 20 November 2026 Job Description Title AI Engineer Department Asset Management Platforms Location Dublin Reports To Head of Research, AMP Level 6 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger. Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more. As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond. About Your Team Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes. About Your Role The AI Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining and delivering AI-enabled software engineering capabilities across Asset Management Platforms (AMP). The role combines enterprise AI strategy, software engineering leadership, and practical adoption of AI-assisted development to improve productivity, quality, and speed of delivery while maintaining Fidelity's standards for architecture, security, governance, and software quality. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards. Key Responsibilities AI Strategy & Platform Leadership Define the technical vision, architecture, and operating model for AI-enabled engineering across AMP. Establish enterprise standards, reference architectures, and governance frameworks for AI, Generative AI, AI agents, and AI-assisted software development. Lead decisions relating to model strategy, orchestration, retrieval architecture, and multi-model AI adoption. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business and engineering value. AI Engineering Enablement Drive adoption of AI-assisted software engineering practices across development teams. Develop reusable patterns, workflows, prompts, and accelerators. Coach engineers in the effective use of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and other AI development assistants. Establish standards for AI-generated code, quality assurance, security, and responsible AI usage. Software Engineering & Architecture Design and deliver modern, scalable software solutions supporting Fidelity's investment platforms. Champion engineering best practices across architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, and automation. Support technical design decisions and guide teams through complex engineering challenges. Contribute to engineering strategy, roadmaps, and architecture governance. Stakeholder Leadership Partner with Engineering Leads, Architects, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvement. Build communities of practice and promote knowledge sharing across engineering teams. Communicate AI strategy and engineering outcomes to technical and business audiences. About You We're looking for an experienced software engineer who has designed and delivered production Generative AI/LLM solutions. Essential Experience Experience in software engineering, architecture, or technical leadership roles. Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale software solutions and leading engineering transformation initiatives. Strong experience with Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevSecOps, engineering governance, and secure software development. Hands-on experience with AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar platforms. Strong understanding of RAG, retrieval, embeddings/vector search, agents and agentic workflows, MCP/tool integration, prompt/context engineering, model orchestration and AI evaluation. Strong software engineering background across modern programming languages, cloud platforms, APIs, containers, automation, and observability. Ability to balance innovation with risk management, governance, and regulatory requirements. Experience within Asset Management, Investment Management, or Financial …

items.desc: Etudiants/ Jeunes diplômés Ingénierie logicielle Stage ID 594812-fr_FR Chez Sogeti, la technologie coule dans nos veines . C’est cet intérêt pour la technologie qui nous guide au quotidien et qui est reflété dans notre slogan « Made In Tech ». Grâce à notre passion commune pour la technologie , à notre culture entrepreneuriale et à l'importance que nous accordons à la formation continue, nous mettrons tout en oeuvre pour vous accompagner à libérer votre plein potentiel VOS MISSIONS Durant votre stage, vous explorerez les opportunités offertes par l’IA générative afin de créer des applications, assistants et agents intelligents capables d’automatiser des tâches, faciliter la prise de décision et améliorer l’expérience utilisateur. Vous participerez à toutes les étapes, de l’expérimentation à la mise en production de prototypes innovants Au sein de nos équipes, vous contribuerez notamment aux activités suivantes : Développement de solutions IA : conception, développement et intégration de fonctionnalités s’appuyant sur des modèles d’intelligence artificielle et des LLM ; IA générative & LLM : expérimentation autour des modèles de langage, conception de prompts, mise en place de solutions de type RAG et développement d’agents IA ; Développement & intégration : création de services, API et interfaces permettant d’intégrer les briques IA au sein d’applications ; Prototypage & POC : réalisation de preuves de concept afin de tester rapidement de nouveaux usages et technologies IA ; Optimisation & qualité : évaluation des résultats, amélioration des performances et participation aux phases de tests et de validation ; Innovation et amélioration continue : participation à l'évaluation de nouvelles technologies, méthodes et outils afin d'optimiser les processus, enrichir nos offres et accompagner la transformation numérique de nos clients Innovation : participation, selon les sujets, aux expérimentations et projets menés au sein du SogetiLab. VOTRE PROFIL Vous préparez un Bac+5 / Master 2 en informatique , idéalement avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, data ou développement logiciel ; Vous avez de bonnes bases en développement , notamment en Python , et appréciez transformer une idée en solution concrète ; Vous aimez explorer de nouvelles technologies, analyser des problématiques complexes et concevoir des solutions pragmatiques apportant une réelle valeur aux utilisateurs Vous avez idéalement déjà expérimenté certains outils ou frameworks liés à l’IA, par exemple LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face ou des API de modèles de langage ; Des connaissances en API, Git, bases de données ou environnements cloud seront appréciées ; Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome et orienté(e) solution : vous aimez expérimenter, tester, apprendre et résoudre des problématiques techniques ; Vous appréciez également le travail en équipe et êtes capable de partager simplement vos choix et vos résultats. QUELQUES RAISONS DE NOUS REJOINDRE Qualité de vie au travail : profitez d’un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, d’une possibilité de télétravailler, ainsi que des dispositifs de santé et bien-être (ligne d'écoute, plateforme dédiée...). Environnement inclusif : rejoignez des réseaux engagés comme Women@Capgemini, Parents@Capgemini, OUTfront ou CapAbility, et évoluez dans un cadre certifié EDGE+ et reconnu par le Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. Happy Trainees : notre engagement envers les jeunes talents est reconnu dans le classement HappyTrainees, preuve que chez nous, les stagiaires et alternants ne viennent pas juste apprendre… ils viennent s’épanouir. Sogeti fait partie du groupe Capgemini et accompagne les organisations dans leur mise en oeuvre de l'innovation , en tant que partenaire local à l'échelle mondiale . En combinant son agilité et sa rapidité Sogeti propose des solutions innovantes en testing, cloud et développement d'applications , toutes pilotées par l'IA , les données et l'automatisation . Plus d’informations sur www.sogeti.com/fr

items.desc: Role Description We are building the next generation of AI-native engineering talent engineers who use AI as a core part of how they work, not as an add-on. As an AI Engineer (Software), you will design, build, and ship production-grade software across the full stack, using AI-assisted tooling as standard daily practice alongside your core engineering skills. You will work on real client programs across industries, building production-grade software that connects to and supports agentic AI systems — understanding how your full-stack work integrates with agent architecture, LLM APIs, and enterprise AI pipelines. This is not a stepping-stone role: it is a core engineering function in the most in-demand part of the market, with a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer program for those who develop agentic depth. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity — combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams, structured AI certification pathways, and a clear development track toward agentic and forward-deployed engineering. Key Responsibilities Use AI coding assistants daily as a standard part of delivery, actively, frequently, and with demonstrable impact on productivity and output quality Integrate LLM APIs into applications in production: calling AI provider APIs in live code, managing token limits and latency, and building initial abstraction layers Apply AI across the full software delivery lifecycle: AI-generated tests, AI-assisted debugging, AI-accelerated code review, and prompt engineering for development tasks Own the quality of AI-generated outputs in your delivery scope, exercise engineering judgment about reliability, limitations, and failure modes; know when AI output is production-ready and when it is not Define and track KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of AI-assisted workflows; present AI productivity and quality metrics to project stakeholders Own delivery end-to-end — from design through to production support — in Agile sprint cycles alongside client engineering teams Contribute to shared knowledge bases, reusable components, and internal AI tooling standards that benefit the wider team Build and integrate the application layers, APIs, and interfaces that connect full-stack systems to agentic backends — understanding data flows, context handoffs, and integration points between your code and AI pipelines Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field Commercial software engineering experience in production environments (or equivalent demonstrated through academic projects, internships, or shipped personal projects) Proficiency in at least one primary backend language: Python, Java, or TypeScript Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools actively in day-to-day engineering work — with practical examples of how AI was used to solve real problems, iterate on outputs, and improve delivery; including direct experience calling LLM APIs in production code with an understanding of token management, latency, and cost tradeoffs Basic understanding of web technologies including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS Familiarity with cloud fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD pipelines Understanding of Agile delivery fundamentals Experience with databases — SQL or NoSQL Ability to validate, evaluate, and improve AI-generated outputs; understanding of AI limitations and responsible use Familiarity with agentic system concepts — awareness of orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent), RAG pipelines, and how full-stack applications connect to agent-based architecture; production experience preferred, conceptual understanding required

items.desc: Role Description We are building the next generation of AI-native engineering talent engineers who use AI as a core part of how they work, not as an add-on. As an AI Engineer (Software), you will design, build, and ship production-grade software across the full stack, using AI-assisted tooling as standard daily practice alongside your core engineering skills. You will work on real client programs across industries, building production-grade software that connects to and supports agentic AI systems — understanding how your full-stack work integrates with agent architecture, LLM APIs, and enterprise AI pipelines. This is not a stepping-stone role: it is a core engineering function in the most in-demand part of the market, with a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer program for those who develop agentic depth. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity — combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams, structured AI certification pathways, and a clear development track toward agentic and forward-deployed engineering. Key Responsibilities Use AI coding assistants daily as a standard part of delivery, actively, frequently, and with demonstrable impact on productivity and output quality Integrate LLM APIs into applications in production: calling AI provider APIs in live code, managing token limits and latency, and building initial abstraction layers Apply AI across the full software delivery lifecycle: AI-generated tests, AI-assisted debugging, AI-accelerated code review, and prompt engineering for development tasks Own the quality of AI-generated outputs in your delivery scope, exercise engineering judgment about reliability, limitations, and failure modes; know when AI output is production-ready and when it is not Define and track KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of AI-assisted workflows; present AI productivity and quality metrics to project stakeholders Own delivery end-to-end — from design through to production support — in Agile sprint cycles alongside client engineering teams Contribute to shared knowledge bases, reusable components, and internal AI tooling standards that benefit the wider team Build and integrate the application layers, APIs, and interfaces that connect full-stack systems to agentic backends — understanding data flows, context handoffs, and integration points between your code and AI pipelines Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field Commercial software engineering experience in production environments (or equivalent demonstrated through academic projects, internships, or shipped personal projects) Proficiency in at least one primary backend language: Python, Java, or TypeScript Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools actively in day-to-day engineering work — with practical examples of how AI was used to solve real problems, iterate on outputs, and improve delivery; including direct experience calling LLM APIs in production code with an understanding of token management, latency, and cost tradeoffs Basic understanding of web technologies including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS Familiarity with cloud fundamentals (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD pipelines Understanding of Agile delivery fundamentals Experience with databases — SQL or NoSQL Ability to validate, evaluate, and improve AI-generated outputs; understanding of AI limitations and responsible use Familiarity with agentic system concepts — awareness of orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent), RAG pipelines, and how full-stack applications connect to agent-based architecture; production experience preferred, conceptual understanding required

Développez des compétences d’avenir, évoluez dans le conseil, la technologie et l’IA, aux côtés de nos experts, et agissez sur des projets concrets pour avoir un impact durable sur le monde qui nous entoure. Vos missions en tant qu’Ingénieur Digital Foundations en stage : Contribuer à la conception et à la modernisation d’architectures cloud, applicatives et AI-native, sur des environnements Azure, AWS ou GCP. Explorer et prototyper des solutions autour de l’Agentic AI et du Software Engineering : agents IA, Agentic SDLC, MCP, RAG, multi-agent systems, AI-assisted testing et CI/CD.
