Concevoir et industrialiser des solutions permettant d’exécuter, superviser et gouverner des agents IA à l’échelle, notamment via AgentOps, observabilité LLM, guardrails et evaluation frameworks. Collaborer avec les architectes, développeurs, cloud engineers et spécialistes IA pour analyser les systèmes d’information et définir des trajectoires de transformation technologique. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Développez votre première expertise du conseil et des métiers. Apprenez aux côtés de nos communautés d’experts en France et à l’international. Explorez l’IA en situation réelle et bénéficiez de formations dédiées. Evoluez dans un cadre de travail hybride et évolutif avec la possibilité de télétravailler selon votre projet et ajusté avec votre manager. Profitez des évènements internes : afterworks, coaching, engagement solidaire via la Fondation Accenture, vie associative et sportive. Votre profil: Vous êtes étudiant(e) en cursus Bac+5 d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'une université, idéalement avec une spécialisation en informatique, génie logiciel, cloud, systèmes distribués ou IA, et recherchez un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois ou une alternance. Vous aimez coder et comprendre comment fonctionnent les choses, mais vous souhaitez également prendre du recul sur l'architecture d'un système et les choix techniques qui le structurent. Vous avez de bonnes bases dans au moins un langage de programmation, idéalement Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go ou C#. Git, APIs, conteneurs, CI/CD ou un premier cloud comme Azure, AWS ou GCP ne vous sont pas totalement étrangers. Vous expérimentez avec les LLM et l'IA générative et avez envie d'aller plus loin que le simple prompting pour comprendre agents, outils, contexte, RAG, MCP, orchestration et évaluation. Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se), aimez apprendre et n'avez pas peur de tester une technologie que vous ne connaissez pas encore. Vous aimez autant construire un prototype que comprendre pourquoi il fonctionne, où il échoue et comment le rendre utilisable à l'échelle. Français et anglais courants. Vous n'avez évidemment pas besoin de maîtriser toutes ces technologies pour nous rejoindre. Nous cherchons avant tout des ingénieurs curieux, qui aiment construire, expérimenter et apprendre vite. Découvrez notre processus de recrutement Accenture, c'est une communauté de plus de 750 000 talents et une mission commune : réaliser la promesse technologique alliée à l’ingéniosité humaine. Dans un monde en perpétuel changement, nous accélérons la transformation des plus grandes entreprises, de la stratégie à la réalisation des projets, grâce à la technologie, la data et l’IA et nous créons de la valeur pour nos clients et pour nos collaborateurs grâce à notre expertise multi-sectorielle. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, ou de genre et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

items.desc: Vous intégrerez l’équipe QA de BIOVIA et collaborerez avec des profils variés : ingénieurs qualité, développeurs, architectes, Product Managers, équipes Industry et équipes techniques avant-vente. Ces interlocuteurs, situés en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Inde, vous aideront à identifier les cas d’usage, à confronter vos idées aux besoins réels et à évaluer le prototype sur des scénarios concrets. Vos missions Comment permettre à une intelligence artificielle de comprendre une demande scientifique, de construire un plan fiable, d’utiliser plusieurs applications et de vérifier ses actions avant de les exécuter ? Au sein de l’équipe Quality Assurance de BIOVIA , vous contribuerez à faire évoluer un prototype interne fondé sur l’ IA générative , les Large Language Models (LLM) et les agents IA . Ce prototype permet déjà de transformer des instructions en langage naturel en actions exécutées dans plusieurs applications scientifiques. Il aide nos équipes à créer plus rapidement des données complexes utilisées pour les tests logiciels et les démonstrations. Votre objectif sera de le rendre plus interactif, plus robuste et capable de traiter de nouveaux scénarios. Vous ne partirez pas d’une page blanche : le prototype, son architecture, ses outils et ses scénarios de test existent déjà. Le sujet sera néanmoins co-construit avec vous , en fonction de vos expérimentations, de vos propositions et des retours des utilisateurs. Ce stage s’adresse à une personne curieuse, qui apprécie les sujets ouverts, l’expérimentation et la recherche de solutions pragmatiques. Toutes les réponses ne sont pas définies à l’avance : vos analyses et vos choix techniques contribueront directement à l’évolution du projet. Vos Qualifications Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau BAC+5 en informatique, intelligence artificielle, Data Science, génie logiciel ou dans un domaine équivalent. Vous disposez : D’une bonne maîtrise de Python ; De bonnes bases en développement logiciel ; D’un intérêt marqué pour l’IA générative, les LLM et les agents IA ; D’une capacité à analyser et décomposer des problèmes complexes ; D’autonomie, de rigueur et de curiosité ; D’un très bon niveau d’anglais pour collaborer dans un environnement international. Une première expérience, académique ou personnelle, autour des LLM ou de l’IA générative sera appréciée, sans être obligatoire. Des connaissances en LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, RAG, APIs REST, Docker, SQL ou tests automatisés constitueront un plus. Il n’est pas attendu que vous maîtrisiez déjà l’ensemble de ces technologies. Aucune connaissance préalable de la chimie, de la pharmacie ou des applications BIOVIA n’est requise. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement collaboratif et innovant Collaboration internationale Diversité des technologies, produits et solutions Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
GenAI Application Dev Team Leader 
 __
 Are you interested in developing applications that leverage generative AI and large language models (LLMs)? We are expanding our team specializing in this type of application within our company — and you can become part of it. If you’re excited about the current GenAI trend, actively follow it, and have experience with at least some of the technologies or approaches listed below, we’d love to talk to you. 
 We offer a flexible hybrid setup, with home office as a natural part of our working style. We value mee-ting in person 2–3 days a week at our Ostrava offices. 
 Job Responsibilities 
 Design and development of advanced AI solutions — building applications based on LLMs and generative AI, contributing to system architecture using concepts such as RAG or LLMOps. 
 Development of robust backend solutions in Python — using technologies and libraries for API development, data transformations, interactive tools, testing, and ensuring code security and performance. 
 DevOps and cloud integration — containerization, deployment to Azure, CI/CD pipeline setup, version control, API gateway integration, including MCP-based integrations, and deployment and lifecycle management of AI models and agents using Azure AI Foundry. 
 Data and API design — working with relational and NoSQL databases, integrating with REST ser-vices with a focus on security, performance, and scalability. 
 Who We’re Looking For 
 University or high school education in IT, software engineering, or a related technical field; inte-rest in generative AI (GenAI), LLMs, and related technologies. 
 Good knowledge of Python and commonly used libraries (FastAPI, NiceGUI, uv, alembic, polars, lxml, pydantic and Azure SDK). 
 Experience in software application development — participation in design, implementation, testing, and deployment; basic understanding of design patterns and application lifecycle. 
 Practical experience with containers (e.g., Docker) and cloud environments (Azure experience is an advantage); basic knowledge of version control and project management. 
 Basic knowledge of databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB), ability to work with queries; familiarity with API design and documentation (REST); awareness of application security principles. 
 Basic experience with AI frameworks and libraries (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph or similar agentic frameworks); willingness to learn GenAI processes (RAG, prompt engineering, DevOps). 
 Basic familiarity with frontend development and a willingness to contribute to user-facing features; experience with NiceGUI is an advantage. 
 Working proficiency in English (reading documentation, team communication); eagerness to learn, proactive approach, and ability to work in a team. 
 We understand that you may not meet all the requirements listed above. If your experience covers at least three of the areas above, we would be glad to hear from you. 
 What kind of applications will we build? 
 From chatbots — which are everywhere today — to summarization and extraction tools, all the way to assistants that automate tasks previously impossible to automate. All of this primarily in the field of industrial automation, where our company has long been active. 
 Benefits: 
 Flexible working hours 
 Option to work from home (Home Office) with a financial contribution 
 Annual financial bonus 
 25 days of vacation 
 Annual salary review 
 Opportunity for further career growth in the Czech Republic and worldwide 
 MultiSport card 
 Meal allowance 
 Contribution to the benefits portal (2-3% of monthly salary) 
 Referral bonus for recommending a new employee 
 Opportunity for education – internal/external professional courses, language courses, and conferences 
 Company events (Christmas party, team buildings, family days, and more) 
 Assistance line – professional psychological counseling 
 Additional leave for extraordinary life events and support for expectant parents 
 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
 Ready to make an impact? 
 Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

items.desc: Le contexte Depuis 2025, nous avons fait de l'IA un axe stratégique, sur deux volets complémentaires : l'adoption de l'IA par les métiers (cadrage des cas d'usage, déploiement, conduite du changement) et le développement accéléré par l'IA (agents de code, spécifications exécutables, plateformes d'agents). Nous pratiquons nous-mêmes ces méthodes au quotidien, et nous les apportons chez nos clients, d'abord en assistance technique, puis en projets que nous pilotons de bout en bout. Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous constituons notre équipe IA : des profils fonctionnels et techniques qui travailleront ensemble sur les missions de nos clients. Beaucoup d'organisations ont identifié des cas d'usage d'IA générative sans parvenir à les relier à des gains mesurables sur leur fonctionnement. Elles cherchent des profils capables de partir du terrain : comprendre comment le travail se fait réellement, chiffrer ce qui coûte du temps, puis concevoir et déployer la bonne réponse, qu'il s'agisse d'une simple automatisation ou d'un assistant IA. En tant que consultant IA et transformation des processus, vous intervenez en assistance technique chez nos clients de la Côte d'Azur (Nice, Sophia Antipolis, Monaco), dans des secteurs variés : industrie, éditeurs de logiciels, services, secteurs à fortes exigences de conformité. Vous travaillez avec les équipes métier, la DSI et les fonctions juridiques et sécurité, et vous rendez compte de vos résultats avec des chiffres. Exemples de missions Chez un industriel, revoir le traitement des commandes : observation sur le terrain, mesure des délais et des reprises, automatisation des saisies répétitives, assistant de recherche dans la documentation technique, suivi des gains sur trois mois Chez un éditeur de logiciels, outiller le support client : tri automatique des demandes, suggestions de réponse appuyées sur la base de connaissances, mesure du temps de résolution avant et après Dans une organisation soumise à de fortes exigences de conformité, cadrer les premiers usages de l'IA générative avec les équipes juridiques et sécurité, puis documenter chaque solution au regard de l'AI Act et du RGPD Vos missions ? Observer et décrire les processus, mesurer la situation de départ et repérer les tâches à faible valeur Choisir la bonne réponse pour chaque irritant : simplification, automatisation ou IA générative Concevoir et livrer les solutions : automatisations, assistants sur base documentaire (RAG), premiers agents branchés sur les outils existants Tester les solutions sur des cas réels et suivre leur qualité dans le temps Accompagner les utilisateurs : prise en main, documentation, recueil des retours Présenter les gains obtenus et proposer les étapes suivantes Et vous ? Vous êtes aussi à l'aise en atelier avec les métiers qu'en échange avec les équipes techniques. Une culture Lean ou la pratique d'un outil d'automatisation sont de vrais plus. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié. Stack : Outils d'automatisation (n8n, Make, Power Automate, UiPath ou équivalent), assistants et modèles du marché (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral), RAG, intégrations par API, modélisation BPMN, AI Act et RGPD. Elle conçoit des solutions logicielles durables, adaptées aux enjeux métier de ses clients et parfaitement intégrées à leurs systèmes d'information. Sa vocation : faire du numérique un levier concret et efficace au service de la performance des entreprises. items.desc: Help shape SEB’s mobile channel and create seamless digital experiences for private, corporate and youth customers. You will combine advanced iOS engineering with close collaboration across business, product management and design, while helping transform our product development model through Agentic Engineering. SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? The business and our way of working: SEB’s mobile apps bring together services from retail and business banking and support overview, self-service, communication and digital sales in an omni-channel customer journey. Our goal is to improve customer and business value through low-friction mobile experiences, strengthen SEB’s digital position and deliver visible improvements that customers can understand and use. You will work in a cross-functional setup where developers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, UX/design, QA, backend teams and architects jointly turn business priorities and customer insights into secure, accessible and reusable mobile capabilities. The mobile teams own the channel foundations and last-mile product integration, while priorities and outcomes are shaped together with the business and product management. About the role: As a senior iOS Developer, you will develop and evolve customer-facing functionality across SEB’s mobile apps and channel foundations. You will translate business goals, customer needs and product requirements into robust technical solutions in close collaboration with business stakeholders, Product Owners, UX/design, QA, backend engineers and architects. You will contribute from discovery and refinement through implementation, release, monitoring and continuous improvement, while balancing delivery with security, accessibility, resilience, lifecycle management and long-term architecture. A key part of the role is helping move Mobile Apps from individual AI-assisted development toward Agentic Engineering as a governed development model. This means contributing to reusable agent workflows, test-first automation, clear guardrails, traceability and human verification, so that we can shorten lead times and improve quality without compromising control. Required experience and qualifications: At least five years of professional iOS development experience, in a senior or similarly independent role, with hands-on responsibility for architecture, implementation, quality, release and operation of customer-facing applications, including substantial hands-on work with Swift and SwiftUI in production applications. Proven experience delivering customer-facing mobile products in a cross-functional team and translating business goals, customer needs and product requirements into technical solutions together with Product Owners, business stakeholders, UX/design, QA and backend engineers. Strong practical knowledge of Apple frameworks, concurrency, memory management and the iOS app lifecycle, together with experience applying mobile architecture patterns such as MVVM or Clean Architecture, modularisation, dependency management and API integration. Hands-on experience building and maintaining unit and UI tests, test automation, CI/CD and release pipelines, Git-based workflows, secure development practices, accessibility and production observability. Professional experience with Xcode, Swift Package Manager, GitHub or an equivalent source-control platform, CI/CD tooling, code-quality and security tooling, app analytics and monitoring, and App Store delivery. Ability to communicate clearly in English and work effectively across business, product, design and engineering disciplines. AI-assisted development or Agentic Engineering, including reusable workflows, automated testing or code review, evaluation, guardrails and human verification. Experience that is advantageous, but not required: Backend for Frontend (BFF), Server-Driven UI (SDUI) or reusable mobile design systems. items.desc: Release, Environments, and Change Engineer (C2) Location: London or Bristol (hybrid, three days a week in the office) Level: C2 Team: Quality Engineering Contract: Permanent Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. About Kaluza Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What you'll do The Release, Environments and Change Engineer (REC Engineer) has three key areas of responsibility. You will operate Release, Environments and Change processes and procedures, and you’ll be involved in, and often lead, the identification and implementation of process improvements using AI and other tools. You will work closely with the REC Manager and Environments Manager and operate the processes they define. These processes may rely on manual activities and controls at first, so you’ll take a leading role in replacing them with appropriate automation, and then identify mechanisms and methods to govern those automated controls. You will collaborate with Enablement teams and engineering teams across Kaluza to make sure processes are understood, embedded and followed. You’ll be a decision maker with the authority to decline or postpone releases and changes, and you’ll handle client communication where approval is required for a change or release. Operating promotion gates, making promote or block decisions between environments in line with contractual and ways-of-working agreements, and escalating high-risk calls. Facilitating change approvals, release Go/No-Go meetings and release trains, preparing releases against readiness criteria and tracking per-team readiness and environment-deployed status. Using AI-assisted checks to confirm quality gates are met, summarise what changed in a release, score change risk and flag incomplete or stale records, applying your own judgment to improve the reliability of the results. Maintaining complete, accurate change and configuration records, keeping every change traceable across the full environment stack, and managing the change and release calendar. Building and maintaining release automation, including readiness checks, artefact promotion, AI-drafted release notes and notifications, and reporting feeds. Working with engineering teams in real time to roll back failed releases or apply fixes, and coordinating with incident and problem management so planned changes, hotfixes and major incidents stay in sync. Communicating changes and releases internally and externally, supporting environment coordination and validation, running post-implementation reviews and retros, and giving operational input into gate definitions and the wider process. What you’ll bring Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple moving parts and spot incomplete records or inconsistencies. Clear communication and strong facilitation skills, comfortable coordinating across teams, leading check-ins, keeping everyone aligned, driving decisions and chasing things through to completion. The confidence to say no and hold the line when something isn’t ready, and to escalate when you’re unsure. Comfort with Jira (or similar), including configuring boards, workflows and tickets. Scripting and automation skills to build and maintain the automation around a release process (readiness checks, artefact promotion, release notes and reporting), plus familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows. Day-to-day use of AI tooling with a critical eye, catching what it gets wrong rather than waving it through. Experience building or integrating AI agents (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen, custom frameworks, MCP-based tooling), with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques such as faithfulness, relevance and LLM-as-a-judge, since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to testing AI agents. What will set you apart Any exposure to how software gets released or how environments work, even informally. Light scripting or automation experience, or the appetite to learn it. items.desc: Your role Every internal team at Cloover, Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, Finance, has work that AI agents can do faster and better. You'll build the systems that make that real: agentic pipelines, MCP servers, and internal tools that change how we operate day-to-day, not in some future roadmap. Success in this role means colleagues stop doing the work you've automated, and start doing the work only they can do. You'll report to Florent (Head of Operations & Energy) and work within a team of amazing people alongside. Your mission Design, build, and ship end-to-end agentic systems, RAG pipelines, embeddings, retrieval, prompt engineering, and evaluation, that automate Cloover's highest-volume internal workflows. Build and deploy custom MCP servers and integrations connecting HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Aircall, and other tools, so data flows where it needs to without manual work in between. Write production-grade Python and TypeScript with sound schema design, security, and authorization, code that ships and runs, not prototypes that sit. Own internal tooling end-to-end: spot the gap, build the tool, and deploy it on Firebase, Vercel, or GCP with proper version control and CI/CD. Build custom Claude Code skills, plugins, and connectors, then onboard colleagues into AI-native workflows that they actually keep using. Partner with Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, and Finance to identify the highest-leverage automation use cases, then personally implement them. Your profile We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role: You've shipped agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or AI-powered tools, in school, side projects, hackathons, or work, not just experimented with prompts in a chat window. You write production-grade Python and/or TypeScript and can defend the trade-offs in your code. You're comfortable wiring REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication across third-party tools (HubSpot, Slack, Notion, or similar) and can model data sensibly. You identify the gap, scope the solution, and ship it without waiting to be told what to do. Based in Berlin and energized by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first, decisions get made in real time, prototypes get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten meters away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here. Nice to have (but not required): Hands-on experience with MCP, Claude Code, or agentic frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or Google ADK. German language proficiency (B1 or above), useful for collaborating with the Ops & Energy team. Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and perspective, credentials are a starting point, not a ceiling. How We Hire We keep things transparent and respect your time. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks. Intro call (30 min) — We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV. Hiring manager interview (30 min) — We go deep: your experience, your thinking, how you approach problems. Case study (1 hour) — You get the brief in advance. We care about your approach, not whether you land on the right answer. Offer & signed contract. Need any adjustments at any stage? Just let us know. Why us? Competitive pay. Fair compensation for your time and contribution, benchmarked to the Berlin internship market. AI-first & unthrottled. Unlimited enterprise-grade AI, no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement. Real ownership on a real mission. From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software, we're powering the energy transition across Europe. Grow faster than anywhere else. You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in. The basics, done well. Prenzlauer Berg office with the latest Apple hardware. Free breakfast and dinner, stocked kitchen, regular team events, 25 days vacation, Urban Sports Club (M), and company discounts Perks & Benefits Latest Apple hardware in our Prenzlauer Berg office 25 days vacation, prorated for part-time Urban Sports Club (M) membership Deutschlandticket, covered Cloover Power Tariff: our own green power tariff, with the monthly base fee on us Free catered lunch every day in the office (via Bella&Bona) Free dinner every day in the office (via Wolt) Fully stocked kitchen with breakfast, snacks, and drinks Team events with €50 per person per month Company discounts via Corporate Benefits and FutureBens About Us At Cloover, we’re building the AI operating system for the energy transition: a platform that helps thousands of installation companies across Germany and Austria sell more, plan faster, and deliver better. items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Qui sommes nous ? Fondé en France, Talan est aujourd’hui un groupe international qui accompagne ses clients dans leur transformation Data & IA, de bout en bout, en combinant conseil en management et expertise technologique. Avec plus de 6000 collaborateurs sur 5 continents, nous accélérons les transformations de nos clients à travers des partenariats de long terme, en créant un impact mesurable et durable. Notre proposition de valeur repose sur un écosystème d’innovation structuré : 2 500 experts Data & IA, des solutions propriétaires construites sur des modèles avancés et un laboratoire de recherche appliquée, de développement expérimental et d’innovation. Nous traduisons l’innovation technologique en avantage concurrentiel depuis plus de 20 ans dans des secteurs stratégiques : banques et services financiers, énergie, transport et mobilité, luxe et distribution, santé. Porté par sa promesse de Positive Innovation, Talan s’impose comme un acteur de référence pour répondre à la complexité croissante des environnements économiques, technologiques et réglementaires. www.talan.com Et Talan Sud Est ? Talan Sud-Est est présent depuis 2007 à Lyon et compte environ 350 collaborateurs répartis entre Aix-Marseille et Lyon. En plein développement, les équipes s'agrandissent ! Nous continuons de développer aujourd'hui nos activités auprès de grands comptes et d’ETI, principalement dans les secteurs de l’Energie et de l’Environnement, du Transport et de la Logistique, de l’Industrie, de la Distribution, de la Santé et des Services Publiques. L’expertise, la bonne humeur, le collectif et de l’esprit d’entreprendre, constituent notre ADN. Description du poste Dans le cadre du développement de notre offre Transformation Digitale à Lyon, nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Applicatif / Expert(e) Technique .NET capable de jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès de nos équipes et de nos clients. Vous intervenez sur la conception et l’évolution d’applications métier web, avec un objectif : construire des architectures robustes, performantes et maintenables, tout en accompagnant progressivement l’intégration de nouveaux usages autour de l’IA. À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir et challenger les architectures applicatives de nos projets ; Définir et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de développement, d’architecture et de qualité logicielle ; Accompagner les équipes techniques à travers les revues de code, le partage de bonnes pratiques et le mentoring ; Conseiller nos clients dans leurs choix technologiques et vulgariser les enjeux techniques auprès d’interlocuteurs variés ; Participer aux phases d’avant-vente : compréhension du besoin, définition de solutions, cadrage, estimation et soutenance ; Contribuer à la veille technologique et à la définition des standards de notre offre ; Explorer et intégrer, lorsque cela apporte une réelle valeur métier, des solutions d’IA générative au sein d’applications existantes ou de nouveaux produits. Environnement technique Vous évoluerez principalement autour de l’écosystème .NET / C# , notamment : .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core ; Clean Architecture, DDD, API REST, microservices et architectures modulaires ; SQL Server, PostgreSQL ou Oracle, ainsi que des environnements NoSQL tels que Cosmos DB, MongoDB ou Redis ; Azure ou GCP, services cloud, CI/CD et Infrastructure as Code ; Angular ou React côté front ; Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, DevSecOps et observabilité. Selon les projets, vous pourrez également intervenir sur des sujets intégrant Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, RAG, agents IA ou bases vectorielles , avec une approche orientée développement et intégration applicative. Qualifications Profil recherché : Diplômé(e) d'un bac+5 (diplôme d'ingénieur ou master informatique), vous disposez d’une expérience significative en développement logiciel, avec idéalement 8 ans d’expérience , dont plusieurs années en tant que Lead Developer, Tech Lead ou Architecte Applicatif , acquises de préférence dans des environnements ESN ou conseil. Vous disposez d’une solide expérience en développement et architecture applicative, notamment autour de .NET / C# et de l’écosystème Microsoft (Azure, Entra ID, Azure DevOps, Power Platform) . Les certifications Microsoft (AZ-204, AZ-305, AI-102, DP-300…) sont particulièrement appréciées, tout comme votre capacité à conseiller les clients et à accompagner les équipes. Curieux(se) et pragmatique, vous vous intéressez également aux nouveaux usages liés à l’IA et à leur intégration dans les applications métier. Enfin, vous êtes curieux(se) des évolutions autour de l’IA et souhaitez participer à leur intégration concrète dans les applications métier, avec suffisamment de recul pour identifier les cas d’usage réellement pertinents. items.desc: Position Overview The Senior Financial AI Solution Architect designs and delivers full-stack AI solutions that transform financial processes across financial by combining intelligent workflows with custom web and mobile applications, enabling dormakaba to reduce cycle time, enhance operational efficiency, and build sustainable competitive advantage. By owning solutions end-to-end—from process analysis and AI architecture through application development and deployment—the AI Solutions Architect eliminates handoffs, accelerates time-to-market, and establishes internal AI capabilities that scale strategically across the organization. What you will do Process Discovery & Requirements Definition : Conduct detailed audits of financial processes to identify automation opportunities and bottlenecks. Define AI workflow architecture, decision logic, and agent behavior for specific business processes. Gather detailed business requirements, success metrics, and constraints from financial stakeholders. Full-stack solution development : Build AI workflows and agents using low-code/no-code platforms or custom development as appropriate. Develop web and mobile applications that expose AI capabilities to users (sales reps, support teams, field staff). Create intuitive user interfaces that simplify interaction with AI-powered processes Implement backend APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations to enable end-to-end automation. Data Lake Optimization & Semantic Design : Map current data pipelines and identify gaps in data availability for AI consumption Apply data science techniques (ontologies, data modeling, semantic understanding) to structure enterprise data. Design data consumption patterns that ground AI solutions in current, accurate business context. Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance for AI-powered system. Solution Delivery & Optimization : Conduct comprehensive testing (functional, performance, UAT) to validate solutions meet requirements. items.desc: About Silent Eight We’ve been a trusted partner to the world’s largest financial institutions for over a decade, with AI running in production at global banks including HSBC and Standard Chartered. We automate the compliance decisions that stop money laundering and terrorism financing, at scale, in production, on real cases. We’re headquartered in Singapore, and we’re hiring an AI Solutions Consultant based in Poland (anywhere in the country): someone our customers want to talk to about their problems, and who can then design and build the AI solution that actually solves them. We’re keeping a high bar for this hire and are looking for exceptional people who meet the full profile below. The Role This is a senior, hands-on role that combines two things in equal measure. On the business side, you’re the consultant customers open up to. They tell you about their problems because they expect to leave the conversation with a good idea for solving them. You listen, ask the right questions, find the real problem behind the one they came in with, and come back with a creative, practical proposal. On the technology side, you build. You’ve designed and shipped complex AI systems yourself, such as agentic systems, multi-step workflows or LLM-based applications, and you can turn an idea from a customer conversation into something that works. We need both halves. Strong engineers without client experience, or strong consultants who don’t build, won’t be the right fit for this role. What You’ll Do Lead conversations with customers to understand their business problems, and dig deeper when the real problem turns out to be different from the one they started with Translate those problems into concrete, creative AI solution ideas and present them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Design and build AI-based solutions, from agentic systems and multi-step workflows to LLM-based applications Prototype quickly to show customers what’s possible, then iterate based on what you learn Work closely with our leadership, product and engineering teams to turn customer insight into working solutions Keep us ahead of the curve: test new AI tools, models and techniques, and share what works What We’re Looking For Proven experience working directly with clients, for example in consulting, pre-sales, solutions engineering or client advisory Substantial hands-on experience designing and building complex AI systems yourself, such as agentic systems, multi-step workflows or LLM-based applications. A simple app for a simple task isn’t enough The ability to explain specifically what you built and decided yourself, not only what your team delivered, including what didn’t work the first time and what you learned Strong discovery skills: you listen, ask good follow-up questions and get to the root of a problem The ability to make sophisticated AI tangible for non-technical buyers You live and breathe AI. Beyond your day job, you build your own apps and projects, test new tools and models, and keep up with the industry simply because it excites you Fluent English Based in Poland Experience with financial institutions, AML/FinCrime or other regulated environments is a plus What We Offer A B2B contract with a competitive salary: PLN 25,000-35,000 net / month + VAT – to confirm Paid time off to balance work and life in the way that suits you best Fully remote work, forever A quarterly wellness allowance added directly to your invoice Real opportunities for development, including paid Development Days and in-house training A product that already works, with AI in production at Tier 1 banks, so you’re solving real problems for real customers Direct access to our leadership team and short decision paths The chance to be an integral part of an award-winning, fast-growing RegTech company that values a friendly working atmosphere How to Apply Along with your CV, please include: A short description (a few sentences) of the most complex AI system you’ve built: what problem it solved, what it was made of, and what your own part in it was A link to your GitHub, portfolio or a working project, if you have one Process Intro with People Ops — 20–30 min In-depth conversation with our COO, Julia Final conversation with our CEO

items.desc: Deine Aufgaben Als AI Backend Engineer baust du das technische Rückgrat unserer Decision-Intelligence-Plattform. Du entwickelst skalierbare Backend-Services, die unsere Forecasting- und Optimierungsmodelle, agentische Workflows und unseren semantischen Data Layer produktiv nutzbar machen. Du arbeitest AI-first: Claude Code oder vergleichbare CLIs, MCPs und eigene Skills gehören zu deinem Standard-Toolkit. Du denkst nicht nur in Endpoints und Datenbanken, sondern in Kundennutzen, Produktwirkung und Adoption, und willst das System stärken, nicht nur die Aufgabe vor dir lösen. Du denkst in Impact und hast ein starkes Produktverständnis: Du misst, ob deine Features wirklich genutzt werden, beobachtest Nutzungsmuster und schärfst die nächste Iteration gemeinsam mit Product und FDE. Du designst, baust und betreibst skalierbare Backend-Services in Python mit FastAPI und pydantic, die Agent-Workflows, Forecasting und Replenishment produktiv tragen. Du entwirfst klare APIs zwischen Plattform, Agents, ML-Modellen, Frontend und Kundensystemen (ERP, BI, Planungstools) und sorgst für Robustheit und Observability. Du baust unseren semantischen Data Layer als Grundlage für präzise Forecasts und verlässliche Antworten unserer Agents aus: Modellierung in PostgreSQL, Transformationen mit dbt, Pipelines, Caching und Retrieval. Du integrierst LLM- und Agent-Systeme tief ins Backend: Tool Use, Function Calling, RAG-Pipelines, Eval-Frameworks für LLM-Outputs, Guardrails und Production Deployment. Du arbeitest AI-first. Claude Code, AI-gestützte Entwicklung und Subagents gehören zu deinem Alltag, und du erweiterst unser internes Setup kontinuierlich (CLAUDE, Hooks, Skills, Plan/Execute/Review-Loop, Plugins, Tooling, Docs). Du übersetzt Business- und Kundenanforderungen gemeinsam mit FDEs und Product in tragfähige technische Lösungen und triffst pragmatische Abwägungen zwischen Geschwindigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit. Du prototypst schnell und nah am Nutzer: Du bringst neue Ideen in Tagen statt Wochen in die Hände von FDEs und Kunden, holst früh eigenständig Feedback ein, iterierst dicht am realen Workflow und entscheidest anhand echter Nutzung, was sich zu härten und auszurollen lohnt. Dein Profil 2 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Backend-, Software- oder AI Engineer in einem produktorientierten Umfeld, idealerweise im Produkt- oder SaaS-Kontext. Startup-Erfahrung ist willkommen. Solides Backend-Fundament: Python mit FastAPI und Pydantic, klares API-Design, asynchrone Programmierung, PostgreSQL und Redis, Containerisierung mit Docker und Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines. Starkes Produktverständnis: Du fragst nicht „Wie baue ich das?“, sondern „Was bauen wir hier, für wen, und woran merken wir, dass es Wirkung hat?“. Du denkst in Nutzern, Adoption und Wirkungsketten, nicht in Tickets. Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und Agent-Systemen: Prompt Engineering, Tool Use und Function Calling, RAG, Eval-Frameworks und Production Deployment. Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur, idealerweise AWS, sowie ein gutes Gefühl für Kubernetes und Infrastructure-as-Code mit Terraform. Du musst nicht alles im Schlaf beherrschen, solltest dich hier aber sicher bewegen können. Hohes Maß an Ownership, Lust auf Ambiguität und Motivation, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln: im Backend Engineering, im Agentic Engineering und in deiner Produktperspektive. Klare, überzeugende Kommunikation, technisch und nicht-technisch, mit wenig Ego. Fließendes Englisch und muttersprachliches Deutsch oder C1-Niveau. items.desc: Dassault Systèmes a pour ambition stratégique de révolutionner les sciences de la vie grâce au développement du jumeau virtuel , transformant ainsi la pratique médicale. Au sein du département Corporate Research & Sciences , vous rejoindrez l'équipe HealthByMe , spécialisée dans la conception d'outils innovants pour les développeurs et les professionnels de santé. Notre mission est d'accélérer la création d'applications médicales en exploitant l' IA agentique et notre framework interne , afin d'améliorer la prise en charge des patients et le travail des médecins. Vos missions Dans le cadre de ce stage, vous contribuerez à la conception d'un Agent IA capable de : Générer des interfaces web à partir de spécifications techniques et de l'état de l'art en pratique médicale, en réutilisant les blocs logiciels de notre framework interne. Créer de nouveaux blocs logiciels si ceux existants ne répondent pas aux besoins, en garantissant leur réutilisabilité et leur intégration fluide. Automatiser la validation des interfaces générées via des tests unitaires, des évaluations utilisateurs, et des métriques de performance. Collaborer avec les équipes pour affiner les spécifications et intégrer les retours des développeurs et des experts médicaux. Activités clés : Conception de l'Agent IA : Définir les capacités et le flux d'interaction de l'agent pour supporter les développeurs. Explorer des approches comme le prompt engineering, le fine-tuning, ou la génération augmentée par retrieval (RAG). Développement et Intégration : Prototyper l'agent et l'intégrer à notre framework. Développer des pipelines pour la génération automatique d'interfaces web (ex. : WebComponents, TypeScript). Validation et Itération : Tester les interfaces générées avec des utilisateurs finaux (développeurs, médecins). Mesurer l'efficacité de l'agent (gain de temps, précision, satisfaction utilisateur). Documentation : Rédiger des guides techniques et des cas d'usage pour assurer la maintenabilité de la solution. Vos Qualifications Actuellement en Master 2 / Bac+5 en Ecole d’ingénieur ou Université, vous vous spécialisez en Intelligence Artificielle, Génie Logiciel, ou Informatique et recherchez un stage entre 5 et 6 mois. Compétences techniques souhaitées : Maîtrise de Python et expérience avec des frameworks d'IA (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Connaissance de framework tels que Langchain et Langgraph. Compréhension des agents IA (architectures, interaction homme-machine). Connaissance des bonnes pratiques en développement logiciel (Git, tests, modularité). Nice-to-have : Expérience avec des frameworks frontend (JavaScript, TypeScript, React/Vue/Angular). Familiarité avec les applications médicales ou les données de santé. Connaissance des outils de déploiement (Docker, FastAPI). Compétences professionnelles souhaitées : Autonomie, curiosité scientifique, et rigueur méthodologique. Capacité à travailler en équipe et à proposer des solutions innovantes Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. items.desc: Wir sind Teil von NTT DATA, einem führenden Anbieter von Unternehmens- und Technologiedienstleistungen, KI und digitaler Infrastruktur mit einem Umsatz von über 30 Mrd. $. Als Global Top Employer betreut NTT DATA 75 % der Fortune Global 100-Unternehmen und entwickelt mit Expert:innen in über 70 Ländern gemeinsam innovative Lösungen, die dazu inspirieren, Neues zu wagen und Erfolge sichtbar zu machen. In der DACH-Region sind wir an 15 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz vertreten. Make this the place where you grow Private AI entsteht nicht auf dem Architekturdiagramm. Du bringst sie vom Design bis in den produktiven Betrieb. Als Private AI Architect (w/m/x) entwickelst du sichere, skalierbare und souveräne AI- und GenAI-Plattformen und verbindest dabei Architektur mit echter Hands-on-Umsetzung. Ob Self-hosted LLMs, RAG oder Agentic AI: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus technologischen Möglichkeiten produktionsreife Enterprise-AI-Lösungen werden. Deine Benefits Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeitregelung und Reisezeit ist Arbeitszeit Home-Office Möglichkeit sowie Vereinbarung mit Vergütungszuschuss inkl. Arbeitsplatzausstattung möglich 30 Tage Urlaub, zusätzlich sind der 24.12. und 31.12. arbeitsfreie Tage Sabbatical bis zu einem Jahr möglich Remote Work sowie mobiles Arbeiten im EU-Ausland möglich Attraktive Benefit- und Entgeltoptimierungsprogramme: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, JobRad, Jobticket, exklusive Rabatte über Corporate Benefits und vieles mehr Umfangreiche Gesundheits- und Vorsorgeangebote: verlängerte Entgeltfortzahlung im Krankheitsfall, Betriebsärztliche Betreuung, Unfallversicherung auch für Freizeitunfälle weltweit, Familienservice Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in der NTT DATA Academy mit fachlichen Trainings, Zertifizierungsangeboten, Soft-Skill-Schulungen, Udemy Zugang Diverse Communities und Initiativen (zu Diversity, Equity & Inclusion, ESG und mehr) mit Wissensaustausch auf Augenhöhe Teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum Deine Mission Du designst, entwickelst, konfigurierst und implementierst Private-AI- und GenAI-Plattformen auf Basis von Open-Source- und Self-hosted-Technologien und erstellst High-Level- und Low-Level-Designs, Blueprints sowie Referenzarchitekturen für On-Premises-, Private-Cloud-, Hybrid- und Sovereign-AI-Umgebungen. Du entwickelst und implementierst LLM-, RAG- und Agentic-AI-Lösungen – von Ingestion Pipelines und Vector Databases über Tool Integrations und Orchestrierung bis hin zu Evaluation Components. Du bringst AI-Plattformen mit Kubernetes, Containerisierung und MLOps/LLMOps zuverlässig in den produktiven Betrieb und verantwortest Deployment, Monitoring, Governance sowie Troubleshooting. Du deployest und optimierst Self-hosted Foundation Models und Enterprise-AI-Workloads und verbesserst GPU Utilization, Quantization, Batching, Autoscaling und Latenz für leistungsfähige und hochverfügbare Inference-Architekturen. Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei AI-Strategie, Platform Modernization und Infrastructure Readiness, treibst POCs und MVPs voran und bringst deine Expertise in RFPs, Angebote und Aufwandsschätzungen ein. Dein Skillset Du verfügst über 10–13 Jahre IT-Erfahrung, davon mindestens 5 Jahre in AI/ML-Architektur, und hast Enterprise-AI-/GenAI-Lösungen in Private-Cloud-, On-Premises- oder Hybrid-Umgebungen erfolgreich umgesetzt. Du bringst ausgeprägte Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Private AI und GenAI mit und beherrschst LLMs, RAG, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering und Agentic AI sowie Frameworks wie LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack oder Semantic Kernel und Open-Source-Modelle wie Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek oder Qwen. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Kubernetes, Docker/OpenShift und MLOps/LLMOps und kennst Technologien wie MLflow, Kubeflow, KServe, Ray, vLLM oder Ollama sowie Evaluation, Tracing, Monitoring, Drift Detection und Production Support. Du kennst dich mit GPU- und AI-Infrastrukturen aus – einschließlich NVIDIA Stack, CUDA, MIG, Model Serving, Quantization, Distributed Inference/Training, Storage und Networking – und kannst AI-Workloads hinsichtlich Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Verfügbarkeit optimieren. Du verbindest dein technisches Know-how mit einem sicheren Verständnis für Security, Privacy und Sovereign AI, überzeugst im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Mit uns hast du unzählige Möglichkeiten, groß zu denken, mutig zu handeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Gestalte deine Zukunft in einer Kultur, die Zugehörigkeit lebt und dir Raum für Lernen und Networking gibt. Vielfalt ist ein unverzichtbarer Teil unseres Erfolges und unserer Unternehmenskultur. Frei von Vorurteilen im Hinblick auf Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, ethnische und soziale Herkunft, Religion oder Behinderung freuen wir uns dich kennenzulernen. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt. Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Deine …

items.desc:
Während Ihres Einsatzes sammeln, strukturieren und bereiten Sie technische Wissensquellen wie technische Dokumente, Spezifikationen, Testberichte und strukturierte Datensätze auf.
 Sie evaluieren geeignete Databricks-native und Open-Source-Tools (z. B. RAG, Text-to-SQL, KI-Agenten, Vector Search, Genie) für unterschiedliche Arten technischer Inhalte.
 Darauf aufbauend konzipieren und implementieren Sie Natural-Language-Workflows auf Databricks, die es Hardware-Ingenieur:innen ermöglichen, sowohl Dokumente als auch strukturierte Daten abzufragen.
 Um verlässliche, quellengestützte Antworten zu liefern, wenden Sie Prompt- und Context-Engineering an und stellen Ergebnisqualität sowie Nachvollziehbarkeit sicher (z. B. Zitate, Evaluation, Guardrails).
 Zusätzlich arbeiten Sie eng mit Hardware-Ingenieur:innen zusammen, um Use Cases zu verstehen und die Lösung iterativ zu verbessern.
 Abschließend kommunizieren Sie Fortschritte und Erkenntnisse mittels Visualisierungen, kurzen Präsentationen und technischer Dokumentation.
Ausbildung: Masterstudium im Bereich Energietechnik, Maschinenbau, HLK (Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimatechnik), Regelungstechnik, Informatik, Data Science oder eines vergleichbaren technischen Studiengangs mit guten Noten – eine Kombination aus ingenieurwissenschaftlichem Fachwissen und KI-/Datenkompetenzen ist ideal
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse: praktische Kenntnisse zu Large Language Models und Generative-AI-Konzepten wie RAG, Embeddings, Vektordatenbanken, Prompt- und Context-Engineering oder AI Agents
 sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise in Python und SQL
 ingenieurwissenschaftlicher Hintergrund von Vorteil
 Erfahrung mit Databricks (z. B. Vector Search, Genie, Mosaic AI Agent Framework, MLflow), LangChain, LlamaIndex oder anderen Generative-AI-Frameworks von Vorteil
 Verständnis der Wärmepumpentechnologie und ihrer Funktions- und Betriebsprinzipien von Vorteil
 Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: Sie sind neugierig und eigenmotiviert, bringen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit, um mit Ingenieur:innen unterschiedlicher Fachrichtungen zusammenzuarbeiten, deren Anforderungen zu verstehen und diese in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen
 Arbeitsroutine: Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, in einem hybriden Setup mit regelmäßiger Präsenz vor Ort zu arbeiten
 Begeisterung: Sie begeistern sich dafür, KI und Hardware-Engineering zu verbinden und komplexes technisches Wissen durch natürliche Sprache leicht zugänglich zu machen
 Sprachen: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
Start: gemäß vorheriger Vereinbarung Dauer: 6 Monate
Voraussetzung für dieses Praktikum ist die Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule. Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf, Ihren Notenspiegel (Transcript of Records), Ihre Immatrikulationsbescheinigung, die Prüfungsordnung sowie ggf. eine gültige Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis bei.
Als global agierendes Unternehmen sind wir gesetzlich verpflichtet, die geltenden EU- und US-(Re-)Exportkontroll- und Sanktionsbestimmungen einzuhalten. Das bedeutet: Auf bestimmten, besonders sensiblen Stellen dürfen wir nur Personen beschäftigen, die eine zusätzliche gesetzliche Prüfung durchlaufen haben. Bei dieser Position handelt es sich um eine solche sensible Stelle. Wir werden dich daher im weiteren Verlauf des Prozesses um weitere, für diese zusätzliche Prüfung erforderliche Angaben bitten. Informationen zur Verarbeitung deiner Daten findest du in unseren Datenschutzhinweisen für den Bewerbungsprozess.
Vielfalt und Inklusion sind für uns nicht nur Trends, sondern fest in unserer Unternehmenskultur verankert. Daher begrüßen wir alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität.

At DLL, you will join a collaborative team that places the right tools in the right hands, understands the ambitions of our partners, and delivers original financial solutions that help businesses succeed for generations. As a Senior Second Line Monitoring & Oversight (SLM&O) Compliance Officer, you will play a critical role in strengthening compliance reporting, monitoring, and oversight across DLL’s regional structure, using sound judgment, strong stakeholder management, and clear communication to deliver meaningful insight and effective challenge across the organization. items.desc: Keep our global cloud platform reliable, scalable, and resilient. Do you enjoy solving complex production challenges before they turn into incidents? Are you the kind of engineer who automates repetitive tasks, improves reliability through engineering, and believes that every outage is an opportunity to build a better system? And are you an experienced, hands-on engineer who wants to stay close to the technology rather than move into people management? We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the Global Platform Team at Vertage. In this role, you'll help build and operate the cloud platform that powers our global Workforce-as-a-Service (WaaS) ecosystem. You'll work alongside Cloud Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to improve platform resilience, reduce operational overhead, and ensure that our Azure-based engineering environment remains reliable, scalable, and resilient. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, with no people management responsibilities. Your impact As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, your focus is to keep our platforms healthy, reliable, and easy to operate while continuously improving how we build, run and recover production systems. You'll help build the engineering foundations behind our Headless Data Architecture (HDA), which runs on Azure and Databricks, as well as the Custom Apps Infrastructure (CA) that powers integrations, internal applications, and operational workflows across our international organization. Instead of spending your days reacting to incidents, you'll focus on preventing them through automation, observability, and reliability engineering. You'll reduce operational burden, improve platform resilience, and build systems that scale, recover automatically whenever possible, and provide engineering teams across Cloud, Data, and AI with the visibility they need to run production workloads with confidence. What you will do Improve the reliability, availability, and performance of our Azure platform and production environments. Build and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting using Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics. Automate operational tasks and eliminate repetitive manual work using Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Design self-healing capabilities and automated remediation to reduce incidents and improve recovery times. Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analyses, and implement long-term improvements. Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Optimize platform performance, scalability, and operational efficiency. Work closely with Cloud Engineers to improve platform design, resilience, security, and operational reliability. Support Data and AI teams by improving the reliability of Azure Databricks environments. Help shape and raise engineering standards around observability, automation, and operational excellence. Continuously look for opportunities to reduce operational complexity and improve developer productivity. Act as a technical point of reference for reliability engineering, helping shape technical decisions while remaining hands-on in the technology. About the role As part of the Global Platform Team, you'll work alongside engineers in Cloud, Data, and AI to improve the reliability of our Azure-based platform. Using technologies such as Kubernetes, Terraform, Databricks, GitHub Actions, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, you'll help ensure that our global Workforce-as-a-Service ecosystem remains reliable, scalable, and resilient. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will have significant technical ownership and will be expected to get into the detail when needed, from troubleshooting complex production issues to improving automation, observability and system reliability. You will act as a technical reference point for others, but you will not have people management responsibilities. About Vertage Vertage is one of Europe's leading providers of workforce and talent solutions. Operating across multiple countries, we are transforming into a cloud-native, AI-powered organization that connects people, technology, and data through a modern digital platform. The Global Platform Team is at the heart of that transformation, enabling engineering teams across Cloud, Data, AI, and Software Engineering to build and operate scalable solutions for the future. You're passionate about building reliable systems and solving operational challenges through engineering rather than manual intervention. You enjoy understanding how distributed systems behave, thrive in cloud-native environments, and are always looking for ways to improve automation, resilience, and observability. You stay calm under pressure, take ownership of problems, and enjoy collaborating with others to continuously improve the platform's reliability. You have significant experience operating production systems and still enjoy getting …

items.desc: Meet the Team The Forward Engineering team is part of Cisco’s Customer Experience Business Unit, focused on driving AI adoption for strategic customers across Cisco’s contact-center portfolio, including Webex Contact Center, Webex Contact Center Enterprise, and on-premises solutions. We bring together customer interactions, human and AI agents, workflows, and enterprise systems to improve customer experience and business performance. You’ll work alongside customers, Cisco’s partner ecosystem, account teams, product managers, and engineers in a collaborative, hands-on environment. Our work connects customer priorities with technical delivery and product development, turning successful deployments into reusable approaches and enabling partners to scale their impact. Join us to help shape how leading organizations bring AI into their contact-center operations. Your Impact Drive AI adoption for strategic customers across Cisco’s contact-center portfolio, working with Cisco’s partner ecosystem to guide engagements from discovery and solution design through production deployment and measurable business outcomes. Identify and prioritize AI use cases with customers and partners by assessing customer journeys, contact-center operations, existing systems, and business objectives. Build and deploy AI solutions and production integrations using Cisco AI capabilities, APIs, and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow. Lead pilots and adoption programs while enabling partners through hands-on collaboration, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing to deliver and scale successful solutions. Translate customer needs and deployment findings into actionable product feedback, reusable architectures, and implementation playbooks that accelerate adoption across customers and partners. Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of experience developing software or delivering enterprise technology solutions, including hands-on implementation. Experience programming in Python, Node.js, or a comparable language. Experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, and enterprise systems. Experience delivering technical solutions for enterprise customers or stakeholders, from requirements gathering through production deployment. Experience building or integrating an AI application using an LLM platform, conversational AI framework, or AI service. Preferred Qualifications Experience with contact-center platforms, CCaaS, CPaaS, CRM, IVR, or call-routing environments. Familiarity with Webex Contact Center, Webex Contact Center Enterprise, or Cisco on-premises contact-center solutions. Experience with conversational AI, voice agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or real-time analytics, including evaluating quality, cost, latency, and reliability. Experience defining success measures, evaluating pilot results, and supporting adoption of AI solutions in enterprise operations. Strong consultative and communication skills, including experience collaborating with partners, providing technical enablement, and translating business needs into technical solutions. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

items.card: About The Role The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions -
items.desc: Location: Prague (Hybrid); Czech Republic (Remote); UK (Remote); Ghent (Hybrid), Poland (Remote), Hungary (Remote), Romania (Remote) Function: Software Engineering Reports to: Manager, Esko AI About The Role The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions - and invoke expert human judgement when required. This is a complex engineering problem that goes beyond the boundaries of standard agentic scenarios. We're looking for a Technical Expert to take technical ownership of core agentic capabilities within Esko’s AI Platform, from experimentation and design through production implementation.be a senior authority and author on agentic AI across Esko's AI Platform. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management one: you'll set direction and raise the bar through writing code, leading experiments, writing documentation, and mentorship of team members for a platform that spans multiple agentic capabilities (knowledge & reasoning, tool use and orchestration, evaluation, and safety/guardrails) and which is used by many product teams across the business. You should bring experience from multiple agentic AI projects with a similar order of complexity in terms of the technical challenges you have successfully tackled, together with a ‘sixth sense’ for agentic AI operation to predict the approaches which are likely yield successful results as the platform grows into new domains. What You Will Do Go deep on the hardest technical problems inside the agentic AI platform - the ones where progress depends on specialist expertise, not just engineering effort: data discovery & consolidation, agent planning and tool-use, retrieval and grounding, validation-before-action, conflict/ambiguity handling, and similar hard sub-problems. Personally design, build, and harden the platform's most technically demanding components - the pieces where correctness, edge cases, and failure modes are subtle enough to need deep, hands-on ownership rather than delegation. Act as the team's go-to technical expert on agentic AI and LLM systems: the person others bring their hardest "how do we actually make this work" problems to, providing depth on specific technical questions rather than setting overall team direction. Diagnose and resolve the platform's toughest technical issues - performance, reliability, correctness, and edge-case failures - where specialist knowledge is the difference between a real fix and a workaround. Contribute into architecture discussions, stress-testing designs against hard technical realities (scaling limits, failure modes, subtle correctness issues) that come from real specialist experience. Evaluate emerging techniques, frameworks, and tools in agentic AI and LLM tooling, and give the team pragmatic, evidence-based recommendations on what's worth adopting. Write technical deep-dives and documentation that make complex mechanisms legible to the rest of the team, so your expertise compounds rather than staying tacit. What We Are Looking For Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language. 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial time as a senior/staff/principal-level individual contributor architecting and operating production agentic AI systems involving multi-step reasoning, tool use, planning, or orchestration, where alignment and dependability of the agent’s output is a key success factor. Experience across multiple distinct agentic AI projects, able to draw on that breadth to guide technical decisions in unfamiliar contexts. Deep, hands-on expertise in: LLM agent frameworks and orchestration, tool-calling and validation-before-action patterns, RAG and retrieval architecture, evaluation and observability for AI systems. A track record of setting technical direction and shaping outcomes across teams without formal management authority. Sound engineering judgement on production concerns at platform scale: reliability, security, multi-tenancy, performance, and observability for services consumed by many internal teams. Excellent technical communication - able to write RFCs and architectural documents that align diverse stakeholders, and to move fluently between deeply technical and business audiences. Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and autonomy, including defining the right problem as much as solving it. Undergraduate, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Preferred Experience Public technical-leadership signals: conference …

items.card: The Role You will own the full lifecycle of Roche's digital analytics and GenAI applications, from identifying user problems through discovery, prototyping, launch, and continuous improvement. You are the accountable product leader: you decide what gets built, why, and in what order, and you are responsible for whether the product gets used and creates value for commercial teams. What You Will Do Discover: Identify
items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 The Role
You will own the full lifecycle of Roche's digital analytics and GenAI applications, from identifying user problems through discovery, prototyping, launch, and continuous improvement. You are the accountable product leader: you decide what gets built, why, and in what order, and you are responsible for whether the product gets used and creates value for commercial teams.
 What You Will Do
 Discover: Identify the business problems to be solved with Commercial stakeholders and turn them into clear problem statements and opportunity areas.
 Define and prioritize: Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for your apps. Make trade-off decisions between features, technical debt, and new AI capabilities.
 Build with your squad: Work daily with engineers, data scientists, ML and GenAI engineers, and UX/UI designers as a hands-on decision partner. Shape solution design, including how LLMs, RAG, and agentic features are used in the user experience.
 Ship and iterate: Manage releases, test with users, and improve the product in short cycles. Own the production roadmap for the app.
 Measure and grow: Define product metrics (adoption, retention, task completion, time saved) and use them to guide decisions. Report results to business leaders.
 Drive adoption: Build onboarding, in-app guidance, training materials, and feedback channels so users adopt the product and keep using it.
 Partner on governance: Work with data platform, IT, security, and compliance teams to ensure the product meets security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. You own the decisions, and these teams advise on constraints.
 Stay current: Track emerging AI tools and patterns and bring practical ones into the product. Have a clear Build / Buy strategy with the current emerging capabilities 
 What You Bring
 8+ years of experience building digital products, with at least 3 years as the accountable owner of a live application used by real users.
 Proven end-to-end product ownership: you have taken ideas from concept through to launch and ongoing operation.
 Working knowledge of how software is built and delivered (web or mobile apps, APIs, cloud, agile delivery). You can have credible technical conversations without needing to write code.
 Experience using data and analytics to make product decisions, including product analytics tools and A/B testing.
 Hands-on understanding of AI and GenAI capabilities (LLMs, prompt design, RAG, semantic search) and their practical limits.
 Track record of user-centered design and research.
 Strong communication skills for both engineers and executives.
 Advanced degree in a quantitative, technical, or product field, or equivalent experience.
 Nice to Have
 Experience in pharma, biotech, or healthcare, especially commercial data (syndicated sales, marketing metrics, RWE, payer data).
 Experience designing adoption programs for complex, matrixed organizations.
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Company description: 
 Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide. 
 Our people work with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place. Taking pride in our work, we draw on each other's expertise and experience to achieve excellence. Our diversity and teamwork culture propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space. 
 Founded in 2021, the Airbus Global Business Services (AGBS) unit will be contributing to Airbus’ global success and play a vital role in Airbus’ transformation journey in standardisation, harmonisation, digitalisation and automation of end-to-end processes (e.g.Procure to Pay) of all overhead functions. Our target is that siloed ways of working / processes will be a relic of the past within the AGBS. To drive such culture change we are looking for candidates with pioneering spirit that make data-driven decisions and take responsibility for the best outcome of their internal customers. All while embracing a spirit of problem-solving and living the Airbus values: Customer focus, integrity, respect, creativity, reliability and teamwork. 
 Our purpose defines why we exist: ‘We pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world’. 
 Responsibilities - your mission 
 SAP Platform lifecycle management with our ESP 
 SAP Platform monitoring 
 Performance analysis (resources, load balancing, Hints, Archiving, etc…) 
 Security guideline deployment (SSO, parameters, SAP note, sFTP, encryption, etc…) 
 Incident management, root cause analysis and associated improvement plan management 
 System refresh and upgrade management (SPAU/SPDD, BlueCopy, etc…) 
 Transports and project support (ChaRM, OSS call, ALE, Workflow, dumps, Interfaces, job scheduling, etc…) 
 Requirements - our ideal candidate will have: 
 Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Basis and NetWeaver system administration. 
 Coordination: Proven experience coordinating external Managed Service Providers, tracking SLA/KPI compliance, validating technical change requests, and orchestrating complex maintenance windows, project cutovers, and incident escalations across cross-functional teams. 
 Database & Core Systems: Advanced administration of SAP HANA (performance tuning, backup/recovery, memory management, and HANA System Replication / HSR). 
 Deep technical knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and legacy SAP ECC 6.0 landscapes. 
 System Lifecycle & Maintenance: Coordinate upgrades, kernel patches and Support Package stacks.

items.desc: Full time Hamburg eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Senior QPU Integration Engineer (Micro-fabrication focused). You will be a lead technical expert in our QPU Development team, driving the physical integration, yield optimization, and technology transfer of next-generation quantum processor architectures. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary bridge between chip design teams and fabrication engineers. You will own both front-end-of-line (FEOL) and back-end-of-line (BEOL) fabrication modules, leading R&D activities within our internal cleanroom facility while managing strategic development projects with external foundry partners. Collaborate closely with QPU designers, device physics teams, and packaging specialists to translate architectural requirements into manufacturable Design Rules (DRC) and process design kits (PDKs).
