Oversee internal R&D projects to develop, qualify, and integrate novel materials, geometries, and process steps for next-gen QPU platforms. Drive technology development and project management with external commercial foundry partners and research institutes. Lead process transfer, yield matching, and contract negotiation for out-of-house fabrication and prototyping runs. Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical integration failures, lot losses, or performance degradation. Define and maintain Statistical Process Control (SPC) guidelines, process windows, and target specifications across internal and external fabrication runs. Mentor junior fabrication engineers and technicians on advanced processing techniques, cleanroom protocols, and experimental design (DOE). Author comprehensive process specifications, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical roadmaps for executive and cross-functional review. Required Skills: Master’s or Ph.D. in Microelectronics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Applied Physics, Nanotechnology, or a related field. 5+ years (or equivalent extensive industry experience) of hands-on semiconductor or quantum hardware integration experience in a professional cleanroom environment (Class 10 / 100 / ISO 4–5). Deep technical expertise in both Front-End (FEOL) and Back-End (BEOL) module development (e.g., e-beam/optical lithography, PVD/ALD thin films, reactive ion etching (RIE/DRIE), planarization, lift-off processes, and flip-chip/interconnect technologies). Proven track record of taking complex solid-state micro/nano devices from initial R&D concept to stable, repeatable integration flows. Demonstrated experience in managing joint development projects (JDPs) or technology transfers with commercial external foundries or external fabrication partners. Strong project management capabilities, including timeline tracking, deliverable management, and milestone execution. Solid understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), PFMEA, and structured RCA techniques (e.g., 8D, Fishbone). Proficiency with layout and data tools (e.g., KLayout, Cadence, Python/MATLAB for yield and parametric analysis). Fluent in English (written and spoken) with excellent technical writing and presentation skills. We value (Bonus): Experience in quantum hardware integration (e.g., superconducting circuits, trapped-ion traps, spin qubits, or photonic chips). Experience developing novel low-loss dielectric materials, superconducting interconnects, or 3D integration / TSV technologies. Proven experience establishing a cleanroom process baseline or setting up new-process lines/tools from scratch. Background in managing foundry contracts, IP considerations, and wafer delivery schedules. items.desc: Consultant Ingénieur IA – Finance de Marché - CDI - 55/60K - PARIS - H/F Ce poste est fait pour vous si... Vous avez mené au moins un projet IA concret, idéalement jusqu’en production, et savez expliquer vos choix techniques et votre contribution. Vous avez une expérience en finance de marché et en comprenez les enjeux : pré-trade, post-trade, risque ou regulatory. Vous cherchez à évoluer dans une practice en construction, où l’on partage ses retours d’expérience, mène une veille active et où chaque initiative fait avancer le cabinet. Ce poste n’est pas fait pour vous si... Votre expérience IA se limite à des formations ou certifications, ou votre profil data est surtout orienté BI, reporting ou data engineering : ce poste demande une vraie expertise, pas un apprentissage depuis zéro. Vous n’avez jamais travaillé en finance de marché : il faut en saisir vite les enjeux pour y appliquer l’IA. Vous êtes indépendant(e) ou souhaitez le rester. Nous recrutons exclusivement en CDI. Nous recrutons un(e) consultant(e) ingénieur IA en finance de marché Les banques de financement et d’investissement multiplient les cas d’usage IA sur leurs activités de marché. Le passage du prototype à la production reste pourtant le point de blocage : il faut comprendre le métier, maîtriser la technique et livrer des outils que les équipes utilisent vraiment. C’est précisément le rôle du Consultant(e) Ingénieur IA Finance de Marché. Recueillir les besoins des équipes Front, Middle ou Risques et les traduire en cas d’usage IA réalistes. Concevoir et développer des solutions IA (modèles ML, LLM, architectures RAG ou agents) adaptées aux contraintes des activités de marché. Industrialiser et mettre en production ces solutions, en lien avec les équipes IT et data du client. Suivre la performance des modèles en production et les faire évoluer. Restituer les résultats aux équipes métier et accompagner l’adoption des outils. Pour vous aider à vous projeter, voici des exemples concrets de mission : Développement d’un assistant RAG permettant aux équipes Front d’interroger la documentation produits et réglementaire (term sheets, procédures, MIFID II). Mise en production d’un modèle de détection d’anomalies sur les données de valorisation ou de P&L côté Middle Office. Automatisation par agents IA de contrôles en post-marché (rapprochements, traitement des suspens). Conception d’un outil d’extraction et de structuration automatique de données issues de confirmations de trades. La personne que nous recherchons 3 à 6 ans d’expérience après un Bac+5, dont minimum 3 ans comme Ingénieur IA en finance de marché. Connaissances en finance de marché (produits financiers, front, risques ou post-marché) et au moins un projet IA mis en production. Python et librairies ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch), LLM et architectures RAG / agents (LangChain, LlamaIndex), MLOps et mise en production (Docker, CI/CD, cloud Azure/AWS). Anglais professionnel obligatoire. Les informations pratiques Contrat : CDI Localisation : Paris Salaire : 55000 - 60000€ Disponibilité : Dès que possible Lamarck Group, qui sommes-nous ? Lamarck Group est un cabinet de conseil en transformation indépendant, né d’un constat simple : une banque en transformation a besoin de consultants qui parlent son langage. Aujourd’hui, c’est une centaine de consultants qui vivent au quotidien les enjeux d’une trentaine d’institutions financières, du tier 1 (BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole, Groupe BPCE) au tier 2 (HSBC, Sfil, LBP, Bpifrance, Milleis), sur trois périmètres complémentaires. Global Markets : valorisation et structuration produits (Front), maîtrise des risques et fiabilité des données (Middle), conformité réglementaire (MIFID II, EMIR, SFTR). Risk Management : crédit, marché et contrepartie (FRTB, SACCR), climat/ESG. Direction Financière : consolidation comptable et prudentielle (FINREP, COREP, MREL, IFRS9), ALMT (LCR, NSFR, IRRBB), contrôle, extra-financier ESG (Taxonomie, SFDR, CSRD). Nos interventions s’articulent autour de trois axes : transformation (projet, change, PMO), production d’indicateurs (analyse, gouvernance, data) et modélisation (conception, validation, gouvernance). Parce que l’IA transforme désormais les activités de marché, nous investissons ces sujets : cas d’usage RAG et agents métier, modèles prédictifs, mise en production via des pipelines MLOps, appliqués aux enjeux concrets du Front, du Middle et du post-marché. 230 collaborateurs, créé en 2014, certifiés B Corp depuis 2020. La suite, c’est simple Un premier entretien avec un recruteur pour découvrir vos attentes et vous présenter Lamarck, une première occasion de vérifier qu’on parle le même langage. Un entretien avec l’un(e) de nos consultants pour évaluer vos compétences et les challenger sur des cas concrets. Un entretien avec un Partner pour se projeter ensemble sur vos perspectives d’évolution au sein du cabinet. Les meilleurs recrutements commencent par une conversation. Lancez-vous et postulez ! …

items.desc:
We are looking for a highly experienced Hardware System Architect to join our team in Valencia. This is a rare, high-impact opportunity for a senior professional who bridges the gap between complex automotive system requirements and silicon implementation. You will be responsible for defining the architecture of state-of-the-art integrated circuits (ICs) for radar and transceiver modules in the automotive sector, translating customer needs into concrete specifications for analog and digital design teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Requirements Translation & Architecture Definition: Drive the IC hardware requirements definition. Translate high-level system concepts into a concrete list of components, functions, and technical specifications. 
 Modeling: Establish and maintain hardware centric SystemC or Matlab models of the complete signal chain, from Radio Frequency (RF) and analog components to the digital domain 
 Technical Leadership: Evaluate trade-offs, drive architecture selection and establish the implementation plan for circuits and firmware, actively contributing to the generation of the final IC product specifications 
 Coordination & Review: Direct, oversee, and review the activities of analog and digital circuit design and firmware development teams 
 Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with Functional Safety and security engineers to define concepts and support corresponding methods (FAM, FMEA, safety analysis, FMEDA, FTA, security analysis) 
 Collaborate with Reliability and package engineers to ensure robust design and ESD protection 
 Partner with Product Test engineers to create Design-for-Test (DfT) concepts 
 Support the Applications and Validation teams during laboratory testing to guarantee the fabricated chip meets all requirements 
 Stakeholder & Negotiation: Use strong soft skills to negotiate technical trade-offs, assess project viability, and reach consensus across different technical areas and external customers 
 Document, manage and baseline requirements in DOORS, support product documentation.
 Technical Stack & Tools 
 Modeling/Simulation: SystemC, Matlab. 
Design/EDA: Cadence. 
Requirements Management: DOORS or equivalent requirement management tools.
Requirements & Qualifications 
 Education: Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or equivalent, with a strong focus on semiconductor technology and microelectronics. 
 Experience: 8+ years of experience as a system architect or senior circuit designer for highly integrated transceivers on advanced CMOS technologies. 
 Proven experience in digitally assisted analog/RF signal chains. 
 Hands-on design experience with blocks such as amplifiers, DACs, ADCs, PLLs, mixers, filters, and control loops (knowledge of PLL or ADC architectures is a major plus). 
 Familiarity with automotive radar systems and integrated circuits (ICs). 
 Soft Skills & Methodologies 
 Results-oriented, quality-conscious, and team player. 
 Ability to work effectively in spatially distributed, multicultural teams. 
 Excellent communication skills to manage negotiations with different stakeholders and defend technical compromises. 
 Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish is mandatory.

items.desc: At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals! As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People. At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights. Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today! Your Role: Advisor, Manufacturing Engineering Elanco Animal Health is seeking an experienced Senior CQV Engineer for our Central Engineering team to lead and execute validation lifecycle activities across bioprocessing equipment, clean utilities, cleanrooms, and facility systems in compliance with global standards, particularly EU GMP. Serving as a technical SME during capital projects, operational changes, and regulatory inspections, the role requires deep expertise in upstream and downstream bioprocesses, utility qualification, and hands-on troubleshooting. Your Responsibilities: CQV Lifecycle Leadership: Author, review, and execute key validation deliverables (VMPs, URS, DQ, FAT/SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ) using ISPE risk-based verification approaches in full compliance with EU GMP (Annex 1 & 15) and FDA 21 CFR Part 211. Audit & Inspection Readiness: Serve as the on-site technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) during internal quality audits and external regulatory agency inspections. You will work hands-on with LangGraph and LangChain across leading model providers, on a Python/FastAPI backend with vector and graph retrieval, where token cost, latency, and auditability are first-class engineering constraints. We are hiring four people at two levels — senior engineers owning major capabilities, and lead engineers who additionally set technical direction and mentor. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Agentic and LLM systems Design and implement multi-step agent workflows in LangGraph / LangChain: state management, checkpoints, tool-calling, and human-in-the-loop patterns Build structured-output and prompt systems (Pydantic-validated) for extraction, summarisation, classification, and reasoning over investment documents Integrate model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock) with production discipline, and own model routing and fallback: choosing the right model per task, degrading gracefully when one is unavailable, and absorbing provider model changes without breaking users Treat context as a managed resource: what enters a window, compaction across long agent runs, and controlling cost through context design as well as model choice Build and consume MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool servers giving agents safe access to internal services, search, and document stores Retrieval and knowledge systems Own RAG pipelines end to end: parsing, chunking, embeddings, vector retrieval (Qdrant), reranking, and hybrid search Extend knowledge-graph-backed retrieval (GraphRAG) on Neo4j, including Cypher and graph data modelling Tune retrieval quality with rigorous relevance evaluation and multi-tenant-safe isolation of indexed content Evaluation, quality, and cost Design and run evaluations: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge patterns, and regression gates on prompt or model changes Instrument every model call (LangSmith / LangFuse class tooling) for latency, cost, and quality in production — token-cost engineering is a core part of this job Apply responsible-AI guardrails: tool-use constraints, output validation, and data-privacy awareness in a UK/GDPR context Ship supporting services in Python 3.11+ / FastAPI with PostgreSQL persistence; operate on AWS through CI/CD with quality gates WHO YOU ARE Prerequisites 5+ years of software engineering with strong Python, including 2+ years building LLM or ML systems that ran in production Deep hands-on experience with an agent/orchestration framework (LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable) beyond prototypes Production RAG experience: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategy, retrieval evaluation Graph-backed retrieval experience, or the graph data-modelling fundamentals to pick up Neo4j and Cypher quickly Evidence of evaluation-led development: you can describe the eval harness of your last system from memory You build with AI coding tools daily (Cursor, Claude Code or comparable) and have a considered view of where they help and where they do not Good to have Qdrant, Weaviate, or pgvector in production; items.desc: Vos missions Notre Vision Est De Placer L'innovation Au Cœur Des Stratégies D'entreprise Grâce à La Data Ingénierie Et à L'IA Générative. En Rejoignant Notre Équipe En Tant Que Stagiaire, Vous Contribuerez à La Réalisation D’un Projet De R&D Porté Par Le Lab De Capgemini Invent, Et Participerez à Des Missions De Conseil En Data Engineering Ainsi Qu’en GenAI / Agentic Engineering Pour Des Clients De Capgemini Invent. Votre Rôle Consistera à Agir Sur Tout Ou Partie De La Chaîne De Valeur De L’ingénierie De La Donnée Et De L'IA, De La Plateforme Data Jusqu'à La Mise En Production De Systèmes à Base De LLM Et D'agents Création de Data Pipeline : construire des solutions à l’état de l’art pour la collecte, l'organisation et la modélisation des données, répondant aux exigences de forte volumétrie, et faciliter leur utilisation optimale par les analystes et data scientists, ainsi que l'alimentation des cas d'usage d'IA générative : ingestion et parsing documentaire, chunking, génération d'embeddings et indexation dans des bases vectorielles ; Déploiement Infrastructure DevOps et LLMOps : déploiement grâce à des outils d’infrastructure-as-code et d’intégration et de déploiement continu d’infrastructures complexes sur cloud provider ou on premise. Déploiement de stacks data et IA incluant notamment des stockages de données brutes / structurées, ainsi que les briques de serving de modèles, de passerelle LLM et d'orchestration d'agents. GenAI & Agentic Engineering : conception et industrialisation d'applications reposant sur des LLM, architectures RAG et RAG avancé, orchestration d'agents et de systèmes multi-agents (LangGraph), outillage des agents, gestion du contexte et de la mémoire, sélection et comparaison des modèles selon les contraintes de coût, de latence et de souveraineté ; Évaluation, observabilité et fiabilité des systèmes d'IA : construction de jeux d'évaluation et de métriques (pertinence, hallucinations, coût, latence), mise en place du tracing et du monitoring en production, et implémentation des garde-fous nécessaires à un usage industriel (sécurité, confidentialité, conformité AI Act) ; Développement Back-End et Exposition de modèles IA : conception, développement et containerisation d’applications back-end en REST API embarquant de la data, de l'IA ou des agents LLM pour exposition en production à des utilisateurs finaux ou d’autres services applicatifs. items.desc: About the Role We're looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer who can bridge the gap between advanced AI engineering and real-world business problems. You'll work directly with clients to design, build, and deploy agentic AI platforms that integrate into their existing systems and workflows. This isn't a role where you'll just build prototypes and hand them off. You'll own technical delivery, work closely with end users, and turn complex requirements into production-ready solutions. We need someone who understands how to build sophisticated AI systems, navigate enterprise environments, and deliver measurable outcomes . What You'll Be Doing Design and build agentic AI platforms using Python and modern AI frameworks. Architect LLM orchestration systems using LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and related technologies. Develop multi-agent systems with tool use, workflow orchestration, memory, and decision-making capabilities. Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connected to enterprise data sources. Integrate AI platforms with client APIs, data platforms, cloud services, and enterprise applications. Configure Kubernetes environments and deploy production workloads. Design deployment architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments. Work directly with clients and end users to understand requirements, solve technical challenges, and iterate on solutions. Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout client engagements. Take ownership of complex consulting engagements, from technical planning through execution and delivery. What We're Looking For 3+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with a proven track record of delivering at Senior Engineer level. Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern AI development frameworks. Experience designing and building agentic platforms and LLM-powered applications. Deep understanding of LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen. Experience implementing multi-agent architectures, including tool calling, memory, and workflow management. Hands-on experience building and deploying RAG pipelines using enterprise data. Experience integrating complex systems through APIs, cloud services, and enterprise platforms. Practical knowledge of Kubernetes configuration and workload deployment. Experience designing cloud, on-premise, and hybrid deployment architectures. Strong consulting and client-facing experience, with the ability to translate business problems into technical solutions. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable working in fast-moving environments where requirements evolve and solutions are refined through direct user feedback. ﻿Why TEN-XER? At TEN-XER, we believe great work starts with great people. We're focused on connecting exceptional talent with opportunities where they can make a meaningful impact. If you're someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems, working closely with clients, and taking AI systems from architecture to production, we'd like to hear from you. Interested? Apply now and let's talk.
